login.intro.from: Sign in to continue your learning.

login.trouble.text: Unenkinga yokungena? Khuluma nomhlahlandlela wakho: angakusethela kabusha iphasiwedi.
login.trouble.from: Trouble signing in? Speak to your facilitator: they can reset a password for you.

login.locked.text: Imizamo eminingi kakhulu. Linda imizuzu eyishumi nanhlanu bese uzama futhi.
login.locked.from: Too many attempts. Wait fifteen minutes and try again.

login.missing.text: Faka ikheli lakho le-imeyili nephasiwedi yakho.
login.missing.from: Enter your email address and password.

login.sso.refused.text: Leyo akhawunti ayikwazi ukungena lapha. Kumele isebenzise ikheli le-imeyili elifanayo nelakhawunti yakho kule platifomu. Ngena ngephasiwedi yakho, noma ucele umphathi wakho.
login.sso.refused.from: That account cannot sign in here. It has to use the same email address as your account on this platform. Sign in with your password, or ask your administrator.

login.sso.expired.text: Lokho kungena kuthathe isikhathi eside kakhulu, noma kuqalelwe kwenye indawo. Zama futhi.
login.sso.expired.from: That sign-in took too long, or was started somewhere else. Try again.

login.sso.off.from: That way of signing in is not switched on here.

account.forcedIntro.text: Omunye umuntu ubeke iphasiwedi owangene ngayo. Yishintshe ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.
account.forcedIntro.from: Somebody else set the password you signed in with. Replace it before carrying on.

account.newHint.text: Okungenani izinhlamvu eziyi-12. Umshwana wamagama ambalwa angahlobene uqine futhi ulula ukuwukhumbula kunefushane enezimpawu.
account.newHint.from: At least 12 characters. A phrase of a few unrelated words is both stronger and easier to remember than something short with symbols in it.

account.mismatch.from: The two new passwords do not match.

account.forcedNote.text: Ukuyishintsha kuphumisa wonke umuntu osebenzisa iphasiwedi endala, kuhlanganise nalowo owayikunikeza.
account.forcedNote.from: Changing it signs out anyone else using the old password, including whoever passed it to you.

account.languageIntro.text: Ulimi lapho le platifomu ikhuluma nawe ngalo. Izikrini ezingakahunyushwa zihlala ziseNgisini, futhi amagama omhlinzeki wakho ezinto agcinwa njengoba ewabhale.
account.languageIntro.from: The language this platform speaks to you in. Screens not yet translated stay in English, and your provider's own names for things are kept as they wrote them.

learn.notYours.text: Ubuka ukubhalisa komunye umuntu. Ungabona intuthuko yakhe kodwa awukwazi ukuyirekhodela.
learn.notYours.from: You are viewing someone else's enrolment. You can see their progress but cannot record it for them.

learn.noLessons.from: This course has no lessons yet.

learn.openMaterial.from: Open the material for this lesson

learn.noContent.from: No written content for this lesson.

learn.scormNote.text: Lesi sifundo siqedwa uma usiqeda kuphakheji engenhla. Indawo oyifinyelele igcinwa uma umisa phakathi nendlela.
learn.scormNote.from: This lesson completes when you finish it in the package above. Your place is kept if you stop part of the way through.

learn.openedByFacilitator.from: Opened for you by your facilitator: {reason}

home.feedbackMany.from: A few things to tell us

home.feedbackIntro.text: Izimpendulo ziyabikwa kanye nezabo bonke abanye, hhayi ngayinye. Imizuzu emibili ngayinye, futhi yiyona kuphela into eshintsha indlela iqoqo elilandelayo elisingathwa ngayo.
home.feedbackIntro.from: Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. Two minutes each, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

home.earnedIntro.text: Kurekhodwa ngosuku owaqeda ngalo, hhayi lapho isitifiketi sifika ekugcineni. Ngayinye inenkomba engabhekwa yinoma ubani.
home.earnedIntro.from: Recorded on the day you finished, rather than when the certificate eventually arrives. Each carries a reference anybody can check.

home.step.afterPrevious.from: Opens when you finish the step before

home.nothingYet.from: You have not been assigned anything yet.

home.statementsIntro.text: Thatha lokhu uye ekuhlolweni kwangaphandle nedokhumenti yakho yobunikazi. Isikhungo siyakuhlola ngaphambi kokuba uvunyelwe ukuhlala ukuhlolwa.
home.statementsIntro.from: Take this to the external assessment with your identity document. The centre checks it before you may sit.

assess.waiting.from: Waiting for an assessor to review it.

assess.developmental.text: Lokhu kungokwenzelwa ukukhula. Akukho lapha okubalwa ngokukuphikisa.
assess.developmental.from: This is developmental. Nothing here counts against you.

assess.competent.text: Uthathwe njengonekhono kulokhu kuhlolwa, ngakho awudingi ukuphinda uhlale.
assess.competent.from: You have been found competent on this assessment, so there is nothing to sit again.

assess.noAttempts.text: Usuwasebenzise wonke umzamo wakho kulokhu kuhlolwa.
assess.noAttempts.from: You have used all your attempts at this assessment.

assess.awaitingAssessor.text: Lokhu kuhlola kubalwa kuziqu zakho, ngakho umhloli uzokubuyekeza futhi arekhode isinqumo sekhono. Uzobona umphumela uma sekwenziwe.
assess.awaitingAssessor.from: This assessment counts towards your qualification, so an assessor will review it and record the competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

assess.practicePassed.text: Lokhu bekungukuzijwayeza, ngakho umphumela urekhodwa ekufundeni kwakho kodwa awunqumi iziqu.
assess.practicePassed.from: This was practice, so the result is recorded against your learning but does not decide a qualification.

assess.practiceFailed.text: Lokhu bekungukuzijwayeza. Buyekeza izinto zokufunda bese uzama futhi.
assess.practiceFailed.from: This was practice. Review the material and try again.

assess.pair.text: Hlanganisa into ngayinye engakwesobunxele neyodwa engakwesokudla.
assess.pair.from: Pair each item on the left with one on the right.

assess.whyMarked.text: Isizathu yilokho okumakiwe lapha, hhayi ibhokisi elingenhla.
assess.whyMarked.from: The reason is what is marked here, not the box above.

assess.keptAt.text: Izimpendulo zakho zigcinwe ngo-{time}. Ukuthumela yikho okuzithumela ukuze zimakwe.
assess.keptAt.from: Your answers were kept at {time}. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

assess.kept.text: Izimpendulo zakho zigcinwa njengoba usebenza. Ukuthumela yikho okuzithumela ukuze zimakwe.
assess.kept.from: Your answers are kept as you work. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

evidence.uploadFailed.text: Ukulayisha kwehlulekile. Hlola uxhumano lwakho bese uzama futhi.
evidence.uploadFailed.from: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.

evidence.doneIntro.text: Umhloli uzobubuyekeza futhi arekhode isinqumo sekhono. Uzobona umphumela uma sekwenziwe.
evidence.doneIntro.from: An assessor will review it and record a competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

evidence.fingerprintNote.text: Uma kwenzeka ifayela eligciniwe lishintshwa, isigxivizo salo sizoyeka ukufana. Lokho kuvikela umsebenzi wakho ngendlela efanayo nokuvikela ukuhlola.
evidence.fingerprintNote.from: If any stored file were ever altered, its fingerprint would stop matching. That protects your work as much as it protects the assessment.

evidence.kinds.text: Izithombe, ukurekhoda komsebenzi, ibhuku lokurekhoda elihlolwe ngesikena, noma idokhumenti. Ungathumela amafayela amaningana ngesikhathi esisodwa.
evidence.kinds.from: Photographs, a recording of the task, a scanned logbook, or a document. You can attach several at once.

paper.summative.text: Lokhu kuyahlolwa futhi kubalwa kuziqu zakho.
paper.summative.from: This is assessed and counts towards your qualification.

paper.formative.text: Lokhu kungukulungiselela. Kuyamakwa futhi kubuyiselwe kuwe, akunqumi lutho.
paper.formative.from: This is preparation. It is marked and returned to you, and it does not decide anything.

paper.goBack.from: Go back to the course to see what is still outstanding.

paper.connection.text: Leyo mpendulo ayigcinekanga. Uxhumano lwakho lungase lube lunqamukile; kuzozanywa futhi uma ushintsha okunye.
paper.connection.from: That answer did not save. Your connection may have dropped; it will be tried again when you next change something.

paper.handInFailed.from: That could not be handed in.

paper.handInConnection.text: Lokho akukwazanga ukungeniswa. Hlola uxhumano lwakho bese uzama futhi.
paper.handInConnection.from: That could not be handed in. Check your connection and try again.

paper.detail.from: Answer in detail, referring to the principles you have studied.

paper.handedIn.from: You handed this in. It cannot be changed.

paper.final.from: Once handed in, this cannot be changed.

paper.confirm.from: Confirm the declaration to hand in.

paper.savedAsYouGo.from: your work is saved as you go

notify.nothingYet.text: Akukho okwamanje. Uzokwaziswa lapha uma kubelwa noma kufika isikhathi sokuqeqeshwa, uma umsebenzi ukulindele, kanye nalapho kufika umphumela wokuhlola noma isitifiketi.
notify.nothingYet.from: Nothing yet. You will be told here when training is assigned or due, when work is waiting for you, and when an assessment result or certificate arrives.

cert.notNational.text: Lesi yisitifiketi sika-{provider} uqobo senkambo ayifundisile. Akuyona iziqu zikazwelonke futhi akunalo ikhredithi noma isihlonzi se-SAQA. Lapho umfundi esebenzela iziqu zomsebenzi othile, isitifiketi saleyo ziqu sikhishwa yi-QCTO.
cert.notNational.from: This is {provider}'s own certificate for a course it delivered. It is not a national qualification and does not carry a SAQA credit or identifier. Where a learner is working towards an occupational qualification, the certificate for it is issued by the QCTO.

cert.anyone.text: Noma ubani angaqinisekisa lesi sitifiketi ngenkomba engenhla, ngaphandle kokudinga i-akhawunti.
cert.anyone.from: Anyone can confirm this certificate with the reference above, without needing an account.

work.introCoach.text: Abafundi obabhekele. Wena uqinisekisa lokho abakwenzile emsebenzini; akukho okuya kumhloli ngaphandle kwesignesha yakho.
work.introCoach.from: The learners you supervise. You confirm what they did in the workplace; nothing reaches an assessor without your signature.

work.introLearner.text: Isipiliyoni sokusebenza senziwa kumqashi futhi sivunywe umqeqeshi wasemsebenzini lapho. Uhlelo lumisiwe: uyarekhoda, umqeqeshi wakho aqinisekise, bese kuya kumhloli.
work.introLearner.from: Work experience is done at an employer and signed off by the workplace coach there. The order is fixed: you record it, your coach confirms it, then it goes to an assessor.

work.noneManage.text: {records}: akukho okwamanje. Setha eyodwa ngenhla: isivumelwano esibiza umfundi, umqashi nomqeqeshi, bese kuba eyodwa kumojuli ngayinye yesipiliyoni sokusebenza.
work.noneManage.from: No {records} yet. Set one up above: an agreement naming the learner, the employer and the coach, then one for each work experience module.

work.none.text: {records}: akukho okwamanje. Umphathi uvula eyodwa uma kukhona isivumelwano sasemsebenzini esibiza umfundi, umqashi nomqeqeshi.
work.none.from: No {records} yet. An administrator opens one once a workplace agreement is in place naming the learner, the employer and the coach.

work.kind.contextual_knowledge.text: Ulwazi lwasemsebenzini: lokho okumele ukwazi ukukhuluma ngakho
work.kind.contextual_knowledge.from: Workplace knowledge: what you must be able to speak to

work.kind.supporting_evidence.text: Ubufakazi obuxhasayo: lokho indawo yokusebenza okumele ikukhiqize
work.kind.supporting_evidence.from: Supporting evidence: what the workplace must produce

work.outstanding.text: Okusasele: {items}. Umqeqeshi wakho akakwazi ukusayina uze wenze yonke imigqa futhi ucezu ngalunye lobufakazi obuxhasayo lube nefayela elinamathiselwe.
work.outstanding.from: Still outstanding: {items}. Your coach cannot sign until every line is done and every piece of supporting evidence has a file attached.

work.allRecorded.text: Konke kurekhodiwe. Thumela kumqeqeshi wakho uma usulungile.
work.allRecorded.from: Everything is recorded. Send it to your coach when you are ready.

work.signingMeans.text: Ukusayina kurekhoda ukuthi uhlolile lobu bufakazi futhi uzobufakazela uma umhloli ekuthinta. Ayikwazi ukushintshwa ngemva kwalokho.
work.signingMeans.from: Signing records that you checked this evidence and will attest to it if the assessor contacts you. It cannot be changed afterwards.

work.readyForPoe.text: Kusayinwe umqeqeshi wasemsebenzini futhi kulungele ukufakwa efayeleni lobufakazi.
work.readyForPoe.from: Signed by the workplace coach and ready to be taken into the Portfolio of Evidence.

scorm.failed.text: Iphakheji ayikwazanga ukuvulwa. Hlola uxhumano lwakho bese uzama futhi.
scorm.failed.from: The package could not be opened. Check your connection and try again.

scorm.preview.text: Ukubuka kuqala: lokho iphakheji ekubikayo akugcinwa, ngoba lokhu akukona ukubhalisa kwakho.
scorm.preview.from: A preview: what the package reports is not kept, because this is not your own enrolment.

certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.text: Umfundi angase ube eyinikile umqashi inkomba. Iyaqhubeka ukusebenza futhi izosho ukuthi isihoxisiwe.
certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.from: The learner may have given the reference to an employer. It keeps resolving and will say it was withdrawn.

assessing.intro.text: Okuthunyelwe okulungele ukwahlulelwa kwekhono. Awukwazi ukuhlola umsebenzi wakho, futhi ingxenye yezinqumo zakho izobuyekezwa ngokuzimela umlinganisi.
assessing.intro.from: Submissions ready for a competency judgement. You cannot assess your own work, and a proportion of your decisions will be reviewed independently by a moderator.

assessing.empty.text: Akukho okulindile. Okuthunyelwe kuvela lapha uma abafundi bekuthumela.
assessing.empty.from: Nothing is waiting. Submissions appear here as learners send them in.

assessing.onScreen.text: Lokhu kuphendulwe esikrinini. {link}: izimpendulo, umhlahlandlela wokumaka nomatrikhi kuhlangene lapho, futhi imibandela ibalelwa wena uma sekumakiwe.
assessing.onScreen.from: This was answered on screen. {link}: the answers, the marking guidance and the matrix are together there, and the criteria are worked out for you once it is marked.

assessing.ownWork.text: Lokhu okuthunyelwe yikho kwakho. Awukwazi ukukuhlola; kufanele omunye umuntu akwenze.
assessing.ownWork.from: This is your own submission. You cannot assess it; someone else must.

assessing.hash.text: Isigxivizo sirekhodwa ekulayisheni. Uma ifayela eligciniwe lishintshwa, alisafani futhi irekhodi liyaphawulwa.
assessing.hash.from: The hash is recorded at upload. If a stored file is ever altered, it no longer matches and the record is flagged.

assessing.whyDiffers.text: Kungani, njengoba kwehlukile kulokho amamaki akuphakamisayo
assessing.whyDiffers.from: Why, since it differs from what the marks propose

assessing.permanent.text: Igama lakho, usuku nala mazwana kugcinwa unomphela futhi akukwazi ukuhlelwa ngemva kwalokho. Ukulungiswa kurekhodwa njengesinqumo esisha.
assessing.permanent.from: Your name, the date and this comment are stored permanently and cannot be edited afterwards. A correction is recorded as a new decision.

marking.impliesIntro.text: Izibalo, hhayi ukwahlulela. Amamaki alinganiswa kanje; ukusebenza kwasemsebenzini nobufakazi basemsebenzini akufinyeleli epulatifomini, futhi wena uzikala ngaphambi kokunquma. Shintsha noma yikuphi kwalokhu esikrinini sesinqumo bese usho isizathu: isizathu sigcinwa eceleni kwesiphakamiso ukuze umlinganisi abone lapho kwehlukanisa khona.
marking.impliesIntro.from: Arithmetic, not a judgement. The marks average out at this; practical performance and workplace evidence do not reach the platform, and you weigh those before deciding. Change any of these on the decision screen and say why: the reason is stored beside the proposal so a moderator can see where the two parted.

marking.markAllFirst.text: Umbuzo ngamunye kumele umakwe ngaphambi kokuba imibandela ibalwe.
marking.markAllFirst.from: Every question has to be marked before the criteria can be worked out.

marking.summative.text: Lokhu kuyahlolwa. Uma sekumakiwe yonke imibuzo, rekhoda isinqumo: imibandela ekufakazelayo iyaphakanyiswa ukuze uyiqinisekise.
marking.summative.from: This is assessed. Once every question is marked, record a decision: the criteria it evidences are proposed for you to confirm.

marking.formative.text: Le yincwadi yomsebenzi. Ingokwenzelwa ukukhula: yimake, bese ubuyisa impendulo. Akukho lapha okurekhoda ikhono noma okuhambisa umfundi ekufanelekeleni.
marking.formative.from: This is a workbook. It is developmental: mark it, then return feedback. Nothing here records competence or moves the learner towards eligibility.

marking.matrix.text: Umatrikhi wokumaka: ukukhetha izinga ngalinye kunikeza imaki
marking.matrix.from: Marking matrix: choosing a level for each gives the mark

marking.toldHint.from: Where it was strong, and what was missing.

marking.returnIntro.text: Impendulo, hhayi isinqumo. Itshela umfundi ukuthi abuyele kuphi ngaphambi kokuhlolwa okuphetha, futhi ayirekhodi ikhono kunoma yimuphi umbandela.
marking.returnIntro.from: Feedback, not a decision. It tells the learner what to go back to before the summative, and it records no competence against any criterion.

marking.returnHint.text: Lokho okwaqina, nalokho okumele kufundwe kabusha ngaphambi kokuhlolwa okuphetha.
marking.returnHint.from: What was solid, and what to re-read before the summative.

marking.concern.from: Criteria the weak answers cluster around

marking.sectionHint.text: Lokho okuhambe kahle lapha, nalokho okumele kwenziwe ngenye indlela ngesikhathi esilandelayo.
marking.sectionHint.from: What went well here, and what to do differently next time.

marking.learnerSees.text: Umfundi ukubona lokhu kanye nempendulo yakhe.
marking.learnerSees.from: The learner sees this with their feedback.

moderating.intro.text: Ukubuyekezwa ngokuzimela kwezinqumo zabahloli. Ukuthi yiziphi izinqumo ezifika kulolu hlu kunqunywa yisistimu, hhayi ukukhethwa yinoma ubani. Awukwazi ukulinganisa isinqumo owasenza wena.
moderating.intro.from: Independent review of assessors' decisions. Which decisions reach this list is decided by the system, not chosen by anyone. You cannot moderate a decision you made yourself.

moderating.reason.new_assessor.from: Newly registered assessor: moderated in full

moderating.referBack.text: Buyisela emuva: umhloli kufanele abheke futhi
moderating.referBack.from: Refer back: the assessor should look again

moderating.ownDecision.text: Wenze lesi sinqumo njengomhloli, ngakho awukwazi ukusilinganisa. Kufanele omunye umlinganisi akwenze.
moderating.ownDecision.from: You made this decision as the assessor, so you cannot moderate it. Another moderator must.

pack.print.text: Phrinta leli khasi ukuze uligcine njenge-PDF.
pack.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF.

pack.instrumentIntro.text: Iphepha njengoba lasethwa, nomhlahlandlela abelimakwe ngawo.
pack.instrumentIntro.from: The paper as it was set, and the guidance it was marked against.

pack.scriptsIntro.text: Ithathwe kuwo wonke ububanzi bamamaki (okuphezulu, okuphansi nokuphakathi) ukuze ukumaka kubonakale ekuhleni nasekubi kwako, hhayi phakathi nendawo kuphela.
pack.scriptsIntro.from: Taken across the mark range (top, bottom and spread between) so the marking is seen at its best and its worst rather than in the middle.

pack.departuresIntro.text: Lapho umhloli ehluke kulokho amamaki akuphakamisile, noma umlinganisi ehluke kumhloli. Iphakethe eliyeqayo lokhu lingcono ukungabi khona.
pack.departuresIntro.from: Where an assessor differed from what the marks proposed, or a moderator differed from the assessor. A pack that leaves these out is worse than no pack.

pack.exceptionsIntro.text: Abafundi abavunyelwe ukudlula esangweni yinoma ubani onegama, kanye nesizathu abasinikeze.
pack.exceptionsIntro.from: Learners let past a gate by a named person, with the reason they gave.

held.intro.text: Umfundi otholakala engakabi nekhono kabili akehlulwa. Ukuhlola kubanjwa, kubizwe ukubuyekezwa kohlelo nomqashi wakhe, ngoba ngalesi sikhathi umbuzo awukhona ukuthi uyakwazi yini, kodwa ukuthi kuyini okwenzeka nxazonke kuye.
held.intro.from: A learner found not yet competent twice is not failed. The assessment is held, and a programme review is convened with their employer, because by this point the question is rarely whether they know it, and usually what has been going on around them.

held.empty.text: Lokhu kugcwala uma umfundi etholakala engakabi nekhono okwesibili ekuhlolweni okuphetha. Kuze kube yileso sikhathi akukho okumele kubuyekezwe.
held.empty.from: This fills when a learner is found not yet competent for a second time on a summative assessment. Until then there is nothing to review.

held.whoConvenes.from: A facilitator or administrator convenes the review.

held.oralAuthorised.text: {assessment} · ukubuyekezwa kugunyaze umzamo wesithathu, owenziwa ngomlomo
held.oralAuthorised.from: {assessment} · the review authorised a third attempt, conducted orally

held.whoConducts.text: Umhloli uqhuba umzamo ngomlomo, hhayi umuntu owawugunyazile.
held.whoConducts.from: An assessor conducts the oral attempt, and not the person who authorised it.

held.furtherLearning.text: Ukufunda okwengeziwe ngaphambi kwanoma yimuphi umzamo owengeziwe
held.furtherLearning.from: Further learning before any further attempt

held.whyHint.text: Lokho ukubuyekezwa okutholile, nalokho okuncike kukho.
held.whyHint.from: What the review found, and what it turns on.

oral.reviewDecidedIntro.text: Izizathu ezenza kwagunyazwa lo mzamo wesithathu.
oral.reviewDecidedIntro.from: The grounds on which this third attempt was authorised.

oral.recordIntro.text: Umzamo ngomlomo awushiyi bufakazi bawo. Lokhu yibona lobo bufakazi, futhi umphumela awukwazi ukurekhodwa ngaphandle kwabo.
oral.recordIntro.from: An oral attempt leaves no evidence of its own. This is that evidence, and the outcome cannot be recorded without it.

oral.outcomeIntro.text: Kwahlulelwa ngendlela efanayo nomzamo obhaliwe, ngezindlela ezifanayo, futhi kulinganiswe ngendlela efanayo ngemva kwalokho.
oral.outcomeIntro.from: Judged the same way as a written attempt, against the same criteria, and moderated the same way afterwards.

oral.howHint.text: Ubuso nobuso, noma ikholi yevidiyo eyabanjelwa kuyo
oral.howHint.from: In person, or the video call it was held on

oral.presentNote.text: Akudingeki. Ukuhlolwa ngomlomo kungekho omunye ekamelweni kunzima ukukuvikela ekulinganisweni, futhi irekhodi kumele lisho ukuthi bekuyiphi.
oral.presentNote.from: Not required. An oral assessment with nobody else in the room is harder to defend at moderation, and the record should say which kind this was.

oral.savedNext.text: Umphumela urekhodwa esikrinini sokumaka, njengomzamo ongomunye.
oral.savedNext.from: The outcome is recorded on the marking screen, the same as any other attempt.

appeals.intro.text: Umfundi angakhala ngomphumela noma ngokuziphatha komhloli. Ukutholwa kuqinisekiswa phakathi kwamahora angu-{hours}, okuyisikhathi esiphuthelwa, ngoba sihamba ngesikhathi umuntu efundisa.
appeals.intro.from: A learner may appeal against a result or against an assessor's conduct. Receipt is acknowledged within {hours} hours, which is the deadline that gets missed, because it runs while somebody is teaching.

appeals.lateIntro.text: Kudlule amahora angu-{hours} futhi akukaqinisekiswa. Ukuqinisekisa sekwephuzile kungcono kunokungaqinisekisi nhlobo, futhi irekhodi lizobonisa kokubili.
appeals.lateIntro.from: Past the {hours} hours and still not acknowledged. Acknowledging late is better than not at all, and the record will show both.

appeals.openIntro.text: Konke okufakiwe futhi okungakavalwa, okusha kuqala.
appeals.openIntro.from: Everything lodged and not yet closed, newest first.

appeals.none.text: Akukho okuvulekile. Isikhalo sifakwa ekhasini lomfundi uqobo.
appeals.none.from: Nothing open. An appeal is lodged from a learner's own page.

appeals.procedureIntro.text: Qinisekisa ukutholwa, hlangana nomfundi, buza umlinganisi lapho isisekelo kungumphumela, bese uxazulula futhi ubatshele.
appeals.procedureIntro.from: Acknowledge, meet the learner, consult the moderator where the ground is a result, then resolve and tell them.

appeals.closedUnacknowledged.text: Kuvalwe ngaphandle kokuba kurekhodwe ukuqinisekiswa kokutholwa.
appeals.closedUnacknowledged.from: Closed without an acknowledgement being recorded.

appeals.firstCounts.text: Ukuqinisekisa kokuqala yikho irekhodi elikugcinayo. Akunakubekwa isikhathi kabusha ngemva kwalokho, ngoba isikhathi esingashintshwa asiyona ubufakazi bofuna.
appeals.firstCounts.from: The first acknowledgement is the one the record keeps. It cannot be re-stamped later, because a time that can be changed is not evidence of anything.

appeals.resultNeedsModerator.text: Isikhalo ngomphumela siya kumlinganisi wangaphakathi ngaphambi kokuba sixazululwe. Yilesi isinyathelo umqinisekisi wangaphandle akubuza ngaso.
appeals.resultNeedsModerator.from: A result appeal goes to the internal moderator before it can be resolved. That is the step an external verifier asks about.

appeals.conductNoModerator.text: Isikhalo ngokuziphatha asixazululwa ukumakwa kabusha, ngakho akudingeki umlinganisi.
appeals.conductNoModerator.from: A conduct appeal is not something re-marking settles, so no moderator is required.

appeals.notFeedback.from: A decision the learner has not been given is not feedback.

appeals.whyHint.from: Why. This is the part the learner is entitled to.

appeals.notesIntro.text: Ingxoxo phakathi komxhumanisi, umhloli nomlinganisi. Ayikhonjiswa umfundi ngaphandle uma usho njalo; lokho ayifanelwe umphumela nesizathu esingenhla.
appeals.notesIntro.from: The discussion between coordinator, assessor and moderator. Not shown to the learner unless you say so; what they are entitled to is the outcome and the reasoning above.

appeals.noteHint.from: What was discussed, and with whom

appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.text: Ukuhoxisa kudinga isizathu. Ukungabi naso kubukeka njengengcindezi, futhi yileyo kanye engaba yisikhalo ngokuziphatha.
appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.from: A withdrawal needs a reason. One with none looks like pressure, and that is exactly what an appeal about conduct would be about.

rpl.intro.text: Kumfundi osevele enza ingxenye yomsebenzi. Akukho okunikezwa lapha ngenxa yamazwi omuntu oyedwa: isahlulelo senziwa ngokwemibandela yemojuli uqobo, sibhalwe ngokugcwele, futhi silinganiswe othile ongesiye owasenza ngaphambi kokuba sibale noma yini.
rpl.intro.from: For a learner who can already do part of the work. Nothing here is granted on one person's say-so: a judgement is made against the module's own criteria, written down in full, and moderated by somebody other than whoever made it before it counts for anything.

rpl.waitingIntro.text: Isahlulelo asinikezi lutho kuze kwenziwe lokhu. Funda isizathu uqhathanise nemojuli ngaphambi kokuvuma: yilona olokuqala umqinisekisi wangaphandle alifunda.
rpl.waitingIntro.from: A judgement grants nothing until this is done. Read the rationale against the module before agreeing: it is the first thing an external verifier reads.

rpl.appearHere.from: Judgements appear here as they are made.

rpl.openIntro.text: Isinyathelo sokuqala, nesenza irekhodi ezinye izinto zonke ezinamathela kulo.
rpl.openIntro.from: The first step, and the one that creates the record everything else attaches to.

rpl.transferIntro.text: Kwehlukile ekwamukelweni kokufunda kwangaphambilini: umfundi usenazo iziqu imiphumela yazo egubuzela le mojuli. Akudingeki ukweluleka, kodwa ukuqhathanisa kumele kubhalwe phansi; ukudluliselwa kungekho lokho kuyisicelo akekho ongasihlola.
rpl.transferIntro.from: Different from RPL: the learner already holds a qualification whose outcomes cover this module. No advisory, but the mapping has to be written down; a transfer without it is a claim nobody can check.

rpl.needsBoth.text: Isicelo sidinga umfundi neziqu okufakelwa zona. Zengeze kuqala.
rpl.needsBoth.from: An application needs a learner and a qualification to apply against. Add those first.

rpl.needsLearner.text: Engeza umfundi ngaphambi kokurekhoda ukudluliselwa kwakhe.
rpl.needsLearner.from: Add a learner before recording a transfer for one.

rpl.mapping.text: Indlela imiphumela yalokho abanakho egubuzela ngayo eyale mojuli
rpl.mapping.from: How the outcomes of what they hold cover this module's

rpl.checked.from: What you checked, and what you concluded

record.print.text: Phrinta leli khasi ukuze uligcine njenge-PDF efayeleni lobufakazi.
record.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF for the portfolio of evidence.

record.timeExpired.text: Akwamukelwanga: isikhathi sesiphelile futhi umsebenzi ungeniswe njengoba wawukhona.
record.timeExpired.from: Not accepted: the time limit expired and the work was handed in as it stood.

record.returned.text: Kubuyiselwe {date}. Lokhu kwenzelwa ukukhula: akurekhodi ikhono.
record.returned.from: Returned {date}. This is developmental: it records no competence.

sor.withdrawConsequence.text: Isikhungo sokuhlola singase sibe nayo kakade ikhophi. Inkomba iyaqhubeka ukusebenza futhi izosho ukuthi isihoxisiwe.
sor.withdrawConsequence.from: An assessment centre may already hold a copy. The reference keeps working and will say it was withdrawn.

sor.print.text: Phrinta noma ugcine lesi Sitatimende Semiphumela
sor.print.from: Print or save this Statement of Results

fisa.intro.text: Iphepha lokusetha lo mhlinzeki lohlelo lwawo lwamakhono. Ngokungafani nokuhlolwa kwangaphandle, wena uyalibhala futhi walinganise, ngakho ukulinganisa kwenzeka ngaphambi kokuba noma ubani alihlale, futhi iphepha elingavunywanga njengelifanele injongo alinakusetshenziswa.
fisa.intro.from: The paper this provider sets for its own skills programme. Unlike an external assessment, you write it and you moderate it, so the moderation happens before anybody sits it, and a paper that has not been signed off as fit for purpose cannot be used.

fisa.waitingIntro.from: Nobody can sit these until a moderator signs them off.

fisa.setNewIntro.text: Ngokohlelo lwamakhono. Iziqu ezigcwele noma ezingxenye ziyahlolwa ngaphandle.
fisa.setNewIntro.from: Against a skills programme. A full or part qualification is assessed externally.

fisa.gate.approved.text: Livunyiwe njengelifanele injongo: abazobhala bangalihlala leli phepha
fisa.gate.approved.from: Signed off as fit for purpose: candidates may sit this paper

fisa.gate.in_moderation.from: With the moderator: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.gate.draft.from: Being written: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.beforeNotAfter.text: I-FISA ilinganiswa ngaphambi kokuba ihlalwe, hhayi ngemva kwalokho. Yilokho okwenza ivikeleke ekuvakasheni kokuqapha.
fisa.beforeNotAfter.from: A FISA is moderated before it is sat, not after. That is what makes it defensible at a monitoring visit.

fisa.practical.text: Inengxenye esebenzayo, ehlulelwa ngokuthi onekhono noma ongakabi nekhono.
fisa.practical.from: Also has a practical component, judged competent or not yet competent.

fisa.moderatorIntro.text: Ubheka ukuthi lifanele injongo yini, ngaphambi kokuba noma ubani alihlale.
fisa.moderatorIntro.from: Checks it is fit for purpose, before anybody sits it.

fisa.unsigned.text: Akukabikho sivumelwano sokufihla. Abanakuliqaphela noma balahlulele iphepha baze basayine.
fisa.unsigned.from: No confidentiality agreement yet. They may not see or judge the paper until it is signed.

fisa.outcomes.text: Imiphumela yezinga lokuphuma, nalapho iphepha liyihlola khona
fisa.outcomes.from: Exit level outcomes, and where the paper assesses them

fisa.outcomesIntro.text: Isigaba 2 sayo yomibili imibiko. Kuwukuphela kwendawo ebonisa ukuthi iphepha lihlanganisa iziqu, hhayi nje ukubukeka njengokuhlolwa.
fisa.outcomesIntro.from: Section 2 of both reports. The only place that shows the paper covers the qualification rather than merely looking like an exam.

fisa.noOutcomes.text: Lolu hlelo alunayo imiphumela yezinga lokuphuma erekhodiwe, ngakho akukho okungaqhathaniswa nephepha. Ngenisa ikharikhulamu kuqala.
fisa.noOutcomes.from: This programme has no exit level outcomes recorded, so there is nothing to map the paper against. Import the curriculum first.

fisa.onlyExaminer.text: Kuphela umlobi wephepha onqunyiwe, uma isivumelwano sakhe sokufihla sisayiniwe, angaphendula lokhu.
fisa.onlyExaminer.from: Only the appointed examiner, once their confidentiality agreement is signed, can answer these.

fisa.onlyModerator.text: Kuphela umlinganisi onqunyiwe, uma isivumelwano sakhe sokufihla sisayiniwe, angaphendula lokhu.
fisa.onlyModerator.from: Only the appointed moderator, once their confidentiality agreement is signed, can answer these.

fisa.handOverIntro.from: Once your own report is complete.

fisa.laterIntro.text: Le ihlala injengoba injalo, ngoba abazobhala bangase base bayihlala. Inguqulo entsha idinga ukulinganiswa kwayo.
fisa.laterIntro.from: This one stays exactly as it is, because candidates may have sat it. A new version needs its own moderation.

fisa.noProgrammes.text: I-FISA isethwa ngokohlelo lwamakhono, futhi alukho okwamanje. Ngenisa olulodwa kuqala; iziqu ezigcwele noma ezingxenye ziyahlolwa ngaphandle yiMlingani Wekhwalithi Yokuhlola, ngakho umhlinzeki akasethi leli phepha.
fisa.noProgrammes.from: A FISA is set against a skills programme, and there are none yet. Import one first; a full or part qualification is assessed externally by the Assessment Quality Partner, so the provider does not set that paper.

fisa.passNote.text: I-FISA iyisivivinyo, ngakho inayo, ngokungafani nekhono langaphakathi.
fisa.passNote.from: A FISA is an examination, so it has one, unlike internal competence.

fisa.hasPractical.text: Inayo futhi ingxenye esebenzayo ehlulelwa ngokuthi onekhono noma ongakabi nekhono
fisa.hasPractical.from: It also has a practical component judged competent or not yet competent

fisa.practicalHint.text: isib. Ukusebenza: amahora angu-4, kwahlulelwa onekhono / ongakabi nekhono
fisa.practicalHint.from: e.g. Practical: 4 hours, judged competent / not yet competent

fisa.idNote.text: Indlela ipulatifomu ehlukanisa ngayo umuntu nomunye uma engenayo i-akhawunti lapha.
fisa.idNote.from: How the platform tells one person from another when they have no account here.

fisa.account.from: Their account here, if they have one

fisa.outside.from: Somebody from outside, with no account

fisa.accountNote.text: Kuphela umuntu one-akhawunti ongagcwalisa umbiko wakhe lapha.
fisa.accountNote.from: Only somebody with an account can fill in their own report here.

fisa.further.from: Further comments for the improvement of assessment standards

fisa.signOff.from: Sign off as fit for purpose

fisa.untilYouDo.text: Akekho ongalihlala leli phepha uze wenze lokho.
fisa.untilYouDo.from: No candidate may sit this paper until you do.

eisa.intro.text: Lapho ukuhlala ngakunye kukhona, lapho ukubhalisela kuvalwa, nokuthi yimaphi amaqoqo asadinga ukungeniswa. Ukubhalisa kuvamise ukuvalwa cishe izinyanga ezintathu ngaphambili, yingakho iqoqo eliqeda ngasekupheleni konyaka kumele lingeniswe kudala ngaphambi kokuba liqede.
eisa.intro.from: When each sitting is, when registration for it closes, and which cohorts still have to be entered. Registration typically closes about three months ahead, which is why a cohort finishing later in the year has to be entered long before it finishes.

eisa.registerNowIntro.text: Ukubhalisa kuvalwa phakathi kwezinsuku eziyishumi zokusebenza futhi la maqoqo awanaso usuku lokubhalisa olurekhodiwe.
eisa.registerNowIntro.from: Registration closes within ten working days and these cohorts have no registration date recorded.

eisa.sittingsIntro.text: Kuphela lawo asavulekele ukubhalisa. Elivaliwe alikho umuntu angakwenza ngalo, futhi ukulishiya lapha kwakuzocindezela isikhathi sokugcina esiqondile esilandelayo phansi ekhasini.
eisa.sittingsIntro.from: Only those still open for registration. A closed one is nothing anybody can act on, and leaving it here would push the next real deadline down the page.

eisa.nextYear.text: Akukho okurekhodiwe ngaphezu kwalo nyaka. Umlingani wekhwalithi yokuhlola ushicilela izinsuku zonyaka ozayo ngoDisemba, ngakho incwadi kumele ibe isikhiphiwe; ukuzengeza manje yikho okugcina ukubala kwezinsuku kuqhubeka kuze kube nguJanuwari.
eisa.nextYear.from: Nothing is recorded beyond this year. The assessment quality partner publishes next year's dates in December, so the letter should be out; adding them now is what keeps the countdown running into January.

eisa.toEnterIntro.text: Konke okunesikhathi sokugcina esivulekile futhi okungenalo usuku lokubhalisa olurekhodiwe.
eisa.toEnterIntro.from: Everything with an open deadline and no registration date recorded against it.

eisa.noIdIntro.text: Zonke izinhlangano zekhwalithi ziyayicela, futhi ukubhalisa okubuyiswa ngenxa yenombolo engekho kubiza umjikelezo. Kungcono kutholwe manje kunangemva kokuthunyelwa kwefayela.
eisa.noIdIntro.from: Every quality partner asks for one, and a registration returned for a missing number costs a cycle. Better found now than after the file is sent.

eisa.readyIntro.text: Yonke imibandela kuyo yonke imojuli iphelele, noma ifundisiwe noma yamukelwe ngokufunda kwangaphambilini.
eisa.readyIntro.from: Every criterion in every module met, whether taught or recognised through prior learning.

eisa.nobodyYet.text: Akekho okwamanje. Uhlu olungezansi lukhombisa ukuthi ngamunye kudingeka ahambe kangakanani.
eisa.nobodyYet.from: Nobody yet. The list below says how far each of them has to go.

eisa.notReadyIntro.text: Ukuthi ngamunye kudingeka ahambe kangakanani. Umuntu oswele umbandela owodwa nje usengafinyelela ekugcineni uma kuqashelwa kuleli sonto.
eisa.notReadyIntro.from: How far each has to go. Somebody one criterion short can still make the deadline if it is noticed this week.

ready.intro.text: Umfundi angahlala i-External Integrated Summative Assessment uma nje yonke imibandela yokuhlola kwangaphakathi kuyo yonke imojuli seyifinyelelwe. Hhayi eminingi yayo, futhi asikho iphesenti elithatha indawo yalokho: iphesenti elingezansi liyintuthuko, ibheji yilona lemvume.
ready.intro.from: A learner may sit the External Integrated Summative Assessment once every internal assessment criterion in every module has been achieved. Not most of them, and no percentage stands in for it: the percentage below is progress, the badge is permission.

ready.nobody.text: Akekho obhalisiwe ngaphansi kweziqu okwamanje. Bhalisa umfundi enkambweni bese ukhetha iziqu ebalwa kuzo, futhi uzovela lapha.
ready.nobody.from: Nobody is enrolled against a qualification yet. Enrol a learner on a course and choose the qualification it counts towards, and they will appear here.

ready.notCaptured.from: A curriculum here is not fully captured.

ready.notCapturedIntro.text: Amanye amamojuli awanayo imibandela yokuhlola, ngakho akukho okungafinyelelwa kuwo futhi akekho kulezi ziqu ongamenyezelwa ukuthi ulungile. Ngenisa idokhumenti ephelele yekharikhulamu ngaphambi kokungenisa noma ubani ku-EISA.
ready.notCapturedIntro.from: Some modules carry no assessment criteria, so nothing can be achieved against them and nobody on that qualification can be declared ready. Import the full curriculum document before entering anyone for an EISA.

ready.notEligible.from: Not yet eligible for the EISA

ready.achieved.text: Kufinyelelwe {achieved} ku-{total} yemibandela yokuhlola kwangaphakathi, futhi isipiliyoni sokusebenza sifakazelwa yilokhu okusayiniwe: {record}.
ready.achieved.from: {achieved} of {total} internal assessment criteria achieved, and work experience proved by a signed {record}.

ready.canIssue.from: A Statement of Results can be issued.

ready.everyOne.from: Every one of them is required; there is no pass mark.

ready.perUnitIntro.text: Isitatimende seyunithi eyodwa yokufunda siqinisekisa yonke imibandela kumamojuli iyunithi enikeza. Singakhishwa ngokushesha lapho leyo yunithi iqediwe, ngaphandle kokulinda okunye kweziqu.
ready.perUnitIntro.from: A statement for one study unit confirms every criterion in the modules that unit delivers. It can be issued as soon as that unit is finished, without waiting for the rest of the qualification.

ready.certificateIntro.text: Sikhishwa yinhlangano enikeza iziqu ngemva kwe-EISA, hhayi ngu-{provider}. Sirekhodwa lapha lapho sifika, ukuze irekhodi lomfundi lisho ukuthi uneziqu.
ready.certificateIntro.from: Issued by the awarding body after the EISA, not by {provider}. Recorded here when it arrives, so the learner's record says they are qualified.

ready.thisNotCaptured.from: This curriculum is not fully captured.

ready.thisNotCapturedIntro.text: {modules} awanayo imibandela yokuhlola. Akekho ongamenyezelwa ukuthi ufaneleka kulezi ziqu kuze kungeniswe idokhumenti ephelele yekharikhulamu; ngaphandle kwalokho amamojuli angekho azobalwa njengaphasile ngokuthula.
ready.thisNotCapturedIntro.from: {modules} carry no assessment criteria. Nobody can be declared eligible against this qualification until the full curriculum document has been imported; otherwise the missing modules would silently count as passed.

ready.weight.document.from: as stated in the curriculum document

ready.weight.credits.text: kutholwe emakhredithini emojuli; idokhumenti ayisho amaphesenti
ready.weight.credits.from: derived from module credits; the document states no percentages

ready.weight.equal.text: kwahlukaniswe ngokulinganayo; idokhumenti ayisho amaphesenti namakhredithi
ready.weight.equal.from: split evenly; the document states no percentages and no credits

ready.workProved.text: Isipiliyoni sokusebenza sifakazelwa yilokhu: {record}, okusayinwe umqeqeshi wasemsebenzini futhi kwamukelwe umhloli, hhayi imibandela yokuhlola. Ikharikhulamu ayichazi lutho kule mojuli.
ready.workProved.from: Work experience is proved by a {record} signed by the workplace coach and accepted by an assessor, not by assessment criteria. The curriculum defines none for this module.

ready.noRecord.from: No {record} has been opened for this module.

ready.noCriteria.text: Akukho mibandela yokuhlola efakiwe kule mojuli.
ready.noCriteria.from: No assessment criteria captured for this module.

issue.notYet.from: A Statement of Results cannot be issued yet.

preview.summative.text: Okuphetha: kwahlulelwa umuntu futhi kulinganiswe ngokuzimela
preview.summative.from: Summative: judged by a person and independently moderated

preview.formative.from: Formative: marked as the learner goes

preview.whoMarks.from: {app} marked by the App, {assessor} by an assessor

preview.isPreviewIntro.text: Kunembile lokho umfundi akubonayo, namabhokisi angabhala kuwo. Akukho okugciniwe futhi akukho umzamo oqalile, ngakho izilawuli zivaliwe. Iphaneli engaphansi kombuzo ngamunye ingeyakho ngoba wakhe leli phepha; umfundi akayiboni.
preview.isPreviewIntro.from: Exactly what a learner sees, with the boxes they would type into. Nothing is saved and no attempt has been started, so the controls are switched off. The panel under each question is for you because you built this paper; a learner never sees it.

preview.empty.from: There are no questions in this paper yet.

preview.tickedAbove.from: The correct option is ticked above.

preview.noGuide.text: Alukho umhlahlandlela wokumaka. Umhloli akanalutho angamaka ngalo; engeza olulodwa ngaphambi kokuba iphepha lisetshenziswe.
preview.noGuide.from: No marking guide. An assessor has nothing to mark this against; add one before the paper is used.

preview.declarationIntro.text: Umfundi akakwazi ukungenisa lokhu ngaphandle kokuvuma, futhi amagama aqondile afakwa ngokungaguquki ekungeniseni.
preview.declarationIntro.from: A learner cannot hand this in without agreeing to it, and the exact wording is frozen into the submission.

people.intro.text: Wonke umuntu ku-{provider}, indima yabo, nokuthi irekhodi labo linakho yini okudingwa umbiko womthetho.
people.intro.from: Everyone in {provider}, their roles, and whether their record carries what a statutory return needs.

people.notEnrolledOne.from: 1 learner is not enrolled on anything.

people.notEnrolledMany.from: {count} learners are not enrolled on anything.

people.notEnrolledWhy.text: Ukuba ngumfundi akunikezi ukufinyelela ngokwakho, ngakho bangena esikrinini esingenalutho. Bhalisa umfundi enkambweni, mengeze eqoqweni, noma umnikeze uhlelo.
people.notEnrolledWhy.from: Being a learner grants no access on its own, so they sign in to an empty screen. Enrol them on a course, add them to a cohort, or assign a programme.

people.missingOne.text: Umuntu o-1 uswele imininingwane edingwa umbiko we-SETA noma we-SAQA.
people.missingOne.from: 1 person is missing details a SETA or SAQA return needs.

people.missingMany.text: Abantu abaswele imininingwane edingwa umbiko we-SETA noma we-SAQA: {count}.
people.missingMany.from: {count} people are missing details a SETA or SAQA return needs.

people.missingWhy.text: Baphawulwe ngezansi. Ukuyifaka manje kulula kakhulu kunasebusuku bangaphambi kokuthunyelwa.
people.missingWhy.from: They are marked below. Filling them in now is far easier than the night before a submission.

people.roster.from: Add a cohort from a spreadsheet

people.rosterIntro.text: Funda ifayela le-CSV noma le-Excel labafundi bese ubadala bonke ngesikhathi esisodwa. Likubonisa ukuthi likwenzeni ifayela ngaphambi kokuba kudalwe noma ubani.
people.rosterIntro.from: Read a CSV or Excel file of learners and create them all at once. It shows you what it made of the file before anybody is created.

people.added.text: Kwengeziwe. Mnike le phasiwedi: ikhonjiswa kanye kuphela futhi ayikwazi ukubuyiselwa.
people.added.from: Added. Give them this password: it is shown once and cannot be retrieved.

people.noMail.text: Alukho iseva yeposi exhunyiwe okwamanje, ngakho akukho okuthunyelwe nge-imeyili. Cela ashintshe iphasiwedi ngemva kokungena.
people.noMail.from: There is no mail server connected yet, so nothing was emailed. Ask them to change it after signing in.

person.lineManagerNote.text: Inquma ukuthi ngabe yikuphi ukuqeqeshwa kwalo muntu okungabonwa ezibikweni.
person.lineManagerNote.from: Decides whose training this person can see in reports.

person.ofoNote.text: Ikhodi yomsebenzi esetshenziselwa ukuqoqa umbiko we-SETA.
person.ofoNote.from: Occupation code used to group a SETA return.

person.statutoryNote.text: Kudingeka embikweni we-SAQA noma we-SETA. Inombolo yokuzazisa ihlolwa ngenombolo yayo yokuhlola ngenkathi ugcina, ngakho iphutha lokuthayipha liyabanjwa lapha kunokuba libanjwe umlawuli.
person.statutoryNote.from: Needed for a SAQA or SETA return. The identity number is checked against its check digit as you save, so a typing error is caught here rather than by the regulator.

person.roleNote.workplace_coach.text: Umengameli womqashi: ubona kuphela abafundi bakhe
person.roleNote.workplace_coach.from: The employer's supervisor: sees only their own learners

roster.how.text: I-CSV noma i-Excel. Izihloko zamakholomu zifaniswa ngegama ("Surname", "Last Name" kanye no-"Van" zonke ziyasebenza) futhi akukho sandiso esidingekayo kukho konke lokhu.
roster.how.from: CSV or Excel. Column headings are matched by name ("Surname", "Last Name" and "Van" all work) and no extension is needed for any of it.

roster.aiOnWhat.text: futhi sizozama ukufanisa noma yisiphi isihloko esingatholwa yimithetho. Siboniswa izihloko kuphela, ingabi izinhlu, ezinamanombolo okuzazisa.
roster.aiOnWhat.from: and will try to match any heading the rules miss. It is shown the headings only, never the rows, which carry identity numbers.

roster.aiOff.text: Uma isandiso sakho se-AI sivuliwe sizofanisa futhi izihloko okungazazwa yimithetho; siboniswa izihloko kuphela, ingabi izinhlu. Iswishi isephezulu ekhasini.
roster.aiOff.from: With your AI extension switched on it would additionally match headings the rules do not recognise; it would be shown the headings only, never the rows. The switch is at the top of the page.

roster.passwords.text: Amaphasiwedi abo okuqala, abonisiwe kanye kuphela

roster.passwordsNote.text: Awagcinwa noma kuphi lapho angafundwa khona futhi. Wakopishe manje, noma uwasethe kabusha ngamunye kamuva. Umuntu ngamunye uzocelwa ukuthi ashintshe eyakhe lapho engena okokuqala.
roster.passwordsNote.from: These are not stored anywhere they can be read again. Copy them now, or reset them individually later. Each person is asked to change theirs on first sign-in.

roster.willCreateSkip.from: {count} will be created, {skipped} will be skipped.

personPage.anonymisedOne.text: Imininingwane yomuntu isisulwe ngomhla ka-{date} ngesicelo somuntu. Isitifiketi sakhe esi-1 siqhubeka sivumelekile futhi siyaqinisekiswa, ngoba iziqu ezitholakele kumele zihlale kurekhodi likazwelonke.
personPage.anonymisedOne.from: The personal details were erased on {date} at the person's request. Their 1 certificate remains valid and verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to stay on the national record.

personPage.anonymisedMany.text: Imininingwane yomuntu isisulwe ngomhla ka-{date} ngesicelo somuntu. Izitifiketi zakhe ezingu-{count} ziqhubeka zivumelekile futhi ziyaqinisekiswa, ngoba iziqu ezitholakele kumele zihlale kurekhodi likazwelonke.
personPage.anonymisedMany.from: The personal details were erased on {date} at the person's request. Their {count} certificates remain valid and verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to stay on the national record.

personPage.conductIntro.text: Okusolwa ngakho, yiziphi izixwayiso ezaziphila ngaleso sikhathi, ukuthi isaziso sokulalelwa besanele yini, nokuthi kunqunywe ini. Ngokulandelana kokwenzeka, okuwukulandelana lapho kufundwa khona kabusha.
personPage.conductIntro.from: What was alleged, which warnings were live at the time, whether notice of a hearing was adequate, and what was decided. In the order it happened, which is the order it gets read back in.

personPage.supportIntro.text: Lokho okwenziwa kulo mfundi, futhi ngubani owenza. Isizathu esingemuva kokwenzelwa indawo yimininingwane yezempilo noma yezimali futhi igcinwa ngokwehlukile, ngoba ukwenza indawo akudingi ukwazi ukuthi kungani.
personPage.supportIntro.from: What is being done for this learner, and by whom. The reason behind an accommodation is health or financial information and is held apart from it, because doing the accommodating does not require knowing why.

personPage.missedIntro.text: Usuku olulodwa olwengeziwe, futhi luhlala lulodwa kuphela. Lapho nalo lushiywa ngezizathu zezokwelapha umfundi uya ekuhlolweni ngomlomo nomlandeli ovela kumqashi.
personPage.missedIntro.from: One additional date, and one only. Where that is also missed on medical grounds the learner goes to an oral assessment with an observer from the employer.

personPage.appealsIntro.text: Ngomphumela, noma ngokuziphatha komhloli. Ukutholwa kuqinisekiswa phakathi kwamahora angu-{hours}, futhi isikhathi siqala uma sifakwe lapha.
personPage.appealsIntro.from: Against a result, or against an assessor's conduct. Receipt is acknowledged within {hours} hours, and the clock starts when it is lodged here.

personPage.documentsIntro.text: Ahlolwa njengoba eqoqwa hhayi lapho kuqoqwa umbiko. Ikhophi eqinisekisiwe engekho etholakala ezinyangeni ezimbalwa kamuva inzima kakhulu ukuyitholuka, futhi isikhathi sokugcina ngokuvamile sesisezinsukwini ezimbalwa ngaleso sikhathi.
personPage.documentsIntro.from: Checked as they are collected rather than when a return is being assembled. A missing certified copy found months later is far harder to get, and the deadline is usually days away by then.

personPage.elsewhereIntro.text: Kungeniswe kusuka kwesinye isistimu. Kuboniswa njengoba kwarekhodwa lapho; akukho kukho okwafundiswa, kwahlolwa noma kwalinganiswa kule platifomu.
personPage.elsewhereIntro.from: Imported from another system. Shown as it was recorded there; none of it was taught, assessed or moderated on this platform.

editor.ownRoles.text: Awukwazi ukushintsha izindima zakho: ukususa ukufinyelela kwakho uqobo yiphutha elilodwa okungenzeka akekho omunye ongalilungisa. Cela omunye umphathi.
editor.ownRoles.from: You cannot change your own roles: removing your own access is the one mistake nobody else may be able to undo. Ask another administrator.

editor.mailboxIntro.text: Ikheli abafundi nabahloli ababhala kulo futhi abathola kulo. Lehlukile ekhelini lokungena elingenhla, ukuze ingxoxo ngokuhlola ihlale ngaphakathi kwerekhodi lomfundi hhayi ebhokisini lomuntu eliyimfihlo, lapho lingaphandle kwerekhodi lokucwaningwa, lingaphandle kwesipele, futhi lishabalala lapho ehamba.
editor.mailboxIntro.from: The address learners and assessors write to and from. Separate from the sign-in address above, so a conversation about an assessment lands inside the learner's record rather than in somebody's private inbox, where it is outside the audit log, outside the backup, and gone when they leave.

editor.noPassword.text: Akukho phasiwedi eyehlukile, ngoba akukho kungena okwehlukile.
editor.noPassword.from: There is no separate password, because there is no separate login.

editor.noPasswordWhy.text: Lokhu akuyona ibhokisi leposi kuseva yeposi enewebhimeyili yayo. Iposi elithunyelwe kulelikheli lifakwa ngaphakathi kwepulatifomu, futhi umuntu uliphendula futhi alifunde ngaphansi kwe-Iposi ngemva kokungena ngendlela ejwayelekile. Yiyo leyo injongo yalo: ukuxoxisana kuhlala ngaphakathi kwerekhodi lomfundi, erekhodini lokucwaningwa nasesipeleni, hhayi ebhokisini eliyimfihlo elihamba naye lapho ehamba.
editor.noPasswordWhy.from: This is not a mailbox on a mail host with its own webmail. Mail sent to this address is delivered into the platform, and the person reads and answers it under Mail after signing in the way they always do. That is the point of it: the correspondence sits inside the learner's record, in the audit log and in the backup, rather than in a private inbox that leaves when they do.

editor.mailboxChange.from: Changing it does not move mail already received.

editor.mailboxSuggested.text: Okuphakanyisiwe: {address}. Shiya kungenalutho ukuze kungabikho ibhokisi leposi.
editor.mailboxSuggested.from: Suggested: {address}. Leave blank for no mailbox.

editor.newPassword.text: Iphasiwedi entsha: ibonisiwe kanye kuphela, yinike ngqo.
editor.newPassword.from: New password: shown once, give it to them directly.

editor.ownSuspend.from: You cannot suspend your own account.

editor.suspendNote.text: Ukumisa kuphelisa ngokushesha noma yisiphi isikhathi somuntu esivuliwe, futhi ukusetha kabusha iphasiwedi kumphumisa yonke indawo.
editor.suspendNote.from: Suspending ends any session the person has open immediately, and resetting a password signs them out everywhere.

editor.eraseIntro.text: Ngesicelo sokusula se-POPIA. Isusa igama, ukuxhumana nemininingwane yezibalo zabantu unomphela. Izitifiketi namarekhodi okuhlola kuyagcinwa futhi kuhlala kuqinisekiswa, ngoba iziqu ezitholakele kumele zihlale kurekhodi likazwelonke, futhi yingakho lokhu kungakhanselwa.
editor.eraseIntro.from: For a POPIA erasure request. Removes the name, contact and demographic details permanently. Certificates and assessment records are kept and stay verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to remain on the national record, which is also why this cannot be undone.

editor.whyHint.from: Kept permanently in the audit log.

lodge.noCohort.text: Isikhalo sifakwa ngokuphathelene neqoqo, futhi lo mfundi akekho eqoqweni eliqhubekayo.
lodge.noCohort.from: An appeal is filed against a cohort, and this learner is not on a running one.

lodge.statementHint.text: Lokho umfundi akushoyo, ngamazwi akhe uma kungenzeka.
lodge.statementHint.from: What the learner says, in their words where possible.

lodge.lateWhy.from: Why this is being accepted out of time

lodge.lateNote.text: Isikhalo esilibele siseyisikhalo, futhi ukusenqaba lapha kwakuzosithumela ebhokisini lomuntu othile kuphela. Isizathu siba yingxenye yefayela.
lodge.lateNote.from: A late appeal is still an appeal, and turning it away here would only send it to somebody's inbox. The reason becomes part of the file.

missed.againOral.from: Missed it again: authorise an oral assessment

missed.wasMedical.from: The second miss was on medical grounds

missed.medicalOnly.text: Indlela yomlomo ivulwa ngenxa yesizathu sezokwelapha kuphela, akukho okunye. Ngaphandle kwaso umphumela uba ukulahlekelwa, umfundi angakhala ngakho.
missed.medicalOnly.from: The oral route opens on a medical ground and nothing else. Without one the outcome is a forfeit, which the learner can still appeal.

missed.whyHint.from: Why it was missed, if known

missed.onlyOne.text: Usuku olulodwa olwengeziwe, futhi luhlala lulodwa kuphela. Ukulirekhoda lapha yikho okuvimbela okwesithathu ukuba lihlelwe kamuva othile ongazi ngalolu.
missed.onlyOne.from: One additional date, and one only. Recording it here is what stops a third being arranged later by somebody who did not know about this one.

support.withheld.text: Kunemininingwane eminingi efayelini. Ivinjelwe, ngoba iyimininingwane yezempilo noma yezimali futhi ukwenza indawo akudingi ukwazi isizathu sayo.
support.withheld.from: There is more detail on file. It is restricted, because it is health or financial information and doing the accommodation does not require knowing the reason for it.

support.changing.from: What is changing as a result

support.accommodation.from: What will be done: shared with whoever has to do it

support.accommodationHint.text: Isihlalo eduze komnyango. Vumela ikhefu njalo ngemizuzu engama-40. Nikeza izinto zokufunda eziphrintiwe.
support.accommodationHint.from: Seat near the door. Allow a break every 40 minutes. Provide printed materials.

support.reason.text: Isizathu esingemuva kwalokho: sivinjelwe, futhi kungcono sishiywe singagcwalisiwe
support.reason.from: The reason behind it: restricted, and better left empty

support.reasonNote.text: Impilo, ukukhubazeka nezimo zezimali kuyimininingwane yomuntu eyinkimbinkimbi. Irekhodi elisho kuphela ukuthi kuzokwenziwa ini lisiza umfundi ngokufanayo futhi lifaka engcupheni encane kakhulu. Gcwalisa lokhu kuphela lapho othile engeke akwazi ukwenza ngaphandle kwalokho.
support.reasonNote.from: Health, disability and financial circumstances are special personal information. A record that says only what to do serves the learner just as well and puts far less at risk. Fill this in only where somebody genuinely could not act without it.

support.consented.from: The learner has agreed to this being recorded

docs.routeNote.text: Indlela inquma okudingekayo. Ukwamukelwa kokufunda kwangaphambilini kudinga ifayela hhayi isitifiketi seziqu, ngoba isicelo siwukuthi ukufunda kwenzeke ngaphandle kohlelo olusemthethweni.
docs.routeNote.from: The route decides what is required. Recognition of prior learning asks for a portfolio rather than a qualification certificate, because the claim is that the learning happened outside a formal programme.

docs.allSupplied.from: Everything required has been supplied and checked.

conduct.liveNote.text: Lezi kuphela ezibalwa ekwandiseni isinyathelo. Isexwayiso esidlulelwe usuku lwaso sihlala efayelini futhi siyeka ukubalwa, yikho isikhalo esiyincike kukho.
conduct.liveNote.from: Only these count towards escalation. A warning past its date stays on file and stops counting, which is what an appeal turns on.

conduct.findingsHint.from: What was found, and on what basis

conduct.givenButton.from: The learner has been given this in writing

conduct.termsHint.text: Umthetho owephulwe, izinga elilindelekile, nokwenzekayo uma kuphinda.
conduct.termsHint.from: The rule broken, the standard expected, and what happens if it recurs.

conduct.allegationsHint.from: The specific allegations put to the learner

conduct.sanctionsHint.text: Izinhlawulo ezingenzeka, kuhlanganise nokuqedwa lapho kukhona
conduct.sanctionsHint.from: Sanctions possible, including termination where it is

conduct.rights.text: Isaziso sitshela umfundi ukuthi angasizwa umfundi ofana naye, afakele icala lakhe, futhi abize futhi abuzeofakazi.
conduct.rights.from: The notice tells the learner they may be assisted by a fellow learner, present their case, and call and question witnesses.

conduct.notice.text: Okungenani amahora angu-{hours} kusukela manje. Isaziso esifushane siyenqatshwa: yiyona iphutha okunqotshwa ngalo isikhalo, noma ngabe umfundi wenzeni.
conduct.notice.from: At least {hours} hours from now. Short notice is refused: it is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

conduct.whyHint.text: Kungani. Leli yisigaba umfundi anelungelo lokusithola.
conduct.whyHint.from: Why. This is the paragraph the learner is entitled to.

conduct.allegationHint.text: Okusolwa ngakho, ngokuqondile. Umfundi akakwazi ukuphendula 'isimo sengqondo esibi'.
conduct.allegationHint.from: What is alleged, specifically. A learner cannot answer 'poor attitude'.

cohorts.intro.text: Iqembu elisebenza kanyekanye ohlelweni, ngeshejuli eyodwa. Sonke isikhathi sokugcina sigcinwa njengenani lezinsuku kusukela osukwini lokuqala, ngakho ukuhambisa ukungena kuhambisa yonke insuku kwabo bonke abakuyo ngesikhathi esisodwa.
cohorts.intro.from: A group working through a programme together, on one schedule. Every deadline is held as a number of days from the start date, so moving an intake moves every date for everyone in it at once.

cohorts.none.text: {cohort} yiqembu elisebenza kanyekanye ku-{course} epapashiwe, ngeshejuli eyodwa. Dala eyodwa ngokumelene ne-{course} bese wonke isikhathi sokugcina silinganiswa kusukela osukwini lokuqala.
cohorts.none.from: A {cohort} is a group working through a published {course} together, on one schedule. Create one against a {course} and every deadline is measured from its start date.

cohorts.roster.from: Add a cohort from a spreadsheet

cohorts.rosterIntro.text: Funda ifayela le-CSV noma le-Excel labafundi bese ubadala bonke ngesikhathi esisodwa. Likubonisa ukuthi liliqonde kanjani ifayela ngaphambi kokuba kudalwe noma ubani, bese ubabhalisa eqoqweni elingenhla.
cohorts.rosterIntro.from: Read a CSV or Excel file of learners and create them all at once. It shows you what it made of the file before anybody is created, then enrol them onto a cohort above.

cohorts.noPublished.text: Awekho {courses} epapashiwe okwamanje. {cohort} isebenza ngokumelene ne-{course} epapashiwe, ukuze impahla yokufunda ingashintshi ngaphansi kweqembu elivele lisebenza kuyo.
cohorts.noPublished.from: There are no published {courses} yet. A {cohort} runs against a published {course}, so that the material cannot change under a group already working through it.

cohorts.startNote.text: Sonke isikhathi sokugcina sibalwa kusukela kulolu suku. Singahanjiswa kamuva, futhi konke kuhamba nalo.
cohorts.startNote.from: Every deadline is counted from this day. It can be moved later, and everything moves with it.

cohort.paid.text: Kukhokhiwe. Wonke umuntu kuleli qoqo ubalwa njengokhokhelwe.
cohort.paid.from: Paid. Everybody on this cohort counts as paid for.

cohort.paidRef.text: Kukhokhiwe · {reference}. Wonke umuntu kuleli qoqo ubalwa njengokhokhelwe.
cohort.paidRef.from: Paid · {reference}. Everybody on this cohort counts as paid for.

cohort.invoiced.text: Kuthunyelwe inqolobane yezikweletu, futhi akukho ukukhokha okurekhodwe kuyo okwamanje.
cohort.invoiced.from: Invoiced, and no payment recorded against it yet.

cohort.nothingRecorded.text: Akukho okurekhodiwe. Inqubo yokubhalisa iqala lapha.
cohort.nothingRecorded.from: Nothing recorded. The enrolment procedure begins here.

cohort.moveIntro.text: Usuku ngalunye olungezansi lugcinwa njengenani lezinsuku kusukela kulolu, ngakho ukulushintsha kuhambisa lonke uhlelo lokwethulwa kwabo bonke abasezakhi zeqoqo.
cohort.moveIntro.from: Every date below is held as a number of days from this one, so changing it moves the whole rollout for everybody on the cohort.

cohort.waitingIntro.text: Umfundi ngamunye kanye, esinyathelweni sokuqala angeke asivule.
cohort.waitingIntro.from: Each learner once, at the earliest step they cannot open.

cohort.progress.from: Where the cohort has got to

cohort.progressIntro.text: Okuvuliwe nokuqediwe esinyathelweni ngasinye, nokuthi kuthathe isikhathi esingakanani kulabo abaqedile. Umaphakathi hhayi isilinganiso, ukuze umfundi oyedwa oshabalale isikhathi esingunyaka wonke angafihli lapho bonke abanye bakhona.
cohort.progressIntro.from: Opened and finished per step, and how long it took those who finished. The median rather than the average, so one learner who disappeared for a term does not hide where everybody else is.

cohort.stalledOne.from: One step has people sitting on it: {steps}.

cohort.stalledMany.from: {count} steps have people sitting on them: {steps}.

cohort.rolloutIntro.text: Izikhathi zokufunda ezinosuku iqoqo elihlangana ngazo, nerejista ethathwa ngasinye. Lapho uhlelo lunamakhredithi kumele luholwe umhlahlandlela, futhi lokhu kuyibufakazi bokuthi lwaholwa.
cohort.rolloutIntro.from: The dated sessions this cohort meets for, and the register taken at each. Where a programme carries credits it has to be facilitator-led, and this is the evidence that it was.

cohort.attendanceIntro.text: Iphelele ilinganiswa nohlelo lonke; kuze kube manje kulinganiswa nalokho okuye kwenziwa ngempela. Ekuqaleni kohlelo eyokuqala iphansi ngokungenamqondo futhi eyesibili iyiqiniso, ngakho yomibili inikezwa hhayi eyodwa ekhethelwe wena.
cohort.attendanceIntro.from: Overall is against the whole programme; to date is against what has actually been held. Early in a programme the first is meaninglessly low and the second is the honest one, so both are given rather than one being chosen for you.

cohort.held.text: Izikhathi zokufunda ezingu-{held} kwezingu-{countable} ziqhutshiwe. Izikhathi ezikhanseliwe nabangenele ngokuzithandela abaphumeleli zombili.
cohort.held.from: {held} of {countable} sessions held. Cancelled sessions and voluntary walk-ins are left out of both.

cohort.feedbackIntro.text: Ithunyelwa ngemva kokuhlola okuphetha, iphendulwe phakathi kwamahora angu-{hours}. Akekho oqinisekisa ukutholwa futhi akekho okhipha lutho: ukutholwa kuyimbumbulu futhi umbiko uyimibuzo.
cohort.feedbackIntro.from: Sent after a summative, answered within {hours} hours. Nobody acknowledges receipt and nobody transcribes anything: receipt is a row and the report is a query.

cohort.assessmentIntro.text: Umfundi ngamunye ngokumelene nomsebenzi ngamunye ohlolwayo, ngokulandelana ohlanganiswa ngako. Kufundwa ekuthunyweni, ezinqumweni nasezirejistheni hhayi kugcinwe ngesandla, ngakho angeke ahluke kuzo.
cohort.assessmentIntro.from: Every learner against every piece of assessed work, in the order it is collected. Read from submissions, decisions and registers rather than kept by hand, so it cannot disagree with them.

cohort.absentNote.text: Ongekho kufundwa erejistheni yokuhlala lapho umsebenzi wabhalwa khona, hhayi ekuthunyweni, ngoba umfundi ongazange ahambele akanakho ukuthunyelwa okuyokurekhodwa kukho.
cohort.absentNote.from: Absent is read from the register of the sitting the work was written at, not from the submission, because a learner who did not attend has no submission for it to be recorded on.

cohort.workIntro.text: Okumele kwenzeke ezungeze ukufundisa: impahla ilungisiwe, amadokhumenti athunyelwe, kubekwe umlinganisi, kulandelwe izitifiketi.
cohort.workIntro.from: What has to happen around the teaching: material readied, documents submitted, a moderator appointed, certificates chased.

cohort.releaseIntro.text: Kugcinwa njengezinsuku kusukela osukwini lokuqala. Shintsha usuku lokuqala futhi zonke lezi zihamba nalo.
cohort.releaseIntro.from: Held as days from the start. Change the start date and every one of these moves with it.

cohort.noSteps.from: This cohort's {course} has no steps yet.

cohort.membersIntro.text: Ukwengeza umuntu lapha kumbhalisa futhi ku-{course}. Igama erejistheni lomuntu ongakwazi ukuvula lutho yisimo esiyingxenye lokhu okukugwema.
cohort.membersIntro.from: Adding somebody here also enrols them on the {course}. A name on a register who cannot open anything is the half-state this avoids.

cohortCtl.noSteps.text: Inkambo yeli qoqo ayinazinyathelo okwamanje, ngakho akukho okuhlelwa.
cohortCtl.noSteps.from: This cohort's course has no steps yet, so there is nothing to schedule.

cohortCtl.dayZero.text: Usuku 0 yisuku lokuqala. Shiya umugqa ungenalutho futhi lesi sinyathelo asinazo izinsuku nhlobo; sivuleka ngokushesha lapho konke okusandulele sekuqediwe.
cohortCtl.dayZero.from: Day 0 is the start date. Leave a row empty and that step carries no dates at all; it opens as soon as whatever comes before it is done.

cohortCtl.everybody.text: Wonke umuntu one-akhawunti yomfundi useyingxenye yeli qoqo. Mema abanye ekhasini Labantu kuqala.
cohortCtl.everybody.from: Everybody with a learner account is already on this cohort. Invite more people from the People screen first.

payment.referenceNote.text: Ukuze kufaniswe nalokho okugcinwa umnyango wezimali.
payment.referenceNote.from: So it can be matched to what finance holds.

tasks.progress.text: {done} ku-{counted} kwenziwe: {percent}%. Umsebenzi okhanseliwe awufakwa kuwo womabili amahhafu, ngakho ukulahla umsebenzi akusizi futhi akulimazi inani.
tasks.progress.from: {done} of {counted} done: {percent}%. Cancelled work is left out of both halves, so abandoning a task neither helps nor hurts the figure.

rollout.nothing.text: Akukahlelwa lutho. Lapho uhlelo lunamakhredithi, kumele lube ngaphansi kwesiqondiso somhlahlandlela, ngakho lapha yikho okuqala khona obufakazi bokuthi lwaluyilo.
rollout.nothing.from: Nothing scheduled yet. Where a programme carries credits it has to be facilitator-led, so this is where the evidence that it was begins.

rollout.announced.text: Iqoqo nomhlahlandlela batshelwa ngesikhathi ngasinye isonto ngaphambi kwaso, ngesikhathi saso nesixhumanisi, futhi batshelwa futhi uma sishintshwa, sikhanselwa noma sihlehlisiwe.
rollout.announced.from: The cohort and the facilitator are told about each session a week before it, with its time and link, and told again if it is moved, cancelled or postponed.

archive.intro.text: Uma umfundi esenesitatimende semiphumela futhi isitifiketi seziqu zakhe esivela enhlanganweni enikeza iziqu sesirekhodwe ekhasini lakhe lokulunga kwe-EISA, ifayela lakhe lobufakazi lingaphuma epulatifomu ku-archive eyodwa oyigcinayo. I-archive ivulwa kunoma iyiphi ibhrawuza ngaphandle kwepulatifomu. Akukho okususwayo kuze kube ikhophi yakho egciniwe isihloliwe ngayo, futhi wonke amarekhodi ahlala lapha, ethi iyiphi i-archive egcine amafayela.
archive.intro.from: Once a learner holds their statement of results and their qualification certificate from the awarding body has been recorded on their EISA readiness page, their Portfolio of Evidence can leave the platform in one archive that you keep. The archive opens in any browser without the platform. Nothing is removed until your stored copy has been checked against it, and every record stays here, saying which archive holds the files.

archive.readyFor.from: Holding a statement of results and the qualification certificate for {qualification}.

archive.noQualification.text: Inkambo yeli qoqo ayibaleli neziqu ezithile.
archive.noQualification.from: This cohort's course counts towards no qualification.

archive.anotherBuilding.text: Enye i-archive iyabhalwa. Qala elandelayo uma isiqedile.
archive.anotherBuilding.from: Another archive is being written. Start the next one when it has finished.

archive.notYetIntro.text: Bahlala epulatifomu futhi balandela ku-archive kamuva uma isitifiketi seziqu zabo sesirekhodiwe.
archive.notYetIntro.from: They stay on the platform and follow in a later archive once their own qualification certificate has been recorded.

archive.step1Note.text: Yigcine lapho inqubomgomo yakho yamarekhodi ithi amarekhodi abafundi agcinwa khona, isikhathi sonke sokugcinwa. Uma amafayela esesusiwe, leli yikhophi eyodwa ephelele.
archive.step1Note.from: Keep it where your records policy says learner records are kept, for the full retention period. Once the files are removed, this is the only complete copy.

archive.step3.from: 3. Remove the files from the platform

archive.building.from: Being written. This page updates by itself.

archive.checkNote.text: Khetha i-archive lapho uyigcine khona. Ifundwa kule khompyutha futhi ayilayishwa; kuthunyelwa isigxivizo sayo kuphela. I-archive inama-byte angu-{bytes}.
archive.checkNote.from: Choose the archive from where you stored it. It is read on this computer and not uploaded; only its fingerprint is sent. The archive is {bytes} bytes.

archive.stored.text: Ikhophi engiyihlolile igcinwe lapho inqubomgomo yethu yamarekhodi ithi kumele igcinwe khona.
archive.stored.from: The copy I checked is stored where our records policy says it should be kept.

archive.keepingOne.text: Idokhumenti e-1 yokubhalisa ihlala epulatifomu futhi, ngoba olunye uhlelo lomfundi lusayidinga.
archive.keepingOne.from: 1 enrolment document stays on the platform as well, because another programme of the learner's still needs it.

archive.keeping.text: Amadokhumenti angu-{count} okubhalisa ahlala epulatifomu futhi, ngoba olunye uhlelo lomfundi lusawadinga.
archive.keeping.from: {count} enrolment documents stay on the platform as well, because another programme of the learner's still needs them.

archive.wrongSize.text: Leli fayela linama-byte angu-{size} kanti i-archive inawo angu-{expected}. Akuyona le i-archive.
archive.wrongSize.from: That file is {size} bytes and the archive is {expected}. It is not this archive.

archive.pieceRefused.from: A piece of the upload was refused.

archive.carryOn.text: {problem} Khetha ifayela futhi ukuze uqhubeke lapho kumiswe khona.
archive.carryOn.from: {problem} Choose the file again to carry on from where it stopped.

archive.restoreNote.text: Kudingeka kuphela uma la mafayela kumele abe sepulatifomu futhi. I-archive iyalayishwa, ihlolwe ngokuqhathaniswa nesigxivizo esithathwe lapho yenziwa, futhi ifayela ngalinye libuyiselwa lapho lalikhona khona.
archive.restoreNote.from: Only needed if these files have to be on the platform again. The archive is uploaded, checked against the fingerprint taken when it was made, and each file is put back where it was.

register.supervisedIntro.text: Ukuthi ngubani owamukelwe, avumelana nani, nokuthi imibhalo yabo yemibuzo yamukelwe. Umhlangano uqhutshwa lapho kuqhutshwa khona izinkulumo zakho; lokhu yirekhodi lokuthi wagadwa kanjani.
register.supervisedIntro.from: Who was admitted, what they agreed to, and that their script was received. The meeting itself runs where your lectures do; this is the record of how it was supervised.

register.canInvigilate.text: Lesi yisikhathi sokuhlola okuphetha, ngakho singagadwa.
register.canInvigilate.from: This is a summative session, so it can be invigilated.

register.intro.text: Ukuthi ubani ubekhona. Amamaki agciniwe angalungiswa kamuva, futhi ushintsho ngalunye lurekhodwa ngokumelene nalowo olwenzile.
register.intro.from: Who was here. Saved marks can be corrected later, and every change is recorded against whoever made it.

register.nobody.text: Akekho umuntu kuleli qoqo okwamanje, ngakho akukho rejista ongayithatha.
register.nobody.from: Nobody is on this cohort yet, so there is no register to take.

register.excusedNote.text: Ukuxolelwa kusho ukungabikho ngenxa yesizathu esamukelwe umhlinzeki. Kugcinwa ngokwehlukile ekungabikhoni okumsulwa ngoba inqubo yokwesekwa komfundi incike kulokho kwehlukana.
register.excusedNote.from: Excused means absent for a reason the provider accepted. It is kept apart from a plain absence because the learner support procedure turns on the difference.

sitting.needsAssessment.text: Ukuhlala okugadiwe kudinga ukuhlola okuzogadwa. Shicilela eyodwa enkambweni kuqala, bese ingasethwa lapha.
sitting.needsAssessment.from: A supervised sitting needs an assessment to supervise. Publish one on the course first, and it can be set up here.

sitting.nothing.text: Akukho okugadwayo kulesi sikhathi. Setha okugadwayo uma lokhu kungukuhlola okugadwayo; kukunikeza isikhathi sokugcina sokwamukelwa, isimemezelo, ukuhlolwa kwekhamera, irejista yeskripthi nelogi yezigameko.
sitting.nothing.from: Nothing is being supervised at this session. Set one up if this is an invigilated assessment; it gives you an admission cut-off, a declaration, a camera check, a script register and an incident log.

sitting.invigilator.text: Umgadi wokuhlola (kukhethwa, futhi ungasethwa ngalolo suku)
sitting.invigilator.from: Invigilator (optional, and can be set on the day)

sitting.early.from: Candidates arrive this many minutes early

sitting.closesAfter.text: Ukwamukelwa kuvalwa ngemva kwale mizuzu emva kokuqala
sitting.closesAfter.from: Admission closes this many minutes after the start

sitting.camera.text: Ikhamera kumele ihlale ivuliwe ngalo lonke isikhathi
sitting.camera.from: A camera must be on throughout

sitting.materialsHint.text: Ikhalkhuleyitha engahleleki nephepha lamafomula elinikeziwe. Akukho okunye.
sitting.materialsHint.from: A non-programmable calculator and the issued formula sheet. Nothing else.

sitting.declaration.text: Lokho umhlolwa ngamunye avuma kukho ngaphambi kokuqala (kukhethwa)
sitting.declaration.from: What each candidate agrees to before starting (optional)

room.elsewhere.text: Lokho kungu-{time} {zone} lapho ukhona. Izikhathi ezirekhodwe lapha zingezomhlinzeki, yilokho irekhodi elikugcinayo.
room.elsewhere.from: That is {time} {zone} where you are. Times recorded here are the provider's, which is what the record keeps.

room.closesAt.text: Ukwamukelwa kuvalwa imizuzu engu-{minutes} ngemva kokuqala, ngo-{time}; ngemva kwalokho ipulatifomu iyenqaba, ngoba umuntu owamukelwe sekwedlule isikhathi useneminye imizuzu eminingi nephepha kunabanye bonke.
room.closesAt.from: Admission closes {minutes} minutes after the start, at {time}; after that the platform refuses, because somebody admitted late has had longer with the paper than everybody else.

room.closes.text: Ukwamukelwa kuvalwa imizuzu engu-{minutes} ngemva kokuqala; ngemva kwalokho ipulatifomu iyenqaba, ngoba umuntu owamukelwe sekwedlule isikhathi useneminye imizuzu eminingi nephepha kunabanye bonke.
room.closes.from: Admission closes {minutes} minutes after the start; after that the platform refuses, because somebody admitted late has had longer with the paper than everybody else.

room.cameras.text: Amakhamera ahlala evuliwe ngalo lonke isikhathi.

room.joinNote.text: Umhlangano uqhutshwa epulatifomu osuvele uyisebenzisa. Okurekhodwa lapha yindlela wagadwa ngayo.
room.joinNote.from: The meeting runs on the platform you already use. What is recorded here is how it was supervised.

room.noLink.text: Akukabikho sixhumanisi somhlangano kulesi sikhathi. Engeza esinye ekwethulweni ukuze abahlolwa bazi lapho beya khona.
room.noLink.from: No meeting link on this session yet. Add one on the roll-out so candidates know where to go.

room.incidentsNote.text: Zifayelwa ngalolo suku. Umlando obhalwe emavikini kamuva unenani elincane kakhulu esikhalweni, okuyindawo kuphela lapho ufundwa khona.
room.incidentsNote.from: Filed on the day. An account written weeks later is worth very little at an appeal, which is the only place it is ever read.

quals.intro.text: Iziqu zomsebenzi zifundiswa ngezinhlobo ezintathu zamamojuli: Ulwazi, Ikhono lokusebenza, kanye Nesipiliyoni sokusebenza. Imojuli ngayinye inemibandela yayo yokuhlola, futhi isistimu ihlola ukuthi okuqukethwe yinkambo kuhlanganisa yonke ngaphambi kokuba inkambo ishicilelwe.
