quals.intro.from: An occupational qualification is delivered across three kinds of module: Knowledge, Practical skill, and Workplace experience. Each module has its own assessment criteria, and the system checks that course content covers every one of them before a course can be published.

quals.folderTitle.from: Or build it from a folder

quals.folderIntro.text: Konke ngesikhathi esisodwa: ikharikhulamu, amayunithi okufunda, imihlahlandlela nezinqubomgomo. Ifolda equkethe isifinyezo sayo ingenisiwe ngemizuzwana; engenaso kumele kuqondwe isakhiwo sayo, futhi leyo yingxenye edinga isandiso se-AI.
quals.folderIntro.from: Everything at once: the curriculum, the study units, the guides and the policies. A folder that includes a summary of itself imports in seconds; one that does not has to have its structure worked out, and that is the part that needs an AI extension.

quals.folderLabel.from: The qualification's folder, from your own computer

quals.folderHint.text: Konke okusefolda nasezifolda zayo ezingaphansi kuyafundwa: ikharikhulamu, amayunithi okufunda, imihlahlandlela nezinqubomgomo.
quals.folderHint.from: Everything in the folder and its subfolders is read: the curriculum, the study units, the guides and the policies.

quals.folderHint2.text: Ifolda eyakhiwe yisistimu yakho yokuthuthukisa uhlelo iqukethe isifinyezo sayo, futhi lokho kufundwa ngqo, ngemizuzwana. Ifolda engenaso ayikwazi ukuqondwa isakhiwo sayo okwamanje.
quals.folderHint2.from: A folder built by your programme development system includes a summary of itself, and that is read directly, in seconds. A folder without one cannot have its structure worked out yet.

quals.driveTitle.from: Or from a drive you have connected

quals.driveIntro.text: Ifolda efanayo, ifundwa lapho isivele ikhona. Iphelela endaweni efanayo: isiphakamiso ongasihlola ngaphambi kokuba kubhalwe lutho.
quals.driveIntro.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

quals.noneManage.text: Yakha eyodwa ngamadokhumenti ayo (ithebhu engenhla): idokhumenti yekharikhulamu nedokhumenti yeziqu kwanele, futhi akukho sandiso se-AI esihilelekile. Konke okunye epulatifomu kuxhomeke kuziqu, ngakho lokhu yikho okuqala ukwenziwa.
quals.noneManage.from: Build one from its documents (the tab above): the curriculum document and the qualification document are enough, and no AI extension is involved. Everything else on the platform hangs off a qualification, so this is the first thing to do.

quals.noneRead.text: Azikalayishwa. Uma sezilayishiwe, ikharikhulamu ofundisayo futhi omaka ngayo izoba lapha: amamojuli ayo, izihloko zayo nemibandela ehlolwa ngayo ngayinye. Ukulayisha ngumsebenzi womphathi.
quals.noneRead.from: None has been loaded yet. When one has been, the curriculum you teach and mark against will be here: its modules, its topics and the criteria each one is assessed by. Loading one is an administrator's job.

how.title.from: How would you like to add it?

how.intro.text: Izindlela ezintathu zokungena. Khetha eyodwa futhi yona kuphela evulekayo; ungayivala futhi bese ukhetha okunye.
how.intro.from: Three ways in. Pick one and only that one opens; you can close it again and choose differently.

how.documents.summary.text: Idokhumenti yekharikhulamu, idokhumenti yeziqu ye-SAQA nencazelo yokuhlola. Isistimu ifunda yonke ikharikhulamu kuyo.
how.documents.summary.from: The curriculum document, the SAQA qualification document and the assessment specification. The App reads the whole curriculum out of them.

how.documents.needs.text: Ama-PDF noma amafayela e-Word amabili noma amathathu.
how.documents.needs.from: Two or three PDFs or Word files.

how.documents.speed.text: Imizuzwana. Akukho AI ngaso sonke isikhathi.
how.documents.speed.from: Seconds. No AI involved at any point.

how.folder.summary.text: Konke ngesikhathi esisodwa: ikharikhulamu, amayunithi okufunda, imihlahlandlela, amabhuku omsebenzi nezinqubomgomo, kufayelwa njengoba kufundwa.
how.folder.summary.from: Everything at once: the curriculum, the study units, the guides, the workbooks and the policies, filed as they are read.

how.folder.needs.text: Yonke ifolda yeziqu, evela kukhompyutha yakho noma kudrayivu.
how.folder.needs.from: The qualification's whole folder, from your computer or a drive.

how.folder.speed.text: Imizuzu. Ifolda equkethe isifinyezo sayo ayidingi AI; engenaso iyaqondwa isakhiwo sayo, futhi leyo ngxenye idinga.
how.folder.speed.from: Minutes. A folder that includes a summary of itself needs no AI; one that does not has its structure worked out, and that part does.

how.blank.summary.text: Iziqu ezingenalutho ozakha ngesandla: isihloko, ikhodi, izinga namakhredithi, bese amamojuli ayo eyodwa ngesikhathi.
how.blank.summary.from: An empty qualification you build by hand: the title, the code, the level and credits, then its modules one at a time.

how.blank.needs.from: The details in front of you.

how.blank.speed.text: Kuze kuthathe isikhathi esidingekayo. Akukho okufundelwa wena.
how.blank.speed.from: As long as it takes. Nothing is read for you.

manager.drawnFrom.from: drawn from {parent}, whose curriculum it shares

manager.standsAlone.from: standing on its own, with its own curriculum

manager.noneFromParent.text: Awekho amamojuli akhethwe ekharikhulamu yeziqu eziyinhloko okwamanje.
manager.noneFromParent.from: No modules chosen from the parent's curriculum yet.

manager.choose.text: Khetha ukuthi yiwaphi amamojuli eziqu eziyinhloko eziwathathayo
manager.choose.from: Choose which of the parent's modules this takes

manager.chooseNote.text: Amamojuli awengezwa lapha. Lokhu kuthatha ekharikhulamu yeziqu eziyinhloko, ngakho umsebenzi womfundi ngokumelene nemojuli ubalwa kanye noma ngabe ubhekane nayo kuphi.
manager.chooseNote.from: Modules are not added here. This draws from its parent's curriculum, so a learner's work against a module counts once wherever they met it.

manager.whichNote.text: Idokhumenti ye-SAQA isho ukuthi yiluphi. Bheka {field} ekhasini layo lokuqala.
manager.whichNote.from: The SAQA document says which. Look for {field} on its first page.

manager.standsOnOwn.from: Nothing: it stands on its own

manager.fullOwn.from: A full qualification carries its own curriculum.

manager.sharesNote.text: Zihlanganyela ikharikhulamu yalezo ziqu futhi zithatha ingxenye yamamojuli azo; wena ukhetha ukuthi yiwaphi, uma sezikhona.
manager.sharesNote.from: It shares that qualification's curriculum and takes a subset of its modules; you choose which, once it exists.

manager.codeFull.text: Njengoba ibhalwe kudokhumenti yekharikhulamu. Ayibalwa: yi-QCTO noma i-OFO kuphela engasho ukuthi iyini.
manager.codeFull.from: As written on the curriculum document. Never worked out: only the QCTO or the OFO can say what it is.

manager.codePart.text: Ikhodi efanayo neyeziqu ezithathwa kuzo. Zihlanganyela ikharikhulamu eyodwa, ngakho zihlanganyela ikhodi yayo.
manager.codePart.from: The same code as the qualification it comes from. They share one curriculum, so they share its code.

manager.accreditationNote.text: Inombolo lapho lezi ziqu zigunyazwe ngayo. Incwadi eyodwa yokugunyazwa ivame ukuhlanganisa iziqu eziningana, ngakho lokhu akuhlali kufana nenombolo yomhlinzeki uqobo. Uma uyishiya ingenalutho, imibiko ibuyela kweyomhlinzeki futhi ikusho.
manager.accreditationNote.from: The number this qualification is accredited under. One accreditation letter usually covers several qualifications, so this is not always the same as the provider's own number. Leave it blank and reports fall back to the provider's and say so.

fromDoc.source.curriculum.note.from: The modules, topics and internal assessment criteria.

fromDoc.source.qualification.note.text: Isicashunwa sokubhalisa se-SAQA. Ngumthombo owodwa kuphela we-SAQA ID kanye Nemiphumela Yezinga Lokuphuma.
fromDoc.source.qualification.note.from: The SAQA registration extract. The only source of the SAQA ID and the Exit Level Outcomes.

fromDoc.source.assessmentSpecification.n.text: Incazelo ye-EISA. Ifayelwe futhi ifakwe inkomba ukuze ikwazi ukusesha.
fromDoc.source.assessmentSpecification.n.from: The EISA specification. Filed and indexed so it is searchable.

fromDoc.intro.text: Lezi ezintathu ziyisisekelo sakho konke okunye. Zilayishe futhi isistimu ifunda imininingwane yeziqu, Imiphumela Yezinga Lokuphuma nayo yonke ikharikhulamu kuzo. Hlola okutholile, lungisa noma yini eyiphosile, futhi kubhalwa konke ngesikhathi sinye.
fromDoc.intro.from: These three are the foundation everything else is built on. Upload them and the App reads the qualification's details, its Exit Level Outcomes and its whole curriculum out of them. Check what it found, correct anything it got wrong, and it is written in one go.

fromDoc.pressThis.from: Now press this. Nothing is written yet.

fromDoc.stillReading.text: Isafunda: imizuzwana engu-{seconds}. Idokhumenti yekharikhulamu inde; lokhu kuvamile.
fromDoc.stillReading.from: Still reading: {seconds} seconds. A curriculum document is long; this is normal.

fromDoc.found.text: Kufundwe amamojuli angu-{modules}, izihloko ezingu-{topics}, imigqa engu-{elements} yokufundisa nemibandela yokuhlola engu-{criteria}.
fromDoc.found.from: Read {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} assessment criteria.

fromDoc.foundWithElo.text: Kufundwe amamojuli angu-{modules}, izihloko ezingu-{topics}, imigqa engu-{elements} yokufundisa nemibandela yokuhlola engu-{criteria}, kanye Nemiphumela Yezinga Lokuphuma engu-{outcomes} enemibandela ehlobene engu-{associated}.
fromDoc.foundWithElo.from: Read {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} assessment criteria, plus {outcomes} Exit Level Outcomes with {associated} associated criteria.

fromDoc.partOf.text: Idokhumenti yayo ithi lokhu kunjena: {kind}, kuthathwe ku-{parent}. Akukho okuzokopishwa: kuhlanganyela ikharikhulamu yeziqu ezithathwa kuzo, futhi kuthatha amamojuli angu-{count} awo.
fromDoc.partOf.from: Its document says this is a {kind} drawn from {parent}. Nothing will be copied: it shares that qualification's curriculum, and takes {count} of its modules.

fromDoc.alreadyWhy.text: Ukungenisa ikharikhulamu futhi kuzosikhipha leyo esinayo, futhi noma yini ehlukaniswe nombandela izohamba nayo. Okungenzeka ukuthi ufuna ukwengeza okushodayo (izinto zokufunda, noma izingxenye zekharikhulamu ezingazange zingene), okwenziwa kuziqu uqobo futhi kuyeka konke okusevele kukhona kungathintwa.
fromDoc.alreadyWhy.from: Importing the curriculum again would replace the one it has, and anything tagged to a criterion would go with it. What you probably want is to add what is missing (the material, or the parts of the curriculum that never made it), which is done on the qualification itself and leaves everything already there untouched.

fromDoc.openIt.from: Open it, and add what is missing

fromDoc.createPart.from: Create it, drawing on its parent's curriculum

fromDoc.filedPart.text: Idokhumenti Yeziqu yayo ifayelwe kuyo. Idokhumenti yekharikhulamu nencazelo yokuhlola akufayelwe: kungezeziqu ezithathwa kuzo, futhi sekufayelwe lapho kakade.
fromDoc.filedPart.from: Its own Qualification Document is filed against it. The curriculum document and the assessment specification are not: they belong to the qualification it comes from, and are already filed there.

fromDoc.filed.text: Wonke amadokhumenti owanikezile afayelwa kuziqu, ukuze umlinganisi akwazi ukuvula umthombo wanoma yimuphi umbandela, nokuze isango lokulunga lanelise ngaphambi kokuba kubhalwe izinto zokufunda.
fromDoc.filed.from: Every document you supplied is filed against the qualification, so a moderator can open the source of any criterion, and so the readiness gate is satisfied before material is authored.

qualPage.step.curriculumDone.text: Amamojuli angu-{modules}, imibandela yokuhlola engu-{criteria}, ifundwe emadokhumentini eziqu uqobo.
qualPage.step.curriculumDone.from: {modules} modules, {criteria} assessment criteria, read from the qualification's own documents.

qualPage.step.curriculumTodo.text: Akukho okungafundiswa noma kuhlolwe lapha kuze kubekhona amamojuli ayo.
qualPage.step.curriculumTodo.from: Nothing here can be taught or assessed until its modules exist.

qualPage.step.unitsDone.text: Amayunithi angu-{count}, imojuli ngayinye ifakwe kwelilodwa.
qualPage.step.unitsDone.from: {count} units, with every module placed in one.

qualPage.step.unitsNone.text: Ikharikhulamu ishicilela amamojuli futhi ayisho lutho ngokuthi uwahlanganisa kanjani, ngakho lokhu kungukunquma kwakho. Idokhumenti yakho yokuqondanisa ikwenza konke ngokulayisha kanye: i-Word noma i-Excel.
qualPage.step.unitsNone.from: The curriculum publishes modules and says nothing about how you group them, so this is yours to decide. Your alignment document does it in one upload: Word or Excel.

qualPage.step.unitsSomeOne.text: Imojuli e-1 ayikho kuyunithi ethile okwamanje. Imojuli engafundiswa yiyunithi yokufunda yimojuli okungekho muntu ozoyifundisa.
qualPage.step.unitsSomeOne.from: 1 module belongs to no unit yet. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches.

qualPage.step.unitsSome.text: Amamojuli angu-{count} awekho kuyunithi ethile okwamanje. Imojuli engafundiswa yiyunithi yokufunda yimojuli okungekho muntu ozoyifundisa.
qualPage.step.unitsSome.from: {count} modules belong to no unit yet. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches.

qualPage.step.materialDone.text: Kufayelwe imihlahlandlela yethiyori, amabhuku omsebenzi nokuhlola okungu-{count}.
qualPage.step.materialDone.from: {count} theory guides, workbooks and assessments filed.

qualPage.step.materialTodo.text: Imihlahlandlela yethiyori, amabhuku omsebenzi nokuhlola. Yonke ifolda ingena ngesikhathi esisodwa, imihlahlandlela yezimpendulo iyaziwa futhi ifihlwe abafundi, futhi akukho AI ngaso sonke isikhathi.
qualPage.step.materialTodo.from: The theory guides, workbooks and assessments. The whole folder goes in at once, answer guides are recognised and withheld from learners, and no AI is involved at any point.

qualPage.step.captureDone.text: Konke okungu-{count} kufakiwe. Abafundi bangakuphendula esikrinini.
qualPage.step.captureDone.from: All {count} captured. Learners can answer them on screen.

qualPage.step.captureTodo.text: {captured} ku-{total} kufakiwe. Okunye amafayela umfundi angawalanda kuphela.
qualPage.step.captureTodo.from: {captured} of {total} captured. The rest are files a learner can only download.

qualPage.summary.text: Amamojuli angu-{modules} · imibandela yokuhlola yangaphakathi engu-{criteria} · {weighting}

qualPage.weighted.from: weighted {k}/{p}/{w} as stated in the document

qualPage.notWeighted.text: akukho ukukalwa kwezingxenye okushiwo; ukulunga kutholwa emakhredithini
qualPage.notWeighted.from: no component weighting stated; readiness derives it from credits

qualPage.partOf.text: Ingxenye yeziqu ethathwe ku-{parent}, ehlanganyela ikharikhulamu yayo. Akukho okukopishwayo, ngakho umsebenzi womfundi ngokumelene nemojuli ubalwa kanye noma ngabe ubhekane nayo kuphi.
qualPage.partOf.from: A part qualification drawn from {parent}, whose curriculum it shares. Nothing is copied, so a learner's work against a module counts once wherever they met it.

qualPage.chooseModules.text: Khetha ukuthi yiwaphi amamojuli lokhu okuwathatha

qualPage.addIntro.text: Konke okufaka okuthile. Okusevele kukhona lapha kusethebhu enye.
qualPage.addIntro.from: Everything that puts something in. What is already here is on the other tab.

qualPage.finish.from: Finish this qualification from a fuller folder

qualPage.finishLabel.text: Ifolda eqediwe yeziqu, evela kukhompyutha yakho
qualPage.finishLabel.from: The completed folder for this qualification, from your own computer

qualPage.finishHint.text: Yeziqu ezalayishwa ngaphambi kokuba amadokhumenti azo aphelele. Yonke ifolda iyafundwa futhi (ikharikhulamu nezinto zokufunda) futhi kwengezwa kuphela okushodayo.
qualPage.finishHint.from: For a qualification that was loaded before its documents were complete. The whole folder is read again (the curriculum as well as the material) and only what is missing is added.

qualPage.finishHint2.text: Akukho okusevele kukhona okuguqulwayo noma okushintshelwayo, ngisho negama elilodwa lombandela, futhi ukuyisebenzisa kabili akwenzi lutho okwesibili. Usabona konke okutholile futhi uyakuqinisekisa ngaphambi kokuba kubhalwe noma yikuphi.
qualPage.finishHint2.from: Nothing already here is changed or replaced, down to the wording of a single criterion, and running it twice does nothing the second time. You still see everything it found and confirm it before any of it is written.

qualPage.finishDrive.text: Noma ifolda eqediwe evela kudrayivu oxhumeke kuyo. Iyagcwaliswa ngendlela efanayo: kwengezwa kuphela okushodayo.
qualPage.finishDrive.from: Or the completed folder from a drive you have connected. It tops up the same way: only what is missing is added.

qualPage.materialHere.text: Izinto zokufunda zifakwa lapha: yonke ifolda ngesikhathi esisodwa. Akukho okugciniwe kuze kube usubone lokho okutholile.
qualPage.materialHere.from: The material goes here: the whole folder at once. Nothing is saved until you have seen what it found.

qualPage.materialLabel.text: Ifolda yezinto zokufunda, evela kukhompyutha yakho
qualPage.materialLabel.from: A folder of material, from your own computer

qualPage.materialHint.text: Imihlahlandlela yethiyori namabhuku omsebenzi kuya kuyunithi yokufunda ebizwa negama lefayela lawo, izinqubomgomo nezivumelwano ziye elabhulari yamadokhumenti, futhi konke okunye kuya kuziqu. Akusetshenziswa AI lapha nhlobo: ukuhlela amadokhumenti ngegama kuyisimiso hhayi isahlulelo.
qualPage.materialHint.from: Theory guides and workbooks go to the study unit their filename names, policies and contracts to the document library, and everything else against this qualification. No AI is used here at all: sorting documents by name is a rule rather than a judgement.

qualPage.whereItLives.from: Or the folder where it already lives

qualPage.alignmentHere.text: Idokhumenti yakho yokuqondanisa ifakwa lapha: yikhethe, setha uhlobo lwayo ku-Imatrikhi Yokuqondanisa Ikharikhulamu, bese uyilayisha. Lokho kwakha amayunithi okufunda.
qualPage.alignmentHere.from: Your alignment document goes here: choose it, set its kind to Curriculum Alignment Matrix, and upload. That builds the study units.

qualPage.blueprintIntro.text: Ifayela elichaza le kharikhulamu ngokunembile: amamojuli angu-{count}, nezihloko zawo, lokho ngalinye elikufundisayo nalokho ngalinye elihlolwa ngakho. Lifake kudayirekthri {folder} yefolda yeziqu futhi konke ukungeniswa kwefolda ngemva kwalokho kuzolifunda ngqo, ngemizuzwana, kungekho sandiso se-AI ngaso sonke isikhathi.
qualPage.blueprintIntro.from: A file describing this curriculum exactly: {count} modules, with their topics, what each teaches and what each is assessed by. Put it in the qualification folder's {folder} directory and every import of that folder afterwards reads it straight off, in seconds, with no AI extension involved at any point.

qualPage.notCarried.from: What the file does not carry

qualPage.notCaptured.text: Amamojuli angu-{count} ku-{total} awanayo imibandela okwamanje.
qualPage.notCaptured.from: {count} of {total} modules have no criteria yet.

qualPage.notCapturedWhy.text: Akekho ongamenyezelwa ukuthi ulungele i-EISA ngokumelene nalezi ziqu uze uthi yonke idokhumenti yekharikhulamu ibhalwe ngokuphelele; imojuli engenambandela ayikwazi ukwehluleka, ngakho ukuyishiya ingenalutho kungenza wonke umfundi abonakale eqedile.
qualPage.notCapturedWhy.from: Nobody can be declared ready for the EISA against this qualification until the whole curriculum document has been transcribed; a module with no criteria cannot be failed, so leaving them empty would make every learner look finished.

qualPage.structureIntro.text: Ikharikhulamu ishicilela amamojuli; umhlinzeki ufundisa amayunithi okufunda. Ngayinye ihlanganisa amamojuli olwazi, ekhono lokusebenza nesipiliyoni sokusebenza asebenzela Umphumela Owodwa Wezinga Lokuphuma, okuwuyo Ukuhlola Okuphetha Okuhlanganisiwe Kwangaphandle okusethelwe wona. Abahlinzeki ababili bangahlanganisa iziqu ezifanayo ngokuhlukile futhi bobabili balungile, ngakho lesi yisakhiwo somhlinzeki hhayi sekharikhulamu.
qualPage.structureIntro.from: The curriculum publishes modules; a provider teaches study units. Each bundles the Knowledge, Practical and Work Experience modules that serve one Exit Level Outcome, which is what the External Integrated Summative Assessment is set against. Two providers may group the same qualification differently and both be correct, so this is the provider's structure rather than the curriculum's.

qualPage.seeAsLearner.from: See it as a learner will

qualPage.seeAsLearnerNote.text: ibonisa uhlelo lonke ngokulandelana elihanjwa ngalo, kanye nanoma yini umfundi angeke ayithole ibizwe ngegama. Akukho okuqalwayo futhi akukho okurekhodwayo.
qualPage.seeAsLearnerNote.from: shows the whole programme in the order it is walked, with anything a learner would not find named. Nothing is started and nothing is recorded.

qualPage.nextStep.text: Isinyathelo esilandelayo: hlanganisa la mamojuli emayunithini okufunda.
qualPage.nextStep.from: The next step: group these modules into study units.

qualPage.nextStepWhy.text: Ikharikhulamu ishicilela amamojuli futhi ayisho lutho ngamayunithi okufunda, ngoba ukuwahlanganisa kuwumnqumo womhlinzeki uqobo, ngakho iziqu ezifundwe emadokhumentini azo ziza namamojuli azo wonke angu-{count} engabekiwe. Lokho kulindelekile, akulona iphutha ekungeniseni.
qualPage.nextStepWhy.from: The curriculum publishes modules and says nothing about study units, because grouping them is the provider's own decision, so a qualification read from its documents arrives with all {count} of its modules unplaced. That is expected, not a fault in the import.

qualPage.nextStepHow.text: Layisha idokhumenti yakho yokuqondanisa: leyo ehlobanisa Umphumela Ngamunye Wezinga Lokuphuma namamojuli awo, ku-Word noma ku-Excel. Idala amayunithi okufunda, iwaqambe, futhi ibeke wonke amamojuli ewahlanganisayo.
qualPage.nextStepHow.from: Upload your alignment document: the one mapping each Exit Level Outcome to its modules, in Word or Excel. It creates the study units, names them, and places every module it covers.

qualPage.unplacedOne.from: 1 module belongs to no study unit.

qualPage.unplaced.from: {count} modules belong to no study unit.

qualPage.unplacedWhy.text: {modules}. Imojuli engafundiswa yiyunithi yokufunda yimojuli okungekho muntu ozoyifundisa, noma ikharikhulamu yayo ithathwe ngokuphelele kangakanani.
qualPage.unplacedWhy.from: {modules}. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches, however completely its curriculum has been captured.

qualPage.noElo.from: Aligned to no Exit Level Outcome

qualPage.eisaTests.text: Imibandela yokuhlola ehlobene: lokho i-EISA ekuhlolayo
qualPage.eisaTests.from: Associated assessment criteria: what the EISA tests

qualPage.noModules.from: This study unit delivers no modules.

qualPage.documentsIntro.text: Okufayelwe lapha yikhophi ezigunyaziwe: amadokhumenti omthombo owakhe ngawo lezi ziqu, ngalinye linamathiselwe engxenyeni yekharikhulamu elisebenzelayo futhi linesigxivizo ukuze kukwazi ukufakazelwa ukuthi alishintshiwe.
qualPage.documentsIntro.from: Filed here are the authoritative copies: the source documents this qualification is built from, each attached to the part of the curriculum it serves and hashed so it can be proved unchanged.

qualPage.recordNotThing.text: Incwadi yomsebenzi noma ukuhlola okufayelwe lapha kuyirekhodi, hhayi lokho umfundi asebenza kukho.
qualPage.recordNotThing.from: A workbook or an assessment filed here is a record, not the thing a learner works on.

qualPage.recordWhy.text: Lokho kufundwa futhi kuboniswe esikrinini, ukuze umfundi aphendule epulatifomu futhi umhlahlandlela amake futhi anikeze amazwana khona. Layisha idokhumenti ye-Word ngaphansi kwe-Faka kunokuba ulayishe lapha, futhi iba yimibuzo uqobo. Izincwadi zomfundi, imihlahlandlela namashidi okusayina asemsebenzini kuhlukile: ahlala njengamadokhumenti, ngoba umhlahlandlela ubhala kuwo futhi umqeqeshi uwasayina ephepheni.
qualPage.recordWhy.from: Those are read in and presented on screen, so a learner answers in the platform and a facilitator marks and comments there. Upload the Word document under Capture rather than here, and it becomes the questions themselves. Handbooks, guides and workplace sign-off sheets are different: they stay as documents, because a facilitator annotates them and a coach signs them on paper.

qualPage.notTranscribed.from: Not yet transcribed from the curriculum document.

qualPage.iac.from: Internal assessment criteria: what must be achieved

qualPage.workplaceNone.text: Ayikho imibandela yokuhlola, okulungile esipiliyonini sokusebenza: siboniswa irekhodi elisayiniwe lomsebenzi hhayi ngokwahlulelwa ngemibandela.
qualPage.workplaceNone.from: No assessment criteria, which is right for work experience: it is proved by a signed record of the work rather than judged against criteria.

qualPage.neverAchieved.text: Ayikho imibandela yokuhlola, ngakho lesi sihloko asikwazi ukufinyelelwa nanini.
qualPage.neverAchieved.from: No assessment criteria, so this topic can never be achieved.

removeQual.cannotWhy.text: Kukhona okurekhodwe ngokumelene nazo, futhi ipulatifomu iyakugcina. Yilokho ukucwaningwa kwe-QCTO okubuza ngakho, futhi kuhlala ngaphezu kweziqu ezirekhodwe ngaphansi kwazo.
removeQual.cannotWhy.from: Things have been recorded against it, and the platform keeps them. They are what a QCTO audit asks about, and they outlive the qualification they were recorded under.

removeQual.canWhy.text: Akukho okurekhodwe ngokumelene nazo (akukho mfundi obhalisiwe, akukho kuhlala okubhalisiwe futhi akukhishwanga Isitatimende Semiphumela) ngakho zingasuswa. Lokhu akukwazi ukuphindiswa.
removeQual.canWhy.from: Nothing has been recorded against it (no learner is enrolled, no sitting is registered and no Statement of Results has been issued) so it can be removed. This cannot be undone.

removeQual.wouldTake.text: Kuzohamba no-{items}, kanye nesihloko ngasinye, isici, umbandela nedokhumenti efayelwe engaphansi kwakho konke.
removeQual.wouldTake.from: It would take {items} with it, along with every topic, element, criterion and filed document beneath them.

captureList.intro.text: Lokhu sekusepulatifomu kakade. Ukukufaka kufunda imibuzo yako efayelweni le-Word futhi kuhambisane nomhlahlandlela wezimpendulo ofayelwe eceleni kwalo; akukho okulayishwa futhi. Lokho okuphakanyiswayo kuboniswa kuwe ngaphambi kokuba noma yikuphi kube ukuhlola.
captureList.intro.from: These are already in the platform. Capturing one reads its questions out of the Word file and pairs the answer guide filed beside it; nothing is uploaded again. What it proposes is shown to you before any of it becomes an assessment.

captureList.all.text: Konke okungu-{count} kufakiwe. Abafundi bangakuphendula lokhu esikrinini.
captureList.all.from: All {count} captured. Learners can answer these on screen.

captureList.noGuide.text: akukho mhlahlandlela wezimpendulo ofayelwe: umbuzo ngamunye ubuzodinga impendulo yawo namamaki ngesandla
captureList.noGuide.from: no answer guide filed: every question would need its answer and marks by hand

uploader.kindNote.text: Imatrikhi yokuqondanisa ikharikhulamu ifundwa futhi igcinwe: lokho ekushoyo ngomugqa ngamunye wekharikhulamu kuyarekhodwa.
uploader.kindNote.from: A curriculum alignment matrix is read as well as stored: what it says about each curriculum line is recorded.

uploader.titleHint.text: Uma kushiywe kungenalutho, kusetshenziswa igama lefayela
uploader.titleHint.from: Left blank, the file name is used

uploader.versionNote.text: Ukulayisha futhi ngohlobo nesihloko esifanayo kubeka inguqulo entsha ngaphezu kwangaphambili kunokuyilahla; inguqulo endala iyahlala.
uploader.versionNote.from: Uploading again with the same kind and title supersedes the previous one rather than replacing it; the old version stays.

uploader.fileNote.text: I-Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint ne-PDF. Ukuthi ifayela liyini empeleni kuvela okuqukethwe kulo, hhayi egameni lalo.
uploader.fileNote.from: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF. What the file actually is comes from its contents, not its name.

uploader.inMatrix.from: In the matrix, not in the curriculum as held

uploader.inMatrixNote.text: Ngayinye ingezwa iphawulwe njengeyakho, nesizathu siboniswe, ukuze umqinisekisi akwazi ukwahlukanisa imigqa yakho neyomlawuli. Susa uphawu kunoma yini okungafanele ingezwe.
uploader.inMatrixNote.from: Each is added marked as your own, with the reason shown, so a verifier can always tell your lines from the regulator's. Untick anything that should not be added.

uploader.add.from: Add the ticked lines to the curriculum

buildCurr.intro.text: Yifake njengoba idokhumenti yekharikhulamu iyishicilela, ngamakhodi afanayo ngokulandelana okufanayo, ukuze kufundwe zombili eceleni komunye. Umugqa ngamunye ugcinwa njengoba uwufaka.
buildCurr.intro.from: Enter it as the curriculum document prints it, with the same codes in the same order, so the two can be read side by side. Every line saves as you enter it.

buildCurr.ready.text: Kulungele izinto zokufunda. Amamojuli angu-{modules} nemibandela engu-{criteria} isifakiwe, ngakho umbuzo ungaphawulwa kulokho okufakazelayo.
buildCurr.ready.from: Ready for material. {modules} modules and {criteria} criteria are in, so a question can be tagged to what it evidences.

buildCurr.whatItIsNote.text: Kusethwe ngesikhathi zingeniswa, futhi kungalungiswa lapha. Iziqu ezigcwele zinekharikhulamu yazo; iziqu eziyingxenye noma uhlelo lwamakhono kukhetha amamojuli kwelinye.
buildCurr.whatItIsNote.from: Set when it was imported, and correctable here. A full qualification has its own curriculum; a part or a skills programme selects modules from one.

buildCurr.faultsNote.text: Akukuvimbeli ukuqhubeka: ungahamba ubuye. Kodwa ngakunye kwalokhu kuyinto ipulatifomu engeke ikwazi ukuyigwema kamuva.
buildCurr.faultsNote.from: Not a gate: you can leave and come back. Each of these, though, is something the platform cannot work around later.

addModule.note.text: Imojuli yesipiliyoni sokusebenza ifakazelwa yibhuku lokurekhoda umqeqeshi alisayinayo, hhayi yimibandela yokuhlola, ngakho ithatha imisebenzi yasemsebenzini.
addModule.note.from: A work experience module is evidenced by a logbook a coach signs, not by assessment criteria, so it takes work activities instead.

addModule.nameHint.from: As the curriculum document titles it

editor.addElement.from: Add a line of what must be taught

editor.wordedHint.from: As the curriculum document words it

editor.noCriteria.text: Imojuli yesipiliyoni sokusebenza ayinayo. Ifakazelwa yibhuku lokurekhoda umqeqeshi alisayinayo futhi umhloli alamukele, ngakho imisebenzi yayo yasemsebenzini ifakwa ezihlokweni ezingenhla.
editor.noCriteria.from: A work experience module carries none. It is evidenced by a logbook the coach signs and an assessor accepts, so its work activities go in the topics above.

reclassify.lockedOne.text: Ayikwazi ukushintshwa: umfundi o-1 ubhalisiwe kuyo. Ukubhalisa kuba ngokwe-ID yohlelo ngalunye, futhi ukushintsha ukuthi lokhu kuyini kungashintsha ukuthi bahlolwa ngamaphi amamojuli, ngakho nokuthi kumele benzeni ukuze baqede. Uma ngempela kuyinto engafanele, dala efanele bese ubabhalisa kuyo.
reclassify.lockedOne.from: It cannot be changed: 1 learner is enrolled on it. Enrolment is per programme ID, and changing what this is would change which modules they are assessed against, and so what they have to do to finish. If it is genuinely the wrong sort of thing, create the right one and enrol them onto that.

reclassify.locked.text: Ayikwazi ukushintshwa: abafundi abangu-{count} babhalisiwe kuyo. Ukubhalisa kuba ngokwe-ID yohlelo ngalunye, futhi ukushintsha ukuthi lokhu kuyini kungashintsha ukuthi bahlolwa ngamaphi amamojuli, ngakho nokuthi kumele benzeni ukuze baqede. Uma ngempela kuyinto engafanele, dala efanele bese ubabhalisa kuyo.
reclassify.locked.from: It cannot be changed: {count} learners are enrolled on it. Enrolment is per programme ID, and changing what this is would change which modules they are assessed against, and so what they have to do to finish. If it is genuinely the wrong sort of thing, create the right one and enrol them onto that.

reclassify.parentNote.text: Iziqu eziyingxenye azinayo idokhumenti yekharikhulamu yazo: zisebenzisa eyeziqu eziyinhloko, futhi zikhetha amamojuli kuyo.
reclassify.parentNote.from: A part has no curriculum document of its own: it uses its parent's, and selects modules from it.

reclassify.ownModulesOne.text: Lezi ziqu zinemojuli e-1 yekharikhulamu yazo, kusukela zingeniswa. Ihlala lapho ikhona: ukuyirekhoda njengengxenye akuyisusi, futhi ukhetha ngokwehlukile ukuthi iziqu eziyinhloko zikhetha amaphi amamojuli.
reclassify.ownModulesOne.from: This qualification has 1 module of its own curriculum, from when it was imported. It stays where it is: recording it as a part does not delete it, and you choose separately which of the parent's modules it selects.

reclassify.ownModules.text: Lezi ziqu zinamamojuli angu-{count} ekharikhulamu yazo, kusukela zingeniswa. Ahlala lapho akhona: ukuyirekhoda njengengxenye akuwasusi, futhi ukhetha ngokwehlukile ukuthi iziqu eziyinhloko zikhetha amaphi amamojuli.
reclassify.ownModules.from: This qualification has {count} modules of its own curriculum, from when it was imported. Those stay where they are: recording it as a part does not delete them, and you choose separately which of the parent's modules it selects.

reclassify.selectedOne.text: Imojuli e-1 ekhethwe kweziyinhloko izosulwa. Iziqu ezigcwele azikhethi lutho kunoma ubani, futhi ukuyishiya kungaqhubeka ukuyibala kumakhredithi azo.
reclassify.selectedOne.from: The 1 module selected from its parent will be cleared. A full qualification selects nothing from anybody, and leaving it would keep it counting towards its credits.

reclassify.selected.text: Amamojuli angu-{count} akhethwe kweziyinhloko azosulwa. Iziqu ezigcwele azikhethi lutho kunoma ubani, futhi ukuwashiya kungaqhubeka ukuwabala kumakhredithi azo.
reclassify.selected.from: The {count} modules selected from its parent will be cleared. A full qualification selects nothing from anybody, and leaving them would keep them counting towards its credits.

takeDoc.readFrom.text: Kufundwe ku-{file}. Akukho okungezwe ngezansi okwamanje: vula imojuli, uyiqhathanise nedokhumenti, bese uyithatha uma ilungile.
takeDoc.readFrom.from: Read from {file}. Nothing below has been added yet: open a module, check it against the document, and take it if it is right.

takeDoc.goToDocuments.from: Go to the documents for this qualification

takeDoc.notesNote.text: Lokho ukufunda okungakwazanga ukukubala, nalokho idokhumenti uqobo lwayo elingahlangani. Akukho kokubili okukuvimbela ukuthatha imojuli, kodwa kokubili kufanele kufundwe kuqala.
takeDoc.notesNote.from: What the reading could not account for, and what the document itself does not add up. Neither stops you taking a module, though both are worth reading first.

takeDoc.addedCounts.text: Kungeziwe izihloko ezingu-{topics}, imigqa engu-{elements} yokufundisa nemibandela engu-{criteria}.
takeDoc.addedCounts.from: Added {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} criteria.

takeDoc.byHand.from: Add these by hand on the curriculum screen.

takeDoc.empty.text: Akukho okufundwe ngaphansi kwale mojuli. Ukuyithatha kuzodala imojuli kuphela, futhi izihloko zayo zingengezwa ngesandla.
takeDoc.empty.from: Nothing was read under this module. Taking it will create the module alone, and its topics can be added by hand.

element.asWorded.text: {kind}, njengoba idokhumenti yekharikhulamu iyibhala. Akukho okungahlelwa kule khasi: ikharikhulamu eshicilelwe ingeye-QCTO, hhayi eyomhlinzeki.
element.asWorded.from: {kind}, exactly as the curriculum document words it. Nothing on this page may be edited here: a published curriculum is the QCTO's, not the provider's.

element.coversNote.text: Kusuka kuMatrikhi Yokuqondanisa Ikharikhulamu, njengoba umhlinzeki ayibhala lapho.
element.coversNote.from: From the Curriculum Alignment Matrix, as the provider wrote it there.

element.uncovered.from: Nothing is recorded as covering this line.

element.uncoveredNote.text: Lokho kungaba isikhala sangempela ohlelweni noma imatrikhi engakalayishwa. Layisha Imatrikhi Yokuqondanisa Ikharikhulamu ngokumelene nalezi ziqu bese yonke imigqa ekhonjiwe igcwaliswa ngesikhathi esisodwa.
element.uncoveredNote.from: That is either a real gap in the programme or a matrix that has not been uploaded yet. Upload the Curriculum Alignment Matrix against this qualification and every line it names is filled in at once.

element.notHeld.text: kukhonjwe kumatrikhi, kodwa akukho dokhumenti egciniwe lapha enegama elinjalo.
element.notHeld.from: named in the matrix, but no document held here has that name.

element.assessedNote.text: Imibandela yokuhlola yangaphakathi yesihloko lo mugqa okuso.
element.assessedNote.from: The internal assessment criteria of the topic this line belongs to.

element.workplace.text: Imojuli yesipiliyoni sokusebenza ayinayo imibandela yokuhlola. Okudingayo kufakazelwa irekhodi elisayiniwe lomsebenzi uqobo, elamukelwe umhloli, hhayi ngokwahlulelwa ngemibandela.
element.workplace.from: A work experience module has no assessment criteria. What it requires is evidenced by a signed record of the work itself, accepted by an assessor, rather than judged against criteria.

element.noCriteria.text: Lesi sihloko asinayo imibandela yokuhlola, ngakho akukho okungafinyelelwa lapha nanini. Kuze kube yilapho ithathwa kudokhumenti yekharikhulamu, akukho mfundi ongaqeda le mojuli.
element.noCriteria.from: This topic has no assessment criteria, so nothing here can ever be achieved. Until they are captured from the curriculum document, no learner can complete this module.

element.taughtNote.text: Amayunithi okufunda okulethwa kuwo le mojuli.
element.taughtNote.from: The study units this module is delivered in.

partModules.introPart.text: Lezi ziqu eziyingxenye zithathwe ku-{parent} futhi zabelana ngekharikhulamu yayo{code}. Maka amamojuli idokhumenti yazo ye-SAQA eyawabala ngaphansi kwe-{rules}. Akukho okukhophiwe: umsebenzi womfundi ngemojuli ubalwa kanye kuphela, noma ubehlangabezane nayo kuphi.
partModules.introPart.from: This part qualification is drawn from {parent} and shares its curriculum{code}. Tick the modules its own SAQA document lists under {rules}. Nothing is copied: a learner's work against a module counts once, wherever they met it.

partModules.introOther.text: Lolu hlelo lwenziwe ku-{parent} futhi lwabelana ngekharikhulamu yayo{code}. Maka amamojuli idokhumenti yalo ye-SAQA eyawabala ngaphansi kwe-{rules}. Akukho okukhophiwe: umsebenzi womfundi ngemojuli ubalwa kanye kuphela, noma ubehlangabezane nayo kuphi.
partModules.introOther.from: This programme is drawn from {parent} and shares its curriculum{code}. Tick the modules its own SAQA document lists under {rules}. Nothing is copied: a learner's work against a module counts once, wherever they met it.

partModules.notRead.from: The parent's curriculum has not been read in yet

partModules.notReadNote.text: Akukho okuzokhethwa kuze kube yilapho i-{parent} ifundwe idokhumenti yayo yekharikhulamu. Kwenze lokho kuqala, bese le nhlu igcwala yona.
partModules.notReadNote.from: There is nothing to choose from until {parent} has its curriculum document read in. Do that first, and this list fills itself.

partModules.noClaim.text: Akukho nani eliphelele lamakhredithi elirekhodwe kulezi ziqu, ngakho akukho okungaqhathaniswa. Idokhumenti yazo ye-SAQA ibeka elilodwa ngaphansi kwe-Minimum Credits.
partModules.noClaim.from: No credit total is recorded for this qualification, so there is nothing to check against. Its SAQA document states one under Minimum Credits.

partModules.agree.text: Lokhu kuyavumelana, okuyisibonakaliso sokuthi amamojuli alungile ayamakiwe.
partModules.agree.from: These agree, which is the sign the right modules are ticked.

partModules.disagree.text: Lokhu akuvumelani. Mhlawumbe kumakwe imojuli idokhumenti ye-SAQA engayibali, noma ilahlekile eyibalayo, noma amakhredithi emojuli afundwe kabi. Kufanele kuhlolwe ngaphambi kokugcina; ipulatifomu izogcina noma kunjalo lokho oyitshela kona.
partModules.disagree.from: These do not agree. Either a module is ticked that the SAQA document does not list, or one it lists is missing, or the credits on a module were read in wrongly. Worth checking before saving; the platform will still save what you tell it.

qualPreview.title.from: As a learner will see it

qualPreview.intro.text: Yonke i-{programme} ngokulandelana umuntu obhalisiwe kuyo ayihamba ngakho. Akukho okuqalayo lapha: akukho kubhalisa okwenziwayo, akukho mzamo ovulwayo futhi akukho ntuthuko erekhodwayo, ngakho lokhu kungafundwa kaningi ngendlela othanda ngayo.
qualPreview.intro.from: The whole {programme} in the order somebody enrolled on it walks it. Nothing here starts anything: no enrolment is made, no attempt is opened and no progress is recorded, so this can be read as often as you like.

qualPreview.gaps.from: What a learner would not find

qualPreview.allReadyNote.text: Isinyathelo ngasinye kuyunithi yokufunda ngayinye sinokuthile ngemuva kwaso. Umfundi obhalisiwe kule {programme} namuhla wayeyitholela yonke.
qualPreview.allReadyNote.from: Every step in every study unit has something behind it. A learner enrolled on this {programme} today would find the whole of it.

qualPreview.build.from: Build what a learner works through

qualPreview.open.from: Open it as a learner sees it

qualPreview.change.from: Change the order or what is on it

courseList.noneAuthor.text: Inkambo yilokho umfundi asebenza ngakho ngempela. Ixhumeke kuyunithi yokufunda noma imojuli yekharikhulamu, ngakho kungcono ukulayisha iziqu kuqala.
courseList.noneAuthor.from: A course is what a learner actually works through. It hangs off a study unit or a curriculum module, so a qualification is worth loading first.

courseList.noneReader.text: Akukashicilelwa lutho kuwe okwamanje. Lapho sekushicilelwe, lokho obhalisiwe kukho kuzoba lapha.
courseList.noneReader.from: Nothing has been published for you yet. When it has been, what you are enrolled on will be here.

newCourse.noModule.from: Not part of an accredited qualification

newCourse.moduleNote.text: Yihlanganise nemojuli yekharikhulamu futhi isistimu izohlola, ngaphambi kokuba ishicilelwe, ukuthi yonke imibandela yokuhlola kuleyo mojuli inesifundo ngemuva kwayo.
newCourse.moduleNote.from: Bind it to a curriculum module and the system will check, before it can be published, that every assessment criterion in that module has a lesson behind it.

courseEdit.published.text: Lokhu kushicilelwe, ngakho okukuyo kumisiwe. Abafundi abakuqedile banamarekhodi abhekisela kule nguqulo kanye.
courseEdit.published.from: This is published, so its content is fixed. Learners who completed it have records that refer to exactly this version.

courseEdit.publishedAuthor.text: Ukuze uyishintshe, vula inguqulo entsha; eshicilelwe ihlala injengoba injalo.
courseEdit.publishedAuthor.from: To change it, open a new version; the published one stays as it is.

courseEdit.folderNote.text: Khetha ifolda lapho le mpahla ikhona futhi yonke okuyo, kuhlanganise namafolda ayo angaphansi, iyafundwa, ifayelwe futhi ifakwe inkomba. Ubona lokho ebeyokufayela ngaphambi kokuba kubhalwe noma yini.
courseEdit.folderNote.from: Choose the folder this material lives in and everything in it, including its subfolders, is read, filed and indexed. You see what it would file before anything is written.

courseEdit.folderLabel.from: Its folder, from your own computer

courseEdit.folderHint.text: Imihlahlandlela, amabhuku omsebenzi, izinqubomgomo namathempulethi kufayelwa kuyo futhi umbhalo wawo ufakwa inkomba ukuze kusesekwe.
courseEdit.folderHint.from: Guides, workbooks, policies and templates are filed against it and their text indexed so they can be searched.

courseEdit.folderHint2.text: Ukwakheka akudalwa lapha: ukwakheka kwayo kwakhiwa kumhleli ongenhla noma kumamojuli eziqu. Lokhu kufayela lokho okukuyo.
courseEdit.folderHint2.from: Structure is not created from here: its own shape is built in the editor above or from a qualification's modules. This files what it holds.

courseEdit.drive.from: Or from a drive you have connected

courseEdit.driveNote.text: Ifolda efanayo, efundwa lapho isivele ikhona. Iphelela endaweni efanayo: isiphakamiso okumele sihlolwe ngaphambi kokuba kubhalwe noma yini.
courseEdit.driveNote.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

courseEdit.noSections.text: Azikho izigaba okwamanje. Yakhiwe ngezigaba, futhi isigaba ngasinye sinezifundo.
courseEdit.noSections.from: No sections yet. It is built from sections, and each section holds lessons.

courseEdit.noLessons.from: No lessons in this section yet.

courseEdit.competenciesNote.text: Lokho ukuqeda kukhombisa. Ayikwazi ukushicilelwa ngaphandle kwekhono, ngoba ukuqeda kwayo bekungeke kubikwe njengekhono.
courseEdit.competenciesNote.from: What completing it demonstrates. It cannot be published with no competency, because its completions could not be reported as capability.

courseEdit.coveredAcross.text: kwemibandela yokuhlola engu-{count} ehlanganisiwe kumamojuli e-{unit}
courseEdit.coveredAcross.from: of {count} assessment criteria covered across {unit}'s modules

courseEdit.coveredNote.text: Ihlanganiswa yisifundo lapha, umbuzo ohlolweni lwayo oxhumene nayo, noma lokho imatrikhi yakho yokuqondanisa ekuqamba njengokukuhlola. Layisha imatrikhi kuziqu ukuze urekhode okugcina.
courseEdit.coveredNote.from: Covered by a lesson here, a question on one of its assessments that is linked to it, or what your alignment matrix names as assessing it. Upload the matrix on the qualification to record the last.

courseEdit.unbound.text: Lokhu akuhlanganiswanga nemojuli yekharikhulamu egunyaziwe, ngakho azikho imibandela yokuhlola okumele ihlanganiswe.
courseEdit.unbound.from: This is not bound to an accredited curriculum module, so there are no assessment criteria to cover.

courseEdit.publishNote.text: Ukushicilela kuyenqatshwa uma kukhona okungenhla okungaqediwe.
courseEdit.publishNote.from: Publishing is refused while anything above is incomplete.

courseEdit.newVersionNote.text: Abafundi abaqede le nguqulo bagcina irekhodi layo.
courseEdit.newVersionNote.from: Learners who completed this version keep their record of it.

spine.intro.text: Ukulandelana kwale {course} nokuthi yini evala isinyathelo ngasinye kuze kuqedwe esandulele. Konke okulapha sekugcinwe ngokumelene nale {course}: ukukubeka ohlwini yikho okwenza umfundi akuhlangabeze.
spine.intro.from: The order this {course} is walked in, and what holds each step shut until the one before it is done. Everything here is already held against this {course}: putting it on the list is what makes a learner meet it.

spine.empty.text: Akukho okukuyo okwamanje, ngakho umfundi obhalisiwe kuyo wayeyivula athole ikhasi elingenalutho. Engeza into yokuqala ngezansi.
spine.empty.from: Nothing is on it yet, so a learner enrolled on it would open it and find an empty page. Add the first thing below.

spine.waitsForBefore.from: Waits for the step before it to be {rule}.

spine.nothingLeft.text: Konke okugcinwe ngokumelene nakho sekusohlwini. Faka incwadi yomsebenzi noma ufayele idokhumenti ngokumelene nayo, futhi izovela lapha.
spine.nothingLeft.from: Everything held against it is already on the list. Capture a workbook or file a document against it, and it will appear here.

spine.openAtStart.text: Vulekile kusukela ekuqaleni, hhayi ngemva kwesinyathelo esandulele
spine.openAtStart.from: Open from the start, rather than after the step before it

courseAssess.intro.text: Ikhwizi eyakhayo iyamakwa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Ukuhlola okuphetha kuhlala kwahlulelwa umuntu futhi kulinganiswa ngokuzimela njalo, ngoba yikho okubalwa kuziqu.
courseAssess.intro.from: A formative quiz is marked automatically. A summative assessment is always judged by a person and always moderated independently, because it is the one that counts towards a qualification.

courseAssess.options.from: Answer options: tick every one that is correct

courseAssess.published.text: Kushicilelwe. Umfundi uyahlangabezana nakho uma sekuyisinyathelo ku-{link}.
courseAssess.published.from: Published. A learner meets it once it is a step in {link}.

courseAssess.sampleNote.text: Isilinganiso esiphansi, hhayi esiphezulu. Usayizi weqoqo uyasikhuphula: iqoqo labantu abayishumi noma ngaphansi lilinganiswa lonke futhi elingamashumi amabili noma ngaphansi lilinganiswa ngesigamu, ngoba ingxenye yesine yamaphepha ayisishiyagalombili ngamabili, futhi amabili asho okuncane kakhulu ngokwahlulela komhloli. Leli nani lilawula amaqoqo angaphezu kwamashumi amabili. Alinakwa ekuhlolweni okuphetha, lapho zonke izinqumo zilinganiswa, futhi umhloli osanda kubhalisa uhlala elinganiswa ngokuphelele.
courseAssess.sampleNote.from: A floor, not a ceiling. Cohort size raises it: a cohort of ten or fewer is moderated in full and one of twenty or fewer at half, because a quarter of eight scripts is two, and two say almost nothing about an assessor's judgement. This figure governs cohorts above twenty. Ignored for a summative assessment, where every decision is moderated, and a newly registered assessor is always moderated in full.

courseEnrol.draft.text: Lokhu kusaluhlaka. Kumele kushicilelwe ngaphambi kokuba kwabelwe noma ubani: uhlaka alukadluli ekuhlolweni okuqinisekisa ukuthi okuqukethwe kwalo kuhlanganisa lokho okushoyo.
courseEnrol.draft.from: This is still a draft. It has to be published before anyone can be assigned to it: a draft has not passed the checks that confirm its content covers what it claims to.

courseEnrol.waitingNote.text: Umfundi ngamunye uvela kanye, esinyathelweni sokuqala angeke asivule. Ukubambezelwa esinyathelweni sesithathu yiqiniso elifanele ukuthathelwa isinyathelo; ukubambezelwa nasezinyathelweni zesine kuya kweshumi kungumsindo nje.
courseEnrol.waitingNote.from: Each learner appears once, at the earliest step they cannot open. Being held up at step three is the fact worth acting on; also being held up at steps four to ten is noise.

courseEnrol.everyone.from: Everyone in the organisation is already on it.

courseEnrol.manyNote.text: Namathisela amakheli e-imeyili, elilodwa ngomugqa. Ikholomu ekhophwe ngqo kusipredishithi iyasebenza.
courseEnrol.manyNote.from: Paste email addresses, one per line. A column copied straight out of a spreadsheet works.

settings.intro.text: Ukuthi i-{name} ibukeka kanjani kubantu bakho, nokuthi isistimu ifunda kanjani amadokhumenti abawalayishayo. Izinguquko zisebenza yonke indawo ngokushesha: akukho okumele kwakhiwe kabusha noma kusakazwe kabusha.
settings.intro.from: How {name} looks to your people, and how the App reads the documents they upload. Changes apply everywhere immediately: there is nothing to rebuild or redeploy.

settings.drive.connected.text: Kuxhumekile. Ifolda ingafundwa ngqo kuyo manje.
settings.drive.connected.from: Connected. A folder can now be read straight from it.

settings.drive.cancelled.from: Nothing was connected: the consent was cancelled.

settings.drive.state.text: Leyo mvume ayizange ifane neyaqalwa yilesi sihloli, ngakho akukho okuxhunyiwe. Qala kabusha kulelikhasi.
settings.drive.state.from: That consent did not match the one this browser started, so nothing was connected. Start again from this page.

settings.drive.nocode.text: Umhlinzeki akathumelanga lutho ukuze uxhumeke ngalo. Zama futhi.
settings.drive.nocode.from: The provider sent nothing back to connect with. Try again.

settings.drive.failed.text: Uxhumano alukwazanga ukuqedwa. Akukho okugciniwe. Ukuzama futhi kufanele ngaphambi kwanoma yini.
settings.drive.failed.from: The connection could not be completed. Nothing was stored. Trying again is worth doing before anything else.

settings.mailNote.text: Ukuthi abafundi bayakwazi ngempela yini ukwamukela imininingwane yabo yokungena nezaziso. Kufanele kuhlolwe ngemva kokuba noma ubani eshintshe amasethingi eposi, futhi yikhona kokuqala ukuhlola uma othile ethi i-imeyili ayizange ifike.
settings.mailNote.from: Whether learners can actually receive their sign-in details and notifications. Worth checking after anybody changes the mail settings, and the first thing to check when somebody says an email never arrived.

settings.sso.from: Signing in with Google or Microsoft

settings.ssoNote.text: Kuvumela abantu bakho ukuthi bangene nge-akhawunti ye-Google noma ye-Microsoft yenhlangano yabo esikhundleni sephasiwedi lapha, okuqhubeka nokusebenza eceleni kwalo. Kungenisa kuphela abantu abasenayo i-akhawunti kule platifomu, abafaniswa nge-imeyili okokuqala; ayidali nhlobo eyodwa.
settings.ssoNote.from: Lets your people sign in with their organisation's Google or Microsoft account instead of a password here, which keeps working beside it. It only signs in people who already have an account on this platform, matched by email address the first time; it never creates one.

settings.terminologyNote.text: Sebenzisa amagama akho. Umhlinzeki ongaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika angase angasho uhlelo, futhi ongaphakathi kwayo angase angasho inkambo; ipulatifomu akufanele ifunde ngokuphoqelela.
settings.terminologyNote.from: Use your own vocabulary. A provider outside South Africa may not say programme, and a provider inside it may not say course; the platform should not insist.

settings.templatesNote.text: Ukuthi idokhumenti ngayinye lo mhlinzeki ayikhipha ifundeka futhi ibukeke kanjani.
settings.templatesNote.from: How each document this provider issues reads and looks.

settings.templatesMoved.text: manje ngaphansi kokuthi Ukuphatha, nayo yonke idokhumenti ipulatifomu ekhiqizayo nokuthi ngubani owamukela ngayinye.
settings.templatesMoved.from: now under Management, with every document the platform produces and who receives each one.

settings.menuNote.text: Hlela kabusha ibha esebusweni: betha kabusha isihloko, hambisa ikhasi ngaphansi kwesinye, noma wenze ikhasi libe yisixhumanisi esiqondile. Kufana kubo bonke kulo mhlinzeki, ngoba abasebenzi bayatshelana ukuthi izinto zikuphi.
settings.menuNote.from: Rearrange the bar at the top: rename a heading, move a page under a different one, or make a page a direct link. The same for everybody at this provider, because staff tell each other where things are.

settings.drivesNote.text: Funda ifolda ngqo ku-Google Drive noma ku-OneDrive, esikhundleni sokuyilanda bese uyilayisha futhi. Ingeyakho hhayi eyalo mhlinzeki: ilungu ngalinye labasebenzi lixhuma elakhe.
settings.drivesNote.from: Read a folder straight from Google Drive or OneDrive, instead of downloading it and uploading it again. Yours rather than this provider's: every member of staff connects their own.

settings.extensionNote.text: Ngokumelene nephrofayela yakho. Ukukhetha, kucishiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, futhi lokho okukuvumela ukukwenza kuvinjelwe indima yakho njengoba nakho konke okunye kunjalo.
settings.extensionNote.from: Against your own profile. Optional, off by default, and what it lets you do is bounded by your role exactly as everything else is.

providerLang.note.text: Ulimi abantu bakho abafunda ngalo ipulatifomu, ngaphandle kokuba bakhethe olwabo ngaphansi kwegama labo phezulu ekhasini. Izikrini ezingakahunyushwa ziyahlala ziseNgisini, futhi amagama akho ezinto (Amasethingi, Isigama) agcinwa njengoba uwabhale kuyo yonke ilimi.
providerLang.note.from: The language your people read the platform in, unless they choose their own under their name at the top of the page. Screens not yet translated stay in English, and your own names for things (Settings, Terminology) are kept as you wrote them in every language.

brand.accentNote.from: Highlights, progress bars and certificate borders.

brand.logoNote.text: Livela ekhanda, ekhasini lokungena nasesitifiketini ngasinye. I-PNG enomumo obonakalayo ihlala kangcono embalweni wekhanda. Ngaphansi kwe-2 MB.
brand.logoNote.from: Appears in the header, on the sign-in page and on every certificate. A PNG with a transparent background sits best on the header colour. Under 2 MB.

brand.unfinished.text: Ukulayisha akuqediwe. Hlola uxhumano bese uzama futhi.
brand.unfinished.from: The upload did not finish. Check the connection and try again.

brand.removeLogo.text: Susa, bese ubonisa igama esikhundleni salo
brand.removeLogo.from: Remove, and show the name instead

brand.logoAddress.text: Noma ikheli, uma isithombe sesivele sisendaweni enye
brand.logoAddress.from: Or an address, if the image is already hosted elsewhere

brand.signInNote.text: Ukukhethwa. Uma kungekho lutho lapha, ikhasi libonisa igama lakho embalweni wakho, okuhlelekile kodwa okulula. Isithombe esisho into eyiqiniso ngalokho okwenzayo sibaluleke kakhulu kunesihlobiso.
brand.signInNote.from: Optional. With nothing here the page shows your name on your own colour, which is tidy but plain. A graphic that says something true about what you do is worth more than a decorative one.

brand.characterNote.text: Livela esikrinini esingenalutho okwamanje, eceleni kwemisho echaza ukuthi kuzoba yini lapho, naseceleni kwenkinobho okumele othile ayicindezele olandelayo, lapho lakhelwe ukuba libonwe. Lincane, limile, futhi lisebenzela ubungane kunesihlobiso. Lishiye lingenalutho ukusebenzisa elale pulatifomu, noma lutho nhlobo.
brand.characterNote.from: Appears on a screen with nothing on it yet, beside the sentence explaining what would be there, and beside a button somebody has to press next, where it is there to be noticed. Small, upright, and friendlier than it is decorative. Leave it empty to use this platform's own, or nothing at all.

shape.intro.text: Imibuzo emibili inquma isimo sepulatifomu yakho nokuthi izingxenye zayo ziyabizwa kanjani. Yonke into ongayikhethi iyahamba: izikrini zayo, izinto zemenyu namakheli.
shape.intro.from: Two questions decide the shape of your platform and what its parts are called. Everything you do not choose goes away: its screens, its menu entries and its addresses.

shape.nothingDeletedNote.text: Ukushintsha lokhu kufihla izinto. Noma yini esivele irekhodiwe ihlala lapho ikhona, futhi ukukhetha futhi kubuyisa izikrini namarekhodi angashintshiwe.
shape.nothingDeletedNote.from: Changing this hides things. Whatever has already been recorded stays where it is, and choosing it again brings the screens back with the records intact.

shape.saved.text: Kugciniwe. Imenyu namagama kushintshile ukuze kuhambisane.
shape.saved.from: Saved. The menu and the wording have changed to match.

shape.unavailable.text: Akutholakali ngokukhetha okungenhla. Iyunithi yokufunda ihlala ngaphakathi kweziqu, futhi le platifomu ayinazo.
shape.unavailable.from: Not available with the choice above. A study unit sits inside a qualification, and this platform has none.

shape.standalone.from: Three things that stand on their own

shape.statutoryCovers.text: Ukuthumela ngaphandle kwe-NLRD ne-Edu.Dex, imibiko ye-WSP ne-ATR, nerejista yomthetho engemuva kwayo.
shape.statutoryCovers.from: NLRD and Edu.Dex exports, WSP and ATR returns, and the statutory register behind them.

shape.statutoryWhen.text: ungaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika, noma othile ufayela egameni lakho.
shape.statutoryWhen.from: you are outside South Africa, or somebody else files on your behalf.

shape.workplaceCovers.text: Izivumelwano zasemsebenzini, imihlahlandlela yabaqeqeshi, amashidi okuvuma namahora umfundi awarekhoda ngokumelene nomqashi obamukelayo.
shape.workplaceCovers.from: Workplace agreements, coach guides, sign off sheets and the hours a learner logs against a host employer.

shape.workplaceWhen.from: nothing you deliver is assessed in a workplace.

shape.offlineCovers.text: Abafundi bafaka ipulatifomu efonini labo, balande impahla yokufunda ngaphambi kokuphuma, bayifunde ngaphandle kwesignali, futhi barekhode umsebenzi wabo ukuze bawuthumele lapho bebuya benayo.
shape.offlineCovers.from: Learners install the platform on their phone, download their study material before they go out, read it with no signal, and record their work to send back when they next have one.

shape.offlineWhen.text: abafundi bachitha izinsuku bengekho endaweni enesignali, njengasensimini. Ukuhlola okuphetha kuhlala kusethwe ku-inthanethi ngaphandle uma uhlelo lubekwe ngenye indlela ngamabomu.
shape.offlineWhen.from: learners spend days away from a signal, such as in the field. Summatives stay online unless a programme is deliberately set otherwise.

shape.rename.text: Ungabiza kabusha noma yikuphi kwalokhu ngaphansi kwe-{link}. Amagama lo mumo awasebenzisa ngempela kuphela abonisiwe lapho.
shape.rename.from: You can rename any of these under {link}. Only the words this shape actually uses are offered there.

shape.award.qualification_programme.cove.text: Into eyodwa. Umfundi ubekwa eziqwini futhi yilokho asebenza ngakho. Akukho ungqimba lokuhlanganisa oluhlukile ngenhla kwayo.
shape.award.qualification_programme.cove.from: One thing. A learner is put onto the qualification and that is what they work through. There is no separate bundling layer above it.

shape.award.qualification_programme.when.text: Uletha iziqu ezingezomsebenzi othile eyodwa njengohlelo lokufunda olulodwa.
shape.award.qualification_programme.when.from: You deliver one occupational qualification as one learning programme.

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: Iziqu noHlelo, ngokwehlukile
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: Qualification and Programme, separately

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: Izinto ezimbili ezihlukile. Iziqu ziqukethe ukugunyazwa nekharikhulamu; uhlelo luhlanganisa lokho umfundi asebenza ngakho, futhi lungase luphendule eziqwini noma lutho.
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: Two different things. A qualification holds the accreditation and the curriculum; a programme bundles what a learner works through, and may answer to a qualification or to none.

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: Uqhuba iziqu ezigunyaziwe futhi uhlanganisa nokuletha ngokulandelana okungezona iziqu eziyodwa ngayinye.
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: You run accredited qualifications and also bundle deliverables into sequences that are not one qualification each.

shape.award.programmes_only.covers.text: Izinhlelo zihlanganisa lokho umfundi asebenza ngakho. Akukho rekhodi lokugunyazwa, akukho kharikhulamu, akukho zitatimende zemiphumela.
shape.award.programmes_only.covers.from: Programmes bundle what a learner works through. No accreditation record, no curriculum, no statements of results.

shape.award.programmes_only.when.text: Akukho okuletha okuphendula eziqwini ezibhalisiwe: uhlelo lokwethula, izinsizakalo zokuvuselela ukuthobela, izinhlelo zamakhono zangaphakathi.
shape.award.programmes_only.when.from: Nothing you deliver answers to a registered qualification: induction, compliance refreshers, internal skills programmes.

shape.award.standalone.covers.text: Konke kuma kwakho. Akukho okuhlanganisa futhi akukho okugunyaza.
shape.award.standalone.covers.from: Everything stands on its own. Nothing bundles it and nothing accredits it.

shape.award.standalone.when.text: Yonke ingxenye yokuqeqeshwa oyiqhubayo ithathwa yodwa, eyodwa ngesikhathi.
shape.award.standalone.when.from: Every piece of training you run is taken on its own, one at a time.

shape.delivery.courses.covers.text: Inkambo yilokho umfundi abekwa kukho futhi asebenza ngakho: izifundo zayo, amabhuku ayo omsebenzi, ukuhlola kwayo. Ingahlala ngaphansi kohlelo, futhi ayidingi ukuphendula eziqwini.
shape.delivery.courses.covers.from: A course is what a learner is put onto and works through: its lessons, its workbooks, its assessments. It may sit under a programme, and it need answer to no qualification.

shape.delivery.courses.when.text: Abantu bakho bathi inkambo, noma wakha ukuqeqeshwa okungalawulwa yiziqu.
shape.delivery.courses.when.from: Your people say course, or you build training that no qualification governs.

shape.delivery.study_units.covers.text: Iyunithi yokufunda yilokho umfundi asebenza ngakho, futhi ithatha isikhundla senkambo ngokuphelele. Ihlala ngaphakathi kweziqu, ihlanganisa amamojuli olwazi, ekhono nasemsebenzini asebenzela umphumela owodwa wezinga lokuphuma.
shape.delivery.study_units.covers.from: A study unit is what a learner works through, and it replaces the course entirely. It sits inside a qualification, bundling the knowledge, practical and workplace modules that serve one exit level outcome.

shape.delivery.study_units.when.text: Abantu bakho bathi iyunithi yokufunda kunenkambo. Ikharikhulamu ishicilela amamojuli futhi ishiya ukuhlanganisa kuwe, ngakho lokhu kuyisakhiwo sakho. Idinga iziqu ngenhla.
shape.delivery.study_units.when.from: Your people say study unit rather than course. The curriculum publishes modules and leaves the grouping to you, so this is your own structure. Requires a qualification at the top.

shape.note.qualificationProgramme.text: Into eyodwa. Umfundi ubekwa eziqwini, futhi yilolo hlelo asebenza ngalo.
shape.note.qualificationProgramme.from: One thing. A learner is put onto the qualification, and that is the programme they work through.

shape.note.qualification.text: Irekhodi lokugunyazwa: ikharikhulamu yalo, imibandela nemiphumela yezinga lokuphuma.
shape.note.qualification.from: The accreditation record: its curriculum, criteria and exit level outcomes.

shape.note.programmeWithQualification.text: Ukulandelana okuhleliwe, okungaphendula eziqwini noma lutho.
shape.note.programmeWithQualification.from: An ordered sequence, which may answer to a qualification or to none.

shape.note.programmeOnly.from: An ordered sequence, answering to no registered qualification.

shape.note.bottom.text: Lokho umfundi asebenza ngakho. Akukho lutho ngaphansi kwakho.
shape.note.bottom.from: What a learner works through. There is nothing below it.

clock.note.text: Yonke inkathi ehlelwe kuthayimthebula kule sistimu isho leli washi. Ileksha ngo-18:30 ngu-18:30 lapha, futhi isikhathi sokugcina sokwamukelwa kokuhlala ukuhlolwa okugadwayo sinqunywa ngalo.
clock.note.from: Every timetabled time in the App means this clock. A lecture at 18:30 is 18:30 here, and an admission cut-off for an invigilated sitting is judged against it.

clock.both.text: Abafundi emazweni amanye babona zombili: isikhathi sakho, esigcinwa irekhodi, nesabo eceleni, ukuze kungabikho obala umehluko enze iphutha. Izikhathi ezirekhodiwe zihlala ziyezakho.
clock.both.from: Learners in other countries see both: your time, which is the one the record keeps, and their own alongside it, so nobody works out the difference themselves and gets it wrong. Recorded times are always yours.

mailTest.intro.text: Kuvula uxhumano kusiseva yeposi futhi kungene, ukuhlola ukuthi imininingwane yokungena yabafundi nezaziso kungafakwa ngempela.
mailTest.intro.from: Opens a connection to the mail server and signs in, to check that learner sign-in details and notifications can actually be delivered.

mailTest.nothingSent.from: No email is sent to anybody.

mailTest.notYours.text: Akukho okulapha ongakushintsha kulelikhasi: iseva yeposi ingeyokusetshenziswa. Dlulisela umugqa ongenhla kunoma ubani ongawugcina.
mailTest.notYours.from: Nothing here is something you can change on this page: the mail server belongs to the deployment. Pass the line above to whoever maintains it.

mailTest.unconfigured.text: Ayikho iseva yeposi esethwe kulokhu kusetshenziswa okwamanje, ngakho lokhu kuzobika lokho kunokuba kube yiphutha ne-akhawunti yakho.
mailTest.unconfigured.from: No mail server is set up on this deployment yet, so this will report that rather than a fault with your account.

sso.register.text: Bhalisa le platifomu ne-akhawunti ye-{provider} yenhlangano yakho futhi uyinike leli kheli ukuze ibuyise abantu, njengoba kubhaliwe: {address}
sso.register.from: Register this platform with your organisation's {provider} account and give it this address to send people back to, exactly as written: {address}

sso.directoryHint.from: From the app's Overview page in Microsoft Entra

sso.offer.from: Offer “Sign in with {provider}” on the sign-in page

termsForm.why.practice.text: elisetshenziswa emkhakheni wonke, akekho ongumnikazi walo
termsForm.why.practice.from: used across the sector, owned by nobody

termsForm.missing.text: Amanye amagama awekho kule nhlu, futhi lokho kwenziwe ngamabomu.
termsForm.missing.from: Some words are not on this list, and that is deliberate.

termsForm.missingNote.text: Iziqu, imojuli yekharikhulamu, umphumela wezinga lokuphuma, izinga le-NQF nokunye kuchazwa yi-QCTO noma i-SAQA hhayi wena. Ukubiza kabusha oyodwa kungabeka amagama esikrinini somfundi nasekulethweni angaziwa umlawuli, ngakho ipulatifomu iwagcina emile. Ungafunda ukuthi ubani ochaza ini ku-{link}.
termsForm.missingNote.from: Qualification, curriculum module, exit level outcome, NQF level and the rest are defined by the QCTO or SAQA rather than by you. Renaming one would put wording on a learner's screen and on a submission that the regulator does not recognise, so the platform keeps them fixed. You can read who defines what in the {link}.

termsForm.note.course.text: Umzimba owodwa wokufunda umuntu abhalisiwe kuwo.
termsForm.note.course.from: A single body of learning a person is enrolled onto.

termsForm.note.programme.from: A sequence of courses taken in order.

termsForm.note.cohort.from: A group of people moving through a course together.

termsForm.note.studyUnit.text: Ukuthi amamojuli ekharikhulamu ahlanganiswa kanjani ekulethweni.
termsForm.note.studyUnit.from: How a curriculum's modules are grouped for delivery.

termsForm.note.enrolment.from: A person's place on a course or programme.

termsForm.note.learner.text: Umuntu ofundayo. Abanye abahlinzeki bathi isitshudeni, noma umhlolwa.
termsForm.note.learner.from: The person doing the learning. Some providers say student, or candidate.

termsForm.note.facilitator.text: Umuntu ofundisayo. Abanye abahlinzeki bathi umqeqeshi, uthisha, noma umfundisi.
termsForm.note.facilitator.from: The person delivering. Some providers say trainer, tutor, or instructor.

termsForm.note.assessor.from: The person judging evidence against the criteria.

termsForm.note.moderator.from: The person checking a sample of those judgements.

termsForm.note.workplaceRecord.text: Irekhodi lomsebenzi umfundi awenzile, umqeqeshi alisayinayo futhi umhloli alamukele.
termsForm.note.workplaceRecord.from: The record of work a learner did, that a coach signs and an assessor accepts.

menuEdit.noHeadingHint.from: No heading: shown as direct links

menuEdit.empty.text: Akukho lutho. Isihloko esingenalutho ngaphansi kwaso asibonisiwe.
menuEdit.empty.from: Empty. A heading with nothing under it is not shown.

menuEdit.under.text: Ukuthi i-{page} ihlala ngaphansi kwasiphi isihloko

menuEdit.note.text: Amakhasi awakwazi ukufihlwa lapha. Lokho umuntu ngamunye akubonayo sekunqunywe indima yakhe, futhi enye indlela yokwenza okuthile kungafinyeleleki ingeke ishiye muntu okwazi ukuchaza ukuthi kungani ikhasi lilahlekile. Ikhasi elingezwe kupulatifomu kamuva livela ngaphansi kwesihloko salo esijwayelekile esikhundleni sokunyamalala ngoba lolu hlelo lwandulela.
menuEdit.note.from: Pages cannot be hidden here. What each person sees is already decided by their role, and a second way to make something unreachable would leave nobody able to say why a page is missing. A page added to the platform later appears under its usual heading rather than disappearing because this arrangement predates it.

drives.none.text: Akukho sitolo samafayela esisethiwe kulokhu kusetshenziswa. Ukufunda ifolda ngqo ku-Google Drive noma ku-OneDrive kudinga uhlelo lokusebenza olubhaliswe nabo ngumuntu ogcina ipulatifomu; kuze kube yilapho, ifolda ikhethwa kukhompyutha yakho, okusebenza futhi okungadingi lutho.
drives.none.from: No file store is set up on this deployment. Reading a folder straight from Google Drive or OneDrive needs an application registered with them by whoever maintains the platform; until then, a folder is chosen from your own computer, which works and needs nothing.

drives.keepsNote.text: Ithokheni evaliwe engafunda, futhi ifunde kuphela, idrayivu ye-akhawunti oyixhumayo, kuze kube yilapho uyinqamula lapha noma uyiphula kumasethingi e-akhawunti uqobo. Isetshenziswa lapho ucela ukuthi ifolda ifundwe, futhi hhayi nanini okunye, ayibonisiwe kuwe, futhi ayibhalwa kulogi. Ingeyakho, hhayi eyalo mhlinzeki: umsebenzi ontanga akakwazi ukufunda amafayela akho ngayo, futhi awukwazi ukufunda awakhe ngoxhumano lwakhe.
drives.keepsNote.from: A sealed token that can read, and only read, the drive of the account you connect, until you disconnect it here or withdraw it from that account's own settings. It is used when you ask for a folder to be read and at no other time, it is never shown back to you, and it is never written to a log. It is yours, not this provider's: a colleague cannot read your files through it, and you cannot read theirs through their connection.

ext.encrypted.text: Ifihlwe futhi ayibonisiwe futhi, lapha noma nakuphi kwenye indawo.
ext.encrypted.from: It is encrypted and is never shown again, here or anywhere else.

ext.cannotRun.text: Le ayikwazi ukusebenza kule platifomu, ngakho ukuyisetha lapha ngeke kwenze izici ze-AI zisebenze.
ext.cannotRun.from: This one cannot run on this platform, so setting it up here will not make the AI features work.

ext.needsProgram.text: Idinga uhlelo olufakwe emshinini ipulatifomu esebenza kuwo.
ext.needsProgram.from: It needs a program installed on the machine the platform runs on.

ext.chooseKey.text: Khetha esikhundleni salokho omunye wabahlinzeki bokhiye be-API: laba babiza umhlinzeki nge-inthanethi futhi basebenza noma kuphi lapho ipulatifomu ifakwe khona.
ext.chooseKey.from: Choose one of the API-key providers instead: those call the provider over the internet and work wherever the platform is installed.

ext.replace.text: Yisuse nge-{credential} entsha; shiya kungenalutho ukugcina egciniwe
ext.replace.from: Replace it with a new {credential}; leave empty to keep the stored one

ext.geminiHint.text: ukhiye wakho ovela ku-Google AI Studio
ext.geminiHint.from: your key from Google AI Studio

ext.available.from: Make it available to switch on

ext.model.text: Imodeli: shiya kungenalutho ukuze kusetshenziswe ejwayelekile yomhlinzeki
ext.model.from: Model: leave empty for the provider's own default

ext.showModels.from: Show the models this {credential} can use

ext.modelsAvailable.text: {count} atholakala kuwe namuhla. Ukukhetha oyedwa kugcwalisa ibhokisi elingenhla; kugcinwa uma ucindezela Gcina.
ext.modelsAvailable.from: {count} available to you today. Choosing one fills the box above; it is saved when you press Save.

ext.keepsNote.text: I-{credential} yakho, efihlwe, kuze kube yilapho uyilahla. Isetshenziswa kuphela emsebenzini oyicelayo, kuphela ngenkathi iswishi ivuliwe, futhi ayibonisiwe kuwe noma ibhalwe kunoma yiluphi ulogi. Ukutholakala akufani nokuvuliwe: ukuhlala ngakunye kuqala kucishiwe, uyayivula emsebenzini, futhi ukuphuma kuyicisha kuwe uma ukhohlwa.
ext.keepsNote.from: Your {credential}, encrypted, until you discard it. It is used only for work you ask for, only while you have the switch on, and it is never shown back to you or written to any log. Available is not the same as on: every sitting starts with it off, you switch it on for a job, and signing out switches it off for you if you forget.

ext.keptUnused.text: Ithokheni yakho igciniwe kodwa ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa. Akukho okuzovela epulatifomu okunikeza usizo lwe-AI uze uyenze itholakale futhi.
ext.keptUnused.from: Your token is kept but cannot be used. Nothing in the platform will offer AI assistance until you make it available again.

ext.offNote.text: Lokhu kucishiwe, ipulatifomu yenza ngempela njengoba yenza ngaphandle kwesandiso: izici azikho esikhundleni sokunikezwa futhi zehluleke.
ext.offNote.from: With this off, the platform behaves exactly as it does without an extension: the affordances are absent rather than offered and failing.

ext.tokenFromNote.text: Lesi sigaba senzeka kukhompyutha yakho, hhayi lapha, okuyinjongo: ukubhalisa kwakho kugunyazwa nguwe, emshinini wakho, futhi ithokheni eyikhiqizayo kuphela efinyelela kule platifomu.
ext.tokenFromNote.from: This part happens on your own computer, not here, which is the point: your subscription is authorised by you, on your machine, and only the token it produces ever reaches this platform.

ext.step1Rest.text: uma ungakayifaki: {link}. Udinga ukubhalisa kwakho kwe-Claude.
ext.step1Rest.from: if you have not already: {link}. You need a Claude subscription of your own.

ext.cmdNote.text: I-{plain} ejwayelekile ku-PowerShell ivamise ukwehluleka ngokuthi “running scripts is disabled on this system”. Lokho kuyisimiso se-Windows hhayi iphutha lokufakwa kwakho, futhi uhlobo lwe-{cmd} luyakugwema ngaphandle kokushintsha noma yisiphi isilungiselelo sokuphepha.
ext.cmdNote.from: Plain {plain} in PowerShell usually fails with “running scripts is disabled on this system”. That is a Windows default rather than anything wrong with your installation, and the {cmd} form avoids it without changing any security setting.

ext.step3.from: 3. Sign in when it opens your browser

ext.step3Rest.text: , bese ukopisha ithokheni ekuphrinta (iqala nge-{prefix}) uyinamathisele ngenhla.
ext.step3Rest.from: , then copy the token it prints (it begins {prefix}) and paste it above.

ext.notApiKey.text: Akuyona ukhiye we-API futhi akukho zindleko ngethokheni ngayinye: kudonsa ebhalisweni le-Claude osuvele ukhokhela. Ungalokothi unikeze muntu iphasiwedi yakho ye-Anthropic: le platifomu ayinayo indawo yayo futhi ngeke iyamukele lapha.
ext.notApiKey.from: It is not an API key and there is no per-token cost: it draws on the Claude subscription you already pay for. Never give anybody your Anthropic password: this platform has no field for one and would not accept it here.

ext.notSubscription.from: A subscription is not an API key.

ext.geminiSeparate.text: I-Gemini Advanced ne-Gemini API yimikhiqizo eyehlukene enokukhokha okuhlukile. Ukukhokhela eyokuqala akukunikezi eyesibili, futhi akukho ndlela yokukwenza.
ext.geminiSeparate.from: Gemini Advanced and the Gemini API are separate products with separate billing. Paying for the first does not give you the second, and there is no way to make it.

ext.openaiSeparate.text: I-ChatGPT Plus ne-OpenAI API yimikhiqizo eyehlukene enokukhokha okuhlukile. Ukukhokhela eyokuqala akukunikezi eyesibili, futhi akukho ndlela yokukwenza.
ext.openaiSeparate.from: ChatGPT Plus and the OpenAI API are separate products with separate billing. Paying for the first does not give you the second, and there is no way to make it.

ext.openaiCreate.text: Dala ukhiye ku-{site}, ngaphansi kwe-{menu}, bese uwunamathisela ngenhla. Uqala nge-{prefix}.
ext.openaiCreate.from: Create a key at {site}, under {menu}, and paste it above. It begins {prefix}.

ext.noFreeTierNote.text: ngokungafani ne-Gemini, ucingo ngalunye lukhokhiswa ku-akhawunti okhiye engeyayo, ngakho lindela i-invoyisi, noma ngabe incane kanjani.
ext.noFreeTierNote.from: unlike Gemini, every call is charged to the account the key belongs to, so expect a bill, however small.
