ext.geminiCreate.text: Ngena ku-{site}, khetha {menu}, dala oyedwa, futhi unamathisele ngenhla. I-Google ikhiphe okhiye ngamafomethi amaningi, ngakho unamathisele noma yini ekunika yona: le platifomu ayiwabuzisisi.
ext.geminiCreate.from: Sign in at {site}, choose {menu}, create one, and paste it above. Google has issued keys in more than one format, so paste whatever it gives you: this platform does not second-guess it.

ext.geminiFree.text: I-Gemini API inezinga lamahhala, ngakho ukuyizama akubizi lutho. Inciphisa ukuthi ungenza izicelo ezingaki ngomzuzu esikhundleni sokukukhokhisa; ukufunda ifolda enkulu kungafinyelela kuleso silinganiso, futhi ipulatifomu izokusho ngokusobala uma kwenzeka.
ext.geminiFree.from: The Gemini API has a free tier, so this costs nothing to try. It limits how many requests you may make in a minute rather than charging for them; reading a large folder can hit that, and the platform will say so plainly if it does.

ext.keyYours.text: Iyeyakho, hhayi eyetenenti. Ifihlwe, isetshenziswa kuphela emsebenzini oyicelayo ngenkathi iswishi yakho ivuliwe, ayibonisiwe kuwe, futhi ayibhalwa kulogi.
ext.keyYours.from: It is yours, not the tenant's. It is encrypted, used only for work you ask for while your switch is on, never shown back to you, and never written to a log.

codes.intro.text: Imojuli eyodwa ibhalwa ngokuhlukile kumadokhumenti ahlukene: {long} ekharikhulamu, {short} kuthebula lokuqondanisa, {shortest} emshweleni. Isihlonzi eside, ukuhlukanisa nezinhlamvu ezinkulu kuphathwa ngomthetho. Yilapho isistimu ixoxelwa khona ngokunye, ukuze ukulayisha kuxhumanise imojuli kunokuyibika ilahlekile.
codes.intro.from: One module is written down differently in different documents: {long} in the curriculum, {short} in the alignment table, {shortest} in a summary. The long identifier, the punctuation and the capitals are handled by rule. This is where the App is told about the rest, so an upload links the module instead of reporting it missing.

codes.saved.text: Kugciniwe. Ukulayisha kuzosebenzisa lokhu kusukela manje.
codes.saved.from: Saved. Uploads will use these from now on.

codes.none.text: Alikho ikharikhulamu elilayishiwe okwamanje, ngakho azikho izindinganiso zokuqagela. Layisha iziqu bese lokhu kuzigcwalisa kusuka emakhodini emojuli.
codes.none.from: No curriculum has been loaded yet, so there are no standards to infer. Load a qualification and this fills itself in from its module codes.

codes.inUse.from: {total} alternative spellings across {modules} modules, in use.

codes.notInUse.from: Not in use until you have looked at them and confirmed.

codes.dialogNote.text: Ikhodi engakwesobunxele yindinganiso yakho. Ukupela okuseceleni kwayo yilokho idokhumenti engakusebenzisa esikhundleni. Susa noma yikuphi okungafanele, engeza akho, bese uqinisekisa.
codes.dialogNote.from: The code on the left is your standard. The spellings beside it are what a document may use instead. Remove any that do not belong, add your own, then confirm.

codes.fullId.text: Isihlonzi se-QCTO esigcwele, {example}, sifundwa njengekhodi yemojuli yaso ngomthetho, futhi asidingi umugqa lapha. Kanjalo nezihlanganisi, izikhala nezinhlamvu ezinkulu.
codes.fullId.from: A full QCTO identifier, {example}, is read as its module code by rule, and needs no row here. So are hyphens, spaces and capitals.

codes.worked.from: Its variations are worked out for you.

codes.putBack.from: Put back everything the App proposed

naming.intro.text: Uma othile elayisha incwadi yomsebenzi noma ukuhlola, isistimu ifunda igama lefayela ukuze ibone ukuthi iyini. Uma lokhu kulungile, ukulayisha kufika sekugcwalisiwe. Uma kungalungile, akukho okuphuka: kufika njengefomu elingenalutho okumele othile aligcwalise ngesandla.
naming.intro.from: When somebody uploads a workbook or an assessment, the App reads the filename to work out what it is. Get this right and an upload arrives already filled in. Get it wrong and nothing breaks: it arrives as a blank form for somebody to complete by hand.

naming.rule.text: Umthetho wekhaya, njengoba ithimba lakho kufanele liwulandele
naming.rule.from: The house rule, as your team should follow it

naming.ruleNote.text: Kuboniswa esikrinini sokulayisha. Isiqondiso sabantu, hhayi okufaniswa yisistimu: ithola amakhodi angezansi noma kuphi lapho evela khona.
naming.ruleNote.from: Shown on the upload screen. Guidance for people, not something the App matches on: it finds the codes below wherever they appear.

naming.codesNote.text: Ingxenye yegama lefayela ebonisa uhlobo lwedokhumenti. Yiwo isistimu iwafanisa ngempela.
naming.codesNote.from: The part of a filename that says what kind of document it is. These are what the App actually matches on.

naming.markerNote.text: Ithokheni ebonisa ukuthi ifayela yimemorandamu hhayi ikhophi yomfundi.
naming.markerNote.from: The token that says a file is the memorandum rather than the learner's copy.

naming.unread.text: Akufundwanga kuleli gama: {parts}. Noma ubani olilayishayo ugcwalisa lokho ngesandla.
naming.unread.from: Not read from this name: {parts}. Whoever uploads it fills those in by hand.

naming.allRead.text: Konke kufundiwe. Ukulayisha okuqanjwe kanje kufika sekugcwalisiwe.
naming.allRead.from: Everything was read. An upload named like this arrives already filled in.

tmpl.note.statement_of_results.text: Kuthathwa kuya ekhaya lokuhlola nedokhumenti yobunikazi yomfundi. Isakhiwo siwesakho ukusetha; ithempulethi ye-QCTO uqobo ibonisa okuthwalwa yiyo.
tmpl.note.statement_of_results.from: Carried to the assessment centre with the learner's identity document. The layout is yours to set; the QCTO's own template shows what one carries.

tmpl.note.certificate.text: Lokho umhlinzeki akukhipha ngezinhlelo zawo. Isitifiketi seziqu sivela ku-QCTO, hhayi lapha.
tmpl.note.certificate.from: What the provider issues for its own programmes. A qualification certificate comes from the QCTO, not from here.

tmpl.note.workplace_statement.text: Lokho umqeqeshi wasemsebenzini akusayinayo ukuqinisekisa isipiliyoni umfundi asiqedile.
tmpl.note.workplace_statement.from: What a workplace coach signs to confirm the experience a learner completed.

tmpl.note.enrolment_form.text: Ifomu lokubhalisa eligcwalisiwe, njengedokhumenti. Umqapheli we-QCTO angalicela lapho evakashile, ngakho kumele libe khona ephepheni, hhayi kuphela njengesikrini othile agcwalise sona.
tmpl.note.enrolment_form.from: The completed enrolment form, as a document. A QCTO monitor may ask for it on a visit, so it has to exist on paper, not only as a screen somebody filled in.

tmpl.platform.text: Isakhiwo sepulatifomu uqobo. Akukho ozokwenza lapha okushintsha idokhumenti esivele ikhishiwe.
tmpl.platform.from: The platform's own layout. Nothing you do here changes a document already issued.

tmpl.documentNote.text: Yibhale ngendlela ofuna ifundeke ngayo. Noma yini ephakathi kwamabhrekhethi aphindwe kabili ithathelwa indawo yimininingwane yomfundi uqobo uma idokhumenti ikhiqizwa, futhi izikhala zakho zigcinwa njengoba uzibhale.
tmpl.documentNote.from: Write it as you want it to read. Anything in double braces is replaced with the learner's own details when the document is produced, and your spacing is kept exactly as you type it.

tmpl.starterNote.text: Lawa magama epulatifomu uqobo, ukuze uwanciphise abe ngawakho.
tmpl.starterNote.from: This is the platform's own wording, for you to cut down into yours.

tmpl.goBack.from: Go back to the platform's own layout

tmpl.fields.from: What you can put in it

tmpl.added.text: Lokho ipulatifomu ikungeza, noma ithempulethi yakho ithini
tmpl.added.from: What the platform adds, whatever your template says

tmpl.addedNote.text: Lokhu kuphrintwa ngemva kwethempulethi yakho. Akuyona eyakho ukushintsha ngoba akuyona eyakho: kudingwa umthetho, futhi umfundi ophethe idokhumenti uthembele ekutheni ziyiqiniso. Awudingi ukukubhala enguqulweni yakho.
tmpl.addedNote.from: These are printed after your template. They are not yours to change because they are not yours: a regulator requires them, and a learner holding the document relies on them being true. You do not need to write them into your own version.

capture.intro.text: Isistimu ifunda lokho ekwazi ukukufunda, ikubonise ukuthi ikwenzeni nalokho ekungakwazanga ukukuqonda, bese ilinda. Akukho okuba ukuhlola uze uqinisekise.
capture.intro.from: The App reads what it can, shows you what it made of it and what it could not work out, and waits. Nothing becomes an assessment until you confirm it.

capture.fromFolder.text: Uma incwadi yomsebenzi ifike nefolda, isivele ilapha: {link} bese uyifaka ngalokho okufayelwe. Akukho ukulayisha kwesibili, futhi umhlahlandlela wezimpendulo uhlanganiswa kuwe. Sebenzisa ifomu elingezansi kuphela ephepheni ipulatifomu engalinaso.
capture.fromFolder.from: If the workbook came in with a folder, it is already here: {link} and capture it from what is filed. There is no second upload, and the answer guide is paired for you. Use the form below only for a paper the platform does not already hold.

capture.changeNaming.text: Shintsha ukuthi amagama efayela afundwa kanjani

capture.noneNote.text: Vula iziqu bese ufaka amabhuku omsebenzi asevele efayelwe ngokumelene nazo, noma layisha eyodwa ngenhla. Lokho isistimu ekufundayo kuboniswa kuwe ngaphambi kokuba noma yikuphi kube ukuhlola.
capture.noneNote.from: Open a qualification and capture the workbooks already filed against it, or upload one above. What the App reads is shown to you before any of it becomes an assessment.

capture.committedOn.text: Kuphothulwe ngo-{date}. Ukulayisha kuphothulwa kanye; layisha idokhumenti futhi ukuze wenze elinye iphepha kuyo.
capture.committedOn.from: Committed on {date}. An upload is committed once; upload the document again to make another paper from it.

capture.which.from: Which qualification is this material for?

capture.guideNote.text: Ngaphandle kwawo, azikho izimpendulo ezilungile, amamaki noma imibandela engafundwa.
capture.guideNote.from: Without it, no correct answers, marks or criteria can be read.

capture.ready.text: Kulungile. Amamojuli angu-{modules} nemibandela yokuhlola engu-{criteria} sekungenile, ngakho imibuzo ingaxhunyaniswa nalokho ekufakazelayo.
capture.ready.from: Ready. {modules} modules and {criteria} assessment criteria are in, so questions can be linked to what they evidence.

capture.notReady.from: This qualification is not ready for material yet.

capture.notReadyNote.text: Yenza lokhu kuqala, ngale ndlela. Ngaphandle kokuba kuqediwe umbuzo ungamakwa kulokho ekufakazelayo, futhi ukulungisa lokho kamuva kusho ukumaka kabusha zonke ngesandla.
capture.notReadyNote.from: Do these first, in this order. Until they are done a question cannot be tagged to what it evidences, and putting that right later means re-tagging every one of them by hand.

capture.whereDocuments.from: Documents are uploaded on the qualification's own page.

capture.original.text: Okwasekuqaleni kugciniwe futhi kuyahashwa, ngakho umbuzo okuphikiswana ngawo uxazululwa ngokumelene nedokhumenti hhayi ngalokhu kuyifunda.
capture.original.from: The original is kept and hashed, so a question in dispute is settled against the document rather than against this reading of it.

capture.committedLong.text: Lokhu kuphothulwe ngo-{date}. Ukulayisha kuphothulwa kanye; layisha idokhumenti futhi ukuze wenze elinye iphepha kuyo.
capture.committedLong.from: This was committed on {date}. An upload is committed once; upload the document again to make another paper from it.

captureReview.noAnswer.text: “{stem}…” imakwa yisistimu kodwa ayinayo impendulo elungile.
captureReview.noAnswer.from: “{stem}…” is marked by the App but has no correct answer.

captureReview.addsUp.text: “{section}” ibhalwe njengamamaki angu-{printed} kodwa imibuzo yayo ihlanganisa {sum}.
captureReview.addsUp.from: “{section}” is printed as {printed} marks but its questions add up to {sum}.

captureReview.edited.text: Wenze ukulungiswa. Lokho okuphothulwayo yilokho okusesikrinini manje, hhayi lokho okwafundwa efayeleni.
captureReview.edited.from: You have made corrections. What gets committed is what is on this screen now, not what was read out of the file.

captureReview.summary.text: Imibuzo engu-{questions} · amamaki angu-{marks} · {app} kumakwa yisistimu
captureReview.summary.from: {questions} questions · {marks} marks · {app} marked by the App

captureReview.unknownOne.text: I-{codes} akuyona umbandela kule ziqu, ngakho ngeke ixhunywe. Lungisa amakhodi angenhla uma kuyiphutha lokuthayipha.
captureReview.unknownOne.from: {codes} is not a criterion on this qualification, so it will not be linked. Correct the codes above if that is a typo.

captureReview.unknown.text: I-{codes} akuyona imibandela kule ziqu, ngakho ngeke ixhunywe. Lungisa amakhodi angenhla uma kuyiphutha lokuthayipha.
captureReview.unknown.from: {codes} are not criteria on this qualification, so they will not be linked. Correct the codes above if that is a typo.

captureReview.acknowledgeOne.text: Ngifundile into e-1 esele ngenhla futhi ngifuna ukuphothula noma kunjalo. Lokhu kurekhodwa egameni lami.
captureReview.acknowledgeOne.from: I have read the 1 outstanding item above and want to commit anyway. This is recorded against my name.

captureReview.acknowledge.text: Ngifundile izinto ezisele ezingu-{count} ngenhla futhi ngifuna ukuphothula noma kunjalo. Lokhu kurekhodwa egameni lami.
captureReview.acknowledge.from: I have read the {count} outstanding items above and want to commit anyway. This is recorded against my name.

captureReview.responsibility.text: Ukuqinisekisa kuyamukela umthwalo wemfanelo wayo yonke impendulo elungile kuleli phepha. Igama lakho lihlala kulo.
captureReview.responsibility.from: Confirming accepts responsibility for every correct answer in this paper. Your name stays on it.

captureReview.swapped.from: The paper and the guide look swapped

captureReview.swappedNote.text: Akukho okunye okushiwo, ngoba konke okunye kulandela lokhu. Qala kabusha ngephepha lomfundi njengephepha nomhlahlandlela womhloli njengomhlahlandlela.
captureReview.swappedNote.from: Nothing else is listed, because everything else follows from this. Start again with the learner's paper as the paper and the assessor guide as the guide.

captureReview.fixNote.text: Zilungise ngezansi, noma uzifunde uthi ufuna ukuqhubeka noma kunjalo.
captureReview.fixNote.from: Correct these below, or read them and say you want to go on anyway.

captureReview.clearNote.text: Umbuzo ngamunye isistimu ezowumaka unempendulo, futhi isigaba ngasinye sihlanganisa lokho esikuphrintayo.
captureReview.clearNote.from: Every question the App will mark has an answer, and every section adds up to what it prints.

captureReview.materialNote.text: Idokhumenti ifundwe kahle. Lezi yizinto ngephepha kuphela umlobi walo angazinquma.
captureReview.materialNote.from: The document was read correctly. These are things about the paper that only its author can decide.

imports.intro.text: Yonke ifolda efundiwe, nokuthi kwenzekeni kuyo. Ukufunda entsha kuqala lapho umsebenzi ukhona, eziqwini, enkambeni noma empahleni oyakhayo, hhayi lapha.
imports.intro.from: Every folder that has been read, and what became of it. Reading a new one starts where the work is, on the qualification, course or material you are building, rather than here.

imports.noExtension.from: You have not set up an AI extension

imports.noExtensionNote.text: Kuyakhethwa futhi kungeyakho hhayi eyetenenti: ilungu ngalinye labasebenzi lisetha elalo, ngokubhalisa kwalo.
imports.noExtensionNote.from: It is optional and yours rather than the tenant's: every member of staff sets up their own, with their own subscription.

imports.readNote.text: Kugcinwa noma kuphothuliwe noma kulahliwe. Lokho okuphakanyisiwe bese kwenqatshwa yikho okwenza noma ubani ahlulele ukuthi ukufunda kuthembekile yini.
imports.readNote.from: Kept whether committed or discarded. What was proposed and then rejected is how anybody judges whether a reading is worth trusting.

imports.byPlatform.from: read by the platform, no AI involved

imports.backFolders.from: ← Back to the folders that have been read

imports.contentsNote.text: Konke okutholiwe, nalokho okwenziwe ngakho. Ama-PDF namadokhumenti e-Word aguqulwa ngesikhipha esifanayo esisetshenziswa yipulatifomu yonke, ukuze imodeli ifunde kanye lokho okuzokufunda ukufaka.
imports.contentsNote.from: Everything found, and what was done with it. PDFs and Word documents are converted with the same extractor the rest of the platform uses, so the model reads exactly what Capture would.

imports.proposesNote.text: Konke endaweni eyodwa. Izixwayiso yizo ezibalulekile: zifunde ngaphambi kwanoma yini.
imports.proposesNote.from: Everything in one place. The warnings are the part that matters: read those before anything else.

proposal.fromBlueprint.text: Kufundwe efayeleni lohlaka lwefolda uqobo. Ukwakheka okungezansi yilokho kanye ifayela elikushoyo: akukho okuqagelwe, futhi akukho modeli ebuziwe.
proposal.fromBlueprint.from: Read from the folder's own blueprint file. The structure below is exactly what that file says: nothing was inferred, and no model was asked.

proposal.fromDocuments.text: Kufundwe emadokhumentini yimodeli. Hlola ngokumelene nedokhumenti yekharikhulamu ngaphambi kokuphothula.
proposal.fromDocuments.from: Read from the documents by the model. Check it against the curriculum document before committing.

proposal.byName.text: Kufayelwe ngegama. Akukho hlaka nemodeli ebandakanyekile: idokhumenti ngayinye iye lapho igama layo lisho ukuthi ingeyakhe, futhi ikharikhulamu ayithintiwe.
proposal.byName.from: Filed by name. No blueprint and no model were involved: each document went where its filename says it belongs, and the curriculum is untouched.

proposal.unitsNamed.text: Amayunithi okufunda angu-{count} aqanjwe ngamagama efayela awo.
proposal.unitsNamed.from: {count} study units are named by their filenames.

proposal.nothingChanged.text: Akukho mojuli, sihloko noma mbandela okungezwa noma okushintshwa yilokhu.
proposal.nothingChanged.from: No module, topic or criterion is added or changed by this.

proposal.counts.text: amamojuli angu-{modules}, izihloko ezingu-{topics}, izici ezingu-{elements}, imibandela engu-{criteria}, amayunithi okufunda angu-{units}, amadokhumenti angu-{documents}
proposal.counts.from: {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} elements, {criteria} criteria, {units} study units, {documents} documents

proposal.withheld.from: {withheld} withheld from learners, {visible} visible to them.

proposal.withheldNote.text: Amamemorandamu, imihlahlandlela yezimpendulo namaphepha okuhlola okuphetha avinjelwe noma ubani ongenalo ilungelo lokuhlola.
proposal.withheldNote.from: Memoranda, answer guides and summative papers are withheld from anybody without the right to assess.

proposal.unknownOne.text: E-1 ayikwazanga ukuqashelwa egameni layo futhi ifayelwe ku-“okunye”, okubonakala kubo bonke.
proposal.unknownOne.from: 1 could not be recognised from its name and is filed as “other”, which is visible to everyone.

proposal.unknown.text: Ezingu-{count} azikwazanga ukuqashelwa emagameni azo futhi zifayelwe ku-“okunye”, okubonakala kubo bonke.
proposal.unknown.from: {count} could not be recognised from their names and are filed as “other”, which is visible to everyone.

proposal.unknownNote.text: Kufanele ubheke ngezansi ngaphambi kokuphothula: umhlahlandlela wezimpendulo onegama elingaziwa yileyo mithetho ungaba lapha.
proposal.unknownNote.from: Worth a look below before committing: an answer guide named in a way these rules do not know would be here.

proposal.orAdd.from: Or add it to one already here

proposal.addNote.text: Ukuyengeza kokuseyikhona lapha akuthinti lutho olukhona futhi kufaka kuphela okusilele.
proposal.addNote.from: Adding it to one already here leaves everything that is there untouched and puts in only what is missing.

proposal.topUp.text: Kungeziwe eziqwini owaqale ngazo. Uhlu olungenhla yikho konke ifolda equkethe khona, hhayi konke okuzodalwa: noma yini esivele ilapha ishiywa injengoba injalo, futhi kungezwa kuphela okusilele. Utshelwa ngemva kwalokho ukuthi amaphi amamojuli ebeseyikhona.
proposal.topUp.from: Added to the qualification you started from. The list above is everything the folder holds, not everything that will be created: whatever is already here is left exactly as it is, and only what is missing is added. You are told afterwards which modules were already held.

proposal.filedCourse.from: Filed against the course you started from.

proposal.filedProgramme.from: Filed against the programme you started from.

proposal.filedQualification.from: Filed against the qualification you started from.

proposal.checks.text: Konke okungenhla kungena ngesikhathi esisodwa, ngokuhlolwa okufanayo okusebenza kunoma yini eyakhiwe ngesandla. Noma yini leyo mihlolo ekwenqabayo iyabikwa, ayishiywa ngokuthula.
proposal.checks.from: Everything above goes in at once, through the same checks that apply to anything built by hand. Whatever those checks turn away is reported rather than skipped quietly.

proposal.discardNote.text: Kugcinwa erekhodini. Lokho okuphakanyisiwe futhi kwenqatshwa yikho okwenza noma ubani ahlulele ukuthi isandiso sifanele yini.
proposal.discardNote.from: Kept on the record. What was proposed and rejected is how anybody judges whether the extension is worth having.

reports.programme.text: Uhlelo uqobo: lokho okungahlolwa yilutho, nemibuzo engasebenzi
reports.programme.from: The programme itself: what nothing tests, which questions are not working

reports.coverageNote.text: Kubalwa kuzitifiketi, hhayi ekuqedweni kwenkambo. Ukuqeda kusho ukuthi othile ufinyelele ekugcineni kwempahla; isitifiketi sisho ukuthi kwenziwe ukwahlulela futhi, lapho kudingeka, kwalinganiswa ngokuzimela.
reports.coverageNote.from: Counted from certificates, not course completions. A completion means somebody reached the end of the material; a certificate means a judgement was made and, where required, independently moderated.

reports.singleNote.text: Kubanjwe umuntu oyedwa kuphela: {codes}. Uma lowo muntu eshiya, ikhono lihamba naye.
reports.singleNote.from: Held by one person only: {codes}. If that person leaves, the capability goes with them.

reports.nobodyEnrolled.from: Nobody is enrolled on anything yet.

progReport.intro.text: Imibuzo emibili ebonakala ibhekise kubafundi kodwa akunjalo: yini engahlolwa yilutho, nemibuzo engasebenzi.
progReport.intro.from: Two questions that look like they are about learners and are not: what nothing assesses, and which questions are not working.

progReport.untestedNote.text: Umbandela ongahlolwa yimibuzo yokuhlola okuphetha akakwazi ukufinyelelwa muntu, noma enze kahle kangakanani. Uvimbela wonke umfundi kulezi ziqu, futhi akukho okunye epulatifomini okusho lokho.
progReport.untestedNote.from: A criterion no summative question assesses cannot be achieved by anybody, however well they do. It holds up every learner on the qualification, and nothing else in the platform says so.

progReport.noCriteria.text: Lezi ziqu azinayo imibandela yokuhlola efakiwe okwamanje.
progReport.noCriteria.from: This qualification has no assessment criteria captured yet.

progReport.allTested.text: Yonke imibandela engu-{count} ihlolwa okungenani ngumbuzo owodwa wokuhlola okuphetha.
progReport.allTested.from: Every one of the {count} criteria is tested by at least one summative question.

progReport.someUntested.text: Imibandela engu-{untested} kwengu-{count} ayihlolwa yimibuzo yokuhlola okuphetha.
progReport.someUntested.from: {untested} of {count} criteria are not tested by any summative question.

progReport.misleading.text: {count} kuyo ivela encwadini yomsebenzi, okwakhayo futhi okungafakazeli lutho.
progReport.misleading.from: {count} of those appear in a workbook, which is developmental and evidences nothing.

progReport.questionsNote.text: Imizamo yokuqala kuphela, ngoba ukuphinda ukuhlala kukala okunye. Akukho okuphawulwa ngaphansi kwemizamo engu-{minimum}: umbuzo abantu ababili abawuphendule ukhuluma ngaba bantu ababili.
progReport.questionsNote.from: First attempts only, because a re-sit measures something else. Nothing is flagged below {minimum} attempts: a question two people have answered tells you about those two people.

progReport.noQuestions.from: That assessment has no questions yet.

progReport.worthLook.from: {flagged} of {count} questions are worth a look.

progReport.nobody.text: Cishe akekho ongawuphendula lo. Noma umbuzo awucacile noma lokho ohlola khona akuzange kufundiswe.
progReport.nobody.from: Almost nobody can answer this. Either the question is unclear or what it tests was never taught.

progReport.everybody.text: Wonke umuntu uthola amamaki aphelele, ngakho awehlukanisi lutho.
progReport.everybody.from: Everybody gets full marks, so it distinguishes nothing.

statutory.intro.text: Imiphumela yeDathabhesi Yamarekhodi Abafundi Kazwelonke ye-SAQA, kanye Nohlelo Lwamakhono Endaweni Yokusebenza noMbiko Onyaka Wokuqeqeshwa. Konke kuhlolwa lapha ngaphambi kokuya noma kuphi, ngoba imiphumela enqatshwa ngenxa yenombolo yobunikazi ethayiphwe kabi ibiza umjikelezo wonke.
statutory.intro.from: The SAQA National Learners' Records Database return, and the Workplace Skills Plan and Annual Training Report. Everything is checked here before it goes anywhere, because a return rejected for a mistyped identity number costs a full cycle.

statutory.locked.text: Amafayela ahlala ekhiyiwe kuze kulungiswe izinkinga eziyisithiyo ezingezansi. Ukuthumela umbiko ozonqatshwa kuchitha umjikelezo kubo bonke abafundi abakuwo.
statutory.locked.from: The files stay locked until the blocking problems below are fixed. Submitting a return that will be rejected wastes a cycle for every learner in it.

statutory.worthFixingNote.text: Lokhu akumisi umbiko, kodwa i-NLRD iphawula imininingwane yezibalo yabantu engaphelele futhi i-SETA ingase iyibuze.
statutory.worthFixingNote.from: These do not stop the return, but the NLRD flags incomplete demographic data and a SETA may query it.

statutory.wsp.text: Uhlelo Lwamakhono Endaweni Yokusebenza noMbiko Onyaka Wokuqeqeshwa
statutory.wsp.from: Workplace Skills Plan and Annual Training Report

statutory.wspNote.text: Umsebenzi wokuqeqeshwa ngokwemisebenzi, njengoba umbiko we-SETA uhlelwa.
statutory.wspNote.from: Training activity by occupation, as a SETA return is organised.

statutory.noOfoOne.text: Umuntu o-1 ongenayo ikhodi ye-OFO: {names}. Usabalwa, kodwa umbiko we-SETA uqoqa ngokwemisebenzi.
statutory.noOfoOne.from: 1 person has no OFO code: {names}. They are still counted, but a SETA return groups by occupation.

statutory.noOfo.text: Abantu abangu-{count} abangenayo ikhodi ye-OFO: {names}. Basabalwa, kodwa umbiko we-SETA uqoqa ngokwemisebenzi.
statutory.noOfo.from: {count} people have no OFO code: {names}. They are still counted, but a SETA return groups by occupation.

statutory.mapping.text: Ukufaniswa kwezinsimu kulandela uhlaka lokugunyazwa (Umuntu 27, Ukubhalisa 28, Impumelelo 29, Umhlinzeki 30). Qinisekisa isakhiwo sefayela le-Edu.Dex esiqondile ngokuqhathanisa nokucaciswa kwamanje kwe-SAQA ngaphambi kokuthumela bukhoma.
statutory.mapping.from: Field mapping follows the accreditation framework (Person 27, Enrolment 28, Achievement 29, Provider 30). Confirm the exact Edu.Dex file layout against the current SAQA specification before a live submission.

enrolNotify.intro.text: I-QCTO kumele ibikelwe ukuthi laba bafundi babhaliswe, phakathi kwezinsuku zokusebenza ezingamashumi amabili nanye ngemva kosuku lwesingeniso kuziqu nezinhlanu kuhlelo lwamakhono. Amaholide kawonke-wonke awabalwa, futhi isikhathi sibalwa kusukela osukwini lwesingeniso hhayi ekubhalisweni noma ekukhokhweni.
enrolNotify.intro.from: The QCTO has to be told that these learners were enrolled, within twenty-one working days of induction for a qualification and five for a skills programme. Public holidays do not count, and the clock runs from the induction date rather than from enrolment or payment.

enrolNotify.overdueNote.text: Zithumele noma kunjalo. Isaziso esibuya sikhona kanye nencazelo siyinkinga ehlukile kunalesi asisenzanga muntu.
enrolNotify.overdueNote.from: Still submit these. A late notification with an explanation is a different problem to one nobody made.

enrolNotify.soonNote.text: Izinsuku zokusebenza ezinhlanu noma ngaphansi ezisele.
enrolNotify.soonNote.from: Five working days or fewer remaining.

enrolNotify.noInductionNote.text: Isikhathi sabo asikaqali, ngakho asikho isikhathi sokugcina ekumele sibikwe. Nika isingeniso seqoqo usuku, noma ubanikeze esabo ngezansi.
enrolNotify.noInductionNote.from: Their clock has not started, so there is no deadline to report. Date the cohort's induction session, or give them their own below.

enrolNotify.draftNote.text: Bonke abethulwe ngosuku olulodwa bahamba ndawonye. Ofike kamuva udinga esakhe.
enrolNotify.draftNote.from: Everybody inducted on the same day goes together. A late joiner needs their own.

enrolNotify.ownInductionNote.text: Umuntu ofike ngemva kokuqala kweqoqo unesingeniso sakhe, ifomu lakhe lokubhalisa nokuthunyelwa kwakhe.
enrolNotify.ownInductionNote.from: Somebody who joined after the cohort started has their own induction, their own enrolment form and their own submission.

enrolNotify.split.text: Lokhu okuthunyelwayo kuhlanganisa uhlelo lwamakhono neziqu. Kuya emakheli ahlukene, ngakho kufanele kuhlukaniswe kuthunyelwe kabili.
enrolNotify.split.from: This submission covers both a skills programme and a qualification. They go to different addresses, so it has to be split and sent twice.

enrolNotify.askAck.text: Cela ukuqinisekiswa, bese ukurekhoda lapha uma sekubuya.
enrolNotify.askAck.from: Ask for an acknowledgement, and record it here when it comes back.

enrolNotify.nobodyOutstanding.text: Akekho osalindile. Bonke abafundi abanosuku lwesingeniso sebaziswe.
enrolNotify.nobodyOutstanding.from: Nobody is outstanding. Every learner with an induction date has been notified about.

enrolNotify.clockFrom.from: The clock runs from this day.

enrolNotify.kind.full.text: Iziqu ezigcwele: izinsuku zokusebenza ezingamashumi amabili nanye

enrolNotify.kind.part.text: Ingxenye yeziqu: izinsuku zokusebenza ezingamashumi amabili nanye

enrolNotify.noneThatDay.text: Akekho osalindile owethulwe ngalolo suku. Shintsha usuku, noma unike ofike kamuva isingeniso sakhe ngezansi.
enrolNotify.noneThatDay.from: Nobody outstanding was inducted on that date. Change the date, or give a late joiner their own induction below.

enrolNotify.nobodyWaiting.from: Nobody is waiting on an induction date.

paths.intro.text: Ama-{courses} amaningana axhunywe ngokulandelana: {programme} yomqashwa omusha, noma ukuqalisa uhlaka lonke lwamakhono. Umfundi unikezwa {course} elandelayo ngokuzenzakalelayo uma eqeda elandulele.
paths.intro.from: Several {courses} chained into a sequence: a new starter {programme}, or a full competency framework roll-out. A learner is given the next {course} automatically as they finish the one before it.

paths.noneAuthor.text: {programme} ixhuma {courses} ngokulandelana, ngakho umfundi unikezwa elandelayo uma eqeda elandulele. Akha {courses} kuqala: {programme} iwuchungechunge lwazo.
paths.noneAuthor.from: A {programme} chains {courses} into an order, so a learner is given the next one as they finish the one before. Build the {courses} first: a {programme} is a sequence of them.

paths.noneReader.text: Akukakhiwa lutho okwamanje. Lapho sekukhiwe, {courses} owenza ngokulandelana kuzoba lapha. Ukwakha okunye kungumsebenzi womlobi.
paths.noneReader.from: None has been built yet. When one has been, the {courses} you work through in order will be here. Building one is an author's job.

paths.empty.text: Akukho {courses} kukho okwamanje: umfundi onikezwe le {programme} wayengathola lutho. Yivule ukuze wengeze.
paths.empty.from: No {courses} in it yet: a learner given this {programme} would receive nothing. Open it to add some.

paths.folderNote.text: Khetha ifolda lapho le mpahla ikhona futhi konke okukuyo, kuhlanganise namafolda ayo amancane, kuyafundwa, kufayelwe futhi kufakwe inkomba. Ubona lokho okwakufayelwa ngaphambi kokuba kubhalwe lutho.
paths.folderNote.from: Choose the folder this material lives in and everything in it, including its subfolders, is read, filed and indexed. You see what it would file before anything is written.

paths.folderLabel.from: Its folder, from your own computer

paths.folderHint.text: Imihlahlandlela, amabhuku omsebenzi, izinqubomgomo namathempulethi kufayelwa kuyo futhi umbhalo wawo ufakwa inkomba ukuze kusesekwe.
paths.folderHint.from: Guides, workbooks, policies and templates are filed against it and their text indexed so they can be searched.

paths.folderHint2.text: Uhlaka alwakhiwa lapha: isimo salo sakhiwa ngokungeza {courses} kulo ngenhla. Lokhu kufayela lokho okukuyo.
paths.folderHint2.from: Structure is not created from here: its own shape is built by adding {courses} to it above. This files what it holds.

paths.drive.from: Or from a drive you have connected

paths.driveNote.text: Ifolda efanayo, efundwa lapho isivele ikhona. Igcina endaweni efanayo: isihlongozo okumele sihlolwe ngaphambi kokuba kubhalwe lutho.
paths.driveNote.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

paths.noSteps.text: Akukho okukhona okwamanje. Engeza ngokulandelana abafundi okufanele bakuthathe.
paths.noSteps.from: Nothing in it yet. Add them in the order learners should take them.

paths.opensFirst.text: Ivuleka ngokushesha uma othile engena kuyo.
paths.opensFirst.from: Opens as soon as somebody joins.

paths.opensAfter.from: Opens when the step before it is finished.

paths.opensNow.from: Opens straight away, alongside the others.

paths.locked.from: Locked until the step before it is finished

paths.lockedNote.text: Susa uphawu ukuze kuthathwe noma kunini.
paths.lockedNote.from: Untick for one that can be taken at any point.

paths.allIn.from: Everything published is already in it.

paths.published.text: Lokhu kushicilelwe futhi abantu bayakwenza, ngakho izinyathelo zako zimisiwe. Ukushintsha ukulandelana ngaphansi komuntu kungashintsha lokho asevele etshelwe ukuthi akwenze.
paths.published.from: This is published and people are working through it, so its steps are fixed. Changing the order underneath somebody would alter what they had already been told to do.

paths.publishNote.from: Everything in it has to be published first.

paths.firstOnly.text: Kuvuleka kuphela owokuqala. Abanye bafika njengoba ngamunye eqedwa.
paths.firstOnly.from: Only the first opens. The rest arrive as each is finished.

badges.intro.text: Ukuqashelwa okufika ngosuku umsebenzi uqedwa, kunokuba kube ngezinyanga kamuva lapho isitifiketi sangaphandle sifika. Ibheji alisiyona iziqu futhi ipulatifomu ayilivumeli ukuthi libukeke njengazo: akukho nombolo ye-SAQA, akukho amakhredithi, futhi ikhasi lokuqinisekisa lisho ngokusobala ukuthi yini nokuthi hhayi yini.
badges.intro.from: Recognition that arrives on the day the work is finished, rather than months later when the external certificate comes through. A badge is not a qualification and the platform never lets it look like one: no SAQA identifier, no credits, and a verification page that says plainly what it is and what it is not.

badges.target.default.text: Noma yini, uma kungasethiwe okuqondile kakhulu
badges.target.default.from: Anything, when nothing more specific is set

badges.nothingNote.text: Alikho ibheji eliklanyiwe, ngakho ukuqeda inkambo noma iziqu okwamanje akunikezi lutho. Ukuklama elilodwa ngezansi kwanele: qala ngebheji lomhlinzeki uqobo uma ungafuni elihlukile into ngayinye.
badges.nothingNote.from: No badge has been designed, so finishing a course or a qualification currently awards nothing. Designing one below is enough: start with the provider's own badge if you do not want a different one for each thing.

badges.legitimate.text: Lokhu kungukukhetha okufanele hhayi iphutha. Ipulatifomu ngeke iqambe elilodwa.
badges.legitimate.from: This is a legitimate choice rather than a fault. The platform will not invent one.

badges.kind.default.text: Noma yini, uma kungasethiwe okuqondile kakhulu
badges.kind.default.from: Anything, when nothing more specific is set

badges.designNote.text: Umumo, imibala emibili nophawu. Akukho okumele kulayishwe futhi akekho okumele umchazele.
badges.designNote.from: A shape, two colours and a symbol. Nothing to upload and nobody to brief.

badges.allHave.text: Konke sekunebheji. Yekisa elilodwa ukuze uklame ibheji elihlukile lento efanayo.
badges.allHave.from: Everything already has a badge. Retire one to design a different badge for the same thing.

badges.says.text: Lokho elikushoyo, kumfundi nakunoma ubani amboniseka lona (kukhethwa)
badges.says.from: What it says, for the learner and anybody they show it to (optional)

badges.saysHint.text: Uqedile imojuli yomsebenzi wezandla mayelana nokusebenza ezindaweni eziphakeme, ehlolwe ngokwemibandela yekharikhulamu.
badges.saysHint.from: Completed the practical module on working at heights, assessed against the curriculum criteria.

badges.retireTitle.from: Stop awarding {name}. Everybody who has it keeps it.

templates.intro.text: Amadokhumenti akhiqizwa yi-{name}. Ukuthi ngamunye ufundeka futhi ubukeke kanjani kungokwakho: bhala inguqulo yakho futhi ipulatifomu iyikhiqiza kuyo esikhundleni sesakhiwo sayo. Lokho okudingwa umlawuli kungezwa ngemva kwakho futhi akunakushintshwa, ngoba leyo ngxenye ayisiyo eyomhlinzeki ukuyishintsha.
templates.intro.from: The documents {name} produces. How each one reads and looks is yours: write your own version and the platform produces it from that instead of its own layout. What a regulator requires is added after yours and cannot be edited, because that part is not the provider's to change.

templates.goesTo.statement_of_results.text: Umfundi, oyithatha ayise ekhaya lokuhlola nedokhumenti yakhe yobunikazi.
templates.goesTo.statement_of_results.from: The learner, who carries it to the assessment centre with their identity document.

templates.goesTo.certificate.from: The learner, and whoever they show it to.

templates.goesTo.workplace_statement.text: Ifayela lomfundi, elisayinwe umqeqeshi kumqashi obamukelayo.
templates.goesTo.workplace_statement.from: The learner's file, signed by a coach at the host employer.

templates.goesTo.enrolment_form.text: Ifayelwa njengobufakazi, futhi inikezwa umqapheli we-QCTO lapho evakashile.
templates.goesTo.enrolment_form.from: Filed as evidence, and handed to a QCTO monitor on a visit.

templates.producesNote.text: Noma yini engenayo inguqulo yakho isebenzisa isakhiwo sepulatifomu, okuyidokhumenti esebenzayo hhayi indawo yokugcina isikhundla.
templates.producesNote.from: Anything without your own version uses the platform's layout, which is a working document rather than a placeholder.

templates.writeNote.text: Qala ngesakhiwo sepulatifomu bese usiguqula sibe esakho. Zonke izinsimu idokhumenti engazithwala zibhalwe eduze kwesihleli nesibonelo sangempela sokuthi zibukeka kanjani.
templates.writeNote.from: Start from the platform's layout and edit it down into yours. Every field the document can carry is listed beside the editor with a real example of what it looks like.

templates.supplied.from: Documents you supply rather than lay out

templates.suppliedNote.text: Akuwona wonke amadokhumenti angamathempulethi ipulatifomu ewagcwalisayo.
templates.suppliedNote.from: Not every document is a template the platform fills in.

templates.policiesNote.text: ileta yakho yokugunyazwa, izinqubomgomo nezivumelwano, kulayishwe futhi kugcinwe kunokukhiqizwa.
templates.policiesNote.from: your accreditation letter, policies and agreements, uploaded and retained rather than generated.

templates.fisaNote.text: abhalwe ngumhloli wakho kanye futhi alinganiswe ngaphambi kokuba muntu awahlale, ngakho abhalwa hhayi ukwenziwa ngethempulethi.
templates.fisaNote.from: written by your own examiner and moderated before anybody sits them, so they are authored rather than templated.

templates.curriculumNote.text: amadokhumenti eziqu ashicilelwe ipulatifomu iwafunda ukuze yakhe ikharikhulamu.
templates.curriculumNote.from: the published qualification documents the platform reads to build a curriculum from.

tracker.all.from: Every cohort, including those finished and cancelled.

tracker.note.text: Kufundwa emarekhodini hhayi kugcinwe ngesandla, ngakho ngeke kuphikisane nepulatifomu ekubikelayo.
tracker.note.from: Read from the records rather than kept by hand, so it cannot disagree with the platform it reports on.

tracker.none.text: Awekho amaqoqo okwamanje. Iqoqo yilo okuxhomeke kulo uhlelo lwesikhathi, irejista nombiko womthetho.
tracker.none.from: No cohorts yet. A cohort is what a schedule, a register and a statutory return all hang from.

dictionary.intro.text: Incazelo evunyelwene yegama ngalinye elisetshenziswa kule platifomu, emadokhumentini ayo nasempahleni yayo yokufunda. Igama ngalinye lisho ukuthi ngubani onelo. Lapho isiphathimandla silichaza, silisebenzisa njengaso futhi isiphathimandla siyabizwa. Lapho igama liyelethu, singalishintsha. Lapho lisebenza nje ngokujwayelekile, akufanele licashunwe njengesidingo.
dictionary.intro.from: The settled meaning of every term used across this platform, its documents and its learning material. Each entry says who owns the word. Where an authority defines it, we use it as they do and the body is named. Where the word is ours, we can change it. Where it is simply common usage, it should never be cited as a requirement.

dictionary.searchHint.from: A term, an abbreviation, or a word in a definition

dictionary.meaning.authority.text: Kuchazwe yisiphathimandla. Yisebenzise njengabo: ukushintsha incazelo kubeka okuthunyelwayo engozini.
dictionary.meaning.authority.from: Defined by an authority. Use it as they do: changing the meaning puts a submission at risk.

dictionary.meaning.platform.text: Leli yigama lale platifomu uqobo. Kungelethu ukulishintsha; akukho siphathimandla esililaya.
dictionary.meaning.platform.from: This platform's own word for it. Ours to change; no authority prescribes it.

dictionary.meaning.practice.text: Ukusetshenziswa okujwayelekile embonini, akunamnikazi oyedwa. Ungakucashuni njengesidingo.
dictionary.meaning.practice.from: Common usage across the sector, with no single owner. Do not cite it as a requirement.

dictionary.none.text: Akukho okufanayo. Uma igama lingekho futhi lingelinye esilisebenzisayo, lifanele ukuba lapha: sitshele futhi lizongezwa ekukhishweni okulandelayo.
dictionary.none.from: Nothing matches. If a term is missing and it is one we use, it belongs here: say so and it will be added in the next release.

feedbackForm.intro.text: {cohort}. Izimpendulo zibikwa kanyekanye nezabo bonke abanye, hhayi eyodwa ngayodwa. Kuthatha cishe imizuzu emibili, futhi yikhona kuphela okushintsha indlela iqoqo elilandelayo eliqhutshwa ngayo.
feedbackForm.intro.from: {cohort}. Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. It takes about two minutes, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

feedbackReport.ratingsNote.text: Isilinganiso esisuka ku-1 (angivumelani nakancane) kuya ku-5 (ngiyavuma kakhulu). Isilinganiso sezimpendulo ezimbalwa siwumoya, hhayi isilinganiso esiqondile, ngakho inani lifakwe eduze kwaso.
feedbackReport.ratingsNote.from: Mean of 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree). A mean over few answers is a mood, not a measurement, so the count is beside it.

feedbackReport.saidNote.text: Kuboniswa kanyekanye futhi kungenamagama. Impendulo ngomhlahlandlela iba neqiniso kuphela uma umfundi ekholelwa ukuthi ngeke ifundwe emuva kuye eyodwa ngayodwa.
feedbackReport.saidNote.from: Shown together and without names. Feedback about a facilitator is only honest if the learner believes it will not be read back to them one by one.

feedbackReport.outstandingNote.text: Indawo eyodwa igama livela kuyo. Ukulandelela kudinga amagama; izimpendulo ezingenhla azizidingi.
feedbackReport.outstandingNote.from: The one place a name appears. Chasing needs them; the answers above do not.

conductPage.intro.text: Izikhalazo ezibekwe ngabafundi, nanoma ubani irejista elikhomba ukuthi uyekile ukufika. Izindaba zesiyalo zisekhasini lomfundi uqobo, lapho kunalo lonke irekhodi lakhe.
conductPage.intro.from: Grievances raised by learners, and anybody the register says has stopped turning up. Disciplinary matters sit on the learner's own page, where the rest of their record is.

conductPage.overdueNote.text: Isikhalazo siqinisekiswa phakathi kwezinsuku zokusebenza ezingu-{days}. Lezi sezidlulile.
conductPage.overdueNote.from: A grievance is acknowledged within {days} working days. These are past that.

conductPage.grievancesNote.text: Kubekwa ngumfundi mayelana nokuphathwa, izimo, noma noma yini enye emthintayo. Kwahlukaniswe nezikhalo, ezimayelana nomphumela futhi ziya kumlinganisi.
conductPage.grievancesNote.from: Raised by a learner about treatment, conditions, or anything else affecting them. Kept apart from appeals, which are about a result and go to the moderator.

conductPage.abscondedNote.text: Izinsuku ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ezilandelanayo zokuqeqeshwa engekho engazisanga muntu. Kufundwa erejistini hhayi kugcinwe, ngakho ukulungisa uphawu kushintsha impendulo ngokushesha. Ukungabikho okurekhodwe njengokuxolelwe kungukuxhumana, futhi kuphula uchungechunge.
conductPage.abscondedNote.from: Two or more consecutive training days absent with no word. Read off the register rather than stored, so correcting a mark changes the answer at once. An absence recorded as excused is communication, and breaks the run.

conductPage.nobody.text: Akekho. Wonke umuntu uyafika noma usetshele othile ukuthi kungani engafiki.
conductPage.nobody.from: Nobody. Everybody is either turning up or has told somebody why not.

conductPage.actOn.text: Uhlu okumele kwenziwe ngalo, hhayi isinqumo. Ukuxhumana nomfundi, ukubhalela umxhasi nokukhipha isaziso sokuhlosa ukuphelisa konke yizinto ezenziwa umuntu.
conductPage.actOn.from: A list to act on, never a decision. Contacting the learner, writing to the sponsor and issuing a notice of intention to terminate are all things a person does.

grievance.decisionHint.text: Lokho okutholakele nalokho okuzokwenziwa. Lokhu kuya kumfundi ngokubhaliwe.
grievance.decisionHint.from: What was found and what will be done. This goes to the learner in writing.

grievance.impartial.text: Umphenyi kumele abe umuntu okungesiye osolwa esikhalazweni. Ukuqoka ofunwe ukukhalazwa ngaye umfundi kuyanqatshwa, ngoba “umuntu ohlonziwe ongachemi” yilokho inqubo ekuthembisayo futhi isonto elinabasebenzi abambalwa yilona lapho inqubo iphulwa khona.
grievance.impartial.from: The investigator must be somebody the grievance is not about. Naming one the learner has complained about is refused, because “a designated impartial person” is what the procedure promises and a short-staffed week is exactly when it gets broken.

access.deniedTitle.from: You do not have access to this

access.deniedNote.text: Ungenile, kodwa lokhu akukona okwakho ukukubona: kungaba kungokomunye umuntu, noma kudinga indima i-akhawunti yakho engenayo. Uma kubonakala kungalungile, cela umphathi wakho ukuthi ahlole.
access.deniedNote.from: You are signed in, but this is not yours to see: either it belongs to someone else, or it needs a role your account does not hold. If you think that is wrong, ask your administrator to check.

access.unknownTitle.from: This address is not in use

access.unknownNote.text: Ayikho inhlangano esethwe kuleli kheli lewebhu, noma ukufinyelela kwayo kumisiwe. Hlola ikheli oliphiwe, noma uxhumane nalowo owahlela ukuqeqeshwa kwakho.
access.unknownNote.from: No organisation is set up at this web address, or its access has been suspended. Check the address you were given, or contact whoever arranged your training.

wpSetup.intro.text: Umfundi wenza isipiliyoni sokusebenza kumqashi, ebhekwa umuntu umqashi amnikezayo. Isivumelwano sirekhoda ukuthi ngubani lowo; ibhuku lokurekhoda lirekhoda lokho ikharikhulamu efuna ukuthi akwenze.
wpSetup.intro.from: A learner does work experience at an employer, supervised by somebody that employer provides. The agreement records who that is; the logbook records what the curriculum requires them to do.

wpSetup.emptyOne.text: Imojuli eyodwa yesipiliyoni sokusebenza ayinazo izidingo ezifakiwe.
wpSetup.emptyOne.from: 1 work experience module has no requirements captured.

wpSetup.empty.text: Amamojuli esipiliyoni sokusebenza angu-{count} awanazo izidingo ezifakiwe.
wpSetup.empty.from: {count} work experience modules have no requirements captured.

wpSetup.emptyNote.text: {codes}. Ibhuku lokurekhoda elakhiwe ngemojuli engenalutho lingafakazela lutho, ngakho lawa awakwazi ukuvulwa kuze kungeniswe imisebenzi yasemsebenzini yekharikhulamu, ulwazi lwendawo yokusebenza nobufakazi obuxhasayo.
wpSetup.emptyNote.from: {codes}. A logbook built from an empty module would attest to nothing, so those cannot be opened until the curriculum's work activities, workplace knowledge and supporting evidence have been imported.

wpSetup.noCoaches.text: Akekho ophethe indima Yomqeqeshi Wasemsebenzini okwamanje. Qala ngokungeza umphathi womfundi ngo-{people}: usebenzela umqashi, hhayi wena, futhi uzobona kuphela abafundi abaqokwe ezivumelwaneni zakhe.
wpSetup.noCoaches.from: Nobody holds the Workplace Coach role yet. Add the learner's supervisor through {people} first: they work for the employer, not for you, and they will only ever see the learners named on their own agreements.

wpSetup.ownCoach.text: Umfundi akakwazi ukuba ngumqeqeshi wakhe uqobo; idathabhesi iyakwenqaba.
wpSetup.ownCoach.from: The learner cannot be their own coach; the database refuses it.

wpSetup.designationNote.text: Kurekhodwe esivumelwaneni njengoba kunjalo namuhla, ukuze ukusayina kuqhubeke kusho ukuthi ubani osayine nasesikhundleni sini.
wpSetup.designationNote.from: Recorded on the agreement as it stands today, so the sign-off keeps saying who signed and in what capacity.

wpSetup.noAgreements.text: Azikabikho izivumelwano zasemsebenzini. Dala esisodwa ngenhla kuqala: ibhuku lokurekhoda lirekhoda umsebenzi owenziwe kumqashi oqokiwe ngaphansi komqeqeshi oqokiwe, ngakho alikwazi ukuba khona ngaphandle kwaso.
wpSetup.noAgreements.from: No workplace agreements yet. Create one above first: a logbook records work done at a named employer under a named coach, so it cannot exist without one.

wpSetup.generated.text: Ibhuku lokurekhoda likhiwa ngemisebenzi yasemsebenzini yekharikhulamu uqobo, ulwazi lwendawo yokusebenza nobufakazi obuxhasayo, ngakho alikwazi ukushiya isidingo.
wpSetup.generated.from: The logbook is generated from the curriculum's own work activities, workplace knowledge and supporting evidence, so it cannot omit a requirement.

enrolForm.intro.text: {provider} kumele ithumelele Umkhandlu Wekhwalithi Yamakhono Ezandla Nemisebenzi le mininingwane lapho ubhaliswa. Okuningi sekwaziwa futhi kuboniswe ngezansi; okusele yilokho okungeke kuphendulwe muntu ngaphandle kwakho. Ungagcina njengoba uqhubeka futhi ubuye kukho.
enrolForm.intro.from: {provider} has to send these details to the Quality Council for Trades and Occupations when you are enrolled. Most of it is already known and shown below; the rest is what nobody can answer except you. You can save as you go and come back to it.

enrolForm.onRecordNote.text: Tshela umqondisi wakho uma okunye kwalokhu kungalungile; akuyona eyakho ukukushintsha lapha.
enrolForm.onRecordNote.from: Tell your coordinator if any of this is wrong; it is not yours to change here.

enrolForm.doesNotAdd.from: Something here does not add up

enrolForm.idNote.text: Inombolo yobunikazi yaseNingizimu Afrika iphethe usuku lokuzalwa nobulili ngaphakathi kwayo, futhi i-QCTO ihlola ukuthi ziyavumelana. Ngokujwayelekile kuba yinombolo ethayiphwe kabi. Umqondisi wakho angakulungisa.
enrolForm.idNote.from: A South African identity number carries the date of birth and the gender inside it, and the QCTO checks that they agree. It is usually a mistyped digit. Your coordinator can correct it.

enrolForm.stillNote.text: Akukho okulahlekayo uma umisa phakathi nendlela. Lokhu yikho okungasekho ekuthunyelweni njengoba kunjalo.
enrolForm.stillNote.from: Nothing is lost if you stop partway. This is what would be missing from the submission as it stands.

enrolForm.completeNote.from: Everything the submission needs is here.

enrolForm.missingPrint.text: Izimpendulo ezingu-{count} zisalahlekile, ngakho leli fomu lizophrintwa linezikhala. Zidwetshwe efomini uqobo.
enrolForm.missingPrint.from: {count} answers are still missing, so this form will print with blanks. They are listed on the form itself.

enrolForm.completePrint.text: Kuphelele. Liphrinte, umfundi alisayine, bese ulifayela.
enrolForm.completePrint.from: Complete. Print it, have the learner sign it, and file it.

enrolForm.titleHint.from: Mr, Ms, Dr, and so on.

enrolForm.middleHint.text: Uma unalo. Lishiye lingenalutho uma ungenalo.
enrolForm.middleHint.from: If you have one. Leave it blank if not.

enrolForm.working.from: Are you working at the moment?

enrolForm.difficulty.from: How much difficulty does it cause?

enrolForm.difficultyHint.text: Kubuzwa ngoba ukukhubazeka kurekhodwe egameni lakho. I-QCTO iyakudinga kanye nakho.
enrolForm.difficultyHint.from: Asked because a disability is recorded against your name. The QCTO requires it alongside.

enrolForm.noId.text: Uma ungenayo inombolo yobunikazi yaseNingizimu Afrika
enrolForm.noId.from: If you do not have a South African identity number

enrolForm.instead.from: What you are enrolled on instead

enrolForm.post.text: Lapho iposi likufinyelela khona, uma kuyindawo ehlukile
enrolForm.post.from: Where post reaches you, if it is somewhere else

enrolForm.provinceHint.text: Lapho usebenza khona, okungesikho njalo lapho uhlala khona.
enrolForm.provinceHint.from: Where you work, which is not always where you live.

enrolForm.statssaHint.from: Your coordinator can look this one up if you do not know it.

enrolForm.flcNote.text: Kudingeka kuphela kuziqu zezinga le-NQF 3 noma 4. Lishiye lingenalutho uma kungekho obekucele.
enrolForm.flcNote.from: Only needed on a qualification at NQF level 3 or 4. Leave it blank if nobody has asked you for it.

enrolForm.agreedOn.text: Uvumile ngomhla ka-{date}. Lolo suku luyingxenye yerekhodi futhi alushintshi uma uhlela leli fomu.
enrolForm.agreedOn.from: You agreed on {date}. That date is part of the record and does not change if you edit this form.

enrolForm.agreedDate.text: Usuku ovuma ngalo lurekhodiwe, ngoba umbiko ucela kokubili.
enrolForm.agreedDate.from: The date you agree is recorded, because the return asks for both.

enrolForm.confirm.text: Gcina futhi uqinisekise ukuthi lokhu kulungile
enrolForm.confirm.from: Save and confirm these are right

records.intro.text: Uhlelo Lokuphatha Ikhwalithi nezinqubomgomo zalo, amaleta okugunyazwa, izinkontileka, namadokhumenti omthetho afana nomhlahlandlela we-PAIA: konke umhlinzeki akuphethe okungengokomfundi oyedwa noma iziqu eziyodwa. Ukungenisa ifolda yeziqu kufayela ngokuzenzakalelayo izinqubomgomo zayo ze-QMS lapha.
records.intro.from: The Quality Management System and its policies, accreditation letters, contracts, and statutory documents like the PAIA manual: everything the provider holds that does not belong to one learner or one qualification. Importing a qualification folder files its QMS policies here automatically.

records.introManage.text: Kuphinde kubonise lokho okufinyelele ekupheleni kwesikhathi sako sokugcinwa.
records.introManage.from: It also shows what has reached the end of its retention period.

records.expiringNote.text: Isitifiketi sokukhululwa entelweni esiphelelwe yisikhathi siyinto engaqashelwa muntu kuze kube yisonto lapho sidingeka khona.
records.expiringNote.from: An expired tax clearance is the kind of thing nobody notices until the week it is needed.

records.libraryNote.text: Izinguqulo ezishintshelwe zigcinwa, ngoba inqubomgomo eyayilawula ngoMashi yilena ukuhlolwa kwangoMashi okuyibuzayo.
records.libraryNote.from: Superseded versions are kept, because the policy that governed in March is the one an audit of March asks about.

records.nothingManage.text: Ileta yokugunyazwa yiyona efanele ukufakwa kuqala.
records.nothingManage.from: The accreditation letter is the one worth putting in first.

records.retentionNote.text: Kubalwa kusukela osukwini lokuqinisekiswa, phezu kwesikhathi sokugcinwa kule tenenti. Akukho lapha okugcinwe ku-archive noma okucekelwe phansi: ipulatifomu isho ukuthi yini ekufanele futhi umuntu unquma.
records.retentionNote.from: Counted from the certification date, over the retention period on this tenant. Nothing here has been archived or destroyed: the platform says what is due and a person decides.

records.registerNote.text: Konke okunqunywe ngerekhodi elidlule usuku lalo, nokuthi ngubani onqume. Irekhodi elinyamalale kungaziwa lisibi kunelelugcinwe isikhathi eside kakhulu.
records.registerNote.from: Everything decided about a record past its date, with who decided it. A record that quietly disappeared is worse than one kept too long.

records.replacesNote.text: Lena ekushintshelwayo iyagcinwa futhi ifakwe uphawu lokushintshelwa. Inqubomgomo eyayilawula ngoMashi yilena ukuhlolwa kwangoMashi okuyibuzayo.
records.replacesNote.from: The one it replaces is kept and marked superseded. The policy that governed in March is what an audit of March asks about.

records.descriptionHint.from: What it is, if the title does not say

records.anybody.from: Anybody signed in may read this

records.anybodyNote.text: Kusebenza emadokhumentini omthetho. Umhlahlandlela womfundi uhlala ubonisiwe kubafundi; izinqubomgomo, izinkontileka, ukugunyazwa namadokhumenti okusebenza awabonisiwe neze.
records.anybodyNote.from: Applies to statutory documents. A learner guide is always shown to learners; policies, contracts, accreditation and operational documents never are.

records.archive.from: Archive: move it out of the way

offline.intro.text: Landa lokho okudingayo ngaphambi kokuba uphume. Noma yini oyirekhodayo uma ungekho igcinwa kule foni futhi ithunyelwe emuva ngesikhathi esilandelayo onesignali.
offline.intro.from: Download what you need before you go out. Anything you record while you are away is kept on this phone and sent back the next time you have a signal.

offline.takeNote.text: Landa lokho okudingayo ngaphambi kokuba uhambe. Akukho okugcinwayo ongakucelanga.
offline.takeNote.from: Download what you need before you go. Nothing is kept that you did not ask for.

offline.nothingToStudy.text: Awunalutho lokufunda okwamanje. Noma yini obhaliswe kuyo ivela lapha ukuze uyilande.
offline.nothingToStudy.from: You have nothing to study at the moment. Anything you are enrolled on appears here to download.

offline.recordNote.text: Kusebenza ngaphandle kwesignali. Kulinda kule foni futhi kuhamba lapho uba nayo.
offline.recordNote.from: Works with no signal. It waits on this phone and goes when you next have one.

offline.waitingDecisionNote.text: Kukhona okushintshile ngesikhathi umfundi engekho. Akukho okuhlanganisiwe noma okubhalwe phezu: othile kumele akhethe.
offline.waitingDecisionNote.from: Something changed while the learner was away. Nothing has been merged or overwritten: somebody has to choose.

offline.bothDates.from: Recorded on the device {captured} · reached us {received}

offline.relaxedNote.text: Umsebenzi orekhodwe ngesikhathi lolu hlelo luvumela ukuhlola okuphetha ukuthathwa ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Uma uhlelo lugunyazwa kamuva, lowo msebenzi awuvikeleki ngemuva kwesikhathi: nasi isilokhu, ngakho kuba isinqumo hhayi ukutholwa ekuvakasheni kokuqapha.
offline.relaxedNote.from: Work recorded while this programme allowed summatives to be taken offline. If the programme is accredited later, that work does not become defensible retrospectively: this is the list, so it is a decision rather than a discovery at a monitoring visit.

offline.cannotHold.text: Leli bhrawuza alikwazi ukugcina impahla yokusetshenziswa ngaphandle kwesignali. Konke kusasebenza kahle uma uxhumekile.
offline.cannotHold.from: This browser cannot hold material for use without a signal. Everything still works normally while you are connected.

offline.noSignal.from: No signal: showing what is held

offline.nothingHeld.text: Akukagcinwa lutho. Vula iyunithi yokufunda bese ukhetha ukuyenza itholakale ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi ngaphambi kokuba uphume.
offline.nothingHeld.from: Nothing is held yet. Open a study unit and choose to make it available offline before you go out.

offline.ofQuota.text: kuwo wonke ucishe ube ngu-{quota} le foni ezowuvumela
offline.ofQuota.from: of about {quota} this phone will allow

offline.keepNote.text: Icela ifoni ukuthi ingakususi uma ungekho.
offline.keepNote.from: Asks the phone not to clear it while you are away.

offline.noRoom.text: Akukho ndawo eyanele kule foni. Susa kuqala okugcinelwe enye iyunithi yokufunda: akukho okulandiwe.
offline.noRoom.from: There is not enough room on this phone. Remove something held for another study unit first: nothing has been downloaded.

offline.onPhone.from: {label} is on this phone. You can read it with no signal.

offline.incomplete.text: Lokho akulandeki ngokuphelele, ngakho akukho okugciniwe. Zama futhi lapho isignali ingcono.
offline.incomplete.from: That did not download completely, so none of it has been kept. Try again where the signal is better.

offline.released.from: {label} is no longer held. It freed up room on this phone.

offline.cannotKeep.text: Leli bhrawuza alikwazi ukugcina impahla yokusetshenziswa ngaphandle kwesignali.
offline.cannotKeep.from: This browser cannot keep material for use without a signal.

offline.pageOne.text: Ikhasi eli-1. Yilande ngaphambi kokuba uphume.
offline.pageOne.from: 1 page. Download it before you go out.

offline.pages.text: Amakhasi angu-{count}. Yilande ngaphambi kokuba uphume.
offline.pages.from: {count} pages. Download it before you go out.

offline.writeFirst.text: Bhala inothi noma engeza isithombe kuqala.
offline.writeFirst.from: Write a note or add a photograph first.

offline.willGo.text: Kurekhodwe kule foni. Kuzohamba lapho unesignali.
offline.willGo.from: Recorded on this phone. It will go when you have a signal.

offline.whatYouDidHint.text: Ngihlolile umugqa wheleni ohamba eceleni komngcele wasempumalanga.
offline.whatYouDidHint.from: Inspected the fence line along the eastern boundary.

offline.shrunk.text: Senziwe sincane ukonga indawo: {from} → {to}. Sisacace ngokwanele ukuhlolwa.
offline.shrunk.from: Made smaller to save room: {from} → {to}. Still clear enough to assess.

mailbox.empty.text: Akukho lutho lapha okwamanje. Noma yini ethunyelwe ku-{address} ifika kulolu hlu, nezithasiselo zigcinwe ngendlela efanayo nobufakazi bokuhlola.
mailbox.empty.from: Nothing here yet. Anything sent to {address} arrives in this list, with attachments stored the same way assessment evidence is.

mailbox.envelope.text: Iseva ethumelayo izibike ngokuthi ingu-{address}, okungewona ikheli elisemgqeni othi Kusuka. Kujwayelekile emalisti okuthumela nakumeyili edluliselwe, futhi kunjalo nokubukeka komthumeli wamanga.
mailbox.envelope.from: The sending server identified itself as {address}, which is not the address in the From line. Ordinary for mailing lists and forwarded mail, and also what a forged sender looks like.

mailbox.notSwitchedOn.text: Ukuthumela akukavulwa: akukho irelay yeposi elungiselelwe, ngakho umyalezo obhalwe lapha ungeke uphume. Izimpendulo ozitholayo zisafika ngokujwayelekile.
mailbox.notSwitchedOn.from: Sending is not switched on yet: no mail relay is configured, so a message written here could not leave the building. Replies you receive still arrive normally.

lrs.intro.text: Amarekhodi abafundi bakho, angenayo naphumayo, njengezitatimende ze-xAPI: ifomethi izitolo zamarekhodi okufunda nezinhlelo eziningi zokufunda ezishintshisana ngayo. Akukho lapha okushintsha imiphumela yomfundi kule platifomu.
lrs.intro.from: Your learners' records, in and out, as xAPI statements: the format learning record stores and most learning systems exchange. Nothing here changes a learner's results on this platform.

lrs.outNote.text: Ukubhalisa ngakunye, isifundo esiqediwe, ukuhlola okuzanyiwe, isinqumo sokuthi onekhono noma ongakabi nekhono, inkambo eqediwe, isitatimende semiphumela, isitifiketi, nesitifiketi seziqu esitholiwe, isitatimende esisodwa ngasinye. Ngasinye sigcina ubunikazi obufanayo isikhathi ngasinye uma uthumela ngaphandle, ngakho ukulayisha okuthunyelwe ngaphandle okubili kwenye isistimu akuphindi kabili umlando womuntu.
lrs.outNote.from: Every enrolment, lesson completed, assessment attempted, competent or not yet competent decision, course completed, statement of results, certificate, and qualification certificate received, one statement each. Each keeps the same identity every time you export, so loading two exports into another system does not double anybody's history.

lrs.downloadNote.text: Ifayela lisho wonke umfundi nekheli lakhe le-imeyili. Ligcine njengoba ungagcina noma yiliphi irekhodi lemininingwane yomuntu siqu.
lrs.downloadNote.from: The file names every learner and their email address. Keep it as you would any record of personal information.

lrs.store.text: Thumela amarekhodi esitolo sakho samarekhodi okufunda
lrs.store.from: Send records to your own learning record store

lrs.storeNote.text: Uma ugcina isitolo samarekhodi okufunda, sixhume lapha futhi wonke amarekhodi angenhla aya kusona phakathi nehora ngemva kokwenzeka, alawo asevele enziwe kuqala. Ngalinye lithunyelwa kanye; isitatimende isitolo esisivele sisiphethe siyashiywa njengoba sinjalo. Imfihlo yesitolo ivalelwe kule platifomu, ayibonisiwe futhi, futhi ikhohlwa lapho unqamula ukuxhumeka.
lrs.storeNote.from: If you keep a learning record store, connect it here and every record above goes to it within the hour of happening, the ones already made first. Each is sent once; a statement the store already holds is left as it is. The store's secret is sealed on this platform, never shown again, and forgotten when you disconnect.

lrs.inNote.text: Ifayela lezitatimende ze-xAPI ezivela kwenye isistimu: uhlu lwezitatimende, noma lokho isitolo samarekhodi okufunda esikubuyisayo. Ngasinye sifaniswa nomfundi lapha nge-imeyili futhi siboniswa erekhodini lakhe. Sigcinwa njengokufunda okwenziwe kwenye indawo, hhayi ukushintshwa sibe ukubhalisa noma umphumela lapha, ngoba akukho kukho okwafundiswa noma kwahlolwa kule platifomu.
lrs.inNote.from: A file of xAPI statements from another system: a list of statements, or what a learning record store returns. Each is matched to a learner here by email and shown on their record. It is kept as learning done elsewhere, not turned into an enrolment or a result here, because none of it was taught or assessed on this platform.

lrs.held.text: Izitatimende ezingu-{count} ezigcinwe zivela kwenye indawo.

lrs.heldUnmatched.text: Izitatimende ezingu-{count} ezigcinwe zivela kwenye indawo, ezingu-{unmatched} zingakafaniswa nomfundi.
lrs.heldUnmatched.from: {count} statements held from elsewhere, {unmatched} not yet matched to a learner.

lrs.addedHeld.text: Izitatimende ezingu-{added} kwezingu-{read} ziyengeziwe; ezingu-{held} bezivele zigciniwe.
lrs.addedHeld.from: {added} of {read} statements added; {held} were already held.

lrs.matchedOne.text: Umfundi o-1 ofaniswe nge-imeyili. Ukufunda kwakhe okungeniswe kuboniswa erekhodini lakhe ngaphansi kwe-Abantu.
lrs.matchedOne.from: 1 learner matched by email. Their imported learning shows on their record under People.

lrs.matched.text: Abafundi abangu-{count} abafaniswe nge-imeyili. Ukufunda kwabo okungeniswe kuboniswa emarekhodini abo ngaphansi kwe-Abantu.
lrs.matched.from: {count} learners matched by email. Their imported learning shows on their record under People.

lrs.unmatched.text: Akufaniswanga nomuntu lapha, futhi kugcinwa kuze kube kunjalo: {names}. Bamemele ngale imeyili efanayo futhi ukufunda kwabo kuzoxhumeka.
lrs.unmatched.from: Not matched to anybody here, and kept until they are: {names}. Invite them with the same email and their learning attaches.

lrs.acceptedOne.text: Isitatimende esi-1 samukelwe kuze kube manje.

lrs.accepted.text: Izitatimende ezingu-{count} zamukelwe kuze kube manje.

lrs.acceptedLast.text: Izitatimende ezingu-{count} zamukelwe kuze kube manje; okokugcina kuthunyelwe {date}.
lrs.acceptedLast.from: {count} statements accepted so far; last sent {date}.

lrs.hourly.text: Thumela amarekhodi kulesi sitolo njalo ngehora
lrs.hourly.from: Send records to this store every hour

verifyPage.intro.text: Faka inkomba eshicilelwe esitifiketini. Akudingeki i-akhawunti.
verifyPage.intro.from: Enter the reference printed on the certificate. No account is needed.

verifyPage.validStatementNote.text: Lo mfundi ufinyelele wonke umbandela wokuhlola wangaphakathi weziqu ezingezansi futhi angabhaliswa ekuHloleni Okuphetha Okuhlanganisiwe Kwangaphandle.
verifyPage.validStatementNote.from: This learner has achieved every internal assessment criterion for the qualification below and may be entered for the External Integrated Summative Assessment.

verifyPage.doNotAccept.text: Ungayamukeli le dokhumenti. Xhumana nomhlinzeki ohlonziwe kuyo uma umfundi ekholelwa ukuthi kuyiphutha.
verifyPage.doNotAccept.from: Do not accept this document. Contact the provider named on it if the learner believes this is a mistake.

verifyPage.expiredNote.text: Isitatimende Semiphumela sisebenza iminyaka emibili kusukela osukwini sakhishwa ngalo. Lesi sakhishwa ngomhla ka-{issued} futhi saphelelwa yisikhathi ngomhla ka-{expired}.
verifyPage.expiredNote.from: A Statement of Results is valid for two years from the date it was issued. This one was issued on {issued} and expired on {expired}.

verifyPage.expiredNote2.text: Akukho okungalungile ngempumelelo yomfundi: yidokhumenti eseqedile isikhathi. Umhlinzeki ohlonziwe kuyo angakhipha esasebenzayo.
verifyPage.expiredNote2.from: Nothing is wrong with the learner's achievement: it is the document that has run out. The provider named on it can issue a current one.

verifyPage.notFoundNote.text: Asikho isitifiketi esiphethe lokho kubhekisela. Hlola ngedokhumenti: izinhlamvu I, L, O, U, 0 no-1 azisetshenziswa neze, ngakho u-1 u-7 noma u-J, no-O u-Q noma u-D.
verifyPage.notFoundNote.from: No certificate carries that reference. Check it against the document: the characters I, L, O, U, 0 and 1 are never used, so a 1 is a 7 or a J, and an O is a Q or a D.

verifyPage.withdrawnDetail.text: Sanikwa ku-{holder} mayelana no-{title}, futhi sahoxiswa ngomhla ka-{date}.
verifyPage.withdrawnDetail.from: It was issued to {holder} for {title}, and withdrawn on {date}.

verifyPage.notRely.from: It should not be relied on.

verifyPage.badgeNote.text: Leli yirekhodi lomhlinzeki uqobo lokuthi umnikazi uqede le mojuli yokufunda. Akuyona iziqu zikazwelonke, ayinawo amakhredithi, futhi ayinikezwa umkhandlu wekhwalithi. Iziqu ziqinisekiswa yinkomba yesitifiketi sazo.
verifyPage.badgeNote.from: This is a provider's own record that the holder completed this module of study. It is not a national qualification, carries no credits, and is not awarded by a quality council. A qualification is verified by its own certificate reference.

platformPage.intro.text: Zonke izinhlangano ezikule platifomu. Ungabona ukuthi ngayinye isebenzisa kangakanani futhi uphathe ukulungiselelwa kwazo, kodwa hhayi abafundi bazo, izinkambo noma amarekhodi okuhlola. Ukusingatha isistimu yekhasimende akufani nokuba nelungelo lokuyifunda, futhi ipulatifomu iyakuphoqelela lokho kunokuthembela ekuzibambeni.
platformPage.intro.from: Every organisation on the platform. You can see how much each is using and manage their configuration, but not their learners, courses or assessment records. Hosting a client's system is not the same as being entitled to read it, and the platform enforces that rather than relying on restraint.

platformPage.noAdminOne.text: Inhlangano e-1 ayinaye umphathi. Akekho lapho ongaphatha isistimu yabo.
platformPage.noAdminOne.from: 1 organisation has no administrator. Nobody there can manage their own system.

platformPage.noAdmin.text: Izinhlangano ezingu-{count} azinaye umphathi. Akekho lapho ongaphatha isistimu yazo.
platformPage.noAdmin.from: {count} organisations have no administrator. Nobody there can manage their own system.

newTenant.intro.text: Idala inhlangano nomphathi wayo wokuqala ndawonye. Ikhasimende elingenamphathi alikwazi ukudluliselwa, ngakho ipulatifomu ayikuvumeli ukuthi wenze elinjalo.
newTenant.intro.from: Creates the organisation and its first administrator together. A client without an administrator cannot be handed over, so the platform does not let you make one.

newTenant.password.text: Iphasiwedi yomphathi: iboniswa kanye, yidlulisele ngqo.
newTenant.password.from: Administrator's password: shown once, hand it over directly.

newTenant.legalNameNote.from: As it appears on statutory returns.

newTenant.displayNameNote.text: Lokho abantu babo abakubona phezulu ekhasini ngalinye.
newTenant.displayNameNote.from: What their people see at the top of every page.

newTenant.ownDomainNote.text: Kudinga irekhodi le-DNS eliyalele lapha ngaphambi kokuba lisebenze.
newTenant.ownDomainNote.from: Needs a DNS record pointing here before it will work.

newTenant.zoneNote.text: Isikhathi ngasinye esihlelwe kule tenenti sisho lo washi. Bangakwazi ukuwushintsha bona ku-Amasethingi.
newTenant.zoneNote.from: Every timetabled time for this tenant means this clock. They can change it themselves in Settings.

newTenant.preview.from: How their people will see it

newTenant.workplaceNote.from: Agreements, coach guides and sign off sheets.

aiSwitch.onTitle.from: Your AI extension is on for this sitting. It switches off when you sign out.

aiSwitch.offTitle.text: Vula isandiso sakho se-AI kulesi sikhathi.
aiSwitch.offTitle.from: Switch your AI extension on for this sitting.

banner.site.text: Isayithi le-{label}. Akukho okwenziwa lapha okufinyelela ipulatifomu ephilayo, futhi abafundi abakhona lapha ngamakhophi.
banner.site.from: {label} site. Nothing done here reaches the live platform, and the learners here are copies.

zoned.timesViewer.text: Izikhathi ngu-{zone}, iwashi lomhlinzeki. Ufunda lokhu usuka e-{viewer}.
zoned.timesViewer.from: Times are {zone}, the provider's clock. You are reading this from {viewer}.

withdraw.why.from: Why it is being withdrawn: this is the record

lessonUpload.scorm.text: Iphakheji ye-SCORM 1.2 “{title}” ivuliwe, amafayela angu-{files}. Abafundi bayidlala kulesi sifundo, futhi iqeda isifundo uma beqeda.
lessonUpload.scorm.from: SCORM 1.2 package “{title}” unpacked, {files} files. Learners play it in this lesson, and it completes the lesson when they finish.

lessonUpload.scormParts.text: Inezingxenye ezingu-{parts}; kudlalwa kuphela eyokuqala okwamanje.
lessonUpload.scormParts.from: It has {parts} parts; only the first is played for now.

lessonUpload.notUploaded.from: That file could not be uploaded.

lessonUpload.failed.from: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.

lessonUpload.scormNote.text: Iphakheji ye-SCORM 1.2 (i-.zip evela ethuluzini lokubhala) idlala ngaphakathi kwesifundo. Amascript ayo asebenza ngokufinyelela komfundi kule platifomu, ngakho sebenzisa amaphakheji avela kuphela emithonjeni oyethembayo.
lessonUpload.scormNote.from: A SCORM 1.2 package (a .zip from an authoring tool) plays inside the lesson. Its own scripts run with the learner's access to this platform, so use packages only from sources you trust.

lessonUpload.choose.from: Choose a file for this lesson

lessonUpload.kinds.text: Ividiyo, izithombe, umsindo, i-PDF, i-Word, i-PowerPoint noma i-Excel. Ifayela lihlolwa ngokuqukethwe kwalo, hhayi igama lalo.
lessonUpload.kinds.from: Video, images, audio, PDF, Word, PowerPoint or Excel. The file is checked by its contents, not its name.

media.noVideo.from: Your browser cannot play this video. {link}.

media.noAudio.text: Ibhrawuza lakho alikwazi ukudlala lokhu okuqoshiwe. {link}.
media.noAudio.from: Your browser cannot play this recording. {link}.

media.pdfFallback.from: {link} ({size}) if it does not display here.

scormPlayer.cannotOpen.from: The package could not be opened.

drivePick.noFolders.text: Awekho amafolda ngaphakathi kwale. Uma impahla ilapha, yifunde.
drivePick.noFolders.from: No folders inside this one. If the material is here, read it.

drivePick.pressThis.text: Manje cindezela lokhu ukuyifunda. Akukagcinwa lutho.
drivePick.pressThis.from: Now press this to read it. Nothing is saved yet.
