drivePick.stillFetching.from: Still fetching: {seconds} seconds. Every file is downloaded before anything is read, so a large folder takes a few minutes.

drivePick.nothingWritten.text: Akukabhalwa lutho: uhlola kuqala lokho okutholiwe.
drivePick.nothingWritten.from: Nothing is written yet: you check what it found first.

folderPick.needs.text: Ukwakha iziqu ngefolda kudinga isandiso se-AI, ngaphandle uma ifolda izichaza yona.
folderPick.needs.from: Building a qualification from a folder needs an AI extension, unless the folder describes itself.

folderPick.notOn.text: Esakho asivulwanga kulesi sikhathi. Sivule ngezansi, noma sebenzisa indlela yamadokhumenti kunalokho: leyo ayidingi i-AI neze futhi ifunda ikharikhulamu yonke.
folderPick.notOn.from: Yours is not switched on for this sitting. Switch it on below, or use the documents route instead: that needs no AI at all and reads the whole curriculum.

folderPick.cannotRun.text: Esakho asikwazi ukusebenza lapha: {reason} Sebenzisa indlela yamadokhumenti kunalokho: ayidingi i-AI neze futhi ifunda ikharikhulamu yonke.
folderPick.cannotRun.from: Yours cannot run here: {reason} Use the documents route instead: it needs no AI at all and reads the whole curriculum.

folderPick.notAvailable.from: it is not available on this machine.

folderPick.none.text: Awunaso esisethiwe. Sebenzisa indlela yamadokhumenti kunalokho: ayidingi i-AI neze futhi ifunda ikharikhulamu yonke.
folderPick.none.from: You do not have one set up. Use the documents route instead: it needs no AI at all and reads the whole curriculum.

folderPick.blueprint.text: Ifolda ekhiqizwe yisistimu yokuthuthukisa uhlelo ihlanganisa isifinyezo sayo (i-{file}), futhi enye yalezo ingenisa lapha ngemizuzwana ngaphandle kwesandiso.
folderPick.blueprint.from: A folder produced by a programme development system includes a summary of itself (a {file}), and one of those imports here in seconds with no extension involved.

folderPick.chosenOne.text: Ifayela e-1, kuhlanganise konke okusemafoldeni ayo amancane.
folderPick.chosenOne.from: 1 file, including everything in its subfolders.

folderPick.chosen.text: Amafayela angu-{count}, kuhlanganise konke okusemafoldeni ayo amancane.
folderPick.chosen.from: {count} files, including everything in its subfolders.

folderPick.notSaved.from: Nothing is saved until you have checked it.

folderPick.pressThis.text: Manje cindezela lokhu ukuyifunda. Akukagcinwa lutho.
folderPick.pressThis.from: Now press this to read it. Nothing is saved yet.

folderPick.stillReading.text: Isafunda: imizuzwana engu-{seconds} kuze kube manje. Idokhumenti yekharikhulamu ithatha imizuzu embalwa.
folderPick.stillReading.from: Still reading: {seconds} seconds so far. A curriculum document takes a few minutes.

folderPick.stillGoing.text: Isaqhubeka: {minutes} min {seconds}s. Lokhu kujwayelekile kufolda enkulu; shiya ikhasi livuliwe.
folderPick.stillGoing.from: Still going: {minutes} min {seconds}s. This is normal for a large folder; leave the page open.

folderPick.onTitle.text: Isandiso sakho se-AI sivuliwe kulesi sikhathi.
folderPick.onTitle.from: Your AI extension is on for this sitting.

folderPick.onNote.text: Ifolda engahlanganisi isifinyezo sayo izokwakhiwa isakhiwo sayo emadokhumentini kunalokho: kancane, futhi kufanele kuhlolwe ngedokhumenti yekharikhulamu. Yicishe uma usuqedile ngayo.
folderPick.onNote.from: A folder that does not include a summary of itself will have its structure worked out from the documents instead: slower, and worth checking against the curriculum document. Switch it off when you are done with it.

said.alignment-document.c3e49767.text: Awekho amayunithi okufunda atholakele kuleyo dokhumenti. Isihloko esisodwa kumele sifundeke njengokuthi “Study Unit 1 – Organisational Architecture”, namamojuli ayihlanganisayo ebhalwe ngaphansi kwayo.

said.alignment-matrix.185b0901.text: Ayikho imatrikhi yokuqondanisa etholakele kule ncwadi yomsebenzi. Ikholomu eyodwa kumele ibe nesihloko esifana no-“Topic Elements”, ukuze imigqa ifaniswe nekharikhulamu.
said.alignment-matrix.185b0901.from: No alignment matrix found in this workbook. One column must be headed something like “Topic Elements”, so the rows can be matched to the curriculum.

said.alignment-matrix.2b19415b.text: Leyo yidokhumenti ye-Word. Idokhumenti uqobo igciniwe, ifayelwe futhi iyasesheka. Okungakwazanga ukwenzeka ukuyifunda, ngoba imatrikhi yokuqondanisa ifundwa njengesipredishithi: umugqa owodwa ngomugqa ngamunye wekharikhulamu, nekholomu enesihloko esifana no-“Topic Elements”. Gcina imatrikhi njengesipredishithi bese ulayisha nalokho, futhi umugqa ngamunye wekharikhulamu uzobonisa lokho okuwuhlanganisayo.
said.alignment-matrix.2b19415b.from: That is a Word document. The document itself is kept, filed and searchable. What could not happen is reading it, because the alignment matrix is read as a spreadsheet: one row per curriculum line, with a column headed something like “Topic Elements”. Save the matrix as a spreadsheet and upload that as well, and each line of the curriculum will show what covers it.

said.alignment-matrix.a0d14e78.text: Imatrikhi ayinawo amakholomu ezinsiza angabonwa: akukho ebizwa ngokuthi Workbook, Assessment, Theory Guide, Legislation njalonjalo.

said.conduct.07e411c2.text: Sho ukuthi isikhalimo sisho ini, ngamazwi omfundi uqobo lapho kungenzeka.
said.conduct.07e411c2.from: Say what the grievance is about, in the learner's own words where possible.

said.conduct.1636d693.text: Isikhalimo sibiza {firstName} {lastName}. Umuntu okhalelwa akakwazi ukusiphenya: inqubo idinga umuntu ohlelwe ongenzi nkolo. Beka omunye.
said.conduct.1636d693.from: The grievance names {firstName} {lastName}. Somebody the complaint is about cannot investigate it: the procedure asks for a designated impartial person. Appoint somebody else.

said.conduct.1d25ed57.text: Isaziso kumele sishano izinsolo ezithile. Ukulalelwa kwecala ngezinsolo ezingashiwongo akukwazi ukuphendulwa.
said.conduct.1d25ed57.from: The notice has to state the specific allegations. A hearing about unstated allegations cannot be answered.

said.conduct.1e2d5837.text: Kurekhodiwe. Izinsuku ezinhlanu zokusebenza zokukhalaza zibalwa kusukela namhlanje.
said.conduct.1e2d5837.from: Recorded. The five working days to appeal run from today.

said.conduct.303f7f08.text: Sho ukuthi zikhona yiziphi izijeziso, kubandakanya ukuqedwa lapho kukhona. Umfundi onquma ukuthi alethe umsizi udinga ukwazi ukuthi yini esengozini.
said.conduct.303f7f08.from: Say what sanctions are possible, including termination where it is. A learner deciding whether to bring assistance needs to know what is at stake.

said.conduct.403b3f35.text: Sho ukuthi kungani. Isijeziso esingachazwanga asivikeleki, futhi lesi yisigaba umfundi asifanele ukusazi.
said.conduct.403b3f35.from: Say why. An unexplained sanction is indefensible, and this is the paragraph the learner is entitled to.

said.conduct.47a20502.text: Sho umthetho owephulwe, izinga elilindelwe nokuthi kwenzekani uma kuphindeka. Isexwayiso esingenakho lokho asiyona.
said.conduct.47a20502.from: State the rule broken, the standard expected and what happens if it recurs. A warning that does not is not one.

said.conduct.4dcaf05f.from: That is not a date and time.

said.conduct.64f7462f.text: Isaziso kumele satshele umfundi ukuthi angasizwa umfundi ofana naye, afakele icala lakhe, futhi abize futhi abuzeofakazi. Thumela isaziso esikwenzayo lokho, bese usirekhoda lapha.
said.conduct.64f7462f.from: The notice must tell the learner they may be assisted by a fellow learner, present their case, and call and question witnesses. Send a notice that does, then record it here.

said.conduct.67f9675a.text: Rekhoda okutholiwe nokuthi ngokwesisekelo sini. Ukulalelwa kwecala okutholakele kwalo kungumugqa owodwa kuyilo elingabanga khona.
said.conduct.67f9675a.from: Record what was found and on what basis. A hearing whose findings are one line is a hearing that did not happen.

said.conduct.6a6b5da7.from: It has to be acknowledged by {acknowledgeBy}.

said.conduct.6d857ec5.text: Ukuqeda uhlelo lomuntu kudinga ukulalelwa kwecala okwenzekile, nokutholakele kurekhodiwe. Biza elilodwa, rekhoda okutholiwe, bese uvala icala.
said.conduct.6d857ec5.from: Ending somebody's programme needs a hearing that was held, with its findings recorded. Convene one, record what was found, then close the case.

said.conduct.77c80d2a.text: Kufakiwe. Kuzokwaziswa phakathi nezinsuku ezimbili zokusebenza.
said.conduct.77c80d2a.from: Lodged. It will be acknowledged within two working days.

said.conduct.869c74ee.text: Ukulalelwa kwecala kudinga okungenani amahora angu-{HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} esaziso futhi lokhu kufushane ngamahora: {hours}. Kungabanjwa ngokushesha kakhulu ngo-{earliest}. Isaziso esifushane yiyo iphutha isikhalo esinqotshwa ngalo, noma ngabe umfundi wenzeni.
said.conduct.869c74ee.from: A hearing needs at least {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} hours' notice and this is {hours} hour short. The earliest it can be held is {earliest}. Short notice is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

said.conduct.8d0ef3ad.text: Ukulalelwa kwecala kubizwe. Isikhathi sesaziso siyafezeka.
said.conduct.8d0ef3ad.from: Hearing convened. The notice period is met.

said.conduct.9f172fca.from: The learner cannot investigate their own grievance.

said.conduct.ad753d2e.text: Isinqumo siya kumfundi ngokubhaliwe futhi kumele sisho okutholiwe nokuzokwenziwa. Umugqa awusiyo isinqumo.
said.conduct.ad753d2e.from: The decision goes to the learner in writing and has to say what was found and what will be done. A line is not a decision.

said.conduct.b0301d88.text: Sho ukuthi kusolwa ini, ngokuqondile. Umfundi akakwazi ukuphendula 'isimo sengqondo esibi', futhi nokulalelwa kwecala akukwazi.
said.conduct.b0301d88.from: Say what is alleged, specifically. A learner cannot answer 'poor attitude', and neither can a hearing.

said.conduct.b0dcbd53.from: Decided, and the learner has it in writing.

said.conduct.cf47131c.text: Kuvaliwe. Nikeza umfundi umphumela ngokubhaliwe, bese urekhoda ukuthi ukwenzile.
said.conduct.cf47131c.from: Closed. Give the learner the outcome in writing, then record that you have.

said.drive-google-drive.3ad31c62.text: I-Google ayisayamukeli lolo xhumano. Kungenzeka lukhishiwe ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Google. Xhuma idrayivu futhi Kumasethingi.
said.drive-google-drive.3ad31c62.from: Google no longer accepts that connection. It may have been withdrawn from your Google account. Connect the drive again in Settings.

said.drive-google-drive.8761e449.text: Leyo folda ayikho, noma i-akhawunti oyixhumile ayikwazi ukuyibona. Ifolda yabelwe wena kumele ivulwe ku-Drive okungenani kanye ngaphambi kokuba ifundwe.
said.drive-google-drive.8761e449.from: That folder is not there, or the account you connected cannot see it. A folder shared with you has to be opened in Drive at least once before it can be read.

said.drive-google-drive.b744db3d.text: I-Google yenqabe lelo cala. Uma lisho ikhwota, umkhawulo we-Drive API wokusebenza usufinyelelwe okwamanje. {message}
said.drive-google-drive.b744db3d.from: Google refused that request. If it mentions a quota, the deployment's Drive API limit has been reached for now. {message}

said.drive-google-drive.c0c95fa0.text: I-Google ayizange ibuyise indlela yokuvuselela uxhumano, okuvame ukusho ukuthi le akhawunti isivele ivumile. Susa ukufinyelela kwepulatifomu ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Google ngaphansi kwe-Third-party apps, bese uxhuma futhi.
said.drive-google-drive.c0c95fa0.from: Google did not return a way to renew the connection, which usually means this account had already granted it. Remove the platform's access in your Google account under Third-party apps, then connect again.

said.drive-google-drive.dcf45956.text: "{name}" inkulu kakhulu ukuthi i-Google ingayithumela ngesiqephu esisodwa. Landa leyo dokhumenti eyodwa ku-Drive njenge-{extension} bese uyengeza yodwa ngemva kwalokho; konke okunye kufolda kufundeka ngokuvamile.
said.drive-google-drive.dcf45956.from: "{name}" is too large for Google to export in one piece. Download that one document from Drive as {extension} and add it on its own afterwards; everything else in the folder reads normally.

said.drive-google-drive.e9fe6eee.text: Funda ifolda ngqo ku-Google Drive yakho. Ukufunda kuphela: ipulatifomu ingabhala futhi ilande, ayikwazi ukudala, ukushintsha noma ukususa lutho. Ungakuhoxisa lapha noma ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Google noma inini.
said.drive-google-drive.e9fe6eee.from: Read a folder straight from your Google Drive. Read-only: the platform can list and download, and cannot create, change or delete anything. You can withdraw it here or from your Google account at any time.

said.drive-import.1f557235.text: Leyo folda ayinalutho ipulatifomu engalufunda. Amadokhumenti, amasipredishithi nezethulo kuyafundwa, kubandakanya ezisemthethweni ze-Google, ngakho umphumela ongenalutho usho ukuthi ifolda ayinalutho ngempela, noma iqukethe izinto njenge-Forms nemikhondo emifushane kuphela.
said.drive-import.1f557235.from: That folder has nothing in it the platform can read. Documents, spreadsheets and presentations are all read, including Google's own, so an empty result means the folder really is empty, or holds only things like Forms and shortcuts.

said.drive-import.6977b553.text: Leyo folda ilingana no-{known} MB ngokulinganiselwa, okungaphezu kwalokho okungafundwa ngesikhathi esisodwa. Khetha ifolda yeziqu ezilodwa kunedrayivu ekuyo.
said.drive-import.6977b553.from: That folder comes to about {known} MB, which is more than can be read in one go. Choose the folder for one qualification rather than the drive it sits in.

said.drive-import.bc65916e.from: That folder holds {listedCount} files, which is more than can be read in one go. Choose the folder for one qualification rather than the drive it sits in.

said.extensions-claude-code.149b1d9d.text: I-Claude Code ayifakiwe lapho ipulatifomu isebenza khona.
said.extensions-claude-code.149b1d9d.from: Claude Code is not installed where the platform is running.

said.extensions-claude-code.1c9bd1dc.text: I-Claude Code ifakiwe kule mishini kodwa akekho ongenile. Vula itheminali, gijima i-claude, bese /login futhi uqedele ukungena kubhrawuza. Lesi isinyathelo esisodwa futhi senziwa nguwe, hhayi yipulatifomu.
said.extensions-claude-code.1c9bd1dc.from: Claude Code is installed on this machine but nobody is signed in. Open a terminal, run claude, then /login and complete the sign-in in the browser. That is a one-time step and it is done by you, not by the platform.

said.extensions-claude-code.53fe3e99.text: Umkhawulo wokusetshenziswa wokubhalisa kwe-Claude usufinyelelwe. Lokhu kuzosebenza futhi uma umkhawulo uvuselelwa.
said.extensions-claude-code.53fe3e99.from: The Claude subscription's usage limit has been reached. This will work again once the limit resets.

said.extensions-claude-code.7f69ba19.text: Isebenzisa ukubhalisa kwakho kwe-Claude, ngethokheni ozikhiqizela yona kukhompyutha yakho nge-`claude setup-token`. Hhayi i-API key: akukho nzuzo yesithokheni ngasinye, futhi ithatha kokubhalisa osukuvele ukhokhela kona kunokwabelwana ngakho.
said.extensions-claude-code.7f69ba19.from: Uses your own Claude subscription, through a token you generate on your own computer with `claude setup-token`. Not an API key: no per-token cost, and it draws on the subscription you already pay for rather than a shared one.

said.extensions-claude-code.801580be.text: I-Claude Code ayiphendulanga phakathi kwamasekhondi angu-{timeoutMs}.
said.extensions-claude-code.801580be.from: Claude Code did not answer within {timeoutMs} seconds.

said.extensions-gemini.0473bc2d.text: Awukho ukhiye we-Gemini API ogciniwe wakho. Engeza oyedwa Kumasethingi. Uvela ku-Google AI Studio, futhi awufani nokubhalisa kwe-Gemini.
said.extensions-gemini.0473bc2d.from: No Gemini API key is stored for you. Add one in Settings. It comes from Google AI Studio, and is not the same as a Gemini subscription.

said.extensions-gemini.18ddcba7.text: Lowo khiye we-Gemini API awulungile. Hlola ukuthi ukukopishe wonke ku-Google AI Studio. Awufani nokubhalisa kwe-Gemini Advanced, okungafaki ukufinyelela kwe-API.
said.extensions-gemini.18ddcba7.from: That Gemini API key is not valid. Check it was copied whole from Google AI Studio. It is not the same thing as a Gemini Advanced subscription, which does not include API access.

said.extensions-gemini.3bf73475.text: Umkhawulo wesivinini we-Google walowo khiye usufinyelelwe. Izinga elikhululekile livumela izicelo ezimbalwa ngomzuzu; linda uzame futhi, noma sebenzisa ukhiye onenkokhelo evuliwe.
said.extensions-gemini.3bf73475.from: Google's rate limit for that key has been reached. The free tier allows a limited number of requests a minute; wait and try again, or use a key with billing enabled.

said.extensions-gemini.599b82c0.text: I-Gemini ayiphendulanga ngesikhathi. Ifolda enkulu ingathatha imizuzu eminingana; ukuzama futhi ngamadokhumenti ambalwa kuyo ngokuvamile kuyasebenza.
said.extensions-gemini.599b82c0.from: Gemini did not answer in time. A large folder can take several minutes; trying again with fewer documents in it usually works.

said.extensions-gemini.5f764f27.text: I-Gemini ayikwazanga ukufinyelelwa. Hlola ukuthi leli khompyutha linoxhumano lwenethiwekhi ne-Google.
said.extensions-gemini.5f764f27.from: Gemini could not be reached. Check that this machine has a network connection to Google.

said.extensions-gemini.6ff1fd27.text: I-Gemini iphelelwe yisikhala ngaphambi kokuba iqedele ukuphendula, ngakho okubuyile kuyingxenye yekharikhulamu hhayi yonke, futhi eyingxenye ibukeka ngokufanayo neyiphelele. Akukho okugciniwe. Iziqu ezigcwele zicelo olukhulu kakhulu ekuphenduleni okukodwa; zingenise emadokhumentini azo kunalokho, okufunda ikharikhulamu ngqo ngaphandle kwemodeli futhi kungenamkhawulo onjalo.
said.extensions-gemini.6ff1fd27.from: Gemini ran out of room before it finished answering, so what came back is part of a curriculum rather than all of it, and a partial one looks exactly like a complete one. Nothing was kept. A whole qualification is a great deal to ask for in a single reply; import it from its documents instead, which reads the curriculum directly with no model involved and no limit of this kind.

said.extensions-gemini.7b1ee4ba.text: I-Gemini iphendule ngaphandle kwalutho. Lokho ngokuvamile kusho ukuthi isicelo senqatshiwe yisihlungi sokuphepha, noma igama lemodeli alilungile.
said.extensions-gemini.7b1ee4ba.from: Gemini answered with nothing. That usually means the request was refused by a safety filter, or the model name is wrong.

said.extensions-gemini.a3035142.text: Lawo madokhumenti adlula izinhlamvu ezingu-{MAX_INPUT_CHARS},000, okungaphezu kwalokho okungathunyelwa ngesicelo esisodwa. Ngenisa iziqu emadokhumentini azo kunalokho: idokhumenti yekharikhulamu yodwa ifundwa ngqo, ngaphandle kwemodeli.
said.extensions-gemini.a3035142.from: Those documents come to more than {MAX_INPUT_CHARS},000 characters, which is more than can be sent in one request. Import the qualification from its documents instead: the curriculum document alone is read directly, with no model involved.

said.extensions-gemini.c9f3d2b7.text: I-Google ibike inkinga ohlangothini lwayo ({status}). Isicelo esincane sifanele ukuzanywa futhi nje. Uma lokhu bekungeziqu eziphelele futhi sekwehlulekile kaningi, isicelo kungenzeka sikhulu kakhulu ukuthi imodeli iqede. Yingenise emadokhumentini ayo kunalokho, okufunda ikharikhulamu ngqo.
said.extensions-gemini.c9f3d2b7.from: Google reported a problem on their side ({status}). A small request is worth simply trying again. If this was a whole qualification and it has now failed more than once, the request is most likely too large for the model to complete. Import it from its documents instead, which reads the curriculum directly with no model involved.

said.extensions-gemini.d7ab5352.text: I-Google yenqabe lowo khiye. Kungenzeka ukhishiwe, noma i-Generative Language API ingavulwanga ephrojekthini okuyiyo. Akukho okungalungile epulatifomu futhi akukho okulahlekile.
said.extensions-gemini.d7ab5352.from: Google refused that key. It may have been revoked, or the Generative Language API may not be enabled on the project it belongs to. Nothing is wrong with the platform and nothing was lost.

said.extensions-gemini.eb60a381.text: Isebenzisa ukhiye wakho we-Google AI Studio API. Akukona ukubhalisa kwe-Gemini Advanced: leso yimikhiqizo ehlukile futhi ayifaki ukufinyelela kwe-API. I-API inezinga elikhululekile, ngakho lokhu kungasetshenziswa ngaphandle kokuthenga lutho, ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yesivinini yayo.
said.extensions-gemini.eb60a381.from: Uses your own Google AI Studio API key. Not a Gemini Advanced subscription: that is a separate product and does not include API access. The API has a free tier, so this can be used without buying anything, within its rate limits.

said.fisa.002355f9.text: Ukuvunywa kudinga inkomba ekhishwe yi-QCTO. Ngaphandle kwayo akukho okungabonisa umbheki.
said.fisa.002355f9.from: An approval needs the reference the QCTO issued. Without it there is nothing to show a monitor.

said.fisa.0d81e0f7.from: Your own report still has {missingCount} unanswered items: {code}.

said.fisa.4ffaa428.text: Le FISA ayikasayinwa umlinganisi. Iphepha elingakalinganiswa kusengaphambili alikwazi ukuhlalwa: yilokho okuwukuqonda kokulinganisa.
said.fisa.4ffaa428.from: This FISA has not been signed off by a moderator yet. A paper that has not been pre-moderated cannot be sat: that is what the moderation is for.

said.fisa.52b6e791.from: A FISA is waiting for pre-moderation

said.fisa.620b3718.text: Isivumelwano sokufihla asikasayinwa. Akekho ovunyelwe ukubona noma ukwahlulela okuqukethwe kwe-FISA ngaphambi kokusayina.
said.fisa.620b3718.from: The confidentiality agreement has not been signed yet. Nobody may see or judge the contents of a FISA before signing it.

said.fisa.6d7ad3d8.text: Kuvuliwe. Nquma ngokulandelayo umlobi wephepha nomlinganisi.
said.fisa.6d7ad3d8.from: Opened. Appoint an examiner and a moderator next.

said.fisa.6e61efe5.text: Qala ngokulilinganisa kusengaphambili. Ukuthumela i-QCTO iphepha umlinganisi wakho angalisayinanga kuyindlela ephambene.
said.fisa.6e61efe5.from: Pre-moderate it first. Sending the QCTO a paper your own moderator has not signed off is the wrong way round.

said.fisa.6f4251d6.text: I-FISA esayiniwe kuphela edinga inguqulo entsha; le isengahlelwa.
said.fisa.6f4251d6.from: Only a signed-off FISA needs a new version; this one can still be edited.

said.fisa.8634f8d4.text: Ungumuntu ofanayo no-{other}. Ukulinganisa kusengaphambili kubalulekile ngoba umuntu wesibili walibheka.
said.fisa.8634f8d4.from: That is the same person as the {other}. A pre-moderation is worth having because a second person looked at it.

said.fisa.86b96040.text: Kuvulwe inguqulo entsha yedrafti. Idinga umlobi wephepha wayo, umlinganisi nokulinganisa kwayo.
said.fisa.86b96040.from: A new draft version is open. It needs its own examiner, moderator and moderation.

said.fisa.8cde49ff.text: Akekho umlinganisi onqunyiwe okwamanje, ngakho akekho ongamthumelela.
said.fisa.8cde49ff.from: No moderator has been appointed yet, so there is nobody to send it to.

said.fisa.99e0c84b.text: I-FISA isethwa ngumhlinzeki wohlelo lwayo lwamakhono. Iziqu ezigcwele noma ezingxenye ziyahlolwa ngaphandle yi-Assessment Quality Partner, ngakho umhlinzeki akasethi leli phepha.
said.fisa.99e0c84b.from: A FISA is set by the provider for its own skills programme. A full or part qualification is assessed externally by the Assessment Quality Partner, so the provider does not set that paper.

said.fisa.a82c37e7.text: Kusayiniwe njengokulungele injongo. Abahlolwa bangakwazi manje ukuhlala leli phepha.
said.fisa.a82c37e7.from: Signed off as fit for purpose. Candidates may now sit this paper.

said.fisa.b493dbf3.text: Kuphela u-{role} onqunyiwe angagcwalisa umbiko we-{role2}.
said.fisa.b493dbf3.from: Only the appointed {role} may fill in the {role2}'s report.

said.fisa.b7354b01.from: A FISA has been signed off as fit for purpose

said.fisa.bc66963d.text: Le FISA ihoxisiwe. Inguqulo yakamuva ingatholakala.
said.fisa.bc66963d.from: This FISA has been withdrawn. A later version may be available.

said.fisa.bf0751f5.from: Your own report still has {missingCount} unanswered item: {code}.

said.fisa.c7fed1e7.text: Le FISA isayiniwe. Vula inguqulo entsha kunokushintsha iphepha okungenzeka selike lahlalwa.
said.fisa.c7fed1e7.from: This FISA has been signed off. Open a new version rather than changing a paper that may already have been sat.

said.fisa.d9072f1c.text: Isivumelwano sirekhodiwe. Bangakwazi manje ukusebenza ephepheni.
said.fisa.d9072f1c.from: Agreement recorded. They may now work on the paper.

said.fisa.e69c5f64.from: Sent to the moderator, and they have been told.

said.fisa.f879ffbf.text: Kunqunyiwe. Abakwazi ukubona iphepha kuze kusayinwe isivumelwano sokufihla.
said.fisa.f879ffbf.from: Appointed. They cannot see the paper until the confidentiality agreement is signed.

said.recognition.61201ac5.text: Sho ukuthi ubufakazi babuyini nokuthi kungani buhlangabezana nemojuli. Leso sigaba siwukuphela kokwahlulela, futhi siwukuqala ukufunda komqinisekisi wangaphandle.
said.recognition.61201ac5.from: Say what the evidence was and why it satisfies the module. This paragraph is the whole of the judgement, and the first thing an external verifier reads.

said.recognition.86f838fe.text: Lokho kunikezwe ngo-{awardedOn}, ngaphezu kweminyaka engu-{CAT_YEARS} ngaphambi kwalokhu kuvunywa. Ukuqoqa Nokudluliselwa Kwamakhredithi kuhlanganisa ukuqedwa phakathi neminyaka engu-{CAT_YEARS2}; ngale kwalokho indlela iwukwamukelwa kokufunda kwangaphambilini, okuhlola lokho umfundi asakwazi ukukwenza hhayi lokho akuphasa kanye. Vula isicelo sokwamukelwa kokufunda kwangaphambilini kunalokho.
said.recognition.86f838fe.from: That was awarded on {awardedOn}, more than {CAT_YEARS} years before this approval. Credit Accumulation and Transfer covers completions within {CAT_YEARS2} years; beyond that the route is Recognition of Prior Learning, which assesses what the learner can still do rather than what they once passed. Open an RPL application instead.

said.study-unit-alignment.dfcd9590.text: Idokhumenti ibiza amamojuli angu-{wantedCount} ({wanted}) futhi lezi ziqu azinayo ikharikhulamu okwamanje. Ngenisa ikharikhulamu kuqala; amayunithi okufunda nemiphumela yawo kuyarekhodwa noma kunjalo, futhi ukulayisha le dokhumenti futhi ngemva kwalokho kuzoyaxhuma.
said.study-unit-alignment.dfcd9590.from: The document names {wantedCount} modules ({wanted}) and this qualification has no curriculum yet. Import the curriculum first; the study units and their outcomes are recorded either way, and uploading this document again afterwards will link them.

said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.text: Awekho kumamojuli angu-{wantedCount} lena idokhumenti ewabizayo angafaniswa, ngakho akukho okubekwe ngaphansi kweyunithi yokufunda. Idokhumenti ibiza {wanted}. Le kharikhulamu inawo {held}. Ukufanisa akunaki izikhala namahayifini, ngakho izinhlelo ezimbili zihluke ngempela. Lungisa amakhodi ohlangothini olulodwa noma kokubili bese ulayisha idokhumenti futhi.
said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.from: None of the {wantedCount} modules this document names could be matched, so nothing has been placed under a study unit. The document names {wanted}. This curriculum holds {held}. Matching ignores spaces and hyphens, so the two schemes genuinely differ. Correct the codes on either side and upload the document again.

said.support.2b757921.text: Ukuhlola ngomlomo kulandela ukwehluleka kwesibili kuphela ngezizathu zezokwelapha. Ngaphandle kwazo umphumela ukulahla, umfundi angakwenza isikhalo ngakho.
said.support.2b757921.from: An oral assessment follows a second miss only on medical grounds. Without one the outcome is a forfeit, which the learner can still appeal.

said.support.32314e12.text: Umfundi kufanele avume ukuthi lokhu kurekhodwe ngaphambi kokuba kurekhodwe. Impilo, ukukhubazeka nezimo zezimali kuyimininingwane eyisipesheli yomuntu, futhi ukuvuma ukubhalisa kwakungekhona ukuvuma lokhu.
said.support.32314e12.from: The learner has to agree to this being recorded before it can be. Health, disability and financial circumstances are special personal information, and agreeing to enrol was not agreeing to this.

said.support.3e521f24.text: Sho ukuthi kungani ukusekelwa kuyaphela. Umfundi ongasakwenzelwa indawo ngaphandle kwesizathu akanayo indlela yokucela ukuthi kubuye.
said.support.3e521f24.from: Say why the support is ending. A learner whose accommodation stops without a reason has no way to ask for it back.

said.support.6396d34b.text: Usuku olwengeziwe selusethiwe kulokhu kuhlola: {additionalDate}, ngemva kokuphutha ngo-{missedOn}. Inqubo ivumela olulodwa. Uma lolo suku nalo lungahlangatshezwanga, rekhoda okwenzeka ngalo kunokusetha olunye.
said.support.6396d34b.from: An additional date was already set for this assessment: {additionalDate}, after a miss on {missedOn}. The procedure allows one. If that date was also missed, record what happened to it rather than setting another.

said.support.6af4db9d.text: Uma ukwenzelwa indawo kungasebenzi, sho ukuthi kushintsha ini. Ukubuyekezwa okurekhoda ukwehluleka kodwa kungalungisi lutho kubukeka njengokuzimisela futhi kuphambene nakho.
said.support.6af4db9d.from: If the accommodation is not working, say what is changing. A review that records a failure and adjusts nothing reads as diligence and is the opposite.

said.support.7af7d42b.text: Usuku olwengeziwe kufanele lube ngemva kwalolo olwaphuthelwa.
said.support.7af7d42b.from: The additional date has to be after the one that was missed.

said.support.8452172c.text: Sho ukuthi utholeni. Ukubuyekezwa okungenakutholwa kuyisikhathi nje efayelini.
said.support.8452172c.from: Say what you found. A review with no finding is a date in a file.

said.support.e34f2e55.text: Sho ukuthi kuzokwenziwani ngempela. Isidingo esingenakwenzelwa indawo akushintshi lutho kumfundi.
said.support.e34f2e55.from: Say what will actually be done. A need with no accommodation against it changes nothing for the learner.

said.support.f4565c1a.text: Sho ukuthi isizathu sezokwelapha sasiyini. Ukuhlola ngomlomo okugunyazwe ngesizathu esingarekhodiwe yikho ukuhlala umqinisekisi wangaphandle akubuza ngakho.
said.support.f4565c1a.from: Say what the medical ground was. An oral assessment authorised on an unrecorded reason is the sitting an external verifier asks about.

login.intro.text: Meld aan om voort te gaan met u leer.
login.intro.from: Sign in to continue your learning.

login.trouble.text: Sukkel u om aan te meld? Praat met u fasiliteerder: hy of sy kan 'n wagwoord vir u terugstel.
login.trouble.from: Trouble signing in? Speak to your facilitator: they can reset a password for you.

login.wrong.text: Daardie besonderhede is nie korrek nie.

login.locked.text: Te veel pogings. Wag vyftien minute en probeer weer.
login.locked.from: Too many attempts. Wait fifteen minutes and try again.

login.missing.text: Voer u e-posadres en wagwoord in.
login.missing.from: Enter your email address and password.

login.sso.refused.text: Daardie rekening kan nie hier aanmeld nie. Dit moet dieselfde e-posadres as u rekening op hierdie platform gebruik. Meld aan met u wagwoord, of vra u administrateur.
login.sso.refused.from: That account cannot sign in here. It has to use the same email address as your account on this platform. Sign in with your password, or ask your administrator.

login.sso.expired.text: Daardie aanmelding het te lank geneem, of is elders begin. Probeer weer.
login.sso.expired.from: That sign-in took too long, or was started somewhere else. Try again.

login.sso.off.text: Daardie manier van aanmeld is nie hier geaktiveer nie.
login.sso.off.from: That way of signing in is not switched on here.

account.forcedIntro.text: Iemand anders het die wagwoord gestel waarmee u aangemeld het. Vervang dit voordat u voortgaan.
account.forcedIntro.from: Somebody else set the password you signed in with. Replace it before carrying on.

account.currentGiven.text: Die wagwoord wat aan u gegee is

account.newHint.text: Minstens 12 karakters. 'n Frase van 'n paar onverwante woorde is sterker en makliker om te onthou as iets kort met simbole daarin.
account.newHint.from: At least 12 characters. A phrase of a few unrelated words is both stronger and easier to remember than something short with symbols in it.

account.mismatch.text: Die twee nuwe wagwoorde stem nie ooreen nie.
account.mismatch.from: The two new passwords do not match.

account.forcedNote.text: Om dit te verander meld enigiemand anders af wat die ou wagwoord gebruik, insluitend die persoon wat dit aan u gegee het.
account.forcedNote.from: Changing it signs out anyone else using the old password, including whoever passed it to you.

account.languageIntro.text: Die taal waarin hierdie platform met u praat. Skerms wat nog nie vertaal is nie, bly in Engels, en u verskaffer se eie name vir dinge word gehou soos hulle dit geskryf het.
account.languageIntro.from: The language this platform speaks to you in. Screens not yet translated stay in English, and your provider's own names for things are kept as they wrote them.

learn.notYours.text: U besigtig iemand anders se inskrywing. U kan hul vordering sien, maar nie namens hulle aanteken nie.
learn.notYours.from: You are viewing someone else's enrolment. You can see their progress but cannot record it for them.

learn.noLessons.text: Hierdie kursus het nog geen lesse nie.
learn.noLessons.from: This course has no lessons yet.

learn.openMaterial.text: Maak die materiaal vir hierdie les oop
learn.openMaterial.from: Open the material for this lesson

learn.noContent.text: Geen geskrewe inhoud vir hierdie les nie.
learn.noContent.from: No written content for this lesson.

learn.scormNote.text: Hierdie les is voltooi wanneer u dit in die pakket hierbo klaarmaak. U plek word behou as u halfpad stop.
learn.scormNote.from: This lesson completes when you finish it in the package above. Your place is kept if you stop part of the way through.

learn.openedByFacilitator.text: Vir u oopgemaak deur u fasiliteerder: {reason}
learn.openedByFacilitator.from: Opened for you by your facilitator: {reason}

home.feedbackOne.text: Een ding om ons te vertel

home.feedbackMany.text: 'n Paar dinge om ons te vertel
home.feedbackMany.from: A few things to tell us

home.feedbackIntro.text: Antwoorde word saam met almal anders s'n gerapporteer, nie een vir een nie. Twee minute elk, en dit is die enigste ding wat verander hoe die volgende kohort bestuur word.
home.feedbackIntro.from: Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. Two minutes each, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

home.earnedIntro.text: Aangeteken op die dag waarop u klaargemaak het, eerder as wanneer die sertifikaat uiteindelik aankom. Elkeen dra 'n verwysing wat enigiemand kan nagaan.
home.earnedIntro.from: Recorded on the day you finished, rather than when the certificate eventually arrives. Each carries a reference anybody can check.

home.step.afterPrevious.text: Maak oop wanneer u die vorige stap klaarmaak
home.step.afterPrevious.from: Opens when you finish the step before

home.nothingYet.text: Niks is nog aan u toegewys nie.
home.nothingYet.from: You have not been assigned anything yet.

home.statementsIntro.text: Neem dit saam met u identiteitsdokument na die eksterne assessering. Die sentrum gaan dit na voordat u mag skryf.
home.statementsIntro.from: Take this to the external assessment with your identity document. The centre checks it before you may sit.

assess.waiting.text: Wag vir 'n assessor om dit te hersien.
assess.waiting.from: Waiting for an assessor to review it.

assess.goBackOver.text: Die moeite werd om weer deur te gaan

assess.competent.text: U is bevoeg bevind in hierdie assessering, dus hoef u dit nie weer af te lê nie.
assess.competent.from: You have been found competent on this assessment, so there is nothing to sit again.

assess.noAttempts.text: U het al u pogings by hierdie assessering gebruik.
assess.noAttempts.from: You have used all your attempts at this assessment.

assess.awaitingAssessor.text: Hierdie assessering tel vir u kwalifikasie, dus sal 'n assessor dit hersien en die bevoegdheidsbesluit aanteken. U sal die uitslag sien sodra dit gedoen is.
assess.awaitingAssessor.from: This assessment counts towards your qualification, so an assessor will review it and record the competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

assess.practicePassed.text: Dit was oefening, dus word die uitslag teen u leer aangeteken, maar bepaal dit nie 'n kwalifikasie nie.
assess.practicePassed.from: This was practice, so the result is recorded against your learning but does not decide a qualification.

assess.practiceFailed.text: Dit was oefening. Hersien die materiaal en probeer weer.
assess.practiceFailed.from: This was practice. Review the material and try again.

assess.selectEvery.text: Kies elke antwoord wat van toepassing is.

assess.pair.text: Koppel elke item links aan een regs.
assess.pair.from: Pair each item on the left with one on the right.

assess.whyMarked.text: Die rede is wat hier gemerk word, nie die blokkie hierbo nie.
assess.whyMarked.from: The reason is what is marked here, not the box above.

assess.keptAt.text: U antwoorde is om {time} gestoor. Deur in te dien, word dit gestuur om gemerk te word.
assess.keptAt.from: Your answers were kept at {time}. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

assess.kept.text: U antwoorde word gestoor terwyl u werk. Deur in te dien, word dit gestuur om gemerk te word.
assess.kept.from: Your answers are kept as you work. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

evidence.failed.text: Dit kon nie ingedien word nie.

evidence.uploadFailed.text: Die oplaai het misluk. Gaan u verbinding na en probeer weer.
evidence.uploadFailed.from: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.

evidence.doneIntro.text: 'n Assessor sal dit hersien en 'n bevoegdheidsbesluit aanteken. U sal die uitslag sien sodra dit gedoen is.
evidence.doneIntro.from: An assessor will review it and record a competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

evidence.fingerprintNote.text: As enige gestoorde lêer ooit verander word, sal sy vingerafdruk nie meer ooreenstem nie. Dit beskerm u werk soveel as wat dit die assessering beskerm.
evidence.fingerprintNote.from: If any stored file were ever altered, its fingerprint would stop matching. That protects your work as much as it protects the assessment.

evidence.kinds.text: Foto's, 'n opname van die taak, 'n geskandeerde logboek, of 'n dokument. U kan verskeie op een slag aanheg.
evidence.kinds.from: Photographs, a recording of the task, a scanned logbook, or a document. You can attach several at once.

evidence.note.text: Enigiets wat die assessor behoort te weet

paper.summative.text: Dit word geassesseer en tel vir u kwalifikasie.
paper.summative.from: This is assessed and counts towards your qualification.

paper.formative.text: Dit is voorbereiding. Dit word gemerk en aan u teruggestuur, en dit bepaal niks nie.
paper.formative.from: This is preparation. It is marked and returned to you, and it does not decide anything.

paper.goBack.text: Gaan terug na die kursus om te sien wat nog uitstaan.
paper.goBack.from: Go back to the course to see what is still outstanding.

paper.notSaved.text: Daardie antwoord is nie gestoor nie.

paper.connection.text: Daardie antwoord is nie gestoor nie. U verbinding het dalk verbreek; dit sal weer probeer word wanneer u volgende iets verander.
paper.connection.from: That answer did not save. Your connection may have dropped; it will be tried again when you next change something.

paper.handInFailed.text: Dit kon nie ingelewer word nie.
paper.handInFailed.from: That could not be handed in.

paper.handInConnection.text: Dit kon nie ingelewer word nie. Gaan u verbinding na en probeer weer.
paper.handInConnection.from: That could not be handed in. Check your connection and try again.

paper.detail.text: Antwoord volledig en verwys na die beginsels wat u bestudeer het.
paper.detail.from: Answer in detail, referring to the principles you have studied.

paper.handedIn.text: U het dit ingelewer. Dit kan nie verander word nie.
paper.handedIn.from: You handed this in. It cannot be changed.

paper.final.text: Nadat dit ingelewer is, kan dit nie verander word nie.
paper.final.from: Once handed in, this cannot be changed.

paper.confirm.text: Bevestig die verklaring om in te lewer.
paper.confirm.from: Confirm the declaration to hand in.

paper.savedAsYouGo.text: u werk word gestoor soos u gaan
paper.savedAsYouGo.from: your work is saved as you go

notify.nothingYet.text: Nog niks. U sal hier ingelig word wanneer opleiding toegewys word of verskuldig is, wanneer werk vir u wag, en wanneer 'n assesseringsuitslag of sertifikaat aankom.
notify.nothingYet.from: Nothing yet. You will be told here when training is assigned or due, when work is waiting for you, and when an assessment result or certificate arrives.

cert.notNational.text: Dit is {provider} se eie sertifikaat vir 'n kursus wat dit aangebied het. Dit is nie 'n nasionale kwalifikasie nie en dra nie 'n SAQA-krediet of -identifiseerder nie. Waar 'n leerder na 'n beroepskwalifikasie toewerk, word die sertifikaat daarvoor deur die QCTO uitgereik.
cert.notNational.from: This is {provider}'s own certificate for a course it delivered. It is not a national qualification and does not carry a SAQA credit or identifier. Where a learner is working towards an occupational qualification, the certificate for it is issued by the QCTO.

cert.anyone.text: Enigiemand kan hierdie sertifikaat met die verwysing hierbo bevestig, sonder om 'n rekening nodig te hê.
cert.anyone.from: Anyone can confirm this certificate with the reference above, without needing an account.

work.introCoach.text: Die leerders wat u toesien. U bevestig wat hulle in die werkplek gedoen het; niks bereik 'n assessor sonder u handtekening nie.
work.introCoach.from: The learners you supervise. You confirm what they did in the workplace; nothing reaches an assessor without your signature.

work.introLearner.text: Werkervaring word by 'n werkgewer gedoen en deur die werkplekafrigter daar afgeteken. Die volgorde is vas: u teken dit aan, u afrigter bevestig dit, dan gaan dit na 'n assessor.
work.introLearner.from: Work experience is done at an employer and signed off by the workplace coach there. The order is fixed: you record it, your coach confirms it, then it goes to an assessor.

work.noneManage.text: Nog geen {records} nie. Stel een hierbo op: 'n ooreenkoms wat die leerder, die werkgewer en die afrigter noem, dan een vir elke werkervaringmodule.
work.noneManage.from: No {records} yet. Set one up above: an agreement naming the learner, the employer and the coach, then one for each work experience module.

work.none.text: Nog geen {records} nie. 'n Administrateur maak een oop sodra 'n werkplekooreenkoms in plek is wat die leerder, die werkgewer en die afrigter noem.
work.none.from: No {records} yet. An administrator opens one once a workplace agreement is in place naming the learner, the employer and the coach.

work.kind.contextual_knowledge.text: Werkplekkennis: waaroor u moet kan praat
work.kind.contextual_knowledge.from: Workplace knowledge: what you must be able to speak to

work.kind.supporting_evidence.text: Ondersteunende bewyse: wat die werkplek moet lewer
work.kind.supporting_evidence.from: Supporting evidence: what the workplace must produce

work.outstanding.text: Steeds uitstaande: {items}. U afrigter kan nie teken voordat elke reël klaar is en elke stuk ondersteunende bewyse 'n lêer aangeheg het nie.
work.outstanding.from: Still outstanding: {items}. Your coach cannot sign until every line is done and every piece of supporting evidence has a file attached.

work.allRecorded.text: Alles is aangeteken. Stuur dit na u afrigter wanneer u gereed is.
work.allRecorded.from: Everything is recorded. Send it to your coach when you are ready.

work.signingMeans.text: Deur te teken, word aangeteken dat u hierdie bewyse nagegaan het en dit sal bevestig indien die assessor u kontak. Dit kan daarna nie verander word nie.
work.signingMeans.from: Signing records that you checked this evidence and will attest to it if the assessor contacts you. It cannot be changed afterwards.

work.forAssessor.text: Enigiets wat die assessor behoort te weet

work.readyForPoe.text: Deur die werkplekafrigter geteken en gereed om in die portefeulje van bewyse opgeneem te word.
work.readyForPoe.from: Signed by the workplace coach and ready to be taken into the Portfolio of Evidence.

scorm.failed.text: Die pakket kon nie oopgemaak word nie. Gaan u verbinding na en probeer weer.
scorm.failed.from: The package could not be opened. Check your connection and try again.

scorm.preview.text: 'n Voorskou: wat die pakket rapporteer word nie bewaar nie, omdat dit nie u eie inskrywing is nie.
scorm.preview.from: A preview: what the package reports is not kept, because this is not your own enrolment.

certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.text: Die leerder het dalk die verwysing aan 'n werkgewer gegee. Dit bly werk en sal sê dat dit onttrek is.
certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.from: The learner may have given the reference to an employer. It keeps resolving and will say it was withdrawn.

assessing.intro.text: Inlewerings gereed vir 'n bevoegdheidsoordeel. U kan nie u eie werk assesseer nie, en 'n deel van u besluite sal onafhanklik deur 'n moderator hersien word.
assessing.intro.from: Submissions ready for a competency judgement. You cannot assess your own work, and a proportion of your decisions will be reviewed independently by a moderator.

assessing.empty.text: Niks wag nie. Inlewerings verskyn hier soos leerders dit instuur.
assessing.empty.from: Nothing is waiting. Submissions appear here as learners send them in.

assessing.onScreen.text: Dit is op die skerm beantwoord. {link}: die antwoorde, die nasienriglyne en die matriks is daar saam, en die kriteria word vir u uitgewerk sodra dit gemerk is.
assessing.onScreen.from: This was answered on screen. {link}: the answers, the marking guidance and the matrix are together there, and the criteria are worked out for you once it is marked.

assessing.ownWork.text: Dit is u eie inlewering. U kan dit nie assesseer nie; iemand anders moet.
assessing.ownWork.from: This is your own submission. You cannot assess it; someone else must.

assessing.hash.text: Die hutswaarde word met die oplaai aangeteken. As 'n gestoorde lêer ooit verander word, stem dit nie meer ooreen nie en word die rekord gemerk.
assessing.hash.from: The hash is recorded at upload. If a stored file is ever altered, it no longer matches and the record is flagged.

assessing.whyDiffers.text: Hoekom, aangesien dit verskil van wat die punte voorstel
assessing.whyDiffers.from: Why, since it differs from what the marks propose

assessing.permanent.text: U naam, die datum en hierdie opmerking word permanent gestoor en kan daarna nie gewysig word nie. 'n Regstelling word as 'n nuwe besluit aangeteken.
assessing.permanent.from: Your name, the date and this comment are stored permanently and cannot be edited afterwards. A correction is recorded as a new decision.

marking.impliesIntro.text: Rekenkunde, nie 'n oordeel nie. Die punte gemiddeld gee hierdie uitslag; praktiese prestasie en werkplekbewyse bereik nie die platform nie, en u weeg dit af voordat u besluit. Verander enige hiervan op die besluitskerm en sê hoekom: die rede word langs die voorstel gestoor sodat 'n moderator kan sien waar die twee verskil het.
marking.impliesIntro.from: Arithmetic, not a judgement. The marks average out at this; practical performance and workplace evidence do not reach the platform, and you weigh those before deciding. Change any of these on the decision screen and say why: the reason is stored beside the proposal so a moderator can see where the two parted.

marking.markAllFirst.text: Elke vraag moet gemerk word voordat die kriteria uitgewerk kan word.
marking.markAllFirst.from: Every question has to be marked before the criteria can be worked out.

marking.summative.text: Dit word geassesseer. Sodra elke vraag gemerk is, teken 'n besluit aan: die kriteria wat dit bewys, word voorgestel sodat u dit kan bevestig.
marking.summative.from: This is assessed. Once every question is marked, record a decision: the criteria it evidences are proposed for you to confirm.

marking.formative.text: Dit is 'n werkboek. Dit is ontwikkelend: merk dit en stuur dan terugvoer. Niks hier teken bevoegdheid aan of bring die leerder nader aan geskiktheid nie.
marking.formative.from: This is a workbook. It is developmental: mark it, then return feedback. Nothing here records competence or moves the learner towards eligibility.

marking.matrix.text: Puntematriks: die keuse van 'n vlak vir elk gee die punt
marking.matrix.from: Marking matrix: choosing a level for each gives the mark

marking.toldHint.text: Waar dit sterk was, en wat ontbreek het.
marking.toldHint.from: Where it was strong, and what was missing.

marking.returnIntro.text: Terugvoer, nie 'n besluit nie. Dit vertel die leerder waarna om terug te gaan voor die summatiewe assessering, en dit teken geen bevoegdheid teen enige kriterium aan nie.
marking.returnIntro.from: Feedback, not a decision. It tells the learner what to go back to before the summative, and it records no competence against any criterion.

marking.returnHint.text: Wat stewig was, en wat om te herlees voor die summatiewe assessering.
marking.returnHint.from: What was solid, and what to re-read before the summative.

marking.concern.text: Kriteria waaromheen die swak antwoorde saamklont
marking.concern.from: Criteria the weak answers cluster around

marking.sectionHint.text: Wat hier goed gegaan het, en wat volgende keer anders gedoen moet word.
marking.sectionHint.from: What went well here, and what to do differently next time.

marking.learnerSees.text: Die leerder sien dit saam met hul terugvoer.
marking.learnerSees.from: The learner sees this with their feedback.

moderating.intro.text: Onafhanklike hersiening van assessors se besluite. Watter besluite op hierdie lys beland, word deur die stelsel bepaal en nie deur iemand gekies nie. U kan nie 'n besluit modereer wat u self geneem het nie.
moderating.intro.from: Independent review of assessors' decisions. Which decisions reach this list is decided by the system, not chosen by anyone. You cannot moderate a decision you made yourself.

moderating.reason.new_assessor.from: Newly registered assessor: moderated in full

moderating.referBack.text: Verwys terug: die assessor moet weer kyk
moderating.referBack.from: Refer back: the assessor should look again

moderating.ownDecision.text: U het hierdie besluit as die assessor geneem, dus kan u dit nie modereer nie. 'n Ander moderator moet dit doen.
moderating.ownDecision.from: You made this decision as the assessor, so you cannot moderate it. Another moderator must.

pack.print.text: Druk hierdie bladsy om dit as 'n PDF te bewaar.
pack.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF.

pack.instrumentIntro.text: Die vraestel soos dit opgestel is, en die riglyne waarteen dit gemerk is.
pack.instrumentIntro.from: The paper as it was set, and the guidance it was marked against.

pack.scriptsIntro.text: Geneem oor die puntereeks (bo, onder en die verspreiding tussenin) sodat die merkwerk op sy beste en sy swakste gesien word eerder as in die middel.
pack.scriptsIntro.from: Taken across the mark range (top, bottom and spread between) so the marking is seen at its best and its worst rather than in the middle.

pack.departuresIntro.text: Waar 'n assessor verskil het van wat die punte voorgestel het, of 'n moderator van die assessor verskil het. 'n Pakket wat dit uitlaat, is slegter as geen pakket nie.
pack.departuresIntro.from: Where an assessor differed from what the marks proposed, or a moderator differed from the assessor. A pack that leaves these out is worse than no pack.

pack.exceptionsIntro.text: Leerders wat deur 'n benoemde persoon by 'n hek verbygelaat is, met die rede wat hulle gegee het.
pack.exceptionsIntro.from: Learners let past a gate by a named person, with the reason they gave.

held.intro.text: 'n Leerder wat twee keer nog nie bevoeg bevind is nie, het nie gedruip nie. Die assessering word teruggehou, en 'n programhersiening word met hul werkgewer belê, want teen hierdie punt is die vraag selde of hulle dit ken nie, en gewoonlik wat rondom hulle aan die gang was.
held.intro.from: A learner found not yet competent twice is not failed. The assessment is held, and a programme review is convened with their employer, because by this point the question is rarely whether they know it, and usually what has been going on around them.

held.empty.text: Dit vul wanneer 'n leerder vir 'n tweede keer nog nie bevoeg bevind word in 'n summatiewe assessering nie. Tot dan is daar niks om te hersien nie.
held.empty.from: This fills when a learner is found not yet competent for a second time on a summative assessment. Until then there is nothing to review.

held.whoConvenes.text: 'n Fasiliteerder of administrateur belê die hersiening.
held.whoConvenes.from: A facilitator or administrator convenes the review.

held.oralAuthorised.text: {assessment} · die hersiening het 'n derde poging gemagtig, mondeling afgelê
held.oralAuthorised.from: {assessment} · the review authorised a third attempt, conducted orally

held.whoConducts.text: 'n Assessor lei die mondelinge poging, en nie die persoon wat dit gemagtig het nie.
held.whoConducts.from: An assessor conducts the oral attempt, and not the person who authorised it.

held.furtherLearning.text: Verdere leer voor enige verdere poging
held.furtherLearning.from: Further learning before any further attempt

held.whyHint.text: Wat die hersiening bevind het, en waarop dit berus.
held.whyHint.from: What the review found, and what it turns on.

oral.reviewDecidedIntro.text: Die gronde waarop hierdie derde poging gemagtig is.
oral.reviewDecidedIntro.from: The grounds on which this third attempt was authorised.

oral.employerNotConsulted.text: Die werkgewer is nie geraadpleeg nie.

oral.recordIntro.text: 'n Mondelinge poging laat geen bewyse van sy eie na nie. Dit is daardie bewyse, en die uitkoms kan nie sonder dit aangeteken word nie.
oral.recordIntro.from: An oral attempt leaves no evidence of its own. This is that evidence, and the outcome cannot be recorded without it.

oral.outcomeIntro.text: Op dieselfde manier beoordeel as 'n skriftelike poging, teenoor dieselfde kriteria, en daarna op dieselfde manier gemodereer.
oral.outcomeIntro.from: Judged the same way as a written attempt, against the same criteria, and moderated the same way afterwards.

oral.howHint.text: Persoonlik, of die video-oproep waarop dit gehou is
oral.howHint.from: In person, or the video call it was held on

oral.presentNote.text: Nie verpligtend nie. 'n Mondelinge assessering met niemand anders in die vertrek nie, is moeiliker om by moderering te verdedig, en die rekord moet sê watter soort dit was.
oral.presentNote.from: Not required. An oral assessment with nobody else in the room is harder to defend at moderation, and the record should say which kind this was.

oral.savedNext.text: Die uitkoms word op die merkskerm aangeteken, soos enige ander poging.
oral.savedNext.from: The outcome is recorded on the marking screen, the same as any other attempt.

appeals.intro.text: 'n Leerder kan appèl aanteken teen 'n uitslag of teen 'n assessor se gedrag. Ontvangs word binne {hours} uur erken, wat die sperdatum is wat gemis word, omdat dit loop terwyl iemand besig is om les te gee.
appeals.intro.from: A learner may appeal against a result or against an assessor's conduct. Receipt is acknowledged within {hours} hours, which is the deadline that gets missed, because it runs while somebody is teaching.

appeals.lateIntro.text: Verby die {hours} uur en steeds nie erken nie. Om laat te erken is beter as glad nie, en die rekord sal albei wys.
appeals.lateIntro.from: Past the {hours} hours and still not acknowledged. Acknowledging late is better than not at all, and the record will show both.

appeals.openIntro.text: Alles wat aangeteken en nog nie gesluit is nie, nuutste eerste.
appeals.openIntro.from: Everything lodged and not yet closed, newest first.

appeals.none.text: Niks oop nie. 'n Appèl word vanaf 'n leerder se eie bladsy aangeteken.
appeals.none.from: Nothing open. An appeal is lodged from a learner's own page.

appeals.procedureIntro.text: Erken, ontmoet die leerder, raadpleeg die moderator waar die grond 'n uitslag is, en los dit dan op en vertel hulle.
appeals.procedureIntro.from: Acknowledge, meet the learner, consult the moderator where the ground is a result, then resolve and tell them.

appeals.closedUnacknowledged.text: Gesluit sonder dat 'n erkenning aangeteken is.
appeals.closedUnacknowledged.from: Closed without an acknowledgement being recorded.

appeals.firstCounts.text: Die eerste erkenning is die een wat die rekord behou. Dit kan nie later oorgestempel word nie, want 'n tyd wat verander kan word, is nie bewys van enigiets nie.
appeals.firstCounts.from: The first acknowledgement is the one the record keeps. It cannot be re-stamped later, because a time that can be changed is not evidence of anything.

appeals.resultNeedsModerator.text: 'n Uitslagappèl gaan na die interne moderator voordat dit opgelos kan word. Dit is die stap waaroor 'n eksterne verifieerder vra.
appeals.resultNeedsModerator.from: A result appeal goes to the internal moderator before it can be resolved. That is the step an external verifier asks about.

appeals.conductNoModerator.text: 'n Gedragsappèl is nie iets wat herbeoordeling besleg nie, dus is geen moderator nodig nie.
appeals.conductNoModerator.from: A conduct appeal is not something re-marking settles, so no moderator is required.

appeals.notFeedback.text: 'n Besluit wat nie aan die leerder gegee is nie, is nie terugvoer nie.
appeals.notFeedback.from: A decision the learner has not been given is not feedback.

appeals.whyHint.text: Hoekom. Dit is die deel waarop die leerder geregtig is.
appeals.whyHint.from: Why. This is the part the learner is entitled to.

appeals.notesIntro.text: Die bespreking tussen koördineerder, assessor en moderator. Word nie aan die leerder gewys nie tensy u so sê; waarop hulle geregtig is, is die uitkoms en die redenasie hierbo.
appeals.notesIntro.from: The discussion between coordinator, assessor and moderator. Not shown to the learner unless you say so; what they are entitled to is the outcome and the reasoning above.

appeals.noteHint.text: Wat bespreek is, en met wie
appeals.noteHint.from: What was discussed, and with whom

appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.text: 'n Onttrekking vereis 'n rede. Een sonder een lyk soos druk, en dit is presies waaroor 'n appèl oor gedrag sou gaan.
appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.from: A withdrawal needs a reason. One with none looks like pressure, and that is exactly what an appeal about conduct would be about.

rpl.intro.text: Vir 'n leerder wat reeds 'n deel van die werk kan doen. Niks hier word op een persoon se woord toegestaan nie: 'n oordeel word gemaak teen die module se eie kriteria, volledig neergeskryf, en gemodereer deur iemand anders as wie dit gemaak het voordat dit enigiets beteken.
rpl.intro.from: For a learner who can already do part of the work. Nothing here is granted on one person's say-so: a judgement is made against the module's own criteria, written down in full, and moderated by somebody other than whoever made it before it counts for anything.

rpl.waitingIntro.text: 'n Oordeel staan niks toe voordat dit gedoen is nie. Lees die motivering teenoor die module voordat u instem: dit is die eerste ding wat 'n eksterne verifieerder lees.
rpl.waitingIntro.from: A judgement grants nothing until this is done. Read the rationale against the module before agreeing: it is the first thing an external verifier reads.

rpl.appearHere.text: Oordele verskyn hier soos dit gemaak word.
rpl.appearHere.from: Judgements appear here as they are made.

rpl.openIntro.text: Die eerste stap, en die een wat die rekord skep waaraan alles anders geheg word.
rpl.openIntro.from: The first step, and the one that creates the record everything else attaches to.

rpl.transferIntro.text: Anders as erkenning van vorige leer: die leerder besit reeds 'n kwalifikasie waarvan die uitkomste hierdie module dek. Geen adviesdiens nie, maar die ooreenstemming moet neergeskryf word; 'n oordrag daarsonder is 'n bewering wat niemand kan nagaan nie.
rpl.transferIntro.from: Different from RPL: the learner already holds a qualification whose outcomes cover this module. No advisory, but the mapping has to be written down; a transfer without it is a claim nobody can check.

rpl.needsBoth.text: 'n Aansoek benodig 'n leerder en 'n kwalifikasie om voor aansoek te doen. Voeg eers daardie by.
rpl.needsBoth.from: An application needs a learner and a qualification to apply against. Add those first.

rpl.needsLearner.text: Voeg 'n leerder by voordat u 'n oordrag vir een aanteken.
rpl.needsLearner.from: Add a learner before recording a transfer for one.

rpl.mapping.text: Hoe die uitkomste van wat hulle besit hierdie module s'n dek
rpl.mapping.from: How the outcomes of what they hold cover this module's

rpl.agree.text: Ek stem saam met hierdie oordeel

rpl.checked.text: Wat u nagegaan het, en wat u tot die gevolgtrekking gekom het
rpl.checked.from: What you checked, and what you concluded

record.print.text: Druk hierdie bladsy om dit as 'n PDF vir die portefeulje van bewyse te bewaar.
record.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF for the portfolio of evidence.

record.timeExpired.text: Nie aanvaar nie: die tydsbeperking het verstryk en die werk is ingelewer soos dit was.
record.timeExpired.from: Not accepted: the time limit expired and the work was handed in as it stood.

record.returned.text: Teruggestuur {date}. Dit is ontwikkelend: dit teken geen bevoegdheid aan nie.
record.returned.from: Returned {date}. This is developmental: it records no competence.

sor.withdrawConsequence.text: 'n Assesseringsentrum het dalk reeds 'n afskrif. Die verwysing bly werk en sal sê dat dit onttrek is.
sor.withdrawConsequence.from: An assessment centre may already hold a copy. The reference keeps working and will say it was withdrawn.

sor.print.from: Print or save this Statement of Results

fisa.intro.text: Die vraestel wat hierdie verskaffer vir sy eie vaardigheidsprogram opstel. Anders as 'n eksterne assessering, skryf u dit en modereer u dit, dus vind die moderering plaas voordat iemand dit skryf, en 'n vraestel wat nie as geskik vir die doel goedgekeur is nie, kan nie gebruik word nie.
fisa.intro.from: The paper this provider sets for its own skills programme. Unlike an external assessment, you write it and you moderate it, so the moderation happens before anybody sits it, and a paper that has not been signed off as fit for purpose cannot be used.

fisa.waitingIntro.text: Niemand kan hierdie skryf voordat 'n moderator dit goedgekeur het nie.
fisa.waitingIntro.from: Nobody can sit these until a moderator signs them off.

fisa.setNewIntro.text: Teenoor 'n vaardigheidsprogram. 'n Volledige of gedeeltelike kwalifikasie word ekstern geassesseer.
fisa.setNewIntro.from: Against a skills programme. A full or part qualification is assessed externally.

fisa.gate.approved.text: Goedgekeur as geskik vir die doel: kandidate mag hierdie vraestel skryf
fisa.gate.approved.from: Signed off as fit for purpose: candidates may sit this paper

fisa.gate.in_moderation.text: By die moderator: niemand mag dit nog skryf nie
fisa.gate.in_moderation.from: With the moderator: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.gate.draft.text: Word geskryf: niemand mag dit nog skryf nie
fisa.gate.draft.from: Being written: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.beforeNotAfter.text: 'n FISA word gemodereer voordat dit geskryf word, nie daarna nie. Dit maak dit verdedigbaar by 'n moniteringsbesoek.
fisa.beforeNotAfter.from: A FISA is moderated before it is sat, not after. That is what makes it defensible at a monitoring visit.

fisa.practical.text: Het ook 'n praktiese komponent, beoordeel as bevoeg of nog nie bevoeg nie.
fisa.practical.from: Also has a practical component, judged competent or not yet competent.

fisa.moderatorIntro.text: Gaan na dat dit geskik is vir die doel, voordat iemand dit skryf.
fisa.moderatorIntro.from: Checks it is fit for purpose, before anybody sits it.

fisa.unsigned.text: Nog geen vertroulikheidsooreenkoms nie. Hulle mag nie die vraestel sien of beoordeel voordat dit geteken is nie.
fisa.unsigned.from: No confidentiality agreement yet. They may not see or judge the paper until it is signed.

fisa.outcomes.text: Uitgangsvlakuitkomste, en waar die vraestel dit assesseer
fisa.outcomes.from: Exit level outcomes, and where the paper assesses them

fisa.outcomesIntro.text: Afdeling 2 van albei verslae. Die enigste plek wat toon dat die vraestel die kwalifikasie dek eerder as om bloot soos 'n eksamen te lyk.
fisa.outcomesIntro.from: Section 2 of both reports. The only place that shows the paper covers the qualification rather than merely looking like an exam.

fisa.noOutcomes.text: Hierdie program het geen uitgangsvlakuitkomste aangeteken nie, dus is daar niks om die vraestel teen te karteer nie. Voer eers die kurrikulum in.
fisa.noOutcomes.from: This programme has no exit level outcomes recorded, so there is nothing to map the paper against. Import the curriculum first.

fisa.onlyExaminer.text: Slegs die aangestelde eksaminator kan hierdie beantwoord, sodra hul vertroulikheidsooreenkoms geteken is.
fisa.onlyExaminer.from: Only the appointed examiner, once their confidentiality agreement is signed, can answer these.

fisa.onlyModerator.text: Slegs die aangestelde moderator kan hierdie beantwoord, sodra hul vertroulikheidsooreenkoms geteken is.
fisa.onlyModerator.from: Only the appointed moderator, once their confidentiality agreement is signed, can answer these.

fisa.handOverIntro.text: Sodra u eie verslag voltooi is.
fisa.handOverIntro.from: Once your own report is complete.

fisa.laterIntro.text: Hierdie een bly presies soos dit is, omdat kandidate dit dalk geskryf het. 'n Nuwe weergawe benodig sy eie moderering.
fisa.laterIntro.from: This one stays exactly as it is, because candidates may have sat it. A new version needs its own moderation.

fisa.noProgrammes.text: 'n FISA word teenoor 'n vaardigheidsprogram opgestel, en daar is nog geen nie. Voer eers een in; 'n volledige of gedeeltelike kwalifikasie word ekstern deur die assesseringskwaliteitsvennoot geassesseer, dus stel die verskaffer nie daardie vraestel nie.
fisa.noProgrammes.from: A FISA is set against a skills programme, and there are none yet. Import one first; a full or part qualification is assessed externally by the Assessment Quality Partner, so the provider does not set that paper.

fisa.passNote.text: 'n FISA is 'n eksamen, dus het dit een, anders as interne bevoegdheid.
fisa.passNote.from: A FISA is an examination, so it has one, unlike internal competence.

fisa.hasPractical.text: Dit het ook 'n praktiese komponent wat as bevoeg of nog nie bevoeg nie beoordeel word
fisa.hasPractical.from: It also has a practical component judged competent or not yet competent

fisa.practicalHint.text: bv. Prakties: 4 uur, beoordeel as bevoeg / nog nie bevoeg nie
fisa.practicalHint.from: e.g. Practical: 4 hours, judged competent / not yet competent

fisa.idNote.text: Hoe die platform een persoon van 'n ander onderskei wanneer hulle nie 'n rekening hier het nie.
fisa.idNote.from: How the platform tells one person from another when they have no account here.

fisa.account.text: Hul rekening hier, indien hulle een het
fisa.account.from: Their account here, if they have one

fisa.outside.from: Somebody from outside, with no account

fisa.accountNote.text: Slegs iemand met 'n rekening kan hul eie verslag hier invul.
fisa.accountNote.from: Only somebody with an account can fill in their own report here.

fisa.standardComment.text: Opmerking oor die standaard wat behaal is

fisa.further.text: Verdere opmerkings vir die verbetering van assesseringstandaarde
fisa.further.from: Further comments for the improvement of assessment standards

fisa.signOff.text: Teken af as geskik vir die doel
fisa.signOff.from: Sign off as fit for purpose

fisa.untilYouDo.text: Geen kandidaat mag hierdie vraestel skryf voordat u dit doen nie.
fisa.untilYouDo.from: No candidate may sit this paper until you do.

eisa.intro.text: Wanneer elke sitting is, wanneer registrasie daarvoor sluit, en watter kohorte nog ingeskryf moet word. Registrasie sluit gewoonlik ongeveer drie maande vooruit, en daarom moet 'n kohort wat later in die jaar klaarmaak lank voordat dit klaarmaak, ingeskryf word.
eisa.intro.from: When each sitting is, when registration for it closes, and which cohorts still have to be entered. Registration typically closes about three months ahead, which is why a cohort finishing later in the year has to be entered long before it finishes.

eisa.registerNowIntro.text: Registrasie sluit binne tien werksdae en hierdie kohorte het geen registrasiedatum aangeteken nie.
eisa.registerNowIntro.from: Registration closes within ten working days and these cohorts have no registration date recorded.

eisa.sittingsIntro.text: Slegs dié wat nog oop is vir registrasie. 'n Gesluite een is niks waarop iemand kan optree nie, en om dit hier te laat, sou die volgende regte sperdatum af teen die bladsy druk.
eisa.sittingsIntro.from: Only those still open for registration. A closed one is nothing anybody can act on, and leaving it here would push the next real deadline down the page.

eisa.nextYear.text: Niks is verder as hierdie jaar aangeteken nie. Die assesseringskwaliteitsvennoot publiseer volgende jaar se datums in Desember, dus behoort die brief uit te wees; om dit nou by te voeg, hou die aftelling tot in Januarie aan die gang.
eisa.nextYear.from: Nothing is recorded beyond this year. The assessment quality partner publishes next year's dates in December, so the letter should be out; adding them now is what keeps the countdown running into January.

eisa.toEnterIntro.text: Alles met 'n oop sperdatum en geen registrasiedatum daarteen aangeteken nie.
eisa.toEnterIntro.from: Everything with an open deadline and no registration date recorded against it.

eisa.noQualification.text: Geen kwalifikasie op hierdie inskrywings nie

eisa.noIdIntro.text: Elke kwaliteitsvennoot vra daarvoor, en 'n registrasie wat vir 'n ontbrekende nommer teruggestuur word, kos 'n siklus. Beter nou gevind as nadat die lêer gestuur is.
eisa.noIdIntro.from: Every quality partner asks for one, and a registration returned for a missing number costs a cycle. Better found now than after the file is sent.

eisa.readyIntro.text: Elke kriterium in elke module behaal, hetsy geleer of deur vorige leer erken.
eisa.readyIntro.from: Every criterion in every module met, whether taught or recognised through prior learning.

eisa.nobodyYet.text: Nog niemand nie. Die lys hieronder sê hoe ver elkeen nog moet gaan.
eisa.nobodyYet.from: Nobody yet. The list below says how far each of them has to go.

eisa.notReadyIntro.text: Hoe ver elkeen nog moet gaan. Iemand een kriterium kort kan steeds die sperdatum haal as dit hierdie week raakgesien word.
eisa.notReadyIntro.from: How far each has to go. Somebody one criterion short can still make the deadline if it is noticed this week.

ready.intro.text: 'n Leerder mag die eksterne geïntegreerde summatiewe assessering skryf sodra elke interne assesseringskriterium in elke module behaal is. Nie die meeste daarvan nie, en geen persentasie kom in sy plek nie: die persentasie hieronder is vordering, die kenteken is toestemming.
ready.intro.from: A learner may sit the External Integrated Summative Assessment once every internal assessment criterion in every module has been achieved. Not most of them, and no percentage stands in for it: the percentage below is progress, the badge is permission.

ready.nobody.text: Niemand is nog teenoor 'n kwalifikasie ingeskryf nie. Skryf 'n leerder in vir 'n kursus en kies die kwalifikasie waarvoor dit tel, en hulle sal hier verskyn.
ready.nobody.from: Nobody is enrolled against a qualification yet. Enrol a learner on a course and choose the qualification it counts towards, and they will appear here.

ready.notCaptured.text: 'n Kurrikulum hier is nie volledig vasgelê nie.
ready.notCaptured.from: A curriculum here is not fully captured.

ready.notCapturedIntro.text: Sommige modules dra geen assesseringskriteria nie, dus kan niks daarteen behaal word nie en kan niemand op daardie kwalifikasie gereed verklaar word nie. Voer die volledige kurrikulumdokument in voordat u iemand vir 'n EISA inskryf.
ready.notCapturedIntro.from: Some modules carry no assessment criteria, so nothing can be achieved against them and nobody on that qualification can be declared ready. Import the full curriculum document before entering anyone for an EISA.

ready.notEligible.text: Nog nie geskik vir die EISA nie
ready.notEligible.from: Not yet eligible for the EISA

ready.achieved.text: {achieved} van {total} interne assesseringskriteria behaal, en werkervaring bewys deur 'n geteken {record}.
ready.achieved.from: {achieved} of {total} internal assessment criteria achieved, and work experience proved by a signed {record}.

ready.canIssue.from: A Statement of Results can be issued.

ready.everyOne.text: Elkeen daarvan is vereis; daar is geen slaagpunt nie.
ready.everyOne.from: Every one of them is required; there is no pass mark.

ready.perUnitIntro.text: 'n Staat vir een studie-eenheid bevestig elke kriterium in die modules wat daardie eenheid lewer. Dit kan uitgereik word sodra daardie eenheid klaar is, sonder om op die res van die kwalifikasie te wag.
ready.perUnitIntro.from: A statement for one study unit confirms every criterion in the modules that unit delivers. It can be issued as soon as that unit is finished, without waiting for the rest of the qualification.

ready.certificateIntro.text: Deur die toekennende liggaam uitgereik ná die EISA, nie deur {provider} nie. Hier aangeteken wanneer dit aankom, sodat die leerder se rekord sê dat hulle gekwalifiseer is.
ready.certificateIntro.from: Issued by the awarding body after the EISA, not by {provider}. Recorded here when it arrives, so the learner's record says they are qualified.

ready.thisNotCaptured.text: Hierdie kurrikulum is nie volledig vasgelê nie.
ready.thisNotCaptured.from: This curriculum is not fully captured.

ready.thisNotCapturedIntro.text: {modules} dra geen assesseringskriteria nie. Niemand kan teenoor hierdie kwalifikasie geskik verklaar word voordat die volledige kurrikulumdokument ingevoer is nie; anders sou die ontbrekende modules stilweg as geslaag tel.
ready.thisNotCapturedIntro.from: {modules} carry no assessment criteria. Nobody can be declared eligible against this qualification until the full curriculum document has been imported; otherwise the missing modules would silently count as passed.

ready.weight.document.from: as stated in the curriculum document

ready.weight.credits.text: afgelei van modulekrediete; die dokument stel geen persentasies nie
ready.weight.credits.from: derived from module credits; the document states no percentages

ready.weight.equal.text: gelykop verdeel; die dokument stel geen persentasies en geen krediete nie
ready.weight.equal.from: split evenly; the document states no percentages and no credits

ready.workProved.text: Werkervaring word bewys deur 'n {record} wat deur die werkplekafrigter geteken en deur 'n assessor aanvaar is, nie deur assesseringskriteria nie. Die kurrikulum omskryf geen vir hierdie module nie.
ready.workProved.from: Work experience is proved by a {record} signed by the workplace coach and accepted by an assessor, not by assessment criteria. The curriculum defines none for this module.

ready.noRecord.text: Geen {record} is vir hierdie module geopen nie.
ready.noRecord.from: No {record} has been opened for this module.

ready.noCriteria.text: Geen assesseringskriteria vir hierdie module vasgelê nie.
ready.noCriteria.from: No assessment criteria captured for this module.

issue.notYet.text: 'n Uitslagstaat kan nog nie uitgereik word nie.
issue.notYet.from: A Statement of Results cannot be issued yet.

preview.summative.text: Summatief: deur 'n persoon beoordeel en onafhanklik gemodereer
preview.summative.from: Summative: judged by a person and independently moderated

preview.formative.text: Formatief: gemerk soos die leerder vorder
preview.formative.from: Formative: marked as the learner goes

preview.whoMarks.text: {app} deur die toepassing gemerk, {assessor} deur 'n assessor
preview.whoMarks.from: {app} marked by the App, {assessor} by an assessor

preview.isPreviewIntro.text: Presies wat 'n leerder sien, met die blokkies waarin hulle sou tik. Niks word gestoor nie en geen poging is begin nie, dus is die kontroles afgeskakel. Die paneel onder elke vraag is vir u omdat u hierdie vraestel opgestel het; 'n leerder sien dit nooit nie.
preview.isPreviewIntro.from: Exactly what a learner sees, with the boxes they would type into. Nothing is saved and no attempt has been started, so the controls are switched off. The panel under each question is for you because you built this paper; a learner never sees it.

preview.empty.text: Daar is nog geen vrae in hierdie vraestel nie.
preview.empty.from: There are no questions in this paper yet.

preview.tickedAbove.text: Die korrekte opsie is hierbo afgemerk.
preview.tickedAbove.from: The correct option is ticked above.

preview.noGuide.text: Geen nasiengids nie. 'n Assessor het niks om dit teen te merk nie; voeg een by voordat die vraestel gebruik word.
preview.noGuide.from: No marking guide. An assessor has nothing to mark this against; add one before the paper is used.

preview.declarationIntro.text: 'n Leerder kan dit nie inlewer sonder om daarmee saam te stem nie, en die presiese bewoording word in die inlewering vasgevries.
preview.declarationIntro.from: A learner cannot hand this in without agreeing to it, and the exact wording is frozen into the submission.

people.intro.text: Almal in {provider}, hul rolle, en of hul rekord bevat wat 'n statutêre opgawe nodig het.
people.intro.from: Everyone in {provider}, their roles, and whether their record carries what a statutory return needs.

people.notEnrolledOne.text: 1 leerder is nie vir enigiets ingeskryf nie.
people.notEnrolledOne.from: 1 learner is not enrolled on anything.

people.notEnrolledMany.text: {count} leerders is nie vir enigiets ingeskryf nie.
people.notEnrolledMany.from: {count} learners are not enrolled on anything.

people.notEnrolledWhy.text: Om 'n leerder te wees, verleen op sigself geen toegang nie, dus meld hulle aan by 'n leë skerm. Skryf hulle in vir 'n kursus, voeg hulle by 'n kohort, of wys 'n program toe.
people.notEnrolledWhy.from: Being a learner grants no access on its own, so they sign in to an empty screen. Enrol them on a course, add them to a cohort, or assign a programme.

people.missingOne.text: 1 persoon mis besonderhede wat 'n SETA- of SAQA-opgawe benodig.
people.missingOne.from: 1 person is missing details a SETA or SAQA return needs.

people.missingMany.text: {count} mense mis besonderhede wat 'n SETA- of SAQA-opgawe benodig.
people.missingMany.from: {count} people are missing details a SETA or SAQA return needs.

people.missingWhy.text: Hulle word hieronder gemerk. Om dit nou in te vul, is baie makliker as die aand voor 'n indiening.
