badges.says.text: Wat dit sê, vir die leerder en enigiemand aan wie hy of sy dit wys (opsioneel)
badges.says.from: What it says, for the learner and anybody they show it to (optional)

badges.saysHint.text: Het die praktiese module oor werk op hoogte voltooi, geassesseer teen die kurrikulumkriteria.
badges.saysHint.from: Completed the practical module on working at heights, assessed against the curriculum criteria.

badges.retireTitle.text: Hou op om {name} toe te ken. Almal wat dit het, behou dit.
badges.retireTitle.from: Stop awarding {name}. Everybody who has it keeps it.

templates.intro.text: Die dokumente wat {name} produseer. Hoe elkeen lees en lyk, is aan u: skryf u eie weergawe en die platform produseer dit daaruit in plaas van volgens sy eie uitleg. Wat 'n reguleerder vereis, word ná u s'n bygevoeg en kan nie gewysig word nie, omdat daardie deel nie die verskaffer s'n is om te verander nie.
templates.intro.from: The documents {name} produces. How each one reads and looks is yours: write your own version and the platform produces it from that instead of its own layout. What a regulator requires is added after yours and cannot be edited, because that part is not the provider's to change.

templates.goesTo.statement_of_results.text: Die leerder, wat dit saam met sy of haar identiteitsdokument na die assesseringsentrum neem.
templates.goesTo.statement_of_results.from: The learner, who carries it to the assessment centre with their identity document.

templates.goesTo.certificate.text: Die leerder, en wie hy of sy dit ook al wys.
templates.goesTo.certificate.from: The learner, and whoever they show it to.

templates.goesTo.workplace_statement.text: Die leerder se lêer, geteken deur 'n afrigter by die gasheerwerkewer.
templates.goesTo.workplace_statement.from: The learner's file, signed by a coach at the host employer.

templates.goesTo.enrolment_form.text: Geliasseer as bewys, en aan 'n QCTO-monitor oorhandig tydens 'n besoek.
templates.goesTo.enrolment_form.from: Filed as evidence, and handed to a QCTO monitor on a visit.

templates.producesNote.text: Enigiets sonder u eie weergawe gebruik die platform se uitleg, wat 'n werkende dokument is eerder as 'n plekhouer.
templates.producesNote.from: Anything without your own version uses the platform's layout, which is a working document rather than a placeholder.

templates.writeNote.text: Begin met die platform se uitleg en wysig dit tot u s'n. Elke veld wat die dokument kan dra, word langs die redigeerder gelys met 'n regte voorbeeld van hoe dit lyk.
templates.writeNote.from: Start from the platform's layout and edit it down into yours. Every field the document can carry is listed beside the editor with a real example of what it looks like.

templates.supplied.text: Dokumente wat u verskaf eerder as uitlê
templates.supplied.from: Documents you supply rather than lay out

templates.suppliedNote.text: Nie elke dokument is 'n sjabloon wat die platform invul nie.
templates.suppliedNote.from: Not every document is a template the platform fills in.

templates.policiesNote.text: u akkrediteringsbrief, beleide en ooreenkomste, opgelaai en bewaar eerder as gegenereer.
templates.policiesNote.from: your accreditation letter, policies and agreements, uploaded and retained rather than generated.

templates.fisaNote.text: geskryf deur u eie eksaminator en gemodereer voordat iemand dit skryf, dus word dit opgestel eerder as gesjabloneer.
templates.fisaNote.from: written by your own examiner and moderated before anybody sits them, so they are authored rather than templated.

templates.curriculumNote.text: die gepubliseerde kwalifikasiedokumente wat die platform lees om 'n kurrikulum daaruit te bou.
templates.curriculumNote.from: the published qualification documents the platform reads to build a curriculum from.

tracker.all.text: Elke kohort, insluitend dié wat klaar en gekanselleer is.
tracker.all.from: Every cohort, including those finished and cancelled.

tracker.note.text: Gelees uit die rekords eerder as met die hand gehou, sodat dit nie kan verskil van die platform waaroor dit verslag doen nie.
tracker.note.from: Read from the records rather than kept by hand, so it cannot disagree with the platform it reports on.

tracker.none.text: Nog geen kohorte nie. 'n Kohort is waaraan 'n skedule, 'n register en 'n statutêre opgawe almal hang.
tracker.none.from: No cohorts yet. A cohort is what a schedule, a register and a statutory return all hang from.

dictionary.intro.text: Die vasgestelde betekenis van elke term wat regdeur hierdie platform, sy dokumente en sy leermateriaal gebruik word. Elke inskrywing sê wie die woord besit. Waar 'n owerheid dit definieer, gebruik ons dit soos hulle, en die liggaam word genoem. Waar die woord ons s'n is, kan ons dit verander. Waar dit bloot algemene gebruik is, moet dit nooit as 'n vereiste aangehaal word nie.
dictionary.intro.from: The settled meaning of every term used across this platform, its documents and its learning material. Each entry says who owns the word. Where an authority defines it, we use it as they do and the body is named. Where the word is ours, we can change it. Where it is simply common usage, it should never be cited as a requirement.

dictionary.searchHint.text: 'n Term, 'n afkorting, of 'n woord in 'n definisie
dictionary.searchHint.from: A term, an abbreviation, or a word in a definition

dictionary.meaning.authority.text: Deur 'n owerheid gedefinieer. Gebruik dit soos hulle: as die betekenis verander word, loop 'n indiening gevaar.
dictionary.meaning.authority.from: Defined by an authority. Use it as they do: changing the meaning puts a submission at risk.

dictionary.meaning.platform.text: Hierdie platform se eie woord daarvoor. Ons s'n om te verander; geen owerheid skryf dit voor nie.
dictionary.meaning.platform.from: This platform's own word for it. Ours to change; no authority prescribes it.

dictionary.meaning.practice.text: Algemene gebruik in die sektor, sonder enkele eienaar. Moenie dit as 'n vereiste aanhaal nie.
dictionary.meaning.practice.from: Common usage across the sector, with no single owner. Do not cite it as a requirement.

dictionary.none.text: Niks stem ooreen nie. As 'n term ontbreek en dit een is wat ons gebruik, hoort dit hier: sê so en dit sal in die volgende vrystelling bygevoeg word.
dictionary.none.from: Nothing matches. If a term is missing and it is one we use, it belongs here: say so and it will be added in the next release.

feedbackForm.intro.text: {cohort}. Antwoorde word saam met almal anders s'n gerapporteer, nie een vir een nie. Dit neem ongeveer twee minute, en dit is die enigste ding wat verander hoe die volgende kohort bestuur word.
feedbackForm.intro.from: {cohort}. Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. It takes about two minutes, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

feedbackReport.ratingsNote.text: Gemiddeld van 1 (verskil sterk) tot 5 (stem sterk saam). 'n Gemiddeld oor min antwoorde is 'n stemming, nie 'n meting nie, dus staan die telling daarnaas.
feedbackReport.ratingsNote.from: Mean of 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree). A mean over few answers is a mood, not a measurement, so the count is beside it.

feedbackReport.saidNote.text: Saam en sonder name gewys. Terugvoer oor 'n fasiliteerder is slegs eerlik as die leerder glo dit sal nie een vir een aan hom of haar teruggelees word nie.
feedbackReport.saidNote.from: Shown together and without names. Feedback about a facilitator is only honest if the learner believes it will not be read back to them one by one.

feedbackReport.outstandingNote.text: Die enigste plek waar 'n naam verskyn. Opvolging het hulle nodig; die antwoorde hierbo nie.
feedbackReport.outstandingNote.from: The one place a name appears. Chasing needs them; the answers above do not.

conductPage.intro.text: Griewe wat deur leerders geopper is, en enigiemand wat volgens die register opgehou het opdaag. Dissiplinêre sake is op die leerder se eie bladsy, waar die res van hul rekord is.
conductPage.intro.from: Grievances raised by learners, and anybody the register says has stopped turning up. Disciplinary matters sit on the learner's own page, where the rest of their record is.

conductPage.overdueNote.text: 'n Grief word binne {days} werksdae erken. Hierdie is verby dit.
conductPage.overdueNote.from: A grievance is acknowledged within {days} working days. These are past that.

conductPage.grievancesNote.text: Geopper deur 'n leerder oor behandeling, toestande, of enigiets anders wat hom of haar raak. Apart gehou van appèlle, wat oor 'n uitslag gaan en na die moderator gaan.
conductPage.grievancesNote.from: Raised by a learner about treatment, conditions, or anything else affecting them. Kept apart from appeals, which are about a result and go to the moderator.

conductPage.abscondedNote.text: Twee of meer opeenvolgende opleidingsdae afwesig sonder berig. Gelees uit die register eerder as gestoor, sodat die regstelling van 'n merk die antwoord dadelik verander. 'n Afwesigheid wat as verskoon aangeteken is, is kommunikasie, en verbreek die reeks.
conductPage.abscondedNote.from: Two or more consecutive training days absent with no word. Read off the register rather than stored, so correcting a mark changes the answer at once. An absence recorded as excused is communication, and breaks the run.

conductPage.nobody.text: Niemand. Almal daag op of het iemand gesê hoekom nie.
conductPage.nobody.from: Nobody. Everybody is either turning up or has told somebody why not.

conductPage.actOn.text: 'n Lys om op op te tree, nooit 'n besluit nie. Om die leerder te kontak, aan die borg te skryf en 'n kennisgewing van voorneme om te beëindig uit te reik, is almal dinge wat 'n mens doen.
conductPage.actOn.from: A list to act on, never a decision. Contacting the learner, writing to the sponsor and issuing a notice of intention to terminate are all things a person does.

grievance.decisionHint.text: Wat bevind is en wat gedoen sal word. Dit gaan skriftelik na die leerder.
grievance.decisionHint.from: What was found and what will be done. This goes to the learner in writing.

grievance.impartial.text: Die ondersoeker moet iemand wees oor wie die grief nie gaan nie. Om een te noem oor wie die leerder gekla het, word geweier, omdat "'n aangewese onpartydige persoon" is wat die prosedure beloof en 'n week met te min personeel juis is wanneer dit verbreek word.
grievance.impartial.from: The investigator must be somebody the grievance is not about. Naming one the learner has complained about is refused, because “a designated impartial person” is what the procedure promises and a short-staffed week is exactly when it gets broken.

access.deniedTitle.text: U het nie toegang hiertoe nie
access.deniedTitle.from: You do not have access to this

access.deniedNote.text: U is aangemeld, maar dit is nie vir u om te sien nie: óf dit behoort aan iemand anders, óf dit vereis 'n rol wat u rekening nie het nie. As u dink dit is verkeerd, vra u administrateur om dit na te gaan.
access.deniedNote.from: You are signed in, but this is not yours to see: either it belongs to someone else, or it needs a role your account does not hold. If you think that is wrong, ask your administrator to check.

access.unknownTitle.text: Hierdie adres is nie in gebruik nie
access.unknownTitle.from: This address is not in use

access.unknownNote.text: Geen organisasie is by hierdie webadres opgestel nie, of sy toegang is opgeskort. Kontroleer die adres wat aan u gegee is, of kontak wie ook al u opleiding gereël het.
access.unknownNote.from: No organisation is set up at this web address, or its access has been suspended. Check the address you were given, or contact whoever arranged your training.

wpSetup.intro.text: 'n Leerder doen werkervaring by 'n werkgewer, onder toesig van iemand wat daardie werkgewer verskaf. Die ooreenkoms teken aan wie dit is; die logboek teken aan wat die kurrikulum van hulle vereis om te doen.
wpSetup.intro.from: A learner does work experience at an employer, supervised by somebody that employer provides. The agreement records who that is; the logbook records what the curriculum requires them to do.

wpSetup.emptyOne.text: 1 werkervaringmodule het geen vereistes vasgelê nie.
wpSetup.emptyOne.from: 1 work experience module has no requirements captured.

wpSetup.empty.text: {count} werkervaringmodules het geen vereistes vasgelê nie.
wpSetup.empty.from: {count} work experience modules have no requirements captured.

wpSetup.emptyNote.text: {codes}. 'n Logboek wat uit 'n leë module gebou is, sou niks bevestig nie, dus kan dié nie oopgemaak word nie totdat die kurrikulum se werkaktiwiteite, werkplekkennis en ondersteunende bewyse ingevoer is.
wpSetup.emptyNote.from: {codes}. A logbook built from an empty module would attest to nothing, so those cannot be opened until the curriculum's work activities, workplace knowledge and supporting evidence have been imported.

wpSetup.noCoaches.text: Niemand hou nog die rol van Werkplekafrigter nie. Voeg eers die leerder se toesighouer by deur {people}: hulle werk vir die werkgewer, nie vir u nie, en sal slegs ooit die leerders sien wat op hul eie ooreenkomste genoem word.
wpSetup.noCoaches.from: Nobody holds the Workplace Coach role yet. Add the learner's supervisor through {people} first: they work for the employer, not for you, and they will only ever see the learners named on their own agreements.

wpSetup.ownCoach.text: Die leerder kan nie hul eie afrigter wees nie; die databasis weier dit.
wpSetup.ownCoach.from: The learner cannot be their own coach; the database refuses it.

wpSetup.designationNote.text: Aangeteken op die ooreenkoms soos dit vandag staan, sodat die afteken aanhou sê wie geteken het en in watter hoedanigheid.
wpSetup.designationNote.from: Recorded on the agreement as it stands today, so the sign-off keeps saying who signed and in what capacity.

wpSetup.noAgreements.text: Nog geen werkplekooreenkomste nie. Skep eers een hierbo: 'n logboek teken werk aan wat by 'n genoemde werkgewer onder 'n genoemde afrigter gedoen is, dus kan dit nie sonder een bestaan nie.
wpSetup.noAgreements.from: No workplace agreements yet. Create one above first: a logbook records work done at a named employer under a named coach, so it cannot exist without one.

wpSetup.generated.text: Die logboek word gegenereer uit die kurrikulum se eie werkaktiwiteite, werkplekkennis en ondersteunende bewyse, sodat dit nie 'n vereiste kan weglaat nie.
wpSetup.generated.from: The logbook is generated from the curriculum's own work activities, workplace knowledge and supporting evidence, so it cannot omit a requirement.

enrolForm.intro.text: {provider} moet hierdie besonderhede aan die Kwaliteitsraad vir Ambagte en Beroepe stuur wanneer u ingeskryf word. Meeste daarvan is reeds bekend en word hieronder gewys; die res is wat niemand behalwe u kan beantwoord nie. U kan stoor soos u gaan en later daarna terugkeer.
enrolForm.intro.from: {provider} has to send these details to the Quality Council for Trades and Occupations when you are enrolled. Most of it is already known and shown below; the rest is what nobody can answer except you. You can save as you go and come back to it.

enrolForm.onRecordNote.text: Sê vir u koördineerder as enige hiervan verkeerd is; dit is nie hier vir u om te verander nie.
enrolForm.onRecordNote.from: Tell your coordinator if any of this is wrong; it is not yours to change here.

enrolForm.doesNotAdd.from: Something here does not add up

enrolForm.idNote.text: 'n Suid-Afrikaanse identiteitsnommer dra die geboortedatum en die geslag binne-in dit, en die QCTO kontroleer dat hulle ooreenstem. Dit is gewoonlik 'n verkeerd getikte syfer. U koördineerder kan dit regstel.
enrolForm.idNote.from: A South African identity number carries the date of birth and the gender inside it, and the QCTO checks that they agree. It is usually a mistyped digit. Your coordinator can correct it.

enrolForm.stillNote.text: Niks gaan verlore as u halfpad stop nie. Dit is wat van die indiening sou ontbreek soos dit nou staan.
enrolForm.stillNote.from: Nothing is lost if you stop partway. This is what would be missing from the submission as it stands.

enrolForm.completeNote.text: Alles wat die indiening nodig het, is hier.
enrolForm.completeNote.from: Everything the submission needs is here.

enrolForm.missingPrint.text: {count} antwoorde ontbreek nog, dus sal hierdie vorm met leemtes druk. Hulle word op die vorm self gelys.
enrolForm.missingPrint.from: {count} answers are still missing, so this form will print with blanks. They are listed on the form itself.

enrolForm.completePrint.text: Volledig. Druk dit, laat die leerder dit teken, en lias dit.
enrolForm.completePrint.from: Complete. Print it, have the learner sign it, and file it.

enrolForm.titleHint.from: Mr, Ms, Dr, and so on.

enrolForm.middleHint.text: As u een het. Los dit leeg indien nie.
enrolForm.middleHint.from: If you have one. Leave it blank if not.

enrolForm.working.from: Are you working at the moment?

enrolForm.difficulty.from: How much difficulty does it cause?

enrolForm.difficultyHint.text: Gevra omdat 'n gestremdheid teen u naam aangeteken is. Die QCTO vereis dit saam daarmee.
enrolForm.difficultyHint.from: Asked because a disability is recorded against your name. The QCTO requires it alongside.

enrolForm.noId.text: As u nie 'n Suid-Afrikaanse identiteitsnommer het nie
enrolForm.noId.from: If you do not have a South African identity number

enrolForm.instead.from: What you are enrolled on instead

enrolForm.post.text: Waar pos u bereik, as dit êrens anders is
enrolForm.post.from: Where post reaches you, if it is somewhere else

enrolForm.provinceHint.text: Waar u werk, wat nie altyd is waar u woon nie.
enrolForm.provinceHint.from: Where you work, which is not always where you live.

enrolForm.statssaHint.text: U koördineerder kan hierdie een naslaan as u dit nie ken nie.
enrolForm.statssaHint.from: Your coordinator can look this one up if you do not know it.

enrolForm.flcNote.text: Slegs nodig vir 'n kwalifikasie op NKR-vlak 3 of 4. Los dit leeg as niemand dit van u gevra het nie.
enrolForm.flcNote.from: Only needed on a qualification at NQF level 3 or 4. Leave it blank if nobody has asked you for it.

enrolForm.agreedOn.text: U het op {date} ingestem. Daardie datum is deel van die rekord en verander nie as u hierdie vorm wysig nie.
enrolForm.agreedOn.from: You agreed on {date}. That date is part of the record and does not change if you edit this form.

enrolForm.agreedDate.text: Die datum waarop u instem, word aangeteken, omdat die opgawe vir albei vra.
enrolForm.agreedDate.from: The date you agree is recorded, because the return asks for both.

enrolForm.confirm.text: Stoor en bevestig dat dit reg is
enrolForm.confirm.from: Save and confirm these are right

records.intro.text: Die Kwaliteitsbestuurstelsel en sy beleide, akkrediteringsbriewe, kontrakte, en statutêre dokumente soos die PAIA-handleiding: alles wat die verskaffer hou wat nie aan een leerder of een kwalifikasie behoort nie. Die invoer van 'n kwalifikasievouer lias sy GBS-beleide outomaties hier.
records.intro.from: The Quality Management System and its policies, accreditation letters, contracts, and statutory documents like the PAIA manual: everything the provider holds that does not belong to one learner or one qualification. Importing a qualification folder files its QMS policies here automatically.

records.introManage.text: Dit wys ook wat die einde van sy bewaringstydperk bereik het.
records.introManage.from: It also shows what has reached the end of its retention period.

records.expiringNote.text: 'n Verstreke belastingklaring is die soort ding wat niemand opmerk totdat die week wanneer dit nodig is nie.
records.expiringNote.from: An expired tax clearance is the kind of thing nobody notices until the week it is needed.

records.libraryNote.text: Vervangde weergawes word gehou, omdat die beleid wat in Maart gegeld het, dié een is waaroor 'n oudit van Maart vra.
records.libraryNote.from: Superseded versions are kept, because the policy that governed in March is the one an audit of March asks about.

records.nothingManage.text: Die akkrediteringsbrief is die een wat die moeite werd is om eerste in te sit.
records.nothingManage.from: The accreditation letter is the one worth putting in first.

records.retentionNote.text: Getel vanaf die sertifiseringsdatum, oor die bewaringstydperk op hierdie huurder. Niks hier is geargiveer of vernietig nie: die platform sê wat verskuldig is en 'n persoon besluit.
records.retentionNote.from: Counted from the certification date, over the retention period on this tenant. Nothing here has been archived or destroyed: the platform says what is due and a person decides.

records.registerNote.text: Alles wat besluit is oor 'n rekord wat sy datum verby is, met wie besluit het. 'n Rekord wat stilweg verdwyn het, is erger as een wat te lank gehou is.
records.registerNote.from: Everything decided about a record past its date, with who decided it. A record that quietly disappeared is worse than one kept too long.

records.replacesNote.text: Die een wat dit vervang, word gehou en as vervang gemerk. Die beleid wat in Maart gegeld het, is waaroor 'n oudit van Maart vra.
records.replacesNote.from: The one it replaces is kept and marked superseded. The policy that governed in March is what an audit of March asks about.

records.descriptionHint.text: Wat dit is, as die titel dit nie sê nie
records.descriptionHint.from: What it is, if the title does not say

records.anybody.text: Enigiemand wat aangemeld is, mag dit lees
records.anybody.from: Anybody signed in may read this

records.anybodyNote.text: Geld vir statutêre dokumente. 'n Leerdergids word altyd aan leerders gewys; beleide, kontrakte, akkreditering en operasionele dokumente nooit.
records.anybodyNote.from: Applies to statutory documents. A learner guide is always shown to learners; policies, contracts, accreditation and operational documents never are.

records.archive.text: Argiveer: skuif dit uit die pad
records.archive.from: Archive: move it out of the way

offline.intro.text: Laai af wat u nodig het voordat u uitgaan. Alles wat u aanteken terwyl u weg is, word op hierdie foon gehou en teruggestuur die volgende keer dat u 'n sein het.
offline.intro.from: Download what you need before you go out. Anything you record while you are away is kept on this phone and sent back the next time you have a signal.

offline.takeNote.text: Laai af wat u nodig het voordat u gaan. Niks word gehou wat u nie gevra het nie.
offline.takeNote.from: Download what you need before you go. Nothing is kept that you did not ask for.

offline.nothingToStudy.text: U het tans niks om te studeer nie. Alles waarop u ingeskryf is, verskyn hier om af te laai.
offline.nothingToStudy.from: You have nothing to study at the moment. Anything you are enrolled on appears here to download.

offline.record.text: Teken aan wat u gedoen het

offline.recordNote.text: Werk sonder sein. Dit wag op hierdie foon en gaan wanneer u weer een het.
offline.recordNote.from: Works with no signal. It waits on this phone and goes when you next have one.

offline.waitingDecisionNote.text: Iets het verander terwyl die leerder weg was. Niks is saamgevoeg of oorskryf nie: iemand moet kies.
offline.waitingDecisionNote.from: Something changed while the learner was away. Nothing has been merged or overwritten: somebody has to choose.

offline.bothDates.text: Aangeteken op die toestel {captured} · by ons gekom {received}
offline.bothDates.from: Recorded on the device {captured} · reached us {received}

offline.relaxedNote.text: Werk wat aangeteken is terwyl hierdie program toegelaat het dat summatiewe assesserings vanlyn afgelê word. As die program later geakkrediteer word, word daardie werk nie terugwerkend verdedigbaar nie: dit is die lys, dus is dit 'n besluit eerder as 'n ontdekking by 'n moniteringsbesoek.
offline.relaxedNote.from: Work recorded while this programme allowed summatives to be taken offline. If the programme is accredited later, that work does not become defensible retrospectively: this is the list, so it is a decision rather than a discovery at a monitoring visit.

offline.cannotHold.text: Hierdie blaaier kan nie materiaal hou vir gebruik sonder 'n sein nie. Alles werk steeds normaal terwyl u gekoppel is.
offline.cannotHold.from: This browser cannot hold material for use without a signal. Everything still works normally while you are connected.

offline.noSignal.text: Geen sein: wys wat gehou word
offline.noSignal.from: No signal: showing what is held

offline.nothingHeld.text: Niks word nog gehou nie. Maak 'n studie-eenheid oop en kies om dit vanlyn beskikbaar te maak voordat u uitgaan.
offline.nothingHeld.from: Nothing is held yet. Open a study unit and choose to make it available offline before you go out.

offline.ofQuota.text: van ongeveer {quota} wat hierdie foon sal toelaat
offline.ofQuota.from: of about {quota} this phone will allow

offline.keepNote.text: Vra die foon om dit nie uit te vee terwyl u weg is nie.
offline.keepNote.from: Asks the phone not to clear it while you are away.

offline.noRoom.text: Daar is nie genoeg ruimte op hierdie foon nie. Verwyder eers iets wat vir 'n ander studie-eenheid gehou word: niks is afgelaai nie.
offline.noRoom.from: There is not enough room on this phone. Remove something held for another study unit first: nothing has been downloaded.

offline.onPhone.text: {label} is op hierdie foon. U kan dit sonder 'n sein lees.
offline.onPhone.from: {label} is on this phone. You can read it with no signal.

offline.incomplete.text: Dit het nie volledig afgelaai nie, dus is niks daarvan gehou nie. Probeer weer waar die sein beter is.
offline.incomplete.from: That did not download completely, so none of it has been kept. Try again where the signal is better.

offline.released.text: {label} word nie meer gehou nie. Dit het ruimte op hierdie foon vrygemaak.
offline.released.from: {label} is no longer held. It freed up room on this phone.

offline.cannotKeep.text: Hierdie blaaier kan nie materiaal hou vir gebruik sonder 'n sein nie.
offline.cannotKeep.from: This browser cannot keep material for use without a signal.

offline.pageOne.text: 1 bladsy. Laai dit af voordat u uitgaan.
offline.pageOne.from: 1 page. Download it before you go out.

offline.pages.text: {count} bladsye. Laai dit af voordat u uitgaan.
offline.pages.from: {count} pages. Download it before you go out.

offline.writeFirst.text: Skryf eers 'n nota of voeg 'n foto by.
offline.writeFirst.from: Write a note or add a photograph first.

offline.willGo.text: Op hierdie foon aangeteken. Dit sal gaan wanneer u 'n sein het.
offline.willGo.from: Recorded on this phone. It will go when you have a signal.

offline.whatYouDidHint.text: Die heininglyn langs die oostelike grens geïnspekteer.
offline.whatYouDidHint.from: Inspected the fence line along the eastern boundary.

offline.shrunk.text: Kleiner gemaak om ruimte te bespaar: {from} → {to}. Steeds duidelik genoeg om te assesseer.
offline.shrunk.from: Made smaller to save room: {from} → {to}. Still clear enough to assess.

mailbox.empty.text: Nog niks hier nie. Enigiets wat aan {address} gestuur word, kom in hierdie lys aan, met aanhegsels wat op dieselfde manier gestoor word as assesseringsbewyse.
mailbox.empty.from: Nothing here yet. Anything sent to {address} arrives in this list, with attachments stored the same way assessment evidence is.

mailbox.envelope.text: Die stuurbediener het homself as {address} geïdentifiseer, wat nie die adres in die Van-reël is nie. Gewoon vir poslyste en aangestuurde pos, en ook hoe 'n vervalste afsender lyk.
mailbox.envelope.from: The sending server identified itself as {address}, which is not the address in the From line. Ordinary for mailing lists and forwarded mail, and also what a forged sender looks like.

mailbox.notSwitchedOn.text: Stuur is nog nie aangeskakel nie: geen posrelais is opgestel nie, dus kon 'n boodskap wat hier geskryf word nie die gebou verlaat nie. Antwoorde wat u ontvang, kom steeds normaal aan.
mailbox.notSwitchedOn.from: Sending is not switched on yet: no mail relay is configured, so a message written here could not leave the building. Replies you receive still arrive normally.

lrs.intro.text: U leerders se rekords, in en uit, as xAPI-stellings: die formaat wat leerrekordstore en die meeste leerstelsels uitruil. Niks hier verander 'n leerder se uitslae op hierdie platform nie.
lrs.intro.from: Your learners' records, in and out, as xAPI statements: the format learning record stores and most learning systems exchange. Nothing here changes a learner's results on this platform.

lrs.outNote.text: Elke inskrywing, les voltooi, assessering aangepak, bevoeg of nog nie bevoeg-besluit, kursus voltooi, uitslagstaat, sertifikaat en kwalifikasiesertifikaat ontvang, een stelling elk. Elkeen behou dieselfde identiteit elke keer wanneer u uitvoer, sodat die laai van twee uitvoere in 'n ander stelsel niemand se geskiedenis verdubbel nie.
lrs.outNote.from: Every enrolment, lesson completed, assessment attempted, competent or not yet competent decision, course completed, statement of results, certificate, and qualification certificate received, one statement each. Each keeps the same identity every time you export, so loading two exports into another system does not double anybody's history.

lrs.downloadNote.text: Die lêer noem elke leerder en hul e-posadres. Hou dit soos u enige rekord van persoonlike inligting sou hou.
lrs.downloadNote.from: The file names every learner and their email address. Keep it as you would any record of personal information.

lrs.store.text: Stuur rekords na u eie leerrekordstoor
lrs.store.from: Send records to your own learning record store

lrs.storeNote.text: As u 'n leerrekordstoor hou, koppel dit hier en elke rekord hierbo gaan daarheen binne die uur nadat dit gebeur het, die reeds gemaakte eerste. Elkeen word een keer gestuur; 'n stelling wat die stoor reeds hou, word gelos soos dit is. Die stoor se geheim word op hierdie platform verseël, word nooit weer gewys nie, en word vergeet wanneer u ontkoppel.
lrs.storeNote.from: If you keep a learning record store, connect it here and every record above goes to it within the hour of happening, the ones already made first. Each is sent once; a statement the store already holds is left as it is. The store's secret is sealed on this platform, never shown again, and forgotten when you disconnect.

lrs.inNote.text: 'n Lêer xAPI-stellings uit 'n ander stelsel: 'n lys stellings, of wat 'n leerrekordstoor terugstuur. Elkeen word hier per e-pos by 'n leerder gepas en op hul rekord gewys. Dit word gehou as leer wat elders gedoen is, nie in 'n inskrywing of 'n uitslag hier verander nie, omdat niks daarvan op hierdie platform onderrig of geassesseer is nie.
lrs.inNote.from: A file of xAPI statements from another system: a list of statements, or what a learning record store returns. Each is matched to a learner here by email and shown on their record. It is kept as learning done elsewhere, not turned into an enrolment or a result here, because none of it was taught or assessed on this platform.

lrs.heldUnmatched.text: {count} stellings van elders gehou, {unmatched} nog nie by 'n leerder gepas nie.
lrs.heldUnmatched.from: {count} statements held from elsewhere, {unmatched} not yet matched to a learner.

lrs.addedHeld.text: {added} van {read} stellings bygevoeg; {held} was reeds gehou.
lrs.addedHeld.from: {added} of {read} statements added; {held} were already held.

lrs.matchedOne.text: 1 leerder per e-pos gepas. Hul ingevoerde leer word op hul rekord onder Mense gewys.
lrs.matchedOne.from: 1 learner matched by email. Their imported learning shows on their record under People.

lrs.matched.text: {count} leerders per e-pos gepas. Hul ingevoerde leer word op hul rekord onder Mense gewys.
lrs.matched.from: {count} learners matched by email. Their imported learning shows on their record under People.

lrs.unmatched.text: Nie by iemand hier gepas nie, en gehou totdat dit is: {names}. Nooi hulle met dieselfde e-posadres en hul leer heg vas.
lrs.unmatched.from: Not matched to anybody here, and kept until they are: {names}. Invite them with the same email and their learning attaches.

lrs.acceptedLast.text: {count} stellings tot dusver aanvaar; laas gestuur {date}.
lrs.acceptedLast.from: {count} statements accepted so far; last sent {date}.

lrs.hourly.text: Stuur elke uur rekords na hierdie stoor
lrs.hourly.from: Send records to this store every hour

verifyPage.intro.text: Voer die verwysing in wat op die sertifikaat gedruk is. Geen rekening is nodig nie.
verifyPage.intro.from: Enter the reference printed on the certificate. No account is needed.

verifyPage.validStatementNote.text: Hierdie leerder het elke interne assesseringskriterium vir die kwalifikasie hieronder behaal en mag vir die Eksterne Geïntegreerde Summatiewe Assessering ingeskryf word.
verifyPage.validStatementNote.from: This learner has achieved every internal assessment criterion for the qualification below and may be entered for the External Integrated Summative Assessment.

verifyPage.doNotAccept.text: Moenie hierdie dokument aanvaar nie. Kontak die verskaffer wat daarop genoem word as die leerder glo dit is 'n fout.
verifyPage.doNotAccept.from: Do not accept this document. Contact the provider named on it if the learner believes this is a mistake.

verifyPage.notFoundNote.from: No certificate carries that reference. Check it against the document: the characters I, L, O, U, 0 and 1 are never used, so a 1 is a 7 or a J, and an O is a Q or a D.

verifyPage.badgeNote.text: Dit is 'n verskaffer se eie rekord dat die houer hierdie studiemodule voltooi het. Dit is nie 'n nasionale kwalifikasie nie, dra geen krediete nie, en word nie deur 'n kwaliteitsraad toegeken nie. 'n Kwalifikasie word deur sy eie sertifikaatverwysing geverifieer.
verifyPage.badgeNote.from: This is a provider's own record that the holder completed this module of study. It is not a national qualification, carries no credits, and is not awarded by a quality council. A qualification is verified by its own certificate reference.

platformPage.intro.text: Elke organisasie op die platform. U kan sien hoeveel elkeen gebruik en hul konfigurasie bestuur, maar nie hul leerders, kursusse of assesseringsrekords nie. Om 'n kliënt se stelsel te huisves is nie dieselfde as om geregtig te wees om dit te lees nie, en die platform dwing dit af eerder as om op selfbeheersing staat te maak.
platformPage.intro.from: Every organisation on the platform. You can see how much each is using and manage their configuration, but not their learners, courses or assessment records. Hosting a client's system is not the same as being entitled to read it, and the platform enforces that rather than relying on restraint.

said.alignment-document.c3e49767.text: Geen studie-eenhede is in daardie dokument gevind nie. Een opskrif moet lees soos "Study Unit 1 – Organisational Architecture", met die modules wat dit dek daaronder gelys.
said.alignment-document.c3e49767.from: No study units were found in that document. One heading has to read like “Study Unit 1 – Organisational Architecture”, with the modules it covers listed under it.

said.alignment-matrix.185b0901.text: Geen belyningsmatriks is in hierdie werkboek gevind nie. Een kolom moet iets soos "Topic Elements" as opskrif hê, sodat die rye by die kurrikulum gepas kan word.
said.alignment-matrix.185b0901.from: No alignment matrix found in this workbook. One column must be headed something like “Topic Elements”, so the rows can be matched to the curriculum.

said.alignment-matrix.2b19415b.text: Dit is 'n Word-dokument. Die dokument self word gehou, geliasseer en is deursoekbaar. Wat nie kon gebeur nie, is dat dit gelees word, omdat die belyningsmatriks as 'n sigblad gelees word: een ry per kurrikulumreël, met 'n kolom met iets soos "Topic Elements" as opskrif. Stoor die matriks as 'n sigblad en laai dit ook op, en elke reël van die kurrikulum sal wys wat dit dek.
said.alignment-matrix.2b19415b.from: That is a Word document. The document itself is kept, filed and searchable. What could not happen is reading it, because the alignment matrix is read as a spreadsheet: one row per curriculum line, with a column headed something like “Topic Elements”. Save the matrix as a spreadsheet and upload that as well, and each line of the curriculum will show what covers it.

said.alignment-matrix.a0d14e78.text: Die matriks het geen hulpbronkolomme wat herken kon word nie: niks met die opskrif Workbook, Assessment, Theory Guide, Legislation ensovoorts nie.
said.alignment-matrix.a0d14e78.from: The matrix has no resource columns that could be recognised: nothing headed Workbook, Assessment, Theory Guide, Legislation and so on.

said.alignment-matrix.a8527ba8.text: Voer die kurrikulumdokument in voor die belyningsmatriks: daar is nog niks waaraan sy rye kan vashou nie.
said.alignment-matrix.a8527ba8.from: Import the curriculum document before the alignment matrix: there is nothing yet for its rows to attach to.

said.alignment-matrix.cf20070f.text: In die matriks, nie in die kurrikulum soos gelees nie.
said.alignment-matrix.cf20070f.from: In the matrix, not in the curriculum as read.

said.alignment-matrix.e1c0c850.text: Die matriks sê die kurrikulum publiseer dit; die kurrikulum soos gelees het dit nie.
said.alignment-matrix.e1c0c850.from: The matrix says the curriculum publishes this; the curriculum as read does not have it.

said.appeals.0db8b611.text: Dit is {lateByWorkingDays} werksdae verby die sperdatum van {deadline}. Dit kan steeds aangeteken word, maar sê hoekom dit buite tyd aanvaar word: daardie rede is deel van die rekord.
said.appeals.0db8b611.from: This is {lateByWorkingDays} working days past the deadline of {deadline}. It can still be lodged, but say why it is being accepted out of time: that reason is part of the record.

said.appeals.28f7ee35.text: Dit is reeds erken. Die eerste erkenning is die een wat die rekord hou.
said.appeals.28f7ee35.from: This was already acknowledged. The first acknowledgement is the one the record keeps.

said.appeals.3a9deae5.text: Hierdie appèl is reeds besleg. Dit kan nie daarna onttrek word nie.
said.appeals.3a9deae5.from: This appeal is already resolved. It cannot be withdrawn afterwards.

said.appeals.44a8137a.text: 'n Uitslagappèl gaan na die interne moderator voordat dit besleg word. Teken eers aan wie geraadpleeg is.
said.appeals.44a8137a.from: A result appeal goes to the internal moderator before it is resolved. Record who was consulted first.

said.appeals.5e354d8e.text: U rol laat dit nie toe nie.
said.appeals.5e354d8e.from: Your role does not allow that.

said.appeals.73f8aadd.text: Appèl aangeteken. Die klok vir die erkenning daarvan begin nou.
said.appeals.73f8aadd.from: Appeal lodged. The clock on acknowledging it starts now.

said.appeals.7caf07c2.text: Besleg. Sê vir die leerder, teken dan aan dat u dit gedoen het.
said.appeals.7caf07c2.from: Resolved. Tell the learner, then record that you have.

said.appeals.86246d01.text: Sê hoekom. 'n Uitkoms sonder redenasie is nie 'n besluit nie, en dit is die deel waarop die leerder geregtig is.
said.appeals.86246d01.from: Say why. An outcome with no reasoning is not a resolution, and it is the part the learner is entitled to.

said.appeals.8875be21.text: Sê aan watter assessering die uitslag behoort. 'n Uitslagappèl wat nie een noem nie, kan nie na 'n moderator gestuur word nie.
said.appeals.8875be21.from: Say which assessment the result belongs to. A result appeal that does not name one cannot be sent to a moderator.

said.appeals.8904ae3b.text: Dit is {lateByWorkingDays} werksdag verby die sperdatum van {deadline}. Dit kan steeds aangeteken word, maar sê hoekom dit buite tyd aanvaar word: daardie rede is deel van die rekord.
said.appeals.8904ae3b.from: This is {lateByWorkingDays} working day past the deadline of {deadline}. It can still be lodged, but say why it is being accepted out of time: that reason is part of the record.

said.appeals.8b380ce0.text: 'n Leë nota is erger as geen.
said.appeals.8b380ce0.from: An empty note is worse than none.

said.appeals.8c5db8b8.text: Sê hoekom dit onttrek is. 'n Onttrekking sonder rede lyk soos druk.
said.appeals.8c5db8b8.from: Say why it was withdrawn. A withdrawal with no reason looks like pressure.

said.appeals.91aa73ce.text: Daar is nog geen uitkoms om aan die leerder te gee nie.
said.appeals.91aa73ce.from: There is no outcome to give the learner yet.

said.appeals.a2fb8815.text: Daardie leerder is nie op daardie kohort nie.
said.appeals.a2fb8815.from: That learner is not on that cohort.

said.appeals.a3ddc6dd.text: Gronde: {ground}. Dit moet erken word, en die klok loop vanaf vandag.

said.appeals.b38737d5.text: Sê waaroor die appèl gaan. Een reël is nie 'n appèl nie.

said.appeals.ded67e92.from: An appeal has been lodged, out of time

said.cohort-archive.e3e27228.from: This archive is still being written. Wait for it to finish, then set it aside.

said.cohorts-id-archive.2342eb4c.from: Set aside. Nothing was removed, and its learners can be archived again.

said.cohorts.043bd894.from: That cohort is {status}, so nobody further can join it.

said.cohorts.5012d3ed.from: Give the start date as YYYY-MM-DD.

said.cohorts.5e4a92c3.from: Drop-out recorded. They cannot be readmitted to this sitting.

said.cohorts.7ee8f7f0.text: Begindatum verskuif. Elke datum op die skedule het saam daarmee verskuif.
said.cohorts.7ee8f7f0.from: Start date moved. Every date on the schedule moved with it.

said.cohorts.c22d7fc1.text: By die kohort gevoeg en op sy kursus ingeskryf.
said.cohorts.c22d7fc1.from: Added to the cohort and enrolled on its course.

said.cohorts.c798922f.text: 'n Stap kan nie verskuldig wees voordat dit oopmaak nie.
said.cohorts.c798922f.from: A step cannot be due before it opens.

said.cohorts.fb75334d.text: Die skedule noem 'n stap wat nie op hierdie kohort se kursus is nie.
said.cohorts.fb75334d.from: The schedule names a step that is not on this cohort's course.

said.conduct.07e411c2.text: Sê waaroor die grief gaan, waar moontlik in die leerder se eie woorde.
said.conduct.07e411c2.from: Say what the grievance is about, in the learner's own words where possible.

said.conduct.1636d693.text: Die grief noem {firstName} {lastName}. Iemand oor wie die klagte gaan, kan dit nie ondersoek nie: die prosedure vra vir 'n aangewese onpartydige persoon. Stel iemand anders aan.
said.conduct.1636d693.from: The grievance names {firstName} {lastName}. Somebody the complaint is about cannot investigate it: the procedure asks for a designated impartial person. Appoint somebody else.

said.conduct.1d25ed57.text: Die kennisgewing moet die spesifieke bewerings stel. 'n Verhoor oor ongestelde bewerings kan nie beantwoord word nie.
said.conduct.1d25ed57.from: The notice has to state the specific allegations. A hearing about unstated allegations cannot be answered.

said.conduct.1e2d5837.text: Aangeteken. Die vyf werkdae om te appelleer loop vanaf vandag.
said.conduct.1e2d5837.from: Recorded. The five working days to appeal run from today.

said.conduct.303f7f08.text: Sê watter sanksies moontlik is, insluitend beëindiging waar dit 'n moontlikheid is. 'n Leerder wat besluit of hulle bystand wil bring, moet weet wat op die spel is.
said.conduct.303f7f08.from: Say what sanctions are possible, including termination where it is. A learner deciding whether to bring assistance needs to know what is at stake.

said.conduct.403b3f35.text: Sê hoekom. 'n Onverklaarde sanksie is onverdedigbaar, en dit is die paragraaf waarop die leerder geregtig is.
said.conduct.403b3f35.from: Say why. An unexplained sanction is indefensible, and this is the paragraph the learner is entitled to.

said.conduct.47a20502.text: Stel die reël wat oortree is, die standaard wat verwag word en wat gebeur as dit weer plaasvind. 'n Waarskuwing wat dit nie doen nie, is nie een nie.
said.conduct.47a20502.from: State the rule broken, the standard expected and what happens if it recurs. A warning that does not is not one.

said.conduct.4dcaf05f.text: Dit is nie 'n datum en tyd nie.
said.conduct.4dcaf05f.from: That is not a date and time.

said.conduct.64f7462f.text: Die kennisgewing moet die leerder meedeel dat hulle deur 'n medeleerder bygestaan mag word, hul saak mag stel, en getuies mag roep en ondervra. Stuur 'n kennisgewing wat dit doen, en teken dit dan hier aan.
said.conduct.64f7462f.from: The notice must tell the learner they may be assisted by a fellow learner, present their case, and call and question witnesses. Send a notice that does, then record it here.

said.conduct.67f9675a.text: Teken aan wat bevind is en op watter grondslag. 'n Verhoor waarvan die bevindinge een sin is, is 'n verhoor wat nie plaasgevind het nie.
said.conduct.67f9675a.from: Record what was found and on what basis. A hearing whose findings are one line is a hearing that did not happen.

said.conduct.6a6b5da7.from: It has to be acknowledged by {acknowledgeBy}.

said.conduct.6d857ec5.text: Om iemand se program te beëindig, is 'n verhoor nodig wat gehou is, met sy bevindinge aangeteken. Belê een, teken aan wat bevind is, en sluit dan die saak.
said.conduct.6d857ec5.from: Ending somebody's programme needs a hearing that was held, with its findings recorded. Convene one, record what was found, then close the case.

said.conduct.77c80d2a.text: Ingedien. Dit sal binne twee werkdae erken word.
said.conduct.77c80d2a.from: Lodged. It will be acknowledged within two working days.

said.conduct.869c74ee.text: 'n Verhoor het minstens {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} uur kennisgewing nodig en dit is {hours} uur te min. Die vroegste wat dit gehou kan word, is {earliest}. Kort kennisgewing is die gebrek waarop 'n appèl gewen word, ongeag wat die leerder gedoen het.
said.conduct.869c74ee.from: A hearing needs at least {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} hours' notice and this is {hours} hour short. The earliest it can be held is {earliest}. Short notice is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

said.conduct.8d0ef3ad.text: Verhoor belê. Die kennisgewingtydperk is nagekom.
said.conduct.8d0ef3ad.from: Hearing convened. The notice period is met.

said.conduct.9f172fca.text: Die leerder kan nie hul eie grief ondersoek nie.
said.conduct.9f172fca.from: The learner cannot investigate their own grievance.

said.conduct.ad753d2e.text: Die besluit gaan skriftelik na die leerder en moet sê wat bevind is en wat gedoen sal word. Een sin is nie 'n besluit nie.
said.conduct.ad753d2e.from: The decision goes to the learner in writing and has to say what was found and what will be done. A line is not a decision.

said.conduct.b0301d88.text: Sê spesifiek wat beweer word. 'n Leerder kan nie 'swak ingesteldheid' beantwoord nie, en 'n verhoor ook nie.
said.conduct.b0301d88.from: Say what is alleged, specifically. A learner cannot answer 'poor attitude', and neither can a hearing.

said.conduct.b0dcbd53.text: Besluit, en die leerder het dit skriftelik.
said.conduct.b0dcbd53.from: Decided, and the learner has it in writing.

said.conduct.cf47131c.text: Gesluit. Gee die leerder die uitkoms skriftelik, en teken dan aan dat u dit gedoen het.
said.conduct.cf47131c.from: Closed. Give the learner the outcome in writing, then record that you have.

said.conduct.e83b2265.text: 'n Verhoor het minstens {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} uur kennisgewing nodig en dit is {hours} uur te min. Die vroegste wat dit gehou kan word, is {earliest}. Kort kennisgewing is die gebrek waarop 'n appèl gewen word, ongeag wat die leerder gedoen het.
said.conduct.e83b2265.from: A hearing needs at least {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} hours' notice and this is {hours} hours short. The earliest it can be held is {earliest}. Short notice is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

said.drive-google-drive.0281fa79.text: Google het nie 'n toegangsteken teruggestuur nie.
said.drive-google-drive.0281fa79.from: Google did not return an access token.

said.drive-google-drive.3ad31c62.text: Google aanvaar nie meer daardie koppeling nie. Dit is dalk uit u Google-rekening onttrek. Koppel die skyf weer in Instellings.
said.drive-google-drive.3ad31c62.from: Google no longer accepts that connection. It may have been withdrawn from your Google account. Connect the drive again in Settings.

said.drive-google-drive.8761e449.text: Daardie vouer is nie daar nie, of die rekening wat u gekoppel het, kan dit nie sien nie. 'n Vouer wat met u gedeel is, moet minstens een keer in Drive oopgemaak word voordat dit gelees kan word.
said.drive-google-drive.8761e449.from: That folder is not there, or the account you connected cannot see it. A folder shared with you has to be opened in Drive at least once before it can be read.

said.drive-google-drive.b744db3d.text: Google het daardie versoek geweier. As dit 'n kwota noem, is die ontplooiing se Drive-API-limiet vir eers bereik. {message}
said.drive-google-drive.b744db3d.from: Google refused that request. If it mentions a quota, the deployment's Drive API limit has been reached for now. {message}

said.drive-google-drive.c0c95fa0.text: Google het nie 'n manier teruggestuur om die koppeling te hernu nie, wat gewoonlik beteken dat hierdie rekening dit reeds toegestaan het. Verwyder die platform se toegang in u Google-rekening onder Derdepartytoepassings, en koppel dan weer.
said.drive-google-drive.c0c95fa0.from: Google did not return a way to renew the connection, which usually means this account had already granted it. Remove the platform's access in your Google account under Third-party apps, then connect again.

said.drive-google-drive.dcf45956.text: "{name}" is te groot vir Google om in een stuk uit te voer. Laai daardie een dokument uit Drive af as {extension} en voeg dit daarna op sy eie by; alles anders in die vouer word normaal gelees.
said.drive-google-drive.dcf45956.from: "{name}" is too large for Google to export in one piece. Download that one document from Drive as {extension} and add it on its own afterwards; everything else in the folder reads normally.

said.drive-google-drive.e9fe6eee.text: Lees 'n vouer regstreeks uit u Google Drive. Slegs lees: die platform kan lys en aflaai, en kan niks skep, verander of uitvee nie. U kan dit enige tyd hier of vanuit u Google-rekening intrek.
said.drive-google-drive.e9fe6eee.from: Read a folder straight from your Google Drive. Read-only: the platform can list and download, and cannot create, change or delete anything. You can withdraw it here or from your Google account at any time.

said.drive-import.1f557235.text: Daardie vouer het niks in nie wat die platform kan lees. Dokumente, sigblaaie en aanbiedings word almal gelees, insluitend Google se eie, dus beteken 'n leë resultaat dat die vouer werklik leeg is, of slegs dinge soos Vorms en kortpaaie bevat.
said.drive-import.1f557235.from: That folder has nothing in it the platform can read. Documents, spreadsheets and presentations are all read, including Google's own, so an empty result means the folder really is empty, or holds only things like Forms and shortcuts.

said.drive-import.6977b553.text: Daardie vouer beloop ongeveer {known} MB, wat meer is as wat in een keer gelees kan word. Kies die vouer vir een kwalifikasie eerder as die skyf waarin dit sit.
said.drive-import.6977b553.from: That folder comes to about {known} MB, which is more than can be read in one go. Choose the folder for one qualification rather than the drive it sits in.

said.drive-import.bc65916e.text: Daardie vouer bevat {listedCount} lêers, wat meer is as wat in een keer gelees kan word. Kies die vouer vir een kwalifikasie eerder as die skyf waarin dit sit.
said.drive-import.bc65916e.from: That folder holds {listedCount} files, which is more than can be read in one go. Choose the folder for one qualification rather than the drive it sits in.

said.drive-index.adeba1a9.text: U het nie {label} gekoppel nie. Koppel dit in Instellings, en die vouer kan van daar af gelees word.
said.drive-index.adeba1a9.from: You have not connected {label}. Connect it in Settings, and the folder can be read from there.

said.drive-index.b3dd24ac.text: Daardie skyf is nie een wat die platform ken nie.
said.drive-index.b3dd24ac.from: That drive is not one the platform knows.

said.drive-index.be999bc2.text: Hierdie ontplooiing kan nie 'n geloofsbrief veilig stoor nie, dus kan 'n skyf nie gekoppel word nie. Wie dit onderhou, moet die verseëlingssleutel stel.
said.drive-index.be999bc2.from: This deployment cannot store a credential safely, so a drive cannot be connected. Whoever maintains it needs to set the sealing key.

said.drive-index.f1db1389.text: Die gestoorde {label}-koppeling kan nie gelees word nie. Koppel dit weer in Instellings.
said.drive-index.f1db1389.from: The stored {label} connection cannot be read. Connect it again in Settings.
