said.drive-one-drive.2d141e83.from: That folder is not there, or the account you connected cannot see it.

said.drive-one-drive.2f5a255d.text: Microsoft het nie 'n toegangsteken teruggestuur nie.
said.drive-one-drive.2f5a255d.from: Microsoft did not return an access token.

said.drive-one-drive.4180c6e1.text: Microsoft het nie 'n manier teruggestuur om die koppeling te hernu nie. Die toepassing vra dalk nie vir vanlyntoegang nie.
said.drive-one-drive.4180c6e1.from: Microsoft did not return a way to renew the connection. The application may not be asking for offline access.

said.drive-one-drive.74ff1cef.text: Microsoft het daardie versoek geweier. Die rekening wat u gekoppel het, het dalk nie toegang tot daardie vouer nie. {message}
said.drive-one-drive.74ff1cef.from: Microsoft refused that request. The account you connected may not have access to that folder. {message}

said.drive-one-drive.a65a4207.text: Microsoft aanvaar nie meer daardie koppeling nie. Dit is dalk uit u rekening onttrek. Koppel die skyf weer in Instellings.
said.drive-one-drive.a65a4207.from: Microsoft no longer accepts that connection. It may have been withdrawn from your account. Connect the drive again in Settings.

said.drive-one-drive.c6aef863.text: Lees 'n vouer regstreeks uit u OneDrive. Slegs lees: die platform kan lys en aflaai, en kan niks skep, verander of uitvee nie. U kan dit enige tyd hier of vanuit u Microsoft-rekening intrek.
said.drive-one-drive.c6aef863.from: Read a folder straight from your OneDrive. Read-only: the platform can list and download, and cannot create, change or delete anything. You can withdraw it here or from your Microsoft account at any time.

said.eisa-registration.3015ea44.text: Registrasie kan nie ná die sitting sluit waarvoor dit is nie.
said.eisa-registration.3015ea44.from: Registration cannot close after the sitting it is for.

said.eisa-sitting-notice.4242bc7f.text: Geen sittings is vir {subject} aangeteken nie. Die datums kom uit die assesseringskwaliteitsvennoot se brief en verander elke jaar. Totdat dit ingevoer is, kan niks hier u waarsku dat 'n registrasiesperdatum nader kom nie.
said.eisa-sitting-notice.4242bc7f.from: No sittings are recorded for {subject}. The dates come from the assessment quality partner's letter and change every year. Until they are entered, nothing here can warn you that a registration deadline is coming.

said.eisa-sitting-notice.b6bf1cc3.text: Geen sittings is vir {subject} aangeteken nie. Die assesseringskwaliteitsvennoot publiseer die datums in Desember, dus behoort die brief uit te wees: voeg hulle by en die aftelling begin.
said.eisa-sitting-notice.b6bf1cc3.from: No sittings are recorded for {subject}. The assessment quality partner publishes the dates in December, so the letter should be out: add them and the countdown starts.

said.eisa-sitting-notice.d6b538b0.text: Geen sittings is aangeteken nie. Hulle kom uit die assesseringskwaliteitsvennoot se brief, wat een keer per jaar gepubliseer word.
said.eisa-sitting-notice.d6b538b0.from: No sittings are recorded. They come from the assessment quality partner's letter, which is published once a year.

said.eisa.041d2d1d.text: Aangeteken. Die aftelling na registrasie begin nou.
said.eisa.041d2d1d.from: Recorded. The countdown to registration starts now.

said.eisa.18104c26.from: No work experience logbook has been opened.

said.eisa.235f3916.text: Deur die werkplekafrigter teruggestuur vir meer bewyse.
said.eisa.235f3916.from: Returned by the workplace coach for more evidence.

said.eisa.2d36e0ea.text: Deur die werkplekafrigter geteken, wag dat 'n assessor dit aanvaar.
said.eisa.2d36e0ea.from: Signed by the workplace coach, waiting for an assessor to accept it.

said.eisa.aabe4744.from: With the workplace coach for signature.

said.enrolment-document-shape.04f2917b.text: Die sertifisering is ouer as die toegelate tydperk. Laat asseblief 'n vars kopie sertifiseer.
said.enrolment-document-shape.04f2917b.from: The certification is older than the period allowed. Please have a fresh copy certified.

said.enrolment-document-shape.3d15f524.text: Dit is nie 'n gesertifiseerde kopie nie. Laat dit asseblief sertifiseer en stuur dit weer.
said.enrolment-document-shape.3d15f524.from: This is not a certified copy. Please have it certified and send it again.

said.enrolment-document-shape.8d2c9fdc.text: Die kopie is nie leesbaar nie. Skandeer of fotografeer dit asseblief weer, plat en in goeie lig.
said.enrolment-document-shape.8d2c9fdc.from: The copy is not legible. Please scan or photograph it again, flat and in good light.

said.enrolment-document-shape.a7aecdc1.text: Die ID het meer as een sertifiseringsdatum daarop. Verskaf asseblief 'n kopie wat een keer, onlangs, gesertifiseer is.
said.enrolment-document-shape.a7aecdc1.from: The ID has more than one certification date on it. Please supply a copy certified once, recently.

said.enrolment-document-shape.ad8ee9a7.text: Dit is nie die dokument waarvoor gevra is nie.
said.enrolment-document-shape.ad8ee9a7.from: This is not the document that was asked for.

said.enrolment-document-shape.d9deb62d.from: Some of the pages are missing.

said.enrolment-documents.07cca752.text: Niks aangeteken nie: nóg die kohort nóg die leerder het 'n betaling daarteen.
said.enrolment-documents.07cca752.from: Nothing recorded: neither the cohort nor the learner has a payment against them.

said.enrolment-documents.221ad898.from: Paid for by the client, against {name}.

said.enrolment-documents.26e4b850.text: Gee die datum waarop hierdie kopie gesertifiseer is. 'n Kopie waarvan die sertifiseringsdatum onbekend is, kan nie as huidig getoon word nie.
said.enrolment-documents.26e4b850.from: Give the date this copy was certified. A copy whose certification date is unknown cannot be shown to be current.

said.enrolment-documents.330b87d3.text: Die leerder het hul eie bewys van betaling verskaf.
said.enrolment-documents.330b87d3.from: The learner supplied their own proof of payment.

said.enrolment-documents.3f1d945a.text: Die leerder het 'n bewys van betaling verskaf, nog nie nagegaan nie.
said.enrolment-documents.3f1d945a.from: The learner has supplied a proof of payment, not yet checked.

said.enrolment-documents.435df660.text: Die leerder se bewys van betaling is geweier.
said.enrolment-documents.435df660.from: The learner's proof of payment was refused.

said.enrolment-documents.98317f79.text: Sê hoekom dit geweier is. Die leerder moet vertel word wat om reg te stel, en 'n weiering sonder rede stuur hulle terug met niks om op te tree nie.
said.enrolment-documents.98317f79.from: Say why it was refused. The learner has to be told what to correct, and a refusal with no reason sends them back with nothing to act on.

said.enrolment-documents.d417e6fa.text: Daardie kopie is op {certifiedOn} gesertifiseer, wat meer as {CERTIFICATION_VALID_DAYS} dae gelede is. 'n Gesertifiseerde kopie moet huidig wees wanneer dit verskaf word.
said.enrolment-documents.d417e6fa.from: That copy was certified on {certifiedOn}, which is more than {CERTIFICATION_VALID_DAYS} days ago. A certified copy has to be current when it is supplied.

said.enrolment-documents.e88ccb00.text: Daardie lêer is nie aanvaar nie: {reason}

said.enrolment-form.141771ac.text: Uit die STATSSA-gebiedskodelys wat die QCTO publiseer.
said.enrolment-form.141771ac.from: From the STATSSA area code list the QCTO publishes.

said.enrolment-form.158eb69b.text: Die opgawe vra of die leerder ingestem het, en op watter datum.
said.enrolment-form.158eb69b.from: The return asks whether the learner agreed, and on what date.

said.enrolment-form.3ecff80b.text: Die geslag wat aangeteken is, stem nie ooreen met die een in die identiteitsnommer nie. Die QCTO gaan dit na, dus is een van die twee verkeerd ingetik.
said.enrolment-form.3ecff80b.from: The gender recorded does not match the one in the identity number. The QCTO checks this, so one of the two is mistyped.

said.enrolment-form.5d06240c.text: Die geboortedatum wat aangeteken is ({recorded}), stem nie ooreen met die identiteitsnommer nie, wat {fromId} sê.
said.enrolment-form.5d06240c.from: The date of birth recorded ({recorded}) does not match the identity number, which says {fromId}.

said.enrolment-form.7d5cda8a.text: Bevestig, en die datum aangeteken. Verander enigiets hier later en dit sal u weer vra om te bevestig.
said.enrolment-form.7d5cda8a.from: Confirmed, and the date recorded. Change anything here later and it will ask you to confirm again.

said.enrolment-form.a380df96.text: Gestoor. U kan later terugkom en dit klaarmaak.
said.enrolment-form.a380df96.from: Saved. You can come back and finish it later.

said.enrolment-form.a8dcc4e9.from: The identity number does not check out: {reason}

said.enrolment-form.b67325d1.text: Niemand het bevestig dat hierdie besonderhede reg is nie. 'n Monitor vra die vorm as bewys, en 'n onbevestigde een is bewys van bitter min.
said.enrolment-form.b67325d1.from: Nobody has confirmed these details are right. A monitor asks for the form as evidence, and an unconfirmed one is evidence of very little.

said.enrolment-form.b711b7ce.text: 'n Gestremdheid is aangeteken, en die QCTO vereis dan hoeveel moeilikheid dit veroorsaak.
said.enrolment-form.b711b7ce.from: A disability was recorded, and the QCTO then requires how much difficulty it causes.

said.enrolment-form.ca9579a9.text: Die provinsie waar die leerder werk, wat nie altyd is waar hulle woon nie.
said.enrolment-form.ca9579a9.from: The province the learner works in, which is not always where they live.

said.enrolment.52c9b5f2.text: Slegs 'n gepubliseerde kursus kan aan 'n leerder toegewys word.
said.enrolment.52c9b5f2.from: Only a published course can be assigned to a learner.

said.enrolment.65b99bc7.text: Daardie persoon is reeds op hierdie kursus ingeskryf.
said.enrolment.65b99bc7.from: That person is already enrolled on this course.

said.enrolment.678cc7c5.text: Daar is geen sperdatum vir hierdie een nie.
said.enrolment.678cc7c5.from: There is no due date on this one.

said.enrolment.6ac9079d.text: Daardie inskrywing behoort aan iemand anders.
said.enrolment.6ac9079d.from: That enrolment belongs to someone else.

said.enrolment.79fda720.text: Slegs die leerder kan hul eie vordering aanteken.
said.enrolment.79fda720.from: Only the learner can record their own progress.

said.enrolment.ab1eec65.text: Daardie les is nie deel van hierdie kursus nie.
said.enrolment.ab1eec65.from: That lesson is not part of this course.

said.extensions-claude-code.149b1d9d.text: Claude Code is nie geïnstalleer waar die platform loop nie.
said.extensions-claude-code.149b1d9d.from: Claude Code is not installed where the platform is running.

said.extensions-claude-code.1c9bd1dc.text: Claude Code is op hierdie masjien geïnstalleer, maar niemand is aangemeld nie. Maak 'n terminaal oop, voer claude uit, dan /login, en voltooi die aanmelding in die blaaier. Dit is 'n eenmalige stap en dit word deur u gedoen, nie deur die platform nie.
said.extensions-claude-code.1c9bd1dc.from: Claude Code is installed on this machine but nobody is signed in. Open a terminal, run claude, then /login and complete the sign-in in the browser. That is a one-time step and it is done by you, not by the platform.

said.extensions-claude-code.30018e0d.text: Kon nie Claude Code begin nie: {error}

said.extensions-claude-code.446b5c16.text: Claude Code het geen uitset teruggegee nie.

said.extensions-claude-code.53fe3e99.text: Die Claude-intekening se gebruikslimiet is bereik. Dit sal weer werk sodra die limiet terugstel.
said.extensions-claude-code.53fe3e99.from: The Claude subscription's usage limit has been reached. This will work again once the limit resets.

said.extensions-claude-code.7f69ba19.text: Gebruik u eie Claude-intekening, deur 'n teken wat u op u eie rekenaar genereer met `claude setup-token`. Nie 'n API-sleutel nie: geen koste per teken nie, en dit put uit die intekening wat u reeds betaal eerder as 'n gedeelde een.
said.extensions-claude-code.7f69ba19.from: Uses your own Claude subscription, through a token you generate on your own computer with `claude setup-token`. Not an API key: no per-token cost, and it draws on the subscription you already pay for rather than a shared one.

said.extensions-claude-code.801580be.text: Claude Code het nie binne {timeoutMs} sekondes geantwoord nie.
said.extensions-claude-code.801580be.from: Claude Code did not answer within {timeoutMs} seconds.

said.extensions-gemini.0473bc2d.text: Geen Gemini-API-sleutel is vir u gestoor nie. Voeg een in Instellings by. Dit kom van Google AI Studio, en is nie dieselfde as 'n Gemini-intekening nie.
said.extensions-gemini.0473bc2d.from: No Gemini API key is stored for you. Add one in Settings. It comes from Google AI Studio, and is not the same as a Gemini subscription.

said.extensions-gemini.18ddcba7.text: Daardie Gemini-API-sleutel is nie geldig nie. Gaan na dat dit heel van Google AI Studio gekopieer is. Dit is nie dieselfde ding as 'n Gemini Advanced-intekening nie, wat nie API-toegang insluit nie.
said.extensions-gemini.18ddcba7.from: That Gemini API key is not valid. Check it was copied whole from Google AI Studio. It is not the same thing as a Gemini Advanced subscription, which does not include API access.

said.extensions-gemini.3bf73475.text: Google se koersbeperking vir daardie sleutel is bereik. Die gratis vlak laat 'n beperkte aantal versoeke per minuut toe; wag en probeer weer, of gebruik 'n sleutel met fakturering aangeskakel.
said.extensions-gemini.3bf73475.from: Google's rate limit for that key has been reached. The free tier allows a limited number of requests a minute; wait and try again, or use a key with billing enabled.

said.extensions-gemini.599b82c0.text: Gemini het nie betyds geantwoord nie. 'n Groot vouer kan etlike minute neem; om weer te probeer met minder dokumente daarin werk gewoonlik.
said.extensions-gemini.599b82c0.from: Gemini did not answer in time. A large folder can take several minutes; trying again with fewer documents in it usually works.

said.extensions-gemini.5f764f27.text: Gemini kon nie bereik word nie. Gaan na dat hierdie masjien 'n netwerkverbinding met Google het.
said.extensions-gemini.5f764f27.from: Gemini could not be reached. Check that this machine has a network connection to Google.

said.extensions-gemini.6ff1fd27.text: Gemini se ruimte het uitgeraak voordat dit klaar geantwoord het, dus is wat teruggekom het deel van 'n kurrikulum eerder as die geheel, en 'n gedeeltelike een lyk presies soos 'n volledige een. Niks is behou nie. 'n Hele kwalifikasie is baie om in een antwoord te vra; voer dit eerder uit sy dokumente in, wat die kurrikulum direk lees sonder 'n model en sonder 'n beperking van hierdie soort.
said.extensions-gemini.6ff1fd27.from: Gemini ran out of room before it finished answering, so what came back is part of a curriculum rather than all of it, and a partial one looks exactly like a complete one. Nothing was kept. A whole qualification is a great deal to ask for in a single reply; import it from its documents instead, which reads the curriculum directly with no model involved and no limit of this kind.

said.extensions-gemini.7b1ee4ba.text: Gemini het met niks geantwoord nie. Dit beteken gewoonlik dat die versoek deur 'n veiligheidsfilter geweier is, of dat die modelnaam verkeerd is.
said.extensions-gemini.7b1ee4ba.from: Gemini answered with nothing. That usually means the request was refused by a safety filter, or the model name is wrong.

said.extensions-gemini.a3035142.text: Daardie dokumente beloop meer as {MAX_INPUT_CHARS}.000 karakters, wat meer is as wat in een versoek gestuur kan word. Voer die kwalifikasie eerder uit sy dokumente in: die kurrikulumdokument alleen word direk gelees, sonder 'n model.
said.extensions-gemini.a3035142.from: Those documents come to more than {MAX_INPUT_CHARS},000 characters, which is more than can be sent in one request. Import the qualification from its documents instead: the curriculum document alone is read directly, with no model involved.

said.extensions-gemini.c9f3d2b7.text: Google het 'n probleem aan hul kant gemeld ({status}). 'n Klein versoek is dit werd om net weer te probeer. As dit 'n hele kwalifikasie was en dit nou meer as een keer misluk het, is die versoek heel waarskynlik te groot vir die model om te voltooi. Voer dit eerder uit sy dokumente in, wat die kurrikulum direk lees sonder 'n model.
said.extensions-gemini.c9f3d2b7.from: Google reported a problem on their side ({status}). A small request is worth simply trying again. If this was a whole qualification and it has now failed more than once, the request is most likely too large for the model to complete. Import it from its documents instead, which reads the curriculum directly with no model involved.

said.extensions-gemini.d7ab5352.text: Google het daardie sleutel geweier. Dit is dalk herroep, of die Generative Language API is dalk nie geaktiveer op die projek waaraan dit behoort nie. Niks is fout met die platform nie en niks is verloor nie.
said.extensions-gemini.d7ab5352.from: Google refused that key. It may have been revoked, or the Generative Language API may not be enabled on the project it belongs to. Nothing is wrong with the platform and nothing was lost.

said.extensions-gemini.eb60a381.text: Gebruik u eie Google AI Studio-API-sleutel. Nie 'n Gemini Advanced-intekening nie: dit is 'n aparte produk en sluit nie API-toegang in nie. Die API het 'n gratis vlak, dus kan dit gebruik word sonder om iets te koop, binne sy koersbeperkings.
said.extensions-gemini.eb60a381.from: Uses your own Google AI Studio API key. Not a Gemini Advanced subscription: that is a separate product and does not include API access. The API has a free tier, so this can be used without buying anything, within its rate limits.

said.extensions-index.002e7790.text: Stoor eers 'n {word}: die lys kom van die verskaffer, en dit het een nodig om te antwoord.
said.extensions-index.002e7790.from: Save a {word} first: the list comes from the provider, and it needs one to answer.

said.extensions-index.04cbda50.text: Dit lyk nie soos {article} {name} {word} nie. Om een te kry, {source}; dit begin {begins}.
said.extensions-index.04cbda50.from: That does not look like {article} {name} {word}. To get one, {source}; it begins {begins}.

said.extensions-index.252509ee.text: Plak eers 'n {word}. Om een te kry, {source}.
said.extensions-index.252509ee.from: Paste an {word} first. To get one, {source}.

said.extensions-index.4532120c.text: Kies eers 'n verskaffer en plak sy geloofsbrief.
said.extensions-index.4532120c.from: Choose a provider and paste its credential first.

said.extensions-index.63d1c167.text: U gestoorde teken kon nie gelees word nie. Dit beteken gewoonlik dat die bediener se geheim verander het sedert u dit gestoor het. Plak 'n nuwe een op u rekeningbladsy.
said.extensions-index.63d1c167.from: Your stored token could not be read. This usually means the server's secret has changed since you saved it. Paste a fresh one on your account page.

said.extensions-index.7d55f18c.text: Kies 'n verskaffer wat die platform ken.
said.extensions-index.7d55f18c.from: Choose a provider the platform knows.

said.extensions-index.870b4f8d.text: Daardie verskaffer is nie meer beskikbaar nie.
said.extensions-index.870b4f8d.from: That provider is no longer available.

said.extensions-index.879f4ba6.text: Stoor eers 'n {word}: die lys kom van die verskaffer, en dit het een nodig om te antwoord.
said.extensions-index.879f4ba6.from: Save an {word} first: the list comes from the provider, and it needs one to answer.

said.extensions-index.8af96ab7.text: Dit lyk nie soos {article} {name} {word} nie. Om een te kry, {source}.
said.extensions-index.8af96ab7.from: That does not look like {article} {name} {word}. To get one, {source}.

said.extensions-index.8b099549.text: Plak eers 'n {word}. Om een te kry, {source}.
said.extensions-index.8b099549.from: Paste a {word} first. To get one, {source}.

said.extensions-index.a66c08f2.text: Dit is 'n Anthropic-API-sleutel, nie 'n Claude Code-teken nie. Dit is verskillende produkte en hierdie een het die teken nodig: voer `claude setup-token` op u eie rekenaar uit en plak wat dit druk. As 'n API-sleutel is wat u het, kies 'n verskaffer wat een aanvaar.
said.extensions-index.a66c08f2.from: That is an Anthropic API key, not a Claude Code token. They are different products and this one needs the token: run `claude setup-token` on your own computer and paste what it prints. If an API key is what you have, choose a provider that takes one.

said.extensions-index.d95a2478.text: U gestoorde geloofsbrief kon nie gelees word nie, dus kon die verskaffer nie gevra word nie.
said.extensions-index.d95a2478.from: Your stored credential could not be read, so the provider could not be asked.

said.extensions-index.e95369f0.text: U het nie 'n KI-uitbreiding opgestel nie. Dit is op u rekeningbladsy onder Instellings, dit is u eie eerder as die huurder s'n, en dit gebruik 'n teken wat u op u eie rekenaar skep.
said.extensions-index.e95369f0.from: You have not set up an AI extension. It is on your account page under Settings, it is yours rather than the tenant's, and it uses a token you generate on your own computer.

said.extensions-index.f448a040.text: U KI-uitbreiding is op u rekeningbladsy gedeaktiveer. Niks is weggegooi nie: skakel dit daar weer aan wanneer u dit wil hê.
said.extensions-index.f448a040.from: Your AI extension is disabled on your account page. Nothing was discarded: switch it back on there when you want it.

said.extensions-index.f5c19ada.text: U KI-uitbreiding is nie vir hierdie sessie aangeskakel nie. Skakel dit aan waar u dit wil gebruik; dit begin elke keer af wanneer u aanmeld, en skakel weer af wanneer u afmeld.
said.extensions-index.f5c19ada.from: Your AI extension is not switched on for this sitting. Switch it on where you want to use it; it starts off every time you sign in, and switches off again when you sign out.

said.extensions-index.fc1b6fc7.text: Hierdie ontplooiing het geen enkripsiesleutel gestel nie, dus kan 'n teken nie veilig gestoor word nie. Niks is gestoor nie. Sê dit vir wie ook al die bediener bestuur.
said.extensions-index.fc1b6fc7.from: This deployment has no encryption key set, so a token cannot be stored safely. Nothing was saved. Tell whoever runs the server.

said.extensions-openai.02885124.text: OpenAI het daardie sleutel vir hierdie model geweier. Die rekening waaraan dit behoort, het dalk nie toegang tot die model wat in u instellings genoem word nie.
said.extensions-openai.02885124.from: OpenAI refused that key for this model. The account it belongs to may not have access to the model named in your settings.

said.extensions-openai.047d249a.text: OpenAI het daardie sleutel geweier. Dit is dalk ingetrek, of dit was dalk nooit geldig nie. Let daarop dat 'n ChatGPT Plus-intekening nie API-toegang insluit nie: 'n API-sleutel is 'n aparte ding, geskep by platform.openai.com. Niks is fout met die platform nie en niks is verlore nie.
said.extensions-openai.047d249a.from: OpenAI refused that key. It may have been revoked, or it may never have been valid. Note that a ChatGPT Plus subscription does not include API access: an API key is a separate thing, created at platform.openai.com. Nothing is wrong with the platform and nothing was lost.

said.extensions-openai.1d2edb4d.text: OpenAI het nie betyds geantwoord nie. 'n Groot vouer kan etlike minute neem; om weer met minder dokumente daarin te probeer, werk gewoonlik.
said.extensions-openai.1d2edb4d.from: OpenAI did not answer in time. A large folder can take several minutes; trying again with fewer documents in it usually works.

said.extensions-openai.241eaa9a.text: Daardie OpenAI-rekening het geen krediet oor nie. Anders as Gemini het die OpenAI-API geen gratis vlak nie: dit word gehef teen die rekening waaraan die sleutel behoort.
said.extensions-openai.241eaa9a.from: That OpenAI account has no credit left. Unlike Gemini, the OpenAI API has no free tier: it is charged against the account the key belongs to.

said.extensions-openai.3d690aea.text: OpenAI het 'n probleem aan sy kant gemeld ({status}). Dit is die moeite werd om net weer te probeer.
said.extensions-openai.3d690aea.from: OpenAI reported a problem on their side ({status}). This is worth simply trying again.

said.extensions-openai.5f8151b1.text: OpenAI se tempolimiet vir daardie sleutel is bereik. Wag 'n rukkie en probeer weer.
said.extensions-openai.5f8151b1.from: OpenAI's rate limit for that key has been reached. Wait a little and try again.

said.extensions-openai.60c45cc3.text: OpenAI het met niks geantwoord nie. Dit beteken gewoonlik dat die modelnaam verkeerd is, of dat die versoek geweier is.
said.extensions-openai.60c45cc3.from: OpenAI answered with nothing. That usually means the model name is wrong, or the request was refused.

said.extensions-openai.d344fc6b.text: Geen OpenAI-API-sleutel is vir u gestoor nie. Voeg een by in Instellings. Dit kom van platform.openai.com en is nie dieselfde as 'n ChatGPT-intekening nie.
said.extensions-openai.d344fc6b.from: No OpenAI API key is stored for you. Add one in Settings. It comes from platform.openai.com, and is not the same as a ChatGPT subscription.

said.extensions-openai.dacd1031.text: Gebruik u eie OpenAI-API-sleutel, geskep by platform.openai.com. Nie 'n ChatGPT Plus-intekening nie: dit is 'n aparte produk en sluit nie API-toegang in nie. Anders as Gemini is daar geen gratis vlak nie, dus word oproepe gehef teen die rekening waaraan die sleutel behoort.
said.extensions-openai.dacd1031.from: Uses your own OpenAI API key, created at platform.openai.com. Not a ChatGPT Plus subscription: that is a separate product and does not include API access. Unlike Gemini there is no free tier, so calls are charged to the account the key belongs to.

said.extensions-openai.e6f50a09.text: OpenAI kon nie bereik word nie. Gaan na dat hierdie masjien 'n netwerkverbinding het.
said.extensions-openai.e6f50a09.from: OpenAI could not be reached. Check that this machine has a network connection.

said.feedback.145353f6.text: Die assessering was 'n regverdige toets van wat onderrig is.
said.feedback.145353f6.from: The assessment was a fair test of what was taught.

said.feedback.510134e7.text: Ek kan gebruik wat ek geleer het in my werk.
said.feedback.510134e7.from: I can use what I learned in my job.

said.feedback.981c7140.text: Die fasiliteerder het die materiaal duidelik verduidelik.
said.feedback.981c7140.from: The facilitator explained the material clearly.

said.feedback.a7324fb9.text: U is nie op daardie kohort nie.
said.feedback.a7324fb9.from: You are not on that cohort.

said.feedback.cb87912c.text: Hierdie kohort is reeds oor daardie assessering gevra. As daar weer gevra word, sal 'n sperdatum wat reeds loop, herbegin en die antwoorde oor twee verslae verdeel word.
said.feedback.cb87912c.from: This cohort has already been asked about that assessment. Asking again would restart a deadline that has run and split the answers across two reports.

said.feedback.d72c5cc9.text: U het hierdie een reeds beantwoord. Dankie.
said.feedback.d72c5cc9.from: You have already answered this one. Thank you.

said.feedback.e62bda7c.text: Die werkboeke en materiaal was nuttig.
said.feedback.e62bda7c.from: The workbooks and materials were useful.

said.fisa.002355f9.text: 'n Goedkeuring het die verwysing nodig wat die QCTO uitgereik het. Daarsonder is daar niks om aan 'n monitor te wys nie.
said.fisa.002355f9.from: An approval needs the reference the QCTO issued. Without it there is nothing to show a monitor.

said.fisa.0d81e0f7.text: U eie verslag het nog {missingCount} onbeantwoorde items: {code}.

said.fisa.2fb3360b.text: Nog nie gereed om af te teken nie.

said.fisa.4ffaa428.text: Hierdie FISA is nog nie deur 'n moderator afgeteken nie. 'n Vraestel wat nie vooraf gemodereer is nie, kan nie geskryf word nie: dit is waarvoor die moderering is.
said.fisa.4ffaa428.from: This FISA has not been signed off by a moderator yet. A paper that has not been pre-moderated cannot be sat: that is what the moderation is for.

said.fisa.52b6e791.from: A FISA is waiting for pre-moderation

said.fisa.620b3718.text: Die vertroulikheidsooreenkoms is nog nie geteken nie. Niemand mag die inhoud van 'n FISA sien of beoordeel voordat dit geteken is nie.
said.fisa.620b3718.from: The confidentiality agreement has not been signed yet. Nobody may see or judge the contents of a FISA before signing it.

said.fisa.6d7ad3d8.text: Oopgemaak. Stel volgende 'n eksaminator en 'n moderator aan.
said.fisa.6d7ad3d8.from: Opened. Appoint an examiner and a moderator next.

said.fisa.6e61efe5.text: Modereer dit eers vooraf. Om 'n vraestel wat u eie moderator nie afgeteken het nie na die QCTO te stuur, is die verkeerde volgorde.
said.fisa.6e61efe5.from: Pre-moderate it first. Sending the QCTO a paper your own moderator has not signed off is the wrong way round.

said.fisa.6f4251d6.text: Slegs 'n afgetekende FISA het 'n nuwe weergawe nodig; hierdie een kan nog gewysig word.
said.fisa.6f4251d6.from: Only a signed-off FISA needs a new version; this one can still be edited.

said.fisa.8634f8d4.text: Dit is dieselfde persoon as die {other}. 'n Vooraf-moderering is die moeite werd omdat 'n tweede persoon daarna gekyk het.
said.fisa.8634f8d4.from: That is the same person as the {other}. A pre-moderation is worth having because a second person looked at it.

said.fisa.86b96040.text: 'n Nuwe konsepweergawe is oop. Dit het sy eie eksaminator, moderator en moderering nodig.
said.fisa.86b96040.from: A new draft version is open. It needs its own examiner, moderator and moderation.

said.fisa.8cde49ff.text: Geen moderator is nog aangestel nie, dus is daar niemand om dit aan te stuur nie.
said.fisa.8cde49ff.from: No moderator has been appointed yet, so there is nobody to send it to.

said.fisa.99e0c84b.text: 'n FISA word deur die verskaffer vir sy eie vaardigheidsprogram opgestel. 'n Volledige of gedeeltelike kwalifikasie word ekstern deur die assesseringskwaliteitsvennoot geassesseer, dus stel die verskaffer nie daardie vraestel nie.
said.fisa.99e0c84b.from: A FISA is set by the provider for its own skills programme. A full or part qualification is assessed externally by the Assessment Quality Partner, so the provider does not set that paper.

said.fisa.a82c37e7.text: Afgeteken as geskik vir die doel. Kandidate mag nou hierdie vraestel skryf.
said.fisa.a82c37e7.from: Signed off as fit for purpose. Candidates may now sit this paper.

said.fisa.c7fed1e7.text: Hierdie FISA is afgeteken. Maak 'n nuwe weergawe oop eerder as om 'n vraestel te verander wat dalk reeds geskryf is.
said.fisa.c7fed1e7.from: This FISA has been signed off. Open a new version rather than changing a paper that may already have been sat.

said.fisa.d9072f1c.text: Ooreenkoms aangeteken. Hulle kan nou aan die vraestel werk.
said.fisa.d9072f1c.from: Agreement recorded. They may now work on the paper.

said.fisa.e69c5f64.text: Aan die moderator gestuur, en hulle is in kennis gestel.

said.fisa.f879ffbf.from: Appointed. They cannot see the paper until the confidentiality agreement is signed.

said.invigilation.01f9be44.text: Laat die kandidaat eers toe. Om 'n kamera te bevestig vir iemand wat nooit toegelaat is nie, teken 'n kontrole aan wat niemand gedoen het nie.
said.invigilation.01f9be44.from: Admit the candidate first. Confirming a camera for somebody who was never admitted records a check nobody made.

said.invigilation.1505c6a0.text: Sê waarom hulle weggewys is. 'n Appèl hang van die rede af, en die kandidaat moet gesê word wat gebeur het.
said.invigilation.1505c6a0.from: Say why they were turned away. An appeal turns on the reason, and the candidate has to be told what happened.

said.invigilation.17e1f6a7.text: Daardie kandidaat is nie by hierdie sitting nie.
said.invigilation.17e1f6a7.from: That candidate is not on this sitting.

said.invigilation.35819929.text: Daardie kandidaat is nie toegelaat nie, dus is daar geen skrif van hulle om te ontvang nie.
said.invigilation.35819929.from: That candidate was not admitted, so there is no script of theirs to receive.

said.invigilation.47b2b98a.text: Daardie persoon is nie op hierdie kohort nie, dus kan hulle nie tot sy sitting toegelaat word nie.
said.invigilation.47b2b98a.from: That person is not on this cohort, so they cannot be admitted to its sitting.

said.invigilation.50504405.text: Daardie kandidaat het by hierdie sitting uitgeval en kan nie weer toegelaat word nie. Teken eerder aan wat gebeur het as 'n voorval.
said.invigilation.50504405.from: That candidate dropped out of this sitting and cannot be readmitted. Record what happened as an incident instead.

said.invigilation.639211b5.text: Hierdie sitting is verby, dus kan niemand daartoe toegelaat word nie.
said.invigilation.639211b5.from: This sitting is over, so nobody can be admitted to it.

said.invigilation.7eff3ae0.text: Laat die kandidaat eers toe. 'n Verklaring van iemand wat nooit toegelaat is nie, teken 'n ooreenkoms aan wat niemand bygewoon het nie.
said.invigilation.7eff3ae0.from: Admit the candidate first. A declaration from somebody who was never admitted records an agreement nobody witnessed.

said.invigilation.994f7ce0.text: Hierdie sitting het geen verklaringsbewoording nie, dus is daar niks vir 'n kandidaat om te aanvaar nie. Stel dit eers op die sitting.
said.invigilation.994f7ce0.from: This sitting has no declaration wording, so there is nothing for a candidate to accept. Set it on the sitting first.

said.invigilation.b19d5680.text: Toelating het om {localClose} {closedAt} gesluit, {lateBySeconds} minute gelede. Teken hulle eerder as geweier aan, met die rede: iemand wat laat toegelaat is, het langer met die vraestel gehad as almal anders.
said.invigilation.b19d5680.from: Admission closed at {localClose} {closedAt}, {lateBySeconds} minutes ago. Record them as refused with the reason instead: somebody admitted late has had longer with the paper than everybody else.

said.invigilation.d1a64ee9.text: 'n Sitting kan slegs by 'n summatiewe of proef-EISA-sessie gehou word. Verander eers die sessie se soort, sodat die skedule sê wat aan die gang is.
said.invigilation.d1a64ee9.from: A sitting can only be run at a summative or mock EISA session. Change the session's kind first, so the schedule says what is happening.

said.invigilation.df78a6b5.text: Beskryf wat gebeur het. 'n Voorvalverslag wat niks sê nie, is erger as geen, omdat die rekord wys dat een gemaak is.
said.invigilation.df78a6b5.from: Describe what happened. An incident report that says nothing is worse than none, because the record shows one was made.

Maak eerder 'n aansoek om erkenning van vorige leer oop.
said.recognition.86f838fe.from: That was awarded on {awardedOn}, more than {CAT_YEARS} years before this approval. Credit Accumulation and Transfer covers completions within {CAT_YEARS2} years; beyond that the route is Recognition of Prior Learning, which assesses what the learner can still do rather than what they once passed. Open an RPL application instead.

said.scorm.354841d8.from: The package has {filesCount} files, more than the {MAX_FILES} allowed.

said.scorm.380a5512.text: Slegs die leerder se eie vordering word gehou.
said.scorm.380a5512.from: Only the learner's own progress is kept.

said.scorm.39e77a3f.text: Dit is 'n cmi5-pakket. Die platform speel tot dusver SCORM 1.2-pakkette; cmi5 kom ná SCORM 2004.
said.scorm.39e77a3f.from: This is a cmi5 package. The platform plays SCORM 1.2 packages so far; cmi5 comes after SCORM 2004.

said.scorm.42f68d85.text: Die zip bevat "{name}", 'n pad wat die pakket sou verlaat.
said.scorm.42f68d85.from: The zip holds "{name}", a path that would leave the package.

said.scorm.4de81b55.text: Hierdie les het geen SCORM-pakket nie.
said.scorm.4de81b55.from: This lesson has no SCORM package.

said.scorm.63cfd3fc.text: Die manifes noem geen lêer om die pakket mee te begin nie.
said.scorm.63cfd3fc.from: The manifest names no file to start the package from.

said.scorm.858c848d.text: Die manifes sê dit is "{version}", wat nie SCORM 1.2 is nie.
said.scorm.858c848d.from: The manifest says it is "{version}", which is not SCORM 1.2.

said.scorm.90319b91.text: Die pakket pak uit tot meer as 'n gigagreep, wat meer is as wat 'n kursus nodig het.
said.scorm.90319b91.from: The package unpacks to more than a gigabyte, which is more than a course needs.

said.scorm.d03f6670.text: Dit is 'n SCORM 2004-pakket. Die platform speel tot dusver SCORM 1.2-pakkette; 2004 is volgende. Die meeste outeurshulpmiddels kan eerder as SCORM 1.2 publiseer.
said.scorm.d03f6670.from: This is a SCORM 2004 package. The platform plays SCORM 1.2 packages so far; 2004 is next. Most authoring tools can publish as SCORM 1.2 instead.

said.scorm.d37e77ff.text: Die manifes begin die pakket by "{launchFile}", wat nie in die zip is nie.
said.scorm.d37e77ff.from: The manifest starts the package at "{launchFile}", which is not in the zip.

said.settings-drive-actions.b27a46f5.text: Dit is nie 'n skyf wat die platform ken nie.
said.settings-drive-actions.b27a46f5.from: That is not a drive the platform knows.

said.settings-language-actions.ecc301e2.from: Only a provider administrator may change this.

said.settings-language-actions.f103b372.text: Gestoor. Mense wat nie hul eie taal gekies het nie, sien nou hierdie een.
said.settings-language-actions.f103b372.from: Saved. People who have not chosen their own language now see this one.

said.settings-mail-actions.77394510.text: U rol sluit nie die toets van die posbediener in nie.
said.settings-mail-actions.77394510.from: Your role does not include testing the mail server.

said.settings-mail-actions.79f94bc8.text: Geen posbediener is op hierdie ontplooiing opgestel nie, dus kan niks nog gestuur word nie.
said.settings-mail-actions.79f94bc8.from: No mail server is set up on this deployment, so nothing can be sent yet.

said.settings-mail-actions.cb649383.text: Die posbediener het die verbinding aanvaar. Leerders kan hul aanmeldbesonderhede en kennisgewings gestuur word.
said.settings-mail-actions.cb649383.from: The mail server accepted the connection. Learners can be sent their sign-in details and notifications.

said.settings-mail-actions.cf3cfef0.text: Wie ook al die platform onderhou, moet MAIL_HOST en MAIL_FROM stel.
said.settings-mail-actions.cf3cfef0.from: Whoever maintains the platform needs to set MAIL_HOST and MAIL_FROM.

said.settings-mail-actions.f1ac9e08.text: Die posbediener kon nou net nie bereik word nie. Dit kan tydelik wees; probeer binnekort weer.
said.settings-mail-actions.f1ac9e08.from: The mail server could not be reached just now. This may be temporary; try again shortly.

said.settings-mail-actions.fc597e55.text: Die posbediener het die verbinding geweier, dus kan niks gestuur word nie.
said.settings-mail-actions.fc597e55.from: The mail server refused the connection, so nothing can be sent.

said.settings-menu-actions.0005a392.text: Slegs 'n administrateur kan die menu herrangskik, omdat dit dieselfde menu vir almal by hierdie verskaffer is.
said.settings-menu-actions.0005a392.from: Only an administrator can rearrange the menu, because it is the same menu for everybody at this provider.

said.settings-menu-actions.c175275c.text: Gestoor. Almal by hierdie verskaffer sien hierdie rangskikking.
said.settings-menu-actions.c175275c.from: Saved. Everybody at this provider sees this arrangement.

said.settings-menu-actions.c38853b5.text: Daardie rangskikking kon nie gelees word nie. Niks het verander nie.
said.settings-menu-actions.c38853b5.from: That arrangement could not be read. Nothing changed.

said.settings-menu-actions.ffff057d.text: Dit sou elke opskrif leeg laat, wat 'n menu met niks daarin is. Niks het verander nie.
said.settings-menu-actions.ffff057d.from: That would leave every heading empty, which is a menu with nothing in it. Nothing changed.

said.settings-module-codes-actions.d585f.text: Daardie tabel kon nie gelees word nie. Maak dit weer oop en probeer weer.
said.settings-module-codes-actions.d585f.from: That table could not be read. Reopen it and try again.

said.settings-sso-actions.4bbd36a4.from: Switched off, and its secret forgotten.

said.settings-sso-actions.52db415d.text: Gestoor. Meld af en probeer dit vanaf die aanmeldbladsy.
said.settings-sso-actions.52db415d.from: Saved. Sign out and try it from the sign-in page.

said.settings-sso-actions.56bfaa85.text: Slegs 'n verskafferadministrateur mag verander hoe mense aanmeld.
said.settings-sso-actions.56bfaa85.from: Only a provider administrator may change how people sign in.

said.settings-template-actions.0690b0fe.text: Gestoor as weergawe {version}, as 'n konsep. Dit is nie in gebruik totdat u dit in gebruik neem nie.
said.settings-template-actions.0690b0fe.from: Saved as version {version}, as a draft. It is not in use until you put it in use.

said.settings-template-actions.9cc3fe2a.text: Gestoor as weergawe {version}, en nou in gebruik. Dokumente van hierdie soort word van nou af daaruit geproduseer; dié wat reeds uitgereik is, hou die weergawe wat hulle geproduseer het.
said.settings-template-actions.9cc3fe2a.from: Saved as version {version}, and now in use. Documents of this kind are produced from it from now on; ones already issued keep the version that produced them.

said.settings-template-actions.a1bce5df.text: Daar was geen sjabloon in gebruik vir daardie dokument nie.
said.settings-template-actions.a1bce5df.from: There was no template in use for that document.

said.settings-template-actions.a1ec16e6.text: Terug na die platform se eie uitleg. U sjabloon word gehou, nie uitgevee nie, dus kan u dit terugsit.
said.settings-template-actions.a1ec16e6.from: Back to the platform's own layout. Your template is kept, not deleted, so you can put it back.

said.settings-template-actions.a53f381a.text: Dit is nie 'n dokument wat die platform produseer nie.
said.settings-template-actions.a53f381a.from: That is not a document the platform produces.

said.settings-terminology-actions.22580f.text: Gestoor. Almal by hierdie verskaffer sien hierdie bewoording.
said.settings-terminology-actions.22580f.from: Saved. Everybody at this provider sees this wording.

said.settings-terminology-actions.8e2222.text: Niks verskil van die standaardbewoording nie, dus is die verstekwaardes terug.
said.settings-terminology-actions.8e2222.from: Nothing differs from the standard wording, so the defaults are back.

said.settings-terminology-actions.98e913.text: Gee beide die enkelvoud en die meervoud vir {one}, of laat albei leeg om die verstek te behou.
said.settings-terminology-actions.98e913.from: Give both the singular and the plural for {one}, or leave both empty to keep the default.

said.settings-terminology-actions.c225e9.text: "{word}" word deur 'n reguleerder gedefinieer, dus kan dit nie vir iets anders gebruik word nie. As een van u eie woorde daarna hernoem word, sou dit 'n bewering op 'n leerder se skerm plaas wat die rekord nie ondersteun nie.
said.settings-terminology-actions.c225e9.from: "{word}" is defined by a regulator, so it cannot be used for something else. Renaming one of your own words to it would put a claim on a learner's screen that the record does not support.

said.settings-terminology-actions.c27704.text: Slegs 'n administrateur kan verander wat dinge genoem word, omdat dit dieselfde bewoording vir almal by hierdie verskaffer is.
said.settings-terminology-actions.c27704.from: Only an administrator can change what things are called, because it is the same wording for everybody at this provider.

said.settings.2e2de6f5.text: Gestoor. Oplaaie van nou af word so gelees.
said.settings.2e2de6f5.from: Saved. Uploads from now on are read this way.

said.settings.5946b233.text: Gestoor. Dit is beskikbaar maar nie aangeskakel nie. Gebruik die KI-skakelaar bo-aan enige bladsy wanneer u dit vir 'n taak wil hê.
said.settings.5946b233.from: Saved. It is available but not switched on. Use the AI switch at the top of any page when you want it for a job.

said.settings.68c5f414.text: Teken weggegooi. Niks daarvan word gehou nie.
said.settings.68c5f414.from: Token discarded. Nothing of it is kept.

said.settings.7a6e099f.text: Die verskaffer kon nie na sy modelle gevra word nie.
said.settings.7a6e099f.from: The provider could not be asked for its models.

said.settings.84b6dbd9.text: U rol sluit nie modelhulp in nie.
said.settings.84b6dbd9.from: Your role does not include model assistance.

said.settings.c0e1fe87.text: Gestoor. Rooster-tye beteken nou hierdie klok.
said.settings.c0e1fe87.from: Saved. Timetabled times now mean this clock.

said.settings.f7c1c376.text: Gestoor. Almal sien dit vanaf hul volgende bladsy.
said.settings.f7c1c376.from: Saved. Everyone sees it from their next page.

said.settings.fdc694bf.text: U rol sluit nie modelhulp in nie. Dit word deur die verskaffer se eie personeel gehou eerder as deur leerders of deur 'n werkgewer se werkplekafrigter.
said.settings.fdc694bf.from: Your role does not include model assistance. It is held by the provider's own staff rather than by learners or by an employer's workplace coach.

said.single-sign-on.052b3446.text: Die aanmelding het nie met 'n identiteit teruggekom nie.
said.single-sign-on.052b3446.from: The sign-in did not come back with an identity.

said.single-sign-on.07757676.text: Die aanmelding het met 'n identiteit teruggekom wat nie gelees kon word nie.
said.single-sign-on.07757676.from: The sign-in came back with an identity that could not be read.

said.single-sign-on.180daa0a.text: Aanmelding met {kind} is nie hier aangeskakel nie.
said.single-sign-on.180daa0a.from: Signing in with {kind} is not switched on here.

said.single-sign-on.2760f640.text: Microsoft het u organisasie se gids- (huurder-) ID nodig, 'n kode soos 72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47, vanaf die toepassing se Oorsig-bladsy in Microsoft Entra.
said.single-sign-on.2760f640.from: Microsoft needs your organisation's directory (tenant) ID, a code like 72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47, from the app's Overview page in Microsoft Entra.

said.single-sign-on.27f12034.text: Daardie rekening kan nie hier aanmeld nie.
said.single-sign-on.27f12034.from: That account cannot sign in here.

said.single-sign-on.52f76de5.text: Die kliëntgeheim is nodig om te koppel.
said.single-sign-on.52f76de5.from: The client secret is needed to connect.

said.single-sign-on.90b663ad.text: Google het nie die adres geverifieer nie
said.single-sign-on.90b663ad.from: Google has not verified the address

said.single-sign-on.af8cc19b.text: Hierdie platform het geen sleutel om geheime mee te verseël nie, dus kan dit nie die kliëntgeheim hou nie.
said.single-sign-on.af8cc19b.from: This platform has no key to seal secrets with, so it cannot keep the client secret.

said.single-sign-on.b83f2863.text: Daardie aanmelding is nie vanaf hierdie bladsy begin nie. Probeer weer.
said.single-sign-on.b83f2863.from: That sign-in was not started from this page. Try again.

said.south-african-id.2a092f1a.from: An identity number is exactly 13 digits.

said.south-african-id.46e0f0e5.text: Die maand in die geboortedatum is nie geldig nie.
said.south-african-id.46e0f0e5.from: The month in the date of birth is not valid.

said.south-african-id.738d1584.text: Die geboortedatum is nie 'n regte datum nie.
said.south-african-id.738d1584.from: The date of birth is not a real date.

said.south-african-id.95e7bd33.from: No valid Luhn check digit exists.

said.south-african-id.e46ae644.from: The citizenship digit must be 0 or 1.

said.south-african-id.f2f17cbd.text: Die kontrolesyfer stem nie ooreen nie; die nommer is waarskynlik verkeerd getik.
said.south-african-id.f2f17cbd.from: The check digit does not match; the number was likely mistyped.

said.spine-editor.2a5955ae.text: Gepubliseer, maar geen van sy vraestelle is nie. 'n Leerder sou niks vind om te beantwoord nie.
said.spine-editor.2a5955ae.from: Published, but none of its papers are. A learner would find nothing to answer.

said.spine-editor.c209d3d2.text: Dit is nog 'n konsep. Dit kan nou op die ruggraat gaan, en 'n leerder sal dit nie aangebied word voordat dit gepubliseer is nie.
said.spine-editor.c209d3d2.from: This is still a draft. It can go on the spine now, and a learner will not be offered it until it is published.

said.spine.09e0bbde.text: 'n {kind}-stap moet die {kind2} noem waarna dit wys.
said.spine.09e0bbde.from: A {kind} step has to name the {kind2} it points at.

said.spine.0b4713d6.text: "{title}" is formatief, dus lewer dit nooit 'n bevoegdheidsbesluit nie, en 'n poort wat op een wag, sou nooit oopgaan nie. Wag eerder totdat dit ingelewer of gemerk is.
said.spine.0b4713d6.from: "{title}" is formative, so it never produces a competence decision, so a gate waiting for one would never open. Wait for it to be handed in or marked instead.

said.spine.129de092.text: Sê hoekom hierdie leerder verbygelaat word. Dit word op hul rekord en in die moderasiepakket gewys.
said.spine.129de092.from: Say why this learner is being let past. It is shown on their record and in the moderation pack.

said.spine.42a3be59.text: 'n Stap kan nie op homself wag nie.
said.spine.42a3be59.from: A step cannot wait for itself.

said.spine.7287fb1d.text: 'n Les of 'n dokument word nie geassesseer nie, dus kan dit nie bevoeg bevind word nie. Wag eerder totdat dit oopgemaak is.
said.spine.7287fb1d.from: A lesson or a document is not assessed, so it cannot be judged competent. Wait for it to be opened instead.

said.spine.81239e1c.text: Slegs 'n werkervaringmodule word afgeteken. Kies 'n ander reël.
said.spine.81239e1c.from: Only a work experience module is signed off. Pick another rule.

said.spine.83528293.text: 'n Stap kan slegs op 'n ander stap op dieselfde kursus wag.
said.spine.83528293.from: A step can only wait for another step on the same course.

said.spine.91ceb611.text: Die nuwe volgorde moet elke stap van die kursus presies een keer lys.
said.spine.91ceb611.from: The new order has to list every step of the course exactly once.

said.spine.ca9b3b5c.text: Dit sou twee stappe op mekaar laat wag, en nie een sou ooit oopgaan nie.
said.spine.ca9b3b5c.from: That would make two steps wait for each other, and neither would ever open.

said.spine.d5e61b5f.text: Daardie dokument word van leerders weggehou, dus kan dit nie 'n stap op hul pad wees nie. 'n Summatiewe vraestel bereik hulle eerder as 'n vasgelegde assessering.
said.spine.d5e61b5f.from: That document is kept from learners, so it cannot be a step on their path. A summative paper reaches them as a captured assessment instead.

said.spine.fc076d64.text: Daardie dokument is vir personeel geskryf eerder as vir leerders om deur te werk, dus kan dit nie 'n stap op hul pad wees nie.
said.spine.fc076d64.from: That document is written for staff rather than for learners to work through, so it cannot be a step on their path.

said.statement-of-results.09720fce.text: Daar is geen modules in omvang vir hierdie staat nie, dus is daar niks vir dit om te bevestig nie.
said.statement-of-results.09720fce.from: There are no modules in scope for this statement, so there is nothing for it to confirm.

said.statement-of-results.3b26ff7f.text: Gee 'n rede. Dit word aan enigiemand gewys wat die verwysing nagaan.
said.statement-of-results.3b26ff7f.from: Give a reason. It is shown to anybody who checks the reference.

said.statement-of-results.57e1914e.text: Hierdie leerder hou reeds 'n Uitslagstaat vir {code}. Trek dit terug voordat u nog een uitreik, sodat twee dokumente wat dieselfde bewering maak, nooit in omloop is nie.
said.statement-of-results.57e1914e.from: This learner already holds a Statement of Results for {code}. Withdraw it before issuing another, so two documents making the same claim are never in circulation.

said.statement-of-results.ab61210b.text: Die kurrikulum is nie ten volle vasgelê nie: {uncaptured} dra niks om te behaal nie. 'n Staat wat nou uitgereik word, sou die behaling van modules bevestig wat niemand getranskribeer het nie.
said.statement-of-results.ab61210b.from: The curriculum is not fully captured: {uncaptured} carry nothing to achieve. A statement issued now would confirm achievement of modules nobody has transcribed.

said.statement-of-results.b5359f01.text: Hierdie leerder hou reeds 'n Uitslagstaat vir hierdie kwalifikasie. Trek dit terug voordat u nog een uitreik, sodat twee dokumente wat dieselfde bewering maak, nooit in omloop is nie.
said.statement-of-results.b5359f01.from: This learner already holds a Statement of Results for this qualification. Withdraw it before issuing another, so two documents making the same claim are never in circulation.

said.statements-id.5fd85b7c.text: U rol sluit nie die terugtrekking van 'n Uitslagstaat in nie.
said.statements-id.5fd85b7c.from: Your role does not include withdrawing a Statement of Results.

said.statements-id.f9ea555b.text: Teruggetrek. Die verwysing los steeds op, en sê so.
said.statements-id.f9ea555b.from: Withdrawn. The reference still resolves, and says so.

said.statutory-export-file.10c070ac.text: Hierdie opgawe het probleme wat reggemaak moet word voordat die lêers geproduseer kan word. Sien die statutêre verslagdoeningsbladsy.
said.statutory-export-file.10c070ac.from: This return has problems that must be fixed before the files can be produced. See the statutory reporting page.

said.statutory-notification.0931542b.text: Daardie leerder is nie in die kohort nie.
said.statutory-notification.0931542b.from: That learner is not in the cohort.

said.statutory-notification.1e928484.text: Vereis, en dit is binne die identiteitsnommer.
said.statutory-notification.1e928484.from: Required, and it is inside the identity number.

said.statutory-notification.5c135418.text: Die leerder het nie op die inskrywingsvorm saamgestem nie.
said.statutory-notification.5c135418.from: The learner has not agreed on the enrolment form.

said.statutory-notification.69c68cc0.text: Die verskaffer se eie akkrediteringsnommer, uit die huurder se instellings.
said.statutory-notification.69c68cc0.from: The provider's own accreditation number, from the tenant's settings.

said.statutory-notification.6a2cb727.text: Vereis, en moet met die identiteitsnommer ooreenstem.
said.statutory-notification.6a2cb727.from: Required, and must match the identity number.

said.statutory-notification.83725bbd.text: Die SAQA-identifiseerder van waarop die leerder ingeskryf is.
said.statutory-notification.83725bbd.from: The SAQA identifier of what the learner is enrolled on.

said.statutory-notification.9cf40e0d.text: Die provinsie waarin die leerder werk.
said.statutory-notification.9cf40e0d.from: The province the learner works in.

said.statutory-notification.a5a405af.text: 'n Erkenning het die verwysing nodig wat die QCTO uitgereik het.
said.statutory-notification.a5a405af.from: An acknowledgement needs the reference the QCTO issued.

said.statutory-notification.bbfb1dec.text: 'n Gestremdheid is aangeteken, dus vereis die QCTO hoeveel moeilikheid dit veroorsaak.
said.statutory-notification.bbfb1dec.from: A disability is recorded, so the QCTO requires how much difficulty it causes.

said.statutory-notify.77d191e5.text: Opgestel, wat {learnerIdsCount} leerders dek. Laai die werkboek af, gaan dit na, en teken dan aan dat dit gestuur is.
said.statutory-notify.77d191e5.from: Drafted, covering {learnerIdsCount} learners. Download the workbook, check it, then record that it went.

said.statutory-notify.7e3fae5a.text: Terug na die kohort se eie induksiedatum.
said.statutory-notify.7e3fae5a.from: Back to the cohort's own induction date.

said.statutory-notify.8cc067d9.text: Opgestel, wat {learnerIdsCount} leerder dek. Laai die werkboek af, gaan dit na, en teken dan aan dat dit gestuur is.
said.statutory-notify.8cc067d9.from: Drafted, covering {learnerIdsCount} learner. Download the workbook, check it, then record that it went.

said.statutory-notify.90d2c47a.text: Kies minstens een leerder om oor in kennis te stel.
said.statutory-notify.90d2c47a.from: Choose at least one learner to notify about.

said.statutory-notify.e80fd17b.text: Aangeteken as gestuur. Voeg die erkenning by wanneer dit terugkom.
said.statutory-notify.e80fd17b.from: Recorded as sent. Add the acknowledgement when it comes back.

said.statutory-notify.fbbcde8b.text: Hul eie induksiedatum is aangeteken, en hul sperdatum loop nou daarvandaan.
said.statutory-notify.fbbcde8b.from: Their own induction date is recorded, and their deadline now runs from it.

said.statutory.36c11667.text: Die leerder is ingeskryf nadat die kwalifikasie se registrasietydperk gesluit het.
said.statutory.36c11667.from: The learner was enrolled after the qualification's registration period closed.

said.statutory.5a5791f9.text: Die assessor het geen registrasienommer aangeteken nie. Die NLRD verifieer assessorregistrasie teen die behaling.
said.statutory.5a5791f9.from: The assessor has no registration number recorded. The NLRD verifies assessor registration against the achievement.

said.statutory.937d409a.text: Geen munisipale wykskode aangeteken nie. Die Verskafferrekord word tot op wyksvlak bekragtig.
said.statutory.937d409a.from: No municipal ward code recorded. The Provider Record is validated down to ward level.

said.statutory.a57124be.text: Die kurrikulummodule het geen kredietwaarde aangeteken nie.
said.statutory.a57124be.from: The curriculum module has no credit value recorded.

said.statutory.aafb40c2.text: Die verskaffer se akkrediteringsnommer ontbreek. Elke rekord in die opgawe word daarteen geliasseer.
said.statutory.aafb40c2.from: The provider accreditation number is missing. Every record in the return is filed against it.

said.statutory.cc126904.text: Die moderator het geen registrasienommer aangeteken nie.
said.statutory.cc126904.from: The moderator has no registration number recorded.

said.statutory.e08f5796.text: Geen gelykheidskode aangeteken nie; die NLRD merk ontbrekende gelykheidsdata.
said.statutory.e08f5796.from: No equity code recorded; the NLRD flags missing equity data.

said.statutory.ef816888.text: Die kwalifikasie het geen SAQA-ID nie, dus kan die inskrywing nie daarteen geliasseer word nie.
said.statutory.ef816888.from: The qualification has no SAQA ID, so the enrolment cannot be filed against it.

said.storage-s3.01b74469.text: STORAGE_DRIVER is "s3" maar {missing} is nie gestel nie. Bewyse kan nie gestoor word totdat dit gestel is nie.

said.study-unit-alignment.dfcd9590.text: Die dokument noem {wantedCount} modules ({wanted}) en hierdie kwalifikasie het nog geen kurrikulum nie. Voer eers die kurrikulum in; die studie-eenhede en hul uitkomste word in elk geval aangeteken, en as u hierdie dokument daarna weer oplaai, sal dit hulle koppel.
said.study-unit-alignment.dfcd9590.from: The document names {wantedCount} modules ({wanted}) and this qualification has no curriculum yet. Import the curriculum first; the study units and their outcomes are recorded either way, and uploading this document again afterwards will link them.

said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.text: Nie een van die {wantedCount} modules wat hierdie dokument noem, kon gepas word nie, dus is niks onder 'n studie-eenheid geplaas nie. Die dokument noem {wanted}. Hierdie kurrikulum hou {held}. Passing ignoreer spasies en koppeltekens, dus verskil die twee skemas werklik. Korrigeer die kodes aan óf kant en laai die dokument weer op.
said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.from: None of the {wantedCount} modules this document names could be matched, so nothing has been placed under a study unit. The document names {wanted}. This curriculum holds {held}. Matching ignores spaces and hyphens, so the two schemes genuinely differ. Correct the codes on either side and upload the document again.

said.support.2b757921.text: 'n Mondelinge assessering volg 'n tweede mis slegs op mediese gronde. Daarsonder is die uitkoms 'n verbeurdverklaring, waarteen die leerder steeds kan appelleer.
said.support.2b757921.from: An oral assessment follows a second miss only on medical grounds. Without one the outcome is a forfeit, which the learner can still appeal.

said.support.32314e12.text: Die leerder moet instem dat dit aangeteken word voordat dit aangeteken kan word. Gesondheid, gestremdheid en finansiële omstandighede is spesiale persoonlike inligting, en instemming om in te skryf was nie instemming hiermee nie.
said.support.32314e12.from: The learner has to agree to this being recorded before it can be. Health, disability and financial circumstances are special personal information, and agreeing to enrol was not agreeing to this.

said.support.3e521f24.text: Sê hoekom die ondersteuning eindig. 'n Leerder wie se akkommodasie sonder rede ophou, het geen manier om dit terug te vra nie.
said.support.3e521f24.from: Say why the support is ending. A learner whose accommodation stops without a reason has no way to ask for it back.

said.support.418c0ecd.text: Daardie rekord is nie gevind nie.

said.support.6396d34b.text: 'n Bykomende datum is reeds vir hierdie assessering gestel: {additionalDate}, ná 'n mis op {missedOn}. Die prosedure laat een toe. As daardie datum ook gemis is, teken aan wat daarmee gebeur het eerder as om nog een te stel.
said.support.6396d34b.from: An additional date was already set for this assessment: {additionalDate}, after a miss on {missedOn}. The procedure allows one. If that date was also missed, record what happened to it rather than setting another.

said.support.6af4db9d.text: As die akkommodasie nie werk nie, sê wat verander. 'n Hersiening wat 'n mislukking aanteken en niks aanpas nie, lyk soos noukeurigheid en is die teenoorgestelde.
said.support.6af4db9d.from: If the accommodation is not working, say what is changing. A review that records a failure and adjusts nothing reads as diligence and is the opposite.

said.support.7af7d42b.text: Die bykomende datum moet ná die een wees wat gemis is.
said.support.7af7d42b.from: The additional date has to be after the one that was missed.

said.support.8452172c.text: Sê wat u gevind het. 'n Hersiening sonder bevinding is 'n datum in 'n lêer.
said.support.8452172c.from: Say what you found. A review with no finding is a date in a file.

said.support.e34f2e55.text: Sê wat werklik gedoen sal word. 'n Behoefte sonder akkommodasie daarteen verander niks vir die leerder nie.
said.support.e34f2e55.from: Say what will actually be done. A need with no accommodation against it changes nothing for the learner.

said.support.f4565c1a.text: Sê wat die mediese grond was. 'n Mondelinge assessering wat op 'n ongeregistreerde rede gemagtig is, is die sitting waaroor 'n eksterne verifieerder vra.
said.support.f4565c1a.from: Say what the medical ground was. An oral assessment authorised on an unrecorded reason is the sitting an external verifier asks about.

login.intro.from: Sign in to continue your learning.

login.trouble.text: Unengxaki yokungena? Thetha nomququzeleli wakho: unokukusetha kwakhona iphasiwedi.
login.trouble.from: Trouble signing in? Speak to your facilitator: they can reset a password for you.

login.locked.text: Iinzame ezininzi kakhulu. Linda imizuzu elishumi elinesihlanu uze uphinde uzame.
login.locked.from: Too many attempts. Wait fifteen minutes and try again.

login.missing.from: Enter your email address and password.

login.sso.refused.text: Loo akhawunti ayikwazi ukungena apha. Kufuneka isebenzise idilesi ye-imeyile efanayo nekwi-akhawunti yakho kule pleyithifomu. Ngena ngephasiwedi yakho, okanye buza kumlawuli wakho.
login.sso.refused.from: That account cannot sign in here. It has to use the same email address as your account on this platform. Sign in with your password, or ask your administrator.

login.sso.expired.text: Loo nzame yokungena ithathe ixesha elide, okanye yaqaliswa kwenye indawo. Zama kwakhona.
login.sso.expired.from: That sign-in took too long, or was started somewhere else. Try again.

login.sso.off.from: That way of signing in is not switched on here.

account.forcedIntro.text: Omnye umntu useta iphasiwedi obungene ngayo. Yitshintshe ngaphambi kokuba uqhubeke.
account.forcedIntro.from: Somebody else set the password you signed in with. Replace it before carrying on.

account.newHint.text: Ubuncinane oonobumba okanye iimpawu ezili-12. Ibinzana elinamagama ambalwa angalalanisiyo lomelele kwaye lilula ukulikhumbula kunelifutshane elinezimpawu.
account.newHint.from: At least 12 characters. A phrase of a few unrelated words is both stronger and easier to remember than something short with symbols in it.

account.mismatch.from: The two new passwords do not match.

account.forcedNote.text: Ukuyitshintsha kuphumisa nabani na osebenzisa iphasiwedi endala, kuquka lowo ukunike yona.
account.forcedNote.from: Changing it signs out anyone else using the old password, including whoever passed it to you.

account.languageIntro.text: Ulwimi ekuthethwa ngalo kuwe kule pleyithifomu. Izikrini ezingekaguqulelwa zihlala ziseNgesini, kwaye amagama omboneleli wakho ezinto agcinwa njengoko nje wawabhala.
account.languageIntro.from: The language this platform speaks to you in. Screens not yet translated stay in English, and your provider's own names for things are kept as they wrote them.

learn.notYours.text: Ubukele ukubhaliswa komnye umntu. Unokubona inkqubela yakhe kodwa awukwazi ukuyirekhoda ngenxa yakhe.
learn.notYours.from: You are viewing someone else's enrolment. You can see their progress but cannot record it for them.

learn.noLessons.from: This course has no lessons yet.

learn.openMaterial.from: Open the material for this lesson

learn.noContent.from: No written content for this lesson.

learn.scormNote.text: Esi sifundo sigqitywa xa usigqibile kwiphakheji ekuthi ngasentla. Indawo oyifikelele kuyo igcinwa ukuba uyayeka phakathi.
learn.scormNote.from: This lesson completes when you finish it in the package above. Your place is kept if you stop part of the way through.

learn.openedByFacilitator.from: Opened for you by your facilitator: {reason}

home.feedbackMany.from: A few things to tell us

home.feedbackIntro.text: Iimpendulo zingxelwa kunye nezabanye bonke, hayi enye ngenye. Imizuzu emibini nganye, kwaye kuphela oko kutshintsha indlela eliqhutywa ngayo iqela elilandelayo.
home.feedbackIntro.from: Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. Two minutes each, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

home.earnedIntro.text: Kurekhodwa ngosuku ogqiba ngalo, kungekhona xa isatifikethi sithi sifike ekugqibeleni. Nganye ineleferensi umntu wonke anokuyiqinisekisa.
home.earnedIntro.from: Recorded on the day you finished, rather than when the certificate eventually arrives. Each carries a reference anybody can check.

home.step.afterPrevious.from: Opens when you finish the step before

home.nothingYet.from: You have not been assigned anything yet.

home.statementsIntro.text: Yiza nale nto kuvavanyo lwangaphandle kunye noxwebhu lwakho lwesazisi. Iziko liyayijonga ngaphambi kokuba uvunyelwe ukuhlala.
home.statementsIntro.from: Take this to the external assessment with your identity document. The centre checks it before you may sit.

assess.waiting.from: Waiting for an assessor to review it.

assess.developmental.text: Oku kuyakha ukufunda. Akukho nto apha ebalwa ngokuchasene nawe.
assess.developmental.from: This is developmental. Nothing here counts against you.

assess.competent.text: Ufunyenwe uyakwazi kolu vavanyo, ngoko akukho nto ifuna ukuphinda uyenze.
assess.competent.from: You have been found competent on this assessment, so there is nothing to sit again.

assess.noAttempts.text: Iinzame zakho zonke zolu vavanyo ziphelile.
assess.noAttempts.from: You have used all your attempts at this assessment.

assess.awaitingAssessor.text: Olu vavanyo lubalwa kwikhwalifikheyishini yakho, ngoko umvavanyi uya kulwenza uphononongo aze arekhode isigqibo sokukwazi. Uya kuwubona umphumo oko kugqityiwe.
assess.awaitingAssessor.from: This assessment counts towards your qualification, so an assessor will review it and record the competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

assess.practicePassed.text: Oku bekuluqheliso, ngoko umphumo urekhodwa ngokuchasene nokufunda kwakho kodwa awugqibi ngekhwalifikheyishini.
assess.practicePassed.from: This was practice, so the result is recorded against your learning but does not decide a qualification.

assess.practiceFailed.text: Oku bekuluqheliso. Phonononga izinto zokufunda uze uzame kwakhona.
assess.practiceFailed.from: This was practice. Review the material and try again.

assess.pair.from: Pair each item on the left with one on the right.

assess.whyMarked.text: Isizathu sesona sihlolwayo apha, hayi ibhokisi ekuthi ngasentla.
assess.whyMarked.from: The reason is what is marked here, not the box above.

assess.keptAt.text: Iimpendulo zakho zigcinwe ngo-{time}. Ukungenisa kokusenza zithunyelwe ukuba zihlolwe.
assess.keptAt.from: Your answers were kept at {time}. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

assess.kept.text: Iimpendulo zakho ziyagcinwa njengoko usebenza. Ukungenisa kokusenza zithunyelwe ukuba zihlolwe.
assess.kept.from: Your answers are kept as you work. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

evidence.uploadFailed.text: Ukulayisha kusilele. Jonga uqhagamshelo lwakho uzame kwakhona.
evidence.uploadFailed.from: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.

evidence.doneIntro.text: Umvavanyi uya kububhekisisa arekhode isigqibo sokukwazi. Uya kuwubona umphumo oko kugqityiwe.
evidence.doneIntro.from: An assessor will review it and record a competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

evidence.fingerprintNote.text: Ukuba nayiphi na ifayile egciniweyo ingatshintshwa, iminwe yayo iya kuyeka ukuhambelana. Oko kukhusela umsebenzi wakho njengoko kukhusela uvavanyo.
evidence.fingerprintNote.from: If any stored file were ever altered, its fingerprint would stop matching. That protects your work as much as it protects the assessment.

evidence.kinds.text: Iifoto, irekhodi lomsebenzi, incwadi yelogi eskenishiweyo, okanye uxwebhu. Unokuncamathisela ezininzi ngaxeshanye.
evidence.kinds.from: Photographs, a recording of the task, a scanned logbook, or a document. You can attach several at once.

evidence.note.text: Nayiphi na into umvavanyi ekufuneka ayazi

paper.summative.text: Oku kuyavavanywa kwaye kubalwa kwikhwalifikheyishini yakho.
paper.summative.from: This is assessed and counts towards your qualification.

paper.formative.text: Oku kukulungiselela. Kuyahlolwa kwaye kubuyiswe kuwe, kwaye akugqibi nto.
paper.formative.from: This is preparation. It is marked and returned to you, and it does not decide anything.

paper.goBack.text: Buyela kwikhosi ukuze ubone oko kusadingeka.
paper.goBack.from: Go back to the course to see what is still outstanding.

paper.connection.text: Loo mpendulo ayigcinwanga. Uqhagamshelo lwakho lunokuba lunqamlekile; luya kuzanywa kwakhona xa uzayo utshintsha into.
paper.connection.from: That answer did not save. Your connection may have dropped; it will be tried again when you next change something.

paper.handInFailed.from: That could not be handed in.

paper.handInConnection.text: Oko akwenzekanga ukuba kunikezelwe. Jonga uqhagamshelo lwakho uzame kwakhona.
paper.handInConnection.from: That could not be handed in. Check your connection and try again.

paper.detail.from: Answer in detail, referring to the principles you have studied.

paper.handedIn.from: You handed this in. It cannot be changed.

paper.final.from: Once handed in, this cannot be changed.

paper.confirm.from: Confirm the declaration to hand in.

paper.savedAsYouGo.from: your work is saved as you go

notify.nothingYet.text: Akukabikho nto. Uya kwaziswa apha xa uqeqesho lwabelwe okanye lufuneka, xa umsebenzi ukulindile, nakuba umphumo wovavanyo okanye isatifikethi sifika.
notify.nothingYet.from: Nothing yet. You will be told here when training is assigned or due, when work is waiting for you, and when an assessment result or certificate arrives.

cert.notNational.text: Esi yisatifikethi sika-{provider} ngokwakhe sekhosi ayinikezeleyo. Asiyondlela yesizwe yekhwalifikheyishini kwaye asiphathi kredithi okanye isazisi se-SAQA. Apho umfundi esebenzela ikhwalifikheyishini yomsebenzi, isatifikethi sayo sikhutshwa yi-QCTO.
cert.notNational.from: This is {provider}'s own certificate for a course it delivered. It is not a national qualification and does not carry a SAQA credit or identifier. Where a learner is working towards an occupational qualification, the certificate for it is issued by the QCTO.

cert.anyone.text: Nabani na unokuqinisekisa esi satifikethi ngereferensi ekuthi ngasentla, engafuni akhawunti.
cert.anyone.from: Anyone can confirm this certificate with the reference above, without needing an account.

work.introCoach.text: Abafundi obabekele iliso. Uqinisekisa oko bakwenzileyo emsebenzini; akukho nto efikelela kumvavanyi ngaphandle kokusayina kwakho.
work.introCoach.from: The learners you supervise. You confirm what they did in the workplace; nothing reaches an assessor without your signature.

work.introLearner.text: Amava omsebenzi enziwa kumqeshi kwaye asayinwa ngumqeqeshi wasemsebenzini apho. Ucwangciso lumiselwe: uyarekhoda, umqeqeshi wakho uyaqinisekisa, emva koko uya kumvavanyi.
work.introLearner.from: Work experience is done at an employer and signed off by the workplace coach there. The order is fixed: you record it, your coach confirms it, then it goes to an assessor.

work.noneManage.text: Akukabikho {records}. Seta enye ngasentla: isivumelwano esibiza umfundi, umqeshi nomqeqeshi, ke enye kwimodyuli nganye yamava omsebenzi.
work.noneManage.from: No {records} yet. Set one up above: an agreement naming the learner, the employer and the coach, then one for each work experience module.

work.none.text: Akukabikho {records}. Umlawuli uvula enye xa sele kukho isivumelwano sasemsebenzini esibiza umfundi, umqeshi nomqeqeshi.
work.none.from: No {records} yet. An administrator opens one once a workplace agreement is in place naming the learner, the employer and the coach.

work.kind.contextual_knowledge.text: Ulwazi lwasemsebenzini: oko kufuneka ukwazi ukuthetha ngako
work.kind.contextual_knowledge.from: Workplace knowledge: what you must be able to speak to

work.kind.supporting_evidence.text: Ubungqina bokuxhasa: oko indawo yomsebenzi kufuneka iwuvelise
work.kind.supporting_evidence.from: Supporting evidence: what the workplace must produce

work.outstanding.text: Kusekho: {items}. Umqeqeshi wakho akanakusayina de ilayini nganye igqitywe kwaye ubungqina obuxhasayo bube nefayile encamathisiweyo.
work.outstanding.from: Still outstanding: {items}. Your coach cannot sign until every line is done and every piece of supporting evidence has a file attached.

work.allRecorded.text: Yonke into irekhodiwe. Ithumele kumqeqeshi wakho xa ulungile.
work.allRecorded.from: Everything is recorded. Send it to your coach when you are ready.

work.signingMeans.text: Ukusayina kurekhoda ukuba ubujonge obu bungqina kwaye uya kububhengeza ukuba umvavanyi uqhagamshelana nawe. Akunakutshintshwa emva koko.
work.signingMeans.from: Signing records that you checked this evidence and will attest to it if the assessor contacts you. It cannot be changed afterwards.

work.forAssessor.text: Nayiphi na into umvavanyi ekufuneka ayazi

work.readyForPoe.text: Isayinwe ngumqeqeshi wasemsebenzini kwaye ilungele ukuthathwa kwiPhotfoliyo Yobungqina.
work.readyForPoe.from: Signed by the workplace coach and ready to be taken into the Portfolio of Evidence.

scorm.failed.text: Iphakheji ayikwazanga ukuvulwa. Jonga uqhagamshelo lwakho uzame kwakhona.
scorm.failed.from: The package could not be opened. Check your connection and try again.

scorm.preview.text: Ukujonga kuqala: oko iphakheji ikuxelayo akugcinwa, kuba oku akungokubhaliswa kwakho.
scorm.preview.from: A preview: what the package reports is not kept, because this is not your own enrolment.

certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.text: Umfundi usenokuba unike umqeshi ireferensi. Iyaqhubeka ivela kwaye iya kuthi yarhoxiswa.
certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.from: The learner may have given the reference to an employer. It keeps resolving and will say it was withdrawn.

assessing.intro.text: Iminikelo elungele isigwebo sokukwazi. Awukwazi ukuvavanya umsebenzi wakho, kwaye ubungakanani beziqu zakho ziza kuphononongwa ngokuzimeleyo ngumhloli.
assessing.intro.from: Submissions ready for a competency judgement. You cannot assess your own work, and a proportion of your decisions will be reviewed independently by a moderator.

assessing.empty.text: Akukho nto ilindileyo. Iminikelo ivela apha njengoko abafundi bayithumela.
assessing.empty.from: Nothing is waiting. Submissions appear here as learners send them in.

assessing.onScreen.text: Oku kuphendulwe kwiskrini. {link}: iimpendulo, isikhokelo sokuhlola kunye nematriki zikunye apho, kwaye imigangatho iyaqikelelwa kuwe emva kokuba kuhloliwe.
assessing.onScreen.from: This was answered on screen. {link}: the answers, the marking guidance and the matrix are together there, and the criteria are worked out for you once it is marked.

assessing.ownWork.text: Lo ngumnikelo wakho. Awukwazi ukuwuvavanya; omnye umntu kufuneka.
assessing.ownWork.from: This is your own submission. You cannot assess it; someone else must.

assessing.hash.text: I-hashi irekhodwa xa kulayishwa. Ukuba ifayile egciniweyo iyatshintshwa, ayisahambelani kwaye irekhodi liyaphawulwa.
assessing.hash.from: The hash is recorded at upload. If a stored file is ever altered, it no longer matches and the record is flagged.

assessing.whyDiffers.text: Kutheni, kuba kwahlukile koko amanqaku akucebisayo
assessing.whyDiffers.from: Why, since it differs from what the marks propose

assessing.permanent.text: Igama lakho, umhla neli qabaka zigcinwa ngokusisigxina kwaye azinakuhlelwa emva koko. Isilungiso sirekhodwa njengesigqibo esitsha.
assessing.permanent.from: Your name, the date and this comment are stored permanently and cannot be edited afterwards. A correction is recorded as a new decision.

marking.impliesIntro.text: Ukubala, hayi isigwebo. Amanqaku aqikelela kuloo mlinganiselo; ukusebenza okusebenzayo nobungqina basemsebenzini abufikeleli kwipleyithifomu, kwaye ubukalisa ngaphambi kokuba ugqibe. Tshintsha nayiphi na kwezi kwiskrini sesigqibo uze uchaze isizathu: isizathu sigcinwa ecaleni kwesicebiso ukuze umhloli abone apho zahlukana khona.
marking.impliesIntro.from: Arithmetic, not a judgement. The marks average out at this; practical performance and workplace evidence do not reach the platform, and you weigh those before deciding. Change any of these on the decision screen and say why: the reason is stored beside the proposal so a moderator can see where the two parted.

marking.markAllFirst.text: Umbuzo wonke kufuneka uhlolwe ngaphambi kokuba imigangatho iqikelelwe.
marking.markAllFirst.from: Every question has to be marked before the criteria can be worked out.

marking.summative.text: Oku kuyavavanywa. Xa sonke isigqibo sirekhodiwe emva kokuhlola yonke imibuzo, imigangatho ebonwayo icetyiswa ukuze uyiqinisekise.
marking.summative.from: This is assessed. Once every question is marked, record a decision: the criteria it evidences are proposed for you to confirm.

marking.formative.text: Le yincwadi yomsebenzi. Iyakha ukufunda: yihlole, uze ubuyise impendulo. Akukho nto apha erekhoda ukukwazi okanye ihambisa umfundi ekufaneleki.
marking.formative.from: This is a workbook. It is developmental: mark it, then return feedback. Nothing here records competence or moves the learner towards eligibility.

marking.matrix.text: Matriki yokuhlola: ukukhetha inqanaba ngalinye kunika inqaku
marking.matrix.from: Marking matrix: choosing a level for each gives the mark
