marking.toldHint.from: Where it was strong, and what was missing.

marking.returnIntro.text: Impendulo, hayi isigqibo. Ixelela umfundi oko kufuneka abuyele kuko phambi kovavanyo lokugqibela, kwaye ayirekhodi kukwazi ngokuchasene nomgangatho ongenamnye.
marking.returnIntro.from: Feedback, not a decision. It tells the learner what to go back to before the summative, and it records no competence against any criterion.

marking.returnHint.text: Oko kwakuqinile, nokufuneka kufundwe kwakhona phambi kovavanyo lokugqibela.
marking.returnHint.from: What was solid, and what to re-read before the summative.

marking.concern.from: Criteria the weak answers cluster around

marking.sectionHint.text: Oko kwahamba kakuhle apha, nokufuneka kwenziwe ngokwahlukileyo ngokulandelayo.
marking.sectionHint.from: What went well here, and what to do differently next time.

marking.learnerSees.from: The learner sees this with their feedback.

moderating.intro.text: Uphononongo oluzimeleyo lwezigqibo zabavavanyi. Ukuba zeziphi izigqibo ezifikelela kolu luhlu kuzinziswa yinkqubo, hayi kukhethwa ngumntu. Awukwazi ukuhlola isigqibo osenzileyo wena.
moderating.intro.from: Independent review of assessors' decisions. Which decisions reach this list is decided by the system, not chosen by anyone. You cannot moderate a decision you made yourself.

moderating.reason.new_assessor.from: Newly registered assessor: moderated in full

moderating.referBack.from: Refer back: the assessor should look again

moderating.ownDecision.text: Wenze esi sigqibo njengomvavanyi, ngoko awukwazi ukusihlola. Omnye umhloli kufuneka.
moderating.ownDecision.from: You made this decision as the assessor, so you cannot moderate it. Another moderator must.

pack.print.text: Printa eli phepha ukuze uligcine njenge-PDF.
pack.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF.

pack.instrumentIntro.text: Iphepha njengoko lalibekwe, nesikhokelo elahlolwa ngaso.
pack.instrumentIntro.from: The paper as it was set, and the guidance it was marked against.

pack.scriptsIntro.text: Athathwe kuluhlu lwamanqaku (okuphezulu, okuphantsi nokwahlukileyo phakathi) ukuze ukuhlola kubonwe kwezona zintle nezona zimbi kunokuba kube phakathi.
pack.scriptsIntro.from: Taken across the mark range (top, bottom and spread between) so the marking is seen at its best and its worst rather than in the middle.

pack.departuresIntro.text: Apho umvavanyi wahluke koko amanqaku akucebisayo, okanye umhloli wahluke kumvavanyi. Ipakethe eshiya ezi ngaphandle imbi ngakumbi kunengekho.
pack.departuresIntro.from: Where an assessor differed from what the marks proposed, or a moderator differed from the assessor. A pack that leaves these out is worse than no pack.

pack.exceptionsIntro.text: Abafundi abagqithiselwe kwisango ngumntu ochaziweyo, kunye nesizathu abasinikeleyo.
pack.exceptionsIntro.from: Learners let past a gate by a named person, with the reason they gave.

held.intro.text: Umfundi ofunyenwe engakakwazi kabini akatshiswa. Uvavanyo luyabanjwa, kwaye uphononongo lwenkqubo luyabizwa kunye nomqeshi wakhe, kuba kweli xesha umbuzo awukho ngakumbi wokuba uyayazi na, kodwa kukuba kuqhubeka ntoni ejikeleze yena.
held.intro.from: A learner found not yet competent twice is not failed. The assessment is held, and a programme review is convened with their employer, because by this point the question is rarely whether they know it, and usually what has been going on around them.

held.empty.text: Oku kuyalayishwa xa umfundi efunyenwa engakakwazi okwesibini kuvavanyo lokugqibela. Ngaphambi koko akukho nto yokuphonononga.
held.empty.from: This fills when a learner is found not yet competent for a second time on a summative assessment. Until then there is nothing to review.

held.whoConvenes.from: A facilitator or administrator convenes the review.

held.oralAuthorised.text: {assessment} · uphononongo luvumele inzame yesithathu, eqhutywa ngomlomo
held.oralAuthorised.from: {assessment} · the review authorised a third attempt, conducted orally

held.whoConducts.text: Umvavanyi uqhuba inzame yomlomo, hayi umntu ovumele.
held.whoConducts.from: An assessor conducts the oral attempt, and not the person who authorised it.

held.furtherLearning.text: Ukufunda ngakumbi phambi kwenzame nayiphi na enye
held.furtherLearning.from: Further learning before any further attempt

held.whyHint.from: What the review found, and what it turns on.

oral.reviewDecidedIntro.text: Iziseko ezavunyelwa ngazo le nzame yesithathu.
oral.reviewDecidedIntro.from: The grounds on which this third attempt was authorised.

oral.recordIntro.text: Inzame yomlomo ayishiyi bungqina bayo. Oku kungubo bungqina, kwaye umphumo awunakurekhodwa ngaphandle kwabo.
oral.recordIntro.from: An oral attempt leaves no evidence of its own. This is that evidence, and the outcome cannot be recorded without it.

oral.outcomeIntro.text: Ugwetywa ngendlela efanayo nenzame ebhaliweyo, ngokuchasene nemigangatho efanayo, kwaye ihlolwa ngendlela efanayo emva koko.
oral.outcomeIntro.from: Judged the same way as a written attempt, against the same criteria, and moderated the same way afterwards.

oral.howHint.text: Ngokwenyama, okanye umnxeba wevidiyo owabanjelwa kuwo
oral.howHint.from: In person, or the video call it was held on

oral.presentNote.text: Akuyimfuneko. Uvavanyo lomlomo ngaphandle komnye umntu egumbini lunzima ukukhuselwa ekuhlolweni, kwaye irekhodi kufuneka lithi luluphi uhlobo lwalo.
oral.presentNote.from: Not required. An oral assessment with nobody else in the room is harder to defend at moderation, and the record should say which kind this was.

oral.savedNext.text: Umphumo urekhodwa kwiskrini sokuhlola, kanye njengenye inzame nayiphi na.
oral.savedNext.from: The outcome is recorded on the marking screen, the same as any other attempt.

appeals.intro.text: Umfundi unokubhena ngokuchasene nomphumo okanye ngokuchasene nokuziphatha komvavanyi. Ukwamkelwa kwaziswa ngaphakathi kweeyure ezi-{hours}, ekusisithuba esishiywa, kuba sisebenza ngoxa umntu efundisa.
appeals.intro.from: A learner may appeal against a result or against an assessor's conduct. Receipt is acknowledged within {hours} hours, which is the deadline that gets missed, because it runs while somebody is teaching.

appeals.lateIntro.text: Iyure ezi-{hours} zidlulile kwaye kusekho ongazisiwe ngokwamkelwa. Ukwazisa emva kwexesha kungcono kunokungazisi, kwaye irekhodi liya kubonisa zombini.
appeals.lateIntro.from: Past the {hours} hours and still not acknowledged. Acknowledging late is better than not at all, and the record will show both.

appeals.openIntro.text: Yonke into efakiweyo engekavalwa, entsha kuqala.
appeals.openIntro.from: Everything lodged and not yet closed, newest first.

appeals.none.text: Akukho nto ivulekileyo. Isibheno sifakwa kwiphepha lomfundi ngokwakhe.
appeals.none.from: Nothing open. An appeal is lodged from a learner's own page.

appeals.procedureIntro.text: Azisa ukwamkelwa, hlangana nomfundi, xoxa nomhloli apho isiseko sisisiphumo, emva koko usonjulule ubaxelele.
appeals.procedureIntro.from: Acknowledge, meet the learner, consult the moderator where the ground is a result, then resolve and tell them.

appeals.closedUnacknowledged.from: Closed without an acknowledgement being recorded.

appeals.firstCounts.text: Isaziso sokuqala sesigcinwa lirekhodi. Asinakutywinwa kwakhona kamva, kuba ixesha elinokutshintshwa alingubungqina bento.
appeals.firstCounts.from: The first acknowledgement is the one the record keeps. It cannot be re-stamped later, because a time that can be changed is not evidence of anything.

appeals.resultNeedsModerator.text: Isibheno somphumo siya kumhloli wangaphakathi phambi kokuba sisonjululwe. Lelo linyathelo umqinisekisi wangaphandle ambuza ngalo.
appeals.resultNeedsModerator.from: A result appeal goes to the internal moderator before it can be resolved. That is the step an external verifier asks about.

appeals.conductNoModerator.text: Isibheno sokuziphatha asisonjululwa kukuhlola kwakhona, ngoko akukho mhloli ufunekayo.
appeals.conductNoModerator.from: A conduct appeal is not something re-marking settles, so no moderator is required.

appeals.notFeedback.from: A decision the learner has not been given is not feedback.

appeals.whyHint.text: Kutheni. Le yeyona nxalenye umfundi anelungelo kuyo.
appeals.whyHint.from: Why. This is the part the learner is entitled to.

appeals.notesIntro.text: Ingxoxo phakathi komququzeleli, umvavanyi nomhloli. Ayibonakaliswa kumfundi ngaphandle kokuba uthi ewe; oko anelungelo kuko ngumphumo nesizathu ekuthi ngasentla.
appeals.notesIntro.from: The discussion between coordinator, assessor and moderator. Not shown to the learner unless you say so; what they are entitled to is the outcome and the reasoning above.

appeals.noteHint.from: What was discussed, and with whom

appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.text: Ukurhoxisa kufuna isizathu. Ongenaso ubonakala njengoxinzelelo, kwaye kanye oko kungaba sisibheno sokuziphatha.
appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.from: A withdrawal needs a reason. One with none looks like pressure, and that is exactly what an appeal about conduct would be about.

rpl.intro.text: Kumfundi osele enokwenza inxalenye yomsebenzi. Akukho nto inikwa apha ngokwamazwi omntu omnye: isigwebo senziwa ngokuchasene nemigangatho yemodyuli ngokwayo, sibhalwe ngokupheleleyo, kwaye sihlolwe ngomnye umntu ongelomntu wasenzayo phambi kokuba sibale nakuphi.
rpl.intro.from: For a learner who can already do part of the work. Nothing here is granted on one person's say-so: a judgement is made against the module's own criteria, written down in full, and moderated by somebody other than whoever made it before it counts for anything.

rpl.waitingIntro.text: Isigwebo asinikeli nto de oku kwenziwe. Funda isizathu ngokuchasene nemodyuli phambi kokuvuma: yeyona nto yokuqala umqinisekisi wangaphandle ayifundayo.
rpl.waitingIntro.from: A judgement grants nothing until this is done. Read the rationale against the module before agreeing: it is the first thing an external verifier reads.

rpl.appearHere.from: Judgements appear here as they are made.

rpl.openIntro.text: Inyathelo lokuqala, nelenza irekhodi lonke lunye elinamathele kulo.
rpl.openIntro.from: The first step, and the one that creates the record everything else attaches to.

rpl.transferIntro.text: Kwahlukile ku-RPL: umfundi sele ephethe ikhwalifikheyishini enemiphumo ekhava le modyuli. Akukho cebiso, kodwa ukumepa kufuneka kubhalwe phantsi; ukudluliselwa ngaphandle koko ngumbango ongenakuqinisekiswa.
rpl.transferIntro.from: Different from RPL: the learner already holds a qualification whose outcomes cover this module. No advisory, but the mapping has to be written down; a transfer without it is a claim nobody can check.

rpl.needsBoth.text: Isicelo sifuna umfundi nekhwalifikheyishini esifaka isicelo ngokuchasene nayo. Yongeza ezo kuqala.
rpl.needsBoth.from: An application needs a learner and a qualification to apply against. Add those first.

rpl.needsLearner.text: Yongeza umfundi ngaphambi kokurekhoda ukudluliselwa kwakhe.
rpl.needsLearner.from: Add a learner before recording a transfer for one.

rpl.mapping.text: Ukuba iimiphumo zoko bekuphethe zikhava njani eyale modyuli
rpl.mapping.from: How the outcomes of what they hold cover this module's

rpl.checked.from: What you checked, and what you concluded

record.print.text: Printa eli phepha ukuze uligcine njenge-PDF yephotfoliyo yobungqina.
record.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF for the portfolio of evidence.

record.timeExpired.text: Ayamkelwanga: ixesha lokugqibela liphelile kwaye umsebenzi unikezelwe njengoko wawunjalo.
record.timeExpired.from: Not accepted: the time limit expired and the work was handed in as it stood.

record.returned.text: Ibuyisiwe {date}. Oku kuyakha ukufunda: akurekhodi kukwazi.
record.returned.from: Returned {date}. This is developmental: it records no competence.

sor.withdrawConsequence.text: Iziko lovavanyo linokuba sele linekopi. Ireferensi iyaqhubeka isebenza kwaye iya kuthi yarhoxiswa.
sor.withdrawConsequence.from: An assessment centre may already hold a copy. The reference keeps working and will say it was withdrawn.

sor.print.text: Printa okanye gcina le Ngxelo yeziPhumo
sor.print.from: Print or save this Statement of Results

fisa.intro.text: Iphepha lisetwa ngumboneleli walo kwinkqubo yakhe yezakhono. Ngokungafaniyo novavanyo lwangaphandle, ulibhala kwaye ulihlola, ngoko ukuhlolwa kwenzeka phambi kokuba nabani alihlale, kwaye iphepha elingasayinwanga njengelifanelekileyo injongo alinakusetyenziswa.
fisa.intro.from: The paper this provider sets for its own skills programme. Unlike an external assessment, you write it and you moderate it, so the moderation happens before anybody sits it, and a paper that has not been signed off as fit for purpose cannot be used.

fisa.waitingIntro.text: Akukho namnye unokuzihlala de umhloli azisayine.
fisa.waitingIntro.from: Nobody can sit these until a moderator signs them off.

fisa.setNewIntro.text: Ngokuchasene nenkqubo yezakhono. Ikhwalifikheyishini epheleleyo okanye eyinxalenye ivavanywa ngaphandle.
fisa.setNewIntro.from: Against a skills programme. A full or part qualification is assessed externally.

fisa.gate.approved.text: Isayiniwe njengefanelekileyo injongo: abafaki-zicelo banokulihlala eli phepha
fisa.gate.approved.from: Signed off as fit for purpose: candidates may sit this paper

fisa.gate.in_moderation.from: With the moderator: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.gate.draft.from: Being written: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.beforeNotAfter.text: I-FISA ihlolwa phambi kokuhlalwa, hayi emva. Yiyo leyo eyenza ukuba ikhuselekile kutyelelo lokubeka iliso.
fisa.beforeNotAfter.from: A FISA is moderated before it is sat, not after. That is what makes it defensible at a monitoring visit.

fisa.practical.text: Kunenxalenye esebenzayo, egwetywa ngokuthi uyakwazi okanye akakakwazi.
fisa.practical.from: Also has a practical component, judged competent or not yet competent.

fisa.moderatorIntro.text: Ujonga ukuba lifanelekile injongo, phambi kokuba nabani alihlale.
fisa.moderatorIntro.from: Checks it is fit for purpose, before anybody sits it.

fisa.unsigned.text: Akukabikho sivumelwano sokugcina imfihlo. Abanakulibona okanye balivavanye iphepha de sisayinwe.
fisa.unsigned.from: No confidentiality agreement yet. They may not see or judge the paper until it is signed.

fisa.outcomes.text: Iziphumo zenqanaba lokuphuma, nalapho iphepha livavanya khona
fisa.outcomes.from: Exit level outcomes, and where the paper assesses them

fisa.outcomesIntro.text: Icandelo 2 lazo zombini iingxelo. Yindawo enye yodwa ebonisa ukuba iphepha likhava ikhwalifikheyishini hayi ukubonakala nje njengovavanyo.
fisa.outcomesIntro.from: Section 2 of both reports. The only place that shows the paper covers the qualification rather than merely looking like an exam.

fisa.noOutcomes.text: Le nkqubo ayinazo iziphumo zenqanaba lokuphuma ezirekhodiweyo, ngoko akukho nto yokumepa iphepha ngayo. Ngenisa ikharityhulam kuqala.
fisa.noOutcomes.from: This programme has no exit level outcomes recorded, so there is nothing to map the paper against. Import the curriculum first.

fisa.onlyExaminer.text: Ngumvavanyi omiselweyo kuphela, xa isivumelwano sakhe sokugcina imfihlo sisayiniwe, onokuphendula ezi.
fisa.onlyExaminer.from: Only the appointed examiner, once their confidentiality agreement is signed, can answer these.

fisa.onlyModerator.text: Ngumhloli omiselweyo kuphela, xa isivumelwano sakhe sokugcina imfihlo sisayiniwe, onokuphendula ezi.
fisa.onlyModerator.from: Only the appointed moderator, once their confidentiality agreement is signed, can answer these.

fisa.handOverIntro.from: Once your own report is complete.

fisa.laterIntro.text: Le ihlala injalo ngqo, kuba abafaki-zicelo banokuba baliyihlala. Uguqulelo olutsha lufuna ukuhlolwa kwalo.
fisa.laterIntro.from: This one stays exactly as it is, because candidates may have sat it. A new version needs its own moderation.

fisa.noProgrammes.text: I-FISA isetwa ngokuchasene nenkqubo yezakhono, kwaye akukabikho. Ngenisa enye kuqala; ikhwalifikheyishini epheleleyo okanye eyinxalenye ivavanywa ngaphandle ngumlingane womgangatho wovavanyo, ngoko umboneleli akalisetyi elo phepha.
fisa.noProgrammes.from: A FISA is set against a skills programme, and there are none yet. Import one first; a full or part qualification is assessed externally by the Assessment Quality Partner, so the provider does not set that paper.

fisa.passNote.text: I-FISA luviwo, ngoko inawo, ngokungafaniyo nokukwazi kwangaphakathi.
fisa.passNote.from: A FISA is an examination, so it has one, unlike internal competence.

fisa.hasPractical.text: Inenxalenye esebenzayo egwetywa ngokuthi uyakwazi okanye akakakwazi
fisa.hasPractical.from: It also has a practical component judged competent or not yet competent

fisa.practicalHint.text: umz. Umsebenzi: iiyure ezi-4, ugwetywa ngokuthi uyakwazi / akakakwazi
fisa.practicalHint.from: e.g. Practical: 4 hours, judged competent / not yet competent

fisa.idNote.text: Indlela ipleyithifomu eyahlula ngayo umntu nomnye xa engenayo akhawunti apha.
fisa.idNote.from: How the platform tells one person from another when they have no account here.

fisa.account.from: Their account here, if they have one

fisa.outside.from: Somebody from outside, with no account

fisa.accountNote.text: Kuphela umntu one-akhawunti onokuzalisa ingxelo yakhe apha.
fisa.accountNote.from: Only somebody with an account can fill in their own report here.

fisa.further.from: Further comments for the improvement of assessment standards

fisa.signOff.from: Sign off as fit for purpose

fisa.untilYouDo.text: Akukho mfaki-sicelo unokulihlala eli phepha de wenze oko.
fisa.untilYouDo.from: No candidate may sit this paper until you do.

eisa.intro.text: Ukuba lisiphi ixesha lokuhlala ngalinye, nokuvalwa kobhaliso lwalo, nokuba ngawaphi amaqela asafuna ukungeniswa. Ubhaliso lusoloko lubuya lulivalwe malunga nezinyanga ezintathu kwangaphambili, yiyo loo nto iqela eligqiba ngasekupheleni konyaka kufuneka lingeniswe kudala ngaphambi kokuba ligqibe.
eisa.intro.from: When each sitting is, when registration for it closes, and which cohorts still have to be entered. Registration typically closes about three months ahead, which is why a cohort finishing later in the year has to be entered long before it finishes.

eisa.registerNowIntro.text: Ubhaliso luvala ngaphakathi kweentsuku zomsebenzi ezilishumi kwaye la maqela akanalo usuku lobhaliso lurekhodiweyo.
eisa.registerNowIntro.from: Registration closes within ten working days and these cohorts have no registration date recorded.

eisa.sittingsIntro.text: Kuphela ezo zisavulekileyo ekubhalisweni. Evaliweyo ayisiyo nto banokuyenza, kwaye ukuyishiya apha kuya kusondeza usuku olulandelayo lokwenyani ezantsi kwephepha.
eisa.sittingsIntro.from: Only those still open for registration. A closed one is nothing anybody can act on, and leaving it here would push the next real deadline down the page.

eisa.nextYear.text: Akukho nto irekhodiweyo ngaphaya konyaka. Umlingane womgangatho wovavanyo upapasha imihla yonyaka olandelayo ngoDisemba, ngoko incwadi kufuneka ibe iphumile; ukuyifaka ngoku kugcina ukubala kuqhubeka ukuya kuJanuwari.
eisa.nextYear.from: Nothing is recorded beyond this year. The assessment quality partner publishes next year's dates in December, so the letter should be out; adding them now is what keeps the countdown running into January.

eisa.toEnterIntro.text: Yonke into enomhla wokugqibela ovulekileyo engenalo usuku lobhaliso lurekhodwe ngokuchasene nayo.
eisa.toEnterIntro.from: Everything with an open deadline and no registration date recorded against it.

eisa.noIdIntro.text: Bonke abalingane bomgangatho bayayicela, kwaye ubhaliso olubuyiselwa ngenxa yenombolo elahlekileyo lubiza umjikelo. Kungcono ukufunyanwa ngoku kunokuba emva kokuthunyelwa kwefayile.
eisa.noIdIntro.from: Every quality partner asks for one, and a registration returned for a missing number costs a cycle. Better found now than after the file is sent.

eisa.readyIntro.text: Umgangatho wonke kwimodyuli yonke uphunyeziwe, nokuba ufundisiwe okanye wamkelwe ngokufunda kwangaphambili.
eisa.readyIntro.from: Every criterion in every module met, whether taught or recognised through prior learning.

eisa.nobodyYet.text: Akukabikho mntu. Uluhlu olungezantsi lubonisa ukuba ngamnye kufuneka ahambe kangakanani.
eisa.nobodyYet.from: Nobody yet. The list below says how far each of them has to go.

eisa.notReadyIntro.text: Ukuba ngamnye kufuneka ahambe kangakanani. Umntu oshiyeke umgangatho omnye usenokuwufikelela umhla wokugqibela ukuba kuqatshelwe kule veki.
eisa.notReadyIntro.from: How far each has to go. Somebody one criterion short can still make the deadline if it is noticed this week.

ready.intro.text: Umfundi unokuhlala i-External Integrated Summative Assessment xa yonke imigangatho yovavanyo lwangaphakathi kwimodyuli nganye iphunyeziwe. Hayi uninzi lwayo, kwaye akukho ipesenti engena endaweni yayo: ipesenti engezantsi yinkqubela, ibheji yimvume.
ready.intro.from: A learner may sit the External Integrated Summative Assessment once every internal assessment criterion in every module has been achieved. Not most of them, and no percentage stands in for it: the percentage below is progress, the badge is permission.

ready.nobody.text: Akukabikho mntu obhalisiweyo kwikhwalifikheyishini. Bhalisa umfundi kwikhosi uze ukhethe ikhwalifikheyishini ebalwa kuyo, kwaye uya kuvela apha.
ready.nobody.from: Nobody is enrolled against a qualification yet. Enrol a learner on a course and choose the qualification it counts towards, and they will appear here.

ready.notCaptured.from: A curriculum here is not fully captured.

ready.notCapturedIntro.text: Ezinye iimodyuli azinamigangatho yovavanyo, ngoko akukho nto inokuphunyezwa ngokuchasene nazo kwaye akukho namnye kuloo khwalifikheyishini unokubhengezwa elungile. Ngenisa uxwebhu lwekharityhulam epheleleyo phambi kokungenisa nabani kwi-EISA.
ready.notCapturedIntro.from: Some modules carry no assessment criteria, so nothing can be achieved against them and nobody on that qualification can be declared ready. Import the full curriculum document before entering anyone for an EISA.

ready.notEligible.from: Not yet eligible for the EISA

ready.achieved.text: Imigangatho yovavanyo lwangaphakathi ephunyeziweyo: {achieved} kwezi-{total}, kwaye amava omsebenzi angqinwe ngo-{record} osayiniweyo.
ready.achieved.from: {achieved} of {total} internal assessment criteria achieved, and work experience proved by a signed {record}.

ready.canIssue.from: A Statement of Results can be issued.

ready.everyOne.text: Yonke kuyo iyafuneka; akukho manqaku okuphumelela.
ready.everyOne.from: Every one of them is required; there is no pass mark.

ready.perUnitIntro.text: Ingxelo yeyunithi enye yokufunda iqinisekisa yonke imigangatho kwiimodyuli ezinikezelwa yiyo leyo yunithi. Inokukhutshwa kwakamsinya ukuba iyunithi igqityiwe, ingalindanga yonke enye yekhwalifikheyishini.
ready.perUnitIntro.from: A statement for one study unit confirms every criterion in the modules that unit delivers. It can be issued as soon as that unit is finished, without waiting for the rest of the qualification.

ready.certificateIntro.text: Sikhutshwa sisiqumrhu esinikezelayo emva kwe-EISA, hayi ngu-{provider}. Sirekhodwa apha xa sifika, ukuze irekhodi lomfundi lithi uqinisekisiwe.
ready.certificateIntro.from: Issued by the awarding body after the EISA, not by {provider}. Recorded here when it arrives, so the learner's record says they are qualified.

ready.thisNotCaptured.from: This curriculum is not fully captured.

ready.thisNotCapturedIntro.text: {modules} azinamigangatho yovavanyo. Akukho namnye unokubhengezwa efanelekile ngokuchasene nale khwalifikheyishini de uxwebhu lwekharityhulam epheleleyo lungeniswe; ngaphandle koko iimodyuli ezingekhoyo zinganjalo ngokungathethi zibalwe njengezidlulileyo.
ready.thisNotCapturedIntro.from: {modules} carry no assessment criteria. Nobody can be declared eligible against this qualification until the full curriculum document has been imported; otherwise the missing modules would silently count as passed.

ready.weight.document.from: as stated in the curriculum document

ready.weight.credits.text: kuphuma kwikhredithi zemodyuli; uxwebhu aluchazi maperesenti
ready.weight.credits.from: derived from module credits; the document states no percentages

ready.weight.equal.text: yahlulwe ngokulinganayo; uxwebhu aluchazi maperesenti okanye ikhredithi
ready.weight.equal.from: split evenly; the document states no percentages and no credits

ready.workProved.text: Amava omsebenzi angqinwa ngo-{record} osayinwe ngumqeqeshi wasemsebenzini kwaye wamkelwe ngumvavanyi, hayi ngemigangatho yovavanyo. Ikharityhulam ayichazi nayiphi na kule modyuli.
ready.workProved.from: Work experience is proved by a {record} signed by the workplace coach and accepted by an assessor, not by assessment criteria. The curriculum defines none for this module.

ready.noRecord.from: No {record} has been opened for this module.

ready.noCriteria.text: Akukho migangatho yovavanyo irekhodiweyo kule modyuli.
ready.noCriteria.from: No assessment criteria captured for this module.

issue.notYet.from: A Statement of Results cannot be issued yet.

preview.summative.text: Ekugqibeleni: igwetywa ngumntu kwaye ihlolwa ngokuzimeleyo
preview.summative.from: Summative: judged by a person and independently moderated

preview.formative.from: Formative: marked as the learner goes

preview.whoMarks.from: {app} marked by the App, {assessor} by an assessor

preview.isPreviewIntro.text: Kanye oko umfundi akubonayo, namabhokisi angabhala kuwo. Akukho nto igciniweyo kwaye akukho nzame iqaliweyo, ngoko izilawuli zicinyiwe. Ipaneli engaphantsi kombuzo nganye ikwenzelwe kuba ulakhile eli phepha; umfundi akayiboni.
preview.isPreviewIntro.from: Exactly what a learner sees, with the boxes they would type into. Nothing is saved and no attempt has been started, so the controls are switched off. The panel under each question is for you because you built this paper; a learner never sees it.

preview.empty.from: There are no questions in this paper yet.

preview.tickedAbove.from: The correct option is ticked above.

preview.noGuide.text: Akukho sikhokelo sokuhlola. Umvavanyi akanto anokuhlola ngokuchasene nayo; yongeza enye phambi kokuba iphepha lisetyenziswe.
preview.noGuide.from: No marking guide. An assessor has nothing to mark this against; add one before the paper is used.

preview.declarationIntro.text: Umfundi akanakukunikezela oku engavumanga kuko, kwaye amagama achanekileyo abekwa ngokungatshintshi kumnikelo.
preview.declarationIntro.from: A learner cannot hand this in without agreeing to it, and the exact wording is frozen into the submission.

people.intro.text: Wonke umntu kwi-{provider}, iindima zabo, nokuba irekhodi labo liphethe oko imbuyekezo esemthethweni ifuna.
people.intro.from: Everyone in {provider}, their roles, and whether their record carries what a statutory return needs.

people.notEnrolledOne.from: 1 learner is not enrolled on anything.

people.notEnrolledMany.from: {count} learners are not enrolled on anything.

people.notEnrolledWhy.text: Ukuba ngumfundi akunikeli ngokwako ukufikelela, ngoko bangena kwiskrini esingenanto. Babhalise kwikhosi, bongeze kwiqela, okanye ubabele inkqubo.
people.notEnrolledWhy.from: Being a learner grants no access on its own, so they sign in to an empty screen. Enrol them on a course, add them to a cohort, or assign a programme.

people.missingOne.text: Umntu o-1 uswele iinkcukacha imbuyekezo ye-SETA okanye ye-SAQA ezifunayo.
people.missingOne.from: 1 person is missing details a SETA or SAQA return needs.

people.missingMany.text: Abantu aba-{count} baswele iinkcukacha imbuyekezo ye-SETA okanye ye-SAQA ezifunayo.
people.missingMany.from: {count} people are missing details a SETA or SAQA return needs.

people.missingWhy.text: Baphawulwe ngezantsi. Ukuzizalisa ngoku kulula kakhulu kunobusuku obandulela ukungeniswa.
people.missingWhy.from: They are marked below. Filling them in now is far easier than the night before a submission.

people.roster.from: Add a cohort from a spreadsheet

people.rosterIntro.text: Funda ifayile ye-CSV okanye ye-Excel yabafundi uze ubadale bonke ngaxeshanye. Ikubonisa oko kuyenzileyo ngefayile phambi kokuba nabani adalwe.
people.rosterIntro.from: Read a CSV or Excel file of learners and create them all at once. It shows you what it made of the file before anybody is created.

people.added.text: Kongezwe. Mnike le phasiwedi: ibonakaliswa kanye kwaye ayinakubuyiswa.
people.added.from: Added. Give them this password: it is shown once and cannot be retrieved.

people.noMail.text: Akukabikho seva yeposi ejongene, ngoko akukho nto ithunyelwe nge-imeyile. Mcele ayitshintshe emva kokungena.
people.noMail.from: There is no mail server connected yet, so nothing was emailed. Ask them to change it after signing in.

person.lineManagerNote.text: Igqiba ukuba uqeqesho lukabani olunokubonwa ngulo mntu kwiingxelo.
person.lineManagerNote.from: Decides whose training this person can see in reports.

person.ofoNote.text: Ikhowudi yomsebenzi esetyenziselwa ukuqokelela imbuyekezo ye-SETA.
person.ofoNote.from: Occupation code used to group a SETA return.

person.statutoryNote.text: Ifuneka kwimbuyekezo ye-SAQA okanye ye-SETA. Inombolo yesazisi iqinisekiswa ngenani layo lokujonga xa ugcina, ukuze impazamo yokuchwetha ibanjwe apha kungekhona liziko elilawulayo.
person.statutoryNote.from: Needed for a SAQA or SETA return. The identity number is checked against its check digit as you save, so a typing error is caught here rather than by the regulator.

person.roleNote.workplace_coach.text: Umongameli womqeshi: ubona abafundi bakhe kuphela
person.roleNote.workplace_coach.from: The employer's supervisor: sees only their own learners

roster.how.text: I-CSV okanye i-Excel. Izihloko zeekholam ziyahambelaniswa ngegama ("Surname", "Last Name" kunye "Van" zonke ziyasebenza) kwaye akukho sandiso sifunekayo kuyo nayiphi na into.
roster.how.from: CSV or Excel. Column headings are matched by name ("Surname", "Last Name" and "Van" all work) and no extension is needed for any of it.

roster.aiOnWhat.text: kwaye siya kuzama ukuhambelanisa nasiphi na isihloko esingaboniswanga yimithetho. Sibonisiwe izihloko kuphela, ungaze zibonakaliswe imiqolo, equlathe amanani esazisi.
roster.aiOnWhat.from: and will try to match any heading the rules miss. It is shown the headings only, never the rows, which carry identity numbers.

roster.aiOff.text: Ukuba isandiso sakho se-AI sivuliwe, sasiya kuhambelanisa nezihloko ezingaziwa yimithetho; sasiya kubonisa izihloko kuphela, ungaze zibonakaliswe imiqolo. Iswitshi ikumhlaba ophezulu wephepha.
roster.aiOff.from: With your AI extension switched on it would additionally match headings the rules do not recognise; it would be shown the headings only, never the rows. The switch is at the top of the page.

roster.passwordsNote.text: Ezi azigcinwanga naphi apho zinokufundwa kwakhona. Zikopishe ngoku, okanye uzisete kwakhona ngabanye kamva. Umntu ngamnye uceliwe ukuba atshintshe eyakhe ekungeneni kokuqala.
roster.passwordsNote.from: These are not stored anywhere they can be read again. Copy them now, or reset them individually later. Each person is asked to change theirs on first sign-in.

roster.willCreateSkip.from: {count} will be created, {skipped} will be skipped.

personPage.anonymisedOne.text: Iinkcukacha zobuqu zicinyiwe ngo-{date} ngesicelo somntu. Isatifikethi sakhe esi-1 sisasebenza kwaye siyaqinisekiseka, kuba ikhwalifikheyishini esele ifunyenwe kufuneka ihlale kwirekhodi likazwelonke.
personPage.anonymisedOne.from: The personal details were erased on {date} at the person's request. Their 1 certificate remains valid and verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to stay on the national record.

personPage.anonymisedMany.text: Iinkcukacha zobuqu zicinyiwe ngo-{date} ngesicelo somntu. Izatifikethi zakhe ezi-{count} zisasebenza kwaye ziyaqinisekiseka, kuba ikhwalifikheyishini esele ifunyenwe kufuneka ihlale kwirekhodi likazwelonke.
personPage.anonymisedMany.from: The personal details were erased on {date} at the person's request. Their {count} certificates remain valid and verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to stay on the national record.

personPage.conductIntro.text: Oko kutyholwayo, izilumkiso ebezisasebenza ngelo xesha, ukuba isaziso sokuviwa kwetyala besifanelekile, nokugqitywe. Ngokulandelelana kokwenzeka, olona lolandelelwano lufundwa ngalo kwakhona.
personPage.conductIntro.from: What was alleged, which warnings were live at the time, whether notice of a hearing was adequate, and what was decided. In the order it happened, which is the order it gets read back in.

personPage.supportIntro.text: Oko kwenziwelwa lo mfundi, nokwenziwa ngubani. Isizathu esiphantsi kolungiselelo sinento yempilo okanye yezemali kwaye sigcinwa ngokwahlukileyo, kuba ukwenza ulungiselelo akufuni ukwazi isizathu.
personPage.supportIntro.from: What is being done for this learner, and by whom. The reason behind an accommodation is health or financial information and is held apart from it, because doing the accommodating does not require knowing why.

personPage.missedIntro.text: Umhla omnye owongezelelweyo, omnye kuphela. Apho nalo luphosiswe ngenxa yezizathu zonyango, umfundi uya kuvavanyo lomlomo kukho umbukeli ovela kumqeshi.
personPage.missedIntro.from: One additional date, and one only. Where that is also missed on medical grounds the learner goes to an oral assessment with an observer from the employer.

personPage.appealsIntro.text: Ngokuchasene nomphumo, okanye ngokuchasene nokuziphatha komvavanyi. Ukwamkelwa kwaziswa ngaphakathi kweeyure ezi-{hours}, kwaye ixesha liqala xa sifakwe apha isibheno.
personPage.appealsIntro.from: Against a result, or against an assessor's conduct. Receipt is acknowledged within {hours} hours, and the clock starts when it is lodged here.

personPage.documentsIntro.text: Ajongwa njengoko eqokelelwa, kungekhona xa imbuyekezo isahlanganiswa. Ikopi eqinisekisiweyo elahlekileyo efunyenwe emva kweenyanga inzima kakhulu ukuyifumana, kwaye umhla wokugqibela uhlala usele iintsuku ngelo xesha.
personPage.documentsIntro.from: Checked as they are collected rather than when a return is being assembled. A missing certified copy found months later is far harder to get, and the deadline is usually days away by then.

personPage.elsewhereIntro.text: Kungeniswe kwenye inkqubo. Kubonisiwe njengoko kwakurekhodwe apho; akukho nto kuko eyafundiswa, yavavanywa okanye yahlolwa kule pleyithifomu.
personPage.elsewhereIntro.from: Imported from another system. Shown as it was recorded there; none of it was taught, assessed or moderated on this platform.

editor.ownRoles.text: Awukwazi ukutshintsha indima zakho: ukuzisusela ukufikelela yimpazamo enye engenakulungiswa ngomnye umntu. Cela omnye umlawuli.
editor.ownRoles.from: You cannot change your own roles: removing your own access is the one mistake nobody else may be able to undo. Ask another administrator.

editor.mailboxIntro.text: Idilesi abafundi nabavavanyi ababhalela kuyo nabathumela kuyo. Eyahlukileyo kwidilesi yokungena ekuthi ngasentla, ukuze incoko malunga novavanyo ifike ngaphakathi kwirekhodi lomfundi, kungekhona kwibhokisi yabucala yomntu, apho ingaphandle kwelogi yophicotho, ingaphandle kwekopi yokugcina, kwaye ilahleka xa ehamba.
editor.mailboxIntro.from: The address learners and assessors write to and from. Separate from the sign-in address above, so a conversation about an assessment lands inside the learner's record rather than in somebody's private inbox, where it is outside the audit log, outside the backup, and gone when they leave.

editor.noPassword.text: Akukho phasiwedi yahlukileyo, kuba akukho ngeniso yahlukileyo.
editor.noPassword.from: There is no separate password, because there is no separate login.

editor.noPasswordWhy.text: Le ayiyo ibhokisi yeposi kwisebenzisi-posi enewebhu-mail yayo. Iposi ethunyelwe kule dilesi ihanjiswa ngaphakathi kwipleyithifomu, kwaye umntu uyifunda aze ayiphendule kwicandelo Iposi emva kokungena ngendlela ahlala eyenza ngayo. Yiyo leyo injongo: uthungelwano lwabhalelwana lusekwirekhodi lomfundi, kwilogi yophicotho nakwikopi yokugcina, kungekhona kwibhokisi yabucala ehamba naye.
editor.noPasswordWhy.from: This is not a mailbox on a mail host with its own webmail. Mail sent to this address is delivered into the platform, and the person reads and answers it under Mail after signing in the way they always do. That is the point of it: the correspondence sits inside the learner's record, in the audit log and in the backup, rather than in a private inbox that leaves when they do.

editor.mailboxChange.from: Changing it does not move mail already received.

editor.mailboxSuggested.text: Kucetyiswa: {address}. Yishiye ingenanto ukuba akukho bhokisi yeposi.
editor.mailboxSuggested.from: Suggested: {address}. Leave blank for no mailbox.

editor.newPassword.text: Iphasiwedi entsha: ibonakaliswa kanye, mnike yona ngokuthe ngqo.
editor.newPassword.from: New password: shown once, give it to them directly.

editor.ownSuspend.from: You cannot suspend your own account.

editor.suspendNote.text: Ukumisa kugqibela naliphi na iseshoni evulekileyo yomntu ngoko nangoko, kwaye ukusetha kwakhona iphasiwedi kumphumisa yonke indawo.
editor.suspendNote.from: Suspending ends any session the person has open immediately, and resetting a password signs them out everywhere.

editor.eraseIntro.text: Kwisicelo sokucima se-POPIA. Kususa igama, iinkcukacha zonxibelelwano neyezinto zabantu ngokusisigxina. Izatifikethi neerekhodi zovavanyo ziyagcinwa kwaye ziyaqinisekiseka, kuba ikhwalifikheyishini esele ifunyenwe kufuneka ihlale kwirekhodi likazwelonke, nto leyo ke ekwenza ukuba oku kungabuyiselwa.
editor.eraseIntro.from: For a POPIA erasure request. Removes the name, contact and demographic details permanently. Certificates and assessment records are kept and stay verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to remain on the national record, which is also why this cannot be undone.

editor.whyHint.from: Kept permanently in the audit log.

lodge.noCohort.text: Isibheno sifakwa ngokuchasene neqela, kwaye lo mfundi akakwiqela eliqhubekayo.
lodge.noCohort.from: An appeal is filed against a cohort, and this learner is not on a running one.

lodge.statementHint.text: Oko umfundi akuthethayo, ngamazwi akhe apho kunokwenzeka.
lodge.statementHint.from: What the learner says, in their words where possible.

lodge.lateWhy.from: Why this is being accepted out of time

lodge.lateNote.text: Isibheno esiphuzileyo sisisibheno, kwaye ukusala apha kwakuya kusithumela kwibhokisi yomnye umntu kuphela. Isizathu siba yinxalenye yefayile.
lodge.lateNote.from: A late appeal is still an appeal, and turning it away here would only send it to somebody's inbox. The reason becomes part of the file.

missed.againOral.from: Missed it again: authorise an oral assessment

missed.wasMedical.from: The second miss was on medical grounds

missed.medicalOnly.text: Indlela yomlomo ivulwa ngenxa yesizathu sonyango kuphela, nakungekho nto ngaphandle koko. Ngaphandle kwaso, umphumo kukulahleka, ekunokuthi umfundi asabhena ngako.
missed.medicalOnly.from: The oral route opens on a medical ground and nothing else. Without one the outcome is a forfeit, which the learner can still appeal.

missed.whyHint.from: Why it was missed, if known

missed.onlyOne.text: Umhla omnye owongezelelweyo, omnye kuphela. Ukuwurekhoda apha kuthintela ukuba owesithathu awuceliswe kamva ngomntu ongawazi lo.
missed.onlyOne.from: One additional date, and one only. Recording it here is what stops a third being arranged later by somebody who did not know about this one.

support.withheld.text: Kukho iinkcukacha ezongezelelweyo kwifayile. Zithintelwe, kuba yinto yempilo okanye yezemali kwaye ukwenza ulungiselelo akufuni ukwazi isizathu salo.
support.withheld.from: There is more detail on file. It is restricted, because it is health or financial information and doing the accommodation does not require knowing the reason for it.

support.changing.from: What is changing as a result

support.accommodation.text: Oko kuya kwenziwa: kwabelwana nabo abamele bakwenze
support.accommodation.from: What will be done: shared with whoever has to do it

support.accommodationHint.text: Ndawo ecaleni komnyango. Vumela ikhefu emva kwemizuzu engama-40 nganye. Nikeza izixhobo eziprintiweyo.
support.accommodationHint.from: Seat near the door. Allow a break every 40 minutes. Provide printed materials.

support.reason.text: Isizathu esiphantsi kwako: sithintelwe, kwaye kungcono sishiywe singenanto
support.reason.from: The reason behind it: restricted, and better left empty

support.reasonNote.text: Impilo, ukukhubazeka nemeko yezemali yinkcazelo yobuqu ekhethekileyo. Irekhodi elithi kuphela oko kufuneka kwenziwe lisebenzela umfundi ngokulinganayo kwaye libeka emngciphekweni kancinci kakhulu. Yigcwalise kuphela apho umntu enokungakwazi ukwenza ngaphandle kwayo.
support.reasonNote.from: Health, disability and financial circumstances are special personal information. A record that says only what to do serves the learner just as well and puts far less at risk. Fill this in only where somebody genuinely could not act without it.

support.consented.from: The learner has agreed to this being recorded

docs.routeNote.text: Indlela igqiba oko kufunekayo. Ukwamkelwa kokufunda kwangaphambili kucela iphotfoliyo kunokuba kucele isatifikethi sekhwalifikheyishini, kuba ibango lelokuba ukufunda kwenzeke ngaphandle kwenkqubo esesikweni.
docs.routeNote.from: The route decides what is required. Recognition of prior learning asks for a portfolio rather than a qualification certificate, because the claim is that the learning happened outside a formal programme.

docs.allSupplied.text: Yonke into efunekayo iye yanikezelwa yajongwa.
docs.allSupplied.from: Everything required has been supplied and checked.

conduct.liveNote.text: Ezi kuphela zibalwa ekunyukeni kwamanyathelo. Isilumkiso esidlulileyo usuku lwaso sihlala kwifayile kwaye siyeke ukubalwa, oko kuxhomekeke kuko isibheno.
conduct.liveNote.from: Only these count towards escalation. A warning past its date stays on file and stops counting, which is what an appeal turns on.

conduct.findingsHint.from: What was found, and on what basis

conduct.givenButton.from: The learner has been given this in writing

conduct.termsHint.text: Umgaqo owaphulwayo, umgangatho okulindelwe, nento eza kwenzeka ukuba iphinde yenzeke.
conduct.termsHint.from: The rule broken, the standard expected, and what happens if it recurs.

conduct.allegationsHint.from: The specific allegations put to the learner

conduct.sanctionsHint.text: Izohlwayo ezinokwenzeka, kubandakanya ukupheliswa apho kunjalo
conduct.sanctionsHint.from: Sanctions possible, including termination where it is

conduct.rights.text: Isaziso sixelela umfundi ukuba unokuncediswa ngumfundi omnye, abeke ityala lakhe, abize kwaye abuze amangqina.
conduct.rights.from: The notice tells the learner they may be assisted by a fellow learner, present their case, and call and question witnesses.

conduct.notice.text: Ubuncinane iiyure ezi-{hours} ukususela ngoku. Isaziso esifutshane siyakhatywa: yeyona ntsilelo isibheno sinokuphumelela ngayo, nokuba umfundi wenze ntoni.
conduct.notice.from: At least {hours} hours from now. Short notice is refused: it is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

conduct.whyHint.text: Kutheni. Le yeyona ndima umfundi anelungelo kuyo.
conduct.whyHint.from: Why. This is the paragraph the learner is entitled to.

conduct.allegationHint.text: Oko kutyholwayo, ngokuthe ngqo. Umfundi akanakuphendula "isimilo esibi".
conduct.allegationHint.from: What is alleged, specifically. A learner cannot answer 'poor attitude'.

cohorts.intro.text: Iqela labantu elisebenza kunye ngenkqubo, ngokwecwangciso elinye. Umhla wokugqibela ngamnye ubanjwa njengenani leentsuku ukususela kumhla wokuqala, ngoko ukuwushukumisa umhla wokuqala kushukumisa yonke imihla yabo bonke abakuwo ngaxeshanye.
cohorts.intro.from: A group working through a programme together, on one schedule. Every deadline is held as a number of days from the start date, so moving an intake moves every date for everyone in it at once.

cohorts.none.text: {cohort}: liqela elisebenza kunye ngenkqubo epapashiweyo, {course}, ngokwecwangciso elinye. Yenza enye ngokuchasene ne-{course} yaye umhla wokugqibela ngamnye ubalwa ukususela kumhla wokuqala.
cohorts.none.from: A {cohort} is a group working through a published {course} together, on one schedule. Create one against a {course} and every deadline is measured from its start date.

cohorts.roster.from: Add a cohort from a spreadsheet

cohorts.rosterIntro.text: Funda ifayile ye-CSV okanye ye-Excel yabafundi uze ubadale bonke ngaxeshanye. Ikubonisa oko ikuqondileyo kwifayile ngaphambi kokuba kudalwe mntu, uze emva koko ubabhalise kwiqela elingasentla.
cohorts.rosterIntro.from: Read a CSV or Excel file of learners and create them all at once. It shows you what it made of the file before anybody is created, then enrol them onto a cohort above.

cohorts.noPublished.text: Akukabikho {courses} zipapashiweyo. {cohort} iqhutywa ngokuchasene ne-{course} epapashiweyo, ukuze izinto zokufunda zingatshintshi phantsi kweqela esele lisebenza kuzo.
cohorts.noPublished.from: There are no published {courses} yet. A {cohort} runs against a published {course}, so that the material cannot change under a group already working through it.

cohorts.startNote.text: Umhla wokugqibela ngamnye ubalwa ukususela kolu suku. Unokushukunyiswa kamva, kwaye yonke into ishukuma kunye nawo.
cohorts.startNote.from: Every deadline is counted from this day. It can be moved later, and everything moves with it.

cohort.paid.text: Kuhlawuliwe. Wonke umntu okweli qela ubalwa njengohlawuliweyo.
cohort.paid.from: Paid. Everybody on this cohort counts as paid for.

cohort.paidRef.text: Kuhlawuliwe · {reference}. Wonke umntu okweli qela ubalwa njengohlawuliweyo.
cohort.paidRef.from: Paid · {reference}. Everybody on this cohort counts as paid for.

cohort.invoiced.text: Kukhutshelwe iinkcukacha zentlawulo, kwaye akukabikho ntlawulo irekhodiweyo ngokuchasene nayo.
cohort.invoiced.from: Invoiced, and no payment recorded against it yet.

cohort.nothingRecorded.text: Akukho nto irekhodiweyo. Inkqubo yokubhaliswa iqala apha.
cohort.nothingRecorded.from: Nothing recorded. The enrolment procedure begins here.

cohort.moveIntro.text: Yonke imihla engezantsi ibanjwa njengenani leentsuku ukususela kuwo lo, ngoko ukuwutshintsha kushukumisa yonke inkqubo yokuqhutywa kwabo bonke abakweli qela.
cohort.moveIntro.from: Every date below is held as a number of days from this one, so changing it moves the whole rollout for everybody on the cohort.

cohort.waitingIntro.text: Umfundi ngamnye kanye, kwinyathelo lokuqala angakwaziyo ukulivula.
cohort.waitingIntro.from: Each learner once, at the earliest step they cannot open.

cohort.progress.from: Where the cohort has got to

cohort.progressIntro.text: Okuvuliweyo nokugqityiweyo ngenyathelo ngalinye, nexesha elithathwe ngabo bagqibileyo. Inani eliphakathi (median) kunelinganiselo eliqhelekileyo, ukuze umfundi omnye ozimele kwithemu yonke angafihli apho bonke abanye bakhoyo.
cohort.progressIntro.from: Opened and finished per step, and how long it took those who finished. The median rather than the average, so one learner who disappeared for a term does not hide where everybody else is.

cohort.stalledOne.from: One step has people sitting on it: {steps}.

cohort.stalledMany.from: {count} steps have people sitting on them: {steps}.

cohort.rolloutIntro.text: Iiseshoni ezinemihla ekudibana kuzo eli qela, nerejista ethathwa kwenye nenye. Apho inkqubo iphethe ikhredithi kufuneka iqhutywe ngumququzeleli, kwaye oku kubungqina bokuba kwakunjalo.
cohort.rolloutIntro.from: The dated sessions this cohort meets for, and the register taken at each. Where a programme carries credits it has to be facilitator-led, and this is the evidence that it was.

cohort.attendanceIntro.text: Okupheleleyo kuthelekiswa nenkqubo iphela; kuse ngoku kuthelekiswa noko kubanjwe ngokwenene. Ekuqaleni kwenkqubo owokuqala uphantsi kakhulu ungenamvuzo kwaye owesibini yiyo inyani, ngoko zombini ziyanikwa endaweni yokuba ukhethelwe enye.
cohort.attendanceIntro.from: Overall is against the whole programme; to date is against what has actually been held. Early in a programme the first is meaninglessly low and the second is the honest one, so both are given rather than one being chosen for you.

cohort.held.text: Iiseshoni ezibanjiweyo ezi-{held} kwezi-{countable}. Iiseshoni ezikhanselweyo nabo bangena ngokuzithandela abaqwalaselwa kuzo zombini.
cohort.held.from: {held} of {countable} sessions held. Cancelled sessions and voluntary walk-ins are left out of both.

cohort.feedbackIntro.text: Ithunyelwa emva kovavanyo lokugqibela, iphenduleke ngaphakathi kweeyure ezi-{hours}. Akukho mntu uqinisekisa ukwamkela kwaye akukho mntu ubhala kwakhona: ukwamkela sisiqhelo somqolo kwaye ingxelo yimibuzo.
cohort.feedbackIntro.from: Sent after a summative, answered within {hours} hours. Nobody acknowledges receipt and nobody transcribes anything: receipt is a row and the report is a query.

cohort.assessmentIntro.text: Umfundi ngamnye ngokuchasene nomsebenzi ngamnye ovavanyiweyo, ngokulandelelana kokuqokelelwa kwawo. Kufundwa kwiminikelo, izigqibo nakwiirejista endaweni yokugcinwa ngesandla, ngoko ayinakungahambelani nazo.
cohort.assessmentIntro.from: Every learner against every piece of assessed work, in the order it is collected. Read from submissions, decisions and registers rather than kept by hand, so it cannot disagree with them.

cohort.absentNote.text: Ukungabikho kufundwa kwirejista yeseshoni apho umsebenzi wabhalwa khona, hayi kwisiniketo, kuba umfundi ongazange abekho akanaso isiniketo apho angarekhodwa khona.
cohort.absentNote.from: Absent is read from the register of the sitting the work was written at, not from the submission, because a learner who did not attend has no submission for it to be recorded on.

cohort.workIntro.text: Oko kufuneka kwenzeke macala onke ekufundisweni: izinto zilungiselelwe, amaxwebhu anikezelwe, umhloli amiselwe, izatifikethi zilandelelwe.
cohort.workIntro.from: What has to happen around the teaching: material readied, documents submitted, a moderator appointed, certificates chased.

cohort.releaseIntro.text: Kubanjwa njengeentsuku ukususela ekuqaleni. Tshintsha umhla wokuqala yaye zonke ezi zishukuma kunye nawo.
cohort.releaseIntro.from: Held as days from the start. Change the start date and every one of these moves with it.

cohort.noSteps.from: This cohort's {course} has no steps yet.

cohort.membersIntro.text: Ukongeza umntu apha kumbhalisa nakwi-{course}. Igama kwirejista lomntu ongenakuvula nto lelona lizwe lisisiqingatha esikuphepheleyo oku.
cohort.membersIntro.from: Adding somebody here also enrols them on the {course}. A name on a register who cannot open anything is the half-state this avoids.

cohortCtl.noSteps.text: Ikhosi yeli qela ayinamanyathelo okwangoku, ngoko akukho nto yokuyicwangcisa.
cohortCtl.noSteps.from: This cohort's course has no steps yet, so there is nothing to schedule.

cohortCtl.dayZero.text: Usuku 0 ngumhla wokuqala. Shiya umqolo ungenanto yaye elo nyathelo alinamihla kwaphela; livulwa kwakamsinya nje ukuba kugqityiwe nantoni na engaphambi kwalo.
cohortCtl.dayZero.from: Day 0 is the start date. Leave a row empty and that step carries no dates at all; it opens as soon as whatever comes before it is done.

cohortCtl.everybody.text: Wonke umntu onee-akhawunti zabafundi sele ekweli qela. Mema abanye abantu kuqala kwiskrini sabaNtu.
cohortCtl.everybody.from: Everybody with a learner account is already on this cohort. Invite more people from the People screen first.

payment.referenceNote.from: So it can be matched to what finance holds.

tasks.progress.text: {done} kwezi-{counted} zenziwe: {percent}%. Umsebenzi ukhanselweyo awubalwa kuzo zombini iintlanganiso, ngoko ukushiya umsebenzi akuluncedi okanye akulonzakalisi inani.
tasks.progress.from: {done} of {counted} done: {percent}%. Cancelled work is left out of both halves, so abandoning a task neither helps nor hurts the figure.

rollout.nothing.text: Akukabikho nto icwangcisiweyo. Apho inkqubo iphethe ikhredithi kufuneka iqhutywe ngumququzeleli, ngoko apha kuqala ubungqina bokuba kwakunjalo.
rollout.nothing.from: Nothing scheduled yet. Where a programme carries credits it has to be facilitator-led, so this is where the evidence that it was begins.

rollout.announced.text: Iqela nomququzeleli baziswa ngeseshoni nganye iveki phambi kwayo, kunye nexesha nelinki yayo, baphinde baziswe ukuba iyashukunyiswa, iyakhanselwa okanye iyadlulisiwe.
rollout.announced.from: The cohort and the facilitator are told about each session a week before it, with its time and link, and told again if it is moved, cancelled or postponed.

archive.intro.text: Xa umfundi ephethe ingxelo yeziphumo zakhe nesatifikethi sekhwalifikheyishini sakhe esivela kumbutho ophumezayo sesirekhodwe kwiphepha lakhe lokulungela i-EISA, iPhotfoliyo yakhe yoBungqina inokushiya ipleyithifomu kwi-archive enye oyigcinayo. I-archive ivulwa kwibrawuza nayiphi na ngaphandle kwepleyithifomu. Akukho nto isuswayo de ikopi yakho egciniweyo ihlolwe ngokuchasene nayo, kwaye onke amarekhodi ahlala apha, esithi yi-archive ephi ephethe iifayile.
archive.intro.from: Once a learner holds their statement of results and their qualification certificate from the awarding body has been recorded on their EISA readiness page, their Portfolio of Evidence can leave the platform in one archive that you keep. The archive opens in any browser without the platform. Nothing is removed until your stored copy has been checked against it, and every record stays here, saying which archive holds the files.

archive.readyFor.text: Ephethe ingxelo yeziphumo nesatifikethi sekhwalifikheyishini sika-{qualification}.
archive.readyFor.from: Holding a statement of results and the qualification certificate for {qualification}.

archive.noQualification.text: Ikhosi yeli qela ayibaleli kwikhwalifikheyishini nayiphi na.
archive.noQualification.from: This cohort's course counts towards no qualification.

archive.anotherBuilding.text: Enye i-archive iyabhalwa. Qalisa elandelayo xa ugqibile.
archive.anotherBuilding.from: Another archive is being written. Start the next one when it has finished.

archive.notYetIntro.text: Bahlala kwipleyithifomu baze balandele kwi-archive elandelayo emva kokuba isatifikethi sabo sekhwalifikheyishini sesirekhodwe.
archive.notYetIntro.from: They stay on the platform and follow in a later archive once their own qualification certificate has been recorded.

archive.step1Note.text: Yigcine apho umgaqo-nkqubo wakho weerekhodi ubeka khona iirekhodi zabafundi, ixesha lonke lokugcinwa. Xa iifayile sezisusiwe, le yiyo yodwa ikopi epheleleyo.
archive.step1Note.from: Keep it where your records policy says learner records are kept, for the full retention period. Once the files are removed, this is the only complete copy.

archive.step3.from: 3. Remove the files from the platform

archive.building.from: Being written. This page updates by itself.

archive.checkNote.text: Khetha i-archive apho uyigcine khona. Ifundwa kule khompyuter kwaye ayilayishwa; kuthunyelwa kuphela iminwe yayo. I-archive ingama-byte angama-{bytes}.
archive.checkNote.from: Choose the archive from where you stored it. It is read on this computer and not uploaded; only its fingerprint is sent. The archive is {bytes} bytes.

archive.stored.text: Ikopi endiyihloliweyo igcinwe apho umgaqo-nkqubo weerekhodi zethu uthi kufuneka igcinwe khona.
archive.stored.from: The copy I checked is stored where our records policy says it should be kept.

archive.keepingOne.text: Uxwebhu olu-1 lokubhaliswa lusahlala kwipleyithifomu nalo, kuba enye inkqubo yomfundi isalufuna.
archive.keepingOne.from: 1 enrolment document stays on the platform as well, because another programme of the learner's still needs it.

archive.keeping.text: Amaxwebhu okubhaliswa ali-{count} asahlala kwipleyithifomu nawo, kuba enye inkqubo yomfundi isawafuna.
archive.keeping.from: {count} enrolment documents stay on the platform as well, because another programme of the learner's still needs them.

archive.wrongSize.text: Loo fayile ingama-byte angama-{size} kwaye i-archive ingama-{expected}. Ayiyiyo le archive.
archive.wrongSize.from: That file is {size} bytes and the archive is {expected}. It is not this archive.

archive.pieceRefused.from: A piece of the upload was refused.

archive.carryOn.text: {problem} Khetha ifayile kwakhona ukuze uqhubeke apho kumise khona.
archive.carryOn.from: {problem} Choose the file again to carry on from where it stopped.

archive.restoreNote.text: Kufuneka kuphela ukuba ezi fayile kufuneka zibe kwipleyithifomu kwakhona. I-archive iyalayishwa, ihlolwe ngokuchasene neminwe ethatyathwe xa yenziwa, kwaye ifayile nganye ibuyiselwa apho yayikhona.
archive.restoreNote.from: Only needed if these files have to be on the platform again. The archive is uploaded, checked against the fingerprint taken when it was made, and each file is put back where it was.

register.supervisedIntro.text: Ngubani owamkelweyo, oko avumelene nako, nokuba isiniketo sabo samkelwe. Intlanganiso ngokwayo iqhutyelwa apho intetho zakho ziqhutyelwa khona; oku kurekhodo lendlela ebukelwe ngayo.
register.supervisedIntro.from: Who was admitted, what they agreed to, and that their script was received. The meeting itself runs where your lectures do; this is the record of how it was supervised.

register.canInvigilate.text: Le yiseshoni yovavanyo lokugqibela, ngoko inokuba nomlindi wovavanyo.
register.canInvigilate.from: This is a summative session, so it can be invigilated.

register.intro.text: Ngubani owayekhona. Iimpawu ezigciniweyo zinokulungiswa kamva, kwaye utshintsho ngalunye lurekhodwa ngokuchasene nalowo walwenzileyo.
register.intro.from: Who was here. Saved marks can be corrected later, and every change is recorded against whoever made it.

register.nobody.text: Akukho mntu kweli qela okwangoku, ngoko akukho rejista yokuthathwa.
register.nobody.from: Nobody is on this cohort yet, so there is no register to take.

register.excusedNote.text: Ukuxolelwa kuthetha ukungabikho ngesizathu esamkelwe ngumboneleli. Kugcinwa ngokwahlukileyo kukungabikho okuqhelekileyo kuba inkqubo yenkxaso yabafundi ijikeleza ngomahluko.
register.excusedNote.from: Excused means absent for a reason the provider accepted. It is kept apart from a plain absence because the learner support procedure turns on the difference.

sitting.needsAssessment.text: Ukuhlala okubukeleweyo kufuna uvavanyo lokubukela. Papasha olunye kwikhosi kuqala, uze uyisete apha.
sitting.needsAssessment.from: A supervised sitting needs an assessment to supervise. Publish one on the course first, and it can be set up here.

sitting.nothing.text: Akukho nto ibukelwayo kule seshoni. Yiseta enye ukuba olu luvavanyo olunomlindi; likunika ixesha lokugqibela lokwamkelwa, isibhengezo, ukujongwa kwekhamera, irejista yeziniketo nelogi yeziganeko.
sitting.nothing.from: Nothing is being supervised at this session. Set one up if this is an invigilated assessment; it gives you an admission cut-off, a declaration, a camera check, a script register and an incident log.

sitting.invigilator.from: Invigilator (optional, and can be set on the day)

sitting.early.text: Abagqatswa bafika kwimizuzu engaka phambi kwexesha
sitting.early.from: Candidates arrive this many minutes early

sitting.closesAfter.text: Ukwamkelwa kuvalwa kwimizuzu engaka emva kokuqala
sitting.closesAfter.from: Admission closes this many minutes after the start

sitting.camera.text: Ikhamera kufuneka ivuliwe ngalo lonke ixesha
sitting.camera.from: A camera must be on throughout

sitting.materialsHint.text: Ikhalkyuleyitha engenakuprogramwa neshiti yefomula enikiweyo. Akukho nto ngaphandle koko.
sitting.materialsHint.from: A non-programmable calculator and the issued formula sheet. Nothing else.

sitting.declaration.text: Oko umgqatswa ngamnye avumelana nako phambi kokuqala (ukhetho)
sitting.declaration.from: What each candidate agrees to before starting (optional)

room.elsewhere.text: Oko ngu-{time} {zone} apho ukhoyo. Amaxesha arekhodwe apha ngawomboneleli, oko kugcinwa lirekhodi.
room.elsewhere.from: That is {time} {zone} where you are. Times recorded here are the provider's, which is what the record keeps.

room.arrive.text: Abagqatswa bafika kwimizuzu emi-{minutes} phambi kokuqala.

room.closesAt.text: Ukwamkelwa kuvalwa kwimizuzu emi-{minutes} emva kokuqala, ngo-{time}; emva koko ipleyithifomu iyala, kuba umntu owamkelwe emva kwexesha ube nexesha elide nephepha kunabanye bonke.
room.closesAt.from: Admission closes {minutes} minutes after the start, at {time}; after that the platform refuses, because somebody admitted late has had longer with the paper than everybody else.

room.closes.text: Ukwamkelwa kuvalwa kwimizuzu emi-{minutes} emva kokuqala; emva koko ipleyithifomu iyala, kuba umntu owamkelwe emva kwexesha ube nexesha elide nephepha kunabanye bonke.
room.closes.from: Admission closes {minutes} minutes after the start; after that the platform refuses, because somebody admitted late has had longer with the paper than everybody else.

room.cameras.text: Iikhamera zihlala zivuliwe ngalo lonke ixesha.

room.joinNote.text: Intlanganiso iqhutyelwa kwipleyithifomu oyisebenzisa sele. Oko kurekhodwe apha yindlela ebukelwe ngayo.
room.joinNote.from: The meeting runs on the platform you already use. What is recorded here is how it was supervised.

room.noLink.text: Akukho linki yentlanganiso kule seshoni okwangoku. Yongeza enye kwisicwangciso sokusasazwa ukuze abagqatswa bazi apho baya khona.
room.noLink.from: No meeting link on this session yet. Add one on the roll-out so candidates know where to go.

room.incidentsNote.text: Zifayilwa ngosuku. Ingxelo ebhalwe iiveki kamva ayibalulekanga kakhulu kwisibheno, apho kuphela indawo eyifundwa khona.
room.incidentsNote.from: Filed on the day. An account written weeks later is worth very little at an appeal, which is the only place it is ever read.

quals.intro.text: Ikhwalifikheyishini yomsebenzi iyanikezelwa kwiindidi ezintathu zeemodyuli: Ulwazi, Isakhono esisebenzayo, kunye Namava omsebenzi. Imodyuli nganye inemigangatho yayo yovavanyo, kwaye inkqubo iqinisekisa ukuba umxholo wekhosi ugubungela yonke ngaphambi kokuba ikhosi ipapashwe.
quals.intro.from: An occupational qualification is delivered across three kinds of module: Knowledge, Practical skill, and Workplace experience. Each module has its own assessment criteria, and the system checks that course content covers every one of them before a course can be published.

quals.folderTitle.from: Or build it from a folder

quals.folderIntro.text: Yonke into ngaxeshanye: ikharityhulam, iiyunithi zokufunda, izikhokelo nemigaqo-nkqubo. Ifolda equka isishwankathelo sayo iyangeniswa kwimizuzwana; enganaso kufuneka isakhiwo sayo sibonakaliswe, kwaye leyo yinxalenye efuna isandiso se-AI.
quals.folderIntro.from: Everything at once: the curriculum, the study units, the guides and the policies. A folder that includes a summary of itself imports in seconds; one that does not has to have its structure worked out, and that is the part that needs an AI extension.

quals.folderLabel.from: The qualification's folder, from your own computer

quals.folderHint.text: Yonke into kwifolda nakwiifolda zayo ezingaphantsi iyafundwa: ikharityhulam, iiyunithi zokufunda, izikhokelo nemigaqo-nkqubo.
quals.folderHint.from: Everything in the folder and its subfolders is read: the curriculum, the study units, the guides and the policies.

quals.folderHint2.text: Ifolda eyakhiwe yinkqubo yakho yophuhliso lwenkqubo iqulathe isishwankathelo sayo, kwaye leso sifundwa ngqo, kwimizuzwana. Ifolda engenaso ayinakuba nesakhiwo sayo sibonakaliswe okwangoku.
quals.folderHint2.from: A folder built by your programme development system includes a summary of itself, and that is read directly, in seconds. A folder without one cannot have its structure worked out yet.

quals.driveTitle.from: Or from a drive you have connected

quals.driveIntro.text: Ifolda enye, ifundwa apho sele ikhona. Iphela kwindawo enye: isiphakamiso sokujonga ngaphambi kokuba kubhalwe nantoni na.
quals.driveIntro.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

quals.noneManage.text: Yakhe enye kumaxwebhu ayo (ithebhu engentla): uxwebhu lwekharityhulam noxwebhu lwekhwalifikheyishini ziyanela, kwaye akukho sandiso se-AI esithatyathwayo. Yonke enye into kwipleyithifomu ixhomekeke kwikhwalifikheyishini, ngoko oku kokuqala ekufuneka ukwenze.
quals.noneManage.from: Build one from its documents (the tab above): the curriculum document and the qualification document are enough, and no AI extension is involved. Everything else on the platform hangs off a qualification, so this is the first thing to do.

quals.noneRead.text: Akukabikho eyalayishwayo. Xa enye ilayishiwe, ikharityhulam ofundisa ngayo kwaye uvavanya ngayo iya kuba apha: iimodyuli zayo, izihloko zayo nemigangatho ngamnye ivavanywa ngayo. Ukulayisha enye ngumsebenzi womlawuli.
quals.noneRead.from: None has been loaded yet. When one has been, the curriculum you teach and mark against will be here: its modules, its topics and the criteria each one is assessed by. Loading one is an administrator's job.

how.title.from: How would you like to add it?

how.intro.text: Iindlela ezintathu zokungena. Khetha enye yaye yona kuphela evulekayo; unokuyivala kwakhona uze ukhethe enye.
how.intro.from: Three ways in. Pick one and only that one opens; you can close it again and choose differently.

how.documents.summary.text: Uxwebhu lwekharityhulam, uxwebhu lwekhwalifikheyishini lwe-SAQA nenkcazelo yovavanyo. I-App ifunda yonke ikharityhulam kuzo.
how.documents.summary.from: The curriculum document, the SAQA qualification document and the assessment specification. The App reads the whole curriculum out of them.

how.documents.needs.text: Ii-PDF ezimbini okanye ezintathu okanye iifayile zeWord.
how.documents.needs.from: Two or three PDFs or Word files.

how.documents.speed.from: Seconds. No AI involved at any point.

how.folder.summary.text: Yonke into ngaxeshanye: ikharityhulam, iiyunithi zokufunda, izikhokelo, iincwadi zomsebenzi nemigaqo-nkqubo, zifayilwe njengoko zifundwa.
how.folder.summary.from: Everything at once: the curriculum, the study units, the guides, the workbooks and the policies, filed as they are read.

how.folder.needs.text: Yonke ifolda yekhwalifikheyishini, ukusuka kwikhompyuter okanye kwidrayivu.
how.folder.needs.from: The qualification's whole folder, from your computer or a drive.

how.folder.speed.text: Imizuzu. Ifolda equka isishwankathelo sayo ayifuni AI; enganaso isakhiwo sayo siyabonakaliswa, kwaye leyo nxalenye ifuna yona.
how.folder.speed.from: Minutes. A folder that includes a summary of itself needs no AI; one that does not has its structure worked out, and that part does.

how.blank.summary.text: Ikhwalifikheyishini engenanto oyakha ngesandla: isihloko, ikhowudi, inqanaba namakhredithi, emva koko iimodyuli zayo enye ngenye.
how.blank.summary.from: An empty qualification you build by hand: the title, the code, the level and credits, then its modules one at a time.

how.blank.needs.from: The details in front of you.

how.blank.speed.text: Ixesha elithatha. Akukho nto ifundelwa wena.
how.blank.speed.from: As long as it takes. Nothing is read for you.

manager.drawnFrom.from: drawn from {parent}, whose curriculum it shares

manager.standsAlone.from: standing on its own, with its own curriculum

manager.noneFromParent.from: No modules chosen from the parent's curriculum yet.

manager.choose.from: Choose which of the parent's modules this takes

manager.chooseNote.text: Iimodyuli ayongezwa apha. Le ithatha kwikharityhulam yomzali wayo, ngoko umsebenzi womfundi ngokuchasene nemodyuli ubalwa kanye naphi na apho ayidibana khona.
manager.chooseNote.from: Modules are not added here. This draws from its parent's curriculum, so a learner's work against a module counts once wherever they met it.

manager.whichNote.text: Uxwebhu lwe-SAQA lubonisa eyiphi. Khangela {field} kwiphepha lalo lokuqala.
manager.whichNote.from: The SAQA document says which. Look for {field} on its first page.

manager.standsOnOwn.from: Nothing: it stands on its own

manager.fullOwn.from: A full qualification carries its own curriculum.

manager.sharesNote.text: Yabelana ngekharityhulam yaloo khwalifikheyishini ithathe isiqingatha seemodyuli zayo; ukhetha ezi, xa sele ikhona.
manager.sharesNote.from: It shares that qualification's curriculum and takes a subset of its modules; you choose which, once it exists.

manager.codeFull.text: Njengoko ibhaliwe kuxwebhu lwekharityhulam. Ayiqikelelwa: yi-QCTO okanye i-OFO kuphela enokuthi yiyiphi.
manager.codeFull.from: As written on the curriculum document. Never worked out: only the QCTO or the OFO can say what it is.

manager.codePart.text: Ikhowudi enye neyekhwalifikheyishini ivela kuyo. Zabelana ngekharityhulam enye, ngoko zabelana ngekhowudi yayo.
manager.codePart.from: The same code as the qualification it comes from. They share one curriculum, so they share its code.

manager.accreditationNote.text: Inombolo apho le khwalifikheyishini ivunywe khona. Ileta enye yokuvunywa ihlala igubungela iikhwalifikheyishini ezininzi, ngoko oku akusoloko kuyinombolo enye neyomboneleli ngokwakhe. Ukuyishiya ingenanto kwenza ukuba iingxelo zisebenzise eyomboneleli zize zikuxele oko.
manager.accreditationNote.from: The number this qualification is accredited under. One accreditation letter usually covers several qualifications, so this is not always the same as the provider's own number. Leave it blank and reports fall back to the provider's and say so.

fromDoc.source.curriculum.note.from: The modules, topics and internal assessment criteria.

fromDoc.source.qualification.note.text: Isicatshulwa sokubhaliswa se-SAQA. Isona kuphela umthombo we-ID ye-SAQA neeZiphumo zeNqanaba lokuPhuma.
fromDoc.source.qualification.note.from: The SAQA registration extract. The only source of the SAQA ID and the Exit Level Outcomes.

fromDoc.source.assessmentSpecification.n.text: Inkcazelo ye-EISA. Ifayilwe yaza yatshixwa ukuze ikhangeleke.
fromDoc.source.assessmentSpecification.n.from: The EISA specification. Filed and indexed so it is searchable.

fromDoc.intro.text: Ezi zintathu zisiseko sokwakhiwa kwayo yonke enye into. Zilayishe kwaye i-App ifunda iinkcukacha zekhwalifikheyishini, iZiphumo zayo zeNqanaba lokuPhuma nekharityhulam yayo yonke kuzo. Jonga oko ikufumeneyo, lungisa nantoni na eyiphosileyo, kwaye ibhalwa ngexesha elinye.
fromDoc.intro.from: These three are the foundation everything else is built on. Upload them and the App reads the qualification's details, its Exit Level Outcomes and its whole curriculum out of them. Check what it found, correct anything it got wrong, and it is written in one go.

fromDoc.pressThis.text: Ngoku cofa oku. Akukabikho nto ibhaliweyo.
fromDoc.pressThis.from: Now press this. Nothing is written yet.

fromDoc.stillReading.text: Kusafundwa: imizuzwana eyi-{seconds}. Uxwebhu lwekharityhulam lude; oku kuqhelekile.
fromDoc.stillReading.from: Still reading: {seconds} seconds. A curriculum document is long; this is normal.

fromDoc.found.text: Zifundiwe iimodyuli ezi-{modules}, izihloko ezi-{topics}, imigca eyi-{elements} yokufundisa kunye nemigangatho yovavanyo eyi-{criteria}.
fromDoc.found.from: Read {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} assessment criteria.

fromDoc.foundWithElo.text: Zifundiwe iimodyuli ezi-{modules}, izihloko ezi-{topics}, imigca eyi-{elements} yokufundisa kunye nemigangatho yovavanyo eyi-{criteria}, kunye neeZiphumo zeNqanaba lokuPhuma ezi-{outcomes} ezinemigangatho ehambelanayo eyi-{associated}.
fromDoc.foundWithElo.from: Read {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} assessment criteria, plus {outcomes} Exit Level Outcomes with {associated} associated criteria.

fromDoc.partOf.text: Uxwebhu lwayo lubonisa ukuba le yi-{kind} ethathwe ku-{parent}. Akukho nto iza kukopishwa: yabelana ngekharityhulam yaloo khwalifikheyishini, kwaye ithatha iimodyuli zayo ezi-{count}.
fromDoc.partOf.from: Its document says this is a {kind} drawn from {parent}. Nothing will be copied: it shares that qualification's curriculum, and takes {count} of its modules.

fromDoc.alreadyWhy.text: Ukungenisa ikharityhulam kwakhona kuya kuyitshintsha leyo ikhoyo, kwaye nantoni na echongwe kumgangatho iya kuhamba nayo. Oko unokukufuna kukongeza oko kusilelayo (izinto zokufunda, okanye iinxalenye zekharityhulam ezingazange zifike), oko kwenziwa kwikhwalifikheyishini ngokwayo kwaye kushiya yonke into esele ikho ingachukumisiwe.
fromDoc.alreadyWhy.from: Importing the curriculum again would replace the one it has, and anything tagged to a criterion would go with it. What you probably want is to add what is missing (the material, or the parts of the curriculum that never made it), which is done on the qualification itself and leaves everything already there untouched.

fromDoc.openIt.from: Open it, and add what is missing

fromDoc.createPart.from: Create it, drawing on its parent's curriculum

fromDoc.filedPart.text: Uxwebhu lwayo lweKhwalifikheyishini lufayilwe ngokuchasene nayo. Uxwebhu lwekharityhulam nenkcazelo yovavanyo azifayilwanga: zezekhwalifikheyishini ivela kuyo, kwaye sele zifayilwe apho.
fromDoc.filedPart.from: Its own Qualification Document is filed against it. The curriculum document and the assessment specification are not: they belong to the qualification it comes from, and are already filed there.

fromDoc.filed.text: Onke amaxwebhu owanikezeleyo afayilwe ngokuchasene nekhwalifikheyishini, ukuze umhloli avule umthombo wawo nawuphi na umgangatho, kwaye ukuze isango lokulungela lanelise phambi kokuba izinto zibhalwe.
fromDoc.filed.from: Every document you supplied is filed against the qualification, so a moderator can open the source of any criterion, and so the readiness gate is satisfied before material is authored.

qualPage.step.curriculumDone.text: Iimodyuli ezi-{modules}, imigangatho yovavanyo eyi-{criteria}, ezifundwe kumaxwebhu ekhwalifikheyishini ngokwayo.
qualPage.step.curriculumDone.from: {modules} modules, {criteria} assessment criteria, read from the qualification's own documents.

qualPage.step.curriculumTodo.text: Akukho nto apha enokufundiswa okanye ivavanywe de kubekho iimodyuli zayo.
qualPage.step.curriculumTodo.from: Nothing here can be taught or assessed until its modules exist.

qualPage.step.unitsDone.text: Iiyunithi ezi-{count}, ngemodyuli nganye ibekwe kwenye.
qualPage.step.unitsDone.from: {count} units, with every module placed in one.

qualPage.step.unitsNone.text: Ikharityhulam ipapasha iimodyuli kwaye ayithethi nto ngendlela ozihlanganisa ngayo, ngoko oku kokwakho ukumisela. Uxwebhu lwakho lokulinganisa lukwenza oku ngokulayisha kanye: iWord okanye i-Excel.
qualPage.step.unitsNone.from: The curriculum publishes modules and says nothing about how you group them, so this is yours to decide. Your alignment document does it in one upload: Word or Excel.

qualPage.step.unitsSomeOne.text: Imodyuli e-1 ayikho kwiyunithi nayiphi na okwangoku. Imodyuli enganiki yiyunithi yokufunda yimodyuli engafundiswa ngumntu.
qualPage.step.unitsSomeOne.from: 1 module belongs to no unit yet. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches.

qualPage.step.unitsSome.text: Iimodyuli ezi-{count} azikho kwiyunithi nayiphi na okwangoku. Imodyuli enganiki yiyunithi yokufunda yimodyuli engafundiswa ngumntu.
qualPage.step.unitsSome.from: {count} modules belong to no unit yet. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches.

qualPage.step.materialDone.text: Izikhokelo zengcaciso, iincwadi zomsebenzi novavanyo olufayilwe olu-{count}.
qualPage.step.materialDone.from: {count} theory guides, workbooks and assessments filed.

qualPage.step.materialTodo.text: Izikhokelo zengcaciso, iincwadi zomsebenzi novavanyo. Yonke ifolda ingena ngaxeshanye, izikhokelo zeempendulo ziyaziwa kwaye zifihlwa abafundi, kwaye akukho AI kwaphela.
qualPage.step.materialTodo.from: The theory guides, workbooks and assessments. The whole folder goes in at once, answer guides are recognised and withheld from learners, and no AI is involved at any point.

qualPage.step.captureDone.text: Zonke ezi-{count} zithathiwe. Abafundi banokuziphendula kwiskrini.
qualPage.step.captureDone.from: All {count} captured. Learners can answer them on screen.

qualPage.step.captureTodo.text: {captured} kwezi-{total} zithathiwe. Ezisele ziifayile umfundi anokuzikhuphela kuphela.
qualPage.step.captureTodo.from: {captured} of {total} captured. The rest are files a learner can only download.

qualPage.summary.text: iimodyuli ezi-{modules} · imigangatho yovavanyo lwangaphakathi eyi-{criteria} · {weighting}

qualPage.weighted.from: weighted {k}/{p}/{w} as stated in the document

qualPage.notWeighted.text: akukho linganiselo lwamalungu lubonisiweyo; ukulungela kulufumana kumakhredithi
qualPage.notWeighted.from: no component weighting stated; readiness derives it from credits

qualPage.partOf.text: Ikhwalifikheyishini eyinxalenye ethathwe ku-{parent}, esabelana ngekharityhulam yayo. Akukho nto ikopishiweyo, ngoko umsebenzi womfundi ngokuchasene nemodyuli ubalwa kanye naphi na apho ayidibana khona.
qualPage.partOf.from: A part qualification drawn from {parent}, whose curriculum it shares. Nothing is copied, so a learner's work against a module counts once wherever they met it.

qualPage.addIntro.text: Yonke into efaka enye into. Oko sele kukho apha kuse kwithebhu enye.
qualPage.addIntro.from: Everything that puts something in. What is already here is on the other tab.

qualPage.finish.from: Finish this qualification from a fuller folder

qualPage.finishLabel.text: Ifolda epheleleyo yale khwalifikheyishini, ukusuka kwikhompyuter yakho
qualPage.finishLabel.from: The completed folder for this qualification, from your own computer

qualPage.finishHint.text: Ngekhwalifikheyishini eyalayishwa phambi kokuba amaxwebhu ayo aphelele. Yonke ifolda iyafundwa kwakhona (ikharityhulam kunye nezinto zokufunda) kwaye kongezwa kuphela oko kusilelayo.
qualPage.finishHint.from: For a qualification that was loaded before its documents were complete. The whole folder is read again (the curriculum as well as the material) and only what is missing is added.

qualPage.finishHint2.text: Akukho nto sele ikho apha etshintshwayo okanye eshenxiswayo, kude kufike kwigama lomgangatho omnye, kwaye ukuyiqhuba kabini akwenzi nto okwesibini. Usabona yonke into eyifumeneyo uze uyiqinisekise phambi kokuba nayiphi na kuyo ibhalwe.
qualPage.finishHint2.from: Nothing already here is changed or replaced, down to the wording of a single criterion, and running it twice does nothing the second time. You still see everything it found and confirm it before any of it is written.

qualPage.finishDrive.text: Okanye ifolda epheleleyo ukusuka kwidrayivu oyiqhagamshelileyo. Igqibezela ngendlela enye: kongezwa kuphela oko kusilelayo.
qualPage.finishDrive.from: Or the completed folder from a drive you have connected. It tops up the same way: only what is missing is added.

qualPage.materialHere.text: Izinto zokufunda ziya apha: yonke ifolda ngaxeshanye. Akukho nto igcinwayo de ubone oko kufunyenweyo.
