qualPage.materialHere.from: The material goes here: the whole folder at once. Nothing is saved until you have seen what it found.

qualPage.materialLabel.text: Ifolda yezinto zokufunda, ukusuka kwikhompyuter yakho
qualPage.materialLabel.from: A folder of material, from your own computer

qualPage.materialHint.text: Izikhokelo zengcaciso neencwadi zomsebenzi ziya kwiyunithi yokufunda echazwa ligama lefayile yazo, imigaqo-nkqubo neenkontraka ziye kwithala lamaxwebhu, yonke enye into iye ngokuchasene nale khwalifikheyishini. Akusetyenziswa AI kwaphela apha: ukulungelelanisa amaxwebhu ngegama ngumthetho hayi isigwebo.
qualPage.materialHint.from: Theory guides and workbooks go to the study unit their filename names, policies and contracts to the document library, and everything else against this qualification. No AI is used here at all: sorting documents by name is a rule rather than a judgement.

qualPage.whereItLives.from: Or the folder where it already lives

qualPage.alignmentHere.text: Uxwebhu lwakho lokulinganisa luya apha: lukhethe, useke uhlobo lwalo lube yiMatriki yokuLinganisa ikharityhulam, uze ulayishe. Oko kwakha iiyunithi zokufunda.
qualPage.alignmentHere.from: Your alignment document goes here: choose it, set its kind to Curriculum Alignment Matrix, and upload. That builds the study units.

qualPage.blueprintIntro.text: Ifayile echaza le kharityhulam ngqo: iimodyuli ezi-{count}, ezinezihloko zazo, oko nganye ifundisa nokuba ivavanywa ngantoni. Yifake kwifolda ye-{folder} yefolda yekhwalifikheyishini yaye yonke ingeniso yaloo folda emva koko iyifunda ngqo, kwimizuzwana, ngaphandle kwesandiso se-AI kwaphela.
qualPage.blueprintIntro.from: A file describing this curriculum exactly: {count} modules, with their topics, what each teaches and what each is assessed by. Put it in the qualification folder's {folder} directory and every import of that folder afterwards reads it straight off, in seconds, with no AI extension involved at any point.

qualPage.notCarried.from: What the file does not carry

qualPage.notCaptured.from: {count} of {total} modules have no criteria yet.

qualPage.notCapturedWhy.text: Akukho mntu unokubhengezwa elungele i-EISA ngokuchasene nale khwalifikheyishini de uxwebhu lonke lwekharityhulam lubhalwe; imodyuli engenamigangatho ayinakusilela, ngoko ukuyishiya ingenanto kwenza ukuba wonke umfundi abonakale egqibile.
qualPage.notCapturedWhy.from: Nobody can be declared ready for the EISA against this qualification until the whole curriculum document has been transcribed; a module with no criteria cannot be failed, so leaving them empty would make every learner look finished.

qualPage.structureIntro.text: Ikharityhulam ipapasha iimodyuli; umboneleli ufundisa iiyunithi zokufunda. Nganye idibanisa iimodyuli zoLwazi, zeZakhono ezisebenzayo nezaMava omsebenzi ezisebenzela iSiphumo esinye seNqanaba lokuPhuma, oko kumiselwa kuko uVavanyo oluSekwe ngokuHlangeneyo lwaNgaphandle. Ababoneleli ababini banokudibanisa ikhwalifikheyishini enye ngokwahlukileyo kwaye bobabini babe phakathi, ngoko esi sisakhiwo somboneleli hayi esekharityhulam.
qualPage.structureIntro.from: The curriculum publishes modules; a provider teaches study units. Each bundles the Knowledge, Practical and Work Experience modules that serve one Exit Level Outcome, which is what the External Integrated Summative Assessment is set against. Two providers may group the same qualification differently and both be correct, so this is the provider's structure rather than the curriculum's.

qualPage.seeAsLearner.from: See it as a learner will

qualPage.seeAsLearnerNote.text: ibonisa yonke inkqubo ngokulandelelana kokuhamba kwayo, ngayo nayiphi na into umfundi angayifumaniyo ixelwe ngegama. Akukho nto iqaliweyo kwaye akukho nto irekhodiweyo.
qualPage.seeAsLearnerNote.from: shows the whole programme in the order it is walked, with anything a learner would not find named. Nothing is started and nothing is recorded.

qualPage.nextStep.text: Inyathelo elilandelayo: dibanisa ezi modyuli zibe ziiyunithi zokufunda.
qualPage.nextStep.from: The next step: group these modules into study units.

qualPage.nextStepWhy.text: Ikharityhulam ipapasha iimodyuli kwaye ayithethi nto ngeeyunithi zokufunda, kuba ukuzidibanisa sisigqibo somboneleli ngokwakhe, ngoko ikhwalifikheyishini efundwe kumaxwebhu ayo ifika neemodyuli zayo zonke ezi-{count} zingabekwanga. Oko kuyalindeleka, hayi ukusilela kokungenisa.
qualPage.nextStepWhy.from: The curriculum publishes modules and says nothing about study units, because grouping them is the provider's own decision, so a qualification read from its documents arrives with all {count} of its modules unplaced. That is expected, not a fault in the import.

qualPage.nextStepHow.text: Layisha uxwebhu lwakho lokulinganisa: leso sifaka iSiphumo seNqanaba lokuPhuma ngasinye kwiimodyuli zaso, kwiWord okanye kwi-Excel. Senza iiyunithi zokufunda, sizibiza ngamagama, size sibeke yonke imodyuli esigubungela.
qualPage.nextStepHow.from: Upload your alignment document: the one mapping each Exit Level Outcome to its modules, in Word or Excel. It creates the study units, names them, and places every module it covers.

qualPage.unplacedOne.text: Imodyuli e-1 ayikho kwiyunithi yokufunda nayiphi na.
qualPage.unplacedOne.from: 1 module belongs to no study unit.

qualPage.unplaced.text: Iimodyuli ezi-{count} azikho kwiyunithi yokufunda nayiphi na.
qualPage.unplaced.from: {count} modules belong to no study unit.

qualPage.unplacedWhy.text: {modules}. Imodyuli enganiki yiyunithi yokufunda yimodyuli engafundiswa ngumntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuba ikharityhulam yayo ithathwe ngokupheleleyo kangakanani.
qualPage.unplacedWhy.from: {modules}. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches, however completely its curriculum has been captured.

qualPage.noElo.from: Aligned to no Exit Level Outcome

qualPage.eisaTests.text: Imigangatho yovavanyo ehambelanayo: oko i-EISA iyivavanya
qualPage.eisaTests.from: Associated assessment criteria: what the EISA tests

qualPage.noModules.from: This study unit delivers no modules.

qualPage.documentsIntro.text: Ezifayilwe apha ziikopi ezigunyazisiweyo: amaxwebhu omthombo ekwakhiwe ngawo le khwalifikheyishini, nganye ncamathiselwe kwinxalenye yekharityhulam eyisebenzelayo yaye ithatyathwe iminwe ukuze kungqineke ukuba ayitshintshanga.
qualPage.documentsIntro.from: Filed here are the authoritative copies: the source documents this qualification is built from, each attached to the part of the curriculum it serves and hashed so it can be proved unchanged.

qualPage.recordNotThing.text: Incwadi yomsebenzi okanye uvavanyo olufayilwe apha lurekhodi, hayi into umfundi asebenza kuyo.
qualPage.recordNotThing.from: A workbook or an assessment filed here is a record, not the thing a learner works on.

qualPage.recordWhy.text: Ezo zifundwa zaze zibonakaliswe kwiskrini, ukuze umfundi aphendule kwipleyithifomu kwaye umququzeleli ahlole aze aphawule apho. Layisha uxwebhu lweWord phantsi kwe-Thatha kunokuba lube apha, kwaye ziba yimibuzo ngokwayo. Iincwadana, izikhokelo namashiti okusayina emsebenzini ahlukile: ahlala njengamaxwebhu, kuba umququzeleli uwaphawula umqeqeshi awasayine ephepheni.
qualPage.recordWhy.from: Those are read in and presented on screen, so a learner answers in the platform and a facilitator marks and comments there. Upload the Word document under Capture rather than here, and it becomes the questions themselves. Handbooks, guides and workplace sign-off sheets are different: they stay as documents, because a facilitator annotates them and a coach signs them on paper.

qualPage.notTranscribed.from: Not yet transcribed from the curriculum document.

qualPage.iac.text: Imigangatho yovavanyo lwangaphakathi: oko kufuneka kuphunyezwe
qualPage.iac.from: Internal assessment criteria: what must be achieved

qualPage.workplaceNone.text: Akukho migangatho yovavanyo, oku kulungile kumava omsebenzi: ungqinwa lirekhodi elisayiniweyo lomsebenzi hayi ngokugwetywa ngokuchasene nemigangatho.
qualPage.workplaceNone.from: No assessment criteria, which is right for work experience: it is proved by a signed record of the work rather than judged against criteria.

qualPage.neverAchieved.text: Akukho migangatho yovavanyo, ngoko esi sihloko asinakuze siphunyezwe.
qualPage.neverAchieved.from: No assessment criteria, so this topic can never be achieved.

removeQual.cannotWhy.text: Kukho izinto ezirekhodwe ngokuchasene nayo, kwaye ipleyithifomu iyazigcina. Zizo ezibuzwa kuphicotho lwe-QCTO, kwaye ziphila ngaphezu kwekhwalifikheyishini ezarekhodwa phantsi kwayo.
removeQual.cannotWhy.from: Things have been recorded against it, and the platform keeps them. They are what a QCTO audit asks about, and they outlive the qualification they were recorded under.

removeQual.canWhy.text: Akukho nto irekhodwe ngokuchasene nayo (akukho mfundi ubhalisiweyo, akukho kuhlala kubhalisiweyo kwaye akukho Ngxelo yeziPhumo ekhutshiweyo) ngoko inokususwa. Oku akunakuphindwa.
removeQual.canWhy.from: Nothing has been recorded against it (no learner is enrolled, no sitting is registered and no Statement of Results has been issued) so it can be removed. This cannot be undone.

removeQual.wouldTake.text: Ingahamba no-{items}, kunye nesihloko, into yesihloko, umgangatho nefayile yonke efayilwe phantsi kwazo.
removeQual.wouldTake.from: It would take {items} with it, along with every topic, element, criterion and filed document beneath them.

captureList.intro.text: Ezi sele zikwipleyithifomu. Ukuthatha enye kufunda imibuzo yayo kwifayile yeWord yaye kubhanqa isikhokelo seempendulo esifayilwe ecaleni kwayo; akukho nto ilayishwa kwakhona. Oko iyiphakamisayo ibonakaliswa kuwe phambi kokuba nayiphi na kuyo ibe luvavanyo.
captureList.intro.from: These are already in the platform. Capturing one reads its questions out of the Word file and pairs the answer guide filed beside it; nothing is uploaded again. What it proposes is shown to you before any of it becomes an assessment.

captureList.all.text: Zonke ezi-{count} zithathiwe. Abafundi banokuphendula ezi kwiskrini.
captureList.all.from: All {count} captured. Learners can answer these on screen.

captureList.noGuide.text: akukho sikhokelo seempendulo esifayilwe: umbuzo ngamnye ufuna impendulo namanqaku awo ngesandla
captureList.noGuide.from: no answer guide filed: every question would need its answer and marks by hand

uploader.kindNote.text: Imatriki yokulinganisa ikharityhulam ifundwa kwaye igcinwe: oko ikuthethayo ngomgca ngamnye wekharityhulam kurekhodwa.
uploader.kindNote.from: A curriculum alignment matrix is read as well as stored: what it says about each curriculum line is recorded.

uploader.titleHint.text: Ukuba ishiywe ingenanto, kusetyenziswa igama lefayile
uploader.titleHint.from: Left blank, the file name is used

uploader.versionNote.text: Ukulayisha kwakhona ngohlobo nesihloko esifanayo kubeka indawo yangaphambili kunokuba iyitshintshe; uguqulelo lwakudala luyahlala.
uploader.versionNote.from: Uploading again with the same kind and title supersedes the previous one rather than replacing it; the old version stays.

uploader.fileNote.text: IWord, i-Excel, iPowerPoint ne-PDF. Oko ifayile injalo ngokwenyani kuvela kwiziqulatho zayo, hayi igama layo.
uploader.fileNote.from: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF. What the file actually is comes from its contents, not its name.

uploader.inMatrix.from: In the matrix, not in the curriculum as held

uploader.inMatrixNote.text: Nganye yongezwa iphawulwe njengeyakho, isizathu sibonisiwe, ukuze umqinisekisi akwazi ngalo lonke ixesha ukwahlula imigca yakho neyomlawuli womthetho. Susa uphawu kuyo nayiphi na engafanele ukongezwa.
uploader.inMatrixNote.from: Each is added marked as your own, with the reason shown, so a verifier can always tell your lines from the regulator's. Untick anything that should not be added.

uploader.add.from: Add the ticked lines to the curriculum

buildCurr.intro.text: Yifake njengoko uxwebhu lwekharityhulam luyiprinta, ngeekhowudi ezifanayo ngokulandelelana okufanayo, ukuze zombini zifundwe ecaleni kwenye. Umgca ngamnye ugcinwa njengoko uwufaka.
buildCurr.intro.from: Enter it as the curriculum document prints it, with the same codes in the same order, so the two can be read side by side. Every line saves as you enter it.

buildCurr.ready.text: Ilungele izinto zokufunda. Iimodyuli ezi-{modules} nemigangatho eyi-{criteria} ingenile, ngoko umbuzo unokuphawulwa ngoko ubungqina bawo.
buildCurr.ready.from: Ready for material. {modules} modules and {criteria} criteria are in, so a question can be tagged to what it evidences.

buildCurr.whatItIsNote.text: Isetwa xa ingeniswa, kwaye ingalungiswa apha. Ikhwalifikheyishini epheleleyo inekharityhulam yayo; inxalenye okanye inkqubo yezakhono ikhetha iimodyuli kwenye.
buildCurr.whatItIsNote.from: Set when it was imported, and correctable here. A full qualification has its own curriculum; a part or a skills programme selects modules from one.

buildCurr.faultsNote.text: Ayisosango: unokuhamba ubuye kamva. Nangona kunjalo, nganye kwezi yinto engenako ukujikelezwa yipleyithifomu kamva.
buildCurr.faultsNote.from: Not a gate: you can leave and come back. Each of these, though, is something the platform cannot work around later.

addModule.note.text: Imodyuli yamava omsebenzi ingqinwa yincwadi yelogi esayinwa ngumqeqeshi, kungekhona yimigangatho yovavanyo, ngoko ithatha imisebenzi yasemsebenzini.
addModule.note.from: A work experience module is evidenced by a logbook a coach signs, not by assessment criteria, so it takes work activities instead.

addModule.nameHint.from: As the curriculum document titles it

editor.addElement.from: Add a line of what must be taught

editor.wordedHint.from: As the curriculum document words it

editor.noCriteria.text: Imodyuli yamava omsebenzi ayinayo nanye. Ingqinwa yincwadi yelogi esayinwa ngumqeqeshi yaye yamkelwa ngumvavanyi, ngoko imisebenzi yayo yasemsebenzini ifakwa kwizihloko ezingentla.
editor.noCriteria.from: A work experience module carries none. It is evidenced by a logbook the coach signs and an assessor accepts, so its work activities go in the topics above.

reclassify.lockedOne.text: Ayinakutshintshwa: umfundi o-1 ubhalisiwe kuyo. Ubhaliso lwenziwa ngokwe-ID yenkqubo, kwaye ukutshintsha ukuba le yintoni kwakuguqula iimodyuli avavanywa ngazo, kwaye ngoko oko kufuneka akwenze ukuze agqibe. Ukuba inene ayilolo hlobo lufanelekileyo, yenza olufanelekileyo umbhalise kulo.
reclassify.lockedOne.from: It cannot be changed: 1 learner is enrolled on it. Enrolment is per programme ID, and changing what this is would change which modules they are assessed against, and so what they have to do to finish. If it is genuinely the wrong sort of thing, create the right one and enrol them onto that.

reclassify.locked.text: Ayinakutshintshwa: abafundi aba-{count} babhalisiwe kuyo. Ubhaliso lwenziwa ngokwe-ID yenkqubo, kwaye ukutshintsha ukuba le yintoni kwakuguqula iimodyuli abavavanywa ngazo, kwaye ngoko oko kufuneka bakwenze ukuze bagqibe. Ukuba inene ayilolo hlobo lufanelekileyo, yenza olufanelekileyo ubabhalise kulo.
reclassify.locked.from: It cannot be changed: {count} learners are enrolled on it. Enrolment is per programme ID, and changing what this is would change which modules they are assessed against, and so what they have to do to finish. If it is genuinely the wrong sort of thing, create the right one and enrol them onto that.

reclassify.parentNote.text: Inxalenye ayinaxwebhu lwayo lwekharityhulam: isebenzisa olomzali wayo, ikhethe iimodyuli kulo.
reclassify.parentNote.from: A part has no curriculum document of its own: it uses its parent's, and selects modules from it.

reclassify.ownModulesOne.text: Le khwalifikheyishini inemodyuli e-1 yekharityhulam yayo, ukususela ekungeniseni kwayo. Ihlala apho ikhoyo: ukuyirekhoda njengenxalenye akuyisusi, kwaye ukhetha ngokwahlukileyo ukuba zeziphi iimodyuli zomzali ezikhethwa yiyo.
reclassify.ownModulesOne.from: This qualification has 1 module of its own curriculum, from when it was imported. It stays where it is: recording it as a part does not delete it, and you choose separately which of the parent's modules it selects.

reclassify.ownModules.text: Le khwalifikheyishini ineemodyuli ezi-{count} zekharityhulam yayo, ukususela ekungeniseni kwayo. Ihlala apho zikhoyo: ukuyirekhoda njengenxalenye akuzisusi, kwaye ukhetha ngokwahlukileyo ukuba zeziphi iimodyuli zomzali ezikhethwa yiyo.
reclassify.ownModules.from: This qualification has {count} modules of its own curriculum, from when it was imported. Those stay where they are: recording it as a part does not delete them, and you choose separately which of the parent's modules it selects.

reclassify.selectedOne.text: Imodyuli e-1 ekhethwe kumzali wayo iya kucinywa. Ikhwalifikheyishini epheleleyo ayikhethi nto kubani na, kwaye ukuyishiya kwakuyenza ihlale ibalwa kumakhredithi ayo.
reclassify.selectedOne.from: The 1 module selected from its parent will be cleared. A full qualification selects nothing from anybody, and leaving it would keep it counting towards its credits.

reclassify.selected.text: Iimodyuli ezi-{count} ezikhethwe kumzali wayo ziya kucinywa. Ikhwalifikheyishini epheleleyo ayikhethi nto kubani na, kwaye ukuzishiya kwakuzenza zihlale zibalwa kumakhredithi ayo.
reclassify.selected.from: The {count} modules selected from its parent will be cleared. A full qualification selects nothing from anybody, and leaving them would keep them counting towards its credits.

takeDoc.readFrom.text: Ifundwe kwi-{file}. Akukabikho nto ingezantsi eyongeziweyo: vula imodyuli, uyijonge ngokuchasene noxwebhu, uze uyithathe ukuba ichanekile.
takeDoc.readFrom.from: Read from {file}. Nothing below has been added yet: open a module, check it against the document, and take it if it is right.

takeDoc.goToDocuments.from: Go to the documents for this qualification

takeDoc.notesNote.text: Oko ukufunda kungakwazanga ukukuchaza, nalapho uxwebhu ngokwalo lungahambisani. Akukho namnye kuzo okuthintelayo ekuthatheni imodyuli, kodwa zombini kufanelekile ukuba zifundwe kuqala.
takeDoc.notesNote.from: What the reading could not account for, and what the document itself does not add up. Neither stops you taking a module, though both are worth reading first.

takeDoc.addedCounts.text: Kongezwe izihloko ezi-{topics}, imigca eyi-{elements} yokufundisa nemigangatho emi-{criteria}.
takeDoc.addedCounts.from: Added {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} criteria.

takeDoc.byHand.from: Add these by hand on the curriculum screen.

takeDoc.empty.text: Akukho nto ifundiweyo phantsi kwale modyuli. Ukuyithatha kuya kudala imodyuli yodwa, kwaye izihloko zayo zingongezwa ngesandla.
takeDoc.empty.from: Nothing was read under this module. Taking it will create the module alone, and its topics can be added by hand.

element.asWorded.text: {kind}, kanye njengoko uxwebhu lwekharityhulam lulubhale ngako. Akukho nto kweli phepha inokuhlelwa apha: ikharityhulam epapashiweyo yeye-QCTO, hayi yomboneleli.
element.asWorded.from: {kind}, exactly as the curriculum document words it. Nothing on this page may be edited here: a published curriculum is the QCTO's, not the provider's.

element.coversNote.text: Kuvela kwiMatriki Yolungelelaniso Lwekharityhulam, njengoko umboneleli wayibhala apho.
element.coversNote.from: From the Curriculum Alignment Matrix, as the provider wrote it there.

element.uncovered.text: Akukho nto irekhodwe njengeyigubungelayo lo mgca.
element.uncovered.from: Nothing is recorded as covering this line.

element.uncoveredNote.text: Oko kungaba likhefu langempela kwinkqubo okanye imatriki engekalayishwa. Layisha iMatriki Yolungelelaniso Lwekharityhulam ngokuchasene nale khwalifikheyishini yaye yonke imigca ayibizayo iyazaliswa kwangoko.
element.uncoveredNote.from: That is either a real gap in the programme or a matrix that has not been uploaded yet. Upload the Curriculum Alignment Matrix against this qualification and every line it names is filled in at once.

element.notHeld.text: ibizwe kwimatriki, kodwa akukho xwebhu lubanjelwe apha elinelo gama.
element.notHeld.from: named in the matrix, but no document held here has that name.

element.assessedNote.text: Imigangatho yovavanyo lwangaphakathi yesihloko esingumgca lo.
element.assessedNote.from: The internal assessment criteria of the topic this line belongs to.

element.workplace.text: Imodyuli yamava omsebenzi ayinayo imigangatho yovavanyo. Oko iyifunayo kungqinwa yirekhodi esayiniweyo yomsebenzi ngokwawo, eyamkelwa ngumvavanyi, kunokuba kugwetywe ngokwemigangatho.
element.workplace.from: A work experience module has no assessment criteria. What it requires is evidenced by a signed record of the work itself, accepted by an assessor, rather than judged against criteria.

element.noCriteria.text: Esi sihloko asinayo imigangatho yovavanyo, ngoko akukho nto apha enokuze iphunyezwe. Kude kube ithathwa kuxwebhu lwekharityhulam, akukho mfundi unokugqiba le modyuli.
element.noCriteria.from: This topic has no assessment criteria, so nothing here can ever be achieved. Until they are captured from the curriculum document, no learner can complete this module.

element.taughtNote.text: Iiyunithi zokufunda apho le modyuli ifundiswa khona.
element.taughtNote.from: The study units this module is delivered in.

partModules.introPart.text: Le khwalifikheyishini yenxalenye ithathwe kwi-{parent} yaye yabelana ngekharityhulam yayo{code}. Khetha iimodyuli ezidweliswe kuxwebhu lwayo lwe-SAQA phantsi kwe-{rules}. Akukho nto ikopishwayo: umsebenzi womfundi ngokuchasene nemodyuli ubalwa kanye, naphi apho ayifumana khona.
partModules.introPart.from: This part qualification is drawn from {parent} and shares its curriculum{code}. Tick the modules its own SAQA document lists under {rules}. Nothing is copied: a learner's work against a module counts once, wherever they met it.

partModules.introOther.text: Le nkqubo ithathwe kwi-{parent} yaye yabelana ngekharityhulam yayo{code}. Khetha iimodyuli ezidweliswe kuxwebhu lwayo lwe-SAQA phantsi kwe-{rules}. Akukho nto ikopishwayo: umsebenzi womfundi ngokuchasene nemodyuli ubalwa kanye, naphi apho ayifumana khona.
partModules.introOther.from: This programme is drawn from {parent} and shares its curriculum{code}. Tick the modules its own SAQA document lists under {rules}. Nothing is copied: a learner's work against a module counts once, wherever they met it.

partModules.notRead.from: The parent's curriculum has not been read in yet

partModules.notReadNote.text: Akukho nto yokukhetha de i-{parent} ifundwe uxwebhu lwayo lwekharityhulam. Yenza oko kuqala, uze lo mbalo uzizalise.
partModules.notReadNote.from: There is nothing to choose from until {parent} has its curriculum document read in. Do that first, and this list fills itself.

partModules.noClaim.text: Akukho mlinganiselo wamakhredithi orekhodiweyo kwale khwalifikheyishini, ngoko akukho nto yokujonga ngokuchasene nayo. Uxwebhu lwayo lwe-SAQA lubonisa omnye phantsi kwe-Minimum Credits.
partModules.noClaim.from: No credit total is recorded for this qualification, so there is nothing to check against. Its SAQA document states one under Minimum Credits.

partModules.agree.text: Ezi ziyavumelana, oko kuyimpawu yokuba iimodyuli ezifanelekileyo zikhethiwe.
partModules.agree.from: These agree, which is the sign the right modules are ticked.

partModules.disagree.text: Ezi azivumelani. Mhlawumbi kukhethwe imodyuli ekungadwelisiwe kuxwebhu lwe-SAQA, okanye kusilele enye edweliswe apho, okanye amakhredithi emodyuli afundwe ngempazamo. Kufanelekile ukujonga phambi kokugcina; kodwa ipleyithifomu iya kugcina oko uyixelela kona.
partModules.disagree.from: These do not agree. Either a module is ticked that the SAQA document does not list, or one it lists is missing, or the credits on a module were read in wrongly. Worth checking before saving; the platform will still save what you tell it.

qualPreview.title.from: As a learner will see it

qualPreview.intro.text: {programme} yonke ngokulandelelana kokuhamba kwabo babhalise kuyo. Akukho nto apha eqalisayo: akukho bhaliso lwenziwayo, akukho nzame ivulwayo yaye akukho nkqubela irekhodwayo, ngoko oku kungafundwa ngokuphindaphindiweyo njengoko uthanda.
qualPreview.intro.from: The whole {programme} in the order somebody enrolled on it walks it. Nothing here starts anything: no enrolment is made, no attempt is opened and no progress is recorded, so this can be read as often as you like.

qualPreview.gaps.from: What a learner would not find

qualPreview.allReadyNote.text: Inyathelo ngalinye kwiyunithi yokufunda nganye linento ekuxhasayo. Umfundi obhalise kule {programme} namhlanje wayeya kuyifumana yonke.
qualPreview.allReadyNote.from: Every step in every study unit has something behind it. A learner enrolled on this {programme} today would find the whole of it.

qualPreview.build.from: Build what a learner works through

qualPreview.open.from: Open it as a learner sees it

qualPreview.change.from: Change the order or what is on it

courseList.noneAuthor.text: Ikhosi yile nto umfundi ayisebenzayo ngokwenene. Ixhomekeke kwiyunithi yokufunda okanye imodyuli yekharityhulam, ngoko kungcono ukuqala ngokulayisha ikhwalifikheyishini.
courseList.noneAuthor.from: A course is what a learner actually works through. It hangs off a study unit or a curriculum module, so a qualification is worth loading first.

courseList.noneReader.text: Akukabikho nto ipapashelwe wena. Xa sele ipapashiwe, oko ubhalise kuko kuya kubakho apha.
courseList.noneReader.from: Nothing has been published for you yet. When it has been, what you are enrolled on will be here.

newCourse.noModule.from: Not part of an accredited qualification

newCourse.moduleNote.text: Yibophelele kwimodyuli yekharityhulam, kwaye inkqubo iya kujonga, ngaphambi kokuba ipapashwe, ukuba wonke umgangatho wovavanyo kuloo modyuli unesifundo esiwuxhasayo.
newCourse.moduleNote.from: Bind it to a curriculum module and the system will check, before it can be published, that every assessment criterion in that module has a lesson behind it.

courseEdit.published.text: Oku kupapashiwe, ngoko umxholo wako umisiwe. Abafundi abakugqibileyo banazo iirekhodi ezibhekisa kolu guqulelo ngqo.
courseEdit.published.from: This is published, so its content is fixed. Learners who completed it have records that refer to exactly this version.

courseEdit.publishedAuthor.text: Ukuze ukutshintshe, vula uguqulelo olutsha; olupapashiweyo lusala njengoko lunjalo.
courseEdit.publishedAuthor.from: To change it, open a new version; the published one stays as it is.

courseEdit.folderNote.text: Khetha ifolda apho eli nqaku lifumaneka khona yaye yonke into ekuyo, kuquka neefolda ezingaphantsi, iyafundwa, ifayilwe, yatshixwa. Ubona oko ibiya kukufayila ngaphambi kokuba kubhalwe nantoni na.
courseEdit.folderNote.from: Choose the folder this material lives in and everything in it, including its subfolders, is read, filed and indexed. You see what it would file before anything is written.

courseEdit.folderLabel.from: Its folder, from your own computer

courseEdit.folderHint.text: Izikhokelo, iincwadi zokusebenza, imigaqo-nkqubo neetemplethi zifayilwa ngokuchasene nayo, kwaye umbhalo wazo utshixwa ukuze zikhangeleke.
courseEdit.folderHint.from: Guides, workbooks, policies and templates are filed against it and their text indexed so they can be searched.

courseEdit.folderHint2.text: Ubume abudalwa apha: ubume bayo bakhiwa kwi-editha engentla okanye kwiimodyuli zekhwalifikheyishini. Oku kufayila oko kukuyo.
courseEdit.folderHint2.from: Structure is not created from here: its own shape is built in the editor above or from a qualification's modules. This files what it holds.

courseEdit.drive.from: Or from a drive you have connected

courseEdit.driveNote.text: Ifolda enye leyo, ifundwa apho sele ikhoyo. Iphelela kwindawo enye: isiphakamiso sokujonga ngaphambi kokuba kubhalwe nantoni na.
courseEdit.driveNote.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

courseEdit.noSections.text: Akukho zicandelo okwangoku. Yakhiwe ngamacandelo, kwaye icandelo ngalinye linezifundo.
courseEdit.noSections.from: No sections yet. It is built from sections, and each section holds lessons.

courseEdit.noLessons.from: No lessons in this section yet.

courseEdit.competenciesNote.text: Oko ukugqiba kukubonisa. Ayinakupapashwa ngaphandle kwesakhono, kuba ukugqitywa kwayo akunakuxelwa njengamandla.
courseEdit.competenciesNote.from: What completing it demonstrates. It cannot be published with no competency, because its completions could not be reported as capability.

courseEdit.coveredAcross.text: kwimigangatho yovavanyo emi-{count} egubungelwe kwiimodyuli ze-{unit}
courseEdit.coveredAcross.from: of {count} assessment criteria covered across {unit}'s modules

courseEdit.coveredNote.text: Igubungelwa sisifundo apha, umbuzo kwelinye lovavanyo lwayo oluqhagamshelene nayo, okanye oko imatriki yakho yolungelelaniso ikubiza ngokuba kuyayivavanya. Layisha imatriki kwikhwalifikheyishini ukuze urekhode eyokugqibela.
courseEdit.coveredNote.from: Covered by a lesson here, a question on one of its assessments that is linked to it, or what your alignment matrix names as assessing it. Upload the matrix on the qualification to record the last.

courseEdit.unbound.text: Oku akubotshelelwanga kwimodyuli yekharityhulam evunyiweyo, ngoko akukho migangatho yovavanyo yokugubungela.
courseEdit.unbound.from: This is not bound to an accredited curriculum module, so there are no assessment criteria to cover.

courseEdit.publishNote.text: Ukupapasha kwaliwe ngoxa nantoni na engentla ingaphelelanga.
courseEdit.publishNote.from: Publishing is refused while anything above is incomplete.

courseEdit.newVersionNote.text: Abafundi abagqibe olu guqulelo bagcina irekhodi labo lalo.
courseEdit.newVersionNote.from: Learners who completed this version keep their record of it.

spine.intro.text: Ulandelelwano lokuhamba kwe-{course}, nento ebamba inyathelo ngalinye livaliwe de kugqitywe elandulelayo. Yonke into apha sele ibanjelwe ngokuchasene ne-{course} le: ukuyifaka kuluhlu yiyo eyenza umfundi ahlangane nayo.
spine.intro.from: The order this {course} is walked in, and what holds each step shut until the one before it is done. Everything here is already held against this {course}: putting it on the list is what makes a learner meet it.

spine.empty.text: Akukabikho nto kuyo, ngoko umfundi obhalise kuyo wayeya kuyivula afumane iphepha elingenanto. Yongeza into yokuqala ngezantsi.
spine.empty.from: Nothing is on it yet, so a learner enrolled on it would open it and find an empty page. Add the first thing below.

spine.waitsForBefore.from: Waits for the step before it to be {rule}.

spine.nothingLeft.text: Yonke into ebanjelwe ngokuchasene nayo sele ikuluhlu. Thatha incwadi yokusebenza okanye ufayile uxwebhu ngokuchasene nayo, kwaye iya kubonakala apha.
spine.nothingLeft.from: Everything held against it is already on the list. Capture a workbook or file a document against it, and it will appear here.

spine.openAtStart.text: Ivuleka ukususela ekuqaleni, kungekhona emva kwenyathelo langaphambili
spine.openAtStart.from: Open from the start, rather than after the step before it

courseAssess.intro.text: Ikhwizi yokwakha ihlolwa ngokwayo. Uvavanyo lokugqibela lugwetywa ngumntu ngalo lonke ixesha kwaye lihlolwa ngokuzimeleyo ngalo lonke ixesha, kuba ngulo obalwa kwikhwalifikheyishini.
courseAssess.intro.from: A formative quiz is marked automatically. A summative assessment is always judged by a person and always moderated independently, because it is the one that counts towards a qualification.

courseAssess.options.from: Answer options: tick every one that is correct

courseAssess.published.text: Kupapashiwe. Umfundi uyahlangana nako xa kuba linyathelo kwi-{link}.
courseAssess.published.from: Published. A learner meets it once it is a step in {link}.

courseAssess.sampleNote.text: Isiseko, hayi isiqongo. Ubungakanani beqela buyayiphakamisa: iqela labantu abalishumi okanye ngaphantsi lihlolwa ngokupheleleyo, kwaye eli labantu abamashumi amabini okanye ngaphantsi lihlolwa ngesiqingatha, kuba ikota yamaphepha asibhozo yimbini, kwaye ezimbini azithethi nto ngokugwetya komvavanyi. Eli nani lilawula amaqela angaphezulu kwamashumi amabini. Ayihoywa kuvavanyo lokugqibela, apho sonke isigqibo sihlolwa, kwaye umvavanyi obhaliswe ngoku ahlala ehlolwa ngokupheleleyo.
courseAssess.sampleNote.from: A floor, not a ceiling. Cohort size raises it: a cohort of ten or fewer is moderated in full and one of twenty or fewer at half, because a quarter of eight scripts is two, and two say almost nothing about an assessor's judgement. This figure governs cohorts above twenty. Ignored for a summative assessment, where every decision is moderated, and a newly registered assessor is always moderated in full.

courseEnrol.draft.text: Le isengumbhalo wedrafti. Kufuneka upapashwe phambi kokuba kubekwe mntu kuyo: idrafti ayikadluli kwiindlela zokujonga eziqinisekisa ukuba umxholo wayo ugubungela oko ikuthethayo.
courseEnrol.draft.from: This is still a draft. It has to be published before anyone can be assigned to it: a draft has not passed the checks that confirm its content covers what it claims to.

courseEnrol.waitingNote.text: Umfundi ngamnye ubonakala kanye, kwinyathelo lokuqala angakwaziyo ukulivula. Ukubanjelwa kwinyathelo lesithathu yinyani efanele ukwenziwa; ukubanjelwa kwakhona kumanyathelo amane ukuya kwelishumi kufuthe nje.
courseEnrol.waitingNote.from: Each learner appears once, at the earliest step they cannot open. Being held up at step three is the fact worth acting on; also being held up at steps four to ten is noise.

courseEnrol.everyone.from: Everyone in the organisation is already on it.

courseEnrol.manyNote.text: Namathelisa idilesi ze-imeyile, enye emgceni ngamnye. Ikholam ekhutshelwe ngqo kwisipredishithi iyasebenza.
courseEnrol.manyNote.from: Paste email addresses, one per line. A column copied straight out of a spreadsheet works.

settings.intro.text: Indlela i-{name} ebonakala ngayo kubantu bakho, nendlela i-App efunda ngayo amaxwebhu abawalayishayo. Utshintsho lusebenza kuyo yonke indawo kwangoko: akukho nto yokuphinda yakhiwe okanye yokuphinda ifakwe.
settings.intro.from: How {name} looks to your people, and how the App reads the documents they upload. Changes apply everywhere immediately: there is nothing to rebuild or redeploy.

settings.drive.connected.text: Kuqhagamshelwe. Ifolda ingafundwa ngqo kuyo ngoku.
settings.drive.connected.from: Connected. A folder can now be read straight from it.

settings.drive.cancelled.from: Nothing was connected: the consent was cancelled.

settings.drive.state.text: Loo mvume ayihambelani neyo ibrawuza le ibiqalise, ngoko akukho nto iqhagamshelweyo. Qala kwakhona kweli phepha.
settings.drive.state.from: That consent did not match the one this browser started, so nothing was connected. Start again from this page.

settings.drive.nocode.text: Umboneleli akathumelanga nto yokuqhagamshela ngayo. Zama kwakhona.
settings.drive.nocode.from: The provider sent nothing back to connect with. Try again.

settings.drive.failed.text: Uqhagamshelo alukwazanga ukugqitywa. Akukho nto igciniweyo. Ukuzama kwakhona kufanelekile ngaphambi kwayo nantoni na enye.
settings.drive.failed.from: The connection could not be completed. Nothing was stored. Trying again is worth doing before anything else.

settings.mailNote.text: Ukuba abafundi banokwamkela ngokwenene iinkcukacha zabo zokungena nezaziso. Kufanelekile ukujonga emva kokuba nabani etshintshe useto lweposi, kwaye yinto yokuqala ekufuneka ijongwe xa umntu esithi i-imeyile ayizange ifike.
settings.mailNote.from: Whether learners can actually receive their sign-in details and notifications. Worth checking after anybody changes the mail settings, and the first thing to check when somebody says an email never arrived.

settings.sso.from: Signing in with Google or Microsoft

settings.ssoNote.text: Kwenza abantu bakho bakwazi ukungena nge-akhawunti ye-Google okanye ye-Microsoft yombutho wabo endaweni yephasiwedi apha, eqhubeka nokusebenza ecaleni kwayo. Ingenisa kuphela abantu abasele benayo i-akhawunti kule pleyithifomu, ehambelaniswa ngedilesi ye-imeyile okokuqala; ayidali nayiphi na.
settings.ssoNote.from: Lets your people sign in with their organisation's Google or Microsoft account instead of a password here, which keeps working beside it. It only signs in people who already have an account on this platform, matched by email address the first time; it never creates one.

settings.terminologyNote.text: Sebenzisa isigama sakho. Umboneleli ongaphandle kweMzantsi Afrika angayisebenzisi into ethi "inkqubo", kwaye lowo ongaphakathi kuyo angayisebenzisi ethi "ikhosi"; ipleyithifomu ayifanele ibe nenkani.
settings.terminologyNote.from: Use your own vocabulary. A provider outside South Africa may not say programme, and a provider inside it may not say course; the platform should not insist.

settings.templatesNote.text: Indlela ixwebhu ngalinye elikhutshwa yile mboneleli elifundeka ngayo nelibonakala ngayo.
settings.templatesNote.from: How each document this provider issues reads and looks.

settings.templatesMoved.text: ngoku phantsi kweLawulo, kunye nawo onke amaxwebhu akhiqizwa yipleyithifomu nokuba ngubani ofumana ngalinye.
settings.templatesMoved.from: now under Management, with every document the platform produces and who receives each one.

settings.menuNote.text: Hlela ibha ephezulu: biza kwakhona isihloko, suntsa iphepha ulibeke phantsi kwesinye, okanye wenze iphepha libe yilinki ethe ngqo. Kunjalo kwabo bonke kule mboneleli, kuba abasebenzi bayaxelelana ukuba izinto zikuphi.
settings.menuNote.from: Rearrange the bar at the top: rename a heading, move a page under a different one, or make a page a direct link. The same for everybody at this provider, because staff tell each other where things are.

settings.drivesNote.text: Funda ifolda ngqo kwi-Google Drive okanye kwi-OneDrive, endaweni yokuyikhuphela uze uyilayishe kwakhona. Yeyakho kunokuba yeyomboneleli: lilungu ngalinye labasebenzi liqhagamshela eyalo.
settings.drivesNote.from: Read a folder straight from Google Drive or OneDrive, instead of downloading it and uploading it again. Yours rather than this provider's: every member of staff connects their own.

settings.extensionNote.text: Ngokuchasene neprofayile yakho. Ngokuzikhethela, ivaliwe ngokungagqibekanga, kwaye oko ikuvumela ukukwenza kubotshelelwe yindima yakho kanye njengayo yonke enye into.
settings.extensionNote.from: Against your own profile. Optional, off by default, and what it lets you do is bounded by your role exactly as everything else is.

providerLang.note.text: Ulwimi abantu bakho abafunda ngalo ipleyithifomu, ngaphandle kokuba bakhetha olwabo phantsi kwegama labo phezulu ephepheni. Izikrini ezingekaguqulelwa zihlala ziseNgesini, kwaye amagama akho ezinto (Useto, Isigama) agcinwa njengoko uwabhale ngako kuzo zonke iilwimi.
providerLang.note.from: The language your people read the platform in, unless they choose their own under their name at the top of the page. Screens not yet translated stay in English, and your own names for things (Settings, Terminology) are kept as you wrote them in every language.

brand.accentNote.text: Izinto eziqaqambisiweyo, imigca yenkqubela neemida zesatifikethi.
brand.accentNote.from: Highlights, progress bars and certificate borders.

brand.logoNote.text: Ibonakala kwiheda, kwiphepha lokungena nakwisatifikethi ngasinye. I-PNG enomva ocacileyo ihlala kakuhle kumbala weheda. Ingaphantsi kwe-2 MB.
brand.logoNote.from: Appears in the header, on the sign-in page and on every certificate. A PNG with a transparent background sits best on the header colour. Under 2 MB.

brand.unfinished.text: Ukulayisha akugqitywanga. Jonga uqhagamshelo uzame kwakhona.
brand.unfinished.from: The upload did not finish. Check the connection and try again.

brand.removeLogo.from: Remove, and show the name instead

brand.logoAddress.text: Okanye idilesi, ukuba umfanekiso sele ubanjelwe kwenye indawo
brand.logoAddress.from: Or an address, if the image is already hosted elsewhere

brand.signInNote.text: Ngokuzikhethela. Ngaphandle kwanto apha iphepha libonisa igama lakho kumbala wakho, oku kucocekile kodwa kulula. Igrafikhi ebonisa into eyinyani ngoko uyenzayo ixabisekile ngaphezu kweyokuhombisa kuphela.
brand.signInNote.from: Optional. With nothing here the page shows your name on your own colour, which is tidy but plain. A graphic that says something true about what you do is worth more than a decorative one.

brand.characterNote.text: Ibonakala kwiskrini esingenanto okwangoku, ecaleni kwesivakalisi esichaza ukuba yintoni eyayiya kubakho, nasecaleni kweqhosha umntu ekufuneka alicinezele okulandelayo, apho ikhona ukuze iqatshelwe. Incinci, ithe nkqo, kwaye ithandeka ngaphezu kokuhombisa. Yishiye ingenanto ukusebenzisa eyale pleyithifomu, okanye ungasebenzisi nto.
brand.characterNote.from: Appears on a screen with nothing on it yet, beside the sentence explaining what would be there, and beside a button somebody has to press next, where it is there to be noticed. Small, upright, and friendlier than it is decorative. Leave it empty to use this platform's own, or nothing at all.

shape.intro.text: Imibuzo emibini ithatha isigqibo ngokwakheka kwepleyithifomu yakho nokuba iinxalenye zayo zibizwa ngokuba yintoni. Yonke into ongayikhethiyo iyasuka: izikrini zayo, izinto zemenyu needilesi zayo.
shape.intro.from: Two questions decide the shape of your platform and what its parts are called. Everything you do not choose goes away: its screens, its menu entries and its addresses.

shape.nothingDeletedNote.text: Ukutshintsha oku kufihla izinto. Nantoni na esele irekhodiwe isala apho ikhoyo, kwaye ukuyikhetha kwakhona kubuyisa izikrini kunye neerekhodi zingachukumisekanga.
shape.nothingDeletedNote.from: Changing this hides things. Whatever has already been recorded stays where it is, and choosing it again brings the screens back with the records intact.

shape.saved.from: Saved. The menu and the wording have changed to match.

shape.unavailable.text: Ayifumaneki kunye nokhetho olungentla. Iyunithi yokufunda ihlala ngaphakathi kwekhwalifikheyishini, kwaye le pleyithifomu ayinayo.
shape.unavailable.from: Not available with the choice above. A study unit sits inside a qualification, and this platform has none.

shape.standalone.from: Three things that stand on their own

shape.statutoryCovers.text: Ukuthunyelwa kwe-NLRD ne-Edu.Dex, iingxelo ze-WSP ne-ATR, nerejista esemthethweni ngasemva kwazo.
shape.statutoryCovers.from: NLRD and Edu.Dex exports, WSP and ATR returns, and the statutory register behind them.

shape.statutoryWhen.text: ungaphandle kweMzantsi Afrika, okanye omnye ufayila egameni lakho.
shape.statutoryWhen.from: you are outside South Africa, or somebody else files on your behalf.

shape.workplaceCovers.text: Izivumelwano zasemsebenzini, izikhokelo zabaqeqeshi, amaphepha okusayina neeyure umfundi azirekhoda ngokuchasene nomqeshi ozamkelayo.
shape.workplaceCovers.from: Workplace agreements, coach guides, sign off sheets and the hours a learner logs against a host employer.

shape.workplaceWhen.text: akukho nto oyifundisayo evavanywa kwindawo yokusebenza.
shape.workplaceWhen.from: nothing you deliver is assessed in a workplace.

shape.offlineCovers.text: Abafundi bafaka ipleyithifomu kwifowuni yabo, bakhuphela izinto zabo zokufunda ngaphambi kokuba baphume, bazifunde ngaphandle komqondiso, kwaye barekhode umsebenzi wabo ukuze bawuthumele emva xa besisifumana kwakhona.
shape.offlineCovers.from: Learners install the platform on their phone, download their study material before they go out, read it with no signal, and record their work to send back when they next have one.

shape.offlineWhen.text: abafundi bachitha iintsuku bengekho kumqondiso, njengasentsimini. Uvavanyo lokugqibela luhlala luku-intanethi ngaphandle kokuba inkqubo isetwe ngenye indlela ngabom.
shape.offlineWhen.from: learners spend days away from a signal, such as in the field. Summatives stay online unless a programme is deliberately set otherwise.

shape.rename.text: Ungabiza kwakhona nayiphi na kwezi phantsi kwe-{link}. Amagama asetyenziswa ngokwenene ngobu bume kuphela ayanikwa apho.
shape.rename.from: You can rename any of these under {link}. Only the words this shape actually uses are offered there.

shape.award.qualification_programme.cove.text: Into enye. Umfundi ubekwa kwikhwalifikheyishini kwaye yiloo nto asebenza ngayo. Akukho ngqi yahlukileyo yokudibanisa ngaphezu kwayo.
shape.award.qualification_programme.cove.from: One thing. A learner is put onto the qualification and that is what they work through. There is no separate bundling layer above it.

shape.award.qualification_programme.when.text: Ufundisa ikhwalifikheyishini enye yomsebenzi njengenkqubo enye yokufunda.
shape.award.qualification_programme.when.from: You deliver one occupational qualification as one learning programme.

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: Ikhwalifikheyishini neNkqubo, ngokwahlukeneyo
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: Qualification and Programme, separately

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: Izinto ezimbini ezahlukeneyo. Ikhwalifikheyishini iphethe ukuvunywa nekharityhulam; inkqubo idibanisa oko umfundi asebenza ngako, kwaye ingaphendula kwikhwalifikheyishini okanye kungabikho.
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: Two different things. A qualification holds the accreditation and the curriculum; a programme bundles what a learner works through, and may answer to a qualification or to none.

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: Uqhuba iikhwalifikheyishini ezivunyiweyo kwaye udibanisa nezinto ezihanjiswayo kulandelelwano olungeyiyo ikhwalifikheyishini enye nganye.
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: You run accredited qualifications and also bundle deliverables into sequences that are not one qualification each.

shape.award.programmes_only.covers.text: Iinkqubo zidibanisa oko umfundi asebenza ngako. Akukho rekhodi yokuvunywa, akukho kharityhulam, akukho ngxelo zeziphumo.
shape.award.programmes_only.covers.from: Programmes bundle what a learner works through. No accreditation record, no curriculum, no statements of results.

shape.award.programmes_only.when.text: Akukho nto uyihambisayo ephendula kwikhwalifikheyishini ebhalisiweyo: uqeqesho lokungenisa, ukuhlaziywa kokuthobela imithetho, iinkqubo zezakhono zangaphakathi.
shape.award.programmes_only.when.from: Nothing you deliver answers to a registered qualification: induction, compliance refreshers, internal skills programmes.

shape.award.standalone.covers.text: Yonke into imi yodwa. Akukho nto ekudibanisayo kwaye akukho nto ekuvumayo.
shape.award.standalone.covers.from: Everything stands on its own. Nothing bundles it and nothing accredits it.

shape.award.standalone.when.text: Yonke into yoqeqesho oyiqhubayo ithatyathwa yodwa, enye ngexesha.
shape.award.standalone.when.from: Every piece of training you run is taken on its own, one at a time.

shape.delivery.courses.covers.text: Ikhosi yile nto umfundi abekwa kuyo asebenza ngayo: izifundo zayo, iincwadi zayo zokusebenza, uvavanyo lwayo. Ingahlala phantsi kwenkqubo, kwaye ayifuni kuphendula kwikhwalifikheyishini.
shape.delivery.courses.covers.from: A course is what a learner is put onto and works through: its lessons, its workbooks, its assessments. It may sit under a programme, and it need answer to no qualification.

shape.delivery.courses.when.text: Abantu bakho bathi ikhosi, okanye wakha uqeqesho olungalawulwa yikhwalifikheyishini.
shape.delivery.courses.when.from: Your people say course, or you build training that no qualification governs.

shape.delivery.study_units.covers.text: Iyunithi yokufunda yile nto umfundi asebenza ngayo, kwaye ithatha indawo yekhosi ngokupheleleyo. Ihlala ngaphakathi kwekhwalifikheyishini, idibanisa iimodyuli zolwazi, ezisebenzayo nezasemsebenzini ezisebenzela isiphumo esinye senqanaba lokuphuma.
shape.delivery.study_units.covers.from: A study unit is what a learner works through, and it replaces the course entirely. It sits inside a qualification, bundling the knowledge, practical and workplace modules that serve one exit level outcome.

shape.delivery.study_units.when.text: Abantu bakho bathi iyunithi yokufunda kunokuba bathi ikhosi. Ikharityhulam ipapasha iimodyuli kwaye ishiya ukudibanisa kuwe, ngoko oku kukwakheka kwakho. Ifuna ikhwalifikheyishini ephezulu.
shape.delivery.study_units.when.from: Your people say study unit rather than course. The curriculum publishes modules and leaves the grouping to you, so this is your own structure. Requires a qualification at the top.

shape.note.qualificationProgramme.text: Into enye. Umfundi ubekwa kwikhwalifikheyishini, kwaye leyo yinkqubo asebenza ngayo.
shape.note.qualificationProgramme.from: One thing. A learner is put onto the qualification, and that is the programme they work through.

shape.note.qualification.text: Irekhodi lokuvunywa: ikharityhulam yayo, imigangatho neziphumo zenqanaba lokuphuma.
shape.note.qualification.from: The accreditation record: its curriculum, criteria and exit level outcomes.

shape.note.programmeWithQualification.text: Ulandelelwano olucwangcisiweyo, olunokuphendula kwikhwalifikheyishini okanye lungaphenduli.
shape.note.programmeWithQualification.from: An ordered sequence, which may answer to a qualification or to none.

shape.note.programmeOnly.from: An ordered sequence, answering to no registered qualification.

shape.note.bottom.text: Oko umfundi asebenza ngako. Akukho nto ingaphantsi kwayo.
shape.note.bottom.from: What a learner works through. There is nothing below it.

clock.note.text: Onke amaxesha akwitayimtheyibhile kwi-App athetha le wotshi. Ilekchara ngentsimbi ye-18:30 yi-18:30 apha, kwaye ixesha lokuvala ukuvunyelwa kokuhlala okujongwayo lugwetywa ngokuchasene nayo.
clock.note.from: Every timetabled time in the App means this clock. A lecture at 18:30 is 18:30 here, and an admission cut-off for an invigilated sitting is judged against it.

clock.both.text: Abafundi kumazwe angaphandle babona zombini: ixesha lakho, elo lelo irekhodi ligcinayo, elabo ecaleni kwalo, ukuze akukho namnye ubala umahluko ngokwakhe aze enze impazamo. Amaxesha arekhodiweyo asoloko eyawe.
clock.both.from: Learners in other countries see both: your time, which is the one the record keeps, and their own alongside it, so nobody works out the difference themselves and gets it wrong. Recorded times are always yours.

mailTest.intro.text: Ivula uqhagamshelo kwiseva yeposi kwaye ingene, ukujonga ukuba iinkcukacha zokungena zabafundi nezaziso ziyakwazi ukuhanjiswa.
mailTest.intro.from: Opens a connection to the mail server and signs in, to check that learner sign-in details and notifications can actually be delivered.

mailTest.nothingSent.from: No email is sent to anybody.

mailTest.notYours.text: Akukho nto apha onokuyitshintsha kweli phepha: iseva yeposi yeyokuhanjiswa. Nika umgca ongentla kulowo uyigcinayo.
mailTest.notYours.from: Nothing here is something you can change on this page: the mail server belongs to the deployment. Pass the line above to whoever maintains it.

mailTest.unconfigured.text: Akukho seva yeposi isetiweyo kolu hanjiso okwangoku, ngoko oku kuya kuxela oko kunokuba yimpazamo kwi-akhawunti yakho.
mailTest.unconfigured.from: No mail server is set up on this deployment yet, so this will report that rather than a fault with your account.

sso.register.text: Bhalisa le pleyithifomu nge-akhawunti ye-{provider} yombutho wakho uze uyinike le dilesi ukuba ibuyise abantu, kanye njengoko ibhaliwe: {address}
sso.register.from: Register this platform with your organisation's {provider} account and give it this address to send people back to, exactly as written: {address}

sso.directoryHint.text: Ukusuka kwiphepha leOverview le-app kwi-Microsoft Entra
sso.directoryHint.from: From the app's Overview page in Microsoft Entra

sso.offer.from: Offer “Sign in with {provider}” on the sign-in page

termsForm.why.practice.from: used across the sector, owned by nobody

termsForm.missing.text: Amanye amagama akekho kolu luhlu, kwaye oko kuyinjongo.
termsForm.missing.from: Some words are not on this list, and that is deliberate.

termsForm.missingNote.text: Ikhwalifikheyishini, imodyuli yekharityhulam, isiphumo senqanaba lokuphuma, inqanaba le-NQF nezinye zichazwa yi-QCTO okanye yi-SAQA kungekhona nguwe. Ukuzibiza kwakhona kwakuya kubeka amagama kwiskrini somfundi nakwisifakelo esingaqatshelwa ligunya elilawulayo; ngoko ipleyithifomu iyawagcina emisiwe. Ungafunda ukuba ngubani ochaza ntoni kwi-{link}.
termsForm.missingNote.from: Qualification, curriculum module, exit level outcome, NQF level and the rest are defined by the QCTO or SAQA rather than by you. Renaming one would put wording on a learner's screen and on a submission that the regulator does not recognise, so the platform keeps them fixed. You can read who defines what in the {link}.

termsForm.note.course.text: Umzimba omnye wokufunda umntu obhalisiwe kuwo.
termsForm.note.course.from: A single body of learning a person is enrolled onto.

termsForm.note.programme.from: A sequence of courses taken in order.

termsForm.note.cohort.from: A group of people moving through a course together.

termsForm.note.studyUnit.text: Indlela iimodyuli zekharityhulam ezidityaniswa ngayo ukuze zihanjiswe.
termsForm.note.studyUnit.from: How a curriculum's modules are grouped for delivery.

termsForm.note.enrolment.from: A person's place on a course or programme.

termsForm.note.learner.text: Umntu ofundayo. Abanye ababoneleli bathi istudent okanye umgqatswa.
termsForm.note.learner.from: The person doing the learning. Some providers say student, or candidate.

termsForm.note.facilitator.text: Umntu ohambisayo. Abanye ababoneleli bathi umqeqeshi, utitshala, okanye umfundisi.
termsForm.note.facilitator.from: The person delivering. Some providers say trainer, tutor, or instructor.

termsForm.note.assessor.from: The person judging evidence against the criteria.

termsForm.note.moderator.from: The person checking a sample of those judgements.

termsForm.note.workplaceRecord.text: Irekhodi lomsebenzi owenziwe ngumfundi, esayinwa ngumqeqeshi yaye yamkelwa ngumvavanyi.
termsForm.note.workplaceRecord.from: The record of work a learner did, that a coach signs and an assessor accepts.

menuEdit.noHeadingHint.text: Akukho sihloko: zibonakala njengeelinki ezithe ngqo
menuEdit.noHeadingHint.from: No heading: shown as direct links

menuEdit.empty.text: Ayinanto. Isihloko esingenanto phantsi kwaso asibonakali.
menuEdit.empty.from: Empty. A heading with nothing under it is not shown.

menuEdit.note.text: Amaphepha awakwazi ukufihlwa apha. Oko umntu ngamnye akubonayo sele kunqunywe yindima yakhe, kwaye enye indlela yokwenza into ingafikeleleki yayiya kushiya akukho namnye unokuchaza ukuba kutheni iphepha lingekho. Iphepha elongezwa kwipleyithifomu kamva libonakala phantsi kwesihloko salo esiqhelekileyo kunokuba lingabikho ngenxa yokuba olu lungiselelo lwandulela lona.
menuEdit.note.from: Pages cannot be hidden here. What each person sees is already decided by their role, and a second way to make something unreachable would leave nobody able to say why a page is missing. A page added to the platform later appears under its usual heading rather than disappearing because this arrangement predates it.

drives.none.text: Akukho ndawo yokugcina iifayile isetiweyo kolu hanjiso. Ukufunda ifolda ngqo kwi-Google Drive okanye kwi-OneDrive kufuna isicelo esibhaliswe nabo ngulowo uyigcinayo ipleyithifomu; kude kube ngoko, ifolda ikhethwa kwikhompyuter yakho, esebenza kwaye ayifuni nto.
drives.none.from: No file store is set up on this deployment. Reading a folder straight from Google Drive or OneDrive needs an application registered with them by whoever maintains the platform; until then, a folder is chosen from your own computer, which works and needs nothing.

drives.keepsNote.text: Uphawu oluvaliweyo olunokufunda, kwaye lufunda kuphela, idrayivu ye-akhawunti oyiqhagamshelayo, de uyinqamule apha okanye uyirhoxise kuseto lwe-akhawunti leyo. Lisetyenziswa xa ucela ukuba ifolda ifundwe kwaye alisetyenziswa ngamanye amaxesha, alibonakaliswa kwakho, kwaye alibhalwa kwilogi. Lelakho, hayi lomboneleli: umlingane wakho akakwazi ukufunda iifayile zakho ngalo, nawe awukwazi ukufunda ezakhe ngoqhagamshelo lwakhe.
drives.keepsNote.from: A sealed token that can read, and only read, the drive of the account you connect, until you disconnect it here or withdraw it from that account's own settings. It is used when you ask for a folder to be read and at no other time, it is never shown back to you, and it is never written to a log. It is yours, not this provider's: a colleague cannot read your files through it, and you cannot read theirs through their connection.

ext.encrypted.text: Ifihliwe kwaye ayiphinde ibonakaliswe, apha okanye naphi na.
ext.encrypted.from: It is encrypted and is never shown again, here or anywhere else.

ext.cannotRun.text: Le ayikwazi ukusebenza kule pleyithifomu, ngoko ukuyiseta apha akuyi kwenza izinto ze-AI zisebenze.
ext.cannotRun.from: This one cannot run on this platform, so setting it up here will not make the AI features work.

ext.needsProgram.text: Ifuna inkqubo efakiweyo kumatshini apho ipleyithifomu isebenza khona.
ext.needsProgram.from: It needs a program installed on the machine the platform runs on.

ext.chooseKey.text: Khetha omnye wababoneleli bezitshixo ze-API endaweni yoko: aba babiza umboneleli ngeintanethi kwaye basebenza naphi apho ipleyithifomu ifakwe khona.
ext.chooseKey.from: Choose one of the API-key providers instead: those call the provider over the internet and work wherever the platform is installed.

ext.replace.text: Yibeke endaweni yayo nge-{credential} entsha; shiya ingenanto ukugcina egciniweyo
ext.replace.from: Replace it with a new {credential}; leave empty to keep the stored one

ext.geminiHint.text: isitshixo sakho esivela kwi-Google AI Studio
ext.geminiHint.from: your key from Google AI Studio

ext.available.from: Make it available to switch on

ext.model.text: Imodeli: shiya ingenanto ukusebenzisa engagqibekanga yomboneleli
ext.model.from: Model: leave empty for the provider's own default

ext.showModels.from: Show the models this {credential} can use

ext.modelsAvailable.text: {count} ifumanekile kuwe namhlanje. Ukukhetha enye kuzalisa ibhokisi engentla; igcinwa xa ucinezela Gcina.
ext.modelsAvailable.from: {count} available to you today. Choosing one fills the box above; it is saved when you press Save.

ext.keepsNote.text: I-{credential} yakho, ifihliwe, de uyilahle. Isetyenziselwa kuphela umsebenzi oyicelayo, kuphela ngoxa iswitshi yakho ivuliwe, kwaye ayibonakaliswa kwakho okanye ibhalwe kuyo nayiphi na ilogi. Ukufumaneka akufani nokuvuleka: ukuhlala ngakunye kuqala ivaliwe, uyivula umsebenzi, kwaye ukuphuma kuyivala ngoku ukuba uyilibele.
ext.keepsNote.from: Your {credential}, encrypted, until you discard it. It is used only for work you ask for, only while you have the switch on, and it is never shown back to you or written to any log. Available is not the same as on: every sitting starts with it off, you switch it on for a job, and signing out switches it off for you if you forget.

ext.keptUnused.text: Uphawu lwakho lugciniwe kodwa alunakusetyenziswa. Akukho nto kwipleyithifomu eya kunika uncedo lwe-AI de uyenze ifumaneke kwakhona.
ext.keptUnused.from: Your token is kept but cannot be used. Nothing in the platform will offer AI assistance until you make it available again.

ext.offNote.text: Xa oku kuvaliwe, ipleyithifomu isebenza kanye njengokuba isebenza ngaphandle kwesandiso: izinto zokusebenza azikho kunokuba zinikwe zisilele.
ext.offNote.from: With this off, the platform behaves exactly as it does without an extension: the affordances are absent rather than offered and failing.

ext.tokenFromNote.text: Le nxalenye yenzeka kwikhompyuter yakho, hayi apha, yiyo le njongo: isabhaskripshini yakho igunyaziswa nguwe, kumatshini wakho, kwaye ngophawu olukhutshwayo kuphela olufika kule pleyithifomu.
ext.tokenFromNote.from: This part happens on your own computer, not here, which is the point: your subscription is authorised by you, on your machine, and only the token it produces ever reaches this platform.

ext.step1Rest.text: ukuba awukayenzi: {link}. Ufuna isabhaskripshini yakho ye-Claude.
ext.step1Rest.from: if you have not already: {link}. You need a Claude subscription of your own.

ext.cmdNote.text: I-{plain} eqhelekileyo kwi-PowerShell idla ngokusilela ithi “running scripts is disabled on this system”. Yindlela engagqibekanga yeWindows kunokuba yimpazamo ekufakweni kwakho, kwaye ifom ye-{cmd} iyayikhwepha ngaphandle kokutshintsha useto lokhuseleko.
ext.cmdNote.from: Plain {plain} in PowerShell usually fails with “running scripts is disabled on this system”. That is a Windows default rather than anything wrong with your installation, and the {cmd} form avoids it without changing any security setting.

ext.step3.from: 3. Sign in when it opens your browser

ext.step3Rest.text: , emva koko kopisha uphawu oluprintiweyo (luqala nge-{prefix}) uluncamathisele ngasentla.
ext.step3Rest.from: , then copy the token it prints (it begins {prefix}) and paste it above.

ext.notApiKey.text: Ayisositshixo se-API kwaye akukho ndleko ngoluphawu ngalunye: itsala kwisabhaskripshini ye-Claude osele uwuhlawulayo. Ungaze unike mntu iphasiwedi yakho ye-Anthropic: le pleyithifomu ayinalo ibhokisi yayo kwaye ngekhe iyamkele apha.
ext.notApiKey.from: It is not an API key and there is no per-token cost: it draws on the Claude subscription you already pay for. Never give anybody your Anthropic password: this platform has no field for one and would not accept it here.

ext.notSubscription.from: A subscription is not an API key.

ext.geminiSeparate.text: I-Gemini Advanced kunye ne-Gemini API ziimveliso ezahlukeneyo ezinamaxabiso ahlukeneyo. Ukuhlawula eyokuqala akukunikeli yesibini, kwaye akukho ndlela yokuyenza.
ext.geminiSeparate.from: Gemini Advanced and the Gemini API are separate products with separate billing. Paying for the first does not give you the second, and there is no way to make it.

ext.openaiSeparate.text: I-ChatGPT Plus kunye ne-OpenAI API ziimveliso ezahlukeneyo ezinamaxabiso ahlukeneyo. Ukuhlawula eyokuqala akukunikeli yesibini, kwaye akukho ndlela yokuyenza.
ext.openaiSeparate.from: ChatGPT Plus and the OpenAI API are separate products with separate billing. Paying for the first does not give you the second, and there is no way to make it.

ext.openaiCreate.text: Yenza isitshixo kwi-{site}, phantsi kwe-{menu}, uze ulunamathisele ngasentla. Siqala nge-{prefix}.
ext.openaiCreate.from: Create a key at {site}, under {menu}, and paste it above. It begins {prefix}.

ext.noFreeTierNote.text: ngokungafaniyo ne-Gemini, ucingo ngalunye lubizwa kwi-akhawunti esekelwe kuyo isitshixo, ngoko lindela ibhili, nokuba incinci kangakanani.
ext.noFreeTierNote.from: unlike Gemini, every call is charged to the account the key belongs to, so expect a bill, however small.

ext.geminiCreate.text: Ngena kwi-{site}, khetha i-{menu}, yenza enye, uze uyinamathisele ngasentla. I-Google ikhuphe izitshixo ngeefomati ezingaphezu kweyodwa, ngoko namathisela nantoni na oyinikwayo: le pleyithifomu ayikuthandabuzi.
ext.geminiCreate.from: Sign in at {site}, choose {menu}, create one, and paste it above. Google has issued keys in more than one format, so paste whatever it gives you: this platform does not second-guess it.

ext.geminiFree.text: I-Gemini API inesigaba simahla, ngoko ayibizi nto ukuzama. Ilinganisa iindlela ofikelela ngazo ngomzuzu kunokuba ihlawulise; ukufunda ifolda enkulu kunokufikelela kuloo mda, kwaye ipleyithifomu iya kuxela ngokucacileyo ukuba kwenzeka.
ext.geminiFree.from: The Gemini API has a free tier, so this costs nothing to try. It limits how many requests you may make in a minute rather than charging for them; reading a large folder can hit that, and the platform will say so plainly if it does.

ext.keyYours.text: Lelakho, hayi lelo mbutho. Ifihliwe, isetyenziselwa kuphela umsebenzi oyicelayo ngoxa iswitshi yakho ivuliwe, ayibonakaliswa kwakho, kwaye ayibhalwa kwilogi.
ext.keyYours.from: It is yours, not the tenant's. It is encrypted, used only for work you ask for while your switch is on, never shown back to you, and never written to a log.

codes.intro.text: Imodyuli enye ibhalwa ngokwahlukileyo kumaxwebhu ahlukeneyo: {long} kwikharityhulam, {short} kwitheyibhile yolungelelaniso, {shortest} kwisishwankathelo. Isazisi eside, izimpawu zokuphumla nonobumba abakhulu zilawulwa ngumgaqo. Lapha yindawo apho i-App ixelelwa ngezinye, ukuze ukulayisha kudibanise imodyuli kunokuba kuxele ukuba ayikho.
codes.intro.from: One module is written down differently in different documents: {long} in the curriculum, {short} in the alignment table, {shortest} in a summary. The long identifier, the punctuation and the capitals are handled by rule. This is where the App is told about the rest, so an upload links the module instead of reporting it missing.

codes.saved.text: Kugciniwe. Ukulayisha kuya kuzisebenzisa ezi ukususela ngoku.
codes.saved.from: Saved. Uploads will use these from now on.

codes.none.text: Akukabikho kharityhulam ilayishiweyo, ngoko akukho migangatho yokuqikelela. Layisha ikhwalifikheyishini yaye oku kuzizalisa ngokwako kwiikhowudi zemodyuli zayo.
codes.none.from: No curriculum has been loaded yet, so there are no standards to infer. Load a qualification and this fills itself in from its module codes.

codes.inUse.text: Ukubhala ngenye indlela {total} kwiimodyuli ezi-{modules}, kusetyenziswa.
codes.inUse.from: {total} alternative spellings across {modules} modules, in use.

codes.notInUse.from: Not in use until you have looked at them and confirmed.

codes.dialogNote.text: Ikhowudi ekhohlo ngumgangatho wakho. Ukubhalwa ecaleni kwayo yile amaxwebhu anokuyisebenzisa endaweni. Susa nayiphi na engafaniyo, yongeza eyakho, uze uqinisekise.
codes.dialogNote.from: The code on the left is your standard. The spellings beside it are what a document may use instead. Remove any that do not belong, add your own, then confirm.

codes.fullId.text: Isazisi esipheleleyo se-QCTO, {example}, sifundwa njengekhowudi yemodyuli yaso ngumgaqo, kwaye asifuni mgca apha. Kunjalo nangeehayifeni, izithuba nonobumba abakhulu.
codes.fullId.from: A full QCTO identifier, {example}, is read as its module code by rule, and needs no row here. So are hyphens, spaces and capitals.

codes.worked.from: Its variations are worked out for you.

codes.putBack.from: Put back everything the App proposed

naming.intro.text: Xa umntu elayisha incwadi yokusebenza okanye uvavanyo, i-App ifunda igama lefayile ukuze isebenze into yayo. Yenza oku kulunge yaye ukulayisha kufika sele kuzaliswe. Ukuba kungalunganga akukho nto iphukayo: kufika njengefomu engenanto ukuba umntu ayizalise ngesandla.
naming.intro.from: When somebody uploads a workbook or an assessment, the App reads the filename to work out what it is. Get this right and an upload arrives already filled in. Get it wrong and nothing breaks: it arrives as a blank form for somebody to complete by hand.

naming.rule.text: Umgaqo wombutho, njengoko iqela lakho kufuneka lilandele
naming.rule.from: The house rule, as your team should follow it

naming.ruleNote.text: Ibonakaliswa kwiskrini sokulayisha. Isikhokelo sabantu, hayi into i-App ehambelana nayo: ifumana iikhowudi ezingezantsi naphi apho zibonakala khona.
naming.ruleNote.from: Shown on the upload screen. Guidance for people, not something the App matches on: it finds the codes below wherever they appear.

naming.codesNote.text: Inxalenye yegama lefayile ebonisa ukuba luhlobo luni lwexwebhu. Ezi yile nto i-App ihambelana nayo ngokwenene.
naming.codesNote.from: The part of a filename that says what kind of document it is. These are what the App actually matches on.

naming.markerNote.text: Uphawu oluthi ifayile yimemorandam kunokuba yikopi yomfundi.
naming.markerNote.from: The token that says a file is the memorandum rather than the learner's copy.

naming.unread.text: Ayifundwanga kweli gama: {parts}. Lowo ulilayishayo uzizalisa ngesandla.
naming.unread.from: Not read from this name: {parts}. Whoever uploads it fills those in by hand.

naming.allRead.text: Yonke into ifundiwe. Ukulayisha okuthiwe ngolu hlobo kufika sele kuzaliswe.
naming.allRead.from: Everything was read. An upload named like this arrives already filled in.

tmpl.note.statement_of_results.text: Ithathwa kunye noxwebhu lwesazisi lomfundi kwiziko lovavanyo. Uyilo lwakho ukuba usete; ithemplethi ye-QCTO ngokwayo ibonisa oko enye ikuphethe.
tmpl.note.statement_of_results.from: Carried to the assessment centre with the learner's identity document. The layout is yours to set; the QCTO's own template shows what one carries.

tmpl.note.certificate.text: Oko umboneleli akukhupha ngenxa yeenkqubo zakhe. Isatifikethi sekhwalifikheyishini sivela kwi-QCTO, hayi apha.
tmpl.note.certificate.from: What the provider issues for its own programmes. A qualification certificate comes from the QCTO, not from here.

tmpl.note.workplace_statement.text: Oko umqeqeshi wasemsebenzini akusayinayo ukuqinisekisa amava umfundi awagqibileyo.
tmpl.note.workplace_statement.from: What a workplace coach signs to confirm the experience a learner completed.

tmpl.note.enrolment_form.text: Ifomu yobhaliso egqityiweyo, njengoxwebhu. Umbonisi we-QCTO angayicela xa etyelele, ngoko kufuneka ibekho ephepheni, hayi kuphela njengeskrini esizalisiwe ngumntu.
tmpl.note.enrolment_form.from: The completed enrolment form, as a document. A QCTO monitor may ask for it on a visit, so it has to exist on paper, not only as a screen somebody filled in.

tmpl.platform.text: Uyilo lwepleyithifomu ngokwayo. Akukho nto oyenzayo apha etshintsha uxwebhu esele lukhutshiwe.
tmpl.platform.from: The platform's own layout. Nothing you do here changes a document already issued.

tmpl.documentNote.text: Bhala ngoko ufuna ukuba kufundeke. Nantoni na ekwiibrakethi ezimbini iyatshintshwa ngeenkcukacha zomfundi ngokwakhe xa uxwebhu lwenziwa, kwaye izithuba zakho zigcinwa kanye njengoko uzibhale ngako.
tmpl.documentNote.from: Write it as you want it to read. Anything in double braces is replaced with the learner's own details when the document is produced, and your spacing is kept exactly as you type it.

tmpl.starterNote.text: Oku kukubhala kwepleyithifomu ngokwayo, ukuba uyinciphise ibe yeyakho.
tmpl.starterNote.from: This is the platform's own wording, for you to cut down into yours.

tmpl.goBack.from: Go back to the platform's own layout

tmpl.fields.from: What you can put in it

tmpl.added.text: Oko ipleyithifomu ikongezayo, nokuba ithemplethi yakho ithini
tmpl.added.from: What the platform adds, whatever your template says

tmpl.addedNote.text: Ezi ziprintwa emva kwethemplethi yakho. Aziyeyakho ukuzitshintsha kuba aziyeyakho: igunya elilawulayo liyazifuna, kwaye umfundi ophethe uxwebhu uxhomekeke ekubeni zichanekile. Akufuneki uzibhale kuguqulelo lwakho.
tmpl.addedNote.from: These are printed after your template. They are not yours to change because they are not yours: a regulator requires them, and a learner holding the document relies on them being true. You do not need to write them into your own version.

capture.intro.text: I-App ifunda oko inokukwazi, ikubonisa oko ikwenze, nalapho ingakwazanga ukukwenza, kwaye ilinda. Akukho nto ibalwa njengovavanyo de uyiqinisekise.
capture.intro.from: The App reads what it can, shows you what it made of it and what it could not work out, and waits. Nothing becomes an assessment until you confirm it.

capture.fromFolder.text: Ukuba incwadi yokusebenza ifike nefolda, sele ikho apha: {link} uze uyithathe kwiifayile ezifayiliweyo. Akukho kulayisha okwesibini, kwaye isikhokelo seempendulo siyabekwa ndawonye kuwe. Sebenzisa ifomu engezantsi kuphela xa iphepha ipleyithifomu ingenalo.
capture.fromFolder.from: If the workbook came in with a folder, it is already here: {link} and capture it from what is filed. There is no second upload, and the answer guide is paired for you. Use the form below only for a paper the platform does not already hold.

capture.changeNaming.text: Tshintsha indlela amagama eefayile afundwa ngayo

capture.noneNote.text: Vula ikhwalifikheyishini uthathe iincwadi zokusebenza sele zifayilwe ngokuchasene nayo, okanye ulayishe enye ngasentla. Oko i-App ikufundayo kubonakaliswa kuwe ngaphambi kokuba nayiphi na yayo ibe luvavanyo.
capture.noneNote.from: Open a qualification and capture the workbooks already filed against it, or upload one above. What the App reads is shown to you before any of it becomes an assessment.

capture.committedOn.text: Kuqinisekisiwe ngo-{date}. Ukulayisha kuqinisekiswa kanye; layisha uxwebhu kwakhona ukwenza elinye iphepha kulo.
capture.committedOn.from: Committed on {date}. An upload is committed once; upload the document again to make another paper from it.

capture.which.from: Which qualification is this material for?

capture.guideNote.text: Ngaphandle kwaso, akukho mpendulo ichanekileyo, manqaku okanye migangatho enokufundwa.
capture.guideNote.from: Without it, no correct answers, marks or criteria can be read.

capture.ready.text: Ilungile. Iimodyuli ezi-{modules} nemigangatho yovavanyo emi-{criteria} ingenile, ngoko imibuzo inokudityaniswa noko iyingqinayo.
capture.ready.from: Ready. {modules} modules and {criteria} assessment criteria are in, so questions can be linked to what they evidence.

capture.notReady.from: This qualification is not ready for material yet.

capture.notReadyNote.text: Yenza ezi kuqala, ngolu landelelwano. Ngaphambi kokuba zenziwe, umbuzo awunakutyagwa kuko ukuyingqinayo, kwaye ukulungisa oko kamva kuthetha ukuphinda utyage nganye ngesandla.
capture.notReadyNote.from: Do these first, in this order. Until they are done a question cannot be tagged to what it evidences, and putting that right later means re-tagging every one of them by hand.

capture.whereDocuments.from: Documents are uploaded on the qualification's own page.

capture.original.text: Eyoqobo igcinwa kwaye ithathwe iminwe, ngoko umbuzo osempikiswaneni usonjululwa ngokuchasene noxwebhu kunokuba ube ngokuchasene nokufundwa kwalo.
capture.original.from: The original is kept and hashed, so a question in dispute is settled against the document rather than against this reading of it.

capture.committedLong.text: Oku kuqinisekiswe ngo-{date}. Ukulayisha kuqinisekiswa kanye; layisha uxwebhu kwakhona ukwenza elinye iphepha kulo.
capture.committedLong.from: This was committed on {date}. An upload is committed once; upload the document again to make another paper from it.

captureReview.noAnswer.text: “{stem}…” uhlolwa yi-App kodwa akanayo impendulo echanekileyo.
captureReview.noAnswer.from: “{stem}…” is marked by the App but has no correct answer.

captureReview.addsUp.text: “{section}” iprintwe njengamanqaku angama-{printed} kodwa imibuzo yayo iyaphela ibe ngama-{sum}.
captureReview.addsUp.from: “{section}” is printed as {printed} marks but its questions add up to {sum}.

captureReview.edited.text: Wenze ukulungisa. Oko kuqinisekiswayo yile nto ikwiskrini ngoku, hayi leyo yafundwa kwifayile.
captureReview.edited.from: You have made corrections. What gets committed is what is on this screen now, not what was read out of the file.

captureReview.summary.text: Imibuzo emi-{questions} · amanqaku angama-{marks} · {app} ihlolwa yi-App
captureReview.summary.from: {questions} questions · {marks} marks · {app} marked by the App

captureReview.unknownOne.text: I-{codes} ayingomgangatho kwikhwalifikheyishini le, ngoko ayiyi kudityaniswa. Lungisa iikhowudi ezingentla ukuba le yimpazamo yokuchwetha.
captureReview.unknownOne.from: {codes} is not a criterion on this qualification, so it will not be linked. Correct the codes above if that is a typo.

captureReview.unknown.text: I-{codes} ayingomigangatho kwikhwalifikheyishini le, ngoko ayiyi kudityaniswa. Lungisa iikhowudi ezingentla ukuba le yimpazamo yokuchwetha.
captureReview.unknown.from: {codes} are not criteria on this qualification, so they will not be linked. Correct the codes above if that is a typo.

captureReview.acknowledgeOne.text: Ndiwufundile umba o-1 osaseleyo ongentla kwaye ndifuna ukuqinisekisa nokuba kunjalo. Oku kurekhodwa ngegama lam.
captureReview.acknowledgeOne.from: I have read the 1 outstanding item above and want to commit anyway. This is recorded against my name.

captureReview.acknowledge.text: Ndiwufundile imiba esele emi-{count} ongentla kwaye ndifuna ukuqinisekisa nokuba kunjalo. Oku kurekhodwa ngegama lam.
captureReview.acknowledge.from: I have read the {count} outstanding items above and want to commit anyway. This is recorded against my name.

captureReview.responsibility.text: Ukuqinisekisa kwamkela uxanduva lwempendulo nganye echanekileyo kweli phepha. Igama lakho lihlala kulo.
captureReview.responsibility.from: Confirming accepts responsibility for every correct answer in this paper. Your name stays on it.

captureReview.swapped.from: The paper and the guide look swapped

captureReview.swappedNote.text: Akukho nto enye edweliswe, kuba yonke enye into ilandela kule. Qala kwakhona ngephepha lomfundi njengephepha nesikhokelo somvavanyi njengesikhokelo.
captureReview.swappedNote.from: Nothing else is listed, because everything else follows from this. Start again with the learner's paper as the paper and the assessor guide as the guide.

captureReview.fixNote.text: Lungisa ezi ngezantsi, okanye uzifunde uthi ufuna ukuqhubeka nangona kunjalo.
captureReview.fixNote.from: Correct these below, or read them and say you want to go on anyway.

captureReview.clearNote.text: Umbuzo wonke i-App eya kuwuhlola unempendulo, kwaye icandelo ngalinye liyaphela kwinto eliyiprintayo.
captureReview.clearNote.from: Every question the App will mark has an answer, and every section adds up to what it prints.

captureReview.materialNote.text: Uxwebhu lufundwe ngokuchanekileyo. Ezi zinto ngephepha ekunokugqiba ngazo umbhali walo kuphela.
captureReview.materialNote.from: The document was read correctly. These are things about the paper that only its author can decide.

imports.intro.text: Yonke ifolda efundiweyo, nento eyenziwe ngayo. Ukufunda entsha kuqala apho umsebenzi ukhona, kwikhwalifikheyishini, ikhosi okanye into oyakhayo, hayi apha.
imports.intro.from: Every folder that has been read, and what became of it. Reading a new one starts where the work is, on the qualification, course or material you are building, rather than here.

imports.noExtension.from: You have not set up an AI extension

imports.noExtensionNote.text: Ngokuzikhethela kwaye yeyakho kunokuba yeyomboneleli: ilungu ngalinye labasebenzi liseta eyalo, ngesabhaskripshini yalo.
imports.noExtensionNote.from: It is optional and yours rather than the tenant's: every member of staff sets up their own, with their own subscription.

imports.readNote.text: Kugcinwa nokuba kuqinisekisiwe okanye kulahliwe. Oko kucetyisiweyo kwaza kwaliwa yiyo indlela wonke umntu agweba ngayo ukuba ukufunda kufanele ukuthenjwa.
imports.readNote.from: Kept whether committed or discarded. What was proposed and then rejected is how anybody judges whether a reading is worth trusting.

imports.byPlatform.from: read by the platform, no AI involved

imports.backFolders.from: ← Back to the folders that have been read

imports.contentsNote.text: Yonke into efunyenwe, nento eyenziwe ngayo. Ii-PDF namaxwebhu eWord ziguqulwa ngesikhupheli esifanayo esisetyenziswa yonke enye indawo kwipleyithifomu, ukuze imodeli ifunde kanye oko Ukuthatha kwakuya kukufunda.
