imports.contentsNote.from: Everything found, and what was done with it. PDFs and Word documents are converted with the same extractor the rest of the platform uses, so the model reads exactly what Capture would.

imports.proposesNote.text: Yonke into kwindawo enye. Izilumkiso yinxalenye ebalulekileyo: zifunde ezo phambi kwayo nantoni na enye.
imports.proposesNote.from: Everything in one place. The warnings are the part that matters: read those before anything else.

proposal.fromBlueprint.text: Ifundwe kwifayile yeplani yefolda ngokwayo. Ubume obungezantsi yiyo kanye le fayile ekuthethayo: akukho nto ebicingelwe, kwaye akukho modeli ibuziwe.
proposal.fromBlueprint.from: Read from the folder's own blueprint file. The structure below is exactly what that file says: nothing was inferred, and no model was asked.

proposal.fromDocuments.text: Ifundwe emaxwebhini yimodeli. Yijonge ngokuchasene noxwebhu lwekharityhulam phambi kokuqinisekisa.
proposal.fromDocuments.from: Read from the documents by the model. Check it against the curriculum document before committing.

proposal.byName.text: Ifayiliwe ngegama. Akukho plani okanye imodeli ebandakanyekileyo: uxwebhu ngalunye lwaya apho igama lefayile yalo lithi lulo, kwaye ikharityhulam ayichukumisekanga.
proposal.byName.from: Filed by name. No blueprint and no model were involved: each document went where its filename says it belongs, and the curriculum is untouched.

proposal.unitsNamed.text: Iiyunithi zokufunda ezi-{count} zibizwa ngamagama eefayile zazo.
proposal.unitsNamed.from: {count} study units are named by their filenames.

proposal.nothingChanged.text: Akukho modyuli, sihloko okanye mgangatho ongezwayo okanye otshintshwayo kule nto.
proposal.nothingChanged.from: No module, topic or criterion is added or changed by this.

proposal.counts.text: Iimodyuli ezi-{modules}, izihloko ezi-{topics}, iinxalenye ezi-{elements}, imigangatho emi-{criteria}, iiyunithi zokufunda ezi-{units}, amaxwebhu angama-{documents}
proposal.counts.from: {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} elements, {criteria} criteria, {units} study units, {documents} documents

proposal.withheld.from: {withheld} withheld from learners, {visible} visible to them.

proposal.withheldNote.text: Iimemorandam, izikhokelo zeempendulo namaphepha okugqibela ayabanjelwa nabani na ongenalo ilungelo lokuvavanya.
proposal.withheldNote.from: Memoranda, answer guides and summative papers are withheld from anybody without the right to assess.

proposal.unknownOne.text: E-1 ayinakwazi kuqatshelwa kwigama layo yaye ifayilwe njengethi “enye”, ebonakala kumntu wonke.
proposal.unknownOne.from: 1 could not be recognised from its name and is filed as “other”, which is visible to everyone.

proposal.unknown.text: Ezi-{count} azinakwazi kuqatshelwa kumagama azo yaye zifayilwe njengethi “enye”, ebonakala kumntu wonke.
proposal.unknown.from: {count} could not be recognised from their names and are filed as “other”, which is visible to everyone.

proposal.unknownNote.text: Kufanelekile ukujonga ngezantsi phambi kokuqinisekisa: isikhokelo seempendulo esibizwa ngendlela le migaqo engayaziyo siya kuba apha.
proposal.unknownNote.from: Worth a look below before committing: an answer guide named in a way these rules do not know would be here.

proposal.orAdd.text: Okanye yongeze kwenye esele ikho apha
proposal.orAdd.from: Or add it to one already here

proposal.addNote.text: Ukuyongeza kwenye esele ikho apha kushiya yonke into ekhoyo ingachukunyiswanga yaye kufaka kuphela oko kusilelayo.
proposal.addNote.from: Adding it to one already here leaves everything that is there untouched and puts in only what is missing.

proposal.topUp.text: Kongezwe kwikhwalifikheyishini oqale kuyo. Uluhlu olungentla yiyo yonke into ekwifolda, hayi yonke into eya kudalwa: nantoni na esele ikho apha ishiywa kanye njengoko injalo, kwaye kongezwa kuphela oko kusilelayo. Uxelelwa emva koko ukuba zeziphi iimodyuli ebezisele zibanjiwe.
proposal.topUp.from: Added to the qualification you started from. The list above is everything the folder holds, not everything that will be created: whatever is already here is left exactly as it is, and only what is missing is added. You are told afterwards which modules were already held.

proposal.filedCourse.from: Filed against the course you started from.

proposal.filedProgramme.from: Filed against the programme you started from.

proposal.filedQualification.from: Filed against the qualification you started from.

proposal.checks.text: Yonke into engentla ingena kanye, ngeendlela zokujonga ezifanayo ezisebenza kuyo nayiphi na into eyakhiwe ngesandla. Nantoni na ezo ndlela zokujonga ziyilelayo iyaxelwa kunokuba ishiywe ngokuthe cwaka.
proposal.checks.from: Everything above goes in at once, through the same checks that apply to anything built by hand. Whatever those checks turn away is reported rather than skipped quietly.

proposal.discardNote.text: Igcinwe kwirekhodi. Oko kucetyisiweyo kwaza kwaliwa yiyo indlela wonke umntu agweba ngayo ukuba isandiso sifanelekile ukuba nalo.
proposal.discardNote.from: Kept on the record. What was proposed and rejected is how anybody judges whether the extension is worth having.

reports.programme.text: Inkqubo ngokwayo: oko kungavavanywa yanto, nemibuzo engasebenziyo
reports.programme.from: The programme itself: what nothing tests, which questions are not working

reports.coverageNote.text: Kubalwa kwizatifikethi, hayi ekugqityweni kweekhosi. Ukugqitywa kuthetha ukuba umntu ufike ekupheleni kwezinto zokufunda; isatifikethi sithetha ukuba kwenziwe isigwebo yaye, apho kufunwa khona, sihlolwe ngokuzimeleyo.
reports.coverageNote.from: Counted from certificates, not course completions. A completion means somebody reached the end of the material; a certificate means a judgement was made and, where required, independently moderated.

reports.singleNote.text: Iphethwe ngumntu omnye kuphela: {codes}. Ukuba lo mntu uyemka, isakhono siyemka naye.
reports.singleNote.from: Held by one person only: {codes}. If that person leaves, the capability goes with them.

reports.nobodyEnrolled.text: Akukho namnye obhalisiweyo kuyo nayiphi na okwangoku.
reports.nobodyEnrolled.from: Nobody is enrolled on anything yet.

progReport.intro.text: Imibuzo emibini ebonakala ngathi ingabafundi kodwa ayiyiyo: oko akukho nto ikuvavanyayo, nemibuzo engasebenziyo.
progReport.intro.from: Two questions that look like they are about learners and are not: what nothing assesses, and which questions are not working.

progReport.untestedNote.text: Umgangatho ongavavanywa ngumbuzo wovavanyo lokugqibela awunakuphunyezwa ngumntu, nokuba usebenza kakuhle kangakanani. Uvimba wonke umfundi kwikhwalifikheyishini, kwaye akukho nto enye kwipleyithifomu ekuxelayo oko.
progReport.untestedNote.from: A criterion no summative question assesses cannot be achieved by anybody, however well they do. It holds up every learner on the qualification, and nothing else in the platform says so.

progReport.noCriteria.text: Le khwalifikheyishini ayinayo imigangatho yovavanyo ethathiweyo okwangoku.
progReport.noCriteria.from: This qualification has no assessment criteria captured yet.

progReport.allTested.text: Yonke eyi-{count} yemigangatho ivavanywa ubuncinane ngumbuzo omnye wovavanyo lokugqibela.
progReport.allTested.from: Every one of the {count} criteria is tested by at least one summative question.

progReport.someUntested.text: {untested} kwezi-{count} zemigangatho azivavanywa nangumbuzo wovavanyo lokugqibela.
progReport.someUntested.from: {untested} of {count} criteria are not tested by any summative question.

progReport.misleading.text: {count} kuzo zibonakala kwincwadi yokusebenza, eyophuhliso kwaye ayingqini nto.
progReport.misleading.from: {count} of those appear in a workbook, which is developmental and evidences nothing.

progReport.questionsNote.text: Iinzame zokuqala kuphela, kuba ukuphinda uhlale kulinganisa into eyahlukileyo. Akukho nto ephawulwayo ngaphantsi kweenzame ezi-{minimum}: umbuzo ophendulwe ngabantu ababini uxelela ngaba bantu babini kuphela.
progReport.questionsNote.from: First attempts only, because a re-sit measures something else. Nothing is flagged below {minimum} attempts: a question two people have answered tells you about those two people.

progReport.noQuestions.from: That assessment has no questions yet.

progReport.worthLook.from: {flagged} of {count} questions are worth a look.

progReport.nobody.text: Phantse akukho namnye unokuwuphendula lo. Nokuba umbuzo awucacanga okanye oko uwuvavanyayo akuzange kufundiswe.
progReport.nobody.from: Almost nobody can answer this. Either the question is unclear or what it tests was never taught.

progReport.everybody.text: Wonke umntu ufumana amanqaku apheleleyo, ngoko akwahlula nto.
progReport.everybody.from: Everybody gets full marks, so it distinguishes nothing.

statutory.intro.text: Ukubuya kweSiseko Sedatha Sezinto Zokufunda Zabafundi Zikazwelonke ze-SAQA, kunye neSicwangciso Sezakhono Zasemsebenzini neNgxelo Yonyaka Yoqeqesho. Yonke into ijongwa apha phambi kokuba ihambe naphi, kuba ukubuya okwaliweyo ngenxa yenombolo yesazisi echwetheke gwenxa kubiza umjikelo opheleleyo.
statutory.intro.from: The SAQA National Learners' Records Database return, and the Workplace Skills Plan and Annual Training Report. Everything is checked here before it goes anywhere, because a return rejected for a mistyped identity number costs a full cycle.

statutory.locked.text: Iifayile zihlala zitshixiwe de kulungiswe iingxaki ezivalayo ezingezantsi. Ukungenisa imbuyekezo eya kwaliwa kuchitha umjikelo kumfundi ngamnye okuyo.
statutory.locked.from: The files stay locked until the blocking problems below are fixed. Submitting a return that will be rejected wastes a cycle for every learner in it.

statutory.worthFixingNote.text: Ezi azithinteli imbuyekezo, kodwa i-NLRD iphawula iinkcukacha zabantu ezingaphelelanga kwaye i-SETA inokuzibuza.
statutory.worthFixingNote.from: These do not stop the return, but the NLRD flags incomplete demographic data and a SETA may query it.

statutory.wsp.text: Icebo lezakhono zasemsebenzini nengxelo yonyaka yoqeqesho
statutory.wsp.from: Workplace Skills Plan and Annual Training Report

statutory.wspNote.text: Umsebenzi woqeqesho ngokwemisebenzi, njengoko imbuyekezo ye-SETA icwangciswe ngayo.
statutory.wspNote.from: Training activity by occupation, as a SETA return is organised.

statutory.noOfoOne.text: Umntu o-1 akanayo ikhowudi ye-OFO: {names}. Usabalwa, kodwa imbuyekezo ye-SETA iqokelela ngokwemisebenzi.
statutory.noOfoOne.from: 1 person has no OFO code: {names}. They are still counted, but a SETA return groups by occupation.

statutory.noOfo.text: Abantu aba-{count} abanayo ikhowudi ye-OFO: {names}. Basabalwa, kodwa imbuyekezo ye-SETA iqokelela ngokwemisebenzi.
statutory.noOfo.from: {count} people have no OFO code: {names}. They are still counted, but a SETA return groups by occupation.

statutory.mapping.text: Ukuhambelanisa iinkalo kulandela isikhokelo sokuvunywa (Umntu 27, Ukubhaliswa 28, Impumelelo 29, Umboneleli 30). Qinisekisa uyilo lwefayile ye-Edu.Dex ngokuchasene nomlinganiselo wangoku we-SAQA phambi kokungenisa ngokuthe ngqo.
statutory.mapping.from: Field mapping follows the accreditation framework (Person 27, Enrolment 28, Achievement 29, Provider 30). Confirm the exact Edu.Dex file layout against the current SAQA specification before a live submission.

enrolNotify.intro.text: I-QCTO kufuneka yaziswe ukuba aba bafundi babhaliswe, ngaphakathi kweentsuku zomsebenzi ezingamashumi amabini anamnye emva kwentshayelelo yekhwalifikheyishini neentsuku ezintlanu kwinkqubo yezakhono. Iiholide zikawonke-wonke aziqwalaselwa, kwaye ixesha liqala kumhla wentshayelelo, hayi ekubhalisweni okanye ekuhlawuleni.
enrolNotify.intro.from: The QCTO has to be told that these learners were enrolled, within twenty-one working days of induction for a qualification and five for a skills programme. Public holidays do not count, and the clock runs from the induction date rather than from enrolment or payment.

enrolNotify.overdueNote.text: Zingenise noko. Isaziso esiphuzileyo esinencazelo yingxaki eyahlukileyo kuneso singenzekanga.
enrolNotify.overdueNote.from: Still submit these. A late notification with an explanation is a different problem to one nobody made.

enrolNotify.soonNote.text: Iintsuku zomsebenzi ezintlanu okanye ngaphantsi ezishiyekileyo.
enrolNotify.soonNote.from: Five working days or fewer remaining.

enrolNotify.noInductionNote.text: Ixesha labo alikaqali, ngoko akukho mhla wokugqibela wokuxela. Beka umhla weseshoni yentshayelelo yeqela, okanye ubanike eyabo ngezantsi.
enrolNotify.noInductionNote.from: Their clock has not started, so there is no deadline to report. Date the cohort's induction session, or give them their own below.

enrolNotify.draftNote.text: Bonke abaye baba nentshayelelo ngosuku olunye bahamba kunye. Owongeneleyo emva kwexesha ufuna eyakhe.
enrolNotify.draftNote.from: Everybody inducted on the same day goes together. A late joiner needs their own.

enrolNotify.ownInductionNote.text: Umntu owongenele emva kokuba iqela liqalile unayo eyakhe intshayelelo, eyakhe ifomu yokubhaliswa neyakhe ingeniso.
enrolNotify.ownInductionNote.from: Somebody who joined after the cohort started has their own induction, their own enrolment form and their own submission.

enrolNotify.split.text: Oku kungeniswa kuquka inkqubo yezakhono nekhwalifikheyishini. Zisiwa kwiidilesi ezahlukeneyo, ngoko kufuneka kwahlulwe kuthunyelwe kabini.
enrolNotify.split.from: This submission covers both a skills programme and a qualification. They go to different addresses, so it has to be split and sent twice.

enrolNotify.askAck.text: Cela isiqinisekiso sokwamkelwa, uze uyirekhode apha xa ibuya.
enrolNotify.askAck.from: Ask for an acknowledgement, and record it here when it comes back.

enrolNotify.nobodyOutstanding.text: Akukho namnye ongekaziswa. Wonke umfundi onomhla wentshayelelo sele ekwaziswe.
enrolNotify.nobodyOutstanding.from: Nobody is outstanding. Every learner with an induction date has been notified about.

enrolNotify.clockFrom.from: The clock runs from this day.

enrolNotify.noneThatDay.text: Akukho namnye ongekaziswa ofumene intshayelelo ngalo mhla. Tshintsha umhla, okanye unike owongeneleyo emva kwexesha eyakhe intshayelelo ngezantsi.
enrolNotify.noneThatDay.from: Nobody outstanding was inducted on that date. Change the date, or give a late joiner their own induction below.

enrolNotify.nobodyWaiting.from: Nobody is waiting on an induction date.

paths.intro.text: Ezininzi ze-{courses} zidityaniswe kulandelelwano: umqeshwa omtsha {programme}, okanye ukuqaliswa kwesakhelo esipheleleyo sezakhono. Umfundi unikwa {course} elandelayo ngokuzenzekelayo xa egqiba leyo iyandulelayo.
paths.intro.from: Several {courses} chained into a sequence: a new starter {programme}, or a full competency framework roll-out. A learner is given the next {course} automatically as they finish the one before it.

paths.noneAuthor.text: {programme} idibanisa {courses} ngokulandelelana, ukuze umfundi anikwe elandelayo xa egqiba eyandulelayo. Yakha {courses} kuqala: {programme} luluhlu lwazo.
paths.noneAuthor.from: A {programme} chains {courses} into an order, so a learner is given the next one as they finish the one before. Build the {courses} first: a {programme} is a sequence of them.

paths.noneReader.text: Akukho ebisakhiwa okwangoku. Xa ikhona, {courses} oza kuzisebenzela ngokulandelelana iya kubonakala apha. Ukuyakha ngumsebenzi wombhali.
paths.noneReader.from: None has been built yet. When one has been, the {courses} you work through in order will be here. Building one is an author's job.

paths.empty.text: Akukho {courses} kuyo okwangoku: umfundi onikwe le {programme} akazi kufumana nto. Yivule ukongeza ezinye.
paths.empty.from: No {courses} in it yet: a learner given this {programme} would receive nothing. Open it to add some.

paths.folderNote.text: Khetha ifolda ekuhlala kuyo olu lwazi, kwaye yonke into ekuyo, kuquka iifolda ezingaphantsi, iyafundwa, ifayilwe kwaye ibhalelwe isalathiso. Uyabona oko iya kukufayila phambi kokuba kubhalwe nantoni na.
paths.folderNote.from: Choose the folder this material lives in and everything in it, including its subfolders, is read, filed and indexed. You see what it would file before anything is written.

paths.folderLabel.from: Its folder, from your own computer

paths.folderHint.text: Izikhokelo, iincwadi zomsebenzi, imigaqo-nkqubo neetemplethi ziyafayilwa kuyo kwaye umbhalo wazo ubhalelwa isalathiso ukuze zikwazi ukukhangelwa.
paths.folderHint.from: Guides, workbooks, policies and templates are filed against it and their text indexed so they can be searched.

paths.folderHint2.text: Ulwakhiwo alwenziwa apha: ubume bayo bakhiwa ngokongeza {courses} kuyo ngasentla. Oku kufayila oko iphethe kona.
paths.folderHint2.from: Structure is not created from here: its own shape is built by adding {courses} to it above. This files what it holds.

paths.drive.from: Or from a drive you have connected

paths.driveNote.text: Ifolda enye, ifundwa apho sele ikhona. Iphela kwindawo enye: isiphakamiso ekufuneka usijonge phambi kokuba kubhalwe nantoni na.
paths.driveNote.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

paths.noSteps.text: Akukho nto kuyo okwangoku. Zongeze ngokulandelelana ekufuneka abafundi bazithathe ngalo.
paths.noSteps.from: Nothing in it yet. Add them in the order learners should take them.

paths.opensFirst.text: Ivuleka kwakamsinya nje ukuba omnye ajoyine.
paths.opensFirst.from: Opens as soon as somebody joins.

paths.opensAfter.from: Opens when the step before it is finished.

paths.opensNow.from: Opens straight away, alongside the others.

paths.locked.from: Locked until the step before it is finished

paths.lockedNote.text: Susa uphawu ukuze ithathwe nangaliphi na ixesha.
paths.lockedNote.from: Untick for one that can be taken at any point.

paths.allIn.from: Everything published is already in it.

paths.published.text: Le ipapashiwe kwaye abantu bayiqhuba, ngoko amanyathelo ayo amiselwe. Ukutshintsha ulandelelwano phantsi komntu kwakuya kutshintsha oko sele ebekelwe ukuba akwenze.
paths.published.from: This is published and people are working through it, so its steps are fixed. Changing the order underneath somebody would alter what they had already been told to do.

paths.publishNote.text: Yonke into ekuyo kufuneka ipapashwe kuqala.
paths.publishNote.from: Everything in it has to be published first.

paths.firstOnly.text: Kuvuleka eyokuqala kuphela. Ezinye zifika njengoko nganye igqitywa.
paths.firstOnly.from: Only the first opens. The rest arrive as each is finished.

badges.intro.text: Ukuqatshelwa okufika ngosuku umsebenzi ugqitywa ngalo, hayi kwiinyanga kamva xa isatifikethi sangaphandle sifika. Ibheji ayiyo ikhwalifikheyishini kwaye ipleyithifomu ayiyivumeli ibonakale injalo: akukho sazisi se-SAQA, akukho khredithi, kwaye kukho iphepha lokuqinisekisa elithi ngokucacileyo ithini kwaye ayithini.
badges.intro.from: Recognition that arrives on the day the work is finished, rather than months later when the external certificate comes through. A badge is not a qualification and the platform never lets it look like one: no SAQA identifier, no credits, and a verification page that says plainly what it is and what it is not.

badges.target.default.text: Nantoni na, xa kungekho nto ithe ngqo isetiwe
badges.target.default.from: Anything, when nothing more specific is set

badges.nothingNote.text: Akukho bheji idizayiniweyo, ngoko ukugqiba ikhosi okanye ikhwalifikheyishini akunikezi nto okwangoku. Ukudizayina enye ngezantsi kwanele: qala ngebheji yomboneleli ngokwakhe ukuba awufuni eyahlukileyo kwinto nganye.
badges.nothingNote.from: No badge has been designed, so finishing a course or a qualification currently awards nothing. Designing one below is enough: start with the provider's own badge if you do not want a different one for each thing.

badges.legitimate.text: Oku ngukhetho olusemgaqweni, hayi impazamo. Ipleyithifomu ayiyi kuyila enye.
badges.legitimate.from: This is a legitimate choice rather than a fault. The platform will not invent one.

badges.kind.default.text: Nantoni na, xa kungekho nto ithe ngqo isetiwe
badges.kind.default.from: Anything, when nothing more specific is set

badges.designNote.text: Umbumbo, imibala emibini nophawu. Akukho nto yokulayisha kwaye akukho mntu wokumnika ingxelo.
badges.designNote.from: A shape, two colours and a symbol. Nothing to upload and nobody to brief.

badges.allHave.text: Yonke into sele inebheji. Yeka enye ukuze udizayine ibheji eyahlukileyo kwinto enye.
badges.allHave.from: Everything already has a badge. Retire one to design a different badge for the same thing.

badges.says.text: Oko ikuthethayo, kumfundi nakubani na amboniswa kuye (ukhetho)
badges.says.from: What it says, for the learner and anybody they show it to (optional)

badges.saysHint.text: Ugqibe imodyuli yezenzo yokusebenza emaphakadeni, kwavavanywa ngokuchasene nemigangatho yekharityhulam.
badges.saysHint.from: Completed the practical module on working at heights, assessed against the curriculum criteria.

badges.retireTitle.text: Yeka ukunikezela {name}. Wonke umntu onayo uyayigcina.
badges.retireTitle.from: Stop awarding {name}. Everybody who has it keeps it.

templates.intro.text: Amaxwebhu akhutshwa ngu-{name}. Indlela ngalinye elifundeka ngayo nelibonakala ngayo yeyakho: bhala eyakho inguqulo kwaye ipleyithifomu iyivelisa kuyo endaweni yoyilo layo. Oko umlawuli ekufunayo kongezwa emva kwakho kwaye akunakuhlelwa, kuba loo nxalenye ayisiyo yomboneleli ukuba ayitshintshe.
templates.intro.from: The documents {name} produces. How each one reads and looks is yours: write your own version and the platform produces it from that instead of its own layout. What a regulator requires is added after yours and cannot be edited, because that part is not the provider's to change.

templates.goesTo.statement_of_results.text: Umfundi, ophatha kwiziko lovavanyo kunye noxwebhu lwakhe lwesazisi.
templates.goesTo.statement_of_results.from: The learner, who carries it to the assessment centre with their identity document.

templates.goesTo.certificate.from: The learner, and whoever they show it to.

templates.goesTo.workplace_statement.text: Ifayile yomfundi, esayinwe ngumqeqeshi kumqeshi owamkelayo.
templates.goesTo.workplace_statement.from: The learner's file, signed by a coach at the host employer.

templates.goesTo.enrolment_form.text: Ifayilwa njengobungqina, kwaye inikwa umbukeli we-QCTO xa etyelele.
templates.goesTo.enrolment_form.from: Filed as evidence, and handed to a QCTO monitor on a visit.

templates.producesNote.text: Nantoni na engenayo inguqulo yakho isebenzisa uyilo lwepleyithifomu, oluluxwebhu olusebenzayo, hayi indawo yokubamba.
templates.producesNote.from: Anything without your own version uses the platform's layout, which is a working document rather than a placeholder.

templates.writeNote.text: Qala ngoyilo lwepleyithifomu uludibanisele libe lolwakho. Yonke inkalo enokuthwalwa lixwebhu ibhalwe ecaleni komhleli kunye nomzekelo wokwenene wokuba ibonakala njani.
templates.writeNote.from: Start from the platform's layout and edit it down into yours. Every field the document can carry is listed beside the editor with a real example of what it looks like.

templates.supplied.from: Documents you supply rather than lay out

templates.suppliedNote.text: Akuwo onke amaxwebhu ayitemplethi ezaliswa yipleyithifomu.
templates.suppliedNote.from: Not every document is a template the platform fills in.

templates.policiesNote.text: ileta yakho yokuvunywa, imigaqo-nkqubo nezivumelwano, zilayishiwe kwaye zigcinwe kunokuba ziveliswe.
templates.policiesNote.from: your accreditation letter, policies and agreements, uploaded and retained rather than generated.

templates.fisaNote.text: zibhalwe ngumvavanyi wakho ngokwakhe kwaye zihlolwe phambi kokuba mntu azihlale, ngoko zibhalwa kunokuba zenziwe ngetemplethi.
templates.fisaNote.from: written by your own examiner and moderated before anybody sits them, so they are authored rather than templated.

templates.curriculumNote.text: amaxwebhu ekhwalifikheyishini apapashiweyo ipleyithifomu iwafundayo ukwakha ikharityhulam.
templates.curriculumNote.from: the published qualification documents the platform reads to build a curriculum from.

tracker.all.from: Every cohort, including those finished and cancelled.

tracker.note.text: Ifundwa kwiirekhodi kunokugcinwa ngesandla, ngoko ayinakungavumelani nepleyithifomu eyixelayo.
tracker.note.from: Read from the records rather than kept by hand, so it cannot disagree with the platform it reports on.

tracker.none.text: Akukho maqela okwangoku. Iqela yinto apho ishedyuli, irejista nembuyekezo esemthethweni zixhomekeke khona.
tracker.none.from: No cohorts yet. A cohort is what a schedule, a register and a statutory return all hang from.

dictionary.intro.text: Intsingiselo esemiselweyo yegama ngalinye elisetyenziswa kule pleyithifomu, kumaxwebhu ayo nakwizinto zayo zokufunda. Into nganye ithi ngubani olilo igama. Apho igunya lilichaza, siliseyenzisa njengoko lenza kwaye igunya liyabizwa. Apho igama lelethu, singalitshintsha. Apho lisetyenziswa nje ngokuqhelekileyo, akufuneki litsalelwe ingqalelo njengesidingo.
dictionary.intro.from: The settled meaning of every term used across this platform, its documents and its learning material. Each entry says who owns the word. Where an authority defines it, we use it as they do and the body is named. Where the word is ours, we can change it. Where it is simply common usage, it should never be cited as a requirement.

dictionary.searchHint.from: A term, an abbreviation, or a word in a definition

dictionary.meaning.authority.text: Ichazwe ligunya. Yisebenzise njengoko lenza: ukutshintsha intsingiselo kubeka ukungeniswa emngciphekweni.
dictionary.meaning.authority.from: Defined by an authority. Use it as they do: changing the meaning puts a submission at risk.

dictionary.meaning.platform.text: Igama lale pleyithifomu ngokwayo. Kuthi ukulitshintsha; akukho gunya lililayo.
dictionary.meaning.platform.from: This platform's own word for it. Ours to change; no authority prescribes it.

dictionary.meaning.practice.text: Ukusetyenziswa okuqhelekileyo kwicandelo lonke, akukho namnini. Sukulicaphula njengesidingo.
dictionary.meaning.practice.from: Common usage across the sector, with no single owner. Do not cite it as a requirement.

dictionary.none.text: Akukho nto ihambelanayo. Ukuba igama alikho kwaye lelo sisebenzisa lona, lelapha: yithi, kwaye liya kongezwa kukhutshwa okulandelayo.
dictionary.none.from: Nothing matches. If a term is missing and it is one we use, it belongs here: say so and it will be added in the next release.

feedbackForm.intro.text: {cohort}. Iimpendulo zibikwa kunye neezabanye bonke, hayi enye enye. Ithatha imizuzu engaba mibini, kwaye yeyona nto iguqula indlela iqela elilandelayo eliqhutywa ngayo.
feedbackForm.intro.from: {cohort}. Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. It takes about two minutes, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

feedbackReport.ratingsNote.text: Umndilili ukusuka kwisi-1 (ndiyaphikisana kakhulu) ukuya kwesi-5 (ndiyavuma kakhulu). Umndilili weempendulo ezimbalwa yimo yokuziva, hayi umlinganiselo, ngoko inani libekwe ecaleni kwawo.
feedbackReport.ratingsNote.from: Mean of 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree). A mean over few answers is a mood, not a measurement, so the count is beside it.

feedbackReport.saidNote.text: Kubonakaliswa kunye ngaphandle kwamagama. Impendulo malunga nomququzeleli inyanisekile kuphela ukuba umfundi ukholelwa ukuba ayiyi kufundelwa yena enye enye.
feedbackReport.saidNote.from: Shown together and without names. Feedback about a facilitator is only honest if the learner believes it will not be read back to them one by one.

feedbackReport.outstandingNote.text: Yeyona ndawo kuphela ekubonakala kuyo igama. Ukubalandela kuyalifuna; iimpendulo ezingentla azilifuni.
feedbackReport.outstandingNote.from: The one place a name appears. Chasing needs them; the answers above do not.

conductPage.intro.text: Izikhalazo ezibekwe ngabafundi, nabani na irejista ithi uyekile ukuza. Imicimbi yezohlwayo ihlala kwiphepha lomfundi ngokwakhe, apho kukho ezinye iinkcukacha zerekhodi lakhe.
conductPage.intro.from: Grievances raised by learners, and anybody the register says has stopped turning up. Disciplinary matters sit on the learner's own page, where the rest of their record is.

conductPage.overdueNote.text: Isikhalazo siyamkelwa ngokusesikweni ngaphakathi kweentsuku zomsebenzi ezi-{days}. Ezi zigqithise loo xesha.
conductPage.overdueNote.from: A grievance is acknowledged within {days} working days. These are past that.

conductPage.grievancesNote.text: Zibekwa ngumfundi ngokuphathwa, iimeko, okanye nantoni na enye emchaphazelayo. Zigcinwa zahlukile kwizibheno, ezingomphumo kwaye ziya kumhloli.
conductPage.grievancesNote.from: Raised by a learner about treatment, conditions, or anything else affecting them. Kept apart from appeals, which are about a result and go to the moderator.

conductPage.abscondedNote.text: Iintsuku ezibini okanye ngaphezulu ezilandelelanayo zoqeqesho engekho engathethanga nto. Kufundwa kwirejista kunokugcinwa, ngoko ukulungisa uphawu kutshintsha impendulo ngoko nangoko. Ukungabikho okurekhodwe njengokuxolelwe kunxibelelwano, kwaye kuphula ulandelelwano.
conductPage.abscondedNote.from: Two or more consecutive training days absent with no word. Read off the register rather than stored, so correcting a mark changes the answer at once. An absence recorded as excused is communication, and breaks the run.

conductPage.nobody.text: Akukho namnye. Wonke umntu uyeza okanye utyhilile omnye isizathu.
conductPage.nobody.from: Nobody. Everybody is either turning up or has told somebody why not.

conductPage.actOn.text: Uluhlu lokwenza, ungasoze ube sisigqibo. Ukunxibelelana nomfundi, ukubhalela umxhasi nokukhupha isaziso sokuqukumbela zizinto eziyenziwa ngumntu.
conductPage.actOn.from: A list to act on, never a decision. Contacting the learner, writing to the sponsor and issuing a notice of intention to terminate are all things a person does.

grievance.decisionHint.text: Oko kufunyenwe nokuya kwenziwa. Oku kuya kumfundi ngokubhaliweyo.
grievance.decisionHint.from: What was found and what will be done. This goes to the learner in writing.

grievance.impartial.text: Umphandi kufuneka abe ngumntu ongachazwanga esikhalazweni. Ukumisela lowo umfundi akhalaze ngaye kuyaliwa, kuba “umntu ongathathi cala omisiweyo” yiyo into ethenjiswa yinkqubo, kwaye iveki enabasebenzi abambalwa yeyona xesha iphulwa ngalo.
grievance.impartial.from: The investigator must be somebody the grievance is not about. Naming one the learner has complained about is refused, because “a designated impartial person” is what the procedure promises and a short-staffed week is exactly when it gets broken.

access.deniedTitle.from: You do not have access to this

access.deniedNote.text: Ungenile, kodwa oku akukokwakho ukukubona: okanye kokomnye umntu, okanye kufuna indima i-akhawunti yakho engenayo. Ukuba ucinga ukuba akuchanekanga, cela umlawuli wakho ajonge.
access.deniedNote.from: You are signed in, but this is not yours to see: either it belongs to someone else, or it needs a role your account does not hold. If you think that is wrong, ask your administrator to check.

access.unknownTitle.from: This address is not in use

access.unknownNote.text: Akukho mbutho useteyo kule dilesi yewebhu, okanye ufikelelo lwawo lumiswe. Jonga idilesi oyinikwe, okanye qhagamshelana nalowo ulungiselele uqeqesho lwakho.
access.unknownNote.from: No organisation is set up at this web address, or its access has been suspended. Check the address you were given, or contact whoever arranged your training.

wpSetup.intro.text: Umfundi wenza amava omsebenzi kumqeshi, ebekwe esweni ngumntu ofunyanwa ngulo mqeshi. Isivumelwano sirekhoda ukuba ngubani lowo; incwadi yelogi irekhoda oko ikharityhulam ifuna ukuba akwenze.
wpSetup.intro.from: A learner does work experience at an employer, supervised by somebody that employer provides. The agreement records who that is; the logbook records what the curriculum requires them to do.

wpSetup.emptyOne.text: Imodyuli e-1 yamava omsebenzi ayinazimfuno ezithathiweyo.
wpSetup.emptyOne.from: 1 work experience module has no requirements captured.

wpSetup.empty.text: Iimodyuli ezi-{count} zamava omsebenzi azinazimfuno ezithathiweyo.
wpSetup.empty.from: {count} work experience modules have no requirements captured.

wpSetup.emptyNote.text: {codes}. Incwadi yelogi eyakhiwe kwimodyuli engenanto ayiyi kuqinisekisa nto, ngoko ayinakuvulwa de kungeniswe imisebenzi yasemsebenzini yekharityhulam, ulwazi lwasemsebenzini nobungqina obuxhasayo.
wpSetup.emptyNote.from: {codes}. A logbook built from an empty module would attest to nothing, so those cannot be opened until the curriculum's work activities, workplace knowledge and supporting evidence have been imported.

wpSetup.noCoaches.text: Akukho namnye ophethe indima yoMqeqeshi Wasemsebenzini okwangoku. Kuqala yongeza umongameli womfundi ngo-{people}: usebenzela umqeshi, hayi wena, kwaye uya kubona kuphela abafundi abachazwe kwizivumelwano zakhe.
wpSetup.noCoaches.from: Nobody holds the Workplace Coach role yet. Add the learner's supervisor through {people} first: they work for the employer, not for you, and they will only ever see the learners named on their own agreements.

wpSetup.ownCoach.text: Umfundi akanakuba ngumqeqeshi wakhe; ideyitha iyalile.
wpSetup.ownCoach.from: The learner cannot be their own coach; the database refuses it.

wpSetup.designationNote.text: Kurekhodwe kwisivumelwano njengoko sinjalo ngoku, ukuze ukusayina kuqhubeke kubonisa ukuba ngubani osayinileyo nakwisikhundla sini.
wpSetup.designationNote.from: Recorded on the agreement as it stands today, so the sign-off keeps saying who signed and in what capacity.

wpSetup.noAgreements.text: Akukho zivumelwano zasemsebenzini okwangoku. Dala esinye ngasentla kuqala: incwadi yelogi irekhoda umsebenzi owenziwe kumqeshi obizwa ngegama phantsi komqeqeshi obizwa ngegama, ngoko ayinakubakho ngaphandle kwesivumelwano.
wpSetup.noAgreements.from: No workplace agreements yet. Create one above first: a logbook records work done at a named employer under a named coach, so it cannot exist without one.

wpSetup.generated.text: Incwadi yelogi yenziwa kwimisebenzi yasemsebenzini, ulwazi lwasemsebenzini nobungqina obuxhasayo bekharityhulam ngokwayo, ngoko ayinakushiya sidingo.
wpSetup.generated.from: The logbook is generated from the curriculum's own work activities, workplace knowledge and supporting evidence, so it cannot omit a requirement.

enrolForm.intro.text: {provider} kufuneka ithumele ezi nkcukacha kwiBhunga lomgangatho lezorhwebo nemisebenzi xa ubhaliswa. Uninzi lwazo luyaziwa sele kwaye lubonakaliswe ngezantsi; eziseleyo zezo mntu angazaziyo ngaphandle kwakho. Unokugcina njengoko uqhubeka ubuye kuyo kamva.
enrolForm.intro.from: {provider} has to send these details to the Quality Council for Trades and Occupations when you are enrolled. Most of it is already known and shown below; the rest is what nobody can answer except you. You can save as you go and come back to it.

enrolForm.onRecordNote.text: Xelela umlungelelanisi wakho ukuba nakuphi apha akuchanekanga; akukokwakho ukukutshintsha apha.
enrolForm.onRecordNote.from: Tell your coordinator if any of this is wrong; it is not yours to change here.

enrolForm.doesNotAdd.from: Something here does not add up

enrolForm.idNote.text: Inombolo yesazisi yaseMzantsi Afrika iphethe umhla wokuzalwa nesini ngaphakathi kuyo, kwaye i-QCTO ijonga ukuba ziyavumelana. Ngokuqhelekileyo yimpazamo yenani elibhalwe kakubi. Umlungelelanisi wakho angayilungisa.
enrolForm.idNote.from: A South African identity number carries the date of birth and the gender inside it, and the QCTO checks that they agree. It is usually a mistyped digit. Your coordinator can correct it.

enrolForm.stillNote.text: Akukho nto elahlekayo ukuba uyeka phakathi. Le yile nto ebiya kulahleka kokungeniswa njengoko kunjalo.
enrolForm.stillNote.from: Nothing is lost if you stop partway. This is what would be missing from the submission as it stands.

enrolForm.completeNote.text: Yonke into efunwa kokungeniswa ikho apha.
enrolForm.completeNote.from: Everything the submission needs is here.

enrolForm.missingPrint.text: Iimpendulo ezi-{count} zisalahlekile, ngoko le fomu iya kuprintwa inezikhewu. Zidweliswe kwifomu ngokwayo.
enrolForm.missingPrint.from: {count} answers are still missing, so this form will print with blanks. They are listed on the form itself.

enrolForm.completePrint.text: Igqityiwe. Yiprinte, umfundi ayisayine, uze uyifayile.
enrolForm.completePrint.from: Complete. Print it, have the learner sign it, and file it.

enrolForm.titleHint.from: Mr, Ms, Dr, and so on.

enrolForm.middleHint.text: Ukuba unalo. Shiya ingenanto ukuba akunalo.
enrolForm.middleHint.from: If you have one. Leave it blank if not.

enrolForm.working.from: Are you working at the moment?

enrolForm.difficulty.from: How much difficulty does it cause?

enrolForm.difficultyHint.text: Iyabuzwa kuba ukukhubazeka kurekhodwe kwigama lakho. I-QCTO iyifuna kunye noko.
enrolForm.difficultyHint.from: Asked because a disability is recorded against your name. The QCTO requires it alongside.

enrolForm.noId.text: Ukuba awunayo inombolo yesazisi yaseMzantsi Afrika
enrolForm.noId.from: If you do not have a South African identity number

enrolForm.instead.from: What you are enrolled on instead

enrolForm.post.text: Apho iposi ikufikelela khona, ukuba ikwenye indawo
enrolForm.post.from: Where post reaches you, if it is somewhere else

enrolForm.provinceHint.text: Apho usebenza khona, ekungahlali kuyiyo apho uhlala khona.
enrolForm.provinceHint.from: Where you work, which is not always where you live.

enrolForm.statssaHint.text: Umlungelelanisi wakho angayikhangela le ukuba awuyazi.
enrolForm.statssaHint.from: Your coordinator can look this one up if you do not know it.

enrolForm.flcNote.text: Ifunekile kuphela kwikhwalifikheyishini yenqanaba le-NQF 3 okanye 4. Yishiye ingenanto ukuba akukho mntu okucele yona.
enrolForm.flcNote.from: Only needed on a qualification at NQF level 3 or 4. Leave it blank if nobody has asked you for it.

enrolForm.agreedOn.text: Ukuvumile ngo-{date}. Loo mhla yinxalenye yerekhodi kwaye awutshintshi ukuba uhlela le fomu.
enrolForm.agreedOn.from: You agreed on {date}. That date is part of the record and does not change if you edit this form.

enrolForm.agreedDate.text: Umhla ovuma ngawo urekhodwa, kuba imbuyekezo iwucela zombini.
enrolForm.agreedDate.from: The date you agree is recorded, because the return asks for both.

enrolForm.confirm.from: Save and confirm these are right

records.intro.text: Inkqubo yolawulo lomgangatho neemigaqo-nkqubo yayo, iileta zokuvunywa, iikontraka, namaxwebhu asemthethweni afana nencwadi yesikhokelo ye-PAIA: yonke into ephethwe ngumboneleli engeyiyo yomfundi omnye okanye yekhwalifikheyishini enye. Ukungenisa ifolda yekhwalifikheyishini kufayila apha ngokuzenzekelayo imigaqo-nkqubo yayo yolawulo lomgangatho.
records.intro.from: The Quality Management System and its policies, accreditation letters, contracts, and statutory documents like the PAIA manual: everything the provider holds that does not belong to one learner or one qualification. Importing a qualification folder files its QMS policies here automatically.

records.introManage.text: Ibonisa nokuba yintoni efikelele ekupheleni kwexesha layo lokugcinwa.
records.introManage.from: It also shows what has reached the end of its retention period.

records.expiringNote.text: Isatifikethi serhafu esiphelelweyo yinto engaqatshelwa mntu de kube yiveki ekufuneka kuyo.
records.expiringNote.from: An expired tax clearance is the kind of thing nobody notices until the week it is needed.

records.libraryNote.text: Iinguqulelo ezithatyathelwe indawo ziyagcinwa, kuba umgaqo-nkqubo obusebenza ngoMatshi yiwo ohlolwa luphicotho lukaMatshi.
records.libraryNote.from: Superseded versions are kept, because the policy that governed in March is the one an audit of March asks about.

records.nothingManage.text: Ileta yokuvunywa yeyona ifanele ukufakwa kuqala.
records.nothingManage.from: The accreditation letter is the one worth putting in first.

records.retentionNote.text: Kubalwa ukususela kumhla wokuqinisekiswa, ngaphezu kwexesha lokugcinwa kulo mbutho. Akukho nto apha efakwe kwi-archive okanye etshatyalalisiweyo: ipleyithifomu ithi yintoni efikelele ixesha kwaye umntu uyagqiba.
records.retentionNote.from: Counted from the certification date, over the retention period on this tenant. Nothing here has been archived or destroyed: the platform says what is due and a person decides.

records.registerNote.text: Yonke into egqityiweyo malunga nerekhodi eligqithise umhla walo, kunye nokuba ngubani ogqibe. Irekhodi elinyamalele ngokuthula libi ngaphezu kweligcinwe ixesha elide kakhulu.
records.registerNote.from: Everything decided about a record past its date, with who decided it. A record that quietly disappeared is worse than one kept too long.

records.replacesNote.text: Leyo ithatyathelwayo iyagcinwa kwaye iphawulwe njengethatyathelwe indawo. Umgaqo-nkqubo obusebenza ngoMatshi yiwo ohlolwa luphicotho lukaMatshi.
records.replacesNote.from: The one it replaces is kept and marked superseded. The policy that governed in March is what an audit of March asks about.

records.descriptionHint.from: What it is, if the title does not say

records.anybody.from: Anybody signed in may read this

records.anybodyNote.text: Kusebenza kumaxwebhu asemthethweni. Isikhokelo somfundi sihlala sibonakala kubafundi; imigaqo-nkqubo, iikontraka, ukuvunywa namaxwebhu okusebenza azibonakali.
records.anybodyNote.from: Applies to statutory documents. A learner guide is always shown to learners; policies, contracts, accreditation and operational documents never are.

records.archive.from: Archive: move it out of the way

offline.intro.text: Khuphela oko ukufunayo ngaphambi kokuba uphume. Nantoni na oyirekhodayo ngoxa ungekho igcinwa kule fowuni kwaye ithunyelwe emva xa unomqondiso okwesibini.
offline.intro.from: Download what you need before you go out. Anything you record while you are away is kept on this phone and sent back the next time you have a signal.

offline.takeNote.text: Khuphela oko ukufunayo ngaphambi kokuba uhambe. Akukho nto igcinwayo ongayicelanga.
offline.takeNote.from: Download what you need before you go. Nothing is kept that you did not ask for.

offline.nothingToStudy.text: Akunanto yokufunda okwangoku. Nantoni na obhaliswe kuyo ibonakala apha ukuze ukhuphele.
offline.nothingToStudy.from: You have nothing to study at the moment. Anything you are enrolled on appears here to download.

offline.recordNote.text: Isebenza ngaphandle komqondiso. Ilinda kule fowuni kwaye ihamba xa unomqondiso.
offline.recordNote.from: Works with no signal. It waits on this phone and goes when you next have one.

offline.waitingDecisionNote.text: Kukho into etshintshileyo ngoxa umfundi engekho. Akukho nto idityaniswe okanye ibhalwe ngaphezulu: kufuneka umntu akhethe.
offline.waitingDecisionNote.from: Something changed while the learner was away. Nothing has been merged or overwritten: somebody has to choose.

offline.bothDates.from: Recorded on the device {captured} · reached us {received}

offline.relaxedNote.text: Umsebenzi orekhodwe ngoxa le nkqubo yayivumela uvavanyo lokugqibela ukuba luthatyathwe ngaphandle komqondiso. Ukuba inkqubo iya kuvunywa kamva, lo msebenzi awuyi kuba nakukhuselwa emva kokuba wenziwe: oku luluhlu, ngoko sisigqibo kunokuba sisifumanisi kutyelelo lokubeka esweni.
offline.relaxedNote.from: Work recorded while this programme allowed summatives to be taken offline. If the programme is accredited later, that work does not become defensible retrospectively: this is the list, so it is a decision rather than a discovery at a monitoring visit.

offline.cannotHold.text: Le brawuza ayikwazi ukugcina izinto zokusetyenziswa ngaphandle komqondiso. Yonke into isasebenza ngokuqhelekileyo ngoxa uqhagamshelekile.
offline.cannotHold.from: This browser cannot hold material for use without a signal. Everything still works normally while you are connected.

offline.noSignal.from: No signal: showing what is held

offline.nothingHeld.text: Akukabanjwa nto. Vula iyunithi yokufunda ukhethe ukuyenza ifumaneke ngaphandle komqondiso ngaphambi kokuba uphume.
offline.nothingHeld.from: Nothing is held yet. Open a study unit and choose to make it available offline before you go out.

offline.ofQuota.from: of about {quota} this phone will allow

offline.keepNote.text: Icela ifowuni ukuba ingayicimi ngoxa ungekho.
offline.keepNote.from: Asks the phone not to clear it while you are away.

offline.noRoom.text: Akukho ndawo eyaneleyo kule fowuni. Susa kuqala into ebanjelwe enye iyunithi yokufunda: akukho nto ikhutshelweyo.
offline.noRoom.from: There is not enough room on this phone. Remove something held for another study unit first: nothing has been downloaded.

offline.onPhone.from: {label} is on this phone. You can read it with no signal.

offline.incomplete.text: Oko akukhuphelwanga ngokupheleleyo, ngoko akukho nxalenye igciniweyo. Zama kwakhona apho umqondiso ungcono.
offline.incomplete.from: That did not download completely, so none of it has been kept. Try again where the signal is better.

offline.released.from: {label} is no longer held. It freed up room on this phone.

offline.cannotKeep.text: Le brawuza ayikwazi ukugcina izinto zokusetyenziswa ngaphandle komqondiso.
offline.cannotKeep.from: This browser cannot keep material for use without a signal.

offline.pageOne.text: Ipheji e-1. Yikhuphele ngaphambi kokuba uphume.
offline.pageOne.from: 1 page. Download it before you go out.

offline.pages.text: Amaphepha ayi-{count}. Yikhuphele ngaphambi kokuba uphume.
offline.pages.from: {count} pages. Download it before you go out.

offline.writeFirst.text: Bhala inqaku okanye wongeze ifoto kuqala.
offline.writeFirst.from: Write a note or add a photograph first.

offline.willGo.text: Kurekhodwe kule fowuni. Iya kuthunyelwa xa unomqondiso.
offline.willGo.from: Recorded on this phone. It will go when you have a signal.

offline.whatYouDidHint.text: Ndihlole umgca wocingo ecaleni komda osempuma.
offline.whatYouDidHint.from: Inspected the fence line along the eastern boundary.

offline.shrunk.text: Yenziwe encinci ukugcina indawo: {from} → {to}. Isacaca ngokwaneleyo ukuba ivavanywe.
offline.shrunk.from: Made smaller to save room: {from} → {to}. Still clear enough to assess.

mailbox.empty.text: Akukabikho nto apha. Nantoni na ethunyelwe ku-{address} ifika kolu luhlu, kunye nezinto ezincanyathiselweyo ezigcinwa ngendlela enye njengobungqina bovavanyo.
mailbox.empty.from: Nothing here yet. Anything sent to {address} arrives in this list, with attachments stored the same way assessment evidence is.

mailbox.envelope.text: Iseva ethumelayo izichaze njengo-{address}, engeyiyo idilesi ekumgca othi Ukusuka. Kuqhelekile kwiilisti zeposi nakwiposi ehanjiswayo, kwaye yiyo nento ebonakala ngayo umthumeli wobuqhetseba.
mailbox.envelope.from: The sending server identified itself as {address}, which is not the address in the From line. Ordinary for mailing lists and forwarded mail, and also what a forged sender looks like.

mailbox.notSwitchedOn.text: Ukuthumela akukavulwa: akukho relay yeposi elungiselelweyo, ngoko umyalezo obhalwe apha awunakuphuma. Iimpendulo oziphumelayo zisafika ngokuqhelekileyo.
mailbox.notSwitchedOn.from: Sending is not switched on yet: no mail relay is configured, so a message written here could not leave the building. Replies you receive still arrive normally.

lrs.intro.text: Iirekhodi zabafundi bakho, zingena zize zisuke, njengeengxelo ze-xAPI: ifomati indawo yokugcina iirekhodi zokufunda nezinto ezininzi zokufunda ezitshintshiselana ngayo. Akukho nto apha itshintsha iziphumo zomfundi kule pleyithifomu.
lrs.intro.from: Your learners' records, in and out, as xAPI statements: the format learning record stores and most learning systems exchange. Nothing here changes a learner's results on this platform.

lrs.outNote.text: Ubhaliso ngalunye, isifundo esigqityiweyo, uvavanyo olwenziwe, isigqibo sokukwazi okanye sokungakakwazi, ikhosi egqityiweyo, ingxelo yeziphumo, isatifikethi, nesatifikethi sekhwalifikheyishini esifunyenweyo, nganye iyingxelo enye. Nganye igcina isazisi esifanayo rhoqo xa ukhupha, ngoko ukulayisha ukhupho ezimbini kwenye inkqubo akuphindi kubale imbali yabani na.
lrs.outNote.from: Every enrolment, lesson completed, assessment attempted, competent or not yet competent decision, course completed, statement of results, certificate, and qualification certificate received, one statement each. Each keeps the same identity every time you export, so loading two exports into another system does not double anybody's history.

lrs.downloadNote.text: Ifayile ibiza wonke umfundi kunye nedilesi yakhe ye-imeyile. Yigcine njengaso nasiphi na irekhodi lolwazi lobuqu.
lrs.downloadNote.from: The file names every learner and their email address. Keep it as you would any record of personal information.

lrs.store.text: Thumela iirekhodi kwindawo yakho yokugcina iirekhodi zokufunda
lrs.store.from: Send records to your own learning record store

lrs.storeNote.text: Ukuba unayo indawo yokugcina iirekhodi zokufunda, iqhagamshele apha kwaye irekhodi ngalinye ngasentla liya kuyo ngaphakathi kweyure yokwenzeka kwalo, ezenziwe kakade zisiya kuqala. Nganye ithunyelwa kanye; ingxelo esele ibanjwe yindawo iyashiywa njengoko injalo. Imfihlo yendawo iyatywinwa kule pleyithifomu, ayiboniswa kwakhona, kwaye iyalityalwa xa uqhawula.
lrs.storeNote.from: If you keep a learning record store, connect it here and every record above goes to it within the hour of happening, the ones already made first. Each is sent once; a statement the store already holds is left as it is. The store's secret is sealed on this platform, never shown again, and forgotten when you disconnect.

lrs.inNote.text: Ifayile yeengxelo ze-xAPI ezivela kwenye inkqubo: uluhlu lweengxelo, okanye oko indawo yokugcina iirekhodi zokufunda ikubuyisayo. Nganye ihambelaniswa nomfundi apha nge-imeyile kwaye ibonakaliswe kwirekhodi lakhe. Igcinwa njengokufunda okwenziwe kwenye indawo, ingaguqulwa ibe bubhaliso okanye umphumo apha, kuba akukho nto kuyo eyafundiswa okanye yavavanywa kule pleyithifomu.
lrs.inNote.from: A file of xAPI statements from another system: a list of statements, or what a learning record store returns. Each is matched to a learner here by email and shown on their record. It is kept as learning done elsewhere, not turned into an enrolment or a result here, because none of it was taught or assessed on this platform.

verifyPage.intro.text: Faka ireferensi eprintwe kwisatifikethi. Akukho akhawunti ifunekayo.
verifyPage.intro.from: Enter the reference printed on the certificate. No account is needed.

verifyPage.validStatementNote.text: Lo mfundi uphumelele yonke imigangatho yovavanyo lwangaphakathi kwikhwalifikheyishini engezantsi kwaye angabhalwa kuvavanyo lokugqibela oludityanisiweyo lwangaphandle.
verifyPage.validStatementNote.from: This learner has achieved every internal assessment criterion for the qualification below and may be entered for the External Integrated Summative Assessment.

verifyPage.doNotAccept.text: Ungawamkeli olu xwebhu. Qhagamshelana nomboneleli ochazwe kulo ukuba umfundi ucinga ukuba yimpazamo.
verifyPage.doNotAccept.from: Do not accept this document. Contact the provider named on it if the learner believes this is a mistake.

verifyPage.expiredNote.text: Ingxelo yeziphumo isebenza iminyaka emibini ukususela kumhla ekhutshwe ngawo. Le ikhutshwe ngo-{issued} kwaye yaphelelwa ngo-{expired}.
verifyPage.expiredNote.from: A Statement of Results is valid for two years from the date it was issued. This one was issued on {issued} and expired on {expired}.

verifyPage.expiredNote2.text: Akukho nto iphosakeleyo empumelelweni yomfundi: luxwebhu olugqithe ixesha. Umboneleli ochazwe kulo unokukhupha olusebenzayo.
verifyPage.expiredNote2.from: Nothing is wrong with the learner's achievement: it is the document that has run out. The provider named on it can issue a current one.

verifyPage.notFoundNote.text: Akukho satifikethi sinale referensi. Yijonge ngokuchasene noxwebhu: oonobumba nezinombolo I, L, O, U, 0 no-1 azisetyenziswa nakanye, ngoko elithi 1 ngu-7 okanye J, kwaye elithi O ngu-Q okanye D.
verifyPage.notFoundNote.from: No certificate carries that reference. Check it against the document: the characters I, L, O, U, 0 and 1 are never used, so a 1 is a 7 or a J, and an O is a Q or a D.

verifyPage.withdrawnDetail.text: Sikhutshelwe u-{holder} ngenxa ye-{title}, kwaye sarhoxiswa ngo-{date}.
verifyPage.withdrawnDetail.from: It was issued to {holder} for {title}, and withdrawn on {date}.

verifyPage.notRely.from: It should not be relied on.

verifyPage.badgeNote.text: Yirekhodi yomboneleli ngokwakhe yokuba umbanjeli ugqibe le modyuli yesifundo. Ayiyo ikhwalifikheyishini yesizwe, ayinakhredithi, kwaye ayinikezwa libhunga lomgangatho. Ikhwalifikheyishini iqinisekiswa ngereferensi yesatifikethi sayo.
verifyPage.badgeNote.from: This is a provider's own record that the holder completed this module of study. It is not a national qualification, carries no credits, and is not awarded by a quality council. A qualification is verified by its own certificate reference.

platformPage.intro.text: Yonke imbutho kwipleyithifomu. Ungabona ukuba nganye isebenzisa kangakanani kwaye ulawule ulungiselelo lwayo, kodwa hayi abafundi bayo, iikhosi okanye iirekhodi zovavanyo. Ukubamba inkqubo yomthengi akufani nokuba unelungelo lokuyifunda, kwaye ipleyithifomu iyakuphumeza oko kunokuba ixhomekeke ekuzibambeni.
platformPage.intro.from: Every organisation on the platform. You can see how much each is using and manage their configuration, but not their learners, courses or assessment records. Hosting a client's system is not the same as being entitled to read it, and the platform enforces that rather than relying on restraint.

platformPage.noAdminOne.text: Imbutho e-1 ayinaye umlawuli. Akukho mntu apho unokulawula inkqubo yabo.
platformPage.noAdminOne.from: 1 organisation has no administrator. Nobody there can manage their own system.

platformPage.noAdmin.text: Imibutho eyi-{count} ayinaye umlawuli. Akukho mntu apho unokulawula inkqubo yabo.
platformPage.noAdmin.from: {count} organisations have no administrator. Nobody there can manage their own system.

newTenant.intro.text: Idala imbutho nomlawuli wayo wokuqala kunye. Umthengi ongenamlawuli akanakunikezelwa, ngoko ipleyithifomu ayikuvumeli ukwenza omnye.
newTenant.intro.from: Creates the organisation and its first administrator together. A client without an administrator cannot be handed over, so the platform does not let you make one.

folderPick.notOn.from: Yours is not switched on for this sitting. Switch it on below, or use the documents route instead: that needs no AI at all and reads the whole curriculum.

folderPick.blueprint.from: A folder produced by a programme development system includes a summary of itself (a {file}), and one of those imports here in seconds with no extension involved.

folderPick.notSaved.from: Nothing is saved until you have checked it.

folderPick.stillReading.from: Still reading: {seconds} seconds so far. A curriculum document takes a few minutes.

folderPick.stillGoing.from: Still going: {minutes} min {seconds}s. This is normal for a large folder; leave the page open.

folderPick.onTitle.text: Isandiso sakho se-AI sivuliwe kule seshoni.
folderPick.onTitle.from: Your AI extension is on for this sitting.

folderPick.onNote.text: Ifolda engaquki isishwankathelo saso ngokwaso iya kuba nolwakhiwo lwayo lucaciswe kumaxwebhu endaweni yoko: kucotha, kwaye kufanele ukujongwa ngokuchasene noxwebhu lwekharityhulam. Sicime xa ugqibile ngaso.
folderPick.onNote.from: A folder that does not include a summary of itself will have its structure worked out from the documents instead: slower, and worth checking against the curriculum document. Switch it off when you are done with it.

folderPick.noneTitle.from: You do not have an AI extension set up.

folderPick.noneNote.text: Songeza into enye apha: ukucacisa ulwakhiwo kumaxwebhu, xa ifolda ingaquki isishwankathelo saso ngokwaso. Yonke enye into kweli phepha isebenza ngaphandle kwaso. Useto, phantsi kwesandiso sakho se-AI, ukuba ufuna esinye.
folderPick.noneNote.from: It adds one thing here: working out the structure from the documents, when a folder does not include a summary of itself. Everything else on this page works without it. Settings, under your AI extension, if you want one.

folderPick.cannotTitle.text: Isandiso sakho se-AI asikwazi ukusebenza apha.
folderPick.cannotTitle.from: Your AI extension cannot run here.

folderPick.cannotNote.text: Ifolda equka isishwankathelo saso ngokwaso isangeniswa ngokuqhelekileyo; leyo ingenaso ayinakuba nolwakhiwo lwayo lucaciswe.
folderPick.cannotNote.from: A folder that includes a summary of itself still imports normally; one without it cannot have its structure worked out.

folderPick.offTitle.text: Isandiso sakho se-AI sivaliwe, okuyindlela zonke iiseshoni eziqala ngayo.
folderPick.offTitle.from: Your AI extension is off, which is how every sitting starts.

folderPick.offNote.text: Songeza into enye apha: ukucacisa ulwakhiwo kumaxwebhu, xa ifolda ingaquki isishwankathelo saso ngokwaso. Yonke enye into kweli phepha isebenza ngaphandle kwaso.
folderPick.offNote.from: It adds one thing here: working out the structure from the documents, when a folder does not include a summary of itself. Everything else on this page works without it.

said.alignment-document.c3e49767.text: Akukho ziyunithi zokufunda zifunyenweyo kolo xwebhu. Isihloko esinye kufuneka sifundeke ngathi “Study Unit 1 – Organisational Architecture”, kunye neemodyuli ezigubungelayo ziludwe phantsi kwaso.
said.alignment-document.c3e49767.from: No study units were found in that document. One heading has to read like “Study Unit 1 – Organisational Architecture”, with the modules it covers listed under it.

said.alignment-matrix.185b0901.text: Akukho matriki yokulinganisa ifunyenweyo kule ncwadi yomsebenzi. Ikholam enye kufuneka ibe nesihloko esifana ne-“Topic Elements”, ukuze imigca ihambelaniswe nekharityhulam.
said.alignment-matrix.185b0901.from: No alignment matrix found in this workbook. One column must be headed something like “Topic Elements”, so the rows can be matched to the curriculum.

said.alignment-matrix.2b19415b.text: Loo luxwebhu lwe-Word. Uxwebhu ngokwalo lugciniwe, lufayiliwe kwaye lunokukhangelwa. Into engenzekanga kukuluqonda, kuba imatriki yokulinganisa ifundwa njengesipredishithi: umgca omnye ngomgca wekharityhulam nganye, kunye nekholam enesihloko esifana ne-“Topic Elements”. Gcina imatriki njengesipredishithi uyilayishe nayo, kwaye umgca ngamnye wekharityhulam uya kubonisa oko kuwugubungela.
said.alignment-matrix.2b19415b.from: That is a Word document. The document itself is kept, filed and searchable. What could not happen is reading it, because the alignment matrix is read as a spreadsheet: one row per curriculum line, with a column headed something like “Topic Elements”. Save the matrix as a spreadsheet and upload that as well, and each line of the curriculum will show what covers it.

said.alignment-matrix.a0d14e78.text: Imatriki ayinazo iikholam zezixhobo ezinokuqatshelwa: akukho nto ibekwe isihloko esithi Workbook, Assessment, Theory Guide, Legislation njalo njalo.
said.alignment-matrix.a0d14e78.from: The matrix has no resource columns that could be recognised: nothing headed Workbook, Assessment, Theory Guide, Legislation and so on.

said.alignment-matrix.a8527ba8.text: Ngenisa uxwebhu lwekharityhulam phambi kwematriki yokulinganisa: akukho nto imigca yayo enokuncamathela kuyo okwangoku.
said.alignment-matrix.a8527ba8.from: Import the curriculum document before the alignment matrix: there is nothing yet for its rows to attach to.

said.alignment-matrix.cf20070f.from: In the matrix, not in the curriculum as read.

said.alignment-matrix.e1c0c850.text: Imatriki ithi ikharityhulam iyapapasha oku; ikharityhulam njengoko ifundiwe ayinako.
said.alignment-matrix.e1c0c850.from: The matrix says the curriculum publishes this; the curriculum as read does not have it.

said.already-competent.169da10a.from: You have already been found competent on this assessment, so there is nothing to sit again.

said.api-xapi-export.291c2b40.from: Only a provider administrator may export learning records.

said.appeals.00468b97.from: Give the date as a date.

said.appeals.08ac2d51.from: That could not be saved. Please try again.

said.appeals.0db8b611.text: Oku kugqithise umhla wokugqibela we-{deadline} ngeentsuku zomsebenzi ezi-{lateByWorkingDays}. Kusenokufakwa, kodwa chaza ukuba kutheni kwamkelwa emva kwexesha: oko kuchaza yinxalenye yerekhodi.
said.appeals.0db8b611.from: This is {lateByWorkingDays} working days past the deadline of {deadline}. It can still be lodged, but say why it is being accepted out of time: that reason is part of the record.

said.appeals.28f7ee35.text: Oku sele kwazisiwe ukwamkelwa. Ukwazisa kokuqala yikona kugcinwa lirekhodi.
said.appeals.28f7ee35.from: This was already acknowledged. The first acknowledgement is the one the record keeps.

said.appeals.3a9deae5.text: Esi sibheno sele sigqityiwe. Asinakurhoxiswa emva koko.
said.appeals.3a9deae5.from: This appeal is already resolved. It cannot be withdrawn afterwards.

said.appeals.44a8137a.text: Isibheno sesiphumo siya kumhloli wangaphakathi phambi kokuba sigqitywe. Rekhoda kuqala ukuba ubani obuziweyo.
said.appeals.44a8137a.from: A result appeal goes to the internal moderator before it is resolved. Record who was consulted first.

said.appeals.5e354d8e.from: Your role does not allow that.

said.appeals.73f8aadd.text: Isibheno sifakiwe. Ixesha lokwazisa ukwamkelwa liqala ngoku.
said.appeals.73f8aadd.from: Appeal lodged. The clock on acknowledging it starts now.

said.appeals.7caf07c2.text: Sigqityiwe. Xelela umfundi, uze urekhode ukuba wenzile.
said.appeals.7caf07c2.from: Resolved. Tell the learner, then record that you have.

said.appeals.86246d01.text: Chaza isizathu. Umphumo ongenasizathu awusosigqibo, kwaye yinxalenye umfundi anelungelo kuyo.
said.appeals.86246d01.from: Say why. An outcome with no reasoning is not a resolution, and it is the part the learner is entitled to.

said.appeals.8875be21.text: Chaza ukuba isiphumo singolwaphi uvavanyo. Isibheno sesiphumo esingachazi nayiphi na asinakuthunyelwa kumhloli.
said.appeals.8875be21.from: Say which assessment the result belongs to. A result appeal that does not name one cannot be sent to a moderator.

said.appeals.8904ae3b.text: Oku kugqithise umhla wokugqibela we-{deadline} ngosuku lomsebenzi olu-{lateByWorkingDays}. Kusenokufakwa, kodwa chaza ukuba kutheni kwamkelwa emva kwexesha: oko kuchaza yinxalenye yerekhodi.
said.appeals.8904ae3b.from: This is {lateByWorkingDays} working day past the deadline of {deadline}. It can still be lodged, but say why it is being accepted out of time: that reason is part of the record.

said.conduct.07e411c2.text: Chaza ukuba isikhalazo sinento yani, ngamagama omfundi ngokwakhe apho kunokwenzeka.
said.conduct.07e411c2.from: Say what the grievance is about, in the learner's own words where possible.

said.conduct.1636d693.text: Isikhalazo sibiza u-{firstName} {lastName}. Umntu ophathelele isikhalazo akakwazi ukusisebenzela: inkqubo icela umntu ongathathi hlangothi ochongiweyo. Chonga omnye umntu.
said.conduct.1636d693.from: The grievance names {firstName} {lastName}. Somebody the complaint is about cannot investigate it: the procedure asks for a designated impartial person. Appoint somebody else.

said.conduct.1d25ed57.text: Isaziso kufuneka sichaze izityholo ezithile. Ukuviwa kwetyala ngezityholo ezingachazwanga akunakuphendulwa.
said.conduct.1d25ed57.from: The notice has to state the specific allegations. A hearing about unstated allegations cannot be answered.

said.conduct.1e2d5837.text: Kurekhodiwe. Iintsuku ezintlanu zomsebenzi zokubhena ziqala namhlanje.
said.conduct.1e2d5837.from: Recorded. The five working days to appeal run from today.

said.conduct.303f7f08.text: Chaza ukuba zeziphi izohlwayo ezinokwenzeka, kubandakanya ukupheliswa apho kunjalo. Umfundi ogqiba ukuba makazise umntu omncedayo okanye hayi ufuna ukwazi ukuba yintoni esemngciphekweni.
said.conduct.303f7f08.from: Say what sanctions are possible, including termination where it is. A learner deciding whether to bring assistance needs to know what is at stake.

said.conduct.403b3f35.text: Chaza isizathu. Isohlwayo esingacacisiwe asikho ngqiqweni, kwaye lo ngumhlathi umfundi anelungelo lawo.
said.conduct.403b3f35.from: Say why. An unexplained sanction is indefensible, and this is the paragraph the learner is entitled to.

said.conduct.47a20502.text: Chaza umthetho owaphulwayo, umgangatho ololiweyo noko kwenzeka ukuba kuphinde kwenzeke. Isilumkiso esingenako oko asisilumkiso.
said.conduct.47a20502.from: State the rule broken, the standard expected and what happens if it recurs. A warning that does not is not one.

said.conduct.4dcaf05f.from: That is not a date and time.

said.conduct.64f7462f.text: Isaziso kufuneka sixelele umfundi ukuba angancediswa ngumfundi osebenza naye, abeke ityala lakhe, kwaye abize aze abuze amangqina. Thumela isaziso esenza oko, uze usirekhode apha.
said.conduct.64f7462f.from: The notice must tell the learner they may be assisted by a fellow learner, present their case, and call and question witnesses. Send a notice that does, then record it here.

said.conduct.67f9675a.text: Rekhoda oko kufunyenweyo nesiseko sako. Ukuviwa kwetyala okufumanisa kuyimigca emnye kukuviwa kwetyala okungazange kwenzeke.
said.conduct.67f9675a.from: Record what was found and on what basis. A hearing whose findings are one line is a hearing that did not happen.

said.conduct.6a6b5da7.from: It has to be acknowledged by {acknowledgeBy}.

said.conduct.6d857ec5.text: Ukuphelisa inkqubo yomntu kufuna ukuviwa kwetyala okwabanjwayo, nokufunyenweyo kurekhodiwe. Biza elinye, urekhode oko kufunyenweyo, uze uvale ityala.
said.conduct.6d857ec5.from: Ending somebody's programme needs a hearing that was held, with its findings recorded. Convene one, record what was found, then close the case.

said.conduct.77c80d2a.text: Kufakiwe. Kuya kwamkelwa ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezimbini zomsebenzi.
said.conduct.77c80d2a.from: Lodged. It will be acknowledged within two working days.

said.conduct.869c74ee.text: Ukuviwa kwetyala kufuna isaziso seeyure ezingama-{HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} ubuncinane, kwaye oku kusweleka ngeeyure ezi-{hours}. Ixesha lokuqala elinokubanjwa ngalo yi-{earliest}. Isaziso esifutshane sisiphene esiphumeza ngaso isibheno, nokuba umfundi wenze ntoni.
said.conduct.869c74ee.from: A hearing needs at least {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} hours' notice and this is {hours} hour short. The earliest it can be held is {earliest}. Short notice is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

said.conduct.8d0ef3ad.text: Ukuviwa kwetyala kubiziwe. Ixesha lesaziso lifikelelwe.
said.conduct.8d0ef3ad.from: Hearing convened. The notice period is met.

said.conduct.9f172fca.from: The learner cannot investigate their own grievance.

said.conduct.ad753d2e.text: Isigqibo siya kumfundi ngokubhaliweyo kwaye kufuneka sichaze oko kufunyenweyo nokuza kwenziwa. Umgca awusosigqibo.
said.conduct.ad753d2e.from: The decision goes to the learner in writing and has to say what was found and what will be done. A line is not a decision.

said.conduct.b0301d88.text: Chaza ngokuthe ngqo oko kutyholwayo. Umfundi akanakuphendula ku-'ukungabi nesimo esifanelekileyo', kwaye nokuviwa kwetyala akunako.
said.conduct.b0301d88.from: Say what is alleged, specifically. A learner cannot answer 'poor attitude', and neither can a hearing.

said.conduct.b0dcbd53.from: Decided, and the learner has it in writing.

said.conduct.cf47131c.text: Kuvaliwe. Nika umfundi isiphumo ngokubhaliweyo, uze urekhode ukuba wenzile.
said.conduct.cf47131c.from: Closed. Give the learner the outcome in writing, then record that you have.

said.conduct.e83b2265.text: Ukuviwa kwetyala kufuna isaziso seeyure ezingama-{HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} ubuncinane, kwaye oku kusweleka ngeeyure ezi-{hours}. Ixesha lokuqala elinokubanjwa ngalo yi-{earliest}. Isaziso esifutshane sisiphene esiphumeza ngaso isibheno, nokuba umfundi wenze ntoni.
said.conduct.e83b2265.from: A hearing needs at least {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} hours' notice and this is {hours} hours short. The earliest it can be held is {earliest}. Short notice is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.
