said.drive-google-drive.3ad31c62.text: I-Google ayisayamkeli loo nkqubo yokuqhagamshela. Isenokuba irhoxisiwe kwi-akhawunti yakho ye-Google. Qhagamshela idrive kwakhona kuSeto.
said.drive-google-drive.3ad31c62.from: Google no longer accepts that connection. It may have been withdrawn from your Google account. Connect the drive again in Settings.

said.drive-google-drive.8761e449.text: Loo folda ayikho, okanye i-akhawunti oyiqhagamshelileyo ayikwazi ukuyibona. Ifolda yabelwe wena kufuneka ivulwe kwi-Drive kanye ubuncinane phambi kokuba ifundwe.
said.drive-google-drive.8761e449.from: That folder is not there, or the account you connected cannot see it. A folder shared with you has to be opened in Drive at least once before it can be read.

said.drive-google-drive.b744db3d.text: I-Google iwaliile loo mfuno. Ukuba ikhankanya ikhwota, umda we-Drive API wokuhanjiswa ufikelelwe okwangoku. {message}
said.drive-google-drive.b744db3d.from: Google refused that request. If it mentions a quota, the deployment's Drive API limit has been reached for now. {message}

said.drive-google-drive.c0c95fa0.text: I-Google ayibuyisanga ndlela yokuvuselela uqhagamshelo, oko kuqhelekile ukuthetha ukuba le akhawunti ibisele iyivumile. Susa ukufikelela kwepleyithifomu kwi-akhawunti yakho ye-Google phantsi kweeapps zabantu abathile, uze uqhagamshele kwakhona.
said.drive-google-drive.c0c95fa0.from: Google did not return a way to renew the connection, which usually means this account had already granted it. Remove the platform's access in your Google account under Third-party apps, then connect again.

said.drive-google-drive.dcf45956.text: "{name}" inkulu kakhulu ukuba i-Google iyithumele ngaphandle isonke. Khuphela olo xwebhu lunye kwi-Drive njenge-{extension} uze ulongeze ngokwalo emva koko; yonke enye into kwifolda ifundeka ngokuqhelekileyo.
said.drive-google-drive.dcf45956.from: "{name}" is too large for Google to export in one piece. Download that one document from Drive as {extension} and add it on its own afterwards; everything else in the folder reads normally.

said.drive-google-drive.e9fe6eee.text: Funda ifolda ngqo kwi-Google Drive yakho. Ukufunda kuphela: ipleyithifomu inokuyidwelisa ize ikhuphele, kodwa ayikwazi ukudala, ukutshintsha okanye ukucima nantoni na. Unokuyirhoxisa apha okanye kwi-akhawunti yakho ye-Google nangaliphi na ixesha.
said.drive-google-drive.e9fe6eee.from: Read a folder straight from your Google Drive. Read-only: the platform can list and download, and cannot create, change or delete anything. You can withdraw it here or from your Google account at any time.

said.drive-import.1f557235.text: Kuloo folda akukho nto ipleyithifomu inokuyifunda. Amaxwebhu, iisipredishithi neepresentation zonke ziyafundwa, kubandakanya ezakwa-Google, ngoko umphumo ongenanto uthetha ukuba ifolda ayinanto ngokwenene, okanye iqulathe izinto ezinjengeeFomu neeshortkati kuphela.
said.drive-import.1f557235.from: That folder has nothing in it the platform can read. Documents, spreadsheets and presentations are all read, including Google's own, so an empty result means the folder really is empty, or holds only things like Forms and shortcuts.

said.drive-import.6977b553.text: Loo folda ilingana malunga ne-{known} MB, ekhulu kunokuba inokufundwa ngexesha elinye. Khetha ifolda yekhwalifikheyishini enye kunokuba ukhethe idrive ekuyo.
said.drive-import.6977b553.from: That folder comes to about {known} MB, which is more than can be read in one go. Choose the folder for one qualification rather than the drive it sits in.

said.drive-import.bc65916e.text: Loo folda iqulathe iifayile ezi-{listedCount}, ezininzi kunokuba zinokufundwa ngexesha elinye. Khetha ifolda yekhwalifikheyishini enye kunokuba ukhethe idrive ekuyo.
said.drive-import.bc65916e.from: That folder holds {listedCount} files, which is more than can be read in one go. Choose the folder for one qualification rather than the drive it sits in.

said.drive-index.adeba1a9.text: Awukaqhagamshelanga {label}. Yiqhagamshele kuSeto, kwaye ifolda inokufundwa apho.
said.drive-index.adeba1a9.from: You have not connected {label}. Connect it in Settings, and the folder can be read from there.

said.drive-index.b3dd24ac.from: That drive is not one the platform knows.

said.drive-index.be999bc2.text: Olu qhutyo alunako ukugcina ngokukhuselekileyo isazisi, ngoko idrive ayinakuqhagamshelwa. Ophethe ukuyigcina kufuneka aseta isitshixo sokutywina.
said.drive-index.be999bc2.from: This deployment cannot store a credential safely, so a drive cannot be connected. Whoever maintains it needs to set the sealing key.

said.drive-index.f1db1389.text: Uqhagamshelo lwe-{label} olugciniweyo alukwazi ukufundwa. Luqhagamshele kwakhona kuSeto.
said.drive-index.f1db1389.from: The stored {label} connection cannot be read. Connect it again in Settings.

said.drive-one-drive.2d141e83.text: Loo folda ayikho, okanye i-akhawunti oyiqhagamshelileyo ayikwazi ukuyibona.
said.drive-one-drive.2d141e83.from: That folder is not there, or the account you connected cannot see it.

said.drive-one-drive.2f5a255d.from: Microsoft did not return an access token.

said.drive-one-drive.4180c6e1.text: I-Microsoft ayibuyisanga ndlela yokuvuselela uqhagamshelo. Isicelo sisenokuba asicelanga ukufikelela ngaphandle kwe-intanethi.
said.drive-one-drive.4180c6e1.from: Microsoft did not return a way to renew the connection. The application may not be asking for offline access.

said.drive-one-drive.74ff1cef.text: I-Microsoft iwaliile loo mfuno. I-akhawunti oyiqhagamshelileyo isenokuba ayinako ukufikelela kuloo folda. {message}
said.drive-one-drive.74ff1cef.from: Microsoft refused that request. The account you connected may not have access to that folder. {message}

said.drive-one-drive.a65a4207.text: I-Microsoft ayisayamkeli loo nkqubo yokuqhagamshela. Isenokuba irhoxisiwe kwi-akhawunti yakho. Qhagamshela idrive kwakhona kuSeto.
said.drive-one-drive.a65a4207.from: Microsoft no longer accepts that connection. It may have been withdrawn from your account. Connect the drive again in Settings.

said.drive-one-drive.c6aef863.text: Funda ifolda ngqo kwi-OneDrive yakho. Ukufunda kuphela: ipleyithifomu inokuyidwelisa ize ikhuphele, kodwa ayikwazi ukudala, ukutshintsha okanye ukucima nantoni na. Unokuyirhoxisa apha okanye kwi-akhawunti yakho ye-Microsoft nangaliphi na ixesha.
said.drive-one-drive.c6aef863.from: Read a folder straight from your OneDrive. Read-only: the platform can list and download, and cannot create, change or delete anything. You can withdraw it here or from your Microsoft account at any time.

said.eisa-registration.3015ea44.text: Ubhaliso alunakuvalwa emva kokuhlala olwenzelwe kona.
said.eisa-registration.3015ea44.from: Registration cannot close after the sitting it is for.

said.eisa-sitting-notice.4242bc7f.text: Akukho kuhlala kurekhodiweyo kwe-{subject}. Imihla ivela kwileta yomlingane womgangatho wovavanyo kwaye itshintsha ngonyaka. Ude uyifake, akukho nto apha inokukulumkisa ukuba umhla wokugqibela wobhaliso useza.
said.eisa-sitting-notice.4242bc7f.from: No sittings are recorded for {subject}. The dates come from the assessment quality partner's letter and change every year. Until they are entered, nothing here can warn you that a registration deadline is coming.

said.eisa-sitting-notice.b6bf1cc3.text: Akukho kuhlala kurekhodiweyo kwe-{subject}. Umlingane womgangatho wovavanyo upapasha imihla ngoDisemba, ngoko ileta kufuneka ibikhutshiwe: yongeze uze uqale ukubala ngasemva.
said.eisa-sitting-notice.b6bf1cc3.from: No sittings are recorded for {subject}. The assessment quality partner publishes the dates in December, so the letter should be out: add them and the countdown starts.

said.eisa-sitting-notice.d6b538b0.text: Akukho kuhlala kurekhodiweyo. Kuvela kwileta yomlingane womgangatho wovavanyo, epapashwa kanye ngonyaka.
said.eisa-sitting-notice.d6b538b0.from: No sittings are recorded. They come from the assessment quality partner's letter, which is published once a year.

said.eisa.041d2d1d.text: Kurekhodiwe. Ukubala ngasemva ukuya kubhaliso kuqala ngoku.
said.eisa.041d2d1d.from: Recorded. The countdown to registration starts now.

said.eisa.18104c26.text: Akukho ncwadi yelogi yamava omsebenzi evuliweyo.
said.eisa.18104c26.from: No work experience logbook has been opened.

said.eisa.235f3916.text: Ibuyiswe ngumqeqeshi wasemsebenzini ukuze kongezwe ubungqina.
said.eisa.235f3916.from: Returned by the workplace coach for more evidence.

said.eisa.2d36e0ea.text: Isayinwe ngumqeqeshi wasemsebenzini, ilindele umvavanyi ukuba ayamkele.
said.eisa.2d36e0ea.from: Signed by the workplace coach, waiting for an assessor to accept it.

said.eisa.aabe4744.from: With the workplace coach for signature.

said.enrolment-document-shape.04f2917b.text: Isatifikethi sekopi side kunexesha eliqhelekileyo. Nceda uyicelele ukuba isayinwe ikopi entsha.
said.enrolment-document-shape.04f2917b.from: The certification is older than the period allowed. Please have a fresh copy certified.

said.enrolment-document-shape.3d15f524.text: Le ayisiyo ikopi eqinisekisiweyo. Nceda uyiqinisekise uze uyithumele kwakhona.
said.enrolment-document-shape.3d15f524.from: This is not a certified copy. Please have it certified and send it again.

said.enrolment-document-shape.8d2c9fdc.text: Ikopi ayifundeki. Nceda uyiskene okanye uyifotografe kwakhona, iyicaba nangokukhanya okuhle.
said.enrolment-document-shape.8d2c9fdc.from: The copy is not legible. Please scan or photograph it again, flat and in good light.

said.enrolment-document-shape.a7aecdc1.text: I-ID inemihla emininzi yokuqinisekiswa. Nceda unikeze ikopi eqinisekiswe kanye, kutshanje.
said.enrolment-document-shape.a7aecdc1.from: The ID has more than one certification date on it. Please supply a copy certified once, recently.

said.enrolment-document-shape.ad8ee9a7.from: This is not the document that was asked for.

said.enrolment-document-shape.d9deb62d.from: Some of the pages are missing.

said.enrolment-documents.07cca752.text: Akukho nto irekhodiweyo: neqela okanye umfundi akanantlawulo ekumelene naye.
said.enrolment-documents.07cca752.from: Nothing recorded: neither the cohort nor the learner has a payment against them.

said.enrolment-documents.221ad898.from: Paid for by the client, against {name}.

said.enrolment-documents.26e4b850.text: Nika umhla apho le kopi yaqinisekiswa khona. Ikopi engaziwa umhla wokuqinisekiswa kwayo ayinakubonakaliswa ukuba imanje.
said.enrolment-documents.26e4b850.from: Give the date this copy was certified. A copy whose certification date is unknown cannot be shown to be current.

said.enrolment-documents.330b87d3.from: The learner supplied their own proof of payment.

said.enrolment-documents.3f1d945a.from: The learner has supplied a proof of payment, not yet checked.

said.enrolment-documents.435df660.from: The learner's proof of payment was refused.

said.enrolment-documents.98317f79.text: Chaza isizathu sokuliwa. Umfundi kufuneka axelelwe into ekufuneka ayilungise, kwaye ukwaliwa okungenasizathu kumbuyisela engenanto anokuyenza.
said.enrolment-documents.98317f79.from: Say why it was refused. The learner has to be told what to correct, and a refusal with no reason sends them back with nothing to act on.

said.enrolment-documents.d417e6fa.text: Loo kopi yaqinisekiswa ngo-{certifiedOn}, oko kuye kwadlula iintsuku ezingaphezu kwe-{CERTIFICATION_VALID_DAYS} eyadlulayo. Ikopi eqinisekisiweyo kufuneka ibe yeyakutshanje xa inikezwa.
said.enrolment-documents.d417e6fa.from: That copy was certified on {certifiedOn}, which is more than {CERTIFICATION_VALID_DAYS} days ago. A certified copy has to be current when it is supplied.

said.enrolment-form.141771ac.text: Ukusuka kuluhlu lweekhowudi zommandla we-STATSSA epapashwa yi-QCTO.
said.enrolment-form.141771ac.from: From the STATSSA area code list the QCTO publishes.

said.enrolment-form.158eb69b.text: Ingxelo ibuza ukuba umfundi uvumile na, nasemhla onjani.
said.enrolment-form.158eb69b.from: The return asks whether the learner agreed, and on what date.

said.enrolment-form.3ecff80b.text: Isini esirekhodiweyo asihambelani nesikwinombolo yesazisi. I-QCTO iyakuhlola oku, ngoko enye kuzo zombini ibhalwe gwenxa.
said.enrolment-form.3ecff80b.from: The gender recorded does not match the one in the identity number. The QCTO checks this, so one of the two is mistyped.

said.enrolment-form.5d06240c.text: Umhla wokuzalwa orekhodiweyo ({recorded}) awuhambelani nenombolo yesazisi, ethi {fromId}.
said.enrolment-form.5d06240c.from: The date of birth recorded ({recorded}) does not match the identity number, which says {fromId}.

said.enrolment-form.7d5cda8a.text: Iqinisekisiwe, kwaye umhla urekhodiwe. Ukuba utshintsha nantoni na apha kamva, iya kukucela uqinisekise kwakhona.
said.enrolment-form.7d5cda8a.from: Confirmed, and the date recorded. Change anything here later and it will ask you to confirm again.

said.enrolment-form.a380df96.from: Saved. You can come back and finish it later.

said.enrolment-form.a8dcc4e9.from: The identity number does not check out: {reason}

said.enrolment-form.b67325d1.text: Akukho bani uqinisekise ukuba ezi nkcukacha zichanekile. Umhloli ucela ifomu njengobungqina, kwaye ifomu engaqinisekiswanga ibubungqina obuncinci kakhulu.
said.enrolment-form.b67325d1.from: Nobody has confirmed these details are right. A monitor asks for the form as evidence, and an unconfirmed one is evidence of very little.

said.enrolment-form.b711b7ce.text: Ukukhubazeka kurekhodiwe, kwaye i-QCTO ke ifuna ukuba ubunzima abubangelayo bube bungakanani.
said.enrolment-form.b711b7ce.from: A disability was recorded, and the QCTO then requires how much difficulty it causes.

said.enrolment-form.ca9579a9.text: Ephondo apho umfundi asebenza khona, ekungabi ndawo ihlala iyeyona apho ahlala khona.
said.enrolment-form.ca9579a9.from: The province the learner works in, which is not always where they live.

said.enrolment.52c9b5f2.from: Only a published course can be assigned to a learner.

said.enrolment.65b99bc7.text: Loo mntu sele ebhalisiwe kule khosi.
said.enrolment.65b99bc7.from: That person is already enrolled on this course.

said.enrolment.678cc7c5.from: There is no due date on this one.

said.enrolment.6ac9079d.from: That enrolment belongs to someone else.

said.enrolment.79fda720.from: Only the learner can record their own progress.

said.enrolment.ab1eec65.from: That lesson is not part of this course.

said.extensions-claude-code.149b1d9d.text: I-Claude Code ayifakwanga apho ipleyithifomu isebenza khona.
said.extensions-claude-code.149b1d9d.from: Claude Code is not installed where the platform is running.

said.extensions-claude-code.1c9bd1dc.text: I-Claude Code ifakwe kwesi sixhobo kodwa akukho namnye ongenile. Vula itheminali, sebenzisa claude, uze /login uqedele ukungena kwibrawuza. Eli linyathelo lexesha elinye elenziwa nguwe, hayi yipleyithifomu.
said.extensions-claude-code.1c9bd1dc.from: Claude Code is installed on this machine but nobody is signed in. Open a terminal, run claude, then /login and complete the sign-in in the browser. That is a one-time step and it is done by you, not by the platform.

said.extensions-claude-code.53fe3e99.text: Umda wokusetyenziswa wesabhaskripshini ye-Claude ufikelelwe. Oku kuya kusebenza kwakhona xa umda uhlaziywa.
said.extensions-claude-code.53fe3e99.from: The Claude subscription's usage limit has been reached. This will work again once the limit resets.

said.extensions-claude-code.7f69ba19.text: Isebenzisa isabhaskripshini yakho ye-Claude, ngophawu olulenzayo kwikhompyuter yakho nge-`claude setup-token`. Asisositshixo se-API: akukho ndleko nge-token nganye, kwaye ithatha kwisabhaskripshini osele uyihlawula kunokuba kube kwabelwana ngayo.
said.extensions-claude-code.7f69ba19.from: Uses your own Claude subscription, through a token you generate on your own computer with `claude setup-token`. Not an API key: no per-token cost, and it draws on the subscription you already pay for rather than a shared one.

said.extensions-claude-code.801580be.text: I-Claude Code ayiphendulanga ngaphakathi kwemizuzwana e-{timeoutMs}.
said.extensions-claude-code.801580be.from: Claude Code did not answer within {timeoutMs} seconds.

said.extensions-gemini.0473bc2d.text: Akukho sitshixo se-API se-Gemini sigciniweyo kuwe. Yongeza esinye kuSeto. Sivela kwi-Google AI Studio, kwaye asifani nesabhaskripshini ye-Gemini.
said.extensions-gemini.0473bc2d.from: No Gemini API key is stored for you. Add one in Settings. It comes from Google AI Studio, and is not the same as a Gemini subscription.

said.extensions-gemini.18ddcba7.text: Loo sitshixo se-API se-Gemini asisebenzi. Jonga ukuba sikhutshelwe sonke kwi-Google AI Studio. Asifani nesabhaskripshini ye-Gemini Advanced, engabandakanyi ukufikelela kwi-API.
said.extensions-gemini.18ddcba7.from: That Gemini API key is not valid. Check it was copied whole from Google AI Studio. It is not the same thing as a Gemini Advanced subscription, which does not include API access.

said.extensions-gemini.3bf73475.text: Umda wesantya we-Google walo sitshixo ufikelelwe. Inqanaba lasimahla livumela inani elilinganiselweyo lezicelo ngomzuzu; linda uphinde uzame, okanye usebenzise isitshixo esinebhili esivuliweyo.
said.extensions-gemini.3bf73475.from: Google's rate limit for that key has been reached. The free tier allows a limited number of requests a minute; wait and try again, or use a key with billing enabled.

said.extensions-gemini.599b82c0.text: I-Gemini ayiphendulanga ngexesha. Ifolda enkulu inokuthatha imizuzu emininzi; ukuzama kwakhona ngamaxwebhu ambalwa kuyo ngokuqhelekileyo kuyasebenza.
said.extensions-gemini.599b82c0.from: Gemini did not answer in time. A large folder can take several minutes; trying again with fewer documents in it usually works.

said.extensions-gemini.5f764f27.text: I-Gemini ayikwazanga ukufikelelwa. Jonga ukuba esi sixhobo sinoqhagamshelo lwenethiwekhi kwi-Google.
said.extensions-gemini.5f764f27.from: Gemini could not be reached. Check that this machine has a network connection to Google.

said.extensions-gemini.6ff1fd27.text: I-Gemini iphelelwe sisithuba ngaphambi kokugqiba ukuphendula, ngoko oko kubuyiswe yinxalenye yekharityhulam kunokuba yonke, kwaye eyinxalenye ibonakala ngendlela efanayo naleyo igqibeleleyo. Akukho nto igciniweyo. Ikhwalifikheyishini yonke ibubuninzi bokucelwa ngempendulo enye; yingenise kumaxwebhu ayo endaweni yoko, oko kufunda ikharityhulam ngqo ngaphandle kwemodeli nangaphandle kwomda onje.
said.extensions-gemini.6ff1fd27.from: Gemini ran out of room before it finished answering, so what came back is part of a curriculum rather than all of it, and a partial one looks exactly like a complete one. Nothing was kept. A whole qualification is a great deal to ask for in a single reply; import it from its documents instead, which reads the curriculum directly with no model involved and no limit of this kind.

said.extensions-gemini.7b1ee4ba.text: I-Gemini iphendule ngokungenanto. Oko kuqhelekile ukuthetha ukuba isicelo saliwe sisihluzi sokhuseleko, okanye igama lemodeli alichanekanga.
said.extensions-gemini.7b1ee4ba.from: Gemini answered with nothing. That usually means the request was refused by a safety filter, or the model name is wrong.

said.extensions-gemini.a3035142.text: Loo maxwebhu ayimigama engaphezu kwe-{MAX_INPUT_CHARS},000, engaphezu kwaleyo inokuthunyelwa kwisicelo esinye. Ngenisa ikhwalifikheyishini kumaxwebhu ayo endaweni yoko: uxwebhu lwekharityhulam lodwa lufundwa ngqo, ngaphandle kwemodeli.
said.extensions-gemini.a3035142.from: Those documents come to more than {MAX_INPUT_CHARS},000 characters, which is more than can be sent in one request. Import the qualification from its documents instead: the curriculum document alone is read directly, with no model involved.

said.extensions-gemini.c9f3d2b7.text: I-Google ixele ingxaki ngasemva kwabo ({status}). Isicelo esincinci sifanele sizanywe kwakhona. Ukuba yayiyikhwalifikheyishini yonke kwaye ilahlekile ngaphezu kwesihlandlo esinye, isicelo sisenokuba sikhulu kakhulu ukuba imodeli isigqibe. Yingenise kumaxwebhu ayo endaweni yoko, oko kufunda ikharityhulam ngqo ngaphandle kwemodeli.
said.extensions-gemini.c9f3d2b7.from: Google reported a problem on their side ({status}). A small request is worth simply trying again. If this was a whole qualification and it has now failed more than once, the request is most likely too large for the model to complete. Import it from its documents instead, which reads the curriculum directly with no model involved.

said.extensions-gemini.d7ab5352.text: I-Google iwaliile eso sitshixo. Sisenokuba sirhoxisiwe, okanye i-Generative Language API isenokuba ayivuliwe kwiprojekthi esiyeyayo. Akukho nto iphosakeleyo kwipleyithifomu kwaye akukho nto ilahlekileyo.
said.extensions-gemini.d7ab5352.from: Google refused that key. It may have been revoked, or the Generative Language API may not be enabled on the project it belongs to. Nothing is wrong with the platform and nothing was lost.

said.extensions-gemini.eb60a381.text: Isebenzisa isitshixo sakho se-API se-Google AI Studio. Asisosabhaskripshini ye-Gemini Advanced: leyo yimveliso eyahlukileyo engabandakanyi ukufikelela kwi-API. I-API inenqanaba lasimahla, ngoko oku kunokusetyenziswa ngaphandle kokuthenga nantoni na, ngaphakathi kwemida yesantya sayo.
said.extensions-gemini.eb60a381.from: Uses your own Google AI Studio API key. Not a Gemini Advanced subscription: that is a separate product and does not include API access. The API has a free tier, so this can be used without buying anything, within its rate limits.

said.extensions-index.002e7790.text: Gcina {word} kuqala: uluhlu luvela kumboneleli, kwaye kufuneka ukuba aphendule.
said.extensions-index.002e7790.from: Save a {word} first: the list comes from the provider, and it needs one to answer.

said.extensions-index.63d1c167.text: Uphawu lwakho olugciniweyo alunakufundwa. Oku kuthetha ngokuqhelekileyo ukuba imfihlo yeseva itshintshile ukususela oko walugcina. Namathisela entsha kwiphepha le-akhawunti yakho.
said.extensions-index.63d1c167.from: Your stored token could not be read. This usually means the server's secret has changed since you saved it. Paste a fresh one on your account page.

said.extensions-index.7d55f18c.from: Choose a provider the platform knows.

said.extensions-index.870b4f8d.from: That provider is no longer available.

said.extensions-index.879f4ba6.text: Gcina {word} kuqala: uluhlu luvela kumboneleli, kwaye ufuna enye ukuze aphendule.
said.extensions-index.879f4ba6.from: Save an {word} first: the list comes from the provider, and it needs one to answer.

said.extensions-index.8af96ab7.text: Oko akufani ne-{article} {name} {word}. Ukuze ufumane enye, {source}.
said.extensions-index.8af96ab7.from: That does not look like {article} {name} {word}. To get one, {source}.

said.extensions-index.a66c08f2.text: Esi sisitshixo se-API se-Anthropic, hayi uphawu lwe-Claude Code. Ziimveliso ezahlukeneyo kwaye le ifuna uphawu: qhuba `claude setup-token` kwikhompyuter yakho uze unamathisele oko ikuprintayo. Ukuba unesitshixo se-API, khetha umboneleli owamkela sona.
said.extensions-index.a66c08f2.from: That is an Anthropic API key, not a Claude Code token. They are different products and this one needs the token: run `claude setup-token` on your own computer and paste what it prints. If an API key is what you have, choose a provider that takes one.

said.extensions-index.d95a2478.text: Iinkcukacha zakho zokungena ezigciniweyo azikwazanga ukufundwa, ngoko umboneleli akakwazanga ukubuzwa.
said.extensions-index.d95a2478.from: Your stored credential could not be read, so the provider could not be asked.

said.extensions-index.e95369f0.text: Awukasetanga isandiso se-AI. Sikwiphepha le-akhawunti yakho phantsi kwe-Useto, singolwakho hayi olwembutho, kwaye sisebenzisa uphawu oluvelisa kwikhompyuter yakho.
said.extensions-index.e95369f0.from: You have not set up an AI extension. It is on your account page under Settings, it is yours rather than the tenant's, and it uses a token you generate on your own computer.

said.extensions-index.f448a040.text: Isandiso sakho se-AI sivaliwe kwiphepha le-akhawunti yakho. Akukho nto ilahliweyo: sivule kwakhona apho xa usifuna.
said.extensions-index.f448a040.from: Your AI extension is disabled on your account page. Nothing was discarded: switch it back on there when you want it.

said.extensions-index.f5c19ada.text: Isandiso sakho se-AI asivulwanga kule seshoni. Sivule apho ufuna ukusisebenzisa; siqala sivaliwe qho ungena, size sivalwe kwakhona xa uphuma.
said.extensions-index.f5c19ada.from: Your AI extension is not switched on for this sitting. Switch it on where you want to use it; it starts off every time you sign in, and switches off again when you sign out.

said.extensions-index.fc1b6fc7.text: Olu fakelo aluna sitshixo sokufihla, ngoko uphawu alunakugcinwa ngokukhuselekileyo. Akukho nto igciniweyo. Xelela lowo uqhuba iseva.
said.extensions-index.fc1b6fc7.from: This deployment has no encryption key set, so a token cannot be stored safely. Nothing was saved. Tell whoever runs the server.

said.extensions-openai.02885124.text: I-OpenAI ayivumanga eso sitshixo kule modeli. I-akhawunti esiyeyo isenokungabi nakho ukufikelela kwimodeli ekuseto lwakho.
said.extensions-openai.02885124.from: OpenAI refused that key for this model. The account it belongs to may not have access to the model named in your settings.

said.extensions-openai.047d249a.text: I-OpenAI ayivumanga eso sitshixo. Sisenokuba sirhoxisiwe, okanye singazange sisebenze. Qaphela ukuba ukubhalisela i-ChatGPT Plus akubandakanyi ukufikelela kwi-API: isitshixo se-API yinto eyahlukileyo, esenziwa kwi-platform.openai.com. Akukho nto iphosakeleyo kwipleyithifomu kwaye akukho nto ilahlekileyo.
said.extensions-openai.047d249a.from: OpenAI refused that key. It may have been revoked, or it may never have been valid. Note that a ChatGPT Plus subscription does not include API access: an API key is a separate thing, created at platform.openai.com. Nothing is wrong with the platform and nothing was lost.

said.extensions-openai.1d2edb4d.text: I-OpenAI ayiphendulanga ngexesha. Ifolda enkulu inokuthatha imizuzu emininzi; ukuzama kwakhona ngamaxwebhu ambalwa kuyo ngokuqhelekileyo kuyasebenza.
said.extensions-openai.1d2edb4d.from: OpenAI did not answer in time. A large folder can take several minutes; trying again with fewer documents in it usually works.

said.extensions-openai.241eaa9a.text: Loo akhawunti ye-OpenAI ayisenayo ikhredithi. Ngokungafaniyo ne-Gemini, i-API ye-OpenAI ayinaqondo lasimahla: ihlawulwa kwi-akhawunti esiyeyo isitshixo.
said.extensions-openai.241eaa9a.from: That OpenAI account has no credit left. Unlike Gemini, the OpenAI API has no free tier: it is charged against the account the key belongs to.

said.extensions-openai.3d690aea.text: I-OpenAI ixele ingxaki kwicala layo ({status}). Kuyafaneleka ukuzama kwakhona nje.
said.extensions-openai.3d690aea.from: OpenAI reported a problem on their side ({status}). This is worth simply trying again.

said.extensions-openai.5f8151b1.text: Umda wamaxesha okusetyenziswa we-OpenAI kweso sitshixo ufikelelwe. Linda kancinane uze uzame kwakhona.
said.extensions-openai.5f8151b1.from: OpenAI's rate limit for that key has been reached. Wait a little and try again.

said.extensions-openai.60c45cc3.text: I-OpenAI ayiphendulanga nto. Oku kuthetha ngokuqhelekileyo ukuba igama lemodeli alichanekanga, okanye isicelo senqatshelwe.
said.extensions-openai.60c45cc3.from: OpenAI answered with nothing. That usually means the model name is wrong, or the request was refused.

said.extensions-openai.d344fc6b.text: Akukho sitshixo se-API se-OpenAI sigciniweyo kuwe. Yongeza esinye kuSeto. Sivela kwi-platform.openai.com, kwaye asifani nokubhalisela i-ChatGPT.
said.extensions-openai.d344fc6b.from: No OpenAI API key is stored for you. Add one in Settings. It comes from platform.openai.com, and is not the same as a ChatGPT subscription.

said.extensions-openai.dacd1031.text: Isebenzisa isitshixo sakho se-API se-OpenAI, esenziwe kwi-platform.openai.com. Ayikukubhalisela i-ChatGPT Plus: leyo yimveliso eyahlukileyo kwaye ayibandakanyi ukufikelela kwi-API. Ngokungafaniyo ne-Gemini akukho nqanaba lasimahla, ngoko izicelo zihlawulwa kwi-akhawunti esiyeyo isitshixo.
said.extensions-openai.dacd1031.from: Uses your own OpenAI API key, created at platform.openai.com. Not a ChatGPT Plus subscription: that is a separate product and does not include API access. Unlike Gemini there is no free tier, so calls are charged to the account the key belongs to.

said.extensions-openai.e6f50a09.text: I-OpenAI ayikwazanga ukufikelelwa. Jonga ukuba lo matshini unoqhagamshelo lwenethiwekhi.
said.extensions-openai.e6f50a09.from: OpenAI could not be reached. Check that this machine has a network connection.

said.fisa.002355f9.text: Ukwamkelwa kufuna ireferensi ekhutshwe yi-QCTO. Ngaphandle kwayo akukho nto ingaboniswa kumbukeli.
said.fisa.002355f9.from: An approval needs the reference the QCTO issued. Without it there is nothing to show a monitor.

said.fisa.0d81e0f7.from: Your own report still has {missingCount} unanswered items: {code}.

said.fisa.4ffaa428.text: Le FISA ayikasayinwa ngumhloli. Iphepha elingakahlolwa kwangaphambili alinakuhlalwa: yiyo loo nto ukuhlolwa kukhona.
said.fisa.4ffaa428.from: This FISA has not been signed off by a moderator yet. A paper that has not been pre-moderated cannot be sat: that is what the moderation is for.

said.fisa.52b6e791.from: A FISA is waiting for pre-moderation

said.fisa.620b3718.text: Isivumelwano sokugcina imfihlo asikasayinwa. Akukho mntu unokubona okanye avavanye okuqulethwe yi-FISA ngaphambi kokusayina.
said.fisa.620b3718.from: The confidentiality agreement has not been signed yet. Nobody may see or judge the contents of a FISA before signing it.

said.fisa.6d7ad3d8.text: Kuvuliwe. Misela umvavanyi wephepha nomhloli emva koko.
said.fisa.6d7ad3d8.from: Opened. Appoint an examiner and a moderator next.

said.fisa.6e61efe5.text: Yihlole kwangaphambili kuqala. Ukuthumela i-QCTO iphepha elingakasayinwa ngumhloli wakho kukwenza ngokuchaseneyo.
said.fisa.6e61efe5.from: Pre-moderate it first. Sending the QCTO a paper your own moderator has not signed off is the wrong way round.

said.fisa.6f4251d6.text: Yi-FISA esayiniweyo kuphela efuna uguqulelo olutsha; le isenokuhlelwa.
said.fisa.6f4251d6.from: Only a signed-off FISA needs a new version; this one can still be edited.

said.fisa.8634f8d4.text: Ngumntu omnye nokwe-{other}. Ukuhlolwa kwangaphambili kuxabisekile ngenxa yokuba omnye umntu ulijongile.
said.fisa.8634f8d4.from: That is the same person as the {other}. A pre-moderation is worth having because a second person looked at it.

said.fisa.86b96040.text: Uguqulelo olutsha lwedrafti luvuliwe. Lufuna umvavanyi walo wephepha, umhloli nokuhlolwa kwalo.
said.fisa.86b96040.from: A new draft version is open. It needs its own examiner, moderator and moderation.

said.fisa.8cde49ff.text: Akukamiselwa mhloli, ngoko akukho mntu wokumthumela kuye.
said.fisa.8cde49ff.from: No moderator has been appointed yet, so there is nobody to send it to.

said.fisa.99e0c84b.text: I-FISA isetwa ngumboneleli kwinkqubo yakhe yezakhono. Ikhwalifikheyishini epheleleyo okanye eyinxalenye ivavanywa ngaphandle nguMlingane Womgangatho Wovavanyo, ngoko umboneleli akalisetheli elo phepha.
said.fisa.99e0c84b.from: A FISA is set by the provider for its own skills programme. A full or part qualification is assessed externally by the Assessment Quality Partner, so the provider does not set that paper.

said.fisa.a82c37e7.text: Isayiniwe njengefanelekileyo injongo. Abagqatswa banokulihlala eli phepha ngoku.
said.fisa.a82c37e7.from: Signed off as fit for purpose. Candidates may now sit this paper.

said.fisa.b7354b01.from: A FISA has been signed off as fit for purpose

said.fisa.c7fed1e7.text: Le FISA isayiniwe. Vula uguqulelo olutsha kunokuba utshintshe iphepha esele lihlalwe mhlawumbi.
said.fisa.c7fed1e7.from: This FISA has been signed off. Open a new version rather than changing a paper that may already have been sat.

said.fisa.f879ffbf.from: Appointed. They cannot see the paper until the confidentiality agreement is signed.

said.invigilation.01f9be44.from: Admit the candidate first. Confirming a camera for somebody who was never admitted records a check nobody made.

said.invigilation.1505c6a0.from: Say why they were turned away. An appeal turns on the reason, and the candidate has to be told what happened.

said.invigilation.7eff3ae0.text: Vumela umgqatswa kuqala. Isibhengezo somntu ongazange avunyelwe sirekhoda isivumelwano ongabonanga mntu.
said.invigilation.7eff3ae0.from: Admit the candidate first. A declaration from somebody who was never admitted records an agreement nobody witnessed.

said.invigilation.994f7ce0.text: Oku kuhlala akunamazwi esibhengezo, ngoko akukho nto umgqatswa anokuyamkela. Yiseta kuqala ekuhlaleni.
said.invigilation.994f7ce0.from: This sitting has no declaration wording, so there is nothing for a candidate to accept. Set it on the sitting first.

said.invigilation.b19d5680.text: Ukuvunyelwa kuvaliwe ngo-{localClose} {closedAt}, imizuzu emi-{lateBySeconds} eyadlulayo. Rekhoda umntu njengokwaliweyo ngesizathu endaweni yoko: umntu ovunyelwe emva kwexesha uye waba nexesha elide nephepha kunabo bonke abanye.
said.invigilation.b19d5680.from: Admission closed at {localClose} {closedAt}, {lateBySeconds} minutes ago. Record them as refused with the reason instead: somebody admitted late has had longer with the paper than everybody else.

said.invigilation.d1a64ee9.text: Ukuhlala kunokuqhutywa kuphela kwiseshoni ye-EISA yovavanyo lokugqibela okanye i-EISA yokuzilinga. Tshintsha uhlobo lweseshoni kuqala, ukuze ishedyuli ithi kwenzeka ntoni.
said.invigilation.d1a64ee9.from: A sitting can only be run at a summative or mock EISA session. Change the session's kind first, so the schedule says what is happening.

said.invigilation.df78a6b5.text: Chaza okwenzekileyo. Ingxelo yesehlo engatsho nto imbi ngakumbi kunokungabikho, kuba irekhodi libonisa ukuba enye yenziwe.

The rest has to be done as ordinary learning, or the limit changed on the qualification with a reason for it.

said.recognition.165f2f8f.text: Lo mgqatswa akaze abe neseshoni yengcebiso. Ukugweba ukufunda kwangaphambili ngokuchasene neemfuno ezingazange zichazwe kuyindlela umgqatswa awiswa ngayo ngokuqokelela ubungqina obungafanelekanga. Rekhoda ingcebiso kuqala.
said.recognition.165f2f8f.from: This candidate has not had an advisory session. Judging prior learning against requirements nobody explained is how a candidate is failed for assembling the wrong evidence. Record the advice first.

said.recognition.2f3e0747.text: Isigwebo sirekhodiwe. Asinikezeli nto de sihlolwe.
said.recognition.2f3e0747.from: Judgement recorded. It grants nothing until it is moderated.

said.recognition.3d78b1cc.text: Chaza oko ukujongile nokuba uyavumelana. Ukuhlolwa okungenamazwana kukusayina nje.
said.recognition.3d78b1cc.from: Say what you looked at and whether you agree. A moderation with no comment is a signature.

said.recognition.4cf70aee.text: Chaza ukuba iziphumo zoko banako zigubungela njani ezale modyuli. Eli candelo lisisigqibo sonke, kwaye ukudluliselwa ngaphandle kwalo sisibango angekho mntu unokusijonga.
said.recognition.4cf70aee.from: Say how the outcomes of what they hold cover this module's. That paragraph is the whole of the decision, and a transfer without it is a claim nobody can check.

said.recognition.61201ac5.text: Chaza ubungqina bubuyintoni nokuba kutheni buneliseka imodyuli. Eli candelo lisisigwebo sonke, kwaye yinto yokuqala efundwa ngumqinisekisi wangaphandle.
said.recognition.61201ac5.from: Say what the evidence was and why it satisfies the module. This paragraph is the whole of the judgement, and the first thing an external verifier reads.

said.recognition.86f838fe.text: Oko kunikwe ngo-{awardedOn}, kwiminyaka engaphezu kwe-{CAT_YEARS} ngaphambi kwale mvume. Ukuqokelelwa Nokudluliselwa Kwekhredithi kugubungela ukugqitywa ngaphakathi kweminyaka emi-{CAT_YEARS2}; ngaphaya koko indlela yiKwamkelwa kokuFunda kwangaPhambili, ekuvavanya oko umfundi asenokukwenza kunokuba oko awakuphumelela ngaxa lithile. Vula isicelo se-RPL endaweni yoko.
said.recognition.86f838fe.from: That was awarded on {awardedOn}, more than {CAT_YEARS} years before this approval. Credit Accumulation and Transfer covers completions within {CAT_YEARS2} years; beyond that the route is Recognition of Prior Learning, which assesses what the learner can still do rather than what they once passed. Open an RPL application instead.

said.recognition.d4a3fd91.text: Rekhoda oko umgqatswa axelelwe ukuba akuqokelele. Umgqatswa owaliweyo uphikisa eli candelo, kwaye 'kucetyiswe ngeemfuno' ayiloo nto.
said.recognition.d4a3fd91.from: Record what the candidate was told to gather. A refused candidate disputes this paragraph, and 'advised on requirements' is not one.

said.recognition.e21aaea2.from: You cannot moderate your own judgement.

said.recognition.e7122f98.from: Your role does not include this. Recognition is held by the provider's own staff, and a judgement is moderated by somebody other than whoever made it.

said.study-unit-alignment.dfcd9590.text: Uxwebhu libiza iimodyuli ezi-{wantedCount} ({wanted}) kwaye le khwalifikheyishini ayinayo ikharityhulam okwangoku. Ngenisa ikharityhulam kuqala; iiyunithi zokufunda neziphumo zazo zirekhodwa nangayiphi na indlela, kwaye ukulayisha olu xwebhu kwakhona emva koko kuya kuzidibanisa.
said.study-unit-alignment.dfcd9590.from: The document names {wantedCount} modules ({wanted}) and this qualification has no curriculum yet. Import the curriculum first; the study units and their outcomes are recorded either way, and uploading this document again afterwards will link them.

said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.text: Akukho nanye kwiimodyuli ezi-{wantedCount} ezibizwa yolu xwebhu enokuhambelaniswa, ngoko akukho nto ibekwe phantsi kweyunithi yokufunda. Uxwebhu libiza {wanted}. Le kharityhulam iphethe {held}. Ukuhambelanisa akuwaqwalaseli mikhawulo neehayfeni, ngoko iinkqubo zombini zahlukile ngokwenene. Lungisa iikhowudi kwelinye icala okanye kwelinye uze ulayishe uxwebhu kwakhona.
said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.from: None of the {wantedCount} modules this document names could be matched, so nothing has been placed under a study unit. The document names {wanted}. This curriculum holds {held}. Matching ignores spaces and hyphens, so the two schemes genuinely differ. Correct the codes on either side and upload the document again.

said.support.2b757921.text: Uvavanyo lomlomo lulandela ukuphosakala kwesibini kuphela ngenxa yezizathu zonyango. Ngaphandle kwazo, umphumo kukuphulukana nelungelo, apho umfundi asenokubhena kuko.
said.support.2b757921.from: An oral assessment follows a second miss only on medical grounds. Without one the outcome is a forfeit, which the learner can still appeal.

said.support.32314e12.text: Umfundi kufuneka avume ukuba oku kurekhodwe ngaphambi kokuba kurekhodwe. Impilo, ukukhubazeka nemeko yemali ziyinkcazelo yobuqu ekhethekileyo, kwaye ukuvuma ukubhalisa ayikokuvuma oku.
said.support.32314e12.from: The learner has to agree to this being recorded before it can be. Health, disability and financial circumstances are special personal information, and agreeing to enrol was not agreeing to this.

said.support.3e521f24.text: Chaza ukuba kutheni uncedo lupheliswa. Umfundi onokupheliswa uncedo ngaphandle kwesizathu akanandlela yokucela ukuba lubuye.
said.support.3e521f24.from: Say why the support is ending. A learner whose accommodation stops without a reason has no way to ask for it back.

said.support.6396d34b.text: Usuku olongezelelweyo sele lwasetwa kolu vavanyo: {additionalDate}, emva kokuphosakala ngo-{missedOn}. Inkqubo ivumela olunye. Ukuba olo suku lwaphosakala nalo, rekhoda oko kwenzekileyo kulo endaweni yokuseta olunye.
said.support.6396d34b.from: An additional date was already set for this assessment: {additionalDate}, after a miss on {missedOn}. The procedure allows one. If that date was also missed, record what happened to it rather than setting another.

said.support.6af4db9d.text: Ukuba uncedo alusebenzi, chaza okutshintshayo. Uphononongo olurekhoda ukusilela kodwa lungalungiseli nto lubonakala ngathi lunenkuthalo, kwaye lulinxenye eluchasene noko.
said.support.6af4db9d.from: If the accommodation is not working, say what is changing. A review that records a failure and adjusts nothing reads as diligence and is the opposite.

said.support.7af7d42b.text: Usuku olongezelelweyo kufuneka lube emva kolo lwaphosakala.
said.support.7af7d42b.from: The additional date has to be after the one that was missed.

said.support.8452172c.text: Chaza oko ukufumeneyo. Uphononongo olungenasifumaneko lusuku nje kwifayile.
said.support.8452172c.from: Say what you found. A review with no finding is a date in a file.

said.support.e34f2e55.text: Chaza oko kuza kwenziwa ngokwenene. Isidingo esingenoncedo olubhekiswe kuso asitshintshi nto kumfundi.
said.support.e34f2e55.from: Say what will actually be done. A need with no accommodation against it changes nothing for the learner.

said.support.f4565c1a.text: Chaza isizathu sonyango yayiyintoni. Uvavanyo lomlomo oluvunyiweyo ngesizathu esingarekhodwanga lulo ukuhlala okubuzwa ngumqinisekisi wangaphandle.
said.support.f4565c1a.from: Say what the medical ground was. An oral assessment authorised on an unrecorded reason is the sitting an external verifier asks about.

said.unit-competency.34155bb7.text: Oko iyunithi yokufunda nganye yale khwalifikheyishini iphumeza: isiphumo sayo senqanaba lokuphuma, okanye iyunithi ngokwayo apho ingakhonzi nanye. Yenziwe yipleyithifomu kumaxwebhu ekhwalifikheyishini ngokwayo.
said.unit-competency.34155bb7.from: What each study unit of this qualification achieves: its exit level outcome, or the unit itself where it serves none. Made by the platform from the qualification's own documents.

said.uploads.d61f0c85.from: That image is {byteLength}. A logo is displayed small, so the limit is {LOGO_MAX_BYTES}. A PNG with a transparent background works best.

said.xapi.0b0b2906.from: That file is not JSON. xAPI statements are exchanged as JSON: a list of statements, or an object with a "statements" list.

said.xapi.a4caddfa.text: Loo fayile iqulethe iingxelo ezi-{listCount}; ukungenisa kunye kuthatha ukuya kutsho kwi-{MAX_IMPORT_STATEMENTS}. Yahlule uze ungenise iinxalenye.
said.xapi.a4caddfa.from: That file holds {listCount} statements; one import takes up to {MAX_IMPORT_STATEMENTS}. Split it and import the parts.

said.xapi.a99169b1.text: Loo fayile inkulu kune-25 MB. Yahlule uze ungenise iinxalenye.
said.xapi.a99169b1.from: That file is larger than 25 MB. Split it and import the parts.

said.xapi.d7790699.from: No statements found. The file should hold a list of statements, or an object with a "statements" list.

login.intro.text: Ngena ukuze uqhubekele phambili nokufunda kwakho.
login.intro.from: Sign in to continue your learning.

login.trouble.text: Unenkinga yokungena? Khuluma nomlekeleli wakho: angakwenzela iphasiwedi entsha.
login.trouble.from: Trouble signing in? Speak to your facilitator: they can reset a password for you.

login.locked.text: Ukulinga kuningi kakhulu. Linda imizuzu eyi-15 bese uyalinga godu.
login.locked.from: Too many attempts. Wait fifteen minutes and try again.

login.missing.from: Enter your email address and password.

login.sso.refused.text: I-akhawunti leyo ayikwazi ukungena lapha. Kufuze isebenzise ikheli le-imeyili elifana nelemi lakho kulesi sikhungo. Ngena ngephasiwedi yakho, namkha buza umlawuli wakho.
login.sso.refused.from: That account cannot sign in here. It has to use the same email address as your account on this platform. Sign in with your password, or ask your administrator.

login.sso.expired.text: Ukungena lokho kuthathe isikhathi eside, namkha kuqalwe kwenye indawo. Linga godu.
login.sso.expired.from: That sign-in took too long, or was started somewhere else. Try again.

login.sso.off.from: That way of signing in is not switched on here.

account.forcedIntro.text: Omunye umuntu wasetha iphasiwedi ongene ngayo. Yitjhinge ngaphambi kokuqhubekela phambili.
account.forcedIntro.from: Somebody else set the password you signed in with. Replace it before carrying on.

account.newHint.text: Kungasikhona iinhlamvu ezili-12. Umusho wamagama ambalwa angahlobene uqinile futhi kulula ukuwukhumbula kunephasiwedi emfitjhani enezimpawu.
account.newHint.from: At least 12 characters. A phrase of a few unrelated words is both stronger and easier to remember than something short with symbols in it.

account.mismatch.from: The two new passwords do not match.

account.forcedNote.text: Ukuyitjhugulula kuphumisa bonke abanye abasebenzisa iphasiwedi endala, kubandakanya loyo okunikele yona.
account.forcedNote.from: Changing it signs out anyone else using the old password, including whoever passed it to you.

account.languageIntro.text: Ilimi elikhuluma nawe ngalo isikhungo lesi. Iiskrini ezingakahunyushwa zisala ngesiNgisi, namagama womphakeli wakho wezinto agcinwa njengoba awabhale ngawo.
account.languageIntro.from: The language this platform speaks to you in. Screens not yet translated stay in English, and your provider's own names for things are kept as they wrote them.

learn.notYours.text: Uyabona ukubhaliswa komunye umuntu. Ungabona ukuqhubeka kwakhe kodwa ungakwazi ukukurekhoda ngaye.
learn.notYours.from: You are viewing someone else's enrolment. You can see their progress but cannot record it for them.

learn.noLessons.from: This course has no lessons yet.

learn.openMaterial.from: Open the material for this lesson

learn.noContent.from: No written content for this lesson.

learn.scormNote.text: Ilesoni le liqedwa nawuliqedile ephakejini engenhla. Indawo yakho igcinwa nawuma phakathi nendlela.
learn.scormNote.from: This lesson completes when you finish it in the package above. Your place is kept if you stop part of the way through.

learn.openedByFacilitator.from: Opened for you by your facilitator: {reason}

home.feedbackMany.from: A few things to tell us

home.feedbackIntro.text: Iimpendulo zibikwa ndawonye nezabanye bonke, hhayi ngazinye. Imizuzu emibili ngayinye, futhi kuphela lokho okutjhugulula ukuthi iqoqo elilandelako liqhutjwa njani.
home.feedbackIntro.from: Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. Two minutes each, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

home.earnedIntro.text: Kurekhodwe ngelanga oqede ngalo, hhayi nasitifikeyidi sitholakala. Ngamunye unereferensi engaqinisekiswa ngumuntu wonke.
home.earnedIntro.from: Recorded on the day you finished, rather than when the certificate eventually arrives. Each carries a reference anybody can check.

home.step.afterPrevious.from: Opens when you finish the step before

home.nothingYet.from: You have not been assigned anything yet.

home.statementsIntro.text: Thatha lokhu uye ekuhlolweni kwangaphandle nedokhumende yakho yokuzazisa. Isikhungo siyakuqinisekisa ngaphambi kokuthi uvunyelwe ukuhlala.
home.statementsIntro.from: Take this to the external assessment with your identity document. The centre checks it before you may sit.

assess.waiting.from: Waiting for an assessor to review it.

assess.developmental.text: Lokhu kwakha. Akukho okubalwa ngokukuphikisa lapha.
assess.developmental.from: This is developmental. Nothing here counts against you.

assess.competent.text: Utholakale ukghona ekuhlolweni lokhu, ngalokho akukho ofuze ukuhlale godu.
assess.competent.from: You have been found competent on this assessment, so there is nothing to sit again.

assess.noAttempts.text: Usebenzise wonke amathuba akho okuhlola lokhu.
assess.noAttempts.from: You have used all your attempts at this assessment.

assess.awaitingAssessor.text: Ukuhlola lokhu kubalelwa eziqwini zakho, ngalokho umhloli uzakukubuyekeza bese arekhoda isiqunto sokukghona. Uzakubona umphumela nakwenziwe lokho.
assess.awaitingAssessor.from: This assessment counts towards your qualification, so an assessor will review it and record the competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

assess.practicePassed.text: Lokhu bekuyikuzijwayeza, ngalokho umphumela urekhodwa ngokufunda kwakho kodwa awunqumi iziqu.
assess.practicePassed.from: This was practice, so the result is recorded against your learning but does not decide a qualification.

assess.practiceFailed.text: Lokhu bekuyikuzijwayeza. Buyekeza izinto bese ulinga godu.
assess.practiceFailed.from: This was practice. Review the material and try again.

assess.pair.from: Pair each item on the left with one on the right.

assess.whyMarked.text: Isizathu yikho okumakiweko lapha, hhayi ibhokisi elingenhla.
assess.whyMarked.from: The reason is what is marked here, not the box above.

assess.keptAt.text: Iimpendulo zakho zigcinwe ku-{time}. Ukuthumela yikho okuzithumela ukuthi zimakwe.
assess.keptAt.from: Your answers were kept at {time}. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

assess.kept.text: Iimpendulo zakho zigcinwa njengoba usebenza. Ukuthumela yikho okuzithumela ukuthi zimakwe.
assess.kept.from: Your answers are kept as you work. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

evidence.uploadFailed.text: Ukukhuphela kuhlulekile. Hlola ukuxhumana kwakho bese ulinga godu.
evidence.uploadFailed.from: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.

evidence.doneIntro.text: Umhloli uzakubukeza bese arekhoda isiqunto sokukghona. Uzakubona umphumela nakwenziwe lokho.
evidence.doneIntro.from: An assessor will review it and record a competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

evidence.fingerprintNote.text: Nakuthiwa ifayela eligciniweko liyatjhugulwa, ilemuko lalo alisayifani. Lokho kuvikela umsebenzi wakho njengoba kuvikela ukuhlola.
evidence.fingerprintNote.from: If any stored file were ever altered, its fingerprint would stop matching. That protects your work as much as it protects the assessment.

evidence.kinds.text: Iinthombe, irekhodi yomsebenzi, ibhuku lokurekhoda elifotiweko, namkha idokhumende. Ungahlanganisa amanengi ngasikhathi sinye.
evidence.kinds.from: Photographs, a recording of the task, a scanned logbook, or a document. You can attach several at once.

paper.summative.text: Lokhu kuyahlolwa futhi kubalelwa eziqwini zakho.
paper.summative.from: This is assessed and counts towards your qualification.

paper.formative.text: Lokhu kungukulungiselela. Kuyamakwa bese kubuyiselwa kuwe, futhi akuqunti lutho.
paper.formative.from: This is preparation. It is marked and returned to you, and it does not decide anything.

paper.goBack.text: Buyela esifundweni ukuze ubone lokho okusalileko.
paper.goBack.from: Go back to the course to see what is still outstanding.

paper.connection.text: Impendulo leyo ayigcinwanga. Mhlawumbe ukuxhumana kwakho kunqamukile; kuzalingwa godu nawutjhugulula into.
paper.connection.from: That answer did not save. Your connection may have dropped; it will be tried again when you next change something.

paper.handInFailed.from: That could not be handed in.

paper.handInConnection.text: Lokho kungakhange kufakwe. Hlola ukuxhumana kwakho bese ulinga godu.
paper.handInConnection.from: That could not be handed in. Check your connection and try again.

paper.detail.from: Answer in detail, referring to the principles you have studied.

paper.handedIn.from: You handed this in. It cannot be changed.

paper.final.from: Once handed in, this cannot be changed.

paper.confirm.from: Confirm the declaration to hand in.

paper.savedAsYouGo.from: your work is saved as you go

notify.nothingYet.text: Akukabikho lutho. Uzakutjelwa lapha nakubelwa noma kuphelela ukuqeqeshwa, nakukhona umsebenzi okulindele, nakufika umphumela wokuhlola namkha isitifikeyidi.
notify.nothingYet.from: Nothing yet. You will be told here when training is assigned or due, when work is waiting for you, and when an assessment result or certificate arrives.

cert.notNational.text: Lesi yisitifikeyidi sika-{provider} ngokwaso sesifundo asiphakileko. Asisiso isiqu sesitjhaba futhi asinayo ikhredithi ye-SAQA namkha isazisi. Nakumfundi asebenzela isiqu somsebenzi, isitifikeyidi saso sikhutjhwa yi-QCTO.
cert.notNational.from: This is {provider}'s own certificate for a course it delivered. It is not a national qualification and does not carry a SAQA credit or identifier. Where a learner is working towards an occupational qualification, the certificate for it is issued by the QCTO.

cert.anyone.text: Noma ngubani angaqinisekisa isitifikeyidi lesi ngereferensi engenhla, angakhange abe ne-akhawunti.
cert.anyone.from: Anyone can confirm this certificate with the reference above, without needing an account.

work.introCoach.text: Abafundi obalawulako. Uqinisekisa lokho abakwenzileko endaweni yokusebenza; akukho okufika komhloli ngaphandle kwesayino yakho.
work.introCoach.from: The learners you supervise. You confirm what they did in the workplace; nothing reaches an assessor without your signature.

work.introLearner.text: Isipiliyoni sokusebenza senziwa kumqashi bese sisayinwa ngumqeqeshi wendawo yokusebenza lapho. Ukulandelana kuqinisiwe: uyarekhoda, umqeqeshi wakho uyaqinisekisa, bese kuya kumhloli.
work.introLearner.from: Work experience is done at an employer and signed off by the workplace coach there. The order is fixed: you record it, your coach confirms it, then it goes to an assessor.

work.noneManage.text: Akukho {records} okwamanje. Setha eyodwa ngenhla: isivumelwano esibiza umfundi, umqashi nomqeqeshi, bese eyodwa ngemojula yesipiliyoni sokusebenza ngayinye.
work.noneManage.from: No {records} yet. Set one up above: an agreement naming the learner, the employer and the coach, then one for each work experience module.

work.none.text: Akukho {records} okwamanje. Umlawuli uyayivula nakufakwe isivumelwano sendawo yokusebenza esibiza umfundi, umqashi nomqeqeshi.
work.none.from: No {records} yet. An administrator opens one once a workplace agreement is in place naming the learner, the employer and the coach.

work.kind.contextual_knowledge.text: Ulwazi lwendawo yokusebenza: lokho okufuze ukwazi ukukhuluma ngakho
work.kind.contextual_knowledge.from: Workplace knowledge: what you must be able to speak to

work.kind.supporting_evidence.text: Ubufakazi obuyisekelo: lokho indawo yokusebenza okufuze ikhiphe
work.kind.supporting_evidence.from: Supporting evidence: what the workplace must produce

work.outstanding.text: Kusekusele: {items}. Umqeqeshi wakho akakwazi ukusayina kuhle konke okufuze kwenziwe futhi ubufakazi obuyisekelo bunefayela elihlanganisiweko.
work.outstanding.from: Still outstanding: {items}. Your coach cannot sign until every line is done and every piece of supporting evidence has a file attached.

work.allRecorded.text: Koke kurekhodiwe. Thumela kumqeqeshi wakho nawulungile.
work.allRecorded.from: Everything is recorded. Send it to your coach when you are ready.

work.signingMeans.text: Ukusayina kurekhoda ukuthi uhlolile ubufakazi obu futhi uzabufakazela nakumhloli akuthinta. Akukwazi ukutjhugululwa ngemva kwalokho.
work.signingMeans.from: Signing records that you checked this evidence and will attest to it if the assessor contacts you. It cannot be changed afterwards.

work.readyForPoe.text: Kusayiniwe ngumqeqeshi wendawo yokusebenza futhi kulungele ukufakwa kuFayela lobufakazi.
work.readyForPoe.from: Signed by the workplace coach and ready to be taken into the Portfolio of Evidence.

scorm.failed.text: Iphakethe alikwazanga ukuvulwa. Hlola ukuxhumana kwakho bese ulinga godu.
scorm.failed.from: The package could not be opened. Check your connection and try again.

scorm.preview.text: Ukubukeza kuphela: lokho iphakethe elikubikako akugcinwa, ngoba lokhu akusiko ukubhaliswa kwakho.
scorm.preview.from: A preview: what the package reports is not kept, because this is not your own enrolment.

certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.text: Umfundi kungenzeka anike umqashi ireferensi. Ihlala isebenza futhi izakuthi isirhoxisiwe.
certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.from: The learner may have given the reference to an employer. It keeps resolving and will say it was withdrawn.

assessing.intro.text: Imisebenzi elungele isiqunto sokukghona. Awukwazi ukuhlola umsebenzi wakho, futhi ingcenye yeziqunto zakho izabuyekezwa ngokuzimela ngumlinganisi.
assessing.intro.from: Submissions ready for a competency judgement. You cannot assess your own work, and a proportion of your decisions will be reviewed independently by a moderator.

assessing.empty.text: Akukho okulindeleko. Imisebenzi ivela lapha nakuthunyelwa ngabafundi.
assessing.empty.from: Nothing is waiting. Submissions appear here as learners send them in.

assessing.onScreen.text: Lokhu kuphenduliwe esikrinini. {link}: iimpendulo, isiqondiso sokumaka nematriksi kunye lapho, futhi iimfuneko zibalwa ngawe nakumakiwe.
assessing.onScreen.from: This was answered on screen. {link}: the answers, the marking guidance and the matrix are together there, and the criteria are worked out for you once it is marked.

assessing.ownWork.text: Lo ngumsebenzi wakho. Awukwazi ukuwuhlola; omunye umuntu kufuze awuhlole.
assessing.ownWork.from: This is your own submission. You cannot assess it; someone else must.

assessing.hash.text: I-hash irekhodwa nakukhutjhelwa. Nakuthiwa ifayela eligciniweko liyatjhugululwa, alisafani, bese irekhodi ithathwa njengesiviko.
assessing.hash.from: The hash is recorded at upload. If a stored file is ever altered, it no longer matches and the record is flagged.

assessing.whyDiffers.text: Kubayini, njengoba kwehlukile kulokho amamaki aphakamisa khona
assessing.whyDiffers.from: Why, since it differs from what the marks propose

assessing.permanent.text: Igama lakho, usuku nekomenti le kugcinwa unomphela futhi akukwazi ukutjhugululwa ngemva kwalokho. Ukulungiswa kurekhodwa njengesiqunto esitjha.
assessing.permanent.from: Your name, the date and this comment are stored permanently and cannot be edited afterwards. A correction is recorded as a new decision.

marking.impliesIntro.text: Ukubala, hhayi isiqunto. Amamaki agaba ngalokhu; ukusebenza okuphathekako nobufakazi bendawo yokusebenza abufiki esikhungweni, futhi uyabukalisa ngaphambi kokuqunta. Tjhugulula noma yini yalokhu esikrinini sesiqunto bese uthi kubayini: isizathu sigcinwa eceleni kwesiphakamiso ukuze umlinganisi abone lapho ezehlukanise khona.
marking.impliesIntro.from: Arithmetic, not a judgement. The marks average out at this; practical performance and workplace evidence do not reach the platform, and you weigh those before deciding. Change any of these on the decision screen and say why: the reason is stored beside the proposal so a moderator can see where the two parted.

marking.markAllFirst.text: Umbuzo ngamunye kufuze umakwe ngaphambi kokuthi iimfuneko zibalwe.
marking.markAllFirst.from: Every question has to be marked before the criteria can be worked out.

marking.summative.text: Lokhu kuyahlolwa. Nakumakwe wonke imibuzo, rekhoda isiqunto: iimfuneko ezifakazelwako ziphakanyiselwa ukuthi uziqinisekise.
marking.summative.from: This is assessed. Once every question is marked, record a decision: the criteria it evidences are proposed for you to confirm.

marking.formative.text: Leli libhuku lomsebenzi. Lakhako: limake, bese ubuyisela impendulo. Akukho okurekhoda ukukghona namkha ukususa umfundi aye ekufaneleneni.
marking.formative.from: This is a workbook. It is developmental: mark it, then return feedback. Nothing here records competence or moves the learner towards eligibility.

marking.matrix.text: Imatriksi yokumaka: ukukhetha izinga ngalinye kunikela imaki
marking.matrix.from: Marking matrix: choosing a level for each gives the mark

marking.toldHint.from: Where it was strong, and what was missing.

marking.returnIntro.text: Impendulo, hhayi isiqunto. Zitjela umfundi lokho afuze aphinde akubuyekeze ngaphambi kokuhlola okuqedako, futhi azirekhodi ukukghona ngemfuneko yinye.
marking.returnIntro.from: Feedback, not a decision. It tells the learner what to go back to before the summative, and it records no competence against any criterion.

marking.returnHint.text: Lokho bekuqinile, nalokho okufuze kufundwe godu ngaphambi kokuqeda.
marking.returnHint.from: What was solid, and what to re-read before the summative.

marking.concern.from: Criteria the weak answers cluster around

marking.sectionHint.text: Lokho okuhambe kuhle lapha, nalokho okufuze kwenziwe ngenye indlela kuzayo.
marking.sectionHint.from: What went well here, and what to do differently next time.

marking.learnerSees.text: Umfundi ubona lokhu kunye nempendulo yakhe.
marking.learnerSees.from: The learner sees this with their feedback.

moderating.intro.text: Ukubuyekeza ngokuzimela iziqunto zabahloli. Iziqunto ezifika kuleli rhelo zikhethwa yisistimu, hhayi mumuntu. Awukwazi ukulinganisa isiqunto osenzileko wena.
moderating.intro.from: Independent review of assessors' decisions. Which decisions reach this list is decided by the system, not chosen by anyone. You cannot moderate a decision you made yourself.

moderating.reason.new_assessor.from: Newly registered assessor: moderated in full

moderating.referBack.text: Buyisela emuva: umhloli kufuze abuyekeze godu
moderating.referBack.from: Refer back: the assessor should look again

moderating.ownDecision.text: Wenze isiqunto lesi njengomhloli, ngalokho awukwazi ukusilinganisa. Kufuze umlinganisi omunye.
moderating.ownDecision.from: You made this decision as the assessor, so you cannot moderate it. Another moderator must.

pack.print.text: Phrinta ikhasi leli ukuze uligcine njenge-PDF.
pack.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF.

pack.counts.text: Imisebenzi engu-{submissions} · {decided} iqunyiwe · {moderated} ilinganisiwe · {sampled} isampulwe lapha

pack.instrumentIntro.text: Iphepha njengoba lasetjhwa, nesiqondiso elimakwe ngaso.
pack.instrumentIntro.from: The paper as it was set, and the guidance it was marked against.

pack.scriptsIntro.text: Ithathwe kuyo yonke ibanga lamamaki (okuphezulu, okuphasi nokuphakathi kwazo) ukuze ukumaka kubonakale kuhle kunye nabi, hhayi phakathi kuphela.
pack.scriptsIntro.from: Taken across the mark range (top, bottom and spread between) so the marking is seen at its best and its worst rather than in the middle.

pack.departuresIntro.text: Lapho umhloli ehluke kulokho amamaki aphakamise khona, namkha umlinganisi ehluke komhloli. Ipakethe eshiya lokhu iyabhuxa kunokungabi nepakethe.
pack.departuresIntro.from: Where an assessor differed from what the marks proposed, or a moderator differed from the assessor. A pack that leaves these out is worse than no pack.

pack.exceptionsIntro.text: Abafundi abavunyelwe ukudlula isango ngumuntu ochaziweko, nesizathu abasinikeleko.
pack.exceptionsIntro.from: Learners let past a gate by a named person, with the reason they gave.

held.intro.text: Umfundi atholakala ukungakakghoni kabili akahluleki. Ukuhlola kuyabanjwa, bese kuhlanganiswa ukubuyekezwa kohlelo nomqashi wakhe, ngoba ngalesi sikhathi umbuzo kanengi akusiko ukuthi uyakwazi yini, kodwa ukuthi kuyini okwenzeka ezindaweni ezimzungezileko.
held.intro.from: A learner found not yet competent twice is not failed. The assessment is held, and a programme review is convened with their employer, because by this point the question is rarely whether they know it, and usually what has been going on around them.

held.empty.text: Lokhu kuyagcwala nakutholakala umfundi engakakghoni ngokwesibili ekuhloleni okuqedako. Kufikela lapho akukho okumele kubuyekezwe.
held.empty.from: This fills when a learner is found not yet competent for a second time on a summative assessment. Until then there is nothing to review.

held.whoConvenes.from: A facilitator or administrator convenes the review.

held.oralAuthorised.text: {assessment} · ukubuyekezwa kugunyaze ukulinga kwesithathu, okuqhutjwa ngomlomo
held.oralAuthorised.from: {assessment} · the review authorised a third attempt, conducted orally

held.whoConducts.text: Umhloli uqhuba ukulinga ngomlomo, hhayi umuntu owakugunyazako.
held.whoConducts.from: An assessor conducts the oral attempt, and not the person who authorised it.

held.furtherLearning.from: Further learning before any further attempt

held.whyHint.text: Lokho ukubuyekezwa akufumene, nalokho okuqondene nakho.
held.whyHint.from: What the review found, and what it turns on.

oral.reviewDecidedIntro.from: The grounds on which this third attempt was authorised.

oral.recordIntro.text: Ukulinga ngomlomo akushiyi bufakazi bakho. Yilobu ubufakazi, futhi umphumela awukwazi ukurekhodwa ngaphandle kwabo.
oral.recordIntro.from: An oral attempt leaves no evidence of its own. This is that evidence, and the outcome cannot be recorded without it.

oral.outcomeIntro.text: Kuyahlulwa njengokulinga okubhaliweko, ngeemfuneko ezifanako, futhi kulinganiswa ngendlela efanako ngemva kwalokho.
oral.outcomeIntro.from: Judged the same way as a written attempt, against the same criteria, and moderated the same way afterwards.

oral.howHint.from: In person, or the video call it was held on

oral.presentNote.text: Akufuneki. Ukuhlola ngomlomo kungekho omunye ekamelweni kunzima ukukuvikela ekulinganisweni, futhi irekhodi kufuze ithi bekuyiluphi uhlobo.
oral.presentNote.from: Not required. An oral assessment with nobody else in the room is harder to defend at moderation, and the record should say which kind this was.

oral.savedNext.text: Umphumela urekhodwa esikrinini sokumaka, njengokulinga okunye.
oral.savedNext.from: The outcome is recorded on the marking screen, the same as any other attempt.

appeals.intro.text: Umfundi angakhalaza ngomphumela namkha ngokuziphatha kwomhloli. Ukwamukelwa kuvunywa ngamahora angu-{hours}, yisikhathi esikhohlwa kaningi, ngoba sigijima nakuqhutjwa ukufundisa.
appeals.intro.from: A learner may appeal against a result or against an assessor's conduct. Receipt is acknowledged within {hours} hours, which is the deadline that gets missed, because it runs while somebody is teaching.

appeals.lateIntro.text: Kudlule amahora angu-{hours} kodwa akukavunywa. Ukuvuma sekwedlule isikhathi kungcono kunokungavumi, futhi irekhodi lizakutjengisa kokubili.
appeals.lateIntro.from: Past the {hours} hours and still not acknowledged. Acknowledging late is better than not at all, and the record will show both.

appeals.openIntro.from: Everything lodged and not yet closed, newest first.

appeals.none.text: Akukho okuvuliweko. Isikhalazo sifakwa ekhasini lomfundi ngokwakhe.
appeals.none.from: Nothing open. An appeal is lodged from a learner's own page.

appeals.procedureIntro.text: Vuma, hlangana nomfundi, buza umlinganisi nakuphathelene nomphumela, bese uyaxazulula bese ubatjela.
appeals.procedureIntro.from: Acknowledge, meet the learner, consult the moderator where the ground is a result, then resolve and tell them.

appeals.closedUnacknowledged.from: Closed without an acknowledgement being recorded.

appeals.firstCounts.text: Ukuvuma kokuqala yikho okugcinwa yirekhodi. Akukwazi ukuphinda kubekwe ngesikhathi esitjha ngemva kwalokho, ngoba isikhathi esingatjhugululwa asiyisiviko santo.
appeals.firstCounts.from: The first acknowledgement is the one the record keeps. It cannot be re-stamped later, because a time that can be changed is not evidence of anything.

appeals.resultNeedsModerator.text: Isikhalazo somphumela siya kumlinganisi wangaphakathi ngaphambi kokuthi sixazululwe. Lesi yisinyathelo umqinisekisi wangaphandle akubuza ngaso.
appeals.resultNeedsModerator.from: A result appeal goes to the internal moderator before it can be resolved. That is the step an external verifier asks about.

appeals.conductNoModerator.text: Isikhalazo sokuziphatha asixazululwa kukumaka godu, ngalokho akukho mlinganisi ofunekako.
appeals.conductNoModerator.from: A conduct appeal is not something re-marking settles, so no moderator is required.

appeals.notFeedback.from: A decision the learner has not been given is not feedback.

appeals.whyHint.text: Kubayini. Le yingcenye umfundi afaneleko ukuyazi.
appeals.whyHint.from: Why. This is the part the learner is entitled to.

appeals.notesIntro.text: Ingxoxo phakathi komhlanganisi, umhloli nomlinganisi. Ayitjengiswa umfundi ngaphandle kokuthi utjho njalo; lokho afaneleko yiyo umphumela nesizathu esingenhla.
appeals.notesIntro.from: The discussion between coordinator, assessor and moderator. Not shown to the learner unless you say so; what they are entitled to is the outcome and the reasoning above.

appeals.noteHint.from: What was discussed, and with whom

appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.text: Ukurhoxisa kufuna isizathu. Ukurhoxisa okungenasizathu kubonakala njengokucindezela, futhi yikho kanye isikhalazo sokuziphatha esingakhuluma ngakho.
appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.from: A withdrawal needs a reason. One with none looks like pressure, and that is exactly what an appeal about conduct would be about.

rpl.intro.text: Ngomfundi osele akghona ingcenye yomsebenzi. Akukho okugunyazwa ngokutjho komuntu munye: isiqunto senziwa ngeemfuneko zemojula ngokwayo, sibhalwe ngokuphelele, silinganiswe ngomunye umuntu okungasosenzileko, ngaphambi kokuthi sibalwe.
rpl.intro.from: For a learner who can already do part of the work. Nothing here is granted on one person's say-so: a judgement is made against the module's own criteria, written down in full, and moderated by somebody other than whoever made it before it counts for anything.

rpl.waitingIntro.text: Isiqunto asigunyazi lutho godu nakungakenziwa lokhu. Funda isizathu ngokweemfuneko zemojula ngaphambi kokuvuma: yiyo into yokuqala umqinisekisi wangaphandle ayifundako.
rpl.waitingIntro.from: A judgement grants nothing until this is done. Read the rationale against the module before agreeing: it is the first thing an external verifier reads.

rpl.appearHere.from: Judgements appear here as they are made.

rpl.openIntro.text: Isinyathelo sokuqala, nesenza irekhodi lapho konke okunye kuhlanganiswa khona.
rpl.openIntro.from: The first step, and the one that creates the record everything else attaches to.

rpl.transferIntro.text: Kwehlukile kwe-RPL: umfundi usaphethe iziqu ezimbozwa mimiphumela yemojula le. Akukho ukululekwa, kodwa ukubalanisa kufuze kubhalwe phansi; ukudluliselwa ngaphandle kwakho kungusitatimende ekungekho ongasiqinisekisa.
rpl.transferIntro.from: Different from RPL: the learner already holds a qualification whose outcomes cover this module. No advisory, but the mapping has to be written down; a transfer without it is a claim nobody can check.

rpl.needsBoth.text: Isicelo sidinga umfundi neziqu ezisicelelwako. Ngeza lezo kuqala.
rpl.needsBoth.from: An application needs a learner and a qualification to apply against. Add those first.

rpl.needsLearner.text: Ngeza umfundi ngaphambi kokurekhoda ukudluliselwa kwakhe.
rpl.needsLearner.from: Add a learner before recording a transfer for one.

rpl.mapping.text: Ukuthi imiphumela yalokho abasaphethe kona imboza njani eyemojula le
rpl.mapping.from: How the outcomes of what they hold cover this module's

rpl.checked.from: What you checked, and what you concluded

record.print.text: Phrinta ikhasi leli ukuze uligcine njenge-PDF yeFayela lobufakazi.
record.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF for the portfolio of evidence.

record.timeExpired.text: Akwamukelwanga: isikhathi sesiphelile bese umsebenzi ufakwe njengoba wawukade unjalo.
record.timeExpired.from: Not accepted: the time limit expired and the work was handed in as it stood.

record.returned.from: Returned {date}. This is developmental: it records no competence.

sor.withdrawConsequence.text: Isikhungo sokuhlola kungenzeka sisenayo ikhophi. Ireferensi ihlala isebenza futhi izakuthi isirhoxisiwe.
sor.withdrawConsequence.from: An assessment centre may already hold a copy. The reference keeps working and will say it was withdrawn.

sor.print.text: Phrinta namkha gcina Isitatimende seMiphumela lesi
sor.print.from: Print or save this Statement of Results

fisa.intro.text: Iphepha lisetjhwa ngumphakeli lo ngohlelo lakhe lwamakghono. Ngokungafani nokuhlola kwangaphandle, wena uliloba futhi uyalilinganisa, ngalokho ukulinganisa kwenzeka ngaphambi kokuthi omunye alihlale, futhi iphepha elingakasayinwa njengelifanele injongo alikwazi ukusetjenziswa.
fisa.intro.from: The paper this provider sets for its own skills programme. Unlike an external assessment, you write it and you moderate it, so the moderation happens before anybody sits it, and a paper that has not been signed off as fit for purpose cannot be used.

fisa.waitingIntro.text: Akekho ongahlala lawa aze asayinwe ngumlinganisi.
fisa.waitingIntro.from: Nobody can sit these until a moderator signs them off.

fisa.setNewIntro.text: Ngohlelo lwamakghono. Iziqu ezipheleleko namkha ezingcenye ziyahlolwa ngaphandle.
fisa.setNewIntro.from: Against a skills programme. A full or part qualification is assessed externally.

fisa.gate.approved.from: Signed off as fit for purpose: candidates may sit this paper

fisa.gate.in_moderation.from: With the moderator: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.gate.draft.from: Being written: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.beforeNotAfter.text: I-FISA ilinganiswa ngaphambi kokuthi ihlalwe, hhayi ngemva kwalokho. Yikho okuyenza ivikeleke ekuvakatjheni kokulandelela.
fisa.beforeNotAfter.from: A FISA is moderated before it is sat, not after. That is what makes it defensible at a monitoring visit.

fisa.practical.text: Kunengcenye yokusebenza ehlulwa ngokukghona namkha ukungakakghoni.
fisa.practical.from: Also has a practical component, judged competent or not yet competent.

fisa.moderatorIntro.text: Uhlola ukuthi lifanele injongo, ngaphambi kokuthi omunye alihlale.
fisa.moderatorIntro.from: Checks it is fit for purpose, before anybody sits it.

fisa.unsigned.text: Akukabikho sivumelwano sokufihla. Akavunyelwe ukubona namkha ukuhlulela iphepha aze asayine.
fisa.unsigned.from: No confidentiality agreement yet. They may not see or judge the paper until it is signed.

fisa.outcomes.text: Imiphumela zezinga lokuphuma, nalapho iphepha liyihlola khona
fisa.outcomes.from: Exit level outcomes, and where the paper assesses them

fisa.outcomesIntro.text: Isigaba 2 semibiko yomibili. Yindawo eyodwa etjengisa ukuthi iphepha limboza iziqu, hhayi ukuthi limane liyafana nokuhlola.
fisa.outcomesIntro.from: Section 2 of both reports. The only place that shows the paper covers the qualification rather than merely looking like an exam.

fisa.noOutcomes.text: Uhlelo lolu alunaphumela yezinga lokuphuma erekhodiweko, ngalokho akukho okungamalanisa iphepha nakho. Ngenisa ikharikhulamu kuqala.
fisa.noOutcomes.from: This programme has no exit level outcomes recorded, so there is nothing to map the paper against. Import the curriculum first.

fisa.onlyExaminer.text: Umlobi ophakanyiswe kuphela, nakusayiniwe isivumelwano sakhe sokufihla, angaphendula lokhu.
fisa.onlyExaminer.from: Only the appointed examiner, once their confidentiality agreement is signed, can answer these.

fisa.onlyModerator.text: Umlinganisi ophakanyiswe kuphela, nakusayiniwe isivumelwano sakhe sokufihla, angaphendula lokhu.
fisa.onlyModerator.from: Only the appointed moderator, once their confidentiality agreement is signed, can answer these.

fisa.handOverIntro.from: Once your own report is complete.

fisa.laterIntro.text: Le ihlala injalo ngokuphelele, ngoba abafundi kungenzeka bayihlalile. Inguqulo entsha idinga ukulinganiswa kwayo.
fisa.laterIntro.from: This one stays exactly as it is, because candidates may have sat it. A new version needs its own moderation.

fisa.noProgrammes.text: I-FISA isetjhwa ngokuphathelene nohlelo lwamakghono, kodwa akukabikho lolo. Ngenisa olulodwa kuqala; iziqu ezipheleleko namkha ezingcenye ziyahlolwa ngaphandle yiSiqhema sekhwalithi yokuhlola, ngalokho umphakeli akasetji iphepha leli.
fisa.noProgrammes.from: A FISA is set against a skills programme, and there are none yet. Import one first; a full or part qualification is assessed externally by the Assessment Quality Partner, so the provider does not set that paper.

fisa.passNote.text: I-FISA yisivivinyo, ngalokho inalo, ngokungafani nokukghona kwangaphakathi.
fisa.passNote.from: A FISA is an examination, so it has one, unlike internal competence.

fisa.hasPractical.text: Iphinda ibe nengcenye yokusebenza ehlulwa ngokukghona namkha ukungakakghoni
fisa.hasPractical.from: It also has a practical component judged competent or not yet competent

fisa.practicalHint.text: isb. Ukusebenza: amahora amane, kuhlulwa ngokukghona / ukungakakghoni
fisa.practicalHint.from: e.g. Practical: 4 hours, judged competent / not yet competent

fisa.idNote.text: Indlela isikhungo esehlukanisa ngayo abantu abangenayo i-akhawunti lapha.
fisa.idNote.from: How the platform tells one person from another when they have no account here.

fisa.account.from: Their account here, if they have one

fisa.outside.from: Somebody from outside, with no account

fisa.accountNote.text: Umuntu onayo i-akhawunti kuphela angafaka umbiko wakhe lapha.
fisa.accountNote.from: Only somebody with an account can fill in their own report here.

fisa.further.from: Further comments for the improvement of assessment standards

fisa.signOff.from: Sign off as fit for purpose

fisa.untilYouDo.text: Akekho umfundi ongahlala iphepha leli aze ukwenze lokhu.
fisa.untilYouDo.from: No candidate may sit this paper until you do.

eisa.intro.text: Ukuthi ukuhlala ngakunye kungezinini, nokuthi ukubhalisa kuvalwa nini, nokuthi amaqoqo athini asafuze angeniswe. Ukubhalisa ngokuvamile kuvalwa cishe emavikini angu-12 ngaphambili, yikho iqoqo eliqeda ngemva konyaka kufuze lingeniswe kade ngaphambi kokuqeda.
eisa.intro.from: When each sitting is, when registration for it closes, and which cohorts still have to be entered. Registration typically closes about three months ahead, which is why a cohort finishing later in the year has to be entered long before it finishes.

eisa.registerNowIntro.text: Ukubhalisa kuvaliwa ezinsukwini zomsebenzi eziyi-10 nala amaqoqo awanalo usuku lokubhalisa olurekhodiweko.
eisa.registerNowIntro.from: Registration closes within ten working days and these cohorts have no registration date recorded.

eisa.sittingsIntro.text: Nalawo asavulelwe ukubhalisa kuphela. Ovaliweko akulutho umuntu angalwenza, futhi ukumshiya lapha kungaphusha usuku lweqiniso elilandelako phansi ekhasini.
eisa.sittingsIntro.from: Only those still open for registration. A closed one is nothing anybody can act on, and leaving it here would push the next real deadline down the page.

eisa.nextYear.text: Akukho okurekhodiweko ngale kwalo nyaka. Isiqhema sekhwalithi yokuhlola sikhipha amadethi wonyaka olandelako ngoDisemba, ngalokho incwadi kufuze isikhipiwe; ukuwangeza khona nje kugcina ukubala emuva kuqhubeka kuze kube nguJanuwari.
eisa.nextYear.from: Nothing is recorded beyond this year. The assessment quality partner publishes next year's dates in December, so the letter should be out; adding them now is what keeps the countdown running into January.

eisa.toEnterIntro.text: Koke okunosuku lokuvalwa oluvulekileko futhi kungenasuku lokubhalisa olurekhodiweko.
eisa.toEnterIntro.from: Everything with an open deadline and no registration date recorded against it.

eisa.noIdIntro.text: Iziqhema zekhwalithi zonke ziyayidinga, futhi ukubhalisa okubuyiswako ngenxa yenomboro engekhoyo kubiza umjikelezo. Kuhle ukukutholela nje kunokutholwa ngemva kokuthunyelwa kwefayela.
eisa.noIdIntro.from: Every quality partner asks for one, and a registration returned for a missing number costs a cycle. Better found now than after the file is sent.

eisa.readyIntro.text: Zonke iimfuneko kuyo yonke imojula zifezwe, kungaba zifundisiwe namkha zibonwe ngokufunda kwangaphambili.
eisa.readyIntro.from: Every criterion in every module met, whether taught or recognised through prior learning.
