eisa.nobodyYet.text: Akekho okwamanje. Uhlu olungezansi lutjho ukuthi ngamunye kusele ukuhamba kangakanani.
eisa.nobodyYet.from: Nobody yet. The list below says how far each of them has to go.

eisa.notReadyIntro.text: Kusele ukuhamba kangakanani ngamunye. Umuntu osele imfuneko eyodwa angakghona nokudlulisa usuku lokuvalwa nakubonwa kuleli viki.
eisa.notReadyIntro.from: How far each has to go. Somebody one criterion short can still make the deadline if it is noticed this week.

ready.intro.text: Umfundi angahlala i-External Integrated Summative Assessment nakufinyelelwe zonke iimfuneko zokuhlola zangaphakathi kuyo yonke imojula. Hhayi ezinengi, futhi akukho iphesenti elingayithatha indawo: iphesenti elingezansi liyinqubekelaphambili, ibheji imvume.
ready.intro.from: A learner may sit the External Integrated Summative Assessment once every internal assessment criterion in every module has been achieved. Not most of them, and no percentage stands in for it: the percentage below is progress, the badge is permission.

ready.nobody.text: Akekho obhalisiwe ngesiqu okwamanje. Bhalisa umfundi esifundweni bese ukhetha isiqu esibalwa kuso, bazakubonakala lapha.
ready.nobody.from: Nobody is enrolled against a qualification yet. Enrol a learner on a course and choose the qualification it counts towards, and they will appear here.

ready.notCaptured.from: A curriculum here is not fully captured.

ready.notCapturedIntro.text: Eminye imojula ayinamfuneko zokuhlola, ngalokho akukho okungafinyelelwa kuzo futhi akekho kuleso siqu ongamenyezelwa ukuthi ulungile. Ngenisa idokhumende ephelele yekharikhulamu ngaphambi kokungenisa noma ngubani ku-EISA.
ready.notCapturedIntro.from: Some modules carry no assessment criteria, so nothing can be achieved against them and nobody on that qualification can be declared ready. Import the full curriculum document before entering anyone for an EISA.

ready.notEligible.from: Not yet eligible for the EISA

ready.achieved.text: Iimfuneko zokuhlola zangaphakathi ezingu-{achieved} kwangu-{total} zifinyelelwe, nesipiliyoni sokusebenza sifakazelwe ngo-{record} osayiniweko.
ready.achieved.from: {achieved} of {total} internal assessment criteria achieved, and work experience proved by a signed {record}.

ready.canIssue.from: A Statement of Results can be issued.

ready.everyOne.text: Yonke imfuneko iyadingeka; akukho uphawu lokuphasa.
ready.everyOne.from: Every one of them is required; there is no pass mark.

ready.perUnitIntro.text: Isitatimende sesigaba sokufunda esisodwa siqinisekisa yonke imfuneko emojulani isigaba lesi esizibhadelako. Singakhutjhwa nasele siqedile isigaba lesi, singalindi ukuqedwa kwesiqu sonke.
ready.perUnitIntro.from: A statement for one study unit confirms every criterion in the modules that unit delivers. It can be issued as soon as that unit is finished, without waiting for the rest of the qualification.

ready.certificateIntro.text: Sikhutjhwa yinhlangano enikela iziqu ngemva kwe-EISA, hhayi ngu-{provider}. Sirekhodwa lapha nasifika, ukuze irekhodi lomfundi lithi uqedile isiqu.
ready.certificateIntro.from: Issued by the awarding body after the EISA, not by {provider}. Recorded here when it arrives, so the learner's record says they are qualified.

ready.thisNotCaptured.from: This curriculum is not fully captured.

ready.thisNotCapturedIntro.text: {modules} azinamfuneko zokuhlola. Akekho ongatjhiwo ukuthi ufanelekile kusiqu lesi aze angeniswe idokhumende ephelele yekharikhulamu; ngaphandle kwalokho iimojula ezingekho zizabalwa njengeziphasiweko ngokuthula.
ready.thisNotCapturedIntro.from: {modules} carry no assessment criteria. Nobody can be declared eligible against this qualification until the full curriculum document has been imported; otherwise the missing modules would silently count as passed.

ready.weight.document.from: as stated in the curriculum document

ready.weight.credits.text: kuphuma emakhredithini emojula; idokhumende ayitjho iphesenti
ready.weight.credits.from: derived from module credits; the document states no percentages

ready.weight.equal.text: kwabelwe ngokulinganako; idokhumende ayitjho iphesenti namakhredithi
ready.weight.equal.from: split evenly; the document states no percentages and no credits

ready.workProved.text: Isipiliyoni sokusebenza sifakazelwa ngo-{record} osayinwe ngumqeqeshi wendawo yokusebenza futhi wamukelwe ngumhloli, hhayi ngeemfuneko zokuhlola. Ikharikhulamu ayichazi lutho ngemojula le.
ready.workProved.from: Work experience is proved by a {record} signed by the workplace coach and accepted by an assessor, not by assessment criteria. The curriculum defines none for this module.

ready.noRecord.from: No {record} has been opened for this module.

ready.noCriteria.text: Akukho mfuneko zokuhlola ezirekhodiweko ngemojula le.
ready.noCriteria.from: No assessment criteria captured for this module.

issue.notYet.from: A Statement of Results cannot be issued yet.

preview.summative.text: Okuqedako: kuhlulwa ngumuntu futhi kulinganiswa ngokuzimela
preview.summative.from: Summative: judged by a person and independently moderated

preview.formative.from: Formative: marked as the learner goes

preview.whoMarks.from: {app} marked by the App, {assessor} by an assessor

preview.isPreviewIntro.text: Kunjengalokho umfundi akubonako, namabhokisi azakufaka kuwo. Akukho okugcinwako futhi akukho ukulinga okuqalwe, ngalokho amakhontrolo avaliwe. Ipaneli engaphansi kombuzo ngamunye ingeyakho ngoba wakhile iphepha leli; umfundi akayiboni.
preview.isPreviewIntro.from: Exactly what a learner sees, with the boxes they would type into. Nothing is saved and no attempt has been started, so the controls are switched off. The panel under each question is for you because you built this paper; a learner never sees it.

preview.empty.from: There are no questions in this paper yet.

preview.tickedAbove.from: The correct option is ticked above.

preview.noGuide.text: Akukho siqondiso sokumaka. Umhloli akanalutho angamaka ngaso; ngeza esinye ngaphambi kokuthi iphepha lisetjenziswe.
preview.noGuide.from: No marking guide. An assessor has nothing to mark this against; add one before the paper is used.

preview.declarationIntro.text: Umfundi akakwazi ukufaka lokhu angakavumi kukho, futhi amagama abhaliweko afakwa ekuthunyelweni.
preview.declarationIntro.from: A learner cannot hand this in without agreeing to it, and the exact wording is frozen into the submission.

people.intro.text: Bonke abantu abakwa-{provider}, iindima zabo, nokuthi irekhodi labo linakho yini lokho umbiko omiswe ngomthetho ukudinga.
people.intro.from: Everyone in {provider}, their roles, and whether their record carries what a statutory return needs.

people.notEnrolledOne.from: 1 learner is not enrolled on anything.

people.notEnrolledMany.from: {count} learners are not enrolled on anything.

people.notEnrolledWhy.text: Ukuba ngumfundi akunikeli ukufinyelela ngokwako, ngalokho bangena esikrinini esilambatha. Babhalise esifundweni, ubafake eqoqweni, namkha ubabele uhlelo.
people.notEnrolledWhy.from: Being a learner grants no access on its own, so they sign in to an empty screen. Enrol them on a course, add them to a cohort, or assign a programme.

people.missingOne.text: Umuntu o-1 unqamuka imininingwana edingwa mbiko we-SETA namkha we-SAQA.
people.missingOne.from: 1 person is missing details a SETA or SAQA return needs.

people.missingMany.text: Abantu abangu-{count} banqamuka imininingwana edingwa mbiko we-SETA namkha we-SAQA.
people.missingMany.from: {count} people are missing details a SETA or SAQA return needs.

people.missingWhy.text: Bamakiwe ngezansi. Ukuyifaka khona nje kulula kakhulu kunokwenza ebusuku bangaphambi kokuthunyelwa.
people.missingWhy.from: They are marked below. Filling them in now is far easier than the night before a submission.

people.roster.from: Add a cohort from a spreadsheet

people.rosterIntro.text: Funda ifayela le-CSV namkha le-Excel labafundi bese ubakha bonke ngasikhathi sinye. Litjengisa lokho eliphethe ngefayela ngaphambi kokuthi omunye akhiwe.
people.rosterIntro.from: Read a CSV or Excel file of learners and create them all at once. It shows you what it made of the file before anybody is created.

people.added.text: Kufakiwe. Mnike iphasiwedi le: itjengiswa kanye kuphela futhi ayikwazi ukubuyiswa.
people.added.from: Added. Give them this password: it is shown once and cannot be retrieved.

people.noMail.text: Akukabikho iseva yeposo exhunyiweko, ngalokho akukho okuthunyelwe nge-imeyili. Mcele atjhugulule ngemva kokungena.
people.noMail.from: There is no mail server connected yet, so nothing was emailed. Ask them to change it after signing in.

person.lineManagerNote.text: Unquma ukuthi ukuqeqeshwa kwabani kungabonwa yilo muntu eemibikweni.
person.lineManagerNote.from: Decides whose training this person can see in reports.

person.ofoNote.text: Ikhodi yomsebenzi esetjenziselwa ukuhlanganisa umbiko we-SETA.
person.ofoNote.from: Occupation code used to group a SETA return.

person.statutoryNote.text: Iyadingeka embikweni we-SAQA namkha we-SETA. Inomboro yesazisi iyahlolwa ngenomboro yayo yokuqinisekisa nawugcina, ngalokho iphutha lokuthayipha liqatjhwa lapha, hhayi yisiphathimandla.
person.statutoryNote.from: Needed for a SAQA or SETA return. The identity number is checked against its check digit as you save, so a typing error is caught here rather than by the regulator.

person.roleNote.workplace_coach.text: Umqondisi womqashi: ubona abafundi bakhe kuphela
person.roleNote.workplace_coach.from: The employer's supervisor: sees only their own learners

roster.how.text: I-CSV namkha i-Excel. Iinhloko zamakholomu zifaniswa ngamagama ("Surname", "Last Name" ne-"Van" zonke ziyasebenza) futhi akukho isengezo esidingekako kulokhu.
roster.how.from: CSV or Excel. Column headings are matched by name ("Surname", "Last Name" and "Van" all work) and no extension is needed for any of it.

roster.aiOnWhat.text: futhi sizakuzama ukufanisa noma yiyiphi inhloko engakafaniswa yimithetho. Sitjengiswa iinhloko kuphela, ingasi imigca, ngoba iphethe iinomboro zezazisi.
roster.aiOnWhat.from: and will try to match any heading the rules miss. It is shown the headings only, never the rows, which carry identity numbers.

roster.aiOff.text: Nakuvulwe isengezo sakho se-AI sizakuphinda sifanise iinhloko ezingatholwa yimithetho; sizakutjengiswa iinhloko kuphela, ingasi imigca. Iswitjhi isekuqaleni kwekhasi.
roster.aiOff.from: With your AI extension switched on it would additionally match headings the rules do not recognise; it would be shown the headings only, never the rows. The switch is at the top of the page.

roster.passwords.text: Iphasiwedi zabo zokuqala, zitjengiswa kanye kuphela

roster.passwordsNote.text: Azigcinwa kunoma iyiphi indawo lapho zingafundwa godu. Zikopishe khonokho nje, namkha uzitjhugulule ngazinye ngemva kwesikhatjhana. Umuntu ngamunye uzakucelwa ukuthi atjhugulule eyakhe nakangena kwesokuqala.
roster.passwordsNote.from: These are not stored anywhere they can be read again. Copy them now, or reset them individually later. Each person is asked to change theirs on first sign-in.

roster.willCreateSkip.from: {count} will be created, {skipped} will be skipped.

personPage.anonymisedOne.text: Imininingwana yobuqu yasuswa ngomhlaka {date} ngokwesicelo somuntu. Isitifikeyidi sakhe esi-1 sisasebenza futhi singaqinisekiswa, ngoba isiqu esitholiweko sifuze sihlale kurekhodi yesitjhaba.
personPage.anonymisedOne.from: The personal details were erased on {date} at the person's request. Their 1 certificate remains valid and verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to stay on the national record.

personPage.anonymisedMany.text: Imininingwana yobuqu yasuswa ngomhlaka {date} ngokwesicelo somuntu. Izitifikeyidi zakhe ezingu-{count} ziyasebenza futhi ziyaqinisekiswa, ngoba isiqu esitholiweko sifuze sihlale kurekhodi yesitjhaba.
personPage.anonymisedMany.from: The personal details were erased on {date} at the person's request. Their {count} certificates remain valid and verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to stay on the national record.

personPage.conductIntro.text: Okuthiwa kwenziwe, izixwayiso ezisebenza ngesikhathi leso, nokuthi isaziso somhlangano besifaneleko na, nokuthi kuqunywe ini. Ngokulandelana kwezehlakalo, yikho okufundwa ngalo godu.
personPage.conductIntro.from: What was alleged, which warnings were live at the time, whether notice of a hearing was adequate, and what was decided. In the order it happened, which is the order it gets read back in.

personPage.supportIntro.text: Lokho okwenzelwa umfundi lo, nokuthi ngubani okwenzako. Isizathu sokulungiselelwa kungolwazi lwezempilo namkha lwezimali futhi sigcinwa ngokwehlukileko, ngoba ukwenza ilungiselelo akudingi ukwazi ukuthi kubayini.
personPage.supportIntro.from: What is being done for this learner, and by whom. The reason behind an accommodation is health or financial information and is held apart from it, because doing the accommodating does not require knowing why.

personPage.missedIntro.text: Idethi eyodwa yokungezelela, futhi yodwa kuphela. Nalapho leyo iphuzwa ngenca yezokwelapha, umfundi uyakuya ekuhlolweni ngomlomo anesibukeli esivela kumqashi.
personPage.missedIntro.from: One additional date, and one only. Where that is also missed on medical grounds the learner goes to an oral assessment with an observer from the employer.

personPage.appealsIntro.text: Ngomphumela namkha ngokuziphatha komhloli. Ukwamukelwa kuvunywa ngamahora angu-{hours}, futhi isikhathi siqala nasifakwe lapha.
personPage.appealsIntro.from: Against a result, or against an assessor's conduct. Receipt is acknowledged within {hours} hours, and the clock starts when it is lodged here.

personPage.documentsIntro.text: Ahlolwa njengoba aqoqwa, hhayi nakwakhiwa umbiko. Ikopi eqinisekisiweko elahlekileko efunyanwa ngemva kwezinyanga kunzima kakhulu ukuyithola, futhi usuku lokuvala ngokuvamile lisele amalanga ambalwa ngesikhathi leso.
personPage.documentsIntro.from: Checked as they are collected rather than when a return is being assembled. A missing certified copy found months later is far harder to get, and the deadline is usually days away by then.

personPage.elsewhereIntro.text: Kungeniswe kwenye isistimu. Kutjengiswa njengoba kurekhodwe khona; akukho okufundiswe, okuhlolwe namkha okulinganiswe kupulatifomu le.
personPage.elsewhereIntro.from: Imported from another system. Shown as it was recorded there; none of it was taught, assessed or moderated on this platform.

editor.ownRoles.text: Awukwazi ukutjhugulula iindima zakho: ukususa ukufinyelela kwakho yikho iphutha elilodwa okungasikho omunye ongaliphinda. Cela omunye umlawuli.
editor.ownRoles.from: You cannot change your own roles: removing your own access is the one mistake nobody else may be able to undo. Ask another administrator.

editor.mailboxIntro.text: Ikheli abafundi nabahloli abalibhalela nabalibhalisa ngalo. Lihlukene nekheli lokungena elingenhla, ukuze ingcoco ngokuhlola iwele erekhodini yomfundi hhayi ebhokisini lomuntu ozimeleleko, lapho ingaphandle kwelogu yokuhlolwa, ngaphandle kwekhophi yokuvikela, futhi ilahleka nakahamba.
editor.mailboxIntro.from: The address learners and assessors write to and from. Separate from the sign-in address above, so a conversation about an assessment lands inside the learner's record rather than in somebody's private inbox, where it is outside the audit log, outside the backup, and gone when they leave.

editor.noPassword.text: Akukho phasiwedi ehlukileko, ngoba akukho ukungena okuhlukileko.
editor.noPassword.from: There is no separate password, because there is no separate login.

editor.noPasswordWhy.text: Lokhu akusibhokisi leposo kuseva yeposo enewebhu yayo. Iposo elithunyelwa kukheli le lithulwa ngaphakathi kwepulatifomu, futhi umuntu ulifunda bese aliphendula ngaphansi kwaleyo ethi Iposo nakangena ngendlela ejwayelekileko. Yikho okuhlosiweko: ukubhalelana kuhlala ngaphakathi kwerekhodi yomfundi, elogwini lokuhlolwa nakukhophi yokuvikela, hhayi ebhokisini lomuntu elihamba nakahamba.
editor.noPasswordWhy.from: This is not a mailbox on a mail host with its own webmail. Mail sent to this address is delivered into the platform, and the person reads and answers it under Mail after signing in the way they always do. That is the point of it: the correspondence sits inside the learner's record, in the audit log and in the backup, rather than in a private inbox that leaves when they do.

editor.mailboxChange.from: Changing it does not move mail already received.

editor.mailboxSuggested.text: Okuphakanyisiweko: {address}. Yiyeke ingenalutho nangabe ungafuni ibhokisi leposo.
editor.mailboxSuggested.from: Suggested: {address}. Leave blank for no mailbox.

editor.newPassword.text: Iphasiwedi entsha: itjengiswa kanye kuphela, yinike umuntu ngqo.
editor.newPassword.from: New password: shown once, give it to them directly.

editor.ownSuspend.from: You cannot suspend your own account.

editor.suspendNote.text: Ukumisa kuphelisa masinyane iseshini yalo muntu evuliweko, futhi ukutjhugulula iphasiwedi kumphumisa yonke indawo.
editor.suspendNote.from: Suspending ends any session the person has open immediately, and resetting a password signs them out everywhere.

editor.eraseIntro.text: Ngesicelo sokususwa se-POPIA. Kususa igama, imininingwana yokuxhumana neyobuqu ngokungapheliko. Izitifikeyidi namarekhodi wokuhlola ayagcinwa futhi ahlala eqinisekiswa, ngoba isiqu esitholiweko sifuze sihlale kurekhodi yesitjhaba, yikho nokuthi lokhu kungabuyiswa.
editor.eraseIntro.from: For a POPIA erasure request. Removes the name, contact and demographic details permanently. Certificates and assessment records are kept and stay verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to remain on the national record, which is also why this cannot be undone.

editor.whyHint.from: Kept permanently in the audit log.

lodge.noCohort.text: Isikhalazo sifakwa ngeqoqo, futhi umfundi lo akekho eqoqweni eliqhubekako.
lodge.noCohort.from: An appeal is filed against a cohort, and this learner is not on a running one.

lodge.statementHint.text: Lokho okutjhiwo ngumfundi, ngamagama akhe nakukghonakala.
lodge.statementHint.from: What the learner says, in their words where possible.

lodge.lateWhy.from: Why this is being accepted out of time

lodge.lateNote.text: Isikhalazo esiphuzwe sisesikhalazo, futhi ukusikhwephula lapha kungasithumela kukhasi lomuntu kwaphela. Isizathu siba yingcenye yefayela.
lodge.lateNote.from: A late appeal is still an appeal, and turning it away here would only send it to somebody's inbox. The reason becomes part of the file.

missed.againOral.from: Missed it again: authorise an oral assessment

missed.wasMedical.from: The second miss was on medical grounds

missed.medicalOnly.text: Indlela yomlomo ivulwa ngesizathu sezokwelapha kuphela. Ngaphandle kwaso umphumela kukulahlekelwa, umfundi angakhalaza ngakho.
missed.medicalOnly.from: The oral route opens on a medical ground and nothing else. Without one the outcome is a forfeit, which the learner can still appeal.

missed.whyHint.from: Why it was missed, if known

missed.onlyOne.text: Idethi eyodwa yokungezelela, futhi yodwa kuphela. Ukuyirekhoda lapha yikho okuvimbela ukuthi eyesithathu ihlelwe kamuva ngomuntu ongazi ngale.
missed.onlyOne.from: One additional date, and one only. Recording it here is what stops a third being arranged later by somebody who did not know about this one.

support.withheld.text: Kunemininingwana eminengi efayelini. Ivinjelwe, ngoba ingolwazi lwezempilo namkha lwezimali futhi ukwenza ilungiselelo akudingi ukwazi isizathu salo.
support.withheld.from: There is more detail on file. It is restricted, because it is health or financial information and doing the accommodation does not require knowing the reason for it.

support.changing.from: What is changing as a result

support.accommodation.from: What will be done: shared with whoever has to do it

support.accommodationHint.text: Hlala eduze nomnyango. Nikela isikhefu njalo ngemizuzu engu-40. Nikela iimpahla eziphrintiweko.
support.accommodationHint.from: Seat near the door. Allow a break every 40 minutes. Provide printed materials.

support.reason.text: Isizathu salo: sivinjelwe, futhi kungcono sishiywe singenalutho
support.reason.from: The reason behind it: restricted, and better left empty

support.reasonNote.text: Ezempilo, ukukhubazeka nezimo zezimali ziyimininingwana yobuqu ekhethekileko. Irekhodi elitjho kuphela okufuze kwenziwe lisiza umfundi ngokufanako futhi lifaka engozini okuncani kakhulu. Gcwalisa lokhu kuphela lapho omunye angakwazi ngokuqinisileko ukwenza lutho ngaphandle kwakho.
support.reasonNote.from: Health, disability and financial circumstances are special personal information. A record that says only what to do serves the learner just as well and puts far less at risk. Fill this in only where somebody genuinely could not act without it.

support.consented.from: The learner has agreed to this being recorded

docs.routeNote.text: Indlela yikho enquma okudingekako. Ukubonwa kokufunda kwangaphambili kudinga ifayela kunesitifikeyidi sesiqu, ngoba ibango lithi ukufunda kwenzeke ngaphandle kohlelo olusemthethweni.
docs.routeNote.from: The route decides what is required. Recognition of prior learning asks for a portfolio rather than a qualification certificate, because the claim is that the learning happened outside a formal programme.

docs.allSupplied.from: Everything required has been supplied and checked.

conduct.liveNote.text: Lezi kuphela ezibalwako ekukhuliseni isijeziso. Isixwayiso esidlulelwe yidethi sihlala efayelini kodwa asisabalwa, yikho isikhalazo esiqonda kuko.
conduct.liveNote.from: Only these count towards escalation. A warning past its date stays on file and stops counting, which is what an appeal turns on.

conduct.findingsHint.from: What was found, and on what basis

conduct.givenButton.from: The learner has been given this in writing

conduct.termsHint.text: Umthetho owephulwe, izinga elilindelekileko, nokuzakwenzeka nakuphindeka.
conduct.termsHint.from: The rule broken, the standard expected, and what happens if it recurs.

conduct.allegationsHint.from: The specific allegations put to the learner

conduct.sanctionsHint.text: Izijeziso ezingakghonakala, kubandakanya ukukhutjhwa lapho kufaneleko
conduct.sanctionsHint.from: Sanctions possible, including termination where it is

conduct.rights.text: Isaziso sitjela umfundi ukuthi angasiwa ngomunye umfundi, azethule indaba yakhe, abize futhi abuze ofakazi.
conduct.rights.from: The notice tells the learner they may be assisted by a fellow learner, present their case, and call and question witnesses.

conduct.notice.text: Kungasikhona amahora angu-{hours} kusukela nje. Isaziso esifitjhani asamukelwa: yiphutha lapho isikhalazo sinqotjhwa khona, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umfundi wenzeni.
conduct.notice.from: At least {hours} hours from now. Short notice is refused: it is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

conduct.whyHint.from: Why. This is the paragraph the learner is entitled to.

conduct.allegationHint.text: Kusolwani, ngokuthize gade. Umfundi akakwazi ukuphendula ku-'ukuziphatha okubi'.
conduct.allegationHint.from: What is alleged, specifically. A learner cannot answer 'poor attitude'.

cohorts.intro.text: Iqoqo labantu abenza uhlelo ndawonye, ngesheduli enye. Usuku ngasinye lokuphela libalwa ngenani lamalanga kusukela ekuqaleni, ngalokho ukususa iqoqo kususa woke amadethi kwabo boke abakulo ngasikhathi sinye.
cohorts.intro.from: A group working through a programme together, on one schedule. Every deadline is held as a number of days from the start date, so moving an intake moves every date for everyone in it at once.

cohorts.none.text: I-{cohort} liqoqo labantu abenza {course} elenyatjhisiweko ndawonye, ngesheduli enye. Yenza ngokwe-{course} bese usuku ngasinye lokuphela libalwa kusukela ekuqaleni kwalo.
cohorts.none.from: A {cohort} is a group working through a published {course} together, on one schedule. Create one against a {course} and every deadline is measured from its start date.

cohorts.roster.from: Add a cohort from a spreadsheet

cohorts.rosterIntro.text: Funda ifayela le-CSV namkha le-Excel labafundi bese ubenza bonke ngasikhathi sinye. Likutjengisa lokho eliliqobe ngefayela ngaphambi kokuthi umuntu owakhiwe, bese ubabhalisa eqoqweni elingenhla.
cohorts.rosterIntro.from: Read a CSV or Excel file of learners and create them all at once. It shows you what it made of the file before anybody is created, then enrol them onto a cohort above.

cohorts.noPublished.text: Akukho {courses} eyenyatjhisiweko okwamanje. I-{cohort} isebenza ngokwe-{course} eyenyatjhisiweko, ukuze izinto zingatjhugulukeli iqoqo eselenza kakade.
cohorts.noPublished.from: There are no published {courses} yet. A {cohort} runs against a published {course}, so that the material cannot change under a group already working through it.

cohorts.startNote.text: Usuku ngasinye lokuphela libalwa kusukela kulolu suku. Lungatjhugululwa kamuva, bese koke kutjhuguluka nalo.
cohorts.startNote.from: Every deadline is counted from this day. It can be moved later, and everything moves with it.

cohort.paid.text: Kukhokhiwe. Wonke umuntu oseqoqweni leli ubalwa njengokukhokhelwe.
cohort.paid.from: Paid. Everybody on this cohort counts as paid for.

cohort.paidRef.text: Kukhokhiwe · {reference}. Wonke umuntu oseqoqweni leli ubalwa njengokukhokhelwe.
cohort.paidRef.from: Paid · {reference}. Everybody on this cohort counts as paid for.

cohort.invoiced.from: Invoiced, and no payment recorded against it yet.

cohort.nothingRecorded.text: Akukho okurekhodiweko. Inqubo yokubhalisa iqalela lapha.
cohort.nothingRecorded.from: Nothing recorded. The enrolment procedure begins here.

cohort.moveIntro.text: Wonke amadethi angezansi abalwa ngenani lamalanga kusukela kuleli, ngalokho ukuliguqula kususa ukwethulwa koke kubo boke abaseqoqweni.
cohort.moveIntro.from: Every date below is held as a number of days from this one, so changing it moves the whole rollout for everybody on the cohort.

cohort.waitingIntro.text: Umfundi ngamunye kanye, esinyathelweni sokuthoma abangakwazi ukusivula.
cohort.waitingIntro.from: Each learner once, at the earliest step they cannot open.

cohort.progress.from: Where the cohort has got to

cohort.progressIntro.text: Okuvuliweko nokuqediweko ngesinyathelo ngasinye, nesikhathi esithathwe ngilabo abaqedileko. Kusetjenziswa umlinganiso omaphakathi hhayi ozinzileko, ukuze umfundi oyedwa olahlekele isikhathi seenyanga zibili angafihli lapho bonke abanye bakhona.
cohort.progressIntro.from: Opened and finished per step, and how long it took those who finished. The median rather than the average, so one learner who disappeared for a term does not hide where everybody else is.

cohort.stalledOne.from: One step has people sitting on it: {steps}.

cohort.stalledMany.from: {count} steps have people sitting on them: {steps}.

cohort.rolloutIntro.text: Iiseshini ezinamadethi iqoqo leli elihlangana ngazo, neregisitha ephathwa ngasinye. Lapho uhlelo lunamakhredithi kufuze kube ngumlekeleli oluhlaba isandla, futhi lokhu kubufakazi bokuthi kwenzeka njalo.
cohort.rolloutIntro.from: The dated sessions this cohort meets for, and the register taken at each. Where a programme carries credits it has to be facilitator-led, and this is the evidence that it was.

cohort.attendanceIntro.text: Okuphelele kuqhathaniswa nohlelo loke; okwamanje kuqhathaniswa nalokho okwenzekileko ngempela. Ekuqaleni kohlelo lokuqala liphansi ngokungasizi lutho, kanti lesibili ngilona elikhuluma iqiniso, ngalokho zombili ziyanikelwa hhayi ukuthi omunye akukhethele.
cohort.attendanceIntro.from: Overall is against the whole programme; to date is against what has actually been held. Early in a programme the first is meaninglessly low and the second is the honest one, so both are given rather than one being chosen for you.

cohort.held.text: Iiseshini ezingu-{held} kwa-{countable} zibanjiwe. Iiseshini ezikhanselweko nabangenela ngokuzithandela abagalelwe ngaphandle kwazo zombili.
cohort.held.from: {held} of {countable} sessions held. Cancelled sessions and voluntary walk-ins are left out of both.

cohort.feedbackIntro.text: Ithunyelwa ngemva kokuhlola okuqedako, iphendulwa ngamahora angu-{hours}. Akukho muntu ovuma ukuthi wamukele futhi akukho ophindela lutho: ukwamukelwa kuyirowu bese umbiko uyibuzo.
cohort.feedbackIntro.from: Sent after a summative, answered within {hours} hours. Nobody acknowledges receipt and nobody transcribes anything: receipt is a row and the report is a query.

cohort.assessmentIntro.text: Umfundi ngamunye ngokuhambisana nomsebenzi ngamunye ohloliweko, ngokulandelana okuqoqwa ngakho. Kufundwa ekuthunyweni, eziquntweni nakumarejista hhayi ngokugcinwa ngesandla, ngalokho akukwazi ukuphikisana nazo.
cohort.assessmentIntro.from: Every learner against every piece of assessed work, in the order it is collected. Read from submissions, decisions and registers rather than kept by hand, so it cannot disagree with them.

cohort.absentNote.text: Ukungabikho kufundwa eregisithini yeseshini lapho umsebenzi wabhalelwa khona, hhayi ekuthunyweni, ngoba umfundi ongazange ahlale akanakho okuthunyiweko okungarekhodwa kukho.
cohort.absentNote.from: Absent is read from the register of the sitting the work was written at, not from the submission, because a learner who did not attend has no submission for it to be recorded on.

cohort.workIntro.text: Lokho okufuze kwenzeke ngaphandle kokufundisa: izinto ezilungiselelwe, amadokhumende athunyelweko, umlinganisi omiselweko, iizitifikeyidi ezilandelwako.
cohort.workIntro.from: What has to happen around the teaching: material readied, documents submitted, a moderator appointed, certificates chased.

cohort.releaseIntro.text: Kubalwa ngamalanga kusukela ekuqaleni. Tjhugulula usuku lokuqala bese konke lokhu kutjhuguluka nalo.
cohort.releaseIntro.from: Held as days from the start. Change the start date and every one of these moves with it.

cohort.noSteps.from: This cohort's {course} has no steps yet.

cohort.membersIntro.text: Ukwengeza umuntu lapha kumbhalisa nakwi-{course}. Ibizo eregisithini elingakwazi ukuvula lutho liyimo engaphelelanga esigwemako lapha.
cohort.membersIntro.from: Adding somebody here also enrols them on the {course}. A name on a register who cannot open anything is the half-state this avoids.

cohortCtl.noSteps.text: Isifundo seqoqo leli asinazo izinyathelo okwamanje, ngalokho akukho okungahlelwa.
cohortCtl.noSteps.from: This cohort's course has no steps yet, so there is nothing to schedule.

cohortCtl.dayZero.text: Ilanga 0 lilusuku lokuqala. Shiya irowu ingenalutho bese isinyathelo leso singabi namadethi nakancani; sivuleka masinyane nakuqediwe okwandulela sona.
cohortCtl.dayZero.from: Day 0 is the start date. Leave a row empty and that step carries no dates at all; it opens as soon as whatever comes before it is done.

cohortCtl.everybody.text: Boke abanee-akhawunti yomfundi sebakade baseqoqweni leli. Mema abanye abantu kuqala esikrinini Sabantu.
cohortCtl.everybody.from: Everybody with a learner account is already on this cohort. Invite more people from the People screen first.

payment.referenceNote.from: So it can be matched to what finance holds.

tasks.progress.text: {done} kwa-{counted} kwenziwe: {percent}%. Umsebenzi okhanselweko ugalelwa ngaphandle kweenhlangothi zombili, ngalokho ukulahla umsebenzi akusizi namkha akulimazi inani.
tasks.progress.from: {done} of {counted} done: {percent}%. Cancelled work is left out of both halves, so abandoning a task neither helps nor hurts the figure.

rollout.nothing.text: Akukho okuhlelweko okwamanje. Lapho uhlelo lunamakhredithi kufuze kube ngumlekeleli oluhlaba isandla, ngalokho lapha kuqala ubufakazi bokuthi kwenzeka njalo.
rollout.nothing.from: Nothing scheduled yet. Where a programme carries credits it has to be facilitator-led, so this is where the evidence that it was begins.

rollout.announced.text: Iqoqo nomlekeleli batjelwa ngeseshini ngayinye ngeviki ngaphambi kwayo, kanye nesikhathi nelinki yayo, futhi batjelwa godu nayitjhugulwa, nayikhanselwa namkha nayiphuziswa.
rollout.announced.from: The cohort and the facilitator are told about each session a week before it, with its time and link, and told again if it is moved, cancelled or postponed.

archive.intro.text: Nakuthi umfundi ubambe isitatimende sakhe semiphumela futhi isitifikeyidi sakhe seziqu esivela esikhungweni sokunikela iziqu sesirekhodiwe ekhasini lakhe lokulungela i-EISA, iFayela lakhe lobufakazi lingaphuma epulatifomini lisesikhombeni esisodwa osigcinako. Isikhombe sivulwa kunoma iyiphi ibrawuza ngaphandle kwepulatifomu. Akukho okususwako ngaphandle kokuthi ikhophi oyigcinileko iqinisekiswe ngesikhombe, futhi wonke amarekhodi ahlala lapha, atjengisa ukuthi isikhombe siphi esibambe amafayela.
archive.intro.from: Once a learner holds their statement of results and their qualification certificate from the awarding body has been recorded on their EISA readiness page, their Portfolio of Evidence can leave the platform in one archive that you keep. The archive opens in any browser without the platform. Nothing is removed until your stored copy has been checked against it, and every record stays here, saying which archive holds the files.

archive.readyFor.text: Kubambe isitatimende semiphumela nesitifikeyidi seziqu sika-{qualification}.
archive.readyFor.from: Holding a statement of results and the qualification certificate for {qualification}.

archive.noQualification.text: Isifundo seqoqo leli asibaleli esiqwini esithileko.
archive.noQualification.from: This cohort's course counts towards no qualification.

archive.anotherBuilding.text: Esinye isikhombe siyabhalwa. Qala esilandelako nasiqedile.
archive.anotherBuilding.from: Another archive is being written. Start the next one when it has finished.

archive.notYetIntro.text: Bahlala epulatifomini futhi balandela esikhombeni esilandelako nakurekhodwe isitifikeyidi sabo seziqu.
archive.notYetIntro.from: They stay on the platform and follow in a later archive once their own qualification certificate has been recorded.

archive.step1Note.text: Sigcine lapho inqubomgomo yakho yamarekhodi ithi khona amarekhodi wabafundi agcinwa, isikhathi sokugcina esipheleleko. Nakususiwe amafayela, leli liyikhophi yodwa ephelele.
archive.step1Note.from: Keep it where your records policy says learner records are kept, for the full retention period. Once the files are removed, this is the only complete copy.

archive.step3.from: 3. Remove the files from the platform

archive.building.from: Being written. This page updates by itself.

archive.checkNote.text: Khetha isikhombe lapho usigcine khona. Sifundwa kukhompyutha le futhi asikhuphelwa; kuthunyelwa isigxivizo sasco kuphela. Isikhombe sikhulu ngama-{bytes} wamabhayithi.
archive.checkNote.from: Choose the archive from where you stored it. It is read on this computer and not uploaded; only its fingerprint is sent. The archive is {bytes} bytes.

archive.stored.text: Ikhophi engiyihlolileko igciniwe lapho inqubomgomo yamarekhodi yethu ithi ifuze igcinwe khona.
archive.stored.from: The copy I checked is stored where our records policy says it should be kept.

archive.keepingOne.text: Ibhalo e-1 lokubhalisa lihlala epulatifomini nalo, ngoba olunye uhlelo lomfundi lisalidinga.
archive.keepingOne.from: 1 enrolment document stays on the platform as well, because another programme of the learner's still needs it.

archive.keeping.text: Amabhalo angu-{count} okubhalisa ahlala epulatifomini nawo, ngoba olunye uhlelo lomfundi lisawadinga.
archive.keeping.from: {count} enrolment documents stay on the platform as well, because another programme of the learner's still needs them.

archive.wrongSize.text: Ifayela lelo likhulu ngama-{size} wamabhayithi kanti isikhombe sinama-{expected}. Asisiso isikhombe lesi.
archive.wrongSize.from: That file is {size} bytes and the archive is {expected}. It is not this archive.

archive.pieceRefused.from: A piece of the upload was refused.

archive.carryOn.text: {problem} Khetha ifayela godu ukuze uqhubeke lapho kumiswe khona.
archive.carryOn.from: {problem} Choose the file again to carry on from where it stopped.

archive.restoreNote.text: Kudingeka kuphela nakufuze amafayela la abe sepulatifomini godu. Isikhombe siyakhuphelwa, sihlolwe ngokwesigxivizo esithathwe nasenziwa, bese ifayela ngalinye libuyiselwa lapho belikhona.
archive.restoreNote.from: Only needed if these files have to be on the platform again. The archive is uploaded, checked against the fingerprint taken when it was made, and each file is put back where it was.

register.supervisedIntro.text: Ukuthi ubani ovunyelwe ukungena, lokho abakuvumileko, nokuthi iphepha labo lokuphendula lamukelwe. Umhlangano ngokwawo uqhutjwa lapho amakhenketho akho aqhutjwa khona; lokhu kurekhodi yokuthi wawugadelwe njani.
register.supervisedIntro.from: Who was admitted, what they agreed to, and that their script was received. The meeting itself runs where your lectures do; this is the record of how it was supervised.

register.canInvigilate.text: Leli yiseshini yokuhlola okuqedako, ngalokho ingagadelwa.
register.canInvigilate.from: This is a summative session, so it can be invigilated.

register.intro.text: Ukuthi ubani obekhona. Amamaki agciniweko angalungiswa kamuva, futhi ukutjhuguluka ngakunye kurekhodwa ngalo owukwenzileko.
register.intro.from: Who was here. Saved marks can be corrected later, and every change is recorded against whoever made it.

register.nobody.text: Akekho umuntu eqoqweni leli okwamanje, ngalokho akukho rejista ekufuze ithathwe.
register.nobody.from: Nobody is on this cohort yet, so there is no register to take.

register.excusedNote.text: Ukuxolelwa kutjho ukungabikho ngesizathu esamukelwe ngumphakeli. Kugcinwa kwehlukile nokungabikho okulula ngoba inqubo yokusekela umfundi ithembele kumehluko lo.
register.excusedNote.from: Excused means absent for a reason the provider accepted. It is kept apart from a plain absence because the learner support procedure turns on the difference.

sitting.needsAssessment.text: Ukuhlala okugadelwako kudinga ukuhlola okuzakugadelwa. Yenyatjhisa oyedwa esifundweni kuqala, bese ungahlelwa lapha.
sitting.needsAssessment.from: A supervised sitting needs an assessment to supervise. Publish one on the course first, and it can be set up here.

sitting.nothing.text: Akukho okugadelwako eseshinini le. Hlela okugadelwako nakuyikuhlola okuvalelwe: kukunikela isikhathi sokuvalwa kokungena, isibhengezo, ukuhlolwa kwekhamera, irejista yamaphepha lokuphendula nelogu yeenkinga.
sitting.nothing.from: Nothing is being supervised at this session. Set one up if this is an invigilated assessment; it gives you an admission cut-off, a declaration, a camera check, a script register and an incident log.

sitting.invigilator.from: Invigilator (optional, and can be set on the day)

sitting.early.from: Candidates arrive this many minutes early

sitting.closesAfter.text: Ukungena kuvalwa ngemva kweemizuzu ezingaka kusukela ekuqaleni
sitting.closesAfter.from: Admission closes this many minutes after the start

sitting.camera.from: A camera must be on throughout

sitting.materialsHint.text: Ikhalkhyulitha engahleleki nephepha lefomula elinikelweko. Akukho okunye.
sitting.materialsHint.from: A non-programmable calculator and the issued formula sheet. Nothing else.

sitting.declaration.text: Lokho umuntu ngamunye avuma kona ngaphambi kokuqala (okukhethwako)
sitting.declaration.from: What each candidate agrees to before starting (optional)

room.elsewhere.text: Kuyi-{time} {zone} lapho ukhona. Isikhathi esirekhodwe lapha siso somphakeli, yikho okugcinwa yirekhodi.
room.elsewhere.from: That is {time} {zone} where you are. Times recorded here are the provider's, which is what the record keeps.

room.closesAt.text: Ukungena kuvalwa ngemva kwemizuzu eyi-{minutes} kusukela ekuqaleni, ngo-{time}; ngemva kwalokho ipulatifomu iyenqaba, ngoba umuntu ongenile emuva sekade ephethe iphepha isikhathi eside kunabo boke abanye.
room.closesAt.from: Admission closes {minutes} minutes after the start, at {time}; after that the platform refuses, because somebody admitted late has had longer with the paper than everybody else.

room.closes.text: Ukungena kuvalwa ngemva kwemizuzu eyi-{minutes} kusukela ekuqaleni; ngemva kwalokho ipulatifomu iyenqaba, ngoba umuntu ongenile emuva sekade ephethe iphepha isikhathi eside kunabo boke abanye.
room.closes.from: Admission closes {minutes} minutes after the start; after that the platform refuses, because somebody admitted late has had longer with the paper than everybody else.

room.joinNote.text: Umhlangano uqhutjwa epulatifomini osuyisebenzisako. Okurekhodwa lapha kukuthi wawugadelwe njani.
room.joinNote.from: The meeting runs on the platform you already use. What is recorded here is how it was supervised.

room.noLink.text: Akukho ilinki yomhlangano eseshinini le okwamanje. Yengeze ekwethulweni ukuze abazokuhlola bazi lapho bayakhona.
room.noLink.from: No meeting link on this session yet. Add one on the roll-out so candidates know where to go.

room.incidentsNote.text: Ifayelwa ngelanga elifanako. Umbiko obhalwe emavikini ngemva kwalokho unelisiza elincani kakhulu esikhalazweni, lapho kuphela ofundelwa khona.
room.incidentsNote.from: Filed on the day. An account written weeks later is worth very little at an appeal, which is the only place it is ever read.

quals.intro.text: Isiqu somsebenzi sifundiswa ngeendlela ezintathu zemojula: Ulwazi, Ikghono elisebenzako nesipiliyoni sokusebenza. Imojula ngayinye inemfuneko yayo yokuhlola, futhi isistimu iyahlola ukuthi ikhontenthi yesifundo ihlanganisa zonke ngaphambi kokuthi isifundo sinyatjhiswe.
quals.intro.from: An occupational qualification is delivered across three kinds of module: Knowledge, Practical skill, and Workplace experience. Each module has its own assessment criteria, and the system checks that course content covers every one of them before a course can be published.

quals.folderTitle.from: Or build it from a folder

quals.folderIntro.text: Koke ngasikhathi sinye: ikharikhulamu, izigaba zokufunda, iinkambiso namapolisi. Ifolda equkethe isifingqo saso iyangeniswa ngemizuzwana; leyo engenaso kufuze ukuthi isakhiwo saso sikhandwe, futhi yiyo ingcenye edinga isengezo se-AI.
quals.folderIntro.from: Everything at once: the curriculum, the study units, the guides and the policies. A folder that includes a summary of itself imports in seconds; one that does not has to have its structure worked out, and that is the part that needs an AI extension.

quals.folderLabel.from: The qualification's folder, from your own computer

quals.folderHint.text: Koke okusefolda nakusefolda ezingaphansi kwayo kuyafundwa: ikharikhulamu, izigaba zokufunda, iinkambiso namapolisi.
quals.folderHint.from: Everything in the folder and its subfolders is read: the curriculum, the study units, the guides and the policies.

quals.folderHint2.text: Ifolda eyakhiwe yisistimu yakho yokuthuthukisa uhlelo ihlanganisa isifingqo saso, futhi lokho kufundwa ngqo, ngemizuzwana. Ifolda engenaso akukakghoneki ukuthi isakhiwo saso sikhandwe.
quals.folderHint2.from: A folder built by your programme development system includes a summary of itself, and that is read directly, in seconds. A folder without one cannot have its structure worked out yet.

quals.driveTitle.from: Or from a drive you have connected

quals.driveIntro.text: Ifolda efanako, efundwa lapho isivele iphila khona. Iphetha ngendawo efanako: isiphakamiso ukuze usihlole ngaphambi kokuthi kubhalwe lutho.
quals.driveIntro.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

quals.noneManage.text: Yakha esisodwa usebenzisa amadokhumende aso (ithebhu engenhla): ikharikhulamu nedokhumende yesiqu kwanele, futhi akukho isengezo se-AI esidingekako. Koke okunye epulatifomini kuncikile esiqwini, ngalokho lokhu kuyinto yokuthoma okufuze uyenze.
quals.noneManage.from: Build one from its documents (the tab above): the curriculum document and the qualification document are enough, and no AI extension is involved. Everything else on the platform hangs off a qualification, so this is the first thing to do.

quals.noneRead.text: Akukabi khona esilayidiweko. Nakusilayidiwe, ikharikhulamu ofundisa ngayo futhi umake ngayo izabe ikhona lapha: iimojula zayo, iindikimba zayo neemfuneko ehlolelwa ngazo. Ukuyilayida kungumsebenzi womlawuli.
quals.noneRead.from: None has been loaded yet. When one has been, the curriculum you teach and mark against will be here: its modules, its topics and the criteria each one is assessed by. Loading one is an administrator's job.

how.title.from: How would you like to add it?

how.intro.text: Iindlela ezintathu zokungena. Khetha eyodwa kuphela iyavuleka; ungayivala godu bese ukhetha okunye.
how.intro.from: Three ways in. Pick one and only that one opens; you can close it again and choose differently.

how.documents.summary.text: Ikharikhulamu, idokhumende yesiqu se-SAQA nesitatimende sokuhlola. I-App ifunda ikharikhulamu yoke kuzo.
how.documents.summary.from: The curriculum document, the SAQA qualification document and the assessment specification. The App reads the whole curriculum out of them.

how.documents.needs.text: Amafayela amabili namkha amathathu e-PDF namkha e-Word.
how.documents.needs.from: Two or three PDFs or Word files.

how.documents.speed.from: Seconds. No AI involved at any point.

how.folder.summary.text: Koke ngasikhathi sinye: ikharikhulamu, izigaba zokufunda, iinkambiso, iincwadi zomsebenzi namapolisi, kufayelwa njengoba kufundwa.
how.folder.summary.from: Everything at once: the curriculum, the study units, the guides, the workbooks and the policies, filed as they are read.

how.folder.needs.text: Ifolda yonke yesiqu, ekhompyutheni yakho namkha kudrayivu.
how.folder.needs.from: The qualification's whole folder, from your computer or a drive.

how.folder.speed.text: Imizuzu. Ifolda ehlanganisa isifingqo saso ayidingi i-AI; leyo engenaso isakhiwo sayo siyakhandwa, futhi ingcenye leyo idinga.
how.folder.speed.from: Minutes. A folder that includes a summary of itself needs no AI; one that does not has its structure worked out, and that part does.

how.blank.summary.text: Isiqu esingenalutho osakha ngesandla: isihloko, ikhodi, izinga namakhredithi, bese iimojula zaso ngayinye.
how.blank.summary.from: An empty qualification you build by hand: the title, the code, the level and credits, then its modules one at a time.

how.blank.needs.from: The details in front of you.

how.blank.speed.from: As long as it takes. Nothing is read for you.

manager.drawnFrom.from: drawn from {parent}, whose curriculum it shares

manager.standsAlone.from: standing on its own, with its own curriculum

manager.noneFromParent.text: Akukhethwanga imojula ekharikhulamu yesiqu esiyisisekelo okwamanje.
manager.noneFromParent.from: No modules chosen from the parent's curriculum yet.

manager.choose.text: Khetha ukuthi yiiphi iimojula zesiqu esiyisisekelo elithatha zona
manager.choose.from: Choose which of the parent's modules this takes

manager.chooseNote.text: Iimojula azengezwa lapha. Lokhu kuthatha ekharikhulamu yesiqu esiyisisekelo, ngalokho umsebenzi womfundi ngokwemojula ubalwa kanye kungakhathaliseki ukuthi wayihlangana kuphi.
manager.chooseNote.from: Modules are not added here. This draws from its parent's curriculum, so a learner's work against a module counts once wherever they met it.

manager.whichNote.text: Idokhumende ye-SAQA ithi yiliphi. Funa {field} ekhasini layo lokuthoma.
manager.whichNote.from: The SAQA document says which. Look for {field} on its first page.

manager.standsOnOwn.from: Nothing: it stands on its own

manager.fullOwn.from: A full qualification carries its own curriculum.

manager.sharesNote.text: Sabelana ngekharikhulamu yesiqu leso bese sithatha ingcenye yeemojula zaso; ukhetha ukuthi yiiphi nasesivele sikhona.
manager.sharesNote.from: It shares that qualification's curriculum and takes a subset of its modules; you choose which, once it exists.

manager.codeFull.text: Njengoba ibhalwe kudokhumende yekharikhulamu. Ayibalwa: yi-QCTO namkha i-OFO kuphela engatjho ukuthi iyini.
manager.codeFull.from: As written on the curriculum document. Never worked out: only the QCTO or the OFO can say what it is.

manager.codePart.text: Ikhodi efanako nesiqu esithathwa kusona. Zabelana ngekharikhulamu eyodwa, ngalokho zabelana ngekhodi yayo.
manager.codePart.from: The same code as the qualification it comes from. They share one curriculum, so they share its code.

manager.accreditationNote.text: Inomboro isiqu lesi esivunywe ngayo. Incwadi yokuvunywa eyodwa ivamise ukuhlanganisa iziqu ezimbalwa, ngalokho lokhu akusoke kufane nenomboro yomphakeli. Ukuyishiya ingenalutho kwenza imibiko ibuyele kweyomphakeli bese itjho njalo.
manager.accreditationNote.from: The number this qualification is accredited under. One accreditation letter usually covers several qualifications, so this is not always the same as the provider's own number. Leave it blank and reports fall back to the provider's and say so.

fromDoc.source.curriculum.note.from: The modules, topics and internal assessment criteria.

fromDoc.source.qualification.note.text: Isiqotjhwa sokubhaliswa kwe-SAQA. Yiyo kuphela umthombo we-ID ye-SAQA neeziphumo zeZinga lokuPhuma.
fromDoc.source.qualification.note.from: The SAQA registration extract. The only source of the SAQA ID and the Exit Level Outcomes.

fromDoc.source.assessmentSpecification.n.text: Isitatimende se-EISA. Sifayelwe futhi sifakelwe isikhombe ukuze sifunwe.
fromDoc.source.assessmentSpecification.n.from: The EISA specification. Filed and indexed so it is searchable.

fromDoc.intro.text: Lawa amathathu asisekelo sakho konke okunye. Wakhuphele bese i-App ifunda imininingwana yesiqu, iziphumo zaso zeZinga lokuPhuma nekharikhulamu yaso yoke kuwo. Hlola lokho okutholileko, lungisa noma yini engalunganga, bese kubhalwa kanye.
fromDoc.intro.from: These three are the foundation everything else is built on. Upload them and the App reads the qualification's details, its Exit Level Outcomes and its whole curriculum out of them. Check what it found, correct anything it got wrong, and it is written in one go.

fromDoc.pressThis.from: Now press this. Nothing is written yet.

fromDoc.stillReading.text: Kusafundwa: imizuzwana eyi-{seconds}. Idokhumende yekharikhulamu inde; lokhu kuyajayeleka.
fromDoc.stillReading.from: Still reading: {seconds} seconds. A curriculum document is long; this is normal.

fromDoc.found.text: Kufundwe iimojula ezingu-{modules}, iindikimba ezingu-{topics}, imigca engu-{elements} yokufundisa neemfuneko zokuhlola ezingu-{criteria}.
fromDoc.found.from: Read {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} assessment criteria.

fromDoc.foundWithElo.text: Kufundwe iimojula ezingu-{modules}, iindikimba ezingu-{topics}, imigca engu-{elements} yokufundisa neemfuneko zokuhlola ezingu-{criteria}, kanye neeziphumo zeZinga lokuPhuma ezingu-{outcomes} neemfuneko ezihlobene ezingu-{associated}.
fromDoc.foundWithElo.from: Read {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} assessment criteria, plus {outcomes} Exit Level Outcomes with {associated} associated criteria.

fromDoc.partOf.text: Idokhumende yayo ithi le yi-{kind} ethathwe ku-{parent}. Akukho okuzakukopishwa: yabelana ngekharikhulamu yesiqu leso bese ithatha iimojula ezingu-{count} zaso.
fromDoc.partOf.from: Its document says this is a {kind} drawn from {parent}. Nothing will be copied: it shares that qualification's curriculum, and takes {count} of its modules.

fromDoc.alreadyWhy.text: Ukungenisa ikharikhulamu godu kuzakuthatha indawo yeyo esele inayo, futhi konke okumakwe emfunekweni kuzakuya nayo. Lokho ongakuthanda kungukwengeza okusalako (izinto, namkha iingcenye zekharikhulamu ezingazange zifike), okwenziwa esiqwini ngokwaso futhi kungathinti okukhona kakade.
fromDoc.alreadyWhy.from: Importing the curriculum again would replace the one it has, and anything tagged to a criterion would go with it. What you probably want is to add what is missing (the material, or the parts of the curriculum that never made it), which is done on the qualification itself and leaves everything already there untouched.

fromDoc.openIt.from: Open it, and add what is missing

fromDoc.createPart.from: Create it, drawing on its parent's curriculum

fromDoc.filedPart.text: Idokhumende yaso yeSiqu ifayelwe kiso. Idokhumende yekharikhulamu nesitatimende sokuhlola azifayelwe: zesiqu esithathwa kiso, futhi sezifayelwe khona.
fromDoc.filedPart.from: Its own Qualification Document is filed against it. The curriculum document and the assessment specification are not: they belong to the qualification it comes from, and are already filed there.

fromDoc.filed.text: Yonke idokhumende oyinikeleko ifayelwe esiqwini, ukuze umlinganisi avule umthombo weemfuneko zinoma iyiphi, nokuthi ukuhlolwa kokulunga kuphelele ngaphambi kokuthi izinto zibhalwe.
fromDoc.filed.from: Every document you supplied is filed against the qualification, so a moderator can open the source of any criterion, and so the readiness gate is satisfied before material is authored.

qualPage.step.curriculumDone.text: Iimojula ezingu-{modules}, iimfuneko zokuhlola ezingu-{criteria}, ezifundwe emadokhumendeni esiqu ngokwaso.
qualPage.step.curriculumDone.from: {modules} modules, {criteria} assessment criteria, read from the qualification's own documents.

qualPage.step.curriculumTodo.text: Akukho okungafundiswa namkha kuhlolwe lapha iimojula zingakabikho.
qualPage.step.curriculumTodo.from: Nothing here can be taught or assessed until its modules exist.

qualPage.step.unitsDone.text: Izigaba ezingu-{count}, imojula ngayinye ibekwe kwesinye.
qualPage.step.unitsDone.from: {count} units, with every module placed in one.

qualPage.step.unitsNone.text: Ikharikhulamu iyanyatjhisa iimojula futhi ayitjho lutho ngokuthi uzihlanganisa njani, ngalokho lokho kumayelana nawe. Idokhumende yakho yokulinganisa ikwenza ngokukhuphela kanye: Word namkha Excel.
qualPage.step.unitsNone.from: The curriculum publishes modules and says nothing about how you group them, so this is yours to decide. Your alignment document does it in one upload: Word or Excel.

qualPage.step.unitsSomeOne.text: Imojula e-1 ayikabi sesigabeni sokufunda. Imojula engafundiswa sigaba sokufunda yimojula engafundiswa muntu.
qualPage.step.unitsSomeOne.from: 1 module belongs to no unit yet. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches.

qualPage.step.unitsSome.text: Iimojula ezingu-{count} azikabi sesigabeni sokufunda. Imojula engafundiswa sigaba sokufunda yimojula engafundiswa muntu.
qualPage.step.unitsSome.from: {count} modules belong to no unit yet. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches.

qualPage.step.materialDone.text: Iinkambiso zeenthiyori, iincwadi zomsebenzi nezokuhlola ezingu-{count} zifayelwe.
qualPage.step.materialDone.from: {count} theory guides, workbooks and assessments filed.

qualPage.step.materialTodo.text: Iinkambiso zeenthiyori, iincwadi zomsebenzi nezokuhlola. Ifolda yoke ingena kanye, iinkambiso zeempendulo ziyabonwa futhi zifihlwa abafundi, futhi akukho i-AI esetjenziswako nakancani.
qualPage.step.materialTodo.from: The theory guides, workbooks and assessments. The whole folder goes in at once, answer guides are recognised and withheld from learners, and no AI is involved at any point.

qualPage.step.captureDone.text: Zoke ezingu-{count} ziqoqiwe. Abafundi bangazipendula esikrinini.
qualPage.step.captureDone.from: All {count} captured. Learners can answer them on screen.

qualPage.step.captureTodo.text: {captured} kwa-{total} ziqoqiwe. Ezisele ngamafayela umfundi angawakhuphela kuphela.
qualPage.step.captureTodo.from: {captured} of {total} captured. The rest are files a learner can only download.

qualPage.weighted.from: weighted {k}/{p}/{w} as stated in the document

qualPage.notWeighted.text: akukho isisindo sengcenye esitjhiwoko; ukulungela kutholwa emakhredithini
qualPage.notWeighted.from: no component weighting stated; readiness derives it from credits

qualPage.partOf.text: Ingcenye yesiqu ethathwe ku-{parent}, esabelana ngekharikhulamu yayo. Akukho okukopishwako, ngalokho umsebenzi womfundi ngokwemojula ubalwa kanye kungakhathaliseki ukuthi wayihlangana kuphi.
qualPage.partOf.from: A part qualification drawn from {parent}, whose curriculum it shares. Nothing is copied, so a learner's work against a module counts once wherever they met it.

qualPage.addIntro.text: Koke okufaka into. Lokho okukhona kakade kusethebhwini enye.
qualPage.addIntro.from: Everything that puts something in. What is already here is on the other tab.

qualPage.finish.text: Qeda isiqu lesi usebenzisa ifolda ephelele
qualPage.finish.from: Finish this qualification from a fuller folder

qualPage.finishLabel.text: Ifolda ephelele yesiqu lesi, ekhompyutheni yakho
qualPage.finishLabel.from: The completed folder for this qualification, from your own computer

qualPage.finishHint.text: Kwesiqu esilayidwe ngaphambi kokuthi amadokhumende aso aphelele. Ifolda yoke iyafundwa godu (ikharikhulamu kanye nezinto) bese kungezwa kuphela okusalako.
qualPage.finishHint.from: For a qualification that was loaded before its documents were complete. The whole folder is read again (the curriculum as well as the material) and only what is missing is added.

qualPage.finishHint2.text: Akukho okukhona kakade okutjhugulwako namkha okuthathelwa indawo, kuhlanganise nokubhalwa kwemfuneko eyodwa, futhi ukuyisebenzisa kabili akwenzi lutho ngasikhathi sesibili. Usabona koke okutholakeleko bese ukuqinisekisa ngaphambi kokuthi kubhalwe lutho.
qualPage.finishHint2.from: Nothing already here is changed or replaced, down to the wording of a single criterion, and running it twice does nothing the second time. You still see everything it found and confirm it before any of it is written.

qualPage.finishDrive.text: Namkha ifolda ephelele evela kudrayivu oyixhumileko. Ifezwa ngendlela efanako: kungezwa kuphela okusalako.
qualPage.finishDrive.from: Or the completed folder from a drive you have connected. It tops up the same way: only what is missing is added.

qualPage.materialHere.text: Izinto zifika lapha: ifolda yoke ngasikhathi sinye. Akukho okugciniwe ngaphambi kokuthi ubone lokho okutholakeleko.
qualPage.materialHere.from: The material goes here: the whole folder at once. Nothing is saved until you have seen what it found.

qualPage.materialLabel.from: A folder of material, from your own computer

qualPage.materialHint.text: Iinkambiso zeenthiyori neencwadi zomsebenzi ziya esigabeni sokufunda igama lefayela lazo elitjho, iinqubomgomo nezivumelwano ziya elabhulari yamadokhumende, futhi konke okunye kuya esiqwini lesi. Akukho i-AI esetjenziswako lapha nakancani: ukuhlela amadokhumende ngegama kungumthetho hhayi isiqunto.
qualPage.materialHint.from: Theory guides and workbooks go to the study unit their filename names, policies and contracts to the document library, and everything else against this qualification. No AI is used here at all: sorting documents by name is a rule rather than a judgement.

qualPage.whereItLives.text: Namkha ifolda lapho sele ikhona khona
qualPage.whereItLives.from: Or the folder where it already lives

qualPage.alignmentHere.text: Idokhumende yakho yokulinganisa iya lapha: yikhethe, setha uhlobo layo kuMatriksi yokuLinganisa Ikharikhulamu, bese uyikhuphela. Lokho kwakha izigaba zokufunda.
qualPage.alignmentHere.from: Your alignment document goes here: choose it, set its kind to Curriculum Alignment Matrix, and upload. That builds the study units.

qualPage.blueprintIntro.text: Ifayela elichaza ikharikhulamu le ngqo: iimojula ezingu-{count}, neendikimba zazo, lokho ngayinye ekufundisako nalokho ehlolelwa kukho. Ilifake kudayirektri ye-{folder} yefolda yesiqu bese ukungenisa ngakunye kwefolda leyo emva kwalokho kulifunda ngqo, ngemizuzwana, kungekho isengezo se-AI nakancani.
qualPage.blueprintIntro.from: A file describing this curriculum exactly: {count} modules, with their topics, what each teaches and what each is assessed by. Put it in the qualification folder's {folder} directory and every import of that folder afterwards reads it straight off, in seconds, with no AI extension involved at any point.

qualPage.notCarried.from: What the file does not carry

qualPage.notCaptured.text: Iimojula ezingu-{count} kwa-{total} azinazo iimfuneko okwamanje.
qualPage.notCaptured.from: {count} of {total} modules have no criteria yet.

qualPage.notCapturedWhy.text: Akekho ongatjhiwo ukuthi ulungele i-EISA ngokwesiqu lesi ngaphambi kokuthi idokhumende yekharikhulamu yoke ibhalwe; imojula engenazo iimfuneko ayikwazi ukuhluleka, ngalokho ukuzishiya zingenalutho kungenza umfundi ngamunye abonakale aqedile.
qualPage.notCapturedWhy.from: Nobody can be declared ready for the EISA against this qualification until the whole curriculum document has been transcribed; a module with no criteria cannot be failed, so leaving them empty would make every learner look finished.

qualPage.structureIntro.text: Ikharikhulamu iyanyatjhisa iimojula; umphakeli ufundisa izigaba zokufunda. Sinye ngasinye sihlanganisa iimojula zoLwazi, zamaKghono asebenzako neZesipiliyoni sokuSebenza ezikhonza iSiphumo esisodwa seZinga lokuPhuma, okuyilokho i-External Integrated Summative Assessment ilungiselelwa khona. Abaphakeli ababili bangahlanganisa isiqu esifanako ngokuhlukileko futhi bobabili balunge, ngalokho lesi sakhiwo somphakeli hhayi sekharikhulamu.
qualPage.structureIntro.from: The curriculum publishes modules; a provider teaches study units. Each bundles the Knowledge, Practical and Work Experience modules that serve one Exit Level Outcome, which is what the External Integrated Summative Assessment is set against. Two providers may group the same qualification differently and both be correct, so this is the provider's structure rather than the curriculum's.

qualPage.seeAsLearner.from: See it as a learner will

qualPage.seeAsLearnerNote.text: kutjengisa uhlelo loke ngokulandelana kwalo, kuhlanganise nanoma yini umfundi angayitholi kuthiwe igama. Akukho okuqalwako futhi akukho okurekhodwako.
qualPage.seeAsLearnerNote.from: shows the whole programme in the order it is walked, with anything a learner would not find named. Nothing is started and nothing is recorded.

qualPage.nextStep.text: Isinyathelo esilandelako: hlanganisa iimojula lezi ezigabeni zokufunda.
qualPage.nextStep.from: The next step: group these modules into study units.

qualPage.nextStepWhy.text: Ikharikhulamu inyatjhisa iimojula futhi ayitjho lutho ngezigaba zokufunda, ngoba ukuzihlanganisa kuqunywa ngumphakeli ngokwakhe, ngalokho isiqu esifundwe emadokhumendeni aso sifika neemojula zaso zoke ezingu-{count} zingakabekwa. Lokho kulindelekile, akusiyo iphutha ekungeniseni.
qualPage.nextStepWhy.from: The curriculum publishes modules and says nothing about study units, because grouping them is the provider's own decision, so a qualification read from its documents arrives with all {count} of its modules unplaced. That is expected, not a fault in the import.

qualPage.nextStepHow.text: Khuphela idokhumende yakho yokulinganisa: leyo etjengisa iSiphumo seZinga lokuPhuma ngasinye neemojula zaso, nge-Word namkha nge-Excel. Iyakha izigaba zokufunda, izinike amagama, bese ibeka imojula ngayinye ekuyihlanganisako.
qualPage.nextStepHow.from: Upload your alignment document: the one mapping each Exit Level Outcome to its modules, in Word or Excel. It creates the study units, names them, and places every module it covers.

qualPage.unplacedOne.from: 1 module belongs to no study unit.

qualPage.unplaced.from: {count} modules belong to no study unit.

qualPage.unplacedWhy.text: {modules}. Imojula engafundiswa sigaba sokufunda yimojula engafundiswa muntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ikharikhulamu yayo iqoqwe ngokuphelele kangakhi.
qualPage.unplacedWhy.from: {modules}. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches, however completely its curriculum has been captured.

qualPage.noElo.text: Alibhekiswe kunoma yisiphi isiphumo seZinga lokuPhuma
qualPage.noElo.from: Aligned to no Exit Level Outcome

qualPage.eisaTests.text: Iimfuneko zokuhlola ezihlobene: lokho i-EISA ehlola kona
qualPage.eisaTests.from: Associated assessment criteria: what the EISA tests

qualPage.noModules.from: This study unit delivers no modules.

qualPage.documentsIntro.text: Lokhu okufayelwe lapha kuyimikhopho eqinisekileko: amadokhumende omthombo esiqu lesi esakhiwe ngawo, ngalinye lihlanganiswe nengcenye yekharikhulamu elikhonzako futhi linesigxivizo ukuze kufakazelwe ukuthi alitjhugulwanga.
qualPage.documentsIntro.from: Filed here are the authoritative copies: the source documents this qualification is built from, each attached to the part of the curriculum it serves and hashed so it can be proved unchanged.

qualPage.recordNotThing.text: Incwadi yomsebenzi namkha ukuhlola okufayelwe lapha kurekhodi, hhayi lokho umfundi asebenza kukho.
qualPage.recordNotThing.from: A workbook or an assessment filed here is a record, not the thing a learner works on.

qualPage.recordWhy.text: Lokho kufundwa bese kutjengiswa esikrinini, ukuze umfundi aphendule epulatifomini futhi umlekeleli amake bese aphawula lapho. Khuphela idokhumende ye-Word ngaphansi kwe-Qoba kunokuthi kube lapha, bese iba yimibuzo ngokwayo. Iincwadi zomfundi, iinkambiso namaphepha wokusayina endaweni yokusebenza kwehlukile: ahlala njengamadokhumende, ngoba umlekeleli uyawaphawula futhi umqeqeshi uwasayina ephepheni.
qualPage.recordWhy.from: Those are read in and presented on screen, so a learner answers in the platform and a facilitator marks and comments there. Upload the Word document under Capture rather than here, and it becomes the questions themselves. Handbooks, guides and workplace sign-off sheets are different: they stay as documents, because a facilitator annotates them and a coach signs them on paper.

qualPage.notTranscribed.from: Not yet transcribed from the curriculum document.

qualPage.iac.text: Iimfuneko zokuhlola zangaphakathi: lokho okufuze kufinyelelwe
qualPage.iac.from: Internal assessment criteria: what must be achieved

qualPage.workplaceNone.text: Akukho iimfuneko zokuhlola, okulungile ngesipiliyoni sokusebenza: sifakazelwa yirekhodi elisayiniweko lomsebenzi hhayi ngokuhlulelwa ngeemfuneko.
qualPage.workplaceNone.from: No assessment criteria, which is right for work experience: it is proved by a signed record of the work rather than judged against criteria.

qualPage.neverAchieved.text: Akukho iimfuneko zokuhlola, ngalokho indikimba le ayinakufinyelelwa.
qualPage.neverAchieved.from: No assessment criteria, so this topic can never be achieved.

removeQual.cannotWhy.text: Kurekhodwe izinto ngokwaso, futhi ipulatifomu iyazigcina. Yizona ukuhlolwa kwe-QCTO okubuza ngazo, futhi ziphila isiqu esirekhodwe ngaphansi kwaso.
removeQual.cannotWhy.from: Things have been recorded against it, and the platform keeps them. They are what a QCTO audit asks about, and they outlive the qualification they were recorded under.

removeQual.canWhy.text: Akukho okurekhodwe ngokwaso (akukho umfundi obhaliswe, akukho ukuhlala okubhalisiweko futhi akukho Sitatimende seMiphumela esikhishiwe) ngalokho singasuswa. Lokhu akukwazi ukubuyiswa.
removeQual.canWhy.from: Nothing has been recorded against it (no learner is enrolled, no sitting is registered and no Statement of Results has been issued) so it can be removed. This cannot be undone.

removeQual.wouldTake.text: Kuzakuthatha {items} nakho, kanye nendikimba ngayinye, ingcenye, imfuneko nedokhumende efayelweko engaphansi kwazo.
removeQual.wouldTake.from: It would take {items} with it, along with every topic, element, criterion and filed document beneath them.

captureList.intro.text: Lezi sezikhona epulatifomini. Ukuqoba esisodwa kufunda imibuzo yaso efayelini le-Word bese kuhlanganiswa nesiqondiso seempendulo esifayelwe eduze kwaso; akukho okukhuphelwa godu. Lokho okuphakanyiswako kutjengiswa kuwe ngaphambi kokuthi okunye kube kokuhlola.
captureList.intro.from: These are already in the platform. Capturing one reads its questions out of the Word file and pairs the answer guide filed beside it; nothing is uploaded again. What it proposes is shown to you before any of it becomes an assessment.

captureList.all.text: Zoke ezingu-{count} ziqoqiwe. Abafundi bangazipendula lezi esikrinini.
captureList.all.from: All {count} captured. Learners can answer these on screen.

captureList.noGuide.text: akukho siqondiso seempendulo esifayelwe: umbuzo ngamunye ungadinga impendulo yawo namamaki ngesandla
captureList.noGuide.from: no answer guide filed: every question would need its answer and marks by hand

uploader.kindNote.text: Imatriksi yokulinganisa ikharikhulamu iyafundwa kanye nokugcinwa: lokho etjho ngomugca ngamunye wekharikhulamu kurekhodwa.
uploader.kindNote.from: A curriculum alignment matrix is read as well as stored: what it says about each curriculum line is recorded.

uploader.titleHint.from: Left blank, the file name is used

uploader.versionNote.text: Ukukhuphela godu ngohlobo nesihloko esifanako kuthatha indawo yesandulelayo hhayi ukusiphindisa; inguqulo endala iyahlala.
uploader.versionNote.from: Uploading again with the same kind and title supersedes the previous one rather than replacing it; the old version stays.

uploader.fileNote.text: I-Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint ne-PDF. Ukuthi ifayela liyini ngempela kuvela ekuqukethweni kwalo, hhayi egameni lalo.
uploader.fileNote.from: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF. What the file actually is comes from its contents, not its name.

uploader.inMatrix.from: In the matrix, not in the curriculum as held

uploader.inMatrixNote.text: Ngayinye yengezwa iphawulwe njengeyakho, isizathu sitjengiswe, ukuze umqinisekisi akwazi ukwehlukanisa imigca yakho neyomlawuli. Susa ithiki kunoma yini engafuze yengezwe.
uploader.inMatrixNote.from: Each is added marked as your own, with the reason shown, so a verifier can always tell your lines from the regulator's. Untick anything that should not be added.

uploader.add.from: Add the ticked lines to the curriculum

buildCurr.intro.text: Yifake njengoba idokhumende yekharikhulamu iyiphrinta, ngamakhodi afanako ngokulandelana okufanako, ukuze zombili zifundwe eceleni. Umugca ngamunye ugcinwa nawuwufaka.
buildCurr.intro.from: Enter it as the curriculum document prints it, with the same codes in the same order, so the two can be read side by side. Every line saves as you enter it.

buildCurr.ready.text: Kulungele izinto. Iimojula ezingu-{modules} neemfuneko ezingu-{criteria} zikhona, ngalokho umbuzo ungamakwa kulokho oufakazelako.
buildCurr.ready.from: Ready for material. {modules} modules and {criteria} criteria are in, so a question can be tagged to what it evidences.

buildCurr.whatItIsNote.text: Kusethwe nakungeniswa, futhi ungakulungisa lapha. Isiqu esiphelele sinekharikhulamu yaso; ingcenye namkha uhlelo lwamakghono kukhetha iimojula kwenye.
buildCurr.whatItIsNote.from: Set when it was imported, and correctable here. A full qualification has its own curriculum; a part or a skills programme selects modules from one.

buildCurr.faultsNote.text: Akusiyo isango: ungahamba bese ubuya. Nokho, lokhu kunye nakunye kuyinto ipulatifomu engakwazi ukuyidlula kamuva.
buildCurr.faultsNote.from: Not a gate: you can leave and come back. Each of these, though, is something the platform cannot work around later.

addModule.note.text: Imojula yesipiliyoni sokusebenza ifakazelwa yibhuku lokurekhoda elisayinwa ngumqeqeshi, hhayi ngeemfuneko zokuhlola, ngalokho ithatha imisebenzi yendawo yokusebenza.
addModule.note.from: A work experience module is evidenced by a logbook a coach signs, not by assessment criteria, so it takes work activities instead.

addModule.nameHint.from: As the curriculum document titles it

editor.addElement.from: Add a line of what must be taught

editor.wordedHint.from: As the curriculum document words it

editor.noCriteria.text: Imojula yesipiliyoni sokusebenza ayinayo. Ifakazelwa yibhuku lokurekhoda elisayinwa ngumqeqeshi futhi lamukelwa ngumhloli, ngalokho imisebenzi yayo yendawo yokusebenza ifakwa eemikhakheni engenhla.
editor.noCriteria.from: A work experience module carries none. It is evidenced by a logbook the coach signs and an assessor accepts, so its work activities go in the topics above.

reclassify.lockedOne.text: Akukwazi ukutjhugululwa: umfundi o-1 ubhalisiwe kukho. Ukubhalisa kwenziwa nge-ID yohlelo ngalunye, futhi ukutjhugulula lokhu kungatjhugulula ukuthi bahlolwa ngeemojula eziphi, ngalokho nokufuze bakwenze ukuze baqede. Nangabe ngeqiniso kuyinto engafaneleko, yenza efaneleko bese ubabhalisa kiyo.
reclassify.lockedOne.from: It cannot be changed: 1 learner is enrolled on it. Enrolment is per programme ID, and changing what this is would change which modules they are assessed against, and so what they have to do to finish. If it is genuinely the wrong sort of thing, create the right one and enrol them onto that.

reclassify.locked.text: Akukwazi ukutjhugululwa: abafundi abangu-{count} babhalisiwe kukho. Ukubhalisa kwenziwa nge-ID yohlelo ngalunye, futhi ukutjhugulula lokhu kungatjhugulula ukuthi bahlolwa ngeemojula eziphi, ngalokho nokufuze bakwenze ukuze baqede. Nangabe ngeqiniso kuyinto engafaneleko, yenza efaneleko bese ubabhalisa kiyo.
reclassify.locked.from: It cannot be changed: {count} learners are enrolled on it. Enrolment is per programme ID, and changing what this is would change which modules they are assessed against, and so what they have to do to finish. If it is genuinely the wrong sort of thing, create the right one and enrol them onto that.

reclassify.parentNote.text: Ingcenye ayinayo idokhumende yekharikhulamu yayo: isebenzisa eyesiqu esiyisisekelo, bese ikhetha iimojula kuyo.
reclassify.parentNote.from: A part has no curriculum document of its own: it uses its parent's, and selects modules from it.

reclassify.ownModulesOne.text: Isiqu lesi sinemojula e-1 yekharikhulamu yaso, kusukela nakungeniswa. Isala lapho isesuka khona: ukusirekhoda njengengcenye akusisusi, futhi ukhetha ngokwahlukileko ukuthi yiiphi iimojula zesiqu esiyisisekelo esizikhethako.
reclassify.ownModulesOne.from: This qualification has 1 module of its own curriculum, from when it was imported. It stays where it is: recording it as a part does not delete it, and you choose separately which of the parent's modules it selects.

reclassify.ownModules.text: Isiqu lesi sinamamojula angu-{count} wekharikhulamu yaso, kusukela nakungeniswa. Asala lapho asesuka khona: ukusirekhoda njengengcenye akuwasusi, futhi ukhetha ngokwahlukileko ukuthi yiiphi iimojula zesiqu esiyisisekelo esizikhethako.
reclassify.ownModules.from: This qualification has {count} modules of its own curriculum, from when it was imported. Those stay where they are: recording it as a part does not delete them, and you choose separately which of the parent's modules it selects.

reclassify.selectedOne.text: Imojula e-1 ekhethwe kwesiqu esiyisisekelo izakususwa. Isiqu esiphelele asikhethi lutho kunanyana ngubani, futhi ukuyishiya kungaqhubeka kuyibalela kumakhredithi aso.
reclassify.selectedOne.from: The 1 module selected from its parent will be cleared. A full qualification selects nothing from anybody, and leaving it would keep it counting towards its credits.

reclassify.selected.text: Iimojula ezingu-{count} ezikhethwe kwesiqu esiyisisekelo zizakususwa. Isiqu esiphelele asikhethi lutho kunanyana ngubani, futhi ukuzishiya kungaqhubeka kuzibalela kumakhredithi aso.
reclassify.selected.from: The {count} modules selected from its parent will be cleared. A full qualification selects nothing from anybody, and leaving them would keep them counting towards its credits.

takeDoc.readFrom.text: Kufundwe ku-{file}. Akukho lutho olungezansi olungezwe okwamanje: vula imojula, uyihlole ngedokhumende, bese uyayithatha nayilungile.
takeDoc.readFrom.from: Read from {file}. Nothing below has been added yet: open a module, check it against the document, and take it if it is right.

takeDoc.goToDocuments.from: Go to the documents for this qualification

takeDoc.notesNote.text: Lokho ukufunda okungakhange kukwazi ukukuchaza, nalokho idokhumende ngokwayo elingabalani. Akukho kokubili okukuvimbela ukuthatha imojula, nokho kokubili kufaneleke ukufundwa kuqala.
takeDoc.notesNote.from: What the reading could not account for, and what the document itself does not add up. Neither stops you taking a module, though both are worth reading first.

takeDoc.addedCounts.text: Kwengezwe imikhakha engu-{topics}, imigca engu-{elements} yokufundisa neemfuneko ezingu-{criteria}.
takeDoc.addedCounts.from: Added {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} criteria.

takeDoc.byHand.from: Add these by hand on the curriculum screen.

takeDoc.empty.text: Akukho okufundiweko ngaphasi kwemojula le. Ukuyithatha kuzakwenza imojula kuphela, bese imikhakha yayo ingengezwa ngesandla.
takeDoc.empty.from: Nothing was read under this module. Taking it will create the module alone, and its topics can be added by hand.

element.asWorded.text: {kind}, njengoba idokhumende yekharikhulamu ikubeka ngamagama. Akukho okungatjhugululwa kuleli khasi: ikharikhulamu ekhutjhiweko ngeye-QCTO, hhayi yomphakeli.
element.asWorded.from: {kind}, exactly as the curriculum document words it. Nothing on this page may be edited here: a published curriculum is the QCTO's, not the provider's.

element.coversNote.text: Kusuka kumatriksi yokufanisa ikharikhulamu, njengoba umphakeli akubhale khona lapho.
element.coversNote.from: From the Curriculum Alignment Matrix, as the provider wrote it there.

element.uncovered.from: Nothing is recorded as covering this line.

element.uncoveredNote.text: Lokho kungaba sikhala sangempela kuhlelo namkha imatriksi engakakhutjhelwa. Khuphela imatriksi yokufanisa ikharikhulamu kusiqu lesi bese yonke imigca ebiza yona igcwaliswa kanyekanye.
element.uncoveredNote.from: That is either a real gap in the programme or a matrix that has not been uploaded yet. Upload the Curriculum Alignment Matrix against this qualification and every line it names is filled in at once.

element.notHeld.text: kubizwe kumatriksi, kodwa akukho dokhumende egciniwe lapha enegama lelo.
element.notHeld.from: named in the matrix, but no document held here has that name.

element.assessedNote.text: Iimfuneko zokuhlola zangaphakathi zomkhakha lo umgca lo okuwo.
element.assessedNote.from: The internal assessment criteria of the topic this line belongs to.

element.workplace.text: Imojula yesipiliyoni sokusebenza ayinaso iimfuneko zokuhlola. Lokho eyakudingako kufakazelwa yirekhodi esayiniweko yomsebenzi ngokwawo, elamukelwa ngumhloli, kunokuthi kuhlulwe ngeemfuneko.
element.workplace.from: A work experience module has no assessment criteria. What it requires is evidenced by a signed record of the work itself, accepted by an assessor, rather than judged against criteria.

element.noCriteria.text: Umkhakha lo awunazo iimfuneko zokuhlola, ngalokho akukho lapha okungafinyelelwa. Zingakabanjwa kudokhumende yekharikhulamu, akukho mfundi ongaqeda imojula le.
element.noCriteria.from: This topic has no assessment criteria, so nothing here can ever be achieved. Until they are captured from the curriculum document, no learner can complete this module.

element.taughtNote.text: Izigaba zokufunda ephakelwa kizo imojula le.
element.taughtNote.from: The study units this module is delivered in.
