partModules.introPart.text: Ingcenye yesiqu le ithathwe ku-{parent} bese yabelana ngekharikhulamu yaso{code}. Tikha iimojula idokhumende yaso ye-SAQA eziveza ngaphasi kwe-{rules}. Akukho okukopiwe: umsebenzi womfundi ngemojula ubalwa kanye, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi wayihlangana kuphi.
partModules.introPart.from: This part qualification is drawn from {parent} and shares its curriculum{code}. Tick the modules its own SAQA document lists under {rules}. Nothing is copied: a learner's work against a module counts once, wherever they met it.

partModules.introOther.text: Uhlelo lolu lithathwe ku-{parent} bese lubelana ngekharikhulamu yalo{code}. Tikha iimojula idokhumende yalo ye-SAQA eziveza ngaphasi kwe-{rules}. Akukho okukopiwe: umsebenzi womfundi ngemojula ubalwa kanye, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi wayihlangana kuphi.
partModules.introOther.from: This programme is drawn from {parent} and shares its curriculum{code}. Tick the modules its own SAQA document lists under {rules}. Nothing is copied: a learner's work against a module counts once, wherever they met it.

partModules.notRead.from: The parent's curriculum has not been read in yet

partModules.notReadNote.text: Akukho okungakhethwa ngaphandle kokuthi idokhumende yekharikhulamu ye-{parent} ifundwe. Enza lokho kuqala, bese uhlu lolu lugcwala lona.
partModules.notReadNote.from: There is nothing to choose from until {parent} has its curriculum document read in. Do that first, and this list fills itself.

partModules.noClaim.text: Akukho sibalo sonke samakhredithi esirekhodiweko sesiqu lesi, ngalokho akukho okungahlolwa ngakho. Idokhumende yaso ye-SAQA ithi ngalinye ngaphasi kwe-Minimum Credits.
partModules.noClaim.from: No credit total is recorded for this qualification, so there is nothing to check against. Its SAQA document states one under Minimum Credits.

partModules.agree.text: Lokhu kuyavumelana, lokho kuyisikhombisi sokuthi iimojula ezifaneleko zitikhiwe.
partModules.agree.from: These agree, which is the sign the right modules are ticked.

partModules.disagree.text: Lokhu akuvumelani. Namkha imojula etikhiweko ayikho ohlwini lwedokhumende ye-SAQA, namkha eyodwa ekhona kuyo ayikho, namkha amakhredithi emojula afundwe kuphosakele. Kufaneleke ukuhlolwa ngaphambi kokugcina; ipulatifomu izakugcina lokho oyitjela khona.
partModules.disagree.from: These do not agree. Either a module is ticked that the SAQA document does not list, or one it lists is missing, or the credits on a module were read in wrongly. Worth checking before saving; the platform will still save what you tell it.

qualPreview.title.from: As a learner will see it

qualPreview.intro.text: Konke okukhona ku-{programme}, ngokulandelana okuhanjwa ngakho ngumuntu obhalisiweko kiyo. Akukho okuqalisa lutho lapha: akukho kubhalisa okwenziwako, akukho kulinga okuvulwako futhi akukho nqubekelaphambili erekhodwako, ngalokho lokhu kungafundwa kangakhulu ngendlela ofuna ngayo.
qualPreview.intro.from: The whole {programme} in the order somebody enrolled on it walks it. Nothing here starts anything: no enrolment is made, no attempt is opened and no progress is recorded, so this can be read as often as you like.

qualPreview.gaps.from: What a learner would not find

qualPreview.allReadyNote.text: Isinyathelo ngasinye kusigaba sokufunda ngasinye sinokuthile ngasemuva kwaso. Umfundi obhalisiwe ku-{programme} le namuhla angakufumana koke.
qualPreview.allReadyNote.from: Every step in every study unit has something behind it. A learner enrolled on this {programme} today would find the whole of it.

qualPreview.build.from: Build what a learner works through

qualPreview.open.from: Open it as a learner sees it

qualPreview.change.from: Change the order or what is on it

courseList.noneAuthor.text: Isifundo yilokho umfundi asebenza ngakho ngempela. Sixhumana nesigaba sokufunda namkha imojula yekharikhulamu, ngalokho kufaneleke ukungenisa isiqu kuqala.
courseList.noneAuthor.from: A course is what a learner actually works through. It hangs off a study unit or a curriculum module, so a qualification is worth loading first.

courseList.noneReader.text: Akukakhutjhwa lutho ngenxa yakho okwamanje. Nakukhona, lokho obhalisiwe kukho kuzakuba lapha.
courseList.noneReader.from: Nothing has been published for you yet. When it has been, what you are enrolled on will be here.

newCourse.noModule.from: Not part of an accredited qualification

newCourse.moduleNote.text: Yihlanganise nemojula yekharikhulamu bese isistimu izakuhlola, ngaphambi kokuthi ikhutjhwe, ukuthi yonke imfuneko yokuhlola kumojula leyo inelesoni ngasemuva kwayo.
newCourse.moduleNote.from: Bind it to a curriculum module and the system will check, before it can be published, that every assessment criterion in that module has a lesson behind it.

courseEdit.published.text: Lokhu sekukhutjhiwe, ngalokho okukiyo kuqinisiwe. Abafundi abakuqedileko banamarekhodi abhekiswa kule nguqulo ngqo.
courseEdit.published.from: This is published, so its content is fixed. Learners who completed it have records that refer to exactly this version.

courseEdit.publishedAuthor.text: Ukuze uyitjhugulule, vula inguqulo entsha; ekhutjhiweko isala injalo.
courseEdit.publishedAuthor.from: To change it, open a new version; the published one stays as it is.

courseEdit.folderNote.text: Khetha ifolda lapho izinto zokufunda zikhona bese koke okuphakathi kwayo, kubandakanya iifolda ezingaphasi kwayo, kufundwa, kufayelwa bese kuqanjwa isikhombi. Ubona lokho okuzakufayelwa ngaphambi kokuthi kubhalwe lutho.
courseEdit.folderNote.from: Choose the folder this material lives in and everything in it, including its subfolders, is read, filed and indexed. You see what it would file before anything is written.

courseEdit.folderLabel.from: Its folder, from your own computer

courseEdit.folderHint.text: Iiqondiso, iincwadi zomsebenzi, iinqubomgomo namathempulethi kufayelwa kiyo bese umbhalo wazo uqanjelwa isikhombi ukuze kuseshwe.
courseEdit.folderHint.from: Guides, workbooks, policies and templates are filed against it and their text indexed so they can be searched.

courseEdit.folderHint2.text: Ukwakheka akwenziwi lapha: isimo saso sakhiwa kumhleli ongenhla namkha eemojulani zesiqu. Lokhu kufayela lokho esinakho.
courseEdit.folderHint2.from: Structure is not created from here: its own shape is built in the editor above or from a qualification's modules. This files what it holds.

courseEdit.drive.from: Or from a drive you have connected

courseEdit.driveNote.text: Ifolda efanako, efundwa lapho isele khona. Iphetha ngendawo efanako: isiphakamiso ekufuze sihlolwe ngaphambi kokuthi kubhalwe lutho.
courseEdit.driveNote.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

courseEdit.noSections.text: Ayikho iingcenye okwamanje. Yakhiwa ngeengcenye, futhi ingcenye ngayinye iqukethe amalesoni.
courseEdit.noSections.from: No sections yet. It is built from sections, and each section holds lessons.

courseEdit.noLessons.from: No lessons in this section yet.

courseEdit.competenciesNote.text: Lokho ukuyiqeda okukubonisako. Ayikwazi ukukhutjhwa ngaphandle kwekghono, ngoba ukuqedwa kwayo akukwazi ukubikwa njengekghono.
courseEdit.competenciesNote.from: What completing it demonstrates. It cannot be published with no competency, because its completions could not be reported as capability.

courseEdit.coveredAcross.text: kweemfuneko zokuhlola ezingu-{count} ezihlanganisiweko eemojulani ze-{unit}
courseEdit.coveredAcross.from: of {count} assessment criteria covered across {unit}'s modules

courseEdit.coveredNote.text: Kuhlanganiswe yilesoni lapha, umbuzo kolunye lokuhlola kwaso okuxhumene nayo, namkha lokho imatriksi yakho yokufanisa ekubiza ngokuyihlola. Khuphela imatriksi esiqwini ukuze urekhode okugcina.
courseEdit.coveredNote.from: Covered by a lesson here, a question on one of its assessments that is linked to it, or what your alignment matrix names as assessing it. Upload the matrix on the qualification to record the last.

courseEdit.unbound.text: Lokhu akuhlanganiswe nemojula yekharikhulamu egunyaziweko, ngalokho akukho mfuneko zokuhlola ekufuze zihlanganiswe.
courseEdit.unbound.from: This is not bound to an accredited curriculum module, so there are no assessment criteria to cover.

courseEdit.publishNote.text: Ukukhipha akuvunyelwa ngesikhathi nanyana yini engenhla ingaphelele.
courseEdit.publishNote.from: Publishing is refused while anything above is incomplete.

courseEdit.newVersionNote.text: Abafundi abaqede inguqulo le bagcina irekhodi yabo yayo.
courseEdit.newVersionNote.from: Learners who completed this version keep their record of it.

spine.intro.text: Ukulandelana kokuhamba {course} le, nokuvala isinyathelo ngasinye aze kuqedwe esandulelako. Koke okulapha sele kubanjelwe {course} le: ukukufaka ohlwini yikho okwenza umfundi akuhlangane.
spine.intro.from: The order this {course} is walked in, and what holds each step shut until the one before it is done. Everything here is already held against this {course}: putting it on the list is what makes a learner meet it.

spine.empty.text: Akukho okukiyo okwamanje, ngalokho umfundi obhalisiweko kiyo angayivula bese athola ikhasi elingenalutho. Engeza into yokuqala ngezansi.
spine.empty.from: Nothing is on it yet, so a learner enrolled on it would open it and find an empty page. Add the first thing below.

spine.waitsForBefore.from: Waits for the step before it to be {rule}.

spine.nothingLeft.text: Koke okubanjelwe kiyo sekusohlwini. Bamba ibhuku lomsebenzi namkha fayela idokhumende kiyo, bese kuzabonakala lapha.
spine.nothingLeft.from: Everything held against it is already on the list. Capture a workbook or file a document against it, and it will appear here.

spine.openAtStart.text: Kuvulekile kusukela ekuqaleni, kunokuthi kube ngemva kwesinyathelo esandulelako
spine.openAtStart.from: Open from the start, rather than after the step before it

courseAssess.intro.text: Ikhwizi yokwakha iyamakwa ngokuzenzakalela. Ukuhlola okuqedako kuhlulwa ngumuntu ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi kulinganiswa ngokuzimela ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngoba yikho okubalelwa esiqwini.
courseAssess.intro.from: A formative quiz is marked automatically. A summative assessment is always judged by a person and always moderated independently, because it is the one that counts towards a qualification.

courseAssess.options.from: Answer options: tick every one that is correct

courseAssess.published.text: Kukhutjhiwe. Umfundi uyakuhlangana nakho nakube sisinyathelo ku-{link}.
courseAssess.published.from: Published. A learner meets it once it is a step in {link}.

courseAssess.sampleNote.text: Izinga eliphasi, hhayi eliphezulu. Ubukhulu beqoqo buliphakamisa: iqoqo elinabantu abangaba ngu-10 namkha ngaphasi lilinganiswa ngokuphelele, bese elinabantu abangaba ngama-20 namkha ngaphasi lilinganiswa ngengcenye, ngoba ikota yeempapha ezi-8 yimbili, futhi ezimbili azitjho lutho ngesiqunto somhloli. Inani leli lilawula amaqoqo angaphezu kwama-20. Liyaphelelwa emandleni ekuhloleni okuqedako, lapho zonke iziqunto zilinganiswa, futhi umhloli osanda kubhaliswa ulinganiswa ngokuphelele njalo.
courseAssess.sampleNote.from: A floor, not a ceiling. Cohort size raises it: a cohort of ten or fewer is moderated in full and one of twenty or fewer at half, because a quarter of eight scripts is two, and two say almost nothing about an assessor's judgement. This figure governs cohorts above twenty. Ignored for a summative assessment, where every decision is moderated, and a newly registered assessor is always moderated in full.

courseEnrol.draft.text: Lokhu kusaba yidrafti. Kufuze kukhutjhwe ngaphambi kokuthi ubani abelwe kukho: idrafti ayikadluli ekuhlolweni okuqinisekisa ukuthi okuqukethwe kwayo kuhlanganisa lokho okutjhoyo.
courseEnrol.draft.from: This is still a draft. It has to be published before anyone can be assigned to it: a draft has not passed the checks that confirm its content covers what it claims to.

courseEnrol.waitingNote.text: Umfundi ngamunye ubonakala kanye, esinyathelweni sokuqala angakwazi ukusivula. Ukubanjwa esinyathelweni sesithathu yiqiniso elifaneleke ukusebenzelwa; ukubanjwa nakuzinyathelo zesine kuya kwesi-10 kungumsindo kuphela.
courseEnrol.waitingNote.from: Each learner appears once, at the earliest step they cannot open. Being held up at step three is the fact worth acting on; also being held up at steps four to ten is noise.

courseEnrol.everyone.from: Everyone in the organisation is already on it.

courseEnrol.manyNote.text: Namathisela amakheli e-imeyili, ikheli linye emgceni ngamunye. Ikholomu ekopiwe ngqo ku-spreadsheet iyasebenza.
courseEnrol.manyNote.from: Paste email addresses, one per line. A column copied straight out of a spreadsheet works.

settings.intro.text: Ukuthi {name} ibonakala njani kubantu bakho, nokuthi i-App ifunda njani amadokhumende abawakhuphelako. Iinguquko zisebenza yonke indawo ngokuphazima: akukho okufuze kwakhiwe godu namkha kuthunyelwe godu.
settings.intro.from: How {name} looks to your people, and how the App reads the documents they upload. Changes apply everywhere immediately: there is nothing to rebuild or redeploy.

settings.drive.connected.text: Kuxhunyiwe. Ifolda ingafundwa ngqo kiyo manje.
settings.drive.connected.from: Connected. A folder can now be read straight from it.

settings.drive.cancelled.from: Nothing was connected: the consent was cancelled.

settings.drive.state.text: Imvume leyo ayifani neqalwe yibhrawusa le, ngalokho akukho okuxhunyiweko. Qala godu kuleli khasi.
settings.drive.state.from: That consent did not match the one this browser started, so nothing was connected. Start again from this page.

settings.drive.nocode.text: Umphakeli akathumelanga lutho ukuze kuxhunywe. Linga godu.
settings.drive.nocode.from: The provider sent nothing back to connect with. Try again.

settings.drive.failed.text: Ukuxhumana kuhlulekile ukuphela. Akukho okugciniwe. Kufaneleke ukulinga godu ngaphambi kwanoma yini.
settings.drive.failed.from: The connection could not be completed. Nothing was stored. Trying again is worth doing before anything else.

settings.mailNote.text: Ukuthi abafundi bayakwazi ngempela ukwamukela imininingwana yabo yokungena namaziso. Kufaneleke ukuhlolwa ngemva kokuthi ubani atjhugulule amasethingi eposo, nokokuqala okufuze kuhlolwe nakuthiwa i-imeyili ayikafiki.
settings.mailNote.from: Whether learners can actually receive their sign-in details and notifications. Worth checking after anybody changes the mail settings, and the first thing to check when somebody says an email never arrived.

settings.sso.from: Signing in with Google or Microsoft

settings.ssoNote.text: Kuvumela abantu bakho ukuthi bangene nge-akhawunti yenhlangano yabo ye-Google namkha ye-Microsoft esikhundleni sephasiwedi lapha, leyo eqhubeka isebenza eceleni kwayo. Ingenisa kuphela abantu abasele banayo i-akhawunti epulatifomini le, ehlanganiswa nekheli le-imeyili ngekhathi lokuqala; ayikaze yenze eyodwa.
settings.ssoNote.from: Lets your people sign in with their organisation's Google or Microsoft account instead of a password here, which keeps working beside it. It only signs in people who already have an account on this platform, matched by email address the first time; it never creates one.

settings.terminologyNote.text: Sebenzisa amagama wakho. Umphakeli ongaphandle kweSewula Afrika angeke athi uhlelo, futhi ophakathi kwayo angeke athi isifundo; ipulatifomu akufaneli ifune ngamandla.
settings.terminologyNote.from: Use your own vocabulary. A provider outside South Africa may not say programme, and a provider inside it may not say course; the platform should not insist.

settings.templatesNote.text: Ukuthi ngamunye wamadokhumende umphakeli lo awakhiphako afundeka njani futhi abonakala njani.
settings.templatesNote.from: How each document this provider issues reads and looks.

settings.templatesMoved.text: manje ngaphasi kwesigaba esithi Ukulawula, nawo wonke amadokhumende ipulatifomu ewakhiphako nokuthi ngamunye uthola ngubani.
settings.templatesMoved.from: now under Management, with every document the platform produces and who receives each one.

settings.menuNote.text: Hlela godu ibha engaphezulu: tjhugulula ihlokwana, hambisa ikhasi ngaphasi kwelinye, namkha yenza ikhasi libe yilinki eqondile. Kufana kubo bonke kumphakeli lo, ngoba abasebenzi batjelana ukuthi izinto zikuphi.
settings.menuNote.from: Rearrange the bar at the top: rename a heading, move a page under a different one, or make a page a direct link. The same for everybody at this provider, because staff tell each other where things are.

settings.drivesNote.text: Funda ifolda ngqo kuGoogle Drive namkha kuOneDrive, kunokuthi uyilande bese uyikhuphela godu. Ngeyakho hhayi yomphakeli: onke amalungu abasebenzi axhuma eyawo.
settings.drivesNote.from: Read a folder straight from Google Drive or OneDrive, instead of downloading it and uploading it again. Yours rather than this provider's: every member of staff connects their own.

settings.extensionNote.text: Ngeprofayili yakho. Okukhethwako, kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalela, futhi lokho kukuvumela ukukwenza kukhawulelwe yindima yakho njengoba kunjalo kokunye koke.
settings.extensionNote.from: Against your own profile. Optional, off by default, and what it lets you do is bounded by your role exactly as everything else is.

providerLang.note.text: Ilimi abantu bakho abafunda ngalo ipulatifomu, ngaphandle kwalabo abazikhethela elabo ngaphasi kwegama labo ngaphezulu kwekhasi. Iiskrini ezingakahunyushwa zisala ngesiNgisi, namagama wakho wezinto (Amasethingi, Amatemu) agcinwa njengoba uwabhale ngawo kuwo wonke amalimi.
providerLang.note.from: The language your people read the platform in, unless they choose their own under their name at the top of the page. Screens not yet translated stay in English, and your own names for things (Settings, Terminology) are kept as you wrote them in every language.

brand.accentNote.from: Highlights, progress bars and certificate borders.

brand.logoNote.text: Ibonakala ehedhani, ekhasini lokungena nakusitifikeyidi ngasinye. I-PNG enemuva ecacileko ilingana kakhulu nombala wehedha. Ingaphasi kwama-2 MB.
brand.logoNote.from: Appears in the header, on the sign-in page and on every certificate. A PNG with a transparent background sits best on the header colour. Under 2 MB.

brand.unfinished.text: Ukukhuphela akuphelelanga. Hlola ukuxhumana bese ulinga godu.
brand.unfinished.from: The upload did not finish. Check the connection and try again.

brand.removeLogo.from: Remove, and show the name instead

brand.logoAddress.text: Namkha ikheli, nangabe isithombe sesigcinwe kwenye indawo
brand.logoAddress.from: Or an address, if the image is already hosted elsewhere

brand.signInNote.text: Okukhethwako. Ngaphandle kwalutho lapha ikhasi litjengisa igama lakho kumbala wakho, okucocekileko kodwa kulula. Igrafikhi etjho into eyiqiniso ngalokho okwenzako ibaluleke kunelihlobisako.
brand.signInNote.from: Optional. With nothing here the page shows your name on your own colour, which is tidy but plain. A graphic that says something true about what you do is worth more than a decorative one.

brand.characterNote.text: Ibonakala esikrinini esingakabi nalutho, eceleni kwesivakalisi esichaza ukuthi kuzakuba yini lapho, naseceleni kwenkinobho ekufuze umuntu ayinyathele ngokulandelako, lapho ikhona ukuze ibonwe. Incani, iqondile, futhi ilungile kunokuhlobisa. Yishiye ingenalutho ukusebenzisa eyepulatifomu le, namkha ungasebenzisi lutho.
brand.characterNote.from: Appears on a screen with nothing on it yet, beside the sentence explaining what would be there, and beside a button somebody has to press next, where it is there to be noticed. Small, upright, and friendlier than it is decorative. Leave it empty to use this platform's own, or nothing at all.

shape.intro.text: Imibuzo emibili iqunta isimo sepulatifomu yakho nokuthi iingcenye zayo zibizwa njani. Koke ongakukhethi kuyanyamalala: iiskrini zako, iinkhomba zemenyu neekheli zakho.
shape.intro.from: Two questions decide the shape of your platform and what its parts are called. Everything you do not choose goes away: its screens, its menu entries and its addresses.

shape.nothingDeletedNote.text: Ukutjhugulula lokhu kufihla izinto. Koke okurekhodwe kakade kusala lapho kuhlala khona, bese ukukhetha godu kubuyisa iiskrini namarekhodi angadlaliwe.
shape.nothingDeletedNote.from: Changing this hides things. Whatever has already been recorded stays where it is, and choosing it again brings the screens back with the records intact.

shape.saved.text: Kugciniwe. Imenyu namagama kutjhugulukile ukuze kufane.
shape.saved.from: Saved. The menu and the wording have changed to match.

shape.unavailable.text: Akutholakali ngokukhethwe ngenhla. Isigaba sokufunda sisendaweni yesiqu, kanti ipulatifomu le ayinaso.
shape.unavailable.from: Not available with the choice above. A study unit sits inside a qualification, and this platform has none.

shape.standalone.from: Three things that stand on their own

shape.statutoryCovers.text: Ukuthumela i-NLRD ne-Edu.Dex, iimbiko ze-WSP ne-ATR, nerejista emiswe ngomthetho ngasemuva kwazo.
shape.statutoryCovers.from: NLRD and Edu.Dex exports, WSP and ATR returns, and the statutory register behind them.

shape.statutoryWhen.text: ungaphandle kweSewula Afrika, namkha omunye ubhala egameni lakho.
shape.statutoryWhen.from: you are outside South Africa, or somebody else files on your behalf.

shape.workplaceCovers.text: Izivumelwano zendawo yokusebenza, iiqondiso zabaqeqeshi, amashidi wokusayina namahora umfundi awarekhodako kumqashi ophakelayo.
shape.workplaceCovers.from: Workplace agreements, coach guides, sign off sheets and the hours a learner logs against a host employer.

shape.workplaceWhen.from: nothing you deliver is assessed in a workplace.

shape.offlineCovers.text: Abafundi bafaka ipulatifomu efonini yabo, balande izinto zabo zokufunda ngaphambi kokuphuma, bazifunde ngaphandle kwesignali, bese barekhoda umsebenzi wabo ukuze bawuthumele nabakhona isignali godu.
shape.offlineCovers.from: Learners install the platform on their phone, download their study material before they go out, read it with no signal, and record their work to send back when they next have one.

shape.offlineWhen.text: abafundi bamala amalanga bangekho kusignali, njengasensimini. Okuqedako kuhlala kuku-inthanethi ngaphandle kokuthi uhlelo lusethwe ngokuhlukileko ngamabomu.
shape.offlineWhen.from: learners spend days away from a signal, such as in the field. Summatives stay online unless a programme is deliberately set otherwise.

shape.rename.text: Ungatjhugulula igama lanoma yikuphi kwalokhu ngaphasi kwe-{link}. Amagama isimo lesi esiwasebenzisako kuphela akhona lapho.
shape.rename.from: You can rename any of these under {link}. Only the words this shape actually uses are offered there.

shape.award.qualification_programme.cove.text: Into eyodwa. Umfundi ufakwa esiqwini bese yilokho asebenza ngakho. Akukho ileya ehlukileko yokuhlanganisa ngenhla kwaso.
shape.award.qualification_programme.cove.from: One thing. A learner is put onto the qualification and that is what they work through. There is no separate bundling layer above it.

shape.award.qualification_programme.when.text: Uphakela isiqu esisodwa somsebenzi njengohlelo olulodwa lokufunda.
shape.award.qualification_programme.when.from: You deliver one occupational qualification as one learning programme.

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: Isiqu noHlelo, ngokwahlukana
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: Qualification and Programme, separately

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: Izinto ezimbili ezahlukileko. Isiqu siphethe ukugunyazwa nekharikhulamu; uhlelo luhlanganisa lokho umfundi asebenza ngakho, bese lungaphendula esiqwini namkha lungaphenduli.
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: Two different things. A qualification holds the accreditation and the curriculum; a programme bundles what a learner works through, and may answer to a qualification or to none.

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: Uqhuba iziqu ezigunyaziweko futhi uhlanganisa okuphakelwako kube yilandelano elingasiso isiqu esisodwa ngasinye.
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: You run accredited qualifications and also bundle deliverables into sequences that are not one qualification each.

shape.award.programmes_only.covers.text: Izihlelo zihlanganisa lokho umfundi asebenza ngakho. Akukho rekhodi yokugunyazwa, akukho kharikhulamu, akukho matatimende weemiphumela.
shape.award.programmes_only.covers.from: Programmes bundle what a learner works through. No accreditation record, no curriculum, no statements of results.

shape.award.programmes_only.when.text: Akukho okuphakelako okuphendula esiqwini esibhalisiweko: ukwethulwa, ukuvuselelwa kokuthobela imithetho, izihlelo zamakghono zangaphakathi.
shape.award.programmes_only.when.from: Nothing you deliver answers to a registered qualification: induction, compliance refreshers, internal skills programmes.

shape.award.standalone.covers.text: Yonke into iziimele. Akukho okuyihlanganisako futhi akukho okuyigunyazako.
shape.award.standalone.covers.from: Everything stands on its own. Nothing bundles it and nothing accredits it.

shape.award.standalone.when.text: Yonke ingcenye yokuqeqeshwa oyiqhubako ithathwa ngokwayo, inye ngesikhathi.
shape.award.standalone.when.from: Every piece of training you run is taken on its own, one at a time.

shape.delivery.courses.covers.text: Isifundo yilokho umfundi afakwa kiko bese asebenza ngakho: amalesoni aso, iincwadi zaso zomsebenzi, ukuhlola kwaso. Singaba ngaphasi kohlelo, futhi asidingi ukuphendula esiqwini.
shape.delivery.courses.covers.from: A course is what a learner is put onto and works through: its lessons, its workbooks, its assessments. It may sit under a programme, and it need answer to no qualification.

shape.delivery.courses.when.text: Abantu bakho bathi isifundo, namkha wakha ukuqeqeshwa okungalawulwa siqu.
shape.delivery.courses.when.from: Your people say course, or you build training that no qualification governs.

shape.delivery.study_units.covers.text: Isigaba sokufunda yilokho umfundi asebenza ngakho, futhi sithatha isikhundla sesifundo ngokuphelele. Sisendaweni yesiqu, sihlanganisa iimojula zolwazi, zokusebenza nezendawo yokusebenza ezisebenzela umphumela owodwa wezinga lokuphuma.
shape.delivery.study_units.covers.from: A study unit is what a learner works through, and it replaces the course entirely. It sits inside a qualification, bundling the knowledge, practical and workplace modules that serve one exit level outcome.

shape.delivery.study_units.when.text: Abantu bakho bathi isigaba sokufunda kunesifundo. Ikharikhulamu ikhipha iimojula bese ishiya ukuhlanganisa kuwe, ngalokho lesi sakhiwo sakho. Sidinga isiqu ngaphezulu.
shape.delivery.study_units.when.from: Your people say study unit rather than course. The curriculum publishes modules and leaves the grouping to you, so this is your own structure. Requires a qualification at the top.

shape.note.qualificationProgramme.text: Into eyodwa. Umfundi ufakwa esiqwini, bese yilo uhlelo asebenza ngalo.
shape.note.qualificationProgramme.from: One thing. A learner is put onto the qualification, and that is the programme they work through.

shape.note.qualification.text: Irekhodi yokugunyazwa: ikharikhulamu yaso, iimfuneko neemiphumela yezinga lokuphuma.
shape.note.qualification.from: The accreditation record: its curriculum, criteria and exit level outcomes.

shape.note.programmeWithQualification.text: Ilandelano elihlelekileko, elingaphendula esiqwini namkha lingaphenduli.
shape.note.programmeWithQualification.from: An ordered sequence, which may answer to a qualification or to none.

shape.note.programmeOnly.from: An ordered sequence, answering to no registered qualification.

shape.note.bottom.text: Lokho umfundi asebenza ngakho. Akukho okungaphasi kwako.
shape.note.bottom.from: What a learner works through. There is nothing below it.

clock.note.text: Wonke isikhathi esisethelwe etafuleni le-App sitjho iwatjhi le. Ilekitjhara ka-18:30 ingu-18:30 lapha, futhi umnqandelo wokungena wesihlalo esigadelwako uhlolwa ngayo.
clock.note.from: Every timetabled time in the App means this clock. A lecture at 18:30 is 18:30 here, and an admission cut-off for an invigilated sitting is judged against it.

clock.both.text: Abafundi bamanye amazwe babona kokubili: isikhathi sakho, esigcinwa yirekhodi, nesabo eceleni kwaso, ukuze kungabikho obala umehluko ngokwakhe bese aphosa. Iinkathi ezirekhodiweko zisikhathi sakho njalo.
clock.both.from: Learners in other countries see both: your time, which is the one the record keeps, and their own alongside it, so nobody works out the difference themselves and gets it wrong. Recorded times are always yours.

mailTest.intro.text: Ivula ukuxhumana neseva yeposo bese ingena, ukuze ihlole ukuthi imininingwana yokungena yabafundi namaziso kungathunyelwa ngempela.
mailTest.intro.from: Opens a connection to the mail server and signs in, to check that learner sign-in details and notifications can actually be delivered.

mailTest.nothingSent.from: No email is sent to anybody.

mailTest.notYours.text: Akukho lapha okungatjhugululwa kuleli khasi: iseva yeposo ngeyokuthunyelwa kwepulatifomu. Nikela umgca ongenhla kunanyana ngubani ayigcinako.
mailTest.notYours.from: Nothing here is something you can change on this page: the mail server belongs to the deployment. Pass the line above to whoever maintains it.

mailTest.unconfigured.text: Akukho seva yeposo esethiweko kule pulatifomu okwamanje, ngalokho lokhu kuzakubika lokho kunokuthi kube yiphutha le-akhawunti yakho.
mailTest.unconfigured.from: No mail server is set up on this deployment yet, so this will report that rather than a fault with your account.

sso.register.text: Bhalisa ipulatifomu le nge-akhawunti yenhlangano yakho ye-{provider} bese uyinikela ikheli le ukuze ibuyisele abantu kilo, njengoba libhalwe ngqo: {address}
sso.register.from: Register this platform with your organisation's {provider} account and give it this address to send people back to, exactly as written: {address}

sso.directoryHint.text: Kukhasi le-Overview lohlelo lokusebenza ku-Microsoft Entra
sso.directoryHint.from: From the app's Overview page in Microsoft Entra

sso.offer.from: Offer “Sign in with {provider}” on the sign-in page

sso.remove.text: Susa i-{provider} bese ulibala imfihlo yayo

termsForm.why.practice.from: used across the sector, owned by nobody

termsForm.missing.text: Amanye amagama akekho kuhlu lolu, futhi lokho kwenziwe ngamabomu.
termsForm.missing.from: Some words are not on this list, and that is deliberate.

termsForm.missingNote.text: Isiqu, imojula yekharikhulamu, umphumela wezinga lokuphuma, izinga le-NQF neminye kuchazwa yi-QCTO namkha yi-SAQA hhayi nguwe. Ukutjhugulula igama lanoma yikuphi kungabeka amagama esikrinini somfundi nasekuthunyweni angakhange amukelwe ngumlawuli, ngalokho ipulatifomu iwagcina aqinile. Ungafunda ukuthi ngubani ochaza ini ku-{link}.
termsForm.missingNote.from: Qualification, curriculum module, exit level outcome, NQF level and the rest are defined by the QCTO or SAQA rather than by you. Renaming one would put wording on a learner's screen and on a submission that the regulator does not recognise, so the platform keeps them fixed. You can read who defines what in the {link}.

termsForm.note.course.text: Umzimba owodwa wokufunda umuntu abhaliswa kiwo.
termsForm.note.course.from: A single body of learning a person is enrolled onto.

termsForm.note.programme.from: A sequence of courses taken in order.

termsForm.note.cohort.from: A group of people moving through a course together.

termsForm.note.studyUnit.text: Ukuthi iimojula zekharikhulamu zihlanganiswa njani ukuze zifundiswe.
termsForm.note.studyUnit.from: How a curriculum's modules are grouped for delivery.

termsForm.note.enrolment.from: A person's place on a course or programme.

termsForm.note.learner.text: Umuntu ofundako. Abanye abaphakeli bathi isitudente, namkha ikhandidethi.
termsForm.note.learner.from: The person doing the learning. Some providers say student, or candidate.

termsForm.note.facilitator.text: Umuntu ophakelako. Abanye abaphakeli bathi umqeqeshi, itutha, namkha umyaleli.
termsForm.note.facilitator.from: The person delivering. Some providers say trainer, tutor, or instructor.

termsForm.note.assessor.from: The person judging evidence against the criteria.

termsForm.note.moderator.from: The person checking a sample of those judgements.

termsForm.note.workplaceRecord.text: Irekhodi yomsebenzi umfundi awenzileko, esayinwa ngumqeqeshi futhi yamukelwa ngumhloli.
termsForm.note.workplaceRecord.from: The record of work a learner did, that a coach signs and an assessor accepts.

menuEdit.noHeadingHint.from: No heading: shown as direct links

menuEdit.empty.text: Ayinalutho. Ihlokwana elingenalutho ngaphasi kwalo alitjengiswa.
menuEdit.empty.from: Empty. A heading with nothing under it is not shown.

menuEdit.note.text: Amakhasi akakwazi ukufihlwa lapha. Lokho umuntu ngamunye akubonako sekuqunyiwe yindima yakhe, futhi ukuphindelela indlela yokwenza into ingafinyeleleki kungenza ukuthi akekho ongatjho ukuthi kubayini ikhasi lingekho. Ikhasi elengezwa epulatifomini kamuva libonakala ngaphasi kwehlokwana lalo elijwayelekileko kunokuthi linyamalale ngoba lolu hlelo lwandulela lona.
menuEdit.note.from: Pages cannot be hidden here. What each person sees is already decided by their role, and a second way to make something unreachable would leave nobody able to say why a page is missing. A page added to the platform later appears under its usual heading rather than disappearing because this arrangement predates it.

drives.none.text: Akukho ndawo yokugcina amafayela esethiweko kule pulatifomu. Ukufunda ifolda ngqo kuGoogle Drive namkha kuOneDrive kudinga uhlelo lokusebenza olubhaliswe kibo ngumuntu ogcina ipulatifomu; kuze kube lapho, ifolda ikhethwa kukhompyutha yakho, okusebenzako futhi akudingi lutho.
drives.none.from: No file store is set up on this deployment. Reading a folder straight from Google Drive or OneDrive needs an application registered with them by whoever maintains the platform; until then, a folder is chosen from your own computer, which works and needs nothing.

drives.keepsNote.text: Ithokheni evaliweko engafunda, futhi ifunde kuphela, idrayivu ye-akhawunti oyixhumako, aze uyinqamule lapha namkha uyisuse kumasethingi e-akhawunti leyo. Isetjenziswa nawucele ukuthi ifolda ifundwe futhi ayisetjenziswa nakunye, ayikaze itjengiswe kuwe, futhi ayikaze ibhalwe kulogi. Ngeyakho, hhayi yomphakeli lo: ozakwenu emsebenzini angeke afunde amafayela akho ngayo, futhi awukhoni ukufunda awabo ngokuxhumana kwabo.
drives.keepsNote.from: A sealed token that can read, and only read, the drive of the account you connect, until you disconnect it here or withdraw it from that account's own settings. It is used when you ask for a folder to be read and at no other time, it is never shown back to you, and it is never written to a log. It is yours, not this provider's: a colleague cannot read your files through it, and you cannot read theirs through their connection.

ext.encrypted.text: Ivalelwe ngekhowudi futhi ayikaze itjengiswe godu, lapha namkha kwenye indawo.
ext.encrypted.from: It is encrypted and is never shown again, here or anywhere else.

ext.cannotRun.text: Le ayikwazi ukusebenza epulatifomini le, ngalokho ukuyisetha lapha akusoze kwenze iimfanelo ze-AI zisebenze.
ext.cannotRun.from: This one cannot run on this platform, so setting it up here will not make the AI features work.

ext.needsProgram.text: Idinga uhlelo olufakwe ekhompyutheni ipulatifomu esebenza kiyo.
ext.needsProgram.from: It needs a program installed on the machine the platform runs on.

ext.chooseKey.text: Khetha omunye wabaphakeli be-API-key esikhundleni: laba babiza umphakeli nge-inthanethi bese basebenza noma ipulatifomu ifakwe kuphi.
ext.chooseKey.from: Choose one of the API-key providers instead: those call the provider over the internet and work wherever the platform is installed.

ext.replace.text: Yithathele indawo nge-{credential} entsha; shiya kungenalutho ukugcina egciniweko
ext.replace.from: Replace it with a new {credential}; leave empty to keep the stored one

ext.geminiHint.text: ikhiye yakho evela ku-Google AI Studio
ext.geminiHint.from: your key from Google AI Studio

ext.available.from: Make it available to switch on

ext.model.text: Imodeli: shiya kungenalutho ukuze kusetjenziswe ejwayelekileko yomphakeli
ext.model.from: Model: leave empty for the provider's own default

ext.showModels.from: Show the models this {credential} can use

ext.modelsAvailable.text: {count} otholakalako namuhla. Ukukhetha oyedwa kugcwalisa ibhokisi elingenhla; kugciniwe nawunyathela Gcina.
ext.modelsAvailable.from: {count} available to you today. Choosing one fills the box above; it is saved when you press Save.

ext.keepsNote.text: I-{credential} yakho, ivalelwe ngekhowudi, aze uyilahle. Isetjenziswa kuphela emsebenzini oyicelako, kuphela nawukhanyisile iswitjhi, futhi ayikaze itjengiswe kuwe namkha ibhalwe kunanyana ngiyiphi ilogi. Ukutholakala akufani nokuvuliwe: isihlalo ngasinye siqala ngayo ivaliwe, uyivula emsebenzini, futhi ukuphuma kuyivala kuwe nangabe ukhohlwa.
ext.keepsNote.from: Your {credential}, encrypted, until you discard it. It is used only for work you ask for, only while you have the switch on, and it is never shown back to you or written to any log. Available is not the same as on: every sitting starts with it off, you switch it on for a job, and signing out switches it off for you if you forget.

ext.keptUnused.text: Ithokheni yakho iyagcinwa kodwa ayikwazi ukusetjenziswa. Akukho epulatifomini okuzakunikela isizo le-AI aze uyenze ikhona godu.
ext.keptUnused.from: Your token is kept but cannot be used. Nothing in the platform will offer AI assistance until you make it available again.

ext.offNote.text: Nakuvaliwe lokhu, ipulatifomu isebenza ngqo njengoba isebenza ngaphandle kwesengezo: iimfanelo aziphakelwa kunokuthi ziphakelwe zihluleke.
ext.offNote.from: With this off, the platform behaves exactly as it does without an extension: the affordances are absent rather than offered and failing.

ext.tokenFromNote.text: Ingcenye le yenzeka kukhompyutha yakho, hhayi lapha, lokho kuyinjongo: ukubhalisela kwakho kugunyazwa nguwe, emishinini yakho, futhi ithokheni ekhiqizako kuphela efika epulatifomini le.
ext.tokenFromNote.from: This part happens on your own computer, not here, which is the point: your subscription is authorised by you, on your machine, and only the token it produces ever reaches this platform.

ext.step1Rest.text: nangabe ungakayifaki: {link}. Udinga ukubhalisela kwakho kweClaude.
ext.step1Rest.from: if you have not already: {link}. You need a Claude subscription of your own.

ext.cmdNote.text: I-{plain} elula ku-PowerShell ijayele ukuhluleka ngokuthi “running scripts is disabled on this system”. Lokho kuyinto ejayelekileko ye-Windows hhayi ukungalungi kokufakwa kwakho, bese isimo se-{cmd} siyigwema ngaphandle kokutjhugulula nanyana yisiphi isethingi sokuvikela.
ext.cmdNote.from: Plain {plain} in PowerShell usually fails with “running scripts is disabled on this system”. That is a Windows default rather than anything wrong with your installation, and the {cmd} form avoids it without changing any security setting.

ext.step3.from: 3. Sign in when it opens your browser

ext.step3Rest.text: , bese ukopa ithokheni ekukhiphako (iqala ngo-{prefix}) uyinamathisele ngenhla.
ext.step3Rest.from: , then copy the token it prints (it begins {prefix}) and paste it above.

ext.notApiKey.text: Akusiyo ikhiye ye-API futhi akukho iindleko ngethokheni: isebenzisa ukubhalisela kweClaude osele ukhokhela khona. Ungaze unikele muntu iphasiwedi yakho ye-Anthropic: ipulatifomu le ayinalo iphuzu lokuyifaka futhi ayizukuyamukela lapha.
ext.notApiKey.from: It is not an API key and there is no per-token cost: it draws on the Claude subscription you already pay for. Never give anybody your Anthropic password: this platform has no field for one and would not accept it here.

ext.notSubscription.from: A subscription is not an API key.

ext.geminiSeparate.text: I-Gemini Advanced ne-Gemini API yimikhiqizo ehlukileko enokukhokhiswa okwahlukileko. Ukukhokhela eyokuqala akukunikeli yesibili, futhi akukho ndlela yokukwenza.
ext.geminiSeparate.from: Gemini Advanced and the Gemini API are separate products with separate billing. Paying for the first does not give you the second, and there is no way to make it.

ext.openaiSeparate.text: I-ChatGPT Plus ne-OpenAI API yimikhiqizo ehlukileko enokukhokhiswa okwahlukileko. Ukukhokhela eyokuqala akukunikeli yesibili, futhi akukho ndlela yokukwenza.
ext.openaiSeparate.from: ChatGPT Plus and the OpenAI API are separate products with separate billing. Paying for the first does not give you the second, and there is no way to make it.

ext.openaiCreate.text: Yenza ikhiye ku-{site}, ngaphasi kwe-{menu}, bese uyinamathisela ngenhla. Iqala ngo-{prefix}.
ext.openaiCreate.from: Create a key at {site}, under {menu}, and paste it above. It begins {prefix}.

ext.noFreeTierNote.text: ngokungafani ne-Gemini, ukubiza ngakunye kukhokhiswa ku-akhawunti ekhiye eyeyayo, ngalokho lindela ikhasi lokukhokha, lanyana lincani kangakanani.
ext.noFreeTierNote.from: unlike Gemini, every call is charged to the account the key belongs to, so expect a bill, however small.

ext.geminiCreate.text: Ngena ku-{site}, khetha {menu}, yenza eyodwa, bese uyinamathisela ngenhla. I-Google ikhiphe iikhiye ngeendlela ezingaphezu kwenye, ngalokho namathisela nanyana yini ekunikako: ipulatifomu le ayiyiphikisi.
ext.geminiCreate.from: Sign in at {site}, choose {menu}, create one, and paste it above. Google has issued keys in more than one format, so paste whatever it gives you: this platform does not second-guess it.

ext.geminiFree.text: I-Gemini API inezinga lamahhala, ngalokho lokhu akubizi lutho ukuligeza. Inqunta ukuthi mingaki imibuzo ongayenza ngomzuzu kunokuthi ikhokhise ngayo; ukufunda ifolda enkulu kungafinyelela lapho, futhi ipulatifomu izakukutjela ngokusobala nakwenzeka.
ext.geminiFree.from: The Gemini API has a free tier, so this costs nothing to try. It limits how many requests you may make in a minute rather than charging for them; reading a large folder can hit that, and the platform will say so plainly if it does.

ext.keyYours.text: Ngeyakho, hhayi yetenant. Ivalelwe ngekhowudi, isetjenziswa kuphela emsebenzini oyicelako ngesikhathi iswitjhi yakho ivuliwe, ayikaze itjengiswe kuwe, futhi ayikaze ibhalwe kulogi.
ext.keyYours.from: It is yours, not the tenant's. It is encrypted, used only for work you ask for while your switch is on, never shown back to you, and never written to a log.

codes.intro.text: Imojula eyodwa ibhalwa ngendlela ehlukileko emadokhumendeni ahlukileko: {long} kwikharikhulamu, {short} etafuleni lokufanisa, {shortest} esifinyezweni. Isazisi eside, iimpawu zokubhala neenhlamvu ezinkulu kuphathwa ngomthetho. Lapha yindawo i-App etjelwa ngayo ngezinye, ukuze ukukhuphela kuxhume imojula kunokuthi kubike ukuthi ayikho.
codes.intro.from: One module is written down differently in different documents: {long} in the curriculum, {short} in the alignment table, {shortest} in a summary. The long identifier, the punctuation and the capitals are handled by rule. This is where the App is told about the rest, so an upload links the module instead of reporting it missing.

codes.saved.text: Kugciniwe. Ukukhuphela kuzakusebenzisa lokhu kusukela manje.
codes.saved.from: Saved. Uploads will use these from now on.

codes.none.text: Alukho ikharikhulamu engenisiweko okwamanje, ngalokho akukho magangatho ekufuze aqunywe. Ngenisa isiqu bese lokhu kuzigcwalisa kusuka kwiikhodi zeemojula zaso.
codes.none.from: No curriculum has been loaded yet, so there are no standards to infer. Load a qualification and this fills itself in from its module codes.

codes.inUse.text: Iindlela ezihlukileko zokubhala ezingu-{total} eemojulani ezingu-{modules}, ziyasetjenziswa.
codes.inUse.from: {total} alternative spellings across {modules} modules, in use.

codes.proposed.text: Iindlela zokubhala ezingu-{total} ziphakanyisiwe eemojulani ezingu-{modules}.

codes.notInUse.from: Not in use until you have looked at them and confirmed.

codes.dialogNote.text: Ikhodi engakwesobunxele ilinganiso yakho. Iindlela zokubhala eziseceleni kwayo yilezo idokhumende engazisebenzisa esikhundleni. Susa nanyana yiziphi ezingafaneli, engeza ezakho, bese uyaqinisekisa.
codes.dialogNote.from: The code on the left is your standard. The spellings beside it are what a document may use instead. Remove any that do not belong, add your own, then confirm.

codes.fullId.text: Isazisi esiphelele se-QCTO, {example}, sifundwa njengekhodi yaso yemojula ngomthetho, futhi asidingi umgca lapha. Kunjalo namahayifeni, ngeendawo ezingenalutho neenhlamvu ezinkulu.
codes.fullId.from: A full QCTO identifier, {example}, is read as its module code by rule, and needs no row here. So are hyphens, spaces and capitals.

codes.worked.from: Its variations are worked out for you.

codes.putBack.from: Put back everything the App proposed

naming.intro.text: Nakukhuphelwa ibhuku lomsebenzi namkha ukuhlola, i-App ifunda igama lefayela ukuze itjhoje ukuthi yini. Nakulungile lokhu ukukhuphela kufika sekugcwaliswe. Nakungalungile akukho okuphulekako: kufika njengefomu elingenalutho ukuze omunye alicedise ngesandla.
naming.intro.from: When somebody uploads a workbook or an assessment, the App reads the filename to work out what it is. Get this right and an upload arrives already filled in. Get it wrong and nothing breaks: it arrives as a blank form for somebody to complete by hand.

naming.rule.text: Umthetho wendawo, njengoba ithimba lakho lifuze likulandele
naming.rule.from: The house rule, as your team should follow it

naming.ruleNote.text: Utjengiswa esikrinini sokukhuphela. Iqondiso labantu, hhayi into i-App efananisa ngayo: ifumana iikhodi ezingezansi noma zibonakala kuphi.
naming.ruleNote.from: Shown on the upload screen. Guidance for people, not something the App matches on: it finds the codes below wherever they appear.

naming.codesNote.text: Ingcenye yegama lefayela etjho ukuthi uhlobo luni lwedokhumende. Yilezi i-App efananisa ngazo ngempela.
naming.codesNote.from: The part of a filename that says what kind of document it is. These are what the App actually matches on.

naming.markerNote.text: Ithokheni etjho ukuthi ifayela yimemorandamu hhayi ikhophi yomfundi.
naming.markerNote.from: The token that says a file is the memorandum rather than the learner's copy.

naming.unread.text: Akufundwa kigama le: {parts}. Ozakukhuphela ugcwalisa lokho ngesandla.
naming.unread.from: Not read from this name: {parts}. Whoever uploads it fills those in by hand.

naming.allRead.text: Koke kufundiwe. Ukukhuphela okunegama elinjengalo kufika sekugcwalisiwe.
naming.allRead.from: Everything was read. An upload named like this arrives already filled in.

tmpl.note.statement_of_results.text: Kuthathwa kiya esikhungweni sokuhlola nedokhumende yomfundi yokuzazisa. Isakhiwo sesakho ukusetha; ithempulethi ye-QCTO ngokwayo itjengisa lokho ephethe khona.
tmpl.note.statement_of_results.from: Carried to the assessment centre with the learner's identity document. The layout is yours to set; the QCTO's own template shows what one carries.

tmpl.note.certificate.text: Lokho umphakeli akukhiphako ngezihlelo zakhe. Isitifikeyidi sesiqu sivela ku-QCTO, hhayi lapha.
tmpl.note.certificate.from: What the provider issues for its own programmes. A qualification certificate comes from the QCTO, not from here.

tmpl.note.workplace_statement.text: Lokho umqeqeshi wendawo yokusebenza akusayinako ukuqinisekisa isipiliyoni umfundi asiqedileko.
tmpl.note.workplace_statement.from: What a workplace coach signs to confirm the experience a learner completed.

tmpl.note.enrolment_form.text: Ifomu yokubhalisa egcwalisiweko, njengedokhumende. Umbukeli we-QCTO angayicela nakavakatjhele, ngalokho kufuze ibe khona ephepheni, hhayi njengeskrini ekugcwalisiwe kuphela.
tmpl.note.enrolment_form.from: The completed enrolment form, as a document. A QCTO monitor may ask for it on a visit, so it has to exist on paper, not only as a screen somebody filled in.

tmpl.platform.text: Isakhiwo sepulatifomu ngokwayo. Akukho okwenzako lapha okutjhugulula idokhumende esele ikhutjhiwe.
tmpl.platform.from: The platform's own layout. Nothing you do here changes a document already issued.

tmpl.documentNote.text: Yibhale njengoba ufuna ifundeke. Noma yini ephakathi kwamabhrasi amabili ithathelwa indawo yimininingwana yomfundi nakukhiqizwa idokhumende, futhi izikhala zakho zigcinwa ngqo njengoba uzithayipha.
tmpl.documentNote.from: Write it as you want it to read. Anything in double braces is replaced with the learner's own details when the document is produced, and your spacing is kept exactly as you type it.

tmpl.starterNote.text: Lawa amagama epulatifomu ngokwayo, ukuze uwafinyeze abe ngawakho.
tmpl.starterNote.from: This is the platform's own wording, for you to cut down into yours.

tmpl.goBack.from: Go back to the platform's own layout

tmpl.fields.from: What you can put in it

tmpl.added.text: Lokho ipulatifomu ekwengezako, noma ithempulethi yakho ithini
tmpl.added.from: What the platform adds, whatever your template says

tmpl.addedNote.text: Lokhu kuphrintwa ngemva kwethempulethi yakho. Akusikho okwakho ukutjhugulula ngoba akusikho kwakho: umlawuli uyakudinga, futhi umfundi ophethe idokhumende uthembele ekutheni kuliqiniso. Akudingi ukukubhala enguqulweni yakho.
tmpl.addedNote.from: These are printed after your template. They are not yours to change because they are not yours: a regulator requires them, and a learner holding the document relies on them being true. You do not need to write them into your own version.

capture.intro.text: I-App ifunda lokho engakwazi, itjengisa ukuthi ikwenzeni nalokho engakhange ikwazi ukukuqonda, bese ilinda. Akukho okuba kuhlola aze uqinisekise.
capture.intro.from: The App reads what it can, shows you what it made of it and what it could not work out, and waits. Nothing becomes an assessment until you confirm it.

capture.fromFolder.text: Nangabe ibhuku lomsebenzi lifike nefolda, selikhona lapha: {link} bese ulibamba kulokho okufayelweko. Akukho kukhuphela kwesibili, futhi isiqondiso sempendulo sihlanganiswa wena. Sebenzisa ifomu engezansi kuphela ephepheni ipulatifomu engalinaso.
capture.fromFolder.from: If the workbook came in with a folder, it is already here: {link} and capture it from what is filed. There is no second upload, and the answer guide is paired for you. Use the form below only for a paper the platform does not already hold.

capture.changeNaming.text: Tjhugulula ukuthi amagama wamafayela afundwa njani

capture.noneNote.text: Vula isiqu bese ubamba iincwadi zomsebenzi esele zifayelwe kiso, namkha ukhuphele eyodwa ngenhla. Lokho i-App eyakufundako kutjengiswa kuwe ngaphambi kokuthi kube kuhlola.
capture.noneNote.from: Open a qualification and capture the workbooks already filed against it, or upload one above. What the App reads is shown to you before any of it becomes an assessment.

capture.committedOn.text: Kugcinwe ngokuphelele ngomhlaka {date}. Ukukhuphela kugcinwa ngokuphelele kanye; khuphela idokhumende godu ukwenza elinye iphepha kuyo.
capture.committedOn.from: Committed on {date}. An upload is committed once; upload the document again to make another paper from it.

capture.which.from: Which qualification is this material for?

capture.guideNote.text: Ngaphandle kwaso, akukho mpendulo elungileko, amamaki namkha iimfuneko ezingafundwa.
capture.guideNote.from: Without it, no correct answers, marks or criteria can be read.

capture.ready.text: Kulungile. Iimojula ezingu-{modules} neemfuneko zokuhlola ezingu-{criteria} sekungenisiwe, ngalokho imibuzo ingaxhunywa nakho ekufakazelako.
capture.ready.from: Ready. {modules} modules and {criteria} assessment criteria are in, so questions can be linked to what they evidence.

capture.notReady.from: This qualification is not ready for material yet.

capture.notReadyNote.text: Enza lokhu kuqala, ngalokhu kulandelana. Kuze kuphele umbuzo awukwazi ukunamathiselwa kulokho ofakazela khona, futhi ukukulungisa kamuva kutjho ukunamathisela ngasinye ngesandla godu.
capture.notReadyNote.from: Do these first, in this order. Until they are done a question cannot be tagged to what it evidences, and putting that right later means re-tagging every one of them by hand.

capture.whereDocuments.from: Documents are uploaded on the qualification's own page.

capture.original.text: Okwangempela kuyagcinwa bese kubalwa i-hash, ngalokho umbuzo oqothisanwako uxazululwa ngedokhumende kunokuthi ube ngalokhu kufunda kwayo.
capture.original.from: The original is kept and hashed, so a question in dispute is settled against the document rather than against this reading of it.

capture.committedLong.text: Lokhu kugcinwe ngokuphelele ngomhlaka {date}. Ukukhuphela kugcinwa ngokuphelele kanye; khuphela idokhumende godu ukwenza elinye iphepha kuyo.
capture.committedLong.from: This was committed on {date}. An upload is committed once; upload the document again to make another paper from it.

captureReview.noAnswer.text: “{stem}…” imakwa yi-App kodwa ayinayo impendulo elungileko.
captureReview.noAnswer.from: “{stem}…” is marked by the App but has no correct answer.

captureReview.addsUp.text: “{section}” iphrintwe ngamamaki angu-{printed} kodwa imibuzo yayo ibalela ku-{sum}.
captureReview.addsUp.from: “{section}” is printed as {printed} marks but its questions add up to {sum}.

captureReview.edited.text: Ulungisile. Lokho okugcinwa ngokuphelele yilokho okusesikrinini manje, hhayi lokho okufundwe efayelini.
captureReview.edited.from: You have made corrections. What gets committed is what is on this screen now, not what was read out of the file.

captureReview.summary.text: Imibuzo engu-{questions} · amamaki angu-{marks} · {app} ezimakwa yi-App
captureReview.summary.from: {questions} questions · {marks} marks · {app} marked by the App

captureReview.unknownOne.text: {codes} akusiyo imfuneko yesiqu lesi, ngalokho ngeke ixhunyiwe. Lungisa iikhodi ezingenhla nangabe kuyiphutha lokuthayipha.
captureReview.unknownOne.from: {codes} is not a criterion on this qualification, so it will not be linked. Correct the codes above if that is a typo.

captureReview.unknown.text: {codes} akusiyo iimfuneko zesiqu lesi, ngalokho ngeke zixhunyiwe. Lungisa iikhodi ezingenhla nangabe kuyiphutha lokuthayipha.
captureReview.unknown.from: {codes} are not criteria on this qualification, so they will not be linked. Correct the codes above if that is a typo.

captureReview.acknowledgeOne.text: Ngifundile into e-1 esele ngenhla bese ngifuna ukugcina ngokuphelele noma kunjalo. Lokhu kurekhodwa ngegama lami.
captureReview.acknowledgeOne.from: I have read the 1 outstanding item above and want to commit anyway. This is recorded against my name.

captureReview.acknowledge.text: Ngifundile izinto ezingu-{count} ezisele ngenhla bese ngifuna ukugcina ngokuphelele noma kunjalo. Lokhu kurekhodwa ngegama lami.
captureReview.acknowledge.from: I have read the {count} outstanding items above and want to commit anyway. This is recorded against my name.

captureReview.responsibility.text: Ukuqinisekisa kutjho ukuthatha umthwalo wempendulo ngayinye elungileko eliphepheni le. Igama lakho lisala kilo.
captureReview.responsibility.from: Confirming accepts responsibility for every correct answer in this paper. Your name stays on it.

captureReview.swapped.from: The paper and the guide look swapped

captureReview.swappedNote.text: Akukho okunye okuveziwe, ngoba koke okunye kulandela lokhu. Qala godu ngephepha lomfundi njengephepha nesiqondiso somhloli njengesiqondiso.
captureReview.swappedNote.from: Nothing else is listed, because everything else follows from this. Start again with the learner's paper as the paper and the assessor guide as the guide.

captureReview.fixNote.text: Lungisa lezi ngezansi, namkha uzifunde bese uthi ufuna ukuqhubeka noma kunjalo.
captureReview.fixNote.from: Correct these below, or read them and say you want to go on anyway.

captureReview.clearNote.text: Umbuzo ngamunye i-App ezawumaka unempendulo, futhi ingcenye ngayinye ibalela ekuphrintwe kiyo.
captureReview.clearNote.from: Every question the App will mark has an answer, and every section adds up to what it prints.

captureReview.materialNote.text: Idokhumende ifundwe ngokulungileko. Lezi yizinto ngephepha ezingaqunywa mbhali waso kuphela.
captureReview.materialNote.from: The document was read correctly. These are things about the paper that only its author can decide.

imports.intro.text: Yoke ifolda efundiweko, nalokho okwenzeke kiyo. Ukufunda entsha kuqala lapho umsebenzi ukhona, esiqwini, esifundweni namkha ezintweni zokufunda ozakha, kunokuthi kube lapha.
imports.intro.from: Every folder that has been read, and what became of it. Reading a new one starts where the work is, on the qualification, course or material you are building, rather than here.

imports.noExtension.from: You have not set up an AI extension

imports.noExtensionNote.text: Kukhethwako futhi kungokwakho hhayi kwetenant: ilunga ngalinye labasebenzi lisetha elalo, ngokubhalisela kwalo.
imports.noExtensionNote.from: It is optional and yours rather than the tenant's: every member of staff sets up their own, with their own subscription.

imports.readNote.text: Kugcinwa kungakhathaliseki nokuthi kugcinwe ngokuphelele namkha kulahliwe. Lokho okuphakanyisiweko bese kulahlwa yikho ubani ahlulela ngakho ukuthi ukufunda kufaneleke ukuthenjwa.
imports.readNote.from: Kept whether committed or discarded. What was proposed and then rejected is how anybody judges whether a reading is worth trusting.

imports.byPlatform.from: read by the platform, no AI involved

imports.backFolders.from: ← Back to the folders that have been read

imports.contentsNote.text: Koke okutholakeleko, nalokho okwenziwe ngako. Amafayela e-PDF namadokhumende e-Word aphendulwa ngesikhipha esifanako esisetjenziswa yipulatifomu, ngalokho imodeli ifunda ngqo lokho i-Bamba eyakufunda.
imports.contentsNote.from: Everything found, and what was done with it. PDFs and Word documents are converted with the same extractor the rest of the platform uses, so the model reads exactly what Capture would.

imports.proposesNote.text: Koke endaweni eyodwa. Izixwayiso yingcenye ebalulekileko: zifunde ngaphambi kwanoma yini.
imports.proposesNote.from: Everything in one place. The warnings are the part that matters: read those before anything else.

proposal.fromBlueprint.text: Kufundwe efayelini lohlaka lwefolda ngokwayo. Isakhiwo esingezansi yilokho ifayela leli elikutjhoyo ngqo: akukho okuqunyiweko, futhi akukho modeli ebuziweko.
proposal.fromBlueprint.from: Read from the folder's own blueprint file. The structure below is exactly what that file says: nothing was inferred, and no model was asked.

proposal.fromDocuments.text: Kufundwe emadokhumendeni yimodeli. Kuhlole ngedokhumende yekharikhulamu ngaphambi kokugcina ngokuphelele.
proposal.fromDocuments.from: Read from the documents by the model. Check it against the curriculum document before committing.

proposal.byName.text: Kufayelwe ngegama. Akukho hlaka nemodeli ebandakanyekileko: idokhumende ngayinye yaya lapho igama lefayela lalo litjho ukuthi ikhona, futhi ikharikhulamu ayithintekile.
proposal.byName.from: Filed by name. No blueprint and no model were involved: each document went where its filename says it belongs, and the curriculum is untouched.

proposal.unitsNamed.text: Izigaba zokufunda ezingu-{count} zibizwa ngamagama wamafayela azo.
proposal.unitsNamed.from: {count} study units are named by their filenames.

proposal.nothingChanged.text: Akukho mojula, umkhakha namkha imfuneko engezwako namkha etjhugululwako ngalokhu.
proposal.nothingChanged.from: No module, topic or criterion is added or changed by this.

proposal.counts.text: Iimojula ezingu-{modules}, iindikimba ezingu-{topics}, iingcenye ezingu-{elements}, iimfuneko ezingu-{criteria}, izigaba zokufunda ezingu-{units}, amadokhumende angu-{documents}
proposal.counts.from: {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} elements, {criteria} criteria, {units} study units, {documents} documents

proposal.withheld.from: {withheld} withheld from learners, {visible} visible to them.

proposal.withheldNote.text: Amamemorandamu, iinkomba zeempendulo namaphepha okuqedako kufihlelwa bonke abangenalo ilungelo lokuhlola.
proposal.withheldNote.from: Memoranda, answer guides and summative papers are withheld from anybody without the right to assess.

proposal.unknownOne.text: Idokhumende e-1 ayikwazanga ukwaziwa ngegama layo, ifayelwe njengo-“okunye”, okubonakala kubo boke.
proposal.unknownOne.from: 1 could not be recognised from its name and is filed as “other”, which is visible to everyone.

proposal.unknown.text: Amadokhumende angu-{count} awakwazanga ukwaziwa ngamagama wawo, afayelwe njengo-“okunye”, okubonakala kubo boke.
proposal.unknown.from: {count} could not be recognised from their names and are filed as “other”, which is visible to everyone.

proposal.unknownNote.text: Kuhle ukubuka ngezansi ngaphambi kokufaka koke: iinkomba zeempendulo ezinikwe igama ngendlela imithetho le engayaziko zizakuba lapha.
proposal.unknownNote.from: Worth a look below before committing: an answer guide named in a way these rules do not know would be here.

proposal.orAdd.from: Or add it to one already here

proposal.addNote.text: Ukukwengeza kokusele kukhona lapha akuthinti lutho olukhona kade, kufaka kuphela okunqambako.
proposal.addNote.from: Adding it to one already here leaves everything that is there untouched and puts in only what is missing.

proposal.topUp.text: Kwengezwe esiqwini obuqale ngaso. Uhlu olungenhla yikho koke ifolda ephethe kona, hhayi koke okuzakwakhiwa: nanyana yini esele ikhona ishiywa injalo, kwengezwa kuphela okunqambako. Uzatjelwa ngemva kwalokho ukuthi ngiimojula ziphi ebezisele zikhona.
proposal.topUp.from: Added to the qualification you started from. The list above is everything the folder holds, not everything that will be created: whatever is already here is left exactly as it is, and only what is missing is added. You are told afterwards which modules were already held.

proposal.filedCourse.from: Filed against the course you started from.

proposal.filedProgramme.from: Filed against the programme you started from.

proposal.filedQualification.from: Filed against the qualification you started from.

proposal.checks.text: Koke okungenhla kufakwa ngasikhathi sinye, kudlule ekuhlolweni okufanako okusebenza kunanyana yini eyakhiwe ngesandla. Nanyana yini okwenqatjwa kuloko kuhlolwa iyabikwa, ayiyeshwa buthule.
proposal.checks.from: Everything above goes in at once, through the same checks that apply to anything built by hand. Whatever those checks turn away is reported rather than skipped quietly.

proposal.discardNote.text: Kugciniwe erekhodini. Lokho okuphakanyisiweko nokwenqatjelwako yikho abantu abahlulela ngakho ukuthi isengezo sifaneleke na.
proposal.discardNote.from: Kept on the record. What was proposed and rejected is how anybody judges whether the extension is worth having.

reports.programme.text: Uhlelo ngokwalo: lokho okungahlolwa lutho, nemibuzo engasebenzi
reports.programme.from: The programme itself: what nothing tests, which questions are not working

reports.coverageNote.text: Kubalwa ngeziftikeyidi, hhayi ngokuqeda izifundo. Ukuqeda kutjho ukuthi umuntu ufike ekupheleni kwezinto zokufunda; isitifikeyidi sitjho ukuthi kwenziwe isiqunto futhi, lapho kufuneka khona, silinganiswe ngokuzimela.
reports.coverageNote.from: Counted from certificates, not course completions. A completion means somebody reached the end of the material; a certificate means a judgement was made and, where required, independently moderated.

reports.singleNote.text: Kubanjwa ngumuntu munye kuphela: {codes}. Nakasuka, ikghono lisuka naye.
reports.singleNote.from: Held by one person only: {codes}. If that person leaves, the capability goes with them.

reports.nobodyEnrolled.from: Nobody is enrolled on anything yet.

progReport.intro.text: Imibuzo emibili ebonakala ngokobafundi kodwa engasikho: lokho okungahlolwa lutho, nemibuzo engasebenzi.
progReport.intro.from: Two questions that look like they are about learners and are not: what nothing assesses, and which questions are not working.

progReport.untestedNote.text: Imfuneko engahlolwa mbuzo wokuqedako ayikwazi ukufinyelelwa muntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi wenza kuhle kangakanani. Iphazamisa bonke abafundi besiqu, futhi akukho okunye epulatifomini okutjho lokho.
progReport.untestedNote.from: A criterion no summative question assesses cannot be achieved by anybody, however well they do. It holds up every learner on the qualification, and nothing else in the platform says so.

progReport.noCriteria.text: Isiqu lesi asinazo iimfuneko zokuhlola ezirekhodiweko okwamanje.
progReport.noCriteria.from: This qualification has no assessment criteria captured yet.

progReport.allTested.text: Zonke iimfuneko ezingu-{count} ziyahlolwa mbuzo munye wokuqedako, nokungenani.
progReport.allTested.from: Every one of the {count} criteria is tested by at least one summative question.

progReport.someUntested.text: Iimfuneko ezingu-{untested} kwezingu-{count} azihlolwa mbuzo wokuqedako.
progReport.someUntested.from: {untested} of {count} criteria are not tested by any summative question.

progReport.misleading.text: {count} zazo zivela ebhukwini lomsebenzi, elakhako futhi elingafakazeli lutho.
progReport.misleading.from: {count} of those appear in a workbook, which is developmental and evidences nothing.

progReport.questionsNote.text: Ukulinga kokuqala kuphela, ngoba ukuhlala godu kulinganisa okunye. Akukho okumakiweko ngaphasi kokulinga okungu-{minimum}: umbuzo ophendulwe ngabantu ababili utjela ngaba bantu ababili kuphela.
progReport.questionsNote.from: First attempts only, because a re-sit measures something else. Nothing is flagged below {minimum} attempts: a question two people have answered tells you about those two people.

progReport.noQuestions.from: That assessment has no questions yet.

progReport.worthLook.from: {flagged} of {count} questions are worth a look.

progReport.nobody.text: Kunzima ukuthi kube muntu ophendula lo. Namkha umbuzo awucacile namkha lokho okuhlolwako akukafundiswa.
progReport.nobody.from: Almost nobody can answer this. Either the question is unclear or what it tests was never taught.

progReport.everybody.text: Boke bathola amamaki aphelele, ngalokho awehlukanisi lutho.
progReport.everybody.from: Everybody gets full marks, so it distinguishes nothing.

statutory.intro.text: Umbiko weDatabase yamaRekhodi wabaFundi wesiTjhaba we-SAQA, kanye ne-Workplace Skills Plan ne-Annual Training Report. Koke kuhlolwa lapha ngaphambi kokuthi kuye kunanyana ngaphi, ngoba umbiko owenqatjelwako ngenxa yenomboro yesazisi etlolwe kabi kubiza umjikelo ophelele.
statutory.intro.from: The SAQA National Learners' Records Database return, and the Workplace Skills Plan and Annual Training Report. Everything is checked here before it goes anywhere, because a return rejected for a mistyped identity number costs a full cycle.

statutory.locked.text: Amafayela asala avaliwe kufikela lapho iinkinga ezivimbako ezingezansi zilungiswe. Ukuthumela umbiko ozakwenqatjhwa kulahlekisa umjikelezo ngamunye wabafundi bonke abakiwo.
statutory.locked.from: The files stay locked until the blocking problems below are fixed. Submitting a return that will be rejected wastes a cycle for every learner in it.

statutory.worthFixingNote.text: Lezi azimisi umbiko, kodwa i-NLRD iphawula imininingwana ye-demografi engaphelele futhi i-SETA ingabuza ngayo.
statutory.worthFixingNote.from: These do not stop the return, but the NLRD flags incomplete demographic data and a SETA may query it.

statutory.wsp.text: Uhlelo lwamakghono endaweni yokusebenza noMbiko wangeNdlela weQeqesho
statutory.wsp.from: Workplace Skills Plan and Annual Training Report

statutory.wspNote.text: Umsebenzi weqeqesho ngokwemisebenzi, njengoba umbiko we-SETA uhlelwe.
statutory.wspNote.from: Training activity by occupation, as a SETA return is organised.

statutory.noOfoOne.text: Umuntu o-1 akanayo ikhodi ye-OFO: {names}. Usabalwa, kodwa umbiko we-SETA uhlanganisa ngomsebenzi.
statutory.noOfoOne.from: 1 person has no OFO code: {names}. They are still counted, but a SETA return groups by occupation.

statutory.noOfo.text: Abantu abangu-{count} abanayo ikhodi ye-OFO: {names}. Basabalwa, kodwa umbiko we-SETA uhlanganisa ngomsebenzi.
statutory.noOfo.from: {count} people have no OFO code: {names}. They are still counted, but a SETA return groups by occupation.

statutory.mapping.text: Ukulinganisa amasimu kulandela uhlaka lokunikela iziqu (Umuntu 27, Ukubhalisa 28, Iimphumelelo 29, Umphakeli 30). Qinisekisa ukuhleleka kwefayela le-Edu.Dex kuvumelaniswa nesitatimende sakamuva se-SAQA ngaphambi kokuthumela ngokuqondile.
statutory.mapping.from: Field mapping follows the accreditation framework (Person 27, Enrolment 28, Achievement 29, Provider 30). Confirm the exact Edu.Dex file layout against the current SAQA specification before a live submission.

enrolNotify.intro.text: I-QCTO kufuze itjelwe ukuthi abafundi laba babhaliswe, phakathi kwezinsuku zomsebenzi ezingamashumi amabili nanye ukusukela ekwethulweni kweziqu nezinsuku ezinhlanu kwezihlelo zamakghono. Iinsuku zokuphumula zomphakathi azibalwa, futhi isikhathi sibalwa kusukela ilanga lokwethulwa, hhayi ekubhalisweni namkha ekukhokhweni.
enrolNotify.intro.from: The QCTO has to be told that these learners were enrolled, within twenty-one working days of induction for a qualification and five for a skills programme. Public holidays do not count, and the clock runs from the induction date rather than from enrolment or payment.

enrolNotify.overdueNote.text: Kusafuze uthumele lezi. Isaziso esiphuzile esinesizathu siyinkinga eyehlukileko kunalokho okungakhange kwenziwe muntu.
enrolNotify.overdueNote.from: Still submit these. A late notification with an explanation is a different problem to one nobody made.

enrolNotify.soonNote.text: Kusele iinsuku zomsebenzi ezinhlanu namkha ngaphasi.
enrolNotify.soonNote.from: Five working days or fewer remaining.

enrolNotify.noInductionNote.text: Isikhathi sabo asikaqali, ngalokho akukho mhlaka wokubika. Beka ilanga leseshini yokwethulwa yeqoqo, namkha unikele umuntu ngamunye elakhe ngezansi.
enrolNotify.noInductionNote.from: Their clock has not started, so there is no deadline to report. Date the cohort's induction session, or give them their own below.

enrolNotify.draftNote.text: Bonke abethulwe ngelanga elifanako bahamba ndawonye. Ozokhamba emva kwabanye udinga ukwethulwa kwakhe.
enrolNotify.draftNote.from: Everybody inducted on the same day goes together. A late joiner needs their own.

enrolNotify.ownInductionNote.text: Umuntu ojoyine ngemva kokuthi iqoqo liqale unokwethulwa kwakhe, ifomu lakhe lokubhalisa nokuthumela kwakhe.
enrolNotify.ownInductionNote.from: Somebody who joined after the cohort started has their own induction, their own enrolment form and their own submission.

enrolNotify.split.text: Okuthunyelwako kuhlanganisa uhlelo lwamakghono neziqu zombili. Kuya emakhelini ahlukileko, ngalokho kufuze kuhlukaniswe bese kuthunyelwa kabili.
enrolNotify.split.from: This submission covers both a skills programme and a qualification. They go to different addresses, so it has to be split and sent twice.

enrolNotify.askAck.text: Cela ukuvunywa kokwamukelwa, bese uyarekhoda lapha nakubuya.
enrolNotify.askAck.from: Ask for an acknowledgement, and record it here when it comes back.

enrolNotify.nobodyOutstanding.text: Akekho ozohlala emuva. Umfundi ngamunye onelanga lokwethulwa uziswe ngakho.
enrolNotify.nobodyOutstanding.from: Nobody is outstanding. Every learner with an induction date has been notified about.

enrolNotify.clockFrom.from: The clock runs from this day.

enrolNotify.noneThatDay.text: Akekho osele owethulwe ngelanga leli. Tjhugulula ilanga, namkha unikele umuntu ozokhamba emva kwabanye ukwethulwa kwakhe ngezansi.
enrolNotify.noneThatDay.from: Nobody outstanding was inducted on that date. Change the date, or give a late joiner their own induction below.

enrolNotify.nobodyWaiting.from: Nobody is waiting on an induction date.

paths.intro.text: Ama-{courses} amanengi axhunyiwe abe yisilandelano: umuntu osanda kuqala {programme}, namkha ukwethulwa okupheleleko kohlaka lwamakghono. Umfundi unikelwa {course} elandelako ngokuzenzakalelako nakaqeda leyo edlulileko.
paths.intro.from: Several {courses} chained into a sequence: a new starter {programme}, or a full competency framework roll-out. A learner is given the next {course} automatically as they finish the one before it.

paths.noneAuthor.text: {programme} ixhuma {courses} ibe ngokulandelana, ukuze umfundi anikelwe elandelako nakaqeda edlulileko. Yakha {courses} kuqala: {programme} isilandelano salo.
paths.noneAuthor.from: A {programme} chains {courses} into an order, so a learner is given the next one as they finish the one before. Build the {courses} first: a {programme} is a sequence of them.

paths.noneReader.text: Akukabakhona eyakhiweko. Nakuba khona, {courses} oyenza ngokulandelana izakuba lapha. Ukuyakha kungumsebenzi womlobi.
paths.noneReader.from: None has been built yet. When one has been, the {courses} you work through in order will be here. Building one is an author's job.

paths.empty.text: Akukho {courses} kiyo okwamanje: umfundi onikelwe {programme} le ngekhe athole lutho. Yivule ukuze wengeze.
paths.empty.from: No {courses} in it yet: a learner given this {programme} would receive nothing. Open it to add some.

paths.folderNote.text: Khetha ifolda okuhlala kiyo lokhu okufundiswako, bese koke okukiyo, kuhlanganise nefolda ezingaphansi kwayo, kufundwa, kufayelwa futhi kufakelwe isikhombe. Ubona lokho okuzakufayelwa ngaphambi kokuthi kubhalwe lutho.
paths.folderNote.from: Choose the folder this material lives in and everything in it, including its subfolders, is read, filed and indexed. You see what it would file before anything is written.

paths.folderLabel.from: Its folder, from your own computer

paths.folderHint.text: Iinkambiso, iincwadi zomsebenzi, iinqubomgomo namathempulethi kufayelwa kiyo bese umbhalo wazo ufakelwa isikhombe ukuze zifunwe.
paths.folderHint.from: Guides, workbooks, policies and templates are filed against it and their text indexed so they can be searched.

paths.folderHint2.text: Isakhiwo asenzelwa lapha: isimo saso sakhiwa ngokwengeza {courses} kiso ngenhla. Lokhu kufayela lokho okukiso.
paths.folderHint2.from: Structure is not created from here: its own shape is built by adding {courses} to it above. This files what it holds.

paths.drive.from: Or from a drive you have connected

paths.driveNote.text: Ifolda efanako, efundwa lapho isekhona. Iphetha endaweni efanako: isiphakamiso ekufuze ubuke ngaphambi kokuthi kubhalwe lutho.
paths.driveNote.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

paths.noSteps.text: Akukho lutho kiso okwamanje. Yengeza ngokulandelana abafundi abafuze bakwenze ngakho.
paths.noSteps.from: Nothing in it yet. Add them in the order learners should take them.

paths.opensFirst.from: Opens as soon as somebody joins.

paths.opensAfter.from: Opens when the step before it is finished.

paths.opensNow.from: Opens straight away, alongside the others.

paths.locked.text: Kuvaliwe kufikela lapho isinyathelo esandulelako siqediwe
paths.locked.from: Locked until the step before it is finished

paths.lockedNote.text: Susa uphawu ukuze kube yinto engenziwa nanini.
paths.lockedNote.from: Untick for one that can be taken at any point.

paths.allIn.from: Everything published is already in it.

paths.published.text: Lokhu kukhutjhiwe futhi abantu bayasebenza ngakho, ngalokho izinyathelo zako ziqinisiwe. Ukutjhugulula ukulandelana ngaphansi komuntu kungatjhugulula lokho asekatjelwe ukuthi akwenze.
paths.published.from: This is published and people are working through it, so its steps are fixed. Changing the order underneath somebody would alter what they had already been told to do.

paths.publishNote.from: Everything in it has to be published first.

paths.firstOnly.text: Kuphela esokuqala esivulwako. Ezisele zifika njengoba ngasinye siqedwa.
paths.firstOnly.from: Only the first opens. The rest arrive as each is finished.

badges.intro.text: Ukuqatjhelwa okufika ngelanga umsebenzi uqedwa, hhayi ngemva kwezinyanga nakufika isitifikeyidi sangaphandle. Ibheji asisiso isiqu futhi ipulatifomu ayivumeli ukuthi libonakale njengaso: akukho sazisi se-SAQA, akukho makhredithi, futhi ikhasi lokuqinisekisa litjho ngokucacileko ukuthi liyini nokuthi aliyona iyini.
badges.intro.from: Recognition that arrives on the day the work is finished, rather than months later when the external certificate comes through. A badge is not a qualification and the platform never lets it look like one: no SAQA identifier, no credits, and a verification page that says plainly what it is and what it is not.

badges.target.default.from: Anything, when nothing more specific is set

badges.nothingNote.text: Akukho bheji elakhiweko, ngalokho ukuqeda isifundo namkha isiqu akunikeli lutho okwamanje. Ukwakha elilodwa ngezansi kwanele: qala ngebheji lomphakeli ngokwakhe nawungafuni elihlukileko kwenye into ngayinye.
badges.nothingNote.from: No badge has been designed, so finishing a course or a qualification currently awards nothing. Designing one below is enough: start with the provider's own badge if you do not want a different one for each thing.

badges.legitimate.text: Lokhu kukhetho olusemthethweni hhayi iphutha. Ipulatifomu ngekhe ilenze.
badges.legitimate.from: This is a legitimate choice rather than a fault. The platform will not invent one.

badges.kind.default.from: Anything, when nothing more specific is set

badges.designNote.text: Isimo, imibala emibili nophawu. Akukho ofuze ukhuphelwe nakho akukho ofuze ubekelwe umlayezo.
badges.designNote.from: A shape, two colours and a symbol. Nothing to upload and nobody to brief.

badges.allHave.text: Yoke into inebheji kakade. Khipha elilodwa emsebenzini ukuze wakhe elihlukileko lento efanako.
badges.allHave.from: Everything already has a badge. Retire one to design a different badge for the same thing.

badges.says.from: What it says, for the learner and anybody they show it to (optional)

badges.saysHint.text: Uqedile imojula yokusebenza ekusebenzeni ekuphakameni, ehlolwe ngokuya ngeemfuneko zekharikhulamu.
badges.saysHint.from: Completed the practical module on working at heights, assessed against the curriculum criteria.

badges.retireTitle.from: Stop awarding {name}. Everybody who has it keeps it.

templates.intro.text: Amadokhumende {name} elikhiphako. Ukuthi ngamunye afundeka njani futhi abukeka njani kukwakho: bhala inguqulo yakho bese ipulatifomu ikhiphe ngokuya ngayo esikhundleni sohlelo layo. Lokho umthetho okudingako kwengezwa ngemva kwalokho okwakho futhi akukwazi ukuhlelwa, ngoba leyo ngcenye ayisiyo yomphakeli ukuyitjhugulula.
templates.intro.from: The documents {name} produces. How each one reads and looks is yours: write your own version and the platform produces it from that instead of its own layout. What a regulator requires is added after yours and cannot be edited, because that part is not the provider's to change.

templates.goesTo.statement_of_results.text: Umfundi, ozokuthatha aye nakho esikhungweni sokuhlola nedokhumende yakhe yokuzazisa.
