templates.goesTo.statement_of_results.from: The learner, who carries it to the assessment centre with their identity document.

templates.goesTo.certificate.from: The learner, and whoever they show it to.

templates.goesTo.workplace_statement.text: Ifayela lomfundi, elisayinwe ngumqeqeshi kumqashi ongumphakeli.
templates.goesTo.workplace_statement.from: The learner's file, signed by a coach at the host employer.

templates.goesTo.enrolment_form.text: Ifayelwa njengobufakazi, futhi linikelwa kumbukeli we-QCTO nakavakatjhile.
templates.goesTo.enrolment_form.from: Filed as evidence, and handed to a QCTO monitor on a visit.

templates.producesNote.text: Noma yini engenayo inguqulo yakho isebenzisa uhlelo lwepulatifomu, olulidokhumende elisebenzako hhayi indawo yokugcina.
templates.producesNote.from: Anything without your own version uses the platform's layout, which is a working document rather than a placeholder.

templates.writeNote.text: Qala ngohlelo lwepulatifomu bese uluhlela libe lakho. Yoke insimu idokhumende engayithwala ibhalwe eceleni kwesihleli kunye nesibonelo sangempela sokuthi ibukeka njani.
templates.writeNote.from: Start from the platform's layout and edit it down into yours. Every field the document can carry is listed beside the editor with a real example of what it looks like.

templates.supplied.from: Documents you supply rather than lay out

templates.suppliedNote.text: Akusiwo wonke amadokhumende angamathempulethi ipulatifomu ekugcwalisako.
templates.suppliedNote.from: Not every document is a template the platform fills in.

templates.policiesNote.text: ilithara lakho lokunikela iziqu, iinqubomgomo nezivumelwano, ezikhutjhelwako futhi zigcinwako hhayi ezenziwako.
templates.policiesNote.from: your accreditation letter, policies and agreements, uploaded and retained rather than generated.

templates.fisaNote.text: abhalwe ngumhloli wakho ngokwakhe futhi alinganiswa ngaphambi kokuthi omunye abhale kiwo, ngalokho abhalwa hhayi enziwa athempulethi.
templates.fisaNote.from: written by your own examiner and moderated before anybody sits them, so they are authored rather than templated.

templates.curriculumNote.text: amadokhumende weziqu akhutjhiweko ipulatifomu efunda kiwo ukwakha ikharikhulamu.
templates.curriculumNote.from: the published qualification documents the platform reads to build a curriculum from.

tracker.all.from: Every cohort, including those finished and cancelled.

tracker.note.text: Kufundwa emarekhodini hhayi kugcinwa ngesandla, ngalokho akukwazi ukuphikisana nepulatifomu ekubikako ngayo.
tracker.note.from: Read from the records rather than kept by hand, so it cannot disagree with the platform it reports on.

tracker.none.text: Akukho maqoqo okwamanje. Iqoqo yilokho isheduli, irejista nombiko omiswe ngomthetho kuxhomeka kikho.
tracker.none.from: No cohorts yet. A cohort is what a schedule, a register and a statutory return all hang from.

dictionary.intro.text: Incazelo emisiweko yeligama ngalinye elisetjenziswa epulatifomini le, emadokhumendeni ayo nakokufundwa kwayo. Isiqalo ngasinye sitjho ukuthi ngubani onelo gama. Lapho igunya lilichaza, silisebenzisa njengabo bese igama lomzimba litjhiwo. Lapho ligama lethu, singalitjhugulula. Lapho lisetjenziswa ngokujayelekileko kuphela, aliwufuze litjhulwe njengeemfuneko.
dictionary.intro.from: The settled meaning of every term used across this platform, its documents and its learning material. Each entry says who owns the word. Where an authority defines it, we use it as they do and the body is named. Where the word is ours, we can change it. Where it is simply common usage, it should never be cited as a requirement.

dictionary.searchHint.from: A term, an abbreviation, or a word in a definition

dictionary.meaning.authority.text: Lichazwe yigunya. Lisebenzise njengabo: ukutjhugulula incazelo kubeka ukuthunyelwa engozini.
dictionary.meaning.authority.from: Defined by an authority. Use it as they do: changing the meaning puts a submission at risk.

dictionary.meaning.platform.text: Igama lepulatifomu le ngokwalo. Ngelethu ukulitjhugulula; akukho gunya elilimisako.
dictionary.meaning.platform.from: This platform's own word for it. Ours to change; no authority prescribes it.

dictionary.meaning.practice.text: Ukusetjenziswa okujayelekileko emkhakheni, akunamnikazi oyedwa. Ungalitjho njengemfuneko.
dictionary.meaning.practice.from: Common usage across the sector, with no single owner. Do not cite it as a requirement.

dictionary.none.text: Akukho okufanako. Nangabe igama lilahlekile futhi liligama esilisebenzisako, lifanele ukuba lapha: tjho bese lengezwa ekhutjhweni elilandelako.
dictionary.none.from: Nothing matches. If a term is missing and it is one we use, it belongs here: say so and it will be added in the next release.

feedbackForm.intro.text: {cohort}. Iimpendulo zibikwa ndawonye nezabanye bonke, hhayi ngazinye. Kuthatha imizuzu emibili ngokulinganisa, futhi kuphela lokho okutjhugulula ukuthi iqoqo elilandelako liqhutjwa njani.
feedbackForm.intro.from: {cohort}. Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. It takes about two minutes, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

feedbackReport.ratingsNote.text: Isilinganiso sika-1 (angivumelani nakancani) kuya ku-5 (ngiyavuma khulu). Isilinganiso seempendulo ezimbalwa siyimizwa, hhayi isilinganiso, ngalokho inani libekwe eceleni kwaso.
feedbackReport.ratingsNote.from: Mean of 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree). A mean over few answers is a mood, not a measurement, so the count is beside it.

feedbackReport.saidNote.text: Kutjengiswa ndawonye futhi ngaphandle kwamagama. Impendulo ngomlekeleli inelaka nakuthi umfundi uyakholelwa ukuthi ngekhe ifundelwe yena ngayinye.
feedbackReport.saidNote.from: Shown together and without names. Feedback about a facilitator is only honest if the learner believes it will not be read back to them one by one.

feedbackReport.outstandingNote.text: Indawo eyodwa ebonakala kiyo igama. Ukubalanda kudinga amagama; iimpendulo ezingenhla azizidingi.
feedbackReport.outstandingNote.from: The one place a name appears. Chasing needs them; the answers above do not.

conductPage.intro.text: Izikhalazo ezifakwe ngabafundi, nanoma ngubani irejista ethi uyekile ukuza. Amacala ezenzo zokuziphatha asekhasini lomfundi ngokwakhe, lapho kunamarekhodi wakhe wonke.
conductPage.intro.from: Grievances raised by learners, and anybody the register says has stopped turning up. Disciplinary matters sit on the learner's own page, where the rest of their record is.

conductPage.overdueNote.text: Isikhalazo sivunywa ngaphakathi kweentsuku zomsebenzi ezingu-{days}. Lezi sezidlulile.
conductPage.overdueNote.from: A grievance is acknowledged within {days} working days. These are past that.

conductPage.grievancesNote.text: Sifakwa ngumfundi ngokuphathwa, iimpilo, namkha noma yini enye emthintako. Sigcinwa ngokwehlukileko ezikhalazweni zomphumela, eziya kumlinganisi.
conductPage.grievancesNote.from: Raised by a learner about treatment, conditions, or anything else affecting them. Kept apart from appeals, which are about a result and go to the moderator.

conductPage.abscondedNote.text: Iinsuku ezimbili namkha ezingaphezulu ezilandelanako zeqeshesho zingekho ngaphandle kwelizwi. Kufundwa erejistini hhayi kugcinwe, ngalokho ukulungisa uphawu kutjhugulula impendulo ngokushesha. Ukungabikho okurekhodwe njengokuxolelwe kuyinkulumo, futhi kuqeda ukulandelana.
conductPage.abscondedNote.from: Two or more consecutive training days absent with no word. Read off the register rather than stored, so correcting a mark changes the answer at once. An absence recorded as excused is communication, and breaks the run.

conductPage.nobody.text: Akekho. Wonke umuntu uyeza namkha utjele umuntu ukuthi kubayini engezi.
conductPage.nobody.from: Nobody. Everybody is either turning up or has told somebody why not.

conductPage.actOn.text: Uhlu lokwenza, hhayi isiqunto. Ukuthintana nomfundi, ukubhalela umsekeli nokukhipha isaziso sokuhlosa ukumisa yizinto umuntu azenzako.
conductPage.actOn.from: A list to act on, never a decision. Contacting the learner, writing to the sponsor and issuing a notice of intention to terminate are all things a person does.

grievance.decisionHint.text: Lokho okutholakeleko nokuzakwenziwa. Lokhu kuya kumfundi ngokubhaliweko.
grievance.decisionHint.from: What was found and what will be done. This goes to the learner in writing.

grievance.impartial.text: Umphenyi kufuze abe ngumuntu okungasosikhalazo ngaye. Ukumisa omunye umfundi akhalele ngaye kwenqatjhwa, ngoba “umuntu ongakhethi uhlangothi omiswe” yikho inqubo ekuthembisako futhi iviki elinabasebenzi abambalwa yilo elenza ukuthi ephuke.
grievance.impartial.from: The investigator must be somebody the grievance is not about. Naming one the learner has complained about is refused, because “a designated impartial person” is what the procedure promises and a short-staffed week is exactly when it gets broken.

access.deniedTitle.from: You do not have access to this

access.deniedNote.text: Ungenile, kodwa lokhu akusikho okwakho ukukubona: ngokuba kwomunye umuntu, namkha kudinga indima i-akhawunti yakho engenayo. Nakuthi ucabanga ukuthi kuyiphutha, cela umlawuli wakho ahlole.
access.deniedNote.from: You are signed in, but this is not yours to see: either it belongs to someone else, or it needs a role your account does not hold. If you think that is wrong, ask your administrator to check.

access.unknownTitle.from: This address is not in use

access.unknownNote.text: Akukho sikhungo esisethwe kwikheli le lewebhu, namkha ukufinyelela kuyo kumisiwe. Hlola ikheli obuphiwe lona, namkha uthintane nalowo obekulungiselele iqeshesho lakho.
access.unknownNote.from: No organisation is set up at this web address, or its access has been suspended. Check the address you were given, or contact whoever arranged your training.

wpSetup.intro.text: Umfundi wenza isipiliyoni sokusebenza kumqashi, aqondiswa ngumuntu umqashi lo amnikelako. Isivumelwano sirekhoda ukuthi ngubani lowo; ibhuku lokurekhoda lirekhoda lokho ikharikhulamu efuna bakwenze.
wpSetup.intro.from: A learner does work experience at an employer, supervised by somebody that employer provides. The agreement records who that is; the logbook records what the curriculum requires them to do.

wpSetup.emptyOne.text: Imojula e-1 yesipiliyoni sokusebenza ayinazo iimfuneko ezitjhaphululiweko.
wpSetup.emptyOne.from: 1 work experience module has no requirements captured.

wpSetup.empty.text: Iimojula ezingu-{count} zesipiliyoni sokusebenza ezinazo iimfuneko ezitjhaphululiweko.
wpSetup.empty.from: {count} work experience modules have no requirements captured.

wpSetup.emptyNote.text: {codes}. Ibhuku lokurekhoda elakhiwe ngemojula engenalutho ngekhe lifakazele lutho, ngalokho lezo ngekhe zivulwe kufikela lapho imisebenzi yendawo yokusebenza yekharikhulamu, ulwazi lwendawo yokusebenza nobufakazi obuyisekelo sekungenisiwe.
wpSetup.emptyNote.from: {codes}. A logbook built from an empty module would attest to nothing, so those cannot be opened until the curriculum's work activities, workplace knowledge and supporting evidence have been imported.

wpSetup.noCoaches.text: Akekho ophethe indima ye-Workplace Coach okwamanje. Yengeza umlawuli womfundi ngo-{people} kuqala: usebenzela umqashi, hhayi wena, futhi uzabona abafundi abaqanjwe ezivumelwaneni zakhe kuphela.
wpSetup.noCoaches.from: Nobody holds the Workplace Coach role yet. Add the learner's supervisor through {people} first: they work for the employer, not for you, and they will only ever see the learners named on their own agreements.

wpSetup.ownCoach.text: Umfundi angeze abe ngumqeqeshi wakhe; isiqinisekiso sedathabesi siyakwenqabela.
wpSetup.ownCoach.from: The learner cannot be their own coach; the database refuses it.

wpSetup.designationNote.text: Kurekhodwe esivumelwaneni njengoba kunjalo namuhla, ukuze ukusayina kuqhubeke kutjho ukuthi ngubani osayinile nangaluphi ulwazi.
wpSetup.designationNote.from: Recorded on the agreement as it stands today, so the sign-off keeps saying who signed and in what capacity.

wpSetup.noAgreements.text: Akukho zivumelwano zendawo yokusebenza okwamanje. Yenza esisodwa ngenhla kuqala: ibhuku lokurekhoda lirekhoda umsebenzi owenziwe kumqashi ogama lakhe likhona ngaphasi komqeqeshi ogama lakhe likhona, ngalokho ngekhe likhona ngaphandle kwaso.
wpSetup.noAgreements.from: No workplace agreements yet. Create one above first: a logbook records work done at a named employer under a named coach, so it cannot exist without one.

wpSetup.generated.text: Ibhuku lokurekhoda likhiwa emisebenzini yekharikhulamu ngokwayo yendawo yokusebenza, ulwazi lwendawo yokusebenza nobufakazi obuyisekelo, ngalokho ngekhe lidlulise imfuneko.
wpSetup.generated.from: The logbook is generated from the curriculum's own work activities, workplace knowledge and supporting evidence, so it cannot omit a requirement.

enrolForm.intro.text: {provider} kufuze athumele imininingwana le eKhansilini yeKhwalithi yeeNkghwa nemiSebenzi nawubhaliswa. Ekunengi sekwaziwa futhi kutjengiswe ngezansi; okusele yilokho akekho ongakuphendula ngaphandle kwakho. Ungagcina njengoba uhamba bese ubuyela kukho.
enrolForm.intro.from: {provider} has to send these details to the Quality Council for Trades and Occupations when you are enrolled. Most of it is already known and shown below; the rest is what nobody can answer except you. You can save as you go and come back to it.

enrolForm.onRecordNote.text: Tjela umhlanganisi wakho nakuthi okunye kwalokhu akulungile; akusikho okwakho ukukutjhugulula lapha.
enrolForm.onRecordNote.from: Tell your coordinator if any of this is wrong; it is not yours to change here.

enrolForm.doesNotAdd.from: Something here does not add up

enrolForm.idNote.text: Inomboro yesazisi yeSewula Afrika ithwala usuku lokuzalwa nobulili ngaphakathi, futhi i-QCTO ihlola ukuthi ivumelene. Ngokujayelekileko yinomboro ebhalwe kabi. Umhlanganisi wakho angayilungisa.
enrolForm.idNote.from: A South African identity number carries the date of birth and the gender inside it, and the QCTO checks that they agree. It is usually a mistyped digit. Your coordinator can correct it.

enrolForm.stillNote.text: Akukho okulahlekako nakumisa ngaphakathi. Lokhu kulokho okungatholakali ekuthumelweni njengoba kunjalo.
enrolForm.stillNote.from: Nothing is lost if you stop partway. This is what would be missing from the submission as it stands.

enrolForm.completeNote.from: Everything the submission needs is here.

enrolForm.missingPrint.text: Iimpendulo ezingu-{count} zisalahlekile, ngalokho ifomu le lizaphrintwa linezikhala. Zibhalwe efomini ngokwalo.
enrolForm.missingPrint.from: {count} answers are still missing, so this form will print with blanks. They are listed on the form itself.

enrolForm.completePrint.text: Kuphelele. Liphrinte, umfundi alisayine, bese uyalifayela.
enrolForm.completePrint.from: Complete. Print it, have the learner sign it, and file it.

enrolForm.titleHint.from: Mr, Ms, Dr, and so on.

enrolForm.middleHint.from: If you have one. Leave it blank if not.

enrolForm.working.from: Are you working at the moment?

enrolForm.difficulty.from: How much difficulty does it cause?

enrolForm.difficultyHint.text: Kubuzwa ngoba ukukhubazeka kurekhodwe ngegama lakho. I-QCTO iyakudinga kunye nakho.
enrolForm.difficultyHint.from: Asked because a disability is recorded against your name. The QCTO requires it alongside.

enrolForm.noId.text: Nakungasi nawe inomboro yesazisi yeSewula Afrika
enrolForm.noId.from: If you do not have a South African identity number

enrolForm.instead.from: What you are enrolled on instead

enrolForm.post.text: Lapho iposo likufikela khona, nakuyindawo eyehlukileko
enrolForm.post.from: Where post reaches you, if it is somewhere else

enrolForm.provinceHint.text: Lapho usebenza khona, okungasosikhathi sinye lapho uhlala khona.
enrolForm.provinceHint.from: Where you work, which is not always where you live.

enrolForm.statssaHint.from: Your coordinator can look this one up if you do not know it.

enrolForm.flcNote.text: Kudingeka kuphela esiqwini sezinga le-NQF 3 namkha 4. Yiyeke ingenalutho nakungekho ongakubuzanga.
enrolForm.flcNote.from: Only needed on a qualification at NQF level 3 or 4. Leave it blank if nobody has asked you for it.

enrolForm.agreedOn.text: Uvumile ngomhlaka {date}. Ilanga leli lingcenye yerekhodi futhi alitjhugululwa nawuhlela ifomu le.
enrolForm.agreedOn.from: You agreed on {date}. That date is part of the record and does not change if you edit this form.

enrolForm.agreedDate.text: Ilanga ovuma ngalo liyarekhodwa, ngoba umbiko ubuza zombili.
enrolForm.agreedDate.from: The date you agree is recorded, because the return asks for both.

enrolForm.confirm.from: Save and confirm these are right

records.intro.text: Isistimu yokuLawula ikhwalithi neenqubomgomo zayo, iilithara zokunikela iziqu, izivumelwano, namadokhumende omthetho afana nomhlahlandlela we-PAIA: koke umphakeli akubambileko okungasokomfundi oyedwa namkha isiqu esisodwa. Ukungenisa ifolda yesiqu kufayela iinqubomgomo zayo ze-QMS lapha ngokuzenzakalelako.
records.intro.from: The Quality Management System and its policies, accreditation letters, contracts, and statutory documents like the PAIA manual: everything the provider holds that does not belong to one learner or one qualification. Importing a qualification folder files its QMS policies here automatically.

records.introManage.text: Kuphinda kutjengise lokho okufike ekupheleni kwesikhathi salo sokugcina.
records.introManage.from: It also shows what has reached the end of its retention period.

records.expiringNote.text: Isitifikeyidi sokukhululwa kwerhafu esiphelelwe yisikhathi yinto engaqatjhelwa muntu kufikela evikini abesidinga ngalo.
records.expiringNote.from: An expired tax clearance is the kind of thing nobody notices until the week it is needed.

records.libraryNote.text: Iinguqulo ezithathelwe indawo ziyagcinwa, ngoba inqubomgomo ebibusa ngoMatjhi yiyo ukubuyekezwa kwangoMatjhi okubuza ngayo.
records.libraryNote.from: Superseded versions are kept, because the policy that governed in March is the one an audit of March asks about.

records.nothingManage.text: Ilithara lokunikela iziqu yilo elifaneleke ukubekwa kuqala.
records.nothingManage.from: The accreditation letter is the one worth putting in first.

records.retentionNote.text: Kubalwa kusukela ilanga lokutifikeyida, ngaphezu kwesikhathi sokugcina kule tenanti. Akukho okugcinelwe iminyaka namkha okucekelwe phasi lapha: ipulatifomu itjho lokho okufuze kwenziwe futhi umuntu uyaqunta.
records.retentionNote.from: Counted from the certification date, over the retention period on this tenant. Nothing here has been archived or destroyed: the platform says what is due and a person decides.

records.registerNote.text: Yoke into equnyiweko ngerekhodi elidlule ilanga lalo, nokuthi ngubani oqunte. Irekhodi elinyamalele buthule limbi kunelibanjwe isikhathi eside.
records.registerNote.from: Everything decided about a record past its date, with who decided it. A record that quietly disappeared is worse than one kept too long.

records.replacesNote.text: Leyo ethathelwa indawo iyagcinwa bese iphawulwa njengethathelwe indawo. Inqubomgomo ebibusa ngoMatjhi yiyo ukubuyekezwa kwangoMatjhi okubuza ngayo.
records.replacesNote.from: The one it replaces is kept and marked superseded. The policy that governed in March is what an audit of March asks about.

records.descriptionHint.from: What it is, if the title does not say

records.anybody.from: Anybody signed in may read this

records.anybodyNote.text: Kusebenza emadokhumendeni omthetho. Inkambiso yomfundi itjengiswa abafundi njalo; iinqubomgomo, izivumelwano, ukunikelwa kweziqu namadokhumende wokwenziwako awatjengiswa ngalanga lithize.
records.anybodyNote.from: Applies to statutory documents. A learner guide is always shown to learners; policies, contracts, accreditation and operational documents never are.

records.archive.from: Archive: move it out of the way

offline.intro.text: Landa lokho okudingako ngaphambi kokuphuma. Noma yini oyirekhodako nawungekho igciniwa efonini le futhi ithunyelwa ngasikhathi olandelako ubuye ube nesignali.
offline.intro.from: Download what you need before you go out. Anything you record while you are away is kept on this phone and sent back the next time you have a signal.

offline.takeNote.text: Landa lokho okudingako ngaphambi kokuhamba. Akukho okugcinwako ongakucelanga.
offline.takeNote.from: Download what you need before you go. Nothing is kept that you did not ask for.

offline.nothingToStudy.text: Awunalutho ofuze ulufunde okwamanje. Noma yini obhalisiwe kiyo itjengiswa lapha ukuze ulande.
offline.nothingToStudy.from: You have nothing to study at the moment. Anything you are enrolled on appears here to download.

offline.recordNote.text: Isebenza ngaphandle kwesignali. Ilinda efonini le bese iyahamba nakuba khona esinye.
offline.recordNote.from: Works with no signal. It waits on this phone and goes when you next have one.

offline.waitingDecisionNote.text: Okuthile kutjhukile umfundi engekho. Akukho okuhlanganisiweko namkha okubhalwe ngaphezulu: kufuze umuntu akhethe.
offline.waitingDecisionNote.from: Something changed while the learner was away. Nothing has been merged or overwritten: somebody has to choose.

offline.bothDates.from: Recorded on the device {captured} · reached us {received}

offline.relaxedNote.text: Umsebenzi orekhodwe ngesikhathi uhlelo lwavumela ukuthi okuqedako kuthathwe ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi. Nakuthi uhlelo lunikelwa iziqu kamuva, lowo msebenzi awuphenduki ovikelekileko emuva: lolu uhlu, ngalokho kuba siqunto hhayi ukutholwa ekuvakatjheleni kokulinganisa.
offline.relaxedNote.from: Work recorded while this programme allowed summatives to be taken offline. If the programme is accredited later, that work does not become defensible retrospectively: this is the list, so it is a decision rather than a discovery at a monitoring visit.

offline.cannotHold.text: Ibrawuza le ayikwazi ukubamba izinto zokusebenzisa ngaphandle kwesignali. Koke kusasebenza ngokujayelekileko nawuxhunyiwe.
offline.cannotHold.from: This browser cannot hold material for use without a signal. Everything still works normally while you are connected.

offline.noSignal.from: No signal: showing what is held

offline.nothingHeld.text: Akukabanjwa lutho. Vula isigaba sokufunda bese ukhetha ukuyenza itholakale ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi ngaphambi kokuphuma.
offline.nothingHeld.from: Nothing is held yet. Open a study unit and choose to make it available offline before you go out.

offline.ofQuota.from: of about {quota} this phone will allow

offline.keepNote.from: Asks the phone not to clear it while you are away.

offline.noRoom.text: Akukho ndawo eyanele efonini le. Susa okuthile okubanjelwe esinye isigaba sokufunda kuqala: akukho okulandiweko.
offline.noRoom.from: There is not enough room on this phone. Remove something held for another study unit first: nothing has been downloaded.

offline.onPhone.text: {label} ikhona efonini le. Ungayifunda ngaphandle kwesignali.
offline.onPhone.from: {label} is on this phone. You can read it with no signal.

offline.incomplete.text: Lokho kungakhange kulandeke ngokuphelele, ngalokho akukho okugciniweko. Linga godu lapho isignali ingcono khona.
offline.incomplete.from: That did not download completely, so none of it has been kept. Try again where the signal is better.

offline.released.from: {label} is no longer held. It freed up room on this phone.

offline.cannotKeep.text: Ibrawuza le ayikwazi ukugcina izinto zokusebenzisa ngaphandle kwesignali.
offline.cannotKeep.from: This browser cannot keep material for use without a signal.

offline.pageOne.from: 1 page. Download it before you go out.

offline.pages.from: {count} pages. Download it before you go out.

offline.writeFirst.text: Bhala inothi namkha wengeze ifoto kuqala.
offline.writeFirst.from: Write a note or add a photograph first.

offline.willGo.text: Kurekhodwe efonini le. Kuzakuthunyelwa nawuba nesignali.
offline.willGo.from: Recorded on this phone. It will go when you have a signal.

offline.whatYouDidHint.text: Ihlolile umugca wesitenda ngeceleni lomngcele wasempumalanga.
offline.whatYouDidHint.from: Inspected the fence line along the eastern boundary.

offline.shrunk.text: Yenziwe encani ukugcina indawo: {from} → {to}. Isacaca ngokwanele ukuhlolwa.
offline.shrunk.from: Made smaller to save room: {from} → {to}. Still clear enough to assess.

mailbox.empty.text: Akukabikho lutho lapha. Noma yini ethunyelwa ku-{address} ifika kuhlu lolu, kunye neenkhambamiswano ezigciniwe ngendlela efanako nobufakazi bokuhlola.
mailbox.empty.from: Nothing here yet. Anything sent to {address} arrives in this list, with attachments stored the same way assessment evidence is.

mailbox.envelope.text: Iseva ethumelako izitjele ngu-{address}, okungasiyo ikheli elisemgceni othi Kusuka ku-. Kujayelekile emalisini eposo nakwiposo eliphindiselweko, futhi yikho nokubukeka kwomthumeli oqambe amanga.
mailbox.envelope.from: The sending server identified itself as {address}, which is not the address in the From line. Ordinary for mailing lists and forwarded mail, and also what a forged sender looks like.

mailbox.notSwitchedOn.text: Ukuthumela akukavulwa: akukho ndlela yeposo elungiselelwe, ngalokho umlayezo obhalwe lapha ngekhe uphume. Iimpendulo oziphiwako zisafika ngokujayelekileko.
mailbox.notSwitchedOn.from: Sending is not switched on yet: no mail relay is configured, so a message written here could not leave the building. Replies you receive still arrive normally.

lrs.intro.text: Amarekhodi wabafundi bakho, angena aphume, njengamatatimende e-xAPI: ifomethi esetjenziswa yizitolo zamarekhodi wokufunda neenkhathi ezinengi zokufunda. Akukho okutjhugulula imiphumela yomfundi epulatifomini le.
lrs.intro.from: Your learners' records, in and out, as xAPI statements: the format learning record stores and most learning systems exchange. Nothing here changes a learner's results on this platform.

lrs.outNote.text: Ukubhalisa ngakunye, ilesoni eliqediweko, ukuhlola okulingwe, isiqunto sokukghona namkha sokungakakghoni, isifundo esiqediweko, isitatimende semiphumela, isitifikeyidi nesitifikeyidi sesiqu esamukelweko, isitatimende esisodwa ngasinye. Sinye ngasinye sigcina isazisi esifanako njalo nawukhipha, ngalokho ukulayisha iinkhipho ezimbili kwenye isistimu akuphindi umlando womuntu.
lrs.outNote.from: Every enrolment, lesson completed, assessment attempted, competent or not yet competent decision, course completed, statement of results, certificate, and qualification certificate received, one statement each. Each keeps the same identity every time you export, so loading two exports into another system does not double anybody's history.

lrs.downloadNote.text: Ifayela litjho wonke umfundi nekheli lakhe le-imeyili. Ligcine njengoba ugcina loke irekhodi lemininingwana yobuqu.
lrs.downloadNote.from: The file names every learner and their email address. Keep it as you would any record of personal information.

lrs.store.text: Thumela amarekhodi esitolo sakho samarekhodi wokufunda
lrs.store.from: Send records to your own learning record store

lrs.storeNote.text: Nakunesitolo samarekhodi wokufunda, sixhume lapha bese loke irekhodi elingenhla liya kiso ngaphakathi kweyure ngemva kokwenzeka, ezakade zenziwe zisokuqala. Elilodwa ngalinye lithunyelwa kanye; isitatimende isitolo esisibambileko sishiywa njengoba sinjalo. Isifihlo sesitolo sifihlwe epulatifomini le, asitjengiswa godu, futhi siyakhohlakala nawuqeda ukuxhuma.
lrs.storeNote.from: If you keep a learning record store, connect it here and every record above goes to it within the hour of happening, the ones already made first. Each is sent once; a statement the store already holds is left as it is. The store's secret is sealed on this platform, never shown again, and forgotten when you disconnect.

lrs.inNote.text: Ifayela lamatatimende e-xAPI evela kwenye isistimu: uhlu lwamatatimende, namkha lokho isitolo samarekhodi wokufunda sikubuyisako. Ngalinye lifaniswa nomfundi lapha nge-imeyili bese litjengiswa erekhodini lakhe. Ligcinwa njengokufundwe kwenye indawo, hhayi kuphendulwe libe kubhalisa namkha umphumela lapha, ngoba akukho okufundiswe namkha okuhlolwe epulatifomini le.
lrs.inNote.from: A file of xAPI statements from another system: a list of statements, or what a learning record store returns. Each is matched to a learner here by email and shown on their record. It is kept as learning done elsewhere, not turned into an enrolment or a result here, because none of it was taught or assessed on this platform.

lrs.heldUnmatched.text: Amatatimende angu-{count} abanjwe kwenye indawo, angu-{unmatched} akakafaniswa nomfundi.
lrs.heldUnmatched.from: {count} statements held from elsewhere, {unmatched} not yet matched to a learner.

lrs.addedHeld.text: Amatatimende angu-{added} kwangu-{read} engeziwe; angu-{held} abesele abanjiwe.
lrs.addedHeld.from: {added} of {read} statements added; {held} were already held.

lrs.matchedOne.text: Umfundi o-1 ufanisiwe nge-imeyili. Ukufunda kwakhe okungeniswe kutjengiswa erekhodini lakhe ngaphasi kwe-Abantu.
lrs.matchedOne.from: 1 learner matched by email. Their imported learning shows on their record under People.

lrs.matched.text: Abafundi abangu-{count} bafanisiwe nge-imeyili. Ukufunda kwabo okungeniswe kutjengiswa erekhodini labo ngaphasi kwe-Abantu.
lrs.matched.from: {count} learners matched by email. Their imported learning shows on their record under People.

lrs.unmatched.text: Akufanisiwe nomuntu lapha, futhi kugcinwa kufikela lapho kufanisiwe: {names}. Bamemele ngokusebenzisa i-imeyili efanako bese ukufunda kwabo kuhlanganiswa.
lrs.unmatched.from: Not matched to anybody here, and kept until they are: {names}. Invite them with the same email and their learning attaches.

lrs.acceptedOne.text: Isitatimende e-1 samukelwe kuze kube nje.

lrs.accepted.text: Amatatimende angu-{count} amukelwe kuze kube nje.

lrs.acceptedLast.text: Amatatimende angu-{count} amukelwe kuze kube nje; okokugcina kuthunyelwe {date}.
lrs.acceptedLast.from: {count} statements accepted so far; last sent {date}.

lrs.hourly.text: Thumela amarekhodi esitolong le njalo ngehora
lrs.hourly.from: Send records to this store every hour

verifyPage.intro.text: Faka ireferensi ephrintiweko esitifikeyidini. Akukho akhawunti edingekako.
verifyPage.intro.from: Enter the reference printed on the certificate. No account is needed.

verifyPage.validStatementNote.text: Umfundi lo ufinyelele zonke iimfuneko zokuhlola zangaphakathi zesiqu esingezansi futhi angabhaliswa i-External Integrated Summative Assessment.
verifyPage.validStatementNote.from: This learner has achieved every internal assessment criterion for the qualification below and may be entered for the External Integrated Summative Assessment.

verifyPage.doNotAccept.text: Ungasamukeli idokhumende le. Thintana nomphakeli otjhiwo kiyo nakuthi umfundi ukholelwa ukuthi kuyiphutha.
verifyPage.doNotAccept.from: Do not accept this document. Contact the provider named on it if the learner believes this is a mistake.

verifyPage.expiredNote.text: Isitatimende seMiphumela sisebenza iminyaka emibili kusukela ilanga sakhutjhwa ngalo. Lesi sakhutjhwa ngomhlaka {issued} futhi siphelelwe ngomhlaka {expired}.
verifyPage.expiredNote.from: A Statement of Results is valid for two years from the date it was issued. This one was issued on {issued} and expired on {expired}.

verifyPage.expiredNote2.text: Akukho okungalungiko ngesitjhaphuluko somfundi: yidokhumende eliphelelwe. Umphakeli otjhiwo kiso angakhipha esikhona.
verifyPage.expiredNote2.from: Nothing is wrong with the learner's achievement: it is the document that has run out. The provider named on it can issue a current one.

verifyPage.notFoundNote.text: Akukho sitifikeyidi esinaleyo ireferensi. Ihlole ngedokhumende: iinhlamvu i-I, i-L, i-O, i-U, 0 no-1 azisetjenziswa nanini, ngalokho u-1 uba ngu-7 namkha nguJ, no-O uba nguQ namkha nguD.
verifyPage.notFoundNote.from: No certificate carries that reference. Check it against the document: the characters I, L, O, U, 0 and 1 are never used, so a 1 is a 7 or a J, and an O is a Q or a D.

verifyPage.withdrawnDetail.text: Sakhutjhelwa u-{holder} ngokwe-{title}, futhi sarhoxiswa ngomhlaka {date}.
verifyPage.withdrawnDetail.from: It was issued to {holder} for {title}, and withdrawn on {date}.

verifyPage.notRely.from: It should not be relied on.

verifyPage.badgeNote.text: Lokhu kurekhodi lomphakeli ngokwakhe lokuthi obambileko uqedile imojula le yokufunda. Akusiso isiqu sesitjhaba, akunamakhredithi, futhi akunikelwa yikhansela lekhwalithi. Isiqu siqinisekiswa yireferensi yaso yesitifikeyidi.
verifyPage.badgeNote.from: This is a provider's own record that the holder completed this module of study. It is not a national qualification, carries no credits, and is not awarded by a quality council. A qualification is verified by its own certificate reference.

platformPage.intro.text: Yoke inhlangano epulatifomini. Ungabona ukuthi ngayinye isebenzisa malini bese ulawula ukuhlelwa kwayo, kodwa hhayi abafundi, izifundo namarekhodi wokuhlola. Ukubamba isistimu yekhasimende akufani nokunikelwa ilungelo lokuyifunda, futhi ipulatifomu iyakuphoqelela lokho kunokuthi ithembele ekuzithibeni.
platformPage.intro.from: Every organisation on the platform. You can see how much each is using and manage their configuration, but not their learners, courses or assessment records. Hosting a client's system is not the same as being entitled to read it, and the platform enforces that rather than relying on restraint.

folderPick.noneTitle.from: You do not have an AI extension set up.

folderPick.noneNote.text: Ingeza into eyodwa lapha: ukusebenza isakhiwo emadokhumendeni, nakuthi ifolda ayiqukethi isifinyezo sayo. Koke okunye ekhasini le kusebenza ngaphandle kwaso. KuSethingi, ngaphasi kwesengezo sakho se-AI, nakufuna esisodwa.

said.alignment-document.c3e49767.text: Akukho zigaba zokufunda ezitholakele kudokhumende leyo. Isihloko esisodwa kufuze sifundeke njengokuthi “Isigaba sokuFunda 1 – Isakhiwo Senhlangano”, kunye neemojula ezikhonjiweko ngaphasi kwaso.
said.alignment-document.c3e49767.from: No study units were found in that document. One heading has to read like “Study Unit 1 – Organisational Architecture”, with the modules it covers listed under it.

said.alignment-matrix.185b0901.text: Akukho matriksi yokulinganisa etholakele ebhukwini lomsebenzi le. Ikholomu eyodwa kufuze ibe nesihloko esifana no-“Topic Elements”, ukuze imigca ifaniswe nekharikhulamu.
said.alignment-matrix.185b0901.from: No alignment matrix found in this workbook. One column must be headed something like “Topic Elements”, so the rows can be matched to the curriculum.

said.alignment-matrix.2b19415b.text: Leyo yidokhumende ye-Word. Idokhumende ngokwayo iyagcinwa, ifayelwe futhi iyafunwa. Okungakwenzeka kukuyifunda, ngoba imatriksi yokulinganisa ifundwa njenge-spreadsheet: umugca owodwa emugceni ngamunye wekharikhulamu, enekholomu enesihloko esifana no-“Topic Elements”. Gcina imatriksi njenge-spreadsheet bese ukhuphela leyo nayo, futhi umugca ngamunye wekharikhulamu utjengisa ukuthi ukuhlanganiswe yini.
said.alignment-matrix.2b19415b.from: That is a Word document. The document itself is kept, filed and searchable. What could not happen is reading it, because the alignment matrix is read as a spreadsheet: one row per curriculum line, with a column headed something like “Topic Elements”. Save the matrix as a spreadsheet and upload that as well, and each line of the curriculum will show what covers it.

said.alignment-matrix.a0d14e78.text: Imatriksi ayinamakholomu weemthombo angabonwa: akukho enesihloko esithi Workbook, Assessment, Theory Guide, Legislation njalo njalo.
said.alignment-matrix.a0d14e78.from: The matrix has no resource columns that could be recognised: nothing headed Workbook, Assessment, Theory Guide, Legislation and so on.

said.alignment-matrix.a8527ba8.text: Ngenisa idokhumende yekharikhulamu ngaphambi kwematriksi yokulinganisa: akukho okuthize okuzakunamathelwa yimigca yayo.
said.alignment-matrix.a8527ba8.from: Import the curriculum document before the alignment matrix: there is nothing yet for its rows to attach to.

said.alignment-matrix.cf20070f.from: In the matrix, not in the curriculum as read.

said.alignment-matrix.e1c0c850.text: Imatriksi itjho ukuthi ikharikhulamu ikhipha lokhu; ikharikhulamu njengoba ifundiwe ayinakho.
said.alignment-matrix.e1c0c850.from: The matrix says the curriculum publishes this; the curriculum as read does not have it.

said.appeals.0db8b611.text: Lokhu kudlule umhlaka we-{deadline} ngeentsuku zomsebenzi ezingu-{lateByWorkingDays}. Kusakwazi ukufakwa, kodwa tjho ukuthi kubayini kwamukelwa kudlulelwe yisikhathi: isizathu leso singcenye yerekhodi.
said.appeals.0db8b611.from: This is {lateByWorkingDays} working days past the deadline of {deadline}. It can still be lodged, but say why it is being accepted out of time: that reason is part of the record.

said.appeals.28f7ee35.text: Lokhu sekuvunyiwe ukwamukelwa. Ukuvuma kokuqala yikho irekhodi elikugcinako.
said.appeals.28f7ee35.from: This was already acknowledged. The first acknowledgement is the one the record keeps.

said.appeals.3a9deae5.text: Isikhalazo lesi sesixazululiwe. Asikwazi ukurhoxiswa emva kwalokho.
said.appeals.3a9deae5.from: This appeal is already resolved. It cannot be withdrawn afterwards.

said.appeals.44a8137a.text: Isikhalazo somphumela siya kumlinganisi wangaphakathi ngaphambi kokuthi sixazululwe. Rekhoda ukuthi ubani obuziwe kuqala.
said.appeals.44a8137a.from: A result appeal goes to the internal moderator before it is resolved. Record who was consulted first.

said.appeals.5e354d8e.from: Your role does not allow that.

said.appeals.73f8aadd.text: Isikhalazo sifakiwe. Isikhathi sokuvuma ukusamukela siqala nje.
said.appeals.73f8aadd.from: Appeal lodged. The clock on acknowledging it starts now.

said.appeals.7caf07c2.text: Kuxazululiwe. Tjela umfundi, bese urekhoda ukuthi umtjelile.
said.appeals.7caf07c2.from: Resolved. Tell the learner, then record that you have.

said.appeals.86246d01.text: Tjho ukuthi kubayini. Umphumela ongenazizathu akusiwo isixazululo, futhi yiyo ingcenye umfundi anelungelo layo.
said.appeals.86246d01.from: Say why. An outcome with no reasoning is not a resolution, and it is the part the learner is entitled to.

said.appeals.8875be21.text: Tjho ukuthi umphumela lo ungowokuhlola muphi. Isikhalazo somphumela esingatjho lokho asikwazi ukuthunyelwa kumlinganisi.
said.appeals.8875be21.from: Say which assessment the result belongs to. A result appeal that does not name one cannot be sent to a moderator.

said.appeals.8904ae3b.text: Lokhu kudlule umhlaka we-{deadline} ngosuku lomsebenzi olu-{lateByWorkingDays}. Kusakwazi ukufakwa, kodwa tjho ukuthi kubayini kwamukelwa kudlulelwe yisikhathi: isizathu leso singcenye yerekhodi.
said.appeals.8904ae3b.from: This is {lateByWorkingDays} working day past the deadline of {deadline}. It can still be lodged, but say why it is being accepted out of time: that reason is part of the record.

said.appeals.8b380ce0.from: An empty note is worse than none.

said.appeals.8c5db8b8.text: Tjho ukuthi kubayini kurhoxisiwe. Ukurhoxisa okungenasizathu kubonakala njengokucindezela.
said.appeals.8c5db8b8.from: Say why it was withdrawn. A withdrawal with no reason looks like pressure.

said.appeals.91aa73ce.from: There is no outcome to give the learner yet.

said.appeals.a2fb8815.from: That learner is not on that cohort.

said.appeals.a3ddc6dd.text: Izizathu: {ground}. Kufuze kuvunywe ukwamukelwa, futhi isikhathi sibalwa kusukela namuhla.
said.appeals.a3ddc6dd.from: Grounds: {ground}. It has to be acknowledged, and the clock runs from today.

said.appeals.b38737d5.text: Tjho ukuthi isikhalazo sikhuluma ngani. Umugca owodwa akusiso isikhalazo.
said.appeals.b38737d5.from: Say what the appeal is about. One line is not an appeal.

said.appeals.ded67e92.from: An appeal has been lodged, out of time

said.appeals.fad9c8a4.text: Izizathu: {ground}. Sifakwe ngemva komhlaka we-{deadline} futhi samukelwa ngesizathu, esingcenye yerekhodi.

said.conduct.07e411c2.text: Tjho ukuthi isikhalazo sikhuluma ngani, ngamagama omfundi ngokwakhe lapho kungenzeka.
said.conduct.07e411c2.from: Say what the grievance is about, in the learner's own words where possible.

said.conduct.1636d693.text: Isikhalazo sibiza {firstName} {lastName}. Umuntu okukhalazwa ngaye akakwazi ukusiphenya: inqubo ibiza umuntu ochaziweko ongakhethi luhlangothi. Khetha omunye.
said.conduct.1636d693.from: The grievance names {firstName} {lastName}. Somebody the complaint is about cannot investigate it: the procedure asks for a designated impartial person. Appoint somebody else.

said.conduct.1d25ed57.text: Isaziso kufuze sitjho iinsolo ezithileko. Umhlangano wokulalelwa ngeensolo ezingatjhiwo awukwazi ukuphendulwa.
said.conduct.1d25ed57.from: The notice has to state the specific allegations. A hearing about unstated allegations cannot be answered.

said.conduct.1e2d5837.text: Kurekhodiwe. Iinsuku zomsebenzi ezisihlanu zokukhalaza ziqala namhlanje.
said.conduct.1e2d5837.from: Recorded. The five working days to appeal run from today.

said.conduct.303f7f08.text: Tjho ukuthi ziyini iinkhambiso ezingenzeka, kubandakanya ukuqediswa lapho kungenzeka. Umfundi ozikhethela ukuthi abe nomsekeli kufuze azi ukuthi kubeke ini engozini.
said.conduct.303f7f08.from: Say what sanctions are possible, including termination where it is. A learner deciding whether to bring assistance needs to know what is at stake.

said.conduct.403b3f35.text: Tjho ukuthi kubayini. Inkhambiso engachazwanga ayivikeleki, futhi yiyo ingcenye umfundi anelungelo layo.
said.conduct.403b3f35.from: Say why. An unexplained sanction is indefensible, and this is the paragraph the learner is entitled to.

said.conduct.47a20502.text: Tjho umthetho owephulwe, ivelo elilindeleko nokuthi kwenzekani nakuphindeka. Isixwayiso esingenzi lokho asisiso.
said.conduct.47a20502.from: State the rule broken, the standard expected and what happens if it recurs. A warning that does not is not one.

said.conduct.4dcaf05f.from: That is not a date and time.

said.conduct.64f7462f.text: Isaziso kufuze sitjele umfundi ukuthi angasekelwa ngumfundi ambanzi, nokuthi angethula ityala lakhe, abize bese abuza oofakazi. Thumela isaziso esenza njalo, bese usirekhoda lapha.
said.conduct.64f7462f.from: The notice must tell the learner they may be assisted by a fellow learner, present their case, and call and question witnesses. Send a notice that does, then record it here.

said.conduct.67f9675a.text: Rekhoda lokho okutholakeleko nesisekelo salo. Umhlangano wokulalelwa ohlakaniswa kumugca owodwa ngumhlangano ongazange ubanjwe.
said.conduct.67f9675a.from: Record what was found and on what basis. A hearing whose findings are one line is a hearing that did not happen.

said.conduct.6a6b5da7.from: It has to be acknowledged by {acknowledgeBy}.

said.conduct.6d857ec5.text: Ukuqeda uhlelo lomuntu kudinga umhlangano wokulalelwa obanjiweko, otholakalo lwawo lurekhodiwe. Biza owodwa, rekhoda lokho okutholakeleko, bese uvala ityala.
said.conduct.6d857ec5.from: Ending somebody's programme needs a hearing that was held, with its findings recorded. Convene one, record what was found, then close the case.

said.conduct.77c80d2a.text: Kufakiwe. Kuzavunywa ngaphakathi kweentsuku zomsebenzi ezimbili.
said.conduct.77c80d2a.from: Lodged. It will be acknowledged within two working days.

said.conduct.869c74ee.text: Umhlangano wokulalelwa udinga isaziso esingasikho ngaphasi kwamahora angu-{HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS}, futhi lokhu kuswela amahora angu-{hours}. Isikhathi sokuqala ongabanjwa ngaso ngu-{earliest}. Isaziso esifitjhani yikho okuwina ngakho isikhalazo, noma umfundi enze noma yini.
said.conduct.869c74ee.from: A hearing needs at least {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} hours' notice and this is {hours} hour short. The earliest it can be held is {earliest}. Short notice is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

said.conduct.8d0ef3ad.text: Umhlangano wokulalelwa ubizwe. Isikhathi sesaziso sifezekile.
said.conduct.8d0ef3ad.from: Hearing convened. The notice period is met.

said.conduct.9f172fca.from: The learner cannot investigate their own grievance.

said.conduct.ad753d2e.text: Isiqunto siya kumfundi ngokubhaliweko futhi kufuze sitjho lokho okutholakeleko nalokho okuzakwenziwa. Umugca akusiso isiqunto.
said.conduct.ad753d2e.from: The decision goes to the learner in writing and has to say what was found and what will be done. A line is not a decision.

said.conduct.b0301d88.text: Tjho ukuthi kuthiwani, ngokuthileko. Umfundi akakwazi ukuphendula 'isimo esibi', begodu nomhlangano wokulalelwa awukwazi.
said.conduct.b0301d88.from: Say what is alleged, specifically. A learner cannot answer 'poor attitude', and neither can a hearing.

said.conduct.b0dcbd53.from: Decided, and the learner has it in writing.

said.conduct.cf47131c.text: Kuvaliwe. Nikela umfundi umphumela ngokubhaliweko, bese urekhoda ukuthi wenzile.
said.conduct.cf47131c.from: Closed. Give the learner the outcome in writing, then record that you have.

said.conduct.e83b2265.text: Umhlangano wokulalelwa udinga isaziso samahora angu-{HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} ubuncani begodu lokhu kuseleka amahora angu-{hours}. Isikhathi sokuqala esingabanjwa ngaso ngu-{earliest}. Isaziso esifitjhani yiphutha elenza ukuthi isikhalazo siphumelele, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umfundi wenzeni.
said.conduct.e83b2265.from: A hearing needs at least {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} hours' notice and this is {hours} hours short. The earliest it can be held is {earliest}. Short notice is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

Amadokhumende, amabhanqa namaphrezentheyitjhini konke kuyafundwa, kubandakanya awe-Google, ngalokho umphumela ongenalutho utjho ukuthi ifolda ayinalutho ngempela, namkha inalokho okufana namaFomu neenkhawulo zendlela kuphela.

said.eisa-sitting-notice.4242bc7f.text: Akukho kuhlala okurekhodiweko kwa-{subject}. Amadethi asuka encwadini yesiqhema sekhwalithi yokuhlola futhi atjhuguluka minyaka yoke. Aze angeniswe, akukho lutho lapha olungakwazi ukukuxwayisa ukuthi usuku lokuphela lokubhalisa lisondela.
said.eisa-sitting-notice.4242bc7f.from: No sittings are recorded for {subject}. The dates come from the assessment quality partner's letter and change every year. Until they are entered, nothing here can warn you that a registration deadline is coming.

said.eisa-sitting-notice.b6bf1cc3.text: Akukho kuhlala okurekhodiweko kwa-{subject}. Isiqhema sekhwalithi yokuhlola sikhipha amadethi ngoDisemba, ngalokho incwadi kufuze ikhutjhiwe: yengeza amadethi bese ukubalwa kwemihla kuqala.
said.eisa-sitting-notice.b6bf1cc3.from: No sittings are recorded for {subject}. The assessment quality partner publishes the dates in December, so the letter should be out: add them and the countdown starts.

said.eisa-sitting-notice.d6b538b0.text: Akukho kuhlala okurekhodiweko. Kuvela encwadini yesiqhema sekhwalithi yokuhlola, ekhutjhwa kanye ngonyaka.
said.eisa-sitting-notice.d6b538b0.from: No sittings are recorded. They come from the assessment quality partner's letter, which is published once a year.

said.eisa.041d2d1d.text: Kurekhodiwe. Ukubalwa kwemihla kuya ekubhalisweni kuqala manje.
said.eisa.041d2d1d.from: Recorded. The countdown to registration starts now.

said.eisa.18104c26.text: Akukho bhuku lokurekhoda lesipiliyoni sokusebenza elivuliweko.
said.eisa.18104c26.from: No work experience logbook has been opened.

said.eisa.235f3916.text: Kubuyiswe ngumqeqeshi wendawo yokusebenza ukuze kufakwe ubufakazi obungeziweko.
said.eisa.235f3916.from: Returned by the workplace coach for more evidence.

said.eisa.2d36e0ea.text: Kusayinwe ngumqeqeshi wendawo yokusebenza, kulindele ukuthi umhloli akwamukele.
said.eisa.2d36e0ea.from: Signed by the workplace coach, waiting for an assessor to accept it.

said.eisa.aabe4744.from: With the workplace coach for signature.

said.enrolment-document-shape.04f2917b.text: Ukutifikeyida kudala kudlula isikhathi esivunyelweko. Sicela ukuthi ukhiphise ikhophi entsha etifikeyidiweko.
said.enrolment-document-shape.04f2917b.from: The certification is older than the period allowed. Please have a fresh copy certified.

said.enrolment-document-shape.3d15f524.text: Le akusiyo ikhophi etifikeyidiweko. Sicela uyitifikeyidise bese uyithumela godu.
said.enrolment-document-shape.3d15f524.from: This is not a certified copy. Please have it certified and send it again.

said.enrolment-document-shape.8d2c9fdc.text: Ikhophi le ayifundeki. Sicela uyiskeni namkha uyifotele godu, ibe mbhoco futhi ikhanya kuhle.
said.enrolment-document-shape.8d2c9fdc.from: The copy is not legible. Please scan or photograph it again, flat and in good light.

said.enrolment-document-shape.a7aecdc1.text: I-ID inamalanga amanengi wokutifikeyida kiyo. Sicela unikele ikhophi etifikeyidiweko kanye, ngasese.
said.enrolment-document-shape.a7aecdc1.from: The ID has more than one certification date on it. Please supply a copy certified once, recently.

said.enrolment-document-shape.ad8ee9a7.from: This is not the document that was asked for.

said.enrolment-document-shape.d9deb62d.from: Some of the pages are missing.

said.enrolment-documents.07cca752.text: Akukho okurekhodiweko: iqoqo namkha umfundi abanakho ukubhadela okumelene nabo.
said.enrolment-documents.07cca752.from: Nothing recorded: neither the cohort nor the learner has a payment against them.

said.enrolment-documents.221ad898.from: Paid for by the client, against {name}.

said.enrolment-documents.26e4b850.text: Nikela ilanga ikhophi le etifikeyidiwe ngalo. Ikhophi elingaziwa ilanga layo lokutifikeyida ayikwazi ukutjengiswa ukuthi isesikhathini.
said.enrolment-documents.26e4b850.from: Give the date this copy was certified. A copy whose certification date is unknown cannot be shown to be current.

said.enrolment-documents.330b87d3.from: The learner supplied their own proof of payment.

said.enrolment-documents.3f1d945a.from: The learner has supplied a proof of payment, not yet checked.

said.enrolment-documents.435df660.from: The learner's proof of payment was refused.

said.enrolment-documents.98317f79.text: Tjho ukuthi kubayini kulaliwe. Umfundi kufuze atjelwe lokho akufuze akulungise, futhi ukulala okungenasizathu kumbuyisela angenalutho angakwenza.
said.enrolment-documents.98317f79.from: Say why it was refused. The learner has to be told what to correct, and a refusal with no reason sends them back with nothing to act on.

said.enrolment-documents.d417e6fa.text: Ikhophi leyo itifikeyidiwe ngomhlaka {certifiedOn}, okudlula amalanga angu-{CERTIFICATION_VALID_DAYS} adlulileko. Ikhophi etifikeyidiweko kufuze ibe sesikhathini nayinikelwa.
said.enrolment-documents.d417e6fa.from: That copy was certified on {certifiedOn}, which is more than {CERTIFICATION_VALID_DAYS} days ago. A certified copy has to be current when it is supplied.

said.enrolment-form.141771ac.text: Kusuka kuluhlu lwamakhodi wendawo we-STATSSA i-QCTO elukhipha.
said.enrolment-form.141771ac.from: From the STATSSA area code list the QCTO publishes.

said.enrolment-form.158eb69b.text: Ukubuya kubuza ukuthi umfundi uvumile yini, nangayiphi idethi.
said.enrolment-form.158eb69b.from: The return asks whether the learner agreed, and on what date.

said.enrolment-form.3ecff80b.text: Ubulili oburekhodiweko abufani nobusenomborweni yesazisi. I-QCTO iyakuhlola lokhu, ngalokho enye yazo ibhalwe kabi.
said.enrolment-form.3ecff80b.from: The gender recorded does not match the one in the identity number. The QCTO checks this, so one of the two is mistyped.

said.enrolment-form.5d06240c.text: Usuku lokuzalwa olurekhodiweko ({recorded}) alufani nenomboro yesazisi, ethi {fromId}.
said.enrolment-form.5d06240c.from: The date of birth recorded ({recorded}) does not match the identity number, which says {fromId}.

said.enrolment-form.7d5cda8a.text: Kuqinisekisiwe, kanye nelanga elirekhodiweko. Nakutjhugululwa lutho lapha ngemva kwalokho, kuzakubuza ukuthi uqinisekise godu.
said.enrolment-form.7d5cda8a.from: Confirmed, and the date recorded. Change anything here later and it will ask you to confirm again.

said.enrolment-form.a380df96.from: Saved. You can come back and finish it later.

said.enrolment-form.a8dcc4e9.from: The identity number does not check out: {reason}

said.enrolment-form.b67325d1.text: Akekho oqinisekise ukuthi imininingwana le ilungile. Umboniseli ucela ifomu njengobufakazi, futhi eliqinisekiswanga alinabufakazi obuningi.
said.enrolment-form.b67325d1.from: Nobody has confirmed these details are right. A monitor asks for the form as evidence, and an unconfirmed one is evidence of very little.

said.enrolment-form.b711b7ce.text: Ukukhubazeka kurekhodiwe, bese i-QCTO idinga ukuthi kubangela ubunzima obungakanani.
said.enrolment-form.b711b7ce.from: A disability was recorded, and the QCTO then requires how much difficulty it causes.

said.enrolment-form.ca9579a9.text: Isifundazwe umfundi asebenzela kiso, okungasoke kube yindawo ahlala kiyo.
said.enrolment-form.ca9579a9.from: The province the learner works in, which is not always where they live.

said.enrolment.52c9b5f2.from: Only a published course can be assigned to a learner.

said.enrolment.65b99bc7.text: Umuntu lowo usabhaliswe kakade kusifundo lesi.
said.enrolment.65b99bc7.from: That person is already enrolled on this course.

said.enrolment.678cc7c5.from: There is no due date on this one.

said.enrolment.6ac9079d.from: That enrolment belongs to someone else.

said.enrolment.79fda720.from: Only the learner can record their own progress.

said.enrolment.ab1eec65.text: Ilesoni leli alisiyo ingcenye yesifundo lesi.
said.enrolment.ab1eec65.from: That lesson is not part of this course.

said.extensions-claude-code.149b1d9d.text: I-Claude Code ayifakiwe lapho ipulatifomu isebenza khona.
said.extensions-claude-code.149b1d9d.from: Claude Code is not installed where the platform is running.

said.extensions-claude-code.1c9bd1dc.text: I-Claude Code ifakiwe kumtjhini lo kodwa akekho ongenileko. Vula i-terminal, sebenzisa u-claude, bese u-/login bese uqeda ukungena kubrawuza. Lokho kusinyathelo esisodwa futhi senziwa nguwe, hhayi yipulatifomu.
said.extensions-claude-code.1c9bd1dc.from: Claude Code is installed on this machine but nobody is signed in. Open a terminal, run claude, then /login and complete the sign-in in the browser. That is a one-time step and it is done by you, not by the platform.

said.extensions-claude-code.53fe3e99.text: Umkhawulo wokusetjenziswa kwesabelo se-Claude uphelile. Lokhu kuzasebenza godu nakubuyiselwa umkhawulo.
said.extensions-claude-code.53fe3e99.from: The Claude subscription's usage limit has been reached. This will work again once the limit resets.

said.extensions-claude-code.7f69ba19.text: Kusebenzisa isabelo sakho se-Claude, ngethokheni oyenza kukhompyutha yakho ngo-`claude setup-token`. Akusiyo ikhiye ye-API: akukho ndleko ngethokheni, futhi kudhonsa esabelweni osesikhokhela sona kunesabelo esabelwana ngaso.
said.extensions-claude-code.7f69ba19.from: Uses your own Claude subscription, through a token you generate on your own computer with `claude setup-token`. Not an API key: no per-token cost, and it draws on the subscription you already pay for rather than a shared one.

said.extensions-claude-code.801580be.text: I-Claude Code ayiphendulanga ngaphakathi kwemizuzwana engu-{timeoutMs}.
said.extensions-claude-code.801580be.from: Claude Code did not answer within {timeoutMs} seconds.

said.extensions-gemini.0473bc2d.text: Akukho khiye ye-API ye-Gemini egciniweko yakho. Yengeze kuAmasethingi. Ivela ku-Google AI Studio, futhi ayifani nesabelo se-Gemini.
said.extensions-gemini.0473bc2d.from: No Gemini API key is stored for you. Add one in Settings. It comes from Google AI Studio, and is not the same as a Gemini subscription.

said.extensions-gemini.18ddcba7.text: Ikhiye ye-API ye-Gemini leyo ayilungi. Hlola ukuthi ikhophiwe yaphela ku-Google AI Studio. Ayifani nesabelo se-Gemini Advanced, esingaqukethi ukufinyelela kwe-API.
said.extensions-gemini.18ddcba7.from: That Gemini API key is not valid. Check it was copied whole from Google AI Studio. It is not the same thing as a Gemini Advanced subscription, which does not include API access.

said.extensions-gemini.3bf73475.text: Umkhawulo wesivinini we-Google wekhiye leyo uphelile. Ileveli yamahhala ivumela izicelo ezimbalwa ngomzuzu; linda bese uyalinga godu, namkha usebenzise ikhiye ebhadelwako.
said.extensions-gemini.3bf73475.from: Google's rate limit for that key has been reached. The free tier allows a limited number of requests a minute; wait and try again, or use a key with billing enabled.

said.extensions-gemini.599b82c0.text: I-Gemini ayiphendulanga ngesikhathi. Ifolda enkulu ingathatha imizuzu eminengi; ukulinga godu ngamadokhumende ambalwa kuyasebenza ngokuvamile.
said.extensions-gemini.599b82c0.from: Gemini did not answer in time. A large folder can take several minutes; trying again with fewer documents in it usually works.

said.extensions-gemini.5f764f27.text: I-Gemini ayitholakalanga. Hlola ukuthi umtjhini lo unokuxhumana ne-Google nge-inthanethi.
said.extensions-gemini.5f764f27.from: Gemini could not be reached. Check that this machine has a network connection to Google.

said.extensions-gemini.6ff1fd27.text: I-Gemini ibaleke indawo ngaphambi kokuthi iqede ukuphendula, ngalokho lokho okubuyileko yingcenye yekharikhulamu hhayi yoke, futhi engaphelelako ibukeka njengephelileko. Akukho okugciniweko. Isiqu esiphelele sikhulu kakhulu ukuthi sicelwe ngempendulo eyodwa; singenise emadokhumendeni waso kunalokho, okufunda ikharikhulamu ngokuqondile ngaphandle kwemodeli nomkhawulo onjalo.
said.extensions-gemini.6ff1fd27.from: Gemini ran out of room before it finished answering, so what came back is part of a curriculum rather than all of it, and a partial one looks exactly like a complete one. Nothing was kept. A whole qualification is a great deal to ask for in a single reply; import it from its documents instead, which reads the curriculum directly with no model involved and no limit of this kind.

said.extensions-gemini.7b1ee4ba.text: I-Gemini iphendule ngokungabi nalutho. Lokho kuvamise ukutjho ukuthi isicelo salaliwa yisihlungi sokuphepha, namkha igama lemodeli alilungi.
said.extensions-gemini.7b1ee4ba.from: Gemini answered with nothing. That usually means the request was refused by a safety filter, or the model name is wrong.

said.extensions-gemini.a3035142.text: Amadokhumende lawo adlula iinhlamvu ezi-{MAX_INPUT_CHARS},000, okukhulu kunalokho okungathunyelwa ngesicelo esisodwa. Ngenisa isiqu emadokhumendeni waso kunalokho: idokhumende yekharikhulamu yodwa ifundwa ngokuqondile, ngaphandle kwemodeli.
said.extensions-gemini.a3035142.from: Those documents come to more than {MAX_INPUT_CHARS},000 characters, which is more than can be sent in one request. Import the qualification from its documents instead: the curriculum document alone is read directly, with no model involved.

said.extensions-gemini.c9f3d2b7.text: I-Google ibike inkinga eseceleni kwayo ({status}). Isicelo esincani sifanele ukulingwa godu. Nakuthi bekuyisiqu sonke futhi sehlulekile ngaphezu kwekanye, isicelo sikhulu kakhulu ukuthi imodeli iyiqede. Singenise emadokhumendeni waso kunalokho, okufunda ikharikhulamu ngokuqondile ngaphandle kwemodeli.
said.extensions-gemini.c9f3d2b7.from: Google reported a problem on their side ({status}). A small request is worth simply trying again. If this was a whole qualification and it has now failed more than once, the request is most likely too large for the model to complete. Import it from its documents instead, which reads the curriculum directly with no model involved.

said.extensions-gemini.d7ab5352.text: I-Google ilile ikhiye leyo. Kungenzeka irhoxisiwe, namkha i-Generative Language API ayivuliwe kuprojekthi ekuyo. Akukho okungasilungi epulatifomu futhi akukho okulahlekileko.
said.extensions-gemini.d7ab5352.from: Google refused that key. It may have been revoked, or the Generative Language API may not be enabled on the project it belongs to. Nothing is wrong with the platform and nothing was lost.

said.extensions-gemini.eb60a381.text: Kusebenzisa ikhiye yakho ye-API ye-Google AI Studio. Hhayi isabelo se-Gemini Advanced: leso siwumkhiqizo owehlukileko futhi asiqukethi ukufinyelela kwe-API. I-API inelevelu yamahhala, ngalokho lokhu kungasebenziswa ngaphandle kokuthenga lutho, phakathi kwemikhawulo yesivinini.
said.extensions-gemini.eb60a381.from: Uses your own Google AI Studio API key. Not a Gemini Advanced subscription: that is a separate product and does not include API access. The API has a free tier, so this can be used without buying anything, within its rate limits.

said.extensions-index.002e7790.text: Gcina i-{word} kuqala: uluhlu luvela komphakeli, futhi ludinga elilodwa ukuze luphendule.
said.extensions-index.002e7790.from: Save a {word} first: the list comes from the provider, and it needs one to answer.

said.extensions-index.04cbda50.text: Lokho akufani ne-{article} {name} {word}. Ukuthola eyodwa, {source}; ithoma ngo-{begins}.
said.extensions-index.04cbda50.from: That does not look like {article} {name} {word}. To get one, {source}; it begins {begins}.

said.extensions-index.252509ee.from: Paste an {word} first. To get one, {source}.

said.extensions-index.4532120c.text: Khetha umphakeli bese unamathisela ilemuko lakhe kuqala.
said.extensions-index.4532120c.from: Choose a provider and paste its credential first.

said.extensions-index.63d1c167.text: Ithokheni yakho egciniweko ayikwazanga ukufundwa. Lokhu kuvamise ukutjho ukuthi isifihlo seseva sitjhugulukile selokhu wagcina. Namathisela entsha ekhasini le-akhawunti yakho.
said.extensions-index.63d1c167.from: Your stored token could not be read. This usually means the server's secret has changed since you saved it. Paste a fresh one on your account page.

said.extensions-index.7d55f18c.from: Choose a provider the platform knows.

said.extensions-index.870b4f8d.from: That provider is no longer available.

said.extensions-index.879f4ba6.text: Gcina i-{word} kuqala: uluhlu luvela komphakeli, futhi ludinga elilodwa ukuze luphendule.
said.extensions-index.879f4ba6.from: Save an {word} first: the list comes from the provider, and it needs one to answer.

said.extensions-index.8af96ab7.from: That does not look like {article} {name} {word}. To get one, {source}.

said.extensions-index.8b099549.from: Paste a {word} first. To get one, {source}.

said.extensions-index.a66c08f2.text: Leyo yikhiye ye-API ye-Anthropic, hhayi ithokheni ye-Claude Code. Iyimikhiqizo eyehlukileko futhi le idinga ithokheni: sebenzisa u-`claude setup-token` kukhompyutha yakho bese unamathisela lokho okuphrintwako. Nakuthi unekhiye ye-API, khetha umphakeli owamukelako.
said.extensions-index.a66c08f2.from: That is an Anthropic API key, not a Claude Code token. They are different products and this one needs the token: run `claude setup-token` on your own computer and paste what it prints. If an API key is what you have, choose a provider that takes one.

said.extensions-index.d95a2478.text: Ilemuko lakho elligciniweko alikwazanga ukufundwa, ngalokho umphakeli akakwazanga ukubuzwa.
said.extensions-index.d95a2478.from: Your stored credential could not be read, so the provider could not be asked.

said.extensions-index.e95369f0.text: Awukasethi isengezo se-AI. Sisekhasini le-akhawunti yakho ngaphasi kweAmasethingi, singesakho hhayi sethenanti, futhi sisebenzisa ithokheni oyenza kukhompyutha yakho.
said.extensions-index.e95369f0.from: You have not set up an AI extension. It is on your account page under Settings, it is yours rather than the tenant's, and it uses a token you generate on your own computer.

said.extensions-index.f448a040.text: Isengezo sakho se-AI sivaliwe ekhasini le-akhawunti yakho. Akukho okulahliweko: sivule godu lapho ufuna khona.
said.extensions-index.f448a040.from: Your AI extension is disabled on your account page. Nothing was discarded: switch it back on there when you want it.

said.extensions-index.f5c19ada.text: Isengezo sakho se-AI asivulwanga kuhlala lokhu. Sivule lapho ufuna ukusisebenzisa khona; siqala sivaliwe njalo nawungena, futhi sivala godu nawuphuma.
said.extensions-index.f5c19ada.from: Your AI extension is not switched on for this sitting. Switch it on where you want to use it; it starts off every time you sign in, and switches off again when you sign out.

said.extensions-index.fc1b6fc7.text: Ipulatifomu le ayinakho ukhiye wokubethelwa osethiweko, ngalokho ithokheni ayikwazi ukugcinwa ngokuvikelekileko. Akukho okugciniweko. Tjela ophethe iseva.
said.extensions-index.fc1b6fc7.from: This deployment has no encryption key set, so a token cannot be stored safely. Nothing was saved. Tell whoever runs the server.

said.extensions-openai.02885124.text: I-OpenAI ilile ikhiye leyo yemodeli le. I-akhawunti ekuyo kungenzeka ayinakho ukufinyelela emodelini ebizwe kuAmasethingi akho.
said.extensions-openai.02885124.from: OpenAI refused that key for this model. The account it belongs to may not have access to the model named in your settings.

said.extensions-openai.047d249a.text: I-OpenAI ilile ikhiye leyo. Kungenzeka irhoxisiwe, namkha ayikaze ibe semthethweni. Qaphela ukuthi isabelo se-ChatGPT Plus asiqukethi ukufinyelela kwe-API: ikhiye ye-API yinto eyehlukileko, eyenziwa ku-platform.openai.com. Akukho okungasilungi epulatifomu futhi akukho okulahlekileko.
said.extensions-openai.047d249a.from: OpenAI refused that key. It may have been revoked, or it may never have been valid. Note that a ChatGPT Plus subscription does not include API access: an API key is a separate thing, created at platform.openai.com. Nothing is wrong with the platform and nothing was lost.

said.extensions-openai.1d2edb4d.text: I-OpenAI ayiphendulanga ngesikhathi. Ifolda enkulu ingathatha imizuzu eminengi; ukulinga godu ngamadokhumende ambalwa kuyasebenza ngokuvamile.
said.extensions-openai.1d2edb4d.from: OpenAI did not answer in time. A large folder can take several minutes; trying again with fewer documents in it usually works.

said.extensions-openai.241eaa9a.text: I-akhawunti leyo ye-OpenAI ayisenayo ikhredithi. Ngokungafani ne-Gemini, i-API ye-OpenAI ayinaleveli yamahhala: ibhadelwa ku-akhawunti ekuyo ikhiye.
said.extensions-openai.241eaa9a.from: That OpenAI account has no credit left. Unlike Gemini, the OpenAI API has no free tier: it is charged against the account the key belongs to.

said.extensions-openai.3d690aea.text: I-OpenAI ibike inkinga eseceleni kwayo ({status}). Kuhle ukulinga godu nje.
said.extensions-openai.3d690aea.from: OpenAI reported a problem on their side ({status}). This is worth simply trying again.

said.extensions-openai.5f8151b1.text: Umkhawulo wesivinini we-OpenAI wekhiye leyo uphelile. Linda kancani bese uyalinga godu.
said.extensions-openai.5f8151b1.from: OpenAI's rate limit for that key has been reached. Wait a little and try again.

said.extensions-openai.60c45cc3.text: I-OpenAI iphendule ngokungabi nalutho. Lokho kuvamise ukutjho ukuthi igama lemodeli alilungi, namkha isicelo salaliwa.
said.extensions-openai.60c45cc3.from: OpenAI answered with nothing. That usually means the model name is wrong, or the request was refused.

said.extensions-openai.d344fc6b.text: Akukho khiye ye-API ye-OpenAI egciniweko yakho. Yengeze kuAmasethingi. Ivela ku-platform.openai.com, futhi ayifani nesabelo se-ChatGPT.
said.extensions-openai.d344fc6b.from: No OpenAI API key is stored for you. Add one in Settings. It comes from platform.openai.com, and is not the same as a ChatGPT subscription.

said.extensions-openai.dacd1031.text: Kusebenzisa ikhiye yakho ye-API ye-OpenAI, eyenziwe ku-platform.openai.com. Hhayi isabelo se-ChatGPT Plus: leso siwumkhiqizo owehlukileko futhi asiqukethi ukufinyelela kwe-API. Ngokungafani ne-Gemini akukho leveli yamahhala, ngalokho ukubizwa kubhadelwa ku-akhawunti ekuyo ikhiye.
said.extensions-openai.dacd1031.from: Uses your own OpenAI API key, created at platform.openai.com. Not a ChatGPT Plus subscription: that is a separate product and does not include API access. Unlike Gemini there is no free tier, so calls are charged to the account the key belongs to.

said.extensions-openai.e6f50a09.text: I-OpenAI ayitholakalanga. Hlola ukuthi umtjhini lo unokuxhumana nge-inthanethi.
said.extensions-openai.e6f50a09.from: OpenAI could not be reached. Check that this machine has a network connection.

said.feedback.145353f6.from: The assessment was a fair test of what was taught.

said.fisa.4ffaa428.text: I-FISA le ayikasayinwa ngumlinganisi. Iphepha elingakalinganiswa ngaphambili alikwazi ukuhlalelwa: yikho ukulinganisa okuyilelo.

said.fisa.620b3718.text: Isivumelwano sokufihla asikasayinwa. Akekho ovunyelwe ukubona namkha ukuhlulela okuqukethwe yi-FISA ngaphambi kokusayina.
said.fisa.620b3718.from: The confidentiality agreement has not been signed yet. Nobody may see or judge the contents of a FISA before signing it.

said.fisa.6d7ad3d8.text: Kuvuliwe. Thikamezela umsethi wephepha nomlinganisi khona manje.

said.fisa.6e61efe5.text: Yilinganise ngaphambili kuqala. Ukuthumela i-QCTO iphepha umlinganisi wakho angakawusayini kuhlanekezele indlela.
said.fisa.6e61efe5.from: Pre-moderate it first. Sending the QCTO a paper your own moderator has not signed off is the wrong way round.

said.fisa.6f4251d6.text: I-FISA esayinwe kuphela edinga inguqulo entsha; le ingatjhugululwa godu.
said.fisa.6f4251d6.from: Only a signed-off FISA needs a new version; this one can still be edited.

said.fisa.8634f8d4.text: Lowo ngumuntu ofanako no-{other}. Ukulinganisa kwangaphambili kunomsebenzi ngoba umuntu wesibili ukubukile.
said.fisa.8634f8d4.from: That is the same person as the {other}. A pre-moderation is worth having because a second person looked at it.

said.fisa.86b96040.text: Inguqulo entsha yedrafti ivuliwe. Idinga umsethi wayo wephepha, umlinganisi nokulinganisa kwayo.
said.fisa.86b96040.from: A new draft version is open. It needs its own examiner, moderator and moderation.

said.fisa.99e0c84b.text: I-FISA isetjhwa ngumphakeli wohlelo lwakhe lwamakghono. Isiqu esipheleleko namkha esingcenye siyahlolwa ngaphandle yiSiqhema sekhwalithi yokuhlola, ngalokho umphakeli akasethi iphepha leso.
said.fisa.99e0c84b.from: A FISA is set by the provider for its own skills programme. A full or part qualification is assessed externally by the Assessment Quality Partner, so the provider does not set that paper.

said.fisa.a82c37e7.text: Kusayinwe njengokufaneleko injongo. Abahlolwako bangahlala iphepha leli manje.

said.fisa.f879ffbf.from: Appointed. They cannot see the paper until the confidentiality agreement is signed.

said.folder-import.1afec190.text: Ifolda le ayinaso isifingqo saso (i-_control/blueprint.json), ngalokho isakhiwo saso kufuze sitholwe emadokhumendeni, futhi leyo yiyo kuphela ingcenye edinga isengezo se-AI. Esakho sivuliwe kodwa asikwazi ukusebenza lapha: {reason} Koke okunye ngokungenisa ifolda kusebenza ngaphandle kwaso.
said.folder-import.1afec190.from: This folder does not include a summary of itself (a _control/blueprint.json), so its structure has to be worked out from the documents, and that is the one part that needs an AI extension. Yours is switched on but cannot run here: {reason} Everything else about importing a folder works without it.

said.folder-import.43cd2360.text: Akukho lutho efolda leyo olutjho isiqu. Bekulindeleke idokhumende yekharikhulamu, idokhumende yesiqu namkha ibanga lokuhlola.
said.folder-import.43cd2360.from: Nothing in that folder describes a qualification. Expected a curriculum document, a qualification document or an assessment specification.

said.folder-import.4ff3755e.text: Ifolda le ibingenayo i-blueprint.json, ngalokho isakhiwo esingezansi sifundwe emadokhumendeni yimodeli. Sihlole ngedokhumende yekharikhulamu ngaphambi kokugcina ngokuphelele: imodeli izakwenza into ebonakala ilungile ngedokhumende engatjho lutho onjalo.
said.folder-import.4ff3755e.from: This folder had no blueprint.json, so the structure below was read from the documents by the model. Check it against the curriculum document before committing: a model will produce something plausible from a document that says nothing of the kind.

said.folder-import.6d63e7d3.text: Ifolda le ayinaso isifingqo saso (i-_control/blueprint.json, elobiwa yisistimu yakho yokuthuthukisa uhlelo), ngalokho isakhiwo saso kufuze sitholwe emadokhumendeni, futhi leyo yiyo kuphela ingcenye edinga isengezo se-AI. Esakho asivuliwe: sebenzisa iswitjhi ye-AI phezulu ekhasini, bese ufunda ifolda godu. Ifolda equkethe isifingqo ingeniswa ngaphandle kwesengezo nakancani.
said.folder-import.6d63e7d3.from: This folder does not include a summary of itself (a _control/blueprint.json, which your programme development system writes), so its structure has to be worked out from the documents, and that is the one part that needs an AI extension. Yours is not switched on: use the AI switch at the top of the page, then read the folder again. A folder that includes a summary imports with no extension at all.

said.invigilation.01f9be44.text: Ngenisa umuntu ohlolwako kuqala. Ukuqinisekisa ikhamera yomuntu ongazange angenisiwe kurekhoda ukuhlola okungakenziwa muntu.
said.invigilation.01f9be44.from: Admit the candidate first. Confirming a camera for somebody who was never admitted records a check nobody made.

said.invigilation.1505c6a0.text: Tjho ukuthi kubayini abaliwe. Isikhalazo sithembele esizathwini, futhi umuntu ohlolwako kufuze atjelwe lokho okwenzekileko.
said.invigilation.1505c6a0.from: Say why they were turned away. An appeal turns on the reason, and the candidate has to be told what happened.

said.invigilation.17e1f6a7.text: Umuntu lowo ohlolwako akekho ekuhlaleni loku.
said.invigilation.17e1f6a7.from: That candidate is not on this sitting.

said.invigilation.35819929.from: That candidate was not admitted, so there is no script of theirs to receive.

said.invigilation.47b2b98a.text: Umuntu lowo akekho eqoqweni leli, ngalokho akakwazi ukungenisiwa ekuhlaleni kwalo.
said.invigilation.47b2b98a.from: That person is not on this cohort, so they cannot be admitted to its sitting.

said.invigilation.50504405.text: Umuntu lowo ohlolwako ubalekile kuhlala loku futhi akakwazi ukungenisiwa godu. Rekhoda lokho okwenzekileko njengesehlakalo kunalokho.
said.invigilation.50504405.from: That candidate dropped out of this sitting and cannot be readmitted. Record what happened as an incident instead.

said.invigilation.639211b5.text: Ukuhlala loku kuphelile, ngalokho akekho ongangenisiwa kukho.
said.invigilation.639211b5.from: This sitting is over, so nobody can be admitted to it.

said.invigilation.7eff3ae0.text: Ngenisa umuntu ohlolwako kuqala. Isitatimende sombani ongazange angenisiwe sirekhoda isivumelwano esingatjhingwanga muntu.
said.invigilation.7eff3ae0.from: Admit the candidate first. A declaration from somebody who was never admitted records an agreement nobody witnessed.

said.invigilation.994f7ce0.text: Ukuhlala loku akunamagama esitatimende, ngalokho akukho lutho lokuthi umuntu ohlolwako alwamukele. Lisethe kuhlala loku kuqala.
said.invigilation.994f7ce0.from: This sitting has no declaration wording, so there is nothing for a candidate to accept. Set it on the sitting first.

said.invigilation.b19d5680.text: Ukungenisa kuvalwe ngo-{localClose} {closedAt}, kwadlula imizuzu engu-{lateBySeconds}. Rekhoda babe balaliwe ngesizathu kunalokho: umuntu ongenisiwe kade unesikhathi eside nephepha kunabo boke.
said.invigilation.b19d5680.from: Admission closed at {localClose} {closedAt}, {lateBySeconds} minutes ago. Record them as refused with the reason instead: somebody admitted late has had longer with the paper than everybody else.

said.invigilation.d1a64ee9.text: Ukuhlala kungabanjwa kuphela eseshinini ye-EISA yokuhlola okuqedako namkha ekulingisweni. Tjhugulula uhlobo lweseshini kuqala, ngalokho ithebula litjho lokho okwenzekako.
said.invigilation.d1a64ee9.from: A sitting can only be run at a summative or mock EISA session. Change the session's kind first, so the schedule says what is happening.

said.invigilation.df78a6b5.text: Chaza lokho okwenzekileko. Umbiko wesehlakalo otjho lutho mubi kunokungabi nawo, ngoba irekhodi litjengisa ukuthi owodwa wenziwe.
said.invigilation.df78a6b5.from: Describe what happened. An incident report that says nothing is worse than none, because the record shows one was made.

It reads as an alignment document, so either the modules it names are not in the curriculum under those codes, or the study units are already there. The detail is in the document library entry.

said.reassessment.051a9a39.text: Bhala phansi lokho okubuziwe nokuphendulwe ngaphambi kokurekhoda umphumela. Ukuphasa ngomlomo ngaphandle kwerekhodi yengxoxo akusibo bufakazi.
