said.recognition.056d89d8.text: Ukukhulula u-{title} kungasusa umfundi lo kuphesenti elingu-{wouldBePercent} lesiqu elibonwe ngaphandle kokufundiswa, futhi umkhawulo walesi siqu ngu-{maxPercent}. Okusele kufuze kwenziwe njengokufunda okujayelekileko, namkha umkhawulo utjhugululwe esiqwini ngesizathu.
said.recognition.056d89d8.from: Exempting {title} would take this learner to {wouldBePercent} per cent of the qualification recognised without being taught, and the limit on this qualification is {maxPercent}. The rest has to be done as ordinary learning, or the limit changed on the qualification with a reason for it.

said.recognition.165f2f8f.text: Umuntu lo ohlolwako akakaneseshini yeeseluleko. Ukuhlulela ukufunda kwangaphambili ngokumelene neemfuneko okungachazwanga muntu yikho okwenza ukuthi umuntu ohlolwako ehlulwe ngokuqoqa ubufakazi obungalungiko. Rekhoda iseluleko kuqala.
said.recognition.165f2f8f.from: This candidate has not had an advisory session. Judging prior learning against requirements nobody explained is how a candidate is failed for assembling the wrong evidence. Record the advice first.

said.recognition.2f3e0747.text: Ukuhlulela kurekhodiwe. Akunikeli lutho aze kulinganiswe.
said.recognition.2f3e0747.from: Judgement recorded. It grants nothing until it is moderated.

said.recognition.3d78b1cc.text: Tjho lokho obukubukile nokuthi uyavuma namkha awuvumi. Ukulinganisa okungenakuphawula kusayinwe kuphela.
said.recognition.3d78b1cc.from: Say what you looked at and whether you agree. A moderation with no comment is a signature.

said.recognition.4cf70aee.text: Tjho ukuthi iimiphumela zalokho abakuphethe zihlanganisa njani leyo yemojula le. Isigaba leso yiso sonke isiqunto, futhi ukudluliselwa ngaphandle kwaso kuyibango okungekho ongalihlola.
said.recognition.4cf70aee.from: Say how the outcomes of what they hold cover this module's. That paragraph is the whole of the decision, and a transfer without it is a claim nobody can check.

said.recognition.61201ac5.text: Tjho ukuthi ubufakazi bebuyini nokuthi kubayini bwanelisa imojula. Isigaba leso yiso sonke ukuhlulela, futhi kuyilokho okufundwa kuqala ngumqinisekisi wangaphandle.
said.recognition.61201ac5.from: Say what the evidence was and why it satisfies the module. This paragraph is the whole of the judgement, and the first thing an external verifier reads.

said.recognition.86f838fe.text: Lokho kunikelwe ngomhlaka {awardedOn}, okudlula iminyaka engu-{CAT_YEARS} ngaphambi kwemvume le. UkuHlanganisa nokuDlulisela Ikhredithi kuhlanganisa ukuqedwa ngaphakathi kweminyaka engu-{CAT_YEARS2}; ngale kwalokho indlela yiKubonwa kokuFunda kwangaPhambili, okuhlola lokho umfundi asakghona ukukwenza hhayi lokho abekade adlule kukho. Vula isicelo se-RPL kunalokho.
said.recognition.86f838fe.from: That was awarded on {awardedOn}, more than {CAT_YEARS} years before this approval. Credit Accumulation and Transfer covers completions within {CAT_YEARS2} years; beyond that the route is Recognition of Prior Learning, which assesses what the learner can still do rather than what they once passed. Open an RPL application instead.

said.recognition.d4a3fd91.text: Rekhoda lokho umuntu ohlolwako atjelwe ukuthi akuqoqe. Umuntu ohlolwako ovinjelweko uphikisa isigaba leso, futhi 'ululeke ngeemfuneko' asiso.
said.recognition.d4a3fd91.from: Record what the candidate was told to gather. A refused candidate disputes this paragraph, and 'advised on requirements' is not one.

said.recognition.e21aaea2.from: You cannot moderate your own judgement.

said.recognition.e7122f98.text: Indima yakho ayifaki lokhu. Ukubonwa kubanjwe basebenzi bomphakeli ngokwabo, futhi ukuhlulela kulinganiswa ngomunye umuntu ongasosenze.
said.recognition.e7122f98.from: Your role does not include this. Recognition is held by the provider's own staff, and a judgement is moderated by somebody other than whoever made it.

term.workplaceRecord.one.text: Go tumelelwa ga maitemogelo a mošomo

login.intro.text: Tsena gore o tšwele pele ka go ithuta ga gago.
login.intro.from: Sign in to continue your learning.

login.trouble.text: Ga o kgone go tsena? Bolela le mohlahli wa gago: o ka go beela phasewete e mpsha.
login.trouble.from: Trouble signing in? Speak to your facilitator: they can reset a password for you.

login.wrong.text: Dintlha tšeo ga se tša nepagala.

login.locked.text: Maiteko a mantši kudu. Emela metsotso e lesomehlano gomme o leke gape.
login.locked.from: Too many attempts. Wait fifteen minutes and try again.

login.missing.text: Tsenya aterese ya gago ya emeile le phasewete.
login.missing.from: Enter your email address and password.

login.sso.refused.text: Akhaonto yeo e ka se tsene mo. E swanetše go diriša aterese ya emeile e swanago le ya akhaonto ya gago mo sethaleng se. Tsena ka phasewete ya gago, goba botšiša molaodi wa gago.
login.sso.refused.from: That account cannot sign in here. It has to use the same email address as your account on this platform. Sign in with your password, or ask your administrator.

login.sso.expired.text: Go tsena moo go tšere nako e telele kudu, goba go thomilwe lefelong le lengwe. Leka gape.
login.sso.expired.from: That sign-in took too long, or was started somewhere else. Try again.

login.sso.off.text: Mokgwa woo wa go tsena ga o a bulwa mo.
login.sso.off.from: That way of signing in is not switched on here.

account.forcedIntro.text: Motho yo mongwe o beile phasewete yeo o tsenego ka yona. E fetole pele o tšwela pele.
account.forcedIntro.from: Somebody else set the password you signed in with. Replace it before carrying on.

account.newHint.text: Bonyane ditlhaka tše 12. Polelwana ya mantšu a mmalwa a sa amanego e matla kudu gape e bonolo go e gopola go feta e khutšwane e nago le disimbolo.
account.newHint.from: At least 12 characters. A phrase of a few unrelated words is both stronger and easier to remember than something short with symbols in it.

account.mismatch.text: Diphasewete tše pedi tše mpsha ga di swane.
account.mismatch.from: The two new passwords do not match.

account.forcedNote.text: Go e fetola go ntšha mang le mang yo a šomišago phasewete ya kgale, gaešita le yo a go filego yona.
account.forcedNote.from: Changing it signs out anyone else using the old password, including whoever passed it to you.

account.languageIntro.text: Polelo yeo sethaleng se se bolelago le wena ka yona. Dikirini tšeo di sa fetolelwago di dula ka Seisemane, gomme maina a moabi wa gago a dilo a bolokwa ka fao a a ngwadilego.
account.languageIntro.from: The language this platform speaks to you in. Screens not yet translated stay in English, and your provider's own names for things are kept as they wrote them.

learn.notYours.text: O lebeletše go ngwadišwa ga motho yo mongwe. O ka bona tšwelopele ya gagwe eupša o ka se e rekhode legatong la gagwe.
learn.notYours.from: You are viewing someone else's enrolment. You can see their progress but cannot record it for them.

learn.counts.text: E bala go kwalifikeišene ya gago

learn.noLessons.text: Khoso ye ga e na dithuto le gatee.

learn.openMaterial.from: Open the material for this lesson

learn.noContent.text: Ga go na diteng tše di ngwadilwego tša thuto ye.
learn.noContent.from: No written content for this lesson.

learn.scormNote.text: Thuto ye e fela ge o e fetša ka phukeišeng ya ka godimo. Lefelo la gago le a bolokwa ge o ka emiša o sa fetša.
learn.scormNote.from: This lesson completes when you finish it in the package above. Your place is kept if you stop part of the way through.

learn.openedByFacilitator.text: E butšwe go wena ke mohlahli wa gago: {reason}
learn.openedByFacilitator.from: Opened for you by your facilitator: {reason}

home.overdueOne.text: E fetile nako ka letšatši le 1

home.overdueMany.text: E fetile nako ka matšatši a {days}

home.assessOne.text: Tlhagišo e tee ya go hlahlobja

home.moderateOne.text: Phetho e tee ya go modereitwa

home.feedbackOne.text: Selo se tee seo re nyakago o se re botša

home.feedbackMany.text: Dilo tše mmalwa tšeo re nyakago o di re botša
home.feedbackMany.from: A few things to tell us

home.feedbackIntro.text: Dikarabo di begwa mmogo le tša ba bangwe bohle, e sego ka o tee ka o tee. Metsotso e mebedi ka o tee, gomme ke selo se tee seo se fetolago ka fao sehlopha se se latelago se tsamaišwago ka gona.
home.feedbackIntro.from: Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. Two minutes each, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

home.earnedIntro.text: E rekhotilwe ka letšatši leo o fedišitšego ka lona, e sego ge setifikeiti se fihla mafelelong. Se sengwe le se sengwe se na le tshupetšo yeo mang le mang a ka e netefatšago.
home.earnedIntro.from: Recorded on the day you finished, rather than when the certificate eventually arrives. Each carries a reference anybody can check.

home.step.afterPrevious.text: E bulega ge o fetša mogato wa pele
home.step.afterPrevious.from: Opens when you finish the step before

home.nothingOutside.text: Ga go selo ka ntle ga mananeo a gago.

home.nothingYet.text: Ga se wa abelwa selo le ga bjale.
home.nothingYet.from: You have not been assigned anything yet.

home.statementsIntro.text: Tšea se o ye tlhahlobong ya ka ntle le tokomane ya gago ya boitsebišo. Setsha se a se lekola pele o ka dula tlhahlobong.
home.statementsIntro.from: Take this to the external assessment with your identity document. The centre checks it before you may sit.

assess.counts.text: e bala go kwalifikeišene ya gago

assess.waiting.text: E emetše go lekolwa ke mohlahlobi.
assess.waiting.from: Waiting for an assessor to review it.

assess.developmental.text: Se ke sa tlhabollo. Ga go selo mo se go kgahlanong le wena.
assess.developmental.from: This is developmental. Nothing here counts against you.

assess.competent.text: O hweditšwe o kgonne tlhahlobong ye, ka gona ga go na seo o swanetšego go se dira gape.
assess.competent.from: You have been found competent on this assessment, so there is nothing to sit again.

assess.noAttempts.text: O šomišitše maiteko a gago ka moka a tlhahlobo ye.
assess.noAttempts.from: You have used all your attempts at this assessment.

assess.notPassed.text: O ile wa se fete lekgetlong le

assess.awaitingAssessor.text: Tlhahlobo ye e bala go kwalifikeišene ya gago, ka gona mohlahlobi o tla e lekola gomme a rekhode phetho ya bokgoni. O tla bona sephetho ge seo se fedile.
assess.awaitingAssessor.from: This assessment counts towards your qualification, so an assessor will review it and record the competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

assess.practicePassed.text: Se e be e le boikwetlišo, ka gona sephetho se rekhotilwe kgahlanong le go ithuta ga gago eupša ga se laole kwalifikeišene.
assess.practicePassed.from: This was practice, so the result is recorded against your learning but does not decide a qualification.

assess.practiceFailed.text: Se e be e le boikwetlišo. Boeleletša thepa gomme o leke gape.
assess.practiceFailed.from: This was practice. Review the material and try again.

assess.selectEvery.text: Kgetha dikarabo ka moka tšeo di swanetšego.

assess.pair.text: Kopanya selo se sengwe le se sengwe sa ka lehlakoreng la nngele le se tee sa ka lehlakoreng la go ja.
assess.pair.from: Pair each item on the left with one on the right.

assess.whyMarked.text: Lebaka ke seo se swailwego mo, e sego lepokisi la ka godimo.
assess.whyMarked.from: The reason is what is marked here, not the box above.

assess.keptAt.from: Your answers were kept at {time}. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

assess.kept.text: Dikarabo tša gago di a bolokwa ge o šoma. Go romela ke go di romela gore di swailwe.
assess.kept.from: Your answers are kept as you work. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

evidence.failed.text: Seo se ile sa palelwa ke go romelwa.

evidence.uploadFailed.text: Go laetša go paletšwe. Lekola kgokagano ya gago gomme o leke gape.
evidence.uploadFailed.from: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.

evidence.doneIntro.text: Mohlahlobi o tla bo lekola gomme a rekhode phetho ya bokgoni. O tla bona sephetho ge seo se fedile.
evidence.doneIntro.from: An assessor will review it and record a competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

evidence.fingerprinted.text: Faele ye nngwe le ye nngwe e na le monwana wa dijithale:

evidence.fingerprintNote.text: Ge e ba faele efe goba efe yeo e bolokilwego e ka fetolwa, monwana wa yona wa dijithale o ka se sa swana. Seo se šireletša mošomo wa gago go swana le tlhahlobo.
evidence.fingerprintNote.from: If any stored file were ever altered, its fingerprint would stop matching. That protects your work as much as it protects the assessment.

evidence.kinds.text: Diswantšho, rekhoto ya mošomo, puku ya direkhoto yeo e skenilwego, goba tokomane. O ka tlema tše dintši ka nako e tee.
evidence.kinds.from: Photographs, a recording of the task, a scanned logbook, or a document. You can attach several at once.

evidence.note.text: Selo se sengwe le se sengwe seo mohlahlobi a swanetšego go se tseba

paper.summative.from: This is assessed and counts towards your qualification.

paper.formative.text: Se ke tokišetšo. Se a swaiwa gomme se bušwa go wena, gomme ga se laole selo.
paper.formative.from: This is preparation. It is marked and returned to you, and it does not decide anything.

paper.goBack.from: Go back to the course to see what is still outstanding.

paper.connection.from: That answer did not save. Your connection may have dropped; it will be tried again when you next change something.

paper.detail.text: Araba ka botlalo, o bolela ka melawana yeo o e ithutilego.
paper.detail.from: Answer in detail, referring to the principles you have studied.

paper.handedIn.text: O gafile se. Ga se sa hlwa se ka fetolwa.
paper.handedIn.from: You handed this in. It cannot be changed.

paper.final.text: Ge se se gafilwe, ga se sa hlwa se ka fetolwa.
paper.final.from: Once handed in, this cannot be changed.

paper.confirm.from: Confirm the declaration to hand in.

paper.savedAsYouGo.text: mošomo wa gago o a bolokwa ge o tšwela pele
paper.savedAsYouGo.from: your work is saved as you go

notify.nothingYet.from: Nothing yet. You will be told here when training is assigned or due, when work is waiting for you, and when an assessment result or certificate arrives.

notify.markAll.text: Swaya tšohle e le tše di badilwego

cert.attesting.text: o bontšha bokgoni bjo bo latelago

cert.notNational.text: Ke setifikeiti sa {provider} ka noši sa khoso yeo e e neilego. Ga se kwalifikeišene ya bosetšhaba gomme ga se na krediti ya SAQA goba lenaneo la boitsebišo. Moo moithuti a šomelago kwalifikeišene ya mošomo, setifikeiti sa yona se filwe ke QCTO.
cert.notNational.from: This is {provider}'s own certificate for a course it delivered. It is not a national qualification and does not carry a SAQA credit or identifier. Where a learner is working towards an occupational qualification, the certificate for it is issued by the QCTO.

cert.anyone.text: Mang le mang a ka netefatša setifikeiti se ka tshupetšo ya ka godimo, a se na akhaonto.
cert.anyone.from: Anyone can confirm this certificate with the reference above, without needing an account.

work.introCoach.text: Baithuti bao o ba okametšego. O netefatša seo ba se dirilego mošomong; ga go selo seo se fihlelago mohlahlobi ntle le mosaeno wa gago.
work.introCoach.from: The learners you supervise. You confirm what they did in the workplace; nothing reaches an assessor without your signature.

work.introLearner.text: Maitemogelo a mošomo a dirwa go mothwadi gomme a saenwa ke mokoutši wa mošomong moo. Tatelano e a tiiša: o a rekhoda, mokoutši wa gago o a a netefatša, gona a ya go mohlahlobi.
work.introLearner.from: Work experience is done at an employer and signed off by the workplace coach there. The order is fixed: you record it, your coach confirms it, then it goes to an assessor.

work.waitingOne.text: Go na le 1 {record} yeo e emetšego mosaeno wa gago.

work.waitingMany.text: Go na le {count} {records} tšeo di emetšego mosaeno wa gago.

work.noneManage.text: Ga go na {records} le ga bjale. Beakanya e tee ka godimo: kwano yeo e umago moithuti, mothwadi le mokoutši, gomme ka morago e tee ya modula o mongwe le o mongwe wa maitemogelo a mošomo.
work.noneManage.from: No {records} yet. Set one up above: an agreement naming the learner, the employer and the coach, then one for each work experience module.

work.none.text: Ga go na {records} le ga bjale. Molaodi o bula e tee ge kwano ya mošomong e šetše e le gona e umago moithuti, mothwadi le mokoutši.
work.none.from: No {records} yet. An administrator opens one once a workplace agreement is in place naming the learner, the employer and the coach.

work.kind.work_activity.text: Mešomo ya mošomong: seo o se dirago

work.kind.contextual_knowledge.text: Tsebo ya mošomong: seo o swanetšego go kgona go bolela ka sona
work.kind.contextual_knowledge.from: Workplace knowledge: what you must be able to speak to

work.kind.supporting_evidence.text: Bohlatse bja thekgo: seo mošomo o swanetšego go se tšweletša
work.kind.supporting_evidence.from: Supporting evidence: what the workplace must produce

work.outstanding.text: E sa šetše: {items}. Mokoutši wa gago a ka se saene go fihlela mothalo o mongwe le o mongwe o dirilwe gomme karolo ye nngwe le ye nngwe ya bohlatse bja thekgo e na le faele yeo e tlemilwego.
work.outstanding.from: Still outstanding: {items}. Your coach cannot sign until every line is done and every piece of supporting evidence has a file attached.

work.allRecorded.text: Tšohle di rekhotilwe. Romela go mokoutši wa gago ge o loketše.
work.allRecorded.from: Everything is recorded. Send it to your coach when you are ready.

work.signingMeans.text: Go saena go rekhoda gore o lekotše bohlatse bjo gomme o tla bo hlatsela ge mohlahlobi a ka ikgokaganya le wena. Ga bo sa hlwa bo ka fetolwa ka morago.
work.signingMeans.from: Signing records that you checked this evidence and will attest to it if the assessor contacts you. It cannot be changed afterwards.

work.forAssessor.text: Selo se sengwe le se sengwe seo mohlahlobi a swanetšego go se tseba

work.readyForPoe.text: E saenwe ke mokoutši wa mošomong gomme e loketše go tsenywa ka Faeleng ya Bohlatse.
work.readyForPoe.from: Signed by the workplace coach and ready to be taken into the Portfolio of Evidence.

scorm.failed.text: Phukeiši e paletšwe ke go bulwa. Lekola kgokagano ya gago gomme o leke gape.
scorm.failed.from: The package could not be opened. Check your connection and try again.

scorm.preview.text: Pontšo ya pele: seo phukeiši e se begago ga se bolokwe, ka gobane ga se go ngwadišwa ga gago.
scorm.preview.from: A preview: what the package reports is not kept, because this is not your own enrolment.

certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.text: Moithuti a ka ba a file mothwadi tshupetšo. E dula e šoma gomme e tla bolela gore e gogilwe.
certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.from: The learner may have given the reference to an employer. It keeps resolving and will say it was withdrawn.

assessing.intro.text: Ditlhagišo tšeo di lokilego go dirwa kahlolo ya bokgoni. O ka se hlahlobe mošomo wa gago, gomme karolo ya diphetho tša gago e tla lekolwa ka thoko ke modereitara.
assessing.intro.from: Submissions ready for a competency judgement. You cannot assess your own work, and a proportion of your decisions will be reviewed independently by a moderator.

assessing.empty.text: Ga go selo seo se emetšego. Ditlhagišo di tšwelela mo ge baithuti ba di romela.
assessing.empty.from: Nothing is waiting. Submissions appear here as learners send them in.

assessing.onScreen.text: Se arabilwe sekirining. {link}: dikarabo, tlhahlo ya go swaya le matrikse di mo gotee, gomme dikriteria di a šetšwa ge se šetše se swailwe.
assessing.onScreen.from: This was answered on screen. {link}: the answers, the marking guidance and the matrix are together there, and the criteria are worked out for you once it is marked.

assessing.ownWork.text: Ye ke tlhagišo ya gago. O ka se e hlahlobe; motho yo mongwe o swanetše go e hlahloba.
assessing.ownWork.from: This is your own submission. You cannot assess it; someone else must.

assessing.hash.text: Monwana wa dijithale o rekhotwa ge go laetšwa. Ge faele ye e bolokilwego e ka fetolwa, ga e sa swane gomme rekhoto e a swayiwa.
assessing.hash.from: The hash is recorded at upload. If a stored file is ever altered, it no longer matches and the record is flagged.

assessing.decisions.text: Diphetho tšeo di šetšego di rekhotilwe

assessing.perCriterion.text: Kgahlanong le kriteria ye nngwe le ye nngwe

assessing.whyDiffers.text: Lebaka, ka gobane e fapana le seo maraka a se šišinyago
assessing.whyDiffers.from: Why, since it differs from what the marks propose

assessing.whyDiffersLabel.text: Lebaka la gore {code} e fapane le tšhišinyo

assessing.permanent.text: Leina la gago, letšatši le ditshwayotshwayo tše di bolokwa ka mo go sa felego gomme ga di sa hlwa di ka fetolwa. Phošollo e rekhotwa e le phetho e mpsha.
assessing.permanent.from: Your name, the date and this comment are stored permanently and cannot be edited afterwards. A correction is recorded as a new decision.

marking.impliesIntro.text: Palo, e sego kahlolo. Maraka a fihlelela palogare ye; tiragatšo ya tirišo le bohlatse bja mošomong ga di fihle sethaleng, gomme o di lekanya pele o phetha. Fetola efe goba efe ya tše sekirining sa phetho gomme o bolele lebaka: lebaka le bolokwa kgauswi le tšhišinyo gore modereitara a bone moo tše pedi di ilego tša aroganela.
marking.impliesIntro.from: Arithmetic, not a judgement. The marks average out at this; practical performance and workplace evidence do not reach the platform, and you weigh those before deciding. Change any of these on the decision screen and say why: the reason is stored beside the proposal so a moderator can see where the two parted.

marking.markAllFirst.text: Potšišo ye nngwe le ye nngwe e swanetše go swaiwa pele dikriteria di ka šetšwa.
marking.markAllFirst.from: Every question has to be marked before the criteria can be worked out.

marking.summative.text: Se a hlahlobja. Ge potšišo ye nngwe le ye nngwe e šetše e swailwe, rekhoda phetho: dikriteria tšeo se di netefatšago di a šišinywa gore o di tiišetše.
marking.summative.from: This is assessed. Once every question is marked, record a decision: the criteria it evidences are proposed for you to confirm.

marking.formative.text: Ye ke puku ya mošomo. Ke ya tlhabollo: e swaye, ka morago o bušetše maikutlo. Ga go selo mo se rekhodago bokgoni goba se sepetšago moithuti go lebana le go loketšwa.
marking.formative.from: This is a workbook. It is developmental: mark it, then return feedback. Nothing here records competence or moves the learner towards eligibility.

marking.toMarkOne.text: Potšišo e 1 e sa šetše go swayiwa.

marking.toMarkMany.text: Dipotšišo tše {count} di sa šetše go swayiwa.

marking.notMarked.text: Maraka a {points} · ga se a swaiwa

marking.blank.text: E tlogetšwe e se na selo.

marking.matrix.text: Matrikse a go swaya: go kgetha legato la o mongwe le o mongwe go fa maraka
marking.matrix.from: Marking matrix: choosing a level for each gives the mark

marking.toldHint.text: Moo e bego e tiile, le seo se hlokegilego.
marking.toldHint.from: Where it was strong, and what was missing.

marking.returnIntro.text: Maikutlo, e sego phetho. A botša moithuti seo a swanetšego go boela go sona pele ga tlhahlobo ya go phetha, gomme ga a rekhode bokgoni kgahlanong le kriteria ye nngwe.
marking.returnIntro.from: Feedback, not a decision. It tells the learner what to go back to before the summative, and it records no competence against any criterion.

marking.returnHint.text: Seo se bego se tiile, le seo se swanetšego go balwa gape pele ga tlhahlobo ya go phetha.
marking.returnHint.from: What was solid, and what to re-read before the summative.

marking.concern.text: Dikriteria tšeo dikarabo tše di fokolago di di dikologilego
marking.concern.from: Criteria the weak answers cluster around

marking.sectionHint.text: Seo se šomilego gabotse mo, le seo se swanetšego go dirwa ka mokgwa o mongwe la go latela.
marking.sectionHint.from: What went well here, and what to do differently next time.

marking.learnerSees.text: Moithuti o bona se le maikutlo a gagwe.
marking.learnerSees.from: The learner sees this with their feedback.

moderating.intro.text: Tekolo ya ka thoko ya diphetho tša bahlahlobi. Diphetho tšeo di fihlelago lelokelelo le di kgethwa ke sistimi, e sego ke motho. O ka se modereite phetho yeo o e dirilego.
moderating.intro.from: Independent review of assessors' decisions. Which decisions reach this list is decided by the system, not chosen by anyone. You cannot moderate a decision you made yourself.

moderating.empty.text: Ga go selo seo se emetšego go modereitwa.

moderating.reason.full_moderation.text: Ya go phetha: phetho ye nngwe le ye nngwe e a modereitwa

moderating.reason.new_assessor.text: Mohlahlobi yo mofsa yo a ngwadišitšwego: o modereitwa ka botlalo
moderating.reason.new_assessor.from: Newly registered assessor: moderated in full

moderating.reason.random_sample.text: E kgethilwe ka sampole ya sebakwa

moderating.referBack.text: Busetša morago: mohlahlobi a ke a lebelele gape
moderating.referBack.from: Refer back: the assessor should look again

moderating.ownDecision.text: O dirile phetho ye e le mohlahlobi, ka gona o ka se e modereite. Modereitara yo mongwe o swanetše go e modereita.
moderating.ownDecision.from: You made this decision as the assessor, so you cannot moderate it. Another moderator must.

pack.print.text: Gatiša letlakala le gore o le boloke e le PDF.
pack.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF.

pack.settings.text: {provider} · {accreditation} · maraka a go feta {pass}% · sekgahla sa modereišene {rate}%

pack.counts.text: Ditlhagišo tše {submissions} · {decided} di ahlotšwe · {moderated} di modereitwe · {sampled} di kgethilwe mo ka sampole

pack.instrumentIntro.text: Pampiri ka fao e beilwego gona, le tlhahlo yeo e swailwego ka yona.
pack.instrumentIntro.from: The paper as it was set, and the guidance it was marked against.

pack.scripts.text: Dipampiri tša dikarabo tše di kgethilwego ({count})

pack.scriptsIntro.text: Di tšerwe go ralala mabaka a maraka (godimo, tlase le magareng) gore go swaya go bonwe ka mo go lokilego kudu le mo go sa lokago kudu, e sego magareng feela.
pack.scriptsIntro.from: Taken across the mark range (top, bottom and spread between) so the marking is seen at its best and its worst rather than in the middle.

pack.departuresIntro.text: Moo mohlahlobi a fapanego le seo maraka a se šišintšego, goba modereitara a fapanego le mohlahlobi. Sephuthelo seo se tlogelago tše ga se kaone go feta ge se se gona.
pack.departuresIntro.from: Where an assessor differed from what the marks proposed, or a moderator differed from the assessor. A pack that leaves these out is worse than no pack.

pack.noReason.text: ga go lebaka le le rekhotilwego

pack.exceptionsIntro.text: Baithuti bao ba ilego ba tlogelwa go feta mojako ke motho yo a rego ke yo, le lebaka leo a le file.
pack.exceptionsIntro.from: Learners let past a gate by a named person, with the reason they gave.

pack.assembled.text: E kopantšwe {date} go tšwa go rekhoto.

held.intro.text: Moithuti yo a hweditšwego a sa kgone ga bobedi ga a paletšwe. Tlhahlobo e a swarwa, gomme tekolo ya lenaneo e biletšwa le mothwadi wa gagwe, ka gobane ka nako ye potšišo e ka se sa hlwa e le ya gore na o a e tseba, gomme gantši ke gore go direga eng go mo dikologa.
held.intro.from: A learner found not yet competent twice is not failed. The assessment is held, and a programme review is convened with their employer, because by this point the question is rarely whether they know it, and usually what has been going on around them.

held.empty.text: Se a tlala ge moithuti a hwetšwa a sa kgone la bobedi tlhahlobong ya go phetha. Go fihla ka nako yeo ga go selo sa go lekola.
held.empty.from: This fills when a learner is found not yet competent for a second time on a summative assessment. Until then there is nothing to review.

held.forReview.text: Tše di emetšego tekolo ya lenaneo ({count})

held.results.text: {assessment} · diphetho tše {count} tša go se kgone

held.whoConvenes.text: Mohlahli goba molaodi o bitša tekolo.
held.whoConvenes.from: A facilitator or administrator convenes the review.

held.oralAuthorised.text: {assessment} · tekolo e dumeletše boiteko bja boraro, bo dirwago ka molomo
held.oralAuthorised.from: {assessment} · the review authorised a third attempt, conducted orally

held.whoConducts.text: Mohlahlobi o dira boiteko bja molomo, e sego motho yo a bo dumeletšego.
held.whoConducts.from: An assessor conducts the oral attempt, and not the person who authorised it.

held.oral.text: Boiteko bja boraro, bo dirwago ka molomo

held.furtherLearning.text: Go ithuta go oketšegilego pele ga boiteko bjo bongwe
held.furtherLearning.from: Further learning before any further attempt

held.whyHint.text: Seo tekolo e se hweditšego, le seo se ipeilego godimo ga sona.
held.whyHint.from: What the review found, and what it turns on.

oral.reviewDecidedIntro.text: Mabaka ao boiteko bja boraro bjo bo dumeletšwego ka ona.
oral.reviewDecidedIntro.from: The grounds on which this third attempt was authorised.

oral.recordIntro.text: Boiteko bja molomo ga bo tlogele bohlatse bja bjona. Se ke bohlatse bjoo, gomme sephetho ga se kgone go rekhotwa ntle le bjona.
oral.recordIntro.from: An oral attempt leaves no evidence of its own. This is that evidence, and the outcome cannot be recorded without it.

oral.nothingYet.text: Ga go selo seo se rekhotilwego le ga bjale.

oral.outcomeIntro.text: Se ahlolwa ka mokgwa o swanago le boiteko bjo bo ngwadilwego, kgahlanong le dikriteria tše di swanago, gomme se modereitwa ka mokgwa o swanago ka morago.
oral.outcomeIntro.from: Judged the same way as a written attempt, against the same criteria, and moderated the same way afterwards.

oral.how.text: Ka fao go dirilwego ka gona

oral.howHint.text: Ka botšona, goba pitšo ya vidio yeo e swerwego ka yona
oral.howHint.from: In person, or the video call it was held on

oral.present.text: Ke mang yo mongwe yo a bego a le gona

oral.presentNote.text: Ga go hlokege. Tlhahlobo ya molomo yeo go se nago motho yo mongwe ka phapošing e thata go e šireletša modereišeneng, gomme rekhoto e swanetše go bolela gore e be e le ya mohuta ofe.
oral.presentNote.from: Not required. An oral assessment with nobody else in the room is harder to defend at moderation, and the record should say which kind this was.

oral.noCriterion.text: Ga e tlemege le e tee

oral.savedNext.text: Sephetho se rekhotwa sekirining sa go swaya, go swana le boiteko bjo bongwe le bjo bongwe.
oral.savedNext.from: The outcome is recorded on the marking screen, the same as any other attempt.

appeals.intro.text: Moithuti a ka ipiletša kgahlanong le sephetho goba boitshwaro bja mohlahlobi. Go amogelwa go dumelelwa ka gare ga diiri tše {hours}, e lego nako yeo gantši e fetilwego, ka gobane e a sepela ge motho a ruta.
appeals.intro.from: A learner may appeal against a result or against an assessor's conduct. Receipt is acknowledged within {hours} hours, which is the deadline that gets missed, because it runs while somebody is teaching.

appeals.late.text: {count} ga se ya amogelwa ka nako

appeals.lateIntro.text: Go fetile diiri tše {hours} gomme ga se ya amogelwa. Go amogela morago ga nako go kaone go feta go se amogele gohlegohle, gomme rekhoto e tla bontšha tše pedi.
appeals.lateIntro.from: Past the {hours} hours and still not acknowledged. Acknowledging late is better than not at all, and the record will show both.

appeals.openIntro.text: Tšohle tše di ngwadilwego gomme di sa tswalwa, tše mpsha di thoma.
appeals.openIntro.from: Everything lodged and not yet closed, newest first.

appeals.none.text: Ga go selo seo se bulegilego. Boipiletšo bo ngwadwa go tšwa letlakaleng la moithuti ka noši.
appeals.none.from: Nothing open. An appeal is lodged from a learner's own page.

appeals.outOfTime.text: e amogetšwe ka ntle ga nako

appeals.acceptedLate.text: E amogetšwe ka ntle ga nako

appeals.procedureIntro.text: Amogela, kopana le moithuti, boledišana le modereitara ge lebaka e le sephetho, ka morago rarolla gomme o ba botše.
appeals.procedureIntro.from: Acknowledge, meet the learner, consult the moderator where the ground is a result, then resolve and tell them.

appeals.closedUnacknowledged.text: E tswaletšwe ntle le gore go rekhotwe go amogelwa.
appeals.closedUnacknowledged.from: Closed without an acknowledgement being recorded.

appeals.firstCounts.text: Go amogelwa ga mathomo ke ga ka moragorago rekhoto e go bolokago. Ga go kgone go bewa nako gape ka morago, ka gobane nako yeo e ka fetolwago ga se bohlatse bja selo.
appeals.firstCounts.from: The first acknowledgement is the one the record keeps. It cannot be re-stamped later, because a time that can be changed is not evidence of anything.

appeals.resultNeedsModerator.text: Boipiletšo bja sephetho bo ya go modereitara wa ka gare pele bo ka rarollwa. Ke mogato woo monetefatši wa ka ntle a o botšišago.
appeals.resultNeedsModerator.from: A result appeal goes to the internal moderator before it can be resolved. That is the step an external verifier asks about.

appeals.conductNoModerator.text: Boipiletšo bja boitshwaro ga bo rarollwe ke go swaya gape, ka gona ga go hlokege modereitara.
appeals.conductNoModerator.from: A conduct appeal is not something re-marking settles, so no moderator is required.

appeals.notConsulted.text: Ga se a boledišwa le ga bjale

appeals.notFeedback.text: Phetho yeo moithuti a sa e filwego ga se maikutlo.
appeals.notFeedback.from: A decision the learner has not been given is not feedback.

appeals.whyHint.text: Ka lebaka la eng. Ye ke karolo yeo moithuti a swanetšego go e hwetša.
appeals.whyHint.from: Why. This is the part the learner is entitled to.

appeals.notesIntro.text: Poledišano magareng ga mokgoordinetara, mohlahlobi le modereitara. Ga e bontšhwe moithuti ntle le ge o rialo; seo a swanetšego go se hwetša ke sephetho le mabaka a ka godimo.
appeals.notesIntro.from: The discussion between coordinator, assessor and moderator. Not shown to the learner unless you say so; what they are entitled to is the outcome and the reasoning above.

appeals.noteHint.from: What was discussed, and with whom

appeals.withdrawWhy.text: Ka lebaka la eng e gogwa

appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.text: Go gogwa go nyaka lebaka. E se nago le lona e swana le kgatelelo, gomme ke seo boipiletšo bja boitshwaro bo tla bago bo lebane le sona.
appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.from: A withdrawal needs a reason. One with none looks like pressure, and that is exactly what an appeal about conduct would be about.

rpl.title.text: Kamogelo ya go ithuta ga pele

rpl.intro.text: Bakeng sa moithuti yo a šetšego a kgona karolo ya mošomo. Ga go selo seo se filwego mo ka polelo ya motho a tee: kahlolo e dirwa kgahlanong le dikriteria tša modula ka noši, e ngwadilwe ka botlalo, gomme e modereitwa ke motho yo mongwe go e na le yo a e dirilego pele e ka bala selo.
rpl.intro.from: For a learner who can already do part of the work. Nothing here is granted on one person's say-so: a judgement is made against the module's own criteria, written down in full, and moderated by somebody other than whoever made it before it counts for anything.

rpl.noneWaiting.text: Ga go selo seo se emetšego modereitara

rpl.waitingIntro.text: Kahlolo ga e fe selo go fihlela se se dirwa. Bala mabaka kgahlanong le modula pele o dumela: ke selo sa mathomo seo monetefatši wa ka ntle a se balago.
rpl.waitingIntro.from: A judgement grants nothing until this is done. Read the rationale against the module before agreeing: it is the first thing an external verifier reads.

rpl.appearHere.text: Dikahlolo di tšwelela mo ge di dirwa.
rpl.appearHere.from: Judgements appear here as they are made.

rpl.openIntro.text: Mogato wa mathomo, woo o hlodišago rekhoto yeo se sengwe le se sengwe se ikgokaganyago le yona.
rpl.openIntro.from: The first step, and the one that creates the record everything else attaches to.

rpl.transferIntro.text: E fapane le kamogelo ya go ithuta ga pele: moithuti o šetše a na le kwalifikeišene yeo dipheto tša yona di akaretšago modula wo. Ga go na keletšo, eupša bapetšo e swanetše go ngwalwa; phetišo ntle le yona ke kgopelo yeo go se nago yo a ka e netefatšago.
rpl.transferIntro.from: Different from RPL: the learner already holds a qualification whose outcomes cover this module. No advisory, but the mapping has to be written down; a transfer without it is a claim nobody can check.

rpl.needsBoth.text: Kgopelo e nyaka moithuti le kwalifikeišene yeo e ka dirwago kgahlanong le yona. Oketša tšeo pele.
rpl.needsBoth.from: An application needs a learner and a qualification to apply against. Add those first.

rpl.needsLearner.text: Oketša moithuti pele o rekhoda phetišo ya yena.
rpl.needsLearner.from: Add a learner before recording a transfer for one.

rpl.holds.text: Seo ba šetšego ba na le sona

rpl.mapping.text: Ka fao dipheto tša seo ba nago le sona di akaretšago tša modula wo
rpl.mapping.from: How the outcomes of what they hold cover this module's

rpl.checked.text: Seo o se lekotšego, le seo o se phethilego
rpl.checked.from: What you checked, and what you concluded

record.print.text: Gatiša letlakala le gore o le boloke e le PDF ya faele ya bohlatse.
record.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF for the portfolio of evidence.

record.timeExpired.text: Ga se ya amogelwa: nako e fetile gomme mošomo o gafilwe bjalo ka ge o be o le bjalo.
record.timeExpired.from: Not accepted: the time limit expired and the work was handed in as it stood.

record.returned.text: E bušitšwe {date}. Ye ke ya tlhabollo: ga e rekhode bokgoni.
record.returned.from: Returned {date}. This is developmental: it records no competence.

marking.notMarkedOne.text: Lemaraka le 1 · ga se la swaiwa

sor.withdrawConsequence.text: Setsha sa tlhahlobo se ka ba se na le kopi. Tshupetšo e dula e šoma gomme e tla bolela gore e gogilwe.
sor.withdrawConsequence.from: An assessment centre may already hold a copy. The reference keeps working and will say it was withdrawn.

sor.print.text: Gatiša goba boloka Setatemente se sa Diphetho
sor.print.from: Print or save this Statement of Results

fisa.title.text: Tlhahlobo ya go phetha ya kopantšwego ya mafelelo

fisa.intro.text: Pampiri yeo moabi yo a e beago bakeng sa lenaneo la gagwe la mabokgoni. Go fapana le tlhahlobo ya ka ntle, o a e ngwala gomme o a e modereita, ka gona modereišene e direga pele ga ge motho a ka e ngwala, gomme pampiri yeo e sa saenwego e loketše morero e ka se šomišwe.
fisa.intro.from: The paper this provider sets for its own skills programme. Unlike an external assessment, you write it and you moderate it, so the moderation happens before anybody sits it, and a paper that has not been signed off as fit for purpose cannot be used.

fisa.waitingIntro.text: Ga go yo a ka e ngwalago go fihlela modereitara a e saena.
fisa.waitingIntro.from: Nobody can sit these until a moderator signs them off.

fisa.usable.text: {count} di saenwe gomme di ka šomišwa.

fisa.noneYet.text: Ga go le e tee le ga bjale.

fisa.setNewIntro.text: Kgahlanong le lenaneo la mabokgoni. Kwalifikeišene e feletšego goba karolo ya yona e hlahlobjwa ka ntle.
fisa.setNewIntro.from: Against a skills programme. A full or part qualification is assessed externally.

fisa.gate.approved.text: E saenwe e loketše morero: batšeakarolo ba ka ngwala pampiri ye
fisa.gate.approved.from: Signed off as fit for purpose: candidates may sit this paper

fisa.gate.in_moderation.text: Go modereitara: ga go yo a ka e ngwalago le ga bjale
fisa.gate.in_moderation.from: With the moderator: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.gate.draft.text: E a ngwalwa: ga go yo a ka e ngwalago le ga bjale
fisa.gate.draft.from: Being written: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.approvedOn.text: E modereitwe gomme ya dumelelwa ka {date}.

fisa.beforeNotAfter.text: FISA e modereitwa pele e ngwalwa, e sego ka morago. Seo ke seo se e dirago gore e šireletšege ge go etetšwe go lekola.
fisa.beforeNotAfter.from: A FISA is moderated before it is sat, not after. That is what makes it defensible at a monitoring visit.

fisa.practical.text: Gape e na le karolo ya tirišo, yeo e ahlolwago ka gore o kgonne goba ga a eso kgone.
fisa.practical.from: Also has a practical component, judged competent or not yet competent.

fisa.moderatorIntro.text: O lekola gore e loketše morero, pele ga ge motho a e ngwala.
fisa.moderatorIntro.from: Checks it is fit for purpose, before anybody sits it.

fisa.noContact.text: Ga go dintlha tša go ikgokaganya tše di rekhotilwego

fisa.unsigned.text: Ga go kwano ya sephiri le ga bjale. Ga a kgone go bona goba go ahlola pampiri go fihlela e saenwe.
fisa.unsigned.from: No confidentiality agreement yet. They may not see or judge the paper until it is signed.

fisa.nobody.text: Ga go yo a kgethilwego le ga bjale.

fisa.outcomes.text: Dipheto tša maemo a go tšwa, le moo pampiri e di hlahlobago
fisa.outcomes.from: Exit level outcomes, and where the paper assesses them

fisa.outcomesIntro.text: Karolo ya 2 ya ditlaleho ka bobedi. Ke lefelo le le tee leo le bontšhago gore pampiri e akaretša kwalifikeišene, e sego feela go bonagala e le tlhahlobo.
fisa.outcomesIntro.from: Section 2 of both reports. The only place that shows the paper covers the qualification rather than merely looking like an exam.

fisa.noOutcomes.text: Lenaneo le ga le na dipheto tša maemo a go tšwa tšeo di rekhotilwego, ka gona ga go selo seo pampiri e ka bapetšwago le sona. Tsenya kharikhulamo pele.
fisa.noOutcomes.from: This programme has no exit level outcomes recorded, so there is nothing to map the paper against. Import the curriculum first.

fisa.onlyExaminer.text: Ke moeksamina yo a kgethilwego feela, ge kwano ya gagwe ya sephiri e šetše e saenwe, yo a ka arabago tše.
fisa.onlyExaminer.from: Only the appointed examiner, once their confidentiality agreement is signed, can answer these.

fisa.onlyModerator.text: Ke modereitara yo a kgethilwego feela, ge kwano ya gagwe ya sephiri e šetše e saenwe, yo a ka arabago tše.
fisa.onlyModerator.from: Only the appointed moderator, once their confidentiality agreement is signed, can answer these.

fisa.handOverIntro.text: Ge pego ya gago e feditšwe.
fisa.handOverIntro.from: Once your own report is complete.

fisa.laterIntro.text: Ye e dula bjalo ka ge e le, ka gobane batšeakarolo ba ka ba ba e ngwadile. Kgatišo e mpsha e nyaka modereišene ya yona.
fisa.laterIntro.from: This one stays exactly as it is, because candidates may have sat it. A new version needs its own moderation.

fisa.noProgrammes.text: FISA e beilwe kgahlanong le lenaneo la mabokgoni, gomme ga go le le tee le ga bjale. Tsenya le tee pele; kwalifikeišene e feletšego goba karolo ya yona e hlahlobjwa ka ntle ke Molekane wa Boleng bja Tlhahlobo, ka gona moabi ga a beele pampiri yeo.
fisa.noProgrammes.from: A FISA is set against a skills programme, and there are none yet. Import one first; a full or part qualification is assessed externally by the Assessment Quality Partner, so the provider does not set that paper.

fisa.passNote.text: FISA e na le lemaraka la go feta, ka gobane ke tlhahlobo, go fapana le bokgoni bja ka gare.
fisa.passNote.from: A FISA is an examination, so it has one, unlike internal competence.

fisa.hasPractical.text: E na le karolo ya tirišo yeo e ahlolwago ka gore o kgonne goba ga a eso kgone
fisa.hasPractical.from: It also has a practical component judged competent or not yet competent

fisa.practicalHint.text: mohl. Tirišo: diiri tše 4, e ahlolwa o kgonne / ga a eso kgone
fisa.practicalHint.from: e.g. Practical: 4 hours, judged competent / not yet competent

fisa.idNote.text: Ka fao sethaleng se se aroganyago motho o tee le yo mongwe ge ba se na akhaonto mo.
fisa.idNote.from: How the platform tells one person from another when they have no account here.

fisa.account.text: Akhaonto ya gagwe mo, ge a na le yona
fisa.account.from: Their account here, if they have one

fisa.outside.text: Motho wa ka ntle, yo a se nago akhaonto
fisa.outside.from: Somebody from outside, with no account

fisa.accountNote.text: Ke motho yo a nago le akhaonto feela yo a ka tlatšago pego ya gagwe mo.
fisa.accountNote.from: Only somebody with an account can fill in their own report here.

fisa.standardComment.text: Ditshwayotshwayo ka maemo ao a fihleletšwego

fisa.further.text: Ditshwayotshwayo tše dingwe bakeng sa go kaonafatša maemo a tlhahlobo
fisa.further.from: Further comments for the improvement of assessment standards

fisa.signOff.text: Saena e le e loketše morero
fisa.signOff.from: Sign off as fit for purpose

fisa.untilYouDo.text: Ga go batšeakarolo yo a ka ngwalago pampiri ye go fihlela o dira bjalo.
fisa.untilYouDo.from: No candidate may sit this paper until you do.

eisa.intro.text: Ge go ngwalwa ka nako efe, ge go ngwadišwa go tswalwa neng, le dihlopha dife tšeo di sa swanelago go tsenywa. Go ngwadiša gantši go tswalwa ka dikgwedi tše tharo pele, ke ka moo sehlopha seo se fetšago mo nywageng se swanetšego go tsenywa kgale pele se fetša.
eisa.intro.from: When each sitting is, when registration for it closes, and which cohorts still have to be entered. Registration typically closes about three months ahead, which is why a cohort finishing later in the year has to be entered long before it finishes.

eisa.registerNowIntro.text: Go ngwadiša go tswalwa ka gare ga matšatši a lesome a mošomo gomme dihlopha tše ga di na letšatši la go ngwadiša le rekhotilwego.
eisa.registerNowIntro.from: Registration closes within ten working days and these cohorts have no registration date recorded.

eisa.sittingsIntro.text: Ke tšeo feela tšeo di sa bulegago go ngwadiša. Yeo e tswetšwego ga se selo seo mang le mang a ka se dirago, gomme go e tlogela mo go tla kgoromeletša nako ya ka mo go latelago ya nnete fase ga letlakala.
eisa.sittingsIntro.from: Only those still open for registration. A closed one is nothing anybody can act on, and leaving it here would push the next real deadline down the page.

eisa.nextYear.text: Ga go selo seo se rekhotilwego ka ntle ga ngwaga wo. Molekane wa boleng bja tlhahlobo o phatlalatša matšatši a ngwaga o latelago ka Disemere, ka gona lengwalo le swanetše go ba le tšwile; go a oketša bjale ke seo se dulago se dira palo ya matšatši e tšwela pele go fihla ka Janaware.
eisa.nextYear.from: Nothing is recorded beyond this year. The assessment quality partner publishes next year's dates in December, so the letter should be out; adding them now is what keeps the countdown running into January.

eisa.toEnterIntro.text: Tšohle tšeo di nago le letšatši le le bulegilego la go fela gomme di se na letšatši la go ngwadiša le rekhotilwego kgahlanong le tšona.
eisa.toEnterIntro.from: Everything with an open deadline and no registration date recorded against it.

eisa.sittingName.text: Leina la nako ya go ngwala, mohl. Matšhe 2027

eisa.noQualification.text: Ga go kwalifikeišene ka dingwadišong tše

eisa.noId.text: {count} ba se nago nomoro ya boitsebišo

eisa.noIdIntro.text: Molekane yo mongwe le yo mongwe wa boleng o e kopa, gomme go ngwadiša mo go busetšwago ka lebaka la nomoro yeo e hlokegago go tšea kgato e nngwe ya nako. Go kaone go e hwetša bjale go e na le ka morago ga ge faele e rometšwe.
eisa.noIdIntro.from: Every quality partner asks for one, and a registration returned for a missing number costs a cycle. Better found now than after the file is sent.

eisa.readyIntro.text: Kriteria ye nngwe le ye nngwe modulong o mongwe le o mongwe e fihleletšwe, ebile e rutilwe goba e amogetšwe ka go ithuta ga pele.
eisa.readyIntro.from: Every criterion in every module met, whether taught or recognised through prior learning.

eisa.nobodyYet.text: Ga go yo le ga bjale. Lenaneo le ka tlase le bolela gore yo mongwe le yo mongwe o sa swanetše go ya kgole ganekae.
eisa.nobodyYet.from: Nobody yet. The list below says how far each of them has to go.

eisa.notReadyIntro.text: Ka fao yo mongwe le yo mongwe a sa swanetšego go ya kgole. Motho yo a hlokago kriteria e tee a ka tšwela pele a fihlela nako ge e ka bonwa mo beke ye.
eisa.notReadyIntro.from: How far each has to go. Somebody one criterion short can still make the deadline if it is noticed this week.

ready.intro.text: Moithuti a ka ngwala Tlhahlobo ya ka Ntle ya go Phetha ya Kopantšwego (EISA) ge kriteria ye nngwe le ye nngwe ya tlhahlobo ya ka gare modulong o mongwe le o mongwe e fihleletšwe. E sego a mantši a tšona, gomme ga go peresente yeo e ka ema legatong la go swana; peresente ya ka tlase ke tšwelopele, bejane ke tumelelo.
ready.intro.from: A learner may sit the External Integrated Summative Assessment once every internal assessment criterion in every module has been achieved. Not most of them, and no percentage stands in for it: the percentage below is progress, the badge is permission.

ready.nobody.text: Ga go yo a ngwadišitšwego kgahlanong le kwalifikeišene le ga bjale. Ngwadiša moithuti khosong gomme o kgethe kwalifikeišene yeo e balelago go yona, gomme o tla tšwelela mo.
ready.nobody.from: Nobody is enrolled against a qualification yet. Enrol a learner on a course and choose the qualification it counts towards, and they will appear here.

ready.notCaptured.text: Kharikhulamo mo ga e a tšewa ka botlalo.
ready.notCaptured.from: A curriculum here is not fully captured.

ready.notCapturedIntro.text: Dimodula tše dingwe ga di na dikriteria tša tlhahlobo, ka gona ga go selo seo se ka fihlelwago kgahlanong le tšona gomme ga go yo a lego kwalifikeišeneng yeo a ka bolelwago gore o loketše. Tsenya tokomane ya kharikhulamo ka botlalo pele o ngwadiša motho go EISA.
ready.notCapturedIntro.from: Some modules carry no assessment criteria, so nothing can be achieved against them and nobody on that qualification can be declared ready. Import the full curriculum document before entering anyone for an EISA.

ready.notEligible.from: Not yet eligible for the EISA

ready.achieved.text: Dikriteria tše {achieved} ka {total} tša tlhahlobo ya ka gare di fihleletšwe, gomme maitemogelo a mošomo a netefaditšwe ke {record} yeo e saenwego.
ready.achieved.from: {achieved} of {total} internal assessment criteria achieved, and work experience proved by a signed {record}.

ready.canIssue.text: Setatemente sa Diphetho se ka filwe.
ready.canIssue.from: A Statement of Results can be issued.

ready.everyOne.text: Ye nngwe le ye nngwe ya tšona e a hlokega; ga go lemaraka la go feta.
ready.everyOne.from: Every one of them is required; there is no pass mark.

ready.perUnit.text: Ditatemente bakeng sa yuniti ye nngwe le ye nngwe ya go ithuta

ready.perUnitIntro.text: Setatemente sa yuniti e tee ya go ithuta se netefatša kriteria ye nngwe le ye nngwe ya dimodula tšeo yuniti yeo e di rutago. Se ka filwe ge feela yuniti yeo e fedile, ntle le go emela tše dingwe tša kwalifikeišene.
ready.perUnitIntro.from: A statement for one study unit confirms every criterion in the modules that unit delivers. It can be issued as soon as that unit is finished, without waiting for the rest of the qualification.

ready.certificateIntro.text: Se filwe ke mokgatlo wa go fa kwalifikeišene ka morago ga EISA, e sego ke {provider}. Se rekhotwa mo ge se fihla, gore rekhoto ya moithuti e bolele gore o na le kwalifikeišene.
ready.certificateIntro.from: Issued by the awarding body after the EISA, not by {provider}. Recorded here when it arrives, so the learner's record says they are qualified.

ready.thisNotCaptured.text: Kharikhulamo ye ga e a tšewa ka botlalo.
ready.thisNotCaptured.from: This curriculum is not fully captured.

ready.thisNotCapturedIntro.text: {modules} ga di na dikriteria tša tlhahlobo. Ga go yo a ka bolelwago gore o loketše kgahlanong le kwalifikeišene ye go fihlela tokomane ya kharikhulamo ka botlalo e tsentšwe; go sego bjalo dimodula tše di hlokegago di be di balwa e le tšeo di fetilego ka khutšo.
ready.thisNotCapturedIntro.from: {modules} carry no assessment criteria. Nobody can be declared eligible against this qualification until the full curriculum document has been imported; otherwise the missing modules would silently count as passed.

ready.weight.document.text: bjalo ka ge go boletšwe tokomaneng ya kharikhulamo
ready.weight.document.from: as stated in the curriculum document

ready.weight.credits.text: e tšwa go dikrediti tša modula; tokomane ga e bolele diperesente
ready.weight.credits.from: derived from module credits; the document states no percentages

ready.weight.equal.text: e arotšwe ka go lekana; tokomane ga e bolele diperesente goba dikrediti
ready.weight.equal.from: split evenly; the document states no percentages and no credits

ready.workProved.text: Maitemogelo a mošomo a netefatšwa ke {record} yeo e saenwego ke mokoutši wa mošomong gomme ya amogelwa ke mohlahlobi, e sego ke dikriteria tša tlhahlobo. Kharikhulamo ga e hlalose le e tee bakeng sa modula wo.
ready.workProved.from: Work experience is proved by a {record} signed by the workplace coach and accepted by an assessor, not by assessment criteria. The curriculum defines none for this module.

ready.noRecord.text: Ga go {record} e butšwego bakeng sa modula wo.
ready.noRecord.from: No {record} has been opened for this module.

ready.noCriteria.text: Ga go dikriteria tša tlhahlobo tše di tšerwego bakeng sa modula wo.
ready.noCriteria.from: No assessment criteria captured for this module.

issue.notYet.text: Setatemente sa Diphetho se ka se filwe le ga bjale.
issue.notYet.from: A Statement of Results cannot be issued yet.

award.wrong.text: O e tsentše ka phošo? E tloše

award.why.text: Ka lebaka la eng e tlošwa

preview.summative.text: Ya go phetha: e ahlolwa ke motho gomme e modereitwa ka thoko
preview.summative.from: Summative: judged by a person and independently moderated

preview.formative.text: Ya tlhabollo: e a swaiwa ge moithuti a tšwela pele
preview.formative.from: Formative: marked as the learner goes

preview.whoMarks.text: {app} di swailwe ke aplikeišene, {assessor} ke mohlahlobi
preview.whoMarks.from: {app} marked by the App, {assessor} by an assessor

preview.isPreviewIntro.text: Ke ka mo go nepilego seo moithuti a se bonago, le dipokisi tšeo a tlago go ngwala ka go tšona. Ga go selo seo se bolokwago gomme ga go boiteko bjo bo thomilwego, ka gona dikontrolo di tima. Panele ka tlase ga potšišo ye nngwe le ye nngwe ke ya gago ka gobane o hlotše pampiri ye; moithuti ga a e bone gohlegohle.
preview.isPreviewIntro.from: Exactly what a learner sees, with the boxes they would type into. Nothing is saved and no attempt has been started, so the controls are switched off. The panel under each question is for you because you built this paper; a learner never sees it.

preview.empty.text: Ga go dipotšišo pampiring ye le ga bjale.
preview.empty.from: There are no questions in this paper yet.

preview.tickedAbove.text: Kgetho ye nepilego e swailwe ka godimo.
preview.tickedAbove.from: The correct option is ticked above.

preview.noGuide.text: Ga go tlhahlo ya go swaya. Mohlahlobi ga a na selo sa go swaya kgahlanong le sona; oketša e tee pele pampiri e šomišwa.
preview.noGuide.from: No marking guide. An assessor has nothing to mark this against; add one before the paper is used.

preview.declarationIntro.text: Moithuti a ka se e gafe ntle le go dumela, gomme mantšu a nepagetšego a bewa ka go tiiša ka gare ga tlhagišo.
preview.declarationIntro.from: A learner cannot hand this in without agreeing to it, and the exact wording is frozen into the submission.

people.intro.text: Bohle ba ka gare ga {provider}, dikarolo tša bona, le gore na rekhoto ya bona e na le seo pego ya semolao e se nyakago.
people.intro.from: Everyone in {provider}, their roles, and whether their record carries what a statutory return needs.

people.notEnrolledOne.text: Moithuti o 1 ga se a ngwadišwa go selo.
people.notEnrolledOne.from: 1 learner is not enrolled on anything.

people.notEnrolledMany.text: Baithuti ba {count} ga se ba ngwadišwa go selo.
people.notEnrolledMany.from: {count} learners are not enrolled on anything.

people.notEnrolledWhy.text: Go ba moithuti ga go fe phihlelo ka noši, ka gona ba tsena sekirining se se se nago selo. Ba ngwadiše khosong, o ba oketše sehlopheng, goba o ba abele lenaneo.
people.notEnrolledWhy.from: Being a learner grants no access on its own, so they sign in to an empty screen. Enrol them on a course, add them to a cohort, or assign a programme.

people.missingOne.text: Motho o 1 o hlokega dintlha tšeo pego ya SETA goba SAQA e di nyakago.
people.missingOne.from: 1 person is missing details a SETA or SAQA return needs.

people.missingMany.text: Batho ba {count} ba hlokega dintlha tšeo pego ya SETA goba SAQA e di nyakago.
people.missingMany.from: {count} people are missing details a SETA or SAQA return needs.

people.missingWhy.text: Ba swailwe ka tlase. Go di tlatša bjale go bonolo kudu go feta bošego bja pele ga go romela.
people.missingWhy.from: They are marked below. Filling them in now is far easier than the night before a submission.

people.notEnrolled.text: Ga se a ngwadišwa go selo

people.roster.text: Oketša sehlopha go tšwa go spreadishiti
people.roster.from: Add a cohort from a spreadsheet

people.rosterIntro.text: Bala faele ya CSV goba ya Excel ya baithuti gomme o ba hlome ka moka ka nako e tee. E go bontšha seo e se dirilego ka faele pele go hlongwa motho.
people.rosterIntro.from: Read a CSV or Excel file of learners and create them all at once. It shows you what it made of the file before anybody is created.

people.added.text: O oketšwe. Mo fe phasewete ye: e bontšhwa gatee gomme ga e kgone go bušetšwa.
people.added.from: Added. Give them this password: it is shown once and cannot be retrieved.

people.noMail.text: Ga go seva ya poso e kgokagantšwego le ga bjale, ka gona ga go emeile e rometšwego. Ba kope go e fetola ka morago ga go tsena.
people.noMail.from: There is no mail server connected yet, so nothing was emailed. Ask them to change it after signing in.

person.lineManagerNote.text: O laola gore ke thuto ya mang yeo motho yo a ka e bonago ditlalehong.
person.lineManagerNote.from: Decides whose training this person can see in reports.

person.ofoNote.text: Khoutu ya modiro yeo e šomišwago go kgetha sehlopha sa pego ya SETA.
person.ofoNote.from: Occupation code used to group a SETA return.

person.statutoryNote.text: Di a hlokega bakeng sa pego ya SAQA goba ya SETA. Nomoro ya boitsebišo e lekolwa ka nomoro ya yona ya go lekola ge o e boloka, ka gona phošo ya go ngwala e swarwa mo e sego ke mokgatlo wa taolo.
person.statutoryNote.from: Needed for a SAQA or SETA return. The identity number is checked against its check digit as you save, so a typing error is caught here rather than by the regulator.

person.roleNote.assessor.text: E nyaka nomoro ya go ngwadišwa

person.roleNote.moderator.text: Ga a kgone go modereita dipheto tša gagwe

person.roleNote.workplace_coach.text: Mohlokomedi wa mothwadi: o bona baithuti ba gagwe feela
person.roleNote.workplace_coach.from: The employer's supervisor: sees only their own learners

roster.how.text: CSV goba Excel. Dihlogo tša dikholomo di swanišwa ka leina ("Surname", "Last Name" le "Van" ka moka di a šoma) gomme ga go hlokege keketšo bakeng sa se sengwe sa tšona.
roster.how.from: CSV or Excel. Column headings are matched by name ("Surname", "Last Name" and "Van" all work) and no extension is needed for any of it.

roster.aiOn.text: Keketšo ya gago ya AI e a šoma

roster.aiOnWhat.text: gomme e tla leka go swanišetša sehlogo se sengwe le se sengwe seo melao e se fošago. E bontšhwa dihlogo feela, ga e bontšhwe methalo le ka mohla, yeo e nago le dinomoro tša boitsebišo.
roster.aiOnWhat.from: and will try to match any heading the rules miss. It is shown the headings only, never the rows, which carry identity numbers.

roster.aiOff.text: Ge keketšo ya gago ya AI e ka bulwa, e be e ka swanišetša le dihlogo tšeo melao e sa di tsebego; e be e ka bontšhwa dihlogo feela, e sego methalo le ka mohla. Sehlopiša se ka godimo ga letlakala.
roster.aiOff.from: With your AI extension switched on it would additionally match headings the rules do not recognise; it would be shown the headings only, never the rows. The switch is at the top of the page.

roster.passwords.text: Diphasewete tša bona tša mathomo, tšeo di bontšhwago gatee

roster.passwordsNote.text: Tše ga di bolokwe felo mo di ka balwago gape. Di kopiše bjale, goba o di tsošološe ka o tee ka o tee ka morago. Motho yo mongwe le yo mongwe o a kgopelwa go fetola phasewete ya gagwe ge a tsena la mathomo.
roster.passwordsNote.from: These are not stored anywhere they can be read again. Copy them now, or reset them individually later. Each person is asked to change theirs on first sign-in.

roster.willCreateSkip.text: {count} di tla hlongwa, {skipped} di tla tlogelwa.
roster.willCreateSkip.from: {count} will be created, {skipped} will be skipped.

personPage.neverSignedIn.text: · ga se a tsena le ga bjale

personPage.anonymisedOne.text: Dintlha tša botho di phumotšwe ka {date} ka kgopelo ya motho yo. Setifikeiti sa gagwe se 1 se sa dutše se na le maatla gomme se ka netefatšwa, ka gobane kwalifikeišene yeo e šetšego e hweditšwe e swanetše go dula rekhotong ya bosetšhaba.
personPage.anonymisedOne.from: The personal details were erased on {date} at the person's request. Their 1 certificate remains valid and verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to stay on the national record.

personPage.anonymisedMany.text: Dintlha tša botho di phumotšwe ka {date} ka kgopelo ya motho yo. Ditifikeiti tša gagwe tše {count} di sa dutše di na le maatla gomme di ka netefatšwa, ka gobane kwalifikeišene yeo e šetšego e hweditšwe e swanetše go dula rekhotong ya bosetšhaba.
personPage.anonymisedMany.from: The personal details were erased on {date} at the person's request. Their {count} certificates remain valid and verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to stay on the national record.

personPage.noEdit.text: Ga go selo mo se ka fetolwago.

personPage.conductIntro.text: Seo se belaetšwago, ke ditemošo dife tšeo di bego di sa dutše di šoma ka nako yeo, ge e ba tsebišo ya kwedišišo e be e lekane, le seo se ahlotšwego. Ka tatelano ya ka fao go diregilego, ke yona tatelano yeo go balwago ka yona gape.
personPage.conductIntro.from: What was alleged, which warnings were live at the time, whether notice of a hearing was adequate, and what was decided. In the order it happened, which is the order it gets read back in.

personPage.supportIntro.text: Seo se dirwago bakeng sa moithuti yo, le ke mang. Lebaka la peakanyo ya thekgo ke tshedimošo ya maphelo goba ya ditšhelete gomme e bolokwa ka thoko, ka gobane go dira peakanyo ga go hloke go tseba lebaka.
personPage.supportIntro.from: What is being done for this learner, and by whom. The reason behind an accommodation is health or financial information and is held apart from it, because doing the accommodating does not require knowing why.

personPage.missed.text: Matšatši a go phetha ao a fošagetšwego

personPage.missedIntro.text: Letšatši le le tee le le oketšegilego, gomme e le le tee feela. Ge le lona le fošagetšwe ka mabaka a bongaka, moithuti o ya tlhahlobong ya molomo le molebeledi yo a tšwago go mothwadi.
personPage.missedIntro.from: One additional date, and one only. Where that is also missed on medical grounds the learner goes to an oral assessment with an observer from the employer.

personPage.appealsIntro.text: Kgahlanong le sephetho, goba kgahlanong le boitshwaro bja mohlahlobi. Go amogelwa go dumelelwa ka gare ga diiri tše {hours}, gomme nako e thoma ge boipiletšo bo beilwe mo.
personPage.appealsIntro.from: Against a result, or against an assessor's conduct. Receipt is acknowledged within {hours} hours, and the clock starts when it is lodged here.

personPage.documentsIntro.text: Di lekolwa ge di kgobokana, e sego ge pego ya go romelwa e hlangwa. Kopi e netefaditšwego yeo e hlokegago e hwetšwago ka morago ga dikgwedi e thata kudu go e hwetša, gomme letšatši la go fela gantši le šetše le le matšatši a mmalwa.
personPage.documentsIntro.from: Checked as they are collected rather than when a return is being assembled. A missing certified copy found months later is far harder to get, and the deadline is usually days away by then.

personPage.elsewhere.text: Go ithuta go rekhotilwego lefelong le lengwe

personPage.elsewhereIntro.text: E tsentšwe go tšwa sistiming ye nngwe. E bontšhwa bjalo ka ge e rekhotilwe kua; ga go le e tee ya yona yeo e rutilwego, ya hlahlobja goba ya modereitwa mo sethaleng se.
personPage.elsewhereIntro.from: Imported from another system. Shown as it was recorded there; none of it was taught, assessed or moderated on this platform.

editor.ownRoles.text: O ka se fetole dikarolo tša gago: go tloša phihlelo ya gago ke phošo e tee yeo ga go yo mongwe yo a ka e phošollago. Kopa molaodi yo mongwe.
editor.ownRoles.from: You cannot change your own roles: removing your own access is the one mistake nobody else may be able to undo. Ask another administrator.

editor.mailboxIntro.text: Aterese yeo baithuti le bahlahlobi ba ngwalelago go yona le go tšwa go yona. E fapane le aterese ya go tsena yeo e lego ka godimo, gore poledišano ka ga tlhahlobo e wele ka gare ga rekhoto ya moithuti e sego lebokosong la poso la motho, moo e lego ka ntle ga log ya odithi, ka ntle ga kopi ya polokelo, gomme e nyametše ge a tloga.
editor.mailboxIntro.from: The address learners and assessors write to and from. Separate from the sign-in address above, so a conversation about an assessment lands inside the learner's record rather than in somebody's private inbox, where it is outside the audit log, outside the backup, and gone when they leave.

editor.noPassword.text: Ga go na phasewete e nngwe, ka gobane ga go na go tsena go le lengwe.
editor.noPassword.from: There is no separate password, because there is no separate login.

editor.noPasswordWhy.text: Ye ga se lebokoso la poso la seva ya poso yeo e nago le webmail ya yona. Poso yeo e romelwago aterese ye e gafelwa ka gare ga sethaleng, gomme motho o e bala le go e araba ka fase ga Poso ka morago ga go tsena ka tsela yeo a e tlwaetšego. Ke yona morero wa yona: dipoledišano di dula ka gare ga rekhoto ya moithuti, ka gare ga log ya odithi le kopi ya polokelo, e sego lebokosong la poso la poraefete leo le tlogago ge a tloga.
editor.noPasswordWhy.from: This is not a mailbox on a mail host with its own webmail. Mail sent to this address is delivered into the platform, and the person reads and answers it under Mail after signing in the way they always do. That is the point of it: the correspondence sits inside the learner's record, in the audit log and in the backup, rather than in a private inbox that leaves when they do.

editor.mailboxChange.text: Go e fetola ga go šuše poso yeo e šetšego e amogetšwe.
editor.mailboxChange.from: Changing it does not move mail already received.

editor.mailboxSuggested.text: Yeo e šišinywago: {address}. E tlogele e se na selo ge o sa nyake lebokoso la poso.
editor.mailboxSuggested.from: Suggested: {address}. Leave blank for no mailbox.

editor.newPassword.text: Phasewete e mpsha: e bontšhwa gatee, e fe motho ka noši.
editor.newPassword.from: New password: shown once, give it to them directly.

editor.ownSuspend.text: O ka se emiše akhaonto ya gago.
editor.ownSuspend.from: You cannot suspend your own account.

editor.suspendNote.text: Go emiša go fediša sešene efe goba efe yeo motho a e butšego gatee, gomme go tsošološa phasewete go ba tšhaba mafelong ka moka.
editor.suspendNote.from: Suspending ends any session the person has open immediately, and resetting a password signs them out everywhere.

editor.eraseIntro.text: Bakeng sa kgopelo ya go phumola ya POPIA. E tloša leina, dintlha tša go ikgokaganya le tša setšhaba ka mo go sa fetogego. Ditifikeiti le direkhoto tša tlhahlobo di bolokwa gomme di dula di ka netefatšwa, ka gobane kwalifikeišene yeo e šetšego e hweditšwe e swanetše go dula rekhotong ya bosetšhaba, ke ka fao le se se ka se fetošwego.
editor.eraseIntro.from: For a POPIA erasure request. Removes the name, contact and demographic details permanently. Certificates and assessment records are kept and stay verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to remain on the national record, which is also why this cannot be undone.

editor.why.text: Ke ka lebaka la eng se se dirwa?

editor.whyHint.text: Se bolokwa ka mo go sa fetogego ka gare ga log ya odithi.
editor.whyHint.from: Kept permanently in the audit log.

editor.erasePermanently.text: Phumola ka mo go sa fetogego

lodge.noCohort.text: Boipiletšo bo bewa kgahlanong le sehlopha, gomme moithuti yo ga a ka sehlopheng seo se sepelago.
lodge.noCohort.from: An appeal is filed against a cohort, and this learner is not on a running one.

lodge.statementHint.text: Seo moithuti a se bolelago, ka mantšu a gagwe ge go kgonega.
lodge.statementHint.from: What the learner says, in their words where possible.

lodge.lateWhy.text: Lebaka la go amogela se ka ntle ga nako
lodge.lateWhy.from: Why this is being accepted out of time

lodge.lateNote.text: Boipiletšo bjo bo tlilego morago ga nako e sa le boipiletšo, gomme go bo gana mo go be go tla bo romela feela lebokosong la poso la motho. Lebaka le ba karolo ya faele.
lodge.lateNote.from: A late appeal is still an appeal, and turning it away here would only send it to somebody's inbox. The reason becomes part of the file.

missed.outcome.additional_date_set.text: Letšatši le le oketšegilego le beilwe

missed.outcome.sat.text: O ngwadile ka letšatši le le oketšegilego

missed.none.text: Ga go matšatši a go phetha ao a fošagetšwego.

missed.againOral.text: Ba e fošitše gape: dumelela tlhahlobo ya molomo
missed.againOral.from: Missed it again: authorise an oral assessment

missed.wasMedical.text: Go fošega ga bobedi e bile ka mabaka a bongaka
missed.wasMedical.from: The second miss was on medical grounds

missed.medicalHint.text: Lebaka la bongaka e bile eng

missed.medicalOnly.text: Tsela ya molomo e bulwa feela ka lebaka la bongaka, e sego ka le lengwe. Ge go se na le lona, sephetho ke go lahlegelwa, seo moithuti a ka se ipiletšago.
missed.medicalOnly.from: The oral route opens on a medical ground and nothing else. Without one the outcome is a forfeit, which the learner can still appeal.

missed.whyHint.text: Lebaka leo e fošagetšwego ka lona, ge le tsebja
missed.whyHint.from: Why it was missed, if known

missed.onlyOne.text: Letšatši le le tee le le oketšegilego, gomme e le le tee feela. Go le rekhota mo ke seo se thibelago la boraro go rulaganywa ka morago ke motho yo a bego a sa tsebe ka le le lengwe.
missed.onlyOne.from: One additional date, and one only. Recording it here is what stops a third being arranged later by somebody who did not know about this one.

support.withheld.text: Go na le dintlha tše dingwe faeleng. Di thibetšwe, ka gobane ke tshedimošo ya maphelo goba ya ditšhelete gomme go dira peakanyo ga go hloke go tseba lebaka la yona.
support.withheld.from: There is more detail on file. It is restricted, because it is health or financial information and doing the accommodation does not require knowing the reason for it.

support.changing.text: Seo se fetogago ka lebaka la seo
support.changing.from: What is changing as a result

support.whyEnding.text: Lebaka leo e felago ka lona

support.closedOne.text: Rekhoto e 1 e tswaletšwego ga e bontšhwe.

support.closedMany.text: Direkhoto tše {count} tše di tswaletšwego ga di bontšhwe.

support.accommodation.text: Seo se tlago dirwa: se abelwa mang le mang yo a swanetšego go se dira
support.accommodation.from: What will be done: shared with whoever has to do it

support.accommodationHint.text: Dula kgauswi le lebati. Dumelela boikhutšo ka morago ga metsotso e 40 ye nngwe le ye nngwe. Fa thepa e gatišitšwego.
support.accommodationHint.from: Seat near the door. Allow a break every 40 minutes. Provide printed materials.

support.reason.text: Lebaka la seo: le thibetšwe, gomme go kaone go le tlogela le se na selo
support.reason.from: The reason behind it: restricted, and better left empty

support.reasonNote.text: Maphelo, bogolofadi le maemo a ditšhelete ke tshedimošo ye e kgethegilego ya motho. Rekhoto yeo e bolelago feela seo se swanetšego go dirwa e hlankela moithuti go swana, gomme e tsenya kotsi ye nnyane kudu. E tlatše feela ge motho a ka se kgone go šoma ntle le yona.
support.reasonNote.from: Health, disability and financial circumstances are special personal information. A record that says only what to do serves the learner just as well and puts far less at risk. Fill this in only where somebody genuinely could not act without it.

support.consented.text: Moithuti o dumetše gore se rekhotwe
support.consented.from: The learner has agreed to this being recorded

docs.kind.certified_id.text: Kopi e netefaditšwego ya tokomane ya boitsebišo

docs.kind.highest_qualification.text: Kopi e netefaditšwego ya kwalifikeišene ya godimodimo

docs.kind.rpl_portfolio.text: Faele ya go ithuta ga pele

docs.route.standard_qualification.text: Kwalifikeišene e feletšego goba karolo ya yona

docs.route.rpl.text: Kamogelo ya go ithuta ga pele

docs.routeNote.text: Tsela e kgetha seo se hlokegago. Kamogelo ya go ithuta ga pele e kopa faele go e na le setifikeiti sa kwalifikeišene, ka gobane kgopelo ke gore go ithuta go diregile ka ntle ga lenaneo la semmušo.
docs.routeNote.from: The route decides what is required. Recognition of prior learning asks for a portfolio rather than a qualification certificate, because the claim is that the learning happened outside a formal programme.

docs.allSupplied.text: Tšohle tšeo di hlokegago di filwe gomme di lekotšwe.
docs.allSupplied.from: Everything required has been supplied and checked.

docs.notChecked.text: ga se ya lekolwa le ga bjale

conduct.stage.informal_counselling.text: Go eletšwa ka mokgwa o sego wa semmušo

conduct.sanction.no_action.text: Ga go kgato yeo e tšerwego

conduct.liveOne.text: Temošo e 1 yeo e sa šomago:

conduct.liveMany.text: Ditemošo tše {count} tšeo di sa šomago:

conduct.liveNote.text: Ke tše feela tšeo di balelago go rolela godimo. Temošo yeo e fetilwego ke letšatši e dula faeleng gomme e emiša go balelwa, e lego seo boipiletšo bo ithekgilego go sona.
conduct.liveNote.from: Only these count towards escalation. A warning past its date stays on file and stops counting, which is what an appeal turns on.

conduct.findingsHint.text: Seo se hweditšwego, le go ya ka motheo ofe
conduct.findingsHint.from: What was found, and on what basis

conduct.givenButton.text: Moithuti o filwe se ka mangwalo
conduct.givenButton.from: The learner has been given this in writing

conduct.termsHint.text: Molao wo o thubilwego, maemo ao a letetšwego, le seo se diregago ge se ka boelwa.
conduct.termsHint.from: The rule broken, the standard expected, and what happens if it recurs.

conduct.allegationsHint.text: Ditšhwaušo tše di kgethegilego tšeo di beilwego moithuting
conduct.allegationsHint.from: The specific allegations put to the learner

conduct.sanctionsHint.text: Dikotlo tšeo di kgonegago, go akaretšwa go fedišwa moo go swanetšego
conduct.sanctionsHint.from: Sanctions possible, including termination where it is

conduct.rights.text: Tsebišo e botša moithuti gore o ka thušwa ke moithuti-gotee le yena, a hlagiša tabakgolo ya gagwe, gomme a bitša le go botšiša dihlatse.
conduct.rights.from: The notice tells the learner they may be assisted by a fellow learner, present their case, and call and question witnesses.

conduct.notice.text: Bonyane diiri tše {hours} go tloga bjale. Tsebišo ye khutšwane e a ganwa: ke phošo yeo boipiletšo bo hlokago ka yona, go sa kgathale seo moithuti a se dirilego.
conduct.notice.from: At least {hours} hours from now. Short notice is refused: it is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

conduct.whyHint.text: Lebaka. Ye ke temana yeo moithuti a swanetšego go e newa.
conduct.whyHint.from: Why. This is the paragraph the learner is entitled to.

conduct.allegationHint.text: Seo se šwašwago ka mo go kgethegilego. Moithuti a ka se kgone go araba 'boitshwaro bjo bobe'.
conduct.allegationHint.from: What is alleged, specifically. A learner cannot answer 'poor attitude'.

cohorts.intro.text: Sehlopha sa batho bao ba šomago ka lenaneo mmogo, ka lenaneo le tee la nako. Letšatši le lengwe le le lengwe la go fela le bolokwa e le palo ya matšatši go tloga letšatšing la go thoma, ka gona go šuthiša sehlopha go šuthiša matšatši ka moka bakeng sa bohle ba ka gare ga sona ka nako e tee.
cohorts.intro.from: A group working through a programme together, on one schedule. Every deadline is held as a number of days from the start date, so moving an intake moves every date for everyone in it at once.

cohorts.none.text: {cohort} ke sehlopha sa batho bao ba šomago mmogo ka {course} yeo e phatlaladitšwego, ka lenaneo le tee la nako. Hlama e tee kgahlanong le {course} gomme letšatši le lengwe le le lengwe la go fela le lekanywa go tloga letšatšing la go thoma.
cohorts.none.from: A {cohort} is a group working through a published {course} together, on one schedule. Create one against a {course} and every deadline is measured from its start date.

cohorts.roster.text: Oketša sehlopha go tšwa go spreadishiti
cohorts.roster.from: Add a cohort from a spreadsheet

cohorts.rosterIntro.text: Bala faele ya CSV goba ya Excel ya baithuti gomme o ba hlame ka moka ka nako e tee. E go bontšha seo e se dirilego ka faele pele ba ka hlangwa, ka morago o ba ngwadiše sehlopheng se se ka godimo.
cohorts.rosterIntro.from: Read a CSV or Excel file of learners and create them all at once. It shows you what it made of the file before anybody is created, then enrol them onto a cohort above.

cohorts.noPublished.text: Ga go na {courses} tšeo di phatlaladitšwego le ga bjale. {cohort} e šoma kgahlanong le {course} yeo e phatlaladitšwego, gore thepa e ka se fetolwe ge sehlopha se šetše se e šomela.
cohorts.noPublished.from: There are no published {courses} yet. A {cohort} runs against a published {course}, so that the material cannot change under a group already working through it.

cohorts.startNote.text: Letšatši le lengwe le le lengwe la go fela le balwa go tloga letšatšing le. Le ka šuthišwa ka morago, gomme se sengwe le se sengwe se šuthela le lona.
cohorts.startNote.from: Every deadline is counted from this day. It can be moved later, and everything moves with it.

cohort.paid.text: E lefilwe. Bohle ba sehlopha se ba balwa e le bao ba lefetšwego.
cohort.paid.from: Paid. Everybody on this cohort counts as paid for.

cohort.paidRef.text: E lefilwe · {reference}. Bohle ba sehlopha se ba balwa e le bao ba lefetšwego.
cohort.paidRef.from: Paid · {reference}. Everybody on this cohort counts as paid for.

cohort.invoiced.text: Invoice e ntšhitšwe, gomme ga go tefo e rekhotilwego kgahlanong le yona le ga bjale.
cohort.invoiced.from: Invoiced, and no payment recorded against it yet.

cohort.nothingRecorded.text: Ga go selo se rekhotilwego. Tsela ya go ngwadiša e thoma mo.
cohort.nothingRecorded.from: Nothing recorded. The enrolment procedure begins here.

cohort.moveIntro.text: Letšatši le lengwe le le lengwe le le ka fase le bolokwa e le palo ya matšatši go tloga go le, ka gona go le fetola go šuthiša peakanyo ka moka bakeng sa bohle ba ka sehlopheng.
cohort.moveIntro.from: Every date below is held as a number of days from this one, so changing it moves the whole rollout for everybody on the cohort.

cohort.waitingIntro.text: Moithuti yo mongwe le yo mongwe gatee, mogatong wa pele woo a ka se kgonego go o bula.
cohort.waitingIntro.from: Each learner once, at the earliest step they cannot open.

cohort.progress.from: Where the cohort has got to
