cohort.progressIntro.text: Tše di butšwego le tše di fedišitšwego ka mogato o mongwe le o mongwe, le nako yeo e tšerego bao ba fedišitšego. Ke palogare ya bogare e sego palogare ya kakaretšo, gore moithuti a tee yo a nyametšego kgwedi tše mmalwa a se ke a uta moo bohle ba bangwe ba lego gona.
cohort.progressIntro.from: Opened and finished per step, and how long it took those who finished. The median rather than the average, so one learner who disappeared for a term does not hide where everybody else is.

cohort.stalledOne.text: Mogato o tee o na le batho bao ba dutšego go wona: {steps}.
cohort.stalledOne.from: One step has people sitting on it: {steps}.

cohort.stalledMany.text: Megato e {count} e na le batho bao ba dutšego go yona: {steps}.
cohort.stalledMany.from: {count} steps have people sitting on them: {steps}.

cohort.rolloutIntro.text: Dikopano tšeo di nago le matšatši tšeo sehlopha se kopanago ka tšona, le rejistara yeo e tšewago kopanong e nngwe le e nngwe. Moo lenaneo le nago le dikrediti, le swanetše go hlahlwa ke mohlahli, gomme ye ke bohlatse bja gore e bile bjalo.
cohort.rolloutIntro.from: The dated sessions this cohort meets for, and the register taken at each. Where a programme carries credits it has to be facilitator-led, and this is the evidence that it was.

cohort.attendanceIntro.text: Kakaretšo e lekantšhwa le lenaneo ka moka; go fihla bjale e lekantšhwa le seo se swerwego ka nnete. Mathomong a lenaneo ye ya pele e nnyane kudu ka mo go se nago mohola gomme ye ya bobedi ke ya nnete, ka gona ka bobedi bja tšona di newa e sego gore go kgethwe e tee bakeng sa gago.
cohort.attendanceIntro.from: Overall is against the whole programme; to date is against what has actually been held. Early in a programme the first is meaninglessly low and the second is the honest one, so both are given rather than one being chosen for you.

cohort.held.text: Dikopano tše {held} ka {countable} di swerwe. Dikopano tšeo di khansetšwego le batho ba tsenago ka boithaopo ga ba akaretšwe go ka bobedi.
cohort.held.from: {held} of {countable} sessions held. Cancelled sessions and voluntary walk-ins are left out of both.

cohort.feedbackIntro.text: A romelwa ka morago ga tlhahlobo ya go phetha, a arabja ka gare ga diiri tše {hours}. Ga go yo a amogelago gore o amogetše gomme ga go yo a ngwalago selo: go amogela ke mothalo gomme pego ke potšišo.
cohort.feedbackIntro.from: Sent after a summative, answered within {hours} hours. Nobody acknowledges receipt and nobody transcribes anything: receipt is a row and the report is a query.

cohort.assessmentIntro.text: Moithuti o mongwe le o mongwe kgahlanong le mošomo o mongwe le o mongwe wo o hlahlobjwago, ka tatelano yeo o kgobokanywago ka yona. O balwa go tšwa go ditlhagišo, diphetho le direjistara e sego go bolokwa ka diatla, ka gona ga o kgone go fapana le tšona.
cohort.assessmentIntro.from: Every learner against every piece of assessed work, in the order it is collected. Read from submissions, decisions and registers rather than kept by hand, so it cannot disagree with them.

cohort.absentNote.text: O ka ntle o balwa go tšwa go rejistara ya kopano yeo mošomo o ngwadilwego go yona, e sego go tšwa go tlhagišo, ka gobane moithuti yo a sa tsenego ga a na tlhagišo yeo e ka rekhotwago go yona.
cohort.absentNote.from: Absent is read from the register of the sitting the work was written at, not from the submission, because a learner who did not attend has no submission for it to be recorded on.

cohort.workIntro.text: Seo se swanetšego go direga go dikologa go ruta: thepa e lokišitšwe, ditokomane di rometšwe, modereitara o kgethilwe, ditifikeiti di latelwa.
cohort.workIntro.from: What has to happen around the teaching: material readied, documents submitted, a moderator appointed, certificates chased.

cohort.releaseIntro.text: E bolokwa e le matšatši go tloga go thoma. Fetola letšatši la go thoma gomme se sengwe le se sengwe sa tše se šuthela le lona.
cohort.releaseIntro.from: Held as days from the start. Change the start date and every one of these moves with it.

cohort.noSteps.text: {course} ya sehlopha se ga e na megato le ga bjale.
cohort.noSteps.from: This cohort's {course} has no steps yet.

cohort.membersIntro.text: Go oketša motho mo le gona go mo ngwadiša go {course}. Leina rejistareng la motho yo a ka se bulego selo ke seemo sa seripa seo se se phemago.
cohort.membersIntro.from: Adding somebody here also enrols them on the {course}. A name on a register who cannot open anything is the half-state this avoids.

cohort.nobody.text: Ga go yo a oketšwego le ga bjale.

cohortCtl.noSteps.text: Khoso ya sehlopha se ga e na megato le ga bjale, ka gona ga go selo sa go beakanya.
cohortCtl.noSteps.from: This cohort's course has no steps yet, so there is nothing to schedule.

cohortCtl.closesAfter.text: E tswalwa matšatši ka morago ga letšatši la go fela

cohortCtl.closesLabel.text: {step}: e tswalwa matšatši ka morago ga letšatši la go fela

cohortCtl.dayZero.text: Letšatši la 0 ke letšatši la go thoma. Ge o tlogela mothalo o se na selo, mogato woo ga o na matšatši ka moka; o bulega ge feela se sengwe le se sengwe seo se tlago pele ga wona se fedile.
cohortCtl.dayZero.from: Day 0 is the start date. Leave a row empty and that step carries no dates at all; it opens as soon as whatever comes before it is done.

cohortCtl.everybody.text: Bohle ba nago le akhaonto ya moithuti ba šetše ba le sehlopheng se. Laletša batho ba bangwe go tšwa sekirining sa Batho pele.
cohortCtl.everybody.from: Everybody with a learner account is already on this cohort. Invite more people from the People screen first.

askFeedback.none.text: Ga go yo a botšišitšwego le ga bjale.

payment.referenceNote.text: Gore e ka swanišwa le seo bahlokomedi ba ditšhelete ba nago le sona.
payment.referenceNote.from: So it can be matched to what finance holds.

tasks.status.not_yet_started.text: Ga se ya thoma le ga bjale

tasks.nothing.text: Ga go selo se latelwago le ga bjale.

tasks.progress.text: {done} ka {counted} di dirilwe: {percent}%. Mošomo wo o khansetšwego o tlogelwa go ka bobedi bja dikarolo, ka gona go tlogela mošomo go se thuše goba go se gobatše palo.
tasks.progress.from: {done} of {counted} done: {percent}%. Cancelled work is left out of both halves, so abandoning a task neither helps nor hurts the figure.

rollout.nothing.text: Ga go selo se rulagantšwego le ga bjale. Moo lenaneo le nago le dikrediti, le swanetše go hlahlwa ke mohlahli, ka gona mo ke moo bohlatse bja gore e bile bjalo bo thomago.
rollout.nothing.from: Nothing scheduled yet. Where a programme carries credits it has to be facilitator-led, so this is where the evidence that it was begins.

rollout.inPerson.text: Ka go ba gona ka mmele

rollout.announced.text: Sehlopha le mohlahli ba botšwa ka ga kopano e nngwe le e nngwe beke pele ga yona, ka nako ya yona le kgokagano, gomme ba botšwa gape ge e šuthišwa, e khansetšwa goba e kgutlišetšwa morago.
rollout.announced.from: The cohort and the facilitator are told about each session a week before it, with its time and link, and told again if it is moved, cancelled or postponed.

archive.intro.text: Ge moithuti a swere setatemente sa gagwe sa diphetho gomme setifikeiti sa gagwe sa kwalifikeišene go tšwa go mokgatlo wa go efa dikwalifikeišene se rekhotilwe letlakaleng la gagwe la go itokišetša EISA, Faele ya gagwe ya Bohlatse e ka tloga sethaleng ka polokelo e tee yeo o e bolokago. Polokelo e bulega ka sebadi sefe goba sefe sa web ntle le sethaleng. Ga go selo se tlošwago go fihlela kopi ya gago yeo e bolokilwego e lekotšwe kgahlanong le yona, gomme rekhoto e nngwe le e nngwe e dula mo, e re polokelo efe e swere difaele.
archive.intro.from: Once a learner holds their statement of results and their qualification certificate from the awarding body has been recorded on their EISA readiness page, their Portfolio of Evidence can leave the platform in one archive that you keep. The archive opens in any browser without the platform. Nothing is removed until your stored copy has been checked against it, and every record stays here, saying which archive holds the files.

archive.readyFor.text: Baswere ba setatemente sa diphetho le setifikeiti sa kwalifikeišene bakeng sa {qualification}.
archive.readyFor.from: Holding a statement of results and the qualification certificate for {qualification}.

archive.noQualification.text: Khoso ya sehlopha se ga e balele go kwalifikeišene efe goba efe.
archive.noQualification.from: This cohort's course counts towards no qualification.

archive.nobody.text: Ga go yo le ga bjale.

archive.anotherBuilding.text: Polokelo e nngwe e a ngwalwa. Thoma e latelago ge e fedile.
archive.anotherBuilding.from: Another archive is being written. Start the next one when it has finished.

archive.notYetIntro.text: Ba dula sethaleng gomme ba latela polokelong ya ka moragorago ge setifikeiti sa bona sa kwalifikeišene se šetše se rekhotilwe.
archive.notYetIntro.from: They stay on the platform and follow in a later archive once their own qualification certificate has been recorded.

archive.step1.text: 1. E tsenye fase gomme o e boloke

archive.step1Note.text: E boloke moo pholisi ya gago ya direkhoto e bolelago gore direkhoto tša baithuti di bolokwa gona, ka nako ka moka ya polokelo. Ge difaele di tlošitšwe, ye ke kopi e tee feela e feletšego.
archive.step1Note.from: Keep it where your records policy says learner records are kept, for the full retention period. Once the files are removed, this is the only complete copy.

archive.step2.text: 2. Lekola kopi yeo o e bolokilego

archive.step3.from: 3. Remove the files from the platform

archive.building.text: Go a ngwalwa. Letlakala le a ikutolla.
archive.building.from: Being written. This page updates by itself.

archive.checkLabel.text: Lekola kopi ya gago yeo e bolokilwego

archive.checkNote.text: Kgetha polokelo moo o e bolokilego gona. E balwa ka khomphuthara ye gomme ga e tsenywe godimo; ke monwana wa yona wa dijithale feela o romelwago. Polokelo e na le bytes tše {bytes}.
archive.checkNote.from: Choose the archive from where you stored it. It is read on this computer and not uploaded; only its fingerprint is sent. The archive is {bytes} bytes.

archive.stored.text: Kopi yeo ke e lekotšego e bolokilwe moo pholisi ya rena ya direkhoto e bolelago gore e swanetše go bolokwa gona.
archive.stored.from: The copy I checked is stored where our records policy says it should be kept.

archive.keepingOne.text: Tokomane e 1 ya go ngwadišwa e dula sethaleng le yona, ka gobane lenaneo le lengwe la moithuti le sa e hloka.
archive.keepingOne.from: 1 enrolment document stays on the platform as well, because another programme of the learner's still needs it.

archive.keeping.text: Ditokomane tše {count} tša go ngwadišwa di dula sethaleng le tšona, ka gobane lenaneo le lengwe la moithuti le sa di hloka.
archive.keeping.from: {count} enrolment documents stay on the platform as well, because another programme of the learner's still needs them.

archive.wrongSize.text: Faele yeo e na le bytes tše {size} gomme polokelo e na le {expected}. Ga se polokelo ye.
archive.wrongSize.from: That file is {size} bytes and the archive is {expected}. It is not this archive.

archive.couldNotStart.text: Go busetša ga se go kgone go thoma.

archive.pieceRefused.text: Karolo ya go tsenya godimo e ganetšwe.
archive.pieceRefused.from: A piece of the upload was refused.

archive.carryOn.text: {problem} Kgetha faele gape go tšwela pele moo e emilego gona.
archive.carryOn.from: {problem} Choose the file again to carry on from where it stopped.

archive.checkingFiles.text: Go lekola faele ye nngwe le ye nngwe…

archive.restoreNote.text: Se hlokega feela ge difaele tše di swanetše go ba sethaleng gape. Polokelo e tsenywa godimo, e lekolwa kgahlanong le monwana wa dijithale wo o tšerwego ge e be e dirwa, gomme faele e nngwe le e nngwe e bewa gape moo e bego e le gona.
archive.restoreNote.from: Only needed if these files have to be on the platform again. The archive is uploaded, checked against the fingerprint taken when it was made, and each file is put back where it was.

register.supervisedIntro.text: Bao ba amogetšwego, seo ba dumetšego go sona, le gore pampiri ya bona ya dikarabo e amogetšwe. Kopano ka noši e tšwela pele moo dilekcha tša gago di tšwelago pele gona; ye ke rekhoto ya ka fao e lebeletšwego.
register.supervisedIntro.from: Who was admitted, what they agreed to, and that their script was received. The meeting itself runs where your lectures do; this is the record of how it was supervised.

register.canInvigilate.text: Ye ke kopano ya go phetha, ka gona e ka lebeletšwa.
register.canInvigilate.from: This is a summative session, so it can be invigilated.

register.intro.text: Ke bomang bao ba bego ba le gona. Dintlha tšeo di bolokilwego di ka lokišwa ka morago, gomme phetogo e nngwe le e nngwe e rekhotwa kgahlanong le yo a e dirilego.
register.intro.from: Who was here. Saved marks can be corrected later, and every change is recorded against whoever made it.

register.nobody.text: Ga go yo a lego sehlopheng se le ga bjale, ka gona ga go rejistara ya go tšewa.
register.nobody.from: Nobody is on this cohort yet, so there is no register to take.

register.excusedNote.text: O lokolotšwe ke go ba ka ntle ka lebaka leo moabi a le amogetšego. E bolokwa e arotšwe le go ba ka ntle feela ka gobane tshepedišo ya thekgo ya moithuti e ithekgile ka phapano yeo.
register.excusedNote.from: Excused means absent for a reason the provider accepted. It is kept apart from a plain absence because the learner support procedure turns on the difference.

sitting.status.open.text: E butšwe bakeng sa go amogela

sitting.move.open.text: E butšwe bakeng sa go amogela

sitting.needsAssessment.text: Go ngwala tlhahlobo go lebeletšwe go nyaka tlhahlobo yeo e lebeletšwago. Phatlalatša e tee khosong pele, gomme e ka beakanywa mo.
sitting.needsAssessment.from: A supervised sitting needs an assessment to supervise. Publish one on the course first, and it can be set up here.

sitting.nothing.text: Ga go selo seo se lebeletšwago kopanong ye. E beakanye ge e le tlhahlobo ya go lebeletšwa; e go fa nako ya mafelelo ya go amogela, boipolelo, tekolo ya khamera, rejistara ya dipampiri tša dikarabo le log ya ditiragalo.
sitting.nothing.from: Nothing is being supervised at this session. Set one up if this is an invigilated assessment; it gives you an admission cut-off, a declaration, a camera check, a script register and an incident log.

sitting.setUp.text: Beakanya go ngwala tlhahlobo go lebeletšwe

sitting.invigilator.text: Molebeledi wa tlhahlobo (ka boithaopo, gomme o ka bewa ka letšatši leo)
sitting.invigilator.from: Invigilator (optional, and can be set on the day)

sitting.nobodyYet.text: Ga go yo le ga bjale

sitting.early.text: Bangwadi ba fihla metsotso e mekae pele
sitting.early.from: Candidates arrive this many minutes early

sitting.closesAfter.text: Go amogela go tswalwa metsotso e mekae ka morago ga go thoma
sitting.closesAfter.from: Admission closes this many minutes after the start

sitting.camera.text: Khamera e swanetše go dula e bulegile ka mo go feletšego
sitting.camera.from: A camera must be on throughout

sitting.materials.text: Seo se ka tlišwago ka gare (ka boithaopo)

sitting.materialsHint.text: Khalkhuleta yeo e sa rulaganywego le letlakala la difomula leo le filwego. Ga go selo se sengwe.
sitting.materialsHint.from: A non-programmable calculator and the issued formula sheet. Nothing else.

sitting.declaration.text: Seo mongwadi a se dumelelago pele a thoma (ka boithaopo)
sitting.declaration.from: What each candidate agrees to before starting (optional)

sitting.nothingFurther.text: Ga go selo se sengwe sa go dirwa mo.

room.elsewhere.text: Ke {time} {zone} moo o lego gona. Dinako tšeo di rekhotilwego mo ke tša moabi, e lego seo rekhoto e se bolokago.
room.elsewhere.from: That is {time} {zone} where you are. Times recorded here are the provider's, which is what the record keeps.

room.arrive.text: Bangwadi ba fihla metsotso e {minutes} pele.

room.closesAt.text: Go amogela go tswalwa metsotso e {minutes} ka morago ga go thoma, ka {time}; ka morago ga moo sethaleng se a gana, ka gobane yo a amogetšwego a diegile o ba le nako e telele le pampiri go feta bohle ba bangwe.
room.closesAt.from: Admission closes {minutes} minutes after the start, at {time}; after that the platform refuses, because somebody admitted late has had longer with the paper than everybody else.

room.closes.text: Go amogela go tswalwa metsotso e {minutes} ka morago ga go thoma; ka morago ga moo sethaleng se a gana, ka gobane yo a amogetšwego a diegile o ba le nako e telele le pampiri go feta bohle ba bangwe.
room.closes.from: Admission closes {minutes} minutes after the start; after that the platform refuses, because somebody admitted late has had longer with the paper than everybody else.

room.cameras.text: Dikhamera di dula di bulegile ka mo go feletšego.

room.joinNote.text: Seboka se tšwela pele sethaleng seo o se šomišago kgale. Seo se rekhotilwego mo ke ka fao go lebeletšwego ka gona.
room.joinNote.from: The meeting runs on the platform you already use. What is recorded here is how it was supervised.

room.noLink.text: Ga go kgokagano ya seboka kopanong ye le ga bjale. Oketša e tee peakanyong ya go hlagiša gore bangwadi ba tsebe moo ba yago gona.
room.noLink.from: No meeting link on this session yet. Add one on the roll-out so candidates know where to go.

room.incidentsNote.text: E rekhotwa ka letšatši leo. Pego yeo e ngwadilwego dibeke ka morago e na le mohola o monyane kudu boipiletšong, e lego felo feela moo e balwago gona.
room.incidentsNote.from: Filed on the day. An account written weeks later is worth very little at an appeal, which is the only place it is ever read.

quals.intro.text: Kwalifikeišene ya modiro e abja ka mehuta e meraro ya dimodula: Kwešišo, Bokgoni bja tirišo, le Maitemogelo a mošomo. Modula o mongwe le o mongwe o na le dikriteria tša wona tša tlhahlobo, gomme sistimi e lekola gore diteng tša khoso di akaretša e nngwe le e nngwe ya tšona pele khoso e ka phatlalatšwa.
quals.intro.from: An occupational qualification is delivered across three kinds of module: Knowledge, Practical skill, and Workplace experience. Each module has its own assessment criteria, and the system checks that course content covers every one of them before a course can be published.

quals.folderTitle.text: Goba e aga go tšwa go foldara
quals.folderTitle.from: Or build it from a folder

quals.folderIntro.text: Tšohle ka nako e tee: kharikhulamo, diyuniti tša go ithuta, ditlhahlo le dipholisi. Foldara yeo e akaretšago kakaretšo ya yona e tsenywa ka disekhondi; yeo e sego nayo e swanetše go rarolwa sebopego sa yona, gomme karolo yeo e nyaka keketšo ya AI.
quals.folderIntro.from: Everything at once: the curriculum, the study units, the guides and the policies. A folder that includes a summary of itself imports in seconds; one that does not has to have its structure worked out, and that is the part that needs an AI extension.

quals.folderLabel.text: Foldara ya kwalifikeišene, go tšwa khomphuthareng ya gago
quals.folderLabel.from: The qualification's folder, from your own computer

quals.folderHint.text: Se sengwe le se sengwe foldareng le difoldareng tša yona tše dinnyane se a balwa: kharikhulamo, diyuniti tša go ithuta, ditlhahlo le dipholisi.
quals.folderHint.from: Everything in the folder and its subfolders is read: the curriculum, the study units, the guides and the policies.

quals.folderHint2.text: Foldara yeo e agilwego ke sistimi ya gago ya tlhabollo ya lenaneo e akaretša kakaretšo ya yona, gomme yeo e balwa ka go lebanwa, ka disekhondi. Foldara yeo e se nago yona ga e kgone go rarolwa sebopego sa yona le ga bjale.
quals.folderHint2.from: A folder built by your programme development system includes a summary of itself, and that is read directly, in seconds. A folder without one cannot have its structure worked out yet.

quals.driveTitle.text: Goba go tšwa draiveng tšeo o di kgokagantšego
quals.driveTitle.from: Or from a drive you have connected

quals.driveIntro.text: Foldara e tee, e balwa moo e lego gona. E fela felong le lengwe: šišinyo leo le swanetšego go lekolwa pele go ngwalwa selo.
quals.driveIntro.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

quals.noneTitle.text: Ga go dikwalifikeišene le ga bjale

quals.noneManage.text: Aga e tee go tšwa ditokomaneng tša yona (thebe ya ka godimo): tokomane ya kharikhulamo le tokomane ya kwalifikeišene di a lekana, gomme ga go keketšo ya AI e šomišwago. Se sengwe le se sengwe se sengwe sethaleng se ithekgile ka kwalifikeišene, ka gona ye ke selo sa mathomo sa go dirwa.
quals.noneManage.from: Build one from its documents (the tab above): the curriculum document and the qualification document are enough, and no AI extension is involved. Everything else on the platform hangs off a qualification, so this is the first thing to do.

quals.noneRead.text: Ga go e tee e tsentšwego le ga bjale. Ge e tee e tsentšwe, kharikhulamo yeo o e rutago o be o e hlahloba e tla ba mo: dimodula tša yona, dihlogotaba tša yona le dikriteria tšeo engwe le e nngwe e hlahlobjwago ka tšona. Go tsenya e tee ke mošomo wa molaodi.
quals.noneRead.from: None has been loaded yet. When one has been, the curriculum you teach and mark against will be here: its modules, its topics and the criteria each one is assessed by. Loading one is an administrator's job.

how.title.text: O ka rata go e oketša bjang?
how.title.from: How would you like to add it?

how.intro.text: Ditsela tše tharo tša go tsena. Kgetha e tee gomme ke yona feela e bulegago; o ka e tswalela gape gomme wa kgetha e nngwe.
how.intro.from: Three ways in. Pick one and only that one opens; you can close it again and choose differently.

how.documents.summary.text: Tokomane ya kharikhulamo, tokomane ya kwalifikeišene ya SAQA le tshepedišo ya tlhahlobo. App e bala kharikhulamo ka moka go tšwa go tšona.
how.documents.summary.from: The curriculum document, the SAQA qualification document and the assessment specification. The App reads the whole curriculum out of them.

how.documents.needs.text: Difaele tše pedi goba tše tharo tša PDF goba tša Word.
how.documents.needs.from: Two or three PDFs or Word files.

how.documents.speed.text: Disekhondi. Ga go AI e šomišwago nakong efe goba efe.
how.documents.speed.from: Seconds. No AI involved at any point.

how.folder.summary.text: Tšohle ka nako e tee: kharikhulamo, diyuniti tša go ithuta, ditlhahlo, dipuku tša mošomo le dipholisi, di bewa ka fao di balwago ka gona.
how.folder.summary.from: Everything at once: the curriculum, the study units, the guides, the workbooks and the policies, filed as they are read.

how.folder.needs.text: Foldara ka moka ya kwalifikeišene, go tšwa khomphuthareng ya gago goba go tšwa go draiveng.
how.folder.needs.from: The qualification's whole folder, from your computer or a drive.

how.folder.speed.text: Metsotso. Foldara yeo e akaretšago kakaretšo ya yona ga e hloke AI; yeo e sego nayo e rarolwa sebopego sa yona, gomme karolo yeo e a e hloka.
how.folder.speed.from: Minutes. A folder that includes a summary of itself needs no AI; one that does not has its structure worked out, and that part does.

how.blank.summary.text: Kwalifikeišene e se nago selo yeo o e agago ka diatla: sehlogo, khoutu, legato le dikrediti, ka morago dimodula tša yona ye nngwe ka nako.
how.blank.summary.from: An empty qualification you build by hand: the title, the code, the level and credits, then its modules one at a time.

how.blank.needs.text: Dintlha tšeo o nago le tšona.
how.blank.needs.from: The details in front of you.

how.blank.speed.text: Nako ka moka yeo e e tšerego. Ga go selo se balwago bakeng sa gago.
how.blank.speed.from: As long as it takes. Nothing is read for you.

qual.noIdentifiers.text: Ga go dihlaodi tša semolao tšeo di rekhotilwego

manager.noneChosen.text: Ga go dimodula tšeo di kgethilwego le ga bjale

manager.none.text: Ga go dimodula le ga bjale

manager.drawnFrom.text: e tšerwe go {parent}, yeo e abelanago kharikhulamo le yona
manager.drawnFrom.from: drawn from {parent}, whose curriculum it shares

manager.standsAlone.text: e eme ka boyona, e na le kharikhulamo ya yona
manager.standsAlone.from: standing on its own, with its own curriculum

manager.parts.text: Dikarolo tšeo di tšerwego go se:

manager.criterionWhat.text: Seo moithuti a swanetšego go se laetša

manager.noneFromParent.text: Ga go dimodula tšeo di kgethilwego go tšwa kharikhulamong ya motswadi le ga bjale.
manager.noneFromParent.from: No modules chosen from the parent's curriculum yet.

manager.noModules.text: Ga go dimodula tša kharikhulamo le ga bjale.

manager.choose.text: Kgetha gore ke dimodula dife tša motswadi tšeo se di tšeago
manager.choose.from: Choose which of the parent's modules this takes

manager.chooseNote.text: Dimodula ga di oketšwe mo. Se se tšea kharikhulamong ya motswadi wa sona, ka gona mošomo wa moithuti kgahlanong le modula o balwa gatee go sa kgathale gore o kopane le wona kae.
manager.chooseNote.from: Modules are not added here. This draws from its parent's curriculum, so a learner's work against a module counts once wherever they met it.

manager.whichNote.text: Tokomane ya SAQA e bolela gore ke efe. Nyaka {field} letlakaleng la yona la mathomo.
manager.whichNote.from: The SAQA document says which. Look for {field} on its first page.

manager.standsOnOwn.text: Ga go selo: e eme ka boyona
manager.standsOnOwn.from: Nothing: it stands on its own

manager.fullOwn.text: Kwalifikeišene e feletšego e na le kharikhulamo ya yona.
manager.fullOwn.from: A full qualification carries its own curriculum.

manager.sharesNote.text: E abelana kharikhulamo ya kwalifikeišene yeo gomme e tšea seripa sa dimodula tša yona; o kgetha gore ke dife, ge e šetše e le gona.
manager.sharesNote.from: It shares that qualification's curriculum and takes a subset of its modules; you choose which, once it exists.

manager.codeFull.text: Bjalo ka ge e ngwadilwe tokomaneng ya kharikhulamo. E ka se šetšwe le ka mohla: ke QCTO goba OFO feela tšeo di ka bolelago gore ke eng.
manager.codeFull.from: As written on the curriculum document. Never worked out: only the QCTO or the OFO can say what it is.

manager.codePart.text: Khoutu e swanago le ya kwalifikeišene yeo e e tšerego go yona. Di abelana kharikhulamo e tee, ka gona di abelana le khoutu ya yona.
manager.codePart.from: The same code as the qualification it comes from. They share one curriculum, so they share its code.

manager.accreditationNote.text: Nomoro yeo kwalifikeišene ye e amogetšwego ka gare ga yona. Lengwalo le tee la go amogela gantši le akaretša dikwalifikeišene tše dintši, ka gona ye ga se ka mehla e swanago le nomoro ya moabi ka noši. E tlogele e se na selo gomme ditlaleho di boela go ya ka ya moabi gomme di bolela bjalo.
manager.accreditationNote.from: The number this qualification is accredited under. One accreditation letter usually covers several qualifications, so this is not always the same as the provider's own number. Leave it blank and reports fall back to the provider's and say so.

fromDoc.source.curriculum.note.text: Dimodula, dihlogotaba le dikriteria tša ka gare tša tlhahlobo.
fromDoc.source.curriculum.note.from: The modules, topics and internal assessment criteria.

fromDoc.source.qualification.note.text: Sešupo sa bongwadišo bja SAQA. Ke mothopo o tee feela wa SAQA ID le Dipheto tša Maemo a go Tšwa.
fromDoc.source.qualification.note.from: The SAQA registration extract. The only source of the SAQA ID and the Exit Level Outcomes.

fromDoc.source.assessmentSpecification.n.text: Tshepedišo ya EISA. E bolokilwe le go bewa lenaneong gore e ka nyakwa.
fromDoc.source.assessmentSpecification.n.from: The EISA specification. Filed and indexed so it is searchable.

fromDoc.open.text: Aga e tee go tšwa ditokomaneng tša yona

fromDoc.intro.text: Tše tharo tše ke motheo wo se sengwe le se sengwe se agilwego godimo ga wona. Di tsenye godimo gomme App e bala dintlha tša kwalifikeišene, Dipheto tša yona tša Maemo a go Tšwa le kharikhulamo ya yona ka moka go tšwa go tšona. Lekola seo e se hweditšego, lokiša se sengwe le se sengwe seo e se fošitšego, gomme se ngwalwa ka nako e tee.
fromDoc.intro.from: These three are the foundation everything else is built on. Upload them and the App reads the qualification's details, its Exit Level Outcomes and its whole curriculum out of them. Check what it found, correct anything it got wrong, and it is written in one go.

fromDoc.pressThis.text: Bjale kgotla se. Ga go selo se ngwadilwego le ga bjale.
fromDoc.pressThis.from: Now press this. Nothing is written yet.

fromDoc.stillReading.text: Go sa balwa: disekhondi tše {seconds}. Tokomane ya kharikhulamo e telele; se ke sa tlwaelo.
fromDoc.stillReading.from: Still reading: {seconds} seconds. A curriculum document is long; this is normal.

fromDoc.found.text: Go badilwe dimodula tše {modules}, dihlogotaba tše {topics}, methalo ya go ruta ye {elements} le dikriteria tše {criteria} tša tlhahlobo.
fromDoc.found.from: Read {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} assessment criteria.

fromDoc.foundWithElo.text: Go badilwe dimodula tše {modules}, dihlogotaba tše {topics}, methalo ya go ruta ye {elements} le dikriteria tše {criteria} tša tlhahlobo, gotee le Dipheto tše {outcomes} tša Maemo a go Tšwa tšeo di nago le dikriteria tše {associated} tšeo di amanago le tšona.
fromDoc.foundWithElo.from: Read {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} assessment criteria, plus {outcomes} Exit Level Outcomes with {associated} associated criteria.

fromDoc.partOf.text: Tokomane ya yona e re ye ke {kind} yeo e tšerwego go {parent}. Ga go selo se tlago kopolwa: e abelana kharikhulamo ya kwalifikeišene yeo gomme e tšea dimodula tše {count} tša yona.
fromDoc.partOf.from: Its document says this is a {kind} drawn from {parent}. Nothing will be copied: it shares that qualification's curriculum, and takes {count} of its modules.

fromDoc.alreadyWhy.text: Go tsenya kharikhulamo gape go tla šuthiša yeo e nago le yona, gomme se sengwe le se sengwe seo se swailwego kgahlanong le kriteria se tla sepela le yona. Seo o ka se ratago ke go oketša seo se hlokegago (thepa, goba dikarolo tša kharikhulamo tšeo di sego tša tsena), seo se dirwago kwalifikeišeneng ka noši gomme sa se ke sa ama selo seo se šetšego se le gona.
fromDoc.alreadyWhy.from: Importing the curriculum again would replace the one it has, and anything tagged to a criterion would go with it. What you probably want is to add what is missing (the material, or the parts of the curriculum that never made it), which is done on the qualification itself and leaves everything already there untouched.

fromDoc.openIt.text: E bule, gomme o oketše seo se hlokegago
fromDoc.openIt.from: Open it, and add what is missing

fromDoc.noQualDoc.text: (ga go Tokomane ya Kwalifikeišene yeo e filwego)

fromDoc.modulesFound.text: Dimodula tše {count} tšeo e di hweditšego

fromDoc.outcomes.text: Dipheto tše {count} tša Maemo a go Tšwa

fromDoc.createPart.text: E hlame, o šomiša kharikhulamo ya motswadi wa yona
fromDoc.createPart.from: Create it, drawing on its parent's curriculum

fromDoc.filedPart.text: Tokomane ya yona ya Kwalifikeišene e bolokilwe kgahlanong le yona. Tokomane ya kharikhulamo le tshepedišo ya tlhahlobo ga di bolokwe: ke tša kwalifikeišene yeo e e tšerego go yona, gomme di šetše di bolokilwe kua.
fromDoc.filedPart.from: Its own Qualification Document is filed against it. The curriculum document and the assessment specification are not: they belong to the qualification it comes from, and are already filed there.

fromDoc.filed.text: Tokomane ye nngwe le ye nngwe yeo o e filego e bolokilwe kgahlanong le kwalifikeišene, gore modereitara a bule mothopo wa kriteria efe goba efe, le gore kgoro ya go loka e kgotsofatšwe pele thepa e ngwalwa.
fromDoc.filed.from: Every document you supplied is filed against the qualification, so a moderator can open the source of any criterion, and so the readiness gate is satisfied before material is authored.

docKind.workbook_memorandum.text: Memorandamo ya go swaya puku ya mošomo

docKind.summative_memorandum.text: Memorandamo ya go swaya tlhahlobo ya go phetha

docKind.workplace_signoff.text: Letlakala la go saena la mošomong

docKind.learning_programme_guide.text: Tlhahlo ya lenaneo la go ithuta

qualPage.step.curriculumDone.text: Dimodula tše {modules}, dikriteria tše {criteria} tša tlhahlobo, tšeo di badilwego go tšwa ditokomaneng tša kwalifikeišene ka noši.
qualPage.step.curriculumDone.from: {modules} modules, {criteria} assessment criteria, read from the qualification's own documents.

qualPage.step.curriculumTodo.text: Ga go selo mo se ka rutwago goba sa hlahlobja go fihlela dimodula tša sona di le gona.
qualPage.step.curriculumTodo.from: Nothing here can be taught or assessed until its modules exist.

qualPage.step.unitsDone.text: Diyuniti tše {count}, modula o mongwe le o mongwe o bewa go yuniti e tee.
qualPage.step.unitsDone.from: {count} units, with every module placed in one.

qualPage.step.unitsNone.text: Kharikhulamo e phatlalatša dimodula gomme ga e bolele selo ka fao o ka di kgobokanyago ka gona, ka gona ke wena o swanetšego go kgetha. Tokomane ya gago ya kopantšho e e dira ka go tsenya godimo gatee: Word goba Excel.
qualPage.step.unitsNone.from: The curriculum publishes modules and says nothing about how you group them, so this is yours to decide. Your alignment document does it in one upload: Word or Excel.

qualPage.step.unitsSomeOne.text: Modula o 1 ga o ye go yuniti le ga bjale. Modula woo yuniti ya go ithuta e sa o abjego ke modula woo go se nago yo a o rutago.
qualPage.step.unitsSomeOne.from: 1 module belongs to no unit yet. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches.

qualPage.step.unitsSome.text: Dimodula tše {count} ga di ye go yuniti le ga bjale. Modula woo yuniti ya go ithuta e sa o abjego ke modula woo go se nago yo a o rutago.
qualPage.step.unitsSome.from: {count} modules belong to no unit yet. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches.

qualPage.step.materialDone.text: Ditlhahlo tša teori, dipuku tša mošomo le ditlhahlobo tše {count} di bolokilwe.
qualPage.step.materialDone.from: {count} theory guides, workbooks and assessments filed.

qualPage.step.materialTodo.text: Ditlhahlo tša teori, dipuku tša mošomo le ditlhahlobo. Foldara ka moka e tsenywa gatee, ditlhahlo tša dikarabo di lemogwa gomme di thibelwa baithuti, gomme ga go AI e šomišwago nakong efe goba efe.
qualPage.step.materialTodo.from: The theory guides, workbooks and assessments. The whole folder goes in at once, answer guides are recognised and withheld from learners, and no AI is involved at any point.

qualPage.step.captureDone.text: Tše {count} ka moka di tšerwe. Baithuti ba ka di araba sekirining.
qualPage.step.captureDone.from: All {count} captured. Learners can answer them on screen.

qualPage.step.captureTodo.text: {captured} ka {total} di tšerwe. Tše dingwe ke difaele tšeo moithuti a ka di tsenyago fase feela.
qualPage.step.captureTodo.from: {captured} of {total} captured. The rest are files a learner can only download.

qualPage.summary.text: {modules} dimodula · {criteria} dikriteria tša ka gare tša tlhahlobo · {weighting}

qualPage.weighted.text: di lekantšhitšwe {k}/{p}/{w} bjalo ka ge go boletšwe tokomaneng
qualPage.weighted.from: weighted {k}/{p}/{w} as stated in the document

qualPage.notWeighted.text: ga go go lekantšha ga dikarolo go boletšwego; go itokišetša go e hwetša go tšwa go dikrediti
qualPage.notWeighted.from: no component weighting stated; readiness derives it from credits

qualPage.partOf.text: Kwalifikeišene ya karolo yeo e tšerwego go {parent}, yeo e abelanago kharikhulamo le yona. Ga go selo se kopolwago, ka gona mošomo wa moithuti kgahlanong le modula o balwa gatee go sa kgathale gore o kopane le wona kae.
qualPage.partOf.from: A part qualification drawn from {parent}, whose curriculum it shares. Nothing is copied, so a learner's work against a module counts once wherever they met it.

qualPage.chooseModules.text: Kgetha gore ke dimodula dife tšeo e di tšeago

qualPage.addIntro.text: Se sengwe le se sengwe seo se tsenyago selo. Seo se šetšego se le mo se ka thebeng e nngwe.
qualPage.addIntro.from: Everything that puts something in. What is already here is on the other tab.

qualPage.finish.text: Feleletša kwalifikeišene ye go tšwa foldareng e feletšego kudu
qualPage.finish.from: Finish this qualification from a fuller folder

qualPage.finishLabel.text: Foldara e feleditšwego ya kwalifikeišene ye, go tšwa khomphuthareng ya gago
qualPage.finishLabel.from: The completed folder for this qualification, from your own computer

qualPage.finishHint.text: Bakeng sa kwalifikeišene yeo e tsentšwego pele ditokomane tša yona di ka feletša. Foldara ka moka e balwa gape (kharikhulamo le thepa) gomme ke seo se sego gona feela se oketšwago.
qualPage.finishHint.from: For a qualification that was loaded before its documents were complete. The whole folder is read again (the curriculum as well as the material) and only what is missing is added.

qualPage.finishHint2.text: Ga go selo seo se šetšego se le mo se fetolwago goba se šuthišwago, go fihla go mantšu a kriteria e tee, gomme go e dira gabedi ga go dire selo la bobedi. O sa bona se sengwe le se sengwe seo e se hweditšego gomme wa se tiišetša pele se sengwe sa sona se ngwalwa.
qualPage.finishHint2.from: Nothing already here is changed or replaced, down to the wording of a single criterion, and running it twice does nothing the second time. You still see everything it found and confirm it before any of it is written.

qualPage.finishDrive.text: Goba foldara e feleditšwego go tšwa draiveng yeo o e kgokagantšego. E tlatša ka mokgwa o swanago: ke seo se sego gona feela se oketšwago.
qualPage.finishDrive.from: Or the completed folder from a drive you have connected. It tops up the same way: only what is missing is added.

qualPage.materialHere.text: Thepa e tla mo: foldara ka moka ka nako e tee. Ga go selo se bolokwago go fihlela o bone seo se hweditšwego.
qualPage.materialHere.from: The material goes here: the whole folder at once. Nothing is saved until you have seen what it found.

qualPage.wholeFolder.text: Foldara ka moka ka nako e tee

qualPage.materialLabel.text: Foldara ya thepa, go tšwa khomphuthareng ya gago
qualPage.materialLabel.from: A folder of material, from your own computer

qualPage.materialHint.text: Ditlhahlo tša teori le dipuku tša mošomo di ya yuniting ya go ithuta yeo leina la faele le e bolelago, dipholisi le dikonteraka di ya polokelong ya ditokomane, gomme se sengwe le se sengwe se se šetšego se ya kgahlanong le kwalifikeišene ye. Ga go AI e šomišwago mo le gatee: go arola ditokomane ka maina ke molao e sego kahlolo.
qualPage.materialHint.from: Theory guides and workbooks go to the study unit their filename names, policies and contracts to the document library, and everything else against this qualification. No AI is used here at all: sorting documents by name is a rule rather than a judgement.

qualPage.whereItLives.text: Goba foldara moo e lego gona
qualPage.whereItLives.from: Or the folder where it already lives

qualPage.alignmentHere.text: Tokomane ya gago ya kopantšho e ya mo: e kgethe, beakanya mohuta wa yona go Curriculum Alignment Matrix, gomme o e tsenye godimo. Seo se aga diyuniti tša go ithuta.
qualPage.alignmentHere.from: Your alignment document goes here: choose it, set its kind to Curriculum Alignment Matrix, and upload. That builds the study units.

qualPage.blueprintIntro.text: Faele yeo e hlalosago kharikhulamo ye ka mo go nepagetšego: dimodula tše {count}, le dihlogotaba tša tšona, seo e nngwe le e nngwe e se rutago le seo e nngwe le e nngwe e hlahlobjwago ka sona. E bee foldareng ya {folder} ya foldara ya kwalifikeišene gomme tsenyo e nngwe le e nngwe ya foldara yeo ka morago e e bala ka go lebanwa, ka disekhondi, ntle le keketšo ya AI nakong efe goba efe.
qualPage.blueprintIntro.from: A file describing this curriculum exactly: {count} modules, with their topics, what each teaches and what each is assessed by. Put it in the qualification folder's {folder} directory and every import of that folder afterwards reads it straight off, in seconds, with no AI extension involved at any point.

qualPage.notCarried.text: Seo faele e sa se rwareng
qualPage.notCarried.from: What the file does not carry

qualPage.notCaptured.text: Dimodula tše {count} ka {total} ga di na dikriteria le ga bjale.
qualPage.notCaptured.from: {count} of {total} modules have no criteria yet.

qualPage.notCapturedWhy.text: Ga go yo a ka bolelwago a loketše EISA kgahlanong le kwalifikeišene ye go fihlela tokomane ka moka ya kharikhulamo e ngwadilwe; modula wo o se nago dikriteria o ka se hlolwe, ka gona go o tlogela o se na selo go tla dira gore moithuti yo mongwe le yo mongwe a bonagale a feditše.
qualPage.notCapturedWhy.from: Nobody can be declared ready for the EISA against this qualification until the whole curriculum document has been transcribed; a module with no criteria cannot be failed, so leaving them empty would make every learner look finished.

qualPage.structureIntro.text: Kharikhulamo e phatlalatša dimodula; moabi o ruta diyuniti tša go ithuta. Yuniti e nngwe le e nngwe e kgobokanya dimodula tša Kwešišo, Tirišo le Maitemogelo a Mošomo tšeo di hlankelago Phetho e tee ya Maemo a go Tšwa, e lego seo Tlhahlobo ya Kopantšwego ya Go Phetha ya ka Ntle e beilwego kgahlanong le sona. Baabi ba babedi ba ka kgobokanya kwalifikeišene e tee ka mekgwa e fapanego gomme ka bobedi ba nepa, ka gona ye ke sebopego sa moabi e sego sa kharikhulamo.
qualPage.structureIntro.from: The curriculum publishes modules; a provider teaches study units. Each bundles the Knowledge, Practical and Work Experience modules that serve one Exit Level Outcome, which is what the External Integrated Summative Assessment is set against. Two providers may group the same qualification differently and both be correct, so this is the provider's structure rather than the curriculum's.

qualPage.seeAsLearner.text: E bone bjalo ka ge moithuti a tla e bona
qualPage.seeAsLearner.from: See it as a learner will

qualPage.seeAsLearnerNote.text: e bontšha lenaneo ka moka ka tatelano yeo le sepelwago ka yona, gomme selo seo moithuti a ka se se hwetšego se a bolelwa. Ga go selo se thomilwego gomme ga go selo se rekhotilwego.
qualPage.seeAsLearnerNote.from: shows the whole programme in the order it is walked, with anything a learner would not find named. Nothing is started and nothing is recorded.

qualPage.nextStep.text: Mogato o latelago: kgobokanya dimodula tše go diyuniti tša go ithuta.
qualPage.nextStep.from: The next step: group these modules into study units.

qualPage.nextStepWhy.text: Kharikhulamo e phatlalatša dimodula gomme ga e bolele selo ka diyuniti tša go ithuta, ka gobane go di kgobokanya ke kgetho ya moabi ka noši, ka gona kwalifikeišene yeo e badilwego go tšwa ditokomaneng tša yona e tla le dimodula ka moka tše {count} tša yona di se na felo. Se se letetšwe, e sego phošo ya go tsenya.
qualPage.nextStepWhy.from: The curriculum publishes modules and says nothing about study units, because grouping them is the provider's own decision, so a qualification read from its documents arrives with all {count} of its modules unplaced. That is expected, not a fault in the import.

qualPage.nextStepHow.text: Tsenya tokomane ya gago ya kopantšho: yeo e bontšhago Phetho e nngwe le e nngwe ya Maemo a go Tšwa le dimodula tša yona, ka Word goba Excel. E hlama diyuniti tša go ithuta, e di file maina, gomme e bea modula o mongwe le o mongwe woo e o akaretšago.
qualPage.nextStepHow.from: Upload your alignment document: the one mapping each Exit Level Outcome to its modules, in Word or Excel. It creates the study units, names them, and places every module it covers.

qualPage.unplacedOne.text: Modula o 1 ga o ye yuniting ya go ithuta.
qualPage.unplacedOne.from: 1 module belongs to no study unit.

qualPage.unplaced.text: Dimodula tše {count} ga di ye yuniting ya go ithuta.
qualPage.unplaced.from: {count} modules belong to no study unit.

qualPage.unplacedWhy.text: {modules}. Modula woo yuniti ya go ithuta e sa o abjego ke modula woo go se nago yo a o rutago, go sa kgathale gore kharikhulamo ya wona e tšerwe ka botlalo gakaakang.
qualPage.unplacedWhy.from: {modules}. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches, however completely its curriculum has been captured.

qualPage.elo.text: Phetho ya Maemo a go Tšwa {number}

qualPage.noElo.text: Ga e amane le Phetho efe ya Maemo a go Tšwa
qualPage.noElo.from: Aligned to no Exit Level Outcome

qualPage.eisaTests.text: Dikriteria tša tlhahlobo tšeo di amanago: seo EISA e se lekolago
qualPage.eisaTests.from: Associated assessment criteria: what the EISA tests

qualPage.noModules.text: Yuniti ye ya go ithuta ga e abe dimodula.
qualPage.noModules.from: This study unit delivers no modules.

qualPage.unitMaterial.text: Thepa yeo e bolokilwego kgahlanong le yuniti ye

qualPage.documentsIntro.text: Tše di bolokilwego mo ke dikopi tša maleba: ditokomane tša mothopo tšeo kwalifikeišene ye e agilwego go tšona, e nngwe le e nngwe e kgokagantšwe le karolo ya kharikhulamo yeo e e hlankelago gomme e na le monwana wa dijithale gore go ka bontšhwa gore ga se ya fetolwa.
qualPage.documentsIntro.from: Filed here are the authoritative copies: the source documents this qualification is built from, each attached to the part of the curriculum it serves and hashed so it can be proved unchanged.

qualPage.recordNotThing.text: Puku ya mošomo goba tlhahlobo yeo e bolokilwego mo ke rekhoto, e sego selo seo moithuti a se šomelago.
qualPage.recordNotThing.from: A workbook or an assessment filed here is a record, not the thing a learner works on.

qualPage.recordWhy.text: Tšeo di balwa gomme di bontšhwa sekirining, gore moithuti a arabe sethaleng gomme mohlahli a swaye a be a fe maikutlo moo. Tsenya tokomane ya Word ka tlase ga Tšea e sego mo, gomme e fetoga dipotšišo ka noši. Dipuku tša tlhahlo, ditlhahlo le maleatla a go saena a mošomong ke tše di fapanego: di dula e le ditokomane, ka gobane mohlahli o di ngwala dintlha gomme mokoutši o di saena ka pampiri.
qualPage.recordWhy.from: Those are read in and presented on screen, so a learner answers in the platform and a facilitator marks and comments there. Upload the Word document under Capture rather than here, and it becomes the questions themselves. Handbooks, guides and workplace sign-off sheets are different: they stay as documents, because a facilitator annotates them and a coach signs them on paper.

qualPage.noDocuments.text: Ga go ditokomane tšeo di swerwego le ga bjale.

qualPage.notTranscribed.text: Ga se ya ngwalwa go tšwa tokomaneng ya kharikhulamo le ga bjale.
qualPage.notTranscribed.from: Not yet transcribed from the curriculum document.

qualPage.iac.text: Dikriteria tša ka gare tša tlhahlobo: seo se swanetšego go fihlelelwa
qualPage.iac.from: Internal assessment criteria: what must be achieved

qualPage.workplaceNone.text: Ga go dikriteria tša tlhahlobo, e lego seo se nepagetšego bakeng sa maitemogelo a mošomo: a netefatšwa ke rekhoto e saenilwego ya mošomo e sego ka go ahlolwa kgahlanong le dikriteria.
qualPage.workplaceNone.from: No assessment criteria, which is right for work experience: it is proved by a signed record of the work rather than judged against criteria.

qualPage.neverAchieved.text: Ga go dikriteria tša tlhahlobo, ka gona hlogotaba ye e ka se fihlelelwe le ka mohla.
qualPage.neverAchieved.from: No assessment criteria, so this topic can never be achieved.

removeQual.cannot.text: Kwalifikeišene ye ga e kgone go tlošwa

removeQual.cannotWhy.text: Dilo di rekhotilwe kgahlanong le yona, gomme sethaleng se a di boloka. Ke tšeo tlhahlobo ya QCTO e di botšišago, gomme di phela go feta kwalifikeišene yeo di rekhotilwego ka fase ga yona.
removeQual.cannotWhy.from: Things have been recorded against it, and the platform keeps them. They are what a QCTO audit asks about, and they outlive the qualification they were recorded under.

removeQual.canWhy.text: Ga go selo se rekhotilwego kgahlanong le yona (ga go moithuti yo a ngwadišitšwego, ga go nako ya go ngwala yeo e ngwadišitšwego gomme ga go Setatemente sa Diphetho seo se filwego) ka gona e ka tlošwa. Se ga se kgone go boelwa.
removeQual.canWhy.from: Nothing has been recorded against it (no learner is enrolled, no sitting is registered and no Statement of Results has been issued) so it can be removed. This cannot be undone.

removeQual.wouldTake.text: E tla tšea {items} le yona, gotee le hlogotaba e nngwe le e nngwe, karolo, kriteria le tokomane yeo e bolokilwego ka fase ga tšona.
removeQual.wouldTake.from: It would take {items} with it, along with every topic, element, criterion and filed document beneath them.

removeQual.remove.text: E tloše ka mo go sa fetogego

captureList.intro.text: Tše di šetše di le sethaleng. Go tšea e tee go bala dipotšišo tša yona go tšwa faeleng ya Word gomme e swanišetša tlhahlo ya dikarabo yeo e bolokilwego kgauswi le yona; ga go selo se tsenywago godimo gape. Seo e se šišinyago se bontšhwa go wena pele se sengwe sa sona se ba tlhahlobo.
captureList.intro.from: These are already in the platform. Capturing one reads its questions out of the Word file and pairs the answer guide filed beside it; nothing is uploaded again. What it proposes is shown to you before any of it becomes an assessment.

captureList.all.text: Tše {count} ka moka di tšerwe. Baithuti ba ka di araba sekirining.
captureList.all.from: All {count} captured. Learners can answer these on screen.

captureList.noGuide.text: ga go tlhahlo ya dikarabo yeo e bolokilwego: potšišo e nngwe le e nngwe e ka hloka karabo ya yona le maraka ka diatla
captureList.noGuide.from: no answer guide filed: every question would need its answer and marks by hand

uploader.kindNote.text: Matrikse a kopantšho ya kharikhulamo a a balwa gape a bolokwa: seo a se bolelago ka mothalo o mongwe le o mongwe wa kharikhulamo se a rekhotwa.
uploader.kindNote.from: A curriculum alignment matrix is read as well as stored: what it says about each curriculum line is recorded.

uploader.titleHint.text: Ge o e tlogetše e se na selo, leina la faele le a šomišwa
uploader.titleHint.from: Left blank, the file name is used

uploader.versionNote.text: Go tsenya godimo gape ka mohuta o swanago le sehlogo go tšea felo ga yeo ya pele e sego go e šuthiša; phetolelo ya kgale e a dula.
uploader.versionNote.from: Uploading again with the same kind and title supersedes the previous one rather than replacing it; the old version stays.

uploader.fileNote.text: Word, Excel, PowerPoint le PDF. Seo faele e lego sona ka nnete se tšwa go diteng tša yona, e sego leina la yona.
uploader.fileNote.from: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF. What the file actually is comes from its contents, not its name.

uploader.inMatrix.text: Matriksing, e sego kharikhulamong bjalo ka ge e swerwe
uploader.inMatrix.from: In the matrix, not in the curriculum as held

uploader.inMatrixNote.text: E nngwe le e nngwe e oketšwa e swailwe e le ya gago, ka lebaka le bontšhwago, gore monetefatši a kgone go fapantšha methalo ya gago le ya mokgatlo wa taolo ka mehla. Tloša letshwao go se sengwe le se sengwe seo se sa swanelago go oketšwa.
uploader.inMatrixNote.from: Each is added marked as your own, with the reason shown, so a verifier can always tell your lines from the regulator's. Untick anything that should not be added.

uploader.add.text: Oketša methalo yeo e swailwego kharikhulamong
uploader.add.from: Add the ticked lines to the curriculum

buildCurr.intro.text: E tsenye bjalo ka ge tokomane ya kharikhulamo e e gatišitše, ka dikhoutu tše di swanago ka tatelano e swanago, gore tše pedi di ka balwa ka thoko ga tše dingwe. Mothalo o mongwe le o mongwe o a bolokwa ge o o tsenya.
buildCurr.intro.from: Enter it as the curriculum document prints it, with the same codes in the same order, so the two can be read side by side. Every line saves as you enter it.

buildCurr.fromDocument.text: Thoma go tšwa tokomaneng ya kharikhulamo

buildCurr.ready.text: Go loketše thepa. Dimodula tše {modules} le dikriteria tše {criteria} di ka gare, ka gona potšišo e ka swaiwa go seo e se hlatsetšago.
buildCurr.ready.from: Ready for material. {modules} modules and {criteria} criteria are in, so a question can be tagged to what it evidences.

buildCurr.notReady.text: Ga se ya loka bakeng sa thepa le ga bjale.

buildCurr.whatItIsNote.text: E beilwe ge e be e tsenywa, gomme e ka lokišwa mo. Kwalifikeišene e feletšego e na le kharikhulamo ya yona; kwalifikeišene ya karolo goba lenaneo la mabokgoni e kgetha dimodula go e nngwe.
buildCurr.whatItIsNote.from: Set when it was imported, and correctable here. A full qualification has its own curriculum; a part or a skills programme selects modules from one.

buildCurr.faultsNote.text: Ga se mojako: o ka tloga wa boa. Le ge go le bjalo, se sengwe le se sengwe sa tše ke selo seo sethala se ka se kgonego go se phema ka morago.
buildCurr.faultsNote.from: Not a gate: you can leave and come back. Each of these, though, is something the platform cannot work around later.

addModule.note.text: Modula wa maitemogelo a mošomo o netefatšwa ke puku ya direkhoto yeo mokoutši a e saenago, e sego ke dikriteria tša tlhahlobo, ka gona o tšea mešomo ya mošomong.
addModule.note.from: A work experience module is evidenced by a logbook a coach signs, not by assessment criteria, so it takes work activities instead.

addModule.nameHint.text: Ka fao tokomane ya kharikhulamo e se bitšago ka gona
addModule.nameHint.from: As the curriculum document titles it

editor.removeTopic.text: Tloša {code} le se sengwe le se sengwe se se lego go yona?

editor.addElement.text: Oketša mothalo wa seo se swanetšego go rutwa
editor.addElement.from: Add a line of what must be taught

editor.wordedHint.text: Ka fao tokomane ya kharikhulamo e se ngwadilego ka gona
editor.wordedHint.from: As the curriculum document words it

editor.noCriteria.text: Modula wa maitemogelo a mošomo ga o na tše dingwe. O netefatšwa ke puku ya direkhoto yeo mokoutši a e saenago gomme mohlahlobi a e amogelago, ka gona mešomo ya wona ya mošomong e ya dihlogotabeng tša ka godimo.
editor.noCriteria.from: A work experience module carries none. It is evidenced by a logbook the coach signs and an assessor accepts, so its work activities go in the topics above.

editor.criterionText.text: Seo moithuti a swanetšego go se bontšha

elementKind.contextual_knowledge.text: Tsebo ya mošomong ya boemo bja go šoma

reclassify.lockedOne.text: Se ka se fetolwe: moithuti e 1 o ngwadišitšwe go sona. Go ngwadišwa go dirwa ka ID ya lenaneo, gomme go fetola seo se lego sona go ka fetola dimodula tšeo ba hlahlobjwago kgahlanong le tšona, ka gona le seo ba swanetšego go se dira gore ba fetše. Ge e ba e le nnete gore ke mohuta o fošagetšego, hlama o nepagetšego gomme o ba ngwadiše go wona.
reclassify.lockedOne.from: It cannot be changed: 1 learner is enrolled on it. Enrolment is per programme ID, and changing what this is would change which modules they are assessed against, and so what they have to do to finish. If it is genuinely the wrong sort of thing, create the right one and enrol them onto that.

reclassify.locked.text: Se ka se fetolwe: baithuti ba {count} ba ngwadišitšwe go sona. Go ngwadišwa go dirwa ka ID ya lenaneo, gomme go fetola seo se lego sona go ka fetola dimodula tšeo ba hlahlobjwago kgahlanong le tšona, ka gona le seo ba swanetšego go se dira gore ba fetše. Ge e ba e le nnete gore ke mohuta o fošagetšego, hlama o nepagetšego gomme o ba ngwadiše go wona.
reclassify.locked.from: It cannot be changed: {count} learners are enrolled on it. Enrolment is per programme ID, and changing what this is would change which modules they are assessed against, and so what they have to do to finish. If it is genuinely the wrong sort of thing, create the right one and enrol them onto that.

reclassify.parentNote.text: Karolo ga e na tokomane ya yona ya kharikhulamo: e diriša ya motswadi wa yona, gomme e kgetha dimodula go yona.
reclassify.parentNote.from: A part has no curriculum document of its own: it uses its parent's, and selects modules from it.

reclassify.ownModulesOne.text: Kwalifikeišene ye e na le modula o 1 wa kharikhulamo ya yona, go tloga ge e be e tsenywa. O dula moo o lego gona: go e rekhoda e le karolo ga go o phumole, gomme o kgetha ka go fapana gore ke dimodula dife tša motswadi tšeo e di kgethago.
reclassify.ownModulesOne.from: This qualification has 1 module of its own curriculum, from when it was imported. It stays where it is: recording it as a part does not delete it, and you choose separately which of the parent's modules it selects.

reclassify.ownModules.text: Kwalifikeišene ye e na le dimodula tše {count} tša kharikhulamo ya yona, go tloga ge e be e tsenywa. Tšeo di dula moo di lego gona: go e rekhoda e le karolo ga go di phumole, gomme o kgetha ka go fapana gore ke dimodula dife tša motswadi tšeo e di kgethago.
reclassify.ownModules.from: This qualification has {count} modules of its own curriculum, from when it was imported. Those stay where they are: recording it as a part does not delete them, and you choose separately which of the parent's modules it selects.

reclassify.selectedOne.text: Modula o 1 wo o kgethilwego go tšwa go motswadi o tla phumolwa. Kwalifikeišene e feletšego ga e kgethe selo go mang le mang, gomme go o tlogela go tla o dira gore o dule o balwa go dikrediti tša yona.
reclassify.selectedOne.from: The 1 module selected from its parent will be cleared. A full qualification selects nothing from anybody, and leaving it would keep it counting towards its credits.

reclassify.selected.text: Dimodula tše {count} tšeo di kgethilwego go tšwa go motswadi di tla phumolwa. Kwalifikeišene e feletšego ga e kgethe selo go mang le mang, gomme go di tlogela go tla di dira gore di dule di balwa go dikrediti tša yona.
reclassify.selected.from: The {count} modules selected from its parent will be cleared. A full qualification selects nothing from anybody, and leaving them would keep them counting towards its credits.

takeDoc.notesNote.from: What the reading could not account for, and what the document itself does not add up. Neither stops you taking a module, though both are worth reading first.

takeDoc.empty.from: Nothing was read under this module. Taking it will create the module alone, and its topics can be added by hand.

element.asWorded.text: {kind}, ka fao tokomane ya kharikhulamo e e ngwadilego ka gona. Ga go selo letlakaleng le seo se ka lokišwago mo: kharikhulamo yeo e phatlaladitšwego ke ya QCTO, e sego ya moabi.
element.asWorded.from: {kind}, exactly as the curriculum document words it. Nothing on this page may be edited here: a published curriculum is the QCTO's, not the provider's.

element.uncovered.text: Ga go selo seo se rekhotilwego e le se se e akaretšago.

element.uncoveredNote.text: Seo ke sekgoba sa nnete lenaneong goba matrikse ao a sego a tsenywa le ga bjale. Tsenya Matrikse a Kopantšho ya Kharikhulamo kgahlanong le kwalifikeišene ye, gomme mothalo o mongwe le o mongwe woo o o bolelago o tlatšwa ka nako e tee.
element.uncoveredNote.from: That is either a real gap in the programme or a matrix that has not been uploaded yet. Upload the Curriculum Alignment Matrix against this qualification and every line it names is filled in at once.

element.notHeld.text: o bolelwa matriksing, eupša ga go tokomane yeo e bolokilwego mo yeo e nago le leina leo.

element.assessedNote.text: Dikriteria tša ka gare tša tlhahlobo tša hlogotaba yeo mothalo wo o e lego wa yona.
element.assessedNote.from: The internal assessment criteria of the topic this line belongs to.

element.workplace.text: Modula wa maitemogelo a mošomo ga o na dikriteria tša tlhahlobo. Seo o se nyakago se netefatšwa ke rekhoto yeo e saenwego ya mošomo ka noši, yeo e amogetšwego ke mohlahlobi, e sego ke go ahlolwa kgahlanong le dikriteria.
element.workplace.from: A work experience module has no assessment criteria. What it requires is evidenced by a signed record of the work itself, accepted by an assessor, rather than judged against criteria.

element.noCriteria.text: Hlogotaba ye ga e na dikriteria tša tlhahlobo, ka gona ga go selo mo se ka fihlelwago ka mohla. Go fihlela di tšewa go tšwa tokomaneng ya kharikhulamo, ga go moithuti yo a ka phethago modula wo.
element.noCriteria.from: This topic has no assessment criteria, so nothing here can ever be achieved. Until they are captured from the curriculum document, no learner can complete this module.

element.taughtNote.text: Diyuniti tša go ithuta tšeo modula wo o gafwago go tšona.

partModules.introPart.text: Kwalifikeišene ye ya karolo e tšerwe go {parent} gomme e abelana kharikhulamo le yona{code}. Swaya dimodula tšeo tokomane ya yona ya SAQA e di badišago ka fase ga {rules}. Ga go selo se kopolwago: mošomo wa moithuti kgahlanong le modula o balwa gatee, go sa kgathale gore o kopane le wona kae.
partModules.introPart.from: This part qualification is drawn from {parent} and shares its curriculum{code}. Tick the modules its own SAQA document lists under {rules}. Nothing is copied: a learner's work against a module counts once, wherever they met it.

partModules.introOther.text: Lenaneo le le tšerwe go {parent} gomme le abelana kharikhulamo le yona{code}. Swaya dimodula tšeo tokomane ya lona ya SAQA e di badišago ka fase ga {rules}. Ga go selo se kopolwago: mošomo wa moithuti kgahlanong le modula o balwa gatee, go sa kgathale gore o kopane le wona kae.
partModules.introOther.from: This programme is drawn from {parent} and shares its curriculum{code}. Tick the modules its own SAQA document lists under {rules}. Nothing is copied: a learner's work against a module counts once, wherever they met it.

partModules.notReadNote.from: There is nothing to choose from until {parent} has its curriculum document read in. Do that first, and this list fills itself.

partModules.noCredits.text: Ga go dikrediti tšeo di rekhotilwego

partModules.noClaim.text: Ga go palomoka ya dikrediti yeo e rekhotilwego kwalifikeišeneng ye, ka gona ga go selo sa go bapetša le sona. Tokomane ya yona ya SAQA e bolela e tee ka fase ga Dikrediti tša Bonyane.
partModules.noClaim.from: No credit total is recorded for this qualification, so there is nothing to check against. Its SAQA document states one under Minimum Credits.

partModules.agree.text: Tše di a swana, ke pontšho ya gore dimodula tše di nepagetšego di swailwe.
partModules.agree.from: These agree, which is the sign the right modules are ticked.

partModules.disagree.text: Tše ga di swane. Goba modula o swailwe woo tokomane ya SAQA e sa o badišego, goba wo e o badišago o a hlaka, goba dikrediti tša modula di badilwe ka phošo. Go loketše go lekola pele o boloka; sethala se tla dula se boloka seo o se botšago sona.
partModules.disagree.from: These do not agree. Either a module is ticked that the SAQA document does not list, or one it lists is missing, or the credits on a module were read in wrongly. Worth checking before saving; the platform will still save what you tell it.

partModules.save.text: Boloka dimodula tšeo se di tšeago

courseEdit.folderNote.from: Choose the folder this material lives in and everything in it, including its subfolders, is read, filed and indexed. You see what it would file before anything is written.

courseEdit.folderHint2.text: Sebopego ga se hlamelwe mo: sebopego sa sona se agilwe ka sengwading sa ka godimo goba go tšwa go dimodula tša kwalifikeišene. Se se bea faeleng seo se nago le sona.

spine.intro.text: Tatelano yeo {course} ye e sepelwago ka yona, le seo se tswalelago mogato o mongwe le o mongwe go fihlela o o e lego pele ga ona o dirilwe. Se sengwe le se sengwe mo se šetše se swerwe kgahlanong le {course} ye: go se bea lenaneong ke go dira gore moithuti a se kopane le sona.
spine.intro.from: The order this {course} is walked in, and what holds each step shut until the one before it is done. Everything here is already held against this {course}: putting it on the list is what makes a learner meet it.

spine.empty.text: Ga go selo mo le ga bjale, ka gona moithuti yo a ngwadišitšwego go yona o tla e bula gomme a hwetše letlakala le se nago selo. Oketša selo sa mathomo ka fase.

spine.waitsForBefore.text: E emetše gore mogato wo o lego pele ga wona o be {rule}.
spine.waitsForBefore.from: Waits for the step before it to be {rule}.

spine.nothingLeft.text: Se sengwe le se sengwe seo se swerwego kgahlanong le yona se šetše se lenaneong. Rekhoda puku ya mošomo goba o bee tokomane faeleng kgahlanong le yona, gomme e tla tšwelela mo.

courseAssess.intro.text: Kwiz ya tlhabollo e a swaiwa ka bo yona. Tlhahlobo ya go phetha e ahlolwa ka mehla ke motho gomme e dula e modereitwa ka ntle, ka gobane ke yeo e balwago go kwalifikeišene.
courseAssess.intro.from: A formative quiz is marked automatically. A summative assessment is always judged by a person and always moderated independently, because it is the one that counts towards a qualification.

courseAssess.assesses.text: Seo potšišo ye e se hlahlobago

courseAssess.noCriterion.text: Ga e kgokagane le kriteria efe

courseAssess.options.from: Answer options: tick every one that is correct

courseAssess.allModerated.text: phetho e nngwe le e nngwe e a modereitwa

courseAssess.published.text: E phatlaladitšwe. Moithuti o kopana le yona ge e šetše e le mogato go {link}.
courseAssess.published.from: Published. A learner meets it once it is a step in {link}.

courseAssess.typeQuiz.text: Kwiz: e swaiwa ka bo yona

courseAssess.typeEvidence.text: Bohlatse: moithuti o tsenya mošomo godimo

courseAssess.summative.text: Ya go phetha: e a balwa, e dula e modereitwa

courseAssess.sampleEvery.text: Phetho e nngwe le e nngwe

courseAssess.sampleNote.text: Ke bonyane, e sego bokgolo. Bogolo bja sehlopha bo bo namelela: sehlopha sa batho ba lesome goba ba ba fokolago se modereitwa ka botlalo gomme sa ba masomepedi goba ba ba fokolago se modereitwa ka halofo, ka gobane kotara ya dipampiri tše seswai ke tše pedi, gomme tše pedi di bolela selo se fokolago kudu ka kahlolo ya mohlahlobi. Palo ye e laola dihlopha tšeo di fetago masomepedi. E a hlokomologwa tlhahlobong ya go phetha, moo phetho e nngwe le e nngwe e modereitwago, gomme mohlahlobi yo mofsa yo a ngwadišitšwego o dula a modereitwa ka botlalo.
courseAssess.sampleNote.from: A floor, not a ceiling. Cohort size raises it: a cohort of ten or fewer is moderated in full and one of twenty or fewer at half, because a quarter of eight scripts is two, and two say almost nothing about an assessor's judgement. This figure governs cohorts above twenty. Ignored for a summative assessment, where every decision is moderated, and a newly registered assessor is always moderated in full.

courseEnrol.draft.text: Se ke sengwalwa sa pele. Se swanetše go phatlalatšwa pele mang le mang a ka abelwa go sona: sengwalwa sa pele ga se a fetela dipatlisiso tšeo di netefatšago gore diteng tša sona di akaretša seo se se bolelago.
courseEnrol.draft.from: This is still a draft. It has to be published before anyone can be assigned to it: a draft has not passed the checks that confirm its content covers what it claims to.

courseEnrol.waitingNote.text: Moithuti yo mongwe le yo mongwe o tšwelela gatee, mogatong wa pele woo a ka se kgonego go o bula. Go tshwarwa mogatong wa boraro ke nnete yeo e swanetšego go dirwa selo ka yona; go tshwarwa le megatong ya bone go ya go lesome ke lešata.
courseEnrol.waitingNote.from: Each learner appears once, at the earliest step they cannot open. Being held up at step three is the fact worth acting on; also being held up at steps four to ten is noise.

settings.intro.from: How {name} looks to your people, and how the App reads the documents they upload. Changes apply everywhere immediately: there is nothing to rebuild or redeploy.
