settings.sso.text: Go tsena ka Google goba Microsoft
settings.sso.from: Signing in with Google or Microsoft

settings.ssoNote.text: Se dumelela batho ba gago go tsena ka akhaonto ya mokgatlo wa bona ya Google goba Microsoft legatong la phasewete mo, yeo e tšwelago pele e šoma gotee le yona. Se tsenya feela batho bao ba šetšego ba na le akhaonto sethaleng se, ba swantšhwa ka aterese ya emeile ka lekga la mathomo; ga se e hlame le ka mohla.
settings.ssoNote.from: Lets your people sign in with their organisation's Google or Microsoft account instead of a password here, which keeps working beside it. It only signs in people who already have an account on this platform, matched by email address the first time; it never creates one.

settings.terminology.text: Seo o se bitšago ka gona

settings.terminologyNote.text: Diriša mantšu a gago. Moabi yo a lego ka ntle ga Afrika Borwa a ka se re lenaneo, gomme yo a lego ka gare ga yona a ka se re khoso; sethala ga se swanela go gapeletša.
settings.terminologyNote.from: Use your own vocabulary. A provider outside South Africa may not say programme, and a provider inside it may not say course; the platform should not insist.

settings.templatesNote.text: Ka fao tokomane e nngwe le e nngwe yeo moabi yo a e ntšhago e balwago le go bonagala ka gona.
settings.templatesNote.from: How each document this provider issues reads and looks.

settings.templatesMoved.text: bjale di ka fase ga Taolo, gotee le tokomane e nngwe le e nngwe yeo sethala se e tšweletšago le gore ke mang yo a amogelago e nngwe le e nngwe.
settings.templatesMoved.from: now under Management, with every document the platform produces and who receives each one.

settings.menuNote.text: Beakanya gape bara ya ka godimo: fetola leina la hlogo, šuthiša letlakala ka fase ga hlogo e nngwe, goba o dire gore letlakala e be kgokagano ya go toba. Go swana go bohle bao ba lego go moabi yo, ka gobane bašomi ba botšana gore dilo di kae.
settings.menuNote.from: Rearrange the bar at the top: rename a heading, move a page under a different one, or make a page a direct link. The same for everybody at this provider, because staff tell each other where things are.

settings.drives.text: Mafelo a gago a go boloka difaele

settings.drivesNote.text: Bala foldara ka go toba go tšwa go Google Drive goba OneDrive, legatong la go e tsenya fase gomme wa e tsenya godimo gape. Ke a gago e sego a moabi yo: modiri yo mongwe le yo mongwe wa bašomi o kgokagana ka a gagwe.
settings.drivesNote.from: Read a folder straight from Google Drive or OneDrive, instead of downloading it and uploading it again. Yours rather than this provider's: every member of staff connects their own.

settings.extensionNote.text: Kgahlanong le profaele ya gago. Ka boithaopo, e tima ka kamehla, gomme seo e go dumelelago go se dira se lekanyeditšwe ke karolo ya gago go swana le se sengwe le se sengwe.
settings.extensionNote.from: Against your own profile. Optional, off by default, and what it lets you do is bounded by your role exactly as everything else is.

providerLang.note.text: Polelo yeo batho ba gago ba balago sethala ka yona, ge e se gore ba kgetha ya bona ka fase ga leina la bona godimo ga letlakala. Dikirini tšeo di sa fetolelwago di dula ka Seisemane, gomme maina a gago a dilo (Dipeakanyo, Mareo) a bolokwa ka fao o a ngwadilego ka gona ka dipolelo ka moka.
providerLang.note.from: The language your people read the platform in, unless they choose their own under their name at the top of the page. Screens not yet translated stay in English, and your own names for things (Settings, Terminology) are kept as you wrote them in every language.

brand.system.text: Sistimi ya Taolo ya Go Ithuta

brand.accentNote.text: Dilo tšeo di gatelelwago, dibara tša tšwelopele le mellwane ya ditifikeiti.
brand.accentNote.from: Highlights, progress bars and certificate borders.

brand.logoNote.text: Le tšwelela hlogong, letlakaleng la go tsena le go setifikeiti se sengwe le se sengwe. PNG yeo e nago le bokamorago bjo bo bonalago e lego kgauswi le mmala wa hlogo. Ka fase ga 2 MB.
brand.logoNote.from: Appears in the header, on the sign-in page and on every certificate. A PNG with a transparent background sits best on the header colour. Under 2 MB.

brand.notAccepted.text: Seswantšho seo ga se a amogelwa.

brand.unfinished.text: Go tsenya godimo ga se a fela. Lekola kgokagano gomme o leke gape.
brand.unfinished.from: The upload did not finish. Check the connection and try again.

brand.removeLogo.text: Tloša, gomme o bontšhe leina legatong la lona
brand.removeLogo.from: Remove, and show the name instead

brand.logoAddress.text: Goba aterese, ge e ba seswantšho se šetše se le lefelong le lengwe
brand.logoAddress.from: Or an address, if the image is already hosted elsewhere

brand.signInNote.text: Ka boithaopo. Ge go se na selo mo, letlakala le bontšha leina la gago mmalong wa gago, seo se kgethegilego eupša se le bonolo. Seswantšho seo se bolelago selo sa nnete ka seo o se dirago se bohlokwa go feta seo se hlabišago fela.
brand.signInNote.from: Optional. With nothing here the page shows your name on your own colour, which is tidy but plain. A graphic that says something true about what you do is worth more than a decorative one.

brand.characterNote.text: Se tšwelela sekirining seo se se nago selo le ga bjale, kgauswi le polelo yeo e hlalošago seo se ka bago gona, le kgauswi le konope yeo motho a swanetšego go e gata ka morago, moo se lego gona gore se lemogwe. Se senyane, se eme ka go otlologa, gomme se botsana go feta ge se hlabiša fela. Se tlogele se se na selo gore o diriše sa sethala se, goba se se ke sa hlaga le gatee.
brand.characterNote.from: Appears on a screen with nothing on it yet, beside the sentence explaining what would be there, and beside a button somebody has to press next, where it is there to be noticed. Small, upright, and friendlier than it is decorative. Leave it empty to use this platform's own, or nothing at all.

brand.straplineHint.text: Kgahlego ya go ithuta bophelo ka moka

shape.intro.text: Dipotšišo tše pedi di laola sebopego sa sethala sa gago le gore dikarolo tša sona di bitšwa eng. Se sengwe le se sengwe seo o sa se kgethego se a tlogela: dikirini tša sona, dilo tša menyu ya sona le diaterese tša sona.
shape.intro.from: Two questions decide the shape of your platform and what its parts are called. Everything you do not choose goes away: its screens, its menu entries and its addresses.

shape.nothingDeleted.text: Ga go selo seo se phumolwago.

shape.nothingDeletedNote.text: Go fetola se go uta dilo. Seo se šetšego se rekhotilwe se dula moo se lego gona, gomme go se kgetha gape go busetša dikirini le direkhoto di sa lahlegelwa ke selo.
shape.nothingDeletedNote.from: Changing this hides things. Whatever has already been recorded stays where it is, and choosing it again brings the screens back with the records intact.

shape.saved.text: Go bolokilwe. Menyu le mantšu di fetogile go swana.
shape.saved.from: Saved. The menu and the wording have changed to match.

shape.unavailable.text: Ga se gona ka kgetho ya ka godimo. Yuniti ya go ithuta e ka gare ga kwalifikeišene, gomme sethala se ga se na e tee.
shape.unavailable.from: Not available with the choice above. A study unit sits inside a qualification, and this platform has none.

shape.standalone.text: Dilo tše tharo tšeo di ikemetšego
shape.standalone.from: Three things that stand on their own

shape.statutoryCovers.text: Dithwalo tša NLRD le Edu.Dex, ditlhagišo tša WSP le ATR, le rejistara ya semolao yeo e di thekgago.
shape.statutoryCovers.from: NLRD and Edu.Dex exports, WSP and ATR returns, and the statutory register behind them.

shape.statutoryWhen.text: o ka ntle ga Afrika Borwa, goba motho yo mongwe a e romela legatong la gago.
shape.statutoryWhen.from: you are outside South Africa, or somebody else files on your behalf.

shape.workplaceCovers.text: Dikwano tša mošomong, ditlhahlo tša bakoutši, dipampiri tša go saena le diiri tšeo moithuti a di rekhodago kgahlanong le mothwadi wa mošomo.
shape.workplaceCovers.from: Workplace agreements, coach guides, sign off sheets and the hours a learner logs against a host employer.

shape.workplaceWhen.text: ga go selo seo o se abago seo se hlahlobjwago lefelong la mošomo.
shape.workplaceWhen.from: nothing you deliver is assessed in a workplace.

shape.offline.text: Go šoma ntle le tshupetšo ya inthanete

shape.offlineCovers.text: Baithuti ba tsenya sethala mogaleng wa bona, ba tsenya fase thepa ya bona ya go ithuta pele ba tšwa, ba e bala ntle le tshupetšo, gomme ba rekhoda mošomo wa bona gore ba o romele morago ge ba na le tshupetšo gape.
shape.offlineCovers.from: Learners install the platform on their phone, download their study material before they go out, read it with no signal, and record their work to send back when they next have one.

shape.offlineWhen.text: baithuti ba feta matšatši ba se na tshupetšo, go swana le mafelong a bjang. Ditlhahlobo tša go phetha di dula inthaneteng ge e se gore lenaneo le beilwe ka mo go fapanego ka boomo.
shape.offlineWhen.from: learners spend days away from a signal, such as in the field. Summatives stay online unless a programme is deliberately set otherwise.

shape.rename.text: O ka fetola leina la se sengwe le se sengwe sa tše ka fase ga {link}. Ke mantšu feela ao sebopego se a šomišago ao a neelwago mo.
shape.rename.from: You can rename any of these under {link}. Only the words this shape actually uses are offered there.

shape.renameLink.text: Seo o se bitšago ka gona

shape.save.text: Boloka seo sethala se lego sona

shape.award.qualification_programme.cove.text: Selo se tee. Moithuti o bewa go kwalifikeišene gomme ke yona yeo a e šomago. Ga go legoro le lengwe la go kopanya godimo ga yona.
shape.award.qualification_programme.cove.from: One thing. A learner is put onto the qualification and that is what they work through. There is no separate bundling layer above it.

shape.award.qualification_programme.when.text: O abela kwalifikeišene e tee ya modiro e le lenaneo le tee la go ithuta.
shape.award.qualification_programme.when.from: You deliver one occupational qualification as one learning programme.

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: Kwalifikeišene le Lenaneo, ka go arogana
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: Qualification and Programme, separately

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: Dilo tše pedi tše di fapanego. Kwalifikeišene e swara kamogelo le kharikhulamo; lenaneo le kopanya seo moithuti a se šomago, gomme le ka araba kwalifikeišeneng goba le se arabe efe.
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: Two different things. A qualification holds the accreditation and the curriculum; a programme bundles what a learner works through, and may answer to a qualification or to none.

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: O tsamaišetša dikwalifikeišene tšeo di amogetšwego gomme o kopanya le dilo tšeo o di abago ka dihlopha tšeo e sego kwalifikeišene e tee e nngwe le e nngwe.
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: You run accredited qualifications and also bundle deliverables into sequences that are not one qualification each.

shape.award.programmes_only.covers.text: Mananeo a kopanya seo moithuti a se šomago. Ga go rekhoto ya kamogelo, ga go kharikhulamo, ga go ditatemente tša diphetho.
shape.award.programmes_only.covers.from: Programmes bundle what a learner works through. No accreditation record, no curriculum, no statements of results.

shape.award.programmes_only.when.text: Ga go selo seo o se abago seo se arabago kwalifikeišeneng yeo e ngwadišitšwego: tlhahlo ya go tsena, ditsošološo tša go obamela melao, mananeo a ka gare a mabokgoni.
shape.award.programmes_only.when.from: Nothing you deliver answers to a registered qualification: induction, compliance refreshers, internal skills programmes.

shape.award.standalone.label.text: Ga go le ge e le efe

shape.award.standalone.covers.text: Se sengwe le se sengwe se ipoeletša. Ga go selo seo se se kopanyago gomme ga go selo seo se se amogelago.
shape.award.standalone.covers.from: Everything stands on its own. Nothing bundles it and nothing accredits it.

shape.award.standalone.when.text: Karolo e nngwe le e nngwe ya tlhahlo yeo o e tsamaišago e tšewa ka boyona, e tee ka nako.
shape.award.standalone.when.from: Every piece of training you run is taken on its own, one at a time.

shape.delivery.courses.covers.text: Khoso ke seo moithuti a bewago go sona gomme a se šoma: dithuto tša yona, dipuku tša yona tša mošomo, ditlhahlobo tša yona. E ka ba ka fase ga lenaneo, gomme ga e hloke go araba kwalifikeišeneng efe.
shape.delivery.courses.covers.from: A course is what a learner is put onto and works through: its lessons, its workbooks, its assessments. It may sit under a programme, and it need answer to no qualification.

shape.delivery.courses.when.text: Batho ba gago ba re khoso, goba o aga tlhahlo yeo e sa laolwego ke kwalifikeišene efe.
shape.delivery.courses.when.from: Your people say course, or you build training that no qualification governs.

shape.delivery.study_units.covers.text: Yuniti ya go ithuta ke seo moithuti a se šomago, gomme e šomiša legatong la khoso ka botlalo. E ka gare ga kwalifikeišene, e kopanya dimodula tša kwešišo, tša tirišo le tša lefelo la mošomo tšeo di šomelago sephetho se tee sa maemo a go tšwa.
shape.delivery.study_units.covers.from: A study unit is what a learner works through, and it replaces the course entirely. It sits inside a qualification, bundling the knowledge, practical and workplace modules that serve one exit level outcome.

shape.delivery.study_units.when.text: Batho ba gago ba re yuniti ya go ithuta e sego khoso. Kharikhulamo e phatlalatša dimodula gomme e tlogela kopanyo go wena, ka gona ke sebopego sa gago. E nyaka kwalifikeišene godimo.
shape.delivery.study_units.when.from: Your people say study unit rather than course. The curriculum publishes modules and leaves the grouping to you, so this is your own structure. Requires a qualification at the top.

shape.note.qualificationProgramme.text: Selo se tee. Moithuti o bewa go kwalifikeišene, gomme ke lona lenaneo leo a le šomago.
shape.note.qualificationProgramme.from: One thing. A learner is put onto the qualification, and that is the programme they work through.

shape.note.qualification.text: Rekhoto ya kamogelo: kharikhulamo ya yona, dikriteria le dipheto tša maemo a go tšwa.
shape.note.qualification.from: The accreditation record: its curriculum, criteria and exit level outcomes.

shape.note.programmeWithQualification.text: Tatelano yeo e beakantšwego, yeo e ka arabago kwalifikeišeneng goba e sa arabe efe.
shape.note.programmeWithQualification.from: An ordered sequence, which may answer to a qualification or to none.

shape.note.programmeOnly.text: Tatelano yeo e beakantšwego, yeo e sa arabego kwalifikeišeneng efe yeo e ngwadišitšwego.
shape.note.programmeOnly.from: An ordered sequence, answering to no registered qualification.

shape.note.bottom.text: Seo moithuti a se šomago. Ga go selo ka fase ga sona.
shape.note.bottom.from: What a learner works through. There is nothing below it.

clock.note.text: Nako e nngwe le e nngwe yeo e beakantšwego ka nako ka App e bolela nako ye. Thuto ya nako ya 18:30 ke 18:30 mo, gomme nako ya go tswalela go amogela ya go ngwala tlhahlobo yeo e lebeletšwego e ahlolwa kgahlanong le yona.
clock.note.from: Every timetabled time in the App means this clock. A lecture at 18:30 is 18:30 here, and an admission cut-off for an invigilated sitting is judged against it.

clock.both.text: Baithuti ba dinaga tše dingwe ba bona tšeo ka bobedi: nako ya gago, yeo rekhoto e e bolokago, le ya bona ka thoko ga yona, ka gona ga go yo a swanetšego go bala phapano a fošetše. Dinako tšeo di rekhotilwego ke tša gago ka mehla.
clock.both.from: Learners in other countries see both: your time, which is the one the record keeps, and their own alongside it, so nobody works out the difference themselves and gets it wrong. Recorded times are always yours.

mailTest.intro.text: E bula kgokagano ya seva ya poso gomme e a tsena, go lekola gore dintlha tša go tsena tša moithuti le ditsebišo di ka fihla ka nnete.
mailTest.intro.from: Opens a connection to the mail server and signs in, to check that learner sign-in details and notifications can actually be delivered.

mailTest.nothingSent.text: Ga go emeile yeo e rometšwego go mang le mang.
mailTest.nothingSent.from: No email is sent to anybody.

mailTest.notYours.text: Ga go selo mo seo o ka se fetolago letlakaleng le: seva ya poso e ya go tsenywa ga sethala. Fetišetša mothalo wa ka godimo go mang le mang yo a e hlokomelago.
mailTest.notYours.from: Nothing here is something you can change on this page: the mail server belongs to the deployment. Pass the line above to whoever maintains it.

mailTest.unconfigured.text: Ga go seva ya poso yeo e beakantšwego go tsenywa ga sethala se le ga bjale, ka gona se se tla bega seo e sego phošo ya akhaonto ya gago.
mailTest.unconfigured.from: No mail server is set up on this deployment yet, so this will report that rather than a fault with your account.

termsForm.why.practice.from: used across the sector, owned by nobody

termsForm.missing.text: Mantšu a mangwe ga a lenaneong le, gomme seo se dirilwe ka boomo.
termsForm.missing.from: Some words are not on this list, and that is deliberate.

termsForm.missingNote.text: Kwalifikeišene, modula wa kharikhulamo, sephetho sa boemo bja go tšwa, boemo bja NQF le tše dingwe di hlalošwa ke QCTO goba SAQA, e sego ke wena. Go fetola e nngwe ya tšona go be go bea mantšu sekirining sa moithuti le tlhagišong yeo molaodi wa melao a sa e lemogego, ka gona sethala se a a tiiša. O ka bala gore ke mang yo a hlalošago eng go {link}.
termsForm.missingNote.from: Qualification, curriculum module, exit level outcome, NQF level and the rest are defined by the QCTO or SAQA rather than by you. Renaming one would put wording on a learner's screen and on a submission that the regulator does not recognise, so the platform keeps them fixed. You can read who defines what in the {link}.

termsForm.note.course.text: Kgoboketšo e tee ya go ithuta yeo motho a ngwadišwago go yona.
termsForm.note.course.from: A single body of learning a person is enrolled onto.

termsForm.note.programme.text: Tatelano ya dikhoso tšeo di tšewago ka tatelano.
termsForm.note.programme.from: A sequence of courses taken in order.

termsForm.note.cohort.text: Sehlopha sa batho bao ba tšwelelago ba le gotee khosong.
termsForm.note.cohort.from: A group of people moving through a course together.

termsForm.note.lesson.text: Mogato o tee ka gare ga khoso.

termsForm.note.studyUnit.text: Ka fao dimodula tša kharikhulamo di kopantšwago ka gona go gafa.
termsForm.note.studyUnit.from: How a curriculum's modules are grouped for delivery.

termsForm.note.enrolment.text: Lefelo la motho khosong goba lenaneong.
termsForm.note.enrolment.from: A person's place on a course or programme.

termsForm.note.learner.text: Motho yo a dirago go ithuta. Baabi ba bangwe ba re seithuti goba motšeakarolo.
termsForm.note.learner.from: The person doing the learning. Some providers say student, or candidate.

termsForm.note.facilitator.text: Motho yo a gafago. Baabi ba bangwe ba re motlwaetši, morutiši goba moruti.
termsForm.note.facilitator.from: The person delivering. Some providers say trainer, tutor, or instructor.

termsForm.note.assessor.text: Motho yo a ahlolago bohlatse kgahlanong le dikriteria.
termsForm.note.assessor.from: The person judging evidence against the criteria.

termsForm.note.moderator.text: Motho yo a lekolago sampole ya dikahlolo tšeo.
termsForm.note.moderator.from: The person checking a sample of those judgements.

termsForm.note.workplaceRecord.text: Rekhoto ya mošomo woo moithuti a o dirilego, yeo mokoutši a e saenago gomme mohlahlobi a e amogelago.
termsForm.note.workplaceRecord.from: The record of work a learner did, that a coach signs and an assessor accepts.

menuEdit.noHeadingHint.text: Ga go hlogo: e bontšhwa e le dikgokagano tša go toba
menuEdit.noHeadingHint.from: No heading: shown as direct links

menuEdit.right.text: Šuthišetša hlogo ye ka go ja

menuEdit.empty.text: Ga go selo. Hlogo yeo e se nago selo ka fase ga yona ga e bontšhwe.
menuEdit.empty.from: Empty. A heading with nothing under it is not shown.

menuEdit.under.text: Hlogo yeo {page} e lego ka fase ga yona

menuEdit.note.text: Matlakala ga a ka utwa mo. Seo motho yo mongwe le yo mongwe a se bonago se šetše se kgethilwe ke karolo ya gagwe, gomme mokgwa wa bobedi wa go dira gore selo se se fihlelelwe o be o tlogela ga go yo a kgonago go hlalosa gore ke ka lebaka la eng letlakala le sa bonagale. Letlakala leo le oketšwago sethaleng ka morago le tšwelela ka fase ga hlogo ya lona ya tlwaelo, le ge peakanyo ye e sa le gona pele ga lona.
menuEdit.note.from: Pages cannot be hidden here. What each person sees is already decided by their role, and a second way to make something unreachable would leave nobody able to say why a page is missing. A page added to the platform later appears under its usual heading rather than disappearing because this arrangement predates it.

drives.none.text: Ga go mafelo a go boloka difaele ao a beakantšwego go tsenywa ga sethala se. Go bala foldara ka go toba go tšwa go Google Drive goba OneDrive go nyaka kopo yeo e ngwadišitšwego le bona ke mang le mang yo a hlokomelago sethala; go fihlela seo, foldara e kgethwa go tšwa khomphuthareng ya gago, seo se šomago gomme se sa hloke selo.
drives.none.from: No file store is set up on this deployment. Reading a folder straight from Google Drive or OneDrive needs an application registered with them by whoever maintains the platform; until then, a folder is chosen from your own computer, which works and needs nothing.

drives.notUsed.text: , ga se ya šomišwa le ga bjale

drives.keepsNote.text: Tokene yeo e tswaletšwego yeo e ka balago, gomme e balago feela, draiv ya akhaonto yeo o e kgokagantšego, go fihlela o e kgaoganya mo goba o e gogela morago dipeakanyong tša akhaonto yeo ka noši. E šomišwa ge o kopa gore foldara e balwe gomme e sa šomišwe nako ye nngwe, ga e bontšhwe go wena gape, gomme ga e ngwalwe rekhotong ya diphošo le ge e le efe. Ke ya gago, e sego ya moabi yo: mmogo wa gago a ka se bale difaele tša gago ka yona, gomme wena o ka se bale tša gagwe ka kgokagano ya gagwe.
drives.keepsNote.from: A sealed token that can read, and only read, the drive of the account you connect, until you disconnect it here or withdraw it from that account's own settings. It is used when you ask for a folder to be read and at no other time, it is never shown back to you, and it is never written to a log. It is yours, not this provider's: a colleague cannot read your files through it, and you cannot read theirs through their connection.

ext.encrypted.text: E sephiretšwe gomme ga e sa bontšhwa gape, mo goba kae le kae.
ext.encrypted.from: It is encrypted and is never shown again, here or anywhere else.

ext.cannotRunHere.text: e ka se šome sethaleng se

ext.cannotRun.text: Se se ka se šome sethaleng se, ka gona go se beakanya mo ga go dire gore dikarolo tša AI di šome.
ext.cannotRun.from: This one cannot run on this platform, so setting it up here will not make the AI features work.

ext.needsProgram.text: Se nyaka lenaneo leo le tsentšwego go mmašini yeo sethala se e šomago go yona.
ext.needsProgram.from: It needs a program installed on the machine the platform runs on.

ext.chooseKey.text: Kgetha yo mongwe wa baabi ba senotlelo sa API: bao ba bitša moabi ka inthanete gomme ba šoma kae le kae moo sethala se tsentšwego gona.
ext.chooseKey.from: Choose one of the API-key providers instead: those call the provider over the internet and work wherever the platform is installed.

ext.replace.text: E ngwe ka {credential} e mpsha; e tlogele e se na selo gore o boloke yeo e bolokilwego
ext.replace.from: Replace it with a new {credential}; leave empty to keep the stored one

ext.geminiHint.text: senotlelo sa gago go tšwa go Google AI Studio
ext.geminiHint.from: your key from Google AI Studio

ext.available.text: E dire gore e ka bulwa
ext.available.from: Make it available to switch on

ext.model.text: Mokgwa: o tlogele o se na selo gore o diriše wa kamehla wa moabi
ext.model.from: Model: leave empty for the provider's own default

ext.showModels.text: Bontšha dimokgwa tšeo {credential} ye e ka di šomišago
ext.showModels.from: Show the models this {credential} can use

ext.modelsAvailable.text: {count} di gona go wena lehono. Go kgetha e tee go tlatša lepokisi la ka godimo; e bolokwa ge o gata Boloka.
ext.modelsAvailable.from: {count} available to you today. Choosing one fills the box above; it is saved when you press Save.

ext.notReady.text: Ga se ya loka le ga bjale

ext.keepsNote.text: {credential} ya gago, e sephiretšwe, go fihlela o e lahla. E šomišwa feela mošomong woo o o kopago, feela ge o e bulotše, gomme ga e bontšhwe go wena gape goba e ngwalwe rekhotong ya diphošo. Go hwetšagala ga se go swana le go bulwa: sešene e nngwe le e nngwe e thoma e timilwe, o e bula bakeng sa mošomo, gomme go tšwa sethaleng go e tima ge o lebala.
ext.keepsNote.from: Your {credential}, encrypted, until you discard it. It is used only for work you ask for, only while you have the switch on, and it is never shown back to you or written to any log. Available is not the same as on: every sitting starts with it off, you switch it on for a job, and signing out switches it off for you if you forget.

ext.keptUnused.text: Tokene ya gago e bolokilwe eupša e ka se šomišwe. Ga go selo sethaleng seo se tlago neela thušo ya AI go fihlela o e dira gore e be gona gape.
ext.keptUnused.from: Your token is kept but cannot be used. Nothing in the platform will offer AI assistance until you make it available again.

ext.offNote.text: Ge se se timilwe, sethala se šoma go swana le ge se se na keketšo: dilo tša thušo ga di gona legatong la go neelwa di paletšwe.
ext.offNote.from: With this off, the platform behaves exactly as it does without an extension: the affordances are absent rather than offered and failing.

ext.tokenFromNote.text: Karolo ye e direga khomphuthareng ya gago, e sego mo, e lego morero: ngwadišo ya gago ya go lefa e dumelelwa ke wena, mmašining wa gago, gomme ke tokene yeo e e tšweletšago feela yeo e fihlelago sethala se.
ext.tokenFromNote.from: This part happens on your own computer, not here, which is the point: your subscription is authorised by you, on your machine, and only the token it produces ever reaches this platform.

ext.step1Rest.text: ge o se wa e tsenya: {link}. O hloka ngwadišo ya gago ya go lefa ya Claude.
ext.step1Rest.from: if you have not already: {link}. You need a Claude subscription of your own.

ext.cmdNote.text: {plain} ya tlwaelo ka PowerShell gantši e palelwa ka “running scripts is disabled on this system”. Seo ke sa kamehla sa Windows, e sego selo se se fošagetšego ka go tsenya ga gago, gomme mokgwa wa {cmd} o se phema ntle le go fetola peakanyo efe ya tšhireletšo.
ext.cmdNote.from: Plain {plain} in PowerShell usually fails with “running scripts is disabled on this system”. That is a Windows default rather than anything wrong with your installation, and the {cmd} form avoids it without changing any security setting.

ext.step3.text: 3. Tsena ge e bula burausa ya gago
ext.step3.from: 3. Sign in when it opens your browser

ext.step3Rest.text: , ka morago kopa tokene yeo e e gatišago (e thoma ka {prefix}) gomme o e kgomaretše ka godimo.
ext.step3Rest.from: , then copy the token it prints (it begins {prefix}) and paste it above.

ext.notApiKey.text: Ga se senotlelo sa API gomme ga go tshenyegelo ya tokene ye nngwe le ye nngwe: e šomiša ngwadišo ya go lefa ya Claude yeo o šetšego o e lefela. O se ke wa fa mang le mang phasewete ya gago ya Anthropic: sethala se ga se na lefelo la yona gomme se ka se e amogele mo.
ext.notApiKey.from: It is not an API key and there is no per-token cost: it draws on the Claude subscription you already pay for. Never give anybody your Anthropic password: this platform has no field for one and would not accept it here.

ext.notSubscription.text: Ngwadišo ya go lefa ga se senotlelo sa API.
ext.notSubscription.from: A subscription is not an API key.

ext.geminiSeparate.text: Gemini Advanced le Gemini API ke ditšweletšwa tše pedi tše di arogilego tšeo di nago le go lefiša go go arogilego. Go lefela sa mathomo ga go go fe sa bobedi, gomme ga go tsela ya go go dira.
ext.geminiSeparate.from: Gemini Advanced and the Gemini API are separate products with separate billing. Paying for the first does not give you the second, and there is no way to make it.

ext.openaiSeparate.text: ChatGPT Plus le OpenAI API ke ditšweletšwa tše pedi tše di arogilego tšeo di nago le go lefiša go go arogilego. Go lefela sa mathomo ga go go fe sa bobedi, gomme ga go tsela ya go go dira.
ext.openaiSeparate.from: ChatGPT Plus and the OpenAI API are separate products with separate billing. Paying for the first does not give you the second, and there is no way to make it.

ext.openaiCreate.text: Hlama senotlelo go {site}, ka fase ga {menu}, gomme o se kgomaretše ka godimo. Se thoma ka {prefix}.
ext.openaiCreate.from: Create a key at {site}, under {menu}, and paste it above. It begins {prefix}.

ext.noFreeTierNote.text: go fapana le Gemini, pitšo e nngwe le e nngwe e lefiša akhaonto yeo senotlelo e lego sa yona, ka gona letela pili, le ge e le ye nnyane.
ext.noFreeTierNote.from: unlike Gemini, every call is charged to the account the key belongs to, so expect a bill, however small.

ext.geminiCreate.text: Tsena go {site}, kgetha {menu}, hlama se sengwe, gomme o se kgomaretše ka godimo. Google e file dinotlelo ka mehuta ye e fetago o tee, ka gona kgomaretša seo e se go fago: sethala se ga se se belaele.
ext.geminiCreate.from: Sign in at {site}, choose {menu}, create one, and paste it above. Google has issued keys in more than one format, so paste whatever it gives you: this platform does not second-guess it.

ext.geminiFree.text: Gemini API e na le legato la mahala, ka gona go e leka ga go go tšhenyege selo. E lekanyetša palo ya dikgopelo tšeo o ka di dirago ka motsotso legatong la go di lefiša; go bala foldara e kgolo go ka fihlelela mollwane woo, gomme sethala se tla o botša ka go se pate ge go direga.
ext.geminiFree.from: The Gemini API has a free tier, so this costs nothing to try. It limits how many requests you may make in a minute rather than charging for them; reading a large folder can hit that, and the platform will say so plainly if it does.

ext.keyYours.text: Ke ya gago, e sego ya mokgatlo. E sephiretšwe, e šomišwa feela mošomong woo o o kopago ge o e bulotše, ga e bontšhwe go wena gape, gomme ga e ngwalwe rekhotong ya diphošo.
ext.keyYours.from: It is yours, not the tenant's. It is encrypted, used only for work you ask for while your switch is on, never shown back to you, and never written to a log.

codes.intro.text: Modula o tee o ngwalwa ka mo go fapanego ditokomaneng tše di fapanego: {long} kharikhulamong, {short} tafoleng ya kopantšho, {shortest} kakaretšong. Boitsebišo bjo bo telele, dipontšhi le ditlhaka tše kgolo di rarollwa ka molao. Mo ke moo App e botšwago ka tše dingwe, gore go tsenya godimo go kgokagane modula legatong la go bega gore ga o gona.
codes.intro.from: One module is written down differently in different documents: {long} in the curriculum, {short} in the alignment table, {shortest} in a summary. The long identifier, the punctuation and the capitals are handled by rule. This is where the App is told about the rest, so an upload links the module instead of reporting it missing.

codes.saved.text: Go bolokilwe. Go tsenya godimo go tla šomiša tše go tloga bjale.
codes.saved.from: Saved. Uploads will use these from now on.

codes.none.text: Ga go kharikhulamo yeo e tsentšwego le ga bjale, ka gona ga go dikhoutu tša maemo tša go di hwetša. Tsenya kwalifikeišene gomme se se ithlatša go tšwa dikhoutung tša yona tša dimodula.
codes.none.from: No curriculum has been loaded yet, so there are no standards to infer. Load a qualification and this fills itself in from its module codes.

codes.inUse.text: Dikwalo tše dingwe tše {total} ka dimodula tše {modules}, di a šomišwa.
codes.inUse.from: {total} alternative spellings across {modules} modules, in use.

codes.proposed.text: Dikwalo tše {total} tšeo di šišintšwego ka dimodula tše {modules}.

codes.notInUse.text: Ga e šomišwe go fihlela o e lebeletše gomme wa e netefatša.
codes.notInUse.from: Not in use until you have looked at them and confirmed.

codes.view.text: Di lebelele gomme o di fetole

codes.dialogNote.text: Khoutu yeo e lego ka lehlakoreng la nngele ke maemo a gago. Dikwalo tšeo di lego ka thoko ga yona ke seo tokomane e ka se šomišago legatong la yona. Tloša efe goba efe yeo e sa swanelego, oketša tša gago, gomme ka morago o netefatše.
codes.dialogNote.from: The code on the left is your standard. The spellings beside it are what a document may use instead. Remove any that do not belong, add your own, then confirm.

codes.fullId.text: Boitsebišo bjo bo feletšego bja QCTO, {example}, bo balwa e le khoutu ya modula wa bjona ka molao, gomme ga bo hloke mothalo mo. Le dihaefene, dikgoba le ditlhaka tše kgolo di bjalo.
codes.fullId.from: A full QCTO identifier, {example}, is read as its module code by rule, and needs no row here. So are hyphens, spaces and capitals.

codes.worked.text: Diphapano tša yona di rarollwa go wena.
codes.worked.from: Its variations are worked out for you.

codes.putBack.text: Busetša tšohle tšeo App e di šišintšego
codes.putBack.from: Put back everything the App proposed

naming.title.text: Ka fao maina a difaele a balwago ka gona

naming.intro.text: Ge motho a tsenya puku ya mošomo goba tlhahlobo godimo, App e bala leina la faele gore e tsebe gore ke eng. Ge se se nepagetše, go tsenya godimo go fihla go šetše go tladitšwe. Ge se fošagetše, ga go selo seo se robegago: se fihla e le foromo e se nago selo gore motho a e tlatše ka seatla.
naming.intro.from: When somebody uploads a workbook or an assessment, the App reads the filename to work out what it is. Get this right and an upload arrives already filled in. Get it wrong and nothing breaks: it arrives as a blank form for somebody to complete by hand.

naming.rule.text: Molao wa ntlo, ka fao sehlopha sa gago se swanetšego go o latela ka gona
naming.rule.from: The house rule, as your team should follow it

naming.ruleNote.text: O bontšhwa sekirining sa go tsenya godimo. Tlhahlo ya batho, e sego seo App e se swantšhago: e hwetša dikhoutu tša ka fase mo di lego gona.
naming.ruleNote.from: Shown on the upload screen. Guidance for people, not something the App matches on: it finds the codes below wherever they appear.

naming.codesNote.text: Karolo ya leina la faele yeo e botšago gore ke mohuta ofe wa tokomane. Tše ke tšeo App e di swantšhago ka nnete.
naming.codesNote.from: The part of a filename that says what kind of document it is. These are what the App actually matches on.

naming.meaning.text: Seo khoutu ye e se bolelago

naming.meaning.workplace_signoff.text: Go saena ga lefelo la mošomo

naming.marker.text: Seo se swayago tlhahlo ya dikarabo

naming.markerNote.text: Leswao leo le botšago gore faele ke memorandamo e sego kopi ya moithuti.
naming.markerNote.from: The token that says a file is the memorandum rather than the learner's copy.

naming.unread.text: Ga se ya balwa go tšwa leineng le: {parts}. Yo a e tsenyago godimo o di tlatša ka seatla.
naming.unread.from: Not read from this name: {parts}. Whoever uploads it fills those in by hand.

naming.allRead.text: Se sengwe le se sengwe se badilwe. Go tsenya godimo ga go bitšwago bjalo go fihla go šetše go tladitšwe.
naming.allRead.from: Everything was read. An upload named like this arrives already filled in.

tmpl.kind.enrolment_form.text: Foromo ya go Ngwadišwa ga Moithuti

tmpl.note.statement_of_results.text: E išwa setsheng sa tlhahlobo le tokomane ya boitsebišo ya moithuti. Sebopego ke sa gago go se beakanya; teemplete ya QCTO ka noši e bontšha seo e se swerego.
tmpl.note.statement_of_results.from: Carried to the assessment centre with the learner's identity document. The layout is yours to set; the QCTO's own template shows what one carries.

tmpl.note.certificate.text: Seo moabi a se ntšhago bakeng sa mananeo a gagwe. Setifikeiti sa kwalifikeišene se tšwa go QCTO, e sego mo.
tmpl.note.certificate.from: What the provider issues for its own programmes. A qualification certificate comes from the QCTO, not from here.

tmpl.note.workplace_statement.text: Seo mokoutši wa lefelo la mošomo a se saenago go netefatša maitemogelo ao moithuti a a phethilego.
tmpl.note.workplace_statement.from: What a workplace coach signs to confirm the experience a learner completed.

tmpl.note.enrolment_form.text: Foromo ya go ngwadišwa yeo e tladitšwego, e le tokomane. Molekodi wa QCTO a ka e kopa ge a etela, ka gona e swanetše go ba gona godimo ga pampiri, e sego feela e le sekirini seo motho a se tladitšego.
tmpl.note.enrolment_form.from: The completed enrolment form, as a document. A QCTO monitor may ask for it on a visit, so it has to exist on paper, not only as a screen somebody filled in.

tmpl.platform.text: Sebopego sa sethala ka noši. Ga go selo seo o se dirago mo seo se fetolago tokomane yeo e šetšego e ntšhitšwe.
tmpl.platform.from: The platform's own layout. Nothing you do here changes a document already issued.

tmpl.name.text: Seo o bitšago kgatišo ye ka sona

tmpl.documentNote.text: E ngwale ka fao o nyakago e balwa ka gona. Se sengwe le se sengwe se lego ka gare ga dikhurumelo tše pedi se šuthišwa ke dintlha tša moithuti ka noši ge tokomane e tšweletšwa, gomme dikgoba tša gago di dula ka fao o di ngwalago ka gona.
tmpl.documentNote.from: Write it as you want it to read. Anything in double braces is replaced with the learner's own details when the document is produced, and your spacing is kept exactly as you type it.

tmpl.starterNote.text: Ye ke mantšu a sethala ka noši, gore o a fokotše go ba a gago.
tmpl.starterNote.from: This is the platform's own wording, for you to cut down into yours.

tmpl.saveDraft.text: Boloka e le sengwalwa sa pele

tmpl.goBack.text: Boela go sebopego sa sethala ka noši
tmpl.goBack.from: Go back to the platform's own layout

tmpl.fields.text: Seo o ka se beago go yona
tmpl.fields.from: What you can put in it

tmpl.added.text: Seo sethala se se oketšago, go sa kgathale seo teemplete ya gago e se bolelago
tmpl.added.from: What the platform adds, whatever your template says

tmpl.addedNote.text: Tše di gatišwa ka morago ga teemplete ya gago. Ga se tša gago go di fetola ka gobane ga se tša gago: molaodi wa melao o a di nyaka, gomme moithuti yo a swerego tokomane o ithekgile ka gore ke nnete. O ka se hloke go di ngwala kgatišong ya gago.
tmpl.addedNote.from: These are printed after your template. They are not yours to change because they are not yours: a regulator requires them, and a learner holding the document relies on them being true. You do not need to write them into your own version.

capture.intro.text: App e bala seo e ka se balago, e go bontšha seo e se dirilego ka sona le seo e sa kgonego go se šoma, gomme e a leta. Ga go selo seo se fetogago tlhahlobo go fihlela o se netefatša.
capture.intro.from: The App reads what it can, shows you what it made of it and what it could not work out, and waits. Nothing becomes an assessment until you confirm it.

capture.fromFolder.text: Ge puku ya mošomo e tlile le foldara, e šetše e le mo: {link} gomme o e rekhode go tšwa go seo se bolokilwego. Ga go go tsenya godimo ga bobedi, gomme tlhahlo ya dikarabo e a bapetšwa bakeng sa gago. Diriša foromo ya ka fase feela bakeng sa pampiri yeo sethala se sa e swereng.
capture.fromFolder.from: If the workbook came in with a folder, it is already here: {link} and capture it from what is filed. There is no second upload, and the answer guide is paired for you. Use the form below only for a paper the platform does not already hold.

capture.naming.text: Ka fao o bitšago faele ka gona

capture.changeNaming.text: Fetola ka fao maina a difaele a balwago ka gona

capture.none.text: Ga go selo seo se rekhotilwego le ga bjale

capture.noneNote.text: Bula kwalifikeišene gomme o rekhode dipuku tša mošomo tšeo di šetšego di bolokilwe kgahlanong le yona, goba o tsenye e tee godimo. Seo App e se badilego se bontšhwa go wena pele ga ge se ka ba tlhahlobo.
capture.noneNote.from: Open a qualification and capture the workbooks already filed against it, or upload one above. What the App reads is shown to you before any of it becomes an assessment.

capture.committedOn.text: E dirilwe ka {date}. Go tsenya godimo go dirwa gatee; tsenya tokomane godimo gape gore o dire pampiri e nngwe go yona.
capture.committedOn.from: Committed on {date}. An upload is committed once; upload the document again to make another paper from it.

capture.which.text: Thepa ye ke ya kwalifikeišene efe?
capture.which.from: Which qualification is this material for?

capture.guideNote.text: Ntle le yona, ga go dikarabo tše di nepagetšego, maraka goba dikriteria tšeo di ka balwago.
capture.guideNote.from: Without it, no correct answers, marks or criteria can be read.

capture.ready.text: E loketše. Dimodula tše {modules} le dikriteria tše {criteria} tša tlhahlobo di ka gare, ka gona dipotšišo di ka kgokaganywa le seo di se netefatšago.
capture.ready.from: Ready. {modules} modules and {criteria} assessment criteria are in, so questions can be linked to what they evidence.

capture.notReady.text: Kwalifikeišene ye ga se ya loka go thepa le ga bjale.
capture.notReady.from: This qualification is not ready for material yet.

capture.notReadyNote.text: Dira tše pele, ka tatelano ye. Go fihlela di phethwa, potšišo ga e kgone go swaywa go seo e se netefatšago, gomme go se lokiša ka morago go ra go swaya gape e nngwe le e nngwe ya tšona ka seatla.
capture.notReadyNote.from: Do these first, in this order. Until they are done a question cannot be tagged to what it evidences, and putting that right later means re-tagging every one of them by hand.

capture.whereDocuments.text: Ditokomane di tsenywa godimo letlakaleng la kwalifikeišene ka noši.
capture.whereDocuments.from: Documents are uploaded on the qualification's own page.

capture.noGuide.text: Ga go tlhahlo ya dikarabo yeo e tsentšwego godimo.

capture.original.text: Ya mathomo e a bolokwa gomme e beelwa monwana wa dijithale, gore potšišo yeo e ganetšwago e rarollwe kgahlanong le tokomane, e sego kgahlanong le go bala ga yona.
capture.original.from: The original is kept and hashed, so a question in dispute is settled against the document rather than against this reading of it.

capture.committedLong.text: Se dirilwe ka {date}. Go tsenya godimo go dirwa gatee; tsenya tokomane godimo gape gore o dire pampiri e nngwe go yona.
capture.committedLong.from: This was committed on {date}. An upload is committed once; upload the document again to make another paper from it.

captureReview.noAnswer.text: “{stem}…” e swaywa ke App eupša ga e na karabo e nepagetšego.
captureReview.noAnswer.from: “{stem}…” is marked by the App but has no correct answer.

captureReview.addsUp.text: “{section}” e gatišitšwe e le maraka a {printed} eupša dipotšišo tša yona di kopana go {sum}.
captureReview.addsUp.from: “{section}” is printed as {printed} marks but its questions add up to {sum}.

captureReview.edited.text: O dirile ditokišo. Seo se dirwago ke seo se lego sekirining bjale, e sego seo se badilwego go faele.
captureReview.edited.from: You have made corrections. What gets committed is what is on this screen now, not what was read out of the file.

captureReview.summary.text: Dipotšišo tše {questions} · maraka a {marks} · {app} di swaywa ke App
captureReview.summary.from: {questions} questions · {marks} marks · {app} marked by the App

captureReview.nothingRecognised.text: ga go selo seo se lemogilwego

captureReview.unknownOne.text: {codes} ga se kriteria kwalifikeišeneng ye, ka gona e ka se kgokaganywe. Lokiša dikhoutu tša ka godimo ge e ba ke phošo ya go ngwala.
captureReview.unknownOne.from: {codes} is not a criterion on this qualification, so it will not be linked. Correct the codes above if that is a typo.

captureReview.unknown.text: {codes} ga se dikriteria kwalifikeišeneng ye, ka gona di ka se kgokaganywe. Lokiša dikhoutu tša ka godimo ge e ba ke phošo ya go ngwala.
captureReview.unknown.from: {codes} are not criteria on this qualification, so they will not be linked. Correct the codes above if that is a typo.

captureReview.acknowledgeOne.text: Ke badile selo se 1 seo se sa fedišwago sa ka godimo gomme ke nyaka go dira le ge go le bjalo. Se se rekhotwa kgahlanong le leina la ka.
captureReview.acknowledgeOne.from: I have read the 1 outstanding item above and want to commit anyway. This is recorded against my name.

captureReview.acknowledge.text: Ke badile dilo tše {count} tšeo di sa fedišwago tša ka godimo gomme ke nyaka go dira le ge go le bjalo. Se se rekhotwa kgahlanong le leina la ka.
captureReview.acknowledge.from: I have read the {count} outstanding items above and want to commit anyway. This is recorded against my name.

captureReview.responsibility.text: Go netefatša go amogela maikarabelo a karabo e nngwe le e nngwe e nepagetšego pampiring ye. Leina la gago le dula go yona.
captureReview.responsibility.from: Confirming accepts responsibility for every correct answer in this paper. Your name stays on it.

captureReview.swapped.text: Pampiri le tlhahlo di bonagala di fetošitšwe
captureReview.swapped.from: The paper and the guide look swapped

captureReview.swappedNote.text: Ga go selo se sengwe seo se badišwago, ka gobane se sengwe le se sengwe se latela se. Thoma gape ka pampiri ya moithuti e le pampiri le tlhahlo ya mohlahlobi e le tlhahlo.
captureReview.swappedNote.from: Nothing else is listed, because everything else follows from this. Start again with the learner's paper as the paper and the assessor guide as the guide.

captureReview.fixOne.text: Selo se 1 se swanetše go lokišwa

captureReview.fix.text: Dilo tše {count} di swanetše go lokišwa

captureReview.fixNote.text: Di lokiše ka fase, goba o di bale gomme o re o nyaka go tšwela pele le ge go le bjalo.
captureReview.fixNote.from: Correct these below, or read them and say you want to go on anyway.

captureReview.clear.text: Ga go selo seo se sa fedišwago

captureReview.clearNote.text: Potšišo e nngwe le e nngwe yeo App e tlago e swaya e na le karabo, gomme karolo e nngwe le e nngwe e kopana le seo e se gatišago.
captureReview.clearNote.from: Every question the App will mark has an answer, and every section adds up to what it prints.

captureReview.materialNote.text: Tokomane e badilwe ka nepo. Tše ke dilo tša pampiri tšeo mongwadi wa yona a ka di kgethago feela.
captureReview.materialNote.from: The document was read correctly. These are things about the paper that only its author can decide.

imports.intro.text: Foldara e nngwe le e nngwe yeo e badilwego, le seo se diregilego ka yona. Go bala e mpsha go thoma moo mošomo o lego gona, kwalifikeišeneng, khosong goba thepa yeo o e agago, e sego mo.
imports.intro.from: Every folder that has been read, and what became of it. Reading a new one starts where the work is, on the qualification, course or material you are building, rather than here.

imports.noExtension.text: O ešo o beakanye keketšo ya AI

imports.readNote.from: Kept whether committed or discarded. What was proposed and then rejected is how anybody judges whether a reading is worth trusting.

imports.contentsNote.text: Se sengwe le se sengwe seo se hweditšwego, le seo se dirilwego ka sona. Difaele tša PDF le tša Word di fetošwa ka sehlodi se se swanago seo karolo ye nngwe ya sethala e se šomišago, gore mmotlolo o bale seo Rekhoda e tlago se bala.
imports.contentsNote.from: Everything found, and what was done with it. PDFs and Word documents are converted with the same extractor the rest of the platform uses, so the model reads exactly what Capture would.

imports.proposesNote.text: Se sengwe le se sengwe lefelong le tee. Ditemošo ke karolo ye e bohlokwa: di bale pele ga se sengwe le se sengwe.
imports.proposesNote.from: Everything in one place. The warnings are the part that matters: read those before anything else.

proposal.fromBlueprint.text: E badilwe go faele ya leanotheo la foldara ka noši. Sebopego sa ka fase ke seo faele yeo e se bolelago ka nepo: ga go selo seo se šetšwego, gomme ga go mmotlolo o botšišitšwego.
proposal.fromBlueprint.from: Read from the folder's own blueprint file. The structure below is exactly what that file says: nothing was inferred, and no model was asked.

proposal.fromDocuments.text: E badilwe go ditokomane ke mmotlolo. E lekole kgahlanong le tokomane ya kharikhulamo pele o e dira.

proposal.byName.from: Filed by name. No blueprint and no model were involved: each document went where its filename says it belongs, and the curriculum is untouched.

proposal.topUp.text: E oketšwe kwalifikeišeneng yeo o thomilego go yona. Lenaneo la ka godimo ke se sengwe le se sengwe seo foldara e se swerego, e sego se sengwe le se sengwe seo se tlago hlangwa: se sengwe le se sengwe seo se šetšego se le mo se dula ka fao se lego ka gona, gomme feela seo se sego gona se a oketšwa. O botšwa ka morago gore ke dimodula dife tšeo di šetšego di swerwe.
proposal.topUp.from: Added to the qualification you started from. The list above is everything the folder holds, not everything that will be created: whatever is already here is left exactly as it is, and only what is missing is added. You are told afterwards which modules were already held.

proposal.checks.from: Everything above goes in at once, through the same checks that apply to anything built by hand. Whatever those checks turn away is reported rather than skipped quietly.

proposal.discardNote.text: E bolokwa rekhotong. Seo se šišintšwego gomme sa gannwa ke seo mang le mang a ahlolago ka sona gore na keketšo e swanetše go ba gona.
proposal.discardNote.from: Kept on the record. What was proposed and rejected is how anybody judges whether the extension is worth having.

progReport.intro.text: Dipotšišo tše pedi tšeo di bonagalago di le ka ga baithuti eupša e sego: seo se sa hlahlobjwego ke selo, le dipotšišo tšeo di sa šomego.
progReport.intro.from: Two questions that look like they are about learners and are not: what nothing assesses, and which questions are not working.

progReport.untested.text: Seo se sa hlahlobjwego ke selo

progReport.untestedNote.text: Kriteria yeo e sa hlahlobjwego ke potšišo efe ya go phetha e ka se fihlelelwe ke mang le mang, go sa kgathale gore o dira gabotse gakaakang. E thibela moithuti yo mongwe le yo mongwe kwalifikeišeneng, gomme ga go selo se sengwe sethaleng seo se se bolelago.
progReport.untestedNote.from: A criterion no summative question assesses cannot be achieved by anybody, however well they do. It holds up every learner on the qualification, and nothing else in the platform says so.

progReport.noCriteria.text: Kwalifikeišene ye ga e na dikriteria tša tlhahlobo tšeo di tšerwego le ga bjale.

progReport.questionsNote.from: First attempts only, because a re-sit measures something else. Nothing is flagged below {minimum} attempts: a question two people have answered tells you about those two people.

progReport.everybody.from: Everybody gets full marks, so it distinguishes nothing.

statutory.intro.text: Pego ya Database ya Bosetšhaba ya Direkhoto tša Baithuti ya SAQA, le Peakanyo ya Mabokgoni a Lefelo la Mošomo le Pego ya Ngwaga ya Tlhahlo. Se sengwe le se sengwe se lekolwa mo pele se ya kae le kae, ka gobane pego yeo e ganetšwego ka lebaka la nomoro ya boitsebišo yeo e ngwadilwego ka phošo e tšea nako e feletšego ya go bega.
statutory.intro.from: The SAQA National Learners' Records Database return, and the Workplace Skills Plan and Annual Training Report. Everything is checked here before it goes anywhere, because a return rejected for a mistyped identity number costs a full cycle.

statutory.locked.from: The files stay locked until the blocking problems below are fixed. Submitting a return that will be rejected wastes a cycle for every learner in it.

statutory.mustFix.text: Di swanetše go rarollwa pele o romela

statutory.worthFixingNote.text: Tše ga di kgaogantše pego, eupša NLRD e swaya dintlha tša setšhaba tšeo di sa fela gomme SETA e ka di botšiša.
statutory.worthFixingNote.from: These do not stop the return, but the NLRD flags incomplete demographic data and a SETA may query it.

statutory.mapping.text: Go bapetšwa ga masimo go latela tlhako ya go amogela (Motho 27, Go ngwadišwa 28, Sephetho 29, Moabi 30). Netefatša moralo wa nnete wa faele ya Edu.Dex go ya ka thulaganyo ya bjale ya SAQA pele o romela ka nnete.
statutory.mapping.from: Field mapping follows the accreditation framework (Person 27, Enrolment 28, Achievement 29, Provider 30). Confirm the exact Edu.Dex file layout against the current SAQA specification before a live submission.

enrolNotify.intro.text: QCTO e swanetše go botšwa gore baithuti ba ba ngwadišitšwe, ka gare ga matšatši a mošomo a masomepedi a tee ka morago ga ditshepedišo tša go tsena a kwalifikeišene le a mahlano a lenaneo la mabokgoni. Matšatši a phomolo a setšhaba ga a balwe, gomme nako e balwa go tloga letšatšing la ditshepedišo tša go tsena, e sego go tloga go ngwadišweng goba tefong.
enrolNotify.intro.from: The QCTO has to be told that these learners were enrolled, within twenty-one working days of induction for a qualification and five for a skills programme. Public holidays do not count, and the clock runs from the induction date rather than from enrolment or payment.

enrolNotify.overdueNote.from: Still submit these. A late notification with an explanation is a different problem to one nobody made.

enrolNotify.noInductionNote.from: Their clock has not started, so there is no deadline to report. Date the cohort's induction session, or give them their own below.

enrolNotify.ownInductionNote.text: Motho yo a tsenetšego ka morago ga ge sehlopha se thomile o na le ditshepedišo tša gagwe tša go tsena, foromo ya gagwe ya go ngwadišwa le tlhagišo ya gagwe.
enrolNotify.ownInductionNote.from: Somebody who joined after the cohort started has their own induction, their own enrolment form and their own submission.

enrolNotify.split.from: This submission covers both a skills programme and a qualification. They go to different addresses, so it has to be split and sent twice.

paths.intro.text: {courses} tše mmalwa tšeo di kopantšwego ka tatelano: {programme} ya mošomi yo mofsa, goba go tsenywa ga tlhako ya bokgoni ka moka. Moithuti o fiwa {course} ye e latelago ka bo yona ge a fetša ye e e feditšego.
paths.intro.from: Several {courses} chained into a sequence: a new starter {programme}, or a full competency framework roll-out. A learner is given the next {course} automatically as they finish the one before it.

paths.noneAuthor.text: {programme} e kopanya {courses} ka tatelano, gore moithuti a fiwe ye e latelago ge a fetša ye e e feditšego. Aga {courses} pele: {programme} ke tatelano ya tšona.
paths.noneAuthor.from: A {programme} chains {courses} into an order, so a learner is given the next one as they finish the one before. Build the {courses} first: a {programme} is a sequence of them.

paths.noneReader.text: Ga go e nngwe yeo e agilwego le ga bjale. Ge e ba e agilwe, {courses} yeo o e šomago ka tatelano e tla ba mo. Go aga e nngwe ke mošomo wa mongwadi.
paths.noneReader.from: None has been built yet. When one has been, the {courses} you work through in order will be here. Building one is an author's job.

paths.empty.text: Ga go {courses} go yona le ga bjale: moithuti yo a filwego {programme} ye a ka se hwetše selo. E bule gore o oketše tše dingwe.
paths.empty.from: No {courses} in it yet: a learner given this {programme} would receive nothing. Open it to add some.

paths.locked.text: E notletšwe go fihlela mogato wa pele ga yona o fedile
paths.locked.from: Locked until the step before it is finished

paths.lockedNote.text: Tloša letshwao bakeng sa e ka tšewago nakong efe goba efe.
paths.lockedNote.from: Untick for one that can be taken at any point.

paths.allIn.text: Se sengwe le se sengwe seo se phatlaladitšwego se šetše se le go yona.
paths.allIn.from: Everything published is already in it.

paths.published.text: Se se phatlaladitšwe gomme batho ba a se šoma, ka gona dikgato tša sona di tiišitšwe. Go fetola tatelano ka tlase ga motho go ka fetola seo a se boletšwego gore a se dire.
paths.published.from: This is published and people are working through it, so its steps are fixed. Changing the order underneath somebody would alter what they had already been told to do.

paths.publishNote.text: Se sengwe le se sengwe seo se lego go yona se swanetše go phatlalatšwa pele.
paths.publishNote.from: Everything in it has to be published first.

paths.firstOnly.text: Ke wa pele feela o bulegago. Tše dingwe di fihla ge e nngwe le e nngwe e fedišwa.
paths.firstOnly.from: Only the first opens. The rest arrive as each is finished.

badges.intro.text: Kgodišo yeo e fihlago ka letšatši leo mošomo o fedišwago ka lona, e sego dikgwedi ka morago ge setifikeiti sa ka ntle se fihla. Bejane ga se kwalifikeišene gomme sethala ga se se dumelele go bonagala e le yona: ga go tshupetšo ya SAQA, ga go dikrediti, gomme letlakala la go netefatša le bolela ka go lebanya gore ke eng le gore ga se eng.
badges.intro.from: Recognition that arrives on the day the work is finished, rather than months later when the external certificate comes through. A badge is not a qualification and the platform never lets it look like one: no SAQA identifier, no credits, and a verification page that says plainly what it is and what it is not.

badges.target.default.text: Selo sefe goba sefe, ge go se na se sengwe se kgethegilego seo se beilwego
badges.target.default.from: Anything, when nothing more specific is set

badges.nothing.text: Ga go selo seo se hweditšwego le ga bjale

badges.nothingNote.text: Ga go bejane yeo e sebeleditšwego, ka gona go feditša khoso goba kwalifikeišene ga bjale ga go fe selo. Go sebeleditše e tee ka tlase go a lekana: thoma ka bejane ya moabi ka noši ge o sa nyake e nngwe ya selo se sengwe le se sengwe.
badges.nothingNote.from: No badge has been designed, so finishing a course or a qualification currently awards nothing. Designing one below is enough: start with the provider's own badge if you do not want a different one for each thing.

badges.legitimate.text: Se ke kgetho ya semolao e sego phošo. Sethala ga se ke sa hlama e nngwe.
badges.legitimate.from: This is a legitimate choice rather than a fault. The platform will not invent one.

badges.kind.default.text: Selo sefe goba sefe, ge go se na se sengwe se kgethegilego seo se beilwego
badges.kind.default.from: Anything, when nothing more specific is set

badges.designNote.text: Sebopego, mebala e mebedi le letshwao. Ga go selo sa go tsenya godimo gomme ga go yo o swanetšego go tsebišwa.
badges.designNote.from: A shape, two colours and a symbol. Nothing to upload and nobody to brief.

badges.allHave.text: Se sengwe le se sengwe se šetše se na le bejane. Ithapološa e nngwe gore o sebeletše e nngwe ya selo se se swanago.
badges.allHave.from: Everything already has a badge. Retire one to design a different badge for the same thing.

badges.appear.text: Ka fao e tlago bonagala ka gona

badges.says.text: Seo e se bolelago, go moithuti le mang le mang yo a mo bontšhago yona (ka boithaopo)
badges.says.from: What it says, for the learner and anybody they show it to (optional)

badges.saysHint.text: O phethile modula wa tirišo wa go šoma bokgoleng, wa hlahlobja kgahlanong le dikriteria tša kharikhulamo.
badges.saysHint.from: Completed the practical module on working at heights, assessed against the curriculum criteria.

badges.retireTitle.text: Tlogela go fa {name}. Bohle bao ba nago le yona ba e boloka.
badges.retireTitle.from: Stop awarding {name}. Everybody who has it keeps it.

templates.intro.text: Ditokomane tšeo {name} e di tšweletšago. Ka fao e nngwe le e nngwe e balwago le go bonagala ka gona ke ya gago: ngwala mohuta wa gago gomme sethala se e tšweletša go tšwa go wona go e na le moralo wa sona. Seo molawana o se nyakago se oketšwa ka morago ga sa gago gomme se ka se fetolwe, ka gobane karolo yeo ga se ya moabi go e fetola.
templates.intro.from: The documents {name} produces. How each one reads and looks is yours: write your own version and the platform produces it from that instead of its own layout. What a regulator requires is added after yours and cannot be edited, because that part is not the provider's to change.

templates.goesTo.statement_of_results.text: Moithuti, yo a e iišago setsheng sa tlhahlobo le tokomane ya gagwe ya boitsebišo.
templates.goesTo.statement_of_results.from: The learner, who carries it to the assessment centre with their identity document.

templates.goesTo.certificate.text: Moithuti, le mang le mang yo a mo bontšhago yona.
templates.goesTo.certificate.from: The learner, and whoever they show it to.

templates.goesTo.workplace_statement.text: Faele ya moithuti, e saenwe ke mokoutši go mothwadi yo a amogetšego.
templates.goesTo.workplace_statement.from: The learner's file, signed by a coach at the host employer.

templates.goesTo.enrolment_form.text: E bewa e le bohlatse, gomme e newa mookamedi wa QCTO ge a etela.
templates.goesTo.enrolment_form.from: Filed as evidence, and handed to a QCTO monitor on a visit.

templates.producesNote.text: Selo sefe goba sefe seo se se nago mohuta wa gago se diriša moralo wa sethala, e lego tokomane ya go šoma e sego sebaka sa go ema.
templates.producesNote.from: Anything without your own version uses the platform's layout, which is a working document rather than a placeholder.

templates.who.text: Ke mang yo a e hwetšago

templates.writeNote.text: Thoma ka moralo wa sethala gomme o o fokotše go ba wa gago. Lefelo le lengwe le le lengwe leo tokomane e ka le swarago le tlaleditšwe ka thoko ga sengwadi, le mohlala wa nnete wa kamoo le lebelelago ka gona.
templates.writeNote.from: Start from the platform's layout and edit it down into yours. Every field the document can carry is listed beside the editor with a real example of what it looks like.

templates.supplied.text: Ditokomane tšeo o di neago go e na le go di rulaganya
templates.supplied.from: Documents you supply rather than lay out

templates.suppliedNote.text: Ga se ditokomane ka moka e lego teemplete yeo sethala se e tlatšago.
templates.suppliedNote.from: Not every document is a template the platform fills in.

templates.policiesNote.text: lengwalo la gago la go amogela, dipholisi le dikwano, di tsentšwe godimo gomme tša bolokwa e sego tša hlangwa.
templates.policiesNote.from: your accreditation letter, policies and agreements, uploaded and retained rather than generated.

templates.fisaNote.text: di ngwadilwe ke mohlahlobi wa gago ka noši gomme tša modereitwa pele ga ge motho a di ngwala, ka gona di a ngwalwa e sego go diriwa ka diteemplete.
templates.fisaNote.from: written by your own examiner and moderated before anybody sits them, so they are authored rather than templated.

templates.curriculumNote.text: ditokomane tša kwalifikeišene tšeo di phatlaladitšwego tšeo sethala se di balago go aga kharikhulamo.
templates.curriculumNote.from: the published qualification documents the platform reads to build a curriculum from.

tracker.all.text: Dihlopha ka moka, go akaretšwa tšeo di fedilego le tšeo di khansetšwego.
tracker.all.from: Every cohort, including those finished and cancelled.

tracker.running.text: Dihlopha ka moka tšeo di sa šomago.

tracker.note.text: E badilwe go tšwa direkhotong e sego go bolokwa ka diatla, ka gona e ka se fapane le sethala seo e se begago.
tracker.note.from: Read from the records rather than kept by hand, so it cannot disagree with the platform it reports on.

tracker.none.text: Ga go dihlopha le ga bjale. Sehlopha ke seo peakanyo, rejistara le pego ya molao di fegilwego go sona.
tracker.none.from: No cohorts yet. A cohort is what a schedule, a register and a statutory return all hang from.

dictionary.intro.text: Tlhaloso e beilwego ya lentšu le lengwe le le lengwe leo le šomišwago ka sethaleng se, ditokomaneng tša sona le thepeng ya sona ya go ithuta. Tlhaloso ye nngwe le ye nngwe e bolela gore lentšu ke la mang. Moo mmuši a le hlalošago, re le diriša ka fao a le hlalošago ka gona gomme leina la mmele le a bolelwa. Moo lentšu le lego la rena, re ka le fetola. Moo e lego tirišo ya kakaretšo feela, le ka se ke la bolelwa e le tlhokego.
dictionary.intro.from: The settled meaning of every term used across this platform, its documents and its learning material. Each entry says who owns the word. Where an authority defines it, we use it as they do and the body is named. Where the word is ours, we can change it. Where it is simply common usage, it should never be cited as a requirement.

dictionary.searchHint.from: A term, an abbreviation, or a word in a definition

dictionary.who.text: Ke mang yo a e hlalošago

dictionary.meaning.authority.text: E hlalošwa ke mmuši. E diriše bjalo ka yena: go fetola tlhaloso go bea tlhagišo kotsing.
dictionary.meaning.authority.from: Defined by an authority. Use it as they do: changing the meaning puts a submission at risk.

dictionary.meaning.platform.text: Lentšu la sethala se ka noši. La rena go le fetola; ga go mmuši yo a le laolago.
dictionary.meaning.platform.from: This platform's own word for it. Ours to change; no authority prescribes it.

dictionary.meaning.practice.text: Tirišo ya kakaretšo ya lekala, e se nago mong o tee. O se ke wa e bolela e le tlhokego.
dictionary.meaning.practice.from: Common usage across the sector, with no single owner. Do not cite it as a requirement.

dictionary.none.text: Ga go selo se se swanago. Ge e ba polelo e a hlaelela gomme ke ye re e šomišago, e swanetše go ba mo: e bolele gomme e tla oketšwa go tokollo ye e latelago.
dictionary.none.from: Nothing matches. If a term is missing and it is one we use, it belongs here: say so and it will be added in the next release.

feedbackForm.intro.text: {cohort}. Dikarabo di begwa mmogo le tša ba bangwe bohle, e sego ka o tee ka o tee. Go tšea metsotso e mebedi ka o tee, gomme ke selo se tee seo se fetolago ka fao sehlopha se se latelago se tsamaišwago ka gona.
feedbackForm.intro.from: {cohort}. Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. It takes about two minutes, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

feedbackForm.scale.1.text: Ke se dumele ka mo go tiilego

feedbackForm.scale.3.text: Ga ke dumele le go se dumele

feedbackForm.scale.5.text: Ke dumela ka mo go tiilego

feedbackReport.ratingsNote.text: Palogare ya 1 (ke se dumele ka mo go tiilego) go ya go 5 (ke dumela ka mo go tiilego). Palogare ya dikarabo tše mmalwa ke maikutlo, e sego tekanyo, ka gona palo e ka thoko ga yona.
feedbackReport.ratingsNote.from: Mean of 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree). A mean over few answers is a mood, not a measurement, so the count is beside it.

feedbackReport.noRatings.text: Ga go selo se se kelwego le ga bjale.

feedbackReport.saidNote.text: Di bontšhwa mmogo gomme ka ntle le maina. Maikutlo ka ga mohlahli a botegela feela ge moithuti a dumela gore a ka se balelwe morago o tee ka o tee.
feedbackReport.saidNote.from: Shown together and without names. Feedback about a facilitator is only honest if the learner believes it will not be read back to them one by one.

feedbackReport.noComments.text: Ga go selo se ngwadilwego le ga bjale.

feedbackReport.outstandingNote.text: Lefelo le tee leo leina le bonagalago go lona. Go latelela go a le nyaka; dikarabo tša ka godimo ga di le nyake.
feedbackReport.outstandingNote.from: The one place a name appears. Chasing needs them; the answers above do not.

conductPage.intro.text: Dikelello tšeo di tšweleditšwego ke baithuti, le mang le mang yo rejistara e re o tlogetše go tla. Ditaba tša taolo di lebeletšwe letlakaleng la moithuti ka noši, moo rekhoto ya gagwe ye nngwe e lego gona.
conductPage.intro.from: Grievances raised by learners, and anybody the register says has stopped turning up. Disciplinary matters sit on the learner's own page, where the rest of their record is.

conductPage.overdue.text: {count} ga se tša amogelwa ka nako

conductPage.overdueNote.text: Kelello e amogelwa ka gare ga matšatši a mošomo a {days}. Tše di fetile nako yeo.
conductPage.overdueNote.from: A grievance is acknowledged within {days} working days. These are past that.

conductPage.grievancesNote.text: Di tšweleditšwe ke moithuti ka ga tsela yeo a swarwago ka yona, maemo, goba selo se sengwe se se mo amago. Di arogantšwe le diboipiletšo, tšeo di lego ka ga sephetho gomme di ya go modereitara.
conductPage.grievancesNote.from: Raised by a learner about treatment, conditions, or anything else affecting them. Kept apart from appeals, which are about a result and go to the moderator.

conductPage.abscondedNote.text: Matšatši a mabedi goba go feta a go latelana a tlhahlo ao a se nago go ba gona le lentšu. E badilwe go tšwa rejistareng e sego go bolokwa, ka gona go lokiša letshwao go fetola karabo ka pela. Go se be gona go rekhotilwego e le go lebalelwa ke go tsebišwa, gomme go thiba tatelano.
conductPage.abscondedNote.from: Two or more consecutive training days absent with no word. Read off the register rather than stored, so correcting a mark changes the answer at once. An absence recorded as excused is communication, and breaks the run.

conductPage.nobody.text: Ga go yo. Bohle ba a tla goba ba botše motho gore ke ka lebaka la eng ba sa tle.
conductPage.nobody.from: Nobody. Everybody is either turning up or has told somebody why not.

conductPage.actOn.text: Lenaneo la go dirwa, le sa ke la ba phetho. Go ikgokaganya le moithuti, go ngwalela mothekgi le go ntšha tsebišo ya maikemišetšo a go fediša ke dilo tšeo motho a di dirago.
conductPage.actOn.from: A list to act on, never a decision. Contacting the learner, writing to the sponsor and issuing a notice of intention to terminate are all things a person does.

grievance.nothing.text: Ga go selo se se bulegilego.

grievance.decisionHint.text: Seo se hweditšwego le seo se tlago dirwa. Se ya go moithuti ka go ngwalwa.
grievance.decisionHint.from: What was found and what will be done. This goes to the learner in writing.

grievance.impartial.text: Monyakišiši e swanetše go ba motho yo kelello e sa mo lebanago. Go bitša yo moithuti a mo tletšego go a gannwa, ka gobane “motho yo a kgethilwego yo a sa nago le leeme” ke seo tshepedišo e se tshepišago, gomme beke yeo go se nago bašomi ba bakaakang ke nako yeo e se senyago.
grievance.impartial.from: The investigator must be somebody the grievance is not about. Naming one the learner has complained about is refused, because “a designated impartial person” is what the procedure promises and a short-staffed week is exactly when it gets broken.

access.deniedTitle.text: Ga o na phihlelo ya se
access.deniedTitle.from: You do not have access to this

access.deniedNote.text: O tsene, eupša se ga se sa gago go se bona: goba se ke sa motho yo mongwe, goba se nyaka karolo yeo akhaonto ya gago e sa e swarego. Ge o naganela gore seo ga se se nepagetšego, kgopela molaodi wa gago a lekole.
access.deniedNote.from: You are signed in, but this is not yours to see: either it belongs to someone else, or it needs a role your account does not hold. If you think that is wrong, ask your administrator to check.

access.home.text: Boela letlakaleng la gago la gae

access.unknownTitle.from: This address is not in use

access.unknownNote.text: Ga go mokgatlo wo o beakantšwego aterese ye ya webo, goba phihlelo ya yona e emišitšwe. Lekola aterese yeo o e filwego, goba o ikgokaganye le yo a beakantšego tlhahlo ya gago.
access.unknownNote.from: No organisation is set up at this web address, or its access has been suspended. Check the address you were given, or contact whoever arranged your training.

wpSetup.intro.text: Moithuti o dira maitemogelo a mošomo go mothwadi, a okametšwe ke motho yo mothwadi a mo neago. Kwano e rekhota gore ke mang; puku ya direkhoto e rekhota seo kharikhulamo e se nyakago gore a se dire.
wpSetup.intro.from: A learner does work experience at an employer, supervised by somebody that employer provides. The agreement records who that is; the logbook records what the curriculum requires them to do.

wpSetup.emptyOne.text: Modula o 1 wa maitemogelo a mošomo ga o na ditlhokego tšeo di tšerwego.
wpSetup.emptyOne.from: 1 work experience module has no requirements captured.

wpSetup.empty.text: Dimodula tše {count} tša maitemogelo a mošomo ga di na ditlhokego tšeo di tšerwego.
wpSetup.empty.from: {count} work experience modules have no requirements captured.

wpSetup.emptyNote.text: {codes}. Puku ya direkhoto yeo e agilwego go tšwa go modula o se nago selo e ka se hlatsele selo, ka gona tše ga di kgone go bulwa go fihlela mešomo ya mošomong ya kharikhulamo, tsebo ya mošomong le bohlatse bja thekgo di tsentšwe.
wpSetup.emptyNote.from: {codes}. A logbook built from an empty module would attest to nothing, so those cannot be opened until the curriculum's work activities, workplace knowledge and supporting evidence have been imported.

wpSetup.none.text: Ga go le ye tee le ga bjale.

wpSetup.noCoaches.text: Ga go yo a swerego karolo ya Mokoutši wa Mošomong le ga bjale. Oketša mohlokomedi wa moithuti ka {people} pele: o šomela mothwadi, e sego wena, gomme o tla bona feela baithuti bao ba bolelwago dikwanong tša gagwe.
wpSetup.noCoaches.from: Nobody holds the Workplace Coach role yet. Add the learner's supervisor through {people} first: they work for the employer, not for you, and they will only ever see the learners named on their own agreements.

wpSetup.ownCoach.text: Moithuti a ka se be mokoutši wa gagwe; polokelo ya datha e a gana.
wpSetup.ownCoach.from: The learner cannot be their own coach; the database refuses it.

wpSetup.designationNote.text: E rekhotilwa kwanong bjalo ka ge e eme lehono, gore go saena go dule go bolela gore ke mang yo a saenilego le ka maemo afe.
wpSetup.designationNote.from: Recorded on the agreement as it stands today, so the sign-off keeps saying who signed and in what capacity.

wpSetup.noAgreements.text: Ga go dikwano tša mošomong le ga bjale. Hlama e tee ka godimo pele: puku ya direkhoto e rekhota mošomo o dirilwego go mothwadi yo a bitšwago ka leina, ka tlase ga mokoutši yo a bitšwago ka leina, ka gona e ka se be gona ntle le yona.
wpSetup.noAgreements.from: No workplace agreements yet. Create one above first: a logbook records work done at a named employer under a named coach, so it cannot exist without one.

wpSetup.generated.text: Puku ya direkhoto e hlangwa go tšwa go mešomo ya mošomong ya kharikhulamo ka noši, tsebo ya mošomong le bohlatse bja thekgo, ka gona e ka se lebale tlhokego.
wpSetup.generated.from: The logbook is generated from the curriculum's own work activities, workplace knowledge and supporting evidence, so it cannot omit a requirement.

enrolForm.titleOwn.text: Foromo ya gago ya go ngwadišwa

enrolForm.intro.text: {provider} e swanetše go romela dintlha tše go Khansele ya Boleng bja Mediro le Mešomo ge o ngwadišwa. Tše dintši di šetše di tsebja gomme di bontšhwa ka tlase; tše dingwe ke seo go se nago yo a ka se arabago ntle le wena. O ka boloka ge o tšwela pele gomme wa boela go yona.
enrolForm.intro.from: {provider} has to send these details to the Quality Council for Trades and Occupations when you are enrolled. Most of it is already known and shown below; the rest is what nobody can answer except you. You can save as you go and come back to it.

enrolForm.onRecordNote.text: Botša mokoordineitara wa gago ge e ba se sengwe sa tše e le phošo; ga se sa gago go se fetola mo.
enrolForm.onRecordNote.from: Tell your coordinator if any of this is wrong; it is not yours to change here.

enrolForm.noInduction.text: ditshepedišo tša go tsena ga di eso ngwalwe letšatši

enrolForm.doesNotAdd.text: Se sengwe mo ga se lekane
enrolForm.doesNotAdd.from: Something here does not add up

enrolForm.idNote.text: Nomoro ya boitsebišo ya Afrika Borwa e swara letšatši la matswalo le bong ka gare ga yona, gomme QCTO e lekola gore di a dumelelana. Gantši ke nomoro yeo e ngwadilwego gampe. Mokoordineitara wa gago a ka e lokiša.
enrolForm.idNote.from: A South African identity number carries the date of birth and the gender inside it, and the QCTO checks that they agree. It is usually a mistyped digit. Your coordinator can correct it.

enrolForm.stillNote.text: Ga go selo seo se lahlegago ge o ka emiša gare. Ke seo se tlago hlaelela tlhagišong bjalo ka ge e eme.
enrolForm.stillNote.from: Nothing is lost if you stop partway. This is what would be missing from the submission as it stands.

enrolForm.completeNote.text: Se sengwe le se sengwe seo tlhagišo e se nyakago se mo.
enrolForm.completeNote.from: Everything the submission needs is here.

enrolForm.printNote.text: gore e saenwe le go bewa.

enrolForm.missingPrint.text: Dikarabo tše {count} di sa hlaelela, ka gona foromo ye e tla gatišwa e na le mafelo a se nago selo. A ngwadilwe foromong ka boyona.
enrolForm.missingPrint.from: {count} answers are still missing, so this form will print with blanks. They are listed on the form itself.

enrolForm.completePrint.text: E feditšwe. E gatiše, moithuti a e saene, gomme o e bee.
enrolForm.completePrint.from: Complete. Print it, have the learner sign it, and file it.

enrolForm.unanswered.text: Ga se ya arabja le ga bjale

enrolForm.notAnswered.text: Ga se ya arabja le ga bjale

enrolForm.titleHint.text: Mna, Mdi, Dr, le tše dingwe.
enrolForm.titleHint.from: Mr, Ms, Dr, and so on.

enrolForm.middleHint.text: Ge o na le lona. Le tlogele le se na selo ge o se na lona.
enrolForm.middleHint.from: If you have one. Leave it blank if not.

enrolForm.homeLanguage.text: Polelo yeo o e bolelago gae

enrolForm.working.text: Na o a šoma ga bjale?
enrolForm.working.from: Are you working at the moment?

enrolForm.difficulty.from: How much difficulty does it cause?

enrolForm.difficultyHint.text: Go botšišwa ka gobane bogolofadi bo rekhotilwe kgahlanong le leina la gago. QCTO e nyaka se gotee le yona.
enrolForm.difficultyHint.from: Asked because a disability is recorded against your name. The QCTO requires it alongside.

enrolForm.noId.text: Ge o se na nomoro ya boitsebišo ya Afrika Borwa
enrolForm.noId.from: If you do not have a South African identity number

enrolForm.instead.text: Seo o ngwadišitšwego go sona legatong la yona
enrolForm.instead.from: What you are enrolled on instead

enrolForm.post.text: Moo poso e go fihlelago gona, ge e le lefelong le lengwe
enrolForm.post.from: Where post reaches you, if it is somewhere else

enrolForm.reach.text: Ka fao o ka fihlelwago ka gona

enrolForm.province.text: Profense yeo o šomago go yona

enrolForm.provinceHint.text: Moo o šomago gona, ka mehla e sego moo o dulago gona.
enrolForm.provinceHint.from: Where you work, which is not always where you live.

enrolForm.statssaHint.text: Mokoordineitara wa gago a ka e nyaka ge o sa e tsebe.
enrolForm.statssaHint.from: Your coordinator can look this one up if you do not know it.

enrolForm.flc.text: Bokgoni bja Motheo bja go Ithuta

enrolForm.flcNote.text: E nyakega feela kwalifikeišeneng ya legato la NQF la 3 goba la 4. E tlogele e se na selo ge go se yo a go e kgopetšego.
enrolForm.flcNote.from: Only needed on a qualification at NQF level 3 or 4. Leave it blank if nobody has asked you for it.

enrolForm.agreedOn.text: O dumetše ka {date}. Letšatši leo ke karolo ya rekhoto gomme ga le fetole ge o fetola foromo ye.
enrolForm.agreedOn.from: You agreed on {date}. That date is part of the record and does not change if you edit this form.
