records.intro.text: Tshepedišo ya Taolo ya Boleng le dipholisi tša yona, mangwalo a go amogela, dikonteraka le ditokomane tša molao tša go swana le puku ya PAIA: se sengwe le se sengwe seo moabi a nago le sona seo se sa amanego le moithuti a le mongwe goba kwalifikeišene e tee. Go tsenya foldara ya kwalifikeišene go bea dipholisi tša yona tša QMS mo ka bo yona.
records.intro.from: The Quality Management System and its policies, accreditation letters, contracts, and statutory documents like the PAIA manual: everything the provider holds that does not belong to one learner or one qualification. Importing a qualification folder files its QMS policies here automatically.

records.introManage.text: Gape e bontšha seo se fihlelego mafelelong a nako ya go se boloka.

offline.title.text: Go šoma ntle le mokgwa wa go kgokagana

offline.intro.text: Theošološa seo o se nyakago pele o tšwa. Se sengwe le se sengwe seo o se rekhodago ge o le kgole se bolokwa mogaleng wo gomme sa romelwa gape ge o na le mokgwa wa go kgokagana lekgetlong le le latelago.
offline.intro.from: Download what you need before you go out. Anything you record while you are away is kept on this phone and sent back the next time you have a signal.

offline.takeNote.text: Theošološa seo o se nyakago pele o tšwa. Ga go selo seo se bolokwago seo o sa se kgopelago.
offline.takeNote.from: Download what you need before you go. Nothing is kept that you did not ask for.

offline.recordNote.from: Works with no signal. It waits on this phone and goes when you next have one.

offline.waitingDecisionNote.from: Something changed while the learner was away. Nothing has been merged or overwritten: somebody has to choose.

offline.relaxedNote.from: Work recorded while this programme allowed summatives to be taken offline. If the programme is accredited later, that work does not become defensible retrospectively: this is the list, so it is a decision rather than a discovery at a monitoring visit.

offline.nothingHeld.from: Nothing is held yet. Open a study unit and choose to make it available offline before you go out.

mailbox.notSwitchedOn.from: Sending is not switched on yet: no mail relay is configured, so a message written here could not leave the building. Replies you receive still arrive normally.

lrs.intro.text: Direkhoto tša baithuti ba gago, go tsena le go tšwa, e le dipolelo tša xAPI: mokgwa wo o šomišwago ke mabolokelo a direkhoto tša go ithuta le dikgoro tše dintši tša go ithuta go fetološana. Ga go selo mo seo se fetolago dipheto tša moithuti sethaleng se.
lrs.intro.from: Your learners' records, in and out, as xAPI statements: the format learning record stores and most learning systems exchange. Nothing here changes a learner's results on this platform.

lrs.outNote.text: Go ngwadišwa ka go tee le go tee, thuto e feditšwego, tlhahlobo e lekilwego, phetho ya gore o kgonne goba ga a eso kgone, khoso e feditšwego, setatemente sa diphetho, setifikeiti se amogetšwego le setifikeiti sa kwalifikeišene se amogetšwego: polelo e tee ka e nngwe. Ye nngwe le ye nngwe e boloka boitsebišo bjo bo swanago nako le nako ge o ntšha, ka gona go tsenya difaele tše pedi tša go ntšha go sistimi e nngwe ga go dire gore histori ya mang le mang e ngwalwe gabedi.
lrs.outNote.from: Every enrolment, lesson completed, assessment attempted, competent or not yet competent decision, course completed, statement of results, certificate, and qualification certificate received, one statement each. Each keeps the same identity every time you export, so loading two exports into another system does not double anybody's history.

lrs.download.text: Theošološa direkhoto ka moka tša go ithuta

lrs.downloadNote.text: Faele e bitša moithuti yo mongwe le yo mongwe le aterese ya gagwe ya emeile. E boloke bjalo ka rekhoto efe goba efe ya tshedimošo ya ka noši.
lrs.downloadNote.from: The file names every learner and their email address. Keep it as you would any record of personal information.

lrs.store.text: Romela direkhoto polokelong ya gago ya direkhoto tša go ithuta
lrs.store.from: Send records to your own learning record store

lrs.storeNote.text: Ge o na le polokelo ya direkhoto tša go ithuta, e kgokagane mo gomme rekhoto ye nngwe le ye nngwe ya ka godimo e ya go yona ka gare ga iri ya ge e diregile, tšeo di šetšego di dirilwe pele. Ye nngwe le ye nngwe e romelwa gatee; polelo yeo polokelo e e swerego e tlogelwa bjalo ka ge e le. Sephiri sa polokelo se tswaletšwe sethaleng se, ga se sa bontšhwa gape, gomme se lebalelwa ge o kgaoga.
lrs.storeNote.from: If you keep a learning record store, connect it here and every record above goes to it within the hour of happening, the ones already made first. Each is sent once; a statement the store already holds is left as it is. The store's secret is sealed on this platform, never shown again, and forgotten when you disconnect.

lrs.inNote.text: Faele ya dipolelo tša xAPI go tšwa go sistimi e nngwe: lenane la dipolelo, goba seo polokelo ya direkhoto tša go ithuta e se busetšago. Ye nngwe le ye nngwe e swantšhwa le moithuti mo ka emeile gomme ya bontšhwa rekhotong ya gagwe. E bolokwa e le go ithuta go dirilwego kae kae, e sego go fetolwa go ngwadišwa goba sephetho mo, ka gobane ga go selo sa yona seo se ilego sa rutwa goba sa hlahlobja sethaleng se.
lrs.inNote.from: A file of xAPI statements from another system: a list of statements, or what a learning record store returns. Each is matched to a learner here by email and shown on their record. It is kept as learning done elsewhere, not turned into an enrolment or a result here, because none of it was taught or assessed on this platform.

verifyPage.intro.text: Tsenya tshupetšo yeo e gatišitšwego setifikeiteng. Ga go akhaonto yeo e nyakegago.
verifyPage.intro.from: Enter the reference printed on the certificate. No account is needed.

verifyPage.validStatement.text: Setatemente sa Diphetho se se nepagetšego

verifyPage.validStatementNote.text: Moithuti yo o fihleleditše dikriteria ka moka tša tlhahlobo ya ka gare tša kwalifikeišene ya ka tlase gomme a ka tsenywa go Tlhahlobo ya Go Phetha ya Kopantšwego ya ka Ntle.
verifyPage.validStatementNote.from: This learner has achieved every internal assessment criterion for the qualification below and may be entered for the External Integrated Summative Assessment.

verifyPage.doNotAccept.text: O se ke wa amogela tokomane ye. Ikgokaganye le moabi yo a bitšwago go yona ge moithuti a dumela gore ye ke phošo.
verifyPage.doNotAccept.from: Do not accept this document. Contact the provider named on it if the learner believes this is a mistake.

verifyPage.statementExpired.text: Setatemente sa Diphetho se fetile nako

verifyPage.expiredNote.text: Setatemente sa Diphetho se šoma ka nywaga e mebedi go tloga letšatšing leo se filwego ka lona. Se se filwe ka {issued} gomme sa fela ka {expired}.
verifyPage.expiredNote.from: A Statement of Results is valid for two years from the date it was issued. This one was issued on {issued} and expired on {expired}.

verifyPage.expiredNote2.text: Ga go phošo ka phihlelo ya moithuti: ke tokomane yeo e felelwego. Moabi yo a bitšwago go yona a ka fa se sefsa.
verifyPage.expiredNote2.from: Nothing is wrong with the learner's achievement: it is the document that has run out. The provider named on it can issue a current one.

verifyPage.notFound.text: Ga go setifikeiti seo se hweditšwego

verifyPage.notFoundNote.text: Ga go setifikeiti seo se nago le tshupetšo yeo. Se lekole kgahlanong le tokomane: ditlhaka I, L, O, U, 0 le 1 ga di šomišwe le ka mohla, ka gona 1 ke 7 goba J, gomme O ke Q goba D.
verifyPage.notFoundNote.from: No certificate carries that reference. Check it against the document: the characters I, L, O, U, 0 and 1 are never used, so a 1 is a 7 or a J, and an O is a Q or a D.

verifyPage.withdrawnDetail.text: Se filwe {holder} bakeng sa {title}, gomme sa gogwa ka {date}.
verifyPage.withdrawnDetail.from: It was issued to {holder} for {title}, and withdrawn on {date}.

verifyPage.notRely.from: It should not be relied on.

verifyPage.badgeNote.text: Ye ke rekhoto ya moabi ka noši ya gore mong wa yona o feditše modula wo wa go ithuta. Ga se kwalifikeišene ya bosetšhaba, ga se na dikrediti, gomme ga se filwe ke khansele ya boleng. Kwalifikeišene e netefatšwa ka tshupetšo ya yona ya setifikeiti.
verifyPage.badgeNote.from: This is a provider's own record that the holder completed this module of study. It is not a national qualification, carries no credits, and is not awarded by a quality council. A qualification is verified by its own certificate reference.

platformPage.intro.text: Mokgatlo o mongwe le o mongwe sethaleng. O ka bona kamoo o mongwe le o mongwe o šomišago ka gona gomme wa laola peakanyo ya wona, eupša e sego baithuti ba wona, dikhoso goba direkhoto tša tlhahlobo. Go swara sistimi ya moreki ga go swane le go ba le tokelo ya go e bala, gomme sethala se se phethagatša e sego go ithekga ka go itshwara.
platformPage.intro.from: Every organisation on the platform. You can see how much each is using and manage their configuration, but not their learners, courses or assessment records. Hosting a client's system is not the same as being entitled to read it, and the platform enforces that rather than relying on restraint.

folderPick.noneNote.from: It adds one thing here: working out the structure from the documents, when a folder does not include a summary of itself. Everything else on this page works without it. Settings, under your AI extension, if you want one.

said.alignment-document.c3e49767.text: Ga go yuniti ya go ithuta yeo e hweditšwego tokomaneng yeo. Hlogotaba e tee e swanetše go swana le “Study Unit 1 – Organisational Architecture”, le dimodula tšeo e di akaretšago tše di lego ka tlase ga yona.
said.alignment-document.c3e49767.from: No study units were found in that document. One heading has to read like “Study Unit 1 – Organisational Architecture”, with the modules it covers listed under it.

said.alignment-matrix.185b0901.text: Ga go matrikse a kopantšho yeo e hweditšwego bukeng ye ya mošomo. Kholomo e tee e swanetše go ba le hlogo e swanago le “Topic Elements”, gore methalo e ka swantšhwa le kharikhulamo.
said.alignment-matrix.185b0901.from: No alignment matrix found in this workbook. One column must be headed something like “Topic Elements”, so the rows can be matched to the curriculum.

said.alignment-matrix.2b19415b.text: Ye ke tokomane ya Word. Tokomane ka noši e bolokwa, e bewa gomme e a nyakwa. Seo se sa kgonegego ke go e bala, ka gobane matrikse a kopantšho a balwa e le letlakala la palo: mothalo o tee bakeng sa mothalo o mongwe le o mongwe wa kharikhulamo, le kholomo yeo e nago le hlogo e swanago le “Topic Elements”. Boloka matrikse e le letlakala la palo gomme o e tsenye godimo le yona, gomme mothalo o mongwe le o mongwe wa kharikhulamo o tla bontšha seo se o akaretšago.
said.alignment-matrix.2b19415b.from: That is a Word document. The document itself is kept, filed and searchable. What could not happen is reading it, because the alignment matrix is read as a spreadsheet: one row per curriculum line, with a column headed something like “Topic Elements”. Save the matrix as a spreadsheet and upload that as well, and each line of the curriculum will show what covers it.

said.alignment-matrix.a0d14e78.text: Matrikse ga a na dikholomo tša methopo tšeo di ka tsebjago: ga go selo seo se nago le hlogo ya Workbook, Assessment, Theory Guide, Legislation le tše dingwe.
said.alignment-matrix.a0d14e78.from: The matrix has no resource columns that could be recognised: nothing headed Workbook, Assessment, Theory Guide, Legislation and so on.

said.alignment-matrix.a8527ba8.text: Tsenya tokomane ya kharikhulamo pele ga matrikse a kopantšho: ga go selo le ga bjale seo methalo ya yona e ka kgomarelago go sona.
said.alignment-matrix.a8527ba8.from: Import the curriculum document before the alignment matrix: there is nothing yet for its rows to attach to.

said.alignment-matrix.cf20070f.text: Matriksing, e sego kharikhulamong bjalo ka ge e badilwe.
said.alignment-matrix.cf20070f.from: In the matrix, not in the curriculum as read.

said.alignment-matrix.e1c0c850.text: Matrikse a re kharikhulamo e phatlalatša se; kharikhulamo bjalo ka ge e badilwe ga e na sona.
said.alignment-matrix.e1c0c850.from: The matrix says the curriculum publishes this; the curriculum as read does not have it.

said.cohorts-id-payment-actions.28dad8d7.from: Invoice recorded. Add the payment date when it comes in.

said.cohorts-id-payment-actions.3b6a1d72.from: Recorded. Everybody in this cohort now counts as paid for.

said.cohorts.043bd894.from: That cohort is {status}, so nobody further can join it.

said.cohorts.2d78adeb.from: Sitting set up. It is scheduled until you open it.

said.cohorts.39a77df0.from: They are not on that cohort.

said.cohorts.5012d3ed.text: Fa letšatši la go thoma ka mokgwa wa YYYY-MM-DD.
said.cohorts.5012d3ed.from: Give the start date as YYYY-MM-DD.

said.cohorts.5e4a92c3.text: Go tlogela go rekhotilwe. Ga ba kgone go amogelwa gape nakong ye ya go ngwala.
said.cohorts.5e4a92c3.from: Drop-out recorded. They cannot be readmitted to this sitting.

said.cohorts.7ee8f7f0.text: Letšatši la go thoma le šuthišitšwe. Letšatši le lengwe le le lengwe la lenaneo le šuthile le lona.
said.cohorts.7ee8f7f0.from: Start date moved. Every date on the schedule moved with it.

said.cohorts.c22d7fc1.text: E oketšwe sehlopheng gomme ba ngwadišitšwe khosong ya sona.
said.cohorts.c22d7fc1.from: Added to the cohort and enrolled on its course.

said.cohorts.c798922f.text: Mogato ga o kgone go swanela pele o bulwa.
said.cohorts.c798922f.from: A step cannot be due before it opens.

said.cohorts.f0b50e14.text: Kopano e oketšwe lenaneong la nako.

said.cohorts.fb75334d.text: Lenaneo la nako le bolela mogato woo o sego khosong ya sehlopha se.
said.cohorts.fb75334d.from: The schedule names a step that is not on this cohort's course.

said.conduct.07e411c2.text: Bolela gore kelello e mabapi le eng, ka mantšu a moithuti ka noši ge go kgonega.
said.conduct.07e411c2.from: Say what the grievance is about, in the learner's own words where possible.

said.conduct.1636d693.text: Kelello e bolela {firstName} {lastName}. Motho yo tletšo e mo lebanago a ka se e nyakišiše: tshepedišo e nyaka motho yo a kgethilwego yo a sa nago le leeme. Kgetha yo mongwe.
said.conduct.1636d693.from: The grievance names {firstName} {lastName}. Somebody the complaint is about cannot investigate it: the procedure asks for a designated impartial person. Appoint somebody else.

said.conduct.1d25ed57.text: Tsebišo e swanetše go bolela ditatofatšo tše di kgethegilego. Kwedišišo ka ga ditatofatšo tšeo di sa boletšwego e ka se arabjwe.
said.conduct.1d25ed57.from: The notice has to state the specific allegations. A hearing about unstated allegations cannot be answered.

said.conduct.1e2d5837.text: E rekhotilwe. Matšatši a mahlano a mošomo a go ipiletša a thoma lehono.
said.conduct.1e2d5837.from: Recorded. The five working days to appeal run from today.

said.conduct.303f7f08.text: Bolela gore ke dikotlo dife tšeo di kgonegago, go akaretša go fediša moo go lego gona. Moithuti yo a nagana ge a tla tliša thušo o swanetše go tseba seo se lego kotsing.
said.conduct.303f7f08.from: Say what sanctions are possible, including termination where it is. A learner deciding whether to bring assistance needs to know what is at stake.

said.conduct.403b3f35.text: Bolela lebaka. Kotlo yeo e sa hlalošwago ga e šireletšege, gomme ye ke temana yeo moithuti a nago le tokelo ya yona.
said.conduct.403b3f35.from: Say why. An unexplained sanction is indefensible, and this is the paragraph the learner is entitled to.

said.conduct.47a20502.text: Bolela molao wo o thulilwego, tekanyetšo yeo e letetšwego le seo se diregago ge se ka boeleletšwa. Temošo yeo e sa dirego bjalo ga se temošo.
said.conduct.47a20502.from: State the rule broken, the standard expected and what happens if it recurs. A warning that does not is not one.

said.conduct.4dcaf05f.text: Seo ga se letšatši le nako.
said.conduct.4dcaf05f.from: That is not a date and time.

said.conduct.64f7462f.text: Tsebišo e swanetše go botša moithuti gore a ka thušwa ke moithuti-mmogo, a tliša taba ya gagwe, gomme a bitša le go botšiša dihlatse. Roma tsebišo yeo e dirago bjalo, gomme o e rekhode mo.
said.conduct.64f7462f.from: The notice must tell the learner they may be assisted by a fellow learner, present their case, and call and question witnesses. Send a notice that does, then record it here.

said.conduct.67f9675a.text: Rekhoda seo se hweditšwego le motheo wa sona. Kwedišišo yeo diphihlelo tša yona e lego mothalo o tee ke kwedišišo yeo e sego ya direga.
said.conduct.67f9675a.from: Record what was found and on what basis. A hearing whose findings are one line is a hearing that did not happen.

said.conduct.6a6b5da7.from: It has to be acknowledged by {acknowledgeBy}.

said.conduct.6d857ec5.text: Go fediša lenaneo la motho go nyaka kwedišišo yeo e swerwego, gomme diphihlelo tša yona di rekhotilwe. Bitša e tee, rekhoda seo se hweditšwego, ka morago o tswale taba.
said.conduct.6d857ec5.from: Ending somebody's programme needs a hearing that was held, with its findings recorded. Convene one, record what was found, then close the case.

said.conduct.77c80d2a.text: E tsentšwe. E tla amogelwa ka gare ga matšatši a mabedi a mošomo.
said.conduct.77c80d2a.from: Lodged. It will be acknowledged within two working days.

said.conduct.869c74ee.text: Kopano ya go theeletša e nyaka bonyane diiri tše {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} tša tsebišo, gomme ye e kopana ka diiri tše {hours}. Nako ya pele yeo e ka swarwago ka yona ke {earliest}. Tsebišo ye khutšwane ke phošo yeo boipiletšo bo hlwahlwago ka yona, go sa kgathale seo moithuti a se dirilego.
said.conduct.869c74ee.from: A hearing needs at least {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} hours' notice and this is {hours} hour short. The earliest it can be held is {earliest}. Short notice is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

said.conduct.8d0ef3ad.text: Kwedišišo e budišitšwe. Nako ya tsebišo e phethagetše.
said.conduct.8d0ef3ad.from: Hearing convened. The notice period is met.

said.conduct.9f172fca.text: Moithuti a ka se nyakišiše kelello ya gagwe ka noši.
said.conduct.9f172fca.from: The learner cannot investigate their own grievance.

said.conduct.ad753d2e.text: Phetho e ya go moithuti ka go ngwalwa gomme e swanetše go bolela seo se hweditšwego le seo se tlago dirwa. Mothalo o tee ga se phetho.
said.conduct.ad753d2e.from: The decision goes to the learner in writing and has to say what was found and what will be done. A line is not a decision.

said.conduct.b0301d88.text: Bolela seo se tlatšwago, ka bogolo. Moithuti a ka se arabe 'boiphihlo bjo bobe', le kwedišišo e ka se kgone.
said.conduct.b0301d88.from: Say what is alleged, specifically. A learner cannot answer 'poor attitude', and neither can a hearing.

said.conduct.b0dcbd53.text: E phethilwe, gomme moithuti o na le yona ka go ngwalwa.
said.conduct.b0dcbd53.from: Decided, and the learner has it in writing.

said.conduct.cf47131c.text: E tswaletšwe. Fa moithuti sephetho ka go ngwalwa, ka morago o rekhode gore o dirile bjalo.
said.conduct.cf47131c.from: Closed. Give the learner the outcome in writing, then record that you have.

said.conduct.e83b2265.text: Kwedišišo e nyaka tsebišo ya diiri tše {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} bonyane gomme ye e šetše ka diiri tše {hours}. Nako ya pele yeo e ka swarwago ka yona ke {earliest}. Tsebišo e khutšwane ke phošo yeo boipiletšo bo hlolwago ka yona, go sa kgathale seo moithuti a se dirilego.
said.conduct.e83b2265.from: A hearing needs at least {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} hours' notice and this is {hours} hours short. The earliest it can be held is {earliest}. Short notice is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

said.drive-google-drive.3ad31c62.text: Google ga e sa amogela kgokagano yeo. E ka ba e tlošitšwe akhaontong ya gago ya Google. Kgokaganya disiki gape go Dipeakanyo.
said.drive-google-drive.3ad31c62.from: Google no longer accepts that connection. It may have been withdrawn from your Google account. Connect the drive again in Settings.

said.drive-google-drive.8761e449.text: Foldara yeo ga e gona, goba akhaonto yeo o e kgokagantšego e ka se e bone. Foldara yeo e abelanwego le wena e swanetše go bulwa go Drive bonyane gatee pele e ka balwa.
said.drive-google-drive.8761e449.from: That folder is not there, or the account you connected cannot see it. A folder shared with you has to be opened in Drive at least once before it can be read.

said.drive-google-drive.b744db3d.text: Google e ganne kgopelo yeo. Ge e bolela ka kgato, mo tlhoko ya Drive API ya go šomiša e fihlile ka nako ye. {message}
said.drive-google-drive.b744db3d.from: Google refused that request. If it mentions a quota, the deployment's Drive API limit has been reached for now. {message}

said.drive-google-drive.c0c95fa0.text: Google ga se ya bušetša tsela ya go mpshafatša kgokagano, seo gantši se bolelago gore akhaonto ye e šetše e e file tetla. Tloša phihlelo ya sethaleng akhaontong ya gago ya Google ka fase ga Third-party apps, gomme o kgokaganye gape.
said.drive-google-drive.c0c95fa0.from: Google did not return a way to renew the connection, which usually means this account had already granted it. Remove the platform's access in your Google account under Third-party apps, then connect again.

said.drive-google-drive.dcf45956.text: "{name}" e kgolo kudu gore Google e e rometše ka nako e tee. Theošološa tokomane yeo o le tee go Drive e le {extension} gomme o e tsenye ka noši ka morago; tše dingwe ka moka tša foldara di balwa ka mo go tlwaelegilego.
said.drive-google-drive.dcf45956.from: "{name}" is too large for Google to export in one piece. Download that one document from Drive as {extension} and add it on its own afterwards; everything else in the folder reads normally.

said.drive-google-drive.e9fe6eee.text: Bala foldara ka go lebanya go tšwa go Google Drive ya gago. Go bala feela: sethaleng se ka lokolla lenaneo le go theošološa, eupša ga se kgone go hlama, go fetola goba go phumola selo. O ka e gogela morago mo goba akhaontong ya gago ya Google nako efe goba efe.
said.drive-google-drive.e9fe6eee.from: Read a folder straight from your Google Drive. Read-only: the platform can list and download, and cannot create, change or delete anything. You can withdraw it here or from your Google account at any time.

said.drive-import.1f557235.text: Foldara yeo ga e na selo seo sethaleng se ka se balago. Ditokomane, diteetšhithi le dipaledišo di a balwa, go akaretša tša Google ka noši, ka gona sephetho se se nago selo se bolela gore foldara e sa le e se na selo, goba e na le dilo feela tše bjalo ka Forms le dikhutšwane.
said.drive-import.1f557235.from: That folder has nothing in it the platform can read. Documents, spreadsheets and presentations are all read, including Google's own, so an empty result means the folder really is empty, or holds only things like Forms and shortcuts.

said.drive-import.6977b553.text: Foldara yeo e ka ba le bogolo bja {known} MB, e lego seo se fetago seo se ka balwago gatee. Kgetha foldara ya kwalifikeišene e tee, e sego disiki yeo e lego go yona.
said.drive-import.6977b553.from: That folder comes to about {known} MB, which is more than can be read in one go. Choose the folder for one qualification rather than the drive it sits in.

said.drive-import.bc65916e.text: Foldara yeo e na le difaele tše {listedCount}, e lego seo se fetago seo se ka balwago gatee. Kgetha foldara ya kwalifikeišene e tee, e sego disiki yeo e lego go yona.
said.drive-import.bc65916e.from: That folder holds {listedCount} files, which is more than can be read in one go. Choose the folder for one qualification rather than the drive it sits in.

said.drive-index.adeba1a9.text: O ešo o kgokagane le {label}. Kgokagana go Dipeakanyo, gomme foldara e ka balwa go tloga fao.
said.drive-index.adeba1a9.from: You have not connected {label}. Connect it in Settings, and the folder can be read from there.

said.drive-index.b3dd24ac.text: Disiki yeo ga se yeo sethaleng se e tsebago.
said.drive-index.b3dd24ac.from: That drive is not one the platform knows.

said.drive-index.be999bc2.text: Kabo ye ga e kgone go boloka tshepetšo ya go tsena ka polokego, ka gona disiki e ka se kgokaganywe. Motho yo a e hlokomelago o swanetše go bea senotlelo sa go tiiša.
said.drive-index.be999bc2.from: This deployment cannot store a credential safely, so a drive cannot be connected. Whoever maintains it needs to set the sealing key.

said.drive-index.f1db1389.text: Kgokagano ya {label} yeo e bolokilwego e ka se balwe. E kgokaganye gape go Dipeakanyo.
said.drive-index.f1db1389.from: The stored {label} connection cannot be read. Connect it again in Settings.

said.drive-one-drive.2d141e83.text: Foldara yeo ga e gona, goba akhaonto yeo o e kgokagantšego e ka se e bone.
said.drive-one-drive.2d141e83.from: That folder is not there, or the account you connected cannot see it.

said.drive-one-drive.2f5a255d.text: Microsoft ga se ya bušetša tokeni ya phihlelo.
said.drive-one-drive.2f5a255d.from: Microsoft did not return an access token.

said.drive-one-drive.4180c6e1.text: Microsoft ga se ya bušetša tsela ya go mpshafatša kgokagano. Aplikhešene e ka ba e sa kgopele phihlelo ya ka ntle ga inthanete.
said.drive-one-drive.4180c6e1.from: Microsoft did not return a way to renew the connection. The application may not be asking for offline access.

said.drive-one-drive.74ff1cef.text: Microsoft e ganne kgopelo yeo. Akhaonto yeo o e kgokagantšego e ka ba e se na phihlelo ya foldara yeo. {message}
said.drive-one-drive.74ff1cef.from: Microsoft refused that request. The account you connected may not have access to that folder. {message}

said.drive-one-drive.a65a4207.text: Microsoft ga e sa amogela kgokagano yeo. E ka ba e tlošitšwe akhaontong ya gago. Kgokaganya disiki gape go Dipeakanyo.
said.drive-one-drive.a65a4207.from: Microsoft no longer accepts that connection. It may have been withdrawn from your account. Connect the drive again in Settings.

said.drive-one-drive.c6aef863.text: Bala foldara ka go lebanya go tšwa go OneDrive ya gago. Go bala feela: sethaleng se ka lokolla lenaneo le go theošološa, eupša ga se kgone go hlama, go fetola goba go phumola selo. O ka e gogela morago mo goba akhaontong ya gago ya Microsoft nako efe goba efe.
said.drive-one-drive.c6aef863.from: Read a folder straight from your OneDrive. Read-only: the platform can list and download, and cannot create, change or delete anything. You can withdraw it here or from your Microsoft account at any time.

said.eisa-registration.3015ea44.text: Go ngwadiša go ka se tswalwe ka morago ga kopano ya go ngwala yeo go e lebanego.
said.eisa-registration.3015ea44.from: Registration cannot close after the sitting it is for.

said.eisa-sitting-notice.4242bc7f.text: Ga go dikopano tša go ngwala tšeo di rekhotilwego bakeng sa {subject}. Matšatši a tšwa lengwalong la molekane wa boleng bja tlhahlobo gomme a fetoga ngwaga o mongwe le o mongwe. Go fihlela a tsentšwe, ga go selo mo se ka go gopotšago gore letšatši la mafelelo la go ngwadiša le a atamela.
said.eisa-sitting-notice.4242bc7f.from: No sittings are recorded for {subject}. The dates come from the assessment quality partner's letter and change every year. Until they are entered, nothing here can warn you that a registration deadline is coming.

said.eisa-sitting-notice.b6bf1cc3.text: Ga go dikopano tša go ngwala tšeo di rekhotilwego bakeng sa {subject}. Molekane wa boleng bja tlhahlobo o phatlalatša matšatši ka Disemere, ka gona lengwalo le swanetše go ba le tšwile: a keketše gomme go bala morago go a thoma.
said.eisa-sitting-notice.b6bf1cc3.from: No sittings are recorded for {subject}. The assessment quality partner publishes the dates in December, so the letter should be out: add them and the countdown starts.

said.eisa-sitting-notice.d6b538b0.text: Ga go dikopano tša go ngwala tšeo di rekhotilwego. Di tšwa lengwalong la molekane wa boleng bja tlhahlobo, leo le phatlalatšwago ga tee ka ngwaga.
said.eisa-sitting-notice.d6b538b0.from: No sittings are recorded. They come from the assessment quality partner's letter, which is published once a year.

said.eisa.041d2d1d.text: E rekhotilwe. Go bala morago go ya go ngwadiša go thoma bjale.
said.eisa.041d2d1d.from: Recorded. The countdown to registration starts now.

said.eisa.18104c26.text: Ga go puku ya direkhoto ya maitemogelo a mošomo yeo e butšwego.
said.eisa.18104c26.from: No work experience logbook has been opened.

said.eisa.235f3916.text: E busetšwe ke mokoutši wa mošomong gore go tsenywe bohlatse bjo bongwe.
said.eisa.235f3916.from: Returned by the workplace coach for more evidence.

said.eisa.2d36e0ea.text: E saenwe ke mokoutši wa mošomong, e emetše gore mohlahlobi a e amogele.
said.eisa.2d36e0ea.from: Signed by the workplace coach, waiting for an assessor to accept it.

said.eisa.aabe4744.text: Go mokoutši wa mošomong gore a e saene.
said.eisa.aabe4744.from: With the workplace coach for signature.

said.enrolment-document-shape.04f2917b.text: Netefatšo e kgale go feta nako yeo e dumeletšwego. Kgopela gore kopi e mpsha e netefatšwe.
said.enrolment-document-shape.04f2917b.from: The certification is older than the period allowed. Please have a fresh copy certified.

said.enrolment-document-shape.3d15f524.text: Ye ga se kopi yeo e netefaditšwego. Kgopela gore e netefatšwe gomme o e romele gape.
said.enrolment-document-shape.3d15f524.from: This is not a certified copy. Please have it certified and send it again.

said.enrolment-document-shape.8d2c9fdc.text: Kopi ga e balege. Skena goba o e tšee diswantšho gape, e le sephara gape e le mo seetšeng se sebotse.
said.enrolment-document-shape.8d2c9fdc.from: The copy is not legible. Please scan or photograph it again, flat and in good light.

said.enrolment-document-shape.a7aecdc1.text: ID e na le matšatši a mantši a netefatšo. Fa kopi yeo e netefaditšwego gatee, e sa le nyenyane.
said.enrolment-document-shape.a7aecdc1.from: The ID has more than one certification date on it. Please supply a copy certified once, recently.

said.enrolment-document-shape.ad8ee9a7.text: Ye ga se tokomane yeo e kgopetšwego.
said.enrolment-document-shape.ad8ee9a7.from: This is not the document that was asked for.

said.enrolment-document-shape.d9deb62d.text: Ditsebe tše dingwe ga di gona.
said.enrolment-document-shape.d9deb62d.from: Some of the pages are missing.

said.enrolment-documents.07cca752.text: Ga go selo seo se rekhotilwego: sehlopha le moithuti ga ba na tefo yeo e ba lebanego.
said.enrolment-documents.07cca752.from: Nothing recorded: neither the cohort nor the learner has a payment against them.

said.enrolment-documents.221ad898.text: E lefilwe ke moreki, kgahlanong le {name}.
said.enrolment-documents.221ad898.from: Paid for by the client, against {name}.

said.enrolment-documents.26e4b850.text: Fa letšatši leo kopi ye e netefaditšwego ka lona. Kopi yeo letšatši la yona la netefatšo le sa tsebjego e ka se bontšhwe e sa le e ntšha.
said.enrolment-documents.26e4b850.from: Give the date this copy was certified. A copy whose certification date is unknown cannot be shown to be current.

said.enrolment-documents.330b87d3.text: Moithuti o file bohlatse bja gagwe bja tefo.
said.enrolment-documents.330b87d3.from: The learner supplied their own proof of payment.

said.enrolment-documents.3f1d945a.text: Moithuti o file bohlatse bja tefo, bjo bo sa lekolwago.
said.enrolment-documents.3f1d945a.from: The learner has supplied a proof of payment, not yet checked.

said.enrolment-documents.435df660.text: Bohlatse bja tefo bja moithuti bo ganetšwe.
said.enrolment-documents.435df660.from: The learner's proof of payment was refused.

said.enrolment-documents.98317f79.text: Bolela lebaka la go e gana. Moithuti o swanetše go botšwa seo a swanetšego go se lokiša, gomme go gana ka ntle le lebaka go mo busetša a se na selo sa go se dira.
said.enrolment-documents.98317f79.from: Say why it was refused. The learner has to be told what to correct, and a refusal with no reason sends them back with nothing to act on.

said.enrolment-documents.d417e6fa.text: Kopi yeo e netefaditšwe ka {certifiedOn}, e lego go feta matšatši a {CERTIFICATION_VALID_DAYS} a a fetilego. Kopi yeo e netefaditšwego e swanetše go ba e sa le ntšha ge e fiwa.
said.enrolment-documents.d417e6fa.from: That copy was certified on {certifiedOn}, which is more than {CERTIFICATION_VALID_DAYS} days ago. A certified copy has to be current when it is supplied.

said.enrolment-documents.e88ccb00.text: Faele yeo ga se ya amogelwa: {reason}

said.enrolment-form.141771ac.text: Go tšwa lenaneong la dikhoutu tša dinaga tša STATSSA leo QCTO e le phatlalatšago.
said.enrolment-form.141771ac.from: From the STATSSA area code list the QCTO publishes.

said.enrolment-form.158eb69b.text: Pego e botšiša gore na moithuti o dumetše, le ka letšatši lefe.
said.enrolment-form.158eb69b.from: The return asks whether the learner agreed, and on what date.

said.enrolment-form.3ecff80b.text: Bong bjo bo rekhotilwego ga bo swane le bjo bo lego nomorong ya boitsebišo. QCTO e lekola se, ka gona e tee ya tše pedi e ngwadilwe ka phošo.
said.enrolment-form.3ecff80b.from: The gender recorded does not match the one in the identity number. The QCTO checks this, so one of the two is mistyped.

said.enrolment-form.5d06240c.text: Letšatši la tswalo leo le rekhotilwego ({recorded}) ga le swane le nomoro ya boitsebišo, yeo e rego {fromId}.
said.enrolment-form.5d06240c.from: The date of birth recorded ({recorded}) does not match the identity number, which says {fromId}.

said.enrolment-form.7d5cda8a.text: E netefaditšwe, gomme letšatši le rekhotilwe. Ge o ka fetola selo mo ka morago, e tla go kgopela gore o netefatše gape.
said.enrolment-form.7d5cda8a.from: Confirmed, and the date recorded. Change anything here later and it will ask you to confirm again.

said.enrolment-form.a380df96.text: E bolokilwe. O ka boela gomme wa e phetha ka morago.
said.enrolment-form.a380df96.from: Saved. You can come back and finish it later.

said.enrolment-form.a8dcc4e9.text: Nomoro ya boitsebišo ga e nepagale: {reason}
said.enrolment-form.a8dcc4e9.from: The identity number does not check out: {reason}

said.enrolment-form.b67325d1.text: Ga go yo a netefaditšego gore dintlha tše di nepagetše. Molekodi o kgopela foromo e le bohlatse, gomme e sa netefatšwago ke bohlatse bjo bo nyenyane kudu.
said.enrolment-form.b67325d1.from: Nobody has confirmed these details are right. A monitor asks for the form as evidence, and an unconfirmed one is evidence of very little.

said.enrolment-form.b711b7ce.text: Bogolofadi bo rekhotilwe, gomme QCTO e nyaka gore bo baka bothata bjo bokaakang.
said.enrolment-form.b711b7ce.from: A disability was recorded, and the QCTO then requires how much difficulty it causes.

said.enrolment-form.ca9579a9.text: Profense yeo moithuti a šomago go yona, yeo e sego ka mehla e lego moo a dulago gona.
said.enrolment-form.ca9579a9.from: The province the learner works in, which is not always where they live.

said.enrolment.52c9b5f2.text: Ke khoso feela yeo e phatlaladitšwego yeo e ka abelwago moithuti.
said.enrolment.52c9b5f2.from: Only a published course can be assigned to a learner.

said.enrolment.65b99bc7.text: Motho yoo o šetše a ngwadišitšwe khosong ye.
said.enrolment.65b99bc7.from: That person is already enrolled on this course.

said.enrolment.678cc7c5.text: Ga go letšatši la go fela le le beilwego go ye.
said.enrolment.678cc7c5.from: There is no due date on this one.

said.enrolment.6ac9079d.text: Go ngwadišwa moo go ba motho yo mongwe.
said.enrolment.6ac9079d.from: That enrolment belongs to someone else.

said.enrolment.79fda720.text: Ke moithuti feela yo a ka rekhodago tšwelopele ya gagwe.
said.enrolment.79fda720.from: Only the learner can record their own progress.

said.enrolment.ab1eec65.text: Thuto yeo ga se karolo ya khoso ye.
said.enrolment.ab1eec65.from: That lesson is not part of this course.

said.extensions-claude-code.149b1d9d.text: Claude Code ga e a ikgetha lefelong leo sethaleng se šomago go lona.
said.extensions-claude-code.149b1d9d.from: Claude Code is not installed where the platform is running.

said.extensions-claude-code.1c9bd1dc.text: Claude Code e ikgethilwe mo motšhineng wo eupša ga go yo a tsenego. Bula terminal, tsenya claude, gomme /login o phethe go tsena ka bruwsara. Ke mogato wa nako e tee, gomme o dirwa ke wena, e sego ke sethaleng.
said.extensions-claude-code.1c9bd1dc.from: Claude Code is installed on this machine but nobody is signed in. Open a terminal, run claude, then /login and complete the sign-in in the browser. That is a one-time step and it is done by you, not by the platform.

said.extensions-claude-code.30018e0d.text: Claude Code e paletšwe ke go thoma: {error}

said.extensions-claude-code.446b5c16.text: Claude Code ga se ya bušetša sephetho.

said.extensions-claude-code.53fe3e99.text: Mothalo wa go diriša wa kaonto ya Claude o fihlile. Se se tla šoma gape ge mothalo o mpshafatšwa.
said.extensions-claude-code.53fe3e99.from: The Claude subscription's usage limit has been reached. This will work again once the limit resets.

said.extensions-claude-code.7f69ba19.text: E diriša kaonto ya gago ya Claude, ka tokeni yeo o e ipopelago komputareng ya gago ka `claude setup-token`. Ga se senotlelo sa API: ga go na tefo ka tokeni, gomme e diriša kaonto yeo o šetšego o e lefela, e sego e abelanwego.
said.extensions-claude-code.7f69ba19.from: Uses your own Claude subscription, through a token you generate on your own computer with `claude setup-token`. Not an API key: no per-token cost, and it draws on the subscription you already pay for rather than a shared one.

said.extensions-claude-code.801580be.text: Claude Code ga se ya araba ka gare ga metsotswana e {timeoutMs}.
said.extensions-claude-code.801580be.from: Claude Code did not answer within {timeoutMs} seconds.

said.extensions-gemini.0473bc2d.text: Ga go senotlelo sa API sa Gemini seo se bolokilwego bakeng sa gago. Se keketše go Dipeakanyo. Se tšwa go Google AI Studio, gomme ga se se swanago le kaonto ya Gemini.
said.extensions-gemini.0473bc2d.from: No Gemini API key is stored for you. Add one in Settings. It comes from Google AI Studio, and is not the same as a Gemini subscription.

said.extensions-gemini.18ddcba7.text: Senotlelo seo sa API sa Gemini ga se šome. Lekola gore se kopilwe ka botlalo go tšwa go Google AI Studio. Ga se selo se swanago le kaonto ya Gemini Advanced, yeo e sa akaretšego phihlelo ya API.
said.extensions-gemini.18ddcba7.from: That Gemini API key is not valid. Check it was copied whole from Google AI Studio. It is not the same thing as a Gemini Advanced subscription, which does not include API access.

said.extensions-gemini.3bf73475.text: Mothalo wa Google wa senotlelo seo o fihlile. Legato la mahala le dumelela dikgopelo tše lekanyeditšwego ka motsotso; emela gomme o leke gape, goba o diriše senotlelo seo se nago le tefo e šomago.
said.extensions-gemini.3bf73475.from: Google's rate limit for that key has been reached. The free tier allows a limited number of requests a minute; wait and try again, or use a key with billing enabled.

said.extensions-gemini.599b82c0.text: Gemini ga se ya araba ka nako. Foldara e kgolo e ka tšea metsotso e mmalwa; go leka gape ka ditokomane tše mmalwa go a šoma gantši.
said.extensions-gemini.599b82c0.from: Gemini did not answer in time. A large folder can take several minutes; trying again with fewer documents in it usually works.

said.extensions-gemini.5f764f27.text: Gemini e ka se fihlelelwe. Lekola gore motšhine wo o na le kgokagano ya inthanete go Google.
said.extensions-gemini.5f764f27.from: Gemini could not be reached. Check that this machine has a network connection to Google.

said.extensions-gemini.6ff1fd27.text: Gemini e feletšwe ke sebaka pele e phetha go araba, ka gona seo se boetšego ke karolo ya kharikhulamo e sego yohle, gomme e sa feleletšwago e swana le e feletšego. Ga go selo seo se bolokilwego. Kwalifikeišene ka moka ke selo se segolo kudu go se kgopela karabong e tee; e tsenye go tšwa ditokomaneng tša yona, tšeo di balago kharikhulamo ka go lebanya ka ntle le mohlala, gomme ga go mothalo o bjalo.
said.extensions-gemini.6ff1fd27.from: Gemini ran out of room before it finished answering, so what came back is part of a curriculum rather than all of it, and a partial one looks exactly like a complete one. Nothing was kept. A whole qualification is a great deal to ask for in a single reply; import it from its documents instead, which reads the curriculum directly with no model involved and no limit of this kind.

said.extensions-gemini.7b1ee4ba.text: Gemini e arabile ka lefeela. Seo gantši se bolela gore kgopelo e ganetšwe ke sefetleki sa polokego, goba leina la mohlala ga le nepagale.
said.extensions-gemini.7b1ee4ba.from: Gemini answered with nothing. That usually means the request was refused by a safety filter, or the model name is wrong.

said.extensions-gemini.a3035142.text: Ditokomane tšeo di fetša ditlhaka tše {MAX_INPUT_CHARS},000, e lego seo se fetago seo se ka romelwago kgopelong e tee. Tsenya kwalifikeišene go tšwa ditokomaneng tša yona: tokomane ya kharikhulamo feela e balwa ka go lebanya, ka ntle le mohlala.
said.extensions-gemini.a3035142.from: Those documents come to more than {MAX_INPUT_CHARS},000 characters, which is more than can be sent in one request. Import the qualification from its documents instead: the curriculum document alone is read directly, with no model involved.

said.extensions-gemini.c9f3d2b7.text: Google e begile bothata ka thoko ya bona ({status}). Kgopelo e nyenyane e swanetše go lekwa gape feela. Ge e be e le kwalifikeišene ka moka gomme e paletše makga a mantši, kgopelo e kgolo kudu gore mohlala o e phethe. E tsenye go tšwa ditokomaneng tša yona, tšeo di balago kharikhulamo ka go lebanya ka ntle le mohlala.
said.extensions-gemini.c9f3d2b7.from: Google reported a problem on their side ({status}). A small request is worth simply trying again. If this was a whole qualification and it has now failed more than once, the request is most likely too large for the model to complete. Import it from its documents instead, which reads the curriculum directly with no model involved.

said.extensions-gemini.d7ab5352.text: Google e ganne senotlelo seo. E ka ba e phumotšwe, goba Generative Language API e ka ba e sa šomišwe projekeng yeo e lego ya yona. Ga go selo se sa nepagalego sethaleng gomme ga go selo seo se lahlegilego.

said.fisa.620b3718.from: The confidentiality agreement has not been signed yet. Nobody may see or judge the contents of a FISA before signing it.

said.fisa.6d7ad3d8.text: E butšwe. Kgetha moeksamina le modereitara ka morago.
said.fisa.6d7ad3d8.from: Opened. Appoint an examiner and a moderator next.

said.fisa.6e61efe5.from: Pre-moderate it first. Sending the QCTO a paper your own moderator has not signed off is the wrong way round.

said.fisa.6f4251d6.text: Ke FISA feela yeo e saenwego yeo e nyakago kgatišo e mpsha; ye e sa ka fetolwa.
said.fisa.6f4251d6.from: Only a signed-off FISA needs a new version; this one can still be edited.

said.fisa.86b96040.from: A new draft version is open. It needs its own examiner, moderator and moderation.

said.reassessment.051a9a39.text: Ngwala seo se botšišitšwego le go arabja pele o rekhoda sephetho. Go feta ka molomo ntle le rekhoto ya poledišano ga se bohlatse.

said.reassessment.7eeb4562.text: Reela motho wa mothwadi yo a šišintšwego. Mothwadi yo a se nago leina ga se bohlatse bja gore poledišano e diregile.
said.reassessment.7eeb4562.from: Name the person at the employer who was consulted. An unnamed employer is not evidence that a consultation happened.

said.reassessment.df7ff299.text: Tumelelo yeo e šetše e šomišitšwe. Boiteko bja boraro bjo bo filwego gabedi ga se boiteko bja boraro.
said.reassessment.df7ff299.from: That authorisation has already been used. A third attempt granted twice is not a third attempt.

said.reassessment.eacc2318.text: Boiteko bjoo ga se tlhahlobo ya molomo ya bobedi yeo e dumeletšwego.

said.reassessments.b53b937e.text: Ngwala bonyane potšišo e tee le karabo yeo e filwego. Go feta ka molomo ntle le rekhoto ya poledišano ga se bohlatse.
said.reassessments.b53b937e.from: Write down at least one question and the answer given. An oral pass with no record of the exchange is not evidence.

said.recognition.056d89d8.text: Go lokolla {title} go tla išetša moithuti go peresente ye {wouldBePercent} ya kwalifikeišene yeo e amogetšwego ntle le go rutwa, gomme mothalo wa kwalifikeišene ye ke {maxPercent}. Tše šetšego di swanetše go dirwa e le go ithuta go tlwaelegilego, goba mothalo o fetolwe kwalifikeišeneng ka lebaka.
said.recognition.056d89d8.from: Exempting {title} would take this learner to {wouldBePercent} per cent of the qualification recognised without being taught, and the limit on this qualification is {maxPercent}. The rest has to be done as ordinary learning, or the limit changed on the qualification with a reason for it.

said.recognition.165f2f8f.text: Motšeakarolo yo ga se a ba le seshene sa keletšo. Go ahlola go ithuta ga pele kgahlanong le ditlhokego tšeo go se yo a di hlalošitšego ke mokgwa woo motšeakarolo a palelwago ka gona ka go kgoboketša bohlatse bja phošo. Rekhoda keletšo pele.
said.recognition.165f2f8f.from: This candidate has not had an advisory session. Judging prior learning against requirements nobody explained is how a candidate is failed for assembling the wrong evidence. Record the advice first.

said.recognition.2f3e0747.text: Kahlolo e rekhotilwe. Ga e neele selo go fihlela e modereitwa.
said.recognition.2f3e0747.from: Judgement recorded. It grants nothing until it is moderated.

said.recognition.3d78b1cc.text: Bolela seo o se lebeletšego le gore na o a dumela. Go modereita ntle le maikutlo ke mosaeno.
said.recognition.3d78b1cc.from: Say what you looked at and whether you agree. A moderation with no comment is a signature.

said.recognition.4cf70aee.text: Bolela gore dipheto tša seo ba se swerego di akaretša tša modula wo bjang. Serapa seo ke phetho ka moka, gomme phetišo ntle le sona ke tsopolo yeo go se yo a ka e lekolago.
said.recognition.4cf70aee.from: Say how the outcomes of what they hold cover this module's. That paragraph is the whole of the decision, and a transfer without it is a claim nobody can check.

said.recognition.61201ac5.text: Bolela gore bohlatse e be e le eng le gore ke ka lebaka la eng bo kgotsofatša modula. Serapa seo ke kahlolo ka moka, gomme ke selo sa mathomo seo monetefatši wa ka ntle a se balago.
said.recognition.61201ac5.from: Say what the evidence was and why it satisfies the module. This paragraph is the whole of the judgement, and the first thing an external verifier reads.

said.recognition.86f838fe.text: Seo se filwe ka {awardedOn}, e lego ngwaga o fetago ye {CAT_YEARS} pele ga tumelelo ye. Kopano ya Dikrediti le Phetišo e akaretša go fetša mo go lego ka gare ga nywaga ye {CAT_YEARS2}; ka ntle ga moo tsela ke Kamogelo ya Go ithuta ga Pele, yeo e hlahlobago seo moithuti a ka se dirago le bjale e sego seo a se fetilego kgale. Bula kopo ya RPL go e na le moo.
said.recognition.86f838fe.from: That was awarded on {awardedOn}, more than {CAT_YEARS} years before this approval. Credit Accumulation and Transfer covers completions within {CAT_YEARS2} years; beyond that the route is Recognition of Prior Learning, which assesses what the learner can still do rather than what they once passed. Open an RPL application instead.

said.recognition.d4a3fd91.text: Rekhoda seo motšeakarolo a boditšwego go se kgoboketša. Motšeakarolo yo a ganetšwego o phegelela serapa se, gomme 'aeleditšwe ka ditlhokego' ga se se sengwe sa tšona.
said.recognition.d4a3fd91.from: Record what the candidate was told to gather. A refused candidate disputes this paragraph, and 'advised on requirements' is not one.

said.recognition.e046c5d9.text: Kopo e butšwe. Keletšo e latela.

said.recognition.e21aaea2.text: O ka se modereite kahlolo ya gago.
said.recognition.e21aaea2.from: You cannot moderate your own judgement.

said.recognition.e7122f98.text: Karolo ya gago ga e akaretše se. Kamogelo e swerwe ke badiredi ba moabi ka noši, gomme kahlolo e modereitwa ke motho yo mongwe go e na le yo a e dirilego.
said.recognition.e7122f98.from: Your role does not include this. Recognition is held by the provider's own staff, and a judgement is moderated by somebody other than whoever made it.

said.recognition.f2bb6227.text: Modula woo ga se wa hwetšwa.

said.spine.0b4713d6.text: "{title}" ke ya tlhabollo, ka gona ga e tšweletše phetho ya bokgoni, ka gona mojako wo o emetšego yona a ka se bulwe. Emela gore e gafelwe goba e swaiwe go e na le moo.
said.spine.0b4713d6.from: "{title}" is formative, so it never produces a competence decision, so a gate waiting for one would never open. Wait for it to be handed in or marked instead.

said.spine.129de092.text: Bolela lebaka leo moithuti yo a tlogelwago go feta ka lona. Le bontšhwa rekhotong ya gagwe le go pakete ya go modereita.
said.spine.129de092.from: Say why this learner is being let past. It is shown on their record and in the moderation pack.

said.spine.42a3be59.from: A step cannot wait for itself.

said.spine.7287fb1d.text: Thuto goba tokomane ga e hlahlobjwe, ka gona e ka se ahlolwe e le e kgonago. Emela gore e bulwe go e na le moo.
said.spine.7287fb1d.from: A lesson or a document is not assessed, so it cannot be judged competent. Wait for it to be opened instead.

said.spine.81239e1c.text: Ke modula wa maitemogelo a mošomo feela o saenwago. Kgetha molao o mongwe.

said.spine.91ceb611.from: The new order has to list every step of the course exactly once.

said.spine.ca9b3b5c.text: Seo se tla dira gore megato e mebedi e emelane, gomme ga go o tee o tlago go bulwa.
said.spine.ca9b3b5c.from: That would make two steps wait for each other, and neither would ever open.

said.spine.d5e61b5f.text: Tokomane yeo e bolokilwe go baithuti, ka gona e ka se be mogato wa tsela ya bona. Pampiri ya go phetha e ba fihlela e le tlhahlobo yeo e tšerwego.
said.spine.d5e61b5f.from: That document is kept from learners, so it cannot be a step on their path. A summative paper reaches them as a captured assessment instead.

said.study-unit-alignment.dfcd9590.text: Tokomane e bolela dimodula tše {wantedCount} ({wanted}) gomme kwalifikeišene ye ga e na kharikhulamo le ga bjale. Tsenya kharikhulamo pele; diyuniti tša go ithuta le dipheto tša tšona di a rekhodwa ka mokgwa o mongwe le o mongwe, gomme go laetša tokomane ye gape ka morago go tla di kgokaganya.
said.study-unit-alignment.dfcd9590.from: The document names {wantedCount} modules ({wanted}) and this qualification has no curriculum yet. Import the curriculum first; the study units and their outcomes are recorded either way, and uploading this document again afterwards will link them.

said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.text: Ga go modula le o tee wa tše {wantedCount} tšeo tokomane e di bolelago woo o ka lekanywago, ka gona ga go selo seo se beilwego ka tlase ga yuniti ya go ithuta. Tokomane e bolela {wanted}. Kharikhulamo ye e na le {held}. Go lekanya go hlokomologa sebaka le disela, ka gona merero e mebedi e a fapana ka nnete. Lokiša dikhoutu ka thoko efe goba efe gomme o laetše tokomane gape.
said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.from: None of the {wantedCount} modules this document names could be matched, so nothing has been placed under a study unit. The document names {wanted}. This curriculum holds {held}. Matching ignores spaces and hyphens, so the two schemes genuinely differ. Correct the codes on either side and upload the document again.

said.support.6396d34b.from: An additional date was already set for this assessment: {additionalDate}, after a miss on {missedOn}. The procedure allows one. If that date was also missed, record what happened to it rather than setting another.

said.support.6947b9e5.text: Tlhokego ya thekgo ga se ya hwetšwa.

said.support.6af4db9d.text: Ge peakanyo e sa šome, bolela seo se fetogago. Tekolo yeo e rekhodago go palelwa gomme e sa fetole selo e bonagala e le ya kgonthe gomme ke kgahlanong le yona.
said.support.6af4db9d.from: If the accommodation is not working, say what is changing. A review that records a failure and adjusts nothing reads as diligence and is the opposite.

said.support.7af7d42b.text: Letšatši le lengwe le swanetše go ba ka morago ga leo le paletšwego.
said.support.7af7d42b.from: The additional date has to be after the one that was missed.

said.support.8452172c.text: Bolela seo o se hweditšego. Tekolo ye e se nago sephetho ke letšatši faeleng.
said.support.8452172c.from: Say what you found. A review with no finding is a date in a file.

said.support.e34f2e55.text: Bolela seo se tlago go dirwa ka kgonthe. Tlhokego ye e se nago peakanyo kgahlanong le yona ga e fetole selo go moithuti.
said.support.e34f2e55.from: Say what will actually be done. A need with no accommodation against it changes nothing for the learner.

said.support.f41a730d.text: Tlhokego yeo ya thekgo e tswaletšwe.

said.support.f4565c1a.text: Bolela gore lebaka la bongaka e be e le eng. Tlhahlobo ya molomo yeo e dumeletšwego ka lebaka leo le sa rekhodwago ke kopano yeo monetefatši wa ka ntle a e botšišago.
said.support.f4565c1a.from: Say what the medical ground was. An oral assessment authorised on an unrecorded reason is the sitting an external verifier asks about.

login.intro.text: Kena o tswelle pele ka ho ithuta ha hao.
login.intro.from: Sign in to continue your learning.

login.trouble.text: O na le bothata ba ho kena? Buisana le motsamaisi wa hao wa thuto: o ka o beela phasewete e ntjha.
login.trouble.from: Trouble signing in? Speak to your facilitator: they can reset a password for you.

login.locked.text: Ho lekilwe makgetlo a mangata haholo. Emela metsotso e 15 o leke hape.
login.locked.from: Too many attempts. Wait fifteen minutes and try again.

login.missing.text: Kenya aterese ya hao ya imeile le phasewete.
login.missing.from: Enter your email address and password.

login.sso.refused.text: Akhaonto eo e ke ke ya kena mona. E tlameha ho sebedisa aterese ya imeile e tshwanang le ya akhaonto ya hao ho sethaleng sena. Kena ka phasewete ya hao, kapa o botse mookameli wa hao.
login.sso.refused.from: That account cannot sign in here. It has to use the same email address as your account on this platform. Sign in with your password, or ask your administrator.

login.sso.expired.text: Ho kena moo ho nkile nako e telele haholo, kapa ho qadilwe kwana. Leka hape.
login.sso.expired.from: That sign-in took too long, or was started somewhere else. Try again.

login.sso.off.text: Mokgwa oo wa ho kena ha o a bulwa mona.
login.sso.off.from: That way of signing in is not switched on here.

account.forcedIntro.text: Motho e mong o behile phasewete eo o keneng ka yona. E nkele sebaka pele o tswela pele.
account.forcedIntro.from: Somebody else set the password you signed in with. Replace it before carrying on.

account.newHint.text: Bonyane ditlhaku tse 12. Polelwana ya mantswe a mmalwa a sa amaneng e matla ebile e bonolo ho e hopola ho feta e kgutshwanyane e nang le matshwao.
account.newHint.from: At least 12 characters. A phrase of a few unrelated words is both stronger and easier to remember than something short with symbols in it.

account.mismatch.text: Diphasewete tse pedi tse ntjha ha di tshwane.
account.mismatch.from: The two new passwords do not match.

account.forcedNote.text: Ho e fetola ho tswisa mang kapa mang ya sebedisang phasewete ya khale, ho kenyeletswa ya o file yona.
account.forcedNote.from: Changing it signs out anyone else using the old password, including whoever passed it to you.

account.languageIntro.text: Puo eo sethala sena se buang le wena ka yona. Diskrine tseo di so fetolelwang di dula ka Senyesemane, mme mabitso a mofani wa hao wa tshebeletso a bolokwa jwalo ka ha a a ngotse.
account.languageIntro.from: The language this platform speaks to you in. Screens not yet translated stay in English, and your provider's own names for things are kept as they wrote them.

home.feedbackIntro.from: Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. Two minutes each, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

home.earnedIntro.text: Se rekotilwe ka letsatsi leo o qetileng ka lona, eseng ha setifikeiti se fihla qetellong. Se seng le se seng se na le tshupetso eo mang kapa mang a ka e netefatsang.
home.earnedIntro.from: Recorded on the day you finished, rather than when the certificate eventually arrives. Each carries a reference anybody can check.

evidence.fingerprintNote.from: If any stored file were ever altered, its fingerprint would stop matching. That protects your work as much as it protects the assessment.

cert.notNational.text: Sena ke setifikeiti sa {provider} ka boyona bakeng sa kosi eo e e nehileng. Ha se kwalifikeishene ya naha mme ha se na sekerediti sa SAQA kapa sesupi. Moo moithuti a sebeletsang ho fumana kwalifikeishene ya mosebetsi, setifikeiti sa yona se ntshwa ke QCTO.
cert.notNational.from: This is {provider}'s own certificate for a course it delivered. It is not a national qualification and does not carry a SAQA credit or identifier. Where a learner is working towards an occupational qualification, the certificate for it is issued by the QCTO.

cert.anyone.text: Mang kapa mang a ka netefatsa setifikeiti sena ka tshupetso e ka hodimo, a sa hloke akhaonto.
cert.anyone.from: Anyone can confirm this certificate with the reference above, without needing an account.

work.introCoach.text: Baithuti bao o ba okametseng. O netefatsa seo ba se entseng mosebetsing; ha ho letho le fihlang ho mohlahlobi ntle le tshaeno ya hao.
work.introCoach.from: The learners you supervise. You confirm what they did in the workplace; nothing reaches an assessor without your signature.

work.introLearner.text: Phihlelo ya mosebetsi e etswa ho mohiri mme e netefatswa ke motataisi wa mosebetsi moo. Tatellano e a tsitsa: o e rekota, motataisi wa hao o e netefatsa, ebe e ya ho mohlahlobi.
work.introLearner.from: Work experience is done at an employer and signed off by the workplace coach there. The order is fixed: you record it, your coach confirms it, then it goes to an assessor.

work.waitingOne.text: {record} e le nngwe e emetse tshaeno ya hao.

work.waitingMany.text: {count} tse {records} di emetse tshaeno ya hao.

work.noneManage.text: Ha ho na {records} hajwale. Beha e nngwe ka hodimo: tumellano e reng moithuti, mohiri le motataisi, ebe e nngwe bakeng sa module e nngwe le e nngwe ya phihlelo ya mosebetsi.
work.noneManage.from: No {records} yet. Set one up above: an agreement naming the learner, the employer and the coach, then one for each work experience module.

work.none.text: Ha ho na {records} hajwale. Mookameli o bula e nngwe ha tumellano ya mosebetsi e le teng e reng moithuti, mohiri le motataisi.
work.none.from: No {records} yet. An administrator opens one once a workplace agreement is in place naming the learner, the employer and the coach.

work.kind.work_activity.text: Mesebetsi ya mosebetsi: seo o se etsang

work.kind.contextual_knowledge.text: Tsebo ya mosebetsi: seo o lokelang ho kgona ho bua ka sona
work.kind.contextual_knowledge.from: Workplace knowledge: what you must be able to speak to

work.kind.supporting_evidence.text: Bopaki ba tshehetso: seo mosebetsi o lokelang ho se hlahisa
work.kind.supporting_evidence.from: Supporting evidence: what the workplace must produce

work.outstanding.text: Ho sa setse: {items}. Motataisi wa hao a ke ke a saena ho fihlela mola o mong le o mong o phethilwe mme bopaki bo mong le bo mong ba tshehetso bo na le faele e kopantsweng.
work.outstanding.from: Still outstanding: {items}. Your coach cannot sign until every line is done and every piece of supporting evidence has a file attached.

work.allRecorded.text: Tsohle di rekotilwe. Di romele ho motataisi wa hao ha o se o loketse.
work.allRecorded.from: Everything is recorded. Send it to your coach when you are ready.

work.signingMeans.text: Ho saena ho rekota hore o hlahlobile bopaki bona mme o tla bo paka haeba mohlahlobi a o founela. Ha ho sa kgone ho fetolwa kamora moo.
work.signingMeans.from: Signing records that you checked this evidence and will attest to it if the assessor contacts you. It cannot be changed afterwards.

work.forAssessor.text: Ntho efe kapa efe eo mohlahlobi a lokelang ho e tseba

work.readyForPoe.text: E saennwe ke motataisi wa mosebetsi mme e loketse ho isoa Foldareng ya Bopaki.
work.readyForPoe.from: Signed by the workplace coach and ready to be taken into the Portfolio of Evidence.

scorm.failed.text: Sephutheloana se ne se sa kgone ho bulwa. Sheba khokahano ya hao mme o leke hape.
scorm.failed.from: The package could not be opened. Check your connection and try again.

scorm.preview.text: Tebello ya pele: seo sephutheloana se se tlalehang ha se bolokwe, hobane ena e seng ngodiso ya hao.
scorm.preview.from: A preview: what the package reports is not kept, because this is not your own enrolment.

common.notYetCompetent.text: Ha a so be le bokgoni

outcome.not_yet_competent.text: ha a so be le bokgoni

certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.text: Moithuti o kanna a file mohiri tshupetso. E tswela pele ho sebetsa mme e tla re e hulotswe.
certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.from: The learner may have given the reference to an employer. It keeps resolving and will say it was withdrawn.

assessing.intro.text: Ho romelwa ho loketseng qeto ya bokgoni. O ke ke wa hlahloja mosebetsi wa hao, mme karolo ya diqeto tsa hao e tla shebisiswa ka ho ikemela ke mohlahlobisisi.
assessing.intro.from: Submissions ready for a competency judgement. You cannot assess your own work, and a proportion of your decisions will be reviewed independently by a moderator.

assessing.empty.text: Ha ho letho le emetseng. Ho romelwa ho hlaha mona ha baithuti ba ho romela.
assessing.empty.from: Nothing is waiting. Submissions appear here as learners send them in.

assessing.onScreen.text: Sena se arabilwe skrineng. {link}: dikarabo, tataiso ya ho tshwaya le matrikse di mmoho moo, mme dikriteria di baliswa bakeng sa hao ha e se e tshwauwe.
assessing.onScreen.from: This was answered on screen. {link}: the answers, the marking guidance and the matrix are together there, and the criteria are worked out for you once it is marked.

assessing.ownWork.text: Ena ke seo o se rometseng. O ke ke wa e hlahloja; motho e mong o lokela ho e etsa.
assessing.ownWork.from: This is your own submission. You cannot assess it; someone else must.

assessing.hash.text: Hash e rekotwa ha ho kenywa. Haeba faele e bolokilweng e ka fetolwa, ha e sa tshwane mme rekoto e a tshwauwa.
assessing.hash.from: The hash is recorded at upload. If a stored file is ever altered, it no longer matches and the record is flagged.

assessing.whyDiffers.text: Hobaneng, kaha e fapane le seo ditshwao di se etsang tlhahiso
assessing.whyDiffers.from: Why, since it differs from what the marks propose

assessing.permanent.text: Lebitso la hao, letsatsi le maikutlo ana di bolokwa ka ho sa feleng mme ha di sa kgone ho hlophiswa kamora moo. Tokiso e rekotwa e le qeto e ntjha.
assessing.permanent.from: Your name, the date and this comment are stored permanently and cannot be edited afterwards. A correction is recorded as a new decision.

marking.implies.text: Seo ditshwao tsena di se bolelang

marking.impliesIntro.text: Palo, eseng qeto. Ditshwao di lekana ka sena; tshebetso ya ho sebetsa le bopaki ba mosebetsi ha di fihle sethaleng, mme o di lekanya pele o etsa qeto. Fetola efe kapa efe ya tsena skrineng sa qeto mme o re hobaneng: lebaka le bolokwa haufi le tlhahiso e le hore mohlahlobisisi a bone moo tse pedi di arohaneng.
marking.impliesIntro.from: Arithmetic, not a judgement. The marks average out at this; practical performance and workplace evidence do not reach the platform, and you weigh those before deciding. Change any of these on the decision screen and say why: the reason is stored beside the proposal so a moderator can see where the two parted.

marking.markAllFirst.text: Potso ka nngwe e lokela ho tshwauwa pele dikriteria di baliswa.
marking.markAllFirst.from: Every question has to be marked before the criteria can be worked out.

marking.summative.text: Sena se a hlahlojwa. Ha potso ka nngwe e se e tshwauwe, rekota qeto: dikriteria tseo e di paka di etswa tlhahiso hore o di netefatse.
marking.summative.from: This is assessed. Once every question is marked, record a decision: the criteria it evidences are proposed for you to confirm.

marking.formative.text: Sena ke buka ya mosebetsi. Ke ya nts'etsopele: e tshwaye, ebe o kgutlisa maikutlo. Ha ho letho mona le rekotang bokgoni kapa le isang moithuti ho tshwanelehang.
marking.formative.from: This is a workbook. It is developmental: mark it, then return feedback. Nothing here records competence or moves the learner towards eligibility.

marking.toMarkOne.text: Potso e le nngwe e sa tshwauwa.

marking.notMarked.text: Dintlha tse {points} · ha di so tshwauwe

marking.blank.text: E siilwe e se na letho.

marking.matrix.text: Matrikse a ho tshwaya: ho kgetha boemo bo bong le bo bong ho fana ka letshwao
marking.matrix.from: Marking matrix: choosing a level for each gives the mark

marking.toldHint.text: Moo e neng e le matla, le seo se neng se haella.
marking.toldHint.from: Where it was strong, and what was missing.

marking.returnIntro.text: Maikutlo, eseng qeto. A bolella moithuti seo a lokelang ho boela ho sona pele ho tlhahlobo ya qetello, mme ha a rekote bokgoni khahlanong le kriteria efe kapa efe.
marking.returnIntro.from: Feedback, not a decision. It tells the learner what to go back to before the summative, and it records no competence against any criterion.

marking.returnHint.text: Seo se neng se tiile, le seo se lokelang ho balwa hape pele ho tlhahlobo ya qetello.
marking.returnHint.from: What was solid, and what to re-read before the summative.

marking.concern.text: Dikriteria tseo dikarabo tse fokolang di di potapotileng
marking.concern.from: Criteria the weak answers cluster around

marking.sectionHint.text: Seo se tsamaileng hantle mona, le seo o lokelang ho se etsa ka tsela e fapaneng nakong e tlang.
marking.sectionHint.from: What went well here, and what to do differently next time.

marking.learnerSees.text: Moithuti o bona sena hammoho le maikutlo a hae.
marking.learnerSees.from: The learner sees this with their feedback.

moderating.intro.text: Tlhahlobisiso ya ho ikemela ya diqeto tsa bahlahlobi. Diqeto tse fihlang lenaneong lena di kgethwa ke sistimi, eseng ke motho. O ke ke wa hlahlobisisa qeto eo o e entseng ka wena.
moderating.intro.from: Independent review of assessors' decisions. Which decisions reach this list is decided by the system, not chosen by anyone. You cannot moderate a decision you made yourself.

moderating.empty.text: Ha ho letho le emetseng ho hlahlobisisoa.

moderating.reason.full_moderation.text: Ya qetello: qeto e nngwe le e nngwe e a hlahlobisisoa

moderating.reason.new_assessor.text: Mohlahlobi ya ngodisitsweng haufinyane: o hlahlobisisoa ka botlalo
moderating.reason.new_assessor.from: Newly registered assessor: moderated in full

moderating.reason.random_sample.text: E kgethilwe ka sampole ya tshohanyetso

moderating.referBack.text: Kgutlisetsa morao: mohlahlobi a ke a sheba hape
moderating.referBack.from: Refer back: the assessor should look again

moderating.override.text: Fetola: nkela qeto ka e nngwe

moderating.ownDecision.text: O entse qeto ena jwalo ka mohlahlobi, ka hoo o ke ke wa e hlahlobisisa. Mohlahlobisisi e mong o lokela ho e etsa.
moderating.ownDecision.from: You made this decision as the assessor, so you cannot moderate it. Another moderator must.

pack.print.text: Kgatisa leqephe lena ho le boloka e le PDF.
pack.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF.

pack.settings.text: {provider} · {accreditation} · letshwao la ho feta {pass}% · sekgahla sa tlhahlobisiso {rate}%

pack.counts.text: Ho romelwa ho {submissions} · {decided} ho ahlotswe · {moderated} ho hlahlobisisitswe · {sampled} ho nkilwe mona

pack.instrumentIntro.text: Pampiri jwalo ka ha e ne e beilwe, le tataiso eo e neng e tshwauwa ka yona.
pack.instrumentIntro.from: The paper as it was set, and the guidance it was marked against.

pack.scriptsIntro.text: Di nkilwe ho pholletsa le sebaka sa ditshwao (tse hodimo, tse tlase le tse mahareng) e le hore ho tshwaya ho bonwe ha ho le molemo ka ho fetisisa le ha ho le hobe ka ho fetisisa, eseng mahareng feela.
pack.scriptsIntro.from: Taken across the mark range (top, bottom and spread between) so the marking is seen at its best and its worst rather than in the middle.

pack.departuresIntro.text: Moo mohlahlobi a fapaneng le seo ditshwao di se etsang tlhahiso, kapa mohlahlobisisi a fapaneng le mohlahlobi. Pakete e siyang tsena ka ntle e mpe ho feta ha e sa eo ho hang.
pack.departuresIntro.from: Where an assessor differed from what the marks proposed, or a moderator differed from the assessor. A pack that leaves these out is worse than no pack.

pack.noReason.text: ha ho na lebaka le rekotilweng

pack.exceptionsIntro.text: Baithuti bao motho ya bitsitsweng ka lebitso a ba dumelletseng ho feta pele ho mokgahlelo, hammoho le lebaka leo a le file.
pack.exceptionsIntro.from: Learners let past a gate by a named person, with the reason they gave.

held.intro.text: Moithuti ya fumanwang a so be le bokgoni habedi ha a hlolehe. Tlhahlobo e a tshwarwa, mme ho bitswa tlhahlobisiso ya lenaneo le mohiri wa hae, hobane ka nako ena potso hase hore na o a e tseba, empa hore na ho etsahetse eng ho mo potapota.
held.intro.from: A learner found not yet competent twice is not failed. The assessment is held, and a programme review is convened with their employer, because by this point the question is rarely whether they know it, and usually what has been going on around them.

held.empty.text: Sena se a tlala ha moithuti a fumanwa a so be le bokgoni lekgetlo la bobedi tlhahlobong ya qetello. Ho fihlela ka nako eo ha ho letho le lokelang ho hlahlojwa.
held.empty.from: This fills when a learner is found not yet competent for a second time on a summative assessment. Until then there is nothing to review.

held.results.text: {assessment} · diphetho tse {count} tsa ho so be le bokgoni

held.whoConvenes.text: Motsamaisi wa thuto kapa mookameli o bitsa tlhahlobisiso.
held.whoConvenes.from: A facilitator or administrator convenes the review.

held.oralAuthorised.text: {assessment} · tlhahlobisiso e dumeletse boiteko ba boraro, bo tshwarwang ka molomo
held.oralAuthorised.from: {assessment} · the review authorised a third attempt, conducted orally

held.whoConducts.text: Mohlahlobi o tshwara boiteko ba molomo, eseng motho ya bo dumeletseng.
held.whoConducts.from: An assessor conducts the oral attempt, and not the person who authorised it.

held.oral.text: Boiteko ba boraro, bo tshwarwang ka molomo

held.furtherLearning.text: Ho ithuta ho eketsehileng pele ho boiteko bofe kapa bofe bo bong
held.furtherLearning.from: Further learning before any further attempt

held.whyHint.text: Seo tlhahlobisiso e se fumaneng, le seo se ipapisitseng le sona.
held.whyHint.from: What the review found, and what it turns on.

oral.reviewDecided.text: Seo tlhahlobisiso e se entseng qeto ka sona

oral.reviewDecidedIntro.text: Mabaka ao boiteko bona ba boraro bo dumeletsweng ka one.
oral.reviewDecidedIntro.from: The grounds on which this third attempt was authorised.

oral.employerNotConsulted.text: Mohiri ha a a buisanwa le yena.

oral.recordIntro.text: Boiteko ba molomo ha bo siye bopaki ba bo ka bo bona. Sena ke bopaki boo, mme sephetho se ke ke sa rekotwa ntle le bona.
oral.recordIntro.from: An oral attempt leaves no evidence of its own. This is that evidence, and the outcome cannot be recorded without it.

oral.nothingYet.text: Ha ho letho leo le so rekotwang.

oral.outcomeIntro.text: E ahlolwa ka tsela e tshwanang le boiteko bo ngotsweng, khahlanong le dikriteria tse tshwanang, mme e hlahlobisisoa ka tsela e tshwanang kamora moo.
oral.outcomeIntro.from: Judged the same way as a written attempt, against the same criteria, and moderated the same way afterwards.

oral.how.text: Tsela eo e neng e tshwaretswe ka yona

oral.howHint.text: Ka sebele, kapa mohala wa vidiyo oo e neng e tshwaretswe ho wona
oral.howHint.from: In person, or the video call it was held on

oral.present.text: Ke mang o mong ya neng a le teng

oral.presentNote.text: Ha ho hlokahale. Tlhahlobo ya molomo ha ho se na motho e mong ka phaposing e thata ho e sireletsa nakong ya tlhahlobisiso, mme rekoto e lokela ho bolela hore e ne e le ya mofuta ofe.
oral.presentNote.from: Not required. An oral assessment with nobody else in the room is harder to defend at moderation, and the record should say which kind this was.

oral.noCriterion.text: Ha e a tlama le e le nngwe

oral.savedNext.text: Sephetho se rekotwa skrineng sa ho tshwaya, jwalo ka boiteko bofe kapa bofe bo bong.
oral.savedNext.from: The outcome is recorded on the marking screen, the same as any other attempt.

appeals.intro.text: Moithuti a ka ipiletsa khahlanong le sephetho kapa boitshwaro ba mohlahlobi. Kamohelo e tiisetswa nakong ya dihora tse {hours}, e leng nako eo hangata e fetwang, hobane e tsamaya ha motho e mong a ntse a ruta.
appeals.intro.from: A learner may appeal against a result or against an assessor's conduct. Receipt is acknowledged within {hours} hours, which is the deadline that gets missed, because it runs while somebody is teaching.

appeals.dayOver.text: Ho fetile letsatsi le le leng

appeals.hourOver.text: Ho fetile hora e le nngwe

appeals.late.text: {count} ha e a amohelwa ka nako

appeals.lateIntro.text: Ho fetile dihora tse {hours} mme ho so ka ho amohelwa. Ho amohela morao ho molemo ho feta ho se amohele ho hang, mme rekoto e tla bontsha tsohle tse pedi.
appeals.lateIntro.from: Past the {hours} hours and still not acknowledged. Acknowledging late is better than not at all, and the record will show both.

appeals.openIntro.text: Tsohle tse kentsweng le tse so kwalwang, tse ntjha pele.
appeals.openIntro.from: Everything lodged and not yet closed, newest first.

appeals.none.text: Ha ho letho le butsweng. Boipiletso bo kenngwa leqepheng la moithuti ka boyena.
appeals.none.from: Nothing open. An appeal is lodged from a learner's own page.

appeals.procedureIntro.text: Amohela, kopana le moithuti, buisana le mohlahlobisisi moo motheo e leng sephetho, ebe o rarolla mme o mo tsebise.
appeals.procedureIntro.from: Acknowledge, meet the learner, consult the moderator where the ground is a result, then resolve and tell them.

appeals.closedUnacknowledged.text: E kwetswe ntle le hore kamohelo e rekotwe.
appeals.closedUnacknowledged.from: Closed without an acknowledgement being recorded.

appeals.firstCounts.text: Kamohelo ya pele ke eo rekoto e e bolokang. E ke ke ya tshwaywa hape kamora moo, hobane nako e ka fetolwang ha se bopaki ba letho.
appeals.firstCounts.from: The first acknowledgement is the one the record keeps. It cannot be re-stamped later, because a time that can be changed is not evidence of anything.

appeals.resultNeedsModerator.text: Boipiletso ba sephetho bo ya ho mohlahlobisisi wa ka hare pele bo ka rarollwa. Ke mohato oo mohlahlobisisi wa kantle a botsang ka ona.
appeals.resultNeedsModerator.from: A result appeal goes to the internal moderator before it can be resolved. That is the step an external verifier asks about.

appeals.conductNoModerator.text: Boipiletso ba boitshwaro ha se ntho eo ho tshwaya hape ho e rarollang, ka hoo ha ho hlokahale mohlahlobisisi.
appeals.conductNoModerator.from: A conduct appeal is not something re-marking settles, so no moderator is required.

appeals.notConsulted.text: Ha a so buisanwe le yena

appeals.notFeedback.text: Qeto eo moithuti a so ka a e fuwa ha se maikutlo.
appeals.notFeedback.from: A decision the learner has not been given is not feedback.

appeals.whyHint.text: Hobaneng. Ena ke karolo eo moithuti a e tshwanetseng.
appeals.whyHint.from: Why. This is the part the learner is entitled to.

appeals.notesIntro.text: Puisano pakeng tsa mohokahanyi, mohlahlobi le mohlahlobisisi. Ha e bontshwe moithuti ntle le ha o re jwalo; seo a se tshwanetseng ke sephetho le mabaka a ka hodimo.
appeals.notesIntro.from: The discussion between coordinator, assessor and moderator. Not shown to the learner unless you say so; what they are entitled to is the outcome and the reasoning above.

appeals.noteHint.text: Seo se buisanweng, le hore na le mang
appeals.noteHint.from: What was discussed, and with whom

appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.text: Ho hula ho hloka lebaka. Ho hula ho se na lebaka ho shebahala jwaloka kgatello, mme hoo ke hona hantle boipiletso ka boitshwaro bo ka bang ka ho hona.
appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.from: A withdrawal needs a reason. One with none looks like pressure, and that is exactly what an appeal about conduct would be about.

rpl.title.text: Kamohelo ya ho ithuta ho fetileng

rpl.intro.text: Bakeng sa moithuti ya seng a kgona karolo ya mosebetsi. Ha ho letho le fanwang mona ka lentswe la motho a le mong: qeto e etswa khahlanong le dikriteria tsa module ka boyona, e ngotswe ka botlalo, mme e hlahlobisiswa ke motho e mong ntle le ya e entseng pele e ka ba le boleng.
rpl.intro.from: For a learner who can already do part of the work. Nothing here is granted on one person's say-so: a judgement is made against the module's own criteria, written down in full, and moderated by somebody other than whoever made it before it counts for anything.

rpl.noneWaiting.text: Ha ho letho le emetseng mohlahlobisisi

rpl.waitingIntro.text: Qeto ha e fane ka letho ho fihlela sena se etswa. Bala lebaka khahlanong le module pele o dumela: ke ntho ya pele eo mohlahlobisisi wa kantle a e balang.
rpl.waitingIntro.from: A judgement grants nothing until this is done. Read the rationale against the module before agreeing: it is the first thing an external verifier reads.

rpl.appearHere.text: Diqeto di hlaha mona ha di etswa.
rpl.appearHere.from: Judgements appear here as they are made.

rpl.openIntro.text: Mohato wa pele, le o etsang rekoto eo tsohle tse ding di kopanngwang le yona.
rpl.openIntro.from: The first step, and the one that creates the record everything else attaches to.

rpl.transferIntro.text: E fapane le RPL: moithuti o se a na le kwalifikeishene eo diphetho tsa yona di kenyeletsang module ena. Ha ho na keletso, empa ho hlophiswa ha tsona ho tlameha ho ngolwa; phetiso e se nang seo ke kopo eo ho se motho ya ka e hlahlobang.
rpl.transferIntro.from: Different from RPL: the learner already holds a qualification whose outcomes cover this module. No advisory, but the mapping has to be written down; a transfer without it is a claim nobody can check.

rpl.needsBoth.text: Kopo e hloka moithuti le kwalifikeishene eo e etswang khahlanong le yona. Kenya tseo pele.
rpl.needsBoth.from: An application needs a learner and a qualification to apply against. Add those first.

rpl.needsLearner.text: Kenya moithuti pele o rekota phetiso bakeng sa yena.
rpl.needsLearner.from: Add a learner before recording a transfer for one.

rpl.holds.text: Seo ba se ntseng ba na le sona

rpl.mapping.text: Kamoo diphetho tsa seo ba nang le sona di kenyeletsang ho tsa module ena
rpl.mapping.from: How the outcomes of what they hold cover this module's

rpl.checked.text: Seo o se hlahlobileng, le seo o qetileng ka sona
rpl.checked.from: What you checked, and what you concluded

record.print.text: Kgatisa leqephe lena ho le boloka e le PDF bakeng sa foldara ya bopaki.
record.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF for the portfolio of evidence.

record.timeExpired.text: Ha e a amohelwa: nako e fedile mme mosebetsi o nehilwe jwalo ka ha o ne o le teng.
