record.timeExpired.from: Not accepted: the time limit expired and the work was handed in as it stood.

record.returned.text: E kgutlisitswe {date}. Sena ke sa nts'etsopele: ha se rekote bokgoni.
record.returned.from: Returned {date}. This is developmental: it records no competence.

marking.notMarkedOne.text: Letshwao le le leng · ha le so tshwauwe

sor.withdrawConsequence.text: Setsi sa tlhahlobo se kanna sa ba le kopi. Tshupetso e tswela pele ho sebetsa mme e tla re e hulotswe.
sor.withdrawConsequence.from: An assessment centre may already hold a copy. The reference keeps working and will say it was withdrawn.

sor.print.text: Kgatisa kapa boloka Tlaleho ena ya Diphetho
sor.print.from: Print or save this Statement of Results

fisa.intro.text: Pampiri eo mofani wa tshebeletso enwa a e beang bakeng sa lenaneo la hae la bokgoni. Ho fapana le tlhahlobo ya kantle, o e ngola mme o e hlahlobisisa, ka hoo tlhahlobisiso e etswa pele motho a e ngola, mme pampiri e so ka ya saennwa hore e lokile morero e ke ke ya sebediswa.
fisa.intro.from: The paper this provider sets for its own skills programme. Unlike an external assessment, you write it and you moderate it, so the moderation happens before anybody sits it, and a paper that has not been signed off as fit for purpose cannot be used.

fisa.waitingIntro.text: Ha ho motho ya ka ngolang tsena ho fihlela mohlahlobisisi a di saena.
fisa.waitingIntro.from: Nobody can sit these until a moderator signs them off.

fisa.usable.text: {count} di saennwe mme di ka sebediswa.

fisa.setNewIntro.text: Khahlanong le lenaneo la bokgoni. Kwalifikeishene e felletseng kapa karolo e hlahlojwa ka kantle.
fisa.setNewIntro.from: Against a skills programme. A full or part qualification is assessed externally.

fisa.gate.approved.text: E saennwe e loketse morero: bakgethwa ba ka ngola pampiri ena
fisa.gate.approved.from: Signed off as fit for purpose: candidates may sit this paper

fisa.gate.in_moderation.text: Ho mohlahlobisisi: ha ho motho ya ka e ngolang hajwale
fisa.gate.in_moderation.from: With the moderator: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.gate.draft.text: E ntse e ngolwa: ha ho motho ya ka e ngolang hajwale
fisa.gate.draft.from: Being written: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.approvedOn.text: E hlahlobisitswe mme ya dumelwa ka {date}.

fisa.beforeNotAfter.text: FISA e hlahlobisiswa pele e ngolwa, eseng ka mora moo. Seo ke seo se e etsang hore e sireletsehe ha ho etswa ketelo ya tlhokomelo.
fisa.beforeNotAfter.from: A FISA is moderated before it is sat, not after. That is what makes it defensible at a monitoring visit.

fisa.practical.text: E boetse e na le karolo ya ho sebetsa, e ahlolwang e na le bokgoni kapa ha e so be le bokgoni.
fisa.practical.from: Also has a practical component, judged competent or not yet competent.

fisa.moderatorIntro.text: O sheba hore na e loketse morero, pele motho a e ngola.
fisa.moderatorIntro.from: Checks it is fit for purpose, before anybody sits it.

fisa.noContact.text: Ha ho na dintlha tsa ho ikopanya tse rekotilweng

fisa.unsigned.text: Ha ho tumellano ya sephiri hajwale. Ha ba a lokela ho bona kapa ho ahlola pampiri ho fihlela e saennwa.
fisa.unsigned.from: No confidentiality agreement yet. They may not see or judge the paper until it is signed.

fisa.nobody.text: Ha ho motho ya thonngweng hajwale.

fisa.outcomes.text: Diphetho tsa boemo ba ho tswa, le moo pampiri e di hlahlobang teng
fisa.outcomes.from: Exit level outcomes, and where the paper assesses them

fisa.outcomesIntro.text: Karolo ya 2 ya ditlaleho tsohle tse pedi. Ke sebaka feela se bontshang hore pampiri e akaretsa kwalifikeishene, eseng feela hore e shebahala jwaloka tlhahlobo.
fisa.outcomesIntro.from: Section 2 of both reports. The only place that shows the paper covers the qualification rather than merely looking like an exam.

fisa.noOutcomes.text: Lenaneo lena ha le na diphetho tsa boemo ba ho tswa tse rekotilweng, ka hoo ha ho letho leo pampiri e ka tshwantshiswang le lona. Kenya kharikhulamo pele.
fisa.noOutcomes.from: This programme has no exit level outcomes recorded, so there is nothing to map the paper against. Import the curriculum first.

fisa.examinerReport.text: Tlaleho ya mohlahlobi wa ditlhahlobo / moqapi

fisa.onlyExaminer.text: Ke mohlahlobi ya thonngweng feela, ha tumellano ya hae ya sephiri e se e saennwe, ya ka araba tsena.
fisa.onlyExaminer.from: Only the appointed examiner, once their confidentiality agreement is signed, can answer these.

fisa.onlyModerator.text: Ke mohlahlobisisi ya thonngweng feela, ha tumellano ya hae ya sephiri e se e saennwe, ya ka araba tsena.
fisa.onlyModerator.from: Only the appointed moderator, once their confidentiality agreement is signed, can answer these.

fisa.handOverIntro.text: Ha tlaleho ya hao e se e phethilwe.
fisa.handOverIntro.from: Once your own report is complete.

fisa.laterIntro.text: Ena e dula jwalo ka ha e ntse e le, hobane bakgethwa ba kanna ba e ngotse. Phetolelo e ntjha e hloka tlhahlobisiso ya yona.
fisa.laterIntro.from: This one stays exactly as it is, because candidates may have sat it. A new version needs its own moderation.

fisa.noProgrammes.text: FISA e etswa khahlanong le lenaneo la bokgoni, mme ha ho le leng hajwale. Kenya le leng pele; kwalifikeishene e felletseng kapa karolo e hlahlojwa ka kantle ke Molekane wa Boleng ba Tlhahlobo, ka hoo mofani wa tshebeletso ha a bee pampiri eo.
fisa.noProgrammes.from: A FISA is set against a skills programme, and there are none yet. Import one first; a full or part qualification is assessed externally by the Assessment Quality Partner, so the provider does not set that paper.

fisa.passNote.text: FISA ke tlhahlobo, ka hoo e na le lona, ho fapana le bokgoni ba ka hare.
fisa.passNote.from: A FISA is an examination, so it has one, unlike internal competence.

fisa.hasPractical.text: E boetse e na le karolo ya ho sebetsa e ahlolwang e na le bokgoni kapa ha e so be le bokgoni
fisa.hasPractical.from: It also has a practical component judged competent or not yet competent

fisa.practicalHint.text: mohlala. Ho sebetsa: dihora tse 4, e ahlolwa e na le bokgoni / ha e so be le bokgoni
fisa.practicalHint.from: e.g. Practical: 4 hours, judged competent / not yet competent

fisa.idNote.text: Tsela eo sethala se hlalosang motho a le mong ho e mong ha ba se na akhaonto mona.
fisa.idNote.from: How the platform tells one person from another when they have no account here.

fisa.account.text: Akhaonto ya hae mona, haeba a e na le yona
fisa.account.from: Their account here, if they have one

fisa.outside.text: Motho ya tswang kantle, ya se nang akhaonto
fisa.outside.from: Somebody from outside, with no account

fisa.accountNote.text: Ke motho ya nang le akhaonto feela ya ka tlatsang tlaleho ya hae mona.
fisa.accountNote.from: Only somebody with an account can fill in their own report here.

fisa.further.text: Maikutlo a mang bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa dikgahlamelo tsa tlhahlobo
fisa.further.from: Further comments for the improvement of assessment standards

fisa.signOff.text: Saena e le e loketse morero
fisa.signOff.from: Sign off as fit for purpose

fisa.untilYouDo.text: Ha ho mokgethwa ya ka ngolang pampiri ena ho fihlela o etsa jwalo.
fisa.untilYouDo.from: No candidate may sit this paper until you do.

eisa.intro.text: Nako ya ngodiso ya ngola ka nngwe, ha ngodiso e kwala, le dihlopha tseo di ntseng di lokela ho ngodiswa. Ngodiso hangata e kwala kamora dikgwedi tse tharo pele, e leng lebaka leo sehlopha se qetang ka mora selemo se lokelang ho ngodiswa kgale pele se qeta.
eisa.intro.from: When each sitting is, when registration for it closes, and which cohorts still have to be entered. Registration typically closes about three months ahead, which is why a cohort finishing later in the year has to be entered long before it finishes.

eisa.registerNowIntro.text: Ngodiso e kwala ka hare ho matsatsi a leshome a mosebetsi mme dihlopha tsena ha di na letsatsi la ngodiso le rekotilweng.
eisa.registerNowIntro.from: Registration closes within ten working days and these cohorts have no registration date recorded.

eisa.sittingsIntro.text: Ke tse ntseng di bulehile bakeng sa ngodiso feela. E kwetsweng ha se letho leo motho a ka le etsang, mme ho le tlohela mona ho ne ho tla sutumetsa nako ya nnete e latelang tlase leqepheng.
eisa.sittingsIntro.from: Only those still open for registration. A closed one is nothing anybody can act on, and leaving it here would push the next real deadline down the page.

eisa.nextYear.text: Ha ho letho le rekotilweng ka mora selemo sena. Molekane wa boleng ba tlhahlobo o phatlalatsa matsatsi a selemo se tlang ka Tshitwe, ka hoo lengolo le lokela ho be le kentswe; ho a kenya jwale ke ho boloka palo ya matsatsi e tsamaya ho fihlela ka Pherekgong.
eisa.nextYear.from: Nothing is recorded beyond this year. The assessment quality partner publishes next year's dates in December, so the letter should be out; adding them now is what keeps the countdown running into January.

eisa.toEnter.text: {cohorts} di ntse di lokela ho kenngwa

eisa.toEnterIntro.text: Tsohle tse nang le nako e butsweng le ntle le letsatsi la ngodiso le rekotilweng khahlanong le tsona.
eisa.toEnterIntro.from: Everything with an open deadline and no registration date recorded against it.

eisa.sittingName.text: Lebitso la nako ya ho ngola, mohlala Hlakubele 2027

eisa.noQualification.text: Ha ho kwalifikeishene ho dingodiso tsena

eisa.noIdIntro.text: Molekane ka mong wa boleng o e kopa, mme ngodiso e kgutlisitsweng ka lebaka la nomoro e haellang e ja potoloho. Ho molemo ho e fumana hona jwale ho feta ha faele e se e rometswe.
eisa.noIdIntro.from: Every quality partner asks for one, and a registration returned for a missing number costs a cycle. Better found now than after the file is sent.

eisa.readyIntro.text: Kriteria e nngwe le e nngwe ho module e nngwe le e nngwe e fihletswe, e ka ba e rutilweng kapa e amohetswe ka ho ithuta ho fetileng.
eisa.readyIntro.from: Every criterion in every module met, whether taught or recognised through prior learning.

eisa.nobodyYet.text: Ha ho motho hajwale. Lenane le ka tlase le bolela hore ba mong le mong o na le tsela e kae.
eisa.nobodyYet.from: Nobody yet. The list below says how far each of them has to go.

eisa.notReadyIntro.text: Hore ba mong le mong o na le tsela e kae. Motho ya haellwang ke kriteria e le nngwe a ntse a ka fihlela nako ha e hlokometswe bekeng ena.
eisa.notReadyIntro.from: How far each has to go. Somebody one criterion short can still make the deadline if it is noticed this week.

ready.intro.text: Moithuti a ka ngola External Integrated Summative Assessment ha kriteria e nngwe le e nngwe ya tlhahlobo ya ka hare ho module e nngwe le e nngwe e se e fihletswe. Eseng tse ngata ho tsona, mme ha ho peresente e e nkelang sebaka: peresente e ka tlase ke tswelopele, baji ke tumello.
ready.intro.from: A learner may sit the External Integrated Summative Assessment once every internal assessment criterion in every module has been achieved. Not most of them, and no percentage stands in for it: the percentage below is progress, the badge is permission.

ready.nobody.text: Ha ho motho ya ngodisitsweng khahlanong le kwalifikeishene hajwale. Ngodisa moithuti kosing mme o kgethe kwalifikeishene eo e balang ho yona, mme o tla hlaha mona.
ready.nobody.from: Nobody is enrolled against a qualification yet. Enrol a learner on a course and choose the qualification it counts towards, and they will appear here.

ready.notCaptured.text: Kharikhulamo mona ha e so kenngwe ka botlalo.
ready.notCaptured.from: A curriculum here is not fully captured.

ready.notCapturedIntro.text: Di-module tse ding ha di na dikriteria tsa tlhahlobo, ka hoo ha ho letho leo ho ka fihlelwang khahlanong le tsona mme ha ho motho ho kwalifikeishene eo ya ka phatlalatswang a loketse. Kenya tokomane e felletseng ya kharikhulamo pele o kenya motho ho EISA.
ready.notCapturedIntro.from: Some modules carry no assessment criteria, so nothing can be achieved against them and nobody on that qualification can be declared ready. Import the full curriculum document before entering anyone for an EISA.

ready.yours.text: Tswelopele ya hao ho ya EISA

ready.notEligible.text: Ha a so tshwanelehe bakeng sa EISA
ready.notEligible.from: Not yet eligible for the EISA

ready.achieved.text: Dikriteria tse {achieved} ho tse {total} tsa tlhahlobo ya ka hare di fihletswe, mme phihlelo ya mosebetsi e pakilwe ke {record} e saennweng.
ready.achieved.from: {achieved} of {total} internal assessment criteria achieved, and work experience proved by a signed {record}.

ready.canIssue.text: Tlaleho ya Diphetho e ka ntshwa.
ready.canIssue.from: A Statement of Results can be issued.

ready.everyOne.text: E nngwe le e nngwe ya tsona e a hlokahala; ha ho letshwao la ho feta.
ready.everyOne.from: Every one of them is required; there is no pass mark.

ready.perUnit.text: Ditlaleho bakeng sa karolo ka nngwe ya ho ithuta

ready.perUnitIntro.text: Tlaleho ya karolo e le nngwe ya ho ithuta e netefatsa dikriteria tsohle ho di-module tseo karolo eo e di fanang. E ka ntshwa hang ha karolo eo e phethilwe, ntle le ho emela tse setseng tsa kwalifikeishene.
ready.perUnitIntro.from: A statement for one study unit confirms every criterion in the modules that unit delivers. It can be issued as soon as that unit is finished, without waiting for the rest of the qualification.

ready.certificateIntro.text: Se ntshwa ke sehlopha se nehang kwalifikeishene kamora EISA, eseng ke {provider}. Se rekotwa mona ha se fihla, e le hore rekoto ya moithuti e re o na le kwalifikeishene.
ready.certificateIntro.from: Issued by the awarding body after the EISA, not by {provider}. Recorded here when it arrives, so the learner's record says they are qualified.

ready.thisNotCaptured.text: Kharikhulamo ena ha e so kenngwe ka botlalo.
ready.thisNotCaptured.from: This curriculum is not fully captured.

ready.thisNotCapturedIntro.text: {modules} ha di na dikriteria tsa tlhahlobo. Ha ho motho ya ka phatlalatswang a tshwanelehile khahlanong le kwalifikeishene ena ho fihlela tokomane e felletseng ya kharikhulamo e kentswe; ho seng jwalo di-module tse haellang di ne di tla balwa e le tse fetileng ka ho khutsa.
ready.thisNotCapturedIntro.from: {modules} carry no assessment criteria. Nobody can be declared eligible against this qualification until the full curriculum document has been imported; otherwise the missing modules would silently count as passed.

ready.weight.document.text: jwalo ka ha ho boletswe tokomaneng ya kharikhulamo
ready.weight.document.from: as stated in the curriculum document

ready.weight.credits.text: e tsoswa ho dikerediti tsa module; tokomane ha e bolele diperesente
ready.weight.credits.from: derived from module credits; the document states no percentages

ready.weight.equal.text: e arotswe ka ho lekana; tokomane ha e bolele diperesente kapa dikerediti
ready.weight.equal.from: split evenly; the document states no percentages and no credits

ready.component.practical.text: Di-module tsa bokgoni ba ho sebetsa

ready.workProved.text: Phihlelo ya mosebetsi e pakwa ke {record} e saennweng ke motataisi wa mosebetsi mme e amohetswe ke mohlahlobi, eseng ke dikriteria tsa tlhahlobo. Kharikhulamo ha e hlalose le e le nngwe bakeng sa module ena.
ready.workProved.from: Work experience is proved by a {record} signed by the workplace coach and accepted by an assessor, not by assessment criteria. The curriculum defines none for this module.

ready.noRecord.text: Ha ho {record} e butsweng bakeng sa module ena.
ready.noRecord.from: No {record} has been opened for this module.

ready.noCriteria.text: Ha ho dikriteria tsa tlhahlobo tse kentsweng bakeng sa module ena.
ready.noCriteria.from: No assessment criteria captured for this module.

issue.unit.text: Ntsha Tlaleho ya Diphetho bakeng sa {unit}

issue.notYet.text: Tlaleho ya Diphetho e ke ke ya ntshwa hajwale.
issue.notYet.from: A Statement of Results cannot be issued yet.

preview.summative.text: Ya qetello: e ahlolwa ke motho mme e hlahlobisiswa ka ho ikemela
preview.summative.from: Summative: judged by a person and independently moderated

preview.formative.text: Ya nts'etsopele: e tshwauwa ha moithuti a ntse a tsamaya
preview.formative.from: Formative: marked as the learner goes

preview.whoMarks.text: {app} di tshwauwa ke App, {assessor} ke mohlahlobi
preview.whoMarks.from: {app} marked by the App, {assessor} by an assessor

preview.isPreviewIntro.text: Hantle jwalo ka ha moithuti a e bona, le mabokose ao a ka ngolang ho wona. Ha ho letho le bolokwang mme ha ho boiteko bo qadilweng, ka hoo ditlhokomelo di kwetswe. Phanele e ka tlasa potso e nngwe le e nngwe ke ya hao hobane o entse pampiri ena; moithuti ha a e bone le ka mohla.
preview.isPreviewIntro.from: Exactly what a learner sees, with the boxes they would type into. Nothing is saved and no attempt has been started, so the controls are switched off. The panel under each question is for you because you built this paper; a learner never sees it.

preview.empty.text: Ha ho dipotso pampiring ena hajwale.
preview.empty.from: There are no questions in this paper yet.

preview.tickedAbove.text: Kgetho e nepahetseng e tshwauwe ka hodimo.
preview.tickedAbove.from: The correct option is ticked above.

preview.noGuide.text: Ha ho tataiso ya ho tshwaya. Mohlahlobi ha a na seo a ka e tshwayang khahlanong le sona; kenya e nngwe pele pampiri e sebediswa.
preview.noGuide.from: No marking guide. An assessor has nothing to mark this against; add one before the paper is used.

preview.declarationIntro.text: Moithuti a ke ke a e nehelana ntle le ho dumela ho yona, mme mantswe a nepahetseng a bolokwa ka ho tiya ho ho romelwa.
preview.declarationIntro.from: A learner cannot hand this in without agreeing to it, and the exact wording is frozen into the submission.

people.intro.text: Bohle ho {provider}, mesebetsi ya bona, le hore na rekoto ya bona e na le seo tlaleho ya molao e se hlokang.
people.intro.from: Everyone in {provider}, their roles, and whether their record carries what a statutory return needs.

people.notEnrolledOne.text: Moithuti a le mong ha a ngodiswa ho letho.
people.notEnrolledOne.from: 1 learner is not enrolled on anything.

people.notEnrolledMany.text: Baithuti ba {count} ha ba ngodiswa ho letho.
people.notEnrolledMany.from: {count} learners are not enrolled on anything.

people.notEnrolledWhy.text: Ho ba moithuti ha ho fane ka phihlello ka boyona, ka hoo ba kena skrineng se se nang letho. Ba ngodise kosing, ba kenye sehlopheng, kapa o ba abele lenaneo.
people.notEnrolledWhy.from: Being a learner grants no access on its own, so they sign in to an empty screen. Enrol them on a course, add them to a cohort, or assign a programme.

people.missingOne.text: Motho a le mong o haellwa ke dintlha tseo tlaleho ya SETA kapa SAQA e di hlokang.
people.missingOne.from: 1 person is missing details a SETA or SAQA return needs.

people.missingMany.text: Batho ba {count} ba haellwa ke dintlha tseo tlaleho ya SETA kapa SAQA e di hlokang.
people.missingMany.from: {count} people are missing details a SETA or SAQA return needs.

people.missingWhy.text: Ba tshwauwe ka tlase. Ho di tlatsa hona jwale ho bonolo haholo ho feta bosiu pele ho ho romelwa.
people.missingWhy.from: They are marked below. Filling them in now is far easier than the night before a submission.

userStatus.anonymised.text: Ha a sa tsejwe ka lebitso

people.roster.text: Kenya sehlopha ho tswa ho spreadsheet
people.roster.from: Add a cohort from a spreadsheet

people.rosterIntro.text: Bala faele ya CSV kapa Excel ya baithuti mme o ba thehe bohle hang. E o bontsha seo e se entseng ka faele pele ho thehwa motho.
people.rosterIntro.from: Read a CSV or Excel file of learners and create them all at once. It shows you what it made of the file before anybody is created.

people.added.text: Ho kentswe. Mo fe phasewete ena: e bontshwa hang feela mme ha e ke e fumanwe hape.
people.added.from: Added. Give them this password: it is shown once and cannot be retrieved.

people.noMail.text: Ha ho seva ya poso e hokahantsweng hajwale, ka hoo ha ho letho le rometsweng ka imeile. Ba kope ho e fetola kamora ho kena.
people.noMail.from: There is no mail server connected yet, so nothing was emailed. Ask them to change it after signing in.

person.lineManagerNote.text: E etsa qeto ya hore koetliso ya motho enwa e ka bonwa ke bo mang ditlalehong.
person.lineManagerNote.from: Decides whose training this person can see in reports.

person.ofoNote.text: Khoutu ya mosebetsi e sebediswang ho kopanya tlaleho ya SETA.
person.ofoNote.from: Occupation code used to group a SETA return.

person.statutoryNote.text: E hlokahala bakeng sa tlaleho ya SAQA kapa SETA. Nomoro ya boitsebiso e hlahlojwa khahlanong le nomoro ya yona ya netefatso ha o boloka, ka hoo phoso ya ho ngola e tshwarwa mona, eseng ke setsi se laolang.
person.statutoryNote.from: Needed for a SAQA or SETA return. The identity number is checked against its check digit as you save, so a typing error is caught here rather than by the regulator.

person.roleNote.moderator.text: A ke ke a hlahlobisisa diqeto tsa hae

person.roleNote.workplace_coach.text: Motsamaisi wa mohiri: o bona baithuti ba hae feela
person.roleNote.workplace_coach.from: The employer's supervisor: sees only their own learners

roster.how.text: CSV kapa Excel. Dihlooho tsa dikholomo di tshwantshanngwa ka lebitso ("Surname", "Last Name" le "Van" kaofela di sebetsa), mme ha ho hlokahale keketso ya AI bakeng sa sena.
roster.how.from: CSV or Excel. Column headings are matched by name ("Surname", "Last Name" and "Van" all work) and no extension is needed for any of it.

roster.aiOn.text: Keketso ya hao ya AI e a sebetsa

roster.aiOnWhat.text: mme e tla leka ho tshwantshanya sehlooho se seng le se seng seo melao e se fositseng. E bontshwa dihlooho feela, ha e ke e bontshwe mela, e nang le dinomoro tsa boitsebiso.
roster.aiOnWhat.from: and will try to match any heading the rules miss. It is shown the headings only, never the rows, which carry identity numbers.

roster.aiOff.text: Ha keketso ya hao ya AI e bulehile, e ne e tla tshwantshanya hape dihlooho tseo melao e sa di tsebeng; e ne e tla bontshwa dihlooho feela, ha e ke e bontshwe mela. Konopo ya ho e bula e ka hodimo ho leqephe.
roster.aiOff.from: With your AI extension switched on it would additionally match headings the rules do not recognise; it would be shown the headings only, never the rows. The switch is at the top of the page.

roster.passwords.text: Diphasewete tsa bona tsa pele, tse bontshwang hang feela

roster.passwordsNote.text: Tsena ha di bolokwe kae kapa kae moo di ka baloang hape. Di kopishe hona jwale, kapa o di beele motho ka mong hamorao. Motho ka mong o botswa hore a fetole phasewete ya hae ha a kena la pele.
roster.passwordsNote.from: These are not stored anywhere they can be read again. Copy them now, or reset them individually later. Each person is asked to change theirs on first sign-in.

roster.willCreateSkip.text: Ho tla thewa {count}, ho tla tlolwa {skipped}.
roster.willCreateSkip.from: {count} will be created, {skipped} will be skipped.

personPage.lastSignedIn.text: · o kene ka {date} la ho qetela

personPage.anonymised.text: Rekoto ena ha e sa tsejwe ka lebitso

personPage.anonymisedOne.text: Dintlha tsa botho di phumotswe ka {date} ka kopo ya motho enwa. Setifikeiti sa hae se le seng se sa sebetsa mme se ka netefatswa, hobane kwalifikeishene ha e se e fumanwe e tlameha ho dula rekotong ya naha.
personPage.anonymisedOne.from: The personal details were erased on {date} at the person's request. Their 1 certificate remains valid and verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to stay on the national record.

personPage.anonymisedMany.text: Dintlha tsa botho di phumotswe ka {date} ka kopo ya motho enwa. Ditifikeiti tsa hae tse {count} di sa sebetsa mme di ka netefatswa, hobane kwalifikeishene ha e se e fumanwe e tlameha ho dula rekotong ya naha.
personPage.anonymisedMany.from: The personal details were erased on {date} at the person's request. Their {count} certificates remain valid and verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to stay on the national record.

personPage.noEdit.text: Ha ho letho mona le ka fetolwang.

personPage.conductIntro.text: Seo ho boletsweng hore se entswe, ke ditemoso dife tse neng di sebetsa ka nako eo, hore na tsebiso ya pitso ya ho mamela e ne e lekane, le hore ho ile ha etswa qeto efe. Ka tatellano eo di etsahetseng ka yona, e leng tatellano eo di balwang hape ka yona.
personPage.conductIntro.from: What was alleged, which warnings were live at the time, whether notice of a hearing was adequate, and what was decided. In the order it happened, which is the order it gets read back in.

personPage.supportIntro.text: Seo se etswang bakeng sa moithuti enwa, le hore ke mang ya se etsang. Lebaka la ho fana ka thuso ke tlhahisoleseding ya bophelo bo botle kapa ya ditjhelete, mme e bolokwa ka thoko, hobane ho etsa thuso ha ho hloke ho tseba hobaneng.
personPage.supportIntro.from: What is being done for this learner, and by whom. The reason behind an accommodation is health or financial information and is held apart from it, because doing the accommodating does not require knowing why.

personPage.missed.text: Matsatsi a tlhahlobo ya qetello a fositsweng

personPage.missedIntro.text: Letsatsi le le leng le eketsehileng, mme ke leo feela. Moo le lona le fositsweng ka lebaka la bongaka, moithuti o ya tlhahlobong ya molomo le molebedi ya tswang ho mohiri.
personPage.missedIntro.from: One additional date, and one only. Where that is also missed on medical grounds the learner goes to an oral assessment with an observer from the employer.

personPage.appealsIntro.text: Khahlanong le sephetho, kapa khahlanong le boitshwaro ba mohlahlobi. Kamohelo e tiisetswa nakong ya dihora tse {hours}, mme nako e qala ha boipiletso bo kenngwa mona.
personPage.appealsIntro.from: Against a result, or against an assessor's conduct. Receipt is acknowledged within {hours} hours, and the clock starts when it is lodged here.

personPage.documentsIntro.text: Di hlahlojwa ha di ntse di bokelwa, eseng ha tlaleho e ntse e kopanngwa. Kopi e netefaditsweng e haellang e fumanwang dikgwedi hamorao e thata ho e fumana haholo, mme letsatsi la ho qetela hangata le ho setse matsatsi a mmalwa ka nako eo.
personPage.documentsIntro.from: Checked as they are collected rather than when a return is being assembled. A missing certified copy found months later is far harder to get, and the deadline is usually days away by then.

personPage.elsewhere.text: Ho ithuta ho rekotilweng kae kapa kae

personPage.elsewhereIntro.text: E kentswe ho tswa sistiming e nngwe. E bontshwa jwalo ka ha e rekotilwe moo; ha ho letho la yona le ileng la rutwa, la hlahlojwa kapa la hlahlobisiswa sethaleng sena.
personPage.elsewhereIntro.from: Imported from another system. Shown as it was recorded there; none of it was taught, assessed or moderated on this platform.

editor.ownRoles.text: O ke ke wa iphetolela mesebetsi ya hao: ho tlosa phihlello ya hao ke phoso e le nngwe eo ho seng motho e mong ya ka e lokisang. Kopa mookameli e mong.
editor.ownRoles.from: You cannot change your own roles: removing your own access is the one mistake nobody else may be able to undo. Ask another administrator.

editor.mailboxIntro.text: Aterese eo baithuti le bahlahlobi ba ngolelanang ka yona. E arohane le aterese ya ho kena e ka hodimo, e le hore puisano ka tlhahlobo e fihle ka hare ho rekoto ya moithuti, eseng lebokoseng la poso la motho ka bomo, moo e leng ka ntle ho log ya tlhahlobo, ka ntle ho kopi ya polokelo, mme e nyamelang ha a tsamaya.
editor.mailboxIntro.from: The address learners and assessors write to and from. Separate from the sign-in address above, so a conversation about an assessment lands inside the learner's record rather than in somebody's private inbox, where it is outside the audit log, outside the backup, and gone when they leave.

editor.noPassword.text: Ha ho na phasewete e arohaneng, hobane ha ho na ho kena ho arohaneng.
editor.noPassword.from: There is no separate password, because there is no separate login.

editor.noPasswordWhy.text: Lena ha se lebokose la poso ho seva ya poso e nang le webmail ya yona. Poso e romelwang ho aterese ena e isoa ka hare ho sethala, mme motho o e bala le ho e araba tlasa Poso ha a se a kene ka tsela eo a tlwaetseng ka yona. Hoo ke morero wa yona: dipuisano di dula ka hare ho rekoto ya moithuti, ka log ya tlhahlobo le kopi ya polokelo, eseng lebokoseng la poso le ikemetseng le tsamayang ha bona ba tsamaya.
editor.noPasswordWhy.from: This is not a mailbox on a mail host with its own webmail. Mail sent to this address is delivered into the platform, and the person reads and answers it under Mail after signing in the way they always do. That is the point of it: the correspondence sits inside the learner's record, in the audit log and in the backup, rather than in a private inbox that leaves when they do.

editor.mailboxChange.text: Ho e fetola ha ho suthise poso e seng e amohetswe.
editor.mailboxChange.from: Changing it does not move mail already received.

editor.mailboxSuggested.text: Tlhahiso: {address}. E siye e se na letho haeba o sa batle lebokose la poso.
editor.mailboxSuggested.from: Suggested: {address}. Leave blank for no mailbox.

editor.newPassword.text: Phasewete e ntjha: e bontshwa hang feela, e nehe motho ka kotloloho.
editor.newPassword.from: New password: shown once, give it to them directly.

editor.ownSuspend.text: O ke ke wa emisa akhaonto ya hao.
editor.ownSuspend.from: You cannot suspend your own account.

editor.suspendNote.text: Ho emisa ho felisa hang-hang nako efe kapa efe eo motho a e butseng, mme ho beha phasewete bocha ho mo ntsha kae kapa kae moo a kenneng teng.
editor.suspendNote.from: Suspending ends any session the person has open immediately, and resetting a password signs them out everywhere.

editor.eraseIntro.text: Bakeng sa kopo ya POPIA ya ho hlakola. E tlosa lebitso, dintlha tsa ho ikopanya le tsa setjhaba ka ho sa feleng. Ditifikeiti le direkoto tsa tlhahlobo di bolokwa mme di dula di ka netefatswa, hobane kwalifikeishene ha e se e fumanwe e tlameha ho dula rekotong ya naha, e leng lebaka hape leo sena se ke keng sa hulwa.
editor.eraseIntro.from: For a POPIA erasure request. Removes the name, contact and demographic details permanently. Certificates and assessment records are kept and stay verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to remain on the national record, which is also why this cannot be undone.

editor.why.text: Ke hobaneng ha ho etswa sena?

editor.whyHint.text: E bolokwa ka ho sa feleng ho log ya tlhahlobo.
editor.whyHint.from: Kept permanently in the audit log.

lodge.noCohort.text: Boipiletso bo kenngwa khahlanong le sehlopha, mme moithuti enwa ha a sehlopheng se sebetsang.
lodge.noCohort.from: An appeal is filed against a cohort, and this learner is not on a running one.

lodge.statementHint.text: Seo moithuti a se reng, ka mantswe a hae ha ho kgonahala.
lodge.statementHint.from: What the learner says, in their words where possible.

lodge.lateWhy.text: Hobaneng ha sena se amohelwa kamora nako
lodge.lateWhy.from: Why this is being accepted out of time

lodge.lateNote.text: Boipiletso bo tlisitsweng morao ke boipiletso ntse bo le jwalo, mme ho bo hana mona ho ne ho tla bo isa feela lebokoseng la poso la motho. Lebaka le ba karolo ya faele.
lodge.lateNote.from: A late appeal is still an appeal, and turning it away here would only send it to somebody's inbox. The reason becomes part of the file.

missed.outcome.sat.text: O ngotse ka letsatsi le eketsehileng

missed.none.text: Ha ho matsatsi a tlhahlobo ya qetello a fositsweng.

missed.againOral.text: Ba e fositse hape: dumella tlhahlobo ya molomo
missed.againOral.from: Missed it again: authorise an oral assessment

missed.wasMedical.text: Ho e fositsa la bobedi ho bile ka lebaka la bongaka
missed.wasMedical.from: The second miss was on medical grounds

missed.medicalHint.text: Lebaka la bongaka e bile eng

missed.medicalOnly.text: Tsela ya molomo e buleha feela ka lebaka la bongaka, eseng ka le leng. Ntle le lona, sephetho ke ho lahla tlhahlobo, seo moithuti a ntseng a ka se ipiletsa.
missed.medicalOnly.from: The oral route opens on a medical ground and nothing else. Without one the outcome is a forfeit, which the learner can still appeal.

missed.whyHint.text: Lebaka la ho e fosetsa, haeba le tsejwa
missed.whyHint.from: Why it was missed, if known

missed.onlyOne.text: Letsatsi le le leng le eketsehileng, mme ke leo feela. Ho le rekota mona ke ho thibela la boraro ho hlophiswa hamorao ke motho ya neng a sa tsebe ka lena.
missed.onlyOne.from: One additional date, and one only. Recording it here is what stops a third being arranged later by somebody who did not know about this one.

support.withheld.text: Dintlha tse ding di teng faeleng. Di thibetswe, hobane ke tlhahisoleseding ya bophelo bo botle kapa ya ditjhelete, mme ho etsa phetoho ya tshehetso ha ho hloke ho tseba lebaka la yona.
support.withheld.from: There is more detail on file. It is restricted, because it is health or financial information and doing the accommodation does not require knowing the reason for it.

support.changing.text: Ho fetolwa eng ka lebaka la seo
support.changing.from: What is changing as a result

support.closedOne.text: Rekoto e le nngwe e kwetsweng ha e bontshwe.

support.closedMany.text: Direkoto tse {count} tse kwetsweng ha di bontshwe.

support.accommodation.text: Seo se tla etswa: se arolelwa mang kapa mang ya tlamehang ho se etsa
support.accommodation.from: What will be done: shared with whoever has to do it

support.accommodationHint.text: Setulo haufi le monyako. Dumella phomolo ka mor'a metsotso e 40 e nngwe le e nngwe. Fana ka dintho tse hatisitsweng.
support.accommodationHint.from: Seat near the door. Allow a break every 40 minutes. Provide printed materials.

support.reason.text: Lebaka le ka morao ho sena: le thibetswe, mme ho betere ho le siya le se na letho
support.reason.from: The reason behind it: restricted, and better left empty

support.reasonNote.text: Bophelo bo botle, bokooa le maemo a ditjhelete ke dintlha tsa botho tse ikgethileng. Rekoto e reng feela seo o lokelang ho se etsa e sebeletsa moithuti hantle ka ho tshwanang mme e beha kotsing e nyenyane haholo. Tlatsa sena feela moo motho a ke keng a sebetsa ntle le sona.
support.reasonNote.from: Health, disability and financial circumstances are special personal information. A record that says only what to do serves the learner just as well and puts far less at risk. Fill this in only where somebody genuinely could not act without it.

support.consented.text: Moithuti o dumetse hore sena se rekotwe
support.consented.from: The learner has agreed to this being recorded

docs.kind.certified_id.text: Kopi e netefaditsweng ya tokomane ya boitsebiso

docs.kind.highest_qualification.text: Kopi e netefaditsweng ya kwalifikeishene e phahameng ka ho fetisisa

docs.kind.rpl_portfolio.text: Foldara ya ho ithuta ho fetileng

docs.route.standard_qualification.text: Kwalifikeishene e felletseng kapa karolo ya yona

docs.route.rpl.text: Ho amohelwa ha ho ithuta ho fetileng

docs.routeNote.text: Tsela ena e etsa qeto ya seo se hlokahalang. Ho amohelwa ha ho ithuta ho fetileng ho kopa foldara ho e na le setifikeiti sa kwalifikeishene, hobane taba ke hore ho ithuta ho etsahetse kantle ho lenaneo la semmuso.
docs.routeNote.from: The route decides what is required. Recognition of prior learning asks for a portfolio rather than a qualification certificate, because the claim is that the learning happened outside a formal programme.

docs.allSupplied.text: Tsohle tse hlokahalang di ntshitswe mme di hlahlojilwe.
docs.allSupplied.from: Everything required has been supplied and checked.

docs.expired.text: e netefaditswe {date}, e felletswe ke nako

conduct.stage.final_written_warning.text: Temoso ya ho qetela e ngotsweng

conduct.warning.final_written.text: Temoso ya ho qetela e ngotsweng

conduct.sanction.final_written_warning.text: Temoso ya ho qetela e ngotsweng

conduct.liveNote.text: Ke tsena feela tse balwang ha ho nyolosetswa. Temoso e fetetsweng ke letsatsi la yona e dula faeleng mme e tlohela ho baleha, e leng seo boipiletso bo itshetlehileng ho sona.
conduct.liveNote.from: Only these count towards escalation. A warning past its date stays on file and stops counting, which is what an appeal turns on.

conduct.hearingAt.text: Pitso ya ho mamela {when}, tsebiso e file ka {notice}.

conduct.findingsHint.text: Seo se fumanweng, le motheo wa sona
conduct.findingsHint.from: What was found, and on what basis

conduct.givenButton.text: Moithuti o filwe sena ka mongolo
conduct.givenButton.from: The learner has been given this in writing

conduct.termsHint.text: Molao o robehileng, tekanyetso e lebelletsweng, le seo se tla etsahalang haeba se boela.
conduct.termsHint.from: The rule broken, the standard expected, and what happens if it recurs.

conduct.allegationsHint.text: Dipelaelo tse ikgethileng tse hlahiswang ho moithuti
conduct.allegationsHint.from: The specific allegations put to the learner

conduct.sanctionsHint.text: Dikotlo tse ka fanwang, ho kenyeletswa ho felisa ngodiso moo ho kgonahalang
conduct.sanctionsHint.from: Sanctions possible, including termination where it is

conduct.rights.text: Tsebiso e bolella moithuti hore a ka thusoa ke moithuti e mong, a hlahisa nyewe ya hae, mme a bitsa le ho botsisa dipaki.
conduct.rights.from: The notice tells the learner they may be assisted by a fellow learner, present their case, and call and question witnesses.

conduct.notice.text: Bonyane dihora tse {hours} ho tloha jwale. Tsebiso e kgutshwanyane e a hanwa: ke bofokodi boo boipiletso bo hlolwang ka bona, ho sa tsotellehe seo moithuti a se entseng.
conduct.notice.from: At least {hours} hours from now. Short notice is refused: it is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

conduct.whyHint.text: Hobaneng. Ena ke serapa seo moithuti a nang le tokelo ya sona.
conduct.whyHint.from: Why. This is the paragraph the learner is entitled to.

conduct.allegationHint.text: Seo ho reng se entswe, ka ho hlakileng. Moithuti a ke ke a araba 'boikutlo bo bobe'.
conduct.allegationHint.from: What is alleged, specifically. A learner cannot answer 'poor attitude'.

cohorts.intro.text: Sehlopha sa batho ba sebetsang lenaneo hammoho, ka lenane le le leng la nako. Letsatsi le leng le le leng la ho qetela le bolokwa e le palo ya matsatsi ho tloha ka letsatsi la ho qala, ka hoo ho suthisa kenyo ya baithuti ho suthisa matsatsi wohle a bohle ba ka hare ho yona hang.
cohorts.intro.from: A group working through a programme together, on one schedule. Every deadline is held as a number of days from the start date, so moving an intake moves every date for everyone in it at once.

cohorts.none.text: {cohort} ke sehlopha sa batho ba sebetsang {course} e phatlalatswitsweng hammoho, ka lenane le le leng la nako. Theha e nngwe khahlanong le {course} mme letsatsi le leng le le leng la ho qetela le lekanngwa ho tloha ka letsatsi la ho qala.
cohorts.none.from: A {cohort} is a group working through a published {course} together, on one schedule. Create one against a {course} and every deadline is measured from its start date.

cohorts.roster.from: Add a cohort from a spreadsheet

cohorts.rosterIntro.text: Bala faele ya CSV kapa Excel ya baithuti mme o ba thehe kaofela hang. E o bontsha seo e se entseng ka faele pele motho ofe kapa ofe a thehwa, ebe o ba ngodisa sehlopheng se ka hodimo.
cohorts.rosterIntro.from: Read a CSV or Excel file of learners and create them all at once. It shows you what it made of the file before anybody is created, then enrol them onto a cohort above.

cohorts.noPublished.text: Ha ho na {courses} tse phatlalatswitsweng hajwale. {cohort} e sebetsa khahlanong le {course} e phatlalatswitsweng, e le hore thepa ya yona e se ke ya fetolwa ha sehlopha se se se ntse se e sebetsa.
cohorts.noPublished.from: There are no published {courses} yet. A {cohort} runs against a published {course}, so that the material cannot change under a group already working through it.

cohorts.startNote.text: Letsatsi le leng le le leng la ho qetela le balwa ho tloha ka letsatsi lena. Le ka suthiswa hamorao, mme tsohle di suthisa le lona.
cohorts.startNote.from: Every deadline is counted from this day. It can be moved later, and everything moves with it.

cohort.payment.text: Ho fana ka invoice le tefo

cohort.paid.text: E tefilwe. Motho e mong le e mong ho sehlopha sena o balwa e le ya tefetsweng.
cohort.paid.from: Paid. Everybody on this cohort counts as paid for.

cohort.paidRef.text: E tefilwe · {reference}. Motho e mong le e mong ho sehlopha sena o balwa e le ya tefetsweng.
cohort.paidRef.from: Paid · {reference}. Everybody on this cohort counts as paid for.

cohort.invoiced.text: Invoice e ntshitswe, mme ha ho tefo e so rekotwe khahlanong le yona.
cohort.invoiced.from: Invoiced, and no payment recorded against it yet.

cohort.nothingRecorded.text: Ha ho letho le rekotilweng. Tsamaiso ya ngodiso e qala mona.
cohort.nothingRecorded.from: Nothing recorded. The enrolment procedure begins here.

cohort.moveIntro.text: Letsatsi le leng le le leng le ka tlase le bolokwa e le palo ya matsatsi ho tloha ho lena, ka hoo ho le fetola ho suthisa morero wohle wa ho qala wa motho e mong le e mong ho sehlopha.
cohort.moveIntro.from: Every date below is held as a number of days from this one, so changing it moves the whole rollout for everybody on the cohort.

cohort.waitingIntro.text: Moithuti ka mong hang, mohatong wa pele oo a ke keng a o bula.
cohort.waitingIntro.from: Each learner once, at the earliest step they cannot open.

cohort.progress.from: Where the cohort has got to

cohort.progressIntro.text: E butswe le ho phethwa mohato ka mong, le hore ba o phethileng ba nkile nako e kae. Ho sebediswa palo e bohareng, eseng palokaho, e le hore moithuti a le mong ya nyametseng kotara e le nngwe a se ke a pata moo ba bang bohle ba leng teng.
cohort.progressIntro.from: Opened and finished per step, and how long it took those who finished. The median rather than the average, so one learner who disappeared for a term does not hide where everybody else is.

cohort.stalledOne.text: Mohato o le mong o na le batho ba kgomaretseng ho ona: {steps}.
cohort.stalledOne.from: One step has people sitting on it: {steps}.

cohort.stalledMany.text: Mehato e {count} e na le batho ba kgomaretseng ho yona: {steps}.
cohort.stalledMany.from: {count} steps have people sitting on them: {steps}.

cohort.rolloutIntro.text: Dikopano tse nang le matsatsi tseo sehlopha sena se kopanang ho tsona, le rejisetara e nkwang ho e nngwe le e nngwe. Moo lenaneo le nang le dikerediti, le tlameha ho tsamaiswa ke motsamaisi wa thuto, mme sena ke bopaki ba hore le ile la tsamaiswa jwalo.
cohort.rolloutIntro.from: The dated sessions this cohort meets for, and the register taken at each. Where a programme carries credits it has to be facilitator-led, and this is the evidence that it was.

cohort.attendanceIntro.text: Kakaretso e lekanngwa khahlanong le lenaneo lohle; 'ho fihlela jwale' e lekanngwa khahlanong le seo se seng se tshwerwe. Qalong ya lenaneo, ya pele e tlase ka mokgwa o hlokang moelelo, mme ya bobedi e a tshepahala, ka hoo ka bobedi di fanwa, eseng e le nngwe feela e o kgethetsweng yona.
cohort.attendanceIntro.from: Overall is against the whole programme; to date is against what has actually been held. Early in a programme the first is meaninglessly low and the second is the honest one, so both are given rather than one being chosen for you.

cohort.held.text: Dikopano tse {held} ho tse {countable} di tshwerwe. Dikopano tse hlakotsweng le ba kenang ka boithatelo ha di balwe ho tse pedi.
cohort.held.from: {held} of {countable} sessions held. Cancelled sessions and voluntary walk-ins are left out of both.

cohort.feedbackIntro.text: E rometswe kamora tlhahlobo ya qetello, mme e arabuwa ka hare ho dihora tse {hours}. Ha ho motho ya netefatsang hore o amohetse mme ha ho motho ya kopanyang letho: kamohelo ke mola mme tlaleho ke potso.
cohort.feedbackIntro.from: Sent after a summative, answered within {hours} hours. Nobody acknowledges receipt and nobody transcribes anything: receipt is a row and the report is a query.

cohort.assessmentIntro.text: Moithuti ka mong khahlanong le mosebetsi o mong le o mong o hlahlojwang, ka tatellano eo o bokelwang ka yona. O balwa ho tswa ho dintho tse rometsweng, diqeto le direjisetara, eseng ho bolokwa ka letsoho, ka hoo o ke ke wa hanyetsana le tsona.
cohort.assessmentIntro.from: Every learner against every piece of assessed work, in the order it is collected. Read from submissions, decisions and registers rather than kept by hand, so it cannot disagree with them.

cohort.absentNote.text: Ho ba siyo ho balwa ho tswa rejisetareng ya kopano eo mosebetsi o ngotsweng ho yona, eseng ho tswa ho se rometsweng, hobane moithuti ya sa tlang ha a na se rometsweng seo ho ka rekotwang ho sona.
cohort.absentNote.from: Absent is read from the register of the sitting the work was written at, not from the submission, because a learner who did not attend has no submission for it to be recorded on.

cohort.workIntro.text: Seo se lokelang ho etsahala ho potoloha ho ruta: thepa e lokiswe, ditokomane di romelwe, mohlahlobisisi a kgethwe, ditifikeiti di lelekwe.
cohort.workIntro.from: What has to happen around the teaching: material readied, documents submitted, a moderator appointed, certificates chased.

cohort.releaseIntro.text: E bolokwa e le matsatsi ho tloha ha ho qala. Fetola letsatsi la ho qala mme tsena tsohle di suthisa le lona.
cohort.releaseIntro.from: Held as days from the start. Change the start date and every one of these moves with it.

cohort.noSteps.text: {course} ya sehlopha sena ha e so na mehato.
cohort.noSteps.from: This cohort's {course} has no steps yet.

cohort.membersIntro.text: Ho eketsa motho mona hape ho mo ngodisa ho {course}. Lebitso le leng rejisetareng la motho ya ke keng a bula letho ke boemo bo sa phethahalang boo sena se bo qobang.
cohort.membersIntro.from: Adding somebody here also enrols them on the {course}. A name on a register who cannot open anything is the half-state this avoids.

cohort.nobody.text: Ha ho motho ya so eketswe.

cohortCtl.noSteps.text: Kosi ya sehlopha sena ha e so na mehato, ka hoo ha ho letho leo ho ka rerwang.
cohortCtl.noSteps.from: This cohort's course has no steps yet, so there is nothing to schedule.

cohortCtl.closesAfter.text: E kwala matsatsi kamora letsatsi la ho lokela

cohortCtl.closesLabel.text: {step}: e kwala matsatsi kamora letsatsi la ho lokela

cohortCtl.dayZero.text: Letsatsi la 0 ke letsatsi la ho qala. Siya mola o se na letho mme mohato oo ha o na matsatsi ho hang; o buleha hang ha se se etellang pele se phethilwe.
cohortCtl.dayZero.from: Day 0 is the start date. Leave a row empty and that step carries no dates at all; it opens as soon as whatever comes before it is done.

cohortCtl.everybody.text: Motho e mong le e mong ya nang le akhaonto ya moithuti o se a le sehlopheng sena. Mema batho ba bang ho tswa skrineng sa Batho pele.
cohortCtl.everybody.from: Everybody with a learner account is already on this cohort. Invite more people from the People screen first.

askFeedback.none.text: Ha ho motho ya so botswa.

payment.referenceNote.text: E le hore e ka tshwantshanngwa le seo ditjhelete di se nang le sona.
payment.referenceNote.from: So it can be matched to what finance holds.

tasks.progress.text: {done} ho {counted} di entswe: {percent}%. Mosebetsi o hlakotsweng ha o balwe ho tse pedi, ka hoo ho tlohela mosebetsi ha ho thuse kapa ho utlwisa palo bohloko.
tasks.progress.from: {done} of {counted} done: {percent}%. Cancelled work is left out of both halves, so abandoning a task neither helps nor hurts the figure.

rollout.nothing.text: Ha ho letho le rerilweng. Moo lenaneo le nang le dikerediti, le tlameha ho tsamaiswa ke motsamaisi wa thuto, ka hoo mona ke moo bopaki ba hore le ile la tsamaiswa jwalo bo qalang.
rollout.nothing.from: Nothing scheduled yet. Where a programme carries credits it has to be facilitator-led, so this is where the evidence that it was begins.

rollout.announced.text: Sehlopha le motsamaisi wa thuto ba tsebiswa ka kopano ka nngwe beke pele, ka nako ya yona le lehokela, mme ba tsebiswa hape haeba e suthiswa, e hlakotswe kapa e fetisetswe hamorao.
rollout.announced.from: The cohort and the facilitator are told about each session a week before it, with its time and link, and told again if it is moved, cancelled or postponed.

archive.intro.text: Hang ha moithuti a e-na le tlaleho ya hae ya diphetho, mme setifikeiti sa hae sa kwalifikeishene ho tswa ho setsi se fanang ka sona se rekotilwe leqepheng la hae la ho itokisetsa EISA, Foldara ya hae ya Bopaki e ka tloha sethaleng polokelong e le nngwe eo o e bolokang. Polokelo e buleha sebading efe kapa efe sa marang-rang ntle le sethala. Ha ho letho le tlosoang ho fihlela kopi eo o e bolokileng e hlahlojwa khahlanong le yona, mme rekoto ka nngwe e dula mona, e bolela hore polokelo efe e na le difaele.
archive.intro.from: Once a learner holds their statement of results and their qualification certificate from the awarding body has been recorded on their EISA readiness page, their Portfolio of Evidence can leave the platform in one archive that you keep. The archive opens in any browser without the platform. Nothing is removed until your stored copy has been checked against it, and every record stays here, saying which archive holds the files.

archive.readyFor.text: Ba na le tlaleho ya diphetho le setifikeiti sa kwalifikeishene bakeng sa {qualification}.
archive.readyFor.from: Holding a statement of results and the qualification certificate for {qualification}.

archive.noQualification.text: Kosi ya sehlopha sena ha e bale ho kwalifikeishene efe kapa efe.
archive.noQualification.from: This cohort's course counts towards no qualification.

archive.nobody.text: Ha ho motho ho fihlela jwale.

archive.anotherBuilding.text: Polokelo e nngwe e a ngolwa. Qala e latelang ha e qetile.
archive.anotherBuilding.from: Another archive is being written. Start the next one when it has finished.

archive.notYetIntro.text: Ba dula sethaleng mme ba latela polokelong e latelang ha setifikeiti sa bona sa kwalifikeishene se se se rekotilwe.
archive.notYetIntro.from: They stay on the platform and follow in a later archive once their own qualification certificate has been recorded.

archive.step1.text: 1. E jarolle mme o e boloke

archive.step1Note.text: E boloke moo pholisi ya hao ya direkoto e reng direkoto tsa baithuti di bolokwa teng, ka nako yohle ya polokelo. Ha difaele di se di tlositswe, ena ke kopi e le nngwe feela e felletseng.
archive.step1Note.from: Keep it where your records policy says learner records are kept, for the full retention period. Once the files are removed, this is the only complete copy.

archive.step2.text: 2. Hlahloja kopi eo o e bolokileng

archive.step3.from: 3. Remove the files from the platform

archive.building.text: E a ngolwa. Leqephe lena le ipapatisa ka boyona.
archive.building.from: Being written. This page updates by itself.

archive.checkLabel.text: Hlahloja kopi ya hao e bolokilweng

archive.checkNote.text: Kgetha polokelo moo o e bolokileng teng. E baleha komporong ena mme ha e kenywe; ke menwana ya yona feela e rometsweng. Polokelo e na le bytes tse {bytes}.
archive.checkNote.from: Choose the archive from where you stored it. It is read on this computer and not uploaded; only its fingerprint is sent. The archive is {bytes} bytes.

archive.stored.text: Kopi eo ke e hlahlojileng e bolokilwe moo pholisi ya rona ya direkoto e reng e lokela ho bolokwa teng.
archive.stored.from: The copy I checked is stored where our records policy says it should be kept.

archive.removeOne.text: Tlosa faele e le nngwe sethaleng

archive.keepingOne.text: Tokomane e le nngwe ya ngodiso e dula sethaleng le yona, hobane lenaneo le leng la moithuti le sa e hloka.
archive.keepingOne.from: 1 enrolment document stays on the platform as well, because another programme of the learner's still needs it.

archive.keeping.text: Ditokomane tse {count} tsa ngodiso di dula sethaleng le tsona, hobane lenaneo le leng la moithuti le sa di hloka.
archive.keeping.from: {count} enrolment documents stay on the platform as well, because another programme of the learner's still needs them.

archive.wrongSize.text: Faele eo e na le bytes tse {size} mme polokelo e na le {expected}. Ha se polokelo ena.
archive.wrongSize.from: That file is {size} bytes and the archive is {expected}. It is not this archive.

archive.couldNotStart.text: Ho khutlisa ho ne ho sa kgone ho qala.

archive.pieceRefused.text: Karolo ya ho kenya e hanilwe.
archive.pieceRefused.from: A piece of the upload was refused.

archive.carryOn.text: {problem} Kgetha faele hape ho tswela pele moo e emetseng teng.
archive.carryOn.from: {problem} Choose the file again to carry on from where it stopped.

archive.restoreNote.text: Ho hlokahala feela haeba difaele tsena di lokela ho boela sethaleng. Polokelo e a kenywa, e hlahlojwe khahlanong le menwana e nkilweng ha e etswa, mme faele ka nngwe e kgutliswa moo e neng e le teng.
archive.restoreNote.from: Only needed if these files have to be on the platform again. The archive is uploaded, checked against the fingerprint taken when it was made, and each file is put back where it was.

register.kind.walk_in.text: Ho kena mosebetsing ntle le ngodiso

register.supervisedIntro.text: Ba dumeletsweng ho kena, seo ba dumellanang le sona, le hore pampiri ya bona e amohetswe. Kopano ka boyona e etsahala moo dilekchara tsa hao di etsahalang teng; ena ke rekoto ya hore e ne e okametswe jwang.
register.supervisedIntro.from: Who was admitted, what they agreed to, and that their script was received. The meeting itself runs where your lectures do; this is the record of how it was supervised.

register.canInvigilate.text: Ena ke kopano ya tlhahlobo ya qetello, ka hoo e ka lebedisisoa.
register.canInvigilate.from: This is a summative session, so it can be invigilated.

register.intro.text: Ba neng ba le teng. Ditshwao tse bolokilweng di ka lokiswa hamorao, mme phetoho ka nngwe e rekotwa khahlanong le ya e entseng.
register.intro.from: Who was here. Saved marks can be corrected later, and every change is recorded against whoever made it.

register.nobody.text: Ha ho motho sehlopheng sena ho fihlela jwale, ka hoo ha ho na rejisetara ya ho nkwa.
register.nobody.from: Nobody is on this cohort yet, so there is no register to take.

register.excusedNote.text: Ho lokolotswa ho bolela ho ba siyo ka lebaka leo mofani wa tshebeletso a le amohetseng. E bolokwa e arohane le ho ba siyo ho tlwaelehileng hobane tsamaiso ya tshehetso ya moithuti e itshetlehile phapang eo.
register.excusedNote.from: Excused means absent for a reason the provider accepted. It is kept apart from a plain absence because the learner support procedure turns on the difference.

sitting.needsAssessment.text: Kopano e okametsweng e hloka tlhahlobo eo e ka e okametsang. Phatlalatsa e nngwe kosing pele, mme e ka behwa mona.
sitting.needsAssessment.from: A supervised sitting needs an assessment to supervise. Publish one on the course first, and it can be set up here.

sitting.nothing.text: Ha ho letho le okametswang kopanong ena. Beha e nngwe haeba ena e le tlhahlobo e okametsweng; e o fa nako ya ho kwala ho kena, boitlhaloso, tlhahlobo ya khamera, rejisetara ya mangolo le log ya diketsahalo.
sitting.nothing.from: Nothing is being supervised at this session. Set one up if this is an invigilated assessment; it gives you an admission cut-off, a declaration, a camera check, a script register and an incident log.

sitting.invigilator.text: Molebedi (ka boikgethelo, mme a ka behwa ka letsatsi leo)
sitting.invigilator.from: Invigilator (optional, and can be set on the day)

sitting.nobodyYet.text: Ha ho motho ho fihlela jwale

sitting.early.text: Palo ya metsotso eo bakgethwa ba fihlang pele ho nako ka yona
sitting.early.from: Candidates arrive this many minutes early

sitting.closesAfter.text: Palo ya metsotso kamora ho qala eo ho kena ho kwalang ka yona
sitting.closesAfter.from: Admission closes this many minutes after the start

sitting.camera.text: Khamera e tlameha ho dula e bulehile nako yohle
sitting.camera.from: A camera must be on throughout

sitting.materialsHint.text: Khalkuleitara e sa kenngwe mananeo le leqephe la difomula le fanweng. Ha ho letho le leng.
sitting.materialsHint.from: A non-programmable calculator and the issued formula sheet. Nothing else.

sitting.declaration.text: Seo mokgethwa ka mong a dumellanang le sona pele a qala (ka boikgethelo)
sitting.declaration.from: What each candidate agrees to before starting (optional)

sitting.nothingFurther.text: Ha ho letho le leng le lokelang ho etswa mona.

room.elsewhere.text: Ke {time} {zone} moo o leng teng. Dinako tse rekotilweng mona ke tsa mofani wa tshebeletso, e leng seo rekoto e se bolokang.
room.elsewhere.from: That is {time} {zone} where you are. Times recorded here are the provider's, which is what the record keeps.

room.arrive.text: Bakgethwa ba fihla metsotso e {minutes} pele.

room.closesAt.text: Ho kena ho kwala metsotso e {minutes} kamora ho qala, ka {time}; kamora moo sethala se a hana, hobane motho ya kentsweng morao o ne a e-na le nako e telele le pampiri ho feta ba bang bohle.
room.closesAt.from: Admission closes {minutes} minutes after the start, at {time}; after that the platform refuses, because somebody admitted late has had longer with the paper than everybody else.

room.closes.text: Ho kena ho kwala metsotso e {minutes} kamora ho qala; kamora moo sethala se a hana, hobane motho ya kentsweng morao o ne a e-na le nako e telele le pampiri ho feta ba bang bohle.
room.closes.from: Admission closes {minutes} minutes after the start; after that the platform refuses, because somebody admitted late has had longer with the paper than everybody else.

room.cameras.text: Dikhamera di dula di bulehile nako yohle.

room.joinNote.text: Kopano e tsamaya sethaleng seo o se sebedisang hajwale. Seo se rekotwang mona ke tsela eo e neng e okametswe ka yona.
room.joinNote.from: The meeting runs on the platform you already use. What is recorded here is how it was supervised.

room.noLink.text: Ha ho lehokela la kopano kopanong ena ho fihlela jwale. Eketsa le leng ho ho tsamaisa hore bakgethwa ba tsebe moo ba yang teng.
room.noLink.from: No meeting link on this session yet. Add one on the roll-out so candidates know where to go.

room.incidentsNote.text: E kentswe ka letsatsi leo. Pego e ngotsweng dibeke hamorao e na le boleng bo bonyenyane haholo boipilletsong, e leng moo e balwang teng feela.
room.incidentsNote.from: Filed on the day. An account written weeks later is worth very little at an appeal, which is the only place it is ever read.

quals.intro.text: Kwalifikeishene ya mosebetsi e fanwa ka mefuta e meraro ya module: Tsebo, Bokgoni ba ho sebetsa, le Phihlelo ya mosebetsi. Module ka nngwe e na le dikriteria tsa yona tsa tlhahlobo, mme sistimi e hlahloja hore dikahare tsa kosi di akaretsa e nngwe le e nngwe ya tsona pele kosi e ka phatlalatswa.
quals.intro.from: An occupational qualification is delivered across three kinds of module: Knowledge, Practical skill, and Workplace experience. Each module has its own assessment criteria, and the system checks that course content covers every one of them before a course can be published.

quals.folderTitle.text: Kapa e haha ho tswa foldareng
quals.folderTitle.from: Or build it from a folder

quals.folderIntro.text: Tsohle hang: kharikhulamo, dikarolo tsa ho ithuta, ditataiso le dipholisi. Foldara e nang le kakaretso ya yona e kenywa ka metsotso; e se nang yona e tlameha ho sebetswa sebopeho sa yona, mme karolo eo e hloka keketso ya AI.
quals.folderIntro.from: Everything at once: the curriculum, the study units, the guides and the policies. A folder that includes a summary of itself imports in seconds; one that does not has to have its structure worked out, and that is the part that needs an AI extension.

quals.folderLabel.text: Foldara ya kwalifikeishene, ho tswa komporong ya hao
quals.folderLabel.from: The qualification's folder, from your own computer

quals.folderHint.text: Tsohle foldareng le foldareng tse ka hare di a baleha: kharikhulamo, dikarolo tsa ho ithuta, ditataiso le dipholisi.
quals.folderHint.from: Everything in the folder and its subfolders is read: the curriculum, the study units, the guides and the policies.

quals.folderHint2.text: Foldara e hahilweng ke sistimi ya hao ya nts'etsopele ya lenaneo e kenyeletsa kakaretso ya yona, mme yona e balwa ka kotloloho, ka metsotso. Foldara e se nang yona ha e so ka e sebetswa sebopeho.
quals.folderHint2.from: A folder built by your programme development system includes a summary of itself, and that is read directly, in seconds. A folder without one cannot have its structure worked out yet.

quals.driveTitle.text: Kapa ho tswa drive eo o e hokelletseng
quals.driveTitle.from: Or from a drive you have connected

quals.driveIntro.text: Foldara e le nngwe, e baleha moo e leng teng. E fela sebakeng se le seng: tlhahiso ya ho hlahloja pele ho ngolwa letho.
quals.driveIntro.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

quals.noneTitle.text: Ha ho dikwalifikeishene ho fihlela jwale

quals.noneManage.text: E hahe ho tswa ditokomaneng tsa yona (tab e ka hodimo): tokomane ya kharikhulamo le tokomane ya kwalifikeishene di lekane, mme ha ho keketso ya AI e sebediswang. Tsohle tse ding sethaleng di hokahane le kwalifikeishene, ka hoo sena ke ntho ya pele eo o lokelang ho e etsa.
quals.noneManage.from: Build one from its documents (the tab above): the curriculum document and the qualification document are enough, and no AI extension is involved. Everything else on the platform hangs off a qualification, so this is the first thing to do.

quals.noneRead.text: Ha ho e so kenywe. Ha e nngwe e se e kentswe, kharikhulamo eo o e rutang le ho tshwaya khahlanong le yona e tla ba mona: di-module tsa yona, dihlooho tsa yona le dikriteria tseo e nngwe le e nngwe e hlahlojwang ka tsona. Ho kenya e nngwe ke mosebetsi wa mookameli.
quals.noneRead.from: None has been loaded yet. When one has been, the curriculum you teach and mark against will be here: its modules, its topics and the criteria each one is assessed by. Loading one is an administrator's job.

how.title.text: O ka rata ho e eketsa jwang?
how.title.from: How would you like to add it?

how.intro.text: Ditsela tse tharo. Kgetha e le nngwe mme ke yona feela e buleha; o ka e kwala hape mme wa kgetha e nngwe.
how.intro.from: Three ways in. Pick one and only that one opens; you can close it again and choose differently.

how.documents.summary.text: Tokomane ya kharikhulamo, tokomane ya kwalifikeishene ya SAQA le tlhaloso ya tlhahlobo. Sethala se bala kharikhulamo yohle ho tsona.
how.documents.summary.from: The curriculum document, the SAQA qualification document and the assessment specification. The App reads the whole curriculum out of them.

how.documents.needs.text: Di-PDF tse pedi kapa tse tharo kapa difaele tsa Word.
how.documents.needs.from: Two or three PDFs or Word files.

how.documents.speed.text: Metsotso. Ha ho AI e sebedisitsweng nako epe.
how.documents.speed.from: Seconds. No AI involved at any point.

how.folder.summary.text: Tsohle hang: kharikhulamo, dikarolo tsa ho ithuta, ditataiso, dibuka tsa mosebetsi le dipholisi, di bolokwa jwalo ka ha di baliwa.
how.folder.summary.from: Everything at once: the curriculum, the study units, the guides, the workbooks and the policies, filed as they are read.

how.folder.needs.text: Foldara yohle ya kwalifikeishene, ho tswa komporong ya hao kapa drive.
how.folder.needs.from: The qualification's whole folder, from your computer or a drive.

how.folder.speed.text: Metsotso e mmalwa. Foldara e nang le kakaretso ya yona ha e hloke AI; e se nang yona e sebetswa sebopeho sa yona, mme karolo eo e a e hloka.
how.folder.speed.from: Minutes. A folder that includes a summary of itself needs no AI; one that does not has its structure worked out, and that part does.

how.blank.summary.text: Kwalifikeishene e se nang letho eo o e hahang ka letsoho: sehlooho, khoutu, boemo le dikerediti, ebe di-module tsa yona ka nngwe.
how.blank.summary.from: An empty qualification you build by hand: the title, the code, the level and credits, then its modules one at a time.

how.blank.needs.from: The details in front of you.

how.blank.speed.text: Ho fihlela o qeta. Ha ho letho le balwang bakeng sa hao.
how.blank.speed.from: As long as it takes. Nothing is read for you.

qual.noIdentifiers.text: Ha ho ditsebiso tsa molao tse rekotilweng

manager.noneChosen.text: Ha ho di-module tse kgethilweng ho fihlela jwale

manager.none.text: Ha ho di-module ho fihlela jwale

manager.drawnFrom.text: e nkilwe ho {parent}, e abelanang kharikhulamo le yona
manager.drawnFrom.from: drawn from {parent}, whose curriculum it shares

manager.standsAlone.text: e ikemetse, e na le kharikhulamo ya yona
manager.standsAlone.from: standing on its own, with its own curriculum

manager.criterionWhat.text: Seo moithuti a lokelang ho se bontsha

manager.noneFromParent.text: Ha ho di-module tse kgethilweng kharikhulamong ya motswadi ho fihlela jwale.
manager.noneFromParent.from: No modules chosen from the parent's curriculum yet.

manager.noModules.text: Ha ho di-module tsa kharikhulamo ho fihlela jwale.

manager.choose.text: Kgetha hore na ke di-module dife tsa motswadi tseo sena se di nkang
manager.choose.from: Choose which of the parent's modules this takes

manager.chooseNote.text: Di-module ha di ekelwe mona. Sena se nka kharikhulamo ya motswadi wa sona, ka hoo mosebetsi wa moithuti khahlanong le module o balwa hang moo a kopanang le yona kae kapa kae.
manager.chooseNote.from: Modules are not added here. This draws from its parent's curriculum, so a learner's work against a module counts once wherever they met it.

manager.componentModule.practical.text: Module ya bokgoni ba ho sebetsa

manager.whichNote.text: Tokomane ya SAQA e bolela hore ke efe. Batla {field} leqepheng la yona la pele.
manager.whichNote.from: The SAQA document says which. Look for {field} on its first page.

manager.standsOnOwn.from: Nothing: it stands on its own

manager.fullOwn.text: Kwalifikeishene e felletseng e na le kharikhulamo ya yona.
manager.fullOwn.from: A full qualification carries its own curriculum.

manager.sharesNote.text: E abelana kharikhulamo ya kwalifikeishene eo mme e nka karolo ya di-module tsa yona; o kgetha tse ling ha e se e ntse e le teng.
manager.sharesNote.from: It shares that qualification's curriculum and takes a subset of its modules; you choose which, once it exists.

manager.codeFull.text: Jwalo ka ha e ngotswe tokomaneng ya kharikhulamo. Ha e ke e balwe: ke QCTO kapa OFO feela ba ka reng ke eng.
manager.codeFull.from: As written on the curriculum document. Never worked out: only the QCTO or the OFO can say what it is.

manager.codePart.text: Khoutu e tshwanang le ya kwalifikeishene eo e tswang ho yona. Di abelana kharikhulamo e le nngwe, ka hoo di abelana khoutu ya yona.
manager.codePart.from: The same code as the qualification it comes from. They share one curriculum, so they share its code.

manager.accreditationNote.text: Nomoro eo kwalifikeishene ena e akhreditilweng ka yona. Lengolo le le leng la akhrediteishene le atisa ho akaretsa dikwalifikeishene tse ngata, ka hoo sena ha se dula se tshwana le nomoro ya mofani wa tshebeletso. Se siye se se na letho mme ditlaleho di sebedisa ya mofani wa tshebeletso mme di re jwalo.
manager.accreditationNote.from: The number this qualification is accredited under. One accreditation letter usually covers several qualifications, so this is not always the same as the provider's own number. Leave it blank and reports fall back to the provider's and say so.

fromDoc.source.curriculum.note.text: Di-module, dihlooho le dikriteria tsa tlhahlobo ya ka hare.
fromDoc.source.curriculum.note.from: The modules, topics and internal assessment criteria.

fromDoc.source.qualification.note.text: Sengwa sa ngodiso ya SAQA. Ke mohloli o le mong wa ID ya SAQA le Diphetho tsa Boemo ba ho Tswa.
fromDoc.source.qualification.note.from: The SAQA registration extract. The only source of the SAQA ID and the Exit Level Outcomes.

fromDoc.source.assessmentSpecification.n.text: Tlhaloso ya EISA. E bolokilwe le ho kenngwa lenaneong hore e ka batlwa.
fromDoc.source.assessmentSpecification.n.from: The EISA specification. Filed and indexed so it is searchable.

fromDoc.open.text: E hahe ho tswa ditokomaneng tsa yona

fromDoc.intro.text: Tse tharo tsena ke motheo oo tsohle tse ding di hahilweng hodima wona. Di kenye mme sethala se bala dintlha tsa kwalifikeishene, Diphetho tsa yona tsa Boemo ba ho Tswa le kharikhulamo yohle ho tsona. Hlahloja seo se se fumaneng, o lokise se fositsweng, mme se ngolwa hang.
fromDoc.intro.from: These three are the foundation everything else is built on. Upload them and the App reads the qualification's details, its Exit Level Outcomes and its whole curriculum out of them. Check what it found, correct anything it got wrong, and it is written in one go.

fromDoc.pressThis.text: Jwale tobetsa sena. Ha ho letho le so ngolwe.
fromDoc.pressThis.from: Now press this. Nothing is written yet.

fromDoc.stillReading.text: Ho ntse ho baleha: disekonto tse {seconds}. Tokomane ya kharikhulamo e telele; sena ke ntho e tlwaelehileng.
fromDoc.stillReading.from: Still reading: {seconds} seconds. A curriculum document is long; this is normal.

fromDoc.found.text: Ho baletswe di-module tse {modules}, dihlooho tse {topics}, mela e {elements} ya ho ruta le dikriteria tsa tlhahlobo tse {criteria}.
fromDoc.found.from: Read {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} assessment criteria.

fromDoc.foundWithElo.text: Ho baletswe di-module tse {modules}, dihlooho tse {topics}, mela e {elements} ya ho ruta le dikriteria tsa tlhahlobo tse {criteria}, hammoho le Diphetho tse {outcomes} tsa Boemo ba ho Tswa tse nang le dikriteria tse {associated} tse amanang le tsona.
fromDoc.foundWithElo.from: Read {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} assessment criteria, plus {outcomes} Exit Level Outcomes with {associated} associated criteria.

fromDoc.partOf.text: Tokomane ya yona e re ena ke {kind} e nkilweng ho {parent}. Ha ho letho le tla kopolwa: e abelana kharikhulamo ya kwalifikeishene eo, mme e nka di-module tse {count} tsa yona.
fromDoc.partOf.from: Its document says this is a {kind} drawn from {parent}. Nothing will be copied: it shares that qualification's curriculum, and takes {count} of its modules.

fromDoc.already.text: {title} e se e le teng mona.

fromDoc.alreadyWhy.text: Ho kenya kharikhulamo hape ho ne ho nkela e nang le yona sebaka, mme ntho efe kapa efe e tshwauweng ho kriteria e ne e tlohela le yona. Seo o se batlang ke ho eketsa se haellang (thepa, kapa dikarolo tsa kharikhulamo tse sa kang tsa kena), seo se etswang kwalifikeishene ka boyona mme se siya tsohle tse seng di le teng di sa fetohe.
fromDoc.alreadyWhy.from: Importing the curriculum again would replace the one it has, and anything tagged to a criterion would go with it. What you probably want is to add what is missing (the material, or the parts of the curriculum that never made it), which is done on the qualification itself and leaves everything already there untouched.

fromDoc.openIt.text: E bule, mme o eketse se haellang
fromDoc.openIt.from: Open it, and add what is missing

fromDoc.noQualDoc.text: (ha ho tokomane ya kwalifikeishene e fanweng)

fromDoc.outcomes.text: Diphetho tse {count} tsa Boemo ba ho Tswa

fromDoc.toCheck.text: Dintho tse {count} tse lokelang ho hlahlojwa

fromDoc.createPart.text: E thehe, e nka kharikhulamo ya motswadi
fromDoc.createPart.from: Create it, drawing on its parent's curriculum

fromDoc.filedPart.text: Tokomane ya yona ya Kwalifikeishene e bolokilwe khahlanong le yona. Tokomane ya kharikhulamo le tlhaloso ya tlhahlobo ha di a bolokwa: ke tsa kwalifikeishene eo e tswang ho yona, mme di se di bolokilwe moo.
fromDoc.filedPart.from: Its own Qualification Document is filed against it. The curriculum document and the assessment specification are not: they belong to the qualification it comes from, and are already filed there.

fromDoc.filed.text: Tokomane ka nngwe eo o e file e bolokilwe khahlanong le kwalifikeishene, hore mohlahlobisisi a ka bula mohloli wa kriteria efe kapa efe, le hore monyako wa boitokiso o kgotsofale pele thepa e ngolwa.
fromDoc.filed.from: Every document you supplied is filed against the qualification, so a moderator can open the source of any criterion, and so the readiness gate is satisfied before material is authored.

docKind.workbook_memorandum.text: Memorandamo ya ho tshwaya buka ya mosebetsi

docKind.summative_memorandum.text: Memorandamo ya ho tshwaya tlhahlobo ya qetello

docKind.learning_programme_guide.text: Tataiso ya lenaneo la ho ithuta

docKind.rollout_schedule.text: Lenane la nako la ho tsamaisa

qualPage.componentModule.practical.text: Module ya bokgoni ba ho sebetsa

qualPage.step.curriculumDone.text: Di-module tse {modules}, dikriteria tsa tlhahlobo tse {criteria}, di baletswe ditokomaneng tsa kwalifikeishene ka boyona.
qualPage.step.curriculumDone.from: {modules} modules, {criteria} assessment criteria, read from the qualification's own documents.

qualPage.step.curriculumTodo.text: Ha ho letho mona le ka rutwang kapa la hlahlojwa ho fihlela di-module tsa yona di le teng.
qualPage.step.curriculumTodo.from: Nothing here can be taught or assessed until its modules exist.

qualPage.step.unitsDone.text: Dikarolo tse {count}, mme module ka nngwe e behilwe karolong e le nngwe.
qualPage.step.unitsDone.from: {count} units, with every module placed in one.

qualPage.step.unitsNone.text: Kharikhulamo e phatlalatsa di-module mme ha e re letho ka hore o di bokella jwang, ka hoo ke qeto ya hao. Tokomane ya hao ya tshwantshanyo e e etsa ka ho kenya hang: Word kapa Excel.
qualPage.step.unitsNone.from: The curriculum publishes modules and says nothing about how you group them, so this is yours to decide. Your alignment document does it in one upload: Word or Excel.

qualPage.step.unitsSomeOne.text: Module e le 1 ha e so be karolong efe ya ho ithuta. Module eo karolo e nngwe ya ho ithuta e sa e fanang ke module eo ho se motho ya e rutang.
qualPage.step.unitsSomeOne.from: 1 module belongs to no unit yet. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches.

qualPage.step.unitsSome.text: Di-module tse {count} ha di so be karolong efe ya ho ithuta. Module eo karolo e nngwe ya ho ithuta e sa e fanang ke module eo ho se motho ya e rutang.
qualPage.step.unitsSome.from: {count} modules belong to no unit yet. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches.

qualPage.step.materialDone.text: Ditataiso tsa thiori tse {count}, dibuka tsa mosebetsi le ditlhahlobo di bolokilwe.
qualPage.step.materialDone.from: {count} theory guides, workbooks and assessments filed.

qualPage.step.materialTodo.text: Ditataiso tsa thiori, dibuka tsa mosebetsi le ditlhahlobo. Foldara yohle e kena hang, ditataiso tsa dikarabo di a tsejwa mme di thibelwa baithuti, mme ha ho AI e sebediswang nako epe.
qualPage.step.materialTodo.from: The theory guides, workbooks and assessments. The whole folder goes in at once, answer guides are recognised and withheld from learners, and no AI is involved at any point.

qualPage.step.captureDone.text: Tsohle tse {count} di hapilwe. Baithuti ba ka di araba skrineng.
qualPage.step.captureDone.from: All {count} captured. Learners can answer them on screen.

qualPage.step.captureTodo.text: {captured} ho {total} di hapilwe. Tse ding ke difaele tseo moithuti a ka di jarollang feela.
qualPage.step.captureTodo.from: {captured} of {total} captured. The rest are files a learner can only download.

qualPage.summary.text: Di-module tse {modules} · dikriteria tsa tlhahlobo ya ka hare tse {criteria} · {weighting}

qualPage.weighted.text: e lekanyeditswe {k}/{p}/{w} jwalo ka ha e boletswe tokomaneng
qualPage.weighted.from: weighted {k}/{p}/{w} as stated in the document

qualPage.notWeighted.text: ha ho tekanyo ya dikarolo e boletsweng; boitokiso bo e tswa dikeredising
qualPage.notWeighted.from: no component weighting stated; readiness derives it from credits

qualPage.partOf.text: Karolo ya kwalifikeishene e nkilweng ho {parent}, e abelanang kharikhulamo le yona. Ha ho letho le kopolwang, ka hoo mosebetsi wa moithuti khahlanong le module o balwa hang moo a kopanang le yona kae kapa kae.
qualPage.partOf.from: A part qualification drawn from {parent}, whose curriculum it shares. Nothing is copied, so a learner's work against a module counts once wherever they met it.

qualPage.chooseModules.text: Kgetha hore na ke di-module dife tseo sena se di nkang

qualPage.addIntro.text: Tsohle tse kenyang ntho. Seo se seng se le teng mona se thebeng e nngwe.
qualPage.addIntro.from: Everything that puts something in. What is already here is on the other tab.

qualPage.finish.text: Qeta kwalifikeishene ena ka foldara e felletseng
qualPage.finish.from: Finish this qualification from a fuller folder

qualPage.finishLabel.text: Foldara e phethetsweng ya kwalifikeishene ena, ho tswa komporong ya hao
qualPage.finishLabel.from: The completed folder for this qualification, from your own computer

qualPage.finishHint.text: Bakeng sa kwalifikeishene e kentsweng pele ditokomane tsa yona di phethega. Foldara yohle e baleha hape (kharikhulamo le thepa) mme ho eketswa feela se haellang.
qualPage.finishHint.from: For a qualification that was loaded before its documents were complete. The whole folder is read again (the curriculum as well as the material) and only what is missing is added.

qualPage.finishHint2.text: Ha ho letho le seng le le teng le fetolwang kapa le nkelwang sebaka, esita le mantswe a kriteria e le nngwe, mme ho e tsamaisa habedi ha ho etse letho lekgetlong la bobedi. O ntse o bona tsohle tseo e di fumaneng mme o di netefatse pele ho ngolwa letho la tsona.
qualPage.finishHint2.from: Nothing already here is changed or replaced, down to the wording of a single criterion, and running it twice does nothing the second time. You still see everything it found and confirm it before any of it is written.

qualPage.finishDrive.text: Kapa foldara e phethetsweng ho tswa drive eo o e hokelletseng. E eketsa ka mokgwa o tshwanang: ho eketswa feela se haellang.
qualPage.finishDrive.from: Or the completed folder from a drive you have connected. It tops up the same way: only what is missing is added.

qualPage.materialHere.text: Thepa e ya mona: foldara yohle hang. Ha ho letho le bolokwang ho fihlela o bone seo e se fumaneng.
qualPage.materialHere.from: The material goes here: the whole folder at once. Nothing is saved until you have seen what it found.

qualPage.materialLabel.text: Foldara ya thepa, ho tswa komporong ya hao
qualPage.materialLabel.from: A folder of material, from your own computer

qualPage.materialHint.text: Ditataiso tsa thiori le dibuka tsa mosebetsi di ya karolong ya ho ithuta eo lebitso la faele ya tsona le e bolelang, dipholisi le dikonteraka di ya laeboraring ya ditokomane, mme tsohle tse ding di ya khahlanong le kwalifikeishene ena. Ha ho AI e sebediswang mona ho hang: ho hlopha ditokomane ka lebitso ke molao, eseng qeto.
