qualPage.materialHint.from: Theory guides and workbooks go to the study unit their filename names, policies and contracts to the document library, and everything else against this qualification. No AI is used here at all: sorting documents by name is a rule rather than a judgement.

qualPage.whereItLives.text: Kapa foldara moo e leng teng
qualPage.whereItLives.from: Or the folder where it already lives

qualPage.alignmentHere.text: Tokomane ya hao ya tshwantshanyo e ya mona: e kgethe, o beha mofuta wa yona e le Matrikse ya Tshwantshanyo ya Kharikhulamo, mme o e kenye. Seo se haha dikarolo tsa ho ithuta.
qualPage.alignmentHere.from: Your alignment document goes here: choose it, set its kind to Curriculum Alignment Matrix, and upload. That builds the study units.

qualPage.blueprintIntro.text: Faele e hlalosang kharikhulamo ena ka nepo: di-module tse {count}, le dihlooho tsa tsona, seo e nngwe le e nngwe e se rutang le seo e hlahlojwang ka sona. E kenye foldareng ya {folder} ka hare ho foldara ya kwalifikeishene mme kenyo e nngwe le e nngwe ya foldara eo hamorao e e bala ka kotloloho, ka metsotso, ntle le keketso ya AI nako epe.
qualPage.blueprintIntro.from: A file describing this curriculum exactly: {count} modules, with their topics, what each teaches and what each is assessed by. Put it in the qualification folder's {folder} directory and every import of that folder afterwards reads it straight off, in seconds, with no AI extension involved at any point.

qualPage.notCarried.text: Seo faele e sa se nkeng
qualPage.notCarried.from: What the file does not carry

qualPage.notCaptured.text: Di-module tse {count} ho tse {total} ha di na dikriteria ho fihlela jwale.
qualPage.notCaptured.from: {count} of {total} modules have no criteria yet.

qualPage.notCapturedWhy.text: Ha ho motho ya ka phatlalatswang a loketse EISA khahlanong le kwalifikeishene ena ho fihlela tokomane yohle ya kharikhulamo e kopilwe; module e se nang dikriteria e ke ke ya hlolwa, ka hoo ho di siya di se na letho ho ne ho etsa hore moithuti e mong le e mong a bonahale a qetile.
qualPage.notCapturedWhy.from: Nobody can be declared ready for the EISA against this qualification until the whole curriculum document has been transcribed; a module with no criteria cannot be failed, so leaving them empty would make every learner look finished.

qualPage.structureIntro.text: Kharikhulamo e phatlalatsa di-module; mofani wa tshebeletso o ruta dikarolo tsa ho ithuta. E nngwe le e nngwe e bokella di-module tsa Tsebo, Bokgoni ba ho sebetsa le Phihlelo ya mosebetsi tse sebeletsang Sephetho se le seng sa Boemo ba ho Tswa, e leng seo Tlhahlobo ya Qetello e Kopaneng ya Kantle e behilweng khahlanong le sona. Bafani ba babedi ba tshebeletso ba ka bokella kwalifikeishene e le nngwe ka tsela e fapaneng mme ka bobedi ba nepahetse, ka hoo sena ke sebopeho sa mofani wa tshebeletso, eseng sa kharikhulamo.
qualPage.structureIntro.from: The curriculum publishes modules; a provider teaches study units. Each bundles the Knowledge, Practical and Work Experience modules that serve one Exit Level Outcome, which is what the External Integrated Summative Assessment is set against. Two providers may group the same qualification differently and both be correct, so this is the provider's structure rather than the curriculum's.

qualPage.seeAsLearner.from: See it as a learner will

qualPage.seeAsLearnerNote.text: e bontsha lenaneo lohle ka tatellano eo le tsamaiswang ka yona, mme se sa fumanweng ke moithuti se rehilwe. Ha ho letho le qalwang mme ha ho letho le rekotwang.
qualPage.seeAsLearnerNote.from: shows the whole programme in the order it is walked, with anything a learner would not find named. Nothing is started and nothing is recorded.

qualPage.nextStep.text: Mohato o latelang: bokella di-module tsena dikarolong tsa ho ithuta.
qualPage.nextStep.from: The next step: group these modules into study units.

qualPage.nextStepWhy.text: Kharikhulamo e phatlalatsa di-module mme ha e re letho ka dikarolo tsa ho ithuta, hobane ho di bokella ke qeto ya mofani wa tshebeletso, ka hoo kwalifikeishene e baletsweng ditokomaneng e fihla le di-module tsohle tse {count} tsa yona di se na sebaka. Seo se lebelletswe, eseng phoso ya kenyo.
qualPage.nextStepWhy.from: The curriculum publishes modules and says nothing about study units, because grouping them is the provider's own decision, so a qualification read from its documents arrives with all {count} of its modules unplaced. That is expected, not a fault in the import.

qualPage.nextStepHow.text: Kenya tokomane ya hao ya tshwantshanyo: e tshwantshanyang Sephetho ka seng sa Boemo ba ho Tswa le di-module tsa sona, ka Word kapa Excel. E theha dikarolo tsa ho ithuta, e di rea mabitso, mme e beha module e nngwe le e nngwe eo e e akaretsang.
qualPage.nextStepHow.from: Upload your alignment document: the one mapping each Exit Level Outcome to its modules, in Word or Excel. It creates the study units, names them, and places every module it covers.

qualPage.unplacedOne.text: Module e le 1 ha e karolong efe ya ho ithuta.
qualPage.unplacedOne.from: 1 module belongs to no study unit.

qualPage.unplaced.text: Di-module tse {count} ha di karolong efe ya ho ithuta.
qualPage.unplaced.from: {count} modules belong to no study unit.

qualPage.unplacedWhy.text: {modules}. Module eo karolo ya ho ithuta e sa e fanang ke module eo ho se motho ya e rutang, leha kharikhulamo ya yona e nkilwe ka botlalo.
qualPage.unplacedWhy.from: {modules}. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches, however completely its curriculum has been captured.

qualPage.noElo.from: Aligned to no Exit Level Outcome

qualPage.eisaTests.text: Dikriteria tsa tlhahlobo tse amanang: seo EISA e se lekang
qualPage.eisaTests.from: Associated assessment criteria: what the EISA tests

qualPage.noModules.text: Karolo ena ya ho ithuta ha e fane ka di-module.
qualPage.noModules.from: This study unit delivers no modules.

qualPage.unitMaterial.text: Thepa e bolokilweng khahlanong le karolo ena

qualPage.documentsIntro.text: Ka mona ke dikopi tsa semmuso: ditokomane tsa mohloli tseo kwalifikeishene ena e hahilweng ka tsona, e nngwe le e nngwe e hokahantswe le karolo ya kharikhulamo eo e e sebeletsang mme e nkilwe menwana hore ho ka pakwa hore ha e a fetoha.
qualPage.documentsIntro.from: Filed here are the authoritative copies: the source documents this qualification is built from, each attached to the part of the curriculum it serves and hashed so it can be proved unchanged.

qualPage.recordNotThing.text: Buka ya mosebetsi kapa tlhahlobo e bolokilweng mona ke rekoto, eseng seo moithuti a se sebetsang.
qualPage.recordNotThing.from: A workbook or an assessment filed here is a record, not the thing a learner works on.

qualPage.recordWhy.text: Tseo di baletswe mme di bontshwa skrineng, ka hoo moithuti a araba sethaleng mme motsamaisi wa thuto a tshwaya le ho fana ka maikutlo moo. Kenya tokomane ya Word tlasa Hapa ho e na le mona, mme e fetoha dipotso ka boyona. Dibukana, ditataiso le maqephe a tshaeno ya mosebetsing di fapane: di dula e le ditokomane, hobane motsamaisi wa thuto o di ngola dintlha mme motataisi a di saena ka pampiri.
qualPage.recordWhy.from: Those are read in and presented on screen, so a learner answers in the platform and a facilitator marks and comments there. Upload the Word document under Capture rather than here, and it becomes the questions themselves. Handbooks, guides and workplace sign-off sheets are different: they stay as documents, because a facilitator annotates them and a coach signs them on paper.

qualPage.noDocuments.text: Ha ho ditokomane tse bolokilweng ho fihlela jwale.

qualPage.notTranscribed.text: Ha ho so ngolwe ho tswa tokomaneng ya kharikhulamo.
qualPage.notTranscribed.from: Not yet transcribed from the curriculum document.

qualPage.iac.text: Dikriteria tsa tlhahlobo ya ka hare: seo se lokelang ho fihlelwa
qualPage.iac.from: Internal assessment criteria: what must be achieved

qualPage.workplaceNone.text: Ha ho dikriteria tsa tlhahlobo, e leng ntho e nepahetseng bakeng sa phihlelo ya mosebetsi: e paka ka rekoto e saennweng ya mosebetsi, eseng ka ho hlahlojwa khahlanong le dikriteria.
qualPage.workplaceNone.from: No assessment criteria, which is right for work experience: it is proved by a signed record of the work rather than judged against criteria.

qualPage.neverAchieved.text: Ha ho dikriteria tsa tlhahlobo, ka hoo sehlooho sena se ke ke sa fihlelwa.
qualPage.neverAchieved.from: No assessment criteria, so this topic can never be achieved.

removeQual.cannot.text: Kwalifikeishene ena e ke ke ya tlosoa

removeQual.cannotWhy.text: Ho na le dintho tse rekotilweng khahlanong le yona, mme sethala se di boloka. Ke tsona tseo tlhahlobo ya QCTO e di botsang, mme di phela ho fetisa kwalifikeishene eo di neng di rekotilwe tlasa yona.
removeQual.cannotWhy.from: Things have been recorded against it, and the platform keeps them. They are what a QCTO audit asks about, and they outlive the qualification they were recorded under.

removeQual.canWhy.text: Ha ho letho le rekotilweng khahlanong le yona (ha ho moithuti ya ngodisitsweng, ha ho kopano e ngodisitsweng mme ha ho Tlaleho ya Diphetho e ntshitsweng) ka hoo e ka tlosoa. Sena ha se ka fetolwa.
removeQual.canWhy.from: Nothing has been recorded against it (no learner is enrolled, no sitting is registered and no Statement of Results has been issued) so it can be removed. This cannot be undone.

removeQual.wouldTake.text: E ne e tla nka {items} hammoho le yona, le sehlooho ka seng, karolo, kriteria le tokomane e bolokilweng ka tlasa tsona.
removeQual.wouldTake.from: It would take {items} with it, along with every topic, element, criterion and filed document beneath them.

removeQual.remove.text: E tlose ka ho sa feleng

captureList.intro.text: Tsena di se di le sethaleng. Ho hapa e nngwe ho bala dipotso tsa yona faeleng ya Word mme ho tshwantshanya tataiso ya dikarabo e bolokilweng haufi le yona; ha ho letho le kenngwang hape. Seo e se etsang tlhahiso ke sona se bontshwang ho wena pele ho e nngwe ya tsona e fetoha tlhahlobo.
captureList.intro.from: These are already in the platform. Capturing one reads its questions out of the Word file and pairs the answer guide filed beside it; nothing is uploaded again. What it proposes is shown to you before any of it becomes an assessment.

captureList.all.text: Tsohle tse {count} di hapilwe. Baithuti ba ka di araba skrineng.
captureList.all.from: All {count} captured. Learners can answer these on screen.

captureList.noGuide.text: ha ho tataiso ya dikarabo e bolokilweng: potso ka nngwe e ne e tla hloka karabo ya yona le ditshwao ka letsoho
captureList.noGuide.from: no answer guide filed: every question would need its answer and marks by hand

uploader.kindNote.text: Matrikse ya tshwantshanyo ya kharikhulamo e balwa hape e bolokwe: seo e se reng ka mola o mong le o mong wa kharikhulamo se a rekotwa.
uploader.kindNote.from: A curriculum alignment matrix is read as well as stored: what it says about each curriculum line is recorded.

uploader.titleHint.text: Ha e siiwe e se na letho, lebitso la faele le a sebediswa
uploader.titleHint.from: Left blank, the file name is used

uploader.versionNote.text: Ho e kenya hape ka mofuta o tshwanang le sehlooho ho nka sebaka sa e fetileng ka ho e feta, eseng ho e nkela sebaka; e ya khale e dula.
uploader.versionNote.from: Uploading again with the same kind and title supersedes the previous one rather than replacing it; the old version stays.

uploader.fileNote.text: Word, Excel, PowerPoint le PDF. Seo faele e leng sona se tswa dikahareng tsa yona, eseng lebitsong la yona.
uploader.fileNote.from: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF. What the file actually is comes from its contents, not its name.

uploader.inMatrix.from: In the matrix, not in the curriculum as held

uploader.inMatrixNote.text: E nngwe le e nngwe e eketswa e tshwauwa e le ya hao, le lebaka le bontshwa, hore mohlahlobisisi a kgone ho bona mela ya hao le ya molaodi. Tlosa letshwao ho seo se sa lokelang ho eketswa.
uploader.inMatrixNote.from: Each is added marked as your own, with the reason shown, so a verifier can always tell your lines from the regulator's. Untick anything that should not be added.

uploader.add.from: Add the ticked lines to the curriculum

buildCurr.intro.text: E kenye jwalo ka ha tokomane ya kharikhulamo e e hatisa, ka dikhoutu tse tshwanang ka tatellano e tshwanang, hore tse pedi di ka baloa ka thoko ho e nngwe. Mola o mong le o mong o bolokwa ha o o kenya.
buildCurr.intro.from: Enter it as the curriculum document prints it, with the same codes in the same order, so the two can be read side by side. Every line saves as you enter it.

buildCurr.ready.text: E loketse thepa. Di-module tse {modules} le dikriteria tse {criteria} di kentswe, ka hoo potso e ka tshwauwa ho seo e se paka.
buildCurr.ready.from: Ready for material. {modules} modules and {criteria} criteria are in, so a question can be tagged to what it evidences.

buildCurr.whatItIs.text: Sena ke kwalifikeishene ya mofuta ofe

buildCurr.whatItIsNote.text: E behilwe ha e kenngwa, mme e ka lokiswa mona. Kwalifikeishene e felletseng e na le kharikhulamo ya yona; karolo kapa lenaneo la mahlale e kgetha di-module ho e nngwe.
buildCurr.whatItIsNote.from: Set when it was imported, and correctable here. A full qualification has its own curriculum; a part or a skills programme selects modules from one.

buildCurr.faultsNote.text: Ha se monyako: o ka tswa wa kgutla. Leha ho le jwalo, e nngwe le e nngwe ya tsena ke ntho eo sethala se ke keng sa e potologa hamorao.
buildCurr.faultsNote.from: Not a gate: you can leave and come back. Each of these, though, is something the platform cannot work around later.

addModule.note.text: Module ya phihlelo ya mosebetsi e paketswe ke bukana ya rekoto eo motataisi a e saenang, eseng ke dikriteria tsa tlhahlobo, ka hoo e nka mesebetsi ya mosebetsi.
addModule.note.from: A work experience module is evidenced by a logbook a coach signs, not by assessment criteria, so it takes work activities instead.

addModule.nameHint.text: Jwalo ka ha tokomane ya kharikhulamo e e reha
addModule.nameHint.from: As the curriculum document titles it

editor.rename.text: Reha module ena lebitso le leng

editor.removeTopic.text: Tlosa {code} le tsohle tse ka hare ho yona?

editor.addElement.text: Eketsa mola wa se lokelang ho rutwa
editor.addElement.from: Add a line of what must be taught

editor.wordedHint.text: Jwalo ka ha tokomane ya kharikhulamo e e bolela
editor.wordedHint.from: As the curriculum document words it

editor.noCriteria.text: Module ya phihlelo ya mosebetsi ha e na tse jwalo. E paketswe ke bukana ya rekoto eo motataisi a e saenang mme mohlahlobi a e amohelang, ka hoo mesebetsi ya yona e ya dihloohong tse ka hodimo.
editor.noCriteria.from: A work experience module carries none. It is evidenced by a logbook the coach signs and an assessor accepts, so its work activities go in the topics above.

editor.criterionText.text: Seo moithuti a lokelang ho se bontsha

reclassify.lockedOne.text: Se ke ke sa fetolwa: moithuti o le mong o ngodisitswe ho sona. Ngodiso e etswa ho ya ka ID ya lenaneo, mme ho fetola hore sena ke eng ho ka fetola di-module tseo a tla hlahlojwa ka tsona, kahoo le seo a lokelang ho se etsa ho qeta. Haeba e le nnete e le mofuta o fosahetseng, theha o nepahetseng mme o ngodise moithuti ho oona.
reclassify.lockedOne.from: It cannot be changed: 1 learner is enrolled on it. Enrolment is per programme ID, and changing what this is would change which modules they are assessed against, and so what they have to do to finish. If it is genuinely the wrong sort of thing, create the right one and enrol them onto that.

reclassify.locked.text: Se ke ke sa fetolwa: baithuti ba {count} ba ngodisitswe ho sona. Ngodiso e etswa ho ya ka ID ya lenaneo, mme ho fetola hore sena ke eng ho ka fetola di-module tseo ba tla hlahlojwa ka tsona, kahoo le seo ba lokelang ho se etsa ho qeta. Haeba e le nnete e le mofuta o fosahetseng, theha o nepahetseng mme o ngodise baithuti ho oona.
reclassify.locked.from: It cannot be changed: {count} learners are enrolled on it. Enrolment is per programme ID, and changing what this is would change which modules they are assessed against, and so what they have to do to finish. If it is genuinely the wrong sort of thing, create the right one and enrol them onto that.

reclassify.parentNote.text: Karolo ha e na tokomane ya kharikhulamo ya yona: e sebedisa ya motswadi wa yona, mme e kgetha di-module ho yona.
reclassify.parentNote.from: A part has no curriculum document of its own: it uses its parent's, and selects modules from it.

reclassify.ownModulesOne.text: Kwalifikeishene ena e na le module e le nngwe ya kharikhulamo ya yona, ho tloha ha e kenngwa. E dula moo e leng teng: ho e rekota e le karolo ha ho e hlakole, mme o kgetha ka thoko hore na ke di-module dife tsa motswadi tseo e di kgethang.
reclassify.ownModulesOne.from: This qualification has 1 module of its own curriculum, from when it was imported. It stays where it is: recording it as a part does not delete it, and you choose separately which of the parent's modules it selects.

reclassify.ownModules.text: Kwalifikeishene ena e na le di-module tse {count} tsa kharikhulamo ya yona, ho tloha ha e kenngwa. Tseo di dula moo di leng teng: ho e rekota e le karolo ha ho di hlakole, mme o kgetha ka thoko hore na ke di-module dife tsa motswadi tseo e di kgethang.
reclassify.ownModules.from: This qualification has {count} modules of its own curriculum, from when it was imported. Those stay where they are: recording it as a part does not delete them, and you choose separately which of the parent's modules it selects.

reclassify.selectedOne.text: Module e le nngwe e kgethilweng ho motswadi wa yona e tla hlakolwa. Kwalifikeishene e felletseng ha e kgethe letho ho motho ofe kapa ofe, mme ho e siya ho ne ho tla e boloka e balwa ho dikerediti tsa yona.
reclassify.selectedOne.from: The 1 module selected from its parent will be cleared. A full qualification selects nothing from anybody, and leaving it would keep it counting towards its credits.

reclassify.selected.text: Di-module tse {count} tse kgethilweng ho motswadi wa yona di tla hlakolwa. Kwalifikeishene e felletseng ha e kgethe letho ho motho ofe kapa ofe, mme ho di siya ho ne ho tla di boloka di balwa ho dikerediti tsa yona.
reclassify.selected.from: The {count} modules selected from its parent will be cleared. A full qualification selects nothing from anybody, and leaving them would keep them counting towards its credits.

takeDoc.readFrom.text: E baliwe ho {file}. Ha ho letho le ka tlase le so eketswe: bula module, e bapise le tokomane, mme o e nke haeba e nepahetse.
takeDoc.readFrom.from: Read from {file}. Nothing below has been added yet: open a module, check it against the document, and take it if it is right.

takeDoc.nothingRead.text: Ha ho letho le so baluwe.

takeDoc.goToDocuments.text: Ya ho ditokomane tsa kwalifikeishene ena
takeDoc.goToDocuments.from: Go to the documents for this qualification

takeDoc.notesNote.from: What the reading could not account for, and what the document itself does not add up. Neither stops you taking a module, though both are worth reading first.

takeDoc.addedCounts.from: Added {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} criteria.

takeDoc.empty.from: Nothing was read under this module. Taking it will create the module alone, and its topics can be added by hand.

element.asWorded.text: {kind}, jwalo ka ha tokomane ya kharikhulamo e e bolela. Ha ho letho leqepheng lena le ka fetolwang mona: kharikhulamo e phatlaladitsweng ke ya QCTO, eseng ya mofani wa tshebeletso.
element.asWorded.from: {kind}, exactly as the curriculum document words it. Nothing on this page may be edited here: a published curriculum is the QCTO's, not the provider's.

element.coversNote.text: Ho tswa Matrikseng ya Tshwantshanyo ya Kharikhulamo, jwalo ka ha mofani wa tshebeletso a e ngotse teng.
element.coversNote.from: From the Curriculum Alignment Matrix, as the provider wrote it there.

element.uncovered.text: Ha ho letho le rekotilweng le e akaretsang.
element.uncovered.from: Nothing is recorded as covering this line.

element.uncoveredNote.text: Sena ke sekgeo sa nnete lenaneong, kapa ke matrikse e so kenngwe. Kenya Matrikse ya Tshwantshanyo ya Kharikhulamo khahlanong le kwalifikeishene ena mme mela yohle eo e e umang e tlatswa hang.
element.uncoveredNote.from: That is either a real gap in the programme or a matrix that has not been uploaded yet. Upload the Curriculum Alignment Matrix against this qualification and every line it names is filled in at once.

element.notHeld.text: e boletswe ka matrikseng, empa ha ho tokomane e bolokilweng mona e nang le lebitso leo.
element.notHeld.from: named in the matrix, but no document held here has that name.

element.assessedNote.text: Dikriteria tsa tlhahlobo ya ka hare tsa sehlooho seo mola ona o leng ho sona.
element.assessedNote.from: The internal assessment criteria of the topic this line belongs to.

element.workplace.text: Module ya phihlelo ya mosebetsi ha e na dikriteria tsa tlhahlobo. Seo e se hlokang se paketswe ke rekoto e saennweng ya mosebetsi ka boyona, e amohelwang ke mohlahlobi, eseng ho ahlolwa khahlanong le dikriteria.
element.workplace.from: A work experience module has no assessment criteria. What it requires is evidenced by a signed record of the work itself, accepted by an assessor, rather than judged against criteria.

element.noCriteria.text: Sehlooho sena ha se na dikriteria tsa tlhahlobo, ka hoo ha ho letho mona le ka fihlellwang. Ho fihlela di kenngwa ho tswa tokomaneng ya kharikhulamo, ha ho moithuti ya ka phethang module ena.
element.noCriteria.from: This topic has no assessment criteria, so nothing here can ever be achieved. Until they are captured from the curriculum document, no learner can complete this module.

element.taughtNote.text: Dikarolo tsa ho ithuta tseo module ena e fanwang ho tsona.
element.taughtNote.from: The study units this module is delivered in.

partModules.title.text: Di-module tseo sena se di nkang

partModules.introPart.text: Kwalifikeishene ena ya karolo e nkilwe ho {parent} mme e arolelana kharikhulamo ya yona{code}. Tshwaya di-module tseo tokomane ya yona ya SAQA e di thathang tlasa {rules}. Ha ho letho le kopilweng: mosebetsi wa moithuti khahlanong le module o balwa hang feela, le hoja a kopane le yona hokae.
partModules.introPart.from: This part qualification is drawn from {parent} and shares its curriculum{code}. Tick the modules its own SAQA document lists under {rules}. Nothing is copied: a learner's work against a module counts once, wherever they met it.

partModules.introOther.text: Lenaneo lena le nkilwe ho {parent} mme le arolelana kharikhulamo ya lona{code}. Tshwaya di-module tseo tokomane ya lona ya SAQA e di thathang tlasa {rules}. Ha ho letho le kopilweng: mosebetsi wa moithuti khahlanong le module o balwa hang feela, le hoja a kopane le yona hokae.
partModules.introOther.from: This programme is drawn from {parent} and shares its curriculum{code}. Tick the modules its own SAQA document lists under {rules}. Nothing is copied: a learner's work against a module counts once, wherever they met it.

partModules.notRead.text: Kharikhulamo ya motswadi ha e so baluwe
partModules.notRead.from: The parent's curriculum has not been read in yet

partModules.notReadNote.text: Ha ho letho la ho kgetha ho fihlela {parent} e na le tokomane ya yona ya kharikhulamo e baluweng. Etsa seo pele, mme lenane lena le ya ipatlatsa.
partModules.notReadNote.from: There is nothing to choose from until {parent} has its curriculum document read in. Do that first, and this list fills itself.

partModules.noClaim.text: Ha ho palo kaofela ya dikerediti e rekotilweng bakeng sa kwalifikeishene ena, ka hoo ha ho letho la ho e bapisa le lona. Tokomane ya yona ya SAQA e bolela e le nngwe tlasa Bonyane ba Dikerediti.
partModules.noClaim.from: No credit total is recorded for this qualification, so there is nothing to check against. Its SAQA document states one under Minimum Credits.

partModules.agree.text: Tsena di a lekana, e leng letshwao la hore di-module tse nepahetseng di tshwauwe.
partModules.agree.from: These agree, which is the sign the right modules are ticked.

partModules.disagree.text: Tsena ha di lekane. Ekaba module e tshwauwe eo tokomane ya SAQA e sa e thathang, kapa e nngwe eo e e thathang e haellwa, kapa dikerediti tsa module di baluwe ka phoso. Ho lokela ho hlahlojwa pele o boloka; sethala se ntse se tla boloka seo o se bolelang.
partModules.disagree.from: These do not agree. Either a module is ticked that the SAQA document does not list, or one it lists is missing, or the credits on a module were read in wrongly. Worth checking before saving; the platform will still save what you tell it.

partModules.save.text: Boloka hore na ke di-module dife tseo sena se di nkang

qualPreview.title.text: Jwalo ka ha moithuti a tla e bona
qualPreview.title.from: As a learner will see it

qualPreview.intro.text: {programme} yohle ka tatellano eo motho ya ngodisitsweng ho yona a e tsamayang ka yona. Ha ho letho mona le qalang letho: ha ho ngodiso e etswang, ha ho boiteko bo butswang mme ha ho tswelopele e rekotwang, ka hoo sena se ka balwa hangata kamoo o ratang.
qualPreview.intro.from: The whole {programme} in the order somebody enrolled on it walks it. Nothing here starts anything: no enrolment is made, no attempt is opened and no progress is recorded, so this can be read as often as you like.

qualPreview.unitsOne.text: Karolo e le nngwe ya ho ithuta

qualPreview.gaps.text: Seo moithuti a ke keng a se fumana
qualPreview.gaps.from: What a learner would not find

qualPreview.allReadyNote.text: Mohato o mong le o mong karolong ka nngwe ya ho ithuta o na le ntho e o tshehetsang. Moithuti ya ngodisitsweng ho {programme} ena kajeno o ne a tla fumana yohle.
qualPreview.allReadyNote.from: Every step in every study unit has something behind it. A learner enrolled on this {programme} today would find the whole of it.

qualPreview.build.text: Haha seo moithuti a se sebetsang
qualPreview.build.from: Build what a learner works through

qualPreview.open.text: E bule jwalo ka ha moithuti a e bona
qualPreview.open.from: Open it as a learner sees it

qualPreview.change.text: Fetola tatellano kapa seo e nang le sona
qualPreview.change.from: Change the order or what is on it

qualPreview.start.text: Qala ho haha karolo ena ya ho ithuta

courseList.noneAuthor.text: Kosi ke seo moithuti a se sebetsang ka nnete. E kgomaretse karolo ya ho ithuta kapa module ya kharikhulamo, ka hoo ho loketse ho jara kwalifikeishene pele.
courseList.noneAuthor.from: A course is what a learner actually works through. It hangs off a study unit or a curriculum module, so a qualification is worth loading first.

courseList.noneReader.text: Ha ho letho le so phatlaladitswe bakeng sa hao. Ha le phatlaladitswe, seo o ngodisitsweng ho sona se tla ba mona.
courseList.noneReader.from: Nothing has been published for you yet. When it has been, what you are enrolled on will be here.

newCourse.noModule.text: Ha se karolo ya kwalifikeishene e nang le akhrediteishene
newCourse.noModule.from: Not part of an accredited qualification

newCourse.moduleNote.text: E kopanye le module ya kharikhulamo mme sistimi e tla hlahloba, pele e ka phatlalatswa, hore kriteria ka nngwe ya tlhahlobo ya module eo e na le thuto e e tshehetsang.
newCourse.moduleNote.from: Bind it to a curriculum module and the system will check, before it can be published, that every assessment criterion in that module has a lesson behind it.

courseEdit.published.text: Sena se phatlaladitswe, ka hoo dikahare tsa sona di tsitsitswe. Baithuti ba se phethileng ba na le direkoto tse supang phetolelo ena ka ho tobileng.
courseEdit.published.from: This is published, so its content is fixed. Learners who completed it have records that refer to exactly this version.

courseEdit.publishedAuthor.text: Ho se fetola, bula phetolelo e ntjha; e phatlaladitsweng e dula jwalo ka ha e le.
courseEdit.publishedAuthor.from: To change it, open a new version; the published one stays as it is.

courseEdit.folderNote.text: Kgetha foldara eo thepa ena e leng ho yona, mme tsohle tse ho yona, ho kenyeletswa le difoldara tse ka tlase, di baliwa, di bolokwa mme di etswa index. O bona seo e tla se boloka pele ho ngolwa letho.
courseEdit.folderNote.from: Choose the folder this material lives in and everything in it, including its subfolders, is read, filed and indexed. You see what it would file before anything is written.

courseEdit.folderLabel.text: Foldara ya yona, ho tswa komporong ya hao
courseEdit.folderLabel.from: Its folder, from your own computer

courseEdit.folderHint.text: Ditataiso, dibuka tsa mosebetsi, dipholisi le ditemplete di bolokwa khahlanong le yona mme mongolo wa tsona o etswa index e le hore di ka batlwa.
courseEdit.folderHint.from: Guides, workbooks, policies and templates are filed against it and their text indexed so they can be searched.

courseEdit.folderHint2.text: Sebopeho ha se thehwe mona: sebopeho sa yona se hahelwa mohlophisong o ka hodimo kapa ho tswa ho di-module tsa kwalifikeishene. Sena se boloka seo e nang le sona.
courseEdit.folderHint2.from: Structure is not created from here: its own shape is built in the editor above or from a qualification's modules. This files what it holds.

courseEdit.drive.text: Kapa ho tswa ho drive eo o e hokelletseng
courseEdit.drive.from: Or from a drive you have connected

courseEdit.driveNote.text: Foldara e le nngwe, e baliwa moo e seng e le teng. E fela sebakeng se le seng: tlhahiso eo o lokelang ho e hlahloba pele ho ngolwa letho.
courseEdit.driveNote.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

courseEdit.noSections.text: Ha ho dikgaolo hajwale. E hahilwe ka dikgaolo, mme kgaolo ka nngwe e na le dithuto.
courseEdit.noSections.from: No sections yet. It is built from sections, and each section holds lessons.

courseEdit.noLessons.text: Ha ho dithuto kgaolong ena hajwale.
courseEdit.noLessons.from: No lessons in this section yet.

courseEdit.lessonCovers.text: Dikriteria tsa tlhahlobo tseo thuto ena e di akaretsang

courseEdit.competenciesNote.text: Seo ho se phethela ho se bontshang. E ke ke ya phatlalatswa ntle le bokgoni, hobane ho phethwa ha yona ho ne ho ke ke ha begwa e le bokgoni.
courseEdit.competenciesNote.from: What completing it demonstrates. It cannot be published with no competency, because its completions could not be reported as capability.

courseEdit.noneTagged.text: Ha ho letho le tlamilweng ho fihlela jwale.

courseEdit.covered.text: ho dikriteria tse {count} tsa tlhahlobo di akaretswe

courseEdit.coveredAcross.text: ho dikriteria tse {count} tsa tlhahlobo di akaretswe ho di-module tsa {unit}
courseEdit.coveredAcross.from: of {count} assessment criteria covered across {unit}'s modules

courseEdit.coveredNote.text: E akaretswa ke thuto mona, potso ho e nngwe ya ditlhahlobo tsa yona e hokahantsweng le yona, kapa seo matrikse ya hao ya tshwantshanyo e reng e e hlahloba. Kenya matrikse ho kwalifikeishene ho rekota ya ho qetela.
courseEdit.coveredNote.from: Covered by a lesson here, a question on one of its assessments that is linked to it, or what your alignment matrix names as assessing it. Upload the matrix on the qualification to record the last.

courseEdit.nothingAssesses.text: Ha ho letho le e hlahlobang hajwale

courseEdit.noLessonCovers.text: Ha ho thuto e e akaretsang

courseEdit.unbound.text: Sena ha se a tlangwa le module ya kharikhulamo e nang le akhrediteishene, ka hoo ha ho dikriteria tsa tlhahlobo tse lokelang ho akaretswa.
courseEdit.unbound.from: This is not bound to an accredited curriculum module, so there are no assessment criteria to cover.

courseEdit.publishNote.text: Ho phatlalatsa ho hanilwe ha ho ntse ho e na le ntho e sa phethelwang ka hodimo.
courseEdit.publishNote.from: Publishing is refused while anything above is incomplete.

courseEdit.newVersionNote.text: Baithuti ba phethileng phetolelo ena ba boloka rekoto ya bona ya yona.
courseEdit.newVersionNote.from: Learners who completed this version keep their record of it.

spine.intro.text: Tatellano eo {course} ena e tsamayang ka yona, le seo se notlelang mohato o mong le o mong ho fihlela o o etellang pele o phethilwe. Tsohle mona di se di ntse di tshwerwe khahlanong le {course} ena: ho di kenya lenaneong ke seo se etsang hore moithuti a kopane le tsona.
spine.intro.from: The order this {course} is walked in, and what holds each step shut until the one before it is done. Everything here is already held against this {course}: putting it on the list is what makes a learner meet it.

spine.rule.competent.text: e ahlotswe e na le bokgoni

spine.empty.text: Ha ho letho ho yona hajwale, ka hoo moithuti ya ngodisitsweng ho yona a ne a tla e bula mme a fumane leqephe le se nang letho. Eketsa ntho ya pele ka tlase.
spine.empty.from: Nothing is on it yet, so a learner enrolled on it would open it and find an empty page. Add the first thing below.

spine.waitsForBefore.text: E emetse hore mohato o e etellang pele o be {rule}.
spine.waitsForBefore.from: Waits for the step before it to be {rule}.

spine.holdUntil.text: Boloka sena se notletswe ho fihlela

spine.nothingLeft.text: Tsohle tse tshwerweng khahlanong le yona di se di ntse di le lenaneong. Hapa buka ya mosebetsi kapa o bolokele tokomane khahlanong le yona, mme e tla hlaha mona.
spine.nothingLeft.from: Everything held against it is already on the list. Capture a workbook or file a document against it, and it will appear here.

spine.meets.text: Seo moithuti a kopanang le sona

spine.rename.text: E rehe lebitso le leng (ka boikgethelo)

spine.guidance.text: Mola o le mong wa moelelo (ka boikgethelo)

spine.openAtStart.text: E bulehile ho tloha qalong, eseng kamora mohato o e etellang pele
spine.openAtStart.from: Open from the start, rather than after the step before it

spine.beforeMustBe.text: Mohato o e etellang pele o tlameha ho ba

courseAssess.intro.text: Kwiz ya nts'etsopele e tshwauwa ka bo yona. Tlhahlobo ya qetello e lula e ahlolwa ke motho mme e lula e hlahlobisiswa ka ho ikemela, hobane ke yona e balwang ho kwalifikeishene.
courseAssess.intro.from: A formative quiz is marked automatically. A summative assessment is always judged by a person and always moderated independently, because it is the one that counts towards a qualification.

courseAssess.assesses.text: Seo potso ena e se hlahlobang

courseAssess.noCriterion.text: Ha e hokahanngwe le kriteria e nngwe

courseAssess.options.text: Dikgetho tsa karabo: tshwaya tsohle tse nepahetseng
courseAssess.options.from: Answer options: tick every one that is correct

courseAssess.allModerated.text: qeto e nngwe le e nngwe e a hlahlobisiswa

courseAssess.published.text: E phatlaladitswe. Moithuti o kopana le yona ha e se e le mohato ho {link}.
courseAssess.published.from: Published. A learner meets it once it is a step in {link}.

courseAssess.typeQuiz.text: Kwiz: e tshwauwa ka bo yona

courseAssess.formative.text: Ya nts'etsopele: boikwetliso, ha e baloe

courseAssess.summative.text: Ya qetello: e a balwa, e lula e hlahlobisiswa

courseAssess.sampleEvery.text: Qeto e nngwe le e nngwe

courseAssess.sampleNote.text: Ke boemo bo tlase, eseng bo hodimo. Boholo ba sehlopha bo bo phahamisa: sehlopha sa batho ba leshome kapa ba ka tlase se hlahlobisiswa ka botlalo, mme sa batho ba mashome a mabedi kapa ba ka tlase se hlahlobisiswa ka halofo, hobane karolo ya bone ya dipampiri tse robedi ke tse pedi, mme tse pedi ha di bolele letho ka kahlolo ya mohlahlobi. Palo ena e laola dihlopha tse fetang mashome a mabedi. Ha e elellwe bakeng sa tlhahlobo ya qetello, moo qeto e nngwe le e nngwe e hlahlobisiswang, mme mohlahlobi ya ngodisitsweng haufinyane o lula a hlahlobisiswa ka botlalo.
courseAssess.sampleNote.from: A floor, not a ceiling. Cohort size raises it: a cohort of ten or fewer is moderated in full and one of twenty or fewer at half, because a quarter of eight scripts is two, and two say almost nothing about an assessor's judgement. This figure governs cohorts above twenty. Ignored for a summative assessment, where every decision is moderated, and a newly registered assessor is always moderated in full.

courseEnrol.draft.text: Ena e ntse e le moralo. E tlameha ho phatlalatswa pele motho a ka abelwa yona: moralo ha o so feta ditlhahlobo tse netefatsang hore dikahare tsa wona di akaretsa seo di reng di se akaretsa.
courseEnrol.draft.from: This is still a draft. It has to be published before anyone can be assigned to it: a draft has not passed the checks that confirm its content covers what it claims to.

courseEnrol.waitingNote.text: Moithuti ka mong o hlaha hang, mohatong wa pele oo a sa kgoneng ho o bula. Ho tshwarelwa mohatong wa boraro ke nnete e lokelang ho sebetsoa; ho tshwarelwa le mehatong ya bone ho isa ho leshome ke lerata feela.
courseEnrol.waitingNote.from: Each learner appears once, at the earliest step they cannot open. Being held up at step three is the fact worth acting on; also being held up at steps four to ten is noise.

courseEnrol.nobody.text: Ha ho motho ya so ngodiswe.

courseEnrol.everyone.text: Bohle ba mokgatlo ba se ba ntse ba le ho yona.
courseEnrol.everyone.from: Everyone in the organisation is already on it.

courseEnrol.manyNote.text: Kgomaretsa diaterese tsa imeile, e nngwe mola o mong le o mong. Kholomo e kopilweng ka ho toba ho spreadsheet e a sebetsa.
courseEnrol.manyNote.from: Paste email addresses, one per line. A column copied straight out of a spreadsheet works.

settings.intro.text: Kamoo {name} e shebahalang ho batho ba hao, le kamoo App e balang ditokomane tseo ba di kenyang. Diphetoho di sebetsa hohle hang-hang: ha ho letho leo o lokelang ho le haha bocha kapa ho le romela hape.
settings.intro.from: How {name} looks to your people, and how the App reads the documents they upload. Changes apply everywhere immediately: there is nothing to rebuild or redeploy.

settings.section.terminology.text: Seo o rehang dintho ka sona

settings.section.filenames.text: Kamoo mabitso a difaele a baliwang kateng

settings.drive.connected.text: Ho hokahantswe. Foldara e ka baliwa ka kotloloho ho yona hajwale.
settings.drive.connected.from: Connected. A folder can now be read straight from it.

settings.drive.cancelled.text: Ha ho letho le hokahantsweng: tumello e hlakotswe.
settings.drive.cancelled.from: Nothing was connected: the consent was cancelled.

settings.drive.state.text: Tumello eo ha e a tshwana le eo sebadi sena se e qadileng, ka hoo ha ho letho le hokahantsweng. Qala hape ho tloha leqepheng lena.
settings.drive.state.from: That consent did not match the one this browser started, so nothing was connected. Start again from this page.

settings.drive.nocode.text: Mofani ha a a romela letho le ka hokahanwang le lona. Leka hape.
settings.drive.nocode.from: The provider sent nothing back to connect with. Try again.

settings.drive.failed.text: Khokahano e ne e sa kgone ho phethwa. Ha ho letho le bolokilweng. Ho leka hape ho lokela ho etswa pele ho tsohle.
settings.drive.failed.from: The connection could not be completed. Nothing was stored. Trying again is worth doing before anything else.

settings.mailNote.text: Hore na baithuti ba ka amohela dintlha tsa bona tsa ho kena le ditsebiso ka nnete. Ho lokela ho hlahlojwa kamora hore motho a fetole ditlhophiso tsa poso, mme ke ntho ya pele ya ho hlahloba ha motho a re imeile ha e a fihla.
settings.mailNote.from: Whether learners can actually receive their sign-in details and notifications. Worth checking after anybody changes the mail settings, and the first thing to check when somebody says an email never arrived.

settings.sso.text: Ho kena ka Google kapa Microsoft
settings.sso.from: Signing in with Google or Microsoft

settings.ssoNote.text: E dumella batho ba hao ho kena ka akhaonto ya mokgatlo wa bona ya Google kapa Microsoft ho e na le phasewete mona, e tswelang pele ho sebetsa haufi le yona. E kenya feela batho ba seng ba na le akhaonto sethaleng sena, ba tshwantshanngwang ka aterese ya imeile lekgetlong la pele; ha e ke e theha le e le nngwe.
settings.ssoNote.from: Lets your people sign in with their organisation's Google or Microsoft account instead of a password here, which keeps working beside it. It only signs in people who already have an account on this platform, matched by email address the first time; it never creates one.

settings.terminology.text: Seo o rehang dintho ka sona

settings.terminologyNote.text: Sebedisa mantswe a hao. Mofani ya ka ntle ho Afrika Borwa a ka be a sa re lenaneo, mme ya ka hare ho yona a ka be a sa re kosi; sethala ha se a lokela ho kgomarela.
settings.terminologyNote.from: Use your own vocabulary. A provider outside South Africa may not say programme, and a provider inside it may not say course; the platform should not insist.

settings.templatesNote.text: Kamoo tokomane ka nngwe eo mofani enwa a e ntshang e balwang le ho shebahala kateng.
settings.templatesNote.from: How each document this provider issues reads and looks.

settings.templatesMoved.text: hajwale di tlasa Tsamaiso, hammoho le tokomane ka nngwe eo sethala se e hlahisang le hore ke mang ya amohelang e nngwe le e nngwe.
settings.templatesMoved.from: now under Management, with every document the platform produces and who receives each one.

settings.menuNote.text: Hlophisa bara e ka hodimo: reha hlooho lebitso le leng, isa leqephe tlasa hlooho e nngwe, kapa o etse hore leqephe e be lehokela la kotloloho. Ho tshwana bakeng sa bohle ho mofani enwa, hobane basebetsi ba bolelelana moo dintho di leng teng.
settings.menuNote.from: Rearrange the bar at the top: rename a heading, move a page under a different one, or make a page a direct link. The same for everybody at this provider, because staff tell each other where things are.

settings.drivesNote.text: Bala foldara ka kotloloho ho tswa Google Drive kapa OneDrive, ho e na le ho e jarolla mme o e kenya hape. Ke tsa hao, eseng tsa mofani enwa: setho ka seng sa basebetsi se hokahanya sa sona.
settings.drivesNote.from: Read a folder straight from Google Drive or OneDrive, instead of downloading it and uploading it again. Yours rather than this provider's: every member of staff connects their own.

settings.extensionNote.text: Khahlanong le boemo ba hao. Ka boikgethelo, e tima ka tlwaelo, mme seo e o dumellang ho se etsa se lekanyeditswe ke mosebetsi wa hao jwalo ka tsohle tse ding.
settings.extensionNote.from: Against your own profile. Optional, off by default, and what it lets you do is bounded by your role exactly as everything else is.

providerLang.note.from: The language your people read the platform in, unless they choose their own under their name at the top of the page. Screens not yet translated stay in English, and your own names for things (Settings, Terminology) are kept as you wrote them in every language.

Small, upright, and friendlier than it is decorative. Leave it empty to use this platform's own, or nothing at all.

shape.intro.text: Dipotso tse pedi di etsa qeto ya sebopeho sa sethala sa hao le hore dikarolo tsa sona di rehiwa jwang. Tsohle tseo o sa di kgethang di a tlosoa: diskrine tsa tsona, dintho tsa menyu le diaterese tsa tsona.
shape.intro.from: Two questions decide the shape of your platform and what its parts are called. Everything you do not choose goes away: its screens, its menu entries and its addresses.

shape.nothingDeletedNote.text: Ho fetola sena ho pata dintho. Tsohle tse seng di rekotilwe di dula moo di leng teng, mme ho di kgetha hape ho kgutlisa diskrine le direkoto di sa senyeha.
shape.nothingDeletedNote.from: Changing this hides things. Whatever has already been recorded stays where it is, and choosing it again brings the screens back with the records intact.

shape.saved.text: Ho bolokilwe. Menyu le mantswe di fetohile ho tsamaisana.
shape.saved.from: Saved. The menu and the wording have changed to match.

shape.unavailable.text: Ha e fumanehe ka kgetho e ka hodimo. Karolo ya ho ithuta e ka hare ho kwalifikeishene, mme sethala sena ha se na e le nngwe.
shape.unavailable.from: Not available with the choice above. A study unit sits inside a qualification, and this platform has none.

shape.standalone.from: Three things that stand on their own

shape.statutoryCovers.text: Dintshetso tsa NLRD le Edu.Dex, ditlaleho tsa WSP le ATR tse romelwang, le rejisetara ya molao e ka morao ho tsona.
shape.statutoryCovers.from: NLRD and Edu.Dex exports, WSP and ATR returns, and the statutory register behind them.

shape.statutoryWhen.text: o ka ntle ho Afrika Borwa, kapa motho e mong o romela bakeng sa hao.
shape.statutoryWhen.from: you are outside South Africa, or somebody else files on your behalf.

shape.workplaceCovers.text: Dikamano tsa mosebetsi, ditataiso tsa batataisi, maqephe a tshaeno le dihora tseo moithuti a di rekotang khahlanong le mohiruwa ya amohelang.
shape.workplaceCovers.from: Workplace agreements, coach guides, sign off sheets and the hours a learner logs against a host employer.

shape.workplaceWhen.text: ha ho letho leo o le fanang le hlahlojwang mosebetsing.
shape.workplaceWhen.from: nothing you deliver is assessed in a workplace.

shape.offlineCovers.text: Baithuti ba kenya sethala mohalang wa bona, ba jarolla thepa ya bona ya ho ithuta pele ba tsamaya, ba e bala ntle le signale, mme ba rekota mosebetsi wa bona ho o romela ha ba na le signale hape.
shape.offlineCovers.from: Learners install the platform on their phone, download their study material before they go out, read it with no signal, and record their work to send back when they next have one.

shape.offlineWhen.text: baithuti ba qeta matsatsi ba le hole le signale, jwalo ka ha ba le naheng. Ditlhahlobo tsa qetello di dula di le inthaneteng ntle le ha lenaneo le hlophisitswe ka tsela e nngwe ka boomo.
shape.offlineWhen.from: learners spend days away from a signal, such as in the field. Summatives stay online unless a programme is deliberately set otherwise.

shape.award.qualification_programme.cove.text: Ntho e le nngwe. Moithuti o kenngwa kwalifikeishening mme seo ke seo a se sebetsang. Ha ho boemo bo arohaneng ba ho kopanya ka hodimo ha yona.
shape.award.qualification_programme.cove.from: One thing. A learner is put onto the qualification and that is what they work through. There is no separate bundling layer above it.

shape.award.qualification_programme.when.text: O fana ka kwalifikeishene e le nngwe ya mosebetsi jwalo ka lenaneo le le leng la ho ithuta.
shape.award.qualification_programme.when.from: You deliver one occupational qualification as one learning programme.

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: Kwalifikeishene le Lenaneo, ka thoko
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: Qualification and Programme, separately

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: Dintho tse pedi tse fapaneng. Kwalifikeishene e na le akhrediteishene le kharikhulamo; lenaneo le kopanya seo moithuti a se sebetsang, mme le ka arabela kwalifikeishene kapa le sa arabele le e le nngwe.
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: Two different things. A qualification holds the accreditation and the curriculum; a programme bundles what a learner works through, and may answer to a qualification or to none.

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: O tsamaisa dikwalifikeishene tse nang le akhrediteishene mme hape o kopanya seo o se fanang ka ditatellano tseo e seng kwalifikeishene e le nngwe ka nngwe.
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: You run accredited qualifications and also bundle deliverables into sequences that are not one qualification each.

shape.award.programmes_only.covers.text: Mananeo a kopanya seo moithuti a se sebetsang. Ha ho rekoto ya akhrediteishene, ha ho kharikhulamo, ha ho ditlaleho tsa diphetho.
shape.award.programmes_only.covers.from: Programmes bundle what a learner works through. No accreditation record, no curriculum, no statements of results.

shape.award.programmes_only.when.text: Ha ho letho leo o le fanang le arabelang kwalifikeishene e ngodisitsweng: ho tlwaetsa, dikoetliso tsa boikobelo tse phetwang, mananeo a ka hare a mahlale.
shape.award.programmes_only.when.from: Nothing you deliver answers to a registered qualification: induction, compliance refreshers, internal skills programmes.

shape.award.standalone.covers.text: Tsohle di ikemetse. Ha ho letho le di kopanyang mme ha ho letho le di ngodisang akhrediteishene.
shape.award.standalone.covers.from: Everything stands on its own. Nothing bundles it and nothing accredits it.

shape.award.standalone.when.text: Karolo ka nngwe ya koetliso eo o e tsamaisang e nkuwa ka boyona, e le nngwe ka nako.
shape.award.standalone.when.from: Every piece of training you run is taken on its own, one at a time.

shape.delivery.courses.covers.text: Kosi ke seo moithuti a se kenngwang ho sona mme a se sebetsang: dithuto tsa yona, dibuka tsa yona tsa mosebetsi, ditlhahlobo tsa yona. E ka ba tlasa lenaneo, mme ha e hloke ho arabela kwalifikeishene e nngwe.
shape.delivery.courses.covers.from: A course is what a learner is put onto and works through: its lessons, its workbooks, its assessments. It may sit under a programme, and it need answer to no qualification.

shape.delivery.courses.when.text: Batho ba hao ba re kosi, kapa o haha koetliso eo ha ho kwalifikeishene e e laolang.
shape.delivery.courses.when.from: Your people say course, or you build training that no qualification governs.

shape.delivery.study_units.covers.text: Karolo ya ho ithuta ke seo moithuti a se sebetsang, mme e nka sebaka sa kosi ka ho feletseng. E ka hare ho kwalifikeishene, e kopanya di-module tsa tsebo, tsa ho sebetsa le tsa mosebetsi tse sebeletsang sephetho se le seng sa boemo ba ho tswa.
shape.delivery.study_units.covers.from: A study unit is what a learner works through, and it replaces the course entirely. It sits inside a qualification, bundling the knowledge, practical and workplace modules that serve one exit level outcome.

shape.delivery.study_units.when.text: Batho ba hao ba re karolo ya ho ithuta ho e na le kosi. Kharikhulamo e phatlalatsa di-module mme e siya dihlopha ho wena, ka hoo sena ke sebopeho sa hao. E hloka kwalifikeishene ka hodimo.
shape.delivery.study_units.when.from: Your people say study unit rather than course. The curriculum publishes modules and leaves the grouping to you, so this is your own structure. Requires a qualification at the top.

shape.note.qualificationProgramme.text: Ntho e le nngwe. Moithuti o kenngwa kwalifikeishening, mme seo ke lenaneo leo a le sebetsang.
shape.note.qualificationProgramme.from: One thing. A learner is put onto the qualification, and that is the programme they work through.

shape.note.qualification.text: Rekoto ya akhrediteishene: kharikhulamo ya yona, dikriteria le diphetho tsa boemo ba ho tswa.
shape.note.qualification.from: The accreditation record: its curriculum, criteria and exit level outcomes.

shape.note.programmeWithQualification.text: Tatellano e hlophisitsweng, e ka arabelang kwalifikeishene kapa e sa arabele le e le nngwe.
shape.note.programmeWithQualification.from: An ordered sequence, which may answer to a qualification or to none.

shape.note.programmeOnly.text: Tatellano e hlophisitsweng, e sa arabeleng kwalifikeishene e ngodisitsweng.
shape.note.programmeOnly.from: An ordered sequence, answering to no registered qualification.

shape.note.bottom.text: Seo moithuti a se sebetsang. Ha ho letho le ka tlase ho yona.
shape.note.bottom.from: What a learner works through. There is nothing below it.

clock.note.text: Nako e nngwe le e nngwe e behilweng ho App e bolela oroloi ena. Thuto ya 18:30 ke 18:30 mona, mme nako ya ho kwala dikamohelo bakeng sa tlhahlobo e okametsweng e ahlolwa khahlanong le yona.
clock.note.from: Every timetabled time in the App means this clock. A lecture at 18:30 is 18:30 here, and an admission cut-off for an invigilated sitting is judged against it.

clock.both.text: Baithuti ba dinaheng tse ding ba bona ka bobedi: nako ya hao, e leng eo rekoto e e bolokang, le ya bona haufi le yona, e le hore ho se motho ya hlwekisang phapang mme a etse phoso. Dinako tse rekotilweng di lula e le tsa hao.
clock.both.from: Learners in other countries see both: your time, which is the one the record keeps, and their own alongside it, so nobody works out the difference themselves and gets it wrong. Recorded times are always yours.

mailTest.intro.text: E bula khokahano ho seva ya poso mme e kena, ho hlahloba hore na dintlha tsa ho kena tsa moithuti le ditsebiso di ka fihla ka nnete.

mailTest.unconfigured.from: No mail server is set up on this deployment yet, so this will report that rather than a fault with your account.

Ho reha e nngwe ya tsona lebitso le leng ho ne ho tla beha mantswe skrineng sa moithuti le tsebisong e romelwang eo molaodi a sa e tsebeng, ka hoo sethala se a boloka a tiile. Renaming one would put wording on a learner's screen and on a submission that the regulator does not recognise, so the platform keeps them fixed. You can read who defines what in the {link}.

menuEdit.note.text: Maqephe a ke ke a patwa mona. Seo motho ka mong a se bonang se se se ntse se etswa ke mosebetsi wa hae, mme tsela ya bobedi ya ho etsa hore ntho e se fihlellehe e ne e tla siya ha ho motho ya ka hlalosang hore ke hobane'ng leqephe le haellwa. Leqephe le kentsweng sethaleng hamorao le hlaha tlasa hlooho ya lona e tlwaelehileng, le se ke la nyamela hobane tlhophiso ena e pele ho lona.
menuEdit.note.from: Pages cannot be hidden here. What each person sees is already decided by their role, and a second way to make something unreachable would leave nobody able to say why a page is missing. A page added to the platform later appears under its usual heading rather than disappearing because this arrangement predates it.

drives.none.text: Ha ho polokelo ya difaele e behilweng ho kenngweng ha sethala tshebetsong ena. Ho bala foldara ka kotloloho ho tswa Google Drive kapa OneDrive ho hloka kopo e ngodisitsweng le bona ke ya tsamaisang sethala; ho fihlela ka nako eo, foldara e kgethwa ho tswa komporong ya hao, e sebetsang mme e se hloke letho.
drives.none.from: No file store is set up on this deployment. Reading a folder straight from Google Drive or OneDrive needs an application registered with them by whoever maintains the platform; until then, a folder is chosen from your own computer, which works and needs nothing.

drives.keepsNote.text: Token e tiisitsweng e ka balang, mme e bala feela, drive ya akhaonto eo o e hokahanyang, ho fihlela o e kgaola mona kapa o e hula ditlhophisong tsa akhaonto eo. E sebediswa ha o kopa hore foldara e baluwe mme ha ho nako e nngwe, ha e ke e bontshwa hape ho wena, mme ha e ke e ngolwa ho log. Ke ya hao, eseng ya mofani enwa: molekane o ke ke a bala difaele tsa hao ka yona, mme wena o ke ke wa bala tsa hae ka khokahano ya hae.
drives.keepsNote.from: A sealed token that can read, and only read, the drive of the account you connect, until you disconnect it here or withdraw it from that account's own settings. It is used when you ask for a folder to be read and at no other time, it is never shown back to you, and it is never written to a log. It is yours, not this provider's: a colleague cannot read your files through it, and you cannot read theirs through their connection.

ext.encrypted.text: E sirelleditswe ka encryption mme ha e ke e bontshwe hape, mona kapa kae kapa kae.
ext.encrypted.from: It is encrypted and is never shown again, here or anywhere else.

ext.chooseKey.from: Choose one of the API-key providers instead: those call the provider over the internet and work wherever the platform is installed.
