ext.keepsNote.text: {credential} ya hao, e sirelleditswe ka encryption, ho fihlela o e lahla. E sebediswa feela bakeng sa mosebetsi oo o o kopang, feela ha switjhi e bulehile, mme ha e ke e bontshwa hape ho wena kapa ya ngolwa ho log efe kapa efe. Ho fumaneha ha se ho bulehile: seboka se seng le se seng se qala e timile, o e bulela mosebetsi, mme ho tswa ho e tima bakeng sa hao haeba o lebala.
ext.keepsNote.from: Your {credential}, encrypted, until you discard it. It is used only for work you ask for, only while you have the switch on, and it is never shown back to you or written to any log. Available is not the same as on: every sitting starts with it off, you switch it on for a job, and signing out switches it off for you if you forget.

ext.keptUnused.text: Token ya hao e bolokilwe empa e ke ke ya sebediswa. Ha ho letho sethaleng le tla fana ka thuso ya AI ho fihlela o etsa hore e fumanehe hape.
ext.keptUnused.from: Your token is kept but cannot be used. Nothing in the platform will offer AI assistance until you make it available again.

ext.offNote.text: Ha sena se timile, sethala se itshwara ka mokgwa o tshwanang le ha se se na katoloso: dikgonahalo ha di yo, di se ke tsa fanwa mme tsa hloleha.
ext.offNote.from: With this off, the platform behaves exactly as it does without an extension: the affordances are absent rather than offered and failing.

ext.tokenFromNote.text: Karolo ena e etsahala komporong ya hao, e seng mona, e leng ntlha ya yona: subscription ya hao e dumelwa ke wena, mochining wa hao, mme ke token e e hlahisang feela e fihlang sethaleng sena.
ext.tokenFromNote.from: This part happens on your own computer, not here, which is the point: your subscription is authorised by you, on your machine, and only the token it produces ever reaches this platform.

ext.step1Rest.text: haeba o so etse jwalo: {link}. O hloka subscription ya hao ya Claude.
ext.step1Rest.from: if you have not already: {link}. You need a Claude subscription of your own.

ext.cmdNote.text: {plain} e tlwaelehileng ho PowerShell hangata e hloleha ka “running scripts is disabled on this system”. Ena ke tlwaelo ya Windows e seng ho hong ho fosahetseng ka ho kenya ha hao, mme foromo ya {cmd} e e qoba ntle le ho fetola boemo bofe kapa bofe ba tshireletso.
ext.cmdNote.from: Plain {plain} in PowerShell usually fails with “running scripts is disabled on this system”. That is a Windows default rather than anything wrong with your installation, and the {cmd} form avoids it without changing any security setting.

ext.step3.text: 3. Kena ha e bula sebadi sa hao
ext.step3.from: 3. Sign in when it opens your browser

ext.step3Rest.text: , ebe o kopa token eo e e kgatisang (e qala ka {prefix}) mme o e kgomaretse ka hodimo.
ext.step3Rest.from: , then copy the token it prints (it begins {prefix}) and paste it above.

ext.notApiKey.text: Ha se kii ya API mme ha ho turu ya token ka nngwe: e sebedisa subscription ya Claude eo o seng o e lefella. O se ke wa fa motho ofe kapa ofe phasewete ya hao ya Anthropic: sethala sena ha se na lebokose la yona mme ha se ka e amohela mona.
ext.notApiKey.from: It is not an API key and there is no per-token cost: it draws on the Claude subscription you already pay for. Never give anybody your Anthropic password: this platform has no field for one and would not accept it here.

ext.notSubscription.text: Subscription ha se kii ya API.
ext.notSubscription.from: A subscription is not an API key.

ext.geminiSeparate.text: Gemini Advanced le Gemini API ke dihlahisoa tse pedi tse arohaneng tse nang le bili e arohaneng. Ho lefella ya pele ha ho o fe ya bobedi, mme ha ho tsela ya ho etsa hore e be jwalo.
ext.geminiSeparate.from: Gemini Advanced and the Gemini API are separate products with separate billing. Paying for the first does not give you the second, and there is no way to make it.

ext.openaiSeparate.text: ChatGPT Plus le OpenAI API ke dihlahisoa tse pedi tse arohaneng tse nang le bili e arohaneng. Ho lefella ya pele ha ho o fe ya bobedi, mme ha ho tsela ya ho etsa hore e be jwalo.
ext.openaiSeparate.from: ChatGPT Plus and the OpenAI API are separate products with separate billing. Paying for the first does not give you the second, and there is no way to make it.

ext.openaiCreate.text: Theha kii ho {site}, tlasa {menu}, mme o e kgomaretse ka hodimo. E qala ka {prefix}.
ext.openaiCreate.from: Create a key at {site}, under {menu}, and paste it above. It begins {prefix}.

ext.noFreeTier.text: Ha ho kgato e sa lefelweng:

ext.noFreeTierNote.text: ho fapana le Gemini, pitso e nngwe le e nngwe e lefiswa akhaonto eo kii e leng ya yona, ka hoo lebella bili, le ha e le nyane.
ext.noFreeTierNote.from: unlike Gemini, every call is charged to the account the key belongs to, so expect a bill, however small.

ext.geminiCreate.text: Kena ho {site}, kgetha {menu}, o theha e nngwe, mme o e kgomaretse ka hodimo. Google e ntshitse dikii ka mefuta e fetang o mong, ka hoo kgomaretsa seo e o fang sona: sethala sena ha se se belaele.
ext.geminiCreate.from: Sign in at {site}, choose {menu}, create one, and paste it above. Google has issued keys in more than one format, so paste whatever it gives you: this platform does not second-guess it.

ext.geminiFree.text: Gemini API e na le kgato e sa lefelweng, ka hoo ho e leka ha ho turu letho. E fokotsa palo ya dikopo tseo o ka di etsang ka motsotso, e seng ho di lefisa; ho bala foldara e kgolo ho ka fihlela moedi oo, mme sethala se tla o bolela ka ho hlaka haeba ho etsahala.
ext.geminiFree.from: The Gemini API has a free tier, so this costs nothing to try. It limits how many requests you may make in a minute rather than charging for them; reading a large folder can hit that, and the platform will say so plainly if it does.

ext.keyYours.text: Ke ya hao, e seng ya mokgatlo. E sirelleditswe ka encryption, e sebediswa feela bakeng sa mosebetsi oo o o kopang ha switjhi ya hao e bulehile, ha e ke e bontshwa hape ho wena, mme ha e ke e ngolwa ho log.
ext.keyYours.from: It is yours, not the tenant's. It is encrypted, used only for work you ask for while your switch is on, never shown back to you, and never written to a log.

codes.intro.text: Module e le nngwe e ngotswe ka ditsela tse fapaneng ditokomaneng tse fapaneng: {long} kharikhulamong, {short} tafoleng ya tshwantshanyo, {shortest} kakaretsong. Sesupi se selelele, matshwao a puo le ditlhaku tse kgolo di sebetswa ka molao. Mona ke moo App e tsebiswang ka tse ding, e le hore ho kenya ho hokahanye module ho e na le ho tlaleha hore e haellwa.
codes.intro.from: One module is written down differently in different documents: {long} in the curriculum, {short} in the alignment table, {shortest} in a summary. The long identifier, the punctuation and the capitals are handled by rule. This is where the App is told about the rest, so an upload links the module instead of reporting it missing.

codes.saved.text: Ho bolokilwe. Ho kenya ho tla sebedisa tsena ho tloha jwale.
codes.saved.from: Saved. Uploads will use these from now on.

codes.none.text: Ha ho kharikhulamo e so kenngwe, ka hoo ha ho maemo a ka tsebahalang. Kenya kwalifikeishene mme sena se ipatlatsa ho tswa dikhoutung tsa yona tsa module.
codes.none.from: No curriculum has been loaded yet, so there are no standards to infer. Load a qualification and this fills itself in from its module codes.

codes.inUse.text: Mengolo e meng e {total} ho di-module tse {modules}, e a sebediswa.
codes.inUse.from: {total} alternative spellings across {modules} modules, in use.

codes.proposed.text: Mengolo e {total} e hlahisitswe ho di-module tse {modules}.

codes.notInUse.text: Ha e sebediswe ho fihlela o di sheba mme o di netefatsa.
codes.notInUse.from: Not in use until you have looked at them and confirmed.

codes.view.text: Di bone mme o di lokise

codes.dialogNote.text: Khoutu e ka letsohong le letshehadi ke maemo a hao. Mengolo e bapileng le yona ke seo tokomane e ka se sebedisang ho e na le yona. Tlosa efe kapa efe e sa tshwanelang, eketsa ya hao, ebe o netefatsa.
codes.dialogNote.from: The code on the left is your standard. The spellings beside it are what a document may use instead. Remove any that do not belong, add your own, then confirm.

codes.fullId.text: Sesupi sa QCTO se tletseng, {example}, se baluwa e le khoutu ya sona ya module ka molao, mme ha se hloke mola mona. Ho jwalo le ka dihaefene, dikgeo le ditlhaku tse kgolo.
codes.fullId.from: A full QCTO identifier, {example}, is read as its module code by rule, and needs no row here. So are hyphens, spaces and capitals.

codes.worked.text: Ditshwantshiso tsa yona di sebetswa bakeng sa hao.
codes.worked.from: Its variations are worked out for you.

codes.putBack.text: Kgutlisa tsohle tseo App e di hlahisitseng
codes.putBack.from: Put back everything the App proposed

naming.title.text: Kamoo mabitso a difaele a baliwang kateng

naming.intro.text: Ha motho a kenya buka ya mosebetsi kapa tlhahlobo, App e bala lebitso la faele ho fumana hore ke eng. Ha o e etsa ka nepo, ho kenya ho fihla ho se ho tlatsitswe. Ha o e etsa ka phoso, ha ho letho le robehang: e fihla e le foromo e se nang letho eo motho a lokelang ho e tlatsa ka matsoho.
naming.intro.from: When somebody uploads a workbook or an assessment, the App reads the filename to work out what it is. Get this right and an upload arrives already filled in. Get it wrong and nothing breaks: it arrives as a blank form for somebody to complete by hand.

naming.rule.text: Molao wa ntlo, jwalo ka ha sehlopha sa hao se lokela ho o latela
naming.rule.from: The house rule, as your team should follow it

naming.ruleNote.text: E bontshwa skrineng sa ho kenya. Tataiso ya batho, eseng ntho eo App e e tshwantshanyang le yona: e fumana dikhoutu tse ka tlase kae kapa kae moo di hlahang teng.
naming.ruleNote.from: Shown on the upload screen. Guidance for people, not something the App matches on: it finds the codes below wherever they appear.

naming.codesNote.text: Karolo ya lebitso la faele e bolelang hore ke mofuta ofe wa tokomane. Tsena ke seo App e se tshwantshanyang le sona ka nnete.
naming.codesNote.from: The part of a filename that says what kind of document it is. These are what the App actually matches on.

naming.meaning.text: Seo khoutu ena e se bolelang

naming.markerNote.text: Token e bolelang hore faele ke memorandamo e seng kopi ya moithuti.
naming.markerNote.from: The token that says a file is the memorandum rather than the learner's copy.

naming.unread.text: Ha e a baluwa ho lebitso lena: {parts}. Ya kenyang o di tlatsa ka matsoho.
naming.unread.from: Not read from this name: {parts}. Whoever uploads it fills those in by hand.

naming.allRead.text: Tsohle di baluwe. Ho kenya ho rehilweng jwalo ho fihla ho se ho tlatsitswe.
naming.allRead.from: Everything was read. An upload named like this arrives already filled in.

tmpl.note.statement_of_results.text: E isiwa setsing sa tlhahlobo hammoho le tokomane ya boitsebiso ya moithuti. Sebopeho ke sa hao ho se beha; template ya QCTO ka boyona e bontsha seo motho a se jarang.
tmpl.note.statement_of_results.from: Carried to the assessment centre with the learner's identity document. The layout is yours to set; the QCTO's own template shows what one carries.

tmpl.note.certificate.text: Seo mofani wa tshebeletso a se ntshang bakeng sa mananeo a hae. Setifikeiti sa kwalifikeishene se tswa ho QCTO, eseng mona.
tmpl.note.certificate.from: What the provider issues for its own programmes. A qualification certificate comes from the QCTO, not from here.

tmpl.note.workplace_statement.text: Seo motataisi wa mosebetsi a se saennang ho netefatsa phihlelo eo moithuti a e phethileng.
tmpl.note.workplace_statement.from: What a workplace coach signs to confirm the experience a learner completed.

tmpl.note.enrolment_form.text: Foromo ya ngodiso e tlatsitsweng, jwalo ka tokomane. Mohlahlobi wa QCTO a ka e kopa ha a etela, ka hoo e tlameha ho ba teng ka pampiri, eseng feela e le skrine seo motho a se tlatseditseng.
tmpl.note.enrolment_form.from: The completed enrolment form, as a document. A QCTO monitor may ask for it on a visit, so it has to exist on paper, not only as a screen somebody filled in.

tmpl.platform.text: Sebopeho sa sethala ka boyona. Ha ho letho leo o le etsang mona le fetolang tokomane e seng e ntshitswe.
tmpl.platform.from: The platform's own layout. Nothing you do here changes a document already issued.

tmpl.name.text: Seo o bitsang phetolelo ena ka sona

tmpl.documentNote.text: E ngole jwalo ka ha o batla e balwe. Ntho efe kapa efe e ka hara dibraese tse pedi e nkelwa sebaka ke dintlha tsa moithuti ha tokomane e hlahiswa, mme dikgeo tsa hao di bolokwa jwalo ka ha o di ngotse.
tmpl.documentNote.from: Write it as you want it to read. Anything in double braces is replaced with the learner's own details when the document is produced, and your spacing is kept exactly as you type it.

tmpl.starterNote.text: Ena ke mantswe a sethala ka boyona, hore o a fokotse e be a hao.
tmpl.starterNote.from: This is the platform's own wording, for you to cut down into yours.

tmpl.goBack.text: Kgutlela sebopehong sa sethala ka boyona
tmpl.goBack.from: Go back to the platform's own layout

tmpl.fields.text: Seo o ka se kenyang ho yona
tmpl.fields.from: What you can put in it

tmpl.added.text: Seo sethala se se eketsang, ho sa natsoe seo template ya hao e se reng
tmpl.added.from: What the platform adds, whatever your template says

tmpl.addedNote.text: Tsena di hatiswa kamora template ya hao. Ha se tsa hao ho di fetola hobane ha se tsa hao: setsi se laolang se a di hloka, mme moithuti ya tshwereng tokomane o itshetlehile ka hore di be nnete. Ha o hloke ho di ngola phetolelong ya hao.
tmpl.addedNote.from: These are printed after your template. They are not yours to change because they are not yours: a regulator requires them, and a learner holding the document relies on them being true. You do not need to write them into your own version.

capture.intro.text: App e bala seo e ka se balang, e o bontsha seo e se entseng ka sona le seo e sa kgoneng ho se hlokomela, ebe e a ema. Ha ho letho le fetohang tlhahlobo ho fihlela o netefatsa.
capture.intro.from: The App reads what it can, shows you what it made of it and what it could not work out, and waits. Nothing becomes an assessment until you confirm it.

capture.fromFolder.text: Haeba buka ya mosebetsi e kene le foldara, e se e le teng mona: {link} mme o e kenye ho tswa ho se bolokilweng. Ha ho na ho kenya ha bobedi, mme tataiso ya dikarabo e kopantswe bakeng sa hao. Sebedisa foromo e ka tlase feela bakeng sa pampiri eo sethala se seng se e tshwara.
capture.fromFolder.from: If the workbook came in with a folder, it is already here: {link} and capture it from what is filed. There is no second upload, and the answer guide is paired for you. Use the form below only for a paper the platform does not already hold.

capture.naming.text: Kamoo o ka rehang faele lebitso

capture.changeNaming.text: Fetola kamoo mabitso a difaele a baliwang kateng

capture.none.text: Ha ho letho le ntseng le kentswe

capture.noneNote.text: Bula kwalifikeishene mme o kenye dibuka tsa mosebetsi tse seng di bolokilwe khahlanong le yona, kapa o kenye e nngwe ka hodimo mona. Seo App e se balang se bontshwa ho wena pele ho ntho efe kapa efe e fetohang tlhahlobo.
capture.noneNote.from: Open a qualification and capture the workbooks already filed against it, or upload one above. What the App reads is shown to you before any of it becomes an assessment.

capture.committedOn.text: E tiisitswe ka {date}. Ho kenya ho tiiswa hang feela; kenya tokomane hape ho etsa pampiri e nngwe ho yona.
capture.committedOn.from: Committed on {date}. An upload is committed once; upload the document again to make another paper from it.

capture.which.text: Thepa ena ke ya kwalifikeishene efe?
capture.which.from: Which qualification is this material for?

capture.guideNote.text: Ntle le yona, ha ho dikarabo tse nepahetseng, ditshwao kapa dikriteria tse ka baleha.
capture.guideNote.from: Without it, no correct answers, marks or criteria can be read.

capture.ready.text: E loketse. Di-module tse {modules} le dikriteria tsa tlhahlobo tse {criteria} di kentswe, ka hoo dipotso di ka hokahanngwa le seo di se paka.
capture.ready.from: Ready. {modules} modules and {criteria} assessment criteria are in, so questions can be linked to what they evidence.

capture.notReady.text: Kwalifikeishene ena ha e so loke bakeng sa thepa.
capture.notReady.from: This qualification is not ready for material yet.

capture.notReadyNote.text: Etsa tsena pele, ka tatelano ena. Ho fihlela di phethilwe potso e ke ke ya tshwauwa ka seo e se paka, mme ho lokisa sena hamorao ho bolela ho tshwaya hape e nngwe le e nngwe ka letsoho.
capture.notReadyNote.from: Do these first, in this order. Until they are done a question cannot be tagged to what it evidences, and putting that right later means re-tagging every one of them by hand.

capture.whereDocuments.text: Ditokomane di kentswe leqepheng la kwalifikeishene ka boyona.
capture.whereDocuments.from: Documents are uploaded on the qualification's own page.

capture.noGuide.text: Ha ho tataiso ya dikarabo e kentsweng.

capture.original.text: Ya mathomo e a bolokwa mme e nkuwa menwana, hore potso e phehisanwang e rarollwe khahlanong le tokomane, eseng khahlanong le ho e bala hona.
capture.original.from: The original is kept and hashed, so a question in dispute is settled against the document rather than against this reading of it.

capture.committedLong.text: Sena se tiisitswe ka {date}. Ho kenya ho tiiswa hang feela; kenya tokomane hape ho etsa pampiri e nngwe ho yona.
capture.committedLong.from: This was committed on {date}. An upload is committed once; upload the document again to make another paper from it.

captureReview.noAnswer.text: “{stem}…” e tshwauwa ke App empa ha e na karabo e nepahetseng.
captureReview.noAnswer.from: “{stem}…” is marked by the App but has no correct answer.

captureReview.addsUp.text: “{section}” e hatisitswe e le ditshwao tse {printed} empa dipotso tsa yona di kopana ho ba {sum}.
captureReview.addsUp.from: “{section}” is printed as {printed} marks but its questions add up to {sum}.

captureReview.edited.text: O entse dikgolo. Seo se tla tiiswa ke seo se leng skrineng hajwale, eseng seo se baletsweng faeleng.
captureReview.edited.from: You have made corrections. What gets committed is what is on this screen now, not what was read out of the file.

captureReview.summary.text: Dipotso tse {questions} · ditshwao tse {marks} · tse {app} di tshwauwa ke App
captureReview.summary.from: {questions} questions · {marks} marks · {app} marked by the App

captureReview.unknownOne.text: {codes} ha se kriteria ho kwalifikeishene ena, ka hoo e ke ke ya hokahanngwa. Lokisa dikhoutu tse ka hodimo haeba ke phoso ya ho ngola.
captureReview.unknownOne.from: {codes} is not a criterion on this qualification, so it will not be linked. Correct the codes above if that is a typo.

captureReview.unknown.text: {codes} ha di dikriteria ho kwalifikeishene ena, ka hoo di ke ke tsa hokahanngwa. Lokisa dikhoutu tse ka hodimo haeba ke phoso ya ho ngola.
captureReview.unknown.from: {codes} are not criteria on this qualification, so they will not be linked. Correct the codes above if that is a typo.

captureReview.acknowledgeOne.text: Ke badile ntho e le nngwe e setseng e ka hodimo mme ke batla ho tiisa le ha ho le jwalo. Sena se rekotwa khahlanong le lebitso la ka.
captureReview.acknowledgeOne.from: I have read the 1 outstanding item above and want to commit anyway. This is recorded against my name.

captureReview.acknowledge.text: Ke badile dintho tse {count} tse setseng tse ka hodimo mme ke batla ho tiisa le ha ho le jwalo. Sena se rekotwa khahlanong le lebitso la ka.
captureReview.acknowledge.from: I have read the {count} outstanding items above and want to commit anyway. This is recorded against my name.

captureReview.responsibility.text: Ho netefatsa ho bolela ho amohela boikarabelo bakeng sa karabo e nngwe le e nngwe e nepahetseng pampiring ena. Lebitso la hao le dula le eona.
captureReview.responsibility.from: Confirming accepts responsibility for every correct answer in this paper. Your name stays on it.

captureReview.swapped.text: Pampiri le tataiso di bonahala di fetotswe
captureReview.swapped.from: The paper and the guide look swapped

captureReview.swappedNote.text: Ha ho letho le leng le thathamisitsweng, hobane tsohle tse ding di latela sena. Qala hape ka pampiri ya moithuti e le pampiri le tataiso ya mohlahlobi e le tataiso.
captureReview.swappedNote.from: Nothing else is listed, because everything else follows from this. Start again with the learner's paper as the paper and the assessor guide as the guide.

captureReview.fixOne.text: Ntho e le nngwe e hloka ho lokiswa

captureReview.fix.text: Dintho tse {count} di hloka ho lokiswa

captureReview.fixNote.text: Di lokise ka tlase mona, kapa o di bale mme o re o batla ho tswela pele le ha ho le jwalo.
captureReview.fixNote.from: Correct these below, or read them and say you want to go on anyway.

captureReview.clearNote.text: Potso ka nngwe eo App e tla e tshwaya e na le karabo, mme karolo e nngwe le e nngwe e kopana le seo e se hatisang.
captureReview.clearNote.from: Every question the App will mark has an answer, and every section adds up to what it prints.

captureReview.materialNote.text: Tokomane e baletswe ka nepo. Tsena ke dintho tse mabapi le pampiri tseo ho ka etsang qeto ka tsona feela mongodi wa yona.
captureReview.materialNote.from: The document was read correctly. These are things about the paper that only its author can decide.

imports.intro.text: Foldara e nngwe le e nngwe e baliloeng, le seo se etsahetseng ho yona. Ho bala e ntjha ho qala moo mosebetsi o leng teng, ho kwalifikeishene, kosi kapa thepa eo o e hahang, eseng mona.
imports.intro.from: Every folder that has been read, and what became of it. Reading a new one starts where the work is, on the qualification, course or material you are building, rather than here.

imports.noExtension.text: Ha o so hlahise katoloso ya AI
imports.noExtension.from: You have not set up an AI extension

imports.noExtensionNote.text: Ke ya boikgethelo mme ke ya hao, eseng ya mokgatlo: setho se seng le se seng sa basebetsi se iketsetsa ya sona, ka ho ingodisa ha sona.
imports.noExtensionNote.from: It is optional and yours rather than the tenant's: every member of staff sets up their own, with their own subscription.

imports.readNote.text: Se bolokwa ebang se tiisitswe kapa se lahlilwe. Seo se etsweng tlhahiso ebe se hanngwa ke tsela eo mang kapa mang a ahlolang ka yona hore na ho bala ho lokela ho tshepiwa.
imports.readNote.from: Kept whether committed or discarded. What was proposed and then rejected is how anybody judges whether a reading is worth trusting.

imports.byAi.text: e baletswe ke katoloso ya AI

imports.byPlatform.text: e baletswe ke sethala, ha ho AI e sebedisitsweng
imports.byPlatform.from: read by the platform, no AI involved

imports.backFolders.from: ← Back to the folders that have been read

imports.contents.text: Seo se neng se le foldareng

imports.contentsNote.text: Tsohle tse fumanweng, le seo se entsweng ka tsona. Ditokomane tsa PDF le tsa Word di fetoleloa ka sebolelo se le seng seo karolo e setseng ya sethala e se sebedisang, ka hoo mohlala o bala hantle seo ho kenya pampiri ho neng ho tla se bala.
imports.contentsNote.from: Everything found, and what was done with it. PDFs and Word documents are converted with the same extractor the rest of the platform uses, so the model reads exactly what Capture would.

imports.proposesNote.text: Tsohle sebakeng se le seng. Ditlhokomediso ke karolo ya bohlokwa: di bale pele ho tse ding.
imports.proposesNote.from: Everything in one place. The warnings are the part that matters: read those before anything else.

proposal.fromBlueprint.text: E baletswe faeleng ya moralo ya foldara ka boyona. Sebopeho se ka tlase ke seo faele eo e se reng: ha ho letho le nahanetsweng, mme ha ho mohlala o botsitsweng.
proposal.fromBlueprint.from: Read from the folder's own blueprint file. The structure below is exactly what that file says: nothing was inferred, and no model was asked.

proposal.fromDocuments.text: E baletswe ditokomaneng ke mohlala. E hlahlobe khahlanong le tokomane ya kharikhulamo pele o tiisa.
proposal.fromDocuments.from: Read from the documents by the model. Check it against the curriculum document before committing.

proposal.byName.text: E hlophilwe ka lebitso. Ha ho faele ya moralo kapa mohlala o kentsweng: tokomane ka nngwe e ile moo lebitso la yona le reng e ya teng, mme kharikhulamo ha e a ama.
proposal.byName.from: Filed by name. No blueprint and no model were involved: each document went where its filename says it belongs, and the curriculum is untouched.

proposal.unitsNamed.text: Dikarolo tsa ho ithuta tse {count} di bitswa ka mabitso a difaele tsa tsona.
proposal.unitsNamed.from: {count} study units are named by their filenames.

proposal.nothingChanged.text: Ha ho module, sehlooho kapa kriteria e eketswang kapa e fetolwang ke sena.
proposal.nothingChanged.from: No module, topic or criterion is added or changed by this.

proposal.counts.text: Di-module tse {modules}, dihlooho tse {topics}, dielemente tse {elements}, dikriteria tse {criteria}, dikarolo tsa ho ithuta tse {units}, ditokomane tse {documents}
proposal.counts.from: {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} elements, {criteria} criteria, {units} study units, {documents} documents

proposal.withheld.from: {withheld} withheld from learners, {visible} visible to them.

progReport.intro.text: Dipotso tse pedi tse bonahalang di mabapi le baithuti empa e seng: ke eng seo ho se nang ho se hlahlobang, le dipotso dife tse sa sebetseng.

progReport.untestedNote.from: A criterion no summative question assesses cannot be achieved by anybody, however well they do. It holds up every learner on the qualification, and nothing else in the platform says so.

statutory.intro.text: Tlaleho ya Database ya Direkoto tsa Baithuti ya Naha ya SAQA, le Morero wa Bokgoni ba Mosebetsing le Tlaleho ya Selemo ya Katiso. Tsohle di hlahlojwa mona pele di ya kae kapa kae, hobane tlaleho e hanetsweng ka lebaka la nomoro ya boitsebiso e ngotsweng hampe e jella potoloho e feletseng.
statutory.intro.from: The SAQA National Learners' Records Database return, and the Workplace Skills Plan and Annual Training Report. Everything is checked here before it goes anywhere, because a return rejected for a mistyped identity number costs a full cycle.

statutory.locked.from: The files stay locked until the blocking problems below are fixed. Submitting a return that will be rejected wastes a cycle for every learner in it.

statutory.mapping.from: Field mapping follows the accreditation framework (Person 27, Enrolment 28, Achievement 29, Provider 30). Confirm the exact Edu.Dex file layout against the current SAQA specification before a live submission.

enrolNotify.intro.text: QCTO e tlameha ho tsebiswa hore baithuti bana ba ngodisitswe, kahare ho matsatsi a mosebetsi a mashome a mabedi le a le mong kamora ho tlwaetsa bakeng sa kwalifikeishene, le a mahlano bakeng sa lenaneo la mahlale. Matsatsi a phomolo a setjhaba ha a balwe, mme nako e qala ho tloha ka letsatsi la ho tlwaetsa, e seng ka ngodiso kapa tefo.
enrolNotify.intro.from: The QCTO has to be told that these learners were enrolled, within twenty-one working days of induction for a qualification and five for a skills programme. Public holidays do not count, and the clock runs from the induction date rather than from enrolment or payment.

enrolNotify.overdueNote.text: Di ntse di lokela ho romelwa. Tsebiso e diehileng e nang le tlhaloso ke bothata bo fapaneng le e sa kang ya etswa ke motho.

paths.intro.text: {courses} a mmalwa a hokahantsweng ka tatellano: motho ya qalang mosebetsi {programme}, kapa phatlalatso e felletseng ya moralo wa bokgoni. Moithuti o fuwa {course} e latelang ka boiketsetso ha a qeta e e fetileng.
paths.intro.from: Several {courses} chained into a sequence: a new starter {programme}, or a full competency framework roll-out. A learner is given the next {course} automatically as they finish the one before it.

paths.noneAuthor.text: {programme} e hokahanya {courses} ka tatellano, hore moithuti a fuwe e latelang ha a qeta e e fetileng. Aha {courses} pele: {programme} ke tatellano ya tsona.
paths.noneAuthor.from: A {programme} chains {courses} into an order, so a learner is given the next one as they finish the one before. Build the {courses} first: a {programme} is a sequence of them.

badges.intro.text: Kamohelo e fihlang ka letsatsi eo mosebetsi o phethwang ka lona, eseng dikgwedi kamora moo ha setifikeiti sa kantle se fihla. Baji ha se kwalifikeishene mme sethala ha se ke se e dumella hore e shebahale jwalo: ha ho sesupi sa SAQA, ha ho dikerediti, mme ho na le leqephe la netefatso le bolelang ka ho hlaka hore ke eng le hore ha se eng.
badges.intro.from: Recognition that arrives on the day the work is finished, rather than months later when the external certificate comes through. A badge is not a qualification and the platform never lets it look like one: no SAQA identifier, no credits, and a verification page that says plainly what it is and what it is not.

templates.intro.text: Ditokomane tseo {name} e di hlahisang. Ka moo e nngwe le e nngwe e balehang le ho shebahala ka teng ke ya hao: ngola phetolelo ya hao mme sethala se e hlahise ho tswa ho yona, e seng ka moralo wa sona. Seo molao o se hlokang se kenngwa kamora ho ya hao mme ha se fetolwe, hobane karolo eo ha se ya mofani wa tshebeletso ho e fetola.
templates.intro.from: The documents {name} produces. How each one reads and looks is yours: write your own version and the platform produces it from that instead of its own layout. What a regulator requires is added after yours and cannot be edited, because that part is not the provider's to change.

templates.goesTo.statement_of_results.from: The learner, who carries it to the assessment centre with their identity document.

templates.goesTo.certificate.text: Moithuti, le mang kapa mang eo a mo bontshang yona.
templates.goesTo.certificate.from: The learner, and whoever they show it to.

templates.goesTo.workplace_statement.text: Faele ya moithuti, e saennweng ke motataisi ho mohiri ya amohelang.
templates.goesTo.workplace_statement.from: The learner's file, signed by a coach at the host employer.

templates.goesTo.enrolment_form.text: E bolokwa e le bopaki, mme e newa molebedi wa QCTO ha a etela.
templates.goesTo.enrolment_form.from: Filed as evidence, and handed to a QCTO monitor on a visit.

templates.producesNote.text: Ntho efe kapa efe e se nang phetolelo ya hao e sebedisa moralo wa sethala, e leng tokomane e sebetsang, e seng sebaka se ntseng se emetse.
templates.producesNote.from: Anything without your own version uses the platform's layout, which is a working document rather than a placeholder.

templates.writeNote.text: Qala ka moralo wa sethala mme o o fetole hore e be wa hao. Lebala le lengwe le le lengwe leo tokomane e ka le nkang le thathamisitswe ka thoko ho mohlophisi, le nang le mohlala wa nnete wa hore le shebahala jwang.
templates.writeNote.from: Start from the platform's layout and edit it down into yours. Every field the document can carry is listed beside the editor with a real example of what it looks like.

templates.supplied.text: Ditokomane tseo o di fanang ho e seng tseo o di hlophisang
templates.supplied.from: Documents you supply rather than lay out

templates.suppliedNote.text: Ha se tokomane ka nngwe e leng templete eo sethala se e tlatsang.
templates.suppliedNote.from: Not every document is a template the platform fills in.

templates.policiesNote.text: lengolo la hao la akhrediteishene, dipholisi le ditumellano, tse kentsweng mme tsa bolokwa, e seng tse hlahiswang.
templates.policiesNote.from: your accreditation letter, policies and agreements, uploaded and retained rather than generated.

templates.fisaNote.text: tse ngotsweng ke mohlahlobi wa hao ka boyena mme tsa hlahlobisiswa pele ho ba ba di ngolang, ka hoo di ngolwa, e seng ho tlatswa ka templete.
templates.fisaNote.from: written by your own examiner and moderated before anybody sits them, so they are authored rather than templated.

templates.curriculumNote.text: ditokomane tse phatlalalitsweng tsa kwalifikeishene tseo sethala se di balang ho aha kharikhulamo.
templates.curriculumNote.from: the published qualification documents the platform reads to build a curriculum from.

tracker.all.text: Sehlopha ka seng, ho kenyeletswa tse phethilweng le tse hlakotsweng.
tracker.all.from: Every cohort, including those finished and cancelled.

tracker.running.text: Sehlopha ka seng se ntseng se tsamaya.

tracker.note.text: E baliwa ho tswa direkotong, e seng ho bolokwa ka letsoho, ka hoo e ke ke ya hanyetsana le sethala seo e se tlalehang.
tracker.note.from: Read from the records rather than kept by hand, so it cannot disagree with the platform it reports on.

tracker.none.text: Ha ho dihlopha hajwale. Sehlopha ke seo lenane la nako, lenane la ho ba teng le tlaleho ya molao di ikamahantseng le sona.
tracker.none.from: No cohorts yet. A cohort is what a schedule, a register and a statutory return all hang from.

dictionary.intro.text: Moelelo o tsitsitseng wa lentswe le leng le le leng le sebediswang sethaleng sena, ditokomaneng tsa sona le thepeng ya sona ya ho ithuta. Kenyo e nngwe le e nngwe e bolela hore lentswe leo ke la mang. Moo setheo se hlalosang lentswe, re le sebedisa jwalo ka sona mme setheo seo se a bitswa. Moo lentswe e leng la rona, re ka le fetola. Moo e leng tshebediso e tlwaelehileng feela, le lokela ho se ke la hlahiswa e le tlhoko.
dictionary.intro.from: The settled meaning of every term used across this platform, its documents and its learning material. Each entry says who owns the word. Where an authority defines it, we use it as they do and the body is named. Where the word is ours, we can change it. Where it is simply common usage, it should never be cited as a requirement.

dictionary.version.text: Phetolelo ya {version}, e ntshitswe ka {issued}: mantswe a {count}.

dictionary.searchHint.text: Lentswe, kgutshwanyo, kapa lentswe le kahare ho tlhaloso
dictionary.searchHint.from: A term, an abbreviation, or a word in a definition

dictionary.meaning.authority.text: E hlalositswe ke setheo. E sebedise jwalo ka bona: ho fetola moelelo ho beha ho romelwa kotsing.
dictionary.meaning.authority.from: Defined by an authority. Use it as they do: changing the meaning puts a submission at risk.

dictionary.meaning.platform.text: Ke lentswe la sethala sena ka boyona. Ke la rona ho le fetola; ha ho setheo se le laelang.
dictionary.meaning.platform.from: This platform's own word for it. Ours to change; no authority prescribes it.

dictionary.meaning.practice.text: Tshebediso e tlwaelehileng ho tswa lekaleng lohle, e se nang mong a le mong. O se ke wa e hlahisa e le tlhoko.
dictionary.meaning.practice.from: Common usage across the sector, with no single owner. Do not cite it as a requirement.

dictionary.none.text: Ha ho letho le tshwanang. Haeba lentswe le haella mme e le leo re le sebedisang, le lokela ho ba mona: re bolelle mme le tla kengwa phetolelong e latelang.
dictionary.none.from: Nothing matches. If a term is missing and it is one we use, it belongs here: say so and it will be added in the next release.

feedbackForm.intro.text: {cohort}. Dikarabo di tlalehwa hammoho le tsa bohle, eseng e le nngwe ka e nngwe. Di nka metsotso e mmedi, mme ke yona feela ntho e fetolang tsela eo sehlopha se latelang se tsamaiswang ka yona.
feedbackForm.intro.from: {cohort}. Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. It takes about two minutes, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

feedbackForm.scale.3.text: Ha ke dumele le ho hana

feedbackReport.ratingsNote.text: Palohare ya 1 (ke hana haholo) ho isa ho 5 (ke dumela haholo). Palohare ya dikarabo tse fokolang ke maikutlo, e seng tekanyo, ka hoo palo ya dikarabo e ngotswe ka thoko ho yona.
feedbackReport.ratingsNote.from: Mean of 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree). A mean over few answers is a mood, not a measurement, so the count is beside it.

feedbackReport.noRatings.text: Ha ho letho le ntseng le lekanyeditswe.

feedbackReport.saidNote.text: Di bontshwa hammoho mme ka ntle le mabitso. Maikutlo a mabapi le motsamaisi wa thuto a nepahetse feela haeba moithuti a dumela hore a ke ke a baliswa ho yena e mong ka e mong.
feedbackReport.saidNote.from: Shown together and without names. Feedback about a facilitator is only honest if the learner believes it will not be read back to them one by one.

feedbackReport.noComments.text: Ha ho letho le ntseng le ngotswe.

feedbackReport.outstanding.text: Ba ntseng ba lokela ho araba

feedbackReport.outstandingNote.text: Sebaka se le seng moo lebitso le hlahang. Ho ba latela ho ba hloka; dikarabo tse ka hodimo ha di ba hloke.
feedbackReport.outstandingNote.from: The one place a name appears. Chasing needs them; the answers above do not.

conductPage.intro.text: Ditletlebo tse phahamiswang ke baithuti, le mang kapa mang eo lenane la ho ba teng le reng o ile a tlohela ho fihla. Dintlha tsa kgalemelo di ho leqephe la moithuti ka boyena, moo rekoto ya hae e setseng e leng teng.
conductPage.intro.from: Grievances raised by learners, and anybody the register says has stopped turning up. Disciplinary matters sit on the learner's own page, where the rest of their record is.

conductPage.overdue.text: {count} ha di a amohelwa ka nako

conductPage.overdueNote.text: Tletlebo e amohelwa kahare ho matsatsi a mosebetsi a {days}. Tsena di fetile nako eo.
conductPage.overdueNote.from: A grievance is acknowledged within {days} working days. These are past that.

conductPage.grievancesNote.text: Di phahamiswa ke moithuti mabapi le tshwaro, maemo, kapa ntho efe kapa efe e mo amang. Di arotswe le diboipiletso, tseo e leng tsa sephetho mme di yang ho mohlahlobisisi.
conductPage.grievancesNote.from: Raised by a learner about treatment, conditions, or anything else affecting them. Kept apart from appeals, which are about a result and go to the moderator.

conductPage.abscondedNote.text: Matsatsi a mabedi kapa ho feta a latellanang a koetliso a se teng ntle le ditaba. E baliwa ho tswa lenaneng la ho ba teng, e seng ho bolokwa, ka hoo ho lokisa letshwao ho fetola karabo hang-hang. Ho se be teng ho rekotilweng e le ho nang le tlhaloso ke puisano, mme ho roba tatellano.
conductPage.abscondedNote.from: Two or more consecutive training days absent with no word. Read off the register rather than stored, so correcting a mark changes the answer at once. An absence recorded as excused is communication, and breaks the run.

conductPage.nobody.text: Ha ho motho. Bohle ba a fihla kapa ba boletse motho hore ke hobaneng ba sa fihle.
conductPage.nobody.from: Nobody. Everybody is either turning up or has told somebody why not.

conductPage.actOn.text: Lenane la ho sebetsa ho lona, e seng qeto. Ho ikopanya le moithuti, ho ngolla mothusi wa ditjhelete le ho ntsha tsebiso ya morero wa ho phethisa ke dintho tseo motho a di etsang.
conductPage.actOn.from: A list to act on, never a decision. Contacting the learner, writing to the sponsor and issuing a notice of intention to terminate are all things a person does.

grievance.decisionHint.text: Seo se fumanweng le seo se tla etswang. Sena se ya ho moithuti ka mongolo.
grievance.decisionHint.from: What was found and what will be done. This goes to the learner in writing.

grievance.impartial.text: Mmatlisisi o tlameha ho ba motho eo tletlebo e sa mo bolelleng. Ho kgetha eo moithuti a mo tletlebileng ho a hanwa, hobane “motho ya sa nke lehlakore ya kgethilweng” ke seo tsamaiso e se tshepisang, mme beke e hlokang basebetsi ke yona nako eo e robehang ka yona.
grievance.impartial.from: The investigator must be somebody the grievance is not about. Naming one the learner has complained about is refused, because “a designated impartial person” is what the procedure promises and a short-staffed week is exactly when it gets broken.

access.deniedTitle.text: Ha o na phihlello ho sena
access.deniedTitle.from: You do not have access to this

access.deniedNote.text: O kene, empa sena ha se sa hao ho se bona: kapa ke sa motho e mong, kapa se hloka karolo eo akhaonto ya hao e se nang yona. Haeba o nahana hore ho fosahetse, kopa mookameli wa hao a hlahlobe.
access.deniedNote.from: You are signed in, but this is not yours to see: either it belongs to someone else, or it needs a role your account does not hold. If you think that is wrong, ask your administrator to check.

access.home.text: Kgutlela leqepheng la hao la lehae

access.unknownTitle.from: This address is not in use

access.unknownNote.text: Ha ho mokgatlo o hlophisitsweng aterese ena ya webo, kapa phihlello ya yona e emisitswe. Sheba aterese eo o e neilweng, kapa o ikopanye le ya hlophisitseng koetliso ya hao.
access.unknownNote.from: No organisation is set up at this web address, or its access has been suspended. Check the address you were given, or contact whoever arranged your training.

wpSetup.intro.text: Moithuti o etsa phihlelo ya mosebetsi ho mohiri, tlasa tlhokomelo ya motho eo mohiri a mo fanang ka yena. Tumellano e rekota hore ke mang; bukana ya rekoto e rekota seo kharikhulamo e se hlokang hore a se etse.
wpSetup.intro.from: A learner does work experience at an employer, supervised by somebody that employer provides. The agreement records who that is; the logbook records what the curriculum requires them to do.

wpSetup.emptyOne.text: Module e le nngwe ya phihlelo ya mosebetsi ha e na ditlhoko tse nkilweng.
wpSetup.emptyOne.from: 1 work experience module has no requirements captured.

wpSetup.empty.text: Dimodule tse {count} tsa phihlelo ya mosebetsi ha di na ditlhoko tse nkilweng.
wpSetup.empty.from: {count} work experience modules have no requirements captured.

wpSetup.emptyNote.text: {codes}. Bukana ya rekoto e hahilweng ho tswa ho module e se nang letho e ne e ke ke ya paka letho, ka hoo tseo di ke ke tsa buloa ho fihlela mesebetsi ya kharikhulamo ya mosebetsi, tsebo ya mosebetsi le bopaki ba tshehetso di kentswe.
wpSetup.emptyNote.from: {codes}. A logbook built from an empty module would attest to nothing, so those cannot be opened until the curriculum's work activities, workplace knowledge and supporting evidence have been imported.

wpSetup.noCoaches.text: Ha ho motho ya nang le karolo ya Motataisi wa Mosebetsi hajwale. Qala ka ho kenya mookameli wa moithuti ka {people}: o sebeletsa mohiri, e seng wena, mme o tla bona feela baithuti ba bitswang ditumellanong tsa hae.
wpSetup.noCoaches.from: Nobody holds the Workplace Coach role yet. Add the learner's supervisor through {people} first: they work for the employer, not for you, and they will only ever see the learners named on their own agreements.

wpSetup.ownCoach.text: Moithuti a ke ke a ba motataisi wa hae; polokelo ya dintlha e a e hana.
wpSetup.ownCoach.from: The learner cannot be their own coach; the database refuses it.

wpSetup.designationNote.text: E rekotilwe ho tumellano jwalo ka ha e eme kajeno, ho netefatsa hore tshaeno e tswela pele ho bolela hore ke mang ya saenneng le ka karolo efe.
wpSetup.designationNote.from: Recorded on the agreement as it stands today, so the sign-off keeps saying who signed and in what capacity.

wpSetup.noAgreements.text: Ha ho ditumellano tsa mosebetsi hajwale. Theha e nngwe ka hodimo pele: bukana ya rekoto e rekota mosebetsi o etsweng ho mohiri ya bitswang tlasa motataisi ya bitswang, ka hoo e ke ke ya ba teng ntle le e nngwe.
wpSetup.noAgreements.from: No workplace agreements yet. Create one above first: a logbook records work done at a named employer under a named coach, so it cannot exist without one.

wpSetup.generated.text: Bukana ya rekoto e hlahiswa ho tswa mesebetsing ya kharikhulamo ka boyona, tsebong ya mosebetsi le bopaking ba tshehetso, ka hoo e ke ke ya siya tlhoko.
wpSetup.generated.from: The logbook is generated from the curriculum's own work activities, workplace knowledge and supporting evidence, so it cannot omit a requirement.

enrolForm.intro.text: {provider} e tlameha ho romela dintlha tsena ho Quality Council for Trades and Occupations ha o ngodiswa. Bongata ba tsona bo se bo tsejwa mme bo bontshitswe ka tlase; tse ding ke tseo ho se motho ya ka di arabang ntle le wena. O ka boloka ha o ntse o tsamaya mme wa kgutla.
enrolForm.intro.from: {provider} has to send these details to the Quality Council for Trades and Occupations when you are enrolled. Most of it is already known and shown below; the rest is what nobody can answer except you. You can save as you go and come back to it.

enrolForm.onRecordNote.text: Bolella mohokahanyi wa hao haeba ho na le se fosahetseng mona; ha se sa hao ho se fetola mona.
enrolForm.onRecordNote.from: Tell your coordinator if any of this is wrong; it is not yours to change here.

enrolForm.noInduction.text: ho tlwaetswa ha ho so tlalehwe ka letsatsi

enrolForm.doesNotAdd.text: Ho na le ntho e sa lekaneng mona
enrolForm.doesNotAdd.from: Something here does not add up

enrolForm.idNote.text: Nomoro ya boitsebiso ya Afrika Borwa e na le letsatsi la tsheho le bong ka hare ho yona, mme QCTO e sheba hore di a lumellana. Hangata ke palo e ngotsweng hampe. Mohokahanyi wa hao a ka e lokisa.
enrolForm.idNote.from: A South African identity number carries the date of birth and the gender inside it, and the QCTO checks that they agree. It is usually a mistyped digit. Your coordinator can correct it.

enrolForm.stillToAnswer.text: {count} di ntse di lokela ho arabuwa

enrolForm.stillNote.text: Ha ho letho le lahlehang haeba o emisa hara tsela. Sena ke seo se tla haellang ho seo se romelwang kamoo se leng kateng.
enrolForm.stillNote.from: Nothing is lost if you stop partway. This is what would be missing from the submission as it stands.

enrolForm.completeNote.text: Tsohle tseo ho romela ho di hlokang di mona.
enrolForm.completeNote.from: Everything the submission needs is here.

enrolForm.printNote.text: bakeng sa ho saena le ho e boloka.

enrolForm.missingPrint.text: Dikarabo tse {count} di ntse di haella, ka hoo foromo ena e tla kgatiswa e na le sebaka se se nang letho. Di thathamisitswe foromong ka boyona.
enrolForm.missingPrint.from: {count} answers are still missing, so this form will print with blanks. They are listed on the form itself.

enrolForm.completePrint.text: E phethilwe. E kgatise, o kope moithuti a saene, mme o e boloke.
enrolForm.completePrint.from: Complete. Print it, have the learner sign it, and file it.

enrolForm.titleHint.from: Mr, Ms, Dr, and so on.

enrolForm.middleHint.text: Haeba o na le lona. Le tlohele le se na letho haeba o se na lona.
enrolForm.middleHint.from: If you have one. Leave it blank if not.

enrolForm.homeLanguage.text: Puo eo o e buang lapeng

enrolForm.working.from: Are you working at the moment?

enrolForm.difficulty.text: Bothata bo bokae bo bo bakang?
enrolForm.difficulty.from: How much difficulty does it cause?

enrolForm.difficultyHint.text: Se botswa hobane bokooa bo rekotilwe khahlanong le lebitso la hao. QCTO e se hloka hammoho le bona.
enrolForm.difficultyHint.from: Asked because a disability is recorded against your name. The QCTO requires it alongside.

enrolForm.noId.text: Haeba o se na nomoro ya boitsebiso ya Afrika Borwa
enrolForm.noId.from: If you do not have a South African identity number

enrolForm.instead.text: Seo o ngodisitsweng ho sona ho e-na le moo
enrolForm.instead.from: What you are enrolled on instead

enrolForm.post.text: Moo poso e fihlang ho wena, haeba e le kae kapa kae ho e mong
enrolForm.post.from: Where post reaches you, if it is somewhere else

enrolForm.reach.text: Kamoo o ka fihlellwang ka teng

enrolForm.province.text: Porofinse eo o sebetsang ho yona

enrolForm.provinceHint.text: Moo o sebetsang teng, e seng kamehla moo o dulang teng.
enrolForm.provinceHint.from: Where you work, which is not always where you live.

enrolForm.statssaHint.text: Mohokahanyi wa hao a ka e batla haeba o sa e tsebe.
enrolForm.statssaHint.from: Your coordinator can look this one up if you do not know it.

enrolForm.flc.text: Bokgoni ba Motheo ba ho Ithuta

enrolForm.flcNote.text: Se hlokahala feela ho kwalifikeishene ya boemo ba NQF 3 kapa 4. Se tlohele se se na letho haeba ho se motho ya o kopileng sona.
enrolForm.flcNote.from: Only needed on a qualification at NQF level 3 or 4. Leave it blank if nobody has asked you for it.

enrolForm.agreedOn.text: O dumetse ka {date}. Letsatsi leo ke karolo ya rekoto mme ha le fetohe haeba o fetola foromo ena.
enrolForm.agreedOn.from: You agreed on {date}. That date is part of the record and does not change if you edit this form.

enrolForm.agreedDate.text: Letsatsi leo o dumelang ka lona le a rekotwa, hobane tlaleho e kopa tsena ka bobedi.
enrolForm.agreedDate.from: The date you agree is recorded, because the return asks for both.

enrolForm.confirm.text: Boloka mme o netefatse hore tsena di nepahetse
enrolForm.confirm.from: Save and confirm these are right

records.intro.text: Tsamaiso ya Boleng le dipholisi tsa yona, mangolo a akhrediteishene, dikontraka, le ditokomane tsa molao jwalo ka bukana ya PAIA: tsohle tseo mofani wa tshebeletso a nang le tsona tseo eseng tsa moithuti a le mong kapa kwalifikeishene e le nngwe. Ho kenya foldara ya kwalifikeishene ho boloka dipholisi tsa yona tsa QMS mona ka boiketsetso.
records.intro.from: The Quality Management System and its policies, accreditation letters, contracts, and statutory documents like the PAIA manual: everything the provider holds that does not belong to one learner or one qualification. Importing a qualification folder files its QMS policies here automatically.

records.introManage.text: E bontsha hape seo se fihletseng qetellong ya nako ya sona ya polokelo.
records.introManage.from: It also shows what has reached the end of its retention period.

records.expiringNote.text: Tokomane ya tlhwekiso ya lekgetho e felileng ke ntho eo ho se motho ya e elelwang ho fihlela beke eo e hlokahalang ho yona.
records.expiringNote.from: An expired tax clearance is the kind of thing nobody notices until the week it is needed.

records.libraryNote.text: Diphetolelo tse nkeletsweng sebaka di a bolokwa, hobane pholisi e neng e laola ka Hlakubele ke yona eo tlhahlobo ya Hlakubele e e botsang.
records.libraryNote.from: Superseded versions are kept, because the policy that governed in March is the one an audit of March asks about.

records.nothing.text: Ha ho letho le bolokilweng le ntse.

records.nothingManage.text: Lengolo la akhrediteishene ke leo le lokelang ho kengwa pele.
records.nothingManage.from: The accreditation letter is the one worth putting in first.

records.everybody.text: mang kapa mang a ka e bala

records.retentionNote.text: E balwa ho tloha letsatsing la netefatso, ho ya ka nako ya polokelo ya moshwelella ona. Ha ho letho mona le bolokelweng kapa le senyehileng: sethala se bolela seo se lokelang, mme motho o etsa qeto.
records.retentionNote.from: Counted from the certification date, over the retention period on this tenant. Nothing here has been archived or destroyed: the platform says what is due and a person decides.

records.registerNote.text: Tsohle tse nkilweng qeto ka rekoto e fetileng letsatsi la yona, le hore ke mang ya entseng qeto. Rekoto e nyametseng ka ho kgutsa e mpe ho feta e bolokilweng nako e telele haholo.
records.registerNote.from: Everything decided about a record past its date, with who decided it. A record that quietly disappeared is worse than one kept too long.

records.new.text: Ha ho letho: ena ke e ntjha

records.replacesNote.text: Eo e e nkelang sebaka e a bolokwa mme e tshwauwe e nkeletswe sebaka. Pholisi e neng e laola ka Hlakubele ke yona eo tlhahlobo ya Hlakubele e e botsang.
records.replacesNote.from: The one it replaces is kept and marked superseded. The policy that governed in March is what an audit of March asks about.

records.descriptionHint.text: Ke eng, haeba sehlooho se sa e bolele
records.descriptionHint.from: What it is, if the title does not say

records.anybody.text: Mang kapa mang ya kenneng a ka bala sena
records.anybody.from: Anybody signed in may read this

records.anybodyNote.text: E sebetsa ho ditokomane tsa molao. Tataiso ya moithuti kamehla e bontshwa baithuti; dipholisi, dikontraka, akhrediteishene le ditokomane tsa tshebetso ha di ke di bontshwe.
records.anybodyNote.from: Applies to statutory documents. A learner guide is always shown to learners; policies, contracts, accreditation and operational documents never are.

records.archive.from: Archive: move it out of the way

records.keep.text: E boloke ho feta nako ya polokelo

records.whyDestroy.text: Hobaneng ha sena se ka senngwa

offline.title.text: Ho sebetsa ntle le matshwao a inthanete

offline.intro.text: Jarolla seo o se hlokang pele o tswa. Ntho efe kapa efe eo o e rekotang ha o le kantle e bolokwa mohaleng ona mme e romelwa ha o boela o fumana matshwao.
offline.intro.from: Download what you need before you go out. Anything you record while you are away is kept on this phone and sent back the next time you have a signal.

offline.takeNote.text: Jarolla seo o se hlokang pele o tswa. Ha ho letho le bolokwang leo o sa le kopang.
offline.takeNote.from: Download what you need before you go. Nothing is kept that you did not ask for.

offline.nothingToStudy.text: Ha o na letho la ho ithuta hajwale. Ntho efe kapa efe eo o e ngodisitsweng e hlaha mona hore o e jarolle.
offline.nothingToStudy.from: You have nothing to study at the moment. Anything you are enrolled on appears here to download.

offline.recordNote.text: E sebetsa ntle le matshwao. E ema mohaleng ona mme e ya ha o boela o na le matshwao.
offline.recordNote.from: Works with no signal. It waits on this phone and goes when you next have one.

offline.waitingDecisionNote.text: Ho na le ntho e fetohileng ha moithuti a le sieo. Ha ho letho le kopantsweng kapa le ngotsweng hodima e nngwe: motho o tlameha ho kgetha.
offline.waitingDecisionNote.from: Something changed while the learner was away. Nothing has been merged or overwritten: somebody has to choose.

offline.bothDates.text: E rekotilwe sesebediswa {captured} · e re fihletse {received}
offline.bothDates.from: Recorded on the device {captured} · reached us {received}

offline.relaxed.text: {count} di nkilwe tlasa molao o bonolo

lrs.intro.text: Direkoto tsa baithuti ba hao, ho kena le ho tswa, e le dipolelo tsa xAPI: sebopeho seo mabenkele a direkoto tsa ho ithuta le bongata ba distimi tsa ho ithuta di bo fapanang. Ha ho letho mona le fetolang diphetho tsa moithuti sethaleng sena.
lrs.intro.from: Your learners' records, in and out, as xAPI statements: the format learning record stores and most learning systems exchange. Nothing here changes a learner's results on this platform.

lrs.outNote.text: Ngodiso e nngwe le e nngwe, thuto e phethilweng, tlhahlobo e lekilweng, qeto ya bokgoni kapa ya ha ho so be le bokgoni, kosi e phethilweng, tlaleho ya diphetho, setifikeiti, le setifikeiti sa kwalifikeishene se amohetsweng, polelo e le nngwe ka nngwe. E nngwe le e nngwe e boloka boitsebiso bo tshwanang nako le nako ha o ntsha, ka hoo ho kenya di-export tse pedi sistiming e nngwe ha ho eketse nalane ya mang kapa mang habedi.
lrs.outNote.from: Every enrolment, lesson completed, assessment attempted, competent or not yet competent decision, course completed, statement of results, certificate, and qualification certificate received, one statement each. Each keeps the same identity every time you export, so loading two exports into another system does not double anybody's history.

lrs.download.text: Jarolla direkoto tsohle tsa ho ithuta

lrs.downloadNote.text: Faele e bolela moithuti e mong le e mong le aterese ya hae ya imeile. E boloke jwalo ka rekoto efe kapa efe ya tlhahisoleseding ya botho.
lrs.downloadNote.from: The file names every learner and their email address. Keep it as you would any record of personal information.

lrs.store.text: Romela direkoto lebenkeleng la hao la direkoto tsa ho ithuta
lrs.store.from: Send records to your own learning record store

lrs.storeNote.text: Haeba o boloka lebenkele la direkoto tsa ho ithuta, le hokahanye mona mme rekoto e nngwe le e nngwe e ka hodimo e ya ho lona kahare ho hora ho tloha ha e etsahala, tse seng di entswe di qala. E nngwe le e nngwe e romelwa hang; polelo eo lebenkele le seng le e tshwere e siwa jwalo ka ha e le. Sephiri sa lebenkele se notletswe sethaleng sena, ha se ke se bontshwa hape, mme se lebalwa ha o kgaola khokahano.
lrs.storeNote.from: If you keep a learning record store, connect it here and every record above goes to it within the hour of happening, the ones already made first. Each is sent once; a statement the store already holds is left as it is. The store's secret is sealed on this platform, never shown again, and forgotten when you disconnect.

lrs.inNote.text: Faele ya dipolelo tsa xAPI ho tswa sistiming e nngwe: lenane la dipolelo, kapa seo lebenkele la direkoto tsa ho ithuta le se busetsang. E nngwe le e nngwe e tshwantshanywa le moithuti mona ka imeile mme e bontshwa rekotong ya hae. E bolokwa e le ho ithuta ho entsweng kae kapa kae, e seng ho fetolwa ngodiso kapa sephetho mona, hobane ha ho letho la yona le ileng la rutwa kapa la hlahlojwa sethaleng sena.
lrs.inNote.from: A file of xAPI statements from another system: a list of statements, or what a learning record store returns. Each is matched to a learner here by email and shown on their record. It is kept as learning done elsewhere, not turned into an enrolment or a result here, because none of it was taught or assessed on this platform.

verifyPage.notFoundNote.from: No certificate carries that reference. Check it against the document: the characters I, L, O, U, 0 and 1 are never used, so a 1 is a 7 or a J, and an O is a Q or a D.

verifyPage.badgeNote.text: Ena ke rekoto ya mofani wa tshebeletso ka boyena hore ya e tshwereng o phethile module ena ya thuto. Ha se kwalifikeishene ya naha, ha e na dikerediti, mme ha e newe ke lekgotla la boleng. Kwalifikeishene e netefatswa ka tshupetso ya yona ya setifikeiti.
verifyPage.badgeNote.from: This is a provider's own record that the holder completed this module of study. It is not a national qualification, carries no credits, and is not awarded by a quality council. A qualification is verified by its own certificate reference.

platformPage.intro.text: Mokgatlo o mong le o mong o ho sethala. O ka bona hore o sebedisa bokae mme wa laola tlhophiso ya wona, empa e seng baithuti ba wona, dikosi kapa direkoto tsa tlhahlobo. Ho tshwara sistimi ya moreki ha ho tshwane le ho fuwa tokelo ya ho e bala, mme sethala se sireletsa seo, se sa itshetlehe ka boiketso.
platformPage.intro.from: Every organisation on the platform. You can see how much each is using and manage their configuration, but not their learners, courses or assessment records. Hosting a client's system is not the same as being entitled to read it, and the platform enforces that rather than relying on restraint.

said.alignment-document.c3e49767.text: Ha ho dikarolo tsa ho ithuta tse fumanweng tokomaneng eo. Sehlooho se seng se tlameha ho bala jwalo ka “Study Unit 1 – Organisational Architecture”, se na le dimodule tseo se di akaretsang ka tlasa sona.
said.alignment-document.c3e49767.from: No study units were found in that document. One heading has to read like “Study Unit 1 – Organisational Architecture”, with the modules it covers listed under it.

said.alignment-matrix.185b0901.text: Ha ho matrikse ya tshwantshanyo e fumanweng bukeng ena ya mosebetsi. Kholomo e nngwe e tlameha ho ba le sehlooho se jwalo ka “Topic Elements”, hore mela e ka tshwantshanywa le kharikhulamo.
said.alignment-matrix.185b0901.from: No alignment matrix found in this workbook. One column must be headed something like “Topic Elements”, so the rows can be matched to the curriculum.

said.alignment-matrix.2b19415b.text: Eo ke tokomane ya Word. Tokomane ka boyona e bolokilwe, e ngotswe mme e ka batlwa. Seo se sa kang sa kgonahala ke ho e bala, hobane matrikse ya tshwantshanyo e baliwa jwalo ka spredshiti: mola o le mong bakeng sa mola o mong le o mong wa kharikhulamo, le kholomo e nang le sehlooho se jwalo ka “Topic Elements”. Boloka matrikse jwalo ka spredshiti mme o e kenye hape, mme mola o mong le o mong wa kharikhulamo o tla bontsha seo se o akaretsang.
said.alignment-matrix.2b19415b.from: That is a Word document. The document itself is kept, filed and searchable. What could not happen is reading it, because the alignment matrix is read as a spreadsheet: one row per curriculum line, with a column headed something like “Topic Elements”. Save the matrix as a spreadsheet and upload that as well, and each line of the curriculum will show what covers it.

said.alignment-matrix.a0d14e78.text: Matrikse ha e na dikholomo tsa dithuso tse ka tsejwang: ha ho letho le nang le sehlooho jwalo ka Workbook, Assessment, Theory Guide, Legislation jwalojwalo.
said.alignment-matrix.a0d14e78.from: The matrix has no resource columns that could be recognised: nothing headed Workbook, Assessment, Theory Guide, Legislation and so on.

said.alignment-matrix.a8527ba8.text: Kenya tokomane ya kharikhulamo pele ho matrikse ya tshwantshanyo: ha ho ntse ho se na letho leo mela ya yona e ka ikamahang le lona.
said.alignment-matrix.a8527ba8.from: Import the curriculum document before the alignment matrix: there is nothing yet for its rows to attach to.

said.alignment-matrix.cf20070f.text: Matrikseng, e seng kharikhulamong jwalo ka ha e baliwa.

said.alignment-matrix.e1c0c850.text: Matrikse e re kharikhulamo e phatlalatsa sena; kharikhulamo jwalo ka ha e baliwa ha e na sona.
said.alignment-matrix.e1c0c850.from: The matrix says the curriculum publishes this; the curriculum as read does not have it.

said.blueprint-export.19776e70.text: Dikarolo tsa ho ithuta tse {studyUnitsCount} ha di faeleng. Kharikhulamo e phatlalatsa dimodule mme ha e bolele letho ka moo mofani wa tshebeletso a di bokellang ka teng, ka hoo dikarolo tsa ho ithuta di dula le tokomane ya tshwantshanyo le mabitso a difaele tsa foldara ka boyona.
said.blueprint-export.19776e70.from: The {studyUnitsCount} study units are not in the file. A curriculum publishes modules and says nothing about how a provider groups them, so study units stay with the alignment document and the folder's own filenames.

said.blueprint-export.228df427.text: Kharikhulamo ena e fapanya mefuta e fetang o mong ya dintlha tsa sehlooho (tsebo e sebediswang, bopaki ba tshehetso jwalojwalo). Moralo o nka lenane le le leng bakeng sa sehlooho ka seng, ka hoo ho e kenya hape ho tswa ho wona ho ne ho tla di rea kaofela ka karolo ya module. Mantswe a mola o mong le o mong a ntse a nkiwe ka nepo.
said.blueprint-export.228df427.from: This curriculum distinguishes more than one kind of topic element (applied knowledge, supporting evidence and so on). A blueprint carries one list per topic, so re-importing from it would label them all by the module's component. The wording of every line is carried exactly.

said.conduct.07e411c2.text: Bolela hore tletlebo e mabapi le eng, ka mantswe a moithuti ka boyena moo ho kgonahalang.
said.conduct.07e411c2.from: Say what the grievance is about, in the learner's own words where possible.

said.conduct.1636d693.text: Tletlebo e bolela {firstName} {lastName}. Motho eo tletlebo e mabapi le yena a ke ke a e batlisisa: mokgwa o hloka motho ya behilweng ya sa tsotelle lehlakore. Kgetha e mong.
said.conduct.1636d693.from: The grievance names {firstName} {lastName}. Somebody the complaint is about cannot investigate it: the procedure asks for a designated impartial person. Appoint somebody else.

said.conduct.1d25ed57.text: Tsebiso e tlameha ho bolela dipehelo tse tobileng. Pitso ya ho mamela mabapi le dipehelo tse sa boletsweng e ke ke ya arabuwa.
said.conduct.1d25ed57.from: The notice has to state the specific allegations. A hearing about unstated allegations cannot be answered.

said.conduct.1e2d5837.text: E rekotilwe. Matsatsi a mahlano a mosebetsi a ho ipiletsa a qala kajeno.
said.conduct.1e2d5837.from: Recorded. The five working days to appeal run from today.

said.conduct.1efe5ff4.text: Pitso ya ho mamela ha e a fumanwa.

said.conduct.303f7f08.text: Bolela hore ke dikotlo dife tse ka fanwang, ho kenyeletswa ho felisa ngodiso moo ho kgonahalang. Moithuti ya nkang qeto ya hore na a lokela ho tla le mothusi o hloka ho tseba seo a se kotsing.
said.conduct.303f7f08.from: Say what sanctions are possible, including termination where it is. A learner deciding whether to bring assistance needs to know what is at stake.

said.conduct.403b3f35.text: Bolela lebaka. Kotlo e sa hlalosoang ha e sireletsehe, mme ena ke serapa seo moithuti a nang le tokelo ya sona.
said.conduct.403b3f35.from: Say why. An unexplained sanction is indefensible, and this is the paragraph the learner is entitled to.

said.conduct.47a20502.text: Bolela molao o robilweng, maemo a lebelletsweng le seo se etsahalang haeba ho ka etsahala hape. Temoso e sa etseng jwalo hase temoso.
said.conduct.47a20502.from: State the rule broken, the standard expected and what happens if it recurs. A warning that does not is not one.

said.conduct.4dcaf05f.from: That is not a date and time.

said.conduct.64f7462f.text: Tsebiso e tlameha ho bolella moithuti hore a ka thusa ke moithuti wa habo, a hlahisa nyewe ya hae, mme a bitsa le ho botsa dipaki. Romela tsebiso e etsang jwalo, ebe o e rekota mona.
said.conduct.64f7462f.from: The notice must tell the learner they may be assisted by a fellow learner, present their case, and call and question witnesses. Send a notice that does, then record it here.

said.conduct.67f9675a.text: Rekota seo se fumanweng le hore ke ka mabaka afe. Pitso ya ho mamela eo diphumano tsa yona e leng mola o le mong ke pitso e sa ka ya tshwarwa.
said.conduct.67f9675a.from: Record what was found and on what basis. A hearing whose findings are one line is a hearing that did not happen.

said.conduct.6a6b5da7.from: It has to be acknowledged by {acknowledgeBy}.

said.conduct.6d857ec5.text: Ho felisa lenaneo la motho ho hloka pitso e tshwarilweng, e nang le diphumano tse rekotilweng. Bitsa e nngwe, rekota seo se fumanweng, ebe o kwala nyewe.
said.conduct.6d857ec5.from: Ending somebody's programme needs a hearing that was held, with its findings recorded. Convene one, record what was found, then close the case.

said.conduct.77c80d2a.text: E kentswe. E tla amohelwa kahare ho matsatsi a mabedi a mosebetsi.
said.conduct.77c80d2a.from: Lodged. It will be acknowledged within two working days.

said.conduct.869c74ee.text: Pitso ya ho mamela e hloka tsebiso ya bonyane dihora tse {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS}, mme sena se kgutshwane ka dihora tse {hours}. Nako ya pele eo e ka tshwarwang ka yona ke {earliest}. Tsebiso e kgutshwane ke bofokodi bo hlolang boipiletso, ho sa tsotellehe seo moithuti a se entseng.
said.conduct.869c74ee.from: A hearing needs at least {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} hours' notice and this is {hours} hour short. The earliest it can be held is {earliest}. Short notice is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

said.conduct.8d0ef3ad.text: Pitso ya ho mamela e bitswa. Nako ya tsebiso e phethilwe.
said.conduct.8d0ef3ad.from: Hearing convened. The notice period is met.

said.conduct.9f172fca.text: Moithuti a ke ke a batlisisa tletlebo ya hae.
said.conduct.9f172fca.from: The learner cannot investigate their own grievance.

said.conduct.ad753d2e.text: Qeto e ya ho moithuti ka mongolo mme e tlameha ho bolela seo se fumanweng le seo se tla etswa. Mola o le mong hase qeto.
said.conduct.ad753d2e.from: The decision goes to the learner in writing and has to say what was found and what will be done. A line is not a decision.

said.conduct.b0301d88.text: Bolela seo ho boletsweng hore se etswe, ka ho toba. Moithuti a ke ke a araba 'boitshwaro bo bobe', mme le pitso ya ho mamela e ke ke ya e araba.
said.conduct.b0301d88.from: Say what is alleged, specifically. A learner cannot answer 'poor attitude', and neither can a hearing.

said.conduct.b0dcbd53.text: Ho nkilwe qeto, mme moithuti o e na le yona ka mongolo.
said.conduct.b0dcbd53.from: Decided, and the learner has it in writing.

said.conduct.cf47131c.text: E kwetswe. Nehela moithuti sephetho ka mongolo, ebe o rekota hore o se entse.
said.conduct.cf47131c.from: Closed. Give the learner the outcome in writing, then record that you have.

said.conduct.e83b2265.text: Pitso ya ho mamela e hloka bonyane diiri tse {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} tsa tsebiso mme sena se fokola ka diiri tse {hours}. said.conduct.e83b2265.from: A hearing needs at least {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} hours' notice and this is {hours} hours short. The earliest it can be held is {earliest}. Short notice is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.
