said.eisa.041d2d1d.text: E rekotilwe. Palo ya matsatsi ho isa ngodisong e qala jwale.
said.eisa.041d2d1d.from: Recorded. The countdown to registration starts now.

said.eisa.18104c26.text: Ha ho bukana ya rekoto ya phihlelo ya mosebetsi e butsweng.
said.eisa.18104c26.from: No work experience logbook has been opened.

said.eisa.235f3916.text: E kgutlisitswe ke motataisi wa mosebetsi bakeng sa bopaki bo bongata.
said.eisa.235f3916.from: Returned by the workplace coach for more evidence.

said.eisa.2d36e0ea.text: E saennwe ke motataisi wa mosebetsi, e emetse hore mohlahlobi a e amohele.
said.eisa.2d36e0ea.from: Signed by the workplace coach, waiting for an assessor to accept it.

said.eisa.aabe4744.text: Ho motataisi wa mosebetsi bakeng sa saena.
said.eisa.aabe4744.from: With the workplace coach for signature.

said.enrolment-document-shape.04f2917b.text: Netefatso e tsofetse ho feta nako e dumelletsweng. Ka kopo netefatsa kopi e ntjha.
said.enrolment-document-shape.04f2917b.from: The certification is older than the period allowed. Please have a fresh copy certified.

said.enrolment-document-shape.3d15f524.text: Ena ha se kopi e netefaditsweng. Ka kopo e netefatse mme o e romele hape.
said.enrolment-document-shape.3d15f524.from: This is not a certified copy. Please have it certified and send it again.

said.enrolment-document-shape.8d2c9fdc.text: Kopi ha e balehe. Ka kopo e skene kapa o e nke ka foto hape, e bataletse mme mabone a lekane.
said.enrolment-document-shape.8d2c9fdc.from: The copy is not legible. Please scan or photograph it again, flat and in good light.

said.enrolment-document-shape.a7aecdc1.text: ID e na le matsatsi a fetang le leng a netefatso. Ka kopo fana ka kopi e netefaditsweng hang, haufinyane.
said.enrolment-document-shape.a7aecdc1.from: The ID has more than one certification date on it. Please supply a copy certified once, recently.

said.enrolment-document-shape.ad8ee9a7.text: Ena ha se tokomane eo e kopilweng.
said.enrolment-document-shape.ad8ee9a7.from: This is not the document that was asked for.

said.enrolment-document-shape.d9deb62d.text: Ho na le maqephe a sa fumanweng.
said.enrolment-document-shape.d9deb62d.from: Some of the pages are missing.

said.enrolment-documents.07cca752.text: Ha ho letho le rekotilweng: sehlopha le moithuti ha ba na tefo khahlanong le bona.
said.enrolment-documents.07cca752.from: Nothing recorded: neither the cohort nor the learner has a payment against them.

said.enrolment-documents.221ad898.text: E patilwe ke moreki, khahlanong le {name}.
said.enrolment-documents.221ad898.from: Paid for by the client, against {name}.

said.enrolment-documents.26e4b850.text: Fa letsatsi leo kopi ena e netefaditsweng ka lona. Kopi eo letsatsi la netefatso ya yona le sa tsejweng e ke ke ya bontshwa e le ya hajwale.
said.enrolment-documents.26e4b850.from: Give the date this copy was certified. A copy whose certification date is unknown cannot be shown to be current.

said.enrolment-documents.330b87d3.text: Moithuti o iphile bopaki ba hae ba tefo.
said.enrolment-documents.330b87d3.from: The learner supplied their own proof of payment.

said.enrolment-documents.3f1d945a.text: Moithuti o file bopaki ba tefo, bo so hlahlojwe.
said.enrolment-documents.3f1d945a.from: The learner has supplied a proof of payment, not yet checked.

said.enrolment-documents.435df660.text: Bopaki ba tefo ba moithuti bo hanetswe.
said.enrolment-documents.435df660.from: The learner's proof of payment was refused.

said.enrolment-documents.98317f79.text: Bolela lebaka la hore e hanetswe. Moithuti o tlameha ho bolellwa seo a lokelang ho se lokisa, mme ho hana ho se nang lebaka ho mo kgutlisetsa a se na letho leo a ka le etsang.
said.enrolment-documents.98317f79.from: Say why it was refused. The learner has to be told what to correct, and a refusal with no reason sends them back with nothing to act on.

said.enrolment-documents.d417e6fa.text: Kopi eo e netefaditswe ka {certifiedOn}, e leng nako e fetang matsatsi a {CERTIFICATION_VALID_DAYS} e fetileng. Kopi e netefaditsweng e tlameha ho ba ya hajwale ha e fanwa.
said.enrolment-documents.d417e6fa.from: That copy was certified on {certifiedOn}, which is more than {CERTIFICATION_VALID_DAYS} days ago. A certified copy has to be current when it is supplied.

said.enrolment-documents.e88ccb00.text: Faele eo ha e a amohelwa: {reason}

said.enrolment-form.141771ac.text: Ho tswa lenaneong la dikhoutu tsa dibaka la STATSSA leo QCTO e le phatlalatsang.
said.enrolment-form.141771ac.from: From the STATSSA area code list the QCTO publishes.

said.enrolment-form.158eb69b.text: Tlaleho e botsa hore na moithuti o dumetse, le hore ke ka letsatsi lefe.
said.enrolment-form.158eb69b.from: The return asks whether the learner agreed, and on what date.

said.enrolment-form.3ecff80b.text: Bong bo rekotilweng ha bo tshwane le bo nomorong ya boitsebiso. QCTO e bo hlahloba, ka hoo e nngwe ya tse pedi e ngotswe hampe.
said.enrolment-form.3ecff80b.from: The gender recorded does not match the one in the identity number. The QCTO checks this, so one of the two is mistyped.

said.enrolment-form.5d06240c.text: Letsatsi la tswalo le rekotilweng ({recorded}) ha le tshwane le nomoro ya boitsebiso, e reng {fromId}.
said.enrolment-form.5d06240c.from: The date of birth recorded ({recorded}) does not match the identity number, which says {fromId}.

said.enrolment-form.7d5cda8a.text: E tiisitswe, mme letsatsi le a rekotwa. Haeba o fetola letho mona hamorao, e tla o kopa ho tiisa hape.
said.enrolment-form.7d5cda8a.from: Confirmed, and the date recorded. Change anything here later and it will ask you to confirm again.

said.enrolment-form.a380df96.text: E bolokilwe. O ka kgutla wa e qeta hamorao.
said.enrolment-form.a380df96.from: Saved. You can come back and finish it later.

said.enrolment-form.a8dcc4e9.text: Nomoro ya boitsebiso ha e a nepahala: {reason}
said.enrolment-form.a8dcc4e9.from: The identity number does not check out: {reason}

said.enrolment-form.b67325d1.text: Ha ho motho ya tiisitseng hore dintlha tsena di nepahetse. Molebedi o kopa foromo e le bopaki, mme e sa tiiswang ke bopaki bo bonyane haholo.
said.enrolment-form.b67325d1.from: Nobody has confirmed these details are right. A monitor asks for the form as evidence, and an unconfirmed one is evidence of very little.

said.enrolment-form.b711b7ce.text: Bokooa bo rekotilwe, mme QCTO ebe e hloka hore na bo baka bothata bo bokae.
said.enrolment-form.b711b7ce.from: A disability was recorded, and the QCTO then requires how much difficulty it causes.

said.enrolment-form.ca9579a9.text: Profense eo moithuti a sebetsang ho yona, e seng kamehla moo a phelang teng.
said.enrolment-form.ca9579a9.from: The province the learner works in, which is not always where they live.

said.enrolment.52c9b5f2.text: Ke kosi feela e phatlaladitsweng e ka abelwang moithuti.
said.enrolment.52c9b5f2.from: Only a published course can be assigned to a learner.

said.enrolment.65b99bc7.text: Motho eo o se a ngodisitswe kosing ena.
said.enrolment.65b99bc7.from: That person is already enrolled on this course.

said.enrolment.678cc7c5.text: Ha ho letsatsi la ho lokela mona.
said.enrolment.678cc7c5.from: There is no due date on this one.

said.enrolment.6ac9079d.text: Ngodiso eo ke ya motho e mong.
said.enrolment.6ac9079d.from: That enrolment belongs to someone else.

said.enrolment.79fda720.text: Ke moithuti feela ya ka rekotang tswelopele ya hae.
said.enrolment.79fda720.from: Only the learner can record their own progress.

said.enrolment.ab1eec65.text: Thuto eo ha se karolo ya kosi ena.
said.enrolment.ab1eec65.from: That lesson is not part of this course.

said.extensions-claude-code.149b1d9d.text: Claude Code ha e a kenngwa moo sethala se sebetsang teng.
said.extensions-claude-code.149b1d9d.from: Claude Code is not installed where the platform is running.

said.extensions-claude-code.1c9bd1dc.text: Claude Code e kentswe komporong ena empa ha ho motho ya kenileng. Bula terminal, tsamaisa claude, ebe /login mme o qete ho kena ka sebadi. Ke mohato o etswang hang, mme o etswa ke wena, eseng ke sethala.
said.extensions-claude-code.1c9bd1dc.from: Claude Code is installed on this machine but nobody is signed in. Open a terminal, run claude, then /login and complete the sign-in in the browser. That is a one-time step and it is done by you, not by the platform.

said.extensions-claude-code.30018e0d.text: Claude Code e ke ke ya qala: {error}

said.extensions-claude-code.446b5c16.text: Claude Code ha e a busetsa sephetho.

said.extensions-claude-code.53fe3e99.text: Moedi wa tshebediso wa subscription ya Claude o fihletswe. Sena se tla sebetsa hape ha moedi o beha bocha.
said.extensions-claude-code.53fe3e99.from: The Claude subscription's usage limit has been reached. This will work again once the limit resets.

said.extensions-claude-code.7f69ba19.text: E sebedisa subscription ya hao ya Claude, ka token eo o e iketsetsang komporong ya hao ka `claude setup-token`. Ha se API key: ha ho theko ya token ka nngwe, mme e sebedisa subscription eo o se o e patela, eseng e abelanwang.
said.extensions-claude-code.7f69ba19.from: Uses your own Claude subscription, through a token you generate on your own computer with `claude setup-token`. Not an API key: no per-token cost, and it draws on the subscription you already pay for rather than a shared one.

said.extensions-claude-code.801580be.text: Claude Code ha e a araba ka hare ho metsotswana e {timeoutMs}.
said.extensions-claude-code.801580be.from: Claude Code did not answer within {timeoutMs} seconds.

said.extensions-gemini.0473bc2d.text: Ha ho Gemini API key e bolokilweng bakeng sa hao. E kenye ho Ditlhophiso. E tswa ho Google AI Studio, mme ha e tshwane le subscription ya Gemini.
said.extensions-gemini.0473bc2d.from: No Gemini API key is stored for you. Add one in Settings. It comes from Google AI Studio, and is not the same as a Gemini subscription.

said.extensions-gemini.18ddcba7.text: Gemini API key eo ha e a nepahala. Hlahloba hore e kopilwe e phethehile ho tswa ho Google AI Studio. Ha e tshwane le subscription ya Gemini Advanced, e se na phihlello ya API.
said.extensions-gemini.18ddcba7.from: That Gemini API key is not valid. Check it was copied whole from Google AI Studio. It is not the same thing as a Gemini Advanced subscription, which does not include API access.

said.extensions-gemini.3bf73475.text: Moedi wa Google wa key eo o fihletswe. Leano la mahala le dumella dikopo tse fokolang ka motsotso; emela mme o leke hape, kapa o sebedise key e nang le billing e butsweng.
said.extensions-gemini.3bf73475.from: Google's rate limit for that key has been reached. The free tier allows a limited number of requests a minute; wait and try again, or use a key with billing enabled.

said.extensions-gemini.599b82c0.text: Gemini ha e a araba ka nako. Foldara e kgolo e ka nka metsotso e mmalwa; ho leka hape ka ditokomane tse fokolang ho atisa ho sebetsa.
said.extensions-gemini.599b82c0.from: Gemini did not answer in time. A large folder can take several minutes; trying again with fewer documents in it usually works.

said.extensions-gemini.5f764f27.text: Gemini e ke ke ya fihlelwa. Hlahloba hore komporo ena e na le kgokahano ya inthanete le Google.
said.extensions-gemini.5f764f27.from: Gemini could not be reached. Check that this machine has a network connection to Google.

said.extensions-gemini.6ff1fd27.text: Gemini e felletswe ke sebaka pele e qeta ho araba, ka hoo seo se buseditsweng ke karolo ya kharikhulamo eseng yohle, mme e sa phethang e shebahala jwaloka e phethetsweng. Ha ho letho le bolokilweng. Kwalifikeishene yohle ke ntho e kgolo haholo ho e kopa karabong e le nngwe; e kenye ho tswa ditokomaneng tsa yona ho e na le moo, e balang kharikhulamo ka kotloloho ntle le model mme e se na moedi o jwalo.
said.extensions-gemini.6ff1fd27.from: Gemini ran out of room before it finished answering, so what came back is part of a curriculum rather than all of it, and a partial one looks exactly like a complete one. Nothing was kept. A whole qualification is a great deal to ask for in a single reply; import it from its documents instead, which reads the curriculum directly with no model involved and no limit of this kind.

said.extensions-gemini.7b1ee4ba.text: Gemini e arabile ka letho. Hangata sena se bolela hore kopo e hanetswe ke sefiltara sa polokeho, kapa lebitso la model ha le a nepahala.
said.extensions-gemini.7b1ee4ba.from: Gemini answered with nothing. That usually means the request was refused by a safety filter, or the model name is wrong.

said.extensions-gemini.a3035142.text: Ditokomane tseo di fetisa ditlhaku tse {MAX_INPUT_CHARS},000, e leng ho fetang seo se ka romelwang kopong e le nngwe. Kenya kwalifikeishene ho tswa ditokomaneng tsa yona ho e na le moo: tokomane ya kharikhulamo feela e baleha ka kotloloho, ntle le model.
said.extensions-gemini.a3035142.from: Those documents come to more than {MAX_INPUT_CHARS},000 characters, which is more than can be sent in one request. Import the qualification from its documents instead: the curriculum document alone is read directly, with no model involved.

said.extensions-gemini.c9f3d2b7.text: Google e tlaleditse bothata ka lehlakoreng la bona ({status}). Kopo e nyenyane e lokela ho lekwa hape feela. Haeba e ne e le kwalifikeishene yohle mme e se e hlolehile makgetlo a fetang le leng, kopo e kanna ya ba kgolo haholo hore model e e phethe. E kenye ho tswa ditokomaneng tsa yona, e balang kharikhulamo ka kotloloho ntle le model.
said.extensions-gemini.c9f3d2b7.from: Google reported a problem on their side ({status}). A small request is worth simply trying again. If this was a whole qualification and it has now failed more than once, the request is most likely too large for the model to complete. Import it from its documents instead, which reads the curriculum directly with no model involved.

said.extensions-gemini.d7ab5352.text: Google e hanne key eo. E kanna ya be e hulotswe, kapa Generative Language API e kanna ya se buletswe projeke eo e leng ya yona. Ha ho na bothata ho sethala mme ha ho letho le lahlehileng.
said.extensions-gemini.d7ab5352.from: Google refused that key. It may have been revoked, or the Generative Language API may not be enabled on the project it belongs to. Nothing is wrong with the platform and nothing was lost.

said.extensions-gemini.eb60a381.text: E sebedisa Google AI Studio API key ya hao. Ha se subscription ya Gemini Advanced: ke sehlahiswa se fapaneng mme ha se na phihlello ya API. API e na le leano la mahala, ka hoo sena se ka sebediswa ntle le ho reka letho, ka hara meedi ya sona.
said.extensions-gemini.eb60a381.from: Uses your own Google AI Studio API key. Not a Gemini Advanced subscription: that is a separate product and does not include API access. The API has a free tier, so this can be used without buying anything, within its rate limits.

said.extensions-index.a66c08f2.text: Ena ke Anthropic API key, ha se token ya Claude Code. Ke dihlahiswa tse fapaneng mme mona ho hlokahala token: tsamaisa `claude setup-token` komporong ya hao mme o kgomarele seo e se ntshang. Haeba o na le API key, kgetha mofani ya e amohelang.
said.extensions-index.a66c08f2.from: That is an Anthropic API key, not a Claude Code token. They are different products and this one needs the token: run `claude setup-token` on your own computer and paste what it prints. If an API key is what you have, choose a provider that takes one.

said.extensions-index.d95a2478.text: Credential ya hao e bolokilweng e ke ke ya baleha, ka hoo mofani a ke ke a botsoa.
said.extensions-index.d95a2478.from: Your stored credential could not be read, so the provider could not be asked.

said.extensions-index.e95369f0.text: Ha o so behe keketso ya AI. E leqepheng la hao la akhaonto tlasa Ditlhophiso, ke ya hao eseng ya mokgatlo, mme e sebedisa token eo o e iketsetsang komporong ya hao.
said.extensions-index.e95369f0.from: You have not set up an AI extension. It is on your account page under Settings, it is yours rather than the tenant's, and it uses a token you generate on your own computer.

said.extensions-index.f448a040.text: Keketso ya hao ya AI e tima leqepheng la hao la akhaonto. Ha ho letho le lahlilweng: e bulele hape moo ha o e batla.
said.extensions-index.f448a040.from: Your AI extension is disabled on your account page. Nothing was discarded: switch it back on there when you want it.

said.extensions-index.f5c19ada.text: Keketso ya hao ya AI ha e a bulwa bakeng sa nako ena ya ho ngola. E bule moo o batlang ho e sebedisa; e qala e timile nako le nako ha o kena, mme e a tima ha o tswa.
said.extensions-index.f5c19ada.from: Your AI extension is not switched on for this sitting. Switch it on where you want to use it; it starts off every time you sign in, and switches off again when you sign out.

said.extensions-index.fc1b6fc7.text: Ho kenngwa ha sethala tshebetsong hono ha ho na encryption key e behilweng, ka hoo token e ke ke ya bolokwa ka polokeho. Ha ho letho le bolokilweng. Bolella ya tsamaisang seva.
said.extensions-index.fc1b6fc7.from: This deployment has no encryption key set, so a token cannot be stored safely. Nothing was saved. Tell whoever runs the server.

said.extensions-openai.02885124.from: OpenAI refused that key for this model. The account it belongs to may not have access to the model named in your settings.

said.extensions-openai.047d249a.text: OpenAI e hanne key eo. E kanna ya be e hulotswe, kapa e ne e so ka e nepahala. Note that a ChatGPT Plus subscription does not include API access: an API key is a separate thing, created at platform.openai.com. Nothing is wrong with the platform and nothing was lost.

said.extensions-openai.1d2edb4d.from: OpenAI did not answer in time. A large folder can take several minutes; trying again with fewer documents in it usually works.

said.extensions-openai.241eaa9a.from: That OpenAI account has no credit left. Unlike Gemini, the OpenAI API has no free tier: it is charged against the account the key belongs to.

said.extensions-openai.5f8151b1.text: Moedi wa OpenAI wa key eo o fihletswe. Emela hanyane mme o leke hape.
said.extensions-openai.5f8151b1.from: OpenAI's rate limit for that key has been reached. Wait a little and try again.

said.extensions-openai.60c45cc3.text: OpenAI e arabile ka letho. Hangata sena se bolela hore lebitso la model ha le a nepahala, kapa kopo e hanetswe.
said.extensions-openai.60c45cc3.from: OpenAI answered with nothing. That usually means the model name is wrong, or the request was refused.

said.extensions-openai.d344fc6b.text: Ha ho OpenAI API key e bolokilweng bakeng sa hao. E kenye ho Ditlhophiso. E tswa ho platform.openai.com, mme ha e tshwane le subscription ya ChatGPT.
said.extensions-openai.d344fc6b.from: No OpenAI API key is stored for you. Add one in Settings. It comes from platform.openai.com, and is not the same as a ChatGPT subscription.

Ho fapana le Gemini ha ho na leano la mahala, ka hoo dikopo di patwa akhaonto eo key e leng ya yona.
said.extensions-openai.dacd1031.from: Uses your own OpenAI API key, created at platform.openai.com. Not a ChatGPT Plus subscription: that is a separate product and does not include API access. Unlike Gemini there is no free tier, so calls are charged to the account the key belongs to.

said.extensions-openai.e6f50a09.text: OpenAI e ke ke ya fihlelwa. Hlahloba hore komporo ena e na le kgokahano ya inthanete.

said.feedback.145353f6.text: Tlhahlobo e ne e le teko e nepahetseng ya seo se rutilweng.
said.feedback.145353f6.from: The assessment was a fair test of what was taught.

said.feedback.510134e7.text: Nka sebedisa seo ke ithutileng sona mosebetsing wa ka.
said.feedback.510134e7.from: I can use what I learned in my job.

Credit Accumulation and Transfer covers completions within {CAT_YEARS2} years; beyond that the route is Recognition of Prior Learning, which assesses what the learner can still do rather than what they once passed. said.study-unit-alignment.dfcd9590.text: Tokomane e reha di-module tse {wantedCount} ({wanted}) mme kwalifikeishene ena ha e so ka e ba le kharikhulamo. Kenya kharikhulamo pele; dikarolo tsa ho ithuta le diphetho tsa tsona di rekotwa ka bobedi, mme ho kenya tokomane ena hape kamora moo ho tla di hokela.

said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.text: Ha ho le e nngwe ya di-module tse {wantedCount} tseo tokomane ena e di rehang e ka tshwantshwang, ka hoo ha ho letho le behilweng tlasa karolo ya ho ithuta. Tokomane e reha {wanted}. Kharikhulamo ena e na le {held}. Ho tshwantshanya ho hlokomolla dikgeo le di-hyphen, ka hoo merero e mmedi e a fapana ka nnete. Lokisa dikhoutu ka lehlakoreng le leng kapa le leng mme o kenye tokomane hape.
said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.from: None of the {wantedCount} modules this document names could be matched, so nothing has been placed under a study unit. The document names {wanted}. This curriculum holds {held}. Matching ignores spaces and hyphens, so the two schemes genuinely differ. Correct the codes on either side and upload the document again.

evidence.fingerprintNote.from: If any stored file were ever altered, its fingerprint would stop matching. That protects your work as much as it protects the assessment.

cert.notNational.from: This is {provider}'s own certificate for a course it delivered. It is not a national qualification and does not carry a SAQA credit or identifier. Where a learner is working towards an occupational qualification, the certificate for it is issued by the QCTO.

work.introCoach.text: Baithuti bao o ba okametseng. O tlhomamisa se ba se dirileng kwa tirong; ga go sepe se se ya kwa go motlhatlhobi kwa ntle ga tshaeno ya gago.
work.introCoach.from: The learners you supervise. You confirm what they did in the workplace; nothing reaches an assessor without your signature.

work.introLearner.text: Maitemogelo a tiro a dirwa kwa mothapong mme a tlhomamisiwa ke mokoetlisi wa lefelo la tiro koo. Tatelano e tsepame: o a e rekota, mokoetlisi wa gago o a e tlhomamisa, morago e ya kwa go motlhatlhobi.
work.introLearner.from: Work experience is done at an employer and signed off by the workplace coach there. The order is fixed: you record it, your coach confirms it, then it goes to an assessor.

work.waitingOne.text: {record} e le 1 e go emetse tshaeno ya gago.

work.waitingMany.text: {count} tse {records} di go emetse tshaeno ya gago.

work.noneManage.text: Ga go na {records} le fa e le jaanong. Thulaganya nngwe kwa godimo: tumalano e e umakang moithuti, mothapi le mokoetlisi, morago e le nngwe ya modiule mongwe le mongwe wa maitemogelo a tiro.
work.noneManage.from: No {records} yet. Set one up above: an agreement naming the learner, the employer and the coach, then one for each work experience module.

work.none.text: Ga go na {records} le fa e le jaanong. Molaodi o bula nngwe fa tumalano ya lefelo la tiro e e umakang moithuti, mothapi le mokoetlisi e setse e le teng.
work.none.from: No {records} yet. An administrator opens one once a workplace agreement is in place naming the learner, the employer and the coach.

work.outstanding.from: Still outstanding: {items}. Your coach cannot sign until every line is done and every piece of supporting evidence has a file attached.

work.allRecorded.text: Sengwe le sengwe se rekotilwe. Se romele kwa go mokoetlisi wa gago fa o ipaakantse.
work.allRecorded.from: Everything is recorded. Send it to your coach when you are ready.

work.signingMeans.text: Go tshwaya go rekota gore o sekasekile bosupi jono mme o tla bo tlhomamisa fa motlhatlhobi a ikgolaganya le wena. Ga bo ka bo fetolwa morago ga moo.
work.signingMeans.from: Signing records that you checked this evidence and will attest to it if the assessor contacts you. It cannot be changed afterwards.

certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.from: The learner may have given the reference to an employer. It keeps resolving and will say it was withdrawn.

assessing.intro.text: Dikabo tse di siametseng katlholo ya bokgoni. O ka se tlhatlhobe tiro ya gago; karolo ya ditshwetso tsa gago e tla sekasekiwa ka go ikemela ke mosekaseki.
assessing.intro.from: Submissions ready for a competency judgement. You cannot assess your own work, and a proportion of your decisions will be reviewed independently by a moderator.

assessing.empty.text: Ga go na sepe se se emetseng. Dikabo di tlhaga fano fa baithuti ba di romela.
assessing.empty.from: Nothing is waiting. Submissions appear here as learners send them in.

assessing.onScreen.text: Seno se arabilwe mo skrineng. {link}: dikarabo, kaelo ya go tshwaya le matrikse di mmogo koo, mme dintlhakgolo di dirwa go wena fa e setse e tshwailwe.
assessing.onScreen.from: This was answered on screen. {link}: the answers, the marking guidance and the matrix are together there, and the criteria are worked out for you once it is marked.

assessing.ownWork.text: Seno ke kabo ya gago. O ka se e tlhatlhobe; mongwe o tshwanetse go e dira.
assessing.ownWork.from: This is your own submission. You cannot assess it; someone else must.

assessing.hash.text: Hash e rekotiwa fa go tsengwa. Fa faele e e bolokilweng e fetolwa, ga e sa tlhole e lekana mme rekoto e tshwaiwa.
assessing.hash.from: The hash is recorded at upload. If a stored file is ever altered, it no longer matches and the record is flagged.

assessing.decisions.text: Ditshwetso tse di setseng di rekotilwe

assessing.perCriterion.text: Kgatlhanong le tekanyetso nngwe le nngwe

assessing.whyDiffers.text: Goreng, ka ge e sa tshwane le se dintlha di se akantshang
assessing.whyDiffers.from: Why, since it differs from what the marks propose

assessing.whyDiffersLabel.text: Goreng {code} e sa tshwane le tshitshinyo

assessing.permanent.text: Leina la gago, letlha le tshwaelo eno di bolokwa ka mo go sa khutleng mme ga di ka tsa fetolwa morago. Tshiamiso e rekotiwa jaaka tshwetso e ntšha.
assessing.permanent.from: Your name, the date and this comment are stored permanently and cannot be edited afterwards. A correction is recorded as a new decision.

marking.implies.text: Se dintlha tseno di se kaya

marking.impliesIntro.text: Palo, e seng katlholo. Dintlha di lekana ka tsela eno; tiragatso ya tiro le bosupi jwa lefelo la tiro ga di goroge kwa sethaleng, mme o di lekanya pele o tsaya tshwetso. Fetola sepe sa tseno mo skrineng ya tshwetso mme o re goreng: lebaka le bolokwa gaufi le tshitshinyo gore mosekaseki a bone gore tse pedi di aroganye kae.
marking.impliesIntro.from: Arithmetic, not a judgement. The marks average out at this; practical performance and workplace evidence do not reach the platform, and you weigh those before deciding. Change any of these on the decision screen and say why: the reason is stored beside the proposal so a moderator can see where the two parted.

marking.markAllFirst.text: Potso nngwe le nngwe e tshwanetse go tshwaiwa pele ga gore ditekanyetso di ka bonwa.
marking.markAllFirst.from: Every question has to be marked before the criteria can be worked out.

marking.summative.text: Seno se a tlhatlhobiwa. Fa potso nngwe le nngwe e setse e tshwailwe, rekota tshwetso: ditekanyetso tse e di tlhomamisang di akanngwa gore o di tlhomamise.
marking.summative.from: This is assessed. Once every question is marked, record a decision: the criteria it evidences are proposed for you to confirm.

marking.formative.text: Seno ke buka ya tiro. Ke ya tlhabololo: e tshwaye, morago o busetse ditshwaelo. Ga go na sepe fano se se rekotang bokgoni kgotsa se isang moithuti kwa pele go ya go tshwanelega.
marking.formative.from: This is a workbook. It is developmental: mark it, then return feedback. Nothing here records competence or moves the learner towards eligibility.

marking.toMarkOne.text: Potso e le 1 e santse e tshwanetse go tshwaiwa.

marking.toMarkMany.text: Dipotso tse {count} di santse di tshwanetse go tshwaiwa.

marking.notMarked.text: Dintlha tse {points} · ga di ise di tshwaiwe

marking.blank.text: E tlogetswe e se na sepe.

marking.matrix.text: Matrikse a go tshwaya: go tlhopha legato la nngwe le nngwe go fa ntlha
marking.matrix.from: Marking matrix: choosing a level for each gives the mark

marking.toldHint.text: Fa e neng e le maatla le se se neng se tlhaela.
marking.toldHint.from: Where it was strong, and what was missing.

marking.returnIntro.text: Ditshwaelo, e seng tshwetso. Di bolelela moithuti gore o boele kae pele ga tlhatlhobo ya bofelo, mme ga di rekote bokgoni kgatlhanong le tekanyetso epe.
marking.returnIntro.from: Feedback, not a decision. It tells the learner what to go back to before the summative, and it records no competence against any criterion.

marking.returnHint.text: Se se neng se tlhomame, le se o tshwanetseng go se bala gape pele ga tlhatlhobo ya bofelo.
marking.returnHint.from: What was solid, and what to re-read before the summative.

marking.concern.text: Ditekanyetso tse dikarabo tse di bokoa di kgobokanang mo go tsone
marking.concern.from: Criteria the weak answers cluster around

marking.markEveryFirst.text: Tshwaya potso nngwe le nngwe pele.

marking.sectionHint.text: Se se dirilweng sentle fano, le se se tshwanetseng go dirwa ka tsela e sele ka nako e e latelang.
marking.sectionHint.from: What went well here, and what to do differently next time.

marking.learnerSees.text: Moithuti o e bona le ditshwaelo tsa gagwe.
marking.learnerSees.from: The learner sees this with their feedback.

moderating.intro.text: Tsekaseko e e ikemetseng ya ditshwetso tsa batlhatlhobi. Ke sistimi e e tlhophang gore ke ditshwetso dife tse di tlang mo lenaaneng leno, e seng motho. O ka se sekaseke tshwetso e o e dirileng wena.
moderating.intro.from: Independent review of assessors' decisions. Which decisions reach this list is decided by the system, not chosen by anyone. You cannot moderate a decision you made yourself.

moderating.empty.text: Ga go na sepe se se emetseng go sekasekiwa.

moderating.reason.full_moderation.text: Ya bofelo: tshwetso nngwe le nngwe e a sekasekiwa

moderating.reason.new_assessor.text: Motlhatlhobi yo o sa tswang go kwadiswa: o sekasekiwa ka botlalo
moderating.reason.new_assessor.from: Newly registered assessor: moderated in full

moderating.reason.random_sample.text: E tlhophilwe ka sampolo ya go sa rulaganngwa

moderating.referBack.text: Busetsa: motlhatlhobi a tshwanetse go e leba gape
moderating.referBack.from: Refer back: the assessor should look again

moderating.ownDecision.text: O dirile tshwetso eno jaaka motlhatlhobi, ka jalo o ka se e sekaseke. Mosekaseki yo mongwe o tshwanetse go e dira.
moderating.ownDecision.from: You made this decision as the assessor, so you cannot moderate it. Another moderator must.

pack.instrumentIntro.from: The paper as it was set, and the guidance it was marked against.

pack.scriptsIntro.text: Di tsewa mo mothamong otlhe wa dintlha (se se kwa godimo, se se kwa tlase le se se magareng) gore go tshwaya go bonwe fa go le botoka le fa go le bosula, e seng fela magareng.
pack.scriptsIntro.from: Taken across the mark range (top, bottom and spread between) so the marking is seen at its best and its worst rather than in the middle.

pack.departuresIntro.text: Fa motlhatlhobi a ne a farologana le se dintlha di se akantshang, kgotsa mosekaseki a farologana le motlhatlhobi. Pakete e e tlogelang tseno e maswe go gaisa e e se nang sepe.
pack.departuresIntro.from: Where an assessor differed from what the marks proposed, or a moderator differed from the assessor. A pack that leaves these out is worse than no pack.

pack.noReason.text: ga go na lebaka le le rekotilweng

pack.exceptionsIntro.text: Baithuti ba ba tlogetswe ba fetela kwa pele ke motho yo o umakilweng, ka lebaka le a le neileng.
pack.exceptionsIntro.from: Learners let past a gate by a named person, with the reason they gave.

pack.assembled.text: E kokoantswe {date} go tswa mo rekotong.

held.intro.text: Moithuti yo o fitlhetsweng a ise a nonofe gabedi ga a a paletswe. Tlhatlhobo e a tshwarwa, mme go bidiwa tekolo ya lenaneo le mothapi wa gagwe, ka gonne ka nako eno potso e sa tlhole e le gore a a itse, mme gantsi e le gore go direga eng go mo dikologa.
held.intro.from: A learner found not yet competent twice is not failed. The assessment is held, and a programme review is convened with their employer, because by this point the question is rarely whether they know it, and usually what has been going on around them.

held.emptyTitle.text: Ga go na yo o tshwerweng

held.empty.text: Seno se a tlala fa moithuti a fitlhelwa a ise a nonofe la bobedi mo tlhatlhobong ya bofelo. Go fitlha foo ga go na sepe se se tshwanetseng go sekasekiwa.
held.empty.from: This fills when a learner is found not yet competent for a second time on a summative assessment. Until then there is nothing to review.

held.results.text: {assessment} · diphetho tse {count} tsa go ise a nonofe

held.whoConvenes.text: Motsamaisi kgotsa molaodi o bitsa tekolo.
held.whoConvenes.from: A facilitator or administrator convenes the review.

held.oralAuthorised.text: {assessment} · tekolo e letlelelwe leiteko la boraro, le dirwang ka molomo
held.oralAuthorised.from: {assessment} · the review authorised a third attempt, conducted orally

held.whoConducts.text: Motlhatlhobi o dira leiteko la molomo, e seng motho yo o le letlelelang.
held.whoConducts.from: An assessor conducts the oral attempt, and not the person who authorised it.

held.oral.text: Leiteko la boraro, le dirwang ka molomo

held.furtherLearning.text: Go ithuta go oketsegileng pele ga leiteko lepe le lengwe
held.furtherLearning.from: Further learning before any further attempt

held.whyHint.text: Se tekolo e se fitlhetseng, le se e se ikaegileng ka sone.
held.whyHint.from: What the review found, and what it turns on.

oral.reviewDecidedIntro.text: Mabaka a leiteko lena la boraro le letlelelweng ka one.
oral.reviewDecidedIntro.from: The grounds on which this third attempt was authorised.

oral.employerNotConsulted.text: Mothapi ga a a kopiwa maikutlo.

oral.recordIntro.text: Leiteko la molomo ga le tlogele bosupi jwa lone. Seno ke bosupi joo, mme phetho e ka se rekotiwe kwa ntle ga jone.
oral.recordIntro.from: An oral attempt leaves no evidence of its own. This is that evidence, and the outcome cannot be recorded without it.

oral.nothingYet.text: Ga go ise go rekotiwe sepe.

oral.outcomeIntro.text: E atlholwa ka tsela e e tshwanang le leiteko le le kwadilweng, kgatlhanong le ditekanyetso tse di tshwanang, mme e sekasekiwa ka tsela e e tshwanang morago.
oral.outcomeIntro.from: Judged the same way as a written attempt, against the same criteria, and moderated the same way afterwards.

oral.goMark.text: Ya kwa skrineng ya go tshwaya

oral.how.text: Ka moo e neng e dirwa ka teng

oral.howHint.text: Ka sebele, kgotsa mo mogaleng wa widio o e neng e tshwerweng ka one
oral.howHint.from: In person, or the video call it was held on

oral.present.text: Ke mang yo mongwe yo o neng a le teng

oral.presentNote.text: Ga go patelesege. Tlhatlhobo ya molomo e e senang mongwe mo phaposing e thata go e sireletsa fa go sekasekiwa, mme rekoto e tshwanetse go bolela gore e ne e le ya mofuta ofe.
oral.presentNote.from: Not required. An oral assessment with nobody else in the room is harder to defend at moderation, and the record should say which kind this was.

oral.savedNext.text: Phetho e rekotiwa mo skrineng ya go tshwaya, jaaka leiteko lepe le lengwe.
oral.savedNext.from: The outcome is recorded on the marking screen, the same as any other attempt.

appeals.intro.text: Moithuti a ka ipiletsa kgatlhanong le phetho kgotsa boitshwaro jwa motlhatlhobi. Go amogelwa go rurifadiwa mo diureng tse {hours}, e leng nako e gantsi e tlogelwang, ka gonne e tsamaya fa mongwe a ruta.
appeals.intro.from: A learner may appeal against a result or against an assessor's conduct. Receipt is acknowledged within {hours} hours, which is the deadline that gets missed, because it runs while somebody is teaching.

appeals.late.text: {count} ga e a rurifadiwa mo nakong

appeals.lateIntro.text: Diura tse {hours} di fetile mme e santse e sa rurifadiwa. Go rurifatsa morago ga nako go botoka go na le go sa rurifatse, mme rekoto e tla bontsha tsotlhe tse pedi.
appeals.lateIntro.from: Past the {hours} hours and still not acknowledged. Acknowledging late is better than not at all, and the record will show both.

appeals.openIntro.text: Tsotlhe tse di tsentsweng le tse di ise di tswalelwe, tse dintšha pele.
appeals.openIntro.from: Everything lodged and not yet closed, newest first.

appeals.none.text: Ga go na sepe se se bulegileng. Boipiletso bo tsentswa go tswa mo letlakaleng la moithuti ka bosone.
appeals.none.from: Nothing open. An appeal is lodged from a learner's own page.

appeals.procedureIntro.text: Rurifatsa, kopana le moithuti, botsa mosekaseki fa lebaka e le phetho, morago o rarabolole mme o ba bolelele.
appeals.procedureIntro.from: Acknowledge, meet the learner, consult the moderator where the ground is a result, then resolve and tell them.

appeals.closedUnacknowledged.text: E tswaletswe kwa ntle ga gore go rurifatsa go rekotiwe.
appeals.closedUnacknowledged.from: Closed without an acknowledgement being recorded.

appeals.firstCounts.text: Go rurifatsa ga ntlha ke go go bolokwang ke rekoto. Ga go kake ga tlhola go tshwaiwa gape, ka gonne nako e e ka fetolwang ga se bosupi jwa sepe.
appeals.firstCounts.from: The first acknowledgement is the one the record keeps. It cannot be re-stamped later, because a time that can be changed is not evidence of anything.

appeals.resultNeedsModerator.text: Boipiletso jwa phetho bo ya kwa go mosekaseki wa selegae pele bo ka rarabololwa. Ke kgato eo moneteledi wa kwa ntle a botsang ka yone.
appeals.resultNeedsModerator.from: A result appeal goes to the internal moderator before it can be resolved. That is the step an external verifier asks about.

appeals.conductNoModerator.text: Boipiletso jwa boitshwaro ga se sepe se go tshwaya gape go se rarabololang, ka jalo ga go tlhokege mosekaseki.
appeals.conductNoModerator.from: A conduct appeal is not something re-marking settles, so no moderator is required.

appeals.notFeedback.text: Tshwetso e moithuti a sa e neelwang ga se ditshwaelo.
appeals.notFeedback.from: A decision the learner has not been given is not feedback.

appeals.whyHint.text: Goreng. Ke karolo e moithuti a e nang le tshwanelo ya go e bona.
appeals.whyHint.from: Why. This is the part the learner is entitled to.

appeals.notesIntro.text: Puisano magareng ga mokoordinata, motlhatlhobi le mosekaseki. Ga e bontshiwe moithuti fa o sa re jalo; se a nang le tshwanelo ya go se bona ke phetho le mabaka a a kwa godimo.
appeals.notesIntro.from: The discussion between coordinator, assessor and moderator. Not shown to the learner unless you say so; what they are entitled to is the outcome and the reasoning above.

appeals.noteHint.text: Se se builweng, le le mang
appeals.noteHint.from: What was discussed, and with whom

appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.text: Go goga go tlhoka lebaka. Go se na lebaka go lebega e le kgatelelo, mme seo ke sone se boipiletso jwa boitshwaro bo ka bong bo bua ka sone.
appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.from: A withdrawal needs a reason. One with none looks like pressure, and that is exactly what an appeal about conduct would be about.

rpl.title.text: Go amogelwa ga thuto ya pele

rpl.intro.text: Go moithuti yo o setseng a kgona karolo ya tiro. Ga go na sepe se se newang fano ka lefoko la motho a le mongwe: katlholo e dirwa kgatlhanong le ditekanyetso tsa modiule ka bosone, e kwalwa ka botlalo, mme e sekasekiwa ke mongwe yo e seng yo o e dirileng pele e ka bala.
rpl.intro.from: For a learner who can already do part of the work. Nothing here is granted on one person's say-so: a judgement is made against the module's own criteria, written down in full, and moderated by somebody other than whoever made it before it counts for anything.

rpl.noneWaiting.text: Ga go na sepe se se emetseng mosekaseki

rpl.waitingIntro.text: Katlholo ga e nee sepe go fitlhela seno se dirwa. Bala lebaka kgatlhanong le modiule pele o dumela: ke selo sa ntlha se moneteledi wa kwa ntle a se balang.
rpl.waitingIntro.from: A judgement grants nothing until this is done. Read the rationale against the module before agreeing: it is the first thing an external verifier reads.

rpl.appearHere.text: Ditshwetso di tlhaga fano fa di dirwa.
rpl.appearHere.from: Judgements appear here as they are made.

rpl.openIntro.text: Kgato ya ntlha, le e e tlhomang rekoto e sengwe le sengwe se kgomarelang mo go yone.
rpl.openIntro.from: The first step, and the one that creates the record everything else attaches to.

rpl.transferIntro.text: Go farologana le RPL: moithuti o setse a na le boitseanape jo diphetho tsa jone di akaretsang modiule ono. Ga go na kgakololo, mme go tshwanetse go kwalwa gore di tshwana jang; go fetisetsa go se nang seo ke kgopolo e go seng ope yo a ka e netefatsang.
rpl.transferIntro.from: Different from RPL: the learner already holds a qualification whose outcomes cover this module. No advisory, but the mapping has to be written down; a transfer without it is a claim nobody can check.

rpl.needsBoth.text: Kopo e tlhoka moithuti le boitseanape jo a ka kopang kgatlhanong le jone. Di oketse pele.
rpl.needsBoth.from: An application needs a learner and a qualification to apply against. Add those first.

rpl.needsLearner.text: Oketsa moithuti pele o rekota go fetisetsa mo go ene.
rpl.needsLearner.from: Add a learner before recording a transfer for one.

rpl.module.text: Modiule o go fetisediwang mo go one

rpl.holds.text: Se ba setseng ba na le sone

rpl.awardedBy.text: Yo o se neileng (ga go patelesege)

rpl.mapping.text: Ka moo diphetho tsa se ba setseng ba na le sone di akaretsang tsa modiule ono
rpl.mapping.from: How the outcomes of what they hold cover this module's

rpl.checked.text: Se o se sekasekileng, le se o se fitlheletseng
rpl.checked.from: What you checked, and what you concluded

record.print.text: Gatisa letlakala leno gore o le boloke jaaka PDF ya portefolio ya bosupi.
record.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF for the portfolio of evidence.

record.timeExpired.text: Ga e a amogelwa: nako e fedile mme tiro e neetswe jaaka e ne e ntse.
record.timeExpired.from: Not accepted: the time limit expired and the work was handed in as it stood.

record.returned.text: E busediwe {date}. Seno ke tlhabololo: ga se rekote bokgoni.
record.returned.from: Returned {date}. This is developmental: it records no competence.

marking.notMarkedOne.text: Ntlha e le 1 · ga e ise e tshwaiwe

sor.withdrawConsequence.text: Lefelo la tlhatlhobo le ka tswa le na le kopi. Tshupetso e tla tswelela go dira mme e tla re e gogilwe.
sor.withdrawConsequence.from: An assessment centre may already hold a copy. The reference keeps working and will say it was withdrawn.

sor.print.text: Gatisa kgotsa boloka Setatemente seno sa Diphetho
sor.print.from: Print or save this Statement of Results

fisa.title.text: Tlhatlhobo ya bofelo e e kopaneng

fisa.intro.text: Pampiri eno e beilwe ke moabi mo lenaneong la gagwe la dikgono. Ka go farologana le tlhatlhobo ya kwa ntle, o e kwala mme o e sekaseka, ka jalo tsekaseko e direga pele ga gore mongwe a e kwale, mme pampiri e e sa tshwaelwang gore e siametse maikaelelo ga e ka dirisiwa.
fisa.intro.from: The paper this provider sets for its own skills programme. Unlike an external assessment, you write it and you moderate it, so the moderation happens before anybody sits it, and a paper that has not been signed off as fit for purpose cannot be used.

fisa.waitingIntro.text: Ga go na yo o ka e kwalang go fitlha mosekaseki a di tshwaya.
fisa.waitingIntro.from: Nobody can sit these until a moderator signs them off.

fisa.usable.text: {count} di tshwailwe mme di ka dirisiwa.

fisa.noneYet.text: Ga go ise go nne le sepe.

fisa.setNewIntro.text: Kgatlhanong le lenaneo la dikgono. Boitseanape jo bo feletseng kgotsa jwa karolo bo tlhatlhobiwa kwa ntle.
fisa.setNewIntro.from: Against a skills programme. A full or part qualification is assessed externally.

fisa.gate.approved.text: E tshwailwe e siametse maikaelelo: baithuti ba ka kwala pampiri eno
fisa.gate.approved.from: Signed off as fit for purpose: candidates may sit this paper

fisa.gate.in_moderation.text: Kwa go mosekaseki: ga go na yo o ka e kwalang jaanong
fisa.gate.in_moderation.from: With the moderator: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.gate.draft.text: E a kwalwa: ga go na yo o ka e kwalang jaanong
fisa.gate.draft.from: Being written: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.approvedOn.text: E sekasekilwe mme ya dumelelwa ka {date}.

fisa.beforeNotAfter.text: FISA e a sekasekiwa pele ga go kwalwa, e seng morago. Seo ke sone se e dirang gore e ka sireletsega kwa ketelong ya tlhokomelo.
fisa.beforeNotAfter.from: A FISA is moderated before it is sat, not after. That is what makes it defensible at a monitoring visit.

fisa.practical.text: E na le karolo ya tiragatso, e atlholwang e nonofile kgotsa e ise e nonofe.
fisa.practical.from: Also has a practical component, judged competent or not yet competent.

fisa.moderatorIntro.text: O tlhola gore e siametse maikaelelo, pele ga gore mongwe a e kwale.
fisa.moderatorIntro.from: Checks it is fit for purpose, before anybody sits it.

fisa.noContact.text: Ga go na dintlha tsa go ikgolaganya tse di rekotilweng

fisa.unsigned.text: Ga go na tumalano ya tsephiso le fa e le jaanong. Ba ka se bone kgotsa ba atlholele pampiri go fitlha e tshwailwe.
fisa.unsigned.from: No confidentiality agreement yet. They may not see or judge the paper until it is signed.

fisa.nobody.text: Ga go ise go tlhophiwe mongwe.

fisa.outcomes.text: Diphetho tsa maemo a go tswa, le kwa pampiri e di tlhatlhobang teng
fisa.outcomes.from: Exit level outcomes, and where the paper assesses them

fisa.outcomesIntro.text: Karolo 2 ya dipego tsotlhe tse pedi. Ke lefelo le le lengwe fela le le bontshang gore pampiri e akaretsa boitseanape, e seng fela go tshwana le tlhatlhobo.
fisa.outcomesIntro.from: Section 2 of both reports. The only place that shows the paper covers the qualification rather than merely looking like an exam.

fisa.noOutcomes.text: Lenaneo leno ga le na diphetho tsa maemo a go tswa tse di rekotilweng, ka jalo ga go na sepe se pampiri e ka bapisiwang le sone. Tsenya tokomane ya kharikhulamo pele.
fisa.noOutcomes.from: This programme has no exit level outcomes recorded, so there is nothing to map the paper against. Import the curriculum first.

fisa.onlyExaminer.text: Ke moeletsi yo o tlhophilweng fela, fa tumalano ya gagwe ya tsephiso e tshwailwe, yo o ka arabang tseno.
fisa.onlyExaminer.from: Only the appointed examiner, once their confidentiality agreement is signed, can answer these.

fisa.onlyModerator.text: Ke mosekaseki yo o tlhophilweng fela, fa tumalano ya gagwe ya tsephiso e tshwailwe, yo o ka arabang tseno.
fisa.onlyModerator.from: Only the appointed moderator, once their confidentiality agreement is signed, can answer these.

fisa.handOverIntro.text: Fa pego ya gago e feletse.
fisa.handOverIntro.from: Once your own report is complete.

fisa.laterIntro.text: E e dula jaaka e ntse, ka gonne baithuti ba ka tswa ba e kwadile. Phetolelo e ntšha e tlhoka tsekaseko ya yone.
fisa.laterIntro.from: This one stays exactly as it is, because candidates may have sat it. A new version needs its own moderation.

fisa.noProgrammes.text: FISA e beelwa kgatlhanong le lenaneo la dikgono, mme ga go na le fa e le nngwe jaanong. Tsenya nngwe pele; boitseanape jo bo feletseng kgotsa jwa karolo bo tlhatlhobiwa kwa ntle ke Molekane wa Boleng jwa Tlhatlhobo, ka jalo moabi ga a beele pampiri eo.
fisa.noProgrammes.from: A FISA is set against a skills programme, and there are none yet. Import one first; a full or part qualification is assessed externally by the Assessment Quality Partner, so the provider does not set that paper.

fisa.callItHint.text: FISA: nako ya ntlha ya go kwala

fisa.passNote.text: FISA ke tlhatlhobo, ka jalo e na le one, ka go farologana le bokgoni jwa selegae.
fisa.passNote.from: A FISA is an examination, so it has one, unlike internal competence.

fisa.hasPractical.text: E na le karolo ya tiragatso e e atlholwang e nonofile kgotsa e ise e nonofe
fisa.hasPractical.from: It also has a practical component judged competent or not yet competent

fisa.practicalHint.text: sk. Tiragatso: diura di le 4, e atlholwa e nonofile / e ise e nonofe
fisa.practicalHint.from: e.g. Practical: 4 hours, judged competent / not yet competent

fisa.idNote.text: Ka moo sethala se farologanyang motho yo mongwe le yo mongwe fa ba se na akhaonto fano.
fisa.idNote.from: How the platform tells one person from another when they have no account here.

fisa.account.text: Akhaonto ya gagwe fano, fa a na le yone
fisa.account.from: Their account here, if they have one

fisa.outside.text: Mongwe wa kwa ntle, yo o se nang akhaonto
fisa.outside.from: Somebody from outside, with no account

fisa.accountNote.text: Ke motho yo o nang le akhaonto fela yo o ka tlatsang pego ya gagwe fano.
fisa.accountNote.from: Only somebody with an account can fill in their own report here.

fisa.standardComment.text: Nopolo ka maemo a a fitlhelweng

fisa.further.text: Ditshwaelo tse dingwe tsa go tokafatsa maemo a tlhatlhobo
fisa.further.from: Further comments for the improvement of assessment standards

fisa.signOff.from: Sign off as fit for purpose

fisa.untilYouDo.text: Ga go na moithuti yo o ka kwalang pampiri eno go fitlha o dira jalo.
fisa.untilYouDo.from: No candidate may sit this paper until you do.

eisa.intro.text: Nako nngwe le nngwe ya go kwala e leng leng, kwadiso ya yone e tswalelwa leng, le gore ke ditlhopha dife tse di santseng di tshwanetse go kwadiswa. Kwadiso gantsi e tswalelwa dikgwedi di le tharo pele, ke ka moo setlhopha se se fetsang morago ga ngwaga se tshwanetseng go kwadiswa e sale pele se fela.
eisa.intro.from: When each sitting is, when registration for it closes, and which cohorts still have to be entered. Registration typically closes about three months ahead, which is why a cohort finishing later in the year has to be entered long before it finishes.

eisa.registerNowIntro.text: Kwadiso e tswalelwa mo malatsing a le lesome a tiro mme ditlhopha tseno ga di na letlha la kwadiso le le rekotilweng.
eisa.registerNowIntro.from: Registration closes within ten working days and these cohorts have no registration date recorded.

eisa.sittingsIntro.text: Fela tse di santseng di bulegetse kwadiso. E e tswaletsweng ga se sepe se motho a ka se dirang ka sone, mme go e tlogela fano go ka isa letlha le le latelang la nnete kwa tlase ga letlakala.
eisa.sittingsIntro.from: Only those still open for registration. A closed one is nothing anybody can act on, and leaving it here would push the next real deadline down the page.

eisa.nextYear.text: Ga go na sepe se se rekotilweng go feta ngwaga ono. Molekane wa boleng jwa tlhatlhobo o phatlalatsa ditlha tsa ngwaga o o tlang ka Tshitwe, ka jalo lekwalo le tshwanetse go bo le ntshitswe; go di tsenya jaanong ke go go dirang gore palo ya malatsi e tswelele go fitlha ka Ferikgong.
eisa.nextYear.from: Nothing is recorded beyond this year. The assessment quality partner publishes next year's dates in December, so the letter should be out; adding them now is what keeps the countdown running into January.

eisa.toEnter.text: {cohorts} di santse di tshwanetse go kwadiswa

eisa.toEnterIntro.text: Tsotlhe tse di nang le nako e e bulegileng mme ga di na letlha la kwadiso le le rekotilweng kgatlhanong le tsone.
eisa.toEnterIntro.from: Everything with an open deadline and no registration date recorded against it.

eisa.sittingName.text: Leina la nako ya go kwala, sk. Mopitlwe 2027

eisa.back.text: ← Morago kwa tlhatlhobong ya kwa ntle

eisa.noQualification.text: Ga go na boitseanape mo dikwadisong tseno

eisa.noId.text: {count} ba se na nomoro ya boitshupo

eisa.noIdIntro.text: Molekane mongwe le mongwe o e kopa, mme kwadiso e e busediwang ka ntlha ya nomoro e e sa nnang teng e senya kgao yotlhe ya tiro. Go botoka go e bona jaanong go na le morago ga go romelwa ga faele.
eisa.noIdIntro.from: Every quality partner asks for one, and a registration returned for a missing number costs a cycle. Better found now than after the file is sent.

eisa.readyIntro.text: Tekanyetso nngwe le nngwe mo modiuleng mongwe le mongwe e fitlheletswe, e ka tswa e rutilwe kgotsa e amogetswe ka go ithuta ga pele.
eisa.readyIntro.from: Every criterion in every module met, whether taught or recognised through prior learning.

eisa.nobodyYet.text: Ga go ope le fa e le jaanong. Lenaane le le kwa tlase le bolela gore mongwe le mongwe o tshwanetse go ya kae.
eisa.nobodyYet.from: Nobody yet. The list below says how far each of them has to go.

eisa.noIdNumber.text: ga go na nomoro ya boitshupo

eisa.notReadyIntro.text: Gore mongwe le mongwe o tshwanetse go ya kae. Motho yo o tlhaelelwang ke tekanyetso e le nngwe a ka fitlha mo nakong fa go lemogiwa beke eno.
eisa.notReadyIntro.from: How far each has to go. Somebody one criterion short can still make the deadline if it is noticed this week.

ready.intro.text: Moithuti a ka kwala Tlhatlhobo ya Bofelo e e Kopaneng ya Kwa Ntle fa ditekanyetso tsotlhe tsa tlhatlhobo ya selegae mo modiuleng mongwe le mongwe di fitlheletswe. E seng tse dintsi, mme ga go na seperesente se se e emelang: seperesente se se kwa tlase ke tswelelopele, baji ke tetlelo.
ready.intro.from: A learner may sit the External Integrated Summative Assessment once every internal assessment criterion in every module has been achieved. Not most of them, and no percentage stands in for it: the percentage below is progress, the badge is permission.

ready.nobody.text: Ga go ise go kwadiswe ope kgatlhanong le boitseanape. Kwadisa moithuti mo kosing o bo o tlhopha boitseanape jo e balang go jone, mme o tla bonala fano.
ready.nobody.from: Nobody is enrolled against a qualification yet. Enrol a learner on a course and choose the qualification it counts towards, and they will appear here.

ready.notCaptured.text: Kharikhulamo fano ga e a tsewa ka botlalo.
ready.notCaptured.from: A curriculum here is not fully captured.

ready.notCapturedIntro.text: Dimodiule dingwe ga di na ditekanyetso tsa tlhatlhobo, ka jalo ga go na sepe se se ka fitlhelwang kgatlhanong le tsone mme ga go na ope mo boitseanapeng jono yo o ka bolelwang a siametse. Tsenya tokomane ya kharikhulamo e e feletseng pele o kwadisa ope EISA.
ready.notCapturedIntro.from: Some modules carry no assessment criteria, so nothing can be achieved against them and nobody on that qualification can be declared ready. Import the full curriculum document before entering anyone for an EISA.

ready.yours.text: Tswelelopele ya gago go ya kwa EISA

ready.notEligible.text: Ga o ise o tshwanelege go kwala EISA
ready.notEligible.from: Not yet eligible for the EISA

ready.achieved.text: Ditekanyetso tse {achieved} mo go tse {total} tsa tlhatlhobo ya selegae di fitlheletswe, mme maitemogelo a tiro a supilwe ke {record} e e tshwailweng.
ready.achieved.from: {achieved} of {total} internal assessment criteria achieved, and work experience proved by a signed {record}.

ready.canIssue.text: Setatemente sa Diphetho se ka ntshiwa.
ready.canIssue.from: A Statement of Results can be issued.

ready.everyOne.text: Nngwe le nngwe ya tsone e a tlhokega; ga go na maduo a go feta.
ready.everyOne.from: Every one of them is required; there is no pass mark.

ready.perUnit.text: Ditatemente tsa yuniti nngwe le nngwe ya thuto

ready.perUnitIntro.text: Setatemente sa yuniti nngwe ya thuto se tlhomamisa tekanyetso nngwe le nngwe mo dimoduleng tse yuniti eo e di neelang. Se ka ntshiwa ka pela fa yuniti eo e fela, go sa emelwe karolo e nngwe ya boitseanape.
ready.perUnitIntro.from: A statement for one study unit confirms every criterion in the modules that unit delivers. It can be issued as soon as that unit is finished, without waiting for the rest of the qualification.

ready.certificateIntro.text: Se ntshiwa ke setheo se se neelang boitseanape morago ga EISA, e seng ke {provider}. Se rekotiwa fano fa se goroga, gore rekoto ya moithuti e bue gore o na le boitseanape.
ready.certificateIntro.from: Issued by the awarding body after the EISA, not by {provider}. Recorded here when it arrives, so the learner's record says they are qualified.

ready.thisNotCaptured.text: Kharikhulamo eno ga e a tsewa ka botlalo.
ready.thisNotCaptured.from: This curriculum is not fully captured.

ready.thisNotCapturedIntro.text: {modules} ga di na ditekanyetso tsa tlhatlhobo. Ga go ope yo o ka bolelwang a tshwanelega kgatlhanong le boitseanape jono go fitlha tokomane yotlhe ya kharikhulamo e tsenngwa; ka tsela e sele dimodiule tse di tlhaelang di ka balwa jaaka tse di fetilweng ka go sa lemogiwe.
ready.thisNotCapturedIntro.from: {modules} carry no assessment criteria. Nobody can be declared eligible against this qualification until the full curriculum document has been imported; otherwise the missing modules would silently count as passed.

ready.weight.document.text: jaaka go builwe mo tokomaneng ya kharikhulamo
ready.weight.document.from: as stated in the curriculum document

ready.weight.credits.text: di dirilwe go tswa mo dikerediting tsa modiule; tokomane ga e bue ka diperesente
ready.weight.credits.from: derived from module credits; the document states no percentages

ready.weight.equal.text: di aroganngwe ka go lekana; tokomane ga e bue ka diperesente le dikerediti
ready.weight.equal.from: split evenly; the document states no percentages and no credits

ready.workProved.text: Maitemogelo a tiro a supiwa ke {record} e e tshwailweng ke mokoetlisi wa lefelo la tiro mme ya amogelwa ke motlhatlhobi, e seng ke ditekanyetso tsa tlhatlhobo. Kharikhulamo ga e tlhalose epe ya modiule ono.
ready.workProved.from: Work experience is proved by a {record} signed by the workplace coach and accepted by an assessor, not by assessment criteria. The curriculum defines none for this module.

ready.noRecord.text: Ga go a bulwa {record} mo modiuleng ono.
ready.noRecord.from: No {record} has been opened for this module.

ready.noCriteria.text: Ga go a tsewa ditekanyetso tsa tlhatlhobo tsa modiule ono.
ready.noCriteria.from: No assessment criteria captured for this module.

issue.notYet.text: Setatemente sa Diphetho ga se ise se ka ntshiwa.
issue.notYet.from: A Statement of Results cannot be issued yet.

award.wrong.text: A e kwadilwe ka phoso? E tlose

preview.summative.text: Ya bofelo: e atlholwa ke motho mme e sekasekiwa ka go ikemela
preview.summative.from: Summative: judged by a person and independently moderated

preview.formative.text: Ya tlhabololo: e tshwaiwa fa moithuti a ntse a tsamaya
preview.formative.from: Formative: marked as the learner goes

preview.whoMarks.text: {app} di tshwailwe ke Sethala, {assessor} ke motlhatlhobi
preview.whoMarks.from: {app} marked by the App, {assessor} by an assessor

preview.isPreviewIntro.text: Ke sone se moithuti a se bonang, ka mabokoso a a tla kwalelwang mo go one. Ga go sepe se se bolokwang mme ga go ise go simologe leiteko lepe, ka jalo dilaolo di timilwe. Lepanele le le kwa tlase ga potso nngwe le nngwe ke ya gago ka gonne o agile pampiri eno; moithuti ga a e bone le ka motlha.
preview.isPreviewIntro.from: Exactly what a learner sees, with the boxes they would type into. Nothing is saved and no attempt has been started, so the controls are switched off. The panel under each question is for you because you built this paper; a learner never sees it.

preview.empty.text: Ga go na dipotso mo pampiring eno le fa e le jaanong.
preview.empty.from: There are no questions in this paper yet.

preview.tickedAbove.text: Tlhopho e e siameng e tshwailwe kwa godimo.
preview.tickedAbove.from: The correct option is ticked above.

preview.noGuide.text: Ga go na kaelo ya go tshwaya. Motlhatlhobi ga a na sepe se a ka tshwayang kgatlhanong le sone; oketsa nngwe pele pampiri e dirisiwa.
preview.noGuide.from: No marking guide. An assessor has nothing to mark this against; add one before the paper is used.

preview.declarationIntro.text: Moithuti ga a kake a neela seno a sa dumele, mme mafoko a tota a bolokelwa mo kabong ya gagwe.
preview.declarationIntro.from: A learner cannot hand this in without agreeing to it, and the exact wording is frozen into the submission.

people.intro.text: Mongwe le mongwe mo {provider}, dikarolo tsa bone, le gore a rekoto ya bone e na le se pego ya molao e se tlhokang.
people.intro.from: Everyone in {provider}, their roles, and whether their record carries what a statutory return needs.

people.notEnrolledOne.text: Moithuti a le 1 ga a kwadisiwa mo sepeng.
people.notEnrolledOne.from: 1 learner is not enrolled on anything.

people.notEnrolledMany.text: Baithuti ba le {count} ga ba kwadisiwa mo sepeng.
people.notEnrolledMany.from: {count} learners are not enrolled on anything.

people.notEnrolledWhy.text: Go nna moithuti ga go neye phitlhelelo ka bosone, ka jalo ba tsena mo skrineng e se nang sepe. Ba kwadise mo kosing, ba ba tsenye mo setlhopheng, kgotsa o ba abele lenaneo.
people.notEnrolledWhy.from: Being a learner grants no access on its own, so they sign in to an empty screen. Enrol them on a course, add them to a cohort, or assign a programme.

people.missingOne.text: Motho a le 1 o tlhaelelwa ke dintlha tse pego ya SETA kgotsa SAQA e di tlhokang.
people.missingOne.from: 1 person is missing details a SETA or SAQA return needs.

people.missingMany.text: Batho ba le {count} ba tlhaelelwa ke dintlha tse pego ya SETA kgotsa SAQA e di tlhokang.
people.missingMany.from: {count} people are missing details a SETA or SAQA return needs.

people.missingWhy.text: Ba tshwailwe kwa tlase. Go di tlatsa jaanong go bonolo go feta bosigo pele ga go romelwa.
people.missingWhy.from: They are marked below. Filling them in now is far easier than the night before a submission.

people.roster.text: Oketsa setlhopha go tswa mo spreadsheet
people.roster.from: Add a cohort from a spreadsheet

people.rosterIntro.text: Bala faele ya CSV kgotsa ya Excel ya baithuti mme o ba tlhome botlhe ka nako e le nngwe. E go bontsha se e se dirileng ka faele pele ga gore ope a tlhongwe.
people.rosterIntro.from: Read a CSV or Excel file of learners and create them all at once. It shows you what it made of the file before anybody is created.

people.added.text: O oketsegile. Mo nee lefoko leno la tsena: le bontshiwa ka nako e le nngwe mme ga le ka le boelediwa.
people.added.from: Added. Give them this password: it is shown once and cannot be retrieved.

people.noMail.text: Ga go ise go nne le seva ya imeile e e kgokaganeng, ka jalo ga go a rometswa imeile epe. Mo kope gore a le fetole morago ga go tsena.
people.noMail.from: There is no mail server connected yet, so nothing was emailed. Ask them to change it after signing in.

person.lineManagerNote.text: E tlhopha gore katiso ya motho yo e ka bonwa ke bomang mo dipegong.
person.lineManagerNote.from: Decides whose training this person can see in reports.

person.ofoNote.text: Khoutu ya tiro e e dirisiwang go bopa pego ya SETA.
person.ofoNote.from: Occupation code used to group a SETA return.

person.statutoryNote.text: Di a tlhokega mo pegong ya SAQA kgotsa ya SETA. Nomoro ya boitshupo e sekasekwa kgatlhanong le nomoro ya yone ya tlhomamiso fa o e boloka, gore phoso ya go kwala e tshwarwe fano, e seng ke motlhaeledi.
person.statutoryNote.from: Needed for a SAQA or SETA return. The identity number is checked against its check digit as you save, so a typing error is caught here rather than by the regulator.

person.roleNote.moderator.text: Ga a kgone go sekaseka ditshwetso tsa gagwe

person.roleNote.workplace_coach.text: Mokaedi wa mothapi: o bona baithuti ba gagwe fela
person.roleNote.workplace_coach.from: The employer's supervisor: sees only their own learners

roster.how.text: CSV kgotsa Excel. Ditlhogo tsa dikholomo di tshwantshiwa ka leina ("Sefane", "Last Name" le "Van" tsotlhe di a dira) mme ga go tlhokege katoloso epe mo go sotlhe.
roster.how.from: CSV or Excel. Column headings are matched by name ("Surname", "Last Name" and "Van" all work) and no extension is needed for any of it.

roster.aiOn.text: Katoloso ya gago ya AI e butswe

roster.aiOnWhat.text: mme e tla leka go tshwantsha tlhogo nngwe le nngwe e melawana e e tlhaelang. E bontshiwa ditlhogo fela, ga e ke e bontshiwe methala, e e nang le dinomoro tsa boitshupo.
roster.aiOnWhat.from: and will try to match any heading the rules miss. It is shown the headings only, never the rows, which carry identity numbers.

roster.aiOff.text: Fa katoloso ya gago ya AI e butswa e ne e tla tshwantsha ditlhogo tse melawana e sa di lemogeng; e ne e tla bontshiwa ditlhogo fela, ga e ke e bontshiwe methala. Sesuiti se kwa godimo ga letlakala.
roster.aiOff.from: With your AI extension switched on it would additionally match headings the rules do not recognise; it would be shown the headings only, never the rows. The switch is at the top of the page.

roster.passwords.text: Mafoko a bone a ntlha a go tsena, a bontshiwa gangwe fela

roster.passwordsNote.text: Ga a bolokwe kwa a ka balwang gape teng. A kopele jaanong, kgotsa a busetse ka bongwe morago. Mongwe le mongwe o kopiwa go a fetola fa a tsena la ntlha.
roster.passwordsNote.from: These are not stored anywhere they can be read again. Copy them now, or reset them individually later. Each person is asked to change theirs on first sign-in.

roster.willCreateSkip.text: {count} di tla dirwa, {skipped} di tla tlogelwa.
roster.willCreateSkip.from: {count} will be created, {skipped} will be skipped.

personPage.anonymised.text: Rekoto eno e sa tsholwa leina

personPage.anonymisedOne.text: Dintlha tsa motho di phimotswe ka {date} ka kopo ya gagwe. Setifikeiti sa gagwe se le 1 se santse se siame mme se ka netefadiwa, ka gonne boitseanape jo bo setseng bo bonwe bo tshwanetse go dula mo rekotong ya bosetšhaba.
personPage.anonymisedOne.from: The personal details were erased on {date} at the person's request. Their 1 certificate remains valid and verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to stay on the national record.

personPage.anonymisedMany.text: Dintlha tsa motho di phimotswe ka {date} ka kopo ya gagwe. Ditifikeiti tsa gagwe di le {count} di santse di siame mme di ka netefadiwa, ka gonne boitseanape jo bo setseng bo bonwe bo tshwanetse go dula mo rekotong ya bosetšhaba.
personPage.anonymisedMany.from: The personal details were erased on {date} at the person's request. Their {count} certificates remain valid and verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to stay on the national record.

personPage.noEdit.text: Ga go sepe fano se se ka fetolwang.

personPage.conductIntro.text: Se se kailweng, ditlhagiso dife tse di neng di santse di dira ka nako eo, a temoso ya kgotla e ne e lekane, le se se tshwaretsweng. Ka tatelano e go diregileng ka yone, e leng tatelano e e balwang gape ka yone.
personPage.conductIntro.from: What was alleged, which warnings were live at the time, whether notice of a hearing was adequate, and what was decided. In the order it happened, which is the order it gets read back in.

personPage.supportIntro.text: Se se dirwang ka moithuti yono, le gore ke ba bomang ba se dirang. Lebaka la tlamelo ke tshedimosetso ya boitekanelo kgotsa ya madi mme le bolokwa le le nosi, ka gonne go dira tlamelo ga go tlhoke go itse gore ke ka goreng.
personPage.supportIntro.from: What is being done for this learner, and by whom. The reason behind an accommodation is health or financial information and is held apart from it, because doing the accommodating does not require knowing why.

personPage.missed.text: Ditlhatlhobo tsa bofelo tse di tlodisitsweng

personPage.missedIntro.text: Letlha le le oketsegileng le le lengwe, e seng go feta. Fa le lone le tlodisiwa ka mabaka a kalafi moithuti o isiwa kwa tlhatlhobong ya molomo e e nang le mosupatsela go tswa kwa mothapong.
personPage.missedIntro.from: One additional date, and one only. Where that is also missed on medical grounds the learner goes to an oral assessment with an observer from the employer.

personPage.appealsIntro.text: Kgatlhanong le phetho, kgotsa kgatlhanong le boitshwaro jwa motlhatlhobi. Go amogelwa go rurifadiwa mo diureng tse {hours}, mme nako e simologa fa e tsentswe fano.
personPage.appealsIntro.from: Against a result, or against an assessor's conduct. Receipt is acknowledged within {hours} hours, and the clock starts when it is lodged here.

personPage.documentsIntro.text: Di sekasekwa fa di kgobokanngwa, e seng fa pego e dirwa. Kopi e e tlhomamisitsweng e e latlhegileng e e fitlhelwang morago ga dikgwedi e thata thata go e bona, mme letlha la bofelo gantsi le setse le le mo malatsing a le mmalwa ka nako eo.
personPage.documentsIntro.from: Checked as they are collected rather than when a return is being assembled. A missing certified copy found months later is far harder to get, and the deadline is usually days away by then.

personPage.elsewhere.text: Go ithuta go rekotilweng kwa ntle

personPage.elsewhereIntro.text: Go tsentswe go tswa mo tsamaisong e nngwe. Go bontshiwa jaaka go ne go rekotilwe koo; ga go sepe sa gone se se ruta, se tlhatlhobilweng kgotsa se sekasekilweng mo sethaleng seno.
personPage.elsewhereIntro.from: Imported from another system. Shown as it was recorded there; none of it was taught, assessed or moderated on this platform.

editor.ownRoles.text: O ka se fetole ditiro tsa gago: go ipeela gore o se ka wa tsena ke phoso e le nngwe e go se nang ope yo o ka e baakanyang. Kopa molaodi yo mongwe.
editor.ownRoles.from: You cannot change your own roles: removing your own access is the one mistake nobody else may be able to undo. Ask another administrator.

editor.mailboxIntro.text: Aterese e baithuti le batlhatlhobi ba kwalelang go yone le go tswa kwa go yone. E kgaogane le aterese ya go tsena e e kwa godimo, gore puisano ka tlhatlhobo e nne mo rekotong ya moithuti, e seng mo lebokoseng la poso la poraefete la mongwe, koo e leng kwa ntle ga logo la tekolo, kwa ntle ga kopi ya tshireletso, mme e nyelela fa a tsamaya.
editor.mailboxIntro.from: The address learners and assessors write to and from. Separate from the sign-in address above, so a conversation about an assessment lands inside the learner's record rather than in somebody's private inbox, where it is outside the audit log, outside the backup, and gone when they leave.

editor.noPassword.text: Ga go na lefoko la tsena le le farologaneng, ka gonne ga go na go tsena go go farologaneng.
editor.noPassword.from: There is no separate password, because there is no separate login.

editor.noPasswordWhy.text: Seno ga se lebokose la poso mo sebeng sa poso se se nang le webmail ya sone. Poso e e romelwang kwa aterese eno e ntshetswa mo sethaleng, mme motho o e bala a bo a e araba ka fa tlase ga Poso fa a setse a tsene ka tsela e a e dirang ka metlha. Seo ke sone se se tlhokegang: dipuisano di dula mo rekotong ya moithuti, mo logong la tekolo le mo kopiing ya tshireletso, e seng mo lebokoseng la poraefete le le tsamayang fa ba tsamaya.
editor.noPasswordWhy.from: This is not a mailbox on a mail host with its own webmail. Mail sent to this address is delivered into the platform, and the person reads and answers it under Mail after signing in the way they always do. That is the point of it: the correspondence sits inside the learner's record, in the audit log and in the backup, rather than in a private inbox that leaves when they do.

editor.mailboxChange.text: Go e fetola ga go fetise poso e e setseng e amogetswe.
editor.mailboxChange.from: Changing it does not move mail already received.

editor.mailboxSuggested.text: Go akantswe: {address}. Tlogela e le lefela fa go se na lebokose la poso.
editor.mailboxSuggested.from: Suggested: {address}. Leave blank for no mailbox.

editor.newPassword.text: Lefoko le lesha la tsena: le bontshiwa gangwe fela, le neele motho ka tlhamalalo.
editor.newPassword.from: New password: shown once, give it to them directly.

editor.ownSuspend.text: O ka se emise akhaonto ya gago.
editor.ownSuspend.from: You cannot suspend your own account.

editor.suspendNote.text: Go emisa go khutlisa gone jaanong seshene sepe se motho a nang le sone se se bulegileng, mme go busetsa lefoko la tsena go mo tswisa gongwe le gongwe.
editor.suspendNote.from: Suspending ends any session the person has open immediately, and resetting a password signs them out everywhere.

editor.eraseIntro.text: Ka kopo ya go phimola ya POPIA. E tlosa leina, dintlha tsa go ikgolagana le tsa setšhaba ka bosakhutleng. Ditifikeiti le direkoto tsa tlhatlhobo di a bolokwa mme di dula di ka netefadiwa, ka gonne boitseanape jo bo setseng bo bonwe bo tshwanetse go dula mo rekotong ya bosetšhaba, ke gone go dirang gore seno se se ka se busediwe.
editor.eraseIntro.from: For a POPIA erasure request. Removes the name, contact and demographic details permanently. Certificates and assessment records are kept and stay verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to remain on the national record, which is also why this cannot be undone.

editor.why.text: Ke ka ntlha yang fa seno se dirwa?

editor.whyHint.text: Go bolokwa ka bosakhutleng mo logong la tekolo.
editor.whyHint.from: Kept permanently in the audit log.

lodge.noCohort.text: Boipiletso bo tsentswe kgatlhanong le setlhopha, mme moithuti yono ga a mo setlhopheng se se dirang.
lodge.noCohort.from: An appeal is filed against a cohort, and this learner is not on a running one.

lodge.statementHint.text: Se moithuti a se buang, ka mafoko a gagwe fa go kgonega.
lodge.statementHint.from: What the learner says, in their words where possible.

lodge.lateWhy.text: Goreng seno se amogelwa morago ga nako
lodge.lateWhy.from: Why this is being accepted out of time

lodge.lateNote.text: Boipiletso jo bo diegileng ke boipiletso fela, mme go bo gana fano e ne e tla bo isa fela kwa lebokoseng la poso la mongwe. Lebaka le nna karolo ya faele.
lodge.lateNote.from: A late appeal is still an appeal, and turning it away here would only send it to somebody's inbox. The reason becomes part of the file.

missed.outcome.additional_date_set.text: Letlha le le oketsegileng le beilwe

missed.outcome.sat.text: O nnile ka letlha le le oketsegileng

missed.none.text: Ga go na ditlhatlhobo tsa bofelo tse di tlodisitsweng.

missed.againOral.text: O e tlodisitse gape: letlelela tlhatlhobo ya molomo
missed.againOral.from: Missed it again: authorise an oral assessment

missed.wasMedical.text: Go tlodisa la bobedi go ne go le ka mabaka a kalafi
missed.wasMedical.from: The second miss was on medical grounds

missed.medicalHint.text: Lebaka la kalafi e ne e le eng

missed.medicalOnly.text: Tsela ya molomo e a bulega ka lebaka la kalafi fela, e seng ka le lengwe. Fa go se na lone phetho ke go latlhegelwa ke tshwanelo, e moithuti a ka e ipiletsang gape.
missed.medicalOnly.from: The oral route opens on a medical ground and nothing else. Without one the outcome is a forfeit, which the learner can still appeal.

missed.whyHint.text: Goreng e tlodisitswe, fa go itsiwe
missed.whyHint.from: Why it was missed, if known

missed.onlyOne.text: Letlha le le oketsegileng le le lengwe, e seng go feta. Go le rekota fano ke go go thibelang gore la boraro le se ka la rulaganngwa morago ke mongwe yo o sa itseng ka le le lengwe leno.
missed.onlyOne.from: One additional date, and one only. Recording it here is what stops a third being arranged later by somebody who did not know about this one.

support.none.text: Ga go na tshegetso e e rekotilweng.

support.withheld.text: Go na le dintlha tse dintsi tse di mo faeleng. Di thibetswe, ka gonne ke tshedimosetso ya boitekanelo kgotsa ya madi mme go dira tlamelo ga go tlhoke go itse lebaka la yone.
support.withheld.from: There is more detail on file. It is restricted, because it is health or financial information and doing the accommodation does not require knowing the reason for it.

support.changing.text: Se se fetolwang ka ntlha ya seo
support.changing.from: What is changing as a result

support.closedOne.text: Rekoto e le 1 e e tswaletsweng ga e bontshiwe.

support.closedMany.text: Direkoto tse {count} tse di tswaletsweng ga di bontshiwe.

support.accommodation.text: Se se tla dirwang: se abelwa mongwe le mongwe yo o tshwanetseng go se dira
support.accommodation.from: What will be done: shared with whoever has to do it

support.accommodationHint.text: Setulo gaufi le kgoro. Letlelela boikhutso morago ga metsotso e le 40 nngwe le nngwe. Neela dilo tse di gatisitsweng.
support.accommodationHint.from: Seat near the door. Allow a break every 40 minutes. Provide printed materials.

support.reason.text: Lebaka la yone: le thibetswe, mme go molemo go le tlogela le le lefela
support.reason.from: The reason behind it: restricted, and better left empty

support.reasonNote.text: Boitekanelo, bogole le maemo a madi ke tshedimosetso ya poraefete e e kgethegileng. Rekoto e e reng fela se se tshwanetseng go dirwa e thusa moithuti go tshwana, mme e tsenya kotsi e nnye thata. E tlatse fela fa mongwe a ka kgoneng go se dire kwa ntle ga yone.
support.reasonNote.from: Health, disability and financial circumstances are special personal information. A record that says only what to do serves the learner just as well and puts far less at risk. Fill this in only where somebody genuinely could not act without it.

support.consented.text: Moithuti o dumetse gore seno se rekotiwe
support.consented.from: The learner has agreed to this being recorded

docs.kind.certified_id.text: Kopi e e tlhomamisitsweng ya tokomane ya boitshupo

docs.kind.highest_qualification.text: Kopi e e tlhomamisitsweng ya boitseanape jo bo kwa godimo

docs.routeNote.text: Tsela e tlhopha se se tlhokegang. Go amogela go ithuta ga pele go kopa portefolio, e seng setifikeiti sa boitseanape, ka gonne kgang ke gore go ithuta go diregile kwa ntle ga lenaneo la semolao.
docs.routeNote.from: The route decides what is required. Recognition of prior learning asks for a portfolio rather than a qualification certificate, because the claim is that the learning happened outside a formal programme.

docs.allSupplied.from: Everything required has been supplied and checked.

conduct.grade.gross.text: Boitshwaro jo bo sa siamang jo bo boitshegang

conduct.warning.final_written.text: Temoso ya bofelo e e kwadilweng

conduct.sanction.no_action.text: Ga go na se se dirilweng

conduct.sanction.final_written_warning.text: Temoso ya bofelo e e kwadilweng

conduct.liveMany.text: Ditemoso tse {count} tse di santseng di dira:

conduct.liveNote.text: Ke tsone fela tse di balwang go ya kwa kgatong e e latelang. Temoso e e fetileng letlha la yone e dula mo faeleng mme ga e sa balwe, ke sone se boipiletso bo ikaegileng ka sone.
conduct.liveNote.from: Only these count towards escalation. A warning past its date stays on file and stops counting, which is what an appeal turns on.

conduct.nothing.text: Ga go na sepe se se rekotilweng.
