conduct.givenButton.text: Moithuti o neetswe seno ka go kwalwa
conduct.givenButton.from: The learner has been given this in writing

conduct.termsHint.text: Molao o o thubilweng, maemo a a solofetsweng, le se se diregang fa go tlhola go direga gape.
conduct.termsHint.from: The rule broken, the standard expected, and what happens if it recurs.

conduct.allegationsHint.text: Ditshutiso tse di tobilweng tse di neetsweng moithuti
conduct.allegationsHint.from: The specific allegations put to the learner

conduct.sanctionsHint.text: Ditshwetso tse di ka nnang teng, go akaretsa go khutlisa fa go le jalo
conduct.sanctionsHint.from: Sanctions possible, including termination where it is

conduct.rights.text: Temoso e bolelela moithuti gore a ka thusiwa ke moithuti yo mongwe, a tlhagisa tsheko ya gagwe, a bitsa basupi mme a ba botsa dipotso.
conduct.rights.from: The notice tells the learner they may be assisted by a fellow learner, present their case, and call and question witnesses.

conduct.notice.text: Bonnye diura tse {hours} go tswa jaanong. Temoso e khutshwane e a ganwa: ke molato o boipiletso bo o wang ka one, go sa kgathalesege gore moithuti o dirile eng.
conduct.notice.from: At least {hours} hours from now. Short notice is refused: it is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

conduct.whyHint.text: Goreng. Ke serapa se moithuti a nang le tshwanelo ya go se bona.
conduct.whyHint.from: Why. This is the paragraph the learner is entitled to.

conduct.allegationHint.text: Se se kailweng, ka go tlhomamisa. Moithuti ga a kgone go araba 'boikutlo jo bo sa siamang'.
conduct.allegationHint.from: What is alleged, specifically. A learner cannot answer 'poor attitude'.

cohorts.intro.text: Setlhopha sa batho ba ba dirang mmogo mo lenaneong, ka thulaganyo e le nngwe. Nako nngwe le nngwe ya bofelo e tsewa jaaka palo ya malatsi go tswa ka letlha la go simolola, ka jalo go fetola tsenelo go fetola letlha lengwe le lengwe la bone botlhe gangwe.
cohorts.intro.from: A group working through a programme together, on one schedule. Every deadline is held as a number of days from the start date, so moving an intake moves every date for everyone in it at once.

cohorts.noneTitle.text: Ga go na {cohorts} le fa e le jaanong

cohorts.none.text: {cohort} ke setlhopha sa batho ba ba dirang mmogo {course} e e phatlaladitsweng, ka thulaganyo e le nngwe. Dira nngwe kgatlhanong le {course} mme nako nngwe le nngwe ya bofelo e balelwa go tswa ka letlha la yone la go simolola.
cohorts.none.from: A {cohort} is a group working through a published {course} together, on one schedule. Create one against a {course} and every deadline is measured from its start date.

cohorts.roster.text: Tsenya setlhopha go tswa mo spreadsheet
cohorts.roster.from: Add a cohort from a spreadsheet

cohorts.rosterIntro.text: Bala faele ya CSV kgotsa Excel ya baithuti mme o ba dire botlhe gangwe. E go bontsha se e se dirileng ka faele pele ga gore ope a dirwe, morago o ba kwadise mo setlhopheng se se kwa godimo.
cohorts.rosterIntro.from: Read a CSV or Excel file of learners and create them all at once. It shows you what it made of the file before anybody is created, then enrol them onto a cohort above.

cohorts.noPublished.text: Ga go na {courses} tse di phatlaladitsweng le fa e le jaanong. {cohort} e dira kgatlhanong le {course} e e phatlaladitsweng, gore dilo tse di mo go yone di se ka tsa fetoga fa setlhopha se setseng se dira ka yone.
cohorts.noPublished.from: There are no published {courses} yet. A {cohort} runs against a published {course}, so that the material cannot change under a group already working through it.

cohorts.startNote.text: Nako nngwe le nngwe ya bofelo e balwa go tswa ka letsatsi leno. E ka fetolwa morago, mme sengwe le sengwe se fetoga le yone.
cohorts.startNote.from: Every deadline is counted from this day. It can be moved later, and everything moves with it.

cohort.paid.text: E duetswe. Mongwe le mongwe mo setlhopheng seno o balwa a duetswe.
cohort.paid.from: Paid. Everybody on this cohort counts as paid for.

cohort.paidRef.text: E duetswe · {reference}. Mongwe le mongwe mo setlhopheng seno o balwa a duetswe.
cohort.paidRef.from: Paid · {reference}. Everybody on this cohort counts as paid for.

cohort.invoiced.text: E kwadiwe ka tsheko, mme ga go ise go rekotiwe tuelo.
cohort.invoiced.from: Invoiced, and no payment recorded against it yet.

cohort.nothingRecorded.text: Ga go sepe se se rekotilweng. Tsamaiso ya kwadiso e simologa fano.
cohort.nothingRecorded.from: Nothing recorded. The enrolment procedure begins here.

cohort.moveIntro.text: Letlha lengwe le lengwe le le kwa tlase le tsewa jaaka palo ya malatsi go tswa ka leno, ka jalo go le fetola go fetola thulaganyo yotlhe ya go tsamaisa mongwe le mongwe mo setlhopheng.
cohort.moveIntro.from: Every date below is held as a number of days from this one, so changing it moves the whole rollout for everybody on the cohort.

cohort.waitingIntro.text: Moithuti mongwe le mongwe gangwe, mo kgatong ya ntlha e a ka se kgoneng go e bula.
cohort.waitingIntro.from: Each learner once, at the earliest step they cannot open.

cohort.progress.from: Where the cohort has got to

cohort.progressIntro.text: E butswe le go fedisiwa mo kgatong nngwe le nngwe, le gore go tsere nako e kae ba ba fedisitseng. Palogare e e magareng e seng e e tlwaelegileng, gore moithuti a le mongwe yo o nyeleletseng nako ya kgwedi tse dintsi a se ka a fitlha gore ba bangwe botlhe ba fitlhile kae.
cohort.progressIntro.from: Opened and finished per step, and how long it took those who finished. The median rather than the average, so one learner who disappeared for a term does not hide where everybody else is.

cohort.stillOn.text: Ba santse ba le mo go yone

cohort.stalledOne.text: Kgato e le nngwe e na le batho ba ba ntseng ba e dira: {steps}.
cohort.stalledOne.from: One step has people sitting on it: {steps}.

cohort.stalledMany.text: Dikgato tse {count} di na le batho ba ba ntseng ba di dira: {steps}.
cohort.stalledMany.from: {count} steps have people sitting on them: {steps}.

cohort.rolloutIntro.text: Dikopano tse di nang le matlha tse setlhopha seno se kopanang ka tsone, le lokwalo la ba ba teng le tsewang kwa go nngwe le nngwe. Fa lenaneo le na le dikerediti le tshwanetse go etelelwa pele ke motsamaisi, mme seno ke bosupi jwa gore go dirilwe jalo.
cohort.rolloutIntro.from: The dated sessions this cohort meets for, and the register taken at each. Where a programme carries credits it has to be facilitator-led, and this is the evidence that it was.

cohort.attendanceIntro.text: Kakaretso e lekanngwa le lenaneo lotlhe; go fitlha jaanong e lekanngwa le se se setseng se tshwerwe. Kwa tshimologong ya lenaneo la ntlha ke le lennye thata mme la bobedi ke la boammaaruri, ka jalo tsotlhe di a newa e seng gore go tlhophiwe nngwe fela.
cohort.attendanceIntro.from: Overall is against the whole programme; to date is against what has actually been held. Early in a programme the first is meaninglessly low and the second is the honest one, so both are given rather than one being chosen for you.

cohort.held.text: Dikopano tse {held} mo go tse {countable} di tshwerwe. Dikopano tse di khutlisitsweng le tsa baithaopi ba ba tsenang ka bobona di tlogetswe mo go tsotlhe.
cohort.held.from: {held} of {countable} sessions held. Cancelled sessions and voluntary walk-ins are left out of both.

cohort.feedbackIntro.text: Di romelwa morago ga tlhatlhobo ya bofelo, di arabiwa mo diureng tse {hours}. Ga go ope yo o tlhomamisang go amogelwa mme ga go ope yo o kwalolotsang sepe: go amogelwa ke mola mme pego ke potso.
cohort.feedbackIntro.from: Sent after a summative, answered within {hours} hours. Nobody acknowledges receipt and nobody transcribes anything: receipt is a row and the report is a query.

cohort.assessmentIntro.text: Moithuti mongwe le mongwe kgatlhanong le tiro nngwe le nngwe e e tlhatlhobiwang, ka tatelano e e kgobokanngwang ka yone. E balwa go tswa mo dintsweng, ditshwetsong le mo dilokwalong tsa ba ba teng, e seng ka diatla, ka jalo ga e kgone go farologana le tsone.
cohort.assessmentIntro.from: Every learner against every piece of assessed work, in the order it is collected. Read from submissions, decisions and registers rather than kept by hand, so it cannot disagree with them.

cohort.absentNote.text: Go seyo go balwa go tswa mo lokwalong lwa ba ba teng la kopano e tiro e neng e kwalwa ka yone, e seng mo go e e neetsweng, ka gonne moithuti yo o sa tlang ga a na e a e neetseng e go ka rekotiwang mo go yone.
cohort.absentNote.from: Absent is read from the register of the sitting the work was written at, not from the submission, because a learner who did not attend has no submission for it to be recorded on.

cohort.workIntro.text: Se se tshwanetseng go direga go dikologa go ruta: dilo tse di siametseng, ditokomane tse di neetsweng, mosekaseki yo o tlhophilweng, ditifikeiti tse di latelwang.
cohort.workIntro.from: What has to happen around the teaching: material readied, documents submitted, a moderator appointed, certificates chased.

cohort.releaseIntro.text: Di tsewa jaaka malatsi go tswa ka tshimologo. Fetola letlha la go simolola mme sengwe le sengwe sa tseno se fetoga le lone.
cohort.releaseIntro.from: Held as days from the start. Change the start date and every one of these moves with it.

cohort.noSteps.text: {course} ya setlhopha seno ga e na dikgato le fa e le jaanong.
cohort.noSteps.from: This cohort's {course} has no steps yet.

cohort.membersIntro.text: Go tsenya mongwe fano le gone go mo kwadisa mo {course}. Leina mo lokwalong lwa ba ba teng la motho yo o sa kgoneng go bula sepe ke seemo se se gare se se thibelwang ke seno.
cohort.membersIntro.from: Adding somebody here also enrols them on the {course}. A name on a register who cannot open anything is the half-state this avoids.

cohort.nobody.text: Ga go ise go tsenngwe ope.

cohortCtl.noSteps.text: Kosi ya setlhopha seno ga e na dikgato le fa e le jaanong, ka jalo ga go na sepe se se ka rulaganngwang.
cohortCtl.noSteps.from: This cohort's course has no steps yet, so there is nothing to schedule.

cohortCtl.opensDay.text: E a bulega ka letsatsi la

cohortCtl.closesAfter.text: E tswalwa malatsi a le mmalwa morago ga nako

cohortCtl.opensLabel.text: {step}: e a bulega ka letsatsi la

cohortCtl.closesLabel.text: {step}: e tswalwa malatsi a le mmalwa morago ga nako

cohortCtl.dayZero.text: Letsatsi la 0 ke letlha la go simolola. Tlogela mola o le lefela mme kgato eo ga e na matlha epe le fa e le mangwe; e a bulega ka pela fa sengwe le sengwe se se e etelelang pele se fedile.
cohortCtl.dayZero.from: Day 0 is the start date. Leave a row empty and that step carries no dates at all; it opens as soon as whatever comes before it is done.

cohortCtl.everybody.text: Mongwe le mongwe yo o nang le akhaonto ya moithuti o setse a le mo setlhopheng seno. Laletsa batho ba bangwe go tswa mo letlakaleng la Batho pele.
cohortCtl.everybody.from: Everybody with a learner account is already on this cohort. Invite more people from the People screen first.

cohortCtl.confirmRemove.text: A o tlosa {name} mo setlhopheng seno?

askFeedback.none.text: Ga go ise go botswe ope.

payment.referenceNote.text: Gore e ka tshwantshiwa le se lefapha la ditshelete le nang le sone.
payment.referenceNote.from: So it can be matched to what finance holds.

tasks.nothing.text: Ga go na sepe se se latelwang go fitlha jaanong.

tasks.progress.text: {done} mo go {counted} di fedile: {percent}%. Tiro e e khutlisitsweng ga e akarediwe mo dikarolong tsotlhe tse pedi, ka jalo go tlogela tiro ga go thuse le fa e le go gobatsa palo eno.
tasks.progress.from: {done} of {counted} done: {percent}%. Cancelled work is left out of both halves, so abandoning a task neither helps nor hurts the figure.

rollout.nothing.text: Ga go na sepe se se rulagantsweng go fitlha jaanong. Fa lenaneo le na le dikhredite, le tshwanetse go tsamaisiwa ke mokoetlisi, ka jalo fano ke mo bosupi jwa gore go dirilwe jalo bo simologang teng.
rollout.nothing.from: Nothing scheduled yet. Where a programme carries credits it has to be facilitator-led, so this is where the evidence that it was begins.

rollout.announced.text: Setlhopha le mokoetlisi ba itsisiwa ka kopano nngwe le nngwe beke pele ga yone, ka nako ya yone le kgokagano, mme ba itsisiwa gape fa e fetolwa, e khutlisiwa kgotsa e busediwa morago.
rollout.announced.from: The cohort and the facilitator are told about each session a week before it, with its time and link, and told again if it is moved, cancelled or postponed.

archive.intro.text: Fa moithuti a na le setatemente sa gagwe sa diphetho mme setifikeiti sa gagwe sa boitseanape go tswa kwa mothong yo o neelang boitseanape se setse se rekotilwe mo letlakaleng la gagwe la go siama ga EISA, Portefolio ya gagwe ya Bosupi e ka tswa mo Sethaleng mo pokanong e le nngwe e o e bolokang. Pokano eo e bulega mo sebadi sepe fela sa webosaete e se na Sethala. Ga go na sepe se se tlosiwang go fitlha kopi ya gago e e bolokilweng e sekasekiwa kgatlhanong le yone, mme rekoto nngwe le nngwe e nna fano, e bolela gore ke pokano efe e e tshwereng difaele.
archive.intro.from: Once a learner holds their statement of results and their qualification certificate from the awarding body has been recorded on their EISA readiness page, their Portfolio of Evidence can leave the platform in one archive that you keep. The archive opens in any browser without the platform. Nothing is removed until your stored copy has been checked against it, and every record stays here, saying which archive holds the files.

archive.readyFor.text: A na le setatemente sa diphetho le setifikeiti sa boitseanape sa {qualification}.
archive.readyFor.from: Holding a statement of results and the qualification certificate for {qualification}.

archive.noQualification.text: Kosi ya setlhopha seno ga e lebe boitseanape epe.
archive.noQualification.from: This cohort's course counts towards no qualification.

archive.nobody.text: Ga go ope go fitlha jaanong.

archive.anotherBuilding.text: Pokano nngwe e a kwalwa. Simolola e e latelang fa e fedile.
archive.anotherBuilding.from: Another archive is being written. Start the next one when it has finished.

archive.notYetIntro.text: Ba nna mo Sethaleng mme ba latela mo pokanong e e tlang fa setifikeiti sa bone sa boitseanape se setse se rekotilwe.
archive.notYetIntro.from: They stay on the platform and follow in a later archive once their own qualification certificate has been recorded.

archive.step1.text: 1. E elole o bo o e boloke

archive.step1Note.text: E boloke gongwe fa pholisi ya gago ya direkoto e reng direkoto tsa baithuti di bolokwe teng, ka nako yotlhe ya go di boloka. Fa difaele di setse di tlositswe, e ke kopi e le nngwe fela e e feletseng.
archive.step1Note.from: Keep it where your records policy says learner records are kept, for the full retention period. Once the files are removed, this is the only complete copy.

archive.step2.text: 2. Sekaseka kopi e o e bolokileng

archive.step3.from: 3. Remove the files from the platform

archive.building.text: Go a kwalwa. Letlakala leno le a itsosolosa ka bonosi.
archive.building.from: Being written. This page updates by itself.

archive.checkLabel.text: Sekaseka kopi ya gago e e bolokilweng

archive.checkNote.text: Tlhopha pokano go tswa kwa o e bolokileng teng. E baliwa mo khomputareng eno mme ga e tsenngwe; ke letshwao la yone la monwana fela le le romelwang. Pokano e na le di-bytes tse {bytes}.
archive.checkNote.from: Choose the archive from where you stored it. It is read on this computer and not uploaded; only its fingerprint is sent. The archive is {bytes} bytes.

archive.stored.text: Kopi e ke e sekasekileng e bolokilwe kwa pholisi ya rona ya direkoto e reng e bolokwe teng.
archive.stored.from: The copy I checked is stored where our records policy says it should be kept.

archive.removeOne.text: Tlosa faele e le 1 mo Sethaleng

archive.remove.text: Tlosa difaele di le {count} mo Sethaleng

archive.keepingOne.text: Tokomane e le 1 ya kwadiso e nna mo Sethaleng gape, ka gonne lenaneo le lengwe la moithuti le santse le e tlhoka.
archive.keepingOne.from: 1 enrolment document stays on the platform as well, because another programme of the learner's still needs it.

archive.keeping.text: Ditokomane di le {count} tsa kwadiso di nna mo Sethaleng gape, ka gonne lenaneo le lengwe la moithuti le santse le di tlhoka.
archive.keeping.from: {count} enrolment documents stay on the platform as well, because another programme of the learner's still needs them.

archive.wrongSize.text: Faele eo e na le di-bytes tse {size} mme pokano e na le tse {expected}. Ga se pokano eno.
archive.wrongSize.from: That file is {size} bytes and the archive is {expected}. It is not this archive.

archive.couldNotStart.text: Go busetsa ga go a kgona go simolola.

archive.pieceRefused.text: Karolo ya go tsenya e ganetswe.
archive.pieceRefused.from: A piece of the upload was refused.

archive.carryOn.text: {problem} Tlhopha faele gape gore o tswelele go tswa kwa go emileng teng.
archive.carryOn.from: {problem} Choose the file again to carry on from where it stopped.

archive.checkingFiles.text: Go sekasekwa faele nngwe le nngwe…

archive.restoreNote.text: E tlhokega fela fa difaele tseno di tshwanetse go boela mo Sethaleng. Pokano e a tsenngwa, e sekasekwa kgatlhanong le letshwao la monwana le le tsewang fa e dirwa, mme faele nngwe le nngwe e busediwa kwa e neng e le teng.
archive.restoreNote.from: Only needed if these files have to be on the platform again. The archive is uploaded, checked against the fingerprint taken when it was made, and each file is put back where it was.

register.supervisedIntro.text: Ke mang yo o amogetsweng, se ba dumetseng, le gore pampiri ya bone e amogetswe. Kopano ka bosone e direga kwa dithuto tsa gago di direlwang teng; fano ke rekoto ya gore e ne ya tlhokomelwa jang.
register.supervisedIntro.from: Who was admitted, what they agreed to, and that their script was received. The meeting itself runs where your lectures do; this is the record of how it was supervised.

register.canInvigilate.text: Seno ke kopano ya tlhatlhobo ya bofelo, ka jalo e ka tlhokomelwa.
register.canInvigilate.from: This is a summative session, so it can be invigilated.

register.intro.text: Ke mang yo o neng a le teng. Dintlha tse di bolokilweng di ka baakanngwa moragonyana, mme phetogo nngwe le nngwe e rekotelwa yo o e dirileng.
register.intro.from: Who was here. Saved marks can be corrected later, and every change is recorded against whoever made it.

register.nobody.text: Ga go ope mo setlhopheng seno go fitlha jaanong, ka jalo ga go na lenaane la go nna teng le le tshwanetseng go tseewa.
register.nobody.from: Nobody is on this cohort yet, so there is no register to take.

register.save.text: Boloka lenaane la go nna teng

register.excusedNote.text: Go lopolotswa go raya go seyo ka lebaka le moabi a le amogetseng. Go tshwaraganngwa kwa thoko le go seyo fela ka gonne mokgwa wa go tshegetsa baithuti o ikaegile ka phapaanyo eo.
register.excusedNote.from: Excused means absent for a reason the provider accepted. It is kept apart from a plain absence because the learner support procedure turns on the difference.

sitting.needsAssessment.text: Tlhatlhobo e e tlhokometsweng e tlhoka tlhatlhobo e e ka tlhokometsweng. Phasalatsa nngwe mo kosing pele, mme e ka rulaganngwa fano.
sitting.needsAssessment.from: A supervised sitting needs an assessment to supervise. Publish one on the course first, and it can be set up here.

sitting.nothing.text: Ga go na sepe se se tlhokometsweng mo kopanong eno. E rulaganye fa e le tlhatlhobo e e tlhokometsweng; e go naya nako ya bofelo ya go amogela, boitlhomamiso, tlhatlhobo ya khamera, lenaane la dipampiri le rekoto ya diteko.
sitting.nothing.from: Nothing is being supervised at this session. Set one up if this is an invigilated assessment; it gives you an admission cut-off, a declaration, a camera check, a script register and an incident log.

sitting.invigilator.text: Motlhokomedi wa tlhatlhobo (ga o patelesege, mme o ka beiwa ka letsatsi leo)
sitting.invigilator.from: Invigilator (optional, and can be set on the day)

sitting.nobodyYet.text: Ga go ope go fitlha jaanong

sitting.early.text: Baithuti ba ba kwalang ba goroga metsotso e e kalo pele
sitting.early.from: Candidates arrive this many minutes early

sitting.closesAfter.text: Go amogela go tswalega metsotso e e kalo morago ga go simolola
sitting.closesAfter.from: Admission closes this many minutes after the start

sitting.camera.text: Khamera e tshwanetse go nna e butswe nako yotlhe
sitting.camera.from: A camera must be on throughout

sitting.materials.text: Se se ka tsenngwang (ga se patelesege)

sitting.materialsHint.text: Khalekhuleita e e sa dirwang ka lekwalo la difomula le le neetsweng. Ga go na sepe se sengwe.
sitting.materialsHint.from: A non-programmable calculator and the issued formula sheet. Nothing else.

sitting.declaration.text: Se moithuti mongwe le mongwe a dumelang go sona pele a simolola (ga se patelesege)
sitting.declaration.from: What each candidate agrees to before starting (optional)

sitting.nothingFurther.text: Ga go sa tlhokega sepe fano.

room.elsewhere.text: Seo ke {time} {zone} kwa o leng teng. Dinako tse di rekotilweng fano ke tsa moabi, e leng se rekoto e se bolokang.
room.elsewhere.from: That is {time} {zone} where you are. Times recorded here are the provider's, which is what the record keeps.

room.arrive.text: Baithuti ba ba kwalang ba goroga metsotso e le {minutes} pele.

room.closesAt.text: Go amogela go tswalega metsotso e le {minutes} morago ga go simolola, ka {time}; morago ga foo Sethala se a gana, ka gonne yo o amogetsweng morago o nnile le nako e telele le pampiri go feta ba bangwe botlhe.
room.closesAt.from: Admission closes {minutes} minutes after the start, at {time}; after that the platform refuses, because somebody admitted late has had longer with the paper than everybody else.

room.closes.text: Go amogela go tswalega metsotso e le {minutes} morago ga go simolola; morago ga foo Sethala se a gana, ka gonne yo o amogetsweng morago o nnile le nako e telele le pampiri go feta ba bangwe botlhe.
room.closes.from: Admission closes {minutes} minutes after the start; after that the platform refuses, because somebody admitted late has had longer with the paper than everybody else.

room.cameras.text: Dikhamera di nna di butswe nako yotlhe.

room.joinNote.text: Kopano e direga mo sethaleng se se se dirisang kgale. Se se rekotilweng fano ke gore e ne ya tlhokomelwa jang.
room.joinNote.from: The meeting runs on the platform you already use. What is recorded here is how it was supervised.

room.noLink.text: Ga go na kgokagano ya kopano mo kopanong eno go fitlha jaanong. Tsenya nngwe mo lenaneong la go tsamaisa gore baithuti ba ba kwalang ba itse gore ba ya kae.
room.noLink.from: No meeting link on this session yet. Add one on the roll-out so candidates know where to go.

room.incidentsNote.text: Di kwalwa ka letsatsi leo. Pego e e kwadilweng dibeke morago e na le boleng jo bonnye thata fa go na le boipiletso, e leng fela fa e balwang teng.
room.incidentsNote.from: Filed on the day. An account written weeks later is worth very little at an appeal, which is the only place it is ever read.

quals.intro.text: Boitseanape jwa tiro bo rutiwa ka mefuta e meraro ya modiule: Kitso, Bokgoni jwa tiro le Maitemogelo a tiro. Modiule mongwe le mongwe o na le ditekanyetso tsa one tsa tlhatlhobo, mme sistimi e sekaseka gore diteng tsa kosi di akaretsa nngwe le nngwe ya tsone pele kosi e ka phasalatswa.
quals.intro.from: An occupational qualification is delivered across three kinds of module: Knowledge, Practical skill, and Workplace experience. Each module has its own assessment criteria, and the system checks that course content covers every one of them before a course can be published.

quals.folderTitle.text: Kgotsa bo agiwe go tswa mo folodareng
quals.folderTitle.from: Or build it from a folder

quals.folderIntro.text: Sengwe le sengwe ka nako e le nngwe: kharikhulamo, diyuniti tsa thuto, ditataiso le melawana. Folodara e e nang le kakaretso ya yone e tsenngwa ka metsotso; e e se nang yone e tlhoka gore go bonwe sebopego sa yone, mme seo ke karolo e e tlhokang katoloso ya AI.
quals.folderIntro.from: Everything at once: the curriculum, the study units, the guides and the policies. A folder that includes a summary of itself imports in seconds; one that does not has to have its structure worked out, and that is the part that needs an AI extension.

quals.folderLabel.text: Folodara ya boitseanape, go tswa mo khomputareng ya gago
quals.folderLabel.from: The qualification's folder, from your own computer

quals.folderHint.text: Sengwe le sengwe mo folodareng le mo difolodareng tse dinnye se a baliwa: kharikhulamo, diyuniti tsa thuto, ditataiso le melawana.
quals.folderHint.from: Everything in the folder and its subfolders is read: the curriculum, the study units, the guides and the policies.

quals.folderHint2.text: Folodara e e agilweng ke sistimi ya gago ya tlhabololo ya lenaneo e na le kakaretso ya yone, mme seo se baliwa ka tlhamalalo, ka metsotso. Folodara e se nang yone ga e ise e kgone go bonwa sebopego sa yone.
quals.folderHint2.from: A folder built by your programme development system includes a summary of itself, and that is read directly, in seconds. A folder without one cannot have its structure worked out yet.

quals.driveTitle.text: Kgotsa go tswa mo drayiveng e o e golaganyeng
quals.driveTitle.from: Or from a drive you have connected

quals.driveIntro.text: Folodara e le nngwe, e baliwa kwa e leng teng. E felela mo lefelong le le tshwanang: tshitshinyo e o e sekasekang pele go kwalwa sepe.
quals.driveIntro.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

quals.noneTitle.text: Ga go na diboitseanape go fitlha jaanong

quals.noneManage.text: Aga nngwe go tswa mo ditokomaneng tsa yone (tebe e e kwa godimo): tokomane ya kharikhulamo le tokomane ya boitseanape di lekane, mme ga go dirisiwe katoloso ya AI. Sengwe le sengwe se sengwe mo Sethaleng se ikaegile ka boitseanape, ka jalo seno ke selo sa ntlha se o tshwanetseng go se dira.
quals.noneManage.from: Build one from its documents (the tab above): the curriculum document and the qualification document are enough, and no AI extension is involved. Everything else on the platform hangs off a qualification, so this is the first thing to do.

quals.noneRead.text: Ga go a tsenngwa nngwe go fitlha jaanong. Fa nngwe e setse e tsentswe, kharikhulamo e o e rutang le e o tlhatlhobang ka yone e tla bo e le fano: dimodiule tsa yone, dikgang tsa yone le ditekanyetso tse nngwe le nngwe e tlhatlhobiwang ka tsone. Go tsenya nngwe ke tiro ya molaodi.
quals.noneRead.from: None has been loaded yet. When one has been, the curriculum you teach and mark against will be here: its modules, its topics and the criteria each one is assessed by. Loading one is an administrator's job.

how.title.from: How would you like to add it?

how.intro.from: Three ways in. Pick one and only that one opens; you can close it again and choose differently.

how.documents.title.text: Go tswa mo ditokomaneng tsa yone

how.documents.summary.text: Tokomane ya kharikhulamo, tokomane ya boitseanape ya SAQA le tlhaloso ya tlhatlhobo. Sethala se bala kharikhulamo yotlhe go tswa mo go tsone.
how.documents.summary.from: The curriculum document, the SAQA qualification document and the assessment specification. The App reads the whole curriculum out of them.

how.documents.needs.text: Difaele tse pedi kgotsa tse tharo tsa PDF kgotsa Word.

how.documents.speed.text: Metsotso. Ga go dirisiwe AI ka nako epe.

how.folder.summary.from: Everything at once: the curriculum, the study units, the guides, the workbooks and the policies, filed as they are read.

how.folder.speed.from: Minutes. A folder that includes a summary of itself needs no AI; one that does not has its structure worked out, and that part does.

how.blank.summary.text: Boitseanape jo bo se nang sepe jo o bo agang ka letsogo: setlhogo, khoutu, boemo le dikhredite, morago dimodiule tsa jone bongwe ka bongwe.

how.blank.speed.from: As long as it takes. Nothing is read for you.

manager.chooseNote.from: Modules are not added here. This draws from its parent's curriculum, so a learner's work against a module counts once wherever they met it.

manager.codeFull.text: Jaaka e kwadilwe mo tokomaneng ya kharikhulamo. Ga e ke e balelwe: ke QCTO fela kgotsa OFO e ka reng ke eng.
manager.codeFull.from: As written on the curriculum document. Never worked out: only the QCTO or the OFO can say what it is.

manager.codePart.text: Khoutu e e tshwanang le ya boitseanape jo e tswang mo go jone. Di abelana kharikhulamo e le nngwe, ka jalo di abelana khoutu ya yone.
manager.codePart.from: The same code as the qualification it comes from. They share one curriculum, so they share its code.

manager.accreditationNote.text: Nomoro e boitseanape jono bo akhredithiwa ka yone. Lekwalo le le lengwe la akhredithesheine gantsi le akaretsa diboitseanape di le mmalwa, ka jalo seno ga se nna se le sengwe le nomoro ya moabi ka bosone. Se tlogele se se na sepe mme dipego di boela kwa go ya moabi mme di re jalo.
manager.accreditationNote.from: The number this qualification is accredited under. One accreditation letter usually covers several qualifications, so this is not always the same as the provider's own number. Leave it blank and reports fall back to the provider's and say so.

fromDoc.source.curriculum.note.text: Dimodiule, dikgang le ditekanyetso tsa selegae tsa tlhatlhobo.
fromDoc.source.curriculum.note.from: The modules, topics and internal assessment criteria.

fromDoc.source.qualification.note.text: Kgatiso ya kwadiso ya SAQA. Ke yone fela motswedi wa ID ya SAQA le Diphetho tsa Maemo a go Tswa.
fromDoc.source.qualification.note.from: The SAQA registration extract. The only source of the SAQA ID and the Exit Level Outcomes.

fromDoc.open.text: Aga nngwe go tswa mo ditokomaneng tsa yone

fromDoc.title.text: Go tswa mo ditokomaneng tsa boitseanape

fromDoc.intro.text: Tse tharo tseno ke motheo o sengwe le sengwe se agilweng mo go one. Di tsenye mme Sethala se bala dintlha tsa boitseanape, Diphetho tsa yone tsa Maemo a go Tswa le kharikhulamo yotlhe go tswa mo go tsone. Sekaseka se se bonweng, baakanya sengwe le sengwe se se sa siamang, mme se kwalwa ka nako e le nngwe.
fromDoc.intro.from: These three are the foundation everything else is built on. Upload them and the App reads the qualification's details, its Exit Level Outcomes and its whole curriculum out of them. Check what it found, correct anything it got wrong, and it is written in one go.

fromDoc.pressThis.text: Jaanong gatelela seno. Ga go a kwalwa sepe go fitlha jaanong.
fromDoc.pressThis.from: Now press this. Nothing is written yet.

fromDoc.stillReading.text: Go santse go balwa: metsotso e le {seconds}. Tokomane ya kharikhulamo e ntsi; seno ke sa tlwaelo.
fromDoc.stillReading.from: Still reading: {seconds} seconds. A curriculum document is long; this is normal.

fromDoc.found.text: Go badilwe dimodiule di le {modules}, dikgang di le {topics}, dintlha tse di le {elements} tsa go ruta le ditekanyetso tsa tlhatlhobo di le {criteria}.
fromDoc.found.from: Read {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} assessment criteria.

fromDoc.foundWithElo.text: Go badilwe dimodiule di le {modules}, dikgang di le {topics}, dintlha tse di le {elements} tsa go ruta le ditekanyetso tsa tlhatlhobo di le {criteria}, gape le Diphetho tsa Maemo a go Tswa di le {outcomes} tse di nang le ditekanyetso tse di amanang le tsone di le {associated}.
fromDoc.foundWithElo.from: Read {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} assessment criteria, plus {outcomes} Exit Level Outcomes with {associated} associated criteria.

fromDoc.partOf.text: Tokomane ya yone e re ke {kind} e e tserweng mo go {parent}. Ga go na sepe se se tla kopololwang: e abelana kharikhulamo ya boitseanape joo, mme e tsaya dimodiule tse {count} tsa jone.
fromDoc.partOf.from: Its document says this is a {kind} drawn from {parent}. Nothing will be copied: it shares that qualification's curriculum, and takes {count} of its modules.

fromDoc.alreadyWhy.text: Go tsenya kharikhulamo gape go ka tsaya nako ya e e leng nayo, mme sengwe le sengwe se se tshwailweng ka tekanyetso se tla tsamaya le yone. Se o ka se batlang ke go okeletsa se se tlhaelang (dilo tse di tlhokegang kgotsa dikarolo tsa kharikhulamo tse di sa ka tsa tsena), se se dirwang mo boitseanapeng ka bosone mme se tlogela sengwe le sengwe se se setseng se le teng se sa tshwenngwa.
fromDoc.alreadyWhy.from: Importing the curriculum again would replace the one it has, and anything tagged to a criterion would go with it. What you probably want is to add what is missing (the material, or the parts of the curriculum that never made it), which is done on the qualification itself and leaves everything already there untouched.

fromDoc.openIt.text: Bula, mme o okeletse se se tlhaelang
fromDoc.openIt.from: Open it, and add what is missing

fromDoc.filedPart.text: Tokomane ya yone ya boitseanape e bolokilwe kgatlhanong le yone. Tokomane ya kharikhulamo le tlhaloso ya tlhatlhobo ga di a bolokwa jalo: ke tsa boitseanape jo e tswang mo go jone, mme di setse di bolokilwe koo.
fromDoc.filedPart.from: Its own Qualification Document is filed against it. The curriculum document and the assessment specification are not: they belong to the qualification it comes from, and are already filed there.

fromDoc.filed.text: Tokomane nngwe le nngwe e o e neetseng e bolokilwe kgatlhanong le boitseanape, gore mosekaseki a ka bula motswedi wa tekanyetso nngwe le nngwe, le gore kgoreletso ya go siama e fitlhelelwe pele dilo tse di tlhokegang di kwalwa.
fromDoc.filed.from: Every document you supplied is filed against the qualification, so a moderator can open the source of any criterion, and so the readiness gate is satisfied before material is authored.

qualPage.finish.from: Finish this qualification from a fuller folder

qualPage.finishLabel.text: Folodara e e feletseng ya boitseanape jono, go tswa mo khomputareng ya gago
qualPage.finishLabel.from: The completed folder for this qualification, from your own computer

qualPage.finishHint.text: Ya boitseanape jo bo tsentsweng pele ga ditokomane tsa jone di feleletse. Folodara yotlhe e baliwa gape (kharikhulamo le dilo tsa go ithuta) mme se se tlhaelang fela se okediwa.
qualPage.finishHint.from: For a qualification that was loaded before its documents were complete. The whole folder is read again (the curriculum as well as the material) and only what is missing is added.

qualPage.finishHint2.text: Ga go na sepe se se setseng se le teng se se fetolwang kgotsa se se emisiwang, go fitlha kwa mafokong a tekanyetso e le nngwe, mme go e dira gabedi ga go dire sepe la bobedi. O santse o bona sengwe le sengwe se se bonweng mme o se dumela pele go kwalwa sepe.
qualPage.finishHint2.from: Nothing already here is changed or replaced, down to the wording of a single criterion, and running it twice does nothing the second time. You still see everything it found and confirm it before any of it is written.

qualPage.finishDrive.text: Kgotsa folodara e e feletseng go tswa mo drayiveng e o e golaganyeng. E okelediwa ka mokgwa o o tshwanang: se se tlhaelang fela se okediwa.
qualPage.finishDrive.from: Or the completed folder from a drive you have connected. It tops up the same way: only what is missing is added.

qualPage.materialHere.text: Dilo tsa go ithuta di ya fano: folodara yotlhe ka nako e le nngwe. Ga go a bolokwa sepe go fitlha o bone se se bonweng.
qualPage.materialHere.from: The material goes here: the whole folder at once. Nothing is saved until you have seen what it found.

qualPage.wholeFolder.text: Folodara yotlhe ka nako e le nngwe
