qualPage.materialHint.text: Ditataiso tsa thuto ya khopolo le dibuka tsa tiro di ya kwa yuniting ya thuto e leina la faele ya tsone le e bolelang, melawana le dikonteraka di ya kwa laeboraring ya ditokomane, mme sengwe le sengwe se sengwe se ya kgatlhanong le boitseanape jono. Ga go dirisiwe AI fano ka gope: go kgaoganya ditokomane ka leina ke molawana, e seng katlholo.
qualPage.materialHint.from: Theory guides and workbooks go to the study unit their filename names, policies and contracts to the document library, and everything else against this qualification. No AI is used here at all: sorting documents by name is a rule rather than a judgement.

qualPage.whereItLives.text: Kgotsa folodara kwa e leng teng
qualPage.whereItLives.from: Or the folder where it already lives

qualPage.alignmentHere.text: Tokomane ya gago ya go tsamaelana e ya fano: e tlhophe, baya mofuta wa yone e le Lenaane la go tsamaelana ga kharikhulamo, mme o e tsenye. Seo se aga diyuniti tsa thuto.
qualPage.alignmentHere.from: Your alignment document goes here: choose it, set its kind to Curriculum Alignment Matrix, and upload. That builds the study units.

qualPage.blueprintIntro.text: Faele e e tlhalosang kharikhulamo eno ka botlalo: dimodiule di le {count}, le dikgang tsa tsone, se nngwe le nngwe e se rutang le se e tlhatlhobiwang ka sone. E baye mo directoring ya {folder} ya folodara ya boitseanape mme tsenyo nngwe le nngwe ya folodara eo morago e e bala ka tlhamalalo, ka metsotso, ntle le katoloso ya AI ka nako epe.
qualPage.blueprintIntro.from: A file describing this curriculum exactly: {count} modules, with their topics, what each teaches and what each is assessed by. Put it in the qualification folder's {folder} directory and every import of that folder afterwards reads it straight off, in seconds, with no AI extension involved at any point.

qualPage.notCarried.text: Se faele e se sa se tsholeng
qualPage.notCarried.from: What the file does not carry

qualPage.notCaptured.text: Dimodiule di le {count} mo go {total} ga di ise di nne le ditekanyetso.
qualPage.notCaptured.from: {count} of {total} modules have no criteria yet.

qualPage.notCapturedWhy.text: Ga go ope yo o ka bolelwang a siametse EISA kgatlhanong le boitseanape jono go fitlha tokomane yotlhe ya kharikhulamo e kwaletswe; modiule o se nang ditekanyetso ga o ka wa palelwa, ka jalo go di tlogela di le sena sepe go ka dira gore moithuti mongwe le mongwe a bonale a fedile.
qualPage.notCapturedWhy.from: Nobody can be declared ready for the EISA against this qualification until the whole curriculum document has been transcribed; a module with no criteria cannot be failed, so leaving them empty would make every learner look finished.

qualPage.structureIntro.text: Kharikhulamo e phasalatsa dimodiule; moabi o ruta diyuniti tsa thuto. Nngwe le nngwe e kopanya dimodiule tsa Kitso, Bokgoni jwa tiro le Maitemogelo a tiro tse di direlang Phetho e le nngwe ya Maemo a go Tswa, e leng se Tlhatlhobo ya Bofelo e e Kopaneng ya Kwa Ntle e beilweng kgatlhanong le sone. Baabi ba le babedi ba ka kopanya boitseanape jo bo tshwanang ka tsela e e farologanang mme botlhe ba nepile, ka jalo seno ke sebopego sa moabi, e seng sa kharikhulamo.
qualPage.structureIntro.from: The curriculum publishes modules; a provider teaches study units. Each bundles the Knowledge, Practical and Work Experience modules that serve one Exit Level Outcome, which is what the External Integrated Summative Assessment is set against. Two providers may group the same qualification differently and both be correct, so this is the provider's structure rather than the curriculum's.

qualPage.seeAsLearner.text: Se bone jaaka moithuti a tla se bona
qualPage.seeAsLearner.from: See it as a learner will

qualPage.seeAsLearnerNote.text: e bontsha lenaneo lotlhe ka tatelano e le tsamaiwang ka yone, mme sengwe le sengwe se moithuti a ka se sa se bonang se rulaganngwa ka leina. Ga go a simololwa sepe mme ga go a rekotiwa sepe.
qualPage.seeAsLearnerNote.from: shows the whole programme in the order it is walked, with anything a learner would not find named. Nothing is started and nothing is recorded.

qualPage.nextStep.text: Kgato e e latelang: kopanya dimodiule tseno mo diyuniting tsa thuto.
qualPage.nextStep.from: The next step: group these modules into study units.

qualPage.nextStepWhy.text: Kharikhulamo e phasalatsa dimodiule mme ga e bue sepe ka diyuniti tsa thuto, ka gonne go di kopanya ke tshwetso ya moabi ka bosone, ka jalo boitseanape jo bo badilweng go tswa mo ditokomaneng tsa jone bo tla bo bo na le dimodiule tsotlhe di le {count} tse di sa beelwang mo go epe. Seo se solofetswe, e seng phoso mo go tsenyeng.
qualPage.nextStepWhy.from: The curriculum publishes modules and says nothing about study units, because grouping them is the provider's own decision, so a qualification read from its documents arrives with all {count} of its modules unplaced. That is expected, not a fault in the import.

qualPage.nextStepHow.text: Tsenya tokomane ya gago ya go tsamaelana: e e bontshang Phetho nngwe le nngwe ya Maemo a go Tswa le dimodiule tsa yone, mo Word kgotsa Excel. E dira diyuniti tsa thuto, e di rea maina, mme e baya modiule mongwe le mongwe o e o akaretsang.
qualPage.nextStepHow.from: Upload your alignment document: the one mapping each Exit Level Outcome to its modules, in Word or Excel. It creates the study units, names them, and places every module it covers.

qualPage.unplacedOne.text: Modiule o le 1 ga o mo yuniting epe ya thuto.
qualPage.unplacedOne.from: 1 module belongs to no study unit.

qualPage.unplaced.text: Dimodiule di le {count} ga di mo yuniting epe ya thuto.
qualPage.unplaced.from: {count} modules belong to no study unit.

qualPage.unplacedWhy.text: {modules}. Modiule o o sa rutiweng ke yuniti epe ya thuto ke modiule o go seng ope yo o o rutang, le fa kharikhulamo ya one e nnile e tsenngwa ka botlalo jang.
qualPage.unplacedWhy.from: {modules}. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches, however completely its curriculum has been captured.

qualPage.elo.text: Phetho ya Maemo a go Tswa {number}

qualPage.noElo.text: E ga e tsamaelane le Phetho epe ya Maemo a go Tswa
qualPage.noElo.from: Aligned to no Exit Level Outcome

qualPage.eisaTests.text: Ditekanyetso tse di amanang tsa tlhatlhobo: se EISA e se tlhatlhobang
qualPage.eisaTests.from: Associated assessment criteria: what the EISA tests

qualPage.noModules.text: Yuniti eno ga e rute dimodiule dipe.
qualPage.noModules.from: This study unit delivers no modules.

qualPage.unitMaterial.text: Dilo tse di bolokilweng kgatlhanong le yuniti eno

qualPage.documentsIntro.text: Tse di bolokilweng fano ke dikopi tse di dumelesegang: ditokomane tsa motswedi tse boitseanape jono bo agilweng ka tsone, nngwe le nngwe e golaganngwa le karolo ya kharikhulamo e e e direlang, mme e nale letshwao la monwana gore go ka supiwa gore ga e a fetolwa.
qualPage.documentsIntro.from: Filed here are the authoritative copies: the source documents this qualification is built from, each attached to the part of the curriculum it serves and hashed so it can be proved unchanged.

qualPage.recordNotThing.text: Buka ya tiro kgotsa tlhatlhobo e e bolokilweng fano ke rekoto, e seng selo se moithuti a dirang mo go sone.
qualPage.recordNotThing.from: A workbook or an assessment filed here is a record, not the thing a learner works on.

qualPage.recordWhy.text: Tseo di baliwa mme di bontshiwa mo skrineng, ka jalo moithuti o araba mo Sethaleng mme mokoetlisi o tshwaya le go tlhagisa ditshwaelo koo. Tsenya tokomane ya Word ka Go di tsenya go na le fano, mme e nna dipotso ka bosone. Dibuka tsa moithuti, ditataiso le makwalo a tlhomamiso ya lefelo la tiro ga a jalo: a nna e le ditokomane, ka gonne mokoetlisi o di kwalela ditshwaelo mme mokoetlisi wa lefelo la tiro o di saena mo pampiring.
qualPage.recordWhy.from: Those are read in and presented on screen, so a learner answers in the platform and a facilitator marks and comments there. Upload the Word document under Capture rather than here, and it becomes the questions themselves. Handbooks, guides and workplace sign-off sheets are different: they stay as documents, because a facilitator annotates them and a coach signs them on paper.

qualPage.noDocuments.text: Ga go na ditokomane tse di tshwerweng go fitlha jaanong.

qualPage.notTranscribed.text: Ga e ise e kwalwe go tswa mo tokomaneng ya kharikhulamo.
qualPage.notTranscribed.from: Not yet transcribed from the curriculum document.

qualPage.iac.text: Ditekanyetso tsa selegae tsa tlhatlhobo: se se tshwanetseng go fitlhelelwa
qualPage.iac.from: Internal assessment criteria: what must be achieved

qualPage.workplaceNone.text: Ga go na ditekanyetso tsa tlhatlhobo, e leng se se siameng mo maitemogelong a tiro: bo supiwa ke rekoto e e saenilweng ya tiro, e seng ka go atlholwa kgatlhanong le ditekanyetso.
qualPage.workplaceNone.from: No assessment criteria, which is right for work experience: it is proved by a signed record of the work rather than judged against criteria.

qualPage.neverAchieved.text: Ga go na ditekanyetso tsa tlhatlhobo, ka jalo setlhogo seno ga se ke sa fitlhelelwa.
qualPage.neverAchieved.from: No assessment criteria, so this topic can never be achieved.

removeQual.cannot.text: Boitseanape jono ga bo ka ba tlosiwa

removeQual.cannotWhy.text: Go rekotilwe dilo kgatlhanong le jone, mme Sethala se di boloka. Ke tsone tse tlhatlhobo ya QCTO e di botsang, mme di tswelela go ba teng fa boitseanape jo di neng di rekotilwe ka jone bo sa tlhole bo le teng.
removeQual.cannotWhy.from: Things have been recorded against it, and the platform keeps them. They are what a QCTO audit asks about, and they outlive the qualification they were recorded under.

removeQual.canWhy.text: Ga go a rekotiwa sepe kgatlhanong le jone (ga go na moithuti yo o kwadisitsweng, ga go na tlhatlhobo e e kwadisitsweng, mme ga go a nna le Setatemente sa Diphetho se se ntshitsweng), ka jalo bo ka tlosiwa. Seno ga se ka sa busediwa.
removeQual.canWhy.from: Nothing has been recorded against it (no learner is enrolled, no sitting is registered and no Statement of Results has been issued) so it can be removed. This cannot be undone.

removeQual.wouldTake.text: E tla tsaya {items} le jone, le setlhogo sengwe le sengwe, karolo, tekanyetso le tokomane e e bolokilweng ka fa tlase ga tsone.
removeQual.wouldTake.from: It would take {items} with it, along with every topic, element, criterion and filed document beneath them.

captureList.intro.text: Tseno di setse di le mo Sethaleng. Go di tsenya go bala dipotso tsa tsone mo faeleng ya Word mme go tshwantsha tataiso ya dikarabo e e bolokilweng go yone; ga go tsenngwe sepe gape. Se se e se tshitshinyang se bontshiwa go wena pele ga sepe sa yone se nna tlhatlhobo.
captureList.intro.from: These are already in the platform. Capturing one reads its questions out of the Word file and pairs the answer guide filed beside it; nothing is uploaded again. What it proposes is shown to you before any of it becomes an assessment.

captureList.all.text: Tsotlhe di le {count} di tsentswe. Baithuti ba ka di araba mo skrineng.
captureList.all.from: All {count} captured. Learners can answer these on screen.

captureList.noGuide.text: ga go na tataiso ya dikarabo e e bolokilweng: potso nngwe le nngwe e ka tlhoka karabo ya yone le dintlha ka letsogo
captureList.noGuide.from: no answer guide filed: every question would need its answer and marks by hand

uploader.kindNote.text: Lenaane la go tsamaelana ga kharikhulamo le a baliwa gape le a bolokwa: se le se buang ka mola mongwe le mongwe wa kharikhulamo se a rekotiwa.
uploader.kindNote.from: A curriculum alignment matrix is read as well as stored: what it says about each curriculum line is recorded.

uploader.titleHint.text: Fa se tlogetswe se se na sepe, leina la faele le a dirisiwa
uploader.titleHint.from: Left blank, the file name is used

uploader.versionNote.text: Go tsenya gape ka mofuta o o tshwanang le setlhogo se se tshwanang go tsaya bonno jwa jo bo fetileng go na le go bo emisa; phetolelo ya kgale e a nna.
uploader.versionNote.from: Uploading again with the same kind and title supersedes the previous one rather than replacing it; the old version stays.

uploader.fileNote.text: Word, Excel, PowerPoint le PDF. Se faele e leng sone se tswa mo diteng tsa yone, e seng mo leineng la yone.
uploader.fileNote.from: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF. What the file actually is comes from its contents, not its name.

uploader.inMatrix.text: Mo lenaaneng, e seng mo kharikhulamong jaaka e tshwerwe
uploader.inMatrix.from: In the matrix, not in the curriculum as held

uploader.inMatrixNote.text: Nngwe le nngwe e okediwa e tshwailwe e le ya gago, ka lebaka le le bontshiwang, gore mosekaseki a ka farologanya mela ya gago le ya molaodi. Tlosa letshwao mo sengweng le sengwe se se sa tshwanelang go okediwa.
uploader.inMatrixNote.from: Each is added marked as your own, with the reason shown, so a verifier can always tell your lines from the regulator's. Untick anything that should not be added.

uploader.add.text: Okeletsa mela e e tshwailweng mo kharikhulamong
uploader.add.from: Add the ticked lines to the curriculum

buildCurr.intro.text: E tsenye jaaka tokomane ya kharikhulamo e e gatisitse, ka dikhoutu tse di tshwanang ka tatelano e e tshwanang, gore tse pedi di baliwe di le mmogo. Mola mongwe le mongwe o a bolokwa fa o o tsenya.
buildCurr.intro.from: Enter it as the curriculum document prints it, with the same codes in the same order, so the two can be read side by side. Every line saves as you enter it.

buildCurr.ready.text: E siametse dilo tsa go ithuta. Dimodiule di le {modules} le ditekanyetso di le {criteria} di setse di tsentswe, ka jalo potso e ka tshwaiwa ka se e se supang.
buildCurr.ready.from: Ready for material. {modules} modules and {criteria} criteria are in, so a question can be tagged to what it evidences.

buildCurr.notReady.text: Ga e ise e siamele dilo tsa go ithuta.

buildCurr.whatItIsNote.text: Se beilwe fa bo tsengwa, mme se ka baakanngwa fano. Boitseanape jo bo feletseng bo na le kharikhulamo ya jone; karolo kgotsa lenaneo la dikgono di tlhopha dimodiule go tswa mo go jone.
buildCurr.whatItIsNote.from: Set when it was imported, and correctable here. A full qualification has its own curriculum; a part or a skills programme selects modules from one.

buildCurr.faultsNote.text: Ga se kgoro: o ka tsamaya mme wa boa. Le fa go ntse jalo, nngwe le nngwe ya tseno ke selo se Sethala se ka se kgoneng go se feta moragonyana.
buildCurr.faultsNote.from: Not a gate: you can leave and come back. Each of these, though, is something the platform cannot work around later.

buildCurr.worthKnowing.text: Se se molemo go se itse

addModule.note.text: Modiule wa maitemogelo a tiro o supiwa ke buka ya rekoto e mokoetlisi a e tshwayang, e seng ke ditekanyetso tsa tlhatlhobo, ka jalo o tsaya ditiro tsa tiro.
addModule.note.from: A work experience module is evidenced by a logbook a coach signs, not by assessment criteria, so it takes work activities instead.

addModule.nameHint.text: Jaaka tokomane ya kharikhulamo e o rea leina
addModule.nameHint.from: As the curriculum document titles it

editor.rename.text: Reela modiule ono leina le lengwe

editor.removeTopic.text: A o tlosa {code} le sengwe le sengwe se se mo go yone?

editor.addElement.text: Okeletsa mola wa se se tshwanetseng go rutiwa
editor.addElement.from: Add a line of what must be taught

editor.wordedHint.text: Jaaka tokomane ya kharikhulamo e se bua
editor.wordedHint.from: As the curriculum document words it

editor.noCriteria.text: Modiule wa maitemogelo a tiro ga o na tsepe. O supiwa ke buka ya rekoto e mokoetlisi a e tshwayang le motlhatlhobi a e amogelang, ka jalo ditiro tsa yone tsa tiro di ya mo ditlhogong tse di kwa godimo.
editor.noCriteria.from: A work experience module carries none. It is evidenced by a logbook the coach signs and an assessor accepts, so its work activities go in the topics above.

editor.criterionText.text: Se moithuti a tshwanetseng go se bontsha

elementKind.contextual_knowledge.text: Kitso ya lefelo la tiro ya go ya ka maemo

reclassify.lockedOne.text: Ga se ka se fetolwa: moithuti a le 1 o kwadisitswe mo go sone. Kwadiso e dirwa ka ID ya lenaneo, mme go fetola gore seno ke eng go ka fetola gore o tlhatlhobiwa mo dimoduleng dife, mme ka jalo se o tshwanetseng go se dira gore o fetse. Fa e le boammaaruri e le mofuta o o sa siamang, bopa o o siameng mme o mo kwadise mo go one.
reclassify.lockedOne.from: It cannot be changed: 1 learner is enrolled on it. Enrolment is per programme ID, and changing what this is would change which modules they are assessed against, and so what they have to do to finish. If it is genuinely the wrong sort of thing, create the right one and enrol them onto that.

reclassify.locked.text: Ga se ka se fetolwa: baithuti ba le {count} ba kwadisitswe mo go sone. Kwadiso e dirwa ka ID ya lenaneo, mme go fetola gore seno ke eng go ka fetola gore ba tlhatlhobiwa mo dimoduleng dife, mme ka jalo se ba tshwanetseng go se dira gore ba fetse. Fa e le boammaaruri e le mofuta o o sa siamang, bopa o o siameng mme o ba kwadise mo go one.
reclassify.locked.from: It cannot be changed: {count} learners are enrolled on it. Enrolment is per programme ID, and changing what this is would change which modules they are assessed against, and so what they have to do to finish. If it is genuinely the wrong sort of thing, create the right one and enrol them onto that.

reclassify.parentNote.text: Karolo ga e na tokomane ya kharikhulamo ya yone: e dirisa ya motheo, mme e tlhopha dimodiule go tswa mo go yone.
reclassify.parentNote.from: A part has no curriculum document of its own: it uses its parent's, and selects modules from it.

reclassify.ownModulesOne.text: Boitseanape jono bo na le modiule o le 1 wa kharikhulamo ya bone, go tswa fa bo ne bo tsengwa. O sala fa o leng teng: go bo rekota e le karolo ga go o phimole, mme o tlhopha ka go farologana gore ke dimodiule dife tsa motheo tse bo di tlhophang.
reclassify.ownModulesOne.from: This qualification has 1 module of its own curriculum, from when it was imported. It stays where it is: recording it as a part does not delete it, and you choose separately which of the parent's modules it selects.

reclassify.ownModules.text: Boitseanape jono bo na le dimodiule di le {count} tsa kharikhulamo ya bone, go tswa fa bo ne bo tsengwa. Di sala fa di leng teng: go bo rekota e le karolo ga go di phimole, mme o tlhopha ka go farologana gore ke dimodiule dife tsa motheo tse bo di tlhophang.
reclassify.ownModules.from: This qualification has {count} modules of its own curriculum, from when it was imported. Those stay where they are: recording it as a part does not delete them, and you choose separately which of the parent's modules it selects.

reclassify.selectedOne.text: Modiule o le 1 o o tlhophilweng go tswa mo motheong o tla tlhatswiwa. Boitseanape jo bo feletseng ga bo tlhophe sepe go tswa kwa go ope, mme go o tlogela go tla o tswelela o bala mo dikhrediteng tsa jone.
reclassify.selectedOne.from: The 1 module selected from its parent will be cleared. A full qualification selects nothing from anybody, and leaving it would keep it counting towards its credits.

reclassify.selected.text: Dimodiule di le {count} tse di tlhophilweng go tswa mo motheong di tla tlhatswiwa. Boitseanape jo bo feletseng ga bo tlhophe sepe go tswa kwa go ope, mme go di tlogela go tla di tswelela di bala mo dikhrediteng tsa jone.
reclassify.selected.from: The {count} modules selected from its parent will be cleared. A full qualification selects nothing from anybody, and leaving them would keep them counting towards its credits.

takeDoc.readFrom.text: E badilwe go tswa mo go {file}. Ga go a okeletswa sepe se se kwa tlase go fitlha jaanong: bula modiule, o o bapisitse le tokomane, mme o o tseye fa o siame.
takeDoc.readFrom.from: Read from {file}. Nothing below has been added yet: open a module, check it against the document, and take it if it is right.

takeDoc.nothingRead.text: Ga go a badiwa sepe go fitlha jaanong.

takeDoc.nothing.text: Ga go na sepe se se akanngwang

takeDoc.goToDocuments.text: Ya kwa ditokomaneng tsa boitseanape jono
takeDoc.goToDocuments.from: Go to the documents for this qualification

takeDoc.notesNote.text: Se go bala go sa kang ga kgona go se tlhalosa, le se tokomane ka bosone e sa lekanang ka sone. Ga go a nngwe ya tsone e e go thibelang go tsaya modiule, le fa go le jalo go molemo go di bala pele.
takeDoc.notesNote.from: What the reading could not account for, and what the document itself does not add up. Neither stops you taking a module, though both are worth reading first.

takeDoc.read.text: Dimodiule di le {count} tse di badilweng

takeDoc.already.text: {count} di setse di le mo kharikhulamong

takeDoc.byLogbook.text: bo supiwa ke buka ya rekoto

takeDoc.addedCounts.text: Go okeleditswe ditlhogo tse {topics}, mela e le {elements} ya go ruta le ditekanyetso tse {criteria}.
takeDoc.addedCounts.from: Added {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} criteria.

takeDoc.refused.text: Mela e le {count} ga e a okeletswa:

takeDoc.byHand.text: Di okeletse ka seatla mo skrineng sa kharikhulamo.
takeDoc.byHand.from: Add these by hand on the curriculum screen.

takeDoc.empty.text: Ga go a badiwa sepe ka fa tlase ga modiule ono. Go o tsaya go tla bopa modiule fela, mme ditlhogo tsa one di ka okeletswa ka seatla.
takeDoc.empty.from: Nothing was read under this module. Taking it will create the module alone, and its topics can be added by hand.

element.asWorded.text: {kind}, fela jaaka tokomane ya kharikhulamo e e bua. Ga go sepe mo tsebeng eno se se ka fetolwang fano: kharikhulamo e e phasaladitsweng ke ya QCTO, e seng ya moabi.
element.asWorded.from: {kind}, exactly as the curriculum document words it. Nothing on this page may be edited here: a published curriculum is the QCTO's, not the provider's.

element.coversNote.text: Go tswa mo Lenaaneng la go Tsamaelana ga Kharikhulamo, jaaka moabi a le kwadile koo.
element.coversNote.from: From the Curriculum Alignment Matrix, as the provider wrote it there.

element.uncovered.text: Ga go na sepe se se rekotilweng se e kwaleletsa.
element.uncovered.from: Nothing is recorded as covering this line.

element.uncoveredNote.text: Seo e ka tswa e le lekgaba le le tlhomameng mo lenaneong kgotsa lenaane le le ise le tsenngwe. Tsenya Lenaane la go Tsamaelana ga Kharikhulamo kgatlhanong le boitseanape jono mme mola mongwe le mongwe o o umakilweng o tlatsiwa ka nako e le nngwe.
element.uncoveredNote.from: That is either a real gap in the programme or a matrix that has not been uploaded yet. Upload the Curriculum Alignment Matrix against this qualification and every line it names is filled in at once.

element.notHeld.text: e umakilwe mo lenaaneng, mme ga go na tokomane e e fano e e nang le leina leo.
element.notHeld.from: named in the matrix, but no document held here has that name.

element.assessedNote.text: Ditekanyetso tsa selegae tsa tlhatlhobo tsa setlhogo se mola ono e leng wa sone.
element.assessedNote.from: The internal assessment criteria of the topic this line belongs to.

element.workplace.text: Modiule wa maitemogelo a tiro ga o na ditekanyetso tsa tlhatlhobo. Se o se tlhokang se supiwa ke rekoto e e tshwailweng ya tiro ka bosone, e e amogetsweng ke motlhatlhobi, e seng go atlholwa kgatlhanong le ditekanyetso.
element.workplace.from: A work experience module has no assessment criteria. What it requires is evidenced by a signed record of the work itself, accepted by an assessor, rather than judged against criteria.

element.noCriteria.text: Setlhogo seno ga se na ditekanyetso tsa tlhatlhobo, ka jalo ga go sepe fano se se ka fitlhelelwang ka gope. Go fitlha di tsewa mo tokomaneng ya kharikhulamo, ga go moithuti yo o ka fetsang modiule ono.
element.noCriteria.from: This topic has no assessment criteria, so nothing here can ever be achieved. Until they are captured from the curriculum document, no learner can complete this module.

element.resource.code_of_good_practice.text: Khoutu ya mokgwa o o siameng

element.taughtNote.text: Diyuniti tsa thuto tse modiule ono o rutiwang mo go tsone.
element.taughtNote.from: The study units this module is delivered in.

partModules.title.text: Ke dimodiule dife tse seno se di tsayang

partModules.introPart.text: Boitseanape jono jwa karolo bo tserwe mo go {parent} mme bo abelana kharikhulamo le yone{code}. Tshwaya dimodiule tse tokomane ya jone ya SAQA e di kwadileng ka fa tlase ga {rules}. Ga go kopiwe sepe: tiro ya moithuti kgatlhanong le modiule e balwa fela gangwe, le fa a kopane le one kae.
partModules.introPart.from: This part qualification is drawn from {parent} and shares its curriculum{code}. Tick the modules its own SAQA document lists under {rules}. Nothing is copied: a learner's work against a module counts once, wherever they met it.

partModules.introOther.text: Lenaneo leno le tserwe mo go {parent} mme le abelana kharikhulamo le yone{code}. Tshwaya dimodiule tse tokomane ya lone ya SAQA e di kwadileng ka fa tlase ga {rules}. Ga go kopiwe sepe: tiro ya moithuti kgatlhanong le modiule e balwa fela gangwe, le fa a kopane le one kae.
partModules.introOther.from: This programme is drawn from {parent} and shares its curriculum{code}. Tick the modules its own SAQA document lists under {rules}. Nothing is copied: a learner's work against a module counts once, wherever they met it.

partModules.notRead.text: Kharikhulamo ya motheo ga e ise e badiwe
partModules.notRead.from: The parent's curriculum has not been read in yet

partModules.notReadNote.text: Ga go na sepe sa go tlhopha go fitlha {parent} e na le tokomane ya yone ya kharikhulamo e badilweng. Dira seo pele, mme lenaane leno le itlatsa.
partModules.notReadNote.from: There is nothing to choose from until {parent} has its curriculum document read in. Do that first, and this list fills itself.

partModules.noCredits.text: Ga go a rekotiwa dikhredite dipe

partModules.noClaim.text: Ga go a rekotiwa palogotlhe ya dikhredite ya boitseanape jono, ka jalo ga go na sepe sa go bapisa le sone. Tokomane ya jone ya SAQA e bolela nngwe ka fa tlase ga Dikhredite tsa Bonnye.
partModules.noClaim.from: No credit total is recorded for this qualification, so there is nothing to check against. Its SAQA document states one under Minimum Credits.

partModules.agree.text: Tseno di a lekana, e leng letshwao la gore dimodiule tse di siameng di tshwailwe.
partModules.agree.from: These agree, which is the sign the right modules are ticked.

partModules.disagree.text: Tseno ga di lekane. Kgotsa go tshwailwe modiule o tokomane ya SAQA e sa o kwaleng, kgotsa modiule o e o kwalang o a tlhaela, kgotsa dikhredite tsa modiule di badilwe ka phoso. Go molemo go di sekaseka pele o boloka; Sethala se sa ntse se tla boloka se o se bolelelang.
partModules.disagree.from: These do not agree. Either a module is ticked that the SAQA document does not list, or one it lists is missing, or the credits on a module were read in wrongly. Worth checking before saving; the platform will still save what you tell it.

partModules.save.text: Boloka gore ke dimodiule dife tse seno se di tsayang

qualPreview.title.text: Jaaka moithuti a tla go bona
qualPreview.title.from: As a learner will see it

qualPreview.intro.text: {programme} yotlhe ka tatelano e mongwe yo o e kwadisitsweng a e tsamayang ka yone. Ga go sepe fano se se simololang sepe: ga go dirwe kwadiso, ga go bulwe leiteko, mme ga go rekotiwe tswelelopele, ka jalo seno se ka baduwa ka makgetlo a le mantsi jaaka o rata.
qualPreview.intro.from: The whole {programme} in the order somebody enrolled on it walks it. Nothing here starts anything: no enrolment is made, no attempt is opened and no progress is recorded, so this can be read as often as you like.

qualPreview.gaps.text: Se moithuti a ka se sa se bonang
qualPreview.gaps.from: What a learner would not find

qualPreview.allReadyNote.text: Kgato nngwe le nngwe mo yuniting nngwe le nngwe ya thuto e na le sengwe se se e tshegeditseng. Moithuti yo o kwadisitsweng mo {programme} eno gompieno o ka bona yotlhe.
qualPreview.allReadyNote.from: Every step in every study unit has something behind it. A learner enrolled on this {programme} today would find the whole of it.

qualPreview.build.text: Aga se moithuti a se dirang
qualPreview.build.from: Build what a learner works through

qualPreview.open.text: E bule jaaka moithuti a e bona
qualPreview.open.from: Open it as a learner sees it

qualPreview.change.text: Fetola tatelano kgotsa se se mo go yone
qualPreview.change.from: Change the order or what is on it

qualPreview.start.text: Simolola go aga yuniti eno ya thuto

courseList.none.text: Ga go na {courses} go fitlha jaanong

courseList.noneAuthor.text: Kosi ke se moithuti a se dirang ka mmatota. E kgomaretswe mo yuniting ya thuto kgotsa modiuleng wa kharikhulamo, ka jalo go molemo go tsenya boitseanape pele.
courseList.noneAuthor.from: A course is what a learner actually works through. It hangs off a study unit or a curriculum module, so a qualification is worth loading first.

courseList.noneReader.text: Ga go a phasalatswa sepe go wena go fitlha jaanong. Fa go setse go phasalatswa, se o kwadisitsweng mo go sone se tla nna fano.
courseList.noneReader.from: Nothing has been published for you yet. When it has been, what you are enrolled on will be here.

newCourse.noModule.text: Ga se karolo ya boitseanape jo bo tlhomamisitsweng
newCourse.noModule.from: Not part of an accredited qualification

newCourse.moduleNote.text: E golaganye le modiule wa kharikhulamo, mme sesteme e tla tlhola, pele e ka phasalatswa, gore tekanyetso nngwe le nngwe ya tlhatlhobo mo modiuleng oo e na le thuto e e e tshegetsang.
newCourse.moduleNote.from: Bind it to a curriculum module and the system will check, before it can be published, that every assessment criterion in that module has a lesson behind it.

courseEdit.enrolments.text: Ke bomang ba ba mo go yone

courseEdit.published.text: Seno se phasaladitswe, ka jalo diteng tsa sone di tsepame. Baithuti ba ba se fetsang ba na le direkoto tse di supang phetolelo eno ka sebele.
courseEdit.published.from: This is published, so its content is fixed. Learners who completed it have records that refer to exactly this version.

courseEdit.publishedAuthor.text: Go e fetola, bula phetolelo e ntšha; e e phasaladitsweng e sala jaaka e ntse.
courseEdit.publishedAuthor.from: To change it, open a new version; the published one stays as it is.

courseEdit.folder.text: Okeletsa ditokomane go tswa mo folodareng

courseEdit.folderNote.text: Tlhopha folodara e dilo tseno di leng mo go yone mme sengwe le sengwe se se mo go yone, go akaretsa difolodara tse di ka fa tlase, se a badiwa, se a bolokwa, mme mokwalo wa sone o a tshwaelwa gore o ka batlwa. O bona se se ka bolokwang pele ga sepe se kwalwa.
courseEdit.folderNote.from: Choose the folder this material lives in and everything in it, including its subfolders, is read, filed and indexed. You see what it would file before anything is written.

courseEdit.folderLabel.text: Folodara ya yone, go tswa mo khomputareng ya gago
courseEdit.folderLabel.from: Its folder, from your own computer

courseEdit.folderHint.text: Ditataiso, dibuka tsa tiro, dipholisi le dikao di bolokwa kgatlhanong le yone mme mokwalo wa tsone o a tshwaelwa gore o ka batlwa.
courseEdit.folderHint.from: Guides, workbooks, policies and templates are filed against it and their text indexed so they can be searched.

courseEdit.folderHint2.text: Mokgwa wa yone ga o bopiwe go tswa fano: sebopego sa yone se agiwa mo mothusing o o kwa godimo kgotsa go tswa mo dimoduleng tsa boitseanape. Seno se boloka se yone e se tshwereng.
courseEdit.folderHint2.from: Structure is not created from here: its own shape is built in the editor above or from a qualification's modules. This files what it holds.

courseEdit.drive.text: Kgotsa go tswa mo drayiveng e o e golaganyeng
courseEdit.drive.from: Or from a drive you have connected

courseEdit.driveNote.text: Folodara e le nngwe, e badilwe kwa e leng teng gone. E felela mo lefelong le le tshwanang: tshitshinyo e o e tlhatlhobang pele ga sepe se kwalwa.
courseEdit.driveNote.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

courseEdit.noSections.text: Ga go na dikarolo go fitlha jaanong. E agilwe ka dikarolo, mme karolo nngwe le nngwe e na le dithuto.
courseEdit.noSections.from: No sections yet. It is built from sections, and each section holds lessons.

courseEdit.noLessons.text: Ga go na dithuto mo karolong eno go fitlha jaanong.
courseEdit.noLessons.from: No lessons in this section yet.

courseEdit.lessonCovers.text: Ditekanyetso tsa tlhatlhobo tse thuto eno e di akaretsang

courseEdit.competenciesNote.text: Se go e fetsa go se bontshang. Ga e ka ke ya phasalatswa e se na bokgoni bope, ka gonne go e fetsa ga yone go ka se begwe e le bokgoni.
courseEdit.competenciesNote.from: What completing it demonstrates. It cannot be published with no competency, because its completions could not be reported as capability.

courseEdit.noneTagged.text: Ga go a tshwaiwa sepe go fitlha jaanong.

courseEdit.covered.text: tsa ditekanyetso tsa tlhatlhobo tse {count} di akareditswe

courseEdit.coveredAcross.text: tsa ditekanyetso tsa tlhatlhobo tse {count} di akareditswe mo dimoduleng tsa {unit}
courseEdit.coveredAcross.from: of {count} assessment criteria covered across {unit}'s modules

courseEdit.coveredNote.text: E akareditswe ke thuto fano, potso mo go nngwe ya ditlhatlhobo tsa yone e e e golaganyeng, kgotsa se lenaane la gago la go tsamaelana le bolela gore se a e tlhatlhoba. Tsenya lenaane mo boitseanapeng gore o rekote la bofelo.
courseEdit.coveredNote.from: Covered by a lesson here, a question on one of its assessments that is linked to it, or what your alignment matrix names as assessing it. Upload the matrix on the qualification to record the last.

courseEdit.nothingAssesses.text: Ga go sepe se se e tlhatlhobang go fitlha jaanong

courseEdit.noLessonCovers.text: Ga go na thuto e e e akaretsang

courseEdit.unbound.text: Seno ga se kgomaretswe mo modiuleng wa kharikhulamo o o tlhomamisitsweng, ka jalo ga go na ditekanyetso tsa tlhatlhobo tse di ka akaretswang.
courseEdit.unbound.from: This is not bound to an accredited curriculum module, so there are no assessment criteria to cover.

courseEdit.publishNote.text: Go phasalatsa go gannwa fa sengwe se se kwa godimo se sa fela.
courseEdit.publishNote.from: Publishing is refused while anything above is incomplete.

courseEdit.newVersionNote.text: Baithuti ba ba fetsang phetolelo eno ba boloka rekoto ya bone ya yone.
courseEdit.newVersionNote.from: Learners who completed this version keep their record of it.

spine.intro.text: Tatelano e {course} eno e tsamaiwang ka yone, le se se tswalelang kgato nngwe le nngwe go fitlha e e fetileng e dirilwe. Sengwe le sengwe fano se setse se tshwerwe kgatlhanong le {course} eno: go se tsenya mo lenaaneng ke sone se dirang gore moithuti a kopane le sone.
spine.intro.from: The order this {course} is walked in, and what holds each step shut until the one before it is done. Everything here is already held against this {course}: putting it on the list is what makes a learner meet it.

spine.empty.text: Ga go na sepe mo go yone go fitlha jaanong, ka jalo moithuti yo o e kwadisitsweng a ka e bula mme a fitlhela letlhakore le le se nang sepe. Okeletsa selo sa ntlha ka fa tlase.
spine.empty.from: Nothing is on it yet, so a learner enrolled on it would open it and find an empty page. Add the first thing below.

spine.openFromStart.text: E bulegile go tswa kwa tshimologong.

spine.waitsForBefore.text: E emetse gore kgato e e e fetileng e nne {rule}.
spine.waitsForBefore.from: Waits for the step before it to be {rule}.

spine.nothingLeft.text: Sengwe le sengwe se se tshwerweng kgatlhanong le yone se setse se le mo lenaaneng. Tsenya buka ya tiro kgotsa boloka tokomane kgatlhanong le yone, mme e tla bonala fano.
spine.nothingLeft.from: Everything held against it is already on the list. Capture a workbook or file a document against it, and it will appear here.

spine.meets.text: Se moithuti a kopanang le sone

spine.rename.text: E rele leina le lengwe (ga le patelesege)

spine.guidance.text: Mola o le mongwe wa tshedimosetso (ga o patelesege)

spine.openAtStart.text: E bulegile go tswa kwa tshimologong, e seng morago ga kgato e e e fetileng
spine.openAtStart.from: Open from the start, rather than after the step before it

spine.beforeMustBe.text: Kgato e e fetileng e tshwanetse go nna

courseAssess.intro.text: Kwiste ya tlhabololo e a tshwaiwa ka bonosi. Tlhatlhobo ya bofelo e nna e atlholwa ke motho, mme e nna e sekasekiwa ka go ikemela, ka gonne ke yone e e balelwang boitseanape.
courseAssess.intro.from: A formative quiz is marked automatically. A summative assessment is always judged by a person and always moderated independently, because it is the one that counts towards a qualification.

courseAssess.assesses.text: Se potso eno e se tlhatlhobang

courseAssess.noCriterion.text: Ga e golaganngwe le tekanyetso epe

courseAssess.options.text: Ditlhopho tsa karabo: tshwaya nngwe le nngwe e e siameng
courseAssess.options.from: Answer options: tick every one that is correct

courseAssess.allModerated.text: tshwetso nngwe le nngwe e a sekasekiwa

courseAssess.published.text: E phasaladitswe. Moithuti o kopana le yone fa e setse e le kgato mo go {link}.
courseAssess.published.from: Published. A learner meets it once it is a step in {link}.

courseAssess.formative.text: Ya tlhabololo: tlwaetso, ga e balwe

courseAssess.summative.text: Ya bofelo: e a bala, e nna e sekasekiwa

courseAssess.sampleNote.text: Bonnye, e seng bogolo: bogolo jwa setlhopha bo bo koketsa. Setlhopha sa ba le lesome kgotsa ba ba kwa tlase ba sekasekwa ka botlalo, mme sa ba le masome a mabedi kgotsa ba ba kwa tlase ba sekasekwa ka halofo, ka gonne kotara ya diskripte tse robedi ke tse pedi, mme tse pedi di bolela sepe fela ka katlholo ya motlhatlhobi. Palo eno e laola ditlhopha tse di fetang masome a mabedi. Ga e tsewe kgato mo tlhatlhobong ya bofelo, e leng gone tshwetso nngwe le nngwe e sekasekiwang, mme motlhatlhobi yo o sa tswang go kwadiswa o nna a sekasekiwa ka botlalo.
courseAssess.sampleNote.from: A floor, not a ceiling. Cohort size raises it: a cohort of ten or fewer is moderated in full and one of twenty or fewer at half, because a quarter of eight scripts is two, and two say almost nothing about an assessor's judgement. This figure governs cohorts above twenty. Ignored for a summative assessment, where every decision is moderated, and a newly registered assessor is always moderated in full.

courseEnrol.title.text: Ke bomang ba ba mo go yone

courseEnrol.draft.text: Seno se santse e le popo ya pele. Se tshwanetse go phasalatswa pele ga mongwe a ka se abelwa: popo ya pele ga e ise e fete ditlhatlhobo tse di tlhomamisang gore diteng tsa yone di akaretsa se di se bolelang.
courseEnrol.draft.from: This is still a draft. It has to be published before anyone can be assigned to it: a draft has not passed the checks that confirm its content covers what it claims to.

courseEnrol.waitingNote.text: Moithuti mongwe le mongwe o bonala gangwe fela, mo kgatong ya ntlha e a sa kgoneng go e bula. Go tshwarelwa mo kgatong ya boraro ke selo se se tshwanetseng go dirwang ka sone; le go tshwarelwa mo dikgatong tsa bone go isa go tse lesome ke modumo o o sa tlhokegeng.
courseEnrol.waitingNote.from: Each learner appears once, at the earliest step they cannot open. Being held up at step three is the fact worth acting on; also being held up at steps four to ten is noise.

courseEnrol.nobody.text: Ga go ise go kwadiswe ope.

courseEnrol.everyone.text: Mongwe le mongwe mo mokgatlhong o setse a le mo go yone.
courseEnrol.everyone.from: Everyone in the organisation is already on it.

courseEnrol.many.text: Kwadisa ba le bantsi ka nako e le nngwe

courseEnrol.manyNote.text: Kgomaretsa diaterese tsa imeile, e le nngwe mo moleng mongwe le mongwe. Kholomo e e kopilweng ka tlhamalalo go tswa mo spreadsheet e a dira.
courseEnrol.manyNote.from: Paste email addresses, one per line. A column copied straight out of a spreadsheet works.

courseEnrol.enrolAll.text: Kwadisa botlhe ba ba mo lenaaneng

settings.intro.text: Kafa {name} e lebegang ka teng go batho ba gago, le kafa Sethala se balang ditokomane tse ba di tsenyang ka teng. Diphetogo di dira gongwe le gongwe ka bonako: ga go na sepe sa go aga gape kgotsa go phasalatsa gape.
settings.intro.from: How {name} looks to your people, and how the App reads the documents they upload. Changes apply everywhere immediately: there is nothing to rebuild or redeploy.

settings.section.terminology.text: Se o bitsang dilo ka sone

settings.section.filenames.text: Kafa maina a difaele a balwang ka teng

settings.drive.connected.text: E golagantswe. Folodara e ka badiwa ka tlhamalalo go tswa kwa go yone jaanong.
settings.drive.connected.from: Connected. A folder can now be read straight from it.

settings.drive.cancelled.text: Ga go a golagantswa sepe: tumelelo e khutlisitswe.
settings.drive.cancelled.from: Nothing was connected: the consent was cancelled.

settings.drive.refused.text: Akhaonto eo e ganne go golagana.

settings.drive.state.text: Tumelelo eo ga e a tshwana le e e simolotsweng ke sebadi seno, ka jalo ga go a golagantswa sepe. Simolola gape go tswa mo tsebeng eno.
settings.drive.state.from: That consent did not match the one this browser started, so nothing was connected. Start again from this page.

settings.drive.nocode.text: Moabi ga a ka a romela sepe sa go golagana ka sone. Leka gape.
settings.drive.nocode.from: The provider sent nothing back to connect with. Try again.

settings.drive.failed.text: Go golagana ga go a ka ga fela. Ga go a bolokwa sepe. Go leka gape go molemo pele ga sepe se sengwe.
settings.drive.failed.from: The connection could not be completed. Nothing was stored. Trying again is worth doing before anything else.

settings.mailNote.text: Go lebelela gore a baithuti ba ka amogela ka mmatota dintlha tsa bone tsa go tsena le dikitsiso. Go molemo go tlhola morago ga gore mongwe a fetole dithulaganyo tsa poso, mme e le selo sa ntlha sa go tlhola fa mongwe a re imeile ga e a goroga.
settings.mailNote.from: Whether learners can actually receive their sign-in details and notifications. Worth checking after anybody changes the mail settings, and the first thing to check when somebody says an email never arrived.

settings.sso.text: Go tsena ka Google kgotsa Microsoft
settings.sso.from: Signing in with Google or Microsoft

settings.ssoNote.text: E letlelela batho ba gago go tsena ka akhaonto ya Google kgotsa Microsoft ya mokgatlho wa bone go na le lefoko la tsena fano, le le tswelelang go dira fa thoko ga yone. E tsenya fela batho ba ba setseng ba na le akhaonto mo Sethaleng seno, ba ba tshwantshiwang ka aterese ya imeile ka lekgetlo la ntlha; ga e ke e bopa nngwe.
settings.ssoNote.from: Lets your people sign in with their organisation's Google or Microsoft account instead of a password here, which keeps working beside it. It only signs in people who already have an account on this platform, matched by email address the first time; it never creates one.

settings.terminology.text: Se o bitsang dilo ka sone

settings.terminologyNote.text: Dirisa mafoko a gago. Moabi yo o kwa ntle ga Aforika Borwa a ka nna a sa bue lenaneo, mme yo o mo teng ga yone a ka nna a sa bue kosi; Sethala ga se a tshwanela go gatelela.
settings.terminologyNote.from: Use your own vocabulary. A provider outside South Africa may not say programme, and a provider inside it may not say course; the platform should not insist.

settings.templatesNote.text: Kafa tokomane nngwe le nngwe e moabi yo a e ntshang e balwang le go lebega ka teng.
settings.templatesNote.from: How each document this provider issues reads and looks.

settings.templatesMoved.text: jaanong ka fa tlase ga Taolo, le tokomane nngwe le nngwe e Sethala se e ntshang le gore ke mang yo o amogelang nngwe le nngwe.
settings.templatesMoved.from: now under Management, with every document the platform produces and who receives each one.

settings.menuNote.text: Baakanya bara e e kwa godimo: reela setlhogo leina le lengwe, fetisetsa tsebe kwa ntle ga setlhogo se sengwe, kgotsa dira gore tsebe e nne kgokagano ya tlhamalalo. Se se tshwanang go mongwe le mongwe kwa moabing yono, ka gonne badiri ba bolelelana gore dilo di kae.
settings.menuNote.from: Rearrange the bar at the top: rename a heading, move a page under a different one, or make a page a direct link. The same for everybody at this provider, because staff tell each other where things are.

settings.drives.text: Mafelo a gago a go bolokela difaele

settings.drivesNote.text: Bala folodara ka tlhamalalo go tswa mo Google Drive kgotsa OneDrive, go na le go e tsenya fa tlase le go e tsenya gape. Ya gago go na le ya moabi yono: modiri mongwe le mongwe o golagana ka ya gagwe.
settings.drivesNote.from: Read a folder straight from Google Drive or OneDrive, instead of downloading it and uploading it again. Yours rather than this provider's: every member of staff connects their own.

settings.extensionNote.text: Kgatlhanong le porofaele ya gago. Ga e patelesege, e tima ka go tlwaela, mme se e go letlelelang go se dira se lekanyeditswe ke tiro ya gago fela, jaaka sengwe le sengwe se sengwe.
settings.extensionNote.from: Against your own profile. Optional, off by default, and what it lets you do is bounded by your role exactly as everything else is.

providerLang.note.text: Puo e batho ba gago ba balang Sethala ka yone, fa ba sa itlhophele ya bone ka fa tlase ga leina la bone kwa godimo ga tsebe. Diskrine tse di ise di ranolwe di dula di le ka Sekgoa, mme maina a gago a dilo (Dithulaganyo, Mafoko a a dirisiwang) a bolokwa jaaka o a kwadile mo dipuong tsotlhe.
providerLang.note.from: The language your people read the platform in, unless they choose their own under their name at the top of the page. Screens not yet translated stay in English, and your own names for things (Settings, Terminology) are kept as you wrote them in every language.

brand.accentNote.text: Dikgatelelo, dibara tsa tswelelopele le mellwane ya ditifikeiti.
brand.accentNote.from: Highlights, progress bars and certificate borders.

brand.logoNote.text: E tlhagelela mo hedareng, mo tsebeng ya go tsena le mo setifikeiting sengwe le sengwe. PNG e e nang le bokamorago jo bo bonaletsang e bonala sentle mo mmalaneng wa hedara. Ka fa tlase ga 2 MB.
brand.logoNote.from: Appears in the header, on the sign-in page and on every certificate. A PNG with a transparent background sits best on the header colour. Under 2 MB.

brand.notAccepted.text: Setshwantsho seo ga se a amogelwa.

brand.unfinished.text: Go tsenya ga go a fela. Sekaseka kgokagano mme o leke gape.
brand.unfinished.from: The upload did not finish. Check the connection and try again.

brand.removeLogo.text: Tlosa, mme o bontshe leina go na le sone
brand.removeLogo.from: Remove, and show the name instead

brand.logoAddress.text: Kgotsa aterese, fa setshwantsho se setse se le kwa gongwe
brand.logoAddress.from: Or an address, if the image is already hosted elsewhere

brand.signInNote.text: Ga e patelesege. Fa go se na sepe fano, tsebe e bontsha leina la gago mo mmaleng wa gago, e leng se se siameng mme e se na kgabiso. Setshwantsho se se bolelang se se boammaaruri ka se o se dirang se botlhokwa go feta se se kgabisang fela.
brand.signInNote.from: Optional. With nothing here the page shows your name on your own colour, which is tidy but plain. A graphic that says something true about what you do is worth more than a decorative one.

brand.characterNote.text: E tlhagelela mo skrineng se se se nang sepe go fitlha jaanong, gaufi le polelwana e e tlhalosang gore go tla nna eng fano, le gaufi le konopo e mongwe a tshwanetseng go e gatelela go latela, kwa e leng teng gore e lemogiwe. Nnye, e eme, mme e le botsalano go na le go kgabisa. E tlogele e le lefela gore o dirise ya Sethala seno, kgotsa e seng sepe gotlhelele.
brand.characterNote.from: Appears on a screen with nothing on it yet, beside the sentence explaining what would be there, and beside a button somebody has to press next, where it is there to be noticed. Small, upright, and friendlier than it is decorative. Leave it empty to use this platform's own, or nothing at all.

brand.strapline.text: Mola ka fa tlase ga yone

brand.straplineHint.text: Go labalabela go ithuta ka bophelo jotlhe

shape.intro.text: Dipotso tse pedi di tlhopha sebopego sa sethala sa gago le gore dikarolo tsa sone di bidiwa jang. Sengwe le sengwe se o sa se tlhophang se a tloga: diskrine tsa sone, dilo tsa menyu le diaterese tsa sone.
shape.intro.from: Two questions decide the shape of your platform and what its parts are called. Everything you do not choose goes away: its screens, its menu entries and its addresses.

shape.nothingDeleted.text: Ga go sepe se se tlosiwang.

shape.nothingDeletedNote.text: Go fetola seno go patika dilo. Se se setseng se rekotilwe se sala fa se leng teng, mme go se tlhopha gape go busetsa diskrine le direkoto di sa senyega.
shape.nothingDeletedNote.from: Changing this hides things. Whatever has already been recorded stays where it is, and choosing it again brings the screens back with the records intact.

shape.saved.text: Go bolokilwe. Menyu le mafoko di fetogile go tsamaelana.
shape.saved.from: Saved. The menu and the wording have changed to match.

shape.unavailable.text: Ga e yo ka tlhopho e e kwa godimo. Yuniti ya thuto e mo teng ga boitseanape, mme sethala seno ga se na jone.
shape.unavailable.from: Not available with the choice above. A study unit sits inside a qualification, and this platform has none.

shape.standalone.text: Dilo tse tharo tse di ikemetseng
shape.standalone.from: Three things that stand on their own

shape.statutoryCovers.text: Dipego tsa NLRD le Edu.Dex, dipego tsa WSP le ATR, le lenaane la molao le le kwa morago ga tsone.
shape.statutoryCovers.from: NLRD and Edu.Dex exports, WSP and ATR returns, and the statutory register behind them.

shape.statutoryWhen.text: o kwa ntle ga Aforika Borwa, kgotsa mongwe o dira ditlhagiso ka boemo jwa gago.
shape.statutoryWhen.from: you are outside South Africa, or somebody else files on your behalf.

shape.workplaceCovers.text: Ditumalano tsa lefelo la tiro, ditataiso tsa bakoetlisi, disheti tsa go saena le diura tse moithuti a di rekotang kgatlhanong le mothapi yo o mo amogetseng.
shape.workplaceCovers.from: Workplace agreements, coach guides, sign off sheets and the hours a learner logs against a host employer.

shape.workplaceWhen.text: ga go sepe se o se rutang se se tlhatlhobiwang kwa lefelong la tiro.
shape.workplaceWhen.from: nothing you deliver is assessed in a workplace.

shape.offline.text: Go dira kwa ntle ga sesupo

shape.offlineCovers.text: Baithuti ba tsenya Sethala mo mogaleng wa bone, ba tsaya dilo tsa bone tsa go ithuta pele ba tswa, ba di bala kwa go se nang sesupo, mme ba rekota tiro ya bone gore ba e romele fa ba nna le sesupo gape.
shape.offlineCovers.from: Learners install the platform on their phone, download their study material before they go out, read it with no signal, and record their work to send back when they next have one.

shape.offlineWhen.text: baithuti ba nna malatsi kwa ntle ga sesupo, jaaka mo naga. Ditlhatlhobo tsa bofelo di dula di le mo inthaneteng fa lenaneo le sa beelwe ka boomo ka tsela e nngwe.
shape.offlineWhen.from: learners spend days away from a signal, such as in the field. Summatives stay online unless a programme is deliberately set otherwise.

shape.gives.text: Se seno se go nayang sone

shape.rename.text: O ka reela nngwe ya tseno leina le lengwe ka fa tlase ga {link}. Ke mafoko fela a sebopego seno se a dirisang a a nayang fano.
shape.rename.from: You can rename any of these under {link}. Only the words this shape actually uses are offered there.

shape.renameLink.text: Se o bitsang dilo ka sone

shape.save.text: Boloka gore sethala seno ke eng

shape.award.qualification_programme.cove.text: Selo se le sengwe. Moithuti o beiwa mo boitseanapeng mme ke sone se a se dirang. Ga go na legato le le farologaneng la go kopanya le le kwa godimo ga jone.
shape.award.qualification_programme.cove.from: One thing. A learner is put onto the qualification and that is what they work through. There is no separate bundling layer above it.

shape.award.qualification_programme.when.text: O ntsha boitseanape jo bo le bongwe jwa tiro e le lenaneo le le lengwe la go ithuta.
shape.award.qualification_programme.when.from: You deliver one occupational qualification as one learning programme.

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: Boitseanape le Lenaneo, ka go farologana
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: Qualification and Programme, separately

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: Dilo tse pedi tse di farologaneng. Boitseanape bo tshwere kitso ya tlhomamiso le kharikhulamo; lenaneo le kopanya se moithuti a se dirang, mme le ka araba boitseanape kgotsa le se ka ke la araba jope.
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: Two different things. A qualification holds the accreditation and the curriculum; a programme bundles what a learner works through, and may answer to a qualification or to none.

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: O tsamaisa boitseanape jo bo tlhomamisitsweng mme gape o kopanya dilo tse di tshwaraganang mo ditatelanong tse e seng boitseanape jo bo le bongwe fela nngwe le nngwe.
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: You run accredited qualifications and also bundle deliverables into sequences that are not one qualification each.

shape.award.programmes_only.covers.text: Dilenaneo di kopanya se moithuti a se dirang. Ga go na rekoto ya tlhomamiso, ga go na kharikhulamo, ga go na ditatemente tsa diphetho.
shape.award.programmes_only.covers.from: Programmes bundle what a learner works through. No accreditation record, no curriculum, no statements of results.

shape.award.programmes_only.when.text: Ga go sepe se o se neelang se se arabelang boitseanape jo bo kwadisitsweng: tlwaetso ya batho ba ba sa tswang go thongwa, dikatiso tsa go ntsha bosha go obamela melao, dilenaneo tsa selegae tsa dikgono.
shape.award.programmes_only.when.from: Nothing you deliver answers to a registered qualification: induction, compliance refreshers, internal skills programmes.

shape.award.standalone.covers.text: Sengwe le sengwe se ikemetse. Ga go sepe se se se kopanyang mme ga go sepe se se se tlhomamisang.
shape.award.standalone.covers.from: Everything stands on its own. Nothing bundles it and nothing accredits it.

shape.award.standalone.when.text: Katiso nngwe le nngwe e o e tsamaisang e tsewa e le nngwe fela, gangwe ka nako.
shape.award.standalone.when.from: Every piece of training you run is taken on its own, one at a time.

shape.delivery.courses.covers.text: Kosi ke se moithuti a beiwang mo go sone mme a se dira: dithuto tsa yone, dibuka tsa yone tsa tiro, ditlhatlhobo tsa yone. E ka nna ka fa tlase ga lenaneo, mme ga e tlhoke go araba boitseanape bope.
shape.delivery.courses.covers.from: A course is what a learner is put onto and works through: its lessons, its workbooks, its assessments. It may sit under a programme, and it need answer to no qualification.

shape.delivery.courses.when.text: Batho ba gago ba re kosi, kgotsa o aga katiso e e sa laolwang ke boitseanape bope.
shape.delivery.courses.when.from: Your people say course, or you build training that no qualification governs.

shape.delivery.study_units.covers.text: Yuniti ya thuto ke se moithuti a se dirang, mme e emisetsa kosi ka botlalo. E mo teng ga boitseanape, e kopanya dimodiule tsa kitso, tsa tiragatso le tsa lefelo la tiro tse di direlang phetho e le nngwe ya maemo a go tswa.
shape.delivery.study_units.covers.from: A study unit is what a learner works through, and it replaces the course entirely. It sits inside a qualification, bundling the knowledge, practical and workplace modules that serve one exit level outcome.

shape.delivery.study_units.when.text: Batho ba gago ba re yuniti ya thuto go na le kosi. Kharikhulamo e phasalatsa dimodiule mme e tlogela go kopanya go wena, ka jalo ono ke sebopego sa gago. E tlhoka boitseanape kwa godimo.
shape.delivery.study_units.when.from: Your people say study unit rather than course. The curriculum publishes modules and leaves the grouping to you, so this is your own structure. Requires a qualification at the top.

shape.note.qualificationProgramme.text: Selo se le sengwe. Moithuti o beiwa mo boitseanapeng, mme ke lenaneo le a le dirang.
shape.note.qualificationProgramme.from: One thing. A learner is put onto the qualification, and that is the programme they work through.

shape.note.qualification.text: Rekoto ya tlhomamiso: kharikhulamo ya yone, ditekanyetso le diphetho tsa maemo a go tswa.
shape.note.qualification.from: The accreditation record: its curriculum, criteria and exit level outcomes.

shape.note.programmeWithQualification.text: Tatelano e e rulaganeng, e ka arabang boitseanape kgotsa e se ka ke ya araba jope.
shape.note.programmeWithQualification.from: An ordered sequence, which may answer to a qualification or to none.

shape.note.programmeOnly.text: Tatelano e e rulaganeng, e e sa arabeng boitseanape jope jo bo kwadisitsweng.
shape.note.programmeOnly.from: An ordered sequence, answering to no registered qualification.

shape.note.bottom.text: Se moithuti a se dirang. Ga go na sepe ka fa tlase ga sone.
shape.note.bottom.from: What a learner works through. There is nothing below it.

clock.note.text: Nako nngwe le nngwe e e beilweng mo lenaaneng mo Sethaleng e bolela nako eno. Thuto ya ka 18:30 ke 18:30 fano, mme nako ya go tswala go amogela batho mo kopanong e e tlhokomelwang e atlholwa kgatlhanong le yone.
clock.note.from: Every timetabled time in the App means this clock. A lecture at 18:30 is 18:30 here, and an admission cut-off for an invigilated sitting is judged against it.

clock.both.text: Baithuti mo dinageng tse dingwe ba bona tsotlhe: nako ya gago, e leng e rekoto e e e tshwereng, le ya bone ka fa thoko ga yone, ka jalo ga go ope yo o ipalelang phapano mme a fosa. Dinako tse di rekotilweng ke tsa gago nako tsotlhe.
clock.both.from: Learners in other countries see both: your time, which is the one the record keeps, and their own alongside it, so nobody works out the difference themselves and gets it wrong. Recorded times are always yours.

mailTest.intro.text: E bula kgokagano le seva ya poso mme e a tsena, gore e tlhole gore dintlha tsa go tsena tsa moithuti le dikitsiso di ka isiwa ka mmatota.
mailTest.intro.from: Opens a connection to the mail server and signs in, to check that learner sign-in details and notifications can actually be delivered.

mailTest.nothingSent.text: Ga go romelwe imeile go ope.
mailTest.nothingSent.from: No email is sent to anybody.

mailTest.notYours.text: Ga go sepe fano se o ka se fetolang mo tsebeng eno: seva ya poso ke ya phasalatso. Isa mola o o kwa godimo kwa go yo o e tlhokomelang.
mailTest.notYours.from: Nothing here is something you can change on this page: the mail server belongs to the deployment. Pass the line above to whoever maintains it.

mailTest.unconfigured.text: Ga go na seva ya poso e e beilweng mo phasalatsong eno go fitlha jaanong, ka jalo seno se tla begela seo go na le go bega bothata ka akhaonto ya gago.
mailTest.unconfigured.from: No mail server is set up on this deployment yet, so this will report that rather than a fault with your account.

termsForm.why.practice.from: used across the sector, owned by nobody

termsForm.oneLabel.text: Se o bitsang {word} e le nngwe

termsForm.missing.text: Mafoko a mangwe ga a mo lenaaneng leno, mme seo ke ka boomo.
termsForm.missing.from: Some words are not on this list, and that is deliberate.

termsForm.missingNote.text: Boitseanape, modiule wa kharikhulamo, phetho ya maemo a go tswa, legato la NQF le tse dingwe di tlhalosiwa ke QCTO kgotsa SAQA, e seng ke wena. Go reela nngwe leina le lengwe go ka baya mafoko mo skrineng sa moithuti le mo kabong e motlhokomedi wa molao a sa e itseng, ka jalo Sethala se di tlogela di tsepame. O ka bala gore ke mang yo o tlhalosang eng mo go {link}.
termsForm.missingNote.from: Qualification, curriculum module, exit level outcome, NQF level and the rest are defined by the QCTO or SAQA rather than by you. Renaming one would put wording on a learner's screen and on a submission that the regulator does not recognise, so the platform keeps them fixed. You can read who defines what in the {link}.

termsForm.reset.text: Boela kwa mafokong a a tlwaelegileng

termsForm.note.course.text: Setlhopha se le sengwe sa go ithuta se motho a kwadisiwang mo go sone.
termsForm.note.course.from: A single body of learning a person is enrolled onto.

termsForm.note.programme.text: Tatelano ya dikosi tse di tsewang ka tatelano.
termsForm.note.programme.from: A sequence of courses taken in order.

termsForm.note.cohort.text: Setlhopha sa batho ba ba tsamayang mmogo mo kosing.
termsForm.note.cohort.from: A group of people moving through a course together.

termsForm.note.lesson.text: Kgato e le nngwe mo teng ga kosi.

termsForm.note.studyUnit.text: Kafa dimodiule tsa kharikhulamo di kopanngwang ka teng go rutiwa.
termsForm.note.studyUnit.from: How a curriculum's modules are grouped for delivery.

termsForm.note.enrolment.text: Boemo jwa motho mo kosing kgotsa mo lenaneong.
termsForm.note.enrolment.from: A person's place on a course or programme.

termsForm.note.learner.text: Motho yo o ithutang. Bangwe ba moabi ba re moithuti wa dithuto, kgotsa moleki.
termsForm.note.learner.from: The person doing the learning. Some providers say student, or candidate.

termsForm.note.facilitator.text: Motho yo o neelang. Bangwe ba moabi ba re moruti wa katiso, morutisi, kgotsa mothusi wa thuto.
termsForm.note.facilitator.from: The person delivering. Some providers say trainer, tutor, or instructor.

termsForm.note.assessor.text: Motho yo o atlholang bosupi kgatlhanong le ditekanyetso.
termsForm.note.assessor.from: The person judging evidence against the criteria.

termsForm.note.moderator.text: Motho yo o sekasekang sampole ya ditshwetso tseo.
termsForm.note.moderator.from: The person checking a sample of those judgements.

termsForm.note.workplaceRecord.text: Rekoto ya tiro e moithuti a e dirileng, e mokoetlisi a e tshwayang mme motlhatlhobi a e amogela.
termsForm.note.workplaceRecord.from: The record of work a learner did, that a coach signs and an assessor accepts.

menuEdit.noHeadingHint.text: Ga go na setlhogo: di bontshiwa e le dikgokagano tsa tlhamalalo
menuEdit.noHeadingHint.from: No heading: shown as direct links

menuEdit.empty.text: Ga go na sepe. Setlhogo se se se nang sepe ka fa tlase ga sone ga se bontshiwe.
menuEdit.empty.from: Empty. A heading with nothing under it is not shown.

menuEdit.under.text: Ke setlhogo sefe se {page} e leng ka fa tlase ga sone

menuEdit.reset.text: Boela kwa menyung e e tlwaelegileng

menuEdit.note.text: Ditsebe ga di ka patikiwa fano. Se mongwe le mongwe a se bonang se setse se tlhophilwe ke tiro ya gagwe, mme tsela ya bobedi ya go dira gore sengwe se se fitlhelesege e ka dira gore go se ne ope yo o ka bolelang gore ke goreng tsebe e tlhaela. Tsebe e e okeletsweng mo Sethaleng moragonyana e tla bonala ka fa tlase ga setlhogo sa yone se se tlwaelegileng, e seng go nyelela ka gonne thulaganyo eno e ne e le teng pele ga yone.
menuEdit.note.from: Pages cannot be hidden here. What each person sees is already decided by their role, and a second way to make something unreachable would leave nobody able to say why a page is missing. A page added to the platform later appears under its usual heading rather than disappearing because this arrangement predates it.

drives.none.text: Ga go na lefelo la go bolokela difaele le le baakantsweng mo phasalatsong eno. Go bala folodara ka tlhamalalo go tswa mo Google Drive kgotsa OneDrive go tlhoka gore yo o tlhokomelang Sethala a kwadise sedirisiwa le bone; go fitlha foo, folodara e tlhophiwa go tswa mo khomputareng ya gago, e e dirang mme e sa tlhoke sepe.
drives.none.from: No file store is set up on this deployment. Reading a folder straight from Google Drive or OneDrive needs an application registered with them by whoever maintains the platform; until then, a folder is chosen from your own computer, which works and needs nothing.

drives.keepsNote.text: Tokene e e tswaletsweng e e ka badang, mme e bala fela, drayive ya akhaonto e o e golaganyang, go fitlha o e kgaoganya fano kgotsa o e ntsha mo dithulaganyong tsa akhaonto eo. E dirisiwa fela fa o kopa gore folodara e badiwe, e seng nako nngwe, ga e ke e bontshiwe gape, mme ga e ke e kwalwe mo logong. Ke ya gago, e seng ya moabi yono: modiri-mmogo wa gago a ka se bale difaele tsa gago ka yone, mme le wena o ka se bale tsa gagwe ka kgokagano ya gagwe.
drives.keepsNote.from: A sealed token that can read, and only read, the drive of the account you connect, until you disconnect it here or withdraw it from that account's own settings. It is used when you ask for a folder to be read and at no other time, it is never shown back to you, and it is never written to a log. It is yours, not this provider's: a colleague cannot read your files through it, and you cannot read theirs through their connection.

ext.encrypted.text: E sirelediwa ka encryption mme ga e ke e bontshiwe gape, fano kgotsa kwa go sengwe.
ext.encrypted.from: It is encrypted and is never shown again, here or anywhere else.

ext.chooseKey.from: Choose one of the API-key providers instead: those call the provider over the internet and work wherever the platform is installed.

ext.modelsAvailable.from: {count} available to you today. Choosing one fills the box above; it is saved when you press Save.

ext.keepsNote.text: {credential} ya gago, e sirelediwa ka encryption, go fitlha o e lebala. E dirisiwa fela mo tirong e o e kopang, fela fa konopo e butswe, ga e ke e bontshiwe gape kgotsa e kwalwe mo logong lepe. Go nna gona ga go tshwane le go bulwa: kopano nngwe le nngwe e simolola e timilwe, o e bula mo tirong nngwe, mme go tswa go e tima fa o lebala.
ext.keepsNote.from: Your {credential}, encrypted, until you discard it. It is used only for work you ask for, only while you have the switch on, and it is never shown back to you or written to any log. Available is not the same as on: every sitting starts with it off, you switch it on for a job, and signing out switches it off for you if you forget.

ext.keptUnused.text: Tokene ya gago e bolokilwe mme ga e kgone go dirisiwa. Ga go sepe mo Sethaleng se se tla neelang thuso ya AI go fitlha o e dira gore e ka dirisiwa gape.
ext.keptUnused.from: Your token is kept but cannot be used. Nothing in the platform will offer AI assistance until you make it available again.

ext.offNote.text: Fa seno se timilwe, Sethala se dira jaaka fela se dira kwa ntle ga katološo: dilo tsa yone ga di yo go na le go tlhagisiwa mme di palelwa.
ext.offNote.from: With this off, the platform behaves exactly as it does without an extension: the affordances are absent rather than offered and failing.

ext.tokenFromNote.text: Karolo eno e diragala mo khomputareng ya gago, e seng fano, e leng maikaelelo: subscription ya gago e tlhomamisiwa ke wena, mo mmesheneng wa gago, mme tokene fela e e e tlhagisang e goroga mo Sethaleng seno.
ext.tokenFromNote.from: This part happens on your own computer, not here, which is the point: your subscription is authorised by you, on your machine, and only the token it produces ever reaches this platform.

ext.step1Rest.text: fa o ise o e tsenye: {link}. O tlhoka subscription ya Claude ya gago.
ext.step1Rest.from: if you have not already: {link}. You need a Claude subscription of your own.

ext.cmdNote.text: {plain} e e tlwaelegileng mo PowerShell gantsi e a palelwa ke “running scripts is disabled on this system”. Seo ke se se tlwaelegileng sa Windows, e seng bothata jwa tsenyo ya gago, mme mokgwa wa {cmd} o se efoga go sa fetole thulaganyo epe ya tshireletso.
ext.cmdNote.from: Plain {plain} in PowerShell usually fails with “running scripts is disabled on this system”. That is a Windows default rather than anything wrong with your installation, and the {cmd} form avoids it without changing any security setting.

ext.step3.text: 3. Tsena fa e bula sebadi sa gago sa webosaete

ext.step3Rest.from: , then copy the token it prints (it begins {prefix}) and paste it above.

ext.notApiKey.text: Ga se senotlolo sa API mme ga go na tlhwatlhwa ya tokene nngwe le nngwe: e dirisa subscription ya Claude e o setseng o e duelela. O se ka wa nna wa neela ope lefoko la gago la tsena la Anthropic: Sethala seno ga se na lefelo la lone mme ga se ka se le amogela fano.
ext.notApiKey.from: It is not an API key and there is no per-token cost: it draws on the Claude subscription you already pay for. Never give anybody your Anthropic password: this platform has no field for one and would not accept it here.

ext.notSubscription.text: Subscription ga se senotlolo sa API.
ext.notSubscription.from: A subscription is not an API key.

ext.geminiSeparate.text: Gemini Advanced le Gemini API ke dilo tse pedi tse di farologaneng tse di nang le tefiso e e farologaneng. Go duela sa ntlha ga go go nee sa bobedi, mme ga go na tsela ya go dira gore go go neye.
ext.geminiSeparate.from: Gemini Advanced and the Gemini API are separate products with separate billing. Paying for the first does not give you the second, and there is no way to make it.

ext.openaiSeparate.text: ChatGPT Plus le OpenAI API ke dilo tse pedi tse di farologaneng tse di nang le tefiso e e farologaneng. Go duela sa ntlha ga go go nee sa bobedi, mme ga go na tsela ya go dira gore go go neye.
ext.openaiSeparate.from: ChatGPT Plus and the OpenAI API are separate products with separate billing. Paying for the first does not give you the second, and there is no way to make it.

ext.openaiCreate.text: Bopa senotlolo kwa {site}, ka fa tlase ga {menu}, mme o se kgomaretse kwa godimo. Se simologa ka {prefix}.
ext.openaiCreate.from: Create a key at {site}, under {menu}, and paste it above. It begins {prefix}.

ext.noFreeTier.text: Ga go na lenaneo la mahala:

ext.noFreeTierNote.text: go farologana le Gemini, kopo nngwe le nngwe e tsholwa mo akhaonteng e senotlolo e leng ya yone, ka jalo solofela ditshenyegelo, le fa e le nnye.
ext.noFreeTierNote.from: unlike Gemini, every call is charged to the account the key belongs to, so expect a bill, however small.

ext.geminiCreate.text: Tsena kwa {site}, tlhopha {menu}, bopa nngwe, mme o e kgomaretse kwa godimo. Google e ntshitse dinotlolo ka mefuta e le mentsi, ka jalo kgomaretsa se e se go neelang: Sethala seno ga se se belaele.
ext.geminiCreate.from: Sign in at {site}, choose {menu}, create one, and paste it above. Google has issued keys in more than one format, so paste whatever it gives you: this platform does not second-guess it.

ext.geminiFree.text: Gemini API e na le lenaneo la mahala, ka jalo go e leka ga go duelwe. E lekanyetsa gore o ka dira dikopo tse kae ka motsotso go na le go tsholela; go bala folodara e kgolo go ka fitlha mo moeding oo, mme Sethala se tla bua sentle fa go diragala.
ext.geminiFree.from: The Gemini API has a free tier, so this costs nothing to try. It limits how many requests you may make in a minute rather than charging for them; reading a large folder can hit that, and the platform will say so plainly if it does.

ext.keyYours.text: Ke sa gago, e seng sa moabi. E sirelediwa ka encryption, e dirisiwa fela mo tirong e o e kopang fa konopo ya gago e butswe, ga e ke e bontshiwe gape, mme ga e ke e kwalwe mo logong.
ext.keyYours.from: It is yours, not the tenant's. It is encrypted, used only for work you ask for while your switch is on, never shown back to you, and never written to a log.

codes.intro.text: Modiule o le mongwe o kwalwa ka mefuta e e farologaneng mo ditokomaneng tse di farologaneng: {long} mo kharikhulamong, {short} mo tafoleng ya go tsamaelana, {shortest} mo kakaretsong. Kitso e e telele, matshwao a puiso le ditlhaka tse dikgolo di rarabololwa ka molao. Fano ke gone Sethala se bolelelwang ka tse dingwe, gore go tsenya go golaganye modiule go na le go bega gore o a tlhaela.
codes.intro.from: One module is written down differently in different documents: {long} in the curriculum, {short} in the alignment table, {shortest} in a summary. The long identifier, the punctuation and the capitals are handled by rule. This is where the App is told about the rest, so an upload links the module instead of reporting it missing.

codes.saved.text: Go bolokilwe. Go tsenya go tla dirisa tseno go tloga jaanong.
codes.saved.from: Saved. Uploads will use these from now on.

codes.none.text: Ga go ise go tsengwe kharikhulamo epe, ka jalo ga go na dikhoutu tse di tlwaelegileng tse di ka akanngwang. Tsenya boitseanape mme seno se itlatsa go tswa mo dikhoutung tsa yone tsa modiule.
codes.none.from: No curriculum has been loaded yet, so there are no standards to infer. Load a qualification and this fills itself in from its module codes.
