codes.view.text: E lebelele mme o e baakanye

codes.dialogNote.text: Khoutu e e kwa nngele ke e e tlwaelegileng ya gago. Mekwalo e e e bapileng le yone ke se tokomane e ka se dirisang go e emisetsa. Tlosa nngwe le nngwe e e sa siamang, okeletsa ya gago, morago o tlhomamise.
codes.dialogNote.from: The code on the left is your standard. The spellings beside it are what a document may use instead. Remove any that do not belong, add your own, then confirm.

codes.fullId.text: ID e e feletseng ya QCTO, {example}, e balwa e le khoutu ya yone ya modiule ka molao, mme ga e tlhoke mola fano. Go ntse jalo le ka dihaefene, dikgaoganyo le ditlhaka tse dikgolo.
codes.fullId.from: A full QCTO identifier, {example}, is read as its module code by rule, and needs no row here. So are hyphens, spaces and capitals.

codes.worked.text: Diphapano tsa yone di dirwa ke Sethala.
codes.worked.from: Its variations are worked out for you.

codes.putBack.text: Busetsa sengwe le sengwe se Sethala se se se akantseng
codes.putBack.from: Put back everything the App proposed

naming.title.text: Kafa maina a difaele a balwang ka teng

naming.intro.text: Fa mongwe a tsenya buka ya tiro kgotsa tlhatlhobo, Sethala se bala leina la faele go bona gore ke eng. Fa seno se siame, se tsenngwa se setse se tlhamaletse. Fa se sa siama, ga go sepe se se robegang: se tla jaaka foromo e e lefela e mongwe a e tlatsang ka seatla.
naming.intro.from: When somebody uploads a workbook or an assessment, the App reads the filename to work out what it is. Get this right and an upload arrives already filled in. Get it wrong and nothing breaks: it arrives as a blank form for somebody to complete by hand.

naming.rule.text: Molao wa ntlo, jaaka setlhopha sa gago se tshwanetse go o latela
naming.rule.from: The house rule, as your team should follow it

naming.ruleNote.text: O bontshiwa mo skrineng sa go tsenya. Tataiso ya batho, e seng se Sethala se se tshwantshanang le sone: se fitlhela dikhoutu tse di kwa tlase gongwe le gongwe fa di leng teng.
naming.ruleNote.from: Shown on the upload screen. Guidance for people, not something the App matches on: it finds the codes below wherever they appear.

naming.codesNote.text: Karolo ya leina la faele e e bolelang gore ke mofuta ofe wa tokomane. Tseno ke tse Sethala se di tshwantshanang le tsone ka mmatota.
naming.codesNote.from: The part of a filename that says what kind of document it is. These are what the App actually matches on.

naming.meaning.workplace_signoff.text: Go saena kwa lefelong la tiro

naming.marker.text: Se se tshwayang tataiso ya dikarabo

naming.markerNote.text: Tshupetso e e bolelang gore faele ke memorandamo, e seng kopi ya moithuti.
naming.markerNote.from: The token that says a file is the memorandum rather than the learner's copy.

naming.unread.text: Ga go a badiwa go tswa mo leineng leno: {parts}. Yo o e tsenyang o di tlatsa ka seatla.
naming.unread.from: Not read from this name: {parts}. Whoever uploads it fills those in by hand.

naming.allRead.text: Sengwe le sengwe se badilwe. Go tsenya go go rulagantsweng jaaka seno go goroga go setse go tlhamaletse.
naming.allRead.from: Everything was read. An upload named like this arrives already filled in.

tmpl.note.statement_of_results.text: E isiwa kwa lefelong la tlhatlhobo le tokomane ya boitshupo ya moithuti. Sebopego ke sa gago go se baakanya; kao ya QCTO ka bosone e bontsha se e se tshwereng.
tmpl.note.statement_of_results.from: Carried to the assessment centre with the learner's identity document. The layout is yours to set; the QCTO's own template shows what one carries.

tmpl.note.certificate.text: Se moabi a se ntshang mo dilenaneong tsa gagwe. Setifikeiti sa boitseanape se tswa kwa QCTO, e seng fano.
tmpl.note.certificate.from: What the provider issues for its own programmes. A qualification certificate comes from the QCTO, not from here.

tmpl.note.workplace_statement.text: Se mokoetlisi wa lefelo la tiro a se tshwayang go tlhomamisa maitemogelo a moithuti a a fetsang.
tmpl.note.workplace_statement.from: What a workplace coach signs to confirm the experience a learner completed.

tmpl.note.enrolment_form.text: Foromo e e feletseng ya kwadiso, e le tokomane. Motlhokomedi wa QCTO a ka e kopa fa a etetse, ka jalo e tshwanetse go nna teng mo pampiring, e seng fela e le skrine se mongwe a se tlatsitseng.
tmpl.note.enrolment_form.from: The completed enrolment form, as a document. A QCTO monitor may ask for it on a visit, so it has to exist on paper, not only as a screen somebody filled in.

tmpl.platform.text: Sebopego sa Sethala ka bosone. Ga go sepe se o se dirang fano se se fetolang tokomane e e setseng e ntshitswe.
tmpl.platform.from: The platform's own layout. Nothing you do here changes a document already issued.

tmpl.documentNote.text: E kwale jaaka o batla e balwe. Sengwe le sengwe mo dibaraketeng tse pedi se emisediwa ka dintlha tsa moithuti ka bosone fa tokomane e ntshiwa, mme sekgoba sa gago se bolokwa jaaka o se kwala.
tmpl.documentNote.from: Write it as you want it to read. Anything in double braces is replaced with the learner's own details when the document is produced, and your spacing is kept exactly as you type it.

tmpl.starterNote.text: Seno ke mafoko a Sethala ka bosone, gore o a fokotse go dira a gago.
tmpl.starterNote.from: This is the platform's own wording, for you to cut down into yours.

tmpl.saveDraft.text: Boloka e le popo ya pele

tmpl.goBack.text: Boela kwa sebopegong sa Sethala ka bosone
tmpl.goBack.from: Go back to the platform's own layout

tmpl.fields.text: Se o ka se tsenyang mo go yone
tmpl.fields.from: What you can put in it

tmpl.added.text: Se Sethala se se okeletsang, le fa kao ya gago e bolela eng
tmpl.added.from: What the platform adds, whatever your template says

tmpl.addedNote.text: Tseno di gatisiwa morago ga kao ya gago. Ga se tsa gago go di fetola ka gonne ga se tsa gago: motlhokomedi wa molao o a di tlhoka, mme moithuti yo o tshwereng tokomane o ikanya gore ke boammaaruri. Ga o tlhoke go di kwala mo phetolelong ya gago.
tmpl.addedNote.from: These are printed after your template. They are not yours to change because they are not yours: a regulator requires them, and a learner holding the document relies on them being true. You do not need to write them into your own version.

capture.intro.text: Sethala se bala se se ka se badang, se go bontsha se se se dirileng ka sone le se se sa kang sa kgona go se tlhaloganya, mme se a ema. Ga go sepe se se nnang tlhatlhobo go fitlha o tlhomamisa.
capture.intro.from: The App reads what it can, shows you what it made of it and what it could not work out, and waits. Nothing becomes an assessment until you confirm it.

capture.fromFolder.text: Fa buka ya tiro e ne e tla le folodara, e setse e le fano: {link} mme o e tseye go tswa mo se se setseng se bolokilwe. Ga go na go tsenya ga bobedi, mme tataiso ya dikarabo e a go kopanngwa ka bonosi. Dirisa foromo e e kwa tlase fela fa go le pampiri e Sethala se sa e tshwereng.
capture.fromFolder.from: If the workbook came in with a folder, it is already here: {link} and capture it from what is filed. There is no second upload, and the answer guide is paired for you. Use the form below only for a paper the platform does not already hold.

capture.naming.text: Kafa go rekelwang faele leina ka teng

capture.changeNaming.text: Fetola kafa maina a difaele a balwang ka teng

capture.none.text: Ga go ise go tsewe sepe

capture.noneNote.text: Bula boitseanape mme o tseye dibuka tsa tiro tse di setseng di bolokilwe kgatlhanong le jone, kgotsa o tsenye nngwe fa godimo. Se Sethala se se badang se bontshiwa go wena pele ga sepe sa sone se nna tlhatlhobo.
capture.noneNote.from: Open a qualification and capture the workbooks already filed against it, or upload one above. What the App reads is shown to you before any of it becomes an assessment.

capture.committedOn.text: E dirilwe ka {date}. Go tsenya go dirwa gangwe fela; tsenya tokomane gape gore o dire pampiri e nngwe go tswa mo go yone.
capture.committedOn.from: Committed on {date}. An upload is committed once; upload the document again to make another paper from it.

capture.which.text: Dilo tseno ke tsa boitseanape bofe?
capture.which.from: Which qualification is this material for?

capture.guideNote.text: Kwa ntle ga yone, ga go na dikarabo tse di siameng, dintlha kgotsa ditekanyetso tse di ka badiwang.
capture.guideNote.from: Without it, no correct answers, marks or criteria can be read.

capture.ready.text: E siametse. Dimodiule di le {modules} le ditekanyetso tsa tlhatlhobo di le {criteria} di teng, ka jalo dipotso di ka golaganngwa le se di se supang.
capture.ready.from: Ready. {modules} modules and {criteria} assessment criteria are in, so questions can be linked to what they evidence.

capture.notReady.text: Boitseanape jono ga bo ise bo siamele dilo.
capture.notReady.from: This qualification is not ready for material yet.

capture.notReadyNote.text: Dira tseno pele, ka tatelano eno. Go fitlha di dirilwe, potso e ka se tshwaiwe ka se e se supang, mme go baakanya seo moragonyana go raya go tshwaya nngwe le nngwe ka seatla gape.
capture.notReadyNote.from: Do these first, in this order. Until they are done a question cannot be tagged to what it evidences, and putting that right later means re-tagging every one of them by hand.

capture.whereDocuments.text: Ditokomane di tsenngwa mo tsebeng ya boitseanape ka bosone.
capture.whereDocuments.from: Documents are uploaded on the qualification's own page.

capture.noGuide.text: Ga go a tsengwa tataiso ya dikarabo.

capture.original.text: Ya mathomo e a bolokwa mme e a tshwaelwa ka hash, ka jalo potso e e ganetsanwang e rarabololwa kgatlhanong le tokomane e seng kgatlhanong le go e bala ga jaanong.
capture.original.from: The original is kept and hashed, so a question in dispute is settled against the document rather than against this reading of it.

capture.committedLong.text: Seno se dirilwe ka {date}. Go tsenya go dirwa gangwe fela; tsenya tokomane gape gore o dire pampiri e nngwe go tswa mo go yone.
capture.committedLong.from: This was committed on {date}. An upload is committed once; upload the document again to make another paper from it.

captureReview.noAnswer.text: “{stem}…” e tshwaiwa ke Sethala mme ga e na karabo e e siameng.
captureReview.noAnswer.from: “{stem}…” is marked by the App but has no correct answer.

captureReview.addsUp.text: “{section}” e gatisitswe e le dintlha tse {printed} mme dipotso tsa yone di kopana go nna {sum}.
captureReview.addsUp.from: “{section}” is printed as {printed} marks but its questions add up to {sum}.

captureReview.edited.text: O dirile ditshiamiso. Se se dirwang ke se se leng mo skrineng jaanong, e seng se se badilweng mo faeleng.
captureReview.edited.from: You have made corrections. What gets committed is what is on this screen now, not what was read out of the file.

captureReview.summary.text: Dipotso tse {questions} · dintlha tse {marks} · {app} di tshwaiwa ke Sethala
captureReview.summary.from: {questions} questions · {marks} marks · {app} marked by the App

captureReview.fromFilename.text: Go tswa mo leineng la faele: {parts}

captureReview.unknownOne.text: {codes} ga se tekanyetso mo boitseanapeng jono, ka jalo ga e ka ke ya golaganngwa. Baakanya dikhoutu tse di kwa godimo fa e le phoso ya go kwala.
captureReview.unknownOne.from: {codes} is not a criterion on this qualification, so it will not be linked. Correct the codes above if that is a typo.

captureReview.unknown.text: {codes} ga se ditekanyetso mo boitseanapeng jono, ka jalo ga di ka ke tsa golaganngwa. Baakanya dikhoutu tse di kwa godimo fa e le phoso ya go kwala.
captureReview.unknown.from: {codes} are not criteria on this qualification, so they will not be linked. Correct the codes above if that is a typo.

captureReview.acknowledgeOne.text: Ke badile selo se le 1 se se santseng se setse se se kwa godimo mme ke batla go tswelela le fa go ntse jalo. Seno se rekotilwe kgatlhanong le leina la me.
captureReview.acknowledgeOne.from: I have read the 1 outstanding item above and want to commit anyway. This is recorded against my name.

captureReview.acknowledge.text: Ke badile dilo tse {count} tse di santseng di setse tse di kwa godimo mme ke batla go tswelela le fa go ntse jalo. Seno se rekotilwe kgatlhanong le leina la me.
captureReview.acknowledge.from: I have read the {count} outstanding items above and want to commit anyway. This is recorded against my name.

captureReview.responsibility.text: Go tlhomamisa go amogela boikarabelo jwa karabo nngwe le nngwe e e siameng mo pampiring eno. Leina la gago le dula mo go yone.
captureReview.responsibility.from: Confirming accepts responsibility for every correct answer in this paper. Your name stays on it.

captureReview.swapped.text: Pampiri le tataiso di lebega di fetoletswe
captureReview.swapped.from: The paper and the guide look swapped

captureReview.swappedNote.text: Ga go bontshiwe sepe se sengwe, ka gonne sengwe le sengwe se sengwe se latela go tswa mo go seno. Simolola gape ka pampiri ya moithuti e le pampiri le tataiso ya motlhatlhobi e le tataiso.
captureReview.swappedNote.from: Nothing else is listed, because everything else follows from this. Start again with the learner's paper as the paper and the assessor guide as the guide.

captureReview.fixOne.text: Selo se le 1 se tlhoka go baakangwa

captureReview.fix.text: Dilo tse {count} di tlhoka go baakangwa

captureReview.fixNote.text: Baakanya tseno ka fa tlase, kgotsa o di bale mme o re o batla go tswelela le fa go ntse jalo.
captureReview.fixNote.from: Correct these below, or read them and say you want to go on anyway.

captureReview.clear.text: Ga go sepe se se santseng se setse

captureReview.clearNote.text: Potso nngwe le nngwe e Sethala se tla e tshwayang e na le karabo, mme karolo nngwe le nngwe e kopana le se e se gatisang.
captureReview.clearNote.from: Every question the App will mark has an answer, and every section adds up to what it prints.

captureReview.material.text: Ka ga dilo tsa go ithuta ka bosone

captureReview.materialNote.text: Tokomane e badilwe sentle. Tseno ke dilo tse di amanang le pampiri tse fela mokwadi wa yone a ka di tlhophang.
captureReview.materialNote.from: The document was read correctly. These are things about the paper that only its author can decide.

captureReview.worthKnowing.text: Se se molemo go se itse

imports.intro.text: Folodara nngwe le nngwe e e badilweng, le se se diragetseng ka yone. Go bala nngwe e ntšha go simolola kwa tiro e leng teng, mo boitseanapeng, kosing kgotsa mo dilong tsa go ithuta tse o di agang, e seng fano.
imports.intro.from: Every folder that has been read, and what became of it. Reading a new one starts where the work is, on the qualification, course or material you are building, rather than here.

imports.noExtension.text: Ga o ise o baakanye katološo ya AI
imports.noExtension.from: You have not set up an AI extension

imports.noExtensionNote.text: Ga e patelesege mme ke ya gago, e seng ya moabi: modiri mongwe le mongwe o baakanya ya gagwe, ka subscription ya gagwe.
imports.noExtensionNote.from: It is optional and yours rather than the tenant's: every member of staff sets up their own, with their own subscription.

imports.readNote.text: Se bolokwa le fa se dirilwe kgotsa se latlhilwe. Se se neng se akantswe mme sa gannwa ke sone se dirang gore mongwe a atlhole gore a go bala go ka ikanngwa.
imports.readNote.from: Kept whether committed or discarded. What was proposed and then rejected is how anybody judges whether a reading is worth trusting.

imports.byAi.text: e badilwe ke katološo ya AI

imports.byPlatform.text: e badilwe ke Sethala, ntle le AI
imports.byPlatform.from: read by the platform, no AI involved

imports.backFolders.text: ← Boela kwa difolodareng tse di badilweng
imports.backFolders.from: ← Back to the folders that have been read

imports.contents.text: Se se neng se le mo folodareng

imports.contentsNote.text: Sengwe le sengwe se se fitlhetsweng, le se se dirilweng ka sone. Difaele tsa PDF le tsa Word di fetolelwa ka sediriswa se se tshwanang se se dirisiwang mo Sethaleng sotlhe, ka jalo model o bala gone se Capture e se badang.
imports.contentsNote.from: Everything found, and what was done with it. PDFs and Word documents are converted with the same extractor the rest of the platform uses, so the model reads exactly what Capture would.

imports.proposesNote.text: Sengwe le sengwe mo lefelong le le lengwe. Ditemoso ke karolo e e botlhokwa: di bale pele ga sepe se sengwe.
imports.proposesNote.from: Everything in one place. The warnings are the part that matters: read those before anything else.

proposal.fromBlueprint.text: E badilwe go tswa mo faeleng ya leano ya folodara ka bosone. Sebopego se se kwa tlase ke se faele eo e se bolelang: ga go a akanngwa sepe, mme ga go a botsiwa model.
proposal.fromBlueprint.from: Read from the folder's own blueprint file. The structure below is exactly what that file says: nothing was inferred, and no model was asked.

proposal.fromDocuments.text: E badilwe go tswa mo ditokomaneng ke model. E bapise le tokomane ya kharikhulamo pele o dira.
proposal.fromDocuments.from: Read from the documents by the model. Check it against the curriculum document before committing.

proposal.byName.text: E bolokilwe ka leina. Ga go a dirisiwa leano kgotsa model: tokomane nngwe le nngwe e ile kwa leina la yone le bolelang gore e tshwanetse go ya teng, mme kharikhulamo ga e a ama.
proposal.byName.from: Filed by name. No blueprint and no model were involved: each document went where its filename says it belongs, and the curriculum is untouched.

proposal.unitsNamed.text: Diyuniti tsa thuto tse {count} di umakilwe ke maina a difaele a tsone.
proposal.unitsNamed.from: {count} study units are named by their filenames.

proposal.nothingChanged.text: Ga go okeletswe kgotsa go fetolwe modiule, setlhogo kgotsa tekanyetso ka seno.
proposal.nothingChanged.from: No module, topic or criterion is added or changed by this.

proposal.counts.text: Dimodiule di le {modules}, ditlhogo tse {topics}, dikarolo tse {elements}, ditekanyetso tse {criteria}, diyuniti tsa thuto tse {units}, ditokomane tse {documents}
proposal.counts.from: {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} elements, {criteria} criteria, {units} study units, {documents} documents

proposal.withheld.from: {withheld} withheld from learners, {visible} visible to them.

proposal.withheldNote.text: Memorandamo, ditataiso tsa dikarabo le dipampiri tsa tlhatlhobo ya bofelo di sireleditswe mongwe le mongwe yo o se nang tshwanelo ya go tlhatlhoba.
proposal.withheldNote.from: Memoranda, answer guides and summative papers are withheld from anybody without the right to assess.

proposal.unknownOne.text: Nngwe e le 1 ga e a lemogiwa go tswa mo leineng la yone mme e bolokilwe e le “tse dingwe”, e leng e e bonwang ke botlhe.

proposal.unknown.from: {count} could not be recognised from their names and are filed as “other”, which is visible to everyone.

proposal.unknownNote.text: Go molemo go lebelela ka fa tlase pele o dira: tataiso ya dikarabo e e umakilweng ka tsela e melao eno e sa e itseng e ka bo e le fano.
proposal.unknownNote.from: Worth a look below before committing: an answer guide named in a way these rules do not know would be here.

proposal.orAdd.from: Or add it to one already here

proposal.addNote.text: Go e okeletsa mo go e e setseng e le fano go tlogela sengwe le sengwe se se leng teng se sa ama, mme go tsenya fela se se tlhaelang.
proposal.addNote.from: Adding it to one already here leaves everything that is there untouched and puts in only what is missing.

proposal.topUp.text: E okeleditswe mo boitseanapeng jo o simolotseng ka jone. Lenaane le le kwa godimo ke sengwe le sengwe se folodara e se tshwereng, e seng sengwe le sengwe se se tla bopiwang: sengwe le sengwe se se setseng se le fano se tlogelwa fela jaaka se ntse, mme se se tlhaelang fela se a okeletswa. O tlhalosetswa morago gore ke dimodiule dife tse di neng di setse di le teng.
proposal.topUp.from: Added to the qualification you started from. The list above is everything the folder holds, not everything that will be created: whatever is already here is left exactly as it is, and only what is missing is added. You are told afterwards which modules were already held.

proposal.filedCourse.text: E bolokilwe kgatlhanong le kosi e o simolotseng ka yone.
proposal.filedCourse.from: Filed against the course you started from.

proposal.filedProgramme.text: E bolokilwe kgatlhanong le lenaneo le o simolotseng ka lone.
proposal.filedProgramme.from: Filed against the programme you started from.

proposal.filedQualification.text: E bolokilwe kgatlhanong le boitseanape jo o simolotseng ka jone.
proposal.filedQualification.from: Filed against the qualification you started from.

proposal.checks.text: Sengwe le sengwe se se kwa godimo se tsena ka nako e le nngwe, ka ditlhatlhobo tse di tshwanang tse di dirwang mo sengweng le sengwe se se agilweng ka seatla. Se ditlhatlhobo tseo di se gannang se a begwa, e seng go tlolwa ka khutso.
proposal.checks.from: Everything above goes in at once, through the same checks that apply to anything built by hand. Whatever those checks turn away is reported rather than skipped quietly.

proposal.discardNote.text: E bolokilwe mo rekotong. Se se neng se akantswe mme sa gannwa ke sone se dirang gore mongwe a atlhole gore a katološo e tshwanetse go nna teng.
proposal.discardNote.from: Kept on the record. What was proposed and rejected is how anybody judges whether the extension is worth having.

reports.coverageNote.from: Counted from certificates, not course completions. A completion means somebody reached the end of the material; a certificate means a judgement was made and, where required, independently moderated.

reports.singleNote.from: Held by one person only: {codes}. If that person leaves, the capability goes with them.

progReport.intro.text: Dipotso tse pedi tse di lebegang di amana le baithuti mme ga di ame: ke eng se se sa tlhatlhobiweng ke sepe, le gore ke dipotso dife tse di sa direng.
progReport.intro.from: Two questions that look like they are about learners and are not: what nothing assesses, and which questions are not working.

progReport.untested.text: Se se sa tlhatlhobiweng ke sepe

progReport.untestedNote.text: Tekanyetso e e sa tlhatlhobiweng ke potso epe ya bofelo ga e ka ke ya fitlhelelwa ke ope, le fa a dira sentle jang. E thibela moithuti mongwe le mongwe mo boitseanapeng, mme ga go sepe se sengwe mo Sethaleng se se e bolelang.
progReport.untestedNote.from: A criterion no summative question assesses cannot be achieved by anybody, however well they do. It holds up every learner on the qualification, and nothing else in the platform says so.

progReport.noCriteria.from: This qualification has no assessment criteria captured yet.

progReport.questionsNote.from: First attempts only, because a re-sit measures something else. Nothing is flagged below {minimum} attempts: a question two people have answered tells you about those two people.

progReport.noAssessments.text: Ga go ise go phasalatswe ditlhatlhobo dipe.

progReport.nobody.from: Almost nobody can answer this. Either the question is unclear or what it tests was never taught.

progReport.everybody.text: Mongwe le mongwe o bona dintlha tsotlhe, ka jalo ga e farologanye sepe.
progReport.everybody.from: Everybody gets full marks, so it distinguishes nothing.

statutory.intro.text: Pego ya SAQA National Learners' Records Database, le Workplace Skills Plan le Annual Training Report. Sengwe le sengwe se tlhatlhobiwa fano pele ga se ya kae kwa go sengwe, ka gonne pego e e gannwang ka ntlha ya nomoro ya boitshupo e e kwadilweng ka phoso e tsaya nako yotlhe ya pego.
statutory.intro.from: The SAQA National Learners' Records Database return, and the Workplace Skills Plan and Annual Training Report. Everything is checked here before it goes anywhere, because a return rejected for a mistyped identity number costs a full cycle.

statutory.problemOne.text: Bothata jo bo le 1 jo bo tshwanetseng go baakangwa pele

statutory.problems.text: Mathata a le {count} a a tshwanetseng go baakangwa pele

statutory.locked.text: Difaele di dula di notletswe go fitlha mathata a a thibelang a a kwa tlase a rarabololwa. Go romela pego e e tla ganetswang go senya sekgala sa nako mo moithuting mongwe le mongwe yo o mo go yone.
statutory.locked.from: The files stay locked until the blocking problems below are fixed. Submitting a return that will be rejected wastes a cycle for every learner in it.

statutory.mustFix.text: A tshwanetse go rarabololwa pele ga go romelwa

statutory.worthFixingNote.text: Tseno ga di emise pego, mme NLRD e supa dintlha tsa demokerafi tse di sa felelang, mme SETA e ka di botsolotsa.
statutory.worthFixingNote.from: These do not stop the return, but the NLRD flags incomplete demographic data and a SETA may query it.

statutory.wsp.text: Togamaano ya Dikgono tsa Lefelo la Tiro le Pego ya Ngwaga ya Katiso
statutory.wsp.from: Workplace Skills Plan and Annual Training Report

statutory.wspNote.text: Ditiro tsa katiso go ya ka tiro, jaaka pego ya SETA e rulagantswe.
statutory.wspNote.from: Training activity by occupation, as a SETA return is organised.

statutory.noOfoOne.text: Motho a le 1 ga a na khoutu ya OFO: {names}. Ba santse ba balwa, mme pego ya SETA e kgobokanya go ya ka tiro.

statutory.mapping.text: Go tshwantsha dikarolo go latela thulaganyo ya kamogelo (Motho 27, Kwadiso 28, Phitlhelelo 29, Moabi 30). Netefatsa sebopego sa faele ya Edu.Dex kgatlhanong le tshedimosetso ya gompieno ya SAQA pele o romela pego ya mmatota.
statutory.mapping.from: Field mapping follows the accreditation framework (Person 27, Enrolment 28, Achievement 29, Provider 30). Confirm the exact Edu.Dex file layout against the current SAQA specification before a live submission.

enrolNotify.intro.text: QCTO e tshwanetse go itsisiwa gore baithuti bano ba kwadisitswe, mo malatsing a tiro a le 21 morago ga tlhaeletso ya boitseanape le a le 5 a lenaneo la dikgono. Malatsi a boikhutso a setšhaba ga a balwe, mme nako e simolola ka letlha la tlhaeletso, e seng ka la kwadiso kgotsa la tuelo.
enrolNotify.intro.from: The QCTO has to be told that these learners were enrolled, within twenty-one working days of induction for a qualification and five for a skills programme. Public holidays do not count, and the clock runs from the induction date rather than from enrolment or payment.

enrolNotify.overdueNote.text: Santse o di romela. Kitsiso e e diegileng e na le tlhaloso e farologane le e e sa dirwang ke ope.
enrolNotify.overdueNote.from: Still submit these. A late notification with an explanation is a different problem to one nobody made.

enrolNotify.daysAgo.text: malatsi a tiro a le {count} a a fetileng

enrolNotify.soon.text: {count} di tshwanetse mo bekeng e le nngwe

enrolNotify.soonNote.text: Go setse malatsi a tiro a le matlhano kgotsa a mmalwa.
enrolNotify.soonNote.from: Five working days or fewer remaining.

enrolNotify.daysLeft.text: go setse malatsi a tiro a le {count}

enrolNotify.noInduction.text: Ga go na letlha la tlhaeletso la {count}

enrolNotify.noInductionNote.text: Nako ya bone ga e ise e simolole, ka jalo ga go na nako ya bofelo e e ka begwang. Beela letlha la kopano ya tlhaeletso ya setlhopha, kgotsa o ba nee ya bone fa tlase.
enrolNotify.noInductionNote.from: Their clock has not started, so there is no deadline to report. Date the cohort's induction session, or give them their own below.

enrolNotify.draftNote.text: Botlhe ba ba nnileng le tlhaeletso ka letsatsi le le tshwanang ba ya mmogo. Motho yo o tsenang morago o tlhoka ya gagwe.
enrolNotify.draftNote.from: Everybody inducted on the same day goes together. A late joiner needs their own.

enrolNotify.ownInductionNote.text: Motho yo o tsenileng morago ga fa setlhopha se simologile o na le tlhaeletso ya gagwe, foromo ya gagwe ya kwadiso le kabo ya gagwe.
enrolNotify.ownInductionNote.from: Somebody who joined after the cohort started has their own induction, their own enrolment form and their own submission.

enrolNotify.notified.text: Baithuti ba le {count} ba setse ba itsisitswe.

enrolNotify.nothingDrafted.text: Ga go ise go baakanngwe sepe.

enrolNotify.split.text: Kabo eno e akaretsa lenaneo la dikgono le boitseanape. Di ya kwa diaterese tse di farologaneng, ka jalo e tshwanetse go aroganngwa mme e romelwe gabedi.
enrolNotify.split.from: This submission covers both a skills programme and a qualification. They go to different addresses, so it has to be split and sent twice.

enrolNotify.askAck.text: Kopa tlhomamiso ya go amogelwa, mme o e rekote fano fa e boa.
enrolNotify.askAck.from: Ask for an acknowledgement, and record it here when it comes back.

enrolNotify.nobodyOutstanding.text: Ga go na ope yo o setseng. Moithuti mongwe le mongwe yo o nang le letlha la tlhaeletso o setse a itsisitswe.
enrolNotify.nobodyOutstanding.from: Nobody is outstanding. Every learner with an induction date has been notified about.

enrolNotify.clockFrom.text: Nako e simolola ka letsatsi leno.
enrolNotify.clockFrom.from: The clock runs from this day.

enrolNotify.kind.full.text: Boitseanape jo bo feletseng: malatsi a tiro a le 21

enrolNotify.kind.part.text: Boitseanape jwa karolo: malatsi a tiro a le 21

enrolNotify.kind.skills_programme.text: Lenaneo la dikgono: malatsi a tiro a le 5

enrolNotify.inductedThatDay.text: {count} ba nnile le tlhaeletso ka letsatsi leo

enrolNotify.noneThatDay.text: Ga go na ope yo o setseng yo o nnileng le tlhaeletso ka letlha leo. Fetola letlha, kgotsa o nee motho yo o tsenang morago tlhaeletso ya gagwe fa tlase.
enrolNotify.noneThatDay.from: Nobody outstanding was inducted on that date. Change the date, or give a late joiner their own induction below.

enrolNotify.nobodyWaiting.text: Ga go na ope yo o emetseng letlha la tlhaeletso.
enrolNotify.nobodyWaiting.from: Nobody is waiting on an induction date.

paths.intro.text: {courses} tse dintsi tse di ntshwafaditsweng mo tatelanong: {programme} e ntšha, kgotsa go tsamaisiwa ga lenaneo lotlhe la bokgoni. Moithuti o newa {course} e e latelang ka bonyena fa a fetsa e e mo pele ga yone.
paths.intro.from: Several {courses} chained into a sequence: a new starter {programme}, or a full competency framework roll-out. A learner is given the next {course} automatically as they finish the one before it.

paths.none.text: Ga go na {programmes} go fitlha jaanong

paths.noneAuthor.text: {programme} e ntsha {courses} mo tatelanong, ka jalo moithuti o newa e e latelang fa a fetsa e e mo pele ga yone. Aga {courses} pele: {programme} ke tatelano ya tsone.
paths.noneAuthor.from: A {programme} chains {courses} into an order, so a learner is given the next one as they finish the one before. Build the {courses} first: a {programme} is a sequence of them.

paths.noneReader.text: Ga go ise go agiwe nngwe. Fa e setse e agilwe, {courses} e o e dirang ka tatelano e tla bo e le fano. Go aga nngwe ke tiro ya mokwadi.
paths.noneReader.from: None has been built yet. When one has been, the {courses} you work through in order will be here. Building one is an author's job.

paths.empty.text: Ga go na {courses} mo go yone go fitlha jaanong: moithuti yo o newang {programme} eno a ka se amogele sepe. E bule gore o okeletse dingwe.
paths.empty.from: No {courses} in it yet: a learner given this {programme} would receive nothing. Open it to add some.

paths.newTitleHint.text: Lenaneo la Motho yo o Tsenang Sesha

paths.onItOne.text: Motho a le 1 mo go yone

paths.onIt.text: Batho ba le {count} mo go yone

paths.folder.text: Okeletsa ditokomane go tswa mo folodareng

paths.folderNote.text: Tlhopha folodara e dilo tseno di leng mo go yone, mme sengwe le sengwe se se mo go yone, go akaretsa le difolodara tse dinnye, se a baliwa, se a bolokwa mme se a kaiwa. O bona se se tla bolokwang pele ga go kwalwa sepe.
paths.folderNote.from: Choose the folder this material lives in and everything in it, including its subfolders, is read, filed and indexed. You see what it would file before anything is written.

paths.folderLabel.text: Folodara ya yone, go tswa mo khomputareng ya gago
paths.folderLabel.from: Its folder, from your own computer

paths.folderHint.text: Ditataiso, dibuka tsa tiro, melawana le ditemplate di bolokwa kgatlhanong le yone mme mokwalo wa tsone o a kaiwa gore di ka batlwa.
paths.folderHint.from: Guides, workbooks, policies and templates are filed against it and their text indexed so they can be searched.

paths.folderHint2.text: Sebopego ga se bopiwe go tswa fano: sebopego sa yone se agiwa ka go okeletsa {courses} mo go yone kwa godimo. Fano go bolokwa se e nang le sone.
paths.folderHint2.from: Structure is not created from here: its own shape is built by adding {courses} to it above. This files what it holds.

paths.driveNote.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

paths.noSteps.text: Ga go na sepe mo go yone go fitlha jaanong. Okeletsa dilo ka tatelano e baithuti ba tshwanetseng go di tsaya ka yone.
paths.noSteps.from: Nothing in it yet. Add them in the order learners should take them.

paths.opensFirst.from: Opens as soon as somebody joins.

paths.opensAfter.text: E butswe fa kgato e e fetileng e fedile.

paths.opensNow.text: E butswe ka pela, mmogo le tse dingwe.

paths.published.text: Seno se phasaladitswe mme batho ba a se dira, ka jalo dikgato tsa sone di tlhomamisitswe. Go fetola tatelano fa tlase ga mongwe go ka fetola se a setseng a ntshiwa se tshwanetse go se dira.
paths.published.from: This is published and people are working through it, so its steps are fixed. Changing the order underneath somebody would alter what they had already been told to do.

paths.publishNote.text: Sengwe le sengwe se se mo go yone se tshwanetse go phasaladiwa pele.
paths.publishNote.from: Everything in it has to be published first.

paths.firstOnly.text: Ke e ntlha fela e e butswang. Tse dingwe di goroga fa nngwe le nngwe e fela.
paths.firstOnly.from: Only the first opens. The rest arrive as each is finished.

badges.intro.text: Kamogelo e e goroga ka letsatsi le tiro e fedileng ka lone, e seng dikgwedi morago fa setifikeiti sa kwa ntle se goroga. Baji ga se boitseanape mme sethala ga se e tlohele e lebege jaaka jone: ga go na tshupo ya SAQA, ga go na dikhredite, mme letlakala la netefatso le bolela ka go phepa gore ke eng le gore ga se eng.
badges.intro.from: Recognition that arrives on the day the work is finished, rather than months later when the external certificate comes through. A badge is not a qualification and the platform never lets it look like one: no SAQA identifier, no credits, and a verification page that says plainly what it is and what it is not.

badges.target.default.text: Sengwe le sengwe, fa go sa tlhophiwa se se tobileng
badges.target.default.from: Anything, when nothing more specific is set

badges.nothing.text: Ga go ise go bonwe sepe

badges.nothingNote.text: Ga go a rulaganngwa baji epe, ka jalo go fetsa kosi kgotsa boitseanape ga go fe sepe jaanong. Go rulaganya nngwe fa tlase go lekane: simolola ka baji ya moabi ka bosone fa o sa batle e e farologaneng ya selo sengwe le sengwe.
badges.nothingNote.from: No badge has been designed, so finishing a course or a qualification currently awards nothing. Designing one below is enough: start with the provider's own badge if you do not want a different one for each thing.

badges.legitimate.text: Seno ke tlhopho e e siameng, e seng phoso. Sethala ga se ka sa tlhama nngwe.
badges.legitimate.from: This is a legitimate choice rather than a fault. The platform will not invent one.

badges.kind.default.text: Sengwe le sengwe, fa go sa tlhophiwa se se tobileng
badges.kind.default.from: Anything, when nothing more specific is set

badges.kind.curriculum_module.text: Modiule o le mongwe wa kharikhulamo

badges.designNote.text: Sebopego, mebala e mebedi le letshwao. Ga go na sepe sa go tsenya le ope wa go bolelelwa.
badges.designNote.from: A shape, two colours and a symbol. Nothing to upload and nobody to brief.

badges.allHave.text: Sengwe le sengwe se na le baji. Ntsha nngwe gore o rulaganye baji e e farologaneng ya selo se se tshwanang.
badges.allHave.from: Everything already has a badge. Retire one to design a different badge for the same thing.

badges.nameHint.text: Go bereka kwa bogodimo ka tshireletso

badges.says.text: Se e se buang, mo moithuting le mongwe le mongwe yo a e mmontshang (ga go patelesege)

badges.saysHint.text: O fetsile modiule wa tiragatso ya go bereka kwa bogodimo, o tlhatlhobilwe kgatlhanong le ditekanyetso tsa kharikhulamo.
badges.saysHint.from: Completed the practical module on working at heights, assessed against the curriculum criteria.

badges.retireTitle.text: Emisa go abela {name}. Botlhe ba ba nang le yone ba e tswelela.
badges.retireTitle.from: Stop awarding {name}. Everybody who has it keeps it.

templates.intro.text: Ditokomane tse {name} e di tlhagisang. Ka moo nngwe le nngwe e balwang le go lebegang ka teng ke ya gago: kwala phetolelo ya gago mme sethala se e tlhagisa go tswa mo go yone go na le go dirisa sebopego sa sone. Se molao o se tlhokang se okediwa morago ga sa gago mme ga se fetolwe, ka gonne karolo eo ga se ya moabi go e fetola.
templates.intro.from: The documents {name} produces. How each one reads and looks is yours: write your own version and the platform produces it from that instead of its own layout. What a regulator requires is added after yours and cannot be edited, because that part is not the provider's to change.

templates.goesTo.statement_of_results.text: Moithuti, yo o e isang kwa lefelong la tlhatlhobo le tokomane ya gagwe ya boitshupo.
templates.goesTo.statement_of_results.from: The learner, who carries it to the assessment centre with their identity document.

templates.goesTo.certificate.text: Moithuti, le mongwe le mongwe yo a mmontshang.
templates.goesTo.certificate.from: The learner, and whoever they show it to.

templates.goesTo.workplace_statement.text: Faele ya moithuti, e e tshwailweng ke mokoetlisi kwa mothapong yo o amogelang.
templates.goesTo.workplace_statement.from: The learner's file, signed by a coach at the host employer.

templates.goesTo.enrolment_form.text: E bolokwa jaaka bosupi, mme e neelwa motlhokomedi wa QCTO mo ketelong.
templates.goesTo.enrolment_form.from: Filed as evidence, and handed to a QCTO monitor on a visit.

templates.producesNote.text: Sengwe le sengwe se se senang phetolelo ya gago se dirisa sebopego sa sethala, e leng tokomane e e dirang tiro, e seng sekgoa fela.
templates.producesNote.from: Anything without your own version uses the platform's layout, which is a working document rather than a placeholder.

templates.writeNote.text: Simolola ka sebopego sa sethala mme o se fetole go nna sa gago. Tshimo nngwe le nngwe e tokomane e ka e tsayang e kaiwa mo thoko ga mokwadi ka sekao sa nnete sa gore e lebega jang.
templates.writeNote.from: Start from the platform's layout and edit it down into yours. Every field the document can carry is listed beside the editor with a real example of what it looks like.

templates.supplied.text: Ditokomane tse o di neelang go na le go di rulaganya
templates.supplied.from: Documents you supply rather than lay out

templates.suppliedNote.text: Ga se tokomane nngwe le nngwe e e leng template e sethala se e tladitseng.
templates.suppliedNote.from: Not every document is a template the platform fills in.

templates.policiesNote.text: lekwalo la gago la kamogelo, melawana le ditumalano, di tsentswe mme di bolokilwe, ga di tlhagiswe.
templates.policiesNote.from: your accreditation letter, policies and agreements, uploaded and retained rather than generated.

templates.fisaNote.text: di kwadilwe ke mokwadi wa gago wa ditlhatlhobo mme di sekasekilwe pele ga gore ope a di kwale, ka jalo di a kwalwa e seng go dirwa ka template.
templates.fisaNote.from: written by your own examiner and moderated before anybody sits them, so they are authored rather than templated.

templates.curriculumNote.text: ditokomane tsa boitseanape tse di phasaladitsweng tse sethala se di balang go aga kharikhulamo.
templates.curriculumNote.from: the published qualification documents the platform reads to build a curriculum from.

tracker.all.text: Setlhopha sengwe le sengwe, go akaretsa le tse di fedileng le tse di khutlisitsweng.
tracker.all.from: Every cohort, including those finished and cancelled.

tracker.running.text: Setlhopha sengwe le sengwe se se santseng se tsamaya.

tracker.note.text: E badilwe mo direkotong go na le go bolokwa ka diatla, ka jalo ga e ka ke ya farologana le sethala se e bega ka sone.
tracker.note.from: Read from the records rather than kept by hand, so it cannot disagree with the platform it reports on.

tracker.none.text: Ga go na ditlhopha go fitlha jaanong. Setlhopha ke se lenaane la nako, lenaane la go nna teng le pego ya molao di ikaegang ka sone.
tracker.none.from: No cohorts yet. A cohort is what a schedule, a register and a statutory return all hang from.

dictionary.intro.text: Tlhaloso e e tlhomameng ya lefoko lengwe le lengwe le le dirisiwang mo sethaleng seno, mo ditokomaneng tsa sone le mo dilong tsa gone tsa go ithuta. Ntlha nngwe le nngwe e bolela gore lefoko le ke la mang. Fa go na le taolo e e le tlhalosang, re le dirisa jaaka e le dirisa mme leina la yone le a umakiwa. Fa lefoko e le la rona, re ka le fetola. Fa e le tiriso ya kakaretso fela, le ka se ke la umakiwa e le sepatelelo.
dictionary.intro.from: The settled meaning of every term used across this platform, its documents and its learning material. Each entry says who owns the word. Where an authority defines it, we use it as they do and the body is named. Where the word is ours, we can change it. Where it is simply common usage, it should never be cited as a requirement.

dictionary.version.text: Phetolelo {version}, e ntshitswe {issued}: mafoko a le {count}.

dictionary.searchHint.text: Lefoko, khutshwafatso, kgotsa lefoko mo tlhalosong
dictionary.searchHint.from: A term, an abbreviation, or a word in a definition

dictionary.meaning.authority.text: Le tlhalositswe ke taolo. Le dirise jaaka e le dirisa: go fetola tlhaloso go baya kabo mo kotsing.
dictionary.meaning.authority.from: Defined by an authority. Use it as they do: changing the meaning puts a submission at risk.

dictionary.meaning.platform.text: Ke lefoko la sethala seno ka bosone. Ke la rona go le fetola; ga go na taolo e e le laolang.
dictionary.meaning.platform.from: This platform's own word for it. Ours to change; no authority prescribes it.

dictionary.meaning.practice.text: Tiriso e e tlwaelegileng mo lekgetlong lotlhe, e se nang mong a le mongwe. O se le umake e le sepatelelo.
dictionary.meaning.practice.from: Common usage across the sector, with no single owner. Do not cite it as a requirement.

dictionary.shown.text: mafoko a le {shown} mo go a le {count}

dictionary.none.text: Ga go na se se lekanang. Fa lefoko le tlhaela mme e le le re le dirisang, ke la fano: re bolelele mme le tla okediwa mo go tswang morago.
dictionary.none.from: Nothing matches. If a term is missing and it is one we use, it belongs here: say so and it will be added in the next release.

feedbackForm.intro.text: {cohort}. Dikarabo di begwa mmogo le tsa mongwe le mongwe, e seng nngwe ka nngwe. Go tsaya metsotso e le mebedi, mme ke selo se le sengwe fela se se fetolang ka moo setlhopha se se latelang se tsamaisiwang ka teng.
feedbackForm.intro.from: {cohort}. Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. It takes about two minutes, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

feedbackForm.scale.3.text: Ga ke ikutlwe ka nngwe kgotsa e nngwe

feedbackReport.asked.text: {cohort} · go kopilwe {time} · go arabilwe {answered} mo go {invited} ({rate}%)

feedbackReport.ratingsNote.text: Palogare ya 1 (ke a ganetsana thata) go ya go 5 (ke a dumela thata). Palogare e e agilweng mo dikarabong tse di sa nnang teng ke maikutlo, e seng tekanyo, ka jalo palo e mo thoko ga yone.
feedbackReport.ratingsNote.from: Mean of 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree). A mean over few answers is a mood, not a measurement, so the count is beside it.

feedbackReport.noRatings.text: Ga go ise go ekelediwe sepe.

feedbackReport.saidNote.text: Di bontshiwa mmogo e bile di se na maina. Maikutlo a a mabapi le motsamaisi a boammaaruri fela fa moithuti a dumela gore ga a kake a bodiwa ka bongwe ka bongwe.
feedbackReport.saidNote.from: Shown together and without names. Feedback about a facilitator is only honest if the learner believes it will not be read back to them one by one.

feedbackReport.noComments.text: Ga go ise go kwalwe sepe.

feedbackReport.outstanding.text: Ba santseng ba tshwanetse go araba

feedbackReport.outstandingNote.text: Ke lefelo le le lengwe fela leina le bonalang mo go lone. Go ba latelela go tlhoka maina; dikarabo tse di kwa godimo ga di a tlhoka.
feedbackReport.outstandingNote.from: The one place a name appears. Chasing needs them; the answers above do not.

conductPage.intro.text: Dingongorego tse di tsentsweng ke baithuti, le mongwe le mongwe yo lenaane la go nna teng le reng o tlogetse go tla. Ditaba tsa taolo ya boitshwaro di mo letlakaleng la moithuti ka bosone, fa rekoto ya gagwe yotlhe e leng teng.
conductPage.intro.from: Grievances raised by learners, and anybody the register says has stopped turning up. Disciplinary matters sit on the learner's own page, where the rest of their record is.

conductPage.overdue.text: {count} ga di a rurifadiwa mo nakong

conductPage.overdueNote.text: Ngongorego e rurifadiwa mo malatsing a tiro a le {days}. Tseno di fetile nako eo.
conductPage.overdueNote.from: A grievance is acknowledged within {days} working days. These are past that.

conductPage.grievancesNote.text: Di tsentswa ke moithuti ka ga tsela e a tshwerweng ka yone, maemo, kgotsa sengwe le sengwe se se mo amang. Di tshwaraganngwa kwa thoko le diboipiletso, tse di leng ka ga phetho mme di ya kwa go mosekaseki.
conductPage.grievancesNote.from: Raised by a learner about treatment, conditions, or anything else affecting them. Kept apart from appeals, which are about a result and go to the moderator.

conductPage.absconded.text: Go ka tswa a tlogetse go tla

conductPage.abscondedNote.text: Malatsi a le mabedi kgotsa a a fetang a katiso a a latelanang a a seyo a se na lefoko. E badilwe mo lenaaneng la go nna teng go na le go bolokwa, ka jalo go baakanya letshwao go fetola karabo ka pela. Go seyo go go rekotilweng e le go lopolotswa ke puisano, mme go roba tatelano eo.
conductPage.abscondedNote.from: Two or more consecutive training days absent with no word. Read off the register rather than stored, so correcting a mark changes the answer at once. An absence recorded as excused is communication, and breaks the run.

conductPage.nobody.text: Ga go ope. Mongwe le mongwe o a tla kgotsa o bolelletse mongwe gore goreng a sa tle.
conductPage.nobody.from: Nobody. Everybody is either turning up or has told somebody why not.

conductPage.consecutive.text: {count} a a latelanang, go simolola ka {date}

conductPage.actOn.text: Lenaane la go dira sengwe, ga se tshwetso. Go ikgolaganya le moithuti, go kwalela mothapi le go ntsha kitsiso ya maikemisetso a go fedisa, tsotlhe ke dilo tse motho a di dirang.
conductPage.actOn.from: A list to act on, never a decision. Contacting the learner, writing to the sponsor and issuing a notice of intention to terminate are all things a person does.

grievance.nothing.text: Ga go na sepe se se bulegileng.

grievance.decisionHint.text: Se se fitlhetsweng le se se tla dirwang. Seno se ya kwa moithuting ka mokwalo.
grievance.decisionHint.from: What was found and what will be done. This goes to the learner in writing.

grievance.impartial.text: Mmatlisisi o tshwanetse go nna mongwe yo ngongorego e seng ka ga gagwe. Go umaka yo moithuti a mo ngongoregetseng go a ganetswa, ka gonne “motho yo o tlhophilweng yo o sa tsholeng letlhakore” ke se thulaganyo e se solofetsang, mme beke e e tlhaelang batho ke yone e e senyang seo.
grievance.impartial.from: The investigator must be somebody the grievance is not about. Naming one the learner has complained about is refused, because “a designated impartial person” is what the procedure promises and a short-staffed week is exactly when it gets broken.

access.deniedTitle.text: Ga o na tetla ya go bona seno
access.deniedTitle.from: You do not have access to this

access.deniedNote.text: O tsene, mme seno ga se sa gago go se bona: ele gore ke sa mongwe, kgotsa se tlhoka karolo e akhaonto ya gago e se nang yone. Fa o akanya gore seo ke phoso, kopa molaodi wa gago gore a se tlhatlhobe.
access.deniedNote.from: You are signed in, but this is not yours to see: either it belongs to someone else, or it needs a role your account does not hold. If you think that is wrong, ask your administrator to check.

access.home.text: Boela kwa letlakaleng la gago la gae

access.unknownTitle.from: This address is not in use

access.unknownNote.text: Ga go na mokgatlo o o thulagantsweng mo aterese eno ya webo, kgotsa phitlhelelo ya yone e emisitswe. Tlhatlhoba aterese e o e neetsweng, kgotsa o ikgolaganye le mongwe yo o rulaganyeng katiso ya gago.
access.unknownNote.from: No organisation is set up at this web address, or its access has been suspended. Check the address you were given, or contact whoever arranged your training.

wpSetup.intro.text: Moithuti o dira maitemogelo a tiro kwa go mothapi, a okamelwa ke mongwe yo mothapi eo a mo neelang. Tumalano e rekota gore ke mang; buka ya rekoto e rekota se kharikhulamo e se tlhokang gore a se dire.
wpSetup.intro.from: A learner does work experience at an employer, supervised by somebody that employer provides. The agreement records who that is; the logbook records what the curriculum requires them to do.

wpSetup.emptyOne.text: Modiule o le 1 wa maitemogelo a tiro ga o na ditlhokego tse di tsentsweng.
wpSetup.emptyOne.from: 1 work experience module has no requirements captured.

wpSetup.empty.text: Dimodiule di le {count} tsa maitemogelo a tiro ga di na ditlhokego tse di tsentsweng.
wpSetup.empty.from: {count} work experience modules have no requirements captured.

wpSetup.emptyNote.text: {codes}. Buka ya rekoto e e agilweng go tswa mo modiuleng o o se nang sepe e ka se tlhomamise sepe, ka jalo tseno di ka se bulwe go fitlha ditiro tsa lefelo la tiro tsa kharikhulamo, kitso ya lefelo la tiro le bosupi jo bo tshegetsang di tsentswe.
wpSetup.emptyNote.from: {codes}. A logbook built from an empty module would attest to nothing, so those cannot be opened until the curriculum's work activities, workplace knowledge and supporting evidence have been imported.

wpSetup.none.text: Ga go ise go nne le nngwe.

wpSetup.noCoaches.text: Ga go ope yo o nang le karolo ya Mokoetlisi wa Lefelo la Tiro go fitlha jaanong. Tsenya molebedi wa moithuti ka {people} pele: o direla mothapi, e seng wena, mme o tla bona fela baithuti ba ba umakilweng mo ditumalanong tsa gagwe.
wpSetup.noCoaches.from: Nobody holds the Workplace Coach role yet. Add the learner's supervisor through {people} first: they work for the employer, not for you, and they will only ever see the learners named on their own agreements.

wpSetup.ownCoach.text: Moithuti ga a kake a nna mokoetlisi wa gagwe: database e a le ganetsa.
wpSetup.ownCoach.from: The learner cannot be their own coach; the database refuses it.

wpSetup.designationNote.text: E rekotilwe mo tumalanong jaaka e ntse gompieno, gore go tshwaya go tswelele go bolela gore ke mang yo o tshwailweng le ka maemo afe.
wpSetup.designationNote.from: Recorded on the agreement as it stands today, so the sign-off keeps saying who signed and in what capacity.

wpSetup.noAgreements.text: Ga go na ditumalano tsa lefelo la tiro go fitlha jaanong. Bopa nngwe kwa godimo pele: buka ya rekoto e rekota tiro e e dirilweng kwa go mothapi yo o umakilweng le mokoetlisi yo o umakilweng, ka jalo e ka se nne teng kwa ntle ga yone.
wpSetup.noAgreements.from: No workplace agreements yet. Create one above first: a logbook records work done at a named employer under a named coach, so it cannot exist without one.

wpSetup.generated.text: Buka ya rekoto e tlhamiwa go tswa mo ditirong tsa lefelo la tiro tsa kharikhulamo, kitso ya lefelo la tiro le bosupi jo bo tshegetsang, ka jalo e ka se lebale tlhokego epe.
wpSetup.generated.from: The logbook is generated from the curriculum's own work activities, workplace knowledge and supporting evidence, so it cannot omit a requirement.

enrolForm.intro.text: {provider} e tshwanetse go romela dintlha tseno kwa Khansele ya Boleng ya Ditiro le Boitseanape fa o kwadisiwa. Bontsi jwa tsone bo setse bo itsiwe mme bo bontshitswe fa tlase; se se setseng ke se go seng ope yo o ka se arabang fa e se wena. O ka boloka fa o ntse o tswelela mme wa boela kwa go yone.
enrolForm.intro.from: {provider} has to send these details to the Quality Council for Trades and Occupations when you are enrolled. Most of it is already known and shown below; the rest is what nobody can answer except you. You can save as you go and come back to it.

enrolForm.onRecord.text: Se se setseng se le mo rekotong

enrolForm.onRecordNote.text: Bolelela mokoordinata wa gago fa sepe sa tseno e le phoso; ga se sa gago go se fetola fano.
enrolForm.onRecordNote.from: Tell your coordinator if any of this is wrong; it is not yours to change here.

enrolForm.noInduction.text: tlhaeletso ga e ise e beelwe letlha

enrolForm.doesNotAdd.from: Something here does not add up

enrolForm.idNote.text: Nomoro ya boitshupo ya Aforika Borwa e na le letlha la matsalo le bong mo teng ga yone, mme QCTO e tlhatlhoba gore di a dumalana. Gantsi ke nomoro e e kwadilweng ka phoso. Mokoordinata wa gago a ka e baakanya.
enrolForm.idNote.from: A South African identity number carries the date of birth and the gender inside it, and the QCTO checks that they agree. It is usually a mistyped digit. Your coordinator can correct it.

enrolForm.stillToAnswer.text: {count} di santse di tshwanetse go arabiwa

enrolForm.stillNote.text: Ga go lebala sepe fa o ema fa gare. Seno ke se se tla tlhaelang mo kabong jaaka e ntse jaanong.
enrolForm.stillNote.from: Nothing is lost if you stop partway. This is what would be missing from the submission as it stands.

enrolForm.completeNote.text: Sengwe le sengwe se kabo e se tlhokang se fano.
enrolForm.completeNote.from: Everything the submission needs is here.

enrolForm.printNote.text: gore e tshwaiwe le go bolokwa.

enrolForm.missingPrint.text: Dikarabo di le {count} di santse di tlhaela, ka jalo foromo eno e tla gatiswa e na le mafelo a a se nang sepe. Di thaiwa mo foromong ka bosone.
enrolForm.missingPrint.from: {count} answers are still missing, so this form will print with blanks. They are listed on the form itself.

enrolForm.completePrint.text: E feletse. E gatise, o dire gore moithuti a e tshwaye, mme o e boloke.
enrolForm.completePrint.from: Complete. Print it, have the learner sign it, and file it.

enrolForm.titleHint.from: Mr, Ms, Dr, and so on.

enrolForm.middleHint.text: Fa o na le lone. Le tlogele le se na sepe fa o se na lone.
enrolForm.middleHint.from: If you have one. Leave it blank if not.

enrolForm.homeLanguage.text: Puo e o e buang kwa gae

enrolForm.working.from: Are you working at the moment?

enrolForm.difficulty.text: Go go dira bothata jo bo kae?
enrolForm.difficulty.from: How much difficulty does it cause?

enrolForm.difficultyHint.text: Go botsiwa ka gonne bogole bo rekotilwe kgatlhanong le leina la gago. QCTO e bo tlhoka mmogo.
enrolForm.difficultyHint.from: Asked because a disability is recorded against your name. The QCTO requires it alongside.

enrolForm.noId.text: Fa o se na nomoro ya boitshupo ya Aforika Borwa
enrolForm.noId.from: If you do not have a South African identity number

enrolForm.instead.text: Se o kwadisitsweng mo go sone go na le seo
enrolForm.instead.from: What you are enrolled on instead

enrolForm.post.text: Kwa poso e go fitlhelelang teng, fa e le kwa lefelong le lengwe
enrolForm.post.from: Where post reaches you, if it is somewhere else

enrolForm.reach.text: Kafa o ka go fitlhelelwang ka teng

enrolForm.province.text: Porofense e o berekang mo go yone

enrolForm.provinceHint.text: Kwa o berekang teng, e seng gantsi e le kwa o nnang teng.
enrolForm.provinceHint.from: Where you work, which is not always where you live.

enrolForm.statssaHint.text: Mokoordinata wa gago a ka e batla fa o sa e itse.
enrolForm.statssaHint.from: Your coordinator can look this one up if you do not know it.

enrolForm.flc.text: Bokgoni jwa Motheo jwa go Ithuta

enrolForm.flcNote.text: E tlhokega fela mo boitseanapeng jwa NQF legato la 3 kgotsa la 4. E tlogele e se na sepe fa ope a sa e go kope.
enrolForm.flcNote.from: Only needed on a qualification at NQF level 3 or 4. Leave it blank if nobody has asked you for it.

enrolForm.agreedOn.text: O dumetse ka {date}. Letlha leo ke karolo ya rekoto mme ga le fetoge fa o fetola foromo eno.
enrolForm.agreedOn.from: You agreed on {date}. That date is part of the record and does not change if you edit this form.

enrolForm.agreedDate.text: Letlha le o dumelang ka lone le a rekotiwa, ka gonne pego e kopa tsotlhe tse pedi.
enrolForm.agreedDate.from: The date you agree is recorded, because the return asks for both.

enrolForm.confirm.text: Boloka mme o tlhomamise gore di siame
enrolForm.confirm.from: Save and confirm these are right

records.intro.text: Tsamaiso ya Boleng le melawana ya yone, maletere a kamogelo, dikonteraka le ditokomane tsa molao jaaka buka ya PAIA: sengwe le sengwe se moabi a nang le sone se se seng sa moithuti a le mongwe kgotsa boitseanape jo bo le bongwe. Go tsenya foladara ya boitseanape go bolokela melawana ya yone ya QMS fano ka bonyena.
records.intro.from: The Quality Management System and its policies, accreditation letters, contracts, and statutory documents like the PAIA manual: everything the provider holds that does not belong to one learner or one qualification. Importing a qualification folder files its QMS policies here automatically.

records.introManage.text: E bontsha gape se se fitlheletseng bofelo jwa nako ya go boloka.
records.introManage.from: It also shows what has reached the end of its retention period.

records.expiringNote.text: Tetla ya lekgetho e e fedileng ke selo se ope a se lemogang go fitlha beke e e se tlhokang.
records.expiringNote.from: An expired tax clearance is the kind of thing nobody notices until the week it is needed.

records.libraryNote.text: Diphetolelo tse di emeletsweng di a bolokwa, ka gonne pholisi e e neng e laola ka Mopitlwe ke yone e tlhatlhobo ya Mopitlwe e e botsang ka yone.
records.libraryNote.from: Superseded versions are kept, because the policy that governed in March is the one an audit of March asks about.

records.nothing.text: Ga go ise go bolokwe sepe.

records.nothingManage.text: Lekwalo la kamogelo ke le le tshwanetseng go tsengwa pele.
records.nothingManage.from: The accreditation letter is the one worth putting in first.

records.everybody.text: mongwe le mongwe a ka e bala

records.retention.text: {count} di fetile nako ya go boloka

records.retentionNote.text: Di balwa go tswa ka letlha la tlhomamiso, mo nakong ya go boloka mo mokgatlong ono. Ga go a bolokelwa mo pokanong kgotsa go senngwa sepe fano: sethala se bolela gore ke eng e e tshwanetseng, mme motho o tsaya tshwetso.
records.retentionNote.from: Counted from the certification date, over the retention period on this tenant. Nothing here has been archived or destroyed: the platform says what is due and a person decides.

records.registerNote.text: Sengwe le sengwe se se tsewang ka rekoto e e fetileng letlha la yone, le gore ke mang yo o se dirileng. Rekoto e e nyeleditsweng ka kgutshwane e maswe go gaisa e e bolokilweng nako e telele.
records.registerNote.from: Everything decided about a record past its date, with who decided it. A record that quietly disappeared is worse than one kept too long.

records.category.operational.text: Tsa tiro ya letsatsi le letsatsi

records.new.text: Ga go sepe: seno ke se sesha

records.replacesNote.text: E e e emeletsweng e a bolokwa mme e tshwaiwa e emeletswe. Pholisi e e neng e laola ka Mopitlwe ke yone e tlhatlhobo ya Mopitlwe e e botsang ka yone.
records.replacesNote.from: The one it replaces is kept and marked superseded. The policy that governed in March is what an audit of March asks about.

records.descriptionHint.text: Ke eng, fa setlhogo se sa bolele
records.descriptionHint.from: What it is, if the title does not say

records.anybody.text: Mongwe le mongwe yo o tsenneng a ka bala seno
records.anybody.from: Anybody signed in may read this

records.anybodyNote.text: E dirisiwa mo ditokomaneng tsa molao. Tataiso ya baithuti e dinako tsotlhe e bontshiwa baithuti; melawana, dikonteraka, kamogelo le ditokomane tsa tiro ya letsatsi le letsatsi ga di ke di bontshiwe.
records.anybodyNote.from: Applies to statutory documents. A learner guide is always shown to learners; policies, contracts, accreditation and operational documents never are.

records.archive.text: Boloka mo pokanong: e tlose mo tseleng
records.archive.from: Archive: move it out of the way

records.keep.text: E boloke go feta nako ya go boloka

offline.title.text: Go dira kwa ntle ga netweke

offline.intro.text: Elola se o se tlhokang pele o tswa. Sengwe le sengwe se o se rekotang fa o le kgakala se bolokwa mo mogaleng ono mme se romelwa morago ka gangwe fa o boa o na le netweke.
offline.intro.from: Download what you need before you go out. Anything you record while you are away is kept on this phone and sent back the next time you have a signal.

offline.takeNote.text: Elola se o se tlhokang pele o tswa. Ga go bolokwe sepe se o sa se kopang.
offline.takeNote.from: Download what you need before you go. Nothing is kept that you did not ask for.

offline.nothingToStudy.text: Ga o na sepe sa go ithuta gompieno. Sengwe le sengwe se o se kwadisitsweng se bonala fano gore o se elole.
offline.nothingToStudy.from: You have nothing to study at the moment. Anything you are enrolled on appears here to download.

offline.recordNote.text: E dira kwa ntle ga netweke. E ema mo mogaleng ono mme e ya fa o boa o na le netweke.
offline.recordNote.from: Works with no signal. It waits on this phone and goes when you next have one.

offline.waitingDecisionNote.text: Sengwe se fetogile fa moithuti a le kgakala. Ga go a kopanngwa kgotsa go kwalwa sepe kwa godimo ga sengwe: mongwe o tshwanetse go tlhopha.
offline.waitingDecisionNote.from: Something changed while the learner was away. Nothing has been merged or overwritten: somebody has to choose.

offline.bothDates.text: E rekotilwe mo sedirisweng {captured} · e re goroletse {received}
offline.bothDates.from: Recorded on the device {captured} · reached us {received}

offline.relaxed.text: {count} di tsewa ka molawana o o siameng

offline.relaxedNote.text: Tiro e e rekotilweng fa lenaneo leno le ne le letleletse gore ditlhatlhobo tsa bofelo di tseelwe kwa ntle ga netweke. Fa lenaneo le amogelwa morago, tiro eo ga e tlhole e ka sireletsega morago ga nako: ke lenaane leno, ka jalo ke tshwetso e e tsewang, e seng selo se se bonwang kwa ketelong ya tlhokomelo.
offline.relaxedNote.from: Work recorded while this programme allowed summatives to be taken offline. If the programme is accredited later, that work does not become defensible retrospectively: this is the list, so it is a decision rather than a discovery at a monitoring visit.

offline.cannotHold.text: Sebatli seno ga se kake sa boloka dilo tse di dirisiwang kwa ntle ga netweke. Sengwe le sengwe se santse se dira ka tlwaelo fa o golagane.
offline.cannotHold.from: This browser cannot hold material for use without a signal. Everything still works normally while you are connected.

offline.noSignal.text: Ga go na netweke: go bontshiwa se se bolokilweng
offline.noSignal.from: No signal: showing what is held

offline.nothingHeld.text: Ga go ise go bolokwe sepe. Bula yuniti ya thuto mme o tlhophe go e dira gore e bonale kwa ntle ga netweke pele o tswa.
offline.nothingHeld.from: Nothing is held yet. Open a study unit and choose to make it available offline before you go out.

offline.ofQuota.text: mo go a ka nnang {quota} tse mogala ono o tla di letlelelang
offline.ofQuota.from: of about {quota} this phone will allow

offline.keepNote.text: E kopa mogala gore o se se tlhatswe fa o le kgakala.
offline.keepNote.from: Asks the phone not to clear it while you are away.

offline.noRoom.text: Ga go na lefelo le le lekaneng mo mogaleng ono. Tlosa se se bolokilweng sa yuniti e nngwe ya thuto pele: ga go a elolwa sepe.
offline.noRoom.from: There is not enough room on this phone. Remove something held for another study unit first: nothing has been downloaded.

offline.onPhone.text: {label} e mo mogaleng ono. O ka e bala kwa ntle ga netweke.
offline.onPhone.from: {label} is on this phone. You can read it with no signal.

offline.incomplete.text: Seo ga se a elolwa ka botlalo, ka jalo ga go a bolokwa sepe sa sone. Leka gape kwa netweke e siameng gone.
offline.incomplete.from: That did not download completely, so none of it has been kept. Try again where the signal is better.

offline.released.text: {label} ga e tlhole e bolokilwe. E lokolotse lefelo mo mogaleng ono.
offline.released.from: {label} is no longer held. It freed up room on this phone.

offline.cannotKeep.text: Sebatli seno ga se kake sa boloka dilo tse di dirisiwang kwa ntle ga netweke.
offline.cannotKeep.from: This browser cannot keep material for use without a signal.

offline.makeAvailable.text: Dira gore seno se bonale kwa ntle ga netweke

offline.pageOne.text: Letlakala le le 1. E elole pele o tswa.
offline.pageOne.from: 1 page. Download it before you go out.

offline.pages.text: Matlakala a le {count}. A elole pele o tswa.
offline.pages.from: {count} pages. Download it before you go out.

offline.dropped.text: {count} e ne ya se ka ya amogelwa: {why}

offline.writeFirst.text: Kwala nopolo kgotsa o okeletse setshwantsho pele.
offline.writeFirst.from: Write a note or add a photograph first.

offline.sending.text: E rekotilwe. Go a romelwa jaanong.

offline.willGo.text: E rekotilwe mo mogaleng ono. E tla ya fa o na le netweke.
offline.willGo.from: Recorded on this phone. It will go when you have a signal.

offline.whatYouDidHint.text: Ke tlhatlhobile morako wa fenseng ya lebopo la botlhaba.
offline.whatYouDidHint.from: Inspected the fence line along the eastern boundary.

offline.shrunk.text: E dirilwe e nnye go boloka lefelo: {from} → {to}. E santse e phepa go lekana go tlhatlhobiwa.
offline.shrunk.from: Made smaller to save room: {from} → {to}. Still clear enough to assess.

mailbox.empty.text: Ga go ise go nne le sepe fano. Sengwe le sengwe se se rometsweng kwa go {address} se goroga mo lenaaneng leno, le dikgomaganyo tse di bolokwang ka tsela e e tshwanang le bosupi jwa tlhatlhobo.
mailbox.empty.from: Nothing here yet. Anything sent to {address} arrives in this list, with attachments stored the same way assessment evidence is.

mailbox.envelope.text: Seva e e rometseng e ipolotse e le {address}, e seng aterese e e mo mola wa Go tswa kwa go. Seo se tlwaelegile mo mekgatlhong ya poso le poso e e rometsweng gape, mme le sone ke se motho yo o itirang mongwe a se dirang.
mailbox.envelope.from: The sending server identified itself as {address}, which is not the address in the From line. Ordinary for mailing lists and forwarded mail, and also what a forged sender looks like.

mailbox.notSwitchedOn.text: Go romela ga go a kgotsololwa go fitlha jaanong: ga go na seromelo sa poso se se beilweng, ka jalo molaetsa o o kwadilweng fano o ka se tswe. Dikarabo tse o di amogelang di santse di goroga ka tlwaelo.
mailbox.notSwitchedOn.from: Sending is not switched on yet: no mail relay is configured, so a message written here could not leave the building. Replies you receive still arrive normally.

lrs.intro.text: Direkoto tsa baithuti ba gago, go tsena le go tswa, jaaka ditatemente tsa xAPI: sebopego seo mafelo a go boloka direkoto tsa go ithuta le bontsi jwa ditsamaiso tsa go ithuta di se bolokanang ka sone. Ga go sepe fano se se fetolang diphetho tsa moithuti mo sethaleng seno.
lrs.intro.from: Your learners' records, in and out, as xAPI statements: the format learning record stores and most learning systems exchange. Nothing here changes a learner's results on this platform.

lrs.outNote.text: Kwadiso nngwe le nngwe, thuto e e fedileng, tlhatlhobo e e lekilweng, tshwetso ya o nonofile kgotsa ga a ise a nonofe, kosi e e fedileng, setatemente sa diphetho, setifikeiti le setifikeiti sa boitseanape se se amogetsweng, setatemente se le sengwe ka nngwe. Nngwe le nngwe e tshwara boitshupo jo bo tshwanang nako nngwe le nngwe fa o ntsha, ka jalo go tsenya diphitlho tse pedi mo tsamaisong e nngwe ga go dirise ditso tsa ope gabedi.
lrs.outNote.from: Every enrolment, lesson completed, assessment attempted, competent or not yet competent decision, course completed, statement of results, certificate, and qualification certificate received, one statement each. Each keeps the same identity every time you export, so loading two exports into another system does not double anybody's history.

lrs.download.text: Elola direkoto tsotlhe tsa go ithuta

lrs.downloadNote.text: Faele e umaka moithuti mongwe le mongwe le aterese ya gagwe ya imeile. E boloke jaaka o ka boloka rekoto epe ya tshedimosetso ya botho.
lrs.downloadNote.from: The file names every learner and their email address. Keep it as you would any record of personal information.

lrs.store.text: Romela direkoto kwa lefelong la gago la go boloka direkoto tsa go ithuta
lrs.store.from: Send records to your own learning record store

lrs.storeNote.text: Fa o na le lefelo la go boloka direkoto tsa go ithuta, le golaganye fano mme rekoto nngwe le nngwe e e kwa godimo e ya kwa go lone mo ura e e latelang morago ga fa e diragetse, tse di setseng di dirilwe di le pele. Nngwe le nngwe e romelwa gangwe; setatemente se lefelo le setseng le na le sone se tlogelwa jaaka se ntse. Lekunutu la lefelo le tswaletswe mo sethaleng seno, ga le tlhole le bontshiwa, mme le lebalwa fa o kgaoganya.
lrs.storeNote.from: If you keep a learning record store, connect it here and every record above goes to it within the hour of happening, the ones already made first. Each is sent once; a statement the store already holds is left as it is. The store's secret is sealed on this platform, never shown again, and forgotten when you disconnect.

lrs.inNote.text: Faele ya ditatemente tsa xAPI go tswa mo tsamaisong e nngwe: lenaane la ditatemente, kgotsa se lefelo la go boloka direkoto tsa go ithuta le se busang. Nngwe le nngwe e tshwantshiwa le moithuti fano ka imeile mme e bontshiwa mo rekotong ya gagwe. E bolokwa jaaka go ithuta go dirilweng kwa ntle, e seng go fetolwa kwadiso kgotsa phetho fano, ka gonne ga go na sepe sa yone se se rutilweng kgotsa se se tlhatlhobilweng mo sethaleng seno.
lrs.inNote.from: A file of xAPI statements from another system: a list of statements, or what a learning record store returns. Each is matched to a learner here by email and shown on their record. It is kept as learning done elsewhere, not turned into an enrolment or a result here, because none of it was taught or assessed on this platform.

platformPage.intro.text: Mokgatlho mongwe le mongwe mo sethaleng. O ka bona gore mongwe le mongwe o dirisa bokae mme wa laola thulaganyo ya one, mme e seng baithuti, dikosi kgotsa direkoto tsa tlhatlhobo tsa one. Go tshwara tsamaiso ya moreki ga go tshwane le go nna le tetla ya go e bala, mme sethala se dira gore seo se diragale go na le go ikaega ka boitshwaro.
platformPage.intro.from: Every organisation on the platform. You can see how much each is using and manage their configuration, but not their learners, courses or assessment records. Hosting a client's system is not the same as being entitled to read it, and the platform enforces that rather than relying on restraint.

said.alignment-document.c3e49767.text: Ga go a bonwa diyuniti tsa thuto mo tokomaneng eo. Setlhogo se le sengwe se tshwanetse go bala jaaka “Study Unit 1 – Organisational Architecture”, se na le dimodiule tse se di akaretsang tse di kwadilweng ka fa tlase ga sone.
said.alignment-document.c3e49767.from: No study units were found in that document. One heading has to read like “Study Unit 1 – Organisational Architecture”, with the modules it covers listed under it.

said.alignment-matrix.185b0901.text: Ga go a bonwa lenaane la go tsamaelana mo bukeng eno ya tiro. Kholomo e le nngwe e tshwanetse go nna le setlhogo se se tshwanang le “Topic Elements”, gore methalo e ka tshwantshiwa le kharikhulamo.
said.alignment-matrix.185b0901.from: No alignment matrix found in this workbook. One column must be headed something like “Topic Elements”, so the rows can be matched to the curriculum.

said.alignment-matrix.2b19415b.text: Seo ke tokomane ya Word. Tokomane ka bosone e a bolokwa, e a tsengwa mme e a batlwa. Se se palelwang ke go e bala, ka gonne lenaane la go tsamaelana le baliwa jaaka spreadsheet: mola o le mongwe mo mothalong mongwe le mongwe wa kharikhulamo, le kholomo e e nang le setlhogo se se tshwanang le “Topic Elements”. Boloka lenaane jaaka spreadsheet mme o le tsenye le lone, mme mola mongwe le mongwe wa kharikhulamo o tla bontsha se se o akaretsang.
said.alignment-matrix.2b19415b.from: That is a Word document. The document itself is kept, filed and searchable. What could not happen is reading it, because the alignment matrix is read as a spreadsheet: one row per curriculum line, with a column headed something like “Topic Elements”. Save the matrix as a spreadsheet and upload that as well, and each line of the curriculum will show what covers it.

said.alignment-matrix.a0d14e78.text: Lenaane ga le na dikholomo tsa didirisiwa tse di ka lemogiwang: ga go na tse di nang le setlhogo sa Workbook, Assessment, Theory Guide, Legislation le tse dingwe.
said.alignment-matrix.a0d14e78.from: The matrix has no resource columns that could be recognised: nothing headed Workbook, Assessment, Theory Guide, Legislation and so on.

said.conduct.1d25ed57.text: Kitsiso e tshwanetse go bolela ditatlhego tse di rileng. Kgotla ka ga ditatlhego tse di sa bolelwang ga e ka ke ya arabiwa.
said.conduct.1d25ed57.from: The notice has to state the specific allegations. A hearing about unstated allegations cannot be answered.

said.conduct.1e2d5837.text: E rekotilwe. Malatsi a le matlhano a tiro a go ipiletsa a bala go simolola gompieno.
said.conduct.1e2d5837.from: Recorded. The five working days to appeal run from today.

said.conduct.303f7f08.text: Bolela gore ke ditshwetso dife tse di ka nnang teng, go akaretsa go khutlisa fa go le jalo. Moithuti yo o sekasekang gore a tle le motho wa go mo thusa o tlhoka go itse gore go ka tsewa eng.
said.conduct.303f7f08.from: Say what sanctions are possible, including termination where it is. A learner deciding whether to bring assistance needs to know what is at stake.

said.conduct.403b3f35.text: Bolela lebaka. Tshwetso e se na lebaka ga e sireletsege, mme ke serapa se moithuti a nang le tshwanelo ya sone.
said.conduct.403b3f35.from: Say why. An unexplained sanction is indefensible, and this is the paragraph the learner is entitled to.

said.conduct.47a20502.text: Bolela molao o o tlolelwang, maemo a a solofetsweng le se se diregang fa go ka tlhola go diragala gape. Temoso e se na tseno ga se temoso.
said.conduct.47a20502.from: State the rule broken, the standard expected and what happens if it recurs. A warning that does not is not one.

said.conduct.4dcaf05f.text: Seo ga se letlha le nako.
said.conduct.4dcaf05f.from: That is not a date and time.

said.conduct.64f7462f.text: Kitsiso e tshwanetse go bolelela moithuti gore a ka thusiwa ke moithuti yo mongwe, a tlhagisa kgang ya gagwe, mme a bitsa le go botsa basupi. Romela kitsiso e e dirang jalo, morago o e rekote fano.
said.conduct.64f7462f.from: The notice must tell the learner they may be assisted by a fellow learner, present their case, and call and question witnesses. Send a notice that does, then record it here.

said.conduct.67f9675a.text: Rekota se se fitlhetsweng le gore ke ka mabaka afe. Kgotla e ditshwetso tsa yone e leng mola o le mongwe ke kgotla e e sa ka ya diragala.
said.conduct.67f9675a.from: Record what was found and on what basis. A hearing whose findings are one line is a hearing that did not happen.

said.conduct.6a6b5da7.from: It has to be acknowledged by {acknowledgeBy}.

said.conduct.6d857ec5.text: Go fedisa lenaneo la mongwe go tlhoka kgotla e e neng ya tshwarwa, e e nang le ditshwetso tsa yone tse di rekotilweng. Bitsa nngwe, rekota se se fitlhetsweng, morago o tswale kgang.
said.conduct.6d857ec5.from: Ending somebody's programme needs a hearing that was held, with its findings recorded. Convene one, record what was found, then close the case.

said.conduct.77c80d2a.text: E tsentswe. E tla amogelwa mo malatsing a le mabedi a tiro.
said.conduct.77c80d2a.from: Lodged. It will be acknowledged within two working days.

said.conduct.869c74ee.text: Kgotla e tlhoka temoso ya diura tse di ka nnang {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} mme eno e kwa tlase ga tsone ka ura e le {hours}. Nako ya ntlha e e ka tshwarwang ka yone ke {earliest}. Temoso e khutshwane ke phoso e boipiletso bo fenyang ka yone, go sa kgathalesege gore moithuti o dirile eng.
said.conduct.869c74ee.from: A hearing needs at least {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} hours' notice and this is {hours} hour short. The earliest it can be held is {earliest}. Short notice is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

said.conduct.8d0ef3ad.text: Kgotla e bidiwa. Nako ya temoso e a fitlhelelwa.
said.conduct.8d0ef3ad.from: Hearing convened. The notice period is met.

said.conduct.9f172fca.text: Moithuti ga a kgone go batlisisa ngongorego ya gagwe ka bosone.
said.conduct.9f172fca.from: The learner cannot investigate their own grievance.

said.conduct.ad753d2e.text: Tshwetso e ya kwa go moithuti e kwadilwe mme e tshwanetse go bolela se se fitlhetsweng le se se tla dirwang. Mola o le mongwe ga se tshwetso.
said.conduct.ad753d2e.from: The decision goes to the learner in writing and has to say what was found and what will be done. A line is not a decision.

said.conduct.b0301d88.text: Bolela se se latlhegetsweng, ka tlhamalalo. Moithuti ga a kgone go araba "boitshwaro jo bo sa siamang", mme le kgotla ga e kgone.
said.conduct.b0301d88.from: Say what is alleged, specifically. A learner cannot answer 'poor attitude', and neither can a hearing.

said.conduct.b0dcbd53.text: E tsserwe, mme moithuti o na le yone e kwadilwe.
said.conduct.b0dcbd53.from: Decided, and the learner has it in writing.

said.conduct.cf47131c.text: E tswaletswe. Naya moithuti phetho ka mokwalo, morago o rekote gore o e mo neile.
said.conduct.cf47131c.from: Closed. Give the learner the outcome in writing, then record that you have.

said.drive-google-drive.8761e449.text: Folodara eo ga e yo, kgotsa akhaonto e o e golagantseng ga e e bone. Folodara e e abelanweng le wena e tshwanetse go butswa mo Drive gangwe fela pele e ka baliwa.

said.drive-google-drive.c0c95fa0.text: Google ga e a busetsa tsela ya go ntšhafatsa kgokagano, seo gantsi se bolelang gore akhaonto eno e ne e setse e e neetse tetla. Tlosa phitlhelelo ya Sethala mo akhaontong ya gago ya Google ka fa tlase ga Third-party apps, o be o golaganya gape.

said.drive-google-drive.dcf45956.text: "{name}" e kgolo thata gore Google e e ntshe ka nako e le nngwe. Tsenya fa tlase tokomane eo e le nngwe go tswa mo Drive jaaka {extension} mme o e okeletse ka bo yone morago; sengwe le sengwe se sengwe mo folodareng se baliwa ka tlwaelo.
