said.drive-google-drive.e9fe6eee.text: Bala folodara ka tlhamalalo go tswa mo Google Drive ya gago. Go bala fela: Sethala se ka dira lenaane le go tsenya fa tlase, mme ga se kgone go dira, go fetola kgotsa go phimola sepe. O ka e gogela morago fano kgotsa mo akhaontong ya gago ya Google nako nngwe le nngwe.

said.drive-import.1f557235.text: Folodara eo ga e na sepe se Sethala se ka se balang. Ditokomane, di-spreadsheet le dipresenteishene di a baliwa, go akaretsa tsa Google ka bosone, ka jalo sephetho se se se nang sepe se bolela gore folodara e feletse, kgotsa e na le fela dilo tse di jaaka Forms le ditsela tse dikhutshwane.

said.enrolment-documents.26e4b850.text: Efa letlha le kopi eno e tlhomamisitsweng ka lone. Kopi e letlha la yone la tlhomamiso le sa itsiweng ga e kgone go bontshiwa e le e ntšha.
said.enrolment-documents.26e4b850.from: Give the date this copy was certified. A copy whose certification date is unknown cannot be shown to be current.

said.enrolment-documents.330b87d3.text: Moithuti o neetse bopaki jwa gagwe jwa tuelo.
said.enrolment-documents.330b87d3.from: The learner supplied their own proof of payment.

said.enrolment-documents.3f1d945a.text: Moithuti o neetse bopaki jwa tuelo, jo bo ise bo tlhatlhobiwe.
said.enrolment-documents.3f1d945a.from: The learner has supplied a proof of payment, not yet checked.

said.enrolment-documents.435df660.text: Bopaki jwa tuelo jwa moithuti bo ganetswe.
said.enrolment-documents.435df660.from: The learner's proof of payment was refused.

said.enrolment-documents.98317f79.text: Bolela lebaka la go e gana. Moithuti o tshwanetse go bolelelwa se a tshwanetseng go se baakanya, mme go gana go se na lebaka go mmusetsa kwa morago a se na sepe sa go se dira.
said.enrolment-documents.98317f79.from: Say why it was refused. The learner has to be told what to correct, and a refusal with no reason sends them back with nothing to act on.

said.enrolment-documents.d417e6fa.text: Kopi eo e tlhomamisitswe ka {certifiedOn}, e leng go feta malatsi a le {CERTIFICATION_VALID_DAYS} a a fetileng. Kopi e e tlhomamisitsweng e tshwanetse go nna e ntšha fa e neelwa.
said.enrolment-documents.d417e6fa.from: That copy was certified on {certifiedOn}, which is more than {CERTIFICATION_VALID_DAYS} days ago. A certified copy has to be current when it is supplied.

said.enrolment-documents.e88ccb00.text: Faele eo ga e a amogelwa: {reason}

said.enrolment-form.0ab864d3.text: Ga go na moithuti yo o jalo.

said.enrolment-form.141771ac.text: Go tswa mo lenaaneng la dikhoutu tsa lefelo la STATSSA tse QCTO e di phasalatsang.
said.enrolment-form.141771ac.from: From the STATSSA area code list the QCTO publishes.

said.enrolment-form.158eb69b.text: Pego e botsa gore a moithuti o dumetse, le ka letlha lefe.
said.enrolment-form.158eb69b.from: The return asks whether the learner agreed, and on what date.

said.enrolment-form.3ecff80b.text: Bong jo bo rekotilweng ga bo tshwane le jo bo mo nomorong ya boitshupo. QCTO e tlhatlhoba seno, ka jalo bongwe jwa tse pedi bo kwadilwe ka phoso.
said.enrolment-form.3ecff80b.from: The gender recorded does not match the one in the identity number. The QCTO checks this, so one of the two is mistyped.

said.enrolment-form.5d06240c.text: Letlha la matsalo le le rekotilweng ({recorded}) ga le tshwane le nomoro ya boitshupo, e e reng {fromId}.
said.enrolment-form.5d06240c.from: The date of birth recorded ({recorded}) does not match the identity number, which says {fromId}.

said.enrolment-form.7d5cda8a.text: E tlhomamisitswe, mme letlha le rekotilwe. Fa o fetola sepe fano moragonyana, e tla go kopa gore o tlhomamise gape.
said.enrolment-form.7d5cda8a.from: Confirmed, and the date recorded. Change anything here later and it will ask you to confirm again.

said.enrolment-form.a380df96.text: E bolokilwe. O ka boela o e fetsa moragonyana.
said.enrolment-form.a380df96.from: Saved. You can come back and finish it later.

said.enrolment-form.a8dcc4e9.text: Nomoro ya boitshupo ga e a nepagala: {reason}
said.enrolment-form.a8dcc4e9.from: The identity number does not check out: {reason}

said.enrolment-form.b67325d1.text: Ga go ope yo o tlhomamisitseng gore dintlha tseno di nepagetse. Mmoni o kopa foromo e le bosupi, mme e e sa tlhomamisiwang ke bosupi jo bonnye thata.
said.enrolment-form.b67325d1.from: Nobody has confirmed these details are right. A monitor asks for the form as evidence, and an unconfirmed one is evidence of very little.

said.enrolment-form.b711b7ce.text: Go rekotilwe bogole, mme QCTO e tlhoka gore bo bakela bothata bo bokae.
said.enrolment-form.b711b7ce.from: A disability was recorded, and the QCTO then requires how much difficulty it causes.

said.enrolment-form.ca9579a9.text: Porofense e moithuti a berekang mo go yone, e e sa nneng gone kwa a nnang teng.
said.enrolment-form.ca9579a9.from: The province the learner works in, which is not always where they live.

said.enrolment.52c9b5f2.text: Ke kosi e e phasaladitsweng fela e e ka abelwang moithuti.
said.enrolment.52c9b5f2.from: Only a published course can be assigned to a learner.

said.enrolment.65b99bc7.text: Motho yoo o setse a kwadisitswe mo kosing eno.
said.enrolment.65b99bc7.from: That person is already enrolled on this course.

said.enrolment.678cc7c5.text: Ga go na letlha la bofelo mo go eno.
said.enrolment.678cc7c5.from: There is no due date on this one.

said.enrolment.6ac9079d.text: Kwadiso eo ke ya mongwe yo mongwe.
said.enrolment.6ac9079d.from: That enrolment belongs to someone else.

said.enrolment.79fda720.text: Ke moithuti fela yo o ka rekotang tswelelopele ya gagwe.
said.enrolment.79fda720.from: Only the learner can record their own progress.

said.enrolment.ab1eec65.text: Thuto eo ga se karolo ya kosi eno.
said.enrolment.ab1eec65.from: That lesson is not part of this course.

said.extensions-claude-code.149b1d9d.text: Claude Code ga e a tsenngwa kwa Sethala se dirang teng.
said.extensions-claude-code.149b1d9d.from: Claude Code is not installed where the platform is running.

said.extensions-claude-code.1c9bd1dc.text: Claude Code e tsentswe mo mochining ono mme ga go ope yo o tsenneng. Bula terminal, dira claude, morago /login o fetse go tsena mo buraosareng. Seo ke kgato ya gangwe fela mme e dirwa ke wena, e seng ke Sethala.
said.extensions-claude-code.1c9bd1dc.from: Claude Code is installed on this machine but nobody is signed in. Open a terminal, run claude, then /login and complete the sign-in in the browser. That is a one-time step and it is done by you, not by the platform.

said.extensions-claude-code.30018e0d.text: Ga se ya kgona go simolola Claude Code: {error}

said.extensions-claude-code.446b5c16.text: Claude Code ga e a busetsa sepe.

said.extensions-claude-code.53fe3e99.text: Moeli wa tiriso wa subscription ya Claude o fitlhetswe. Seno se tla dira gape fa moeli o tsosolosiwa.
said.extensions-claude-code.53fe3e99.from: The Claude subscription's usage limit has been reached. This will work again once the limit resets.

said.extensions-claude-code.7f69ba19.text: E dirisa subscription ya gago ya Claude, ka tokene e o e itlhagisang mo khomputareng ya gago ka `claude setup-token`. Ga se senotlolo sa API: ga go na tlhwatlhwa ya tokene nngwe le nngwe, mme e dirisa subscription e o setseng o e duelela go na le e e abelanwang.
said.extensions-claude-code.7f69ba19.from: Uses your own Claude subscription, through a token you generate on your own computer with `claude setup-token`. Not an API key: no per-token cost, and it draws on the subscription you already pay for rather than a shared one.

said.extensions-claude-code.801580be.from: Claude Code did not answer within {timeoutMs} seconds.

said.extensions-gemini.0473bc2d.text: Ga go na senotlolo sa Gemini API se se bolokilweng go wena. Tsenya se sengwe mo Dithulaganyong. Se tswa mo Google AI Studio, mme ga se se se tshwanang le subscription ya Gemini.
said.extensions-gemini.0473bc2d.from: No Gemini API key is stored for you. Add one in Settings. It comes from Google AI Studio, and is not the same as a Gemini subscription.

said.extensions-gemini.18ddcba7.text: Senotlolo seo sa Gemini API ga se a siama. Tlhatlhoba gore se kopilwe se le sotlhe go tswa mo Google AI Studio. Ga se selo se se tshwanang le subscription ya Gemini Advanced, e e sa akaretseng phitlhelelo ya API.
said.extensions-gemini.18ddcba7.from: That Gemini API key is not valid. Check it was copied whole from Google AI Studio. It is not the same thing as a Gemini Advanced subscription, which does not include API access.

said.extensions-gemini.3bf73475.text: Moeli wa ditlhwaelo wa Google wa senotlolo seo o fitlhetswe. Kgato ya mahala e letlelela palo e e lekanyeditsweng ya dikopo ka motsotso; leta o bo o leke gape, kgotsa o dirise senotlolo se se nang le tuelo e e butswe.
said.extensions-gemini.3bf73475.from: Google's rate limit for that key has been reached. The free tier allows a limited number of requests a minute; wait and try again, or use a key with billing enabled.

said.extensions-gemini.599b82c0.text: Gemini ga e a araba ka nako. Folodara e kgolo e ka tsaya metsotso e le mmalwa; go leka gape ka ditokomane tse dinnye gantsi go a dira.
said.extensions-gemini.599b82c0.from: Gemini did not answer in time. A large folder can take several minutes; trying again with fewer documents in it usually works.

said.extensions-gemini.5f764f27.text: Gemini ga e a fitlhelwa. Tlhatlhoba gore mochini ono o golagane le Google.
said.extensions-gemini.5f764f27.from: Gemini could not be reached. Check that this machine has a network connection to Google.

said.extensions-gemini.6ff1fd27.text: Gemini e felletswe ke sebaka pele e fetsa go araba, ka jalo se se boseditsweng ke karolo ya kharikhulamo e seng yotlhe, mme e e sa felelang e lebega e tshwana fela le e e feletseng. Ga go a bolokwa sepe. Boitseanape jo bo feletseng ke selo se segolo thata go se kopa ka karabo e le nngwe; bo tsenye go tswa mo ditokomaneng tsa jone, tse di balang kharikhulamo ka tlhamalalo go se na sekao epe le moeli o o jalo.
said.extensions-gemini.6ff1fd27.from: Gemini ran out of room before it finished answering, so what came back is part of a curriculum rather than all of it, and a partial one looks exactly like a complete one. Nothing was kept. A whole qualification is a great deal to ask for in a single reply; import it from its documents instead, which reads the curriculum directly with no model involved and no limit of this kind.

said.extensions-gemini.7b1ee4ba.text: Gemini e arabile ka sepe. Seo gantsi se kayang gore kopo e ganetswe ke sesekiso sa polokesego, kgotsa leina la sekao ga le a nepagala.
said.extensions-gemini.7b1ee4ba.from: Gemini answered with nothing. That usually means the request was refused by a safety filter, or the model name is wrong.

said.extensions-gemini.a3035142.text: Ditokomane tseo di feta ditlhaka tse {MAX_INPUT_CHARS},000, e leng go feta se se ka romelwang mo kopong e le nngwe. Tsenya boitseanape go tswa mo ditokomaneng tsa jone: tokomane ya kharikhulamo fela e baliwa ka tlhamalalo, go se na sekao epe.
said.extensions-gemini.a3035142.from: Those documents come to more than {MAX_INPUT_CHARS},000 characters, which is more than can be sent in one request. Import the qualification from its documents instead: the curriculum document alone is read directly, with no model involved.

said.extensions-gemini.c9f3d2b7.text: Google e begile bothata ka fa go bone ({status}). Kopo e nnye e siametse go leka gape fela. Fa e ne e le boitseanape jo bo feletseng mme jaanong bo paletswe go feta gangwe, kopo e ka nna e le kgolo thata gore sekao se e fetse. Bo tsenye go tswa mo ditokomaneng tsa jone, tse di balang kharikhulamo ka tlhamalalo go se na sekao.
said.extensions-gemini.c9f3d2b7.from: Google reported a problem on their side ({status}). A small request is worth simply trying again. If this was a whole qualification and it has now failed more than once, the request is most likely too large for the model to complete. Import it from its documents instead, which reads the curriculum directly with no model involved.

said.extensions-gemini.d7ab5352.text: Google e ganne senotlolo seo. Se ka tswa se ile sa gogwa, kgotsa Generative Language API e ka tswa e sa butswa mo porojekeng e se leng ya yone. Ga go na sepe se se phoso mo Sethaleng mme ga go a latlhega sepe.
said.extensions-gemini.d7ab5352.from: Google refused that key. It may have been revoked, or the Generative Language API may not be enabled on the project it belongs to. Nothing is wrong with the platform and nothing was lost.

said.extensions-gemini.eb60a381.text: E dirisa senotlolo sa gago sa Google AI Studio API. Ga se subscription ya Gemini Advanced: seo ke sediriswa se sengwe mme ga se akaretse phitlhelelo ya API. API e na le kgato ya mahala, ka jalo seno se ka dirisiwa go sa rekwe sepe, mo mellwaneng ya ditlhwaelo tsa yone.
said.extensions-gemini.eb60a381.from: Uses your own Google AI Studio API key. Not a Gemini Advanced subscription: that is a separate product and does not include API access. The API has a free tier, so this can be used without buying anything, within its rate limits.

said.fisa.6f4251d6.text: Ke FISA e e tshwailweng fela e e tlhokang phetolelo e ntšha; eno e santse e ka fetolwa.

said.fisa.8634f8d4.text: Ke motho a le mongwe le {other}. Tsekaseko ya pele e na le boleng ka gonne motho wa bobedi o e lebeletse.

said.fisa.86b96040.text: Phetolelo e ntšha ya popo ya pele e butswe. E tlhoka moeletsi wa yone, mosekaseki le tsekaseko.

said.fisa.99e0c84b.text: FISA e beilwe ke moabi mo lenaneong la gagwe la dikgono. Boitseanape jo bo feletseng kgotsa jwa karolo bo tlhatlhobiwa kwa ntle ke Molekane wa Boleng jwa Tlhatlhobo, ka jalo moabi ga a beele pampiri eo.
said.fisa.99e0c84b.from: A FISA is set by the provider for its own skills programme. A full or part qualification is assessed externally by the Assessment Quality Partner, so the provider does not set that paper.

said.fisa.a82c37e7.text: E tshwailwe e le e e siametseng maikaelelo. Baithuti jaanong ba ka kwala pampiri eno.

said.invigilation.01f9be44.text: Amogela moithuti pele. Go tlhomamisa khamera ya motho yo o ise a amogelwe go rekota tlhatlhobo e e sa dirwang ke ope.
said.invigilation.01f9be44.from: Admit the candidate first. Confirming a camera for somebody who was never admitted records a check nobody made.

said.invigilation.1505c6a0.text: Bolela lebaka la go mo gana. Boipiletso bo ikaegile ka lebaka, mme moithuti o tshwanetse go bolelelwa se se diregileng.
said.invigilation.1505c6a0.from: Say why they were turned away. An appeal turns on the reason, and the candidate has to be told what happened.

said.invigilation.17e1f6a7.text: Moithuti yoo ga a mo nakong eno ya go kwala.

said.invigilation.35819929.text: Moithuti yoo ga a a amogelwa, ka jalo ga go na skripte ya gagwe e e ka amogelwang.

said.invigilation.47b2b98a.text: Motho yoo ga a mo setlhopheng seno, ka jalo a ka se amogelwe mo nakong ya go kwala ya sone.
said.invigilation.47b2b98a.from: That person is not on this cohort, so they cannot be admitted to its sitting.

said.invigilation.50504405.text: Moithuti yoo o tlogetse nako eno ya go kwala mme a ka se boele a amogelwe. Rekota se se diregileng e le tiragalo go na le moo.
said.invigilation.50504405.from: That candidate dropped out of this sitting and cannot be readmitted. Record what happened as an incident instead.

said.invigilation.639211b5.text: Nako eno ya go kwala e fedile, ka jalo ga go ope yo o ka amogelwang mo go yone.

said.invigilation.7eff3ae0.text: Amogela moithuti pele. Boitlhomamiso jwa motho yo o ise a amogelwe bo rekota tumalano e e sa bonwang ke ope.
said.invigilation.7eff3ae0.from: Admit the candidate first. A declaration from somebody who was never admitted records an agreement nobody witnessed.

said.invigilation.994f7ce0.text: Nako eno ya go kwala ga e na mafoko a boitlhomamiso, ka jalo ga go na sepe se moithuti a ka se amogelang. Se beele mo nakong ya go kwala pele.
said.invigilation.994f7ce0.from: This sitting has no declaration wording, so there is nothing for a candidate to accept. Set it on the sitting first.

said.invigilation.b19d5680.text: Kamogelo e tswaletswe ka {localClose} {closedAt}, metsotso e le {lateBySeconds} e fetile. Go na le moo, mo rekote e le yo o ganetsweng, ka lebaka: yo o amogetsweng morago o nnile le pampiri nako e telele go feta botlhe.

said.invigilation.c9a64bed.text: Nako ya go kwala ga e a fitlhelwa.

said.invigilation.d1a64ee9.text: Nako ya go kwala e ka tsamaisiwa fela mo kopanong ya EISA ya bofelo kgotsa ya boikatiso. Fetola mofuta wa kopano pele, gore lenaane le bolele se se diregang.
said.invigilation.d1a64ee9.from: A sitting can only be run at a summative or mock EISA session. Change the session's kind first, so the schedule says what is happening.

said.invigilation.df78a6b5.text: Tlhalosa se se diregileng. Pego ya tiragalo e e se na sepe e maswe go feta go se nne le epe, ka gonne rekoto e bontsha gore e ne ya dirwa.
said.invigilation.df78a6b5.from: Describe what happened. An incident report that says nothing is worse than none, because the record shows one was made.

said.spine.42a3be59.from: A step cannot wait for itself.

account.forcedIntro.text: Umuntfu lomunye usete iphasiwedi lengena ngayo. Yishintshe ngaphambi kwekuchubeka.
account.forcedIntro.from: Somebody else set the password you signed in with. Replace it before carrying on.

account.newHint.text: Ubuncane bemabhonco la-12. Umshwana wemagama ambalwa langahlobene unemandla kakhulu futsi kulula kuwukhumbula kunalokufishane lokunemasimbolo.
account.newHint.from: At least 12 characters. A phrase of a few unrelated words is both stronger and easier to remember than something short with symbols in it.

account.mismatch.from: The two new passwords do not match.

account.forcedNote.text: Kuyishintsha kuphumisa wonkhe umuntfu losebentisa iphasiwedi lendzala, kubandakanya lowakunikile yona.
account.forcedNote.from: Changing it signs out anyone else using the old password, including whoever passed it to you.

account.languageIntro.text: Lulwimi lapho lepulatifomu ikhuluma nawe khona. Tikrini letingakahunyushwa tihlala esiNgisini, futsi emagama emhlinzeki wakho etintfo agcinwa kanye nalokushiwo nguye.
account.languageIntro.from: The language this platform speaks to you in. Screens not yet translated stay in English, and your provider's own names for things are kept as they wrote them.

learn.notYours.text: Ubuka kubhalisa kwomunye umuntfu. Ungabona kuchubeka kwakhe kodvwa ungakwati kukurekhoda ngenxa yakhe.
learn.notYours.from: You are viewing someone else's enrolment. You can see their progress but cannot record it for them.

learn.noLessons.from: This course has no lessons yet.

learn.openMaterial.from: Open the material for this lesson

learn.noContent.from: No written content for this lesson.

learn.scormNote.text: Lelesoni liphela uma uliphetsa ephakethe laphezulu. Indzawo yakho iyagcinwa uma umisa phakathi nendlela.
learn.scormNote.from: This lesson completes when you finish it in the package above. Your place is kept if you stop part of the way through.

learn.openedByFacilitator.from: Opened for you by your facilitator: {reason}

home.feedbackMany.from: A few things to tell us

home.feedbackIntro.text: Tiphendvulo tibikwa kanyekanye netabo bonkhe bantfu, hhayi nye nye. Imizuzu lemibili ngalunye, futsi kuphela lokushintsha indlela liqoqo lelilandzelako lelicutfwa ngayo.
home.feedbackIntro.from: Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. Two minutes each, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

home.earnedIntro.text: Kurekhodwa ngelilanga lapho uphetse khona, hhayi uma sitifiketi sifika ekugcineni. Sinye ngasinye sinerefrensi lengahlolwa yinoma ngubani.
home.earnedIntro.from: Recorded on the day you finished, rather than when the certificate eventually arrives. Each carries a reference anybody can check.

home.step.afterPrevious.from: Opens when you finish the step before

home.nothingYet.from: You have not been assigned anything yet.

home.statementsIntro.text: Ngena nalesi ekuhlolweni kwangaphandle nedokhumenti yakho yesazisi. Isikhungo siyasihlola ngaphambi kwekutsi uhlale.
home.statementsIntro.from: Take this to the external assessment with your identity document. The centre checks it before you may sit.

assess.waiting.from: Waiting for an assessor to review it.

assess.developmental.text: Loku kwekutfutfukisa. Akukho lokubalwa ngekuphambana nawe lapha.
assess.developmental.from: This is developmental. Nothing here counts against you.

assess.competent.text: Utfole kutsi unelikhono kulokuhlolwa, ngako akukho lokufanele ukuphindze.
assess.competent.from: You have been found competent on this assessment, so there is nothing to sit again.

assess.noAttempts.from: You have used all your attempts at this assessment.

assess.awaitingAssessor.text: Lokuhlolwa kubalwa kulikhwalifikheshini lakho, ngako umhloli utakubuyeketa futsi arekhode siphetfo selikhono. Utawubona umphumela uma loko sekwenteke.
assess.awaitingAssessor.from: This assessment counts towards your qualification, so an assessor will review it and record the competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

assess.practicePassed.text: Loku bekukuzijwayeza, ngako umphumela urekhodwa ekufundzeni kwakho kodvwa awunquli likhwalifikheshini.
assess.practicePassed.from: This was practice, so the result is recorded against your learning but does not decide a qualification.

assess.practiceFailed.text: Loku bekukuzijwayeza. Buyeketa lokufundzako bese uyazama futsi.
assess.practiceFailed.from: This was practice. Review the material and try again.

assess.pair.text: Bhanjanisa sinye ngasinye sesinye sesobunxele nesesokudla.
assess.pair.from: Pair each item on the left with one on the right.

assess.whyMarked.text: Sizatfu yilesibhalwe lapha, hhayi libhokisi laphezulu.
assess.whyMarked.from: The reason is what is marked here, not the box above.

assess.keptAt.text: Tiphendvulo takho tigcinwe ngo-{time}. Kuyisa kuyiko kuletitiyisa kutsi tiphawulwe.
assess.keptAt.from: Your answers were kept at {time}. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

assess.kept.text: Tiphendvulo takho tiyagcinwa ngesikhatsi usebenta. Kuyisa kuyiko kuletitiyisa kutsi tiphawulwe.
assess.kept.from: Your answers are kept as you work. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

evidence.uploadFailed.text: Kuphakela kwehlulekile. Hlola uxhumo lwakho bese uyazama futsi.
evidence.uploadFailed.from: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.

evidence.doneIntro.text: Umhloli utabubuyeketa futsi arekhode siphetfo selikhono. Utawubona umphumela uma loko sekwenteke.
evidence.doneIntro.from: An assessor will review it and record a competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

evidence.fingerprintNote.text: Uma noma ngabe ngukuphi ifayela leligcinwe lishintshwa, sigxivo saso semunwe sitawukhawuka kufana. Loku kuvikela umsebenti wakho njengobe kuvikela kuhlolwa.
evidence.fingerprintNote.from: If any stored file were ever altered, its fingerprint would stop matching. That protects your work as much as it protects the assessment.

evidence.kinds.text: Titfombe, kurekhoda kwemsebenti, ilogibhuku lelihlolwe ngesikena, noma lidokhumenti. Ungasindzisa emafayela lamanyenti kanyekanye.
evidence.kinds.from: Photographs, a recording of the task, a scanned logbook, or a document. You can attach several at once.

paper.summative.text: Loku kuyahlolwa futsi kubalwa kulikhwalifikheshini lakho.
paper.summative.from: This is assessed and counts towards your qualification.

paper.formative.text: Loku kungekulungiselela. Kuyaphawulwa futsi kubuyiswe kuwe, futsi akunquli lutfo.
paper.formative.from: This is preparation. It is marked and returned to you, and it does not decide anything.

paper.goBack.from: Go back to the course to see what is still outstanding.

paper.connection.text: Lokuphendvule akukagcinwa. Uxhumo lwakho lungahle lube lulahlekile; kutawuzanywa futsi uma ushintsha lutfo lolulandzelako.
paper.connection.from: That answer did not save. Your connection may have dropped; it will be tried again when you next change something.

paper.handInFailed.from: That could not be handed in.

paper.handInConnection.text: Loko akukwatanga kunikelwa. Hlola uxhumo lwakho bese uyazama futsi.
paper.handInConnection.from: That could not be handed in. Check your connection and try again.

paper.detail.from: Answer in detail, referring to the principles you have studied.

paper.handedIn.from: You handed this in. It cannot be changed.

paper.final.from: Once handed in, this cannot be changed.

paper.confirm.from: Confirm the declaration to hand in.

paper.savedAsYouGo.from: your work is saved as you go

notify.nothingYet.text: Akukabi khona lutfo. Utawatiswa lapha uma kuqeqeshwa kwabelwa noma kufanele kuphele, uma umsebenti ukulindzele, nasekufikeni kwemiphumela yekuhlolwa noma sitifiketi.
notify.nothingYet.from: Nothing yet. You will be told here when training is assigned or due, when work is waiting for you, and when an assessment result or certificate arrives.

cert.notNational.text: Lesi ngusitifiketi sa-{provider} ngokwaso ngesifundvo leshanyele sona. Asisiso likhwalifikheshini leliveni futsi asinaso sikweleti se-SAQA noma sikhomba. Lapho umfundzi asebenta kulikhwalifikheshini lemsebenti, sitifiketi saso sikhishwa yi-QCTO.
cert.notNational.from: This is {provider}'s own certificate for a course it delivered. It is not a national qualification and does not carry a SAQA credit or identifier. Where a learner is working towards an occupational qualification, the certificate for it is issued by the QCTO.

cert.anyone.text: Noma ngubani ungacinisekisa lesitifiketi ngerifrensi lengetulu, angadzingi akhawunti.
cert.anyone.from: Anyone can confirm this certificate with the reference above, without needing an account.

work.introCoach.text: Bafundzi lobabhekile. Ucinisekisa lokwentile emsebentini; akukho lokufika kumhloli ngaphandle kwesayini yakho.
work.introCoach.from: The learners you supervise. You confirm what they did in the workplace; nothing reaches an assessor without your signature.

work.introLearner.text: Lwati lwasemsebentini lwentiwa kumqashi futsi lusayinwa ngumqeqeshi wasemsebentini lapho. Ludzingekile kulandzelana: uyalurekhoda, umqeqeshi wakho uyalucinisekisa, bese lubuyela kumhloli.
work.introLearner.from: Work experience is done at an employer and signed off by the workplace coach there. The order is fixed: you record it, your coach confirms it, then it goes to an assessor.

work.noneManage.text: Akukabi na-{records}. Setha yinye ngenhla: sivumelwano lesibalula umfundzi, umqashi nemqeqeshi, bese kuba nalunye ngalunye lwemojula yelwati lwasemsebentini.
work.noneManage.from: No {records} yet. Set one up above: an agreement naming the learner, the employer and the coach, then one for each work experience module.

work.none.text: Akukabi na-{records}. Umphatsi uyavula yinye uma sivumelwano sasemsebentini sesikhona lesibalula umfundzi, umqashi nemqeqeshi.
work.none.from: No {records} yet. An administrator opens one once a workplace agreement is in place naming the learner, the employer and the coach.

work.kind.contextual_knowledge.text: Lwati lwasemsebentini: lokufanele ukhone kukhuluma ngalo
work.kind.contextual_knowledge.from: Workplace knowledge: what you must be able to speak to

work.kind.supporting_evidence.text: Bufakazi lobusekelako: lokufanele indzawo yemsebenti ikhiphe
work.kind.supporting_evidence.from: Supporting evidence: what the workplace must produce

work.outstanding.text: Kusekusele: {items}. Umqeqeshi wakho akakwati kusayina kuze kube yonkhe imigca yentiwe futsi wonkhe bufakazi lobusekelako bunefayela lelinamathiselwe.
work.outstanding.from: Still outstanding: {items}. Your coach cannot sign until every line is done and every piece of supporting evidence has a file attached.

work.allRecorded.text: Konkhe kurekhodiwe. Kuyise kumqeqeshi wakho uma usulungile.
work.allRecorded.from: Everything is recorded. Send it to your coach when you are ready.

work.signingMeans.text: Kusayina kurekhoda kutsi uhlolile lobufakazi futsi utawubufakazela uma umhloli ukutsintsa. Akukwati kushintshwa emvakwaloko.
work.signingMeans.from: Signing records that you checked this evidence and will attest to it if the assessor contacts you. It cannot be changed afterwards.

work.readyForPoe.text: Kusayiniwe ngumqeqeshi wasemsebentini futsi kulungele kufakwa Efayelini Lebufakazi.
work.readyForPoe.from: Signed by the workplace coach and ready to be taken into the Portfolio of Evidence.

scorm.failed.text: Lipakethe alikwatanga kuvulwa. Hlola uxhumo lwakho bese uyazama futsi.
scorm.failed.from: The package could not be opened. Check your connection and try again.

scorm.preview.text: Kuyabukwa kucala: lokubikwa lipakethe akugcinwa, ngoba loku akusiko kubhalisa kwakho.
scorm.preview.from: A preview: what the package reports is not kept, because this is not your own enrolment.

certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.text: Umfundzi angahle abe nikele umqashi rifrensi. Iyaqhubeka ivula futsi itawubonisa kutsi yarekwa.
certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.from: The learner may have given the reference to an employer. It keeps resolving and will say it was withdrawn.

assessing.intro.text: Lokuyiswe kulungele siphetfo selikhono. Awukwati kuhlola umsebenti wakho, futsi sikhatsi lesithile tesiphetfo sakho sitawubuyekelwa ngokuzimela ngumlinganisi.
assessing.intro.from: Submissions ready for a competency judgement. You cannot assess your own work, and a proportion of your decisions will be reviewed independently by a moderator.

assessing.empty.text: Akukho lokulindzele. Lokuyiswe kuvela lapha njengobe bafundzi bakuyisa.
assessing.empty.from: Nothing is waiting. Submissions appear here as learners send them in.

assessing.onScreen.text: Loku kuphendvulwe esikrinini. {link}: tiphendvulo, sikhombisi semaki nematriksi kunye lapho, futsi tindlela tekuhlola tibalelwa wena uma sekuphawulwe.
assessing.onScreen.from: This was answered on screen. {link}: the answers, the marking guidance and the matrix are together there, and the criteria are worked out for you once it is marked.

assessing.ownWork.text: Lena yinkhomba yakho. Awukwati kuyihlola; kufanele kwenta lomunye umuntfu.
assessing.ownWork.from: This is your own submission. You cannot assess it; someone else must.

assessing.hash.text: I-hash irekhodwa ekuphakeleni. Uma ifayela legcinwe lishintshwa, alisafani futsi rekhodi iphawulwa.
assessing.hash.from: The hash is recorded at upload. If a stored file is ever altered, it no longer matches and the record is flagged.

assessing.whyDiffers.from: Why, since it differs from what the marks propose

assessing.permanent.text: Ligama lakho, lusuku nalamacophelo kugcinwa unomphela futsi akukwati kuhlelwa emvakwaloko. Kulungiswa kurekhodwa njengesiphetfo lesisha.
assessing.permanent.from: Your name, the date and this comment are stored permanently and cannot be edited afterwards. A correction is recorded as a new decision.

marking.impliesIntro.text: Kubala, hhayi siphetfo. Emamaki ahlanganiswa abe yile; kwenta kwemsebenti nebufakazi basemsebentini akufiki kupulatifomu, futsi wena uyabaphimisa ngaphambi kwekutsi unqume. Shintsha noma yini yalokuhlobene kusikrini sesiphetfo bese utsi kungani: sizatfu sigcinwa eceleni kwesiphakamiso kuze umlinganisi abone lapho bahlukane khona.
marking.impliesIntro.from: Arithmetic, not a judgement. The marks average out at this; practical performance and workplace evidence do not reach the platform, and you weigh those before deciding. Change any of these on the decision screen and say why: the reason is stored beside the proposal so a moderator can see where the two parted.

marking.markAllFirst.text: Yonkhe imibuto kufanele iphawulwe ngaphambi kwekutsi tindlela tekuhlola tibalwe.
marking.markAllFirst.from: Every question has to be marked before the criteria can be worked out.

marking.summative.text: Loku kuyahlolwa. Uma yonkhe imibuto isiphawulwe, rekhoda siphetfo: tindlela tekuhlola lokufakazelwe ngato tiyaphakanyiswa kuze utivumele.
marking.summative.from: This is assessed. Once every question is marked, record a decision: the criteria it evidences are proposed for you to confirm.

marking.formative.text: Lena yincwadzi yemisebenti. Iyatfutfukisa: yiphawule, bese ubuyisa imibono. Akukho lokurekhoda likhono noma kusondzelisa umfundzi ekufanelekeni.
marking.formative.from: This is a workbook. It is developmental: mark it, then return feedback. Nothing here records competence or moves the learner towards eligibility.

marking.matrix.text: Matriksi yekuphawula: kukhetsa leveli yinye ngayinye kunika lemaki
marking.matrix.from: Marking matrix: choosing a level for each gives the mark

marking.toldHint.from: Where it was strong, and what was missing.

marking.returnIntro.text: Imibono, hhayi siphetfo. Itjela umfundzi lokufanele abuyele kukona ngaphambi kwesekugcina, futsi ayirekhodi likhono kunoma yiliphi ligunya.
marking.returnIntro.from: Feedback, not a decision. It tells the learner what to go back to before the summative, and it records no competence against any criterion.

marking.returnHint.text: Lokwakuqinile, nalokufanele kufundvwe kabusha ngaphambi kwesekugcina.
marking.returnHint.from: What was solid, and what to re-read before the summative.

marking.concern.text: Emagunya lapho tiphendvulo letiphele emandleni tihlanganisana khona
marking.concern.from: Criteria the weak answers cluster around

marking.sectionHint.text: Lokwentekile kahle lapha, nalokufanele kwentiwe ngendlela lehlukile ngesikhatsi lesilandzelako.
marking.sectionHint.from: What went well here, and what to do differently next time.

marking.learnerSees.from: The learner sees this with their feedback.

moderating.intro.text: Kubuyeketa ngokuzimela kwetiphetfo tebahloli. Kutsi tiphi tiphetfo tifika kuleluhlu kunqunywa yisistimu, hhayi ngumuntfu. Awukwati kulinganisa siphetfo lesentile wena.
moderating.intro.from: Independent review of assessors' decisions. Which decisions reach this list is decided by the system, not chosen by anyone. You cannot moderate a decision you made yourself.

moderating.reason.new_assessor.from: Newly registered assessor: moderated in full

moderating.referBack.text: Buyisa emuva: umhloli kufanele abuke futsi
moderating.referBack.from: Refer back: the assessor should look again

moderating.ownDecision.text: Wente lesiphetfo njengomhloli, ngako awukwati kusilinganisa. Kufanele kwenta lomunye umlinganisi.
moderating.ownDecision.from: You made this decision as the assessor, so you cannot moderate it. Another moderator must.

pack.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF.

pack.instrumentIntro.text: Iphepha njengoba lasetwa, nesikhombisi lelaphawulwa ngaso.
pack.instrumentIntro.from: The paper as it was set, and the guidance it was marked against.

pack.scriptsIntro.text: Kutfolwe ngesikhala semamaki (laphezulu, laphansi nalaphakathi) kuze kuphawula kubonakale ngekuhle kwako nangekubi kwako hhayi phakathi nje.
pack.scriptsIntro.from: Taken across the mark range (top, bottom and spread between) so the marking is seen at its best and its worst rather than in the middle.

pack.departuresIntro.text: Lapho umhloli akhetse kwehluka kulokuphakanyiswe ngemamaki, noma umlinganisi akhetse kwehluka kumhloli. Phakethe lelishiya loku libi kunalengenalo lutfo.
pack.departuresIntro.from: Where an assessor differed from what the marks proposed, or a moderator differed from the assessor. A pack that leaves these out is worse than no pack.

pack.exceptionsIntro.text: Bafundzi labavunyelwe ngumuntfu longuliwe, ngesizatfu lasinikelile.
pack.exceptionsIntro.from: Learners let past a gate by a named person, with the reason they gave.

held.intro.text: Umfundzi lotfolwe angakabi nelikhono kabili akehluleki. Kuhlolwa kuyabanjwa, futsi kubuyeketwa kweluhlelo kubitwa nemqashi wakhe, ngoba ngalesikhatsi umbuto awusekho wekutsi uyakwati yini, kodvwa kutsi kwentekani ngakuye.
held.intro.from: A learner found not yet competent twice is not failed. The assessment is held, and a programme review is convened with their employer, because by this point the question is rarely whether they know it, and usually what has been going on around them.

held.empty.text: Loku kugcwala uma umfundzi atfolwa angakabi nelikhono okwesibili ekuhlolweni kwekugcina. Kuze kube ngaleso sikhatsi akukho lokufanele kubuyekezwe.
held.empty.from: This fills when a learner is found not yet competent for a second time on a summative assessment. Until then there is nothing to review.

held.whoConvenes.from: A facilitator or administrator convenes the review.

held.oralAuthorised.text: {assessment} · kubuyeketa kuvumele umzamo wesitsatfu, lokwentiwa ngekuncokola
held.oralAuthorised.from: {assessment} · the review authorised a third attempt, conducted orally

held.whoConducts.text: Umhloli wenta umzamo ngekuncokola, hhayi lowuvumele.
held.whoConducts.from: An assessor conducts the oral attempt, and not the person who authorised it.

held.furtherLearning.text: Kufundza lokwengetiwe ngaphambi kwanoma imuphi umzamo lolandzelako
held.furtherLearning.from: Further learning before any further attempt

held.whyHint.from: What the review found, and what it turns on.

oral.reviewDecidedIntro.from: The grounds on which this third attempt was authorised.

oral.recordIntro.text: Umzamo wekuncokola awushiyi bufakazi bawo. Lobu ngibufakazi, futsi umphumela awukwati kurekhodwa ngabo.
oral.recordIntro.from: An oral attempt leaves no evidence of its own. This is that evidence, and the outcome cannot be recorded without it.

oral.outcomeIntro.text: Kuhlolwa ngendlela lefanako nemzamo lobhaliwe, ngetindlela tekuhlola letifanako, futsi kulinganiswe ngendlela lefanako emvakwaloko.
oral.outcomeIntro.from: Judged the same way as a written attempt, against the same criteria, and moderated the same way afterwards.

oral.howHint.text: Ngamuntfu, noma ngekufona kwevidiyo lekwentiwe kuyo
oral.howHint.from: In person, or the video call it was held on

oral.presentNote.text: Akudzingeki. Kuhlolwa ngekuncokola ngaphandle kwanoma ngubani lomunye ekamelweni kuyatima kakhulu ekulinganisweni, futsi irekhodi kufanele litsi kwaba luhlobo luni.
oral.presentNote.from: Not required. An oral assessment with nobody else in the room is harder to defend at moderation, and the record should say which kind this was.

oral.savedNext.text: Umphumela urekhodwa esikrinini sekuphawula, njengomunye umzamo.
oral.savedNext.from: The outcome is recorded on the marking screen, the same as any other attempt.

appeals.intro.text: Umfundzi angakhalela umphumela noma indlela lenta ngayo umhloli. Kutfolwa kwesicelo kuyavunywa emahoreni la-{hours}, lesikhatsi lesihlala sicashiswa, ngoba sihamba kusenta umuntfu afundzisa.
appeals.intro.from: A learner may appeal against a result or against an assessor's conduct. Receipt is acknowledged within {hours} hours, which is the deadline that gets missed, because it runs while somebody is teaching.

appeals.lateIntro.text: Sekwedlule emahora la-{hours} futsi kusengakavunywa. Kuvuma sekwephuzile kuncono kunekungavumi nhlobo, futsi irekhodi litawukhombisa kokubili.
appeals.lateIntro.from: Past the {hours} hours and still not acknowledged. Acknowledging late is better than not at all, and the record will show both.

appeals.openIntro.text: Konkhe lokubhaliswe futsi kungakavalwa, lokusha kucala.
appeals.openIntro.from: Everything lodged and not yet closed, newest first.

appeals.none.text: Akukho lokuvulekile. Sikhalo sibhaliswa ekhasini lomfundzi ngokwakhe.
appeals.none.from: Nothing open. An appeal is lodged from a learner's own page.

appeals.procedureIntro.text: Vuma kutfola, hlangana nomfundzi, buta umlinganisi uma sizatfu singumphumela, bese uyaqeda futsi umtjele.
appeals.procedureIntro.from: Acknowledge, meet the learner, consult the moderator where the ground is a result, then resolve and tell them.

appeals.closedUnacknowledged.from: Closed without an acknowledgement being recorded.

appeals.firstCounts.text: Kuvuma kwekucala kuyilokugcinwa yirekhodi. Akukwati kubekwa sikhatsi kabusha ngemuva, ngoba sikhatsi lesingashintshwa asisiso bufakazi bebutfo.
appeals.firstCounts.from: The first acknowledgement is the one the record keeps. It cannot be re-stamped later, because a time that can be changed is not evidence of anything.

appeals.resultNeedsModerator.text: Sikhalo semphumela siya kumlinganisi wangekhatsi ngaphambi kwekutsi siqedwe. Lelo linyatselo lelibutwa ngumcinisekisi wangaphandle.
appeals.resultNeedsModerator.from: A result appeal goes to the internal moderator before it can be resolved. That is the step an external verifier asks about.

appeals.conductNoModerator.text: Sikhalo sendlela yekwenta asiphetfwa ngekuphawula kabusha, ngako akudzingeki umlinganisi.
appeals.conductNoModerator.from: A conduct appeal is not something re-marking settles, so no moderator is required.

appeals.notFeedback.from: A decision the learner has not been given is not feedback.

appeals.whyHint.text: Kungani. Lena yingcenye umfundzi lonelilungelo layo.
appeals.whyHint.from: Why. This is the part the learner is entitled to.

appeals.notesIntro.text: Kuxoxisana phakathi kwemcondzisi, umhloli nemlinganisi. Akukhonjiswa umfundzi ngaphandle kwekutsi utsi kunjalo; lokunelilungelo layo kungumphumela nalokubangela lokungenhla.
appeals.notesIntro.from: The discussion between coordinator, assessor and moderator. Not shown to the learner unless you say so; what they are entitled to is the outcome and the reasoning above.

appeals.noteHint.from: What was discussed, and with whom

appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.text: Kurekwa kudzinga sizatfu. Loku lokungenaso kubukeka njengekucindzeteleka, futsi loko ngiko kanyekanye lokungaba ngukwesikhalo ngendlela yekwenta.
appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.from: A withdrawal needs a reason. One with none looks like pressure, and that is exactly what an appeal about conduct would be about.

rpl.intro.text: Kumfundzi lotsiwe akwati kakade kwenta ingcenye yemsebenti. Akukho lokunikwa ngenkhulumo yemuntfu munye: siphetfo senteka ngetindlela tekuhlola temojula ngayinye, sibhalwe ngalokuphelele, silinganiswe ngumuntfu lomunye kunalowasentako ngaphambi kwekutsi sibale lutfo.
rpl.intro.from: For a learner who can already do part of the work. Nothing here is granted on one person's say-so: a judgement is made against the module's own criteria, written down in full, and moderated by somebody other than whoever made it before it counts for anything.

rpl.waitingIntro.text: Siphetfo asinikeli lutfo kuze loku kwentiwe. Fundza sizatfu esihlangana nemojula ngaphambi kwekuvuma: kulokucala lokufundwa ngumcinisekisi wangaphandle.
rpl.waitingIntro.from: A judgement grants nothing until this is done. Read the rationale against the module before agreeing: it is the first thing an external verifier reads.

rpl.appearHere.from: Judgements appear here as they are made.

rpl.openIntro.text: Linyatselo lekucala, futsi lelakha irekhodi lonkhe lokunye lehlangana nalo.
rpl.openIntro.from: The first step, and the one that creates the record everything else attaches to.

rpl.transferIntro.text: Kwehluke ku-RPL: umfundzi usenalo likhwalifikheshini lelivalele imiphumela yalemojula. Akukho seluleko, kodvwa kubalwa kufanele kubhalwe; kudlulisela ngaphandle kwako kusho lokungeke kucinisekiswe.
rpl.transferIntro.from: Different from RPL: the learner already holds a qualification whose outcomes cover this module. No advisory, but the mapping has to be written down; a transfer without it is a claim nobody can check.

rpl.needsBoth.text: Sicelo sidzinga umfundzi nelikhwalifikheshini lokufanele sicelele lona. Engeta loko kucala.
rpl.needsBoth.from: An application needs a learner and a qualification to apply against. Add those first.

rpl.needsLearner.text: Engeta umfundzi ngaphambi kwekurekhoda kudlulisela kwakhe.
rpl.needsLearner.from: Add a learner before recording a transfer for one.

rpl.mapping.text: Kutsi imiphumela yalokusenako ivalela njani lemojula
rpl.mapping.from: How the outcomes of what they hold cover this module's

rpl.checked.from: What you checked, and what you concluded

record.print.text: Phrinta lelikhasi kuze uligcine njenge-PDF yefayela lebufakazi.
record.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF for the portfolio of evidence.

record.timeExpired.text: Akwemukelwanga: sikhatsi sesiphelile futsi umsebenti unikelwe njengoba unjalo.
record.timeExpired.from: Not accepted: the time limit expired and the work was handed in as it stood.

record.returned.from: Returned {date}. This is developmental: it records no competence.

sor.withdrawConsequence.text: Sikhungo sekuhlola singahle sibe nayo kakade lekhophi. Rifrensi iyaqhubeka isebenta futsi itawubonisa kutsi yarekwa.
sor.withdrawConsequence.from: An assessment centre may already hold a copy. The reference keeps working and will say it was withdrawn.

sor.print.text: Phrinta noma gcina lesi Sitatimende Semiphumela
sor.print.from: Print or save this Statement of Results

fisa.intro.text: Iphepha lelisetwa ngulomhlinzeki luhlelo lwakhe lwemakhono. Ngokungafani nekuhlolwa kwangaphandle, wena uyalibhala futsi uyalilinganisa, ngako kulinganisa kwenteka ngaphambi kwekutsi kuhlale noma ngubani, futsi iphepha lelingakasayinwa njengelifanele injongo alikwati kusetjentiswa.
fisa.intro.from: The paper this provider sets for its own skills programme. Unlike an external assessment, you write it and you moderate it, so the moderation happens before anybody sits it, and a paper that has not been signed off as fit for purpose cannot be used.

fisa.waitingIntro.text: Akekho longahlala loku kuze umlinganisi akusayine.
fisa.waitingIntro.from: Nobody can sit these until a moderator signs them off.

fisa.setNewIntro.text: Ngeluhlelo lwemakhono. Likhwalifikheshini lelipheleleko noma lengcenye lihlolwa ngaphandle.
fisa.setNewIntro.from: Against a skills programme. A full or part qualification is assessed externally.

fisa.gate.approved.text: Kusayiniwe njengekufanele injongo: bakhandidethi bangahlala leliphepha
fisa.gate.approved.from: Signed off as fit for purpose: candidates may sit this paper

fisa.gate.in_moderation.from: With the moderator: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.gate.draft.from: Being written: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.beforeNotAfter.text: I-FISA iyalinganiswa ngaphambi kwekutsi ihlalwe, hhayi ngemuva. Loko kwenta kutsi ivikeleke ekuvakasheni kwekuphaha.
fisa.beforeNotAfter.from: A FISA is moderated before it is sat, not after. That is what makes it defensible at a monitoring visit.

fisa.practical.text: Ibuye ibe nengcenye yekwenta, lehlolwa ngekutsi unelikhono noma akakabi nelikhono.
fisa.practical.from: Also has a practical component, judged competent or not yet competent.

fisa.moderatorIntro.text: Uhlola kutsi lifanele injongo, ngaphambi kwekutsi kuhlale noma ngubani.
fisa.moderatorIntro.from: Checks it is fit for purpose, before anybody sits it.

fisa.unsigned.text: Akukabi khona sivumelwano sekufihla. Angeke abone noma ahlole leliphepha kuze sisayinwe.
fisa.unsigned.from: No confidentiality agreement yet. They may not see or judge the paper until it is signed.

fisa.outcomes.text: Imiphumela yeleveli yekuphuma, nalapho iphepha lihlola khona
fisa.outcomes.from: Exit level outcomes, and where the paper assesses them

fisa.outcomesIntro.text: Sigaba 2 semibiko yomibili. Yindzawo yodvwa lekhombisa kutsi iphepha livalela likhwalifikheshini hhayi kubukeka nje njengembhalo.
fisa.outcomesIntro.from: Section 2 of both reports. The only place that shows the paper covers the qualification rather than merely looking like an exam.

fisa.noOutcomes.text: Lolu hlelo alunayo imiphumela yeleveli yekuphuma lerekhodiwe, ngako akukho lokungatfolwa iphepha kulo. Ngenisa likharikhulamu kucala.
fisa.noOutcomes.from: This programme has no exit level outcomes recorded, so there is nothing to map the paper against. Import the curriculum first.

fisa.onlyExaminer.text: Kuphela umhloli lonikwe umsebenti, uma sivumelwano sakhe sekufihla sisayiniwe, angaphendvula loku.
fisa.onlyExaminer.from: Only the appointed examiner, once their confidentiality agreement is signed, can answer these.

fisa.onlyModerator.text: Kuphela umlinganisi lonikwe umsebenti, uma sivumelwano sakhe sekufihla sisayiniwe, angaphendvula loku.
fisa.onlyModerator.from: Only the appointed moderator, once their confidentiality agreement is signed, can answer these.

fisa.handOverIntro.from: Once your own report is complete.

fisa.laterIntro.text: Le ihlala injalo, ngoba bakhandidethi bangahle babe balihlalile. Inguqulo lensha idzinga kulinganiswa kwayo.
fisa.laterIntro.from: This one stays exactly as it is, because candidates may have sat it. A new version needs its own moderation.

fisa.noProgrammes.text: I-FISA isetwa ngeluhlelo lwemakhono, futsi akukho lolukhona nyalo. Ngenisa kucala; likhwalifikheshini lelipheleleko noma lengcenye lihlolwa ngaphandle ngumlingani wekuhlola kwemgangatsi, ngako umhlinzeki akalisebentisi leliphepha.
fisa.noProgrammes.from: A FISA is set against a skills programme, and there are none yet. Import one first; a full or part qualification is assessed externally by the Assessment Quality Partner, so the provider does not set that paper.

fisa.passNote.text: I-FISA ngumhlolo, ngako inaso, ngokungafani nelikhono langekhatsi.
fisa.passNote.from: A FISA is an examination, so it has one, unlike internal competence.

fisa.hasPractical.text: Ibuye ibe nengcenye yekwenta lehlolwa ngekutsi unelikhono noma akakabi nelikhono
fisa.hasPractical.from: It also has a practical component judged competent or not yet competent

fisa.practicalHint.text: isib. Kwenta: emahora lama-4, kuhlolwa ngekutsi unelikhono / akakabi nelikhono
fisa.practicalHint.from: e.g. Practical: 4 hours, judged competent / not yet competent

fisa.idNote.text: Indlela lapho pulatifomu ihlukanisa khona umuntfu nomunye uma bangenayo akhawunti lapha.
fisa.idNote.from: How the platform tells one person from another when they have no account here.

fisa.account.from: Their account here, if they have one

fisa.outside.from: Somebody from outside, with no account

fisa.accountNote.text: Kuphela umuntfu lonayo akhawunti angagcwalisa umbiko wakhe lapha.
fisa.accountNote.from: Only somebody with an account can fill in their own report here.

fisa.further.text: Emacophelo lasele ekwenteni ngcono kwetitandzi tekuhlola
fisa.further.from: Further comments for the improvement of assessment standards

fisa.signOff.from: Sign off as fit for purpose

fisa.untilYouDo.text: Akekho umkhandidethi longahlala leliphepha kuze wena wente kunjalo.
fisa.untilYouDo.from: No candidate may sit this paper until you do.

eisa.intro.text: Nini ngamunye umhlangano wekuhlala, nini kuvalwa kubhaliswa kwawo, nekutsi ngukuphi kuqoqwa lokusafanele kufakwe. Kubhaliswa kuvamise kuvalwa cishe tinyanga letintsatfu ngaphambili, loko kwenta kutsi liqoqo lelicedza ngasekupheleni kwemnyaka kufanele lifakwe kudze ngaphambi kwekucedza kwalo.
eisa.intro.from: When each sitting is, when registration for it closes, and which cohorts still have to be entered. Registration typically closes about three months ahead, which is why a cohort finishing later in the year has to be entered long before it finishes.

eisa.registerNowIntro.text: Kubhaliswa kuvalwa emalangeni lalishumi ekusebenta futsi lamaqoqo awanalo lilanga lekubhaliswa lerekhodiwe.
eisa.registerNowIntro.from: Registration closes within ten working days and these cohorts have no registration date recorded.

eisa.sittingsIntro.text: Kuphela lokusavulekele kubhaliswa. Lokuvalwe akusiko lokungenta noma ngubani, futsi kukushiya lapha kutawuphusha sikhatsi sangempela lesilandzelako ngaphansi kwelikhasi.
eisa.sittingsIntro.from: Only those still open for registration. A closed one is nothing anybody can act on, and leaving it here would push the next real deadline down the page.

eisa.nextYear.text: Akukho lokurekhodiwe ngale kwalomnyaka. Umlingani wekuhlola kwemgangatsi ushicilela emalanga emnyaka lolandzelako ngeNgongoni, ngako incwadzi kufanele isivele isitfunyiwe; kuwafaka nyalo kugcina kubala kuchubeka kuze kube seNcwaba.
eisa.nextYear.from: Nothing is recorded beyond this year. The assessment quality partner publishes next year's dates in December, so the letter should be out; adding them now is what keeps the countdown running into January.

eisa.toEnterIntro.text: Konkhe lokunesikhatsi lesivulekile futsi lokungenalo lilanga lekubhaliswa lerekhodwe kukona.
eisa.toEnterIntro.from: Everything with an open deadline and no registration date recorded against it.

eisa.noIdIntro.text: Wonkhe umlingani uyayicela, futsi kubhaliswa lokubuyiselwe ngenxa yenombolo lengekho kubiza sikhatsi. Kungcono kutfolwe nyalo kunasemuva kwekutfunyelwa kwefayela.
eisa.noIdIntro.from: Every quality partner asks for one, and a registration returned for a missing number costs a cycle. Better found now than after the file is sent.

eisa.readyIntro.text: Onkhe emagunya kuyo yonkhe imojula atfolakele, noma afundziswe noma aphawulwe ngekufundza lokwedlule.
eisa.readyIntro.from: Every criterion in every module met, whether taught or recognised through prior learning.

eisa.nobodyYet.text: Akekho kuze kube nyalo. Luhlu lungentasi lubonisa kutsi ngamunye usele kanganani.
eisa.nobodyYet.from: Nobody yet. The list below says how far each of them has to go.

eisa.notReadyIntro.text: Kutsi ngamunye usele kanganani. Umuntfu losele ligunya linye usengakhona kufinyelela sikhatsi uma kubonwa kuleliviki.
eisa.notReadyIntro.from: How far each has to go. Somebody one criterion short can still make the deadline if it is noticed this week.

ready.intro.text: Umfundzi angahlala Kuhlolwa Kwekugcina Kwangaphandle Lokuhlanganisiwe uma onkhe emagunya ekuhlolwa kwangekhatsi kuyo yonkhe imojula afinyelelwe. Akusiwo lamanyenti, futsi ipesenti ayimeli loko: ipesenti langentasi ngukuchubeka, ibheji ngumvume.
ready.intro.from: A learner may sit the External Integrated Summative Assessment once every internal assessment criterion in every module has been achieved. Not most of them, and no percentage stands in for it: the percentage below is progress, the badge is permission.

ready.nobody.text: Akekho lobhalise ngelikhwalifikheshini. Bhalisa umfundzi kusifundvo bese ukhetsa likhwalifikheshini lalibalwa kulo, futsi utawuvela lapha.
ready.nobody.from: Nobody is enrolled against a qualification yet. Enrol a learner on a course and choose the qualification it counts towards, and they will appear here.

ready.notCaptured.from: A curriculum here is not fully captured.

ready.notCapturedIntro.text: Eminye imojula ayinamagunya ekuhlola, ngako akukho lokungafinyelelwa kuyo futsi akekho kulelikhwalifikheshini longememetelwa kutsi ulungele. Ngenisa lonkhe lidokhumenti lelikharikhulamu ngaphambi kwekufaka noma ngubani ku-EISA.
ready.notCapturedIntro.from: Some modules carry no assessment criteria, so nothing can be achieved against them and nobody on that qualification can be declared ready. Import the full curriculum document before entering anyone for an EISA.

ready.notEligible.from: Not yet eligible for the EISA

ready.achieved.text: {achieved} kusuka ku-{total} emagunya ekuhlolwa kwangekhatsi afinyelelwe, futsi lwati lwasemsebentini lufakazelwe ngu-{record} losayiniwe.
ready.achieved.from: {achieved} of {total} internal assessment criteria achieved, and work experience proved by a signed {record}.

ready.canIssue.from: A Statement of Results can be issued.

ready.everyOne.text: Ngamunye wawo uyadzingeka; akukho umaki wekuphasa.
ready.everyOne.from: Every one of them is required; there is no pass mark.

ready.perUnitIntro.text: Sitatimende sesigaba sinye sekufundza sicinisekisa onkhe emagunya kumamojula lalesigaba sitfumela. Singakhishwa ngekushesha nje uma lesigaba siphelile, ngaphandle kwekulindza lokunye kwelikhwalifikheshini.
ready.perUnitIntro.from: A statement for one study unit confirms every criterion in the modules that unit delivers. It can be issued as soon as that unit is finished, without waiting for the rest of the qualification.

ready.certificateIntro.text: Sikhishwa yinhlangano yekunikela ngemuva kwe-EISA, hhayi ngu-{provider}. Sirekhodwa lapha uma sifika, kuze irekhodi lomfundzi litsi unelikhwalifikheshini.
ready.certificateIntro.from: Issued by the awarding body after the EISA, not by {provider}. Recorded here when it arrives, so the learner's record says they are qualified.

ready.thisNotCaptured.from: This curriculum is not fully captured.

ready.thisNotCapturedIntro.text: {modules} anemagunya ekuhlola. Akekho longamemetelwa kutsi uyafanelekela kulelikhwalifikheshini kuze lonkhe lidokhumenti lekharikhulamu lingeniswe; ngaphandle kwaloko emamojula lantfulako atawubalwa njengekuphasiwe ngesitsi.
ready.thisNotCapturedIntro.from: {modules} carry no assessment criteria. Nobody can be declared eligible against this qualification until the full curriculum document has been imported; otherwise the missing modules would silently count as passed.

ready.weight.document.from: as stated in the curriculum document

ready.weight.credits.text: kutfolwe emakhredithini emamojula; lidokhumenti alisho emaphesenti
ready.weight.credits.from: derived from module credits; the document states no percentages

ready.weight.equal.text: kwehlukaniswe ngalokulingana; lidokhumenti alisho emaphesenti noma emakhredithi
ready.weight.equal.from: split evenly; the document states no percentages and no credits

ready.workProved.text: Lwati lwasemsebentini lufakazelwa ngu-{record} losayiniwe ngumqeqeshi wasemsebentini futsi wemukelwe ngumhloli, hhayi ngemagunya ekuhlola. Likharikhulamu alichazi lelilodvwa kulemojula.
ready.workProved.from: Work experience is proved by a {record} signed by the workplace coach and accepted by an assessor, not by assessment criteria. The curriculum defines none for this module.

ready.noRecord.from: No {record} has been opened for this module.

ready.noCriteria.from: No assessment criteria captured for this module.

issue.notYet.from: A Statement of Results cannot be issued yet.

preview.summative.text: Sekugcina: kwahlulelwa ngumuntfu futsi kulinganiswa ngokuzimela
preview.summative.from: Summative: judged by a person and independently moderated

preview.formative.from: Formative: marked as the learner goes

preview.whoMarks.from: {app} marked by the App, {assessor} by an assessor

preview.isPreviewIntro.text: Kufanana ncó nalokubonwa ngumfundzi, nemabhokisi lakhona angabhala kuwo. Akukho lokugcinwako futsi akukho umzamo lowucalile, ngako tikhiya tiyacimiswa. Liphaneli lelingaphansi kwembuto ngamunye ngelakho ngoba wena wakhe leliphepha; umfundzi akaliboni nakoke.
preview.isPreviewIntro.from: Exactly what a learner sees, with the boxes they would type into. Nothing is saved and no attempt has been started, so the controls are switched off. The panel under each question is for you because you built this paper; a learner never sees it.

preview.empty.from: There are no questions in this paper yet.

preview.tickedAbove.from: The correct option is ticked above.

preview.noGuide.text: Akukho sikhombisi sekuphawula. Umhloli akanalutfo lokuphawula ngalo; engeta sinye ngaphambi kwekutsi leliphepha lisetjentiswe.
preview.noGuide.from: No marking guide. An assessor has nothing to mark this against; add one before the paper is used.

preview.declarationIntro.text: Umfundzi akakwati kunikela loku ngaphandle kwekuvuma, futsi emagama lacondzile ayakhiywa esicelweni.
preview.declarationIntro.from: A learner cannot hand this in without agreeing to it, and the exact wording is frozen into the submission.

people.intro.text: Wonkhe umuntfu ku-{provider}, tindzima tabo, nekutsi irekhodi labo linakho yini lokudzingwa ngumbiko lomtsetfweni.
people.intro.from: Everyone in {provider}, their roles, and whether their record carries what a statutory return needs.

people.notEnrolledOne.from: 1 learner is not enrolled on anything.

people.notEnrolledMany.from: {count} learners are not enrolled on anything.

people.notEnrolledWhy.text: Kuba ngumfundzi akunikeli kufinyelela ngekwako, ngako bangena esikrinini lesingenalutfo. Babhalise kusifundvo, ubafake eliqoqweni, noma ubabele luhlelo.
people.notEnrolledWhy.from: Being a learner grants no access on its own, so they sign in to an empty screen. Enrol them on a course, add them to a cohort, or assign a programme.

people.missingOne.text: Umuntfu munye ushiywe yimininingwane lefunwa yimbiko we-SETA noma we-SAQA.
people.missingOne.from: 1 person is missing details a SETA or SAQA return needs.

people.missingMany.text: Bantfu {count} bashiywe yimininingwane lefunwa yimbiko we-SETA noma we-SAQA.
people.missingMany.from: {count} people are missing details a SETA or SAQA return needs.

people.missingWhy.text: Bacalwe ngentasi. Kubagcwalisa nyalo kulula kakhulu kunebusuku bangaphambi kwekutfunyelwa.
people.missingWhy.from: They are marked below. Filling them in now is far easier than the night before a submission.

people.roster.from: Add a cohort from a spreadsheet

people.rosterIntro.text: Fundza ifayela le-CSV noma le-Excel lebafundzi bese ubakha bonkhe kanyekanye. Likhombisa lokwenteke ngefayela ngaphambi kwekutsi kwakhiwe noma ngubani.
people.rosterIntro.from: Read a CSV or Excel file of learners and create them all at once. It shows you what it made of the file before anybody is created.

people.added.text: Kwengetiwe. Mnikete leliphasiwedi: liyabonakala kanye kuphela futsi alikwati kubuyiswa.
people.added.from: Added. Give them this password: it is shown once and cannot be retrieved.

people.noMail.text: Akukabi khona sikhulumi semeyili lesixhumile, ngako akukho lokutfunyelwe nge-imeyili. Bacele bayishintshe emvakwekungena.
people.noMail.from: There is no mail server connected yet, so nothing was emailed. Ask them to change it after signing in.

person.lineManagerNote.text: Unquma kutsi kuqeqeshwa kwabani lomuntfu langakubona etibikweni.
person.lineManagerNote.from: Decides whose training this person can see in reports.

person.ofoNote.text: Khodi yemsebenti lesetjentiselwa kuhlanganisa umbiko we-SETA.
person.ofoNote.from: Occupation code used to group a SETA return.

person.statutoryNote.text: Iyadzingeka embikweni we-SAQA noma we-SETA. Inombolo yesazisi iyahlolwa ngenombolo yayo yekuhlola uma ugcina, ngako liphutsa lekubhala litfolakala lapha hhayi ngumlawuli.
person.statutoryNote.from: Needed for a SAQA or SETA return. The identity number is checked against its check digit as you save, so a typing error is caught here rather than by the regulator.

person.roleNote.workplace_coach.text: Umbheki wemqashi: ubona bafundzi bakhe kuphela
person.roleNote.workplace_coach.from: The employer's supervisor: sees only their own learners

roster.how.text: CSV noma Excel. Tihloko tetikholomu tifaniswa ngeligama ("Surname", "Last Name" kanye no-"Van" tonkhe tiyasebenta) futsi akukho sengeti lesidzingekile kunoma ngukuphi kwako.
roster.how.from: CSV or Excel. Column headings are matched by name ("Surname", "Last Name" and "Van" all work) and no extension is needed for any of it.

roster.aiOnWhat.text: futsi itawuzama kufanisa nanoma yiluphi luhloko lolutfulwa yimitsetfo. Ibona tihloko kuphela, ingabi nayo imigca, lenetinombolo tetazisi.
roster.aiOnWhat.from: and will try to match any heading the rules miss. It is shown the headings only, never the rows, which carry identity numbers.

roster.aiOff.text: Uma sengeti yakho ye-AI ivuliwe yingatsi ingafanisa nangetihloko lokungatiwa yimitsetfo; ingabona tihloko kuphela, ingabi nayo imigca. Iswitjhi iphezulu ekhasini.
roster.aiOff.from: With your AI extension switched on it would additionally match headings the rules do not recognise; it would be shown the headings only, never the rows. The switch is at the top of the page.

roster.passwordsNote.text: Atigcinwandzawo lapho tingafundvwa khona futsi. Tikopishe nyalo, noma utisethe kabusha ngamunye ngemuva. Umuntfu ngamunye uyacelwa kutsi ashintshe eyakhe uma angena okokucala.
roster.passwordsNote.from: These are not stored anywhere they can be read again. Copy them now, or reset them individually later. Each person is asked to change theirs on first sign-in.

roster.willCreateSkip.from: {count} will be created, {skipped} will be skipped.

personPage.anonymisedOne.text: Imininingwane yakhe yobuntfu isuswe mhla ka-{date} ngesicelo salomuntfu. Sitifiketi sakhe sinye sisasebenta futsi siyacinisekiswa, ngoba likhwalifikheshini lelitfolwe kanye kufanele lihlale erekhodini lesive.
personPage.anonymisedOne.from: The personal details were erased on {date} at the person's request. Their 1 certificate remains valid and verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to stay on the national record.

personPage.anonymisedMany.text: Imininingwane yakhe yobuntfu isuswe mhla ka-{date} ngesicelo salomuntfu. Titifiketi takhe letingu-{count} tisasebenta futsi tiyacinisekiswa, ngoba likhwalifikheshini lelitfolwe kanye kufanele lihlale erekhodini lesive.
personPage.anonymisedMany.from: The personal details were erased on {date} at the person's request. Their {count} certificates remain valid and verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to stay on the national record.

personPage.conductIntro.text: Lokusolwe, kutsi ngutiphi tixwayiso lebetisasebenta ngaleso sikhatsi, kutsi kwaziswa ngekulalelwa kwecala bekwanele yini, nalokunqunyiwe. Ngendlela lokwenteke ngayo, futsi ngiyo leyo lendlela lokufundvwa ngayo emuva.
personPage.conductIntro.from: What was alleged, which warnings were live at the time, whether notice of a hearing was adequate, and what was decided. In the order it happened, which is the order it gets read back in.

personPage.supportIntro.text: Lokwentelwa lomfundzi, nekutsi kwentiwa ngubani. Sizatfu lesisemuva kwekumelekelelwa siyimininingwane yetempilo noma yetimali futsi sigcinwa sihlukanisiwe, ngoba kumelekelela akudzingi kwati kutsi kungani.
personPage.supportIntro.from: What is being done for this learner, and by whom. The reason behind an accommodation is health or financial information and is held apart from it, because doing the accommodating does not require knowing why.

personPage.missedIntro.text: Lilanga linye lelengetiwe, futsi linye kuphela. Uma nalo lishiywa ngesizatfu setempilo umfundzi uyaya ekuhlolweni ngekuncokola nombukeli lovela kumqashi.
personPage.missedIntro.from: One additional date, and one only. Where that is also missed on medical grounds the learner goes to an oral assessment with an observer from the employer.

personPage.appealsIntro.text: Ngemphumela, noma ngendlela lenta ngayo umhloli. Kutfolwa kuyavunywa emahoreni la-{hours}, futsi sikhatsi sicala uma sibhaliswa lapha.
personPage.appealsIntro.from: Against a result, or against an assessor's conduct. Receipt is acknowledged within {hours} hours, and the clock starts when it is lodged here.

personPage.documentsIntro.text: Ahlolwa njengoba aqoqwa hhayi uma kuhlanganiswa umbiko. Likhophi lelicinisekisiwe lelilahlekile litfolakala ngemuva kwetinyanga kunzima kakhulu kulitfola, futsi sikhatsi sekuphela sivamise kuba semalangeni lambalwa ngaleso sikhatsi.
personPage.documentsIntro.from: Checked as they are collected rather than when a return is being assembled. A missing certified copy found months later is far harder to get, and the deadline is usually days away by then.

personPage.elsewhereIntro.text: Kungeniswe kusuka kulenye sistimu. Kukhonjiswa njengoba kurekhodwe khona; akukho kuko lokufundziswe, lokuhloliwe noma lokulinganiswe kulepulatifomu.
personPage.elsewhereIntro.from: Imported from another system. Shown as it was recorded there; none of it was taught, assessed or moderated on this platform.

editor.ownRoles.text: Awukwati kushintsha tindzima takho: kususa kufinyelela kwakho kungumbhedo lomunye longaneke kwenteke akekho lomunye longawuhlehlisa. Cela omunye umphatsi.
editor.ownRoles.from: You cannot change your own roles: removing your own access is the one mistake nobody else may be able to undo. Ask another administrator.

editor.mailboxIntro.text: Likheli labafundzi nabahloli lababhalela kulo futsi lababhala kulo. Lehlukile kulelikheli lekungena lelingenhla, kuze kuxoxisana ngekuhlolwa kungene erekhodini lomfundzi hhayi kubhokisi lemeyili lelicashile lomuntfu, lapho kungaphandle kwerekhodi lekulandzelela, ngaphandle kwekhophi yekugcina, futsi kuncipha uma aphuma.
editor.mailboxIntro.from: The address learners and assessors write to and from. Separate from the sign-in address above, so a conversation about an assessment lands inside the learner's record rather than in somebody's private inbox, where it is outside the audit log, outside the backup, and gone when they leave.

editor.noPassword.text: Akukho phasiwedi lehlukile, ngoba akukho kungena lokuhlukile.
editor.noPassword.from: There is no separate password, because there is no separate login.

editor.noPasswordWhy.text: Lesi asisilo libhokisi lemeyili endzaweni yemeyili leneyayo iwebimeyili. Imeyili leyiswa kulelikheli iyatfunyelwa kulepulatifomu, futsi umuntfu uyayifundza futsi ayiphendvule ngaphansi kwe-Imeyili emvakwekungena ngendlela lajwayele ngayo. Loko kuyinjongo yako: tincwadzi tihlala erekhodini lomfundzi, erekhodini lekulandzelela nasekhophini yekugcina, hhayi ebhokisini lemeyili lelicashile lelihamba naye.
editor.noPasswordWhy.from: This is not a mailbox on a mail host with its own webmail. Mail sent to this address is delivered into the platform, and the person reads and answers it under Mail after signing in the way they always do. That is the point of it: the correspondence sits inside the learner's record, in the audit log and in the backup, rather than in a private inbox that leaves when they do.

editor.mailboxChange.from: Changing it does not move mail already received.

editor.mailboxSuggested.from: Suggested: {address}. Leave blank for no mailbox.

editor.newPassword.text: Iphasiwedi lensha: likhonjiswa kanye, libanikete ngokuqondile.
editor.newPassword.from: New password: shown once, give it to them directly.

editor.ownSuspend.from: You cannot suspend your own account.

editor.suspendNote.text: Kumisa kuphelisa loku kuvulekile kwalomuntfu ngaso leso sikhatsi, futsi kusetha kabusha iphasiwedi kumphumisa yonkhe indzawo.
editor.suspendNote.from: Suspending ends any session the person has open immediately, and resetting a password signs them out everywhere.

editor.eraseIntro.text: Ngesicelo sekususa se-POPIA. Kususa ligama, imininingwane yekutsintsana neyebubantfu unomphela. Titifiketi nemarekhodi ekuhlola kuyagcinwa futsi kuhlala kuyacinisekiswa, ngoba likhwalifikheshini lelitfolakele kanye kufanele lihlale erekhodini lesive, futsi ngiko loko lokwenta kutsi loku kungakhandzeki kuhlehliswa.
editor.eraseIntro.from: For a POPIA erasure request. Removes the name, contact and demographic details permanently. Certificates and assessment records are kept and stay verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to remain on the national record, which is also why this cannot be undone.

editor.whyHint.from: Kept permanently in the audit log.

lodge.noCohort.text: Sikhalo sifakwa ngeliqoqo, futsi lomfundzi akekho eliqoqweni lelisebentako.
lodge.noCohort.from: An appeal is filed against a cohort, and this learner is not on a running one.

lodge.statementHint.text: Lokushiwo ngumfundzi, ngemagama akhe uma kungenteka.
lodge.statementHint.from: What the learner says, in their words where possible.

lodge.lateWhy.from: Why this is being accepted out of time

lodge.lateNote.text: Sikhalo lesiphuzile sisengusikhalo, futsi kusala lapha kutawusifaka kubhokisi lemeyili lomuntfu. Sizatfu siba yingcenye yefayela.
lodge.lateNote.from: A late appeal is still an appeal, and turning it away here would only send it to somebody's inbox. The reason becomes part of the file.

missed.againOral.from: Missed it again: authorise an oral assessment

missed.wasMedical.from: The second miss was on medical grounds

missed.medicalOnly.text: Indlela yekuncokola ivulwa kuphela ngesizatfu setempilo, akukho lesinye. Uma kungekho sizatfu, siphetfo kulahlekelwa, lapho umfundzi asengakwati khona kufaka sikhalo.
missed.medicalOnly.from: The oral route opens on a medical ground and nothing else. Without one the outcome is a forfeit, which the learner can still appeal.

missed.whyHint.from: Why it was missed, if known

missed.onlyOne.text: Lilanga linye lelengetiwe, futsi linye kuphela. Kulirekhoda lapha kuvimbela kutsi lesitsatfu singahleleki ngemuva ngumuntfu lobengati ngalelinye.
missed.onlyOne.from: One additional date, and one only. Recording it here is what stops a third being arranged later by somebody who did not know about this one.

support.withheld.text: Kunemininingwane lengetiwe efayelini. Iyagcinwa ngaphansi kwemakhiye, ngobe yimininingwane yetempilo noma yetimali, futsi kwenta lusito akudzingi kwati sizatfu salo.
support.withheld.from: There is more detail on file. It is restricted, because it is health or financial information and doing the accommodation does not require knowing the reason for it.

support.changing.from: What is changing as a result

support.accommodation.text: Lokutawentiwa: kwabelwana nanoma ngubani lofanele akwente
support.accommodation.from: What will be done: shared with whoever has to do it

support.accommodationHint.text: Sihlalo eceleni kwelisango. Vumela kuphumula njalo emaminithi la-40. Nikeza emafayela lanyatselwe.
support.accommodationHint.from: Seat near the door. Allow a break every 40 minutes. Provide printed materials.

support.reason.text: Sizatfu lesisemuva kwako: siyagcinwa ngaphansi kwemakhiye, futsi kungaba ngcono kusishiya singenalutfo
support.reason.from: The reason behind it: restricted, and better left empty

support.reasonNote.text: Impilo, kukhubateka nemibandzela yetimali kuyimininingwane yobuntfu lekhetsekile. Rekhodi lelitsi kuphela lokufanele kwentiwe lisebenta umfundzi kufanana, futsi lisengcupheni lencane kakhulu. Vula lapha kuphela lapho umuntfu angeke akhone kwenta lutfo ngaphandle kwaso.
support.reasonNote.from: Health, disability and financial circumstances are special personal information. A record that says only what to do serves the learner just as well and puts far less at risk. Fill this in only where somebody genuinely could not act without it.

support.consented.from: The learner has agreed to this being recorded

docs.routeNote.text: Indlela inquma lokudzingekile. Kwemukelwa kwekufundza lokwendlulile kucela fayela kunesitifiketi sekhwalifikheshini, ngobe sicelo sitsi kufundza kwenteke ngaphandle kwenhlelo yasemtsetfweni.
docs.routeNote.from: The route decides what is required. Recognition of prior learning asks for a portfolio rather than a qualification certificate, because the claim is that the learning happened outside a formal programme.

docs.allSupplied.from: Everything required has been supplied and checked.

conduct.liveNote.text: Kuphela loku lokubalwa ekwenyuketeni kwesijeziso. Xwayiso lelidlulelwe sikhatsi salo lihlala efayelini futsi liyayekela kubalwa, futsi sikhalo sicinile kuloko.
conduct.liveNote.from: Only these count towards escalation. A warning past its date stays on file and stops counting, which is what an appeal turns on.

conduct.findingsHint.from: What was found, and on what basis

conduct.givenButton.from: The learner has been given this in writing

conduct.termsHint.text: Umtsetfo lophulwe, sitandardi lesilindzeleke, nalokwentekako uma loko kwenteka futsi.
conduct.termsHint.from: The rule broken, the standard expected, and what happens if it recurs.

conduct.allegationsHint.from: The specific allegations put to the learner

conduct.sanctionsHint.text: Tijeziso letingenteka, kubalwa nekuphelisa lapho kungulokufanele
conduct.sanctionsHint.from: Sanctions possible, including termination where it is

conduct.rights.text: Saziso sitjela umfundzi kutsi angasitwa ngumfundzi lofundza naye, ashwiyele udaba lwakhe, futsi ababize futsi abuke bofakazi.
conduct.rights.from: The notice tells the learner they may be assisted by a fellow learner, present their case, and call and question witnesses.

conduct.notice.text: Ngetulu kwemahora la-{hours} kusuka nyalo. Saziso lesifishane siyenqatjwa: siyiphutsa lelinqotjelwa ngalo sikhalo, noma ngabe umfundzi wentani.
conduct.notice.from: At least {hours} hours from now. Short notice is refused: it is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

conduct.whyHint.text: Kungani. Lesi sigaba lomfundzi anelungelo lekusifundza.
conduct.whyHint.from: Why. This is the paragraph the learner is entitled to.

conduct.allegationHint.text: Lokusolwako, ngalokucondzile. Umfundzi akakwati kuphendvula 'sitfobhoso sisebubi'.
conduct.allegationHint.from: What is alleged, specifically. A learner cannot answer 'poor attitude'.

cohorts.intro.text: Liqoqo lebantfu lelisebenta ngeluhlelo ndzawonye, ngesheduli yinye. Sikhatsi ngasinye lesifanele sigcinwa njengenani lemalanga kusukela ngelilanga lekucala, ngako uma kushukunyiswa kungenisa, wonkhe emalanga ashukuma kanyekanye kubo bonkhe lababa kuko.
cohorts.intro.from: A group working through a programme together, on one schedule. Every deadline is held as a number of days from the start date, so moving an intake moves every date for everyone in it at once.

cohorts.none.text: {cohort} liqoqo lebantfu lelisebenta ndzawonye ngelinye {course} lelishicilelwe, ngesheduli yinye. Dala lolunye kulesinye {course} futsi sikhatsi ngasinye lesifanele sibalwa kusukela ngelilanga lekucala.
cohorts.none.from: A {cohort} is a group working through a published {course} together, on one schedule. Create one against a {course} and every deadline is measured from its start date.

cohorts.roster.from: Add a cohort from a spreadsheet

cohorts.rosterIntro.text: Fundza ifayela le-CSV noma le-Excel lebafundzi bese ubadala bonkhe kanyekanye. Likukhombisa lokushiwo ngufayela ngaphambi kwekutsi kudalwe noma ngubani, bese ubabhalisa eliqoqweni lelingenhla.
cohorts.rosterIntro.from: Read a CSV or Excel file of learners and create them all at once. It shows you what it made of the file before anybody is created, then enrol them onto a cohort above.

cohorts.noPublished.text: Akukabikho {courses} lashicilelwe. {cohort} isebenta ngelinye {course} lelishicilelwe, kuze kutsi lokufundzwako kungashintshi ngenkhatsi kweliqoqo lesivele lisebenta ngako.
cohorts.noPublished.from: There are no published {courses} yet. A {cohort} runs against a published {course}, so that the material cannot change under a group already working through it.

cohorts.startNote.text: Sikhatsi ngasinye lesifanele sibalwa kusukela kulelilanga. Singashukunyiswa ngemuva, futsi konkhe kushukuma nalo.
cohorts.startNote.from: Every deadline is counted from this day. It can be moved later, and everything moves with it.

cohort.paid.text: Kukhokhiwe. Wonkhe umuntfu kuleliqoqo ubalwa njengokukhokhelwe.
cohort.paid.from: Paid. Everybody on this cohort counts as paid for.

cohort.paidRef.text: Kukhokhiwe · {reference}. Wonkhe umuntfu kuleliqoqo ubalwa njengokukhokhelwe.
cohort.paidRef.from: Paid · {reference}. Everybody on this cohort counts as paid for.

cohort.invoiced.text: I-invoyisi yenziwe, kodvwa akukabi khona kukhokha lokurekhodiwe.
cohort.invoiced.from: Invoiced, and no payment recorded against it yet.

cohort.nothingRecorded.text: Akukho lokurekhodiwe. Inchubo yekubhalisa icala lapha.
cohort.nothingRecorded.from: Nothing recorded. The enrolment procedure begins here.

cohort.moveIntro.text: Lilanga ngalinye lelingentasi lihlelwe njengenani lemalanga kusukela kulelilanga, ngako kulishintsha kushukumisa wonkhe luhlelo kubo bonkhe lababa kuleliqoqo.
cohort.moveIntro.from: Every date below is held as a number of days from this one, so changing it moves the whole rollout for everybody on the cohort.

cohort.waitingIntro.text: Umfundzi ngamunye kanye, esinyatselweni sekucala lesingakwati kusivula.
cohort.waitingIntro.from: Each learner once, at the earliest step they cannot open.

cohort.progress.from: Where the cohort has got to
