cohort.progressIntro.text: Lokuvuliwe nalokuphelile ngesinyatselo ngasinye, nekutsi kuthathe sikhatsi lesingakanani kulabo labaphetse. Kusetjentiswa umkhatsi lophakatsi hhayi ilinganiso, kuze kutsi umfundzi munye lolahlekile kwenta sikhatsi sonkhe angafihli lapho bonkhe labanye bakhona.
cohort.progressIntro.from: Opened and finished per step, and how long it took those who finished. The median rather than the average, so one learner who disappeared for a term does not hide where everybody else is.

cohort.stalledOne.from: One step has people sitting on it: {steps}.

cohort.stalledMany.from: {count} steps have people sitting on them: {steps}.

cohort.rolloutIntro.text: Tinsuku letihleliwe leliqoqo lihlangana ngato, nerejista lethathwa ngasinye. Lapho luhlelo lunemakhredithi kufanele lukhokhiswe ngumsekeli, futsi loku kufakazela kutsi kwaba njalo.
cohort.rolloutIntro.from: The dated sessions this cohort meets for, and the register taken at each. Where a programme carries credits it has to be facilitator-led, and this is the evidence that it was.

cohort.attendanceIntro.text: Jikelele kuhlanganiswe nawo wonkhe luhlelo; kuze kube namuhla kuhlanganiswe nalokuhlelwe kwentiwa ngempela. Ekucaleni kweluhlelo lokucala kuncane ngendlela lengenamcondvo futsi lesibili sikhombisa liciniso, ngako kuniketwa kokubili hhayi lesinye sikhethelwe wena.
cohort.attendanceIntro.from: Overall is against the whole programme; to date is against what has actually been held. Early in a programme the first is meaninglessly low and the second is the honest one, so both are given rather than one being chosen for you.

cohort.held.text: {held} kusuka ku-{countable} tinsuku tibanjiwe. Tinsuku letirekiwe nalabafika ngekwabo bayashiywa kokubili.
cohort.held.from: {held} of {countable} sessions held. Cancelled sessions and voluntary walk-ins are left out of both.

cohort.feedbackIntro.text: Itfunyelwa ngemuva kwekuhlolwa kwekugcina, iphendvulwa emahoreni la-{hours}. Akekho lovuma kutsi utfolile futsi akekho lobhala phasi lutfo: kutfola kungumugca futsi umbiko ngumbuto.
cohort.feedbackIntro.from: Sent after a summative, answered within {hours} hours. Nobody acknowledges receipt and nobody transcribes anything: receipt is a row and the report is a query.

cohort.assessmentIntro.text: Umfundzi ngamunye ngasinye sisebenti lesihlolwako, ngendlela lesiqoqwa ngayo. Kufundvwa kusuka ekuniketweni, etinqumweni nasemarejistheni hhayi kugcinwa ngesandla, ngako akunakwehluka kuto.
cohort.assessmentIntro.from: Every learner against every piece of assessed work, in the order it is collected. Read from submissions, decisions and registers rather than kept by hand, so it cannot disagree with them.

cohort.absentNote.text: Kushiya kufundvwa erejisteni yekuhlala lapho umsebenti bewubhalwa khona, hhayi ekuniketweni, ngobe umfundzi lowengakabi khona akanakho kuniketa lapho kungarekhodwa khona.
cohort.absentNote.from: Absent is read from the register of the sitting the work was written at, not from the submission, because a learner who did not attend has no submission for it to be recorded on.

cohort.workIntro.text: Lokufanele kwenteke ngasemsebentini wekufundzisa: emafayela alungisiwe, emadokhumenti aniketiwe, umlinganisi ashiselwe, titifiketi tilandzelwe.
cohort.workIntro.from: What has to happen around the teaching: material readied, documents submitted, a moderator appointed, certificates chased.

cohort.releaseIntro.text: Kugcinwa njengemalanga kusukela ekucaleni. Shintsha lilanga lekucala bese konkhe loku kushukuma nalo.
cohort.releaseIntro.from: Held as days from the start. Change the start date and every one of these moves with it.

cohort.noSteps.from: This cohort's {course} has no steps yet.

cohort.membersIntro.text: Kufaka umuntfu lapha kuphindze kumbhalise ku-{course}. Ligama erejisteni lomuntfu longakwati kuvula lutfo yindzawo lengakahlelekile lesigamu, futsi loku kuyayivimbela.
cohort.membersIntro.from: Adding somebody here also enrols them on the {course}. A name on a register who cannot open anything is the half-state this avoids.

cohortCtl.noSteps.text: Sifundvo saleliqoqo asinato tinyatselo okwamanje, ngako akukho lokungahlelwa.
cohortCtl.noSteps.from: This cohort's course has no steps yet, so there is nothing to schedule.

cohortCtl.dayZero.text: Lilanga 0 lilanga lekucala. Shiya umugca ungenalutfo futsi lesinyatselo asinawo emalanga nakancane; siyavuleka ngekushesha uma lokusandulele kuphelile.
cohortCtl.dayZero.from: Day 0 is the start date. Leave a row empty and that step carries no dates at all; it opens as soon as whatever comes before it is done.

cohortCtl.everybody.text: Wonkhe lonemakhawunti emfundzi usesele akhona kuleliqoqo. Memela bantfu labanyenti kucala esikrinini Sebantfu.
cohortCtl.everybody.from: Everybody with a learner account is already on this cohort. Invite more people from the People screen first.

payment.referenceNote.from: So it can be matched to what finance holds.

tasks.progress.text: {done} kusuka ku-{counted} kwentiwe: {percent}%. Umsebenti lorekiwe ushiywa kuwo onkhe emahhafu, ngako kulahla umsebenti akusiti futsi akulimati inani.
tasks.progress.from: {done} of {counted} done: {percent}%. Cancelled work is left out of both halves, so abandoning a task neither helps nor hurts the figure.

rollout.nothing.text: Akukabi khona lokuhleliwe. Lapho luhlelo lunemakhredithi kufanele lukhokhiswe ngumsekeli, ngako lapha kucala bufakazi bekutsi kwaba njalo.
rollout.nothing.from: Nothing scheduled yet. Where a programme carries credits it has to be facilitator-led, so this is where the evidence that it was begins.

rollout.announced.text: Liqoqo nomsekeli bayatiswa ngesikhatsi ngasinye sekuhlangana liviki ngaphambi kwaso, nesikhatsi saso nesixhumanisi, futsi batiswa futsi uma sishukunyiswa, sirekwa noma sentelwa kamuva.
rollout.announced.from: The cohort and the facilitator are told about each session a week before it, with its time and link, and told again if it is moved, cancelled or postponed.

archive.intro.text: Uma umfundzi sekasitfolile sitatimende semiphumela yakhe futsi sitifiketi salikhwalifikheshini lakhe lesivela emtimbeni lophakela likhwalifikheshini sesirekhodiwe ekhasini lakhe lekulungela kwe-EISA, Efayela lakhe Lebufakazi lingaphuma kulepulatifomu lisemfayelweni munye we-archive lokhawugcinako. I-archive ivuleka kunoma yiliphi ibrawuza ngaphandle kwepulatifomu. Akukho lokususwako kuze likhophi lakho leligciniwe lihlolwe kulo, futsi wonkhe emarekhodi asala lapha, atsi ngukuphi i-archive lenemafayela.
archive.intro.from: Once a learner holds their statement of results and their qualification certificate from the awarding body has been recorded on their EISA readiness page, their Portfolio of Evidence can leave the platform in one archive that you keep. The archive opens in any browser without the platform. Nothing is removed until your stored copy has been checked against it, and every record stays here, saying which archive holds the files.

archive.readyFor.from: Holding a statement of results and the qualification certificate for {qualification}.

archive.noQualification.text: Sifundvo saleliqoqo asibalwa kunoma yiliphi likhwalifikheshini.
archive.noQualification.from: This cohort's course counts towards no qualification.

archive.anotherBuilding.text: Enye i-archive iyabhalwa. Cala lelandzelako uma seliphelile.
archive.anotherBuilding.from: Another archive is being written. Start the next one when it has finished.

archive.notYetIntro.text: Basala kulepulatifomu futsi balandzela ku-archive lelandzelako uma sitifiketi salikhwalifikheshini labo sesirekhodiwe.
archive.notYetIntro.from: They stay on the platform and follow in a later archive once their own qualification certificate has been recorded.

archive.step1Note.text: Ligcine lapho umtsetfo wakho wemarekhodi utsi emarekhodi ebafundzi agcinwa khona, ngesikhatsi sonkhe sekugcinwa. Uma emafayela asusiwe, leli ngilo kuphela likhophi lelipheleleko.
archive.step1Note.from: Keep it where your records policy says learner records are kept, for the full retention period. Once the files are removed, this is the only complete copy.

archive.step3.from: 3. Remove the files from the platform

archive.building.from: Being written. This page updates by itself.

archive.checkNote.text: Khetsa i-archive lapho uyilondvolote khona. Ifundvwa kulekhompyutha futsi ayisindziswa; kutfunyelwa kuphela sigxivo sayo semunwe. I-archive ingu-{bytes} emabhayithi.
archive.checkNote.from: Choose the archive from where you stored it. It is read on this computer and not uploaded; only its fingerprint is sent. The archive is {bytes} bytes.

archive.stored.text: Likhophi lengilihloliwe lilondvolotwe lapho umtsetfo wemarekhodi wetfu utsi kufanele ligcinwe khona.
archive.stored.from: The copy I checked is stored where our records policy says it should be kept.

archive.keepingOne.text: Ludvwa lolulodvwa lwekubhalisa lusala kulepulatifomu futsi, ngobe kunelinye luhlelo lwemfundzi lolusadzinga lona.
archive.keepingOne.from: 1 enrolment document stays on the platform as well, because another programme of the learner's still needs it.

archive.keeping.text: Emadokhumenti ekubhalisa {count} asala kulepulatifomu futsi, ngobe kunelinye luhlelo lwemfundzi lolusadzinga wona.
archive.keeping.from: {count} enrolment documents stay on the platform as well, because another programme of the learner's still needs them.

archive.wrongSize.text: Lelifayela lingu-{size} emabhayithi futsi i-archive ingu-{expected}. Akusiyo lena i-archive.
archive.wrongSize.from: That file is {size} bytes and the archive is {expected}. It is not this archive.

archive.pieceRefused.from: A piece of the upload was refused.

archive.carryOn.text: {problem} Khetsa ifayela futsi uchubeke lapho kumile khona.
archive.carryOn.from: {problem} Choose the file again to carry on from where it stopped.

archive.restoreNote.text: Kudzingeka kuphela uma loku kufanele kubuyele kulepulatifomu. I-archive iyasindziswa, ihlolwe ngesigxivo semunwe lesatfolwa uma yenziwa, futsi lonkhe lifayela libuyiselwa lapho lalikhona.
archive.restoreNote.from: Only needed if these files have to be on the platform again. The archive is uploaded, checked against the fingerprint taken when it was made, and each file is put back where it was.

register.supervisedIntro.text: Ngubani lowemukelwe, lokuvumelene nako, nekutsi sikripthi sabo sitfolakele. Umhlangano ngekwawo ubanjwa lapho nemakhuluma akho abanjwa khona; lena yirekhodi yekutsi wabhekwa njani.
register.supervisedIntro.from: Who was admitted, what they agreed to, and that their script was received. The meeting itself runs where your lectures do; this is the record of how it was supervised.

register.canInvigilate.text: Lena inkhulumo yekuhlolwa kwekugcina, ngako ingabhekwa.
register.canInvigilate.from: This is a summative session, so it can be invigilated.

register.intro.text: Bekukhona bani. Emamaki agcinwe angalungiswa kamuva, futsi loku lokushintshile kurekhodwa ngasola kubhekene nalowakwentile.
register.intro.from: Who was here. Saved marks can be corrected later, and every change is recorded against whoever made it.

register.nobody.text: Akekho kuleliqoqo okwamanje, ngako akukho rejista lekufanele ithathwe.
register.nobody.from: Nobody is on this cohort yet, so there is no register to take.

register.excusedNote.text: Kuxolelwa kusho kungabi khona ngesizatfu lesemukelwe ngumhlinzeki. Kugcinwa kwehlukile kulokungabi khona lokulula ngobe inchubo yelusito lwemfundzi incike kulokwehlukile.
register.excusedNote.from: Excused means absent for a reason the provider accepted. It is kept apart from a plain absence because the learner support procedure turns on the difference.

sitting.needsAssessment.text: Kuhlolwa lokubhekiwe kudzinga kuhlolwa lokufanele kubhekwe. Shicilela lokunye kucala esifundvweni, bese kungahlelwa lapha.
sitting.needsAssessment.from: A supervised sitting needs an assessment to supervise. Publish one on the course first, and it can be set up here.

sitting.nothing.text: Akukho lokubhekiwe kulesikhatsi sekuhlangana. Hlela lokunye uma lena ingukuhlolwa lokubhekiwe; kukunika sikhatsi sekugcina sekwemukelwa, simemetelo, kuhlolwa kwekhamera, rejista yemasikripthi nelogi yetehlakalo.
sitting.nothing.from: Nothing is being supervised at this session. Set one up if this is an invigilated assessment; it gives you an admission cut-off, a declaration, a camera check, a script register and an incident log.

sitting.invigilator.from: Invigilator (optional, and can be set on the day)

sitting.early.from: Candidates arrive this many minutes early

sitting.closesAfter.text: Kwemukelwa kuyavalwa emaminithi lanyenti ngemuva kwekucala
sitting.closesAfter.from: Admission closes this many minutes after the start

sitting.camera.from: A camera must be on throughout

sitting.materialsHint.text: Khalkhyuleta lengeke ihlelwe nelishidi lemafomula lelinikiwe. Akukho lokunye.
sitting.materialsHint.from: A non-programmable calculator and the issued formula sheet. Nothing else.

sitting.declaration.from: What each candidate agrees to before starting (optional)

room.elsewhere.text: Loko kungu-{time} {zone} lapho ukhona. Tikhatsi letirekhodwe lapha tesomhlinzeki, lokungikuko lokugcinwa erekhodini.
room.elsewhere.from: That is {time} {zone} where you are. Times recorded here are the provider's, which is what the record keeps.

room.closesAt.text: Kwemukelwa kuyavalwa emaminithini la-{minutes} ngemuva kwekucala, ngo-{time}; ngemuva kwaloko pulatifomu iyenqaba, ngobe lowemukelwe sekwephuzile uba nesikhatsi lesidze nephepha kunabo bonkhe labanye.
room.closesAt.from: Admission closes {minutes} minutes after the start, at {time}; after that the platform refuses, because somebody admitted late has had longer with the paper than everybody else.

room.closes.text: Kwemukelwa kuyavalwa emaminithini la-{minutes} ngemuva kwekucala; ngemuva kwaloko pulatifomu iyenqaba, ngobe lowemukelwe sekwephuzile uba nesikhatsi lesidze nephepha kunabo bonkhe labanye.
room.closes.from: Admission closes {minutes} minutes after the start; after that the platform refuses, because somebody admitted late has had longer with the paper than everybody else.

room.joinNote.text: Umhlangano wenteka epulatifomu lesivele uyisebentisa. Lokurekhodwe lapha kutsi wabhekwa njani.
room.joinNote.from: The meeting runs on the platform you already use. What is recorded here is how it was supervised.

room.noLink.text: Alukho sixhumanisi semhlangano kulesikhatsi sekuhlangana. Sifake ekwentiweni kwaso kuze labahlolwako batsi baya kuphi.
room.noLink.from: No meeting link on this session yet. Add one on the roll-out so candidates know where to go.

room.incidentsNote.text: Kufakwa ngelilanga lekwenteka. Lokubhalwe emaviki kamuva akubalulekile kakhulu esikhalweni, lapho kufundvwa khona kuphela.
room.incidentsNote.from: Filed on the day. An account written weeks later is worth very little at an appeal, which is the only place it is ever read.

quals.intro.text: Likhwalifikheshini lemsebenti lifundziswa ngetinhlobo letintsatfu tetimojula: Lwati, Likhono lekwenta, nelwati lwasemsebentini. Umojula ngamunye unemaligunya awo ekuhlola, futsi sistimu ihlola kutsi lokuphakatsi kwesifundvo kuwaphatsa onkhe ngaphambi kwekutsi sifundvo sishicilelwe.
quals.intro.from: An occupational qualification is delivered across three kinds of module: Knowledge, Practical skill, and Workplace experience. Each module has its own assessment criteria, and the system checks that course content covers every one of them before a course can be published.

quals.folderTitle.from: Or build it from a folder

quals.folderIntro.text: Konkhe kanyekanye: kharikhulamu, tigaba tekufundza, tinkombandlela nemitsetfo. Ifolda lenesifinyezo saso ngekwayo ingeniswa ngemizuzwana; lengenaso kufanele isakhiwo sayo sitfolakale, futsi loko ngilokudzinga sengeti ye-AI.
quals.folderIntro.from: Everything at once: the curriculum, the study units, the guides and the policies. A folder that includes a summary of itself imports in seconds; one that does not has to have its structure worked out, and that is the part that needs an AI extension.

quals.folderLabel.from: The qualification's folder, from your own computer

quals.folderHint.text: Konkhe lokusefolodeni nasetinhlakeni tayo kuyafundvwa: kharikhulamu, tigaba tekufundza, tinkombandlela nemitsetfo.
quals.folderHint.from: Everything in the folder and its subfolders is read: the curriculum, the study units, the guides and the policies.

quals.folderHint2.text: Ifolda lakhiwe yisistimu yakho yekutfutfukisa luhlelo ifaka sifinyezo saso ngekwayo, futsi lesi siyafundvwa ngco, ngemizuzwana. Ifolda lengenaso ayikwati kutfolakala isakhiwo sayo okwamanje.
quals.folderHint2.from: A folder built by your programme development system includes a summary of itself, and that is read directly, in seconds. A folder without one cannot have its structure worked out yet.

quals.driveTitle.from: Or from a drive you have connected

quals.driveIntro.text: Lefolda lefanako, ifundvwa lapho seyivele ikhona. Igcina endzaweni lefanako: sicelo lekufanele sihlolwe ngaphambi kwekutsi kubhalwe lutfo.
quals.driveIntro.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

quals.noneManage.text: Lakhe kusuka emadokhumenteni alo (litebhu lelingenhla): dokhumenti yekharikhulamu nedokhumenti yelikhwalifikheshini kwenele, futsi asikho sengeti ye-AI lesetjentiswako. Konkhe lokunye kuncike ekhwalifikheshini, ngako lena yinto yekucala lekufanele yentiwe.
quals.noneManage.from: Build one from its documents (the tab above): the curriculum document and the qualification document are enough, and no AI extension is involved. Everything else on the platform hangs off a qualification, so this is the first thing to do.

quals.noneRead.text: Alukho lolulayidwe okwamanje. Uma selulayidiwe, kharikhulamu lofundzisako nalohlolwa ngayo itakuba lapha: timojula tayo, tihloko tayo nemaligunya lekuhlolwa ngawo ngalinye. Kulayida kungumsebenti wemlawuli.
quals.noneRead.from: None has been loaded yet. When one has been, the curriculum you teach and mark against will be here: its modules, its topics and the criteria each one is assessed by. Loading one is an administrator's job.

how.title.from: How would you like to add it?

how.intro.text: Tindlela letintsatfu. Khetsa yinye bese kuvuleka lena kuphela; ungayivala futsi bese ukhetsa lenye.
how.intro.from: Three ways in. Pick one and only that one opens; you can close it again and choose differently.

how.documents.summary.text: Dokhumenti yekharikhulamu, dokhumenti yelikhwalifikheshini ye-SAQA nemininingwane yekuhlolwa. I-App ifundza sonkhe kharikhulamu kuwo.
how.documents.summary.from: The curriculum document, the SAQA qualification document and the assessment specification. The App reads the whole curriculum out of them.

how.documents.needs.text: Emafayela lamabili noma lamatsatfu e-PDF noma e-Word.
how.documents.needs.from: Two or three PDFs or Word files.

how.documents.speed.text: Imizuzwana. Akukho ye-AI lesetjentiswako nanoma ngunini.
how.documents.speed.from: Seconds. No AI involved at any point.

how.folder.summary.text: Konkhe kanyekanye: kharikhulamu, tigaba tekufundza, tinkombandlela, tincwadzi temisebenti nemitsetfo, kufayelwa njengoba kufundvwa.
how.folder.summary.from: Everything at once: the curriculum, the study units, the guides, the workbooks and the policies, filed as they are read.

how.folder.needs.text: Yonkhe ifolda yelikhwalifikheshini, kusuka ekhompyutheni yakho noma edrayivini.
how.folder.needs.from: The qualification's whole folder, from your computer or a drive.

how.folder.speed.text: Imizuzu. Ifolda lenesifinyezo saso ngekwayo ayidzingi ye-AI; lengenaso isakhiwo sayo siyatfolwa, futsi loko kudzinga yona.
how.folder.speed.from: Minutes. A folder that includes a summary of itself needs no AI; one that does not has its structure worked out, and that part does.

how.blank.summary.text: Likhwalifikheshini lelingenalutfo lolakhako ngesandla: sihloko, khodi, leveli nemakhredithi, bese kuba timojula talo linye ngalinye.
how.blank.summary.from: An empty qualification you build by hand: the title, the code, the level and credits, then its modules one at a time.

how.blank.needs.from: The details in front of you.

how.blank.speed.from: As long as it takes. Nothing is read for you.

manager.drawnFrom.from: drawn from {parent}, whose curriculum it shares

manager.standsAlone.from: standing on its own, with its own curriculum

manager.noneFromParent.text: Alukho lumojula lolukhetsiwe kusuka kukharikhulamu yekhwalifikheshini lelingumzali.
manager.noneFromParent.from: No modules chosen from the parent's curriculum yet.

manager.choose.text: Khetsa ukutsi ngutiphi timojula talelingumzali lekufanele lokhetfwe
manager.choose.from: Choose which of the parent's modules this takes

manager.chooseNote.text: Timojula atifakwa lapha. Lokhu kukhipha kukharikhulamu yalelingumzali, ngako umsebenti wemfundzi ngumojula ubalwa kanye noma ngabe wehlangana nawo kuphi.
manager.chooseNote.from: Modules are not added here. This draws from its parent's curriculum, so a learner's work against a module counts once wherever they met it.

manager.whichNote.text: Dokhumenti ye-SAQA ikhomba kutsi ngulokuphi. Bheka {field} ekhasini layo lekucala.
manager.whichNote.from: The SAQA document says which. Look for {field} on its first page.

manager.standsOnOwn.from: Nothing: it stands on its own

manager.fullOwn.from: A full qualification carries its own curriculum.

manager.sharesNote.text: Lesabelana ngekharikhulamu yalelikhwalifikheshini futsi lithatha ingcenye yetimojula talo; wena ukhetsa tiphi, uma seliyekhona.
manager.sharesNote.from: It shares that qualification's curriculum and takes a subset of its modules; you choose which, once it exists.

manager.codeFull.text: Njengoba ibhalwe kudokhumenti yekharikhulamu. Ayiyinqunywa: yi-QCTO noma i-OFO kuphela lengatsi yini.
manager.codeFull.from: As written on the curriculum document. Never worked out: only the QCTO or the OFO can say what it is.

manager.codePart.text: Khodi lefanako nelikhwalifikheshini lelivela kulo. Balabelana ngekharikhulamu yinye, ngako balabelana ngekhodi yayo.
manager.codePart.from: The same code as the qualification it comes from. They share one curriculum, so they share its code.

manager.accreditationNote.text: Inombolo lelikhwalifikheshini lelikhonjiswe ngayo. Incwadzi yekugunyaza inye ivamise kuhlanganisa emakhwalifikheshini lamanyenti, ngako loku akusoyonkhe sikhatsi kufanana nenombolo yomhlinzeki uqobo. Uyishiye ingenalutfo futsi imibiko ibuyela kulena yomhlinzeki futsi ibike loko.
manager.accreditationNote.from: The number this qualification is accredited under. One accreditation letter usually covers several qualifications, so this is not always the same as the provider's own number. Leave it blank and reports fall back to the provider's and say so.

fromDoc.source.curriculum.note.from: The modules, topics and internal assessment criteria.

fromDoc.source.qualification.note.text: Sicucu se-SAQA sekubhaliswa. Ngiyo kuphela imvelaphi ye-ID ye-SAQA nemiphumela yeleveli yekuphuma.
fromDoc.source.qualification.note.from: The SAQA registration extract. The only source of the SAQA ID and the Exit Level Outcomes.

fromDoc.source.assessmentSpecification.n.text: Imininingwane ye-EISA. Ifayelwe futsi yenziwa incwadzi yesikhombo kuze kutfolakale ngekusesha.
fromDoc.source.assessmentSpecification.n.from: The EISA specification. Filed and indexed so it is searchable.

fromDoc.intro.text: Lamatsatfu ngiwo sisekelo sonkhe lokunye lokwakhelwe kuso. Wasindzise futsi i-App ifundze imininingwane yelikhwalifikheshini, Imiphumela yalo yeleveli yekuphuma nayo yonkhe kharikhulamu kuwo. Hlola lokutfolile, lungisa noma yini lephutsile, bese kubhalwa konkhe kanyekanye.
fromDoc.intro.from: These three are the foundation everything else is built on. Upload them and the App reads the qualification's details, its Exit Level Outcomes and its whole curriculum out of them. Check what it found, correct anything it got wrong, and it is written in one go.

fromDoc.pressThis.from: Now press this. Nothing is written yet.

fromDoc.stillReading.text: Isafundza: imizuzwana {seconds}. Dokhumenti yekharikhulamu inde; loku kujwayelekile.
fromDoc.stillReading.from: Still reading: {seconds} seconds. A curriculum document is long; this is normal.

fromDoc.found.text: Kufundvwe timojula {modules}, tihloko {topics}, tintfo {elements} tekufundzisa nemaligunya ekuhlola {criteria}.
fromDoc.found.from: Read {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} assessment criteria.

fromDoc.foundWithElo.text: Kufundvwe timojula {modules}, tihloko {topics}, tintfo {elements} tekufundzisa nemaligunya ekuhlola {criteria}, kanye neMiphumela Yeleveli Yekuphuma {outcomes} nemaligunya {associated} lahlangene nayo.
fromDoc.foundWithElo.from: Read {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} assessment criteria, plus {outcomes} Exit Level Outcomes with {associated} associated criteria.

fromDoc.partOf.text: Dokhumenti yalo itsi loku ngu-{kind} lokhishwe ku-{parent}. Akukho lokuyofakelwa: lesabelana ngekharikhulamu yalelikhwalifikheshini, futsi lithatha {count} yetimojula talo.
fromDoc.partOf.from: Its document says this is a {kind} drawn from {parent}. Nothing will be copied: it shares that qualification's curriculum, and takes {count} of its modules.

fromDoc.alreadyWhy.text: Kungenisa kharikhulamu futsi kuchibiyela lena leyivele ikhona, futsi noma yini lemakwe ligunya itawukhishwa nayo. Lokungenteka ufuna kukwenta kwengeta lokushodako (lokufundvwako, noma tingcenye tekharikhulamu letingazange tingeniswe), lokwentiwa elikhwalifikheshini ngekwalo futsi akushintshi lutfo lesivele sikhona.
fromDoc.alreadyWhy.from: Importing the curriculum again would replace the one it has, and anything tagged to a criterion would go with it. What you probably want is to add what is missing (the material, or the parts of the curriculum that never made it), which is done on the qualification itself and leaves everything already there untouched.

fromDoc.openIt.from: Open it, and add what is missing

fromDoc.createPart.from: Create it, drawing on its parent's curriculum

fromDoc.filedPart.text: Dokhumenti yalo Yelikhwalifikheshini ifayelwe kulo. Dokhumenti yekharikhulamu nemininingwane yekuhlola akukho: ngekwelikhwalifikheshini lelivela kulo, futsi seyivele ifayelwe lapho.
fromDoc.filedPart.from: Its own Qualification Document is filed against it. The curriculum document and the assessment specification are not: they belong to the qualification it comes from, and are already filed there.

fromDoc.filed.text: Yonkhe dokhumenti lenikete ifayelwe kulelikhwalifikheshini, kuze umlinganisi akwati kuvula umtfombo weligunya lelitsite, futsi kuze sigaba sekulungela sitfokotiswe ngaphambi kwekutsi lokufundvwako kubhalwe.
fromDoc.filed.from: Every document you supplied is filed against the qualification, so a moderator can open the source of any criterion, and so the readiness gate is satisfied before material is authored.

qualPage.step.curriculumDone.text: timojula {modules}, emagunya ekuhlola {criteria}, lafundvwe kumadokhumenti alelikhwalifikheshini ngekwalo.
qualPage.step.curriculumDone.from: {modules} modules, {criteria} assessment criteria, read from the qualification's own documents.

qualPage.step.curriculumTodo.text: Akukho lokungafundziswa noma kuhlolwe lapha kuze kube khona timojula tako.
qualPage.step.curriculumTodo.from: Nothing here can be taught or assessed until its modules exist.

qualPage.step.unitsDone.from: {count} units, with every module placed in one.

qualPage.step.unitsNone.text: Kharikhulamu ishicilela timojula futsi ayitsi lutfo ngekutihlanganisa, ngako loku kungokwakho kutinquma. Dokhumenti yakho yekuhambisana ikwenta ngekuyisindzisa kanye: Word noma Excel.
qualPage.step.unitsNone.from: The curriculum publishes modules and says nothing about how you group them, so this is yours to decide. Your alignment document does it in one upload: Word or Excel.

qualPage.step.unitsSomeOne.text: Umojula 1 awukabi kuso sigaba sekufundza. Umojula lokungekho sigaba sekufundza lesiwufundzisako ngumojula longekho umuntfu lowufundzisako.
qualPage.step.unitsSomeOne.from: 1 module belongs to no unit yet. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches.

qualPage.step.unitsSome.text: Timojula {count} atikabi kuso sigaba sekufundza. Umojula lokungekho sigaba sekufundza lesiwufundzisako ngumojula longekho umuntfu lowufundzisako.
qualPage.step.unitsSome.from: {count} modules belong to no unit yet. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches.

qualPage.step.materialDone.text: Tinkombandlela tetiyori, tincwadzi temisebenti nekuhlola lokufayelwe: {count}.
qualPage.step.materialDone.from: {count} theory guides, workbooks and assessments filed.

qualPage.step.materialTodo.text: Tinkombandlela tetiyori, tincwadzi temisebenti nekuhlola. Yonkhe ifolda ingena kanyekanye, tinkombandlela tetiphendvulo ayatiwa futsi ayifihlelwa bafundzi, futsi akukho ye-AI lesetjentiswako nanoma ngunini.
qualPage.step.materialTodo.from: The theory guides, workbooks and assessments. The whole folder goes in at once, answer guides are recognised and withheld from learners, and no AI is involved at any point.

qualPage.step.captureDone.text: Tonkhe tibhalwe esistimini: {count}. Bafundzi bangatiphendvula esikrinini.
qualPage.step.captureDone.from: All {count} captured. Learners can answer them on screen.

qualPage.step.captureTodo.text: {captured} kusuka ku-{total} tibhalwe esistimini. Letisele ngemafayela lomfundzi langakwati kuwadawunilodha kuphela.
qualPage.step.captureTodo.from: {captured} of {total} captured. The rest are files a learner can only download.

qualPage.weighted.from: weighted {k}/{p}/{w} as stated in the document

qualPage.notWeighted.text: alukho lulinganiso lwetingcenye lolushiwo; kulungela kutfola lolulinganiso emakhredithini
qualPage.notWeighted.from: no component weighting stated; readiness derives it from credits

qualPage.partOf.text: Likhwalifikheshini lengcenye lelikhishwe ku-{parent}, lesabelana ngekharikhulamu yalo. Akukho lokukopishiwe, ngako umsebenti wemfundzi ngumojula ubalwa kanye noma ngabe wehlangana nawo kuphi.
qualPage.partOf.from: A part qualification drawn from {parent}, whose curriculum it shares. Nothing is copied, so a learner's work against a module counts once wherever they met it.

qualPage.chooseModules.text: Khetsa kutsi ngutiphi timojula lapho lithatha khona

qualPage.addIntro.text: Konkhe lokufaka lutfo. Lokuvele kukhona lapha kusetabheni lelinye.
qualPage.addIntro.from: Everything that puts something in. What is already here is on the other tab.

qualPage.finish.from: Finish this qualification from a fuller folder

qualPage.finishLabel.text: Ifolda leyeleleko yalelikhwalifikheshini, kusuka ekhompyutheni yakho
qualPage.finishLabel.from: The completed folder for this qualification, from your own computer

qualPage.finishHint.text: Kwelikhwalifikheshini lelalayidwa ngaphambi kwekutsi emadokhumenti alo aphele. Yonkhe ifolda ifundvwa futsi (kharikhulamu kanye nalokufundvwako) futsi kwengetwa kuphela lokushodako.
qualPage.finishHint.from: For a qualification that was loaded before its documents were complete. The whole folder is read again (the curriculum as well as the material) and only what is missing is added.

qualPage.finishHint2.text: Akukho lokuvele kukhona lapha lokushintshwako noma lokuchibiyelwako, nasewordini linye leligunya, futsi kuyisebentisa kabili akukwenti lutfo ngekwesibili. Usabona konkhe lokutfolile futsi uyakucinisekisa ngaphambi kwekutsi kubhalwe kunoma yini.
qualPage.finishHint2.from: Nothing already here is changed or replaced, down to the wording of a single criterion, and running it twice does nothing the second time. You still see everything it found and confirm it before any of it is written.

qualPage.finishDrive.text: Noma ifolda leyeleleko kusuka edrayivini lolixhumile. Iyagcwalisa ngendlela lefanako: kwengetwa kuphela lokushodako.
qualPage.finishDrive.from: Or the completed folder from a drive you have connected. It tops up the same way: only what is missing is added.

qualPage.materialHere.text: Lokufundvwako kuya lapha: yonkhe ifolda kanyekanye. Akukho lokugcinwako kuze ubone lokutfolile.
qualPage.materialHere.from: The material goes here: the whole folder at once. Nothing is saved until you have seen what it found.

qualPage.materialLabel.from: A folder of material, from your own computer

qualPage.materialHint.text: Tinkombandlela tetiyori netincwadzi temisebenti tiya esigabeni sekufundza lesishiwo ligama lefayela, nemitsetfo netivumelwano tiya elabhulareni yemadokhumenti, futsi konkhe lokunye kulelikhwalifikheshini. Akukho ye-AI lesetjentiswako lapha nakancane: kuhlela emadokhumenti ngeligama kungumtsetfo hhayi sinqumo.
qualPage.materialHint.from: Theory guides and workbooks go to the study unit their filename names, policies and contracts to the document library, and everything else against this qualification. No AI is used here at all: sorting documents by name is a rule rather than a judgement.

qualPage.whereItLives.from: Or the folder where it already lives

qualPage.alignmentHere.text: Dokhumenti yakho yekuhambisana iya lapha: yikhetse, setha luhlobo lwayo ku-Matriksi yekuhambisana kwekharikhulamu, bese uyayisindzisa. Loko kwakha tigaba tekufundza.
qualPage.alignmentHere.from: Your alignment document goes here: choose it, set its kind to Curriculum Alignment Matrix, and upload. That builds the study units.

qualPage.blueprintIntro.text: Ifayela lelichaza kharikhulamu leyo ngokuchaza: timojula {count}, netihloko tato, lokufundziswa yiwo ngamunye nalokuhlolwa ngako. Lifake efolodeni {folder} yelikhwalifikheshini futsi yonkhe ifolda lengenwa ngemuva kwaloko ilifundza ngco, ngemizuzwana, ngaphandle kwe-AI lesetjentiswako nanoma ngunini.
qualPage.blueprintIntro.from: A file describing this curriculum exactly: {count} modules, with their topics, what each teaches and what each is assessed by. Put it in the qualification folder's {folder} directory and every import of that folder afterwards reads it straight off, in seconds, with no AI extension involved at any point.

qualPage.notCarried.from: What the file does not carry

qualPage.notCaptured.from: {count} of {total} modules have no criteria yet.

qualPage.notCapturedWhy.text: Akekho lofanele kubikwa kutsi ulungele i-EISA kulelikhwalifikheshini kuze yonkhe dokhumenti yekharikhulamu ibhalwe kabusha; umojula longenamaligunya angeke ehluleke, ngako kuwashiya angenalutfo kwenta wonkhe umfundzi abukeke aphetsile.
qualPage.notCapturedWhy.from: Nobody can be declared ready for the EISA against this qualification until the whole curriculum document has been transcribed; a module with no criteria cannot be failed, so leaving them empty would make every learner look finished.

qualPage.structureIntro.text: Kharikhulamu ishicilela timojula; umhlinzeki ufundzisa tigaba tekufundza. Sinye ngasinye sihlanganisa timojula Telwati, Tekwenta Nelwasemsebentini letisebenta Umphumela Weleveli Yekuphuma munye, lokuyilona lokuhlolwa nge-External Integrated Summative Assessment kubhekene nako. Bahlinzeki labamabili bangahlanganisa likhwalifikheshini lelifanako ngendlela lehlukene bese bobabili balungile, ngako lesi sakhiwo somhlinzeki hhayi sekharikhulamu.
qualPage.structureIntro.from: The curriculum publishes modules; a provider teaches study units. Each bundles the Knowledge, Practical and Work Experience modules that serve one Exit Level Outcome, which is what the External Integrated Summative Assessment is set against. Two providers may group the same qualification differently and both be correct, so this is the provider's structure rather than the curriculum's.

qualPage.seeAsLearner.from: See it as a learner will

qualPage.seeAsLearnerNote.text: ikhombisa luhlelo lonkhe ngendlela lehanjwa ngayo, ichaza noma yini umfundzi langeke ayitfole. Akukho lokucaliwe futsi akukho lokurekhodiwe.
qualPage.seeAsLearnerNote.from: shows the whole programme in the order it is walked, with anything a learner would not find named. Nothing is started and nothing is recorded.

qualPage.nextStep.text: Sinyatselo lesilandzelako: hlanganisa timojula kutigaba tekufundza.
qualPage.nextStep.from: The next step: group these modules into study units.

qualPage.nextStepWhy.text: Kharikhulamu ishicilela timojula futsi ayitsi lutfo ngetigaba tekufundza, ngobe kuhlanganisa timojula sinqumo somhlinzeki, ngako likhwalifikheshini lelifundvwe emadokhumenteni lifika nayo yonkhe timojula talo {count} letingenaso sigaba. Loku kulindzelekile, akusiko liphutsa lekungenisa.
qualPage.nextStepWhy.from: The curriculum publishes modules and says nothing about study units, because grouping them is the provider's own decision, so a qualification read from its documents arrives with all {count} of its modules unplaced. That is expected, not a fault in the import.

qualPage.nextStepHow.text: Sindzisa dokhumenti yakho yekuhambisana: leyo etfula Umphumela Weleveli Yekuphuma ngamunye netimojula tawo, ngeWord noma Excel. Idala tigaba tekufundza, tinike emagama, futsi ifaka yonkhe imojula leyibhekene nayo.
qualPage.nextStepHow.from: Upload your alignment document: the one mapping each Exit Level Outcome to its modules, in Word or Excel. It creates the study units, names them, and places every module it covers.

qualPage.unplacedOne.from: 1 module belongs to no study unit.

qualPage.unplaced.from: {count} modules belong to no study unit.

qualPage.unplacedWhy.text: {modules}. Umojula lokungekho sigaba sekufundza lesiwufundzisako ngumojula longekho umuntfu lowufundzisako, noma ngabe kharikhulamu yawo ibhalwe ngalokuphelele kanganani.
qualPage.unplacedWhy.from: {modules}. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches, however completely its curriculum has been captured.

qualPage.noElo.text: Akuhambisani nanoma yimuphi Umphumela Weleveli Yekuphuma
qualPage.noElo.from: Aligned to no Exit Level Outcome

qualPage.eisaTests.text: Emagunya ekuhlola lahlangene nako: lokuhlolwa yi-EISA
qualPage.eisaTests.from: Associated assessment criteria: what the EISA tests

qualPage.noModules.from: This study unit delivers no modules.

qualPage.documentsIntro.text: Lokufayelwe lapha ngemakhophi asemtsetfweni: emadokhumenti emtfombo lelikhwalifikheshini lakhelwe kuwo, ngamunye ubhekene nengcenye yekharikhulamu lekuyisebentelako futsi une-hash kuze kufakazelwe kutsi akashintshi.
qualPage.documentsIntro.from: Filed here are the authoritative copies: the source documents this qualification is built from, each attached to the part of the curriculum it serves and hashed so it can be proved unchanged.

qualPage.recordNotThing.text: Incwadzi yemisebenti noma kuhlola lokufayelwe lapha kurekhodi, hhayi lokusebenta kona umfundzi.
qualPage.recordNotThing.from: A workbook or an assessment filed here is a record, not the thing a learner works on.

qualPage.recordWhy.text: Loko kufundvwa kufakwe kubukwe esikrinini, ngako umfundzi uphendvula epulatifomu futsi umsekeli uyaphawula futsi anike imibono khona. Sindzisa dokhumenti ye-Word ngaphansi kwe-Bhala esistimini hhayi lapha, futsi ibe yimibuto ngekwayo. Tincwadzi, tinkombandlela netishidi tekusayina kwasemsebentini tehlukile: tihlala njengemadokhumenti, ngobe umsekeli uyatichazela futsi umqeqeshi uyasayina ephepheni.
qualPage.recordWhy.from: Those are read in and presented on screen, so a learner answers in the platform and a facilitator marks and comments there. Upload the Word document under Capture rather than here, and it becomes the questions themselves. Handbooks, guides and workplace sign-off sheets are different: they stay as documents, because a facilitator annotates them and a coach signs them on paper.

qualPage.notTranscribed.from: Not yet transcribed from the curriculum document.

qualPage.iac.from: Internal assessment criteria: what must be achieved

qualPage.workplaceNone.text: Akukho emagunya ekuhlola, lokulungile kulwati lwasemsebentini: lufakazelwa ngerekhodi lesayinwe lemsebenti hhayi lokuhlolwa ngemagunya.
qualPage.workplaceNone.from: No assessment criteria, which is right for work experience: it is proved by a signed record of the work rather than judged against criteria.

qualPage.neverAchieved.text: Akukho emagunya ekuhlola, ngako lesihloko singeke sifezekiswe.
qualPage.neverAchieved.from: No assessment criteria, so this topic can never be achieved.

removeQual.cannotWhy.text: Kunelokurekhodiwe ngalo, futsi pulatifomu iyakugcina. Yiko lokubutwa yi-QCTO uma ihlola, futsi kuhlala lapha ngemuva kwelikhwalifikheshini lelirekhodwe ngaphansi kwalo.
removeQual.cannotWhy.from: Things have been recorded against it, and the platform keeps them. They are what a QCTO audit asks about, and they outlive the qualification they were recorded under.

removeQual.canWhy.text: Akukho lokurekhodiwe ngalo (akukho mfundzi lobhalisiwe, akukho kuhlala kuhlolwa lokubhalisiwe futsi akukho Sitatimende Semiphumela lesikhishiwe), ngako lingasuswa. Loku akukwati kuhlehliswa.
removeQual.canWhy.from: Nothing has been recorded against it (no learner is enrolled, no sitting is registered and no Statement of Results has been issued) so it can be removed. This cannot be undone.

removeQual.wouldTake.text: Kutawususwa nako {items}, kanye netihloko tonkhe, tincenye, emagunya nemadokhumenti lafayelwe ngaphansi kwato.
removeQual.wouldTake.from: It would take {items} with it, along with every topic, element, criterion and filed document beneath them.

captureList.intro.text: Loku sekukulepulatifomu. Kubhala lokunye esistimini kufundza imibuto yako efayeleni le-Word futsi kuhambisana nenkombandlela yetiphendvulo lefayelwe eceleni; akukho lokusindziswa futsi. Lokuphakanyiswako kukhonjiswa kuwe ngaphambi kwekutsi lutfo lube ngukuhlolwa.
captureList.intro.from: These are already in the platform. Capturing one reads its questions out of the Word file and pairs the answer guide filed beside it; nothing is uploaded again. What it proposes is shown to you before any of it becomes an assessment.

captureList.all.text: Tonkhe tibhalwe esistimini: {count}. Bafundzi bangatiphendvula esikrinini.
captureList.all.from: All {count} captured. Learners can answer these on screen.

captureList.noGuide.text: akukho nkombandlela yetiphendvulo lefayelwe: umbuto ngamunye ungadzinga tiphendvulo natimaki tawo ngesandla
captureList.noGuide.from: no answer guide filed: every question would need its answer and marks by hand

uploader.kindNote.text: Matriksi yekuhambisana kwekharikhulamu iyafundvwa futsi igcinwe: lokushiwo ngayo ngalolunye lumugca wekharikhulamu kuyarekhodwa.
uploader.kindNote.from: A curriculum alignment matrix is read as well as stored: what it says about each curriculum line is recorded.

uploader.titleHint.text: Uma kushiywe kungenalutfo, kusetjentiswa ligama lefayela
uploader.titleHint.from: Left blank, the file name is used

uploader.versionNote.text: Kusindzisa futsi ngeluhlobo lolufanako nesihloko lesifanako kufaka indzawo yalokwendlulile kunekukuchibiyela; inguqulo yendzala iyahlala.
uploader.versionNote.from: Uploading again with the same kind and title supersedes the previous one rather than replacing it; the old version stays.

uploader.fileNote.text: Word, Excel, PowerPoint ne-PDF. Lokungilona ifayela ngempela kuvela kulokusekhatsini kwalo, hhayi ligama laso.
uploader.fileNote.from: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF. What the file actually is comes from its contents, not its name.

uploader.inMatrix.from: In the matrix, not in the curriculum as held

uploader.inMatrixNote.text: Lunye ngalunye lengetwa lufakwe luphawu njengekwakho, nesizatfu sikhonjisiwe, kuze umhloli akwati kwehlukanisa emalayini akho nalawomlawuli. Susa luphawu kunoma yini lengafanele yengetwe.
uploader.inMatrixNote.from: Each is added marked as your own, with the reason shown, so a verifier can always tell your lines from the regulator's. Untick anything that should not be added.

uploader.add.from: Add the ticked lines to the curriculum

buildCurr.intro.text: Yifake njengoba dokhumenti yekharikhulamu iyinyatsela, ngemakhodi lafanako ngendlela lefanako, kuze emabili afundvwe eceleni kwalelinye. Ngamunye umugca ugcinwa njengoba uwufaka.
buildCurr.intro.from: Enter it as the curriculum document prints it, with the same codes in the same order, so the two can be read side by side. Every line saves as you enter it.

buildCurr.ready.text: Kulungele lokufundvwako. Timojula {modules} nemaligunya {criteria} sekungenile, ngako umbuto ungamakwa kulokuwufakazelako.
buildCurr.ready.from: Ready for material. {modules} modules and {criteria} criteria are in, so a question can be tagged to what it evidences.

buildCurr.whatItIsNote.text: Lisetwe uma lingeniswa, futsi lingalungiswa lapha. Likhwalifikheshini lelipheleleko linekharikhulamu yalo; lelengcenye noma luhlelo lwemakhono likhetsa timojula kulenye.
buildCurr.whatItIsNote.from: Set when it was imported, and correctable here. A full qualification has its own curriculum; a part or a skills programme selects modules from one.

buildCurr.faultsNote.text: Akusiyo sivalo: ungahamba bese uyabuya. Nobe kunjalo, lokulandzelako ngakunye yintfo lepulatifomu lengeke ikwati kuyigwema kamuva.
buildCurr.faultsNote.from: Not a gate: you can leave and come back. Each of these, though, is something the platform cannot work around later.

addModule.note.text: Umojula welwati lwasemsebentini ufakazelwa yilogibhuku lelisayinwa ngumqeqeshi, hhayi ngemaligunya ekuhlola, ngako uthatha imisebenti yasemsebentini kunalokho.
addModule.note.from: A work experience module is evidenced by a logbook a coach signs, not by assessment criteria, so it takes work activities instead.

addModule.nameHint.from: As the curriculum document titles it

editor.addElement.from: Add a line of what must be taught

editor.wordedHint.from: As the curriculum document words it

editor.noCriteria.text: Umojula welwati lwasemsebentini awunawo. Ufakazelwa yilogibhuku lelisayinwa ngumqeqeshi futsi lemukelwa ngumhloli, ngako imisebenti yawo yasemsebentini ifakwa etihlokweni letingenhla.
editor.noCriteria.from: A work experience module carries none. It is evidenced by a logbook the coach signs and an assessor accepts, so its work activities go in the topics above.

reclassify.lockedOne.text: Akukwati kushintshwa: umfundzi munye ubhalisiwe kukona. Kubhaliswa kwenta nge-ID yeluhlelo ngalunye, futsi kushintsha lokutsi lena yini kutawushintsha kutsi bahlolwa ngato tiphi timojula, ngako nekutsi kufanele bente ini kuze bapheteke. Uma ngempela kuyintfo lengafanele, dala lefanele bese ubabhalisa kuyo.
reclassify.lockedOne.from: It cannot be changed: 1 learner is enrolled on it. Enrolment is per programme ID, and changing what this is would change which modules they are assessed against, and so what they have to do to finish. If it is genuinely the wrong sort of thing, create the right one and enrol them onto that.

reclassify.locked.text: Akukwati kushintshwa: bafundzi {count} babhalisiwe kukona. Kubhaliswa kwenta nge-ID yeluhlelo ngalunye, futsi kushintsha lokutsi lena yini kutawushintsha kutsi bahlolwa ngato tiphi timojula, ngako nekutsi kufanele bente ini kuze bapheteke. Uma ngempela kuyintfo lengafanele, dala lefanele bese ubabhalisa kuyo.
reclassify.locked.from: It cannot be changed: {count} learners are enrolled on it. Enrolment is per programme ID, and changing what this is would change which modules they are assessed against, and so what they have to do to finish. If it is genuinely the wrong sort of thing, create the right one and enrol them onto that.

reclassify.parentNote.text: Ingcenye ayinalo lidokhumenti lekharikhulamu yayo: isebentisa leliyalo lelingumzali, futsi ikhetsa timojula kulo.
reclassify.parentNote.from: A part has no curriculum document of its own: it uses its parent's, and selects modules from it.

reclassify.ownModulesOne.text: Lelikhwalifikheshini linemojula yinye yekharikhulamu yalo, kusukela lapho lingeniswa khona. Isala lapho isekhona: kulirekhoda njengengcenye akuyisusi, futsi wena ukhetsa ngekwehlukana kutsi likhetsa yiphi imojula kulelikhwalifikheshini lelingumzali.
reclassify.ownModulesOne.from: This qualification has 1 module of its own curriculum, from when it was imported. It stays where it is: recording it as a part does not delete it, and you choose separately which of the parent's modules it selects.

reclassify.ownModules.text: Lelikhwalifikheshini linetimojula {count} tekharikhulamu yalo, kusukela lapho lingeniswa khona. Tisala lapho tisekhona: kulirekhoda njengengcenye akutisusi, futsi wena ukhetsa ngekwehlukana kutsi likhetsa timojula tiphi kulelikhwalifikheshini lelingumzali.
reclassify.ownModules.from: This qualification has {count} modules of its own curriculum, from when it was imported. Those stay where they are: recording it as a part does not delete them, and you choose separately which of the parent's modules it selects.

reclassify.selectedOne.text: Umojula munye lokhetfwe kulelingumzali utawususwa. Likhwalifikheshini lelipheleleko alikhetsi lutfo kunoma ngumuphi, futsi kuwushiya kungawenta uchubeke ubalwa emakhredithini alo.
reclassify.selectedOne.from: The 1 module selected from its parent will be cleared. A full qualification selects nothing from anybody, and leaving it would keep it counting towards its credits.

reclassify.selected.text: Timojula {count} letikhetfwe kulelingumzali titawususwa. Likhwalifikheshini lelipheleleko alikhetsi lutfo kunoma ngumuphi, futsi kutishiya kungatenta tichubeke tibalwa emakhredithini alo.
reclassify.selected.from: The {count} modules selected from its parent will be cleared. A full qualification selects nothing from anybody, and leaving them would keep them counting towards its credits.

takeDoc.readFrom.text: Kufundvwe ku-{file}. Akukabi khona lutfo lokungetiwe ngasentfo: vula umojula, uyihlole ngedokhumenti, bese uyayitsatsa uma ilungile.
takeDoc.readFrom.from: Read from {file}. Nothing below has been added yet: open a module, check it against the document, and take it if it is right.

takeDoc.goToDocuments.from: Go to the documents for this qualification

takeDoc.notesNote.text: Lokungakhange kubalwe ekufundveni, nalokungahlangani kudokhumenti uqobo. Akukho lokuvimbela kutsi utsatse umojula, nobe kunjalo kokubili kufanele kufundvwe kucala.
takeDoc.notesNote.from: What the reading could not account for, and what the document itself does not add up. Neither stops you taking a module, though both are worth reading first.

takeDoc.addedCounts.from: Added {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} criteria.

takeDoc.byHand.from: Add these by hand on the curriculum screen.

takeDoc.empty.text: Akukho lokufundvwe ngaphansi kwalomojula. Kuwutsatsa kutawudala umojula kuphela, futsi tihloko tawo tingengetwa ngesandla.
takeDoc.empty.from: Nothing was read under this module. Taking it will create the module alone, and its topics can be added by hand.

element.asWorded.text: {kind}, ngco njengoba lidokhumenti yekharikhulamu lilibhale. Akukho lokungachibiyelwa kulelikhasi lapha: kharikhulamu lekhishiwe yeyi-QCTO, hhayi yemhlinzeki.
element.asWorded.from: {kind}, exactly as the curriculum document words it. Nothing on this page may be edited here: a published curriculum is the QCTO's, not the provider's.

element.coversNote.text: Kusuka eMatriksini Yekuhambisana Kwekharikhulamu, njengoba umhlinzeki ayibhale lapho.
element.coversNote.from: From the Curriculum Alignment Matrix, as the provider wrote it there.

element.uncovered.from: Nothing is recorded as covering this line.

element.uncoveredNote.text: Loko kusho likhefu lelingiliciniso eluhlelweni noma matriksi lengakalayidwa. Layida Matriksi Yekuhambisana Kwekharikhulamu kulelikhwalifikheshini bese wonkhe umugca lawubiza ugcwaliswa kanyekanye.
element.uncoveredNote.from: That is either a real gap in the programme or a matrix that has not been uploaded yet. Upload the Curriculum Alignment Matrix against this qualification and every line it names is filled in at once.

element.notHeld.text: kubhalwe ematriksini, kodvwa akukho dokhumenti lesakhona lapha lelinaleligama.
element.notHeld.from: named in the matrix, but no document held here has that name.

element.assessedNote.text: Emaligunya ekuhlola langekhatsi esihloko lomugca lona longaso.
element.assessedNote.from: The internal assessment criteria of the topic this line belongs to.

element.workplace.text: Umojula welwati lwasemsebentini awunamaligunya ekuhlola. Lokudzingako kufakazelwa yirekhodi lelisayiniwe lemsebenti uqobo, lemukelwe ngumhloli, kunekutsi kuhlolwe ngemaligunya.
element.workplace.from: A work experience module has no assessment criteria. What it requires is evidenced by a signed record of the work itself, accepted by an assessor, rather than judged against criteria.

element.noCriteria.text: Lesihloko asinamaligunya ekuhlola, ngako akukho lokungatfolakala lapha. Kuze kube atsatfwa kudokhumenti yekharikhulamu, akekho umfundzi longaphetsa lomojula.
element.noCriteria.from: This topic has no assessment criteria, so nothing here can ever be achieved. Until they are captured from the curriculum document, no learner can complete this module.

element.taughtNote.text: Tigaba tekufundza lapho lomojula ufundziswa khona.
element.taughtNote.from: The study units this module is delivered in.

partModules.introPart.text: Lelikhwalifikheshini lengcenye lithathwe ku-{parent} futsi lisabelana ngekharikhulamu yalo{code}. Phawula timojula ledokhumenti yalo ye-SAQA letibhala ngaphansi kwe-{rules}. Akukho lokukopishwako: umsebenti wemfundzi kulemojula ubalwa kanye, noma ngabe bahlangana nayo kuphi.
partModules.introPart.from: This part qualification is drawn from {parent} and shares its curriculum{code}. Tick the modules its own SAQA document lists under {rules}. Nothing is copied: a learner's work against a module counts once, wherever they met it.

partModules.introOther.text: Lolu hlelo luthathwe ku-{parent} futsi lusabelana ngekharikhulamu yalo{code}. Phawula timojula ledokhumenti yalo ye-SAQA letibhala ngaphansi kwe-{rules}. Akukho lokukopishwako: umsebenti wemfundzi kulemojula ubalwa kanye, noma ngabe bahlangana nayo kuphi.
partModules.introOther.from: This programme is drawn from {parent} and shares its curriculum{code}. Tick the modules its own SAQA document lists under {rules}. Nothing is copied: a learner's work against a module counts once, wherever they met it.

partModules.notRead.from: The parent's curriculum has not been read in yet

partModules.notReadNote.text: Akukho lokungakhetfwa kuze kube {parent} ifundvwe dokhumenti yayo yekharikhulamu. Kwenta loko kucala, futsi loluhlu luyagcwala ngekwalo.
partModules.notReadNote.from: There is nothing to choose from until {parent} has its curriculum document read in. Do that first, and this list fills itself.

partModules.noClaim.text: Alikho inani lonkhe lemakhredithi lelirekhodiwe kulelikhwalifikheshini, ngako akukho lokungahlolwa ngako. Dokhumenti yalo ye-SAQA iyalishito ngaphansi kwe-Minimum Credits.
partModules.noClaim.from: No credit total is recorded for this qualification, so there is nothing to check against. Its SAQA document states one under Minimum Credits.

partModules.agree.text: Loku kuyahambisana, kube kuyinkhomba yekutsi timojula letifanele tiphawulwe.
partModules.agree.from: These agree, which is the sign the right modules are ticked.

partModules.disagree.text: Loku akuhambisani. Noma kuphawulwe umojula lodokhumenti ye-SAQA ingawubhali, noma kushoda lobhaliwe, noma emakhredithi emojula afundvwe kabi. Kufanele kuhlolwe ngaphambi kwekugcina; nobe kunjalo pulatifomu itawugcina loko lokutsi kuyo.
partModules.disagree.from: These do not agree. Either a module is ticked that the SAQA document does not list, or one it lists is missing, or the credits on a module were read in wrongly. Worth checking before saving; the platform will still save what you tell it.

qualPreview.title.from: As a learner will see it

qualPreview.intro.text: {programme} yonkhe ngalolandzelano lolulandzelwa ngumuntfu lobhalisiwe kuyo. Akukho lokucalako lapha: akukho kubhalisa lokwentiwako, akukho mzamo lovulwako futsi akukho kuchubeka lokurekhodwako, ngako loku kungafundvwa kaningi njengoba ufisa.
qualPreview.intro.from: The whole {programme} in the order somebody enrolled on it walks it. Nothing here starts anything: no enrolment is made, no attempt is opened and no progress is recorded, so this can be read as often as you like.

qualPreview.gaps.from: What a learner would not find

qualPreview.allReadyNote.text: Sinyatselo ngasinye kulesigaba ngasinye sekufundza sinalokusisekelako. Umfundzi lobhalisiwe kulo {programme} lamuhla angatfola sonkhe.
qualPreview.allReadyNote.from: Every step in every study unit has something behind it. A learner enrolled on this {programme} today would find the whole of it.

qualPreview.build.from: Build what a learner works through

qualPreview.open.from: Open it as a learner sees it

qualPreview.change.from: Change the order or what is on it

courseList.noneAuthor.text: Sifundvo yilokusebenta kona ngempela umfundzi. Sixhumana nesigaba sekufundza noma umojula wekharikhulamu, ngako kufanele kucale kulayidwe likhwalifikheshini.
courseList.noneAuthor.from: A course is what a learner actually works through. It hangs off a study unit or a curriculum module, so a qualification is worth loading first.

courseList.noneReader.text: Akukabi khona lokushicilelwe kuwe. Uma sekushicilelwe, lokubhalisele kona kutawuba lapha.
courseList.noneReader.from: Nothing has been published for you yet. When it has been, what you are enrolled on will be here.

newCourse.noModule.from: Not part of an accredited qualification

newCourse.moduleNote.text: Yihlanganisele nemojula yekharikhulamu bese sistimu itawuhlola, ngaphambi kwekutsi ishicilelwe, kutsi ligunya lekuhlola ngalinye kulemojula line-lesoni lelilisekelako.
newCourse.moduleNote.from: Bind it to a curriculum module and the system will check, before it can be published, that every assessment criterion in that module has a lesson behind it.

courseEdit.published.text: Loku kushicilelwe, ngako lokukuko kumisiwe. Bafundzi labaphetse kukhona banemarekhodi lacondzana ngco nalenguqulo.
courseEdit.published.from: This is published, so its content is fixed. Learners who completed it have records that refer to exactly this version.

courseEdit.publishedAuthor.text: Kuze ukushintshe, vula inguqulo lensha; leshicilelwe isala injalo.
courseEdit.publishedAuthor.from: To change it, open a new version; the published one stays as it is.

courseEdit.folderNote.text: Khetsa ifolda lapho lokufundvwa kuhlala khona bese konkhe lokukuyo, kufaka nemafolda lamancane, kufundvwa, kufayelwa futsi kufakwe inkhomba. Ubona lokungakufayela ngaphambi kwekutsi kubhalwe lutfo.
courseEdit.folderNote.from: Choose the folder this material lives in and everything in it, including its subfolders, is read, filed and indexed. You see what it would file before anything is written.

courseEdit.folderLabel.from: Its folder, from your own computer

courseEdit.folderHint.text: Tinkhombandlela, tincwadzi temisebenti, tinqubomgomo nemathempulethi kufayelwa kuyo futsi umbhalo wato ufakwe inkhomba kuze tifinyeleleke ekucheshweni.
courseEdit.folderHint.from: Guides, workbooks, policies and templates are filed against it and their text indexed so they can be searched.

courseEdit.folderHint2.text: Sakhiwo asidalwa lapha: sakhiwo saso sakhiwa esihlelini lesingenhla noma kutimojula zelikhwalifikheshini. Loku kufayela lokukuyo.
courseEdit.folderHint2.from: Structure is not created from here: its own shape is built in the editor above or from a qualification's modules. This files what it holds.

courseEdit.drive.from: Or from a drive you have connected

courseEdit.driveNote.text: Ifolda lefanako, ifundvwe lapho isivele ikhona. Iphetsa endzaweni lefanako: siphakamiso sekuhlolwa ngaphambi kwekutsi kubhalwe lutfo.
courseEdit.driveNote.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

courseEdit.noSections.text: Akukabi khona tincenye. Yakhiwa ngetincenye, futsi ingcenye ngayinye inemalesoni.
courseEdit.noSections.from: No sections yet. It is built from sections, and each section holds lessons.

courseEdit.noLessons.from: No lessons in this section yet.

courseEdit.competenciesNote.text: Lokufakazelwa kuyiphetsa. Ayikwati kushicilelwa ingenalo likhono, ngobe kuphetsa kwayo kungeke kubikwe njengekhono.
courseEdit.competenciesNote.from: What completing it demonstrates. It cannot be published with no competency, because its completions could not be reported as capability.

courseEdit.coveredAcross.text: kusuka ku-{count} emaligunya ekuhlola lambatsiwe kuto tonkhe timojula ta-{unit}
courseEdit.coveredAcross.from: of {count} assessment criteria covered across {unit}'s modules

courseEdit.coveredNote.text: Kwembatswe yilesoni lelikhona lapha, umbuto kwelinye lekuhlolwa kwalo lohlobene nalo, noma yilokubhalwe ngumatriksi wakho wekuhambisana njengalokuhlolako. Layida matriksi kulikhwalifikheshini kuze urekhode lokugcina.
courseEdit.coveredNote.from: Covered by a lesson here, a question on one of its assessments that is linked to it, or what your alignment matrix names as assessing it. Upload the matrix on the qualification to record the last.

courseEdit.unbound.text: Loku akuhlanganiswanga nemojula yekharikhulamu lelagunyaziwe, ngako akukho maligunya ekuhlola lokufanele kwembatswe.
courseEdit.unbound.from: This is not bound to an accredited curriculum module, so there are no assessment criteria to cover.

courseEdit.publishNote.text: Kushicilela kuyaliwa nangabe kukhona lokungakaphelelanga ngenhla.
courseEdit.publishNote.from: Publishing is refused while anything above is incomplete.

courseEdit.newVersionNote.text: Bafundzi labaphetse lenguqulo bagcina irekhodi layo.
courseEdit.newVersionNote.from: Learners who completed this version keep their record of it.

spine.intro.text: Ulandzelano lolulandzelwa kulo {course}, nalokuvala sinyatselo ngasinye kuze kuphele lesendlulile. Konkhe lapha sekuvele kugcinwe kulo {course}: kukubeka elukhwini kwenta umfundzi ahlangane nako.
spine.intro.from: The order this {course} is walked in, and what holds each step shut until the one before it is done. Everything here is already held against this {course}: putting it on the list is what makes a learner meet it.

spine.empty.text: Akukabi khona lokukuyo, ngako umfundzi lobhalisiwe kuyo angayivula atfole likhasi lelilite. Engeta lokucala ngentasi.
spine.empty.from: Nothing is on it yet, so a learner enrolled on it would open it and find an empty page. Add the first thing below.

spine.waitsForBefore.from: Waits for the step before it to be {rule}.

spine.nothingLeft.text: Konkhe lokugcinwe kuyo sekuvele kusenhlwini. Bamba incwadzi yemisebenti noma ufayele dokhumenti kuyo, futsi itawuvela lapha.
spine.nothingLeft.from: Everything held against it is already on the list. Capture a workbook or file a document against it, and it will appear here.

spine.openAtStart.text: Kuvulekile kusukela ekucaleni, kunekulandzela sinyatselo lesendlulile
spine.openAtStart.from: Open from the start, rather than after the step before it

courseAssess.intro.text: Sivivinyo sekutfutfukisa siphawulwa ngokutsi ngekwaso. Kuhlolwa kwekugcina kuhlala kuhlulelwa ngumuntfu futsi kulinganiswa ngokuzimela, ngobe kwenta kuhlolwa lokubalwa kulikhwalifikheshini.
courseAssess.intro.from: A formative quiz is marked automatically. A summative assessment is always judged by a person and always moderated independently, because it is the one that counts towards a qualification.

courseAssess.options.from: Answer options: tick every one that is correct

courseAssess.published.text: Kushicilelwe. Umfundzi uhlangana nako uma sekuba sinyatselo ku-{link}.
courseAssess.published.from: Published. A learner meets it once it is a step in {link}.

courseAssess.sampleNote.text: Ngusisekelo, hhayi sicongo. Bungako beliqoqo buyalenyusa: liqoqo lebantfu labalishumi noma lokuncane lilinganiswa lonkhe, nelabamashumi lamabili noma lokuncane lilinganiswa ngesigamu, ngobe kwesine kwemasikripthi lasishiyagalombili kungemabili, futsi lamabili awasho cishe lutfo ngekwahlulela kwemhloli. Lenani lilawula emaqoqo langetulu kwamashumi lamabili. Alinakwa kuhlolwa kwekugcina, lapho sonkhe sinqumo silinganiswa khona, futsi umhloli lobhalise nje kusha ulinganiswa lonkhe sikhatsi.
courseAssess.sampleNote.from: A floor, not a ceiling. Cohort size raises it: a cohort of ten or fewer is moderated in full and one of twenty or fewer at half, because a quarter of eight scripts is two, and two say almost nothing about an assessor's judgement. This figure governs cohorts above twenty. Ignored for a summative assessment, where every decision is moderated, and a newly registered assessor is always moderated in full.

courseEnrol.draft.text: Loku kusengumdvwebo. Kufanele kushicilelwe ngaphambi kwekutsi kunikwe noma ngubani: umdvwebo awukakadluli kuhlolwa lokucinisekisa kutsi lokukuwo kwembatsa lokushoko.
courseEnrol.draft.from: This is still a draft. It has to be published before anyone can be assigned to it: a draft has not passed the checks that confirm its content covers what it claims to.

courseEnrol.waitingNote.text: Umfundzi ngamunye uvela kanye, esinyatselweni sekucala lesingakwati kusivula. Kubambeleka esinyatselweni sesitsatfu kuyiciniso lekufanele kwentiwe ngalo; nekubambeleka etinyatselweni tesine kuya kuletilishumi kuyimisindvo nje.
courseEnrol.waitingNote.from: Each learner appears once, at the earliest step they cannot open. Being held up at step three is the fact worth acting on; also being held up at steps four to ten is noise.

courseEnrol.everyone.from: Everyone in the organisation is already on it.

courseEnrol.manyNote.text: Namathisela emakheli e-imeyili, lelilodvwa emgceni ngamunye. Ikholamu lekopishwe ngco kusuka kushidi lemafomula iyasebenta.
courseEnrol.manyNote.from: Paste email addresses, one per line. A column copied straight out of a spreadsheet works.

settings.intro.text: Kutsi {name} ibukeka njani kubantfu bakho, nekutsi i-App ifundza njani emadokhumenti labalayida. Tinguquko tisebenta yonkhe indzawo ngco: akukho lokufanele kwakhiwe kabusha noma kufakwe kabusha.
settings.intro.from: How {name} looks to your people, and how the App reads the documents they upload. Changes apply everywhere immediately: there is nothing to rebuild or redeploy.

settings.drive.connected.text: Kuxhumekile. Ifolda ingafundvwa ngco kuyo nyalo.
settings.drive.connected.from: Connected. A folder can now be read straight from it.

settings.drive.cancelled.from: Nothing was connected: the consent was cancelled.

settings.drive.state.text: Lemvume ayifani nalena lebrawuza lecale ngayo, ngako akukho lokuxhunyiwe. Cala kabusha kulelikhasi.
settings.drive.state.from: That consent did not match the one this browser started, so nothing was connected. Start again from this page.

settings.drive.nocode.text: Umhlinzeki akatfumelanga lutfo lekuxhuma ngato. Zama futsi.
settings.drive.nocode.from: The provider sent nothing back to connect with. Try again.

settings.drive.failed.text: Kuxhuma akukwatanga kuphela. Akukho lokugcinwe. Kuzama futsi kuncono kwenta ngaphambi kwanoma yini.
settings.drive.failed.from: The connection could not be completed. Nothing was stored. Trying again is worth doing before anything else.

settings.mailNote.text: Kutsi bafundzi bangatitfola yini ngempela timininingwane tabo tekungena nemaziso. Kufanele kuhlolwe ngemuva kwekutsi noma ngubani ashintsha tinkhetho temeyili, futsi kuyintfo yekucala yekuhlola uma umuntfu asho kutsi i-imeyili ayizange ifike.
settings.mailNote.from: Whether learners can actually receive their sign-in details and notifications. Worth checking after anybody changes the mail settings, and the first thing to check when somebody says an email never arrived.

settings.sso.from: Signing in with Google or Microsoft

settings.ssoNote.text: Kuvumela bantfu bakho kutsi bangene ngeakhawunti yenhlangano yabo ye-Google noma ye-Microsoft esikhundleni sephasiwedi lapha, leyachubeka isebenta eceleni kwako. Kungenisa kuphela bantfu labasivele nayo akhawunti kulepulatifomu, lefaniswa ngelikheli le-imeyili ngekwekucala; ayiyidali nakanye.
settings.ssoNote.from: Lets your people sign in with their organisation's Google or Microsoft account instead of a password here, which keeps working beside it. It only signs in people who already have an account on this platform, matched by email address the first time; it never creates one.

settings.terminologyNote.text: Sebentisa emagama akho. Umhlinzeki longaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika angeke asho luhlelo, futsi umhlinzeki lokuyo angeke asho sifundvo; lepulatifomu akufanele iphikelele.
settings.terminologyNote.from: Use your own vocabulary. A provider outside South Africa may not say programme, and a provider inside it may not say course; the platform should not insist.

settings.templatesNote.text: Kutsi dokhumenti ngalinye lelikhishwa ngulomhlinzeki lifundvwa futsi libukeka njani.
settings.templatesNote.from: How each document this provider issues reads and looks.

settings.templatesMoved.text: nyalo ngaphansi kwe-Kuphatfwa, kanye nawo onkhe emadokhumenti lakhiwa yipulatifomu nekutsi ngubani lotfola lilinye ngalinye.
settings.templatesMoved.from: now under Management, with every document the platform produces and who receives each one.

settings.menuNote.text: Hlela kabusha libha lelingetulu: shintsha ligama lesihloko, shukumisa likhasi ulifake ngaphansi kwelinye, noma wente likhasi libe sixhumanisi sangco. Kufanako kubo bonkhe kulomhlinzeki, ngobe basebenti batjelana kutsi tintfo tikuphi.
settings.menuNote.from: Rearrange the bar at the top: rename a heading, move a page under a different one, or make a page a direct link. The same for everybody at this provider, because staff tell each other where things are.

settings.drivesNote.text: Fundza ifolda ngco kusuka ku-Google Drive noma ku-OneDrive, esikhundleni sekuyidawunilodha bese uyayilayida futsi. Yakho hhayi yalomhlinzeki: lilunga ngalinye lebasebenti lixhuma layo.
settings.drivesNote.from: Read a folder straight from Google Drive or OneDrive, instead of downloading it and uploading it again. Yours rather than this provider's: every member of staff connects their own.

settings.extensionNote.text: Ngeprofayli yakho. Ngekukhetsa, icishiwe ngekuvamile, futsi lokuyivumela kutsi wente kulinganiswe ngendzima yakho njengoba nakho konkhe lokunye kunjalo.
settings.extensionNote.from: Against your own profile. Optional, off by default, and what it lets you do is bounded by your role exactly as everything else is.

providerLang.note.text: Lulwimi lapho bantfu bakho bafundza khona lepulatifomu, ngaphandle kwekutsi bakhetse lolwabo ngaphansi kweligama labo etulu ekhasini. Tikrini letingakahunyushwa tihlala esiNgisini, futsi emagama akho ekubita tintfo (Tinkhetho, Emagama) agcinwa njengoba uwabhale kuwo onkhe emalwimi.
providerLang.note.from: The language your people read the platform in, unless they choose their own under their name at the top of the page. Screens not yet translated stay in English, and your own names for things (Settings, Terminology) are kept as you wrote them in every language.

brand.accentNote.from: Highlights, progress bars and certificate borders.

brand.logoNote.text: Livela ekhanda lelingetulu, ekhasini lekungena nakusitifiketi ngasinye. I-PNG lenemvelaphi lebonakalako ihlala kahle kakhulu ekhalarini lekhanda. Ingephasi kwe-2 MB.
brand.logoNote.from: Appears in the header, on the sign-in page and on every certificate. A PNG with a transparent background sits best on the header colour. Under 2 MB.

brand.unfinished.text: Kulayida akuphelanga. Hlola uxhumo lwakho bese uyazama futsi.
brand.unfinished.from: The upload did not finish. Check the connection and try again.

brand.removeLogo.from: Remove, and show the name instead

brand.logoAddress.text: Noma likheli, uma sitfombe sesivele sigcinwe kwenye indzawo
brand.logoAddress.from: Or an address, if the image is already hosted elsewhere

brand.signInNote.text: Ngekukhetsa. Uma kungekho lutfo lapha likhasi likhombisa ligama lakho ekhalarini yakho, loko kuhlantekile kodvwa kulula. Sitfombe lesitsi lutfo lweliciniso ngalokwentako sinenani lelikhulu kunalesehlobisako.
brand.signInNote.from: Optional. With nothing here the page shows your name on your own colour, which is tidy but plain. A graphic that says something true about what you do is worth more than a decorative one.

brand.characterNote.text: Kuvela esikrinini lesingakabi nalutfo, eceleni kwemusho lochaza kutsi kutawuba yini lapho, nasecaleni kwebhathini lokufanele umuntfu alicindzete lelilandzelako, lapho kukhona khona kuze kubonakale. Kuncane, kuqondile, futsi kuhlobene kakhulu kunekuba sihlobiso. Shiya kungenalutfo kuze usebentise lokwepulatifomu, noma ungasebentisi lutfo nhlobo.
brand.characterNote.from: Appears on a screen with nothing on it yet, beside the sentence explaining what would be there, and beside a button somebody has to press next, where it is there to be noticed. Small, upright, and friendlier than it is decorative. Leave it empty to use this platform's own, or nothing at all.

shape.intro.text: Imibuto lemibili inquma sakhiwo sepulatifomu yakho nekutsi tingcenye tayo tibitwa ngani. Konkhe longakakhetsi kuyanyamalala: tikrini tako, tintfo tako temenyu netakheli takho.
shape.intro.from: Two questions decide the shape of your platform and what its parts are called. Everything you do not choose goes away: its screens, its menu entries and its addresses.

shape.nothingDeletedNote.text: Kushintsha loku kufihla tintfo. Konkhe lokusevele kurekhodiwe kusala lapho kukhona, futsi kukhetsa kabusha kubuyisa tikrini nemarekhodi ingashintshile.
shape.nothingDeletedNote.from: Changing this hides things. Whatever has already been recorded stays where it is, and choosing it again brings the screens back with the records intact.

shape.saved.text: Kugcinwe. Imenyu nemagama kushintshe kuze kuhambisane.
shape.saved.from: Saved. The menu and the wording have changed to match.

shape.unavailable.text: Akutfolakali ngalokukhetfwe ngenhla. Sigaba sekufundza sisekhatsi kwelikhwalifikheshini, futsi lepulatifomu ayinalo.
shape.unavailable.from: Not available with the choice above. A study unit sits inside a qualification, and this platform has none.

shape.standalone.from: Three things that stand on their own

shape.statutoryCovers.text: Kuphumisa kwe-NLRD ne-Edu.Dex, emabuyiselo e-WSP ne-ATR, nerejista yasemtsetfweni lesekela loko.
shape.statutoryCovers.from: NLRD and Edu.Dex exports, WSP and ATR returns, and the statutory register behind them.

shape.statutoryWhen.text: ungaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika, noma kukhona lomunye lofayela egameni lakho.
shape.statutoryWhen.from: you are outside South Africa, or somebody else files on your behalf.

shape.workplaceCovers.text: Tivumelwano tasemsebentini, tinkhombandlela tabaqeqeshi, emashidi ekusayina nemahora lawalogako umfundzi kumqashi lomemukelile.
shape.workplaceCovers.from: Workplace agreements, coach guides, sign off sheets and the hours a learner logs against a host employer.

shape.workplaceWhen.from: nothing you deliver is assessed in a workplace.

shape.offlineCovers.text: Bafundzi bafaka lepulatifomu kufoni yabo, badawunilodhe lokufundvwa kwabo ngaphambi kwekutsi baphume, bakufundze bangenaso signali, futsi barekhode umsebenti wabo kuze bawubuyisele uma sebaphindze bayitfola.
shape.offlineCovers.from: Learners install the platform on their phone, download their study material before they go out, read it with no signal, and record their work to send back when they next have one.

shape.offlineWhen.text: bafundzi bachitsa emalanga bangenaso signali, njengasensimini. Kuhlolwa kwekugcina kuhlala kusenthanethini ngaphandle kwekutsi luhlelo lusetwe ngenhloso ngalenye indlela.
shape.offlineWhen.from: learners spend days away from a signal, such as in the field. Summatives stay online unless a programme is deliberately set otherwise.

shape.rename.text: Ungashintsha emagama onkhe alawa ngaphansi kwe-{link}. Kuphela emagama lalesakhiwo lesisebentisa ngempela kuyanikelwa lapho.
shape.rename.from: You can rename any of these under {link}. Only the words this shape actually uses are offered there.

shape.award.qualification_programme.cove.text: Intfo yinye. Umfundzi ubekwa kulikhwalifikheshini futsi lokusebenta kona. Akukho sigaba lesihlukile sekuhlanganisa etulu kwaso.
shape.award.qualification_programme.cove.from: One thing. A learner is put onto the qualification and that is what they work through. There is no separate bundling layer above it.

shape.award.qualification_programme.when.text: Ufundzisa likhwalifikheshini lelilodvwa lemsebenti njengeluhlelo lunye lwekufundza.
shape.award.qualification_programme.when.from: You deliver one occupational qualification as one learning programme.

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: Likhwalifikheshini neluhlelo, ngekwehlukana
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: Qualification and Programme, separately

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: Tintfo letimbili letehlukile. Likhwalifikheshini liphatsa kugunyaza nekharikhulamu; luhlelo luhlanganisa lokusebenta kona umfundzi, futsi lungaphendvula kulikhwalifikheshini noma kungabi khona.
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: Two different things. A qualification holds the accreditation and the curriculum; a programme bundles what a learner works through, and may answer to a qualification or to none.

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: Uphatsa emakhwalifikheshini lagunyaziwe futsi uhlanganisa nalokufundziswako abe malandzelano langasiwo likhwalifikheshini linye ngalinye.
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: You run accredited qualifications and also bundle deliverables into sequences that are not one qualification each.

shape.award.programmes_only.covers.text: Tinhlelo tihlanganisa lokusebenta kona umfundzi. Akukho rekhodi lekugunyaza, akukho kharikhulamu, akukho titatimende temiphumela.
shape.award.programmes_only.covers.from: Programmes bundle what a learner works through. No accreditation record, no curriculum, no statements of results.

shape.award.programmes_only.when.text: Akukho lokufundziswa nguwe lokuphendvula kulikhwalifikheshini lelibhalisiwe: kwetfulwa kwabasha, kubuyeketa kwekuhambisana, tinhlelo tangekhatsi temakhono.
shape.award.programmes_only.when.from: Nothing you deliver answers to a registered qualification: induction, compliance refreshers, internal skills programmes.

shape.award.standalone.covers.text: Konkhe kuma ngakho. Akukho lokuhlanganisako futsi akukho lokugunyazako.
shape.award.standalone.covers.from: Everything stands on its own. Nothing bundles it and nothing accredits it.

shape.award.standalone.when.text: Ingcenye ngayinye yekuqeqeshwa lokuphatsako itsatfwa ngayo, yinye ngesikhatsi.
shape.award.standalone.when.from: Every piece of training you run is taken on its own, one at a time.

shape.delivery.courses.covers.text: Sifundvo yilokubekwa kona umfundzi futsi asebente ngako: emalesoni aso, tincwadzi tato temisebenti, kuhlolwa kwaso. Singaba ngaphansi keluhlelo, futsi asidzingi kuphendvula kunoma yiliphi likhwalifikheshini.
shape.delivery.courses.covers.from: A course is what a learner is put onto and works through: its lessons, its workbooks, its assessments. It may sit under a programme, and it need answer to no qualification.

shape.delivery.courses.when.text: Bantfu bakho batsi sifundvo, noma wakha kuqeqeshwa lokungalawulwa ngulikhwalifikheshini.
shape.delivery.courses.when.from: Your people say course, or you build training that no qualification governs.
