shape.delivery.study_units.covers.text: Sigaba sekufundza yilokusebenta kona umfundzi, futsi sitsatsa indzawo yesifundvo sonkhe. Sisekhatsi kwelikhwalifikheshini, sihlanganisa timojula telwati, tekwenta netasemsebentini letisebenta Umphumela Weleveli Yekuphuma munye.
shape.delivery.study_units.covers.from: A study unit is what a learner works through, and it replaces the course entirely. It sits inside a qualification, bundling the knowledge, practical and workplace modules that serve one exit level outcome.

shape.delivery.study_units.when.text: Bantfu bakho batsi sigaba sekufundza kunesifundvo. Kharikhulamu ishicilela timojula futsi ishiya kuhlanganisa kuwe, ngako lesi sakhiwo sakho. Sidzinga likhwalifikheshini etulu.
shape.delivery.study_units.when.from: Your people say study unit rather than course. The curriculum publishes modules and leaves the grouping to you, so this is your own structure. Requires a qualification at the top.

shape.note.qualificationProgramme.text: Intfo yinye. Umfundzi ubekwa kulikhwalifikheshini, futsi ngilo luhlelo lasebenta kulo.
shape.note.qualificationProgramme.from: One thing. A learner is put onto the qualification, and that is the programme they work through.

shape.note.qualification.text: Irekhodi lekugunyaza: kharikhulamu yalo, emaligunya nemiphumela yeleveli yekuphuma.
shape.note.qualification.from: The accreditation record: its curriculum, criteria and exit level outcomes.

shape.note.programmeWithQualification.text: Ulandzelano lolulandzelanako, lolungaphendvula kulikhwalifikheshini noma lungaphendvuli.
shape.note.programmeWithQualification.from: An ordered sequence, which may answer to a qualification or to none.

shape.note.programmeOnly.text: Ulandzelano lolulandzelanako, lolungaphendvuli kunoma yiliphi likhwalifikheshini lelibhalisiwe.
shape.note.programmeOnly.from: An ordered sequence, answering to no registered qualification.

shape.note.bottom.text: Lokusebenta kona umfundzi. Akukho lutfo ngaphansi kwako.
shape.note.bottom.from: What a learner works through. There is nothing below it.

clock.note.text: Sikhatsi ngasinye lesihleliwe ku-App sisho lelihora. Inkhulumo ngo-18:30 iba ngu-18:30 lapha, futsi sikhatsi sekugcina sekwemukelwa kwekuhlala lokubhekiwe sihlolwa ngalo.
clock.note.from: Every timetabled time in the App means this clock. A lecture at 18:30 is 18:30 here, and an admission cut-off for an invigilated sitting is judged against it.

clock.both.text: Bafundzi bakwelinye live babona kokubili: sikhatsi sakho, lesigcinwa yirekhodi, nesabo eceleni kwaso, kuze kungabi khona lobala umehluko yena bese ubala kabi. Tikhatsi lerekhodiwe tihlala tingato takho.
clock.both.from: Learners in other countries see both: your time, which is the one the record keeps, and their own alongside it, so nobody works out the difference themselves and gets it wrong. Recorded times are always yours.

mailTest.intro.text: Ivula uxhumo kusevha yemeyili futsi ingene, kuze kuhlolwe kutsi timininingwane tekungena netaziso tabafundzi tingakhona ngempela kutfunyelwa.
mailTest.intro.from: Opens a connection to the mail server and signs in, to check that learner sign-in details and notifications can actually be delivered.

mailTest.nothingSent.from: No email is sent to anybody.

mailTest.notYours.text: Akukho lapha lokungashintshwa nguwe kulelikhasi: sevha yemeyili ingeyekufakwa. Nikela umugca lengenhla kunoma ngumuphi lonakekela yona.
mailTest.notYours.from: Nothing here is something you can change on this page: the mail server belongs to the deployment. Pass the line above to whoever maintains it.

mailTest.unconfigured.text: Alikho sevha yemeyili lesetiwe kulokufakwa kwamanje, ngako loku kutawubika loko kunekutsi kube liphutsa ngeakhawunti yakho.
mailTest.unconfigured.from: No mail server is set up on this deployment yet, so this will report that rather than a fault with your account.

sso.register.text: Bhalisa lepulatifomu ngeakhawunti yenhlangano yakho ye-{provider} futsi uyinike lelikheli lokubuyisela kulo bantfu, ngco njengoba libhaliwe: {address}
sso.register.from: Register this platform with your organisation's {provider} account and give it this address to send people back to, exactly as written: {address}

sso.secretHeld.text: (igcinwe, iphela nge-{hint}; uma ushiya ayinalutfo iyagcina)

sso.directoryHint.text: Kusuka ekhasini lekubukisa le-app ku-Microsoft Entra
sso.directoryHint.from: From the app's Overview page in Microsoft Entra

sso.offer.from: Offer “Sign in with {provider}” on the sign-in page

termsForm.why.practice.text: lisetjentiswa kuwo wonkhe umkhakha, alilona lomuntfu
termsForm.why.practice.from: used across the sector, owned by nobody

termsForm.missing.text: Lamanye emagama akekho kuloluhlu, futsi loko kwentiwe ngenhloso.
termsForm.missing.from: Some words are not on this list, and that is deliberate.

termsForm.missingNote.text: Likhwalifikheshini, umojula wekharikhulamu, umphumela weleveli yekuphuma, leveli ye-NQF nalokunye kuchazwa yi-QCTO noma ye-SAQA hhayi nguwe. Kushintsha ligama lalenye kungabeka emagama esikrinini semfundzi nasekuniketweni lokungatiwa ngumlawuli, ngako lepulatifomu iwagcina amile. Ungafundza kutsi ngubani lochaza ini ku-{link}.
termsForm.missingNote.from: Qualification, curriculum module, exit level outcome, NQF level and the rest are defined by the QCTO or SAQA rather than by you. Renaming one would put wording on a learner's screen and on a submission that the regulator does not recognise, so the platform keeps them fixed. You can read who defines what in the {link}.

termsForm.note.course.text: Sihlanganisela sinye sekufundza lomuntfu abhalisiwe kuso.
termsForm.note.course.from: A single body of learning a person is enrolled onto.

termsForm.note.programme.from: A sequence of courses taken in order.

termsForm.note.cohort.from: A group of people moving through a course together.

termsForm.note.studyUnit.text: Kutsi timojula tekharikhulamu tihlanganiswa njani kuze kufundziswe.
termsForm.note.studyUnit.from: How a curriculum's modules are grouped for delivery.

termsForm.note.enrolment.from: A person's place on a course or programme.

termsForm.note.learner.text: Umuntfu lofundzako. Abanye bahlinzeki batsi sitjudeni, noma likhandidethi.
termsForm.note.learner.from: The person doing the learning. Some providers say student, or candidate.

termsForm.note.facilitator.text: Umuntfu lofundzisako. Abanye bahlinzeki batsi umqeqeshi, umfundzisi, noma umkhombisi.
termsForm.note.facilitator.from: The person delivering. Some providers say trainer, tutor, or instructor.

termsForm.note.assessor.from: The person judging evidence against the criteria.

termsForm.note.moderator.from: The person checking a sample of those judgements.

termsForm.note.workplaceRecord.text: Irekhodi lemsebenti lowentiwe ngumfundzi, lelisayinwa ngumqeqeshi futsi lemukelwe ngumhloli.
termsForm.note.workplaceRecord.from: The record of work a learner did, that a coach signs and an assessor accepts.

menuEdit.noHeadingHint.from: No heading: shown as direct links

menuEdit.empty.text: Kulite. Sihloko lesingenalutfo ngaphansi kwaso asikhonjiswa.
menuEdit.empty.from: Empty. A heading with nothing under it is not shown.

menuEdit.note.text: Emakhasi angeke afihlwe lapha. Lokubona umuntfu ngamunye sekuvele kunqunywe yindzima yakhe, futsi enye indlela yekwenta intfo ingatfolakali ingenta kutsi akekho longasho kutsi likhasi lishoneleni. Likhasi lelengetwa kulepulatifomu kamuva livela ngaphansi kwesihloko salo lesivamile hhayi kutsi litsi nyamalala ngobe lolungiselelo lwabakhona ngaphambi kwalo.
menuEdit.note.from: Pages cannot be hidden here. What each person sees is already decided by their role, and a second way to make something unreachable would leave nobody able to say why a page is missing. A page added to the platform later appears under its usual heading rather than disappearing because this arrangement predates it.

drives.none.text: Alikho indzawo yekugcina emafayela lesetiwe kulokufakwa. Kufundza ifolda ngco kusuka ku-Google Drive noma ku-OneDrive kudzinga sicelo lesibhaliswe kuko ngulonakekela lepulatifomu; kuze kube khona loko, ifolda ikhetfwa ekhompyutheni yakho, loko kuyasebenta futsi akudzingi lutfo.
drives.none.from: No file store is set up on this deployment. Reading a folder straight from Google Drive or OneDrive needs an application registered with them by whoever maintains the platform; until then, a folder is chosen from your own computer, which works and needs nothing.

drives.keepsNote.text: Ithokheni lesitsiyiwe lengafundza, futsi ifundze kuphela, idrayivu yeakhawunti loyixhumako, kuze kube uyinqamula lapha noma uyisuse etinkhetho tayo leakhawunti. Isetjentiswa kuphela uma ucela kutsi ifolda ifundvwe futsi akukho nobe ngusiphi sikhatsi lesinye, ayikhonjiswa kuwe futsi, futsi ayibhalwa elogini. Iyakho, hhayi yalomhlinzeki: lomunye lomsebenti akakwati kufundza emafayela akho ngayo, futsi nawe awukwati kufundza awakhe ngeluxhumo lwakhe.
drives.keepsNote.from: A sealed token that can read, and only read, the drive of the account you connect, until you disconnect it here or withdraw it from that account's own settings. It is used when you ask for a folder to be read and at no other time, it is never shown back to you, and it is never written to a log. It is yours, not this provider's: a colleague cannot read your files through it, and you cannot read theirs through their connection.

ext.encrypted.text: Ifihlwe ngekufihla futsi ayikhonjiswa futsi, lapha noma kunoma yiphi indzawo.
ext.encrypted.from: It is encrypted and is never shown again, here or anywhere else.

ext.cannotRun.text: Lena ayikwati kusebenta kulepulatifomu, ngako kuyisetha lapha ngeke kwente tici te-AI tisebente.
ext.cannotRun.from: This one cannot run on this platform, so setting it up here will not make the AI features work.

ext.needsProgram.text: Idzinga isofthiwe lefakiwe emshinini lapho lepulatifomu isebenta khona.
ext.needsProgram.from: It needs a program installed on the machine the platform runs on.

ext.chooseKey.text: Kunalokho khetsa lomunye wabahlinzeki besihluthulelo se-API: bona bahlangana nemhlinzeki nge-inthanethi futsi basebenta noma ngabe lepulatifomu ifakwe kuphi.
ext.chooseKey.from: Choose one of the API-key providers instead: those call the provider over the internet and work wherever the platform is installed.

ext.replace.text: Yishintsele ngelisha {credential}; shiya kungenalutfo kuze ugcine leligcinwe
ext.replace.from: Replace it with a new {credential}; leave empty to keep the stored one

ext.geminiHint.text: sihluthulelo sakho kusuka ku-Google AI Studio
ext.geminiHint.from: your key from Google AI Studio

ext.available.from: Make it available to switch on

ext.model.text: Modeli: shiya kungenalutfo kuze usebentise lokuvamile kwemhlinzeki
ext.model.from: Model: leave empty for the provider's own default

ext.showModels.from: Show the models this {credential} can use

ext.modelsAvailable.text: {count} atfolakala kuwe lamuhla. Kukhetsa linye kugcwalisa libhokisi lingenhla; kugcinwa uma ucindzetela Gcina.
ext.modelsAvailable.from: {count} available to you today. Choosing one fills the box above; it is saved when you press Save.

ext.keepsNote.text: {credential} yakho, ifihliwe, kuze kube uyilahla. Isetjentiswa kuphela emsebentini lowucelile, kuphela nasekuvuliwe iswitjhi, futsi ayikhonjiswa kuwe noma ibhalwe kunoma yiliphi ilogi. Kutfolakala akufani nekuvuliwe: sonkhe sikhatsi sekuhlala siyacala ivalwe, uyivula emsebentini, futsi kuphuma kuyicisha uma ukhohliwe.
ext.keepsNote.from: Your {credential}, encrypted, until you discard it. It is used only for work you ask for, only while you have the switch on, and it is never shown back to you or written to any log. Available is not the same as on: every sitting starts with it off, you switch it on for a job, and signing out switches it off for you if you forget.

ext.keptUnused.text: Ithokheni yakho iyagcinwa kodvwa ayikwati kusetjentiswa. Akukho kulepulatifomu lokutawunikela lusito lwe-AI kuze kube uyenta ikhona futsi.
ext.keptUnused.from: Your token is kept but cannot be used. Nothing in the platform will offer AI assistance until you make it available again.

ext.offNote.text: Uma loku kucishiwe, lepulatifomu yenta ngco njengoba yenta ingenayo sengeti: tinketho tiyashoda kunekutsi tinikelwe bese tehluleka.
ext.offNote.from: With this off, the platform behaves exactly as it does without an extension: the affordances are absent rather than offered and failing.

ext.tokenFromNote.text: Lengcenye yenteka ekhompyutheni yakho, hhayi lapha, ngiyo injongo: kubhalisa kwakho kugunyazwa nguwe, emshinini wakho, futsi kuphela ithokheni lekhiphako lefinyelela kulepulatifomu.
ext.tokenFromNote.from: This part happens on your own computer, not here, which is the point: your subscription is authorised by you, on your machine, and only the token it produces ever reaches this platform.

ext.step1Rest.text: uma ungakayifaki: {link}. Udzinga kubhalisela i-Claude wena ngekwakho.
ext.step1Rest.from: if you have not already: {link}. You need a Claude subscription of your own.

ext.cmdNote.text: {plain} lelula ku-PowerShell ivamise kwehluleka ngesitfumeli “running scripts is disabled on this system”. Loko kuyalokuvamile kwe-Windows hhayi lokungahambi kahle ekufakweni kwakho, futsi lifomu le-{cmd} liyakugwema ngaphandle kwekushintsha tinkhetho tekuvikela.
ext.cmdNote.from: Plain {plain} in PowerShell usually fails with “running scripts is disabled on this system”. That is a Windows default rather than anything wrong with your installation, and the {cmd} form avoids it without changing any security setting.

ext.step3.from: 3. Sign in when it opens your browser

ext.step3Rest.text: , bese ukopisha ithokheni lekhipha yona (icala nge-{prefix}) uyinamathisele ngenhla.
ext.step3Rest.from: , then copy the token it prints (it begins {prefix}) and paste it above.

ext.notApiKey.text: Akusiso sihluthulelo se-API futsi akukho kubita ngethokheni ngayinye: kusebentisa kubhalisa kwe-Claude lokukhokhelako sekukhona. Ungaze unikele noma ngumuphi iphasiwedi yakho ye-Anthropic: lepulatifomu ayinalo libhokisi layo futsi ayiyemukeli lapha.
ext.notApiKey.from: It is not an API key and there is no per-token cost: it draws on the Claude subscription you already pay for. Never give anybody your Anthropic password: this platform has no field for one and would not accept it here.

ext.notSubscription.from: A subscription is not an API key.

ext.geminiSeparate.text: I-Gemini Advanced ne-Gemini API tintfo letehlukile letinemabhili lahlukile. Kukhokhela lekucala akukunikeli lesibili, futsi akukho indlela yekukwenta loko.
ext.geminiSeparate.from: Gemini Advanced and the Gemini API are separate products with separate billing. Paying for the first does not give you the second, and there is no way to make it.

ext.openaiSeparate.text: I-ChatGPT Plus ne-OpenAI API tintfo letehlukile letinemabhili lahlukile. Kukhokhela lekucala akukunikeli lesibili, futsi akukho indlela yekukwenta loko.
ext.openaiSeparate.from: ChatGPT Plus and the OpenAI API are separate products with separate billing. Paying for the first does not give you the second, and there is no way to make it.

ext.openaiCreate.text: Dala sihluthulelo ku-{site}, ngaphansi kwe-{menu}, bese usinamathisela ngenhla. Sicala nge-{prefix}.
ext.openaiCreate.from: Create a key at {site}, under {menu}, and paste it above. It begins {prefix}.

ext.noFreeTierNote.text: ngokungafani ne-Gemini, sicelo ngasinye sikhokhelwa ngeakhawunti yesihluthulelo, ngako lindzela libhili, noma ngabe lincane kanganani.
ext.noFreeTierNote.from: unlike Gemini, every call is charged to the account the key belongs to, so expect a bill, however small.

ext.geminiCreate.text: Ngena ku-{site}, khetsa {menu}, dala sinye, bese usinamathisela ngenhla. I-Google ikhiphe tihluthulelo ngeteluhlobo lolungetulu kwelilodvwa, ngako namathisela noma yini lekunika yona: lepulatifomu ayiyikuvivinyi.
ext.geminiCreate.from: Sign in at {site}, choose {menu}, create one, and paste it above. Google has issued keys in more than one format, so paste whatever it gives you: this platform does not second-guess it.

ext.geminiFree.text: I-Gemini API inaleveli yamahhala, ngako loku akubiti lutfo kuzama. Iyakhawula kutsi ungenta ticelo tingaki ngemizuzu kunekutikhokhisa; kufundza ifolda lenkhulu kungafinyelela lapho, futsi lepulatifomu itawubika ngalokucacile uma kwenteka loko.
ext.geminiFree.from: The Gemini API has a free tier, so this costs nothing to try. It limits how many requests you may make in a minute rather than charging for them; reading a large folder can hit that, and the platform will say so plainly if it does.

ext.keyYours.text: Iyakho, hhayi yetenanti. Ifihlwe, isetjentiswa kuphela emsebentini lowucelile ngesikhatsi iswitjhi yakho ivuliwe, ayikhonjiswa kuwe, futsi ayibhalwa elogini nanini.
ext.keyYours.from: It is yours, not the tenant's. It is encrypted, used only for work you ask for while your switch is on, never shown back to you, and never written to a log.

codes.intro.text: Umojula munye ubhalwa ngendlela lehlukile emadokhumentini lahlukene: {long} kukharikhulamu, {short} etafuleni lekuhambisana, {shortest} kusifinyezo. Sichasiso lesidze, tigcizelelo nemabhalomkhulu kuphatfwa ngemtsetfo. Lapha yikhona i-App itjelwa ngalokunye, kuze kulayida kuxhumanise umojula kunekutsi kubike kutsi awukho.
codes.intro.from: One module is written down differently in different documents: {long} in the curriculum, {short} in the alignment table, {shortest} in a summary. The long identifier, the punctuation and the capitals are handled by rule. This is where the App is told about the rest, so an upload links the module instead of reporting it missing.

codes.saved.text: Kugcinwe. Kulayida kutawusebentisa loku kusukela nyalo.
codes.saved.from: Saved. Uploads will use these from now on.

codes.none.text: Akukabi khona kharikhulamu lelayidiwe, ngako akukho emazinga lokungakhulunywa ngawo. Layida likhwalifikheshini futsi loku kuyagcwala ngekwako kusuka etikhodini tamojula tayo.
codes.none.from: No curriculum has been loaded yet, so there are no standards to infer. Load a qualification and this fills itself in from its module codes.

codes.inUse.text: {total} tindlela tekubhala lehlukile kuto tonkhe timojula {modules}, tiyasetjentiswa.
codes.inUse.from: {total} alternative spellings across {modules} modules, in use.

codes.proposed.text: {total} tindlela tekubhala tiphakanyisiwe kuto tonkhe timojula {modules}.

codes.notInUse.text: Ayisetjentiswa kuze kube uyibukile futsi wayivuma.
codes.notInUse.from: Not in use until you have looked at them and confirmed.

codes.dialogNote.text: Khodi lesesobunxele isitandadi sakho. Tindlela tekubhala leceleni kwayo yilokungasetjentiswa ngudokhumenti esikhundleni. Susa noma yiluphi lolungabambekiko, wengete letakho, bese uyacinisekisa.
codes.dialogNote.from: The code on the left is your standard. The spellings beside it are what a document may use instead. Remove any that do not belong, add your own, then confirm.

codes.fullId.text: Sichasiso sonkhe se-QCTO, {example}, sifundvwa njengekhodi yemojula ngemtsetfo, futsi asidzingi umugca lapha. Kunjalo nangemahayifini, tikhala nemabhalomkhulu.
codes.fullId.from: A full QCTO identifier, {example}, is read as its module code by rule, and needs no row here. So are hyphens, spaces and capitals.

codes.worked.from: Its variations are worked out for you.

codes.putBack.from: Put back everything the App proposed

naming.intro.text: Uma umuntfu alayida incwadzi yemisebenti noma kuhlolwa, i-App ifundza ligama lefayela kuze itfole kutsi yini. Uma loku kulungile kulayida kufika sekugcwele. Uma kungalungile akukho lokuphukako: kufika njengefomu lelite kuze umuntfu aligcwalise ngesandla.
naming.intro.from: When somebody uploads a workbook or an assessment, the App reads the filename to work out what it is. Get this right and an upload arrives already filled in. Get it wrong and nothing breaks: it arrives as a blank form for somebody to complete by hand.

naming.rule.text: Umtsetfo wendlu, njengoba ligembu lakho kufanele lilandzele
naming.rule.from: The house rule, as your team should follow it

naming.ruleNote.text: Kukhonjiswa esikrinini sekulayida. Seluleko sebantfu, hhayi lokufanisa nako i-App: itfola tikhodi letingentasi noma ngabe tivela kuphi.
naming.ruleNote.from: Shown on the upload screen. Guidance for people, not something the App matches on: it finds the codes below wherever they appear.

naming.codesNote.text: Ingcenye yeligama lefayela lechaza kutsi luhlobo luni ludokhumenti. Yilena i-App lefanisa ngayo ngempela.
naming.codesNote.from: The part of a filename that says what kind of document it is. These are what the App actually matches on.

naming.markerNote.text: Ithokheni lechaza kutsi ifayela yimemorandamu hhayi likhophi lemfundzi.
naming.markerNote.from: The token that says a file is the memorandum rather than the learner's copy.

naming.unread.text: Akufundvwanga kuleligama: {parts}. Lolayidako ugcwalisa loko ngesandla.
naming.unread.from: Not read from this name: {parts}. Whoever uploads it fills those in by hand.

naming.allRead.text: Konkhe kufundvwe. Kulayida lokuchazwe ngalendlela kufika sekugcwele.
naming.allRead.from: Everything was read. An upload named like this arrives already filled in.

tmpl.note.statement_of_results.text: Kuyiswa esikhungweni sekuhlola nedokhumenti yesazisi semfundzi. Isakhiwo sisetwa nguwe; themplethi ye-QCTO uqobo ikhombisa lokutfwalwako.
tmpl.note.statement_of_results.from: Carried to the assessment centre with the learner's identity document. The layout is yours to set; the QCTO's own template shows what one carries.

tmpl.note.certificate.text: Lokukhishwa ngumhlinzeki emahlelweni akhe. Sitifiketi selikhwalifikheshini sivela ku-QCTO, hhayi lapha.
tmpl.note.certificate.from: What the provider issues for its own programmes. A qualification certificate comes from the QCTO, not from here.

tmpl.note.workplace_statement.text: Lokusayinwa ngumqeqeshi wasemsebentini kucinisekisa lwati lolwaphetfwa ngumfundzi.
tmpl.note.workplace_statement.from: What a workplace coach signs to confirm the experience a learner completed.

tmpl.note.enrolment_form.text: Fomu yekubhalisa lephelele, njengedokhumenti. Umphenyi we-QCTO angayicela uma avakashile, ngako kufanele ibe khona ephepheni, hhayi esikrinini nje lapho umuntfu ayigcwalise khona.
tmpl.note.enrolment_form.from: The completed enrolment form, as a document. A QCTO monitor may ask for it on a visit, so it has to exist on paper, not only as a screen somebody filled in.

tmpl.platform.text: Isakhiwo sepulatifomu uqobo. Akukho lokwentako lapha lokushintsha ludokhumenti lesivele sikhishiwe.
tmpl.platform.from: The platform's own layout. Nothing you do here changes a document already issued.

tmpl.documentNote.text: Bhala kuyo njengoba ufuna kufundvwe. Noma yini lesemabhrekhethi lamabili ishintshwa ngemininingwane yemfundzi uqobo uma ludokhumenti lukhiwa, futsi tikhala takho tigcinwa kahle njengoba uticinisa.
tmpl.documentNote.from: Write it as you want it to read. Anything in double braces is replaced with the learner's own details when the document is produced, and your spacing is kept exactly as you type it.

tmpl.starterNote.text: Lena imisho yepulatifomu uqobo, kuze uyinciphise ibe yakho.
tmpl.starterNote.from: This is the platform's own wording, for you to cut down into yours.

tmpl.goBack.from: Go back to the platform's own layout

tmpl.fields.from: What you can put in it

tmpl.added.text: Lokufakwa yipulatifomu, noma ngabe themplethi yakho ishoni
tmpl.added.from: What the platform adds, whatever your template says

tmpl.addedNote.text: Loku kushicilelwa ngemuva kwethemplethi yakho. Akusiko kwakho kukushintsha ngobe akusikwakho: umlawuli uyakudzinga, futsi umfundzi lophethe ludokhumenti uyancika ekutseni kutsembekile. Awudzingi kukubhala enguqulweni yakho.
tmpl.addedNote.from: These are printed after your template. They are not yours to change because they are not yours: a regulator requires them, and a learner holding the document relies on them being true. You do not need to write them into your own version.

capture.intro.text: I-App ifundza lokungakwenta, ikukhombise lokuyitfole nalokungakhonanga kutfolakala, bese iyalindza. Akukho lokuba ngukuhlolwa kuze uvume.
capture.intro.from: The App reads what it can, shows you what it made of it and what it could not work out, and waits. Nothing becomes an assessment until you confirm it.

capture.fromFolder.text: Uma incwadzi yemisebenti ifike nefolda, sekuvele kusilapha: {link} bese uyayibhala esistimini kuloko lokufayelwe. Akukho kulayida kwesibili, futsi sikhombisi setiphendvulo siyabhangiswa ngekwaso. Sebentisa fomu lengentasi kuphela ephepheni lelingakabi sepulatifomini.
capture.fromFolder.from: If the workbook came in with a folder, it is already here: {link} and capture it from what is filed. There is no second upload, and the answer guide is paired for you. Use the form below only for a paper the platform does not already hold.

capture.changeNaming.text: Shintsha kutsi emagama emafayela afundvwa njani

capture.noneNote.text: Vula likhwalifikheshini ubhale tincwadzi temisebenti lesivele tifayelwe kulo, noma ulayide yinye ngenhla. Lokufundvwa yi-App kukhonjiswa kuwe ngaphambi kwekutsi lutfo lube ngukuhlolwa.
capture.noneNote.from: Open a qualification and capture the workbooks already filed against it, or upload one above. What the App reads is shown to you before any of it becomes an assessment.

capture.committedOn.text: Kufakwe ngalokuphelele ngomhla wa-{date}. Kulayida kufakwa ngalokuphelele kanye kuphela; layida ludokhumenti futsi kuze wente elinye iphepha kulo.
capture.committedOn.from: Committed on {date}. An upload is committed once; upload the document again to make another paper from it.

capture.which.from: Which qualification is this material for?

capture.guideNote.text: Ngaphandle kwaso, akukho tiphendvulo letilungile, emamaki noma emagunya lengafundvwa.
capture.guideNote.from: Without it, no correct answers, marks or criteria can be read.

capture.ready.text: Kulungile. Timojula {modules} nemagunya ekuhlola {criteria} sekungenile, ngako imibuto ingaxhumaniswa nalokufakazelwako.
capture.ready.from: Ready. {modules} modules and {criteria} assessment criteria are in, so questions can be linked to what they evidence.

capture.notReady.from: This qualification is not ready for material yet.

capture.notReadyNote.text: Yenta loku kucala, ngalendlela. Kuze kuphele, umbuto awukwati kuhlanganiswa nalokufakazelwako, futsi kulungisa loko emvakwaloko kutawudzinga kuyimaka yonkhe ngesandla.
capture.notReadyNote.from: Do these first, in this order. Until they are done a question cannot be tagged to what it evidences, and putting that right later means re-tagging every one of them by hand.

capture.whereDocuments.from: Documents are uploaded on the qualification's own page.

capture.original.text: Lokwekucala kugcinwa futsi kwentelwe i-hash, ngako umbuto lophikisanwako uxazululwa ngedokhumenti hhayi ngalokufundvwe kulo lapha.
capture.original.from: The original is kept and hashed, so a question in dispute is settled against the document rather than against this reading of it.

capture.committedLong.text: Loku kufakwe ngalokuphelele ngomhla wa-{date}. Kulayida kufakwa ngalokuphelele kanye kuphela; layida ludokhumenti futsi kuze wente elinye iphepha kulo.
capture.committedLong.from: This was committed on {date}. An upload is committed once; upload the document again to make another paper from it.

captureReview.noAnswer.from: “{stem}…” is marked by the App but has no correct answer.

captureReview.addsUp.text: “{section}” ishicilelwe ngemamaki la-{printed} kodvwa imibuto yayo yehlanganisa ibe {sum}.
captureReview.addsUp.from: “{section}” is printed as {printed} marks but its questions add up to {sum}.

captureReview.edited.text: Wente tichibiyelo. Lokufakwa ngalokuphelele yilokusesikrinini nyalo, hhayi lokwafundvwa efayelini.
captureReview.edited.from: You have made corrections. What gets committed is what is on this screen now, not what was read out of the file.

captureReview.summary.from: {questions} questions · {marks} marks · {app} marked by the App

captureReview.unknownOne.text: {codes} akusiyo ligunya kulelikhwalifikheshini, ngako angeke axhumaniswe. Lungisa tikhodi ngenhla uma kuyiphutfo.
captureReview.unknownOne.from: {codes} is not a criterion on this qualification, so it will not be linked. Correct the codes above if that is a typo.

captureReview.unknown.text: {codes} akusiwo emagunya kulelikhwalifikheshini, ngako angeke axhumaniswe. Lungisa tikhodi ngenhla uma kuyiphutfo.
captureReview.unknown.from: {codes} are not criteria on this qualification, so they will not be linked. Correct the codes above if that is a typo.

captureReview.acknowledgeOne.text: Ngiyifundzile 1 lengakaphelile ngenhla futsi ngifuna kuyifaka ngalokuphelele noma kunjalo. Loku kurekhodwa ngeligama lami.
captureReview.acknowledgeOne.from: I have read the 1 outstanding item above and want to commit anyway. This is recorded against my name.

captureReview.acknowledge.text: Ngiwafundzile {count} lengakaphelile ngenhla futsi ngifuna kuwafaka ngalokuphelele noma kunjalo. Loku kurekhodwa ngeligama lami.
captureReview.acknowledge.from: I have read the {count} outstanding items above and want to commit anyway. This is recorded against my name.

captureReview.responsibility.text: Kucinisekisa kwemukela umtfwalo wayo yonkhe iphendvulo lelungile kuleliphepha. Ligama lakho lihlala kulo.
captureReview.responsibility.from: Confirming accepts responsibility for every correct answer in this paper. Your name stays on it.

captureReview.swapped.from: The paper and the guide look swapped

captureReview.swappedNote.text: Akukho lokunye lokuchazwe, ngobe konkhe lokunye kulandzela kulokuhle. Qala kabusha ngephepha lemfundzi njengephepha nesikhombisi semhloli njengesikhombisi.
captureReview.swappedNote.from: Nothing else is listed, because everything else follows from this. Start again with the learner's paper as the paper and the assessor guide as the guide.

captureReview.fixNote.text: Lungisa loku ngentasi, noma ukufundze bese utsi ufuna kuchubeka noma kunjalo.
captureReview.fixNote.from: Correct these below, or read them and say you want to go on anyway.

captureReview.clearNote.text: Yonkhe imibuto lezakuphawulwa yi-App inaphendvulo, futsi yonkhe ingcenye yehlanganisa loko lekushicilelwe kuyo.
captureReview.clearNote.from: Every question the App will mark has an answer, and every section adds up to what it prints.

captureReview.materialNote.text: Ludokhumenti lufundvwe kahle. Lena tintfo ngephepha lekufanele linqunywe ngumbhali walo kuphela.
captureReview.materialNote.from: The document was read correctly. These are things about the paper that only its author can decide.

imports.intro.text: Yonkhe ifolda lefundvwe, nalokwentiwe ngayo. Kufundza lensha kucala lapho umsebenti ukhona, elikhwalifikheshini, kusifundvo noma kulokufundvwako lokwakhako, hhayi lapha.
imports.intro.from: Every folder that has been read, and what became of it. Reading a new one starts where the work is, on the qualification, course or material you are building, rather than here.

imports.noExtension.from: You have not set up an AI extension

imports.noExtensionNote.text: Iyakhetfwa futsi ngeyakho hhayi yenhlangano: ngamunye emsebentini uyasetha yakhe, ngesibhalisiso sakhe.
imports.noExtensionNote.from: It is optional and yours rather than the tenant's: every member of staff sets up their own, with their own subscription.

imports.readNote.text: Kugcinwa noma ngabe kufakwe ngalokuphelele noma kulahlwe. Lokuphakanyiswe bese kwenqatjwa yikona lokwenta umuntfu anqume kutsi kufundza kuyetsenjelwa yini.
imports.readNote.from: Kept whether committed or discarded. What was proposed and then rejected is how anybody judges whether a reading is worth trusting.

imports.byPlatform.from: read by the platform, no AI involved

imports.backFolders.from: ← Back to the folders that have been read

imports.contentsNote.text: Konkhe lokutfolakele, nalokwentiwe ngako. Ama-PDF nemadokhumenti e-Word ayaguculwa ngesikhishi lesifanako lesisetjentiswa yonkhe indzawo yepulatifomu, ngako imodeli ifundza ncamashi lokutawubhalwa esistimini.
imports.contentsNote.from: Everything found, and what was done with it. PDFs and Word documents are converted with the same extractor the rest of the platform uses, so the model reads exactly what Capture would.

imports.proposesNote.text: Konkhe endzaweni yinye. Tixwayiso yingcenye lebalulekile: tifundze ngaphambi kwalokunye.
imports.proposesNote.from: Everything in one place. The warnings are the part that matters: read those before anything else.

proposal.fromBlueprint.text: Kufundvwe efayelini lebhluphrinti yefolda uqobo. Sakhiwo lesingentasi yilokushiwo ngulelifayela ncamashi: akukho lokucatjangwe, futsi akukho imodeli lebuliwe.
proposal.fromBlueprint.from: Read from the folder's own blueprint file. The structure below is exactly what that file says: nothing was inferred, and no model was asked.

proposal.fromDocuments.text: Kufundvwe emadokhumenteni yimodeli. Kuhlole kudokhumenti yekharikhulamu ngaphambi kwekufaka ngalokuphelele.
proposal.fromDocuments.from: Read from the documents by the model. Check it against the curriculum document before committing.

proposal.byName.text: Kufayelwe ngeligama. Akukho bhluphrinti futsi akukho imodeli lebuliwe: ludokhumenti ngalunye lwaya lapho ligama lalo lisho khona, futsi likharikhulamu alitsintshiwe.
proposal.byName.from: Filed by name. No blueprint and no model were involved: each document went where its filename says it belongs, and the curriculum is untouched.

proposal.unitsNamed.text: Tigaba tekufundza {count} tinemagama ekuhlolwa ngemagama emafayela.
proposal.unitsNamed.from: {count} study units are named by their filenames.

proposal.nothingChanged.text: Akukho mojula, sihloko noma ligunya lelengetiwe noma lelishintshwe ngaloku.
proposal.nothingChanged.from: No module, topic or criterion is added or changed by this.

proposal.counts.text: Timojula {modules}, tihloko {topics}, timphahla {elements}, emagunya {criteria}, tigaba tekufundza {units}, emadokhumenti {documents}
proposal.counts.from: {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} elements, {criteria} criteria, {units} study units, {documents} documents

proposal.withheld.from: {withheld} withheld from learners, {visible} visible to them.

proposal.withheldNote.text: Emamemorandamu, tikhombisi tetiphendvulo nemaphepha ekugcina kubanjwa kunoma ngubani longenalo lilungelo lekuhlola.
proposal.withheldNote.from: Memoranda, answer guides and summative papers are withheld from anybody without the right to assess.

proposal.unknownOne.text: 1 akukwati kwatiwa ngeligama lako futsi kufayelwe ngephansi kwe-“lokunye”, lokubonwa yibo bonkhe.
proposal.unknownOne.from: 1 could not be recognised from its name and is filed as “other”, which is visible to everyone.

proposal.unknown.text: {count} akukwati kwatiwa ngemagama awo futsi afayelwe ngephansi kwe-“lokunye”, lokubonwa yibo bonkhe.
proposal.unknown.from: {count} could not be recognised from their names and are filed as “other”, which is visible to everyone.

proposal.unknownNote.text: Kufanele ubuke ngentasi ngaphambi kwekufaka ngalokuphelele: sikhombisi setiphendvulo lesibitwe ngendlela lengaziwa yilemitsetfo sitawuba lapha.
proposal.unknownNote.from: Worth a look below before committing: an answer guide named in a way these rules do not know would be here.

proposal.orAdd.from: Or add it to one already here

proposal.addNote.text: Kuyengeta kulelivele likhona lapha akushintshi lutfo lesivele sikhona futsi kufaka kuphela lokushodako.
proposal.addNote.from: Adding it to one already here leaves everything that is there untouched and puts in only what is missing.

proposal.topUp.text: Kwengetwe elikhwalifikheshini lolaqale ngalo. Luhlu lungenhla yikho konkhe lokusefolodeni, hhayi konkhe lokutawudalwa: noma yini lesivele ikhona ishiywa injalo, futsi kwengetwa kuphela lokushodako. Utawutjelwa emvakwaloko kutsi timojula tiphi lebesivele tikhona.
proposal.topUp.from: Added to the qualification you started from. The list above is everything the folder holds, not everything that will be created: whatever is already here is left exactly as it is, and only what is missing is added. You are told afterwards which modules were already held.

proposal.filedCourse.from: Filed against the course you started from.

proposal.filedProgramme.from: Filed against the programme you started from.

proposal.filedQualification.from: Filed against the qualification you started from.

proposal.checks.text: Konkhe lokungenhla kungena kanyekanye, ngekuhlolwa lokufanako lokusebenta kunoma yini lekhiwe ngesandla. Noma yini lehlolwa ibone ingayemukeli iyabikwa, ayishiywa buthule.
proposal.checks.from: Everything above goes in at once, through the same checks that apply to anything built by hand. Whatever those checks turn away is reported rather than skipped quietly.

proposal.discardNote.text: Kugcinwe erekhodini. Lokuphakanyiswe bese kwenqatjwa yikona lokwenta umuntfu anqume kutsi sengeti iyafaneleka yini.
proposal.discardNote.from: Kept on the record. What was proposed and rejected is how anybody judges whether the extension is worth having.

reports.programme.text: Luhlelo uqobo: lokungahlolwa yilutfo, imibuto lengasebenti
reports.programme.from: The programme itself: what nothing tests, which questions are not working

reports.coverageNote.text: Kubalwa kusuka etitifiketini, hhayi ekuphetseni sifundvo. Kuphetsa kusho kutsi umuntfu ufike ekugcineni kwalokufundvwako; sitifiketi sisho kutsi kwentiwe siphetfo futsi, lapho kudzingeka khona, salinganiswa ngokuzimela.
reports.coverageNote.from: Counted from certificates, not course completions. A completion means somebody reached the end of the material; a certificate means a judgement was made and, where required, independently moderated.

reports.singleNote.text: Ibanjwe ngumuntfu munye kuphela: {codes}. Uma lomuntfu ahamba, likhono liyahamba naye.
reports.singleNote.from: Held by one person only: {codes}. If that person leaves, the capability goes with them.

reports.nobodyEnrolled.from: Nobody is enrolled on anything yet.

progReport.intro.text: Imibuto lemibili lebukeka ngekungatsi ibhekane nebafundzi kodvwa ingekho: kutsi yini lengahlolwa yilutfo, nekutsi imibuto ephi lengasebenti.
progReport.intro.from: Two questions that look like they are about learners and are not: what nothing assesses, and which questions are not working.

progReport.untestedNote.text: Ligunya lelingahlolwa ngumbuto wekugcina longeke lifinyelelwe ngumuntfu, noma ngabe wenta kahle kangakanani. Lidzimbisa bonkhe bafundzi kulelikhwalifikheshini, futsi akukho lokunye epulatifomini lokushoko loku.
progReport.untestedNote.from: A criterion no summative question assesses cannot be achieved by anybody, however well they do. It holds up every learner on the qualification, and nothing else in the platform says so.

progReport.noCriteria.from: This qualification has no assessment criteria captured yet.

progReport.allTested.text: Onkhe emagunya la-{count} ahlolwa ngumbuto wekugcina lokungenani linye.
progReport.allTested.from: Every one of the {count} criteria is tested by at least one summative question.

progReport.someUntested.text: Emagunya {untested} kusuka ku-{count} awahlolwa ngumbuto wekugcina nomunye.
progReport.someUntested.from: {untested} of {count} criteria are not tested by any summative question.

progReport.misleading.text: {count} alawo avela encwadzini yemisebenti, lekwekutfutfukisa futsi ayifakazeli lutfo.
progReport.misleading.from: {count} of those appear in a workbook, which is developmental and evidences nothing.

progReport.questionsNote.text: Imizamo yekucala kuphela, ngobe kuphindza kuhlola lokunye. Akukho lokuphawulwa ngephansi kwemizamo {minimum}: umbuto lophendvulwe bantfu labambili ukutjela ngalaba bantfu labambili.
progReport.questionsNote.from: First attempts only, because a re-sit measures something else. Nothing is flagged below {minimum} attempts: a question two people have answered tells you about those two people.

progReport.noQuestions.from: That assessment has no questions yet.

progReport.worthLook.from: {flagged} of {count} questions are worth a look.

progReport.nobody.text: Cishe akekho longayiphendvula. Noma umbuto awucondzile noma lokuhlolwako akuzange kufundziswe.
progReport.nobody.from: Almost nobody can answer this. Either the question is unclear or what it tests was never taught.

progReport.everybody.text: Wonkhe umuntfu utfola wonkhe emamaki, ngako awuhlukanisi lutfo.
progReport.everybody.from: Everybody gets full marks, so it distinguishes nothing.

statutory.intro.text: Umbiko we-SAQA weBhesi Yemarekhodi Emfundzi Kazwelonkhe, kanye Neluhlelo Lwemakhono Asemsebentini nemBiko Wemnyaka Wekuceceshwa. Konkhe kuhlolwa lapha ngaphambi kwekutsi kuye kunoma ngaphi, ngobe umbiko lowenqatjwe ngenombolo yesazisi lebhalwe kabi ubiza sikhatsi sonkhe.
statutory.intro.from: The SAQA National Learners' Records Database return, and the Workplace Skills Plan and Annual Training Report. Everything is checked here before it goes anywhere, because a return rejected for a mistyped identity number costs a full cycle.

statutory.locked.text: Emafayela ahlala akhiyiwe kuze kulungiswe tinkinga letivimbelako letingentasi. Kuyisa umbiko lotawenqatjwa kuchitsa umjikelo wemfundzi ngamunye lohlanganisiwe kuwo.
statutory.locked.from: The files stay locked until the blocking problems below are fixed. Submitting a return that will be rejected wastes a cycle for every learner in it.

statutory.worthFixingNote.text: Loku akuvimbi umbiko, kodvwa i-NLRD iphawula imininingwane yetibalo tebantfu lengakapheli futsi i-SETA ingabuza ngayo.
statutory.worthFixingNote.from: These do not stop the return, but the NLRD flags incomplete demographic data and a SETA may query it.

statutory.wsp.text: Luhlelo Lwemakhono Emsebentini Nembiko Yemnyaka Yekuqeqeshwa
statutory.wsp.from: Workplace Skills Plan and Annual Training Report

statutory.wspNote.text: Umsebenti wekuqeqesha ngemsebenti, njengoba umbiko we-SETA uhlelwe.
statutory.wspNote.from: Training activity by occupation, as a SETA return is organised.

statutory.noOfoOne.text: Umuntfu 1 akanayo khodi ye-OFO: {names}. Usabalwa, kodvwa umbiko we-SETA uhlanganisa ngemsebenti.
statutory.noOfoOne.from: 1 person has no OFO code: {names}. They are still counted, but a SETA return groups by occupation.

statutory.noOfo.text: Bantfu {count} abanayo khodi ye-OFO: {names}. Basabalwa, kodvwa umbiko we-SETA uhlanganisa ngemsebenti.
statutory.noOfo.from: {count} people have no OFO code: {names}. They are still counted, but a SETA return groups by occupation.

statutory.mapping.text: Kuhlelwa kwetinkhundla kulandzela luhlaka lwekugunyazwa (Umuntfu 27, Kubhalisa 28, Tiphumelelo 29, Umhlinzeki 30). Cinisekisa luhlobo lwefayela le-Edu.Dex ngemininingwane yamanje ye-SAQA ngaphambi kwekuyisa lokusebentako.
statutory.mapping.from: Field mapping follows the accreditation framework (Person 27, Enrolment 28, Achievement 29, Provider 30). Confirm the exact Edu.Dex file layout against the current SAQA specification before a live submission.

enrolNotify.intro.text: I-QCTO kufanele itjelwe kutsi lababafundzi babhalisiwe, emalangeni ekusebenta lamashumi lamabili nakunye ngemuva kwekwetfulwa kulikhwalifikheshini nalasihlanu kuluhlelo lwemakhono. Tinsuku tekuphumula tesive atibalwa, futsi sikhatsi sicalwa ngelilanga lekwetfulwa hhayi ngekubhalisa noma ngekukhokha.
enrolNotify.intro.from: The QCTO has to be told that these learners were enrolled, within twenty-one working days of induction for a qualification and five for a skills programme. Public holidays do not count, and the clock runs from the induction date rather than from enrolment or payment.

enrolNotify.overdueNote.text: Buye uyise lokuke. Saziso lesiphuzile nesizatfu sihlukile ekungatshelwe muntfu.
enrolNotify.overdueNote.from: Still submit these. A late notification with an explanation is a different problem to one nobody made.

enrolNotify.soonNote.text: Kusele emalanga ekusebenta lasihlanu noma lambalwa.
enrolNotify.soonNote.from: Five working days or fewer remaining.

enrolNotify.noInductionNote.text: Sikhatsi sabo asikacali, ngako akukho sikhatsi lesibikwako. Tfola lilanga lesikhatsi sekwetfulwa seliqoqo, noma unike umuntfu ngamunye lakhe ngentasi.
enrolNotify.noInductionNote.from: Their clock has not started, so there is no deadline to report. Date the cohort's induction session, or give them their own below.

enrolNotify.draftNote.text: Bonkhe labetfulwe ngelilanga linye baya ndzawonye. Lofike ngemuva ufuna lakhe.
enrolNotify.draftNote.from: Everybody inducted on the same day goes together. A late joiner needs their own.

enrolNotify.ownInductionNote.text: Umuntfu lofike ngemuva kwekucala kweliqoqo unekwetfulwa kwakhe, fomu yakhe yekubhalisa nekuyisa kwakhe.
enrolNotify.ownInductionNote.from: Somebody who joined after the cohort started has their own induction, their own enrolment form and their own submission.

enrolNotify.split.text: Loku kuyisa kufaka kokubili luhlelo lwemakhono nelikhwalifikheshini. Kuya emakheli lahlukene, ngako kufanele kwehlukaniswe kuyiswe kabili.
enrolNotify.split.from: This submission covers both a skills programme and a qualification. They go to different addresses, so it has to be split and sent twice.

enrolNotify.askAck.text: Cela kwemukelwa, bese ukurekhoda lapha uma kubuya.
enrolNotify.askAck.from: Ask for an acknowledgement, and record it here when it comes back.

enrolNotify.nobodyOutstanding.text: Akekho losele. Wonkhe umfundzi lonelilanga lekwetfulwa utisiwe.
enrolNotify.nobodyOutstanding.from: Nobody is outstanding. Every learner with an induction date has been notified about.

enrolNotify.clockFrom.from: The clock runs from this day.

enrolNotify.noneThatDay.text: Akekho losele lowetfulwe ngalelolanga. Shintsha lilanga, noma unike lofike ngemuva kwekwetfulwa kwakhe ngentasi.
enrolNotify.noneThatDay.from: Nobody outstanding was inducted on that date. Change the date, or give a late joiner their own induction below.

enrolNotify.nobodyWaiting.from: Nobody is waiting on an induction date.

paths.intro.text: Tinhlobo letinyenti te-{courses} tihlanganiswe kulandzelana: umuntfu lomusha lofika {programme}, noma kuhanjiswa kwalonkhe luhlaka lwemakhono. Umfundzi unikwa i-{course} lelandzelako ngokwakhe uma asaphetsa leyendlulile.
paths.intro.from: Several {courses} chained into a sequence: a new starter {programme}, or a full competency framework roll-out. A learner is given the next {course} automatically as they finish the one before it.

paths.noneAuthor.text: I-{programme} ihlanganisa {courses} ngekulandzelana, ngako umfundzi unikwa lelandzelako uma asaphetsa leyendlulile. Kucala wakhe {courses}: i-{programme} kulandzelana kwato.
paths.noneAuthor.from: A {programme} chains {courses} into an order, so a learner is given the next one as they finish the one before. Build the {courses} first: a {programme} is a sequence of them.

paths.noneReader.text: Akukabi khona lokwakhiwe. Uma sekukhona, i-{courses} lokufanele uyisebente ngekulandzelana itawuba lapha. Kwakha kungumsebenti wemlobi.
paths.noneReader.from: None has been built yet. When one has been, the {courses} you work through in order will be here. Building one is an author's job.

paths.empty.text: Akukabi na-{courses} kuyo: umfundzi lonikwa lena {programme} angeke atfole lutfo. Yivule ukuze wengete.
paths.empty.from: No {courses} in it yet: a learner given this {programme} would receive nothing. Open it to add some.

paths.folderNote.text: Khetsa ifolda lapho lokufundvwa kuhlala khona, futsi konkhe lokuphakatsi, kubandakanya tifolda tayo letincane, kuyafundvwa, kufayelwe kanye nekutsi kwenziwe incwadzi yesikhombo. Ubona lokutawufayelwa ngaphambi kwekutsi kubhalwe lutfo.
paths.folderNote.from: Choose the folder this material lives in and everything in it, including its subfolders, is read, filed and indexed. You see what it would file before anything is written.

paths.folderLabel.from: Its folder, from your own computer

paths.folderHint.text: Tincwadzi tekuhola, tincwadzi temisebenti, tinqubomgomo netithempulethi tifayelwa kuyo futsi umbhalo wato wenziwa incwadzi yesikhombo kuze tikwati kuseshwa.
paths.folderHint.from: Guides, workbooks, policies and templates are filed against it and their text indexed so they can be searched.

paths.folderHint2.text: Sakhiwo asakhiwa lapha: umumo waso wakhiwa ngekwengeta {courses} kuso ngenhla. Loku kufayela lokusephakatsi kwaso.
paths.folderHint2.from: Structure is not created from here: its own shape is built by adding {courses} to it above. This files what it holds.

paths.drive.from: Or from a drive you have connected

paths.driveNote.text: Ifolda leyodvwa, ifundvwe lapho isivele ikhona. Ikuphetsa endzaweni leyodvwa: sicelo sekutsi uhlole ngaphambi kwekutsi kubhalwe lutfo.
paths.driveNote.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

paths.noSteps.text: Akukabi lutfo kuko. Ngeta ngekulandzelana lokufanele bafundzi bakutsatse ngako.
paths.noSteps.from: Nothing in it yet. Add them in the order learners should take them.

paths.opensFirst.from: Opens as soon as somebody joins.

paths.opensAfter.from: Opens when the step before it is finished.

paths.opensNow.from: Opens straight away, alongside the others.

paths.locked.from: Locked until the step before it is finished

paths.lockedNote.text: Susa sicherechere uma lokunye kungatsatfwa nganoma nini.
paths.lockedNote.from: Untick for one that can be taken at any point.

paths.allIn.from: Everything published is already in it.

paths.published.text: Loku kushicilelwe futsi bantfu bayakusebentela, ngako tinyatselo tayo tiyalungiswa. Kushintsha kulandzelana ngaphansi kwemuntfu kungashintsha lokutsi ubatjelwe kutsi bakwente.
paths.published.from: This is published and people are working through it, so its steps are fixed. Changing the order underneath somebody would alter what they had already been told to do.

paths.publishNote.from: Everything in it has to be published first.

paths.firstOnly.text: Kuvuleka kuphela lokucala. Lokusele kufika njengoba lunye ngalunye luphela.
paths.firstOnly.from: Only the first opens. The rest arrive as each is finished.

badges.intro.text: Kwemukelwa lokufika ngelilanga umsebenti uphela, hhayi ngemuva kwetinyanga uma sitifiketi sangaphandle sifika. Libheji alisilo likhwalifikheshini futsi lepulatifomu ayikuvumeli kubukeka njalo: alinaso sikhomba se-SAQA, alinamakhredithi, futsi likhasi lekucinisekisa lisho ngalokucacile kutsi liyini nekutsi aliyini.
badges.intro.from: Recognition that arrives on the day the work is finished, rather than months later when the external certificate comes through. A badge is not a qualification and the platform never lets it look like one: no SAQA identifier, no credits, and a verification page that says plainly what it is and what it is not.

badges.target.default.text: Noma yini, uma kungasetwanga lokutsite kakhulu
badges.target.default.from: Anything, when nothing more specific is set

badges.nothingNote.text: Alukho libheji lelakhiwe, ngako kuphetsa sifundvo noma likhwalifikheshini nyalo akunikeli lutfo. Kwakha linye ngentasi kwenele: cala ngelibheji lemhlinzeki ngokwakhe uma ungafuni lelehlukile kulokunye nalokunye.
badges.nothingNote.from: No badge has been designed, so finishing a course or a qualification currently awards nothing. Designing one below is enough: start with the provider's own badge if you do not want a different one for each thing.

badges.legitimate.text: Loku kuyinketho lecondzile hhayi liphutsa. Lepulatifomu ngeke ilakhe ngokwayo.
badges.legitimate.from: This is a legitimate choice rather than a fault. The platform will not invent one.

badges.kind.default.text: Noma yini, uma kungasetwanga lokutsite kakhulu
badges.kind.default.from: Anything, when nothing more specific is set

badges.designNote.text: Umumo, imibala lemibili nesimbolo. Akukho lokufanele kusindzislwe futsi akekho umuntfu lofanele atjelwe.
badges.designNote.from: A shape, two colours and a symbol. Nothing to upload and nobody to brief.

badges.allHave.text: Konkhe sekunelibheji. Rekha lelinye kuze ukhe elehlukile kulokufanako.
badges.allHave.from: Everything already has a badge. Retire one to design a different badge for the same thing.

badges.says.text: Lokushiwo, kumfundzi nakunoma ngubani lamtjengisa lona (ngekukhetsa)
badges.says.from: What it says, for the learner and anybody they show it to (optional)

badges.saysHint.text: Waphetsa umojula wekwenta wekusebenta ngekuphakama, wahlolwa ngemaligunya ekharikhulamu.
badges.saysHint.from: Completed the practical module on working at heights, assessed against the curriculum criteria.

badges.retireTitle.from: Stop awarding {name}. Everybody who has it keeps it.

templates.intro.text: Emadokhumenti lakhiwa yi-{name}. Indlela ngayinye lefundvwa ngayo nalebukeka ngayo yeyakho: bhala inguqulo yakho futsi lepulatifomu iyakha ngayo esikhundleni salayoyayo. Lokudzingwa ngumtsetfo kufakwa ngemuva kwelakho futsi akwati kuhlelwa, ngobe leyongcenye ayisiyo yemhlinzeki kutsi ishintshe.
templates.intro.from: The documents {name} produces. How each one reads and looks is yours: write your own version and the platform produces it from that instead of its own layout. What a regulator requires is added after yours and cannot be edited, because that part is not the provider's to change.

templates.goesTo.statement_of_results.text: Umfundzi, lokuyiswa kusikhungo sekuhlolwa nedokhumenti yakhe yesazisi.
templates.goesTo.statement_of_results.from: The learner, who carries it to the assessment centre with their identity document.

templates.goesTo.certificate.from: The learner, and whoever they show it to.

templates.goesTo.workplace_statement.text: Ifayela lemfundzi, lelisayinwe ngumqeqeshi kumqashi lophatsa.
templates.goesTo.workplace_statement.from: The learner's file, signed by a coach at the host employer.

templates.goesTo.enrolment_form.text: Ifayelwe njengebufakazi, futsi inikwe umbhekisisi we-QCTO uma uvakashile.
templates.goesTo.enrolment_form.from: Filed as evidence, and handed to a QCTO monitor on a visit.

templates.producesNote.text: Noma yini lengenayo inguqulo yakho isebentisa luhlaka lwepulatifomu, lolusebentako hhayi lokubekwe endzaweni yalokunye.
templates.producesNote.from: Anything without your own version uses the platform's layout, which is a working document rather than a placeholder.

templates.writeNote.text: Cala ngeluhlaka lwepulatifomu bese ulwehlisa lube lolwakho. Inkhundla ngayinye lidokhumenti leyingatfwala itfolakala eceleni kwemhleli, nesibonelo sangempela sekutsi ibukeka njani.
templates.writeNote.from: Start from the platform's layout and edit it down into yours. Every field the document can carry is listed beside the editor with a real example of what it looks like.

templates.supplied.from: Documents you supply rather than lay out

templates.suppliedNote.text: Akusiyo yonkhe lidokhumenti lithempulethi lepulatifomu leligcwalisako.
templates.suppliedNote.from: Not every document is a template the platform fills in.

templates.policiesNote.text: incwadzi yakho yekugunyazwa, tinqubomgomo netivumelwano, kufakwa futsi kugcinwe, hhayi kukhiqizwa.
templates.policiesNote.from: your accreditation letter, policies and agreements, uploaded and retained rather than generated.

templates.fisaNote.text: abhalwe ngumhloli webhalo wakho futsi alinganiswe ngaphambi kwekutsi kube nalotsi uwabhala, ngako abhalwa hhayi akhiwe ngethempulethi.
templates.fisaNote.from: written by your own examiner and moderated before anybody sits them, so they are authored rather than templated.

templates.curriculumNote.text: emadokhumenti elikhwalifikheshini lashicilelwe lapulatifomu layifundzako kuze yakhe likharikhulamu.
templates.curriculumNote.from: the published qualification documents the platform reads to build a curriculum from.

tracker.all.text: Wonkhe emaqoqo, kubandakanya lawo aphelile nalarekiwe.
tracker.all.from: Every cohort, including those finished and cancelled.

tracker.note.text: Kufundvwa emarekhodini hhayi kugcinwa ngesandla, ngako akunakuhlukana nepulatifomu leyibikako.
tracker.note.from: Read from the records rather than kept by hand, so it cannot disagree with the platform it reports on.

tracker.none.text: Akukabi khona emaqoqo. Liqoqo yilokutfolako sheduli, rejista nembiko wasemtsetfweni.
tracker.none.from: No cohorts yet. A cohort is what a schedule, a register and a statutory return all hang from.

dictionary.intro.text: Incazelo lemile yeligama ngalinye lelisetjentiswa kulepulatifomu, emadokhumenti ayo nakulokufundvwako kuyo. Lokungeniswe ngalinye kusho kutsi ngubani lonelilungelo leligama. Lapho umlawuli achaza ligama, siyalisebentisa njengoba asebentisa, futsi umtimba uyatiwa. Lapho ligama lilelethu, singalishintsha. Lapho lisetjentiswa ngekuvamile, akufanele licashunwe njengesidzingo.
dictionary.intro.from: The settled meaning of every term used across this platform, its documents and its learning material. Each entry says who owns the word. Where an authority defines it, we use it as they do and the body is named. Where the word is ours, we can change it. Where it is simply common usage, it should never be cited as a requirement.

dictionary.searchHint.text: Ligama, isifinyezo, noma livi lise incazelweni
dictionary.searchHint.from: A term, an abbreviation, or a word in a definition

dictionary.meaning.authority.text: Lichazwe ngumlawuli. Lisebentise njengoba asebentisa: kushintsha incazelo kubeka kuyisa kusengotini.
dictionary.meaning.authority.from: Defined by an authority. Use it as they do: changing the meaning puts a submission at risk.

dictionary.meaning.platform.text: Ligama lepulatifomu ngokwayo. Lelethu kushintsha; akukho mlawuli lolinquma.
dictionary.meaning.platform.from: This platform's own word for it. Ours to change; no authority prescribes it.

dictionary.meaning.practice.text: Kusetjentiswa ngekuvamile embonini, kute umnikati munye. Ungalicashuni njengesidzingo.
dictionary.meaning.practice.from: Common usage across the sector, with no single owner. Do not cite it as a requirement.

dictionary.none.text: Akukho lokuhambisana. Uma ligama lisele futsi ngelilodvwa lesilisebentisako, lilifanele lapha: sitjele futsi litawengetwa emkhishweni lolandzelako.
dictionary.none.from: Nothing matches. If a term is missing and it is one we use, it belongs here: say so and it will be added in the next release.

feedbackForm.intro.text: {cohort}. Tiphendvulo tibikwa kanyekanye netabo bonkhe bantfu, hhayi nye nye. Kuthatsa imizuzu lemibili, futsi kuphela lokushintsha indlela liqoqo lelilandzelako lelicutfwa ngayo.
feedbackForm.intro.from: {cohort}. Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. It takes about two minutes, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

feedbackReport.ratingsNote.text: Iphakathi lema-1 (angivumelani neze) kuya kwelema-5 (ngiyavumelana kakhulu). Iphakathi lemiphendvulo lembalwa liyimibono hhayi sibalo, ngako inani lisecaleni.
feedbackReport.ratingsNote.from: Mean of 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree). A mean over few answers is a mood, not a measurement, so the count is beside it.

feedbackReport.saidNote.text: Kubonakala kanyekanye futsi kungenamagama. Imibono ngemsekeli ilungile kuphela uma umfundzi akholwa kutsi ngeke ifundvwe kuye munye nye.
feedbackReport.saidNote.from: Shown together and without names. Feedback about a facilitator is only honest if the learner believes it will not be read back to them one by one.

feedbackReport.outstandingNote.text: Yindzawo yodvwa lapho ligama livela khona. Kulandzelela kudzinga emagama; tiphendvulo ngenhla atitidzingi.
feedbackReport.outstandingNote.from: The one place a name appears. Chasing needs them; the answers above do not.

conductPage.intro.text: Timangalo tembulwe bafundzi, nanoma ngubani lorejista itsi uyekile kufika. Timo tekuhlawulisa tisekhasini lemfundzi ngokwakhe, lapho lonkhe lirekhodi lakhe lisekhona.
conductPage.intro.from: Grievances raised by learners, and anybody the register says has stopped turning up. Disciplinary matters sit on the learner's own page, where the rest of their record is.

conductPage.overdueNote.text: Kutfolwa kwemmangalo kuvunyelwa emalangeni ekusebenta la-{days}. Lawa asedlulele kuleso sikhatsi.
conductPage.overdueNote.from: A grievance is acknowledged within {days} working days. These are past that.

conductPage.grievancesNote.text: Tibekwa ngumfundzi ngekuphatfwa, timo, noma nome yini lenye lemtsintsako. Tihlukaniswa netikhalo, letimayelana nemphumela futsi tiya kumlinganisi.
conductPage.grievancesNote.from: Raised by a learner about treatment, conditions, or anything else affecting them. Kept apart from appeals, which are about a result and go to the moderator.

conductPage.abscondedNote.text: Emalanga lamabili noma ngetulu lalandzelanako ekuqeqeshwa umuntfu angekho ngaphandle kwekwatisa. Kufundvwa erejistini hhayi kugcinwa, ngako kulungisa uphawu kushintsha impendvulo ngekushesha. Kungekho lokurekhodwe njengokuxolelwe kuyinkhulumisano, futsi kuphula lomshana.
conductPage.abscondedNote.from: Two or more consecutive training days absent with no word. Read off the register rather than stored, so correcting a mark changes the answer at once. An absence recorded as excused is communication, and breaks the run.

conductPage.nobody.text: Akekho. Wonkhe umuntfu uyafika noma utjelile umuntfu kutsi kungani angafiki.
conductPage.nobody.from: Nobody. Everybody is either turning up or has told somebody why not.

conductPage.actOn.text: Luhlu lwalokufanele kwentiwe, hhayi siphetfo. Kutsintsana nomfundzi, kubhalela lomnikeli wemali nekukhipha saziso sekuhlosa kuphelisa konkhe kuyintfo lokwentiwa ngumuntfu.
conductPage.actOn.from: A list to act on, never a decision. Contacting the learner, writing to the sponsor and issuing a notice of intention to terminate are all things a person does.

grievance.decisionHint.text: Lokutfolwe nalokutawentiwa. Loku kuyiswa kumfundzi ngekubhalwa.
grievance.decisionHint.from: What was found and what will be done. This goes to the learner in writing.

grievance.impartial.text: Umphenyi kufanele abe ngumuntfu lokungabhekiswa kuye ummangalo. Kuchaza lomfundzi asekhalile ngaye kuyenqatjwa, ngobe “umuntfu lokhetsiwe longakhethi luhlangotsi” kuyilokutsenjiswe yinqubo, futsi liviki lelinabasebenti labambalwa yilona lapho kwephulwa khona.
grievance.impartial.from: The investigator must be somebody the grievance is not about. Naming one the learner has complained about is refused, because “a designated impartial person” is what the procedure promises and a short-staffed week is exactly when it gets broken.

access.deniedTitle.from: You do not have access to this

access.deniedNote.text: Ungenile, kodvwa loku akusikho lokwakho kukubona: kungaba kwemunye umuntfu, noma kudzinga indzima lengekho ku-akhawunti yakho. Uma ucabanga kutsi loku akulungile, cela umphatsi wakho kutsi ahlole.
access.deniedNote.from: You are signed in, but this is not yours to see: either it belongs to someone else, or it needs a role your account does not hold. If you think that is wrong, ask your administrator to check.

access.unknownTitle.from: This address is not in use

access.unknownNote.text: Akukho nhlangano lesetiwe kuleli likheli le-inthanethi, noma kungena kwayo kumisiwe. Hlola likheli lelinikelwe lona, noma utsintse lowahlela kuqeqeshwa kwakho.
access.unknownNote.from: No organisation is set up at this web address, or its access has been suspended. Check the address you were given, or contact whoever arranged your training.

wpSetup.intro.text: Umfundzi wenta lwati lwasemsebentini kumqashi, aphatfwe ngumuntfu lonikwa ngumqashi. Sivumelwano sirekhoda kutsi ngubani lowo; ilogibhuku lirekhoda lokudzingwa ngukharikhulamu kutsi akwente.
wpSetup.intro.from: A learner does work experience at an employer, supervised by somebody that employer provides. The agreement records who that is; the logbook records what the curriculum requires them to do.

wpSetup.emptyOne.text: Umojula 1 welwati lwasemsebentini awunato tidzingo letibhaliwe.
wpSetup.emptyOne.from: 1 work experience module has no requirements captured.

wpSetup.empty.text: Timojula {count} telwati lwasemsebentini atinato tidzingo letibhaliwe.
wpSetup.empty.from: {count} work experience modules have no requirements captured.

wpSetup.emptyNote.text: {codes}. Ilogibhuku lelakhiwe ngemojula lengenalutfo lingafakazela lutfo, ngako alikwati kuvulwa kuze imisebenti yasemsebentini yekharikhulamu, lwati lwasemsebentini nebufakazi lobusekelako kungenisiwe.
wpSetup.emptyNote.from: {codes}. A logbook built from an empty module would attest to nothing, so those cannot be opened until the curriculum's work activities, workplace knowledge and supporting evidence have been imported.

wpSetup.noCoaches.text: Akekho lophetse indzima yoMqeqeshi Wasemsebentini. Kucala wengete umbheki wemfundzi nge-{people}: usebentela umqashi, hhayi wena, futsi utabona kuphela bafundzi labashiwo etivumelwaneni takhe.
wpSetup.noCoaches.from: Nobody holds the Workplace Coach role yet. Add the learner's supervisor through {people} first: they work for the employer, not for you, and they will only ever see the learners named on their own agreements.

wpSetup.ownCoach.text: Umfundzi angeke abe ngumqeqeshi wakhe; sisekelo semininingwane siyakwenqaba.
wpSetup.ownCoach.from: The learner cannot be their own coach; the database refuses it.

wpSetup.designationNote.text: Kurekhodwe kusivumelwano njengoba simi lamuhla, ngako kusayina kuhlala kusho kutsi ngubani lowasayinako nangasiphi sikhundla.
wpSetup.designationNote.from: Recorded on the agreement as it stands today, so the sign-off keeps saying who signed and in what capacity.

wpSetup.noAgreements.text: Akukabi khona tivumelwano tasemsebentini. Kha yinye ngenhla kucala: ilogibhuku lirekhoda umsebenti lowentiwe kumqashi longuliwe ngaphansi kwemqeqeshi longuliwe, ngako ayikwati kuba khona ngaphandle kwesivumelwano.
wpSetup.noAgreements.from: No workplace agreements yet. Create one above first: a logbook records work done at a named employer under a named coach, so it cannot exist without one.

wpSetup.generated.text: Ilogibhuku lakhiwa ngemisebenti yasemsebentini, lwati lwasemsebentini nebufakazi lobusekelako bekharikhulamu ngokwayo, ngako ayikwati kushiya sidzingo.
wpSetup.generated.from: The logbook is generated from the curriculum's own work activities, workplace knowledge and supporting evidence, so it cannot omit a requirement.

enrolForm.intro.text: {provider} kufanele itfumele lemininingwane kuLubandla Lekulawula Kwemikhakha Nemisebenti uma ubhalisiwe. Lokunyenti sekwatiwa futsi kutjengiswe ngentasi; lokusele kungulokungakhona umuntfu longakuphendvula ngaphandle kwakho. Ungagcina uchubeka, bese ubuya kuyo.
enrolForm.intro.from: {provider} has to send these details to the Quality Council for Trades and Occupations when you are enrolled. Most of it is already known and shown below; the rest is what nobody can answer except you. You can save as you go and come back to it.

enrolForm.onRecordNote.text: Tjela umhlelisi wakho uma lokunye kwalokungakalungile; akusiko kwakho kukushintsha lapha.
enrolForm.onRecordNote.from: Tell your coordinator if any of this is wrong; it is not yours to change here.

enrolForm.doesNotAdd.from: Something here does not add up

enrolForm.idNote.text: Inombolo yesazisi yaseNingizimu Afrika ithwele lilanga lekutalwa nebulili ngaphakatsi kwayo, futsi i-QCTO iyahlola kutsi kuyahambisana yini. Ngekuvamile kuba yinombolo lelotjwe kabi. Umhlelisi wakho angayilungisa.
enrolForm.idNote.from: A South African identity number carries the date of birth and the gender inside it, and the QCTO checks that they agree. It is usually a mistyped digit. Your coordinator can correct it.

enrolForm.stillNote.text: Akukho lolahlekile uma umisa phakatsi. Lokungaphelele lapha kuloko lokungasekho ekuyiseni njengoba kumi.
enrolForm.stillNote.from: Nothing is lost if you stop partway. This is what would be missing from the submission as it stands.

enrolForm.completeNote.from: Everything the submission needs is here.

enrolForm.missingPrint.text: Tiphendvulo {count} tisashiywe, ngako lefomu itawuphrintwa inendzawo lezingenalutfo. Tibhalwe efomini ngokwayo.
enrolForm.missingPrint.from: {count} answers are still missing, so this form will print with blanks. They are listed on the form itself.

enrolForm.completePrint.text: Kuphelele. Yiphrinte, umfundzi ayisayine, bese uyifayela.
enrolForm.completePrint.from: Complete. Print it, have the learner sign it, and file it.

enrolForm.titleHint.from: Mr, Ms, Dr, and so on.

enrolForm.middleHint.text: Uma unalo. Uma ute, shiya lingenalutfo.
enrolForm.middleHint.from: If you have one. Leave it blank if not.

enrolForm.working.from: Are you working at the moment?

enrolForm.difficulty.from: How much difficulty does it cause?

enrolForm.difficultyHint.text: Kubutwa ngobe kukhubateka kurekhodwe ngeligama lakho. I-QCTO iyakudzinga kanye nako.
enrolForm.difficultyHint.from: Asked because a disability is recorded against your name. The QCTO requires it alongside.

enrolForm.noId.text: Uma ungenayo inombolo yesazisi yaseNingizimu Afrika
enrolForm.noId.from: If you do not have a South African identity number

enrolForm.instead.from: What you are enrolled on instead

enrolForm.post.text: Lapho iposi ikufikela khona, uma kuyindzawo lenye
enrolForm.post.from: Where post reaches you, if it is somewhere else

enrolForm.provinceHint.text: Lapho usebenta khona, lokungatsi kuhlale kuyilapho uhlala khona.
enrolForm.provinceHint.from: Where you work, which is not always where you live.

enrolForm.statssaHint.text: Umhlelisi wakho angayitfola lena uma ungayati.
enrolForm.statssaHint.from: Your coordinator can look this one up if you do not know it.

enrolForm.flcNote.text: Kudzingeka kuphela kulikhwalifikheshini leleveli ye-NQF 3 noma 4. Shiya kungenalutfo uma akekho lokucelile kona.
enrolForm.flcNote.from: Only needed on a qualification at NQF level 3 or 4. Leave it blank if nobody has asked you for it.

enrolForm.agreedOn.text: Uvumile mhla ka-{date}. Lelilanga ingcenye yerekhodi futsi alishintshi uma uhlela lefomu.
enrolForm.agreedOn.from: You agreed on {date}. That date is part of the record and does not change if you edit this form.

enrolForm.agreedDate.text: Lilanga lokuvuma lirekhodiwe, ngobe umbiko ucela kokubili.
enrolForm.agreedDate.from: The date you agree is recorded, because the return asks for both.

enrolForm.confirm.from: Save and confirm these are right

records.intro.text: Simiso Sekuphatsa Lizinga Lemsebenti (QMS) netinqubomgomo taso, tincwadzi tekugunyazwa, tivumelwano, nemadokhumenti asemtsetfweni njengemanuwali ye-PAIA: konkhe lokugcinwe ngumhlinzeki lokungewumfundzi munye noma likhwalifikheshini linye. Kungenisa efolda yelikhwalifikheshini kufayela ngokuzenzakalela tinqubomgomo taso te-QMS lapha.
records.intro.from: The Quality Management System and its policies, accreditation letters, contracts, and statutory documents like the PAIA manual: everything the provider holds that does not belong to one learner or one qualification. Importing a qualification folder files its QMS policies here automatically.

records.introManage.text: Kuphindze kutjengise lokufike ekugcineni kwesikhatsi sekugcinwa.
records.introManage.from: It also shows what has reached the end of its retention period.

records.expiringNote.text: Sitifiketi sentela lesiphelelwe sikhatsi yintfo lengaqapheliwe ngumuntfu kuze liviki lapho sidzingeka khona.
records.expiringNote.from: An expired tax clearance is the kind of thing nobody notices until the week it is needed.

records.libraryNote.text: Tinguqulo letishintshiwe tiyagcinwa, ngobe inqubomgomo lebeyisebenta eNdlovana yiyo lebutwa kuhlolwa kweNdlovana.
records.libraryNote.from: Superseded versions are kept, because the policy that governed in March is the one an audit of March asks about.

records.nothingManage.text: Incwadzi yekugunyazwa iyo lokufanele iyifakwe kucala.
records.nothingManage.from: The accreditation letter is the one worth putting in first.

records.retentionNote.text: Kubalwa kusukela ngelilanga lekucinisekiswa, ngaphezu kwesikhatsi sekugcinwa kulomtimba. Alukho lokugcinwe ku-archive noma lokucitfwe lapha: pulatifomu ityela kutsi kufanele kwentiwe yini futsi umuntfu unquma.
records.retentionNote.from: Counted from the certification date, over the retention period on this tenant. Nothing here has been archived or destroyed: the platform says what is due and a person decides.

records.registerNote.text: Konkhe lokunqunywe ngerekhodi lelidlulise lilanga lalo, nekutsi ngubani lonqunyile. Irekhodi lelanyamalala kalula lisemabi kunalelagcinwe sikhatsi lesidze.
records.registerNote.from: Everything decided about a record past its date, with who decided it. A record that quietly disappeared is worse than one kept too long.

records.replacesNote.text: Leyo leshintshwako iyagcinwa futsi iphawulwe njengeshintshiwe. Inqubomgomo lebeyisebenta eNdlovana yiyo lebutwa kuhlolwa kweNdlovana.
records.replacesNote.from: The one it replaces is kept and marked superseded. The policy that governed in March is what an audit of March asks about.

records.descriptionHint.from: What it is, if the title does not say

records.anybody.from: Anybody signed in may read this

records.anybodyNote.text: Kusebenta kumadokhumenti asemtsetfweni. Incwadzi yemfundzi ihlala itjengiswa bafundzi; tinqubomgomo, tivumelwano, kugunyazwa nemadokhumenti ekusebenta akatjengiswa.
records.anybodyNote.from: Applies to statutory documents. A learner guide is always shown to learners; policies, contracts, accreditation and operational documents never are.

records.archive.from: Archive: move it out of the way

offline.intro.text: Landa lokudzingako ngaphambi kwekuphuma. Konkhe lokurekhodako uma ungekho kugcinwa kulefoni futsi kutfunyelwe emuva ngesikhatsi lelandzelako lapho unesignali.
offline.intro.from: Download what you need before you go out. Anything you record while you are away is kept on this phone and sent back the next time you have a signal.

offline.takeNote.text: Landa lokudzingako ngaphambi kwekuhamba. Akukho lokugcinwa lokungakacelwa nguwe.
offline.takeNote.from: Download what you need before you go. Nothing is kept that you did not ask for.

offline.nothingToStudy.text: Awunalutfo lekutifundza nyalo. Noma yini lobhalisele yona itfolakala lapha kuze uyilande.
offline.nothingToStudy.from: You have nothing to study at the moment. Anything you are enrolled on appears here to download.

offline.recordNote.text: Kusebenta ngaphandle kwesignali. Kulindza kulefoni futsi kuyahamba uma unesignali lelandzelako.
offline.recordNote.from: Works with no signal. It waits on this phone and goes when you next have one.

offline.waitingDecisionNote.text: Lokutsite kushintshe ngesikhatsi umfundzi angekho. Alukho lokuhlanganisiwe noma lokubhalwe kabusha: kufanele kube khona lokhetsako.
offline.waitingDecisionNote.from: Something changed while the learner was away. Nothing has been merged or overwritten: somebody has to choose.

offline.bothDates.from: Recorded on the device {captured} · reached us {received}

lrs.intro.text: Emarekhodi ebafundzi bakho, lafikako nalaphumako, njengetitatimende te-xAPI: luhlobo lwemarekhodi lesitolo semarekhodi ekufundza nalokunyenti kwetisistimu tekufundza tikuhlanyela. Alukho lapha lolushintsha imiphumela yemfundzi kulepulatifomu.
lrs.intro.from: Your learners' records, in and out, as xAPI statements: the format learning record stores and most learning systems exchange. Nothing here changes a learner's results on this platform.

lrs.outNote.text: Sinye ngasinye: kubhalisa, lesoni lephetfwe, kuhlolwa lokuzanyiwe, siphetfo sekutsi unelikhono noma akakabi nelikhono, sifundvo lesiphetfwe, sitatimende semiphumela, sitifiketi nesitifiketi selikhwalifikheshini lesitfolwe, sitatimende sinye ngasinye. Sitatimende ngasinye sigcina sazisi lesifanako njalo uma uphumisa, ngako kulayisha kuphumisa lokubili kulenye sistimu akuphindzi umlandvo wanoma ngubani.
lrs.outNote.from: Every enrolment, lesson completed, assessment attempted, competent or not yet competent decision, course completed, statement of results, certificate, and qualification certificate received, one statement each. Each keeps the same identity every time you export, so loading two exports into another system does not double anybody's history.

lrs.downloadNote.text: Ifayela lisho ligama lemfundzi ngamunye nelikheli lakhe le-imeyili. Ligcine njengoba ubungagcina noma yirekhodi lini lemininingwane yobuntfu.
lrs.downloadNote.from: The file names every learner and their email address. Keep it as you would any record of personal information.

lrs.store.from: Send records to your own learning record store

lrs.storeNote.text: Uma unesitolo semarekhodi ekufundza, sixhume lapha futsi lonkhe lirekhodi lenhla lisiyiswa kuso ngaphakatsi kwehora lalenteka kulo, lelivele lenteke lisiyiswe kucala. Ngalinye litfunyelwa kanye; sitatimende lesitolo sesivele sinaso sishiywa njengoba sinjalo. Imfihlo yesitolo iyakhiywa kulepulatifomu, ayiphindzi ibonwe, futsi iyakhohlakala uma uhlukanisa.
lrs.storeNote.from: If you keep a learning record store, connect it here and every record above goes to it within the hour of happening, the ones already made first. Each is sent once; a statement the store already holds is left as it is. The store's secret is sealed on this platform, never shown again, and forgotten when you disconnect.

lrs.inNote.text: Ifayela letitatimende te-xAPI kusuka kwenye sistimu: luhlu lwetitatimende, noma lokubuyiswa sitolo semarekhodi ekufundza. Sitatimende ngasinye sihambisana nomfundzi lapha nge-imeyili futsi sitjengiswa erekhodini lakhe. Sigcinwa njengekufundza lokwentiwe kwenye indzawo, hhayi lokwentiwe kube kubhalisa noma umphumela lapha, ngobe alukho lokufundziswe noma lokuhlolwe kulepulatifomu.
lrs.inNote.from: A file of xAPI statements from another system: a list of statements, or what a learning record store returns. Each is matched to a learner here by email and shown on their record. It is kept as learning done elsewhere, not turned into an enrolment or a result here, because none of it was taught or assessed on this platform.
