verifyPage.intro.text: Faka rifrensi lebhalwe kusitifiketi. Akudzingeki akhawunti.
verifyPage.intro.from: Enter the reference printed on the certificate. No account is needed.

verifyPage.validStatementNote.text: Lomfundzi uphetse onkhe emagunya ekuhlolwa kwangekhatsi elikhwalifikheshini lelingentasi futsi angabhaliswa Kuhlolwa Kwekugcina Kwangaphandle Lokuhlanganisiwe.
verifyPage.validStatementNote.from: This learner has achieved every internal assessment criterion for the qualification below and may be entered for the External Integrated Summative Assessment.

verifyPage.doNotAccept.text: Ungalemukeli lelidokhumenti. Tsintsana nemhlinzeki lochazwe kulo uma umfundzi acabanga kutsi loku kuliphutsa.
verifyPage.doNotAccept.from: Do not accept this document. Contact the provider named on it if the learner believes this is a mistake.

verifyPage.expiredNote.text: Sitatimende Semiphumela sisebenta iminyaka lemibili kusukela ngelilanga lesakhishwa ngalo. Lesi sakhishwa mhla ka-{issued} futsi siphelelwe sikhatsi mhla ka-{expired}.
verifyPage.expiredNote.from: A Statement of Results is valid for two years from the date it was issued. This one was issued on {issued} and expired on {expired}.

verifyPage.expiredNote2.text: Akukho lokungalungile ngekufeza kwemfundzi: yidokhumenti lephelelwe sikhatsi. Umhlinzeki lochazwe kulo angakhipha lesisha.
verifyPage.expiredNote2.from: Nothing is wrong with the learner's achievement: it is the document that has run out. The provider named on it can issue a current one.

verifyPage.notFoundNote.text: Akukho sitifiketi lesinale rifrensi. Ihlole ngedokhumenti: emabhonco la-I, L, O, U, 0 na-1 awasetjentiswa, ngako 1 ngu-7 noma J, futsi O ngu-Q noma D.
verifyPage.notFoundNote.from: No certificate carries that reference. Check it against the document: the characters I, L, O, U, 0 and 1 are never used, so a 1 is a 7 or a J, and an O is a Q or a D.

verifyPage.notRely.from: It should not be relied on.

verifyPage.badgeNote.text: Lena yirekhodi lemhlinzeki ngokwakhe lekutsi lolibanjwe uphetse lelimojula yekufundza. Akusilo likhwalifikheshini leliveni, alinamakhredithi, futsi alinikwa lubandla lwekulawula. Likhwalifikheshini licinisekiswa yirifrensi yesitifiketi salo.
verifyPage.badgeNote.from: This is a provider's own record that the holder completed this module of study. It is not a national qualification, carries no credits, and is not awarded by a quality council. A qualification is verified by its own certificate reference.

platformPage.intro.text: Yonkhe inhlangano kulepulatifomu. Ungabona kutsi ngamunye usebentisa kangakanani futsi uphatse kucushwa kwabo, kodvwa hhayi bafundzi babo, tifundvo noma emarekhodi abo ekuhlola. Kuphatsa sistimu yenkhasimende akusikho kuvunyelwa kuyifundza, futsi lepulatifomu iyakuphoqa loku esikhundleni sekuncika ekuzibambeni.
platformPage.intro.from: Every organisation on the platform. You can see how much each is using and manage their configuration, but not their learners, courses or assessment records. Hosting a client's system is not the same as being entitled to read it, and the platform enforces that rather than relying on restraint.

said.alignment-document.c3e49767.text: Akukho sigaba sekufundza lesitfolwe kulelidokhumenti. Sihloko sinye kufanele sifundvwe njenge-“Study Unit 1 – Organisational Architecture”, netimojula lesihlanganisa tona tibhalwe ngaphansi kwaso.
said.alignment-document.c3e49767.from: No study units were found in that document. One heading has to read like “Study Unit 1 – Organisational Architecture”, with the modules it covers listed under it.

said.alignment-matrix.185b0901.text: Akukho matriksi yekuhambisana lotfolwe kulencwadzi yemakhasi. Sikhala sinye kufanele sibe nesihloko lesifana ne-“Topic Elements”, kuze emalayini ahambisane nekharikhulamu.
said.alignment-matrix.185b0901.from: No alignment matrix found in this workbook. One column must be headed something like “Topic Elements”, so the rows can be matched to the curriculum.

said.alignment-matrix.2b19415b.text: Lelo yidokhumenti ye-Word. Lidokhumenti ngokwalo liyagcinwa, liyafayelwa futsi liyatfolakala ngekusesha. Lokungakwatanga kwenteka kufundza kwalo, ngobe matriksi yekuhambisana ifundvwa njengeshidi: umugca munye kulayini ngamunye wekharikhulamu, nesikhala lesinesihloko lesifana ne-“Topic Elements”. Gcina matriksi njengeshidi futsi uliphakele nalo, futsi lilayini ngalinye lekharikhulamu litawutjengisa lokukumbatsele.
said.alignment-matrix.2b19415b.from: That is a Word document. The document itself is kept, filed and searchable. What could not happen is reading it, because the alignment matrix is read as a spreadsheet: one row per curriculum line, with a column headed something like “Topic Elements”. Save the matrix as a spreadsheet and upload that as well, and each line of the curriculum will show what covers it.

said.conduct.07e411c2.text: Sho kutsi likhalo lilelani, ngemagama emfundzi uqobo lapho kungenteka.
said.conduct.07e411c2.from: Say what the grievance is about, in the learner's own words where possible.

said.conduct.1636d693.text: Likhalo lisho {firstName} {lastName}. Umuntfu lolikhalo lisitsintsa akakwati kulicubungula: inqubo icela umuntfu lotsetfwe longakhethi luhlangotsi. Tsatsa lomunye.
said.conduct.1636d693.from: The grievance names {firstName} {lastName}. Somebody the complaint is about cannot investigate it: the procedure asks for a designated impartial person. Appoint somebody else.

said.conduct.1d25ed57.text: Saziso kufanele sisho timangalo letsite. Kulalelwa kwecala ngetimangalo letingashiwo akukwati kuphendvulwa.
said.conduct.1d25ed57.from: The notice has to state the specific allegations. A hearing about unstated allegations cannot be answered.

said.conduct.1e2d5837.text: Kurekhodwe. Emalanga ekusebenta lasihlanu ekufaka sikhalo aqala lamuhla.
said.conduct.1e2d5837.from: Recorded. The five working days to appeal run from today.

said.conduct.303f7f08.text: Sho kutsi tijeziso letingenteka tiyini, kubalwa nekuphelisa lapho kungulokufanele. Umfundzi lonquma kutsi ulethe umsekeli kufanele wati kutsi kusengcupheni ini.
said.conduct.303f7f08.from: Say what sanctions are possible, including termination where it is. A learner deciding whether to bring assistance needs to know what is at stake.

said.conduct.403b3f35.text: Sho kutsi kungani. Sijeziso lesingachazwanga asivikeleki, futsi lesi yisigaba umfundzi lasifanele.
said.conduct.403b3f35.from: Say why. An unexplained sanction is indefensible, and this is the paragraph the learner is entitled to.

said.conduct.47a20502.text: Sho umtsetfo lophulwe, sitandadi lesilindzelekile nalokwenteka uma kwenteka futsi. Xwayiso lelingenako loku aliyo xwayiso.
said.conduct.47a20502.from: State the rule broken, the standard expected and what happens if it recurs. A warning that does not is not one.

said.conduct.4dcaf05f.from: That is not a date and time.

said.conduct.64f7462f.text: Saziso kufanele sitjele umfundzi kutsi angasekelwa ngumfundzi lofundza naye, kutsi angetfula licala lakhe, futsi angabita futsi abuze bafakazi. Tfumela saziso lesenta loko, bese uyasirekhoda lapha.
said.conduct.64f7462f.from: The notice must tell the learner they may be assisted by a fellow learner, present their case, and call and question witnesses. Send a notice that does, then record it here.

said.conduct.67f9675a.text: Rekhoda lokutfolakele nalokusekelwe kukho. Kulalelwa kwecala lokutfolakala kwako kungumugca munye kulalelwa kwecala lelingazange lenteke.
said.conduct.67f9675a.from: Record what was found and on what basis. A hearing whose findings are one line is a hearing that did not happen.

said.conduct.6a6b5da7.from: It has to be acknowledged by {acknowledgeBy}.

said.conduct.6d857ec5.text: Kuphelisa luhlelo lwemuntfu kudzinga kulalelwa kwecala lekwentiwe, nalokutfolakele kurekhodiwe. Buta kulalelwa kwecala, urekhode lokutfolakele, bese uvala icala.
said.conduct.6d857ec5.from: Ending somebody's programme needs a hearing that was held, with its findings recorded. Convene one, record what was found, then close the case.

said.conduct.77c80d2a.from: Lodged. It will be acknowledged within two working days.

said.conduct.869c74ee.text: Kulalelwa kwecala kudzinga saziso lesingenani lemahora la-{HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} futsi lesi sishoda ngehora {hours}. Sikhatsi lesisheshe kakhulu lesingabanjwa ngaso ngu-{earliest}. Saziso lesifishane siyiphutsa lelinqotjelwa ngalo sikhalo, noma ngabe umfundzi wentani.
said.conduct.869c74ee.from: A hearing needs at least {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} hours' notice and this is {hours} hour short. The earliest it can be held is {earliest}. Short notice is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

said.conduct.8d0ef3ad.text: Kulalelwa kwecala kubitiwe. Sikhatsi sesaziso siyafezekiswa.
said.conduct.8d0ef3ad.from: Hearing convened. The notice period is met.

said.conduct.9f172fca.from: The learner cannot investigate their own grievance.

said.conduct.ad753d2e.text: Sincumo siya emfundzini ngekubhalwa futsi kufanele sisho lokutfolakele nalokutawentiwa. Umugca akusiyo sincumo.
said.conduct.ad753d2e.from: The decision goes to the learner in writing and has to say what was found and what will be done. A line is not a decision.

said.conduct.b0301d88.text: Sho lokushiwo ngekuhlelekile. Umfundzi akakwati kuphendvula 'imizwa lemibi', futsi nekulalelwa kwecala akukwati.
said.conduct.b0301d88.from: Say what is alleged, specifically. A learner cannot answer 'poor attitude', and neither can a hearing.

said.conduct.b0dcbd53.from: Decided, and the learner has it in writing.

said.conduct.cf47131c.text: Kuvaliwe. Nika umfundzi umphumela ngekubhalwa, bese urekhoda kutsi wente njalo.
said.conduct.cf47131c.from: Closed. Give the learner the outcome in writing, then record that you have.

said.conduct.e83b2265.text: Kulalelwa kwecala kudzinga saziso lesingenani lemahora la-{HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} futsi lesi sishoda ngemahora la-{hours}. Sikhatsi lesisheshe kakhulu lesingabanjwa ngaso ngu-{earliest}. Saziso lesifishane siyiphutsa lelinqotjelwa ngalo sikhalo, noma ngabe umfundzi wentani.
said.conduct.e83b2265.from: A hearing needs at least {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} hours' notice and this is {hours} hours short. The earliest it can be held is {earliest}. Short notice is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

said.curriculum-from-document.bbcd3682.text: Dokhumenti yekharikhulamu igcinwe kodvwa akukho mbhalo lokwatanga kufundvwa kuyo. Uma kungusikena, pulatifomu ayikwati kuyifundza. Layida likhophi ledijithali bese lelikhasi lifakwa.
said.curriculum-from-document.bbcd3682.from: The curriculum document is stored but no text could be read from it. If it is a scan, the platform cannot read it. Upload a digital copy and this page will fill in.

said.curriculum-from-document.ef7c089d.text: Akukho dokhumenti yekharikhulamu lelayidiwe kulelikhwalifikheshini. Yilayide kucala futsi pulatifomu itawufundza lokungakwenta kuyo.
said.curriculum-from-document.ef7c089d.from: No curriculum document has been uploaded for this qualification yet. Upload it first and the platform will read what it can from it.

said.drive-google-drive.0281fa79.from: Google did not return an access token.

said.drive-google-drive.3ad31c62.text: Google ayisayemukeli lolo xhumo. Kungenteka lwahoxiswa ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Google. Xhuma idrayivu futsi ku-Tinkhetho.
said.drive-google-drive.3ad31c62.from: Google no longer accepts that connection. It may have been withdrawn from your Google account. Connect the drive again in Settings.

said.drive-google-drive.8761e449.text: Leyo folda ayikho, noma akhawunti lolixhumile ayikwati kuyibona. Ifolda lekwabelwana ngayo nawe kufanele ivulwe ku-Drive okungenani kanye ngaphambi kwekutsi ifundvwe.
said.drive-google-drive.8761e449.from: That folder is not there, or the account you connected cannot see it. A folder shared with you has to be opened in Drive at least once before it can be read.

said.drive-google-drive.b744db3d.text: Google yenqabe lelo sicelo. Uma lishiwo lelinani lemvume, umkhawulo we-Drive API wekufakwa kwepulatifomu ufinyelelwe okwamanje. {message}
said.drive-google-drive.b744db3d.from: Google refused that request. If it mentions a quota, the deployment's Drive API limit has been reached for now. {message}

said.drive-google-drive.c0c95fa0.text: Google ayibuyisanga indlela yekuvuselela lolo xhumo, loko kuvame kusho kutsi lena akhawunti yayisivele iyinikile. Susa kufinyelela kwepulatifomu ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Google ngaphansi kwe-Third-party apps, bese uxhuma futsi.
said.drive-google-drive.c0c95fa0.from: Google did not return a way to renew the connection, which usually means this account had already granted it. Remove the platform's access in your Google account under Third-party apps, then connect again.

said.drive-google-drive.dcf45956.text: "{name}" inkhulu kakhulu kutsi Google iyiphumise ngesicephu sinye. Landa ledokhumenti linye ku-Drive njenge-{extension} bese uyayengeta yodvwa ngemuva kwaloko; konkhe lokunye kufolda kuyafundvwa ngendlela lejwayelekile.
said.drive-google-drive.dcf45956.from: "{name}" is too large for Google to export in one piece. Download that one document from Drive as {extension} and add it on its own afterwards; everything else in the folder reads normally.

said.drive-google-drive.e9fe6eee.text: Fundza ifolda ngco ku-Google Drive yakho. Kufundvwa kuphela: pulatifomu ingatfola luhlu futsi ilande, kodvwa ayikwati kwakha, kushintsha noma kususa lutfo. Ungakuhoxisa lapha noma ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Google nganoma nini.
said.drive-google-drive.e9fe6eee.from: Read a folder straight from your Google Drive. Read-only: the platform can list and download, and cannot create, change or delete anything. You can withdraw it here or from your Google account at any time.

said.drive-import.1f557235.text: Leyo folda ayinalo lutfo lelikhona pulatifomu ingalifundza. Emadokhumenti, emaspredshithi nemaphrezentheshini onkhe ayafundvwa, kubalwa lawe-Google uqobo, ngako umphumela longenalutfo usho kutsi ifolda ayinalutfo neloko, noma inaloko lokufana ne-Forms netindlela letimfishane kuphela.
said.drive-import.1f557235.from: That folder has nothing in it the platform can read. Documents, spreadsheets and presentations are all read, including Google's own, so an empty result means the folder really is empty, or holds only things like Forms and shortcuts.

said.drive-import.6977b553.text: Leyo folda ingemaphuzu la-{known} MB, lokukhulu kunalokungafundvwa kanyekanye. Khetsa ifolda yelikhwalifikheshini linye kunedrayivu lesikuyo.
said.drive-import.6977b553.from: That folder comes to about {known} MB, which is more than can be read in one go. Choose the folder for one qualification rather than the drive it sits in.

said.drive-import.bc65916e.text: Leyo folda inemafayela la-{listedCount}, lokungetulu kwalokungafundvwa kanyekanye. Khetsa ifolda yelikhwalifikheshini linye kunedrayivu lesikuyo.
said.drive-import.bc65916e.from: That folder holds {listedCount} files, which is more than can be read in one go. Choose the folder for one qualification rather than the drive it sits in.

said.drive-index.adeba1a9.text: Awukayixhumi {label}. Yixhume ku-Tinkhetho, futsi ifolda ingafundvwa kusuka khona.
said.drive-index.adeba1a9.from: You have not connected {label}. Connect it in Settings, and the folder can be read from there.

said.drive-index.b3dd24ac.from: That drive is not one the platform knows.

said.drive-index.be999bc2.text: Lokufakwa kwepulatifomu akukwati kugcina imininingwane yekungena ngekuphepha, ngako idrayivu ayikwati kuxhunywa. Lophatsa kufanele asethe sikhiya sekuvala.
said.drive-index.be999bc2.from: This deployment cannot store a credential safely, so a drive cannot be connected. Whoever maintains it needs to set the sealing key.

said.drive-index.f1db1389.text: Xhumo le-{label} lelegciniwe alikwatanga kufundvwa. Lixhume futsi ku-Tinkhetho.
said.drive-index.f1db1389.from: The stored {label} connection cannot be read. Connect it again in Settings.

said.drive-one-drive.2f5a255d.from: Microsoft did not return an access token.

said.drive-one-drive.4180c6e1.text: Microsoft ayibuyisanga indlela yekuvuselela lolo xhumo. Kungenteka lesicelo asikhoneli kufinyelela ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
said.drive-one-drive.4180c6e1.from: Microsoft did not return a way to renew the connection. The application may not be asking for offline access.

said.drive-one-drive.74ff1cef.text: Microsoft yenqabe lelo sicelo. Akhawunti lolixhumile ingase ingabi nakho kufinyelela kuleyo folda. {message}
said.drive-one-drive.74ff1cef.from: Microsoft refused that request. The account you connected may not have access to that folder. {message}

said.drive-one-drive.a65a4207.from: Microsoft no longer accepts that connection. It may have been withdrawn from your account. Connect the drive again in Settings.

said.eisa-registration.3015ea44.text: Kubhalisa akukwati kuvalwa ngemuva kwekuhlala kuhlolwa lokusikona.
said.eisa-registration.3015ea44.from: Registration cannot close after the sitting it is for.

said.eisa-sitting-notice.4242bc7f.text: Akukho kuhlala kuhlolwa lokurekhodiwe kwe-{subject}. Emalanga atfolakala encwadzini yemlingani wesikhwalitsi sekuhlola futsi ashintsha njalo ngemnyaka. Kuze afakwe, akukho lapha lokungakwenta likuxwayise kutsi lilanga lekuvala kubhalisa liyasondzela.
said.eisa-sitting-notice.4242bc7f.from: No sittings are recorded for {subject}. The dates come from the assessment quality partner's letter and change every year. Until they are entered, nothing here can warn you that a registration deadline is coming.

said.eisa-sitting-notice.b6bf1cc3.text: Akukho kuhlala kuhlolwa lokurekhodiwe kwe-{subject}. Umlingani wesikhwalitsi sekuhlola ushicilela emalanga ngaDisemba, ngako incwadzi kufanele isivele iphumile: wengete futsi kubala kucale.
said.eisa-sitting-notice.b6bf1cc3.from: No sittings are recorded for {subject}. The assessment quality partner publishes the dates in December, so the letter should be out: add them and the countdown starts.

said.eisa-sitting-notice.d6b538b0.text: Akukho kuhlala kuhlolwa lokurekhodiwe. Kutfolakala encwadzini yemlingani wesikhwalitsi sekuhlola, leshicilelwa kanye ngemnyaka.
said.eisa-sitting-notice.d6b538b0.from: No sittings are recorded. They come from the assessment quality partner's letter, which is published once a year.

said.eisa.041d2d1d.text: Kurekhodwe. Kubala kucala kwekubhalisa kucala manje.
said.eisa.041d2d1d.from: Recorded. The countdown to registration starts now.

said.enrolment-document-shape.04f2917b.text: Kucinisekiswa kudzala kunesikhatsi lesivunyelwe. Sicela ucinisekiswe likhophi lelisha.
said.enrolment-document-shape.04f2917b.from: The certification is older than the period allowed. Please have a fresh copy certified.

said.enrolment-document-shape.3d15f524.text: Lena akusilo likhophi lelicinisekisiwe. Sicela ulicinisekise bese uyalitfumela futsi.
said.enrolment-document-shape.3d15f524.from: This is not a certified copy. Please have it certified and send it again.

said.enrolment-document-shape.8d2c9fdc.text: Likhophi alifundzeki. Sicela ulisikene noma ulitsatse titfombe futsi, licondzile futsi likhanya kahle.
said.enrolment-document-shape.8d2c9fdc.from: The copy is not legible. Please scan or photograph it again, flat and in good light.

said.enrolment-document-shape.a7aecdc1.text: I-ID inelilanga lekucinisekisa lelinyenti kunelilodvwa. Sicela unikele likhophi lelicinisekiswe kanye, kamuva nje.
said.enrolment-document-shape.a7aecdc1.from: The ID has more than one certification date on it. Please supply a copy certified once, recently.

said.enrolment-document-shape.ad8ee9a7.from: This is not the document that was asked for.

said.enrolment-document-shape.d9deb62d.from: Some of the pages are missing.

said.enrolment-documents.07cca752.text: Akukho lokurekhodiwe: akukho kukhokha lokwenteke ngeliqoqo noma ngemfundzi.
said.enrolment-documents.07cca752.from: Nothing recorded: neither the cohort nor the learner has a payment against them.

said.enrolment-documents.221ad898.from: Paid for by the client, against {name}.

said.enrolment-documents.26e4b850.text: Nika lilanga lekucinisekiswa kwalelikhophi. Likhophi lelingatiwa lilanga lekucinisekiswa kwalo alikwati kukhonjiswa kutsi lisha.
said.enrolment-documents.26e4b850.from: Give the date this copy was certified. A copy whose certification date is unknown cannot be shown to be current.

said.enrolment-documents.330b87d3.from: The learner supplied their own proof of payment.

said.enrolment-documents.3f1d945a.from: The learner has supplied a proof of payment, not yet checked.

said.enrolment-documents.435df660.from: The learner's proof of payment was refused.

said.enrolment-documents.98317f79.text: Sho kutsi kungani kwenqatjwe. Umfundzi kufanele atjelwe kutsi kufanele alungise ini, futsi kwenqaba ngaphandle kwesizatfu kumbuyisa angenalutfo lekwentiwa.
said.enrolment-documents.98317f79.from: Say why it was refused. The learner has to be told what to correct, and a refusal with no reason sends them back with nothing to act on.

said.enrolment-documents.d417e6fa.text: Lelikhophi licinisekiswe ngo-{certifiedOn}, lokungetulu kwemalanga la-{CERTIFICATION_VALID_DAYS} ledlule. Likhophi lelicinisekisiwe kufanele libe lisha uma linikelwa.
said.enrolment-documents.d417e6fa.from: That copy was certified on {certifiedOn}, which is more than {CERTIFICATION_VALID_DAYS} days ago. A certified copy has to be current when it is supplied.

said.enrolment-form.141771ac.text: Kusuka kuluhlu lwamakhodi endzawo we-STATSSA lolushicilelwa yi-QCTO.
said.enrolment-form.141771ac.from: From the STATSSA area code list the QCTO publishes.

said.enrolment-form.158eb69b.text: Umbiko ubuta kutsi umfundzi uvumile yini, nangulilanga lini.
said.enrolment-form.158eb69b.from: The return asks whether the learner agreed, and on what date.

said.enrolment-form.3ecff80b.text: Ubulili loburekhodiwe abuhambelani nalobusenombolweni yesazisi. I-QCTO iyakuhlola loku, ngako lenye yato totimbili ibhalwe kabi.
said.enrolment-form.3ecff80b.from: The gender recorded does not match the one in the identity number. The QCTO checks this, so one of the two is mistyped.

said.enrolment-form.5d06240c.text: Lilanga lekutalwa lelirekhodiwe ({recorded}) alihambelani nenombolo yesazisi, lesho {fromId}.
said.enrolment-form.5d06240c.from: The date of birth recorded ({recorded}) does not match the identity number, which says {fromId}.

said.enrolment-form.7d5cda8a.text: Kucinisekisiwe, futsi lilanga lirekhodiwe. Shintsha noma yini lapha kamuva futsi itakucela kutsi ucinisekise futsi.
said.enrolment-form.7d5cda8a.from: Confirmed, and the date recorded. Change anything here later and it will ask you to confirm again.

said.enrolment-form.a380df96.from: Saved. You can come back and finish it later.

said.enrolment-form.a8dcc4e9.from: The identity number does not check out: {reason}

said.enrolment-form.b67325d1.text: Akekho lovumile kutsi lemininingwane ilungile. Umphenyi ucela lefomu njengebufakazi, futsi lelingakacinisekiswa libufakazi lobuncane kakhulu.
said.enrolment-form.b67325d1.from: Nobody has confirmed these details are right. A monitor asks for the form as evidence, and an unconfirmed one is evidence of very little.

said.enrolment-form.b711b7ce.text: Kukhubateka kurekhodiwe, futsi i-QCTO iyacela kutsi kubanga kuhlupheka lokungakanani.
said.enrolment-form.b711b7ce.from: A disability was recorded, and the QCTO then requires how much difficulty it causes.

said.enrolment-form.ca9579a9.text: Sifundza lapho umfundzi asebenta khona, lokungahlali kuyindzawo lapho ahlala khona.
said.enrolment-form.ca9579a9.from: The province the learner works in, which is not always where they live.

said.enrolment.65b99bc7.from: That person is already enrolled on this course.

said.enrolment.678cc7c5.from: There is no due date on this one.

said.enrolment.6ac9079d.from: That enrolment belongs to someone else.

said.enrolment.79fda720.from: Only the learner can record their own progress.

said.enrolment.ab1eec65.from: That lesson is not part of this course.

said.extensions-claude-code.149b1d9d.text: I-Claude Code ayifakiwe lapho pulatifomu isebenta khona.
said.extensions-claude-code.149b1d9d.from: Claude Code is not installed where the platform is running.

said.extensions-claude-code.1c9bd1dc.text: I-Claude Code ifakiwe kulekhompyutha kodvwa akekho lowengiwe. Vula itheminali, gijima claude, bese /login uphelelise kungena ebrawuzeni. Loku kwenteka kanye kuphela futsi kwentiwa nguwe, hhayi yipulatifomu.
said.extensions-claude-code.1c9bd1dc.from: Claude Code is installed on this machine but nobody is signed in. Open a terminal, run claude, then /login and complete the sign-in in the browser. That is a one-time step and it is done by you, not by the platform.

said.extensions-claude-code.53fe3e99.text: Umkhawulo wekusetjentiswa wesibhalisiso se-Claude usifinyelelwe. Loku kutawusebenta futsi uma umkhawulo usubuyele ekucaleni.
said.extensions-claude-code.53fe3e99.from: The Claude subscription's usage limit has been reached. This will work again once the limit resets.

said.extensions-claude-code.7f69ba19.text: Isebentisa sibhalisiso sakho se-Claude, ngethokheni lozivelelela yona ekhompyutheni yakho ngo-`claude setup-token`. Akusiyo API key: akukho kucanjelwa ngethokheni ngayinye, futsi isebentisa sibhalisiso losivele usikhokhela hhayi lesabelwanako.
said.extensions-claude-code.7f69ba19.from: Uses your own Claude subscription, through a token you generate on your own computer with `claude setup-token`. Not an API key: no per-token cost, and it draws on the subscription you already pay for rather than a shared one.

said.extensions-claude-code.801580be.from: Claude Code did not answer within {timeoutMs} seconds.

said.extensions-gemini.0473bc2d.text: Akukho API key ye-Gemini lolondvolotelwe wena. Yengete ku-Tinkhetho. Ivela ku-Google AI Studio, futsi ayifani nesibhalisiso se-Gemini.
said.extensions-gemini.0473bc2d.from: No Gemini API key is stored for you. Add one in Settings. It comes from Google AI Studio, and is not the same as a Gemini subscription.

said.extensions-gemini.18ddcba7.text: Leyo API key ye-Gemini ayilungile. Hlola kutsi yakopishwe yonkhe kusuka ku-Google AI Studio. Ayifani nesibhalisiso se-Gemini Advanced, lesingafaki kufinyelela kwe-API.
said.extensions-gemini.18ddcba7.from: That Gemini API key is not valid. Check it was copied whole from Google AI Studio. It is not the same thing as a Gemini Advanced subscription, which does not include API access.

said.extensions-gemini.3bf73475.text: Umkhawulo wemacelo we-Google walolo API key ufinyelelwe. Leleveli lesimahhala livumela emacelo lanciphile ngemizuzu; linda uphindze uzame, noma usebentise API key lenekukhokha lokuvuliwe.
said.extensions-gemini.3bf73475.from: Google's rate limit for that key has been reached. The free tier allows a limited number of requests a minute; wait and try again, or use a key with billing enabled.

said.extensions-gemini.599b82c0.text: Gemini ayiphendvulanga ngesikhatsi. Ifolda lenkhulu ingatsatsa emizuzu lemibalwa; kuzama futsi ngemadokhumenti lambalwa kuvamise kusebenta.
said.extensions-gemini.599b82c0.from: Gemini did not answer in time. A large folder can take several minutes; trying again with fewer documents in it usually works.

said.extensions-gemini.5f764f27.text: Gemini ayikwatanga kufinyelelwa. Hlola kutsi lekhompyutha inayo inethiwekhi ku-Google.
said.extensions-gemini.5f764f27.from: Gemini could not be reached. Check that this machine has a network connection to Google.

said.extensions-gemini.6ff1fd27.text: Gemini iphelelwe yindzawo ngaphambi kwekuphetsa kuphendvula, ngako lokubuyile kuyingcenye yekharikhulamu hhayi yonkhe, futsi lengcenye ibukeka injengephelele. Akukho lokugcinwe. Likhwalifikheshini lonkhe kucela kakhulu ngephendvulo linye; lingenise emadokhumenteni alo kunalokho, lokufundza kharikhulamu ngco ngaphandle kwemodeli futsi ngaphandle kwemkhawulo kanjena.
said.extensions-gemini.6ff1fd27.from: Gemini ran out of room before it finished answering, so what came back is part of a curriculum rather than all of it, and a partial one looks exactly like a complete one. Nothing was kept. A whole qualification is a great deal to ask for in a single reply; import it from its documents instead, which reads the curriculum directly with no model involved and no limit of this kind.

said.extensions-gemini.7b1ee4ba.text: Gemini iphendvule ngekungabi nalutfo. Loko kuvame kusho kutsi sicelo senqatjwe sihlungi sekuphepha, noma ligama lemodeli alilungile.
said.extensions-gemini.7b1ee4ba.from: Gemini answered with nothing. That usually means the request was refused by a safety filter, or the model name is wrong.

said.extensions-gemini.a3035142.text: Lamadokhumenti angetulu kwema-{MAX_INPUT_CHARS},000 emabhonco, lokukhulu kunalokungatfunyelwa ngesicelo sinye. Ngenisa likhwalifikheshini emadokhumenteni alo kunalokho: dokhumenti yekharikhulamu yodvwa ifundvwa ngco, ngaphandle kwemodeli.
said.extensions-gemini.a3035142.from: Those documents come to more than {MAX_INPUT_CHARS},000 characters, which is more than can be sent in one request. Import the qualification from its documents instead: the curriculum document alone is read directly, with no model involved.

said.extensions-gemini.c9f3d2b7.text: Google ibike inkinga ngasohlangotsini lwayo ({status}). Sicelo lesincane sifanele kuzanywa futsi kalula. Uma lelibekukhonjiswa ngukuphelela kwelikhwalifikheshini futsi sehlulekile kanyenti, sicelo sikhulu kakhulu kutsi imodeli isiphelelise. Ngeniswe emadokhumenteni alo kunalokho, lokufundza kharikhulamu ngco ngaphandle kwemodeli.
said.extensions-gemini.c9f3d2b7.from: Google reported a problem on their side ({status}). A small request is worth simply trying again. If this was a whole qualification and it has now failed more than once, the request is most likely too large for the model to complete. Import it from its documents instead, which reads the curriculum directly with no model involved.

said.fisa.4ffaa428.text: Le-FISA ayikasayinwa ngumlinganisi. Liphepha lelingakalinganiswa ngaphambi kwekusetjentiswa alikwati kubhalwa: loko yikona kulinganiswa kwentelwe kona.
said.fisa.4ffaa428.from: This FISA has not been signed off by a moderator yet. A paper that has not been pre-moderated cannot be sat: that is what the moderation is for.

said.fisa.620b3718.text: Sivumelwano sekufihla asikasayinwa. Akekho longabona noma ahlole lokusekhatsi kwe-FISA angakasayini.
said.fisa.620b3718.from: The confidentiality agreement has not been signed yet. Nobody may see or judge the contents of a FISA before signing it.

said.fisa.6d7ad3d8.text: Kuvuliwe. Beka umhloli wephepha nomlinganisi ngasemuva.
said.fisa.6d7ad3d8.from: Opened. Appoint an examiner and a moderator next.

said.fisa.6e61efe5.from: Pre-moderate it first. Sending the QCTO a paper your own moderator has not signed off is the wrong way round.

said.fisa.6f4251d6.text: Kuphela i-FISA lesayinwe ledzinga inguqulo lensha; lena isangalungiswa.
said.fisa.6f4251d6.from: Only a signed-off FISA needs a new version; this one can still be edited.

said.fisa.8634f8d4.text: Lowo ngumuntfu lofanako no-{other}. Kulinganiswa kwangaphambi kunenzuzo ngobe umuntfu lowesibili ulibukile.

said.fisa.86b96040.text: Inguqulo lensha yesifanekiso ivuliwe. Idzinga umhloli wephepha wayo, umlinganisi nekulinganisa.
said.fisa.86b96040.from: A new draft version is open. It needs its own examiner, moderator and moderation.

said.fisa.8cde49ff.text: Akekho umlinganisi lobekiwe, ngako akekho lokungamtfumelwa.
said.fisa.8cde49ff.from: No moderator has been appointed yet, so there is nobody to send it to.

said.fisa.99e0c84b.text: I-FISA isetwa ngumhlinzeki luhlelo lwakhe lwemakhono. Likhwalifikheshini lelipheleleko noma lengcenye lihlolwa ngaphandle ngumlingani wesikhwalitsi sekuhlola, ngako umhlinzeki akasibeki leliphepha.
said.fisa.99e0c84b.from: A FISA is set by the provider for its own skills programme. A full or part qualification is assessed externally by the Assessment Quality Partner, so the provider does not set that paper.

said.fisa.a82c37e7.text: Kusayinwe njengekufanele injongo. Labahlolwako bangahlala leliphepha manje.
said.fisa.a82c37e7.from: Signed off as fit for purpose. Candidates may now sit this paper.

said.fisa.c7fed1e7.text: Le-FISA isayinwe. Vula inguqulo lensha kunekushintsha liphepha lelingenteka lisivele lahlalwa.
said.fisa.c7fed1e7.from: This FISA has been signed off. Open a new version rather than changing a paper that may already have been sat.

said.fisa.d9072f1c.from: Agreement recorded. They may now work on the paper.

said.qualification-from-document.b40e3a7.text: Kwakhiwe njengengcenye ye-"{title}", kutsatfwa timojula la-{idsCount} kulete-{parentModulesCount}. Kharikhulamu yayo ngeyomzali; akukho lokukopishiwe, ngako umsebenti wemfundzi ngemojula ubalwa kanye noma ngabe bahlangana nayo kuphi.
said.qualification-from-document.b40e3a7.from: Created as a part of "{title}", taking {idsCount} of its {parentModulesCount} modules. Its curriculum is the parent's; nothing was copied, so a learner's work against a module counts once wherever they met it.

said.qualification-from-document.bd19467.from: "{title}" already carries the code {curriculumCode}. Importing again here would replace its whole curriculum, and anything tagged to a criterion would go with it. Open that qualification instead.

said.reassessment.051a9a39.text: Bhala phasi lokubutiwe nalokuphendvulwe ngaphambi kwekurekhoda umphumela. Kuphasa ngemlomo ngaphandle kwerekhodi yalokwentiwe akusiyo bufakazi.
said.reassessment.051a9a39.from: Write down what was asked and answered before recording the outcome. An oral pass with no record of the exchange is not evidence.

said.reassessment.2a95a5d9.from: A programme review follows {ATTEMPTS_BEFORE_REVIEW} not-yet-competent results. This learner has {notYetCompetent}.

said.reassessment.54d33118.text: Lomfundzi usevele wadlula ekubuyeketeni luhlelo kulokuhlolwa.
said.reassessment.54d33118.from: This learner has already been through a programme review on this assessment.

said.reassessment.7eeb4562.text: Chaza umuntfu kumsebenti locoshwe naye. Umsebenti longenaligama akusiyo bufakazi bekutsi kucoshwa kwenteke.
said.reassessment.7eeb4562.from: Name the person at the employer who was consulted. An unnamed employer is not evidence that a consultation happened.

said.reassessment.df7ff299.from: That authorisation has already been used. A third attempt granted twice is not a third attempt.

said.recognition.056d89d8.text: Kukhululela {title} kutawuyisa lomfundzi ku-{wouldBePercent} yetiphesenti telikhwalifikheshini lelemukelwe ngaphandle kwekufundziswa, futsi umkhawulo kulelikhwalifikheshini ngu-{maxPercent}. Lokusele kufanele kwentiwe njengekufundza lokujwayelekile, noma umkhawulo ushintshwe kulikhwalifikheshini ngesizatfu.
said.recognition.056d89d8.from: Exempting {title} would take this learner to {wouldBePercent} per cent of the qualification recognised without being taught, and the limit on this qualification is {maxPercent}. The rest has to be done as ordinary learning, or the limit changed on the qualification with a reason for it.

said.recognition.165f2f8f.text: Lohlolwako akakabi nesikhatsi sekululekwa. Kuhlola kufundza lokwendlulile ngetidzingo lengazange kuchazwe muntfu yikona kwehlulwa lohlolwako ngekubutsa bufakazi lobungafanele. Rekhoda seluleko kucala.
said.recognition.165f2f8f.from: This candidate has not had an advisory session. Judging prior learning against requirements nobody explained is how a candidate is failed for assembling the wrong evidence. Record the advice first.

said.recognition.2f3e0747.text: Sincumo sirekhodiwe. Asinikeli lutfo kuze silinganiswe.
said.recognition.2f3e0747.from: Judgement recorded. It grants nothing until it is moderated.

said.recognition.3d78b1cc.text: Sho lokubuke kona nekutsi uyavuma yini. Kulinganisa ngaphandle kwembono kungusayino.
said.recognition.3d78b1cc.from: Say what you looked at and whether you agree. A moderation with no comment is a signature.

said.recognition.4cf70aee.text: Sho kutsi emiphumela yalokubanjwe ihlanganisa njani yemojula. Lesigaba siwo wonkhe sincumo, futsi kuhambisa ngaphandle kwaso kungumangalo longekho longawucinisekisa.
said.recognition.4cf70aee.from: Say how the outcomes of what they hold cover this module's. That paragraph is the whole of the decision, and a transfer without it is a claim nobody can check.

said.recognition.61201ac5.text: Sho kutsi bufakazi bebuyini futsi kungani buhlangabetana nemojula. Lesigaba siwo wonkhe sincumo, futsi yikona kucala umcinisekisi wangaphandle akufundza.
said.recognition.61201ac5.from: Say what the evidence was and why it satisfies the module. This paragraph is the whole of the judgement, and the first thing an external verifier reads.

said.recognition.86f838fe.text: Loko kwanikwa ngo-{awardedOn}, lokungetulu kweminyaka la-{CAT_YEARS} ngaphambi kwalokuvunywa. Kuhambisa nekuqoqa Likhredithi kubhekelela kuphetsa ngaphakatsi kweminyaka la-{CAT_YEARS2}; ngetulu kwaloko indlela ngiKwemukelwa Kwekufundza Lokwendlulile, lokuhlola lokusakwati umfundzi kukwente hhayi lokwake wakuphasa. Vula sicelo se-RPL kunalokho.
said.recognition.86f838fe.from: That was awarded on {awardedOn}, more than {CAT_YEARS} years before this approval. Credit Accumulation and Transfer covers completions within {CAT_YEARS2} years; beyond that the route is Recognition of Prior Learning, which assesses what the learner can still do rather than what they once passed. Open an RPL application instead.

said.recognition.d4a3fd91.text: Rekhoda lokutjelwe lohlolwako kutsi akubute. Lohlolwako lonqatjiwe uyakuphikisa lesigaba, futsi 'kululekwe ngetidzingo' akusiso.
said.recognition.d4a3fd91.from: Record what the candidate was told to gather. A refused candidate disputes this paragraph, and 'advised on requirements' is not one.

said.recognition.e21aaea2.from: You cannot moderate your own judgement.

said.recognition.e7122f98.text: Indzima yakho ayifaki loku. Kwemukelwa kubanjwe bantfu bemhlinzeki uqobo, futsi sincumo silinganiswa ngumuntfu lohlukile kulowasenta.
said.recognition.e7122f98.from: Your role does not include this. Recognition is held by the provider's own staff, and a judgement is moderated by somebody other than whoever made it.

said.study-unit-alignment.dfcd9590.text: Dokhumenti ichaza timojula {wantedCount} ({wanted}) futsi lelikhwalifikheshini alinayo kharikhulamu okwamanje. Ngenisa kharikhulamu kucala; tigaba tekufundza nemiphumela yato tirekhodwa kokubili, futsi kulayida lena dokhumenti futsi ngemuva kutawutixhuma.
said.study-unit-alignment.dfcd9590.from: The document names {wantedCount} modules ({wanted}) and this qualification has no curriculum yet. Import the curriculum first; the study units and their outcomes are recorded either way, and uploading this document again afterwards will link them.

said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.text: Akukho neyodvwa yetimojula la-{wantedCount} lechazwe yileyo dokhumenti lekwatiwe kufaniswa, ngako akukho lokufakwe ngaphansi kwesigaba sekufundza. Dokhumenti ishiwo {wanted}. Kharikhulamu ibamba {held}. Kufaniswa akunaki tikhala nemahayfeni, ngako tinhlelo totimbili tihlukile ngeliphutsa. Lungisa emakhodi kuwo onkhe emaceleni bese ulayida dokhumenti futsi.
said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.from: None of the {wantedCount} modules this document names could be matched, so nothing has been placed under a study unit. The document names {wanted}. This curriculum holds {held}. Matching ignores spaces and hyphens, so the two schemes genuinely differ. Correct the codes on either side and upload the document again.

said.support.2b757921.text: Kuhlolwa ngemlomo kulandzela kuphutsa kwesibili kuphela ngesizatfu setemphilo. Ngaphandle kwaso siphetfo kulahlekelwa, lapho umfundzi asengakwati kufaka sikhalo.
said.support.2b757921.from: An oral assessment follows a second miss only on medical grounds. Without one the outcome is a forfeit, which the learner can still appeal.

said.support.32314e12.text: Umfundzi kufanele avume kutsi loku kurekhodwe ngaphambi kwekutsi kwentiwe njalo. Temphilo, kukhubateka netimo tetimali lokungemininingwane yangasese lekhetsekile, futsi kuvuma kubhalisa kwakusiko kuvuma loku.
said.support.32314e12.from: The learner has to agree to this being recorded before it can be. Health, disability and financial circumstances are special personal information, and agreeing to enrol was not agreeing to this.

said.support.3e521f24.text: Sho kutsi kungani lusito luphela. Umfundzi lokulungiselelwe kwakhe kuyekela ngaphandle kwesizatfu akanayo indlela yekukubuyisa.
said.support.3e521f24.from: Say why the support is ending. A learner whose accommodation stops without a reason has no way to ask for it back.

said.support.6396d34b.text: Lilanga lekwengeta selivele lisethelwe lokuhlolwa: {additionalDate}, ngemuva kwekuphutsa ngo-{missedOn}. Inqubo ivumela linye. Uma lelo lilanga nalo lishiywe, rekhoda lokwentekile kulo kunekusetha lelinye.
said.support.6396d34b.from: An additional date was already set for this assessment: {additionalDate}, after a miss on {missedOn}. The procedure allows one. If that date was also missed, record what happened to it rather than setting another.

said.support.6af4db9d.text: Uma lokulungiselelwe kungasebenti, sho kutsi kuyashintsha ini. Kubuyeketa lokurekhoda kwehluleka kungashintshi lutfo kubukeka njengekukhutsala kanye nalokuphambene.
said.support.6af4db9d.from: If the accommodation is not working, say what is changing. A review that records a failure and adjusts nothing reads as diligence and is the opposite.

said.support.7af7d42b.text: Lilanga lekwengeta kufanele libe ngemuva kwalelo lelashiywa.
said.support.7af7d42b.from: The additional date has to be after the one that was missed.

said.support.8452172c.text: Sho lokutfolile. Kubuyeketa lokungenalo lokutfolile kungulilanga ngekwalo efayelini.
said.support.8452172c.from: Say what you found. A review with no finding is a date in a file.

said.support.e34f2e55.text: Sho kutsi kuyentiwani ngempela. Sidzingo lesingenalo lokulungiselelwe alutfo lolushintsha kumfundzi.
said.support.e34f2e55.from: Say what will actually be done. A need with no accommodation against it changes nothing for the learner.

said.support.f4565c1a.text: Sho kutsi sizatfu setemphilo bekuyini. Kuhlolwa ngemlomo lokugunyaziwe ngesizatfu lesingaphandle kwerekhodi kuyikuhlala lokubutwa ngumcinisekisi wangaphandle.
said.support.f4565c1a.from: Say what the medical ground was. An oral assessment authorised on an unrecorded reason is the sitting an external verifier asks about.

said.unit-competency.34155bb7.from: What each study unit of this qualification achieves: its exit level outcome, or the unit itself where it serves none. Made by the platform from the qualification's own documents.

shell.account.text: Akhawunti ya wena: phasiwedi na ririmi

nav./recognition.text: Dyondzo leyi tshameke yi ri kona

login.intro.text: Nghena leswaku u ya emahlweni ni dyondzo ya wena.
login.intro.from: Sign in to continue your learning.

login.trouble.text: U na xiphiqo xo nghena? Vulavula ni mufambisi wa wena: u nga ku cincela phasiwedi.
login.trouble.from: Trouble signing in? Speak to your facilitator: they can reset a password for you.

login.locked.text: Ku ringete ka ku tala. Yimela timinete ta khume-ntlhanu kutani u ringeta nakambe.
login.locked.from: Too many attempts. Wait fifteen minutes and try again.

login.missing.text: Nghenisa adiresi ya wena ya imeyili ni phasiwedi.
login.missing.from: Enter your email address and password.

login.sso.refused.text: Akhawunti yoleyo a yi nge ngheni laha. Yi fanele ku tirhisa adiresi yin'we ya imeyili ni akhawunti ya wena eka pulatifomo leyi. Nghena hi phasiwedi ya wena, kumbe u kombela mutirhisi-lonkulu.
login.sso.refused.from: That account cannot sign in here. It has to use the same email address as your account on this platform. Sign in with your password, or ask your administrator.

login.sso.expired.text: Ku nghena loku ku tekile nkarhi wo leha, kumbe ku sungurile kun'wana. Ringeta nakambe.
login.sso.expired.from: That sign-in took too long, or was started somewhere else. Try again.

login.sso.off.text: Ndlela yoleyo yo nghena a yi pfuriwanga laha.
login.sso.off.from: That way of signing in is not switched on here.

account.forcedIntro.text: Un'wana u vekile phasiwedi leyi u nghenaka ha yona. Yi cinceni u nga se ya emahlweni.
account.forcedIntro.from: Somebody else set the password you signed in with. Replace it before carrying on.

account.newHint.text: Ku nga heti eka swikhale swa 12. Xivulwa xa marito mambirhi kumbe ku tlula, lama nga fambisani, xi tiya ngopfu naswona xi olova ku tsundzuka ku tlula xo koma xi ni timaki.
account.newHint.from: At least 12 characters. A phrase of a few unrelated words is both stronger and easier to remember than something short with symbols in it.

account.mismatch.text: Tiphasiwedi leti tintshwa timbirhi a ti fani.
account.mismatch.from: The two new passwords do not match.

account.forcedNote.text: Ku yi cinca ku humesa un'wana ni un'wana la tirhisaka phasiwedi ya khale, ku katsa loyi a ku nyikeke yona.
account.forcedNote.from: Changing it signs out anyone else using the old password, including whoever passed it to you.

account.languageIntro.text: Ririmi leri pulatifomo leyi vulavulaka na wena hi rona. Swiscrini leswi nga si hundzuluxiwa swi tshama hi Xinghezi, naswona mavito ya mupfuneti wa wena wa swilo swa yena ma hlayisiwa hilaha a ma tsaleke hakona.
account.languageIntro.from: The language this platform speaks to you in. Screens not yet translated stay in English, and your provider's own names for things are kept as they wrote them.

learn.notYours.text: U ri karhi u languta ku tsarisiwa ka un'wana. U nga vona mahanyelo ya yena kambe u nga khomi rekhodo ya wona.
learn.notYours.from: You are viewing someone else's enrolment. You can see their progress but cannot record it for them.

home.feedbackMany.text: Swilo swin'wana leswi u fanelaka ku hi byela swona
home.feedbackMany.from: A few things to tell us

home.feedbackIntro.text: Tinhlamulo ti tivisiwa swin'we ni ta un'wana ni un'wana, ku nga ri yin'we yin'we. Timinete timbirhi ha yin'we, naswona hi yona ntsena leyi cincaka ndlela leyi ntlawa lowu landzelaka wu fambisiwaka hi yona.
home.feedbackIntro.from: Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. Two minutes each, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

home.earnedIntro.text: Swi tsariwa hi siku leri u hetiseke ha rona, ku nga ri loko xitifikeyiti xi fika. Xin'wana ni xin'wana xi ni nkomba lowu un'wana ni un'wana a nga wu kambisisaka.
home.earnedIntro.from: Recorded on the day you finished, rather than when the certificate eventually arrives. Each carries a reference anybody can check.

home.step.afterPrevious.text: Swi pfuriwa loko u heta ntlhandlamano lowu tlulaka

home.nothingYet.from: You have not been assigned anything yet.

home.statementsIntro.text: Xi tise eka nkambisiso wa le handle na dokumente ya wena ya vun'wini. Ndhawu yo kambisisa yi xi kambisisa u nga se tshama.
home.statementsIntro.from: Take this to the external assessment with your identity document. The centre checks it before you may sit.

assess.moderated.text: Swi languteriwile naswona swi languteriwile hi mulanguteri.

assess.developmental.text: Leswi i swa nhluvuko. A ku na nchumu laha lowu ku lwisaka.

assess.awaitingAssessor.text: Nkambisiso lowu wu hlayiwa eka kwalifikheyixini ya wena, hikwalaho mukambisisi u ta wu languta a tlhela a tsala xiboho xa vuswikoti. U ta vona mbuyelo loko leswi swi hetiwile.
assess.awaitingAssessor.from: This assessment counts towards your qualification, so an assessor will review it and record the competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

assess.practicePassed.text: Lowu a wu ri wa ku ringeta, hikwalaho mbuyelo wu tsariwa eka dyondzo ya wena kambe a wu nge tlheli wu boha kwalifikheyixini.
assess.practicePassed.from: This was practice, so the result is recorded against your learning but does not decide a qualification.

assess.practiceFailed.text: Lowu a wu ri wa ku ringeta. Languta swilo swa dyondzo kutani u ringeta nakambe.
assess.practiceFailed.from: This was practice. Review the material and try again.

assess.whyMarked.text: Xivangelo hi xona lexi kombiwaka laha, ku nga ri bokisi le henhla.
assess.whyMarked.from: The reason is what is marked here, not the box above.

assess.kept.text: Tinhlamulo ta wena ti hlayisiwa loko u ri karhi u tirha. Ku rhumela hi ku ti rhumela leswaku ti kambisiswa.
assess.kept.from: Your answers are kept as you work. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

evidence.doneIntro.from: An assessor will review it and record a competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

evidence.fingerprinted.text: Rifayili rin'wana ni rin'wana ri kumile mfungho wa rona:

evidence.fingerprintNote.text: Loko rifayili leri hlayisiweke ri cinciwile, mfungho wa rona a wu nge ha fambelani. Leswi swi sirhelela ntirho wa wena hilaha swi sirhelelaka nkambisiso hakona.
evidence.fingerprintNote.from: If any stored file were ever altered, its fingerprint would stop matching. That protects your work as much as it protects the assessment.

evidence.kinds.text: Swifaniso, xirhekhodo xa ntirho, bukwana ya ntirho leyi skenweke, kumbe dokumente. U nga hlanganisa swin'wana swo tala hi nkarhi wun'we.
evidence.kinds.from: Photographs, a recording of the task, a scanned logbook, or a document. You can attach several at once.

evidence.note.text: Nchumu wun'wana ni wun'wana lowu mukambisisi a fanelaka ku wu tiva

paper.formative.text: Leswi i ku lulamisela. Swi kambisisiwa kutani swi tlhelisiwa eka wena, naswona a swi tekeli xiboho xin'wana.

paper.handedIn.text: U yi nyikeleke. A yi nge cinciwi.
