notify.nothingYet.from: Nothing yet. You will be told here when training is assigned or due, when work is waiting for you, and when an assessment result or certificate arrives.

cert.print.text: Print kumbe u hlayisa xitifikeyiti lexi

cert.notNational.text: Lexi i xitifikeyiti xa {provider} n'wini xa ndzetelo lowu wu wu nyikeke. Xi nga ri xitifikeyiti xa tiko naswona a xi na kridithi kumbe nkomba wa SAQA. Loko mudyondzi a ri karhi a tirha ku ya eka kwalifikheyixini ya ntirho, xitifikeyiti xa yona xi humesiwa hi QCTO.
cert.notNational.from: This is {provider}'s own certificate for a course it delivered. It is not a national qualification and does not carry a SAQA credit or identifier. Where a learner is working towards an occupational qualification, the certificate for it is issued by the QCTO.

cert.anyone.text: Un'wana ni un'wana a nga tiyisisa xitifikeyiti lexi hi nkomba lowu nga laha henhla, handle ko lava akhawunti.
cert.anyone.from: Anyone can confirm this certificate with the reference above, without needing an account.

work.introCoach.text: Vadyondzi lava u va langutaka. U tiyisisa leswi va swi endleke ntirhweni; a ku na nchumu lowu fikaka eka mukambisisi handle ka xisayino xa wena.
work.introCoach.from: The learners you supervise. You confirm what they did in the workplace; nothing reaches an assessor without your signature.

work.introLearner.text: Ntokoto wa ntirho wu endliwa eka mutirhisi kutani wu sayiniwa hi mukoki wa ntirho la nga kona. Ntlhandlamano wu tiyisiwile: u wu tsala, mukoki wa wena u wu tiyisisa, kutani wu ya eka mukambisisi.
work.introLearner.from: Work experience is done at an employer and signed off by the workplace coach there. The order is fixed: you record it, your coach confirms it, then it goes to an assessor.

work.noneManage.text: A ku na {records} yin'wana. Lulamisa yin'we laha henhla: ntwanano lowu vitanaka mudyondzi, mutirhisi ni mukoki, kutani wun'wana eka modyuli wun'wana ni wun'wana wa ntokoto wa ntirho.
work.noneManage.from: No {records} yet. Set one up above: an agreement naming the learner, the employer and the coach, then one for each work experience module.

work.none.text: A ku na {records} yin'wana. Mutirhisi-lonkulu u yi pfula loko ntwanano wa ndhawu ya ntirho wu vekiwile, wu vitana mudyondzi, mutirhisi ni mukoki.
work.none.from: No {records} yet. An administrator opens one once a workplace agreement is in place naming the learner, the employer and the coach.

work.kind.contextual_knowledge.text: Vutivi bya ndhawu ya ntirho: leswi u fanelaka ku kota ku swi vulavula
work.kind.contextual_knowledge.from: Workplace knowledge: what you must be able to speak to

work.kind.supporting_evidence.text: Vumbhoni lebyi seketelaka: leswi ndhawu ya ntirho yi fanelaka ku swi humesa
work.kind.supporting_evidence.from: Supporting evidence: what the workplace must produce

work.outstanding.text: Swi ha ta: {items}. Mukoki wa wena a nge sayini ku fikela ti mitsari hinkwato ti hetile naswona xiphemu xin'wana ni xin'wana xa vumbhoni lebyi seketelaka xi ni rifayili leri hlanganisiweke.
work.outstanding.from: Still outstanding: {items}. Your coach cannot sign until every line is done and every piece of supporting evidence has a file attached.

work.allRecorded.text: Hinkwaswo swi tsariwile. Swi rhumele eka mukoki wa wena loko u lulamile.
work.allRecorded.from: Everything is recorded. Send it to your coach when you are ready.

work.signingMeans.text: Ku sayina swi tsala leswaku u kambisisile vumbhoni lebyi kutani u ta byi tiyisisa loko mukambisisi a ku vitana. A swi nge cinciwi endzhaku ka sweswo.
work.signingMeans.from: Signing records that you checked this evidence and will attest to it if the assessor contacts you. It cannot be changed afterwards.

work.forAssessor.text: Nchumu wun'wana ni wun'wana lowu mukambisisi a fanelaka ku wu tiva

work.readyForPoe.text: Swi sayiniwile hi mukoki wa ntirho kutani swi lulamile ku nghenisiwa eka Pothifoliyo ya Vumbhoni.
work.readyForPoe.from: Signed by the workplace coach and ready to be taken into the Portfolio of Evidence.

scorm.failed.text: Phakeji a yi nga pfuriwanga. Kambisisa vuhlanganisi bya wena kutani u ringeta nakambe.
scorm.failed.from: The package could not be opened. Check your connection and try again.

scorm.preview.text: Ku languta ku sungula: leswi phakeji yi swi vikaka a swi hlayisiwi, hikuva lowu a wu ri ku tsarisiwa ka wena n'wini.
scorm.preview.from: A preview: what the package reports is not kept, because this is not your own enrolment.

certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.text: Mudyondzi a nga ha va a nyikele nkomba eka mutirhisi. Wu ya emahlweni wu tirha, naswona wu ta vula leswaku xi tlhelisiwile.
certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.from: The learner may have given the reference to an employer. It keeps resolving and will say it was withdrawn.

assessing.intro.text: Swikambisiso leswi lulameleke xiboho xa vuswikoti. A wu nge kambisisi ntirho wa wena n'wini, naswona xiphemu xa swiboho swa wena xi ta languteriwa hi mulanguteri hi ku ntshunxeka.
assessing.intro.from: Submissions ready for a competency judgement. You cannot assess your own work, and a proportion of your decisions will be reviewed independently by a moderator.

assessing.empty.text: A ku na leswi rindzeleke. Swikambisiso swi humelela laha loko vadyondzi va swi rhumela.
assessing.empty.from: Nothing is waiting. Submissions appear here as learners send them in.

assessing.onScreen.text: Leswi swi hlamuriwile eka xiscrini. {link}: tinhlamulo, nkongomiso wa ku maka ni matrikisi swi le kun'we kwalaho, naswona swipimelo swi tirhiwa eka wena loko swi makiwile.
assessing.onScreen.from: This was answered on screen. {link}: the answers, the marking guidance and the matrix are together there, and the criteria are worked out for you once it is marked.

assessing.ownWork.text: Lowu i nkambisiso wa wena n'wini. A wu nge wu kambisisi; un'wana u fanele ku wu kambisisa.
assessing.ownWork.from: This is your own submission. You cannot assess it; someone else must.

assessing.hash.text: Mfungho wu tsariwa loko swi tlakusiwa. Loko rifayili leri hlayisiweke ri cinciwile, a ri ha fambelani naswona rekhodo yi kombisiwa.
assessing.hash.from: The hash is recorded at upload. If a stored file is ever altered, it no longer matches and the record is flagged.

assessing.whyDiffers.text: Hikwalaho ka yini swi hambana ni leswi timaki ti swi ringanyetaka
assessing.whyDiffers.from: Why, since it differs from what the marks propose

assessing.whyDiffersLabel.text: Hikwalaho ka yini {code} yi hambana ni xiringanyeto

assessing.permanent.text: Vito ra wena, siku ni xihlamuselo lexi swi hlayisiwa hi masiku hinkwawo naswona a swi nge cinciwi endzhaku. Ku lulamisa swi tsariwa tanihi xiboho lexintshwa.
assessing.permanent.from: Your name, the date and this comment are stored permanently and cannot be edited afterwards. A correction is recorded as a new decision.

marking.impliesIntro.text: Timatimatiki, ku nga ri xiboho. Timaki ti hlayeka hi ndlela leyi; ntirho wa ku endla ni vumbhoni bya ndhawu ya ntirho a swi fiki eka pulatifomo, naswona u swi pimisa u nga se boha. Cinca xin'wana ni xin'wana xa leswi eka xiscrini xa xiboho u vula leswaku hikwalaho ka yini: xivangelo xi hlayisiwa ekusuhi ni xiringanyeto leswaku mulanguteri a vona laha swi hambaneke kona.
marking.impliesIntro.from: Arithmetic, not a judgement. The marks average out at this; practical performance and workplace evidence do not reach the platform, and you weigh those before deciding. Change any of these on the decision screen and say why: the reason is stored beside the proposal so a moderator can see where the two parted.

marking.markAllFirst.text: Xivutiso xin'wana ni xin'wana xi fanele ku makiwa ku nga si tirhiwa swipimelo.
marking.markAllFirst.from: Every question has to be marked before the criteria can be worked out.

marking.summative.text: Leswi swa kambisisiwa. Loko xivutiso xin'wana ni xin'wana xi makiwile, tsala xiboho: swipimelo leswi swi kombisiwaka swi ringanyetiwa leswaku u swi tiyisisa.
marking.summative.from: This is assessed. Once every question is marked, record a decision: the criteria it evidences are proposed for you to confirm.

marking.formative.text: Lowu i buku ya ntirho. I wa nhluvuko: wu make, kutani u tlhelisa vuxokoxoko. A ku na nchumu laha lowu tsalaka vuswikoti kumbe ku endla leswaku mudyondzi a tshineta eka ku fanelekela.
marking.formative.from: This is a workbook. It is developmental: mark it, then return feedback. Nothing here records competence or moves the learner towards eligibility.

marking.toMarkOne.text: Xivutiso 1 xi ha fanele ku makiwa.

marking.toMarkMany.text: Swivutiso swa {count} swi ha fanele ku makiwa.

marking.matrix.text: Matrikisi ya ku maka: ku hlawula ntlawa eka xin'wana ni xin'wana swi nyika maki
marking.matrix.from: Marking matrix: choosing a level for each gives the mark

marking.toldHint.text: Laha swi tiyeke kona, ni leswi a swi pfumala.
marking.toldHint.from: Where it was strong, and what was missing.

marking.returnIntro.text: Vuxokoxoko, ku nga ri xiboho. Swi byela mudyondzi leswi a fanelaka ku tlhelela eka swona ku nga si va nkambisiso wa makumu, naswona a swi tsali vuswikoti eka xipimelo xin'wana.
marking.returnIntro.from: Feedback, not a decision. It tells the learner what to go back to before the summative, and it records no competence against any criterion.

marking.returnHint.text: Leswi a swi tiyile, ni leswi a fanelaka ku swi hlaya nakambe ku nga si va nkambisiso wa makumu.
marking.returnHint.from: What was solid, and what to re-read before the summative.

marking.concern.text: Swipimelo leswi tinhlamulo leti tsaneke ti ti rhendzeleke
marking.concern.from: Criteria the weak answers cluster around

marking.markEveryFirst.text: Maka xivutiso xin'wana ni xin'wana ku sungula.

marking.sectionHint.text: Leswi swi endliweke kahle laha, ni leswi u nga swi endlaka hi ndlela yin'wana nkarhi lowu landzelaka.
marking.sectionHint.from: What went well here, and what to do differently next time.

marking.learnerSees.text: Mudyondzi u swi vona swin'we ni vuxokoxoko bya yena.
marking.learnerSees.from: The learner sees this with their feedback.

moderating.intro.text: Ku languta hi ku ntshunxeka swiboho swa vakambisisi. Swiboho leswi fikaka eka nxaxamelo lowu swi hlawuriwa hi sisiteme, ku nga ri hi munhu. A wu nge languti xiboho lexi u xi endleke n'wini.
moderating.intro.from: Independent review of assessors' decisions. Which decisions reach this list is decided by the system, not chosen by anyone. You cannot moderate a decision you made yourself.

moderating.empty.text: A ku na leswi rindzeleke ku languteriwa.

moderating.reason.full_moderation.text: Wa makumu: xiboho xin'wana ni xin'wana xa languteriwa

moderating.reason.new_assessor.text: Mukambisisi lowintshwa la tsarisiweke: wa languteriwa hinkwawo
moderating.reason.new_assessor.from: Newly registered assessor: moderated in full

moderating.reason.random_sample.text: Swi hlawuriwe hi xikombiso xa xiwelo

moderating.referBack.text: Tlhelisa: mukambisisi u fanele ku xi languta nakambe
moderating.referBack.from: Refer back: the assessor should look again

moderating.ownDecision.text: U endle xiboho lexi tanihi mukambisisi, hikwalaho a wu nge xi languti. Mulanguteri un'wana u fanele ku xi languta.
moderating.ownDecision.from: You made this decision as the assessor, so you cannot moderate it. Another moderator must.

pack.print.text: Print rhijisi leri u ri hlayisa tanihi PDF.
pack.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF.

pack.settings.text: {provider} · {accreditation} · xikoro xo hundza {pass}% · mpimo wa ku languteriwa {rate}%

pack.counts.text: {submissions} swikambisiso · {decided} swi vekiwile xiboho · {moderated} swi languteriwile · {sampled} swi hlawuriwile laha

pack.instrumentIntro.text: Phephara hilaha ri vekiweke hakona, ni nkongomiso lowu ri makiweke ha wona.
pack.instrumentIntro.from: The paper as it was set, and the guidance it was marked against.

pack.scriptsIntro.text: Ma tekiwile eka mpimo hinkwawo wa timaki (leti tlakukeke, leti tsongahataka ni leti nga exikarhi) leswaku ku maka ku voniwa kahle ni ku biha ku nga ri ntsena exikarhi.
pack.scriptsIntro.from: Taken across the mark range (top, bottom and spread between) so the marking is seen at its best and its worst rather than in the middle.

pack.departuresIntro.text: Laha mukambisisi a hambaneke ni leswi timaki ti swi ringanyetaka, kumbe mulanguteri a hambaneke ni mukambisisi. Phakeji leyi ti tshikaka i yo biha ku tlula ku nga va na yona.
pack.departuresIntro.from: Where an assessor differed from what the marks proposed, or a moderator differed from the assessor. A pack that leaves these out is worse than no pack.

pack.noReason.text: a ku na xivangelo lexi tsariweke

pack.exceptionsIntro.text: Vadyondzi lava tshiveriweke hi munhu la vitaniweke, ni xivangelo lexi a xi nyikeke.
pack.exceptionsIntro.from: Learners let past a gate by a named person, with the reason they gave.

held.intro.text: Mudyondzi loyi a kumiweke a nga swikoti ha kambirhi a nga hluleki. Nkambisiso wu khomiwa, kutani ku hlengeletiwa nhlamuselo ya purogirama swin'we ni mutirhisi wa yena, hikuva hi nkarhi lowu xivutiso a ku ri ntsena leswaku wa swi tiva, kambe hi leswi humelelaka ku n'wi rhendzela.
held.intro.from: A learner found not yet competent twice is not failed. The assessment is held, and a programme review is convened with their employer, because by this point the question is rarely whether they know it, and usually what has been going on around them.

held.emptyTitle.text: A ku na loyi a khomiweke

held.empty.text: Leswi swi tala loko mudyondzi a kumiwa a nga swikoti ha ku fika ka vumbirhi eka nkambisiso wa makumu. Ku fikela kwalaho, a ku na nchumu lowu fanelaka ku hlayisisiwa.
held.empty.from: This fills when a learner is found not yet competent for a second time on a summative assessment. Until then there is nothing to review.

held.whoConvenes.text: Mufambisi kumbe mutirhisi-lonkulu u hlengeleta nhlamuselo.
held.whoConvenes.from: A facilitator or administrator convenes the review.

held.oralAuthorised.text: {assessment} · nhlamuselo yi pfumelele ku ringeta ka vunharhu, ku endliwa hi nomu
held.oralAuthorised.from: {assessment} · the review authorised a third attempt, conducted orally

held.whoConducts.text: Mukambisisi u endla nkambisiso wa nomu, ku nga ri munhu la ku pfumeleleke.
held.whoConducts.from: An assessor conducts the oral attempt, and not the person who authorised it.

held.oral.text: Ku ringeta ka vunharhu, ku endliwa hi nomu

held.furtherLearning.text: Dyondzo yin'wana ku nga si va na ku ringeta kun'wana
held.furtherLearning.from: Further learning before any further attempt

held.whyHint.text: Leswi nhlamuselo yi swi kumeke, ni leswi swi titshegeke hi swona.
held.whyHint.from: What the review found, and what it turns on.

oral.reviewDecidedIntro.text: Swivangelo leswi ku ringeta loku ka vunharhu ku pfumeleriweke ha swona.
oral.reviewDecidedIntro.from: The grounds on which this third attempt was authorised.

oral.recordIntro.text: Ku ringeta hi nomu a ku siyi vumbhoni bya kona. Lebyi i vumbhoni byoleyo, naswona mbuyelo a wu nge tsariwi handle ka byona.
oral.recordIntro.from: An oral attempt leaves no evidence of its own. This is that evidence, and the outcome cannot be recorded without it.

oral.outcomeIntro.text: Wu vekiwa xiboho hi ndlela leyi fanaka ni ku ringeta loku tsaliweke, eka swipimelo leswi fanaka, kutani wu languteriwa hi ndlela leyi fanaka endzhaku.
oral.outcomeIntro.from: Judged the same way as a written attempt, against the same criteria, and moderated the same way afterwards.

oral.goMark.text: Ya eka xiscrini xa ku maka

oral.how.text: Ndlela leyi swi endliweke ha yona

oral.howHint.text: Hi munhu n'wini, kumbe hi ku vitana hi vhidiyo leyi swi endliweke ha yona
oral.howHint.from: In person, or the video call it was held on

oral.present.text: Un'wana loyi a a ri kona

oral.presentNote.text: A swi laveki. Nkambisiso wa nomu lowu nga riki na munhu un'wana endlwini wu tika ku sirhelela eku languteriweni, naswona rekhodo yi fanele ku vula leswaku a wu ri wa muxaka wihi.
oral.presentNote.from: Not required. An oral assessment with nobody else in the room is harder to defend at moderation, and the record should say which kind this was.

oral.savedNext.text: Mbuyelo wu tsariwa eka xiscrini xa ku maka, ku fana ni ku ringeta ka un'wana ni un'wana.
oral.savedNext.from: The outcome is recorded on the marking screen, the same as any other attempt.

appeals.intro.text: Mudyondzi a nga kandziyisa mbuyelo kumbe mahanyelo ya mukambisisi. Ku amukeriwa ku tiviwa endzeni ka tiawara ta {hours}, leti hi ti tlulaka, hikuva ti tirha loko un'wana a ri karhi a dyondzisa.
appeals.intro.from: A learner may appeal against a result or against an assessor's conduct. Receipt is acknowledged within {hours} hours, which is the deadline that gets missed, because it runs while somebody is teaching.

appeals.daysOver.text: Swi hundzile nkarhi hi masiku ya {count}

appeals.hoursOver.text: Swi hundzile nkarhi hi tiawara ta {count}

appeals.minutesOver.text: Swi hundzile nkarhi hi timinete ta {count}

appeals.lateIntro.text: Ku hundzile tiawara ta {hours} naswona ku nga si amukeriwa. Ku amukela hi nkarhi lowu hundzeke swi antswa ku tlula ku nga amukeli, naswona rekhodo yi ta kombisa swimbirhi.
appeals.lateIntro.from: Past the {hours} hours and still not acknowledged. Acknowledging late is better than not at all, and the record will show both.

appeals.openIntro.text: Hinkwaswo leswi nyikeriweke naswona swi nga si pfaleriwa, leswintshwa ku sungula.
appeals.openIntro.from: Everything lodged and not yet closed, newest first.

appeals.none.text: A ku na leswi pfuriweke. Xikombelo xo kandziyisa xi nyikeriwa eka rhijisi ra mudyondzi n'wini.
appeals.none.from: Nothing open. An appeal is lodged from a learner's own page.

appeals.procedureIntro.text: Amukela, hlanganisa ni mudyondzi, kombela mulanguteri loko xivangelo ku ri mbuyelo, kutani u tlhantlha u va tivisa.
appeals.procedureIntro.from: Acknowledge, meet the learner, consult the moderator where the ground is a result, then resolve and tell them.

appeals.closedUnacknowledged.text: Swi pfaleriwile ku nga tsariwanga leswaku swi amukeriwile.
appeals.closedUnacknowledged.from: Closed without an acknowledgement being recorded.

appeals.firstCounts.text: Ku amukela ka ku sungula hi ku hlayisiwaka eka rekhodo. A ku nge tlheriseleki ku tshaha nkarhi, hikuva nkarhi lowu nga cinciwaka a hi vumbhoni bya nchumu.
appeals.firstCounts.from: The first acknowledgement is the one the record keeps. It cannot be re-stamped later, because a time that can be changed is not evidence of anything.

appeals.resultNeedsModerator.text: Xikombelo xa mbuyelo xi ya eka mulanguteri wa le ndzeni ku nga si tlhantlhiwa. Lexi i xikhala lexi mukambisisi wa le handle a xi vutisaka hi xona.
appeals.resultNeedsModerator.from: A result appeal goes to the internal moderator before it can be resolved. That is the step an external verifier asks about.

appeals.conductNoModerator.text: Xikombelo xa mahanyelo a xi tlhantlhiwi hi ku maka nakambe, hikwalaho a ku na mulanguteri lo laveka.
appeals.conductNoModerator.from: A conduct appeal is not something re-marking settles, so no moderator is required.

appeals.notFeedback.text: Xiboho lexi mudyondzi a nga xi nyikiwangiki a hi vuxokoxoko.
appeals.notFeedback.from: A decision the learner has not been given is not feedback.

appeals.whyHint.text: Hikwalaho ka yini. Lexi i xiphemu lexi mudyondzi a nga ni gandzelo ra ku xi kuma.
appeals.whyHint.from: Why. This is the part the learner is entitled to.

appeals.notesIntro.text: Nkanelo exikarhi ka mukongomisi, mukambisisi ni mulanguteri. A wu kombisiwi mudyondzi handle loko u vula; leswi a swi faneleke hi mbuyelo ni ku tirhisa ka wona laha henhla.
appeals.notesIntro.from: The discussion between coordinator, assessor and moderator. Not shown to the learner unless you say so; what they are entitled to is the outcome and the reasoning above.

appeals.noteHint.text: Leswi nga vulavuriwa, ni ni mani
appeals.noteHint.from: What was discussed, and with whom

appeals.learnerMayRead.text: Mudyondzi a nga swi hlaya leswi

appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.text: Ku tlhelisa swi lava xivangelo. Loko ku nga ri na xin'we, swi languteka ku ri ku tshikilela, kutani lexi hi xona xikombelo xa mahanyelo xi vulavulaka hi xona.
appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.from: A withdrawal needs a reason. One with none looks like pressure, and that is exactly what an appeal about conduct would be about.

rpl.title.text: Ku tiveka ka dyondzo leyi tshameke yi ri kona

rpl.intro.text: Eka mudyondzi loyi a sweswi a swi kotaka xiphemu xa ntirho. A ku na nchumu lowu nyikiwaka hi ku vula ka munhu un'we: xiboho xi endliwa hi ku ya hi swipimelo swa modyuli n'wini, xi tsariwa hinkwaswo, kutani xi languteriwa hi un'wana handle ka la xi endleke ku nga si va na nchumu.
rpl.intro.from: For a learner who can already do part of the work. Nothing here is granted on one person's say-so: a judgement is made against the module's own criteria, written down in full, and moderated by somebody other than whoever made it before it counts for anything.

rpl.noneWaiting.text: A ku na leswi rindzeleke mulanguteri

rpl.waitingIntro.text: Xiboho a xi nyiki nchumu ku fikela loko leswi swi hetiwile. Hlaya xivangelo eka modyuli u nga se pfumela: hi xona xilo xo sungula lexi mukambisisi wa le handle a xi hlayaka.
rpl.waitingIntro.from: A judgement grants nothing until this is done. Read the rationale against the module before agreeing: it is the first thing an external verifier reads.

rpl.appearHere.text: Swiboho swi humelela laha loko swi endliwa.
rpl.appearHere.from: Judgements appear here as they are made.

rpl.openIntro.text: Ntikelo wo sungula, ni lowu tumbulukaka rekhodo leyi hinkwaswo swi hlanganisiwaka eka yona.
rpl.openIntro.from: The first step, and the one that creates the record everything else attaches to.

rpl.transferIntro.text: Swa hambana ni RPL: mudyondzi u sweswi u ni kwalifikheyixini leyi vuyelo bya yona byi funengetaka modyuli lowu. A ku na xitsundzuxo, kambe ku tumbuluxa ku fanele ku tsariwa; ku hundzisela ku nga ri na ku tumbuluxa i xikombelo lexi nga riki na munhu la nga xi kambisisaka.
rpl.transferIntro.from: Different from RPL: the learner already holds a qualification whose outcomes cover this module. No advisory, but the mapping has to be written down; a transfer without it is a claim nobody can check.

rpl.needsBoth.text: Xikombelo xi lava mudyondzi ni kwalifikheyixini leyi xi tirhisiwaka eka yona. Engetela leswi ku sungula.
rpl.needsBoth.from: An application needs a learner and a qualification to apply against. Add those first.

rpl.needsLearner.text: Engetela mudyondzi ku nga si tsariwa ku hundzisela eka yena.
rpl.needsLearner.from: Add a learner before recording a transfer for one.

rpl.holds.text: Leswi va swi na swona sweswi

rpl.awardedBy.text: Loyi a swi nyikeke (swa ku hlawula)

rpl.awardedOn.text: Swi nyikiwe hi siku ra (swa ku hlawula)

rpl.mapping.text: Ndlela leyi vuyelo bya leswi va nga na swona byi funengetaka ha yona ta modyuli lowu
rpl.mapping.from: How the outcomes of what they hold cover this module's

rpl.checked.text: Leswi u swi kambisiseke, ni leswi u swi gimeteke
rpl.checked.from: What you checked, and what you concluded

record.print.text: Print rhijisi leri u ri hlayisa tanihi PDF eka pothifoliyo ya vumbhoni.
record.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF for the portfolio of evidence.

record.timeExpired.text: A swi amukeriwanga: nkarhi wu herile kutani ntirho wu nyikeleriwe hilaha wu nga kona.
record.timeExpired.from: Not accepted: the time limit expired and the work was handed in as it stood.

record.returned.text: Swi tlhelisiwile {date}. Leswi i swa nhluvuko: a swi tsali vuswikoti.
record.returned.from: Returned {date}. This is developmental: it records no competence.

sor.withdrawConsequence.text: Ndhawu yo kambisisa yi nga ha va yi ni kopi. Nkomba wu ya emahlweni wu tirha, naswona wu ta vula leswaku xi tlhelisiwile.
sor.withdrawConsequence.from: An assessment centre may already hold a copy. The reference keeps working and will say it was withdrawn.

sor.print.text: Print kumbe u hlayisa Xitatimente lexi xa Mbuyelo
sor.print.from: Print or save this Statement of Results

fisa.intro.text: Phephara leri mupfuneti loyi a ri vekaka eka purogirama ya yena ya vuswikoti. Ku hambana ni nkambisiso wa le handle, u wu tsala naswona u wu languta, hikwalaho ku languteriwa ku endliwa ku nga si tshama munhu, naswona phephara leri nga si sayiniwaka tanihi leri fanelaka xikongomelo a ri nge tirhisiwi.
fisa.intro.from: The paper this provider sets for its own skills programme. Unlike an external assessment, you write it and you moderate it, so the moderation happens before anybody sits it, and a paper that has not been signed off as fit for purpose cannot be used.

fisa.waiting.text: {count} swi rindzele ku languteriwa ka ku sungula

fisa.waitingIntro.text: A ku na loyi a nga tshamaka leswi ku fikela mulanguteri a swi sayina.
fisa.waitingIntro.from: Nobody can sit these until a moderator signs them off.

fisa.usable.text: {count} swi sayiniwile naswona swi nga tirhisiwa.

fisa.setNewIntro.text: Eka purogirama ya vuswikoti. Kwalifikheyixini yo helela kumbe xiphemu xa yona yi kambisisiwa hi le handle.
fisa.setNewIntro.from: Against a skills programme. A full or part qualification is assessed externally.

fisa.gate.approved.text: Swi sayiniwile tanihi leswi fanelekaka xikongomelo: vatshami va nga tshama phephara leri
fisa.gate.approved.from: Signed off as fit for purpose: candidates may sit this paper

fisa.gate.in_moderation.text: Swi le ka mulanguteri: a nga ri na munhu la nga tshamaka ha ku ri
fisa.gate.in_moderation.from: With the moderator: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.gate.draft.text: Ku ri karhi ku tsariwa: a nga ri na munhu la nga tshamaka ha ku ri
fisa.gate.draft.from: Being written: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.approvedOn.text: Swi languteriwile kutani swi pfumeleriwile hi siku ra {date}.

fisa.beforeNotAfter.text: FISA yi languteriwa ku nga si tshamiwa, ku nga ri endzhaku. Hi yona leswi yi endlaka leswaku yi sirheleleka eku endzeleni ka ku langutiwa.
fisa.beforeNotAfter.from: A FISA is moderated before it is sat, not after. That is what makes it defensible at a monitoring visit.

fisa.practical.text: Xi ni xiphemu xa ntirho wa ku endla lexi vekiwaka xi swikota kumbe xi nga swikoti ha.
fisa.practical.from: Also has a practical component, judged competent or not yet competent.

fisa.moderatorIntro.text: U kambisisa leswaku ri fanelekile xikongomelo, ku nga si tshama munhu.
fisa.moderatorIntro.from: Checks it is fit for purpose, before anybody sits it.

fisa.noContact.text: A ku na vuxokoxoko bya vuhlanganisi lebyi tsariweke

fisa.unsigned.text: A ku na ntwanano wa vuhlayiseki. A va nge ri voni kumbe ku ri languta ku fikela wu sayiniwile.
fisa.unsigned.from: No confidentiality agreement yet. They may not see or judge the paper until it is signed.

fisa.outcomes.text: Vuyelo bya le henhla bya ntiko, ni laha phephara ri byi kambisisaka kona
fisa.outcomes.from: Exit level outcomes, and where the paper assesses them

fisa.outcomesIntro.text: Xiphemu 2 xa swiviko hinkwaswo. Ndhawu ntsena leyi kombisaka leswaku phephara ri funengeta kwalifikheyixini, ku nga ri ntsena ku languteka ku fana ni ndzavisiso.
fisa.outcomesIntro.from: Section 2 of both reports. The only place that shows the paper covers the qualification rather than merely looking like an exam.

fisa.noOutcomes.text: Purogirama leyi a yi na vuyelo bya le henhla bya ntiko lebyi tsariweke, hikwalaho a ku na nchumu lowu phephara ri nga hlanganisiwaka na wona. Nghenisa kharikhulamu ku sungula.
fisa.noOutcomes.from: This programme has no exit level outcomes recorded, so there is nothing to map the paper against. Import the curriculum first.

fisa.onlyExaminer.text: Mukambisisi loyi a vekiweke ntsena, loko ntwanano wa yena wa vuhlayiseki wu sayiniwile, a nga hlamula leswi.
fisa.onlyExaminer.from: Only the appointed examiner, once their confidentiality agreement is signed, can answer these.

fisa.onlyModerator.text: Mulanguteri loyi a vekiweke ntsena, loko ntwanano wa yena wa vuhlayiseki wu sayiniwile, a nga hlamula leswi.
fisa.onlyModerator.from: Only the appointed moderator, once their confidentiality agreement is signed, can answer these.

fisa.handOverIntro.text: Loko xiviko xa wena n'wini xi hetisiwile.
fisa.handOverIntro.from: Once your own report is complete.

fisa.laterIntro.text: Leyi yi tshama hilaha yi nga kona, hikuva vatshami va nga ha va va yi tshamile. Vhezini yintshwa yi lava ku languteriwa ka yona.
fisa.laterIntro.from: This one stays exactly as it is, because candidates may have sat it. A new version needs its own moderation.

fisa.noProgrammes.text: FISA yi vekiwa eka purogirama ya vuswikoti, naswona a ku na yin'wana. Nghenisa yin'we ku sungula; kwalifikheyixini yo helela kumbe xiphemu xa yona yi kambisisiwa hi le handle hi Muhlanganyeri wa Vunene bya Nkambisiso, hikwalaho mupfuneti a nge vekeli phephara rero.
fisa.noProgrammes.from: A FISA is set against a skills programme, and there are none yet. Import one first; a full or part qualification is assessed externally by the Assessment Quality Partner, so the provider does not set that paper.

fisa.callItHint.text: FISA: ku tshama ka ku sungula

fisa.passNote.text: FISA i ndzavisiso, hikwalaho yi na xikoro, ku hambana ni vuswikoti bya le ndzeni.
fisa.passNote.from: A FISA is an examination, so it has one, unlike internal competence.

fisa.hasPractical.text: Yi ni xiphemu xa ntirho wa ku endla lexi vekiwaka xi swikota kumbe xi nga swikoti ha
fisa.hasPractical.from: It also has a practical component judged competent or not yet competent

fisa.practicalHint.text: xik. Ntirho wa ku endla: awara ya 4, wu vekiwa wu swikota / wu nga swikoti ha
fisa.practicalHint.from: e.g. Practical: 4 hours, judged competent / not yet competent

fisa.idNote.text: Ndlela leyi pulatifomo yi hambanisaka munhu ni munhu ha yona loko va nga na akhawunti laha.
fisa.idNote.from: How the platform tells one person from another when they have no account here.

fisa.account.text: Akhawunti ya vona laha, loko va na yona
fisa.account.from: Their account here, if they have one

fisa.outside.text: Munhu wa le handle, a nga na akhawunti
fisa.outside.from: Somebody from outside, with no account

fisa.accountNote.text: Munhu la nga na akhawunti ntsena a nga tata xiviko xa yena n'wini laha.
fisa.accountNote.from: Only somebody with an account can fill in their own report here.

fisa.further.text: Swihlamuselo swin'wana swo antswisa mimpimo ya nkambisiso
fisa.further.from: Further comments for the improvement of assessment standards

fisa.signOff.from: Sign off as fit for purpose

fisa.untilYouDo.text: A ku na mutshami loyi a nga tshamaka phephara leri ku fikela u endla leswi.
fisa.untilYouDo.from: No candidate may sit this paper until you do.

eisa.intro.text: Loko ku tshama ka ha yin'wana ni yin'wana ku ri kona, loko ku tsarisiwa ka ku tshama loku ku pfaleka, ni tintlawa leti ha fanelaka ku nghenisiwa. Ku tsarisiwa ku pfala hi ku angarhela endzhaku ka tin'hweti tinharhu, hikwalaho ntlawa lowu heteke emakumu ka lembe wu fanele ku nghenisiwa khale ku nga si heta.
eisa.intro.from: When each sitting is, when registration for it closes, and which cohorts still have to be entered. Registration typically closes about three months ahead, which is why a cohort finishing later in the year has to be entered long before it finishes.

eisa.registerNowIntro.text: Ku tsarisiwa ku pfala endzeni ka masiku ya ntirho ya khume naswona tintlawa leti a ti na siku ra ku tsarisiwa leri tsariweke.
eisa.registerNowIntro.from: Registration closes within ten working days and these cohorts have no registration date recorded.

eisa.sittingsIntro.text: Leswi ha ku ri swi pfuriwile ku tsarisiwa ntsena. Leswi swi pfaleke a hi swa munhu ku swi endla, naswona ku swi siya laha ku ta tshikilela nkarhi wa xiviko lowu landzelaka lowu tiyaka hi ku ya ehansi ka rhijisi.
eisa.sittingsIntro.from: Only those still open for registration. A closed one is nothing anybody can act on, and leaving it here would push the next real deadline down the page.

eisa.nextYear.text: A ku na leswi tsariweke endzhaku ka lembe leri. Muhlanganyeri wa vunene bya nkambisiso u kandziyisa masiku ya lembe leri landzelaka hi N'wendzamhala, hikwalaho papila ri fanele ri humile; ku ma engetela sweswi hi ku endla leswaku ku hlaya nkarhi ku ya emahlweni ku ya eka Sunguti.
eisa.nextYear.from: Nothing is recorded beyond this year. The assessment quality partner publishes next year's dates in December, so the letter should be out; adding them now is what keeps the countdown running into January.

eisa.toEnterIntro.text: Hinkwaswo leswi nga ni siku ra ku pfala leri pfuriweke naswona ku nga tsariwanga siku ra ku tsarisiwa eka swona.
eisa.toEnterIntro.from: Everything with an open deadline and no registration date recorded against it.

eisa.sittingName.text: Vito ra ku tshama, xik. Nyenyankulu 2027

eisa.back.text: ← Tlhelela eka nkambisiso wa le handle

eisa.noQualification.text: A ku na kwalifikheyixini eka ku tsarisiwa loku

eisa.noIdIntro.text: Muhlanganyeri un'wana ni un'wana u yi kombela, naswona ku tsarisiwa loku tlhelisiwaka hikwalaho ka nomboro leyi nga kona swi durha xikhala. Swi antswa ku swi kuma sweswi ku tlula endzhaku ka loko rifayili ri rhumeriwile.
eisa.noIdIntro.from: Every quality partner asks for one, and a registration returned for a missing number costs a cycle. Better found now than after the file is sent.

eisa.readyIntro.text: Xipimelo xin'wana ni xin'wana eka modyuli wun'wana ni wun'wana xi fikeleriwile, xi dyondzisiwile kumbe xi tiviwile hi dyondzo leyi tshameke yi ri kona.
eisa.readyIntro.from: Every criterion in every module met, whether taught or recognised through prior learning.

eisa.nobodyYet.text: A ku na loyi ha ku ri. Mutsariso lowu nga hansi wu vula leswaku un'wana ni un'wana u ta fika ekule ku fikela kwihi.
eisa.nobodyYet.from: Nobody yet. The list below says how far each of them has to go.

eisa.noIdNumber.text: a ku na nomboro ya vun'wini

eisa.download.text: Rhijisi ra rifayili ra ku tsarisiwa

eisa.notReadyIntro.text: Ekule ka kwihi eka un'wana ni un'wana. Munhu la pfumalaka xipimelo xin'we a nga ha fika siku ra ku pfala loko swi vonaka mahiku lawa.
eisa.notReadyIntro.from: How far each has to go. Somebody one criterion short can still make the deadline if it is noticed this week.

ready.intro.text: Mudyondzi a nga tshama Nkambisiso wa Makumu lowu Hlanganisiweke wa le Handle loko xipimelo xin'wana ni xin'wana xa nkambisiso wa le ndzeni eka modyuli wun'wana ni wun'wana xi fikeleriwile. A hi swo tala, naswona a ku na phesente leyi yi tlhelaka xiyimo xa yona: phesente leyi nga hansi i nhluvuko, bheji i mpfumelelo.
ready.intro.from: A learner may sit the External Integrated Summative Assessment once every internal assessment criterion in every module has been achieved. Not most of them, and no percentage stands in for it: the percentage below is progress, the badge is permission.

ready.nobody.text: A ku na loyi a tsarisiweke eka kwalifikheyixini. Tsarisa mudyondzi eka ndzetelo kutani u hlawula kwalifikheyixini leyi wu hlayiwaka eka yona, kutani va ta humelela laha.
ready.nobody.from: Nobody is enrolled against a qualification yet. Enrol a learner on a course and choose the qualification it counts towards, and they will appear here.

ready.working.text: Va tirha ku ya eka wun'we

ready.notCaptured.text: Kharikhulamu laha a yi si tsariwa hinkwayo.
ready.notCaptured.from: A curriculum here is not fully captured.

ready.notCapturedIntro.text: Swimodyuli swin'wana a swi na swipimelo swa nkambisiso, hikwalaho a ku na nchumu lowu nga fikeleriwaka eka swona naswona a ku na munhu eka kwalifikheyixini yoleyo la nga vitaniwaka a lulamile. Nghenisa dokumente yo helela ya kharikhulamu ku nga si nghenisiwa munhu eka EISA.
ready.notCapturedIntro.from: Some modules carry no assessment criteria, so nothing can be achieved against them and nobody on that qualification can be declared ready. Import the full curriculum document before entering anyone for an EISA.

ready.notEligible.from: Not yet eligible for the EISA

ready.achieved.text: Swipimelo swa {achieved} eka {total} swa nkambisiso wa le ndzeni swi fikeleriwile, naswona ntokoto wa ntirho wu tiyisiwile hi {record} leyi sayiniweke.
ready.achieved.from: {achieved} of {total} internal assessment criteria achieved, and work experience proved by a signed {record}.

ready.canIssue.text: Xitatimente xa Mbuyelo xi nga humesiwa.
ready.canIssue.from: A Statement of Results can be issued.

ready.everyOne.text: Xin'wana ni xin'wana xa swona xi laveka; a ku na xikoro xo hundza.
ready.everyOne.from: Every one of them is required; there is no pass mark.

ready.perUnit.text: Switatimente swa yuniti yin'wana ni yin'wana ya dyondzo

ready.perUnitIntro.text: Xitatimente xa yuniti yin'we ya dyondzo xi tiyisisa xipimelo xin'wana ni xin'wana eka swimodyuli leswi yuniti yoleyo yi swi nyikaka. Xi nga humesiwa hi ku hatlisa loko yuniti yoleyo yi hetile, ku nga rindzeli lexi saleke xa kwalifikheyixini.
ready.perUnitIntro.from: A statement for one study unit confirms every criterion in the modules that unit delivers. It can be issued as soon as that unit is finished, without waiting for the rest of the qualification.

ready.certificateIntro.text: Xi humesiwa hi xiphemu lexi nyikaka, endzhaku ka EISA, ku nga ri hi {provider}. Xi tsariwa laha loko xi fika, leswaku rekhodo ya mudyondzi yi vula leswaku u kwalifikile.
ready.certificateIntro.from: Issued by the awarding body after the EISA, not by {provider}. Recorded here when it arrives, so the learner's record says they are qualified.

ready.thisNotCaptured.text: Kharikhulamu leyi a yi si tsariwa hinkwayo.
ready.thisNotCaptured.from: This curriculum is not fully captured.

ready.thisNotCapturedIntro.text: {modules} a swi na swipimelo swa nkambisiso. A ku na munhu loyi a nga vulaka leswaku u fanelekile eka kwalifikheyixini leyi ku fikela dokumente yo helela ya kharikhulamu yi nghenisiwile; loko ku nga ri kwalaho, swimodyuli leswi nga kona swi ta hlayiwa ku nga ri na loyi a swi vonaka tanihi leswi hundzeke.
ready.thisNotCapturedIntro.from: {modules} carry no assessment criteria. Nobody can be declared eligible against this qualification until the full curriculum document has been imported; otherwise the missing modules would silently count as passed.

ready.weight.document.text: hilaha swi vuriweke hakona eka dokumente ya kharikhulamu
ready.weight.document.from: as stated in the curriculum document

ready.weight.credits.text: swi humesiwe eka tikridithi ta modyuli; dokumente a yi vuli tiphesente
ready.weight.credits.from: derived from module credits; the document states no percentages

ready.weight.equal.text: swi avanyisiwe ku ringana; dokumente a yi vuli tiphesente kumbe tikridithi
ready.weight.equal.from: split evenly; the document states no percentages and no credits

ready.component.practical.text: Swimodyuli swa tinhundzu ta ntirho wa ku endla

ready.workProved.text: Ntokoto wa ntirho wu tiyisiwa hi {record} leyi sayiniweke hi mukoki wa ntirho kutani yi amukeriwa hi mukambisisi, ku nga ri hi swipimelo swa nkambisiso. Kharikhulamu a yi hlamuseli na xin'we eka modyuli lowu.
ready.workProved.from: Work experience is proved by a {record} signed by the workplace coach and accepted by an assessor, not by assessment criteria. The curriculum defines none for this module.

ready.noRecord.text: A ku na {record} leyi pfuriweke eka modyuli lowu.
ready.noRecord.from: No {record} has been opened for this module.

ready.noCriteria.text: A ku na swipimelo swa nkambisiso leswi tsariweke eka modyuli lowu.
ready.noCriteria.from: No assessment criteria captured for this module.

issue.notYet.text: Xitatimente xa Mbuyelo a xi nge humesiwi sweswi.
issue.notYet.from: A Statement of Results cannot be issued yet.

award.held.text: Xitifikeyiti {number}, xi nyikiwe hi {by} hi siku ra {date}.

award.wrong.text: Xi nghenisiwe hi xihoxo? Xi susa

preview.summative.text: Wa makumu: wu vekiwa xiboho hi munhu naswona wu languteriwa hi ku ntshunxeka
preview.summative.from: Summative: judged by a person and independently moderated

preview.formative.text: Wa nhluvuko: wu makiwa loko mudyondzi a ri karhi a famba
preview.formative.from: Formative: marked as the learner goes

preview.whoMarks.text: {app} swi makiwe hi Apu, {assessor} hi mukambisisi
preview.whoMarks.from: {app} marked by the App, {assessor} by an assessor

preview.isPreview.text: Leswi i ku languta ku sungula.

preview.isPreviewIntro.text: Hi ndlela leyi mudyondzi a swi voniweke hakona, ni tibokisi leti a nga ti tsalaka eka tona. A ku na nchumu lowu hlayisiwaka naswona a ku na ku ringeta loku sunguriweke, hikwalaho swihlanganisi swi tshikiwile. Xiphemu lexi nga hansi ka xivutiso xin'wana ni xin'wana i xa wena hikuva u vumbe phephara leri; mudyondzi a nga xi voni.
preview.isPreviewIntro.from: Exactly what a learner sees, with the boxes they would type into. Nothing is saved and no attempt has been started, so the controls are switched off. The panel under each question is for you because you built this paper; a learner never sees it.

preview.empty.text: A ku na swivutiso eka phephara leri.
preview.empty.from: There are no questions in this paper yet.

preview.tickedAbove.text: Nhlawulo lowu lulameke wu tsariwile laha henhla.
preview.tickedAbove.from: The correct option is ticked above.

preview.noGuide.text: A ku na nkongomiso wa ku maka. Mukambisisi a nga na nchumu lowu a nga wu makaka hi wona; engetela wun'we ku nga si tirhisiwa phephara.
preview.noGuide.from: No marking guide. An assessor has nothing to mark this against; add one before the paper is used.

preview.declarationIntro.text: Mudyondzi a nga swi nyikeli handle ko pfumela leswi, naswona marito lama tsariweke ma tiyisiwa eka leswi nyikeriweke.
preview.declarationIntro.from: A learner cannot hand this in without agreeing to it, and the exact wording is frozen into the submission.

people.intro.text: Un'wana ni un'wana eka {provider}, swiavelo swa vona, ni loko rekhodo ya vona yi ni leswi tsalwa ra nawu ri swi lavaka.
people.intro.from: Everyone in {provider}, their roles, and whether their record carries what a statutory return needs.

people.notEnrolledOne.text: Mudyondzi 1 a a tsarisiwanga eka nchumu.
people.notEnrolledOne.from: 1 learner is not enrolled on anything.

people.notEnrolledMany.text: Vadyondzi va {count} a va tsarisiwanga eka nchumu.
people.notEnrolledMany.from: {count} learners are not enrolled on anything.

people.notEnrolledWhy.text: Ku va mudyondzi a ku nyiki vuxaka hi ku tiya, hikwalaho va nghena eka xiscrini lexi nga riki na nchumu. Va tsarisi eka ndzetelo, u va engetela eka ntlawa, kumbe u va averela purogirama.
people.notEnrolledWhy.from: Being a learner grants no access on its own, so they sign in to an empty screen. Enrol them on a course, add them to a cohort, or assign a programme.

people.missingOne.text: Munhu 1 u pfumala vuxokoxoko lebyi tsalwa ra SETA kumbe ra SAQA ri byi lavaka.
people.missingOne.from: 1 person is missing details a SETA or SAQA return needs.

people.missingMany.text: Vanhu va {count} va pfumala vuxokoxoko lebyi tsalwa ra SETA kumbe ra SAQA ri byi lavaka.
people.missingMany.from: {count} people are missing details a SETA or SAQA return needs.

people.missingWhy.text: Va kombisiwile laha hansi. Ku byi tata sweswi swi olova ku tlula vusiku byo sungula ku nga si va ku rhumela.
people.missingWhy.from: They are marked below. Filling them in now is far easier than the night before a submission.

people.roster.text: Engetela ntlawa ku suka eka spredshiti
people.roster.from: Add a cohort from a spreadsheet

people.rosterIntro.text: Hlaya rifayili ra CSV kumbe ra Excel ra vadyondzi kutani u va tumbuluxa hinkwavo hi kun'we. Yi ku kombisa leswi yi swi endleke hi rifayili ku nga si tumbuluxiwa munhu.
people.rosterIntro.from: Read a CSV or Excel file of learners and create them all at once. It shows you what it made of the file before anybody is created.

people.added.text: Swi engeteriwile. Va nyike phasiwedi leyi: yi kombisiwa kan'we naswona a yi nge tlheli yi kumiwa.
people.added.from: Added. Give them this password: it is shown once and cannot be retrieved.

people.noMail.text: A ku na sesiva ya mahungu leyi hlanganisiweke, hikwalaho a ku rhumeriwanga nchumu hi imeyili. Va kombele ku yi cinca endzhaku ka ku nghena.
people.noMail.from: There is no mail server connected yet, so nothing was emailed. Ask them to change it after signing in.

person.lineManagerNote.text: Wu vula leswaku i vuleteri bya mani lebyi munhu loyi a nga byi vonaka eka tirhiphothi.
person.lineManagerNote.from: Decides whose training this person can see in reports.

person.ofoNote.text: Khodi ya ntirho leyi tirhisiwaka ku hlanganisa xihlawulo xa SETA.
person.ofoNote.from: Occupation code used to group a SETA return.

person.statutoryNote.text: Byi laveka eka xihlawulo xa SAQA kumbe xa SETA. Nomboro ya vuvani yi kambisisiwa hi nomboro ya yona yo kambisisa loko u yi hlayisa, hikwalaho xihoxo xa ku tsala xi kumiwa laha, ku nga ri hi mulawuri.
person.statutoryNote.from: Needed for a SAQA or SETA return. The identity number is checked against its check digit as you save, so a typing error is caught here rather than by the regulator.

person.roleNote.assessor.text: Swi lava nomboro ya ku tsarisiwa

person.roleNote.moderator.text: A nga swi koti ku languta swiboho swa yena n'wini

person.roleNote.workplace_coach.text: Mulanguteri wa mutirhisi: u vona vadyondzi va yena n'wini ntsena
person.roleNote.workplace_coach.from: The employer's supervisor: sees only their own learners

roster.how.text: CSV kumbe Excel. Swihlokwana swa tikholomo swi fambisana hi vito ("Vito ra ndyangu", "Last Name" na "Van" hinkwaswo swa tirha) naswona a ku laveki xiengeteleko xin'wana eka xin'wana xa swona.
roster.how.from: CSV or Excel. Column headings are matched by name ("Surname", "Last Name" and "Van" all work) and no extension is needed for any of it.

roster.aiOn.text: Xiengeteleko xa wena xa AI xi pfuriwile

roster.aiOnWhat.text: naswona xi ta ringeta ku fambisana ni xihlokwana xin'wana ni xin'wana lexi milawu yi xi hoxaka. Xi kombisiwa swihlokwana ntsena, a xi voni mitsari, leyi nga na tinomboro ta vuvani.
roster.aiOnWhat.from: and will try to match any heading the rules miss. It is shown the headings only, never the rows, which carry identity numbers.

roster.aiOff.text: Loko xiengeteleko xa wena xa AI xi pfuriwile xi ta engetela ku fambisana ni swihlokwana leswi milawu yi nga swi tiviki; xi ta kombisiwa swihlokwana ntsena, a xi nge voni mitsari. Xiswichi xi le henhla ka xiphephana.
roster.aiOff.from: With your AI extension switched on it would additionally match headings the rules do not recognise; it would be shown the headings only, never the rows. The switch is at the top of the page.

roster.passwords.text: Tiphasiwedi ta vona to sungula, leti kombisiwaka kan'we

roster.passwordsNote.text: Leti a ti hlayisiwi laha ti nga ha hlayiwaka nakambe. Ti kopiye sweswi, kumbe u ti tlhela u ti cinca un'we hi un'we endzhaku. Munhu un'wana ni un'wana u kombeleriwa ku cinca phasiwedi ya yena loko a nghena ro sungula.
roster.passwordsNote.from: These are not stored anywhere they can be read again. Copy them now, or reset them individually later. Each person is asked to change theirs on first sign-in.

roster.willCreateSkip.text: {count} ti ta endliwa, {skipped} ti ta tshikiwa.
roster.willCreateSkip.from: {count} will be created, {skipped} will be skipped.

personPage.anonymised.text: Rekhodo leyi yi endliwe leswaku yi nga tivikanga

personPage.anonymisedOne.text: Vuxokoxoko bya munhu byi herisiwe hi {date} hi xikombelo xa yena. Xitifikeyiti xa yena xin'we xi ha tirha naswona xi nga kambisisiwa, hikuva kwalifikheyixini leyi kumiweke yi fanele ku tshama eka rhekhodo ya tiko.
personPage.anonymisedOne.from: The personal details were erased on {date} at the person's request. Their 1 certificate remains valid and verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to stay on the national record.

personPage.anonymisedMany.text: Vuxokoxoko bya munhu byi herisiwe hi {date} hi xikombelo xa yena. Switifikeyiti swa yena swa {count} swi ha tirha naswona swi nga kambisisiwa, hikuva kwalifikheyixini leyi kumiweke yi fanele ku tshama eka rhekhodo ya tiko.
personPage.anonymisedMany.from: The personal details were erased on {date} at the person's request. Their {count} certificates remain valid and verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to stay on the national record.

personPage.noEdit.text: A ku na nchumu laha lowu nga cinciwaka.

personPage.conductIntro.text: Leswi vuriweke, swilemukiso swihi leswi a swi ha tirha hi nkarhi wolowo, loko xitiviso xa nhlengeletano xi ringene, ni leswi vekiweke. Hi ku landza ndlela leyi swi humeleleke hakona, leyi hi yona leyi swi hlayiwaka hakona nakambe.
personPage.conductIntro.from: What was alleged, which warnings were live at the time, whether notice of a hearing was adequate, and what was decided. In the order it happened, which is the order it gets read back in.

personPage.supportIntro.text: Leswi endliwaka eka mudyondzi loyi, ni leswi endliwaka hi mani. Xivangelo xa ku endlela munhu ku olova xi nga vuxokoxoko bya rihanyo kumbe bya mali naswona xi hlayisiwa xi hambanile, hikuva ku endla ku olova a swi lavi ku tiva leswi endlaka.
personPage.supportIntro.from: What is being done for this learner, and by whom. The reason behind an accommodation is health or financial information and is held apart from it, because doing the accommodating does not require knowing why.

personPage.missed.text: Masiku ya makumu lama nga tsutsumiwangiki

personPage.missedIntro.text: Siku rin'we ro engetela, ni rin'we ntsena. Loko ra kona na rona ri tsutsumiwile hikwalaho ka vuvabyi, mudyondzi u ya eka nkambisiso wa nomu na mulanguteri la huma eka mutirhisi.
personPage.missedIntro.from: One additional date, and one only. Where that is also missed on medical grounds the learner goes to an oral assessment with an observer from the employer.

personPage.appealsIntro.text: Ku kandziyisa mbuyelo, kumbe ku kandziyisa mahanyelo ya mukambisisi. Ku amukeriwa ku tiviwa endzeni ka tiawara ta {hours}, naswona nkarhi wu sungula loko wu tsariwe laha.
personPage.appealsIntro.from: Against a result, or against an assessor's conduct. Receipt is acknowledged within {hours} hours, and the clock starts when it is lodged here.

personPage.documentsIntro.text: Ti kambisisiwa loko ti ri karhi ti hlengeletiwa, ku nga ri loko xihlawulo xi ri karhi xi hlanganisiwa. Kopi leyi tiyisiweke leyi pfumalaka leyi kumiweke endzhaku ka tin'hweti swi tika ngopfu ku yi kuma, naswona siku ro pfala hi ntolovelo ri le kusuhi ni masiku hi nkarhi wolowo.
personPage.documentsIntro.from: Checked as they are collected rather than when a return is being assembled. A missing certified copy found months later is far harder to get, and the deadline is usually days away by then.

personPage.elsewhereIntro.text: Yi tisiwe eka sisiteme yin'wana. Yi kombisiwa hilaha yi tsariweke hakona kwalaho; a ku na nchumu eka yona lowu dyondzisiweke, kambisisiwaka kumbe languteriweke eka pulatifomo leyi.
personPage.elsewhereIntro.from: Imported from another system. Shown as it was recorded there; none of it was taught, assessed or moderated on this platform.

editor.ownRoles.text: A wu nge swi koti ku cinca swiavelo swa wena n'wini: ku susa ku nghena ka wena n'wini i xihoxo lexi ku nga riki na munhu un'wana la nga xi lulamisaka. Kombela mutirhisi-lonkulu un'wana.
editor.ownRoles.from: You cannot change your own roles: removing your own access is the one mistake nobody else may be able to undo. Ask another administrator.

editor.mailboxIntro.text: Adiresi leyi vadyondzi ni vakambisisi va tsalaka ni ku amukela mahungu eka yona. Yi hambanile ni adiresi yo nghena leyi nga laha henhla, leswaku mahungu lama vulavulaka hi nkambisiso wu vula eka rekhodo ya mudyondzi ku nga ri eka bokisi ra munhu, laha ku nga riki na rhekhodo ya vuhloli, ku nga riki na kopi yo hlayisa, naswona ku heta loko a suka.
editor.mailboxIntro.from: The address learners and assessors write to and from. Separate from the sign-in address above, so a conversation about an assessment lands inside the learner's record rather than in somebody's private inbox, where it is outside the audit log, outside the backup, and gone when they leave.

editor.noPassword.text: A ku na phasiwedi yo hambana, hikuva a ku na ku nghena loku hambaneke.
editor.noPassword.from: There is no separate password, because there is no separate login.

editor.noPasswordWhy.text: Leri a hi bokisi ra imeyili eka sesiva ya imeyili leyi nga na webmeyili ya yona. Mahungu lama rhumeriwaka eka adiresi leyi ma tisiwa endzeni ka pulatifomo, kutani munhu u ma hlaya a tlhela a ma hlamula eka Imeyili endzhaku ka ku nghena hilaha a tolovelekeke hakona. Hi wona xikongomelo: vuhlanganisi byi le rhekhodo ya mudyondzi, eka rhekhodo ya vuhloli ni le kopi yo hlayisa, ku nga ri eka bokisi ra munhu leri suka loko a suka.
editor.noPasswordWhy.from: This is not a mailbox on a mail host with its own webmail. Mail sent to this address is delivered into the platform, and the person reads and answers it under Mail after signing in the way they always do. That is the point of it: the correspondence sits inside the learner's record, in the audit log and in the backup, rather than in a private inbox that leaves when they do.

editor.mailboxChange.text: Ku yi cinca a ku hundzisi mahungu lama se ma amukeriweke.
editor.mailboxChange.from: Changing it does not move mail already received.

editor.mailboxSuggested.text: Leswi ringanyetiwaka: {address}. Yi siye yi nga tsariwanga loko u nga lavi bokisi.
editor.mailboxSuggested.from: Suggested: {address}. Leave blank for no mailbox.

editor.newPassword.text: Phasiwedi leyintshwa: yi kombisiwa kan'we, yi nyike munhu hi ku kongoma.
editor.newPassword.from: New password: shown once, give it to them directly.

editor.ownSuspend.text: A wu nge swi koti ku yimisa akhawunti ya wena n'wini.
editor.ownSuspend.from: You cannot suspend your own account.

editor.suspendNote.text: Ku yimisa swi herisa nkarhi wun'wana ni wun'wana lowu munhu a wu pfuleke sweswi, naswona ku cinca phasiwedi swi n'wi humesa ndhawu hinkwayo.
editor.suspendNote.from: Suspending ends any session the person has open immediately, and resetting a password signs them out everywhere.

editor.eraseIntro.text: Eka xikombelo xa ku herisa xa POPIA. Swi susa vito, vuxokoxoko bya vuhlanganisi ni bya vaaki hi masiku hinkwawo. Switifikeyiti ni tirhekhodo ta nkambisiso swi hlayisiwa naswona swi ha kota ku kambisisiwa, hikuva kwalifikheyixini leyi kumiweke yi fanele ku tshama eka rhekhodo ya tiko, hi kona ha yini leswi swi nga tlheliseki endzhaku.
editor.eraseIntro.from: For a POPIA erasure request. Removes the name, contact and demographic details permanently. Certificates and assessment records are kept and stay verifiable, because a qualification once earned has to remain on the national record, which is also why this cannot be undone.

editor.whyHint.text: Swi hlayisiwa hi masiku hinkwawo eka rhekhodo ya vuhloli.
editor.whyHint.from: Kept permanently in the audit log.

lodge.noCohort.text: Xikombelo xo kandziyisa xi nyikiwa eka ntlawa, naswona mudyondzi loyi a nga eka ntlawa lowu tirhaka.
lodge.noCohort.from: An appeal is filed against a cohort, and this learner is not on a running one.

lodge.statementHint.text: Leswi mudyondzi a swi vulaka, hi marito ya yena loko swi koteka.
lodge.statementHint.from: What the learner says, in their words where possible.

lodge.lateWhy.text: Hikwalaho ka yini leswi swi amukeriwa endzhaku ka nkarhi
lodge.lateWhy.from: Why this is being accepted out of time

lodge.lateNote.text: Xikombelo xo kandziyisa lexi endzhaku ka nkarhi na xona i xikombelo xo kandziyisa, naswona ku xi alanisa laha a swi ta xi rhumela ntsena eka bokisi ra munhu. Xivangelo xi va xiphemu xa fayili.
lodge.lateNote.from: A late appeal is still an appeal, and turning it away here would only send it to somebody's inbox. The reason becomes part of the file.

missed.outcome.sat.text: U tshamile eka siku ro engetela

missed.none.text: A ku na masiku ya makumu lama nga tsutsumiwangiki.

missed.againOral.text: U tlhele a tsutsuma: pfumelela nkambisiso wa nomu
missed.againOral.from: Missed it again: authorise an oral assessment

missed.wasMedical.text: Ku tsutsuma ka vumbirhi a ku ri hikwalaho ka vuvabyi
missed.wasMedical.from: The second miss was on medical grounds

missed.medicalHint.text: Xivangelo xa vuvabyi a xi ri xihi

missed.medicalOnly.text: Ndlela ya nomu yi pfuriwa hi xivangelo xa vuvabyi ntsena, ku nga ri xin'wana. Handle ka xona mbuyelo i ku lahlekelwa, lexi mudyondzi a nga ha xi kandziyisaka.
missed.medicalOnly.from: The oral route opens on a medical ground and nothing else. Without one the outcome is a forfeit, which the learner can still appeal.

missed.whyHint.text: Hikwalaho ka yini swi tsutsumiwile, loko swi tiviwa
missed.whyHint.from: Why it was missed, if known

missed.onlyOne.text: Siku rin'we ro engetela, ni rin'we ntsena. Ku ri tsala laha swi tivisa leswaku ra vunharhu a ri nga vekiwi endzhaku hi munhu la nga tivangi hi leri.
missed.onlyOne.from: One additional date, and one only. Recording it here is what stops a third being arranged later by somebody who did not know about this one.

support.none.text: A ku na nseketelo lowu tsariweke.

support.withheld.text: Ku na vuxokoxoko byo tala eka fayili. Byi sirhelelekile, hikuva i vuxokoxoko bya rihanyo kumbe bya mali naswona ku endla ku olova a swi lavi ku tiva xivangelo xa swona.
support.withheld.from: There is more detail on file. It is restricted, because it is health or financial information and doing the accommodation does not require knowing the reason for it.

support.changing.text: Leswi swi cinca hikwalaho ka leswi
support.changing.from: What is changing as a result

support.closedOne.text: Rekhodo 1 leyi pfariweke a yi kombisiwi.

support.closedMany.text: Tirhekhodo ta {count} leti pfariweke a ti kombisiwi.

support.accommodation.text: Leswi swi ta endliwa: swi avelana ni loyi a fanelaka ku swi endla
support.accommodation.from: What will be done: shared with whoever has to do it

support.accommodationHint.text: Tshama ekusuhi ni nyangwa. Pfumelela ku wisa endzhaku ka timinete ta 40 hinkwato. Nyika swilo leswi kandziyisiweke.
support.accommodationHint.from: Seat near the door. Allow a break every 40 minutes. Provide printed materials.

support.reason.text: Xivangelo lexi nga ehansi ka sweswo: xa sirhelela, naswona swa antswa ku xi siya xi nga tsariwanga
support.reason.from: The reason behind it: restricted, and better left empty

support.reasonNote.text: Rihanyo, vuhlanya bya miri ni maemo ya mali i vuxokoxoko byo hlawuleka bya munhu. Rekhodo leyi vulaka leswi ku fanelaka ku endliwa ntsena yi vuyerisa mudyondzi hi ndlela leyi fanaka, naswona yi hlohletela khombo ro tsongo swinene. Yi tata ntsena laha munhu a nga swi koti ku tirha handle ka yona.
support.reasonNote.from: Health, disability and financial circumstances are special personal information. A record that says only what to do serves the learner just as well and puts far less at risk. Fill this in only where somebody genuinely could not act without it.

support.consented.text: Mudyondzi u pfumelele leswaku leswi swi tsariwa
support.consented.from: The learner has agreed to this being recorded

docs.kind.certified_id.text: Kopi leyi tiyisiweke ya dokumente ya vuvani

docs.kind.highest_qualification.text: Kopi leyi tiyisiweke ya kwalifikheyixini ya le henhla

docs.kind.learnership_agreement.text: Ntwanano wa ku dyondzisa hi ntirho

docs.kind.rpl_portfolio.text: Pothifoliyo ya dyondzo leyi tshameke yi ri kona

docs.kind.employment_equity_form.text: Foromo ya ku ringana ka ntirho
