docs.route.rpl.text: Ku tiviwa ka dyondzo leyi tshameke yi ri kona

docs.routeNote.text: Ndlela yi vula leswi laveriwaka. Ku tiviwa ka dyondzo leyi tshameke yi ri kona swi lava pothifoliyo ku nga ri xitifikeyiti xa kwalifikheyixini, hikuva xikombelo hi leswaku dyondzo yi humelerile handle ka purogirama ya nawu.
docs.routeNote.from: The route decides what is required. Recognition of prior learning asks for a portfolio rather than a qualification certificate, because the claim is that the learning happened outside a formal programme.

docs.allSupplied.text: Hinkwaswo leswi laveriwaka swi nyikiwile naswona swi kambisisiwile.
docs.allSupplied.from: Everything required has been supplied and checked.

conduct.stage.informal_counselling.text: Ku tsundzuxiwa hi ku nga tirhisi nawu

conduct.liveNote.text: Leswi ntsena swa hlayiwa eka ku tlakuka ka ntsheketo. Xilemukiso lexi hundzeke siku ra xona xi tshama eka fayili kambe a xi ha hlayiwi, hi kona xikombelo xo kandziyisa xi titshegeke hi xona.
conduct.liveNote.from: Only these count towards escalation. A warning past its date stays on file and stops counting, which is what an appeal turns on.

conduct.nothing.text: A ku na nchumu lowu tsariweke.

conduct.recordSignature.text: tsala xikombelo xa mudyondzi xa ku sayina

conduct.hearingAt.text: Ku yingiseriwa ka {when}, xitiviso xi nyikiwe hi {notice}.

conduct.findingsHint.text: Leswi kumiweke, ni leswi ku hlawuriweke ha swona
conduct.findingsHint.from: What was found, and on what basis

conduct.givenButton.text: Mudyondzi u nyikiwe leswi hi ku tsariwa
conduct.givenButton.from: The learner has been given this in writing

conduct.termsHint.text: Nawu lowu tshoveriweke, xiyimo lexi languteriweke, ni leswi humelelaka loko swi tlhela swi endleka.
conduct.termsHint.from: The rule broken, the standard expected, and what happens if it recurs.

conduct.allegationsHint.text: Swikombiso swo karhi leswi vekiweke mudyondzi
conduct.allegationsHint.from: The specific allegations put to the learner

conduct.sanctionsHint.text: Switshunxo leswi nga endliwaka, ku katsa ku herisiwa laha swi nga ta endliwa
conduct.sanctionsHint.from: Sanctions possible, including termination where it is

conduct.rights.text: Xitiviso xi byela mudyondzi leswaku a nga pfuniwa hi mudyondzi-kulobye, a nyikela mhaka ya yena, a vitana ni ku vutisa timbhoni.
conduct.rights.from: The notice tells the learner they may be assisted by a fellow learner, present their case, and call and question witnesses.

conduct.notice.text: Ku ehleketa ku sukela sweswi tiawara ta {hours} kumbe ku tlula. Xitiviso xa nkarhi wo koma xa alaniwa: hi xona xihoxo lexi xikombelo xo kandziyisa xi wiwaka hi xona, ku nga khathariseki leswi mudyondzi a swi endleke.
conduct.notice.from: At least {hours} hours from now. Short notice is refused: it is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

conduct.whyHint.text: Hikwalaho ka yini. Leri i ndzimana leri mudyondzi a ri faneleke.
conduct.whyHint.from: Why. This is the paragraph the learner is entitled to.

conduct.allegationHint.text: Leswi vuriwaka, hi ku kongoma. Mudyondzi a nga swi hlamuli 'mahanyelo yo biha'.
conduct.allegationHint.from: What is alleged, specifically. A learner cannot answer 'poor attitude'.

cohorts.intro.text: Ntlawa wa vanhu lava tirhaka purogirama swin'we, hi nkarhi wun'we. Siku ro pfala rin'wana ni rin'wana ri hlayisiwa tanihi nhlayo ya masiku ku suka eka siku ro sungula, hikwalaho ku cinca ku nghena ku cinca masiku hinkwawo eka un'wana ni un'wana la nga eka wona hi xikan'we.
cohorts.intro.from: A group working through a programme together, on one schedule. Every deadline is held as a number of days from the start date, so moving an intake moves every date for everyone in it at once.

cohorts.none.text: {cohort} i ntlawa wa vanhu lava tirhaka {course} leyi kandziyisiweke swin'we, hi nkarhi wun'we. Endla yin'we eka {course} kutani siku ro pfala rin'wana ni rin'wana ri hlayiwa ku suka eka siku ra yona ro sungula.
cohorts.none.from: A {cohort} is a group working through a published {course} together, on one schedule. Create one against a {course} and every deadline is measured from its start date.

cohorts.roster.text: Engetela ntlawa ku suka eka spredshiti
cohorts.roster.from: Add a cohort from a spreadsheet

cohorts.rosterIntro.text: Hlaya fayili ya CSV kumbe Excel ya vadyondzi u va endla hinkwavo hi kan'we. Yi ku kombisa leswi yi swi endleke hi fayili ku nga si endliwa munhu, kutani u va tsarisa eka ntlawa lowu nga laha henhla.
cohorts.rosterIntro.from: Read a CSV or Excel file of learners and create them all at once. It shows you what it made of the file before anybody is created, then enrol them onto a cohort above.

cohorts.noPublished.text: A ku na {courses} leyi kandziyisiweke leyi nga se va kona. {cohort} yi tirha eka {course} leyi kandziyisiweke, leswaku swilo swa dyondzo swi nga cinci ntlawa lowu se wu tirhaka.
cohorts.noPublished.from: There are no published {courses} yet. A {cohort} runs against a published {course}, so that the material cannot change under a group already working through it.

cohorts.startNote.text: Siku rin'wana ni rin'wana ro pfala ri hlayiwa ku suka eka siku leri. Ri nga cinciwa endzhaku, naswona hinkwaswo swa cinca swin'we na rona.
cohorts.startNote.from: Every deadline is counted from this day. It can be moved later, and everything moves with it.

cohort.payment.text: Xihlangi xa mali ni ku hakelela

cohort.paid.text: Swi hakeliwile. Un'wana ni un'wana eka ntlawa lowu u hlayiwa u hakeliwile.
cohort.paid.from: Paid. Everybody on this cohort counts as paid for.

cohort.paidRef.text: Swi hakeliwile · {reference}. Un'wana ni un'wana eka ntlawa lowu u hlayiwa u hakeliwile.
cohort.paidRef.from: Paid · {reference}. Everybody on this cohort counts as paid for.

cohort.invoiced.text: Xihlangi xi rhumeriwile, naswona a ku na ku hakeliwa loku tsariweke.
cohort.invoiced.from: Invoiced, and no payment recorded against it yet.

cohort.nothingRecorded.text: A ku na nchumu lowu tsariweke. Ndlela ya ku tsarisiwa yi sungula laha.
cohort.nothingRecorded.from: Nothing recorded. The enrolment procedure begins here.

cohort.moveIntro.text: Siku rin'wana ni rin'wana laha hansi ri hlayisiwa tanihi nhlayo ya masiku ku suka eka leri, hikwalaho ku cinca leri swi cinca ku tirha hinkwako eka un'wana ni un'wana la nga eka ntlawa.
cohort.moveIntro.from: Every date below is held as a number of days from this one, so changing it moves the whole rollout for everybody on the cohort.

cohort.waitingIntro.text: Mudyondzi un'wana ni un'wana kan'we, eka xikhala xo sungula lexi a nga kotiki ku xi pfula.
cohort.waitingIntro.from: Each learner once, at the earliest step they cannot open.

cohort.progress.from: Where the cohort has got to

cohort.progressIntro.text: Leswi pfuriweke ni leswi hetisiweke eka xikhala xin'wana ni xin'wana, ni nkarhi lowu lava va hetisaka va wu tekeke. Median ku nga ri nhlayo ya ku ringanisa, leswaku mudyondzi un'we la nyamalaleke nkarhi wa kotara a nga fihli laha van'wana hinkwavo va fikeleke kona.
cohort.progressIntro.from: Opened and finished per step, and how long it took those who finished. The median rather than the average, so one learner who disappeared for a term does not hide where everybody else is.

cohort.stalledOne.text: Xikhala xin'we xi na vanhu lava tshameke eka xona: {steps}.
cohort.stalledOne.from: One step has people sitting on it: {steps}.

cohort.stalledMany.text: Swikhala swa {count} swi na vanhu lava tshameke eka swona: {steps}.
cohort.stalledMany.from: {count} steps have people sitting on them: {steps}.

cohort.rolloutIntro.text: Ti-sesheni leti nga na masiku leti ntlawa lowu hlanganaka eka tona, ni rhejista leyi tekiweke eka rin'wana ni rin'wana. Laha purogirama yi nga na tikridithi yi fanele ku fambisiwa hi mufambisi, naswona lexi i vumbhoni bya leswaku a swi ri tano.
cohort.rolloutIntro.from: The dated sessions this cohort meets for, and the register taken at each. Where a programme carries credits it has to be facilitator-led, and this is the evidence that it was.

cohort.attendanceIntro.text: Hinkwaswo swi lavisisiwa hi purogirama hinkwayo; "ku ya emahlweni" swi lavisisiwa hi leswi se swi tshameke swi endliwa. Eku sunguleni ka purogirama xo sungula xi le hansi swinene naswona xa vumbirhi i xa ntiyiso, hikwalaho hinkwaswo swi nyikiwa ku nga ri xin'we lexi ku hlawuriweke xona.
cohort.attendanceIntro.from: Overall is against the whole programme; to date is against what has actually been held. Early in a programme the first is meaninglessly low and the second is the honest one, so both are given rather than one being chosen for you.

cohort.held.text: Ti-sesheni ta {held} eka {countable} ti hlayisiwile. Ti-sesheni leti herisiweke ni lava nghenaka hi ku tihlawulela va siyiwile eka swimbirhi.
cohort.held.from: {held} of {countable} sessions held. Cancelled sessions and voluntary walk-ins are left out of both.

cohort.feedbackIntro.text: Swi rhumeriwa endzhaku ka wa makumu, swi hlamuriwa endzeni ka tiawara ta {hours}. A ku na munhu la tivisaka ku amukela naswona a ku na munhu la kopiyaka nchumu: ku amukela i mutsari naswona xiviko i xivutiso.
cohort.feedbackIntro.from: Sent after a summative, answered within {hours} hours. Nobody acknowledges receipt and nobody transcribes anything: receipt is a row and the report is a query.

cohort.assessmentIntro.text: Mudyondzi un'wana ni un'wana eka ntirho wun'wana ni wun'wana lowu kambisisiwaka, hi ku landza ndlela leyi wu hlengeletiwaka hakona. Swi hlayiwa eka leswi rhumeriweke, swiboho ni tirhejista, ku nga ri hi voko, leswaku swi nga hambani na swona.
cohort.assessmentIntro.from: Every learner against every piece of assessed work, in the order it is collected. Read from submissions, decisions and registers rather than kept by hand, so it cannot disagree with them.

cohort.absentNote.text: Ku nga vi kona swi hlayiwa eka rhejista ya nkhomano lowu ntirho wu tsaliweke eka wona, ku nga ri eka leswi rhumeriweke, hikuva mudyondzi la nga tshamangiki a nga na nchumu lowu rhumeriweke lowu swi nga tsariwaka eka wona.
cohort.absentNote.from: Absent is read from the register of the sitting the work was written at, not from the submission, because a learner who did not attend has no submission for it to be recorded on.

cohort.workIntro.text: Leswi fanelaka ku endliwa ku rhendzela ku dyondzisa: swilo swa dyondzo swi lunghekile, tidokumente ti rhumeriwile, mulanguteri u vekiwile, switifikeyiti swi lavisisiwa.
cohort.workIntro.from: What has to happen around the teaching: material readied, documents submitted, a moderator appointed, certificates chased.

cohort.release.text: ku hunguta ntirho ka swikhala swa {course}

cohort.releaseIntro.text: Swi hlayisiwa tanihi masiku ku suka eka siku ro sungula. Cinca siku ro sungula kutani hinkwaswo leswi swa cinca swin'we na rona.
cohort.releaseIntro.from: Held as days from the start. Change the start date and every one of these moves with it.

cohort.noSteps.text: {course} ya ntlawa lowu a yi na swikhala.
cohort.noSteps.from: This cohort's {course} has no steps yet.

cohort.membersIntro.text: Ku engetela munhu laha na kona swa n'wi tsarisa eka {course}. Vito eka rhejista ra munhu la nga pfuleki nchumu i xiyimo xa hafu lexi swi xi papalataka.
cohort.membersIntro.from: Adding somebody here also enrols them on the {course}. A name on a register who cannot open anything is the half-state this avoids.

cohort.nobody.text: A ku na munhu la engeteliweke.

cohortCtl.noSteps.text: Ndzetelo wa ntlawa lowu a wu na swikhala, hikwalaho a ku na nchumu lowu ku fanelaka ku kunguhata.
cohortCtl.noSteps.from: This cohort's course has no steps yet, so there is nothing to schedule.

cohortCtl.closesAfter.text: Xi pfala masiku endzhaku ka ku fanela

cohortCtl.closesLabel.text: {step}: xi pfala masiku endzhaku ka ku fanela

cohortCtl.dayZero.text: Siku 0 i siku ro sungula. Siya luni ri nga tsariwanga kutani xikhala lexo a xi na masiku hi xikan'we; xi pfuriwa hi ku hatlisa loko xin'wana ni xin'wana lexi xi rhangeke xi hetile.
cohortCtl.dayZero.from: Day 0 is the start date. Leave a row empty and that step carries no dates at all; it opens as soon as whatever comes before it is done.

cohortCtl.everybody.text: Un'wana ni un'wana la nga na akhawunti ya mudyondzi u se a ri eka ntlawa lowu. Rhanga u vitana vanhu van'wana eka xiscrini xa Vanhu.
cohortCtl.everybody.from: Everybody with a learner account is already on this cohort. Invite more people from the People screen first.

askFeedback.none.text: A ku na loyi a kombeleriweke.

payment.reference.text: Nomboro ya vona ya ku kombela

payment.referenceNote.text: Leswaku swi nga fambisaniswa ni leswi tshamaka eka swa timali.
payment.referenceNote.from: So it can be matched to what finance holds.

tasks.progress.text: {done} eka {counted} swi hetisiwile: {percent}%. Ntirho lowu herisiweke a wu hlayiwi eka tinhlayo hinkwato, hikwalaho ku tshika ntirho a ku pfuni kumbe ku onha nhlayo.
tasks.progress.from: {done} of {counted} done: {percent}%. Cancelled work is left out of both halves, so abandoning a task neither helps nor hurts the figure.

rollout.nothing.text: A ku na leswi kunguhatiweke. Laha purogirama yi nga na tikridithi yi fanele ku fambisiwa hi mufambisi, kutani laha ku sunguriwa vumbhoni bya leswaku a swi ri tano.
rollout.nothing.from: Nothing scheduled yet. Where a programme carries credits it has to be facilitator-led, so this is where the evidence that it was begins.

rollout.announced.text: Ntlawa ni mufambisi va tivisiwa hi sesheni yin'wana ni yin'wana vhiki rin'we emahlweni ka yona, ni nkarhi ni lin'ki ya yona, kutani va tlhela va tivisiwa loko yi cincisiwa, yi herisiwa kumbe yi hlwerisiwa.
rollout.announced.from: The cohort and the facilitator are told about each session a week before it, with its time and link, and told again if it is moved, cancelled or postponed.

archive.intro.text: Loko mudyondzi a ri na xitatimente xa yena xa mbuyelo naswona xitifikeyiti xa yena xa kwalifikheyixini lexi humaka eka nhlangano lowu nyikaka xi tsariwile eka tluka ra yena ra ku lunghekela EISA, Rhekhodo ya yena ya Vumbhoni yi nga huma eka pulatifomo eka xihlayiselo xin'we lexi u xi hlayisaka. Xihlayiselo xi pfuriwa eka browser yin'wana ni yin'wana handle ka pulatifomo. A ku susiwi nchumu ku fikela kopi ya wena leyi hlayisiweke yi kambisisiwa hi xona, naswona rhekhodo yin'wana ni yin'wana yi tshama laha, yi vula leswaku i xihlayiselo xihi lexi nga na tifayili.
archive.intro.from: Once a learner holds their statement of results and their qualification certificate from the awarding body has been recorded on their EISA readiness page, their Portfolio of Evidence can leave the platform in one archive that you keep. The archive opens in any browser without the platform. Nothing is removed until your stored copy has been checked against it, and every record stays here, saying which archive holds the files.

archive.readyFor.text: Va na xitatimente xa mbuyelo ni xitifikeyiti xa kwalifikheyixini xa {qualification}.
archive.readyFor.from: Holding a statement of results and the qualification certificate for {qualification}.

archive.noQualification.text: Ndzetelo wa ntlawa lowu a wu hlanganisiwi ni kwalifikheyixini yin'wana.
archive.noQualification.from: This cohort's course counts towards no qualification.

archive.anotherBuilding.text: Xihlayiselo xin'wana xa tsariwa. Sungula xa xona xi landzelaka loko xi hetile.
archive.anotherBuilding.from: Another archive is being written. Start the next one when it has finished.

archive.notYetIntro.text: Va tshama eka pulatifomo kutani va landzela exihlayiselweni xa ha ta loko xitifikeyiti xa vona xa kwalifikheyixini xi tsariwile.
archive.notYetIntro.from: They stay on the platform and follow in a later archive once their own qualification certificate has been recorded.

archive.step1Note.text: Yi hlayise laha pholisi ya wena ya tirhekhodo yi vulaka leswaku tirhekhodo ta vadyondzi ti hlayisiwa kona, ku ya hi nkarhi hinkwawo wa ku hlayisa. Loko tifayili ti susiwile, leyi i kopi yo helela ntsena.
archive.step1Note.from: Keep it where your records policy says learner records are kept, for the full retention period. Once the files are removed, this is the only complete copy.

archive.step2.text: 2. Kambisisa kopi leyi u yi hlayiseke

archive.step3.from: 3. Remove the files from the platform

archive.building.text: Xa tsariwa. Tluka leri ri tihlantswa ntsena.
archive.building.from: Being written. This page updates by itself.

archive.checkLabel.text: Kambisisa kopi leyi u yi hlayiseke

archive.checkNote.text: Hlawula xihlayiselo laha u xi hlayiseke kona. Xi hlayiwa eka khompyuta leyi, a xi tlakusiwi; ntsena mfungho wa xona wu rhumeriwa. Xihlayiselo xi na bayiti ta {bytes}.
archive.checkNote.from: Choose the archive from where you stored it. It is read on this computer and not uploaded; only its fingerprint is sent. The archive is {bytes} bytes.

archive.stored.text: Kopi leyi ndzi yi kambisiseke yi hlayisiwile laha pholisi ya hina ya tirhekhodo yi vulaka leswaku yi fanele ku hlayisiwa kona.
archive.stored.from: The copy I checked is stored where our records policy says it should be kept.

archive.keepingOne.text: Dokumente 1 ya ku tsarisiwa yi tshama eka pulatifomo na yona, hikuva purogirama yin'wana ya mudyondzi yi ha yi lava.
archive.keepingOne.from: 1 enrolment document stays on the platform as well, because another programme of the learner's still needs it.

archive.keeping.text: Tidokumente ta {count} ta ku tsarisiwa ti tshama eka pulatifomo na tona, hikuva purogirama yin'wana ya mudyondzi yi ha ti lava.
archive.keeping.from: {count} enrolment documents stay on the platform as well, because another programme of the learner's still needs them.

archive.wrongSize.text: Fayili yoleyo yi na bayiti ta {size} naswona xihlayiselo xi na {expected}. A hi xihlayiselo lexi.
archive.wrongSize.from: That file is {size} bytes and the archive is {expected}. It is not this archive.

archive.couldNotStart.text: Ku tlherisela a ku kotanga ku sungula.

archive.pieceRefused.text: Xiphemu xin'wana xa ku tlakusa xi arile.
archive.pieceRefused.from: A piece of the upload was refused.

archive.carryOn.text: {problem} Hlawula fayili nakambe leswaku u ya emahlweni laha yi yimeke kona.
archive.carryOn.from: {problem} Choose the file again to carry on from where it stopped.

archive.checkingFiles.text: Ku kambisisa fayili yin'wana ni yin'wana…

archive.restoreNote.text: Swi laveka ntsena loko tifayili leti ti fanele ku tlhela ti va eka pulatifomo. Xihlayiselo xi tlakusiwa, xi kambisisiwa hi mfungho lowu tekiweke loko xi endliwa, kutani fayili yin'wana ni yin'wana yi vekiwa ndhawini ya yona ya khale.
archive.restoreNote.from: Only needed if these files have to be on the platform again. The archive is uploaded, checked against the fingerprint taken when it was made, and each file is put back where it was.

register.supervised.text: Ku tshama ka nkambisiso loku lawuriwaka

register.supervisedIntro.text: Leswi vekiweke, leswi va pfumelaneke na swona, ni leswaku xiphephana xa vona xi amukeriwile. Nhlangano wu tshama laha tilekitšha ta wena ti tshamaka kona; leri i rekhodo ya ndlela leyi ku lawuriweke ha yona.
register.supervisedIntro.from: Who was admitted, what they agreed to, and that their script was received. The meeting itself runs where your lectures do; this is the record of how it was supervised.

register.canInvigilate.text: Leyi i sesheni ya makumu, hikwalaho yi nga lawuriwa.
register.canInvigilate.from: This is a summative session, so it can be invigilated.

register.intro.text: Lava a va ri kona. Swikombiso leswi hlayisiweke swi nga lulamisiwa endzhaku, naswona ku cinca ku hlayisiwa ku ri ni vito ra loyi a ku endleke.
register.intro.from: Who was here. Saved marks can be corrected later, and every change is recorded against whoever made it.

register.nobody.text: A ku na munhu eka ntlawa lowu, hikwalaho a ku na rhejista yo tekiwa.
register.nobody.from: Nobody is on this cohort yet, so there is no register to take.

register.excusedNote.text: Ku khomeleriwa swi vula ku nga vi kona hi xivangelo lexi amukeriweke hi mupfuneti. Swi hambanisiwa ni ku nga vi kona loku nga riki na xivangelo, hikuva endlelo ra ku seketela vadyondzi ri titshege hi ku hambana loku.
register.excusedNote.from: Excused means absent for a reason the provider accepted. It is kept apart from a plain absence because the learner support procedure turns on the difference.

sitting.needsAssessment.text: Ku tshama ka nkambisiso loku lawuriwaka ku lava nkambisiso lowu ku nga lawuriwaka. Rhanga wu kandziyise eka ndzetelo, kutani wu nga vekiwa laha.
sitting.needsAssessment.from: A supervised sitting needs an assessment to supervise. Publish one on the course first, and it can be set up here.

sitting.nothing.text: A ku na leswi lawuriwaka eka sesheni leyi. Veka ku tshama loku loko leyi i nkambisiso lowu lawuriwaka; swi ku nyika siku ro pfala ku amukeriwa, xitiviso, ku kambisisa kamera, rhejista ya swiphephana ni rhekhodo ya swiendlakalo.
sitting.nothing.from: Nothing is being supervised at this session. Set one up if this is an invigilated assessment; it gives you an admission cut-off, a declaration, a camera check, a script register and an incident log.

sitting.setUp.text: Veka ku tshama ka nkambisiso loku lawuriwaka

sitting.invigilator.text: Mulawuri wa nkambisiso (swa ku hlawula, naswona u nga vekiwa hi siku ra wona)
sitting.invigilator.from: Invigilator (optional, and can be set on the day)

sitting.early.text: Timinete leti vakhandidheyiti va fikaka emahlweni ka nkarhi
sitting.early.from: Candidates arrive this many minutes early

sitting.closesAfter.text: Timinete endzhaku ka ku sungula leti ku amukeriwa ku pfalaka
sitting.closesAfter.from: Admission closes this many minutes after the start

sitting.camera.text: Kamera yi fanele ku va yi tshama yi pfuriwile
sitting.camera.from: A camera must be on throughout

sitting.materialsHint.text: Khalikhuleta leyi nga tsariwiki ni xiphephana xa mafomula lexi nyikiweke. A ku na nchumu wun'wana.
sitting.materialsHint.from: A non-programmable calculator and the issued formula sheet. Nothing else.

sitting.declaration.text: Leswi khandidheyiti yin'wana ni yin'wana yi pfumelelanaka na swona ku nga si sungula (swa ku hlawula)
sitting.declaration.from: What each candidate agrees to before starting (optional)

sitting.nothingFurther.text: A ku na nchumu wun'wana lowu fanelaka ku endliwa laha.

room.elsewhere.text: Leyo i {time} {zone} laha u nga kona. Minkarhi leyi tsariweke laha i ya mupfuneti, leswi hi swona rhekhodo yi swi hlayisaka.
room.elsewhere.from: That is {time} {zone} where you are. Times recorded here are the provider's, which is what the record keeps.

room.arrive.text: Vakhandidheyiti va fika timinete ta {minutes} ku nga si sungula.

room.closesAt.text: Ku amukeriwa ku pfala timinete ta {minutes} endzhaku ka ku sungula, hi {time}; endzhaku ka sweswo pulatifomo yi arile, hikuva loyi a amukeriweke hi ku hlwela u va ni nkarhi wo leha wa xiphephana ku tlula un'wana ni un'wana.
room.closesAt.from: Admission closes {minutes} minutes after the start, at {time}; after that the platform refuses, because somebody admitted late has had longer with the paper than everybody else.

room.closes.text: Ku amukeriwa ku pfala timinete ta {minutes} endzhaku ka ku sungula; endzhaku ka sweswo pulatifomo yi arile, hikuva loyi a amukeriweke hi ku hlwela u va ni nkarhi wo leha wa xiphephana ku tlula un'wana ni un'wana.
room.closes.from: Admission closes {minutes} minutes after the start; after that the platform refuses, because somebody admitted late has had longer with the paper than everybody else.

room.cameras.text: Tikamera ti tshama ti pfuriwile hinkwako.

room.joinNote.text: Nhlangano wu tshama eka pulatifomo leyi u tolovelaka ku yi tirhisa. Leswi tsariweke laha i ndlela leyi ku lawuriweke ha yona.
room.joinNote.from: The meeting runs on the platform you already use. What is recorded here is how it was supervised.

room.noLink.text: A ku na lin'ki ya nhlangano eka sesheni leyi. Yi engetele eka xikhale xa ku tirhisa, leswaku vakhandidheyiti va tiva laha va yaka kona.
room.noLink.from: No meeting link on this session yet. Add one on the roll-out so candidates know where to go.

room.incidentsNote.text: Swi tsariwa hi siku ra ku endleka. Xiviko lexi tsariweke tin'hweti endzhaku xi na nkoka wutsongo eka xikombelo xo kandziyisa, laha ku nga ndhawu ntsena leyi xi hlayiwaka eka yona.
room.incidentsNote.from: Filed on the day. An account written weeks later is worth very little at an appeal, which is the only place it is ever read.

quals.intro.text: Kwalifikheyixini ya ntirho yi nyikiwa hi mixaka yinharhu ya swimodyuli: Vutivi, Ntirho wa ku endla, na Ntokoto wa ntirho. Modyuli yin'wana ni yin'wana yi na swipimelo swa yona swa nkambisiso, naswona sisiteme yi kambisisa leswaku vunene bya ndzetelo byi katsa hinkwaswo ku nga si va ndzetelo wu nga kandziyisiwa.
quals.intro.from: An occupational qualification is delivered across three kinds of module: Knowledge, Practical skill, and Workplace experience. Each module has its own assessment criteria, and the system checks that course content covers every one of them before a course can be published.

quals.folderTitle.text: Kumbe yi aka ku suka eka foludara
quals.folderTitle.from: Or build it from a folder

quals.folderIntro.text: Hinkwaswo hi kan'we: kharikhulamu, tiyuniti ta dyondzo, tigayidi ni milawu. Foludara leyi katsaka nkomiso wa yona yi nghenisiwa hi tisekonto; leyi nga riki na wona yi fanele ku kambisisiwa xivumbeko xa yona, kutani xiphemu lexo xi lava xiengeteleko xa AI.
quals.folderIntro.from: Everything at once: the curriculum, the study units, the guides and the policies. A folder that includes a summary of itself imports in seconds; one that does not has to have its structure worked out, and that is the part that needs an AI extension.

quals.folderLabel.text: Foludara ya kwalifikheyixini, ku suka eka khompyuta ya wena
quals.folderLabel.from: The qualification's folder, from your own computer

quals.folderHint.text: Hinkwaswo leswi nga eka foludara ni tifoludara ta yona ta le hansi swa hlayiwa: kharikhulamu, tiyuniti ta dyondzo, tigayidi ni milawu.
quals.folderHint.from: Everything in the folder and its subfolders is read: the curriculum, the study units, the guides and the policies.

quals.folderHint2.text: Foludara leyi akiweke hi sisiteme ya wena ya nhluvukiso wa purogirama yi katsa nkomiso wa yona, kutani wu hlayiwa hi ku kongoma, hi mafambiselo. Foludara leyi nga riki na wona a yi nge kotiwi ku languta xivumbeko xa yona.
quals.folderHint2.from: A folder built by your programme development system includes a summary of itself, and that is read directly, in seconds. A folder without one cannot have its structure worked out yet.

quals.driveTitle.text: Kumbe ku suka eka drayivi leyi u yi hlanganiseke
quals.driveTitle.from: Or from a drive you have connected

quals.driveIntro.text: Foludara leyi fanaka, yi hlayiwa laha yi tshamaka kona. Yi hela ndhawini yin'we: xiphakelo lexi u fanelaka ku xi kambisisa ku nga si tsariwa nchumu.
quals.driveIntro.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

quals.noneManage.text: Yi ake ku suka eka tidokumente ta yona (tluka ra le henhla): dokumente ya kharikhulamu ni dokumente ya kwalifikheyixini swi enerile, naswona a ku na xiengeteleko xa AI lexi tirhisiwaka. Hinkwaswo leswin'wana eka pulatifomo swi titshege hi kwalifikheyixini, hikwalaho leyi i xa ku sungula.
quals.noneManage.from: Build one from its documents (the tab above): the curriculum document and the qualification document are enough, and no AI extension is involved. Everything else on the platform hangs off a qualification, so this is the first thing to do.

quals.noneRead.text: A ku na leyi nga nghenisiwa. Loko yin'wana yi nghenisiwile, kharikhulamu leyi u yi dyondzisaka u tlhela u kambisisa hi yona yi ta va laha: swimodyuli swa yona, tinhloko-mhaka ni swipimelo leswi yin'wana ni yin'wana yi kambisisiwaka hi swona. Ku nghenisa i ntirho wa mutirhisi-lonkulu.
quals.noneRead.from: None has been loaded yet. When one has been, the curriculum you teach and mark against will be here: its modules, its topics and the criteria each one is assessed by. Loading one is an administrator's job.

how.title.text: U navela ku yi engetela ku fana ni yini?
how.title.from: How would you like to add it?

how.intro.text: Ndlela tinharhu. Hlawula yin'we kutani yi yin'we ntsena yi pfuriwa; u nga yi pfala kutani u hlawula yin'wana.
how.intro.from: Three ways in. Pick one and only that one opens; you can close it again and choose differently.

how.documents.title.text: Ku suka eka tidokumente ta yona

how.documents.summary.text: Dokumente ya kharikhulamu, dokumente ya kwalifikheyixini ya SAQA ni nhlamuselo ya nkambisiso. App yi hlaya kharikhulamu hinkwayo eka tona.
how.documents.summary.from: The curriculum document, the SAQA qualification document and the assessment specification. The App reads the whole curriculum out of them.

how.documents.needs.text: Tifayili ta PDF kumbe ta Word timbirhi kumbe tinharhu.
how.documents.needs.from: Two or three PDFs or Word files.

how.documents.speed.text: Tisekonto. A ku na AI eka nkarhi wun'wana ni wun'wana.
how.documents.speed.from: Seconds. No AI involved at any point.

how.folder.summary.text: Hinkwaswo hi kan'we: kharikhulamu, tiyuniti ta dyondzo, tigayidi, tibuku ta ntirho ni milawu, swi hlayisiwa hilaha swi hlayiwaka hakona.
how.folder.summary.from: Everything at once: the curriculum, the study units, the guides, the workbooks and the policies, filed as they are read.

how.folder.needs.text: Foludara hinkwayo ya kwalifikheyixini, ku suka eka khompyuta ya wena kumbe drayivi.
how.folder.needs.from: The qualification's whole folder, from your computer or a drive.

how.folder.speed.text: Timinete. Foludara leyi katsaka nkomiso wa yona a yi lavi AI; leyi nga riki na wona yi kambisisiwa xivumbeko xa yona, naswona xiphemu lexo xi lava AI.
how.folder.speed.from: Minutes. A folder that includes a summary of itself needs no AI; one that does not has its structure worked out, and that part does.

how.blank.title.text: Ku suka eka nchumu wo hava

how.blank.summary.text: Kwalifikheyixini yo nga riki na nchumu leyi u yi akaka hi voko: xihloko, khodi, leveli ni tikridithi, kutani swimodyuli swa yona un'we hi un'we.
how.blank.summary.from: An empty qualification you build by hand: the title, the code, the level and credits, then its modules one at a time.

how.blank.needs.text: Vuxokoxoko lebyi u nga byi vonaka.
how.blank.needs.from: The details in front of you.

how.blank.speed.text: Nkarhi lowu swi wu lavaka. A ku na leswi hlayiwaka ku ku pfuna.
how.blank.speed.from: As long as it takes. Nothing is read for you.

qual.noIdentifiers.text: A ku na swivumbeko swa nawu leswi tsariweke

manager.noneChosen.text: A ku na swimodyuli leswi hlawuriweke

manager.drawnFrom.text: yi humesiwe eka {parent}, leyi yi avelanaka kharikhulamu na yona
manager.drawnFrom.from: drawn from {parent}, whose curriculum it shares

manager.standsAlone.text: yi tshama yi ri yoxe, yi ri ni kharikhulamu ya yona
manager.standsAlone.from: standing on its own, with its own curriculum

manager.criterionWhat.text: Leswi mudyondzi a fanelaka ku swi kombisa

manager.noneFromParent.text: A ku na swimodyuli leswi hlawuriweke eka kharikhulamu ya kwalifikheyixini leyi yi humaka eka yona.
manager.noneFromParent.from: No modules chosen from the parent's curriculum yet.

manager.noModules.text: A ku na swimodyuli swa kharikhulamu.

manager.choose.text: Hlawula swimodyuli leswi leyi yi swi tekaka eka kwalifikheyixini leyi yi humaka eka yona
manager.choose.from: Choose which of the parent's modules this takes

manager.chooseNote.text: Swimodyuli a swi engeteleriwi laha. Leyi yi teka eka kharikhulamu ya kwalifikheyixini leyi yi humaka eka yona, hikwalaho ntirho wa mudyondzi eka modyuli wu hlayiwa kan'we laha a wu hlanganeke na wona kwihi na kwihi.
manager.chooseNote.from: Modules are not added here. This draws from its parent's curriculum, so a learner's work against a module counts once wherever they met it.

manager.componentModule.practical.text: Modyuli ya ntirho wa ku endla

manager.componentModule.general.text: Xo angarhela (lexi nga kandziyisiwiki hi nawu)

manager.whichNote.text: Dokumente ya SAQA yi vula leswaku i xihi. Languta {field} eka tluka ra yona ro sungula.
manager.whichNote.from: The SAQA document says which. Look for {field} on its first page.

manager.standsOnOwn.text: A ku na nchumu: yi tshama yi ri yoxe
manager.standsOnOwn.from: Nothing: it stands on its own

manager.fullOwn.text: Kwalifikheyixini yo helela yi na kharikhulamu ya yona.
manager.fullOwn.from: A full qualification carries its own curriculum.

manager.sharesNote.text: Yi avelana kharikhulamu ya kwalifikheyixini yoleyo, kutani yi teka xiphemu xa swimodyuli swa yona; u hlawula leswi, loko yi va kona.
manager.sharesNote.from: It shares that qualification's curriculum and takes a subset of its modules; you choose which, once it exists.

manager.codeFull.text: Hilaha yi tsariweke hakona eka dokumente ya kharikhulamu. A yi tshuki yi kambisisiwa: ntsena QCTO kumbe OFO swi nga vula leswaku i yini.
manager.codeFull.from: As written on the curriculum document. Never worked out: only the QCTO or the OFO can say what it is.

manager.codePart.text: Khodi leyi fanaka ni ya kwalifikheyixini leyi yi humaka eka yona. Yi avelana kharikhulamu yin'we, hikwalaho yi avelana khodi ya yona.
manager.codePart.from: The same code as the qualification it comes from. They share one curriculum, so they share its code.

manager.accreditation.text: Nomboro ya ku amukeriwa hi nawu

manager.accreditationNote.text: Nomboro leyi kwalifikheyixini leyi yi amukeriweke hi yona. Papila rin'we ra ku amukeriwa hi nawu ri ta katsa tikwalifikheyixini to tala, hikwalaho leyi a hi minkarhi hinkwayo yi fanaka ni nomboro ya mupfuneti n'wini. Loko u yi siya yi nga tsariwanga, tixiviko ti tirhisa ya mupfuneti kutani ti vula leswi.
manager.accreditationNote.from: The number this qualification is accredited under. One accreditation letter usually covers several qualifications, so this is not always the same as the provider's own number. Leave it blank and reports fall back to the provider's and say so.

fromDoc.source.curriculum.note.text: Swimodyuli, tinhloko-mhaka ni swipimelo swa nkambisiso swa le ndzeni.
fromDoc.source.curriculum.note.from: The modules, topics and internal assessment criteria.

fromDoc.source.qualification.note.text: Xiteko xa ku tsarisiwa xa SAQA. Hi xona ntsena xihlovo xa ID ya SAQA ni Vuyelo bya Leveli yo Huma.
fromDoc.source.qualification.note.from: The SAQA registration extract. The only source of the SAQA ID and the Exit Level Outcomes.

fromDoc.source.assessmentSpecification.n.text: Nhlamuselo ya EISA. Yi hlayisiwa kutani yi endliwa leswaku yi nga lavisisiwa.
fromDoc.source.assessmentSpecification.n.from: The EISA specification. Filed and indexed so it is searchable.

fromDoc.open.text: Yi ake ku suka eka tidokumente ta yona

fromDoc.title.text: Ku suka eka tidokumente ta kwalifikheyixini

fromDoc.intro.text: Leti tinharhu i xisekelo lexi hinkwaswo leswin'wana swi akiweke eka xona. Ti nghenise kutani App yi hlaya vuxokoxoko bya kwalifikheyixini, Vuyelo bya yona bya Leveli yo Huma ni kharikhulamu ya yona hinkwayo eka tona. Kambisisa leswi yi swi kumeke, lulamisa leswi yi hoxeke eka swona, kutani hinkwaswo swi tsariwa hi ku hatlisa.
fromDoc.intro.from: These three are the foundation everything else is built on. Upload them and the App reads the qualification's details, its Exit Level Outcomes and its whole curriculum out of them. Check what it found, correct anything it got wrong, and it is written in one go.

fromDoc.pressThis.text: Sweswi tshikelela leri. A ku si tsariwa nchumu.
fromDoc.pressThis.from: Now press this. Nothing is written yet.

fromDoc.stillReading.text: Ha ku hlaya: tisekonto ta {seconds}. Dokumente ya kharikhulamu yi leha; leswi swa tolovelekile.
fromDoc.stillReading.from: Still reading: {seconds} seconds. A curriculum document is long; this is normal.

fromDoc.found.text: Swi hlayile swimodyuli swa {modules}, tinhloko-mhaka ta {topics}, mitsari ya {elements} yo dyondzisiwa ni swipimelo swa nkambisiso swa {criteria}.
fromDoc.found.from: Read {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} assessment criteria.

fromDoc.foundWithElo.text: Swi hlayile swimodyuli swa {modules}, tinhloko-mhaka ta {topics}, mitsari ya {elements} yo dyondzisiwa ni swipimelo swa nkambisiso swa {criteria}, ku katsa Vuyelo bya Leveli yo Huma bya {outcomes} leswi nga na swipimelo swa {associated} leswi hlanganisiweke.
fromDoc.foundWithElo.from: Read {modules} modules, {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} assessment criteria, plus {outcomes} Exit Level Outcomes with {associated} associated criteria.

fromDoc.partOf.text: Dokumente ya yona yi vula leswaku leyi i {kind} leyi humesiweke eka {parent}. A ku na nchumu lowu ta kopiyiwa: yi avelana kharikhulamu ya kwalifikheyixini yoleyo, kutani yi teka swimodyuli swa {count} swa yona.
fromDoc.partOf.from: Its document says this is a {kind} drawn from {parent}. Nothing will be copied: it shares that qualification's curriculum, and takes {count} of its modules.

fromDoc.already.text: {title} yi se yi ri kona laha.

fromDoc.alreadyWhy.text: Ku nghenisa kharikhulamu nakambe swi ta cincisa leyi yi nga na yona, kutani xin'wana ni xin'wana lexi tirhaniweke ni xipimelo xi ta susiwa na xona. Leswi u nga ha swi lavaka i ku engetela leswi nga kona (swilo swa dyondzo, kumbe swiphemu swa kharikhulamu leswi nga tshamangiki), leswi endliwaka eka kwalifikheyixini n'wini kutani swi siya hinkwaswo leswi nga se ri kona swi nga khumbiwi.
fromDoc.alreadyWhy.from: Importing the curriculum again would replace the one it has, and anything tagged to a criterion would go with it. What you probably want is to add what is missing (the material, or the parts of the curriculum that never made it), which is done on the qualification itself and leaves everything already there untouched.

fromDoc.openIt.text: Yi pfule, kutani u engetela leswi nga kona
fromDoc.openIt.from: Open it, and add what is missing

fromDoc.outcomes.text: Vuyelo bya Leveli yo Huma bya {count}

fromDoc.toCheck.text: Swilo swa {count} leswi fanelaka ku kambisisiwa

fromDoc.createPart.text: Yi endle, yi tirhisa kharikhulamu ya leyi yi humaka eka yona
fromDoc.createPart.from: Create it, drawing on its parent's curriculum

fromDoc.create.text: Yi endle, yi ri ni kharikhulamu leyi

fromDoc.filedPart.text: Dokumente ya yona ya kwalifikheyixini yi hlayisiwa eka yona. Dokumente ya kharikhulamu ni nhlamuselo ya nkambisiso a swi hlayisiwi: swi ni kwalifikheyixini leyi yi humaka eka yona, naswona swi se swi hlayisiwile kwalaho.
fromDoc.filedPart.from: Its own Qualification Document is filed against it. The curriculum document and the assessment specification are not: they belong to the qualification it comes from, and are already filed there.

fromDoc.filed.text: Dokumente yin'wana ni yin'wana leyi u yi nyikeke yi hlayisiwa eka kwalifikheyixini, leswaku mulanguteri a kota ku pfula xihlovo xa xipimelo xin'wana ni xin'wana, ni leswaku nkambisiso wa ku lunghela wu enerile ku nga si endliwa swilo swa dyondzo.
fromDoc.filed.from: Every document you supplied is filed against the qualification, so a moderator can open the source of any criterion, and so the readiness gate is satisfied before material is authored.

docKind.alignment_matrix.text: Matrikisi ya ku fambisana ka kharikhulamu

docKind.workbook_memorandum.text: Memorandamu ya ku maka buku ya ntirho

docKind.summative_memorandum.text: Memorandamu ya ku maka nkambisiso wa makumu

qualPage.componentModule.practical.text: Modyuli ya ntirho wa ku endla

qualPage.step.curriculumDone.text: Swimodyuli swa {modules}, swipimelo swa nkambisiso swa {criteria}, leswi hlayiweke eka tidokumente ta kwalifikheyixini n'wini.
qualPage.step.curriculumDone.from: {modules} modules, {criteria} assessment criteria, read from the qualification's own documents.

qualPage.step.curriculumTodo.text: A ku na nchumu laha lowu nga dyondzisiwaka kumbe ku kambisisiwa ku fikela swimodyuli swi kona.
qualPage.step.curriculumTodo.from: Nothing here can be taught or assessed until its modules exist.

qualPage.step.unitsDone.text: Tiyuniti ta {count}, ni modyuli yin'wana ni yin'wana yi vekiwe eka yin'we.
qualPage.step.unitsDone.from: {count} units, with every module placed in one.

qualPage.step.unitsNone.text: Kharikhulamu yi kandziyisa swimodyuli kambe a yi vuli nchumu hi ndlela leyi u swi hlanganisaka ha yona, hikwalaho leswi i swa wena ku swi endla. Dokumente ya wena ya ku fambisana yi swi endla hi ku nghenisa kan'we: Word kumbe Excel.
qualPage.step.unitsNone.from: The curriculum publishes modules and says nothing about how you group them, so this is yours to decide. Your alignment document does it in one upload: Word or Excel.

qualPage.step.unitsSomeOne.text: Modyuli 1 yi nga si vekiwa eka yuniti. Modyuli leyi nga dyondzisiwiki hi yuniti ya dyondzo i modyuli lowu ku nga riki na munhu la wu dyondzisaka.
qualPage.step.unitsSomeOne.from: 1 module belongs to no unit yet. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches.

qualPage.step.unitsSome.text: Swimodyuli swa {count} swi nga si vekiwa eka yuniti. Modyuli leyi nga dyondzisiwiki hi yuniti ya dyondzo i modyuli lowu ku nga riki na munhu la wu dyondzisaka.
qualPage.step.unitsSome.from: {count} modules belong to no unit yet. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches.

qualPage.step.materialDone.text: Tigayidi ta thiyori ta {count}, tibuku ta ntirho ni tinkambisiso leti hlayisiweke.
qualPage.step.materialDone.from: {count} theory guides, workbooks and assessments filed.

qualPage.step.materialTodo.text: Tigayidi ta thiyori, tibuku ta ntirho ni tinkambisiso. Foludara hinkwayo yi nghenisiwa kan'we, tigayidi ta tinhlamulo ti tiviwa kutani ti fihliwa vadyondzi, naswona a ku na AI eka nkarhi wun'wana ni wun'wana.
qualPage.step.materialTodo.from: The theory guides, workbooks and assessments. The whole folder goes in at once, answer guides are recognised and withheld from learners, and no AI is involved at any point.

qualPage.step.captureDone.text: Hinkwaswo swa {count} swi tsariwile. Vadyondzi va nga swi hlamula eka xiscrini.
qualPage.step.captureDone.from: All {count} captured. Learners can answer them on screen.

qualPage.step.captureTodo.text: {captured} eka {total} swi tsariwile. Leswi saleke i tifayili leti mudyondzi a nga ti dawunilowadaka ntsena.
qualPage.step.captureTodo.from: {captured} of {total} captured. The rest are files a learner can only download.

qualPage.summary.text: swimodyuli swa {modules} · swipimelo swa nkambisiso swa le ndzeni swa {criteria} · {weighting}

qualPage.weighted.text: swi pimiwile {k}/{p}/{w} hilaha swi vuriweke hakona eka dokumente
qualPage.weighted.from: weighted {k}/{p}/{w} as stated in the document

qualPage.notWeighted.text: a ku vuriwi ndlela ya ku pima swiphemu; ku lunghela ku yi kuma eka tikridithi
qualPage.notWeighted.from: no component weighting stated; readiness derives it from credits

qualPage.partOf.text: Kwalifikheyixini ya xiphemu leyi humesiweke eka {parent}, leyi yi avelanaka kharikhulamu na yona. A ku na nchumu lowu kopiyiweke, hikwalaho ntirho wa mudyondzi eka modyuli wu hlayiwa kan'we laha a wu hlanganeke na wona kwihi na kwihi.
qualPage.partOf.from: A part qualification drawn from {parent}, whose curriculum it shares. Nothing is copied, so a learner's work against a module counts once wherever they met it.

qualPage.parentLink.text: kwalifikheyixini leyi yi humaka eka yona

qualPage.chooseModules.text: Hlawula swimodyuli leswi leyi yi swi tekaka

qualPage.addIntro.text: Hinkwaswo leswi engetelaka nchumu. Leswi se swi kona laha swi le tlukeni rin'wana.
qualPage.addIntro.from: Everything that puts something in. What is already here is on the other tab.

qualPage.finish.text: Helisa kwalifikheyixini leyi hi foludara leyi helelaka
qualPage.finish.from: Finish this qualification from a fuller folder

qualPage.finishLabel.text: Foludara leyi helelaka ya kwalifikheyixini leyi, ku suka eka khompyuta ya wena
qualPage.finishLabel.from: The completed folder for this qualification, from your own computer

qualPage.finishHint.text: Eka kwalifikheyixini leyi nghenisiweke ku nga si helela tidokumente ta yona. Foludara hinkwayo yi hlayiwa nakambe (kharikhulamu ni swilo swa dyondzo) kutani ntsena leswi pfumalaka swi engetiwa.
qualPage.finishHint.from: For a qualification that was loaded before its documents were complete. The whole folder is read again (the curriculum as well as the material) and only what is missing is added.

qualPage.finishHint2.text: A ku cinciwi nchumu lowu se wu kona laha, ku ya eka marito ya xipimelo xin'we, naswona ku yi tirhisa kanharhu a swi endli nchumu ka vumbirhi. U tshama u vona hinkwaswo leswi swi kumeke, kutani u swi tiyisisa ku nga si tsariwa nchumu.
qualPage.finishHint2.from: Nothing already here is changed or replaced, down to the wording of a single criterion, and running it twice does nothing the second time. You still see everything it found and confirm it before any of it is written.

qualPage.finishDrive.text: Kumbe foludara leyi helelaka ku suka eka drayivi leyi u yi hlanganiseke. Yi engetela hi ndlela leyi fanaka: ntsena leswi pfumalaka swi engetiwa.
qualPage.finishDrive.from: Or the completed folder from a drive you have connected. It tops up the same way: only what is missing is added.

qualPage.materialHere.text: Swilo swa dyondzo swi ta laha: foludara hinkwayo hi kan'we. A ku hlayisiwi nchumu ku fikela u vona leswi swi kumeke.
qualPage.materialHere.from: The material goes here: the whole folder at once. Nothing is saved until you have seen what it found.

qualPage.materialLabel.text: Foludara ya swilo swa dyondzo, ku suka eka khompyuta ya wena
qualPage.materialLabel.from: A folder of material, from your own computer

qualPage.materialHint.text: Tigayidi ta thiyori ni tibuku ta ntirho swi ya eka yuniti ya dyondzo leyi vito ra fayili ri yi vulaka, milawu ni tinkontiraka eka buku ya tidokumente, kutani hinkwaswo leswin'wana swi ya eka kwalifikheyixini leyi. A ku tirhisiwi AI kwalaho: ku hlela tidokumente hi vito i nawu, ku nga ri xiboho.
qualPage.materialHint.from: Theory guides and workbooks go to the study unit their filename names, policies and contracts to the document library, and everything else against this qualification. No AI is used here at all: sorting documents by name is a rule rather than a judgement.

qualPage.whereItLives.text: Kumbe foludara laha yi tshamaka kona
qualPage.whereItLives.from: Or the folder where it already lives

qualPage.alignmentHere.text: Dokumente ya wena ya ku fambisana yi ya laha: yi hlawule, u veka muxaka wa yona eka Matrikisi ya ku fambisana ka kharikhulamu, kutani u yi nghenisa. Leswi swi aka tiyuniti ta dyondzo.
qualPage.alignmentHere.from: Your alignment document goes here: choose it, set its kind to Curriculum Alignment Matrix, and upload. That builds the study units.

qualPage.blueprintIntro.text: Fayili leyi hlamuselaka kharikhulamu leyi hi ku helela: swimodyuli swa {count}, ni tinhloko-mhaka ta swona, leswi yin'wana ni yin'wana yi swi dyondzisaka ni leswi yi kambisisiwaka hi swona. Yi veke eka foludara ya {folder} ya kwalifikheyixini, kutani ku nghenisiwa ka foludara yoleyo endzhaku ka sweswo ku yi hlaya hi ku kongoma, hi tisekonto, handle ka xiengeteleko xa AI.
qualPage.blueprintIntro.from: A file describing this curriculum exactly: {count} modules, with their topics, what each teaches and what each is assessed by. Put it in the qualification folder's {folder} directory and every import of that folder afterwards reads it straight off, in seconds, with no AI extension involved at any point.

qualPage.notCarried.text: Leswi fayili yi nga swi rhwaliki
qualPage.notCarried.from: What the file does not carry

qualPage.notCaptured.text: Swimodyuli swa {count} eka swa {total} a swi na swipimelo.
qualPage.notCaptured.from: {count} of {total} modules have no criteria yet.

qualPage.notCapturedWhy.text: A ku na munhu la nga vuriwaka a lunghekele EISA eka kwalifikheyixini leyi ku fikela dokumente hinkwayo ya kharikhulamu yi tsariwile; modyuli lowu nga riki na swipimelo a wu nge hlawuli, hikwalaho ku wu siya wu nga tsariwanga swi ta endla leswaku mudyondzi un'wana ni un'wana a vonaka a heteke.
qualPage.notCapturedWhy.from: Nobody can be declared ready for the EISA against this qualification until the whole curriculum document has been transcribed; a module with no criteria cannot be failed, so leaving them empty would make every learner look finished.

qualPage.structureIntro.text: Kharikhulamu yi kandziyisa swimodyuli; mupfuneti u dyondzisa tiyuniti ta dyondzo. Yin'wana ni yin'wana yi hlanganisa swimodyuli swa Vutivi, Ntirho wa ku endla na Ntokoto wa ntirho leswi tirhelaka Vuyelo byin'we bya Leveli yo Huma, lebyi Nkambisiso wa Makumu lowu Hlanganisiweke wa le Handle wu vekiweke ehenhla ka byona. Vapfuneti vambirhi va nga hlanganisa kwalifikheyixini yin'we hi ndlela leyi hambaneke, kutani havambirhi va lulama, hikwalaho leyi i xivumbeko xa mupfuneti, ku nga ri xa kharikhulamu.
qualPage.structureIntro.from: The curriculum publishes modules; a provider teaches study units. Each bundles the Knowledge, Practical and Work Experience modules that serve one Exit Level Outcome, which is what the External Integrated Summative Assessment is set against. Two providers may group the same qualification differently and both be correct, so this is the provider's structure rather than the curriculum's.

qualPage.seeAsLearner.text: Yi vone hilaha mudyondzi a nga yi vonaka
qualPage.seeAsLearner.from: See it as a learner will

qualPage.seeAsLearnerNote.text: yi kombisa purogirama hinkwayo hi ndlela leyi yi fambiwaka ha yona, ni nchumu wun'wana ni wun'wana lowu mudyondzi a nga wu kumiki wu tirhaniwile. A ku na nchumu lowu sunguriwaka kumbe ku tsariwaka.
qualPage.seeAsLearnerNote.from: shows the whole programme in the order it is walked, with anything a learner would not find named. Nothing is started and nothing is recorded.

qualPage.nextStep.text: Nkanelo lowu landzelaka: hlanganisa swimodyuli leswi eka tiyuniti ta dyondzo.
qualPage.nextStep.from: The next step: group these modules into study units.

qualPage.nextStepWhy.text: Kharikhulamu yi kandziyisa swimodyuli kambe a yi vuli nchumu hi tiyuniti ta dyondzo, hikuva ku swi hlanganisa i xiboho xa mupfuneti n'wini; hikwalaho kwalifikheyixini leyi hlayiweke eka tidokumente ta yona yi fika ni swimodyuli hinkwaswo swa {count} swi nga si vekiwa. Leswi swi languteriwile, a hi xihoxo xa ku nghenisa.
qualPage.nextStepWhy.from: The curriculum publishes modules and says nothing about study units, because grouping them is the provider's own decision, so a qualification read from its documents arrives with all {count} of its modules unplaced. That is expected, not a fault in the import.

qualPage.nextStepHow.text: Nghenisa dokumente ya wena ya ku fambisana: leyi kombisaka Vuyelo bya Leveli yo Huma byin'wana ni byin'wana ni swimodyuli swa byona, eka Word kumbe Excel. Yi endla tiyuniti ta dyondzo, yi swi thya mavito, kutani yi veka modyuli yin'wana ni yin'wana leyi yi yi katsaka.
qualPage.nextStepHow.from: Upload your alignment document: the one mapping each Exit Level Outcome to its modules, in Word or Excel. It creates the study units, names them, and places every module it covers.

qualPage.unplacedOne.text: Modyuli 1 a yi si eka yuniti ya dyondzo.
qualPage.unplacedOne.from: 1 module belongs to no study unit.

qualPage.unplaced.text: Swimodyuli swa {count} a swi si eka yuniti ya dyondzo.
qualPage.unplaced.from: {count} modules belong to no study unit.

qualPage.unplacedWhy.text: {modules}. Modyuli leyi yuniti ya dyondzo yi nga yi dyondzisiki i modyuli lowu ku nga riki na munhu la wu dyondzisaka, hambi ku ri leswaku kharikhulamu ya wona yi tsariwile hi ku helela.
qualPage.unplacedWhy.from: {modules}. A module no study unit delivers is a module nobody teaches, however completely its curriculum has been captured.

qualPage.noElo.text: A yi hlanganisiwi ni Vuyelo byo Huma
qualPage.noElo.from: Aligned to no Exit Level Outcome

qualPage.eisaTests.text: Swipimelo swa nkambisiso leswi hlanganisiweke: leswi EISA yi swi kambisisaka
qualPage.eisaTests.from: Associated assessment criteria: what the EISA tests

qualPage.noModules.text: Yuniti ya dyondzo leyi a yi dyondzisi swimodyuli.
qualPage.noModules.from: This study unit delivers no modules.

qualPage.unitMaterial.text: Swilo swa dyondzo leswi hlayisiweke eka yuniti leyi

qualPage.documentsIntro.text: Leti hlayisiweke laha i tikopi ta xiviko: tidokumente ta xihlovo leti kwalifikheyixini leyi akiweke eka tona, yin'wana ni yin'wana yi khomisiwile eka xiphemu xa kharikhulamu lexi yi xi tirhelaka, ni mfungho lowu kombisaka leswaku a yi cincanga.
qualPage.documentsIntro.from: Filed here are the authoritative copies: the source documents this qualification is built from, each attached to the part of the curriculum it serves and hashed so it can be proved unchanged.

qualPage.recordNotThing.text: Buku ya ntirho kumbe nkambisiso lowu hlayisiweke laha i rekhodo, ku nga ri leswi mudyondzi a swi tirhaka.
qualPage.recordNotThing.from: A workbook or an assessment filed here is a record, not the thing a learner works on.

qualPage.recordWhy.text: Leswi swa hlayiwa kutani swi kombisiwa eka xiscrini, leswaku mudyondzi a hlamula eka pulatifomo, kutani mufambisi a maka a tlhela a nyika mavonelo kwalaho. Nghenisa dokumente ya Word ehansi ka Tsala ku nga ri laha, kutani yi va swivutiso n'wini. Tibuku ta mudyondzi, tigayidi ni tixiphephana ta ku sayina ntirho i swin'wana: swi tshama swi ri tidokumente, hikuva mufambisi a swi tsala kutani mukoki a swi sayina ehenhla ka phepha.
qualPage.recordWhy.from: Those are read in and presented on screen, so a learner answers in the platform and a facilitator marks and comments there. Upload the Word document under Capture rather than here, and it becomes the questions themselves. Handbooks, guides and workplace sign-off sheets are different: they stay as documents, because a facilitator annotates them and a coach signs them on paper.

qualPage.noDocuments.text: A ku na tidokumente leti hlayisiweke.

qualPage.notTranscribed.text: A yi si tsariwa ku suka eka dokumente ya kharikhulamu.
qualPage.notTranscribed.from: Not yet transcribed from the curriculum document.

qualPage.iac.text: Swipimelo swa nkambisiso swa le ndzeni: leswi fanelaka ku fikeleriwa
qualPage.iac.from: Internal assessment criteria: what must be achieved

qualPage.workplaceNone.text: A ku na swipimelo swa nkambisiso, leswi lulameke eka ntokoto wa ntirho: wu tiyisiwa hi rekhodo leyi sayiniweke ya ntirho, ku nga ri hi ku avanyisiwa hi swipimelo.
qualPage.workplaceNone.from: No assessment criteria, which is right for work experience: it is proved by a signed record of the work rather than judged against criteria.

qualPage.neverAchieved.text: A ku na swipimelo swa nkambisiso, hikwalaho nhloko-mhaka leyi yi nga tshuki yi fikeleriwa.
qualPage.neverAchieved.from: No assessment criteria, so this topic can never be achieved.

removeQual.cannot.text: Kwalifikheyixini leyi a yi nge susiwi

removeQual.cannotWhy.text: Ku na leswi tsariweke eka yona, naswona pulatifomo yi swi hlayisa. Hi swona leswi nkambisiso wa QCTO wu swi vutisaka, naswona swi tshama swi ri kona endzhaku ka kwalifikheyixini leyi swi tsariweke ehansi ka yona.
removeQual.cannotWhy.from: Things have been recorded against it, and the platform keeps them. They are what a QCTO audit asks about, and they outlive the qualification they were recorded under.

removeQual.canWhy.text: A ku na nchumu lowu tsariweke eka yona (a ku na mudyondzi la tsarisiweke, a ku na ku tshama loku tsarisiweke, naswona a ku na Xitatimente xa Mbuyelo lexi humesiweke), hikwalaho yi nga susiwa. Leswi a swi tlheliseki endzhaku.
removeQual.canWhy.from: Nothing has been recorded against it (no learner is enrolled, no sitting is registered and no Statement of Results has been issued) so it can be removed. This cannot be undone.

removeQual.wouldTake.text: Yi ta teka {items} na yona, ku katsa nhloko-mhaka yin'wana ni yin'wana, xiphemu, xipimelo ni dokumente leyi hlayisiweke ehansi ka swona.
removeQual.wouldTake.from: It would take {items} with it, along with every topic, element, criterion and filed document beneath them.

captureList.intro.text: Leswi se swi le pulatifomo. Ku tsala yin'we swi hlaya swivutiso swa yona eka fayili ya Word kutani swi hlanganisa gayidi ya tinhlamulo leyi hlayisiweke ekusuhi na yona; a ku na nchumu lowu tlhelaka wu tlakusiwa. Leswi swi yi kombisiwaka swi kombisiwa eka wena ku nga si va nkambisiso.
captureList.intro.from: These are already in the platform. Capturing one reads its questions out of the Word file and pairs the answer guide filed beside it; nothing is uploaded again. What it proposes is shown to you before any of it becomes an assessment.

captureList.all.text: Hinkwaswo swa {count} swi tsariwile. Vadyondzi va nga swi hlamula eka xiscrini.
captureList.all.from: All {count} captured. Learners can answer these on screen.

captureList.noGuide.text: a ku na gayidi ya tinhlamulo leyi hlayisiweke: xivutiso xin'wana ni xin'wana xi ta lava nhlamulo ni maki hi voko
captureList.noGuide.from: no answer guide filed: every question would need its answer and marks by hand

uploader.kindNote.text: Matrikisi ya ku fambisana ka kharikhulamu yi hlayiwa ni ku hlayisiwa: leswi yi swi vulaka hi mutsari wun'wana ni wun'wana wa kharikhulamu swa tsariwa.
uploader.kindNote.from: A curriculum alignment matrix is read as well as stored: what it says about each curriculum line is recorded.

uploader.titleHint.text: Loko swi siyiwile swi nga tsariwanga, vito ra fayili ri tirhisiwa
uploader.titleHint.from: Left blank, the file name is used

uploader.versionNote.text: Ku tlakusa nakambe hi muxaka lowu fanaka ni xihloko lexi fanaka swi wisa leyi hundzeke ku nga ri ku yi cincisa; vhezini ya khale yi tshama.
uploader.versionNote.from: Uploading again with the same kind and title supersedes the previous one rather than replacing it; the old version stays.

uploader.fileNote.text: Word, Excel, PowerPoint ni PDF. Leswi fayili yi nga swona ka ntiyiso swi huma eka leswi nga endzeni ka yona, ku nga ri eka vito ra yona.
uploader.fileNote.from: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF. What the file actually is comes from its contents, not its name.

uploader.inMatrix.text: Eka matrikisi, ku nga ri eka kharikhulamu leyi hlayisiweke
uploader.inMatrix.from: In the matrix, not in the curriculum as held

uploader.inMatrixNote.text: Yin'wana ni yin'wana yi engeteriwa yi ri ni xikombiso xa leswaku i ya wena, ni xivangelo lexi kombisiweke, leswaku mukambisisi a kota ku hambanisa mitsari ya wena ni ya mulawuri. Susa xikombiso eka leswi nga fanelangiki ku engeteriwa.
uploader.inMatrixNote.from: Each is added marked as your own, with the reason shown, so a verifier can always tell your lines from the regulator's. Untick anything that should not be added.

uploader.add.text: Engetela mitsari leyi tikiweke eka kharikhulamu
uploader.add.from: Add the ticked lines to the curriculum

buildCurr.intro.text: Yi nghenise hilaha dokumente ya kharikhulamu yi yi kandziyisaka hakona, hi tikhodo leti fanaka hi ku landzelelana loku fanaka, leswaku swi kota ku hlayiwa swi ri swin'we. Mutsari wun'wana ni wun'wana wa hlayisiwa loko u wu nghenisa.
buildCurr.intro.from: Enter it as the curriculum document prints it, with the same codes in the same order, so the two can be read side by side. Every line saves as you enter it.

buildCurr.fromDocument.text: Sungula ku suka eka dokumente ya kharikhulamu

buildCurr.ready.text: Swi lunghekile swilo swa dyondzo. Swimodyuli swa {modules} ni swipimelo swa {criteria} swi le ndzeni, hikwalaho xivutiso xi nga thayiwa eka leswi xi swi kombisaka.
buildCurr.ready.from: Ready for material. {modules} modules and {criteria} criteria are in, so a question can be tagged to what it evidences.

buildCurr.notReady.text: A swi si lunghela swilo swa dyondzo.

buildCurr.whatItIsNote.text: Swi vekiwa loko yi nghenisiwa, naswona swi nga lulamisiwa laha. Kwalifikheyixini yo helela yi na kharikhulamu ya yona; xiphemu kumbe purogirama ya swikili swi hlawula swimodyuli eka yin'we.
buildCurr.whatItIsNote.from: Set when it was imported, and correctable here. A full qualification has its own curriculum; a part or a skills programme selects modules from one.

buildCurr.faultsNote.text: A hi nyangwa: u nga huma kutani u tlhelela. Kambe xin'wana ni xin'wana xa leswi i nchumu lowu pulatifomo yi nga kotiki ku wu papalata endzhaku.
buildCurr.faultsNote.from: Not a gate: you can leave and come back. Each of these, though, is something the platform cannot work around later.

addModule.note.text: Modyuli wa ntokoto wa ntirho wu tiyisiwa hi bukwana ya ntirho leyi mukoki a yi sayinaka, ku nga ri hi swipimelo swa nkambisiso, hikwalaho wu teka mintirho ya ntirho ematshan'wini ya swona.
addModule.note.from: A work experience module is evidenced by a logbook a coach signs, not by assessment criteria, so it takes work activities instead.

addModule.nameHint.text: Hilaha dokumente ya kharikhulamu yi xi vitanaka hakona
addModule.nameHint.from: As the curriculum document titles it

editor.removeTopic.text: Susa {code} ni hinkwaswo leswi nga endzeni ka yona?

editor.addElement.text: Engetela mutsari wa leswi fanelaka ku dyondzisiwa
editor.addElement.from: Add a line of what must be taught

editor.wordedHint.text: Hilaha dokumente ya kharikhulamu yi swi vulaka hakona
editor.wordedHint.from: As the curriculum document words it

editor.noCriteria.text: Modyuli wa ntokoto wa ntirho a wu na swona. Wu tiyisiwa hi bukwana ya ntirho leyi mukoki a yi sayinaka naswona mukambisisi a yi amukelaka, hikwalaho mintirho ya wona yi nghena eka tinhloko-mhaka leti nga laha henhla.
editor.noCriteria.from: A work experience module carries none. It is evidenced by a logbook the coach signs and an assessor accepts, so its work activities go in the topics above.

editor.criterionText.text: Leswi mudyondzi a fanelaka ku swi kombisa

reclassify.lockedOne.text: A swi nge cinciwi: mudyondzi 1 u tsarisiwile eka swona. Ku tsarisiwa ku endliwa hi ID ya purogirama, naswona ku cinca leswi swi nga xiswona swi ta cinca swimodyuli leswi va kambisisiwaka eka swona, ni leswi va fanelaka ku swi endla ku hetisa. Loko swi ri xihoxo hakunene, endla leswi lulameke kutani u va tsarisa eka swona.
reclassify.lockedOne.from: It cannot be changed: 1 learner is enrolled on it. Enrolment is per programme ID, and changing what this is would change which modules they are assessed against, and so what they have to do to finish. If it is genuinely the wrong sort of thing, create the right one and enrol them onto that.

reclassify.locked.text: A swi nge cinciwi: vadyondzi va {count} va tsarisiwile eka swona. Ku tsarisiwa ku endliwa hi ID ya purogirama, naswona ku cinca leswi swi nga xiswona swi ta cinca swimodyuli leswi va kambisisiwaka eka swona, ni leswi va fanelaka ku swi endla ku hetisa. Loko swi ri xihoxo hakunene, endla leswi lulameke kutani u va tsarisa eka swona.
reclassify.locked.from: It cannot be changed: {count} learners are enrolled on it. Enrolment is per programme ID, and changing what this is would change which modules they are assessed against, and so what they have to do to finish. If it is genuinely the wrong sort of thing, create the right one and enrol them onto that.

reclassify.parentNote.text: Xiphemu a xi na dokumente ya kharikhulamu ya xona: xi tirhisa ya leyi xi humaka eka yona, xi hlawula swimodyuli eka yona.
reclassify.parentNote.from: A part has no curriculum document of its own: it uses its parent's, and selects modules from it.

reclassify.ownModulesOne.text: Kwalifikheyixini leyi yi na modyuli 1 wa kharikhulamu ya yona, ku suka loko yi nghenisiwile. Wu tshama laha wu nga kona: ku yi tsala tanihi xiphemu a ku wu susi, naswona u hlawula hi ku hambana swimodyuli swa leyi yi humaka eka yona leswi yi swi hlawulaka.
reclassify.ownModulesOne.from: This qualification has 1 module of its own curriculum, from when it was imported. It stays where it is: recording it as a part does not delete it, and you choose separately which of the parent's modules it selects.

reclassify.ownModules.text: Kwalifikheyixini leyi yi na swimodyuli swa {count} swa kharikhulamu ya yona, ku suka loko yi nghenisiwile. Swi tshama laha swi nga kona: ku yi tsala tanihi xiphemu a ku swi susi, naswona u hlawula hi ku hambana swimodyuli swa leyi yi humaka eka yona leswi yi swi hlawulaka.
reclassify.ownModules.from: This qualification has {count} modules of its own curriculum, from when it was imported. Those stay where they are: recording it as a part does not delete them, and you choose separately which of the parent's modules it selects.

reclassify.selectedOne.text: Modyuli 1 lowu hlawuriweke eka leyi yi humaka eka yona wu ta sukiwa. Kwalifikheyixini yo helela a yi hlawuli nchumu eka munhu, naswona ku wu siya swi ta endla leswaku wu ya emahlweni wu hlayiwa eka tikridithi ta yona.
reclassify.selectedOne.from: The 1 module selected from its parent will be cleared. A full qualification selects nothing from anybody, and leaving it would keep it counting towards its credits.

reclassify.selected.text: Swimodyuli swa {count} leswi hlawuriweke eka leyi yi humaka eka yona swi ta sukiwa. Kwalifikheyixini yo helela a yi hlawuli nchumu eka munhu, naswona ku swi siya swi ta endla leswaku swi ya emahlweni swi hlayiwa eka tikridithi ta yona.
reclassify.selected.from: The {count} modules selected from its parent will be cleared. A full qualification selects nothing from anybody, and leaving them would keep them counting towards its credits.

takeDoc.readFrom.text: Swi hlayiwe eka {file}. A ku na nchumu lowu nga hansi lowu engeteriweke ha ku ri: pfula modyuli, u wu kambisise hi dokumente, kutani u wu tekela loko wu lulamile.
takeDoc.readFrom.from: Read from {file}. Nothing below has been added yet: open a module, check it against the document, and take it if it is right.

takeDoc.nothing.text: A ku na leswi nga ringanyetiwaka

takeDoc.goToDocuments.text: Ya eka tidokumente ta kwalifikheyixini leyi
takeDoc.goToDocuments.from: Go to the documents for this qualification

takeDoc.notesNote.text: Leswi ku hlaya ku nga swi kotangiki ku swi hlamusela, ni leswi dokumente n'wini yi nga hlanganiki ha swona. A swi ku sivi ku teka modyuli, kambe swi fanele ku hlayiwa ku sungula.
takeDoc.notesNote.from: What the reading could not account for, and what the document itself does not add up. Neither stops you taking a module, though both are worth reading first.

takeDoc.already.text: {count} leswi se swi nga eka kharikhulamu

takeDoc.byLogbook.text: yi tiyisiwa hi bukwana ya ntirho

takeDoc.addedCounts.text: Ku engeteriwe tinhloko-mhaka ta {topics}, mitsari ya {elements} leyi fanelaka ku dyondzisiwa ni swipimelo swa {criteria}.
takeDoc.addedCounts.from: Added {topics} topics, {elements} lines to teach and {criteria} criteria.

takeDoc.byHand.text: Yi engetele hi voko eka xiscrini xa kharikhulamu.
takeDoc.byHand.from: Add these by hand on the curriculum screen.

takeDoc.empty.text: A ku hlayiwanga nchumu ehansi ka modyuli lowu. Ku wu teka swi ta endla modyuli ntsena, naswona tinhloko-mhaka ta wona ti nga engeteriwa hi voko.
takeDoc.empty.from: Nothing was read under this module. Taking it will create the module alone, and its topics can be added by hand.

element.asWorded.text: {kind}, hilaha dokumente ya kharikhulamu yi swi vulaka hakona. A ku na nchumu eka rhijisi leri lowu nga cinciwaka laha: kharikhulamu leyi kandziyisiweke i ya QCTO, ku nga ri ya mupfuneti.
element.asWorded.from: {kind}, exactly as the curriculum document words it. Nothing on this page may be edited here: a published curriculum is the QCTO's, not the provider's.

element.coversNote.text: Ku suka eka Matrikisi ya ku fambisana ka Kharikhulamu, hilaha mupfuneti a yi tsaleke hakona.
element.coversNote.from: From the Curriculum Alignment Matrix, as the provider wrote it there.

element.uncovered.text: A ku na nchumu lowu tsariweke tanihi lowu funengetaka mutsari lowu.
element.uncovered.from: Nothing is recorded as covering this line.

element.uncoveredNote.text: Leswi i mpfhuka wa xiviri eka purogirama kumbe i matrikisi leyi nga si tlakusiwaka. Tlakusa Matrikisi ya ku fambisana ka Kharikhulamu eka kwalifikheyixini leyi, kutani mitsari hinkwayo leyi yi yi vitanaka yi tata hi kan'we.
element.uncoveredNote.from: That is either a real gap in the programme or a matrix that has not been uploaded yet. Upload the Curriculum Alignment Matrix against this qualification and every line it names is filled in at once.

element.notHeld.text: yi vitaniwe eka matrikisi, kambe a ku na dokumente leyi hlayisiweke laha leyi nga ni vito rero.
element.notHeld.from: named in the matrix, but no document held here has that name.

element.assessedNote.text: Swipimelo swa nkambisiso swa le ndzeni swa nhloko-mhaka leyi mutsari lowu wu nga wa yona.
element.assessedNote.from: The internal assessment criteria of the topic this line belongs to.

element.workplace.text: Modyuli wa ntokoto wa ntirho a wu na swipimelo swa nkambisiso. Leswi wu swi lavaka swi tiyisiwa hi rhekhodo leyi sayiniweke ya ntirho n'wini, leyi amukeriweke hi mukambisisi, ku nga ri leswi kambisisiweke hi swipimelo.
element.workplace.from: A work experience module has no assessment criteria. What it requires is evidenced by a signed record of the work itself, accepted by an assessor, rather than judged against criteria.

element.noCriteria.text: Nhloko-mhaka leyi a yi na swipimelo swa nkambisiso, hikwalaho a ku na nchumu laha lowu nga tshukaka wu fikeleriwa. Ku ya fika swi tsariwa ku suka eka dokumente ya kharikhulamu, a ku na mudyondzi la nga heta modyuli lowu.
element.noCriteria.from: This topic has no assessment criteria, so nothing here can ever be achieved. Until they are captured from the curriculum document, no learner can complete this module.

element.taughtNote.text: Tiyuniti ta dyondzo leti modyuli lowu nyikiwaka eka tona.
element.taughtNote.from: The study units this module is delivered in.

partModules.title.text: Swimodyuli leswi leyi yi swi tekaka

partModules.introPart.text: Kwalifikheyixini leyi ya xiphemu yi humesiwe eka {parent} naswona yi avelana kharikhulamu na yona{code}. Tikisa swimodyuli leswi dokumente ya yona ya SAQA yi swi tsalaka ehansi ka {rules}. A ku kopiwi nchumu: ntirho wa mudyondzi eka modyuli wu hlayiwa kan'we, ku nga khathariseki laha a wu hlanganeke na wona.
partModules.introPart.from: This part qualification is drawn from {parent} and shares its curriculum{code}. Tick the modules its own SAQA document lists under {rules}. Nothing is copied: a learner's work against a module counts once, wherever they met it.

partModules.introOther.text: Purogirama leyi yi humesiwe eka {parent} naswona yi avelana kharikhulamu na yona{code}. Tikisa swimodyuli leswi dokumente ya yona ya SAQA yi swi tsalaka ehansi ka {rules}. A ku kopiwi nchumu: ntirho wa mudyondzi eka modyuli wu hlayiwa kan'we, ku nga khathariseki laha a wu hlanganeke na wona.
partModules.introOther.from: This programme is drawn from {parent} and shares its curriculum{code}. Tick the modules its own SAQA document lists under {rules}. Nothing is copied: a learner's work against a module counts once, wherever they met it.

partModules.notRead.text: Kharikhulamu ya leyi yi humaka eka yona a yi si hlayiwa
partModules.notRead.from: The parent's curriculum has not been read in yet

partModules.notReadNote.text: A ku na leswi u nga swi hlawulaka ku ya fika {parent} yi hlayiwa dokumente ya kharikhulamu. Endla sweswo ku sungula, kutani mutsari lowu wu tatiwa hi wexe.
partModules.notReadNote.from: There is nothing to choose from until {parent} has its curriculum document read in. Do that first, and this list fills itself.

partModules.noCredits.text: A ku na tikridithi leti tsariweke

partModules.noClaim.text: A ku na nhlayo hinkwayo ya tikridithi leyi tsariweke eka kwalifikheyixini leyi, hikwalaho a ku na nchumu wo ringanisa na wona. Dokumente ya yona ya SAQA yi vula yin'we ehansi ka Tikridithi to Tsongo.
partModules.noClaim.from: No credit total is recorded for this qualification, so there is nothing to check against. Its SAQA document states one under Minimum Credits.

partModules.agree.text: Leswi swi fambisana, leswi kombisaka leswaku swimodyuli leswi lulameke swi tikisiwile.
partModules.agree.from: These agree, which is the sign the right modules are ticked.

partModules.disagree.text: Leswi a swi fambisani. Kumbe ku na modyuli lowu tikisiweke lowu dokumente ya SAQA yi nga wu tsaliki, kumbe wun'wana lowu yi wu tsalaka a wu kona, kumbe tikridithi eka modyuli ti hlayiwe hi xihoxo. Swi fanele ku kambisisiwa ku nga si hlayisiwa; pulatifomo yi ta ya emahlweni yi hlayisa leswi u yi byelaka swona.
partModules.disagree.from: These do not agree. Either a module is ticked that the SAQA document does not list, or one it lists is missing, or the credits on a module were read in wrongly. Worth checking before saving; the platform will still save what you tell it.

partModules.save.text: Hlayisa swimodyuli leswi leyi yi swi tekaka

qualPreview.title.text: Hilaha mudyondzi a nga ta swi vona hakona
qualPreview.title.from: As a learner will see it

qualPreview.intro.text: {programme} hinkwayo hi ndlela leyi la tsarisiweke eka yona a yi fambaka ha yona. A ku na nchumu laha lowu sunguriwaka: a ku endliwi ku tsarisiwa, a ku pfuriwi ku ringeta, naswona a ku tsariwi nhluvuko, hikwalaho leswi u nga swi hlaya kan'we-kan'we loko u lava.
qualPreview.intro.from: The whole {programme} in the order somebody enrolled on it walks it. Nothing here starts anything: no enrolment is made, no attempt is opened and no progress is recorded, so this can be read as often as you like.

qualPreview.gaps.text: Leswi mudyondzi a nga ta nga swi kumiki
qualPreview.gaps.from: What a learner would not find

qualPreview.allReadyNote.text: Xikhale xin'wana ni xin'wana eka yuniti yin'wana ni yin'wana ya dyondzo xi na nchumu lowu xi seketelaka. Mudyondzi la tsarisiweke eka {programme} namuntlha a nga kuma hinkwaswo.
qualPreview.allReadyNote.from: Every step in every study unit has something behind it. A learner enrolled on this {programme} today would find the whole of it.

qualPreview.build.text: Aka leswi mudyondzi a swi tirhaka
qualPreview.build.from: Build what a learner works through

qualPreview.open.text: Yi pfule hilaha mudyondzi a yi vonaka hakona
qualPreview.open.from: Open it as a learner sees it

qualPreview.change.text: Cinca ntlhandlamano kumbe leswi nga eka yona
qualPreview.change.from: Change the order or what is on it

qualPreview.start.text: Sungula ku aka yuniti leyi ya dyondzo

courseList.noneAuthor.text: Ndzetelo i leswi mudyondzi a swi tirhaka hakunene. Wu boheka eka yuniti ya dyondzo kumbe modyuli wa kharikhulamu, hikwalaho kwalifikheyixini yi fanele ku tekiwa ku sungula.
courseList.noneAuthor.from: A course is what a learner actually works through. It hangs off a study unit or a curriculum module, so a qualification is worth loading first.

courseList.noneReader.text: A ku si kandziyisiwa nchumu eka wena. Loko swi endliwile, leswi u tsarisiweke eka swona swi ta va laha.
courseList.noneReader.from: Nothing has been published for you yet. When it has been, what you are enrolled on will be here.

courseList.noQualification.text: A xi hi xiphemu xa kwalifikheyixini

newCourse.noModule.text: A hi xiphemu xa kwalifikheyixini leyi amukeriweke hi nawu
newCourse.noModule.from: Not part of an accredited qualification

newCourse.moduleNote.text: Yi boha eka modyuli wa kharikhulamu, kutani sisiteme yi ta kambisisa, ku nga si kandziyisiwa, leswaku xipimelo xin'wana ni xin'wana xa nkambisiso eka modyuli wolowo xi na dyondzo leyi xi seketelaka.
newCourse.moduleNote.from: Bind it to a curriculum module and the system will check, before it can be published, that every assessment criterion in that module has a lesson behind it.

newCourse.component.practical.text: Modyuli wa xikili xa ntirho wa ku endla

courseEdit.published.text: Leswi swi kandziyisiwile, hikwalaho leswi nga endzeni ka swona swi tiyisiwile. Vadyondzi lava swi hetiseke va na tirhekhodo leti kombaka vhezini leyi hi ku kongoma.
courseEdit.published.from: This is published, so its content is fixed. Learners who completed it have records that refer to exactly this version.

courseEdit.publishedAuthor.text: Ku swi cinca, pfula vhezini yintshwa; leyi kandziyisiweke yi tshama hilaha yi nga kona.
courseEdit.publishedAuthor.from: To change it, open a new version; the published one stays as it is.

courseEdit.folder.text: Engetela tidokumente ku suka eka foludara

courseEdit.folderNote.text: Hlawula foludara leyi swilo leswi swi nga eka yona, kutani hinkwaswo leswi nga endzeni ka yona, ku katsa tifoludara ta le ndzeni, swi hlayiwa, swi hlayisiwa naswona swi endliwa leswaku swi nga lavisisiwa. U vona leswi swi nga hlayisiwaka ku nga si tsariwa nchumu.
courseEdit.folderNote.from: Choose the folder this material lives in and everything in it, including its subfolders, is read, filed and indexed. You see what it would file before anything is written.

courseEdit.folderLabel.text: Foludara ya yona, ku suka eka khompyuta ya wena
courseEdit.folderLabel.from: Its folder, from your own computer

courseEdit.folderHint.text: Magayidi, tibuku ta ntirho, milawu ni tithempiliti swi hlayisiwa eka yona, naswona matsalwa ya swona ma endliwa leswaku ma nga lavisisiwa.
courseEdit.folderHint.from: Guides, workbooks, policies and templates are filed against it and their text indexed so they can be searched.

courseEdit.folderHint2.text: Xivumbeko a xi endliwi ku suka laha: xivumbeko xa xona xi akiwa eka xilulamisi lexi nga laha henhla kumbe ku suka eka swimodyuli swa kwalifikheyixini. Leswi swi hlayisa leswi xi swi khomaka.
courseEdit.folderHint2.from: Structure is not created from here: its own shape is built in the editor above or from a qualification's modules. This files what it holds.

courseEdit.drive.text: Kumbe ku suka eka drayivu leyi u yi hlanganiseke na yona
courseEdit.drive.from: Or from a drive you have connected

courseEdit.driveNote.text: Foludara yin'we, yi hlayiwa laha yi tshamaka kona sweswi. Yi hela ndhawini yin'we: xiringanyeto lexi u fanelaka ku xi kambisisa ku nga si tsariwa nchumu.
courseEdit.driveNote.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

courseEdit.noSections.text: A ku na swiphemu ha ku ri. Wu akiwa hi swiphemu, naswona xiphemu xin'wana ni xin'wana xi na tidyondzo.
courseEdit.noSections.from: No sections yet. It is built from sections, and each section holds lessons.

courseEdit.noLessons.text: A ku na tidyondzo eka xiphemu lexi ha ku ri.
courseEdit.noLessons.from: No lessons in this section yet.

courseEdit.lessonBody.text: Leswi nga eka dyondzo (swa ku hlawula)

courseEdit.lessonCovers.text: Swipimelo swa nkambisiso leswi dyondzo leyi yi swi funengetaka

courseEdit.competenciesNote.text: Leswi ku hetiseka ka swona swi swi kombisaka. A swi nge kandziyisiwi ku nga ri na vuswikoti, hikuva ku hetiseka ka swona a ku nge vikiwi tanihi vuswikoti.
courseEdit.competenciesNote.from: What completing it demonstrates. It cannot be published with no competency, because its completions could not be reported as capability.

courseEdit.noneTagged.text: A ku na leswi tsariweke ha ku ri.
