courseEdit.coveredAcross.from: of {count} assessment criteria covered across {unit}'s modules

courseEdit.coveredNote.text: Swi funengetiwa hi dyondzo laha, xivutiso eka xin'wana xa tinkambisiso ta yona lexi hlanganisiweke na swona, kumbe leswi matrikisi ya wena ya ku fambisana yi swi vitanaka tanihi leswi swi kambisisaka. Tlakusa matrikisi eka kwalifikheyixini leswaku u tsala leswi ka makumu.
courseEdit.coveredNote.from: Covered by a lesson here, a question on one of its assessments that is linked to it, or what your alignment matrix names as assessing it. Upload the matrix on the qualification to record the last.

courseEdit.nothingAssesses.text: A ku na nchumu lowu swi kambisisaka

courseEdit.noLessonCovers.text: A ku na dyondzo leyi swi funengetaka

courseEdit.unbound.from: This is not bound to an accredited curriculum module, so there are no assessment criteria to cover.

courseEdit.publishNote.text: Ku kandziyisa a swi pfumeleriwi loko ku ri na nchumu lowu nga helelangiki laha henhla.
courseEdit.publishNote.from: Publishing is refused while anything above is incomplete.

courseEdit.newVersionNote.text: Vadyondzi lava hetiseke vhezini leyi va hlayisa rekhodo ya yona.
courseEdit.newVersionNote.from: Learners who completed this version keep their record of it.

spine.intro.text: Ntlhandlamano lowu {course} wu fambiwaka hi wona, ni leswi pfalaka xikhale xin'wana ni xin'wana ku fikela lexi tlulaka xi hetiwile. Hinkwaswo leswi nga laha se swi khomiwa eka {course}: ku swi veka eka mutsari hi kona ku endlaka leswaku mudyondzi a swi hlanganisa.
spine.intro.from: The order this {course} is walked in, and what holds each step shut until the one before it is done. Everything here is already held against this {course}: putting it on the list is what makes a learner meet it.

spine.empty.text: A ku na nchumu ha ku ri, hikwalaho mudyondzi la tsarisiweke eka yona a nga yi pfula a kuma rhijisi leri nga riki na nchumu. Engetela nchumu wo sungula laha ehansi.
spine.empty.from: Nothing is on it yet, so a learner enrolled on it would open it and find an empty page. Add the first thing below.

spine.waitsForBefore.text: Yi rindzele xikhale lexi tlulaka ku va {rule}.
spine.waitsForBefore.from: Waits for the step before it to be {rule}.

spine.nothingLeft.text: Hinkwaswo leswi khomiweke eka yona se swi le ka mutsari. Tsala buku ya ntirho kumbe u hlayisa dokumente eka yona, kutani yi ta humelela laha.
spine.nothingLeft.from: Everything held against it is already on the list. Capture a workbook or file a document against it, and it will appear here.

spine.rename.text: Yi vitane hi vito rin'wana (swa ku hlawula)

spine.guidance.text: Mutsari wun'we wa xiyimo (swa ku hlawula)

spine.openAtStart.text: Yi pfule ku sungula, ku nga ri endzhaku ka xikhale lexi tlulaka
spine.openAtStart.from: Open from the start, rather than after the step before it

spine.beforeMustBe.text: Xikhale lexi tlulaka xi fanele ku va

courseAssess.intro.text: Kwizi ya nhluvuko yi makiwa hi ku tiendlela. Nkambisiso wa makumu wu tshama wu vekiwa xiboho hi munhu naswona wu tshama wu languteriwa hi ku ntshunxeka, hikuva hi wona lowu hlayiwaka eka kwalifikheyixini.
courseAssess.intro.from: A formative quiz is marked automatically. A summative assessment is always judged by a person and always moderated independently, because it is the one that counts towards a qualification.

courseAssess.assesses.text: Leswi xivutiso lexi xi swi kambisisaka

courseAssess.options.text: Tinhlawulo ta nhlamulo: tikisa hinkwato leti nga tinene
courseAssess.options.from: Answer options: tick every one that is correct

courseAssess.allModerated.text: xiboho xin'wana ni xin'wana xa languteriwa

courseAssess.type.practical_observation.text: Ku xiyaxiya ntirho wa ku endla

courseAssess.published.text: Swi kandziyisiwile. Mudyondzi u swi kuma loko swi va xikhale eka {link}.
courseAssess.published.from: Published. A learner meets it once it is a step in {link}.

courseAssess.typeQuiz.text: Kwizi: yi makiwa hi ku tiendlela

courseAssess.typePractical.text: Ku xiyaxiya ntirho wa ku endla

courseAssess.formative.text: Wa nhluvuko: ku ringeta, a wu hlayiwi

courseAssess.summative.text: Wa makumu: wa hlayiwa, tshama wu languteriwa

courseAssess.sampleNote.text: A hi xiphemu xa le henhla: i xa le hansi. Vukulu bya ntlawa byi ri tlakusa: ntlawa wa khume kumbe ku tsongo wu languteriwa hinkwawo, naswona wa makumembirhi kumbe ku tsongo wu languteriwa hi hafu, hikuva xa mune xa matsalwa ya nhungu i mambirhi, naswona mambirhi ma vula swintsongo swinene hi xiboho xa mukambisisi. Nhlayo leyi yi lawula tintlawa leti tlulaka makumembirhi. Yi tshikiwa eka nkambisiso wa makumu, laha xiboho xin'wana ni xin'wana xi languteriwaka, naswona mukambisisi la tsarisiweke lowintshwa u tshama a languteriwa hinkwawo.
courseAssess.sampleNote.from: A floor, not a ceiling. Cohort size raises it: a cohort of ten or fewer is moderated in full and one of twenty or fewer at half, because a quarter of eight scripts is two, and two say almost nothing about an assessor's judgement. This figure governs cohorts above twenty. Ignored for a summative assessment, where every decision is moderated, and a newly registered assessor is always moderated in full.

courseEnrol.draft.text: Leswi ha ku ri xihlamuselo xo sungula. Swi fanele ku kandziyisiwa ku nga si averiwa munhu eka swona: xihlamuselo xo sungula a xi si hundza eka swikambisiso leswi tiyisisaka leswaku leswi nga endzeni ka xona swi funengeta leswi xi swi vulaka.
courseEnrol.draft.from: This is still a draft. It has to be published before anyone can be assigned to it: a draft has not passed the checks that confirm its content covers what it claims to.

courseEnrol.waitingNote.text: Mudyondzi un'wana ni un'wana u humelela kan'we, eka xikhale xo sungula lexi a nga kotiki ku xi pfula. Ku sivekiwa eka xikhale xa vunharhu i ntiyiso lowu fanelaka ku endliwa xiendlo; ku sivekiwa na le swikhaleni swa mune ku ya eka khume swi nga pfuni nchumu.
courseEnrol.waitingNote.from: Each learner appears once, at the earliest step they cannot open. Being held up at step three is the fact worth acting on; also being held up at steps four to ten is noise.

courseEnrol.nobody.text: A ku na loyi a tsarisiweke ha ku ri.

courseEnrol.everyone.text: Un'wana ni un'wana eka nhlengeletano se u eka yona.
courseEnrol.everyone.from: Everyone in the organisation is already on it.

courseEnrol.many.text: Tsarisa vanhu vo tala hi kan'we

courseEnrol.manyNote.text: Namarhela tiadiresi ta imeyili, yin'we eka mutsari wun'wana ni wun'wana. Kholumu leyi kopiweke ku suka eka spredshiti yi tirha hi ku kongoma.
courseEnrol.manyNote.from: Paste email addresses, one per line. A column copied straight out of a spreadsheet works.

settings.intro.text: Ndlela leyi {name} yi vonakaka ha yona eka vanhu va wena, ni ndlela leyi Apu yi hlayaka tidokumente leti va ti tlakusaka. Ku cinca ku tirha hi ku hatlisa kun'wana ni kun'wana: a ku na nchumu lowu fanelaka ku akiwa nakambe kumbe ku vekiwa nakambe.
settings.intro.from: How {name} looks to your people, and how the App reads the documents they upload. Changes apply everywhere immediately: there is nothing to rebuild or redeploy.

settings.section.capabilities.text: Leswi pulatifomo leyi yi nga swona

settings.section.filenames.text: Ndlela leyi mavito ya tifayili ma hlayiwaka ha yona

settings.drive.connected.text: Swi hlanganisiwile. Foludara yi nga hlayiwa hi ku kongoma ku suka eka yona sweswi.
settings.drive.connected.from: Connected. A folder can now be read straight from it.

settings.drive.cancelled.text: A ku hlanganisiwanga nchumu: ku pfumela ku herisiwile.
settings.drive.cancelled.from: Nothing was connected: the consent was cancelled.

settings.drive.refused.text: Akhawunti yoleyo yi arile ku hlanganisiwa.

settings.drive.state.text: Ku pfumela loku a ku fambisani ni loku browsara leyi yi ku sunguleke, hikwalaho a ku hlanganisiwanga nchumu. Sungula nakambe ku suka eka rhijisi leri.
settings.drive.state.from: That consent did not match the one this browser started, so nothing was connected. Start again from this page.

settings.drive.nocode.text: Mupfuneti a nga rhumelanga nchumu wo hlanganisa na wona. Ringeta nakambe.
settings.drive.nocode.from: The provider sent nothing back to connect with. Try again.

settings.drive.failed.text: Ku hlanganisa a ku helelanga. A ku hlayisiwanga nchumu. Ku ringeta nakambe hi swona swi fanelaka ku sungula.
settings.drive.failed.from: The connection could not be completed. Nothing was stored. Trying again is worth doing before anything else.

settings.mailNote.text: Leswaku vadyondzi va nga kuma vuxokoxoko bya vona bya ku nghena ni switiviso. Swi fanele ku kambisisiwa endzhaku ka loko un'wana a cince swivekiwa swa imeyili, naswona i swona swo sungula ku kambisisiwa loko munhu a vula leswaku imeyili a yi fikanga.
settings.mailNote.from: Whether learners can actually receive their sign-in details and notifications. Worth checking after anybody changes the mail settings, and the first thing to check when somebody says an email never arrived.

settings.sso.text: Ku nghena hi Google kumbe Microsoft
settings.sso.from: Signing in with Google or Microsoft

settings.ssoNote.text: Yi pfumelela vanhu va wena ku nghena hi akhawunti ya Google kumbe Microsoft ya nhlengeletano ya vona ematshan'wini ya phasiwedi laha, leyi yi ya emahlweni yi tirha na yona. Yi nghenisa ntsena vanhu lava se va nga na akhawunti eka pulatifomo leyi, va hlanganisiwa hi adiresi ya imeyili ka ku sungula; a yi tshuki yi endla yin'wana.
settings.ssoNote.from: Lets your people sign in with their organisation's Google or Microsoft account instead of a password here, which keeps working beside it. It only signs in people who already have an account on this platform, matched by email address the first time; it never creates one.

settings.terminologyNote.text: Tirhisa marito ya wena n'wini. Mupfuneti la nga ri ka Afrika-Dzonga a nga nge vuli purogirama, naswona la nga eka wona a nga nge vuli ndzetelo; pulatifomo a yi fanelanga ku sindzisa.
settings.terminologyNote.from: Use your own vocabulary. A provider outside South Africa may not say programme, and a provider inside it may not say course; the platform should not insist.

settings.templatesNote.text: Ndlela leyi dokumente yin'wana ni yin'wana leyi mupfuneti loyi a yi humesaka yi hlayekaka ni ku vonaka ha yona.
settings.templatesNote.from: How each document this provider issues reads and looks.

settings.templatesMoved.text: sweswi ti le hansi ka Ku fambisa, swin'we ni dokumente yin'wana ni yin'wana leyi pulatifomo yi yi humesaka ni loyi a amukelaka yin'wana ni yin'wana.
settings.templatesMoved.from: now under Management, with every document the platform produces and who receives each one.

settings.menuNote.text: Cincacinca bara ya le henhla: cinca vito ra xihloko, hundzisela rhijisi eka xihloko xin'wana, kumbe u endla rhijisi ri va lin'ki ya hi ku kongoma. Swi fana eka un'wana ni un'wana eka mupfuneti loyi, hikuva vatirhi va byelana laha swilo swi nga kona.
settings.menuNote.from: Rearrange the bar at the top: rename a heading, move a page under a different one, or make a page a direct link. The same for everybody at this provider, because staff tell each other where things are.

settings.drivesNote.text: Hlaya foludara hi ku kongoma ku suka eka Google Drive kumbe OneDrive, ematshan'wini ya ku yi dawunilowada kutani u yi tlakusa nakambe. I swa wena ku nga ri swa mupfuneti loyi: lowu wun'wana wa vatirhi wu hlanganisa wa yena.
settings.drivesNote.from: Read a folder straight from Google Drive or OneDrive, instead of downloading it and uploading it again. Yours rather than this provider's: every member of staff connects their own.

settings.extension.text: Ku engetelela ka wena ka AI

settings.extensionNote.text: Eka profayili ya wena n'wini. Swa ku hlawula, swi tshama swi pfariwile ku sungula, naswona leswi swi ku pfumelelaka ku swi endla swi khomiwa hi xiyimo xa wena hilaha swi nga na hakona hinkwaswo.
settings.extensionNote.from: Against your own profile. Optional, off by default, and what it lets you do is bounded by your role exactly as everything else is.

providerLang.note.text: Ririmi leri vanhu va wena va hlayaka pulatifomo hi rona, handle ka loko va hlawula ra vona n'wini ehansi ka vito ra vona ehenhla ka rhijisi. Swiscrini leswi nga si hundzuluxiwa swi tshama hi Xinghezi, naswona mavito ya wena n'wini ya swilo (Swivekiwa, Marito) ma hlayisiwa hilaha u ma tsaleke hakona eka ririmi rin'wana ni rin'wana.
providerLang.note.from: The language your people read the platform in, unless they choose their own under their name at the top of the page. Screens not yet translated stay in English, and your own names for things (Settings, Terminology) are kept as you wrote them in every language.

providerLang.label.text: Ririmi leri tshamaka ri ri kona

brand.accentNote.text: Swilo leswi kombisiwaka, tibara ta nhluvuko ni mahlelo ya switifikeyiti.
brand.accentNote.from: Highlights, progress bars and certificate borders.

brand.logoNote.text: Yi humelela eka nhloko ya rhijisi, eka rhijisi ro nghena ni eka xitifikeyiti xin'wana ni xin'wana. PNG leyi nga riki na ndzhaku lowu nga vonakiki yi lulamile swinene eka muvala wa nhloko. Ehansi ka 2 MB.
brand.logoNote.from: Appears in the header, on the sign-in page and on every certificate. A PNG with a transparent background sits best on the header colour. Under 2 MB.

brand.unfinished.text: Ku tlakusa a ku helelanga. Kambisisa vuhlanganisi bya wena kutani u ringeta nakambe.
brand.unfinished.from: The upload did not finish. Check the connection and try again.

brand.removeLogo.from: Remove, and show the name instead

brand.logoAddress.text: Kumbe adiresi, loko xifaniso xi se xi hlayisiwile kun'wana
brand.logoAddress.from: Or an address, if the image is already hosted elsewhere

brand.signInNote.text: Swa ku hlawula. Loko ku nga ri na nchumu laha, rhijisi ri kombisa vito ra wena eka muvala wa wena n'wini, leswi swi tolovelekeke kambe swi olova. Xifaniso lexi vulaka leswi nga ntiyiso hi leswi u swi endlaka xi ni nkoka ku tlula lexi tsakisaka ntsena.
brand.signInNote.from: Optional. With nothing here the page shows your name on your own colour, which is tidy but plain. A graphic that says something true about what you do is worth more than a decorative one.

brand.characterNote.text: Xi humelela eka xiscrini lexi nga si ni nchumu, ekusuhi ni xivulwa lexi hlamuselaka leswi a swi ta va kona, ni ekusuhi ni bhatani leyi munhu a fanelaka ku yi tshikelela ku landzela, laha xi nga kona ku xiyiwa. Xitsongo, xi yimile, naswona xi ni vunghana ku tlula ku sasekisa. Yi siye yi nga tsariwanga leswaku u tirhisa xa pulatifomo leyi n'wini, kumbe u nga tirhisi nchumu.
brand.characterNote.from: Appears on a screen with nothing on it yet, beside the sentence explaining what would be there, and beside a button somebody has to press next, where it is there to be noticed. Small, upright, and friendlier than it is decorative. Leave it empty to use this platform's own, or nothing at all.

brand.strapline.text: Mutsari lowu nga ehansi ka yona

brand.straplineHint.text: Ku navela ku dyondza vutomi hinkwabyo

shape.title.text: Leswi pulatifomo leyi yi nga swona

shape.intro.text: Swivutiso swimbirhi swi tekela xivumbeko xa pulatifomo ya wena ni leswi swiphemu swa yona swi vuriwaka swona. Hinkwaswo leswi u nga swi hlawuliki swa suka: swiscrini swa swona, swilo swa menyu ni tiadiresi ta swona.
shape.intro.from: Two questions decide the shape of your platform and what its parts are called. Everything you do not choose goes away: its screens, its menu entries and its addresses.

shape.nothingDeletedNote.text: Ku cinca leswi swi fihla swilo. Leswi se swi tsariweke swi tshama laha swi nga kona, naswona ku yi hlawula nakambe swi tlhelisa swiscrini swi ri ni tirhekhodo leti nga onhakangiki.
shape.nothingDeletedNote.from: Changing this hides things. Whatever has already been recorded stays where it is, and choosing it again brings the screens back with the records intact.

shape.saved.text: Swi hlayisiwile. Menyu ni marito swi cincile ku fambisana ni swona.
shape.saved.from: Saved. The menu and the wording have changed to match.

shape.unavailable.text: A swi kumeki ni nhlawulo wa le henhla. Yuniti ya dyondzo yi tshama endzeni ka kwalifikheyixini, naswona pulatifomo leyi a yi na yona.
shape.unavailable.from: Not available with the choice above. A study unit sits inside a qualification, and this platform has none.

shape.standalone.text: Swilo swinharhu leswi tshamaka swi ri swoxe
shape.standalone.from: Three things that stand on their own

shape.statutoryCovers.text: Ku humesiwa ka NLRD ni Edu.Dex, tirhiphothi ta WSP ni ATR, ni rhejista ya nawu leyi ta hi ku seketela.
shape.statutoryCovers.from: NLRD and Edu.Dex exports, WSP and ATR returns, and the statutory register behind them.

shape.statutoryWhen.text: u le handle ka Afrika-Dzonga, kumbe un'wana u tsala hi vito ra wena.
shape.statutoryWhen.from: you are outside South Africa, or somebody else files on your behalf.

shape.workplaceCovers.text: Tintwanano ta ndhawu ya ntirho, magayidi ya vakoki, tishiti ta ku sayina ni tiawara leti mudyondzi a ti tsalaka eka mutirhisi la amukelaka.
shape.workplaceCovers.from: Workplace agreements, coach guides, sign off sheets and the hours a learner logs against a host employer.

shape.workplaceWhen.text: a ku na nchumu lowu u wu nyikaka lowu kambisisiwaka endhawini ya ntirho.
shape.workplaceWhen.from: nothing you deliver is assessed in a workplace.

shape.offlineCovers.text: Vadyondzi va nghenisa pulatifomo eka foni ya vona, va dawunilowada swilo swa vona swa dyondzo va nga si huma, va swi hlaya va nga ri na signali, kutani va tsala ntirho wa vona leswaku wu rhumeriwa loko va ha kuma signali.
shape.offlineCovers.from: Learners install the platform on their phone, download their study material before they go out, read it with no signal, and record their work to send back when they next have one.

shape.offlineWhen.text: vadyondzi va tshama masiku va nga ri na signali, ku fana ni le nhoveni. Tinkambisiso ta makumu ti tshama ti ri eka intanete handle ka loko purogirama yi vekiwe hi ndlela yin'wana hi ku tikhethela.
shape.offlineWhen.from: learners spend days away from a signal, such as in the field. Summatives stay online unless a programme is deliberately set otherwise.

shape.rename.text: U nga cinca vito ra xin'wana ni xin'wana xa leswi ehansi ka {link}. Ntsena marito lawa xivumbeko lexi xi ma tirhisaka ma nyikiwa kona.
shape.rename.from: You can rename any of these under {link}. Only the words this shape actually uses are offered there.

shape.save.text: Hlayisa leswi pulatifomo leyi yi nga swona

shape.award.qualification_programme.cove.text: Nchumu wun'we. Mudyondzi u vekiwa eka kwalifikheyixini kutani leswi hi swona leswi a swi tirhaka. A ku na xiphemu xo hlanganisa xa ehenhla ka yona.
shape.award.qualification_programme.cove.from: One thing. A learner is put onto the qualification and that is what they work through. There is no separate bundling layer above it.

shape.award.qualification_programme.when.text: U nyiketa kwalifikheyixini yin'we ya ntirho tanihi purogirama yin'we ya dyondzo.
shape.award.qualification_programme.when.from: You deliver one occupational qualification as one learning programme.

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: Kwalifikheyixini ni Purogirama, hi ku hambana
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: Qualification and Programme, separately

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: Swilo swimbirhi leswi hambaneke. Kwalifikheyixini yi khoma ku amukeriwa hi nawu ni kharikhulamu; purogirama yi hlanganisa leswi mudyondzi a swi tirhaka, naswona yi nga fambisana ni kwalifikheyixini kumbe ku nga fambisani ni yin'we.
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: Two different things. A qualification holds the accreditation and the curriculum; a programme bundles what a learner works through, and may answer to a qualification or to none.

shape.award.qualification_and_programme..text: U fambisa tikwalifikheyixini leti amukeriweke hi nawu naswona u hlanganisa swilo leswi u swi nyikaka ku va tintlhandlamano leti nga riki kwalifikheyixini yin'we yin'wana ni yin'wana.
shape.award.qualification_and_programme..from: You run accredited qualifications and also bundle deliverables into sequences that are not one qualification each.

shape.award.programmes_only.covers.text: Tipurogirama ti hlanganisa leswi mudyondzi a swi tirhaka. A ku na rekhodo ya ku amukeriwa hi nawu, a ku na kharikhulamu, a ku na switatimente swa mbuyelo.
shape.award.programmes_only.covers.from: Programmes bundle what a learner works through. No accreditation record, no curriculum, no statements of results.

shape.award.programmes_only.when.text: A ku na nchumu lowu u wu nyikaka lowu yaka eka kwalifikheyixini leyi tsarisiweke: ku sungula ntirho, ku dyondzisa nakambe hi ku landzelela milawu, tipurogirama ta swikili ta le ndzeni.
shape.award.programmes_only.when.from: Nothing you deliver answers to a registered qualification: induction, compliance refreshers, internal skills programmes.

shape.award.standalone.label.text: A ku na yin'we ya tona

shape.award.standalone.covers.text: Hinkwaswo swi yima swi ri swoxe. A ku na nchumu lowu swi hlanganisaka naswona a ku na nchumu lowu swi amukelaka hi nawu.
shape.award.standalone.covers.from: Everything stands on its own. Nothing bundles it and nothing accredits it.

shape.award.standalone.when.text: Ku dyondzisa xin'wana ni xin'wana lexi u xi fambisaka xi tekiwa xi ri xoxe, xin'we-xin'we.
shape.award.standalone.when.from: Every piece of training you run is taken on its own, one at a time.

shape.delivery.courses.covers.text: Ndzetelo i leswi mudyondzi a vekiwaka eka swona a swi tirha: tidyondzo ta wona, tibuku ta wona ta ntirho, tinkambisiso ta wona. Wu nga va ehansi ka purogirama, naswona a wu fanelanga ku fambisana ni kwalifikheyixini.
shape.delivery.courses.covers.from: A course is what a learner is put onto and works through: its lessons, its workbooks, its assessments. It may sit under a programme, and it need answer to no qualification.

shape.delivery.courses.when.text: Vanhu va wena va vula ndzetelo, kumbe u aka vuleteri lebyi kwalifikheyixini yi nga byi lawuliki.
shape.delivery.courses.when.from: Your people say course, or you build training that no qualification governs.

shape.delivery.study_units.covers.text: Yuniti ya dyondzo i leswi mudyondzi a swi tirhaka, naswona yi tekela ndzetelo ndhawu hi ku helela. Yi tshama endzeni ka kwalifikheyixini, yi hlanganisa swimodyuli swa vutivi, swa ntirho wa ku endla ni swa ndhawu ya ntirho leswi tirhelaka vuyelo byin'we bya leveli yo huma.
shape.delivery.study_units.covers.from: A study unit is what a learner works through, and it replaces the course entirely. It sits inside a qualification, bundling the knowledge, practical and workplace modules that serve one exit level outcome.

shape.delivery.study_units.when.text: Vanhu va wena va vula yuniti ya dyondzo ematshan'wini ya ndzetelo. Kharikhulamu yi kandziyisa swimodyuli, yi siya ku swi hlanganisa eka wena, hikwalaho leswi i xivumbeko xa wena n'wini. Yi lava kwalifikheyixini ehenhla.
shape.delivery.study_units.when.from: Your people say study unit rather than course. The curriculum publishes modules and leaves the grouping to you, so this is your own structure. Requires a qualification at the top.

shape.note.qualificationProgramme.text: Nchumu wun'we. Mudyondzi u vekiwa eka kwalifikheyixini, naswona leyo hi yona purogirama leyi a yi tirhaka.
shape.note.qualificationProgramme.from: One thing. A learner is put onto the qualification, and that is the programme they work through.

shape.note.qualification.text: Rekhodo ya ku amukeriwa hi nawu: kharikhulamu ya yona, swipimelo ni vuyelo bya leveli yo huma.
shape.note.qualification.from: The accreditation record: its curriculum, criteria and exit level outcomes.

shape.note.programmeWithQualification.text: Ntlhandlamano lowu hlelekeke, lowu nga fambisanaka ni kwalifikheyixini kumbe ku nga fambisani ni yin'we.
shape.note.programmeWithQualification.from: An ordered sequence, which may answer to a qualification or to none.

shape.note.programmeOnly.text: Ntlhandlamano lowu hlelekeke, lowu nga fambisaniki ni kwalifikheyixini leyi tsarisiweke.
shape.note.programmeOnly.from: An ordered sequence, answering to no registered qualification.

shape.note.bottom.text: Leswi mudyondzi a swi tirhaka. A ku na nchumu ehansi ka swona.
shape.note.bottom.from: What a learner works through. There is nothing below it.

clock.note.text: Nkarhi wun'wana ni wun'wana lowu vekiweke eka Apu wu vula wachi leyi. Ku dyondzisa hi 18:30 i 18:30 laha, naswona nkarhi wo hetelela wa ku amukeriwa eka ku tshama ka nkambisiso loku lawuriwaka wu avanyisiwa hi wona.
clock.note.from: Every timetabled time in the App means this clock. A lecture at 18:30 is 18:30 here, and an admission cut-off for an invigilated sitting is judged against it.

clock.yours.text: U ri karhi u hlaya leswi hi {time}.

clock.both.text: Vadyondzi va le matikweni man'wana va vona hinkwavo: nkarhi wa wena, lowu rekhodo yi wu hlayisaka, ni wa vona n'wini ekusuhi na wona, hikwalaho a ku na munhu loyi a fanelaka ku tihlayela ku hambana kutani a hoxa. Tinkarhi leti tsariweke hi minkarhi hinkwayo i ta wena.
clock.both.from: Learners in other countries see both: your time, which is the one the record keeps, and their own alongside it, so nobody works out the difference themselves and gets it wrong. Recorded times are always yours.

mailTest.intro.text: Yi pfula vuhlanganisi ni sevha ya imeyili kutani yi nghenisa, ku kambisisa leswaku vuxokoxoko bya ku nghena bya mudyondzi ni switiviso swi nga fikeleriwa hakunene.
mailTest.intro.from: Opens a connection to the mail server and signs in, to check that learner sign-in details and notifications can actually be delivered.

mailTest.nothingSent.text: A ku rhumeriwi imeyili eka munhu.
mailTest.nothingSent.from: No email is sent to anybody.

mailTest.notYours.text: A ku na nchumu laha lowu u nga wu cincaka eka rhijisi leri: sevha ya imeyili i ya ku vekiwa ka sisiteme. Nyikela mutsari lowu nga laha henhla eka loyi a yi hlayisaka.
mailTest.notYours.from: Nothing here is something you can change on this page: the mail server belongs to the deployment. Pass the line above to whoever maintains it.

mailTest.unconfigured.text: A ku na sevha ya imeyili leyi vekiweke eka ku vekiwa ka sisiteme leyi, hikwalaho leswi swi ta vika sweswo ku nga ri xiphiqo xa akhawunti ya wena.
mailTest.unconfigured.from: No mail server is set up on this deployment yet, so this will report that rather than a fault with your account.

sso.register.text: Tsarisa pulatifomo leyi eka akhawunti ya {provider} ya nhlengeletano ya wena, kutani u yi nyika adiresi leyi leswaku yi tlhela yi tlherisa vanhu eka yona, hilaha swi tsariweke hakona: {address}
sso.register.from: Register this platform with your organisation's {provider} account and give it this address to send people back to, exactly as written: {address}

sso.secretHeld.text: (swi hlayisiwile, swi hela hi {hint}; yi siye yi nga tsariwanga leswaku yi hlayisiwa)

sso.directoryHint.text: Ku suka eka rhijisi ra Nkombiso lowu angarhelaka wa apu eka Microsoft Entra
sso.directoryHint.from: From the app's Overview page in Microsoft Entra

sso.domainsNote.text: (swa ku hlawula, ti hambanisiwa hi tikhoma)

sso.offer.text: Nyika “Nghena hi {provider}” eka rhijisi ro nghena
sso.offer.from: Offer “Sign in with {provider}” on the sign-in page

sso.remove.text: Susa {provider} kutani u rivala xihundla xa yona

termsForm.many.text: U vitana yo tala ku ri

termsForm.why.practice.text: ri tirhisiwa eka sekhtara hinkwayo, a ri na n'winyi
termsForm.why.practice.from: used across the sector, owned by nobody

termsForm.missing.text: Van'wana marito a ma nga eka mutsari lowu, naswona swi endliwe hi ku tiyimisela.
termsForm.missing.from: Some words are not on this list, and that is deliberate.

termsForm.missingNote.text: Kwalifikheyixini, modyuli wa kharikhulamu, vuyelo bya leveli yo huma, leveli ya NQF ni van'wana swi hlamuriwa hi QCTO kumbe SAQA ku nga ri hi wena. Ku cinca vito ra xin'wana xa swona swi ta veka marito eka xiscrini xa mudyondzi ni eka leswi swi nyikeliweke leswi muvekisi wa milawu a nga swi tiviki, hikwalaho pulatifomo yi swi tshama swi nga cinciwi. U nga hlaya leswi xin'wana ni xin'wana xi hlamuriwaka hi swona eka {link}.
termsForm.missingNote.from: Qualification, curriculum module, exit level outcome, NQF level and the rest are defined by the QCTO or SAQA rather than by you. Renaming one would put wording on a learner's screen and on a submission that the regulator does not recognise, so the platform keeps them fixed. You can read who defines what in the {link}.

termsForm.note.course.text: Dyondzo yin'we yo helela leyi munhu a tsarisiweke eka yona.
termsForm.note.course.from: A single body of learning a person is enrolled onto.

termsForm.note.programme.text: Ntlhandlamano wa swindzetelo leswi tekiwaka hi ku landzelelana.
termsForm.note.programme.from: A sequence of courses taken in order.

termsForm.note.cohort.text: Ntlawa wa vanhu lava fambaka swin'we eka ndzetelo.
termsForm.note.cohort.from: A group of people moving through a course together.

termsForm.note.studyUnit.text: Ndlela leyi swimodyuli swa kharikhulamu swi hlanganisiwaka ha yona leswaku swi nyikeriwa.
termsForm.note.studyUnit.from: How a curriculum's modules are grouped for delivery.

termsForm.note.enrolment.text: Ndhawu ya munhu eka ndzetelo kumbe purogirama.
termsForm.note.enrolment.from: A person's place on a course or programme.

termsForm.note.learner.text: Munhu la dyondzaka. Van'wana va vula xitudenti kumbe mukhandidheti.
termsForm.note.learner.from: The person doing the learning. Some providers say student, or candidate.

termsForm.note.facilitator.text: Munhu la nyikelaka. Van'wana va vula muleteri, mutyuta kumbe mudyondzisi.
termsForm.note.facilitator.from: The person delivering. Some providers say trainer, tutor, or instructor.

termsForm.note.assessor.text: Munhu la veke xiboho eka vumbhoni hi ku tirhisa swipimelo.
termsForm.note.assessor.from: The person judging evidence against the criteria.

termsForm.note.moderator.text: Munhu la kambisisaka xikombiso xa swiboho leswo.
termsForm.note.moderator.from: The person checking a sample of those judgements.

termsForm.note.workplaceRecord.text: Rekhodo ya ntirho lowu mudyondzi a wu endleke, leyi mukoki a yi sayinaka naswona mukambisisi a yi amukelaka.
termsForm.note.workplaceRecord.from: The record of work a learner did, that a coach signs and an assessor accepts.

menuEdit.noHeadingHint.text: A ku na xihloko: swi kombisiwa tanihi tilin'ki ta hi ku kongoma
menuEdit.noHeadingHint.from: No heading: shown as direct links

menuEdit.empty.text: Ku nga ri na nchumu. Xihloko lexi nga riki na nchumu ehansi ka xona a xi kombisiwi.
menuEdit.empty.from: Empty. A heading with nothing under it is not shown.

menuEdit.under.text: Xihloko lexi {page} yi nga ehansi ka xona

menuEdit.note.text: Matluka a ma fihliwi laha. Leswi un'wana ni un'wana a swi vonaka swi se swi vekiwa hi xiyimo xa yena, naswona ndlela yin'wana yo endla leswaku nchumu a wu fikeleriwi a yi nge siyi munhu a ku kota ku hlamusela leswaku hikwalaho ka yini rhijisi ri nga ri kona. Rhijisi leri engeteriweke eka pulatifomo endzhaku ri humelela ehansi ka xihloko xa rona xa ntolovelo, ku nga ri ku nyamalala hikuva ku hlelekeka loku ku sunguleke ku nga si ri kona.
menuEdit.note.from: Pages cannot be hidden here. What each person sees is already decided by their role, and a second way to make something unreachable would leave nobody able to say why a page is missing. A page added to the platform later appears under its usual heading rather than disappearing because this arrangement predates it.

drives.none.text: A ku na xihlayiselo xa tifayili lexi vekiweke eka ku vekiwa ka sisiteme leyi. Ku hlaya foludara hi ku kongoma ku suka eka Google Drive kumbe OneDrive ku lava apu leyi tsarisiweke eka tona hi loyi a hlayisaka pulatifomo; ku fikela kwalaho, foludara yi hlawuriwa ku suka eka khompyuta ya wena, leswi swi tirhaka naswona swi nga lavi nchumu.
drives.none.from: No file store is set up on this deployment. Reading a folder straight from Google Drive or OneDrive needs an application registered with them by whoever maintains the platform; until then, a folder is chosen from your own computer, which works and needs nothing.

drives.keepsNote.text: Tokeni leyi pfaleriweke leyi nga hlayaka, naswona yi hlaya ntsena, drayivu ya akhawunti leyi u yi hlanganisaka, ku fikela u yi tsemakanya laha kumbe u yi susa eka swivekiwa swa akhawunti yoleyo n'wini. Yi tirhisiwa loko u kombela ku hlayiwa ka foludara ni le nkarhini wun'wana ni wun'wana ku nga ri kona, a yi tshuki yi kombisiwa eka wena nakambe, naswona a yi tshuki yi tsariwa eka log. I ya wena, ku nga ri ya mupfuneti: munghana wa ntirho a nga swi koti ku hlaya tifayili ta wena hi yona, kumbe wena ku hlaya ta yena hi vuhlanganisi bya yena.
drives.keepsNote.from: A sealed token that can read, and only read, the drive of the account you connect, until you disconnect it here or withdraw it from that account's own settings. It is used when you ask for a folder to be read and at no other time, it is never shown back to you, and it is never written to a log. It is yours, not this provider's: a colleague cannot read your files through it, and you cannot read theirs through their connection.

ext.encrypted.text: Yi tsaleriwe hi xihundla naswona a yi tshuki yi kombisiwa nakambe, laha kumbe kun'wana.
ext.encrypted.from: It is encrypted and is never shown again, here or anywhere else.

ext.cannotRunHere.text: a yi nge tirhi eka pulatifomo leyi

ext.cannotRun.text: Leyi a yi nge tirhi eka pulatifomo leyi, hikwalaho ku yi veka laha a ku nge endli leswaku swiphemu swa AI swi tirha.
ext.cannotRun.from: This one cannot run on this platform, so setting it up here will not make the AI features work.

ext.needsProgram.text: Yi lava purogirama leyi vekiweke eka muchini lowu pulatifomo yi tirhaka eka wona.
ext.needsProgram.from: It needs a program installed on the machine the platform runs on.

ext.chooseKey.text: Hlawula un'wana wa vapfuneti va khii ya API ematshan'wini: lava va vitana mupfuneti hi intanete, naswona va tirha kun'wana ni kun'wana laha pulatifomo yi vekiweke kona.
ext.chooseKey.from: Choose one of the API-key providers instead: those call the provider over the internet and work wherever the platform is installed.

ext.replace.text: Yi tekela ndhawu hi {credential} yintshwa; yi siye yi nga tsariwanga leswaku u hlayisa leyi hlayisiweke
ext.replace.from: Replace it with a new {credential}; leave empty to keep the stored one

ext.geminiHint.text: khii ya wena ku suka eka Google AI Studio
ext.geminiHint.from: your key from Google AI Studio

ext.available.text: Yi endle yi kumeka leswaku yi pfuriwa
ext.available.from: Make it available to switch on

ext.model.text: Modele: yi siye yi nga tsariwanga leswaku u tirhisa leyi mupfuneti a yi tekaka
ext.model.from: Model: leave empty for the provider's own default

ext.showModels.text: Kombisa swimodele leswi {credential} leyi yi swi tirhisaka
ext.showModels.from: Show the models this {credential} can use

ext.modelsAvailable.text: {count} leswi swi kumekaka eka wena namuntlha. Ku hlawula xin'we swi tata bokisi leri nga laha henhla; swi hlayisiwa loko u tshikelela Hlayisa.
ext.modelsAvailable.from: {count} available to you today. Choosing one fills the box above; it is saved when you press Save.

ext.keepsNote.text: {credential} ya wena, leyi tsaleriweke hi xihundla, ku fikela u yi lahla. Yi tirhisiwa ntsena eka ntirho lowu u wu kombelaka, ntsena loko switshi swi pfuriwile, naswona a yi tshuki yi kombisiwa eka wena kumbe ku tsariwa eka log. Ku kumeka a hi ku pfuriwa: ku tshama ka xin'wana ni xin'wana ku sungula ku ri ku pfariwile, u ku pfula eka ntirho, naswona ku huma swi ku pfala loko u rivala.
ext.keepsNote.from: Your {credential}, encrypted, until you discard it. It is used only for work you ask for, only while you have the switch on, and it is never shown back to you or written to any log. Available is not the same as on: every sitting starts with it off, you switch it on for a job, and signing out switches it off for you if you forget.

ext.keptUnused.text: Tokeni ya wena yi hlayisiwile kambe a yi nge tirhisiwi. A ku na nchumu eka pulatifomo lowu nga ta nyika nseketelo wa AI ku fikela u yi endla yi kumeka nakambe.
ext.keptUnused.from: Your token is kept but cannot be used. Nothing in the platform will offer AI assistance until you make it available again.

ext.offNote.text: Loko leswi swi pfariwile, pulatifomo yi tirha hilaha yi tirhaka hakona handle ka ku engetelela: swilo swa yona a swi kona, ku nga ri ku nyikiwa kutani swi tsandza.
ext.offNote.from: With this off, the platform behaves exactly as it does without an extension: the affordances are absent rather than offered and failing.

ext.tokenFromNote.text: Xiphemu lexi xi humelela eka khompyuta ya wena n'wini, ku nga ri laha, leswi hi swona xikongomelo: sabskripxini ya wena yi pfumeleriwa hi wena, eka muchini wa wena, naswona i tokeni leyi yi yi humesaka ntsena leyi fikaka eka pulatifomo leyi.
ext.tokenFromNote.from: This part happens on your own computer, not here, which is the point: your subscription is authorised by you, on your machine, and only the token it produces ever reaches this platform.

ext.step1Rest.text: loko u nga se endla sweswo: {link}. U lava sabskripxini ya wena n'wini ya Claude.
ext.step1Rest.from: if you have not already: {link}. You need a Claude subscription of your own.

ext.cmdNote.text: {plain} yo olova eka PowerShell hakanyingi yi tsandza yi ri “running scripts is disabled on this system”. Leswo i ntolovelo wa Windows ku nga ri xihoxo eka ku nghenisa ka wena, naswona xivumbeko xa {cmd} xi swi papalata handle ko cinca swivekiwa swa vuhlayiseki.
ext.cmdNote.from: Plain {plain} in PowerShell usually fails with “running scripts is disabled on this system”. That is a Windows default rather than anything wrong with your installation, and the {cmd} form avoids it without changing any security setting.

ext.step3.text: 3. Nghena loko yi pfula browsara ya wena
ext.step3.from: 3. Sign in when it opens your browser

ext.step3Rest.text: , kutani u kopa tokeni leyi yi yi nyikaka (yi sungula hi {prefix}) u yi namarhela laha henhla.
ext.step3Rest.from: , then copy the token it prints (it begins {prefix}) and paste it above.

ext.notApiKey.text: A hi khii ya API naswona a ku na nxavo wa tokeni yin'wana ni yin'wana: yi tirhisa sabskripxini ya Claude leyi se u yi hakelaka. U nga tshuki u nyika munhu phasiwedi ya wena ya Anthropic: pulatifomo leyi a yi na bokisi ra yona naswona a yi nge yi amukeli laha.
ext.notApiKey.from: It is not an API key and there is no per-token cost: it draws on the Claude subscription you already pay for. Never give anybody your Anthropic password: this platform has no field for one and would not accept it here.

ext.notSubscription.text: Sabskripxini a hi khii ya API.
ext.notSubscription.from: A subscription is not an API key.

ext.geminiSeparate.text: Gemini Advanced ni Gemini API i swilo swimbirhi leswi hambaneke, leswi nga ni tihakelo leti hambaneke. Ku hakela xo sungula a ku ku nyiki xa vumbirhi, naswona a ku na ndlela yo swi endla.
ext.geminiSeparate.from: Gemini Advanced and the Gemini API are separate products with separate billing. Paying for the first does not give you the second, and there is no way to make it.

ext.openaiSeparate.text: ChatGPT Plus ni OpenAI API i swilo swimbirhi leswi hambaneke, leswi nga ni tihakelo leti hambaneke. Ku hakela xo sungula a ku ku nyiki xa vumbirhi, naswona a ku na ndlela yo swi endla.
ext.openaiSeparate.from: ChatGPT Plus and the OpenAI API are separate products with separate billing. Paying for the first does not give you the second, and there is no way to make it.

ext.openaiCreate.text: Endla khii eka {site}, ehansi ka {menu}, kutani u yi namarhela laha henhla. Yi sungula hi {prefix}.
ext.openaiCreate.from: Create a key at {site}, under {menu}, and paste it above. It begins {prefix}.

ext.noFreeTier.text: A ku na ndlela yo ntshunxeka:

ext.noFreeTierNote.text: ku hambana ni Gemini, xikombelo xin'wana ni xin'wana xi hakeliwa eka akhawunti leyi khii yi nga ya yona, hikwalaho languterisa xibalo, ku nga khathariseki leswaku xi ntsongo ku fika kwihi.
ext.noFreeTierNote.from: unlike Gemini, every call is charged to the account the key belongs to, so expect a bill, however small.

ext.geminiCreate.text: Nghena eka {site}, u hlawula {menu}, u endla yin'we, kutani u yi namarhela laha henhla. Google yi humesile tikhii hi mixaka yo tala, hikwalaho namarhela leswi yi ku nyikaka swona: pulatifomo leyi a yi nge swi kanakani.
ext.geminiCreate.from: Sign in at {site}, choose {menu}, create one, and paste it above. Google has issued keys in more than one format, so paste whatever it gives you: this platform does not second-guess it.

ext.geminiFree.text: Gemini API yi na ndlela yo ntshunxeka, hikwalaho ku yi ringeta a ku hakeliwi nchumu. Yi tshaha nhlayo ya swikombelo leswi u nga swi endlaka hi mineti, ku nga ri ku swi hakela; ku hlaya foludara leyikulu swi nga fika eka leswo, naswona pulatifomo yi ta vula sweswo sweswi loko swi endleka.
ext.geminiFree.from: The Gemini API has a free tier, so this costs nothing to try. It limits how many requests you may make in a minute rather than charging for them; reading a large folder can hit that, and the platform will say so plainly if it does.

ext.keyYours.text: I ya wena, ku nga ri ya tenanti. Yi tsaleriwe hi xihundla, yi tirhisiwa ntsena eka ntirho lowu u wu kombelaka loko switshi swa wena swi pfuriwile, a yi tshuki yi kombisiwa eka wena, naswona a yi tshuki yi tsariwa eka log.
ext.keyYours.from: It is yours, not the tenant's. It is encrypted, used only for work you ask for while your switch is on, never shown back to you, and never written to a log.

codes.intro.text: Modyuli wun'we wu tsariwa hi ndlela yo hambana eka tidokumente to hambana: {long} eka kharikhulamu, {short} eka thebula ya ku fambisana, {shortest} eka nkomiso. Xihlawulekisi xo leha, swikombiso swa ku tsala ni tiletara letikulu swi khomiwa hi nawu. Laha hi laha Apu yi byeriwaka hi leswi saleke, leswaku loko ku tlakusiwa yi hlanganisa modyuli ematshan'wini ya ku vika leswaku a wu kona.
codes.intro.from: One module is written down differently in different documents: {long} in the curriculum, {short} in the alignment table, {shortest} in a summary. The long identifier, the punctuation and the capitals are handled by rule. This is where the App is told about the rest, so an upload links the module instead of reporting it missing.

codes.saved.text: Swi hlayisiwile. Ku tlakusa ku ta tirhisa leswi ku suka sweswi.
codes.saved.from: Saved. Uploads will use these from now on.

codes.none.text: A ku na kharikhulamu leyi tlakusiweke ha ku ri, hikwalaho a ku na swiyimeso swo tekelela. Tlakusa kwalifikheyixini kutani leswi swi tatiwa hi swexe ku suka eka tikhodi ta swimodyuli swa yona.
codes.none.from: No curriculum has been loaded yet, so there are no standards to infer. Load a qualification and this fills itself in from its module codes.

codes.inUse.text: tindlela tin'wana ta ku tsala ta {total} eka swimodyuli swa {modules}, ti tirhisiwa.
codes.inUse.from: {total} alternative spellings across {modules} modules, in use.

codes.proposed.text: tindlela ta ku tsala ta {total} leti ringanyetiweke eka swimodyuli swa {modules}.

codes.notInUse.text: A ti tirhisiwi ku fikela u ti languta u tlhela u ti tiyisisa.
codes.notInUse.from: Not in use until you have looked at them and confirmed.

codes.dialogNote.text: Khodi ya ekhohlo i xiyimeso xa wena. Tindlela to tsala leti nga ekusuhi na yona i leti dokumente yi nga ti tirhisaka ematshan'wini. Susa leti nga fanelangiki, engetela ta wena, kutani u tiyisisa.
codes.dialogNote.from: The code on the left is your standard. The spellings beside it are what a document may use instead. Remove any that do not belong, add your own, then confirm.

codes.fullId.text: Xihlawulekisi xa QCTO lexi helelaka, {example}, xi hlayiwa tanihi khodi ya modyuli ya xona hi nawu, naswona a xi lavi mutsari laha. Ku fana ni tihayifeni, switshunxa ni tiletara letikulu.
codes.fullId.from: A full QCTO identifier, {example}, is read as its module code by rule, and needs no row here. So are hyphens, spaces and capitals.

codes.worked.text: Tindlela ta yona to hambana ti kumiwa eka wena.
codes.worked.from: Its variations are worked out for you.

codes.putBack.text: Tlherisa hinkwaswo leswi Apu yi swi ringanyetiweke
codes.putBack.from: Put back everything the App proposed

naming.title.text: Ndlela leyi mavito ya tifayili ma hlayiwaka ha yona

naming.intro.text: Loko munhu a tlakusa buku ya ntirho kumbe nkambisiso, Apu yi hlaya vito ra fayili ku kuma leswaku i yini. Loko leswi swi lulamile, ku tlakusiwa ku fika ku tatiwile. Loko swi ri hoxo, a ku na nchumu lowu tshoveka: ku fika ku ri foromo leyi nga riki na nchumu leyi munhu a fanelaka ku yi tata hi voko.
naming.intro.from: When somebody uploads a workbook or an assessment, the App reads the filename to work out what it is. Get this right and an upload arrives already filled in. Get it wrong and nothing breaks: it arrives as a blank form for somebody to complete by hand.

naming.rule.text: Nawu wa ndlu, hilaha ntlawa wa wena wu fanelaka ku wu landzela hakona
naming.rule.from: The house rule, as your team should follow it

naming.ruleNote.text: Wu kombisiwa eka xiscrini xo tlakusa. Nkongomiso wa vanhu, ku nga ri nchumu lowu Apu yi wu fambisanaka na wona: yi kuma tikhodi leti nga hansi laha ti nga kona kun'wana ni kun'wana.
naming.ruleNote.from: Shown on the upload screen. Guidance for people, not something the App matches on: it finds the codes below wherever they appear.

tmpl.note.statement_of_results.from: Carried to the assessment centre with the learner's identity document. The layout is yours to set; the QCTO's own template shows what one carries.

tmpl.note.enrolment_form.text: Foromo ya ku tsarisiwa leyi hetisiweke, tanihi dokumente. Muxiyaxiyi wa QCTO a nga yi kombela loko a endzela, hikwalaho yi fanele ku va kona eka phephara, ku nga ri eka xiscrini lexi munhu a xi tateke ntsena.
tmpl.note.enrolment_form.from: The completed enrolment form, as a document. A QCTO monitor may ask for it on a visit, so it has to exist on paper, not only as a screen somebody filled in.

tmpl.platform.text: Ku hlelekeka ka pulatifomo n'wini. Nchumu lowu u wu endlaka laha a wu cinci dokumente leyi se yi humesiweke.

tmpl.documentNote.text: Yi tsale hilaha u lavaka yi hlayeka hakona. Nchumu wun'wana ni wun'wana lowu nga eka tibhurasi timbirhi wu cincisiwa hi vuxokoxoko bya mudyondzi n'wini loko dokumente yi humesiwa, naswona switshunxa swa wena swi hlayisiwa hilaha u swi tsalaka hakona.
tmpl.documentNote.from: Write it as you want it to read. Anything in double braces is replaced with the learner's own details when the document is produced, and your spacing is kept exactly as you type it.

tmpl.starterNote.text: Leswi i marito ya pulatifomo n'wini, leswaku u ma ntsongisa ma va ya wena.

tmpl.addedNote.text: Leswi swi printiwa endzhaku ka thempiliti ya wena. A hi swa wena ku swi cinca hikuva a hi swa wena: muvekisi wa milawu wa swi lava, naswona mudyondzi la khomaka dokumente u titshega hi leswaku swi hi ntiyiso. A wu lavi ku swi tsala eka vhezini ya wena.
tmpl.addedNote.from: These are printed after your template. They are not yours to change because they are not yours: a regulator requires them, and a learner holding the document relies on them being true. You do not need to write them into your own version.

capture.intro.text: Apu yi hlaya leswi yi swi kotaka, yi ku kombisa leswi yi swi endleke ni leswi yi nga swi kotiki ku swi hlamusela, kutani yi rindza. A ku na nchumu lowu vaka nkambisiso ku fikela u wu tiyisisa.
capture.intro.from: The App reads what it can, shows you what it made of it and what it could not work out, and waits. Nothing becomes an assessment until you confirm it.

imports.intro.text: Foludara yin'wana ni yin'wana leyi hlayiweke, ni leswi endliweke hi yona. Ku hlaya leyintshwa swi sungula laha ntirho wu nga kona, eka kwalifikheyixini, ndzetelo kumbe swilo swa dyondzo leswi u swi akaka, ku nga ri laha.
imports.intro.from: Every folder that has been read, and what became of it. Reading a new one starts where the work is, on the qualification, course or material you are building, rather than here.

imports.noExtensionNote.from: It is optional and yours rather than the tenant's: every member of staff sets up their own, with their own subscription.

imports.readNote.text: Swi hlayisiwa ku nga khathariseki loko swi tiyisisiwile kumbe swi lahliwile. Leswi ringanyetiweke kutani swi arisiwa hi leswi munhu a avanyisaka ha swona loko ku hlaya ku fanele ku tshembiwa.

statutory.intro.text: Ku vuyisa ka SAQA National Learners' Records Database, ni Workplace Skills Plan ni Annual Training Report. Hinkwaswo swi kambisisiwa laha ku nga si va swi ya kun'wana, hikuva ku vuyisa loku arisiweke hikwalaho ka nomboro ya vutivisi leyi thyiweke hi xihoxo swi durha nkarhi hinkwawo wa ku vuyisa.
statutory.intro.from: The SAQA National Learners' Records Database return, and the Workplace Skills Plan and Annual Training Report. Everything is checked here before it goes anywhere, because a return rejected for a mistyped identity number costs a full cycle.

statutory.problemOne.text: Xiphiqo xin'we lexi fanelaka ku lulamisiwa rhanga

statutory.problems.text: Swiphiqo swa {count} leswi fanelaka ku lulamisiwa rhanga

statutory.locked.from: The files stay locked until the blocking problems below are fixed. Submitting a return that will be rejected wastes a cycle for every learner in it.

statutory.mustFix.text: Swi fanele ku lulamisiwa ku nga si rhumeriwa

statutory.mapping.text: Ku fambisana ka swiyenge swa mafayili ku landzelela rimba ra ku amukeriwa hi nawu (Munhu 27, Ku Tsarisiwa 28, Swihumelelo 29, Mupfuneti 30). Tiyisisa xivumbeko xa ntiyiso xa fayili ya Edu.Dex eka nhlamuselo ya sweswi ya SAQA ku nga si rhumeriwa ka ntiyiso.
statutory.mapping.from: Field mapping follows the accreditation framework (Person 27, Enrolment 28, Achievement 29, Provider 30). Confirm the exact Edu.Dex file layout against the current SAQA specification before a live submission.

enrolNotify.intro.text: QCTO yi fanele ku tivisiwa leswaku vadyondzi lava va tsarisiwile, endzeni ka masiku ya ntirho ya kukhume-nkombo-un'we endzhaku ka ku nghenisa loko ku ri kwalifikheyixini, ni masiku ya ntirho ya ntlhanu loko ku ri purogirama ya swikili. Masiku ya ku wisa ka tiko a ma hlayiwi, naswona nkarhi wu sungula hi siku ra ku nghenisa, ku nga ri hi ku tsarisiwa kumbe ku hakelela.
enrolNotify.intro.from: The QCTO has to be told that these learners were enrolled, within twenty-one working days of induction for a qualification and five for a skills programme. Public holidays do not count, and the clock runs from the induction date rather than from enrolment or payment.

enrolNotify.overdueNote.text: Ha ku ri tano rhumela leswi. Xitiviso lexi hlwerisiweke ni xihlamuselo i xiphiqo xo hambana ni lexi nga tshamaka xi nga endliwanga hi munhu.
enrolNotify.overdueNote.from: Still submit these. A late notification with an explanation is a different problem to one nobody made.

enrolNotify.soonNote.text: Ku sale masiku ya ntirho ya ntlhanu kumbe ku tlula ku fana.
enrolNotify.soonNote.from: Five working days or fewer remaining.

enrolNotify.daysLeft.text: ku sale masiku ya ntirho ya {count}

enrolNotify.noInduction.text: {count} a va na siku ro nghenisiwa

enrolNotify.noInductionNote.text: Nkarhi wa vona a wu si sungula, hikwalaho a ku na siku ro hetelela leri fanelaka ku vikiwa. Veka siku ra sesheni ya ku nghenisa ya ntlawa, kumbe u va nyika ya vona n'wini laha hansi.
enrolNotify.noInductionNote.from: Their clock has not started, so there is no deadline to report. Date the cohort's induction session, or give them their own below.

enrolNotify.ownInductionNote.text: Loyi a nghenaka endzhaku ka loko ntlawa wu sungurile u na ku nghenisiwa ka yena n'wini, foromo ya yena ya ku tsarisiwa ni ku rhumela ka yena n'wini.
enrolNotify.ownInductionNote.from: Somebody who joined after the cohort started has their own induction, their own enrolment form and their own submission.

enrolNotify.notified.text: {count} vadyondzi lava va tivisiweke hi vona.

enrolNotify.nothingDrafted.text: A ku si tsariwa xo sungula nchumu.

enrolNotify.split.text: Ku rhumela loku ku katsa purogirama ya swikili ni kwalifikheyixini. Swi ya eka tiadiresi leti hambaneke, hikwalaho swi fanele ku avanyisiwa kutani swi rhumeriwa kambirhi.
enrolNotify.split.from: This submission covers both a skills programme and a qualification. They go to different addresses, so it has to be split and sent twice.

enrolNotify.askAck.text: Kombela xiviko xo amukeriwa, u xi tsala laha loko xi tlhela xi tile.

paths.intro.text: Swin'wana swa {courses} leswi hlanganisiweke hi ku landzelelana: {programme} lowuntshwa, kumbe ku tirhisiwa ka rimba hinkwaro ra vuswikoti. Mudyondzi u nyikiwa {course} leyi landzelaka hi ku tiyimela loko a heta leyi rhangaka.
paths.intro.from: Several {courses} chained into a sequence: a new starter {programme}, or a full competency framework roll-out. A learner is given the next {course} automatically as they finish the one before it.

paths.noneAuthor.text: {programme} yi hlanganisa {courses} hi ku landzelelana, leswaku mudyondzi a nyikiwa leyi landzelaka loko a heta leyi rhangaka. Rhanga u aka {courses}: {programme} i ku landzelelana ka swona.
paths.noneAuthor.from: A {programme} chains {courses} into an order, so a learner is given the next one as they finish the one before. Build the {courses} first: a {programme} is a sequence of them.

paths.noneReader.text: A ku si akiwa nchumu. Loko yin'we yi akiwile, {courses} leyi u nga ta tirha ha yona hi ku landzelelana yi ta va laha. Ku aka yin'we i ntirho wa mutsari.
paths.noneReader.from: None has been built yet. When one has been, the {courses} you work through in order will be here. Building one is an author's job.

paths.empty.text: A ku na {courses} eka yona se: mudyondzi loyi a nyikiweke {programme} leyi a nga ta kuma nchumu. Yi pfule u engetela swin'wana.
paths.empty.from: No {courses} in it yet: a learner given this {programme} would receive nothing. Open it to add some.

paths.onIt.text: Vanhu va {count} va ri eka yona

paths.folder.text: Engetela tidokumente ku suka eka foludara

paths.folderNote.text: Hlawula foludara leyi swilo leswi swi tshamaka eka yona, kutani hinkwaswo leswi nga endzeni ka yona, ku katsa tifoludara ta yona leti nga ehansi, swi ta hlayiwa, swi hlayisiwa naswona swi ta tsariwa leswaku swi nga lavisisiwa. U vona leswi a swi ta hlayisiwa ku nga si tsariwa nchumu.
paths.folderNote.from: Choose the folder this material lives in and everything in it, including its subfolders, is read, filed and indexed. You see what it would file before anything is written.

paths.folderLabel.text: Foludara ya yona, ku suka eka khompyuta ya wena n'wini

paths.folderHint.from: Guides, workbooks, policies and templates are filed against it and their text indexed so they can be searched.

paths.folderHint2.text: Xivumbeko a xi endliwi laha: xivumbeko xa yona xi akiwa hi ku engetela {courses} eka yona laha henhla. Leswi swi hlayisa leswi yi swi khomeke.
paths.folderHint2.from: Structure is not created from here: its own shape is built by adding {courses} to it above. This files what it holds.

paths.driveNote.text: Foludara yoleyo yoleyo, yi hlayiwa laha yi tshameke kona. Yi heta yi ri endhawini yin'we: xikombiso lexi u fanelaka ku xi kambisisa ku nga si tsariwa nchumu.
paths.driveNote.from: The same folder, read where it already lives. It ends in the same place: a proposal to check before anything is written.

paths.noSteps.from: Nothing in it yet. Add them in the order learners should take them.

paths.published.from: This is published and people are working through it, so its steps are fixed. Changing the order underneath somebody would alter what they had already been told to do.

badges.intro.text: Ku amukeriwa loku fikaka hi siku leri ntirho wu hetisiweke ha rona, ku nga ri endzhaku ka tinhweti loko xitifikeyiti xa le handle xi fika. Bheji a hi kwalifikheyixini naswona pulatifomo a yi tshiki yi vonaka ku ri tano: a ku na xikombisi xa SAQA, a ku na tikridithi, ni rhijisi ro kambisisa leri vulaka hi ku pfuleka leswaku i yini ni leswaku a hi yini.
badges.intro.from: Recognition that arrives on the day the work is finished, rather than months later when the external certificate comes through. A badge is not a qualification and the platform never lets it look like one: no SAQA identifier, no credits, and a verification page that says plainly what it is and what it is not.

badges.target.default.text: Xin'wana ni xin'wana, loko ku nga vekiwanga nchumu lowu kongomeke
badges.target.default.from: Anything, when nothing more specific is set

badges.nothing.text: A ku na nchumu lowu kumiweke se

badges.nothingNote.text: A ku na bheji leyi endliweke, hikwalaho ku heta ndzetelo kumbe kwalifikheyixini a ku nyiki nchumu sweswi. Ku endla yin'we laha hansi swa ringana: sungula hi bheji ya mupfuneti n'wini loko u nga lavi yin'wana eka nchumu wun'wana ni wun'wana.
badges.nothingNote.from: No badge has been designed, so finishing a course or a qualification currently awards nothing. Designing one below is enough: start with the provider's own badge if you do not want a different one for each thing.

badges.legitimate.text: Leswi i nhlawulo lowu pfumeleriweke, ku nga ri xihoxo. Pulatifomo a yi nge yi kumi.
badges.legitimate.from: This is a legitimate choice rather than a fault. The platform will not invent one.

badges.kind.default.text: Xin'wana ni xin'wana, loko ku nga vekiwanga nchumu lowu kongomeke
badges.kind.default.from: Anything, when nothing more specific is set

badges.designNote.from: A shape, two colours and a symbol. Nothing to upload and nobody to brief.

badges.allHave.text: Xin'wana ni xin'wana se xi na bheji. Tshika ku tirhisa yin'we leswaku u endla bheji yin'wana eka nchumu wolowo.
badges.allHave.from: Everything already has a badge. Retire one to design a different badge for the same thing.

badges.retireTitle.text: Yima ku nyika {name}. Un'wana ni un'wana loyi a nga na yona u ya hlayisa.
badges.retireTitle.from: Stop awarding {name}. Everybody who has it keeps it.

templates.intro.text: Tidokumente leti {name} yi ti humesaka. Hilaha rin'wana ni rin'wana ri hlayekaka ni ku languteka hakona i ra wena: tsala vhezini ya wena n'wini kutani pulatifomo yi ri humesa ku suka eka yona ematshan'wini ya xivumbeko xa yona. Leswi muvekisi wa milawu a swi lavaka swi engeteriwa endzhaku ka swa wena naswona a swi lulamisiwi, hikuva xiphemu lexi a hi xa mupfuneti ku xi cinca.
templates.intro.from: The documents {name} produces. How each one reads and looks is yours: write your own version and the platform produces it from that instead of its own layout. What a regulator requires is added after yours and cannot be edited, because that part is not the provider's to change.

templates.goesTo.statement_of_results.text: Mudyondzi, loyi a xi rhwalaka a xi ya na xona eka ndhawu ya nkambisiso swin'we ni dokumente ya vun'wini bya yena.
templates.goesTo.statement_of_results.from: The learner, who carries it to the assessment centre with their identity document.

templates.goesTo.certificate.text: Mudyondzi, ni un'wana ni un'wana loyi a nga ta n'wi kombisa.
templates.goesTo.certificate.from: The learner, and whoever they show it to.

templates.goesTo.workplace_statement.text: Fayili ya mudyondzi, leyi sayiniweke hi mukoki eka mutirhisi loyi a amukeleke.
templates.goesTo.workplace_statement.from: The learner's file, signed by a coach at the host employer.

templates.goesTo.enrolment_form.text: Xi hlayisiwa tanihi vumbhoni, naswona xi nyikiwa mulavisisi wa QCTO loko a endzela.
templates.goesTo.enrolment_form.from: Filed as evidence, and handed to a QCTO monitor on a visit.

templates.producesNote.text: Dokumente yin'wana ni yin'wana leyi nga riki na vhezini ya wena yi tirhisa xivumbeko xa pulatifomo, lexi nga dokumente leyi tirhaka ku nga ri xitshamiseli.
templates.producesNote.from: Anything without your own version uses the platform's layout, which is a working document rather than a placeholder.

templates.writeNote.text: Sungula hi xivumbeko xa pulatifomo kutani u xi lulamisa u xi hunguta u xi endla xa wena. Rimba rin'wana ni rin'wana leri dokumente yi nga ri rhwalaka ri tsariwile ekusuhi ni muhlayisi, swin'we ni xikombiso xa ntiyiso xa leswi ri swi vonakaka.
templates.writeNote.from: Start from the platform's layout and edit it down into yours. Every field the document can carry is listed beside the editor with a real example of what it looks like.

templates.supplied.text: Tidokumente leti u ti nyikaka ku nga ri ku ti vumba
templates.supplied.from: Documents you supply rather than lay out

templates.suppliedNote.text: A hi tidokumente hinkwato leti nga tithempiliti leti pulatifomo yi ti tatisaka.
templates.suppliedNote.from: Not every document is a template the platform fills in.

templates.policiesNote.text: papila ra wena ra ku amukeriwa hi nawu, milawu ni ntwanano, leswi tlakusiweke naswona swi hlayisiwaka, ku nga ri leswi humesiwaka.
templates.policiesNote.from: your accreditation letter, policies and agreements, uploaded and retained rather than generated.

templates.fisaNote.text: leswi tsariweke hi mukambisisi wa wena n'wini naswona swi languteriwaka ku nga si va munhu a swi tshama, hikwalaho swi tsariwa, a hi tithempiliti.
templates.fisaNote.from: written by your own examiner and moderated before anybody sits them, so they are authored rather than templated.

templates.curriculumNote.text: tidokumente ta kwalifikheyixini leti kandziyisiweke leti pulatifomo yi ti hlayaka ku aka kharikhulamu.
templates.curriculumNote.from: the published qualification documents the platform reads to build a curriculum from.
