dictionary.intro.text: Nhlamuselo leyi tiyisiweke ya rito rin'wana ni rin'wana leri tirhisiwaka eka pulatifomo leyi, tidokumente ta yona ni swilo swa yona swa dyondzo. Xin'wana ni xin'wana xi vula leswaku rito ri va ra mani. Laha vulawuri byi ri hlamuselaka, hi ri tirhisa hilaha byi ri tirhisaka hakona, naswona huvo yoleyo yi vekiwa vito. Laha rito ri ri ra hina, hi nga ri cinca. Laha ri tirhisiwaka ntsena hi ku tolovelekeka, a ri fanelanga ku vuriwa leswaku i xilaveko.
dictionary.intro.from: The settled meaning of every term used across this platform, its documents and its learning material. Each entry says who owns the word. Where an authority defines it, we use it as they do and the body is named. Where the word is ours, we can change it. Where it is simply common usage, it should never be cited as a requirement.

dictionary.searchHint.text: Rito, ku koxiwa, kumbe rito eka nhlamuselo
dictionary.searchHint.from: A term, an abbreviation, or a word in a definition

dictionary.meaning.authority.text: Ri hlamuseriwile hi vulawuri. Ri tirhise hilaha byi ri tirhisaka hakona: ku cinca nhlamuselo swi endla leswaku ku rhumela ku va ni khombo.
dictionary.meaning.authority.from: Defined by an authority. Use it as they do: changing the meaning puts a submission at risk.

dictionary.meaning.platform.text: Rito ra pulatifomo leyi n'wini. Ri ra hina, hi nga ri cinca; a ku na vulawuri lebyi ri vekaka.
dictionary.meaning.platform.from: This platform's own word for it. Ours to change; no authority prescribes it.

dictionary.meaning.practice.text: Ku tirhisiwa ka ntolovelo eka ndzawulo hinkwayo, handle ka n'wini un'we. U nga ri vuli leswaku i xilaveko.
dictionary.meaning.practice.from: Common usage across the sector, with no single owner. Do not cite it as a requirement.

dictionary.none.text: A ku na leswi fanaka. Loko rito ri nga kona naswona i rin'wana leri hi ri tirhisaka, ri fanele ku va laha: hi byele kutani ri ta engeteriwa eka nkandziyiso lowu landzelaka.
dictionary.none.from: Nothing matches. If a term is missing and it is one we use, it belongs here: say so and it will be added in the next release.

feedbackForm.intro.text: {cohort}. Tinhlamulo ti vikiwa swin'we ni ta un'wana ni un'wana, ku nga ri un'we un'we. Swi teka timinete ta mbirhi, naswona i xilo xin'we lexi cincaka ndlela leyi ntlawa lowu landzelaka wu fambisiwaka ha yona.
feedbackForm.intro.from: {cohort}. Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. It takes about two minutes, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

feedbackForm.scale.1.text: Ndzi pfumelelana ngopfu ni ku hambana

feedbackForm.scale.3.text: A ndzi pfumeli kumbe ku hambana

feedbackReport.ratingsNote.text: Ntsengo wa le xikarhi wa 1 (ndzi hambana ngopfu) ku ya eka 5 (ndzi pfumelelana swinene). Ntsengo wa le xikarhi wa tinhlamulo leti nga ri tingani i mavonelo, a hi ku pima, hikwalaho nhlayo yi tshama ekusuhi na wona.
feedbackReport.ratingsNote.from: Mean of 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree). A mean over few answers is a mood, not a measurement, so the count is beside it.

feedbackReport.saidNote.text: Swi kombisiwa swin'we handle ka mavito. Mavonelo hi mufambisi ma ri ta ntiyiso ntsena loko mudyondzi a pfumela leswaku a ma nge hlayiwi eka yena un'we un'we.
feedbackReport.saidNote.from: Shown together and without names. Feedback about a facilitator is only honest if the learner believes it will not be read back to them one by one.

feedbackReport.outstandingNote.text: Ndhawu yin'we leyi vito ri humelelaka eka yona. Ku hlongorisa swa lava vito; tinhlamulo leti nga ehenhla a swi lavi.
feedbackReport.outstandingNote.from: The one place a name appears. Chasing needs them; the answers above do not.

conductPage.intro.text: Swivilelo leswi tlakusiweke hi vadyondzi, ni un'wana ni un'wana loyi rhejista yi vulaka leswaku u yimile ku ta. Timhaka ta ku tshinya nawu ti le rhijisini ra mudyondzi n'wini, laha rhekhoda ya yena yin'wana yi nga kona.
conductPage.intro.from: Grievances raised by learners, and anybody the register says has stopped turning up. Disciplinary matters sit on the learner's own page, where the rest of their record is.

conductPage.overdueNote.text: Xivilelo xi amukeriwa endzeni ka masiku ya ntirho ya {days}. Leswi swi hundzile nkarhi wolowo.
conductPage.overdueNote.from: A grievance is acknowledged within {days} working days. These are past that.

conductPage.grievancesNote.text: Swi tlakusiwa hi mudyondzi hi ndlela leyi a khomiweke ha yona, swiyimo, kumbe nchumu wun'wana ni wun'wana lowu n'wi khumbaka. Swi hambanisiwa ni swikombelo xo kandziyisa, leswi vulaka hi mbuyelo, naswona swi ya eka mulanguteri.
conductPage.grievancesNote.from: Raised by a learner about treatment, conditions, or anything else affecting them. Kept apart from appeals, which are about a result and go to the moderator.

conductPage.abscondedNote.text: Masiku mambirhi kumbe ku tlula ya vuleteri lama landzelelanaka a nga vangi kona a ku vuriwanga nchumu. Swi hlayiwa eka rhejista ku nga ri ku hlayisiwa, hikwalaho ku lulamisa marikhi swi cinca nhlamulo hi ku hatlisa. Ku nga vi kona loku tsariweke tanihi loku khomeleriweke i vuhlanganisi, naswona swi tsema ku landzelelana.
conductPage.abscondedNote.from: Two or more consecutive training days absent with no word. Read off the register rather than stored, so correcting a mark changes the answer at once. An absence recorded as excused is communication, and breaks the run.

conductPage.nobody.text: A ku na munhu. Un'wana ni un'wana u ta, kumbe u byerile munhu leswaku hikwalaho ka yini a nga tiki.
conductPage.nobody.from: Nobody. Everybody is either turning up or has told somebody why not.

conductPage.actOn.text: Nxaxamelo wa leswi fanelaka ku endliwa, a hi xiboho. Ku vulavula ni mudyondzi, ku tsalela mutseketeli ni ku humesa xitiviso xa ku kunguhata ku herisa ntwanano swi endliwa hi munhu.
conductPage.actOn.from: A list to act on, never a decision. Contacting the learner, writing to the sponsor and issuing a notice of intention to terminate are all things a person does.

grievance.decisionBy.text: Xiboho xi fanele ku nyikiwa ku nga si hela {date}

grievance.decisionHint.text: Leswi kumiweke ni leswi swi nga ta endliwa. Leswi swi ya eka mudyondzi hi matsalwa.
grievance.decisionHint.from: What was found and what will be done. This goes to the learner in writing.

grievance.impartial.text: Mulavisisi u fanele ku va munhu loyi xivilelo xi nga mu vulavuliki. Ku thyaka loyi mudyondzi a n'wi vilelaka ku arisiwa, hikuva “munhu la thyiweke la lulameke” i leswi endlelo ri swi tshembisaka, naswona vhiki leri vatirhi va nga ri vangani hi rona leri ku tshamaka ku tshoveka ha rona.
grievance.impartial.from: The investigator must be somebody the grievance is not about. Naming one the learner has complained about is refused, because “a designated impartial person” is what the procedure promises and a short-staffed week is exactly when it gets broken.

access.deniedTitle.text: A wu na ndlela yo nghena eka leswi
access.deniedTitle.from: You do not have access to this

access.deniedNote.text: U nghenile, kambe leswi a hi swa wena ku swi vona: swi ni n'wini un'wana, kumbe swi lava xiave lexi akhawunti ya wena yi nga na xona. Loko u ehleketa leswaku leswi a swi lulamanga, kombela mutirhisi-lonkulu ku kambisisa.
access.deniedNote.from: You are signed in, but this is not yours to see: either it belongs to someone else, or it needs a role your account does not hold. If you think that is wrong, ask your administrator to check.

access.home.text: Tlhelela eka rhijisi ra wena ro sungula

access.unknownTitle.from: This address is not in use

access.unknownNote.text: A ku na nhlangano lowu vekiweke eka adiresi leyi ya webu, kumbe ku nghena ka wona ku tshikiwile. Kambisisa adiresi leyi u nyikiweke yona, kumbe u vulavula ni loyi a lulamiseleke vuleteri bya wena.
access.unknownNote.from: No organisation is set up at this web address, or its access has been suspended. Check the address you were given, or contact whoever arranged your training.

wpSetup.intro.text: Mudyondzi u endla ntokoto wa ntirho eka mutirhisi, a langutiwa hi munhu loyi mutirhisi loyo a n'wi nyikaka. Ntwanano wu tsala leswaku i mani; bukwana ya ntirho yi tsala leswi kharikhulamu yi lavaka leswaku a swi endla.
wpSetup.intro.from: A learner does work experience at an employer, supervised by somebody that employer provides. The agreement records who that is; the logbook records what the curriculum requires them to do.

wpSetup.emptyOne.text: Modyuli 1 ya ntokoto wa ntirho a yi na swilaveko leswi tsariweke.
wpSetup.emptyOne.from: 1 work experience module has no requirements captured.

wpSetup.empty.text: Swimodyuli swa {count} swa ntokoto wa ntirho a swi na swilaveko leswi tsariweke.
wpSetup.empty.from: {count} work experience modules have no requirements captured.

wpSetup.emptyNote.text: {codes}. Bukwana ya ntirho leyi akiweke ku suka eka modyuli leyi nga riki na nchumu a yi nge tiyiseli nchumu, hikwalaho a yi nge pfuriwi ku fikela mintirho ya ndhawu ya ntirho ya kharikhulamu, vutivi bya ndhawu ya ntirho ni vumbhoni lebyi seketelaka swi nghenisiwile.
wpSetup.emptyNote.from: {codes}. A logbook built from an empty module would attest to nothing, so those cannot be opened until the curriculum's work activities, workplace knowledge and supporting evidence have been imported.

wpSetup.noCoaches.text: A ku na munhu loyi a nga na xiave xa Mukoki wa Ntirho se. Rhanga u engetela mulanguteri wa mudyondzi hi ku tirhisa {people}: u tirhela mutirhisi, a hi wena, naswona u ta vona ntsena vadyondzi lava va vitaniweke eka tintwanano ta yena n'wini.
wpSetup.noCoaches.from: Nobody holds the Workplace Coach role yet. Add the learner's supervisor through {people} first: they work for the employer, not for you, and they will only ever see the learners named on their own agreements.

wpSetup.ownCoach.text: Mudyondzi a nga vi mukoki wa yena n'wini; databhesi yi swi arisa.
wpSetup.ownCoach.from: The learner cannot be their own coach; the database refuses it.

wpSetup.designationNote.text: Swi tsariwa eka ntwanano hilaha swi nga xiswona namuntlha, leswaku ku sayina ku tshama ku vula leswaku i mani loyi a sayinileko ni hi xiave xihi.
wpSetup.designationNote.from: Recorded on the agreement as it stands today, so the sign-off keeps saying who signed and in what capacity.

wpSetup.noAgreements.text: A ku na tintwanano ta ndhawu ya ntirho se. Rhanga u endla yin'we laha henhla: bukwana ya ntirho yi tsala ntirho lowu endliweke eka mutirhisi la vitaniweke ehansi ka mukoki la vitaniweke, hikwalaho a yi nge vi kona handle ka yin'we.
wpSetup.noAgreements.from: No workplace agreements yet. Create one above first: a logbook records work done at a named employer under a named coach, so it cannot exist without one.

wpSetup.generated.text: Bukwana ya ntirho yi akiwa ku suka eka mintirho ya ndhawu ya ntirho ya kharikhulamu n'wini, vutivi bya ndhawu ya ntirho ni vumbhoni lebyi seketelaka, hikwalaho a yi nge tshiki xilaveko.
wpSetup.generated.from: The logbook is generated from the curriculum's own work activities, workplace knowledge and supporting evidence, so it cannot omit a requirement.

enrolForm.intro.text: {provider} yi fanele ku rhumela mahungu lawa eka Huvo ra Vunene bya Vuhandzi ni Mintirho loko u tsarisiwile. Yo tala yi tiviwa se naswona yi kombisiwile laha hansi; leswi saleke i leswi ku nga riki na munhu la nga swi hlamulaka handle ka wena. U nga hlayisa loko u ya emahlweni, u tlhela u tlhelela eka yona.
enrolForm.intro.from: {provider} has to send these details to the Quality Council for Trades and Occupations when you are enrolled. Most of it is already known and shown below; the rest is what nobody can answer except you. You can save as you go and come back to it.

enrolForm.onRecordNote.text: Byela muhlanganisi wa wena loko xin'wana xa leswi xi nga lulamanga; a hi xa wena ku xi cinca laha.
enrolForm.onRecordNote.from: Tell your coordinator if any of this is wrong; it is not yours to change here.

enrolForm.noInduction.text: ku nghenisiwa a ku si vekiwa siku

enrolForm.doesNotAdd.text: Ku ni nchumu laha lowu nga fambisaniki
enrolForm.doesNotAdd.from: Something here does not add up

enrolForm.idNote.text: Nomboro ya vun'wini ya Afrika Dzonga yi rhwala siku ro velekiwa ni rimba endzeni ka yona, naswona QCTO yi kambisisa leswaku swi fambisana. Hi ku tolovelekeka i xiphemu xin'wana xa nomboro lexi tsariweke hi xihoxo. Muhlanganisi wa wena a nga yi lulamisa.
enrolForm.idNote.from: A South African identity number carries the date of birth and the gender inside it, and the QCTO checks that they agree. It is usually a mistyped digit. Your coordinator can correct it.

enrolForm.stillNote.text: A ku lahleki nchumu loko u yima hi le xikarhi. Leswi i leswi a swi ta pfumala eka leswi rhumeriweke hilaha swi nga kona sweswi.
enrolForm.stillNote.from: Nothing is lost if you stop partway. This is what would be missing from the submission as it stands.

enrolForm.completeNote.text: Hinkwaswo leswi ku rhumela ku swi lavaka swi laha.
enrolForm.completeNote.from: Everything the submission needs is here.

enrolForm.missingPrint.text: Tinhlamulo ta {count} ti ha pfumala, hikwalaho foromo leyi yi ta printiwa ku ri ni tindhawu leti nga tsariwangiki. Ti tsariwile eka foromo n'wini.
enrolForm.missingPrint.from: {count} answers are still missing, so this form will print with blanks. They are listed on the form itself.

enrolForm.completePrint.text: Swi helerile. Yi print, u endla leswaku mudyondzi a yi sayina, u yi hlayisa.
enrolForm.completePrint.from: Complete. Print it, have the learner sign it, and file it.

enrolForm.titleHint.from: Mr, Ms, Dr, and so on.

enrolForm.middleHint.text: Loko u ri na rona. Ri siye ri nga tsariwanga loko u nga ri na rona.
enrolForm.middleHint.from: If you have one. Leave it blank if not.

enrolForm.homeLanguage.text: Ririmi leri u ri vulavulaka ekaya

enrolForm.working.text: Xana u karhi u tirha sweswi?
enrolForm.working.from: Are you working at the moment?

enrolForm.immigrant.text: Xiyimo xa ku fika eka tiko

enrolForm.difficulty.text: Swi ku vangela ku tika ku fika kwihi?
enrolForm.difficulty.from: How much difficulty does it cause?

enrolForm.difficultyHint.text: Swi vutisiwa hikuva vuhlanya byi tsariwile eka vito ra wena. QCTO yi swi lava swin'we ni byona.
enrolForm.difficultyHint.from: Asked because a disability is recorded against your name. The QCTO requires it alongside.

enrolForm.noId.text: Loko u nga na nomboro ya vun'wini ya Afrika Dzonga
enrolForm.noId.from: If you do not have a South African identity number

enrolForm.instead.text: Leswi u tsarisiweke eka swona ematshan'wini
enrolForm.instead.from: What you are enrolled on instead

enrolForm.post.text: Laha poso yi ku fikaka kona, loko ku ri endhawini yin'wana
enrolForm.post.from: Where post reaches you, if it is somewhere else

enrolForm.province.text: Xifundzha lexi u tirhaka eka xona

enrolForm.provinceHint.text: Laha u tirhaka kona, leswi nga tshamaka swi nga ri laha u tshamaka kona.
enrolForm.provinceHint.from: Where you work, which is not always where you live.

enrolForm.statssaHint.text: Muhlanganisi wa wena a nga yi lavisisa loko u nga yi tivi.
enrolForm.statssaHint.from: Your coordinator can look this one up if you do not know it.

enrolForm.flc.text: Vuswikoti bya Ku Dyondza bya Masungulo

enrolForm.flcNote.text: Swi lavekile ntsena eka kwalifikheyixini ya NQF level 3 kumbe 4. Yi siye yi nga tsariwanga loko a ku na munhu loyi a ku yi kombeleke.
enrolForm.flcNote.from: Only needed on a qualification at NQF level 3 or 4. Leave it blank if nobody has asked you for it.

enrolForm.agreedOn.text: U pfumelele hi {date}. Siku leri i xiphemu xa rhekhoda naswona a ri cinci loko u lulamisa foromo leyi.
enrolForm.agreedOn.from: You agreed on {date}. That date is part of the record and does not change if you edit this form.

enrolForm.agreedDate.text: Siku leri u pfumelelaka ha rona ri tsariwa, hikuva mbiko wu kombela swimbirhi.
enrolForm.agreedDate.from: The date you agree is recorded, because the return asks for both.

enrolForm.confirm.text: Hlayisa u tiyisisa leswaku leswi swi lulamile
enrolForm.confirm.from: Save and confirm these are right

records.intro.text: Sisiteme ya Ku Fambisa Vunene ni milawu ya yona, tileteri ta ku amukeriwa hi nawu, tikontiraka, ni tidokumente ta nawu ku fana ni mabuku ya PAIA: hinkwaswo leswi mupfuneti a swi hlayisaka leswi nga vangiki swa mudyondzi un'we kumbe kwalifikheyixini yin'we. Ku nghenisa foludara ya kwalifikheyixini ku hlayisa milawu ya yona ya QMS laha hi ku hatlisa.
records.intro.from: The Quality Management System and its policies, accreditation letters, contracts, and statutory documents like the PAIA manual: everything the provider holds that does not belong to one learner or one qualification. Importing a qualification folder files its QMS policies here automatically.

records.introManage.text: Yi kombisa ni leswi fikeleke makumu ka nkarhi wa swona wo hlayisiwa.
records.introManage.from: It also shows what has reached the end of its retention period.

records.expiringNote.text: Xitifikeyiti xa xibalo lexi hundzeke nkarhi i xilo lexi munhu a nga xi xiyiki ku fikela vhiki leri xi lavekaka ha rona.
records.expiringNote.from: An expired tax clearance is the kind of thing nobody notices until the week it is needed.

records.libraryNote.text: Tivhezini leti cincisiweke ti hlayisiwa, hikuva mulawu lowu a wu fambisa hi Nyenyankulu hi lowu ku kambisisiwa ka Nyenyankulu ku wu vutisaka.
records.libraryNote.from: Superseded versions are kept, because the policy that governed in March is the one an audit of March asks about.

records.nothingManage.text: Papila ra ku amukeriwa hi nawu hi rona ra ku rhanga ku nghenisiwa.
records.nothingManage.from: The accreditation letter is the one worth putting in first.

records.everybody.text: un'wana ni un'wana a nga swi hlaya

records.retentionNote.text: Swi hlayiwa ku sukela hi siku ro tiyisiwa, ku tlula nkarhi wo hlayisiwa lowu vekiweke eka nhlengeletano leyi. A ku na nchumu lowu hlayisiweke exihlayiselweni kumbe ku herisiwa laha: pulatifomo yi vula leswi fanelaka, kutani munhu a endla xiboho.
records.retentionNote.from: Counted from the certification date, over the retention period on this tenant. Nothing here has been archived or destroyed: the platform says what is due and a person decides.

records.registerNote.text: Hinkwaswo leswi nga endliwa xiboho hi rhekhoda leyi hundzeke siku ra yona, ni loyi a endleke xiboho. Rhekhoda leyi nyamalaleke hi ku miyela yi biha ku tlula leyi hlayisiweke nkarhi wo leha.
records.registerNote.from: Everything decided about a record past its date, with who decided it. A record that quietly disappeared is worse than one kept too long.

records.referenceHint.text: Nomboro ya wena ya ku vekisa

records.replacesNote.text: Leyi yi yi cincisaka yi hlayisiwa naswona yi tsariwa leswaku yi cincisiwile. Mulawu lowu a wu fambisa hi Nyenyankulu hi lowu ku kambisisiwa ka Nyenyankulu ku wu vutisaka.
records.replacesNote.from: The one it replaces is kept and marked superseded. The policy that governed in March is what an audit of March asks about.

records.descriptionHint.text: Leswi yi nga swona, loko xihloko xi nga swi vuli
records.descriptionHint.from: What it is, if the title does not say

records.anybody.text: Un'wana ni un'wana loyi a nghenileko a nga swi hlaya
records.anybody.from: Anybody signed in may read this

records.anybodyNote.text: Swi tirha eka tidokumente ta nawu. Gayidi ya mudyondzi yi tshama yi kombisiwa vadyondzi; milawu, tikontiraka, ku amukeriwa hi nawu ni tidokumente leti tirhaka a ti kombisiwi.
records.anybodyNote.from: Applies to statutory documents. A learner guide is always shown to learners; policies, contracts, accreditation and operational documents never are.

records.archive.from: Archive: move it out of the way

records.keep.text: Yi hlayise ku tlula nkarhi wo hlayisiwa

records.whyDestroy.text: Hikwalaho ka yini leswi swi nga herisiwaka

records.whyKeep.text: Hikwalaho ka yini leswi swi hlayisiwaka

offline.intro.text: Dawunilowada leswi u swi lavaka u nga se huma. Nchumu wun'wana ni wun'wana lowu u wu tsalaka loko u nga ri kona wu hlayisiwa eka riqingho leri kutani wu rhumeriwa nakambe loko u ri ni signali.
offline.intro.from: Download what you need before you go out. Anything you record while you are away is kept on this phone and sent back the next time you have a signal.

offline.takeNote.text: Dawunilowada leswi u swi lavaka u nga se famba. A ku hlayisiwi nchumu lowu u nga wu kombelangiki.
offline.takeNote.from: Download what you need before you go. Nothing is kept that you did not ask for.

offline.nothingToStudy.text: A wu na nchumu wo dyondza sweswi. Nchumu wun'wana ni wun'wana lowu u tsarisiweke eka wona wu humelela laha leswaku wu dawunilowadiwa.
offline.nothingToStudy.from: You have nothing to study at the moment. Anything you are enrolled on appears here to download.

offline.recordNote.text: Wa tirha handle ka signali. Wu rindzela eka riqingho leri kutani wu famba loko u ri ni signali.
offline.recordNote.from: Works with no signal. It waits on this phone and goes when you next have one.

offline.waitingDecisionNote.text: Nchumu wu cincile loko mudyondzi a ri ehandle. A ku na nchumu lowu hlanganisiweke kumbe ku tsariwa ehenhla ka wona: munhu u fanele ku hlawula.
offline.waitingDecisionNote.from: Something changed while the learner was away. Nothing has been merged or overwritten: somebody has to choose.

offline.bothDates.text: Swi tsariwile eka xitirhisiwa {captured} · swi hi fikile {received}
offline.bothDates.from: Recorded on the device {captured} · reached us {received}

offline.relaxed.text: {count} leswi tsariweke hi nawu lowu olovaka

offline.relaxedNote.text: Ntirho lowu tsariweke loko purogirama leyi a yi pfumelela leswaku swa makumu swi tekiwa handle ka intanete. Loko purogirama yi amukeriwa hi nawu endzhaku, ntirho wolowo a wu nge sirheleki endzhaku ka nkarhi: leyi i nxaxamelo, hikwalaho i xiboho, a hi leswi u swi kumaka loko u endzeriwa hi mulavisisi.
offline.relaxedNote.from: Work recorded while this programme allowed summatives to be taken offline. If the programme is accredited later, that work does not become defensible retrospectively: this is the list, so it is a decision rather than a discovery at a monitoring visit.

offline.cannotHold.text: Browsara leyi a yi nge hlayisi swilo swa ku tirhisiwa handle ka signali. Hinkwaswo swi ha tirha hi ntolovelo loko u hlanganisiwile.
offline.cannotHold.from: This browser cannot hold material for use without a signal. Everything still works normally while you are connected.

offline.noSignal.text: A ku na signali: ku kombisiwa leswi hlayisiweke
offline.noSignal.from: No signal: showing what is held

offline.nothingHeld.text: A ku hlayisiwanga nchumu se. Pfula yuniti ya dyondzo u hlawula ku yi endla leswaku yi kumeka handle ka intanete u nga se huma.
offline.nothingHeld.from: Nothing is held yet. Open a study unit and choose to make it available offline before you go out.

offline.ofQuota.text: eka swa {quota} leswi riqingho leri swi nga pfumelelaka
offline.ofQuota.from: of about {quota} this phone will allow

offline.keepNote.text: Yi kombela riqingho leswaku ri nga swi susi loko u ri ehandle.
offline.keepNote.from: Asks the phone not to clear it while you are away.

offline.noRoom.text: A ku na ndhawu leyi ringanaka eka riqingho leri. Rhanga u susa leswi hlayisiweke yuniti yin'wana ya dyondzo: a ku dawunilowadiwanga nchumu.
offline.noRoom.from: There is not enough room on this phone. Remove something held for another study unit first: nothing has been downloaded.

offline.onPhone.text: {label} yi le riqingho leri. U nga yi hlaya handle ka signali.
offline.onPhone.from: {label} is on this phone. You can read it with no signal.

offline.incomplete.text: Leswi a swi dawunilowadiwanga hinkwaswo, hikwalaho a ku hlayisiwanga nchumu. Ringeta nakambe laha signali yi nga ni matimba.
offline.incomplete.from: That did not download completely, so none of it has been kept. Try again where the signal is better.

offline.released.text: {label} a yi ha hlayisiwi. Yi tshike ndhawu eka riqingho leri.
offline.released.from: {label} is no longer held. It freed up room on this phone.

offline.cannotKeep.text: Browsara leyi a yi nge hlayisi swilo swa ku tirhisiwa handle ka signali.
offline.cannotKeep.from: This browser cannot keep material for use without a signal.

offline.makeAvailable.text: Endla leswaku yi kumeka handle ka intanete

offline.pageOne.text: Phepha 1. Yi dawunilowade u nga se huma.
offline.pageOne.from: 1 page. Download it before you go out.

offline.pages.text: Tiphepha ta {count}. Yi dawunilowade u nga se huma.
offline.pages.from: {count} pages. Download it before you go out.

offline.writeFirst.text: Rhanga u tsala xihlamuselo kumbe u engetela xifaniso.
offline.writeFirst.from: Write a note or add a photograph first.

offline.willGo.text: Swi tsariwile eka riqingho leri. Swi ta famba loko u ri ni signali.
offline.willGo.from: Recorded on this phone. It will go when you have a signal.

offline.whatYouDidHint.text: Ndzi kambisise fensi eka ntila wa vuxa.
offline.whatYouDidHint.from: Inspected the fence line along the eastern boundary.

lrs.intro.text: Tirekhodo ta vadyondzi va wena, leti nghenaka ni leti humaka, tanihi switatimente swa xAPI: xivumbeko lexi xihlayiselo xa tirekhodo ta dyondzo ni tisisiteme to tala ta dyondzo ti xi cinjanaka. A ku na nchumu laha lowu cincaka mbuyelo wa mudyondzi eka pulatifomo leyi.
lrs.intro.from: Your learners' records, in and out, as xAPI statements: the format learning record stores and most learning systems exchange. Nothing here changes a learner's results on this platform.

lrs.outNote.text: Ku tsarisiwa ka xin'wana ni xin'wana, dyondzo leyi hetisiweke, nkambisiso lowu ringetiweke, xiboho xa wa swikota kumbe a nga swikoti ha, ndzetelo lowu hetisiweke, xitatimente xa mbuyelo, xitifikeyiti, ni xitifikeyiti xa kwalifikheyixini leyi amukeriweke, xitatimente xin'we xin'we. Xin'wana ni xin'wana xi tshama xi ri ni vun'wini lebyi fanaka minkarhi hinkwayo loko u humesa, hikwalaho ku nghenisa ku humesiwa kambirhi eka sisiteme yin'wana a ku nge pfuki ku phindha matimu ya munhu.
lrs.outNote.from: Every enrolment, lesson completed, assessment attempted, competent or not yet competent decision, course completed, statement of results, certificate, and qualification certificate received, one statement each. Each keeps the same identity every time you export, so loading two exports into another system does not double anybody's history.

lrs.downloadNote.text: Fayili yi vula vadyondzi hinkwavo ni tiadiresi ta vona ta imeyili. Yi hlayise hilaha u hlayisaka rhekhoda yin'wana ni yin'wana ya mahungu ya munhu n'wini.
lrs.downloadNote.from: The file names every learner and their email address. Keep it as you would any record of personal information.

lrs.store.text: Rhumela tirekhodo eka xihlayiselo xa wena xa tirekhodo ta dyondzo
lrs.store.from: Send records to your own learning record store

lrs.storeNote.text: Loko u na xihlayiselo xa tirekhodo ta dyondzo, xi hlanganise laha, kutani rhekhoda yin'wana ni yin'wana leyi nga ehenhla yi ya eka xona endzeni ka awara ya loko yi endliwile, leyi endliweke khale yi rhanga. Yin'wana ni yin'wana yi rhumeriwa kan'we; xitatimente lexi xihlayiselo xi nga na xona xi siyiwa hilaha xi nga kona. Xihundla xa xihlayiselo xi pfaleriwile eka pulatifomo leyi, a xi nge tlheli xi kombisiwa, naswona xi rivaleriwa loko u tshika ku hlanganisa.
lrs.storeNote.from: If you keep a learning record store, connect it here and every record above goes to it within the hour of happening, the ones already made first. Each is sent once; a statement the store already holds is left as it is. The store's secret is sealed on this platform, never shown again, and forgotten when you disconnect.

lrs.inNote.text: Fayili ya switatimente swa xAPI ku suka eka sisiteme yin'wana: nxaxamelo wa switatimente, kumbe leswi xihlayiselo xa tirekhodo ta dyondzo xi swi tlhelisaka. Xin'wana ni xin'wana xi fambisaniwa ni mudyondzi laha hi imeyili kutani xi kombisiwa eka rhekhoda ya yena. Xi hlayisiwa tanihi dyondzo leyi endliweke kun'wana, ku nga ri ku endliwa ku tsarisiwa kumbe mbuyelo laha, hikuva a ku na nchumu wa xona lowu dyondziseriweke kumbe ku kambisisiwa eka pulatifomo leyi.
lrs.inNote.from: A file of xAPI statements from another system: a list of statements, or what a learning record store returns. Each is matched to a learner here by email and shown on their record. It is kept as learning done elsewhere, not turned into an enrolment or a result here, because none of it was taught or assessed on this platform.

lrs.unmatched.from: Not matched to anybody here, and kept until they are: {names}. Invite them with the same email and their learning attaches.

verifyPage.intro.text: Nghenisa nomboro leyi printiweke eka xitifikeyiti. A ku lavekiwi akhawunti.
verifyPage.intro.from: Enter the reference printed on the certificate. No account is needed.

verifyPage.validStatementNote.text: Mudyondzi loyi u hetisile xipimelo xin'wana ni xin'wana xa nkambisiso wa le ndzeni eka kwalifikheyixini leyi nga laha hansi, naswona a nga tsarisiwa eka Nkambisiso wa Makumu lowu Hlanganisiweke wa le Handle.
verifyPage.validStatementNote.from: This learner has achieved every internal assessment criterion for the qualification below and may be entered for the External Integrated Summative Assessment.

verifyPage.doNotAccept.text: U nga amukeli dokumente leyi. Vulavula ni mupfuneti loyi a vuriweke eka yona loko mudyondzi a ehleketa leswaku leswi i xihoxo.
verifyPage.doNotAccept.from: Do not accept this document. Contact the provider named on it if the learner believes this is a mistake.

verifyPage.statementExpired.text: Xitatimente xa Mbuyelo xi hundzile nkarhi

verifyPage.expiredNote.text: Xitatimente xa Mbuyelo xa tirha malembe mambirhi ku sukela hi siku leri xi humesiweke ha rona. Lexi xi humesiwile hi {issued} kutani xi hundzile nkarhi hi {expired}.
verifyPage.expiredNote.from: A Statement of Results is valid for two years from the date it was issued. This one was issued on {issued} and expired on {expired}.

verifyPage.expiredNote2.text: A ku na xihoxo eka ku humelela ka mudyondzi: i dokumente leyi hundzeke nkarhi. Mupfuneti loyi a vuriweke eka yona a nga humesa leyi tirhaka.
verifyPage.expiredNote2.from: Nothing is wrong with the learner's achievement: it is the document that has run out. The provider named on it can issue a current one.

verifyPage.notFoundNote.text: A ku na xitifikeyiti lexi rhwalaka nomboro yoleyo. Yi kambisise eka dokumente: swikhale swa I, L, O, U, 0 ni 1 a swi tirhisiwi, hikwalaho 1 i 7 kumbe J, naswona O i Q kumbe D.
verifyPage.notFoundNote.from: No certificate carries that reference. Check it against the document: the characters I, L, O, U, 0 and 1 are never used, so a 1 is a 7 or a J, and an O is a Q or a D.

verifyPage.withdrawnDetail.text: Xi nyikiwe {holder} eka {title}, kutani xi tlhelisiwile hi {date}.
verifyPage.withdrawnDetail.from: It was issued to {holder} for {title}, and withdrawn on {date}.

verifyPage.notRely.from: It should not be relied on.

verifyPage.badgeNote.text: Leswi i rhekhoda ya mupfuneti n'wini leyi vulaka leswaku loyi a xi hlayisaka u hetisile yuniti leyi ya dyondzo. A hi kwalifikheyixini ya tiko, a yi na tikridithi, naswona a yi nyikiwi hi huvo ya vunene. Kwalifikheyixini yi kambisisiwa hi nomboro ya xitifikeyiti xa yona n'wini.
verifyPage.badgeNote.from: This is a provider's own record that the holder completed this module of study. It is not a national qualification, carries no credits, and is not awarded by a quality council. A qualification is verified by its own certificate reference.

platformPage.intro.text: Nhlengeletano yin'wana ni yin'wana eka pulatifomo. U nga vona leswaku yin'wana ni yin'wana yi tirhisa ngopfu ku fikela kwihi kutani u fambisa ku vekiwa ka yona, kambe a hi vadyondzi, tindzetelo kumbe tirekhodo ta nkambisiso ta vona. Ku amukela sisiteme ya muclayenti a hi ku fana ni ku va ni gandzelo ro yi hlaya, naswona pulatifomo yi swi tiyisa ku nga ri ku tshemba ku tiyiselela.
platformPage.intro.from: Every organisation on the platform. You can see how much each is using and manage their configuration, but not their learners, courses or assessment records. Hosting a client's system is not the same as being entitled to read it, and the platform enforces that rather than relying on restraint.

platformPage.noAdminOne.text: Nhlengeletano 1 a yi na mutirhisi-lonkulu. A ku na munhu laha la nga fambisaka sisiteme ya yena n'wini.
platformPage.noAdminOne.from: 1 organisation has no administrator. Nobody there can manage their own system.

platformPage.noAdmin.text: Tinhlengeletano ta {count} a ti na mutirhisi-lonkulu. A ku na munhu laha la nga fambisaka sisiteme ya yena n'wini.
platformPage.noAdmin.from: {count} organisations have no administrator. Nobody there can manage their own system.

newTenant.intro.text: Yi endla nhlengeletano ni mutirhisi-lonkulu wa yona wo sungula swin'we. Muclayenti loyi a nga na mutirhisi-lonkulu a nga nyikiwi, hikwalaho pulatifomo a yi ku pfumeleli ku endla loyi.
newTenant.intro.from: Creates the organisation and its first administrator together. A client without an administrator cannot be handed over, so the platform does not let you make one.

folderPick.notSaved.from: Nothing is saved until you have checked it.

folderPick.stillGoing.from: Still going: {minutes} min {seconds}s. This is normal for a large folder; leave the page open.

folderPick.onNote.text: Foludara leyi nga katsiki nkomiso wa yona n'wini yi ta va ni xivumbeko xa yona lexi kumiweke ku suka eka tidokumente: xi hlwela, naswona xi fanele ku kambisisiwa hi dokumente ya kharikhulamu. Yi pfale loko u heta ku yi tirhisa.
folderPick.onNote.from: A folder that does not include a summary of itself will have its structure worked out from the documents instead: slower, and worth checking against the curriculum document. Switch it off when you are done with it.

folderPick.noneTitle.text: A wu na ku engetelela ka AI loku vekiweke.
folderPick.noneTitle.from: You do not have an AI extension set up.

folderPick.noneNote.text: Ku engetelela nchumu wun'we laha: ku kuma xivumbeko ku suka eka tidokumente, loko foludara yi nga katsi nkomiso wa yona n'wini. Hinkwaswo leswi nga eka rhijisi leri swi tirha handle ka ku engetelela loku. Swivekiwa, ehansi ka ku engetelela ka wena ka AI, loko u lava yin'we.
folderPick.noneNote.from: It adds one thing here: working out the structure from the documents, when a folder does not include a summary of itself. Everything else on this page works without it. Settings, under your AI extension, if you want one.

folderPick.cannotTitle.text: Ku engetelela ka wena ka AI a ku nge tirhi laha.

folderPick.cannotNote.text: Foludara leyi katsaka nkomiso wa yona n'wini yi ha nghenisiwa hi ntolovelo; leyi nga na wona a yi nge kumi xivumbeko xa yona.
folderPick.cannotNote.from: A folder that includes a summary of itself still imports normally; one without it cannot have its structure worked out.

folderPick.offTitle.text: Ku engetelela ka wena ka AI ku pfaleriwile, hi ndlela leyi ku tshama hinkwako ku sungulaka ha yona.
folderPick.offTitle.from: Your AI extension is off, which is how every sitting starts.

folderPick.offNote.text: Ku engetelela nchumu wun'we laha: ku kuma xivumbeko ku suka eka tidokumente, loko foludara yi nga katsi nkomiso wa yona n'wini. Hinkwaswo leswi nga eka rhijisi leri swi tirha handle ka ku engetelela loku.
folderPick.offNote.from: It adds one thing here: working out the structure from the documents, when a folder does not include a summary of itself. Everything else on this page works without it.

said.alignment-matrix.2b19415b.text: Leyo i dokumente ya Word. Dokumente n'wini yi hlayisiwile, yi tsariwile naswona yi nga lavisisiwa. Leswi nga endliwangiki i ku yi hlaya, hikuva matrikisi yo fambisana yi hlayiwa tanihi spredshiti: rho rin'we eka layini yin'wana ni yin'wana ya kharikhulamu, ni kholomo leyi nga na xihloko lexi fanaka ni “Topic Elements”. Hlayisa matrikisi tanihi spredshiti u yi tlakusa na yona, kutani layini yin'wana ni yin'wana ya kharikhulamu yi ta kombisa leswi yi nga hlayiwaka hi swona.
said.alignment-matrix.2b19415b.from: That is a Word document. The document itself is kept, filed and searchable. What could not happen is reading it, because the alignment matrix is read as a spreadsheet: one row per curriculum line, with a column headed something like “Topic Elements”. Save the matrix as a spreadsheet and upload that as well, and each line of the curriculum will show what covers it.

said.conduct.07e411c2.text: Vula leswaku xivilelo xi vulavula hi yini, hi marito ya mudyondzi n'wini laha swi kotekaka.
said.conduct.07e411c2.from: Say what the grievance is about, in the learner's own words where possible.

said.conduct.1636d693.text: Xivilelo xi vula {firstName} {lastName}. Munhu loyi xikhomelo xi mu vulavulaka a nge xi lavisisi: endlelo ri lava munhu la thyiweke la lulameke. Veka un'wana.
said.conduct.1636d693.from: The grievance names {firstName} {lastName}. Somebody the complaint is about cannot investigate it: the procedure asks for a designated impartial person. Appoint somebody else.

said.conduct.1d25ed57.text: Xitiviso xi fanele ku vula swikombiso swo karhi. Nhlengeletano hi swikombiso leswi nga vuriwangiki a yi nge hlamuriwi.
said.conduct.1d25ed57.from: The notice has to state the specific allegations. A hearing about unstated allegations cannot be answered.

said.conduct.1e2d5837.text: Swi tsariwile. Masiku ya ntirho ya ntlhanu ya ku kombela ku pfuxeta ma sungula namuntlha.
said.conduct.1e2d5837.from: Recorded. The five working days to appeal run from today.

said.conduct.1efe5ff4.text: Nhlengeletano ya ku yingiseriwa a yi kumiwanga.

said.conduct.303f7f08.text: Vula switshunxo leswi nga endliwaka, ku katsa ku herisiwa laha swi nga ta endliwa. Mudyondzi loyi a vonaka loko a ta tisa mupfuni u fanele ku tiva leswi nga ta lahleka.
said.conduct.303f7f08.from: Say what sanctions are possible, including termination where it is. A learner deciding whether to bring assistance needs to know what is at stake.

said.conduct.403b3f35.text: Vula xivangelo. Xitshunxo lexi nga hlamuseriwangiki a xi lweriwi, naswona lexi i ndzimana leyi mudyondzi a nga na mfanelo ya yona.
said.conduct.403b3f35.from: Say why. An unexplained sanction is indefensible, and this is the paragraph the learner is entitled to.

said.conduct.47a20502.text: Vula nawu lowu tshoviweke, xiyimo lexi rindzeriweke ni leswi humelelaka loko swi tlhela swi endleka. Xilemukiso lexi nga endliki sweswo a hi xilemukiso.
said.conduct.47a20502.from: State the rule broken, the standard expected and what happens if it recurs. A warning that does not is not one.

said.conduct.4dcaf05f.text: Leswo a hi siku ni nkarhi.
said.conduct.4dcaf05f.from: That is not a date and time.

said.conduct.64f7462f.text: Xitiviso xi fanele ku byela mudyondzi leswaku u nga pfuniwa hi mudyondzi kumbe u nga tisa mhaka ya yena, naswona u nga vitana ni ku vutisa timbhoni. Rhumela xitiviso lexi endlaka sweswo, kutani u xi tsala laha.
said.conduct.64f7462f.from: The notice must tell the learner they may be assisted by a fellow learner, present their case, and call and question witnesses. Send a notice that does, then record it here.

said.conduct.67f9675a.text: Tsala leswi kumiweke ni leswi swi sekeriweke eka swona. Nhlengeletano leyi swikumiwa swa yona ku nga ri mutsari wun'we i nhlengeletano leyi nga ka yi nga endliwanga.
said.conduct.67f9675a.from: Record what was found and on what basis. A hearing whose findings are one line is a hearing that did not happen.

said.conduct.6a6b5da7.from: It has to be acknowledged by {acknowledgeBy}.

said.conduct.6d857ec5.text: Ku herisa purogirama ya munhu ku lava nhlengeletano leyi endliweke, ni swikumiwa swa yona leswi tsariweke. Vitana yin'we, tsala leswi kumiweke, kutani u pfala mhaka.
said.conduct.6d857ec5.from: Ending somebody's programme needs a hearing that was held, with its findings recorded. Convene one, record what was found, then close the case.

said.conduct.77c80d2a.text: Swi tlhandlamisiwile. Swi ta amukeriwa endzeni ka masiku ya ntirho ya mbirhi.
said.conduct.77c80d2a.from: Lodged. It will be acknowledged within two working days.

said.conduct.869c74ee.text: Nhlengeletano yi lava xitiviso xa tiawara ta {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} ni ku tlula, naswona leri ri kayivela awara ya {hours}. Nkarhi wo sungula lowu yi nga tshamiwaka hi wona i {earliest}. Xitiviso xo koma i xihoxo lexi xikombelo xi hlulaka hi xona, ku nga khathariseki leswi mudyondzi a swi endleke.
said.conduct.869c74ee.from: A hearing needs at least {HEARING_NOTICE_HOURS} hours' notice and this is {hours} hour short. The earliest it can be held is {earliest}. Short notice is the defect an appeal is won on, whatever the learner did.

said.conduct.8d0ef3ad.text: Nhlengeletano yi vitaniwile. Nkarhi wa xitiviso wu hetisisiwile.
said.conduct.8d0ef3ad.from: Hearing convened. The notice period is met.

said.conduct.9f172fca.text: Mudyondzi a nge lavisisi xivilelo xa yena n'wini.
said.conduct.9f172fca.from: The learner cannot investigate their own grievance.

said.conduct.ad753d2e.text: Xiboho xi ya eka mudyondzi hi matsalwa naswona xi fanele ku vula leswi kumiweke ni leswi nga ta endliwa. Mutsari wun'we a hi xiboho.
said.conduct.ad753d2e.from: The decision goes to the learner in writing and has to say what was found and what will be done. A line is not a decision.

said.conduct.b0301d88.text: Vula leswi vuriwaka, hi ndlela yo karhi. Mudyondzi a nge hlamuli 'mahanyelo yo biha', naswona ni nhlengeletano a yi nge swi kotiki.
said.conduct.b0301d88.from: Say what is alleged, specifically. A learner cannot answer 'poor attitude', and neither can a hearing.

said.conduct.b0dcbd53.text: Ku vekiwile xiboho, naswona mudyondzi u na xona hi matsalwa.
said.conduct.b0dcbd53.from: Decided, and the learner has it in writing.

said.drive-google-drive.0281fa79.text: Google a yi vuyisanga tokeni yo fikelela.
said.drive-google-drive.0281fa79.from: Google did not return an access token.

said.drive-google-drive.3ad31c62.text: Google a yi ha amukeli vuhlanganisi byoleyo. Swi nga endleka swi susiwile eka akhawunti ya wena ya Google. Hlanganisa drayivu nakambe eka Swivekiwa.
said.drive-google-drive.3ad31c62.from: Google no longer accepts that connection. It may have been withdrawn from your Google account. Connect the drive again in Settings.

said.drive-google-drive.8761e449.text: Foludara yoleyo a yi kona, kumbe akhawunti leyi u yi hlanganiseke a yi yi voni. Foludara leyi avelaniweke na wena yi fanele ku pfuriwa eka Drive kan'we ku nga si hlayiwa.
said.drive-google-drive.8761e449.from: That folder is not there, or the account you connected cannot see it. A folder shared with you has to be opened in Drive at least once before it can be read.

said.drive-google-drive.b744db3d.text: Google yi arile xikombelo xexo. Loko swi vula kota, ku fikeleriwile ku pimiwa ka Drive API ka ndhawu leyi hi sweswi. {message}
said.drive-google-drive.b744db3d.from: Google refused that request. If it mentions a quota, the deployment's Drive API limit has been reached for now. {message}

said.drive-google-drive.c0c95fa0.text: Google a yi vuyisanga ndlela yo pfuxeta vuhlanganisi, leswi hakanyingi swi vulaka leswaku akhawunti leyi yi se yi swi nyikile. Susa ku fikelela ka pulatifomo eka akhawunti ya wena ya Google ehansi ka Third-party apps, kutani u hlanganisa nakambe.
said.drive-google-drive.c0c95fa0.from: Google did not return a way to renew the connection, which usually means this account had already granted it. Remove the platform's access in your Google account under Third-party apps, then connect again.

said.drive-google-drive.dcf45956.text: "{name}" yi kulu ngopfu leswaku Google yi yi humesa hi xiphemu xin'we. Dawunilowada dokumente yoleyo yin'we eka Drive tanihi {extension} kutani u yi engetela yi ri yoxe endzhaku; hinkwaswo leswi nga eka foludara swi hlayiwa hi ndlela yo tolovelekile.
said.drive-google-drive.dcf45956.from: "{name}" is too large for Google to export in one piece. Download that one document from Drive as {extension} and add it on its own afterwards; everything else in the folder reads normally.

said.drive-google-drive.e9fe6eee.text: Hlaya foludara hi ku kongoma ku suka eka Google Drive ya wena. Ku hlaya ntsena: pulatifomo yi nga kombisa rhijisi ni ku dawunilowada, kambe a yi nge vumbi, yi cinca kumbe yi susa nchumu. U nga yi susa laha kumbe eka akhawunti ya wena ya Google nkarhi wihi na wihi.
said.drive-google-drive.e9fe6eee.from: Read a folder straight from your Google Drive. Read-only: the platform can list and download, and cannot create, change or delete anything. You can withdraw it here or from your Google account at any time.

said.drive-import.1f557235.text: Foludara yoleyo a yi na nchumu lowu pulatifomo yi nga wu hlayaka. Tidokumente, tispredshiti ni tipresentheyixini hinkwato ti a hlayiwa, ku katsa leti humaka eka Google, hikwalaho mbuyelo wo hava wu vula leswaku foludara yi nga na nchumu, kumbe yi na swilo ntsena ku fana ni Forms ni tindlela to hatlisa.
said.drive-import.1f557235.from: That folder has nothing in it the platform can read. Documents, spreadsheets and presentations are all read, including Google's own, so an empty result means the folder really is empty, or holds only things like Forms and shortcuts.

said.drive-one-drive.2f5a255d.from: Microsoft did not return an access token.

said.drive-one-drive.4180c6e1.text: Microsoft a yi vuyisanga ndlela yo pfuxeta vuhlanganisi. Xitirhisiwa xi nga ha ri xi nga kombeli ku fikelela loku nga na vuhlanganisi handle.
said.drive-one-drive.4180c6e1.from: Microsoft did not return a way to renew the connection. The application may not be asking for offline access.

said.drive-one-drive.74ff1cef.text: Microsoft yi arile xikombelo xexo. Akhawunti leyi u yi hlanganiseke yi nga ha ri yi nga na ku fikelela eka foludara yoleyo. {message}
said.drive-one-drive.74ff1cef.from: Microsoft refused that request. The account you connected may not have access to that folder. {message}

said.drive-one-drive.a65a4207.text: Microsoft a yi ha amukeli vuhlanganisi byoleyo. Swi nga endleka swi susiwile eka akhawunti ya wena. Hlanganisa drayivu nakambe eka Swivekiwa.
said.drive-one-drive.a65a4207.from: Microsoft no longer accepts that connection. It may have been withdrawn from your account. Connect the drive again in Settings.

said.drive-one-drive.c6aef863.text: Hlaya foludara hi ku kongoma ku suka eka OneDrive ya wena. Ku hlaya ntsena: pulatifomo yi nga kombisa rhijisi ni ku dawunilowada, kambe a yi nge vumbi, yi cinca kumbe yi susa nchumu. U nga yi susa laha kumbe eka akhawunti ya wena ya Microsoft nkarhi wihi na wihi.
said.drive-one-drive.c6aef863.from: Read a folder straight from your OneDrive. Read-only: the platform can list and download, and cannot create, change or delete anything. You can withdraw it here or from your Microsoft account at any time.

said.eisa-registration.3015ea44.text: Ku tsarisiwa a ku nge pfaleki endzhaku ka ku tshama loku ku nga ka kona.
said.eisa-registration.3015ea44.from: Registration cannot close after the sitting it is for.

said.eisa-sitting-notice.4242bc7f.text: A ku na ku tshama loku tsariweke ka {subject}. Masiku ma suka eka papila ra muhlanganyeri wa vunene bya nkambisiso, naswona ma cinca lembe na lembe. Ku fikela ma nghenisiwa, a ku na nchumu laha lowu nga ku tsundzuxaka leswaku siku ro hetelela ra ku tsarisiwa ri ta.
said.eisa-sitting-notice.4242bc7f.from: No sittings are recorded for {subject}. The dates come from the assessment quality partner's letter and change every year. Until they are entered, nothing here can warn you that a registration deadline is coming.

said.eisa-sitting-notice.b6bf1cc3.text: A ku na ku tshama loku tsariweke ka {subject}. Muhlanganyeri wa vunene bya nkambisiso u kandziyisa masiku eDisemba, hikwalaho papila ri fanele ku va ri humile: ma engetele kutani ku hlayiwa ka masiku ku sungula.
said.eisa-sitting-notice.b6bf1cc3.from: No sittings are recorded for {subject}. The assessment quality partner publishes the dates in December, so the letter should be out: add them and the countdown starts.

said.eisa-sitting-notice.d6b538b0.text: A ku na ku tshama loku tsariweke. Ku tshama loku ku suka eka papila ra muhlanganyeri wa vunene bya nkambisiso, leri kandziyisiwaka kan'we hi lembe.
said.eisa-sitting-notice.d6b538b0.from: No sittings are recorded. They come from the assessment quality partner's letter, which is published once a year.

said.eisa.041d2d1d.text: Swi tsariwile. Ku hlayiwa ka masiku ku ya eku tsarisiweni ku sungula sweswi.
said.eisa.041d2d1d.from: Recorded. The countdown to registration starts now.

said.eisa.18104c26.text: A ku pfuriwanga bukwana ya ntirho ya ntokoto wa ntirho.
said.eisa.18104c26.from: No work experience logbook has been opened.

said.eisa.235f3916.text: Yi tlheliseriwile hi mukoki wa ntirho leswaku ku engeteriwa vumbhoni.
said.eisa.235f3916.from: Returned by the workplace coach for more evidence.

said.eisa.2d36e0ea.text: Yi sayiniwile hi mukoki wa ntirho, yi rindzele leswaku mukambisisi a yi amukela.
said.eisa.2d36e0ea.from: Signed by the workplace coach, waiting for an assessor to accept it.

said.eisa.aabe4744.text: Yi le ka mukoki wa ntirho leswaku a yi sayina.
said.eisa.aabe4744.from: With the workplace coach for signature.

said.enrolment-document-shape.04f2917b.text: Ku tiyisisiwa ka kopi leyi ku tlula nkarhi lowu pfumeleriweke. Hi kombela u tiyisisa kopi leyintshwa.
said.enrolment-document-shape.04f2917b.from: The certification is older than the period allowed. Please have a fresh copy certified.

said.enrolment-document-shape.3d15f524.text: Leyi a hi kopi leyi tiyisisiweke. Hi kombela u yi tiyisisa kutani u yi rhumela nakambe.
said.enrolment-document-shape.3d15f524.from: This is not a certified copy. Please have it certified and send it again.

said.enrolment-document-shape.8d2c9fdc.text: Kopi a yi hlayeki. Hi kombela u yi skena kumbe u yi teka xifaniso nakambe, yi ri yi lulamile ni ku vonakala kahle.
said.enrolment-document-shape.8d2c9fdc.from: The copy is not legible. Please scan or photograph it again, flat and in good light.

said.enrolment-document-shape.a7aecdc1.text: ID yi na siku ro tiyisisa ku tlula rin'we. Hi kombela u nyika kopi leyi tiyisisiweke kan'we, ku nga ri khale.
said.enrolment-document-shape.a7aecdc1.from: The ID has more than one certification date on it. Please supply a copy certified once, recently.

said.enrolment-document-shape.ad8ee9a7.text: Leyi a hi dokumente leyi kombeliweke.
said.enrolment-document-shape.ad8ee9a7.from: This is not the document that was asked for.

said.enrolment-document-shape.d9deb62d.from: Some of the pages are missing.

said.enrolment-documents.07cca752.text: A ku na leswi tsariweke: hambi ntlawa kumbe mudyondzi a va na ku hakeliwa loku tsariweke eka vona.
said.enrolment-documents.07cca752.from: Nothing recorded: neither the cohort nor the learner has a payment against them.

said.enrolment-documents.221ad898.from: Paid for by the client, against {name}.

said.enrolment-documents.26e4b850.text: Nyika siku leri kopi leyi yi tiyisisiweke ha rona. Kopi leyi siku ra yona ra ku tiyisisiwa ri nga tiviwiki a yi nge kombisiwi leswaku yi ha tirha.
said.enrolment-documents.26e4b850.from: Give the date this copy was certified. A copy whose certification date is unknown cannot be shown to be current.

said.enrolment-documents.330b87d3.text: Mudyondzi u nyike vumbhoni bya yena bya ku hakelela.
said.enrolment-documents.330b87d3.from: The learner supplied their own proof of payment.

said.enrolment-documents.3f1d945a.text: Mudyondzi u nyike vumbhoni bya ku hakelela, lebyi nga se kambisisiwaka.
said.enrolment-documents.3f1d945a.from: The learner has supplied a proof of payment, not yet checked.

said.enrolment-documents.435df660.text: Vumbhoni bya mudyondzi bya ku hakelela byi alaniwile.
said.enrolment-documents.435df660.from: The learner's proof of payment was refused.

said.enrolment-documents.98317f79.text: Vula xivangelo xa ku alaniwa. Mudyondzi u fanele ku byeriwa leswi fanelaka ku lulamisiwa, kutani ku alana loku nga na xivangelo ku n'wi tlherisela a nga na nchumu lowu a nga wu endlaka.
said.enrolment-documents.98317f79.from: Say why it was refused. The learner has to be told what to correct, and a refusal with no reason sends them back with nothing to act on.

said.enrolment-documents.d417e6fa.text: Kopi yoleyo yi tiyisisiwe hi {certifiedOn}, leswi tlulaka masiku ya {CERTIFICATION_VALID_DAYS}. Kopi leyi tiyisisiweke yi fanele ku va yi ha tirha loko yi nyikiwa.
said.enrolment-documents.d417e6fa.from: That copy was certified on {certifiedOn}, which is more than {CERTIFICATION_VALID_DAYS} days ago. A certified copy has to be current when it is supplied.

said.enrolment-form.0ab864d3.text: A ku na mudyondzi wo tano.

said.enrolment-form.141771ac.text: Ku suka eka rhijisi ra tikhodi ta swindhawu ta STATSSA leri QCTO yi ri kandziyisaka.
said.enrolment-form.141771ac.from: From the STATSSA area code list the QCTO publishes.

said.enrolment-form.158eb69b.text: Mbiko wu vutisa loko mudyondzi a pfumerile, ni hi siku rihi.
said.enrolment-form.158eb69b.from: The return asks whether the learner agreed, and on what date.

said.enrolment-form.3ecff80b.text: Rimbewu leri tsariweke a ri fambisani ni leri nga eka nomboro ya vun'wini. QCTO yi swi kambisisa, hikwalaho yin'we ya mimbirhi yi tsariwe hi ku hoxa.
said.enrolment-form.3ecff80b.from: The gender recorded does not match the one in the identity number. The QCTO checks this, so one of the two is mistyped.

said.enrolment-form.5d06240c.text: Siku ro velekiwa leri tsariweke ({recorded}) a ri fambisani ni nomboro ya vun'wini, leyi vulaka {fromId}.
said.enrolment-form.5d06240c.from: The date of birth recorded ({recorded}) does not match the identity number, which says {fromId}.

said.enrolment-form.7d5cda8a.text: Swi tiyisisiwile, ni siku ri tsariwile. Loko u cinca nchumu laha endzhaku, u ta kombeliwa ku tiyisisa nakambe.
said.enrolment-form.7d5cda8a.from: Confirmed, and the date recorded. Change anything here later and it will ask you to confirm again.

said.enrolment-form.a380df96.text: Swi hlayisiwile. U nga tlhela u ta u swi heta endzhaku.
said.enrolment-form.a380df96.from: Saved. You can come back and finish it later.

said.enrolment-form.a8dcc4e9.text: Nomboro ya vun'wini a yi tiyisisiwi: {reason}
said.enrolment-form.a8dcc4e9.from: The identity number does not check out: {reason}

said.enrolment-form.b67325d1.text: A ku na munhu loyi a tiyisiseke leswaku vuxokoxoko lebyi byi lulamile. Mulanguteri u kombela foromo tanihi vumbhoni, kutani leyi nga tiyisisiwangiki i vumbhoni byi nga ri na nkoka.
said.enrolment-form.b67325d1.from: Nobody has confirmed these details are right. A monitor asks for the form as evidence, and an unconfirmed one is evidence of very little.

said.enrolment-form.b711b7ce.text: Vuhlanya bya miri byi tsariwile, kutani QCTO yi lava ku tiva leswaku byi vangela ku tika ku fikela kwihi.
said.enrolment-form.b711b7ce.from: A disability was recorded, and the QCTO then requires how much difficulty it causes.

said.enrolment-form.ca9579a9.text: Xifundzha lexi mudyondzi a tirhaka eka xona, lexi hi minkarhi hinkwayo xi nga ri laha a tshamaka kona.
said.enrolment-form.ca9579a9.from: The province the learner works in, which is not always where they live.

said.enrolment.2f3e062d.text: Swi fanele ku endliwa ku nga si hela {dueDate}.

said.enrolment.52c9b5f2.text: Ndzetelo lowu kandziyisiweke ntsena wu nga averiwa mudyondzi.
said.enrolment.52c9b5f2.from: Only a published course can be assigned to a learner.

said.enrolment.65b99bc7.text: Munhu yoleyo se u tsarisiwile eka ndzetelo lowu.
said.enrolment.65b99bc7.from: That person is already enrolled on this course.

said.enrolment.678cc7c5.text: A ku na siku ro hetelela eka leyi.
said.enrolment.678cc7c5.from: There is no due date on this one.

said.enrolment.6ac9079d.text: Ku tsarisiwa loku i ka un'wana.
said.enrolment.6ac9079d.from: That enrolment belongs to someone else.

said.enrolment.79fda720.text: Mudyondzi ntsena a nga tsala ku hluvuka ka yena.
said.enrolment.79fda720.from: Only the learner can record their own progress.

said.enrolment.ab1eec65.text: Dyondzo yoleyo a hi xiphemu xa ndzetelo lowu.
said.enrolment.ab1eec65.from: That lesson is not part of this course.

said.extensions-claude-code.149b1d9d.text: Claude Code a yi vekiwanga laha pulatifomo yi tirhaka kona.
said.extensions-claude-code.149b1d9d.from: Claude Code is not installed where the platform is running.

said.extensions-claude-code.1c9bd1dc.text: Claude Code yi vekiwile eka muchini lowu kambe a ku na munhu la nghenaka. Pfula theminali, u tirha claude, kutani /login u heta ku nghena eka buraweza. Leswi i xiendlo xa kan'we, naswona xi endliwa hi wena, ku nga ri hi pulatifomo.
said.extensions-claude-code.1c9bd1dc.from: Claude Code is installed on this machine but nobody is signed in. Open a terminal, run claude, then /login and complete the sign-in in the browser. That is a one-time step and it is done by you, not by the platform.

said.extensions-claude-code.30018e0d.text: A ku kotiwanga ku sungula Claude Code: {error}

said.extensions-claude-code.446b5c16.text: Claude Code a yi vuyisanga nchumu.

said.extensions-claude-code.53fe3e99.text: Ku pimiwa ka ku tirhisiwa ka sabsikripishini ya Claude ku fikeleriwile. Leswi swi ta tlhela swi tirha loko ku pimiwa loku ku sungula nakambe.
said.extensions-claude-code.53fe3e99.from: The Claude subscription's usage limit has been reached. This will work again once the limit resets.

said.extensions-claude-code.7f69ba19.text: Yi tirhisa sabsikripishini ya wena n'wini ya Claude, hi tokeni leyi u yi endlaka eka khompyuta ya wena n'wini hi `claude setup-token`. A hi khii ya API: a ku na ntsengo wa tokeni yin'wana ni yin'wana, naswona yi tirhisa sabsikripishini leyi se u yi hakelaka ku nga ri leyi avelaniweke.
said.extensions-claude-code.7f69ba19.from: Uses your own Claude subscription, through a token you generate on your own computer with `claude setup-token`. Not an API key: no per-token cost, and it draws on the subscription you already pay for rather than a shared one.

said.extensions-claude-code.801580be.text: Claude Code a yi hlamuleli endzeni ka tisekonto ta {timeoutMs}.
said.extensions-claude-code.801580be.from: Claude Code did not answer within {timeoutMs} seconds.

said.extensions-gemini.0473bc2d.text: A ku na khii ya API ya Gemini leyi hlayisiweke eka wena. Yi engetele eka Swivekiwa. Yi suka eka Google AI Studio, naswona a yi fani ni sabsikripishini ya Gemini.
said.extensions-gemini.0473bc2d.from: No Gemini API key is stored for you. Add one in Settings. It comes from Google AI Studio, and is not the same as a Gemini subscription.

said.extensions-gemini.18ddcba7.text: Khii yoleyo ya API ya Gemini a yi tirhi. Kambisisa leswaku yi kopiwile hinkwayo ku suka eka Google AI Studio. A yi fani ni sabsikripishini ya Gemini Advanced, leyi nga ri na ku fikelela ka API.
said.extensions-gemini.18ddcba7.from: That Gemini API key is not valid. Check it was copied whole from Google AI Studio. It is not the same thing as a Gemini Advanced subscription, which does not include API access.

said.extensions-gemini.3bf73475.text: Nkarhi wa Google wa ku pimiwa ka khii yoleyo wu fikeleriwile. Xiyimo xa mahala xi pfumelela swikombelo swi ringaneke hi meniti; yimela u ringeta nakambe, kumbe u tirhisa khii leyi hakeleriwaka.
said.extensions-gemini.3bf73475.from: Google's rate limit for that key has been reached. The free tier allows a limited number of requests a minute; wait and try again, or use a key with billing enabled.

said.extensions-gemini.599b82c0.text: Gemini a yi hlamulanga hi nkarhi. Foludara yi kulu yi nga teka timinete to tala; ku ringeta nakambe hi tidokumente to tsongo ku tolovelekile ku tirha.
said.extensions-gemini.599b82c0.from: Gemini did not answer in time. A large folder can take several minutes; trying again with fewer documents in it usually works.

said.extensions-gemini.5f764f27.text: A ku kotiwanga ku fika eka Gemini. Kambisisa leswaku muchini lowu wu na vuhlanganisi bya intanete ni Google.
said.extensions-gemini.5f764f27.from: Gemini could not be reached. Check that this machine has a network connection to Google.

said.extensions-gemini.6ff1fd27.text: Gemini yi helelwe hi ndhawu ku nga si heta ku hlamula, hikwalaho leswi vuyeke i xiphemu xa kharikhulamu ku nga ri hinkwayo, naswona leyi nga hetiwangiki yi vonaka yi fana ni leyi hetiweke. A ku hlayisiwanga nchumu. Kwalifikheyixini hinkwayo i nchumu lowu kulu ngopfu leswaku wu kombeleriwa hi ku hlamula kan'we; yi nghenise ku suka eka tidokumente ta yona, leswi hlayaka kharikhulamu hi ku kongoma handle ka model ni ku nga ri na ku pimiwa ka muxaka lowu.
said.extensions-gemini.6ff1fd27.from: Gemini ran out of room before it finished answering, so what came back is part of a curriculum rather than all of it, and a partial one looks exactly like a complete one. Nothing was kept. A whole qualification is a great deal to ask for in a single reply; import it from its documents instead, which reads the curriculum directly with no model involved and no limit of this kind.

said.extensions-gemini.7b1ee4ba.text: Gemini yi hlamule hi ku nga vuyisi nchumu. Hakanyingi leswi swi vula leswaku xikombelo xi arisiwile hi xihlawuleri xa vuhlayiseki, kumbe vito ra model a ri lulamanga.
said.extensions-gemini.7b1ee4ba.from: Gemini answered with nothing. That usually means the request was refused by a safety filter, or the model name is wrong.

said.extensions-gemini.a3035142.text: Tidokumente teto ti tlula timfungho ta {MAX_INPUT_CHARS},000, leswi tlulaka leswi swi nga rhumeriwaka hi xikombelo xin'we. Nghenisa kwalifikheyixini ku suka eka tidokumente ta yona: dokumente ya kharikhulamu yoxe yi hlayiwa hi ku kongoma, handle ka model.
said.extensions-gemini.a3035142.from: Those documents come to more than {MAX_INPUT_CHARS},000 characters, which is more than can be sent in one request. Import the qualification from its documents instead: the curriculum document alone is read directly, with no model involved.

said.extensions-gemini.c9f3d2b7.text: Google yi tivise ku va ni xiphiqo eka vona ({status}). Xikombelo xo tsongo xi fanele ku ringetiwa nakambe. Loko leswi a ku ri kwalifikheyixini hinkwayo naswona yi hluleke ku tlula kan'we, xikombelo xi nga ha va xi kulu ngopfu leswaku model yi xi heta. Yi nghenise ku suka eka tidokumente ta yona, leswi hlayaka kharikhulamu hi ku kongoma.
said.extensions-gemini.c9f3d2b7.from: Google reported a problem on their side ({status}). A small request is worth simply trying again. If this was a whole qualification and it has now failed more than once, the request is most likely too large for the model to complete. Import it from its documents instead, which reads the curriculum directly with no model involved.

said.extensions-gemini.d7ab5352.text: Google yi arile khii yoleyo. Yi nga ha va yi susiwile, kumbe Generative Language API yi nga ha va yi nga tirhisiwi eka phurojeke leyi yi nga ya yona. A ku na xiphiqo eka pulatifomo naswona a ku lahlekanga nchumu.
said.extensions-gemini.d7ab5352.from: Google refused that key. It may have been revoked, or the Generative Language API may not be enabled on the project it belongs to. Nothing is wrong with the platform and nothing was lost.

said.extensions-gemini.eb60a381.text: Yi tirhisa khii ya wena n'wini ya API ya Google AI Studio. A hi sabsikripishini ya Gemini Advanced: leyo i xihlahluva xin'wana naswona a yi katsi ku fikelela ka API. API yi na xiyimo xa mahala, hikwalaho yi nga tirhisiwa handle ko xava nchumu, endzeni ka swipimelo swa yona.
said.extensions-gemini.eb60a381.from: Uses your own Google AI Studio API key. Not a Gemini Advanced subscription: that is a separate product and does not include API access. The API has a free tier, so this can be used without buying anything, within its rate limits.

said.extensions-index.002e7790.text: Sungula u hlayisa {word}: rhijisi ri suka eka mupfuneti, naswona wu yi lava ku hlamula.
said.extensions-index.002e7790.from: Save a {word} first: the list comes from the provider, and it needs one to answer.

said.extensions-index.63d1c167.text: Tokeni ya wena leyi hlayisiweke a yi hlayiwi. Hakanyingi leswi swi vula leswaku xihundla xa sevha xi cincile ku sukela loko u yi hlayisa. Namarhela leyintshwa eka rhijisi ra akhawunti ya wena.
said.extensions-index.63d1c167.from: Your stored token could not be read. This usually means the server's secret has changed since you saved it. Paste a fresh one on your account page.

said.extensions-index.7d55f18c.from: Choose a provider the platform knows.

said.extensions-index.879f4ba6.from: Save an {word} first: the list comes from the provider, and it needs one to answer.

said.extensions-index.8af96ab7.text: Leswi a swi fani ni {article} {name} {word}. Ku yi kuma, {source}.
said.extensions-index.8af96ab7.from: That does not look like {article} {name} {word}. To get one, {source}.

said.extensions-index.8b099549.from: Paste a {word} first. To get one, {source}.

said.extensions-index.a66c08f2.text: Leyo i khii ya API ya Anthropic, ku nga ri tokeni ya Claude Code. Ti hambanile, naswona leyi yi lava tokeni: tirhisa `claude setup-token` eka khompyuta ya wena n'wini u namarhela leswi yi swi kombisaka. Loko u ri na khii ya API, hlawula mupfuneti loyi a yi amukelaka.
said.extensions-index.a66c08f2.from: That is an Anthropic API key, not a Claude Code token. They are different products and this one needs the token: run `claude setup-token` on your own computer and paste what it prints. If an API key is what you have, choose a provider that takes one.

said.extensions-index.d95a2478.text: Vumbhoni bya wena lebyi hlayisiweke a byi hlayiwi, hikwalaho mupfuneti a nga vutisiwanga.
said.extensions-index.d95a2478.from: Your stored credential could not be read, so the provider could not be asked.

said.extensions-index.e95369f0.text: U nga se veka xiengeteleko xa AI. Xi le rhijisini ra akhawunti ya wena eka Swivekiwa, i xa wena ku nga ri xa muqashi, naswona xi tirhisa tokeni leyi u yi endlaka eka khompyuta ya wena n'wini.
said.extensions-index.e95369f0.from: You have not set up an AI extension. It is on your account page under Settings, it is yours rather than the tenant's, and it uses a token you generate on your own computer.

said.extensions-index.f448a040.text: Xiengeteleko xa wena xa AI xi tshikiwile eka rhijisi ra akhawunti ya wena. A ku lahliwanga nchumu: xi pfule nakambe kwalaho loko u xi lava.
said.extensions-index.f448a040.from: Your AI extension is disabled on your account page. Nothing was discarded: switch it back on there when you want it.

said.extensions-index.f5c19ada.text: Xiengeteleko xa wena xa AI a xi pfuriwanga eka ku tshama loku. Xi pfule laha u lavaka ku xi tirhisa; xi sungula xi pfaleriwile minkarhi hinkwayo loko u nghena, kutani xi tlhela xi pfala loko u huma.
said.extensions-index.f5c19ada.from: Your AI extension is not switched on for this sitting. Switch it on where you want to use it; it starts off every time you sign in, and switches off again when you sign out.

said.extensions-index.fc1b6fc7.from: This deployment has no encryption key set, so a token cannot be stored safely. Nothing was saved. Tell whoever runs the server.

said.extensions-openai.02885124.text: OpenAI yi arile khii yoleyo eka model leyi. Akhawunti leyi yi nga yaka eka yona yi nga ha va yi nga na ku fikelela eka model leyi vuriweke eka swivekiwa swa wena.
said.extensions-openai.02885124.from: OpenAI refused that key for this model. The account it belongs to may not have access to the model named in your settings.

said.extensions-openai.047d249a.text: OpenAI yi arile khii yoleyo. Yi nga ha va yi susiwile, kumbe a yi si tshama yi tirha. Xiya leswaku sabsikripishini ya ChatGPT Plus a yi katsi ku fikelela ka API: khii ya API i xihlahluva xin'wana, lexi endliwaka eka platform.openai.com. A ku na xiphiqo eka pulatifomo naswona a ku lahlekanga nchumu.
said.extensions-openai.047d249a.from: OpenAI refused that key. It may have been revoked, or it may never have been valid. Note that a ChatGPT Plus subscription does not include API access: an API key is a separate thing, created at platform.openai.com. Nothing is wrong with the platform and nothing was lost.

said.extensions-openai.1d2edb4d.text: OpenAI a yi hlamulanga hi nkarhi. Foludara yi kulu yi nga teka timinete to tala; ku ringeta nakambe hi tidokumente to tsongo ku tolovelekile ku tirha.
said.extensions-openai.1d2edb4d.from: OpenAI did not answer in time. A large folder can take several minutes; trying again with fewer documents in it usually works.

said.extensions-openai.241eaa9a.text: Akhawunti yoleyo ya OpenAI a yi na mali leyi saleke. Ku hambana ni Gemini, OpenAI API a yi na xiyimo xa mahala: yi hakeriwa eka akhawunti leyi khii yi nga ya yona.
said.extensions-openai.241eaa9a.from: That OpenAI account has no credit left. Unlike Gemini, the OpenAI API has no free tier: it is charged against the account the key belongs to.

said.extensions-openai.3d690aea.text: OpenAI yi tivise ku va ni xiphiqo eka vona ({status}). Leswi swi fanele ku ringetiwa nakambe.
said.extensions-openai.3d690aea.from: OpenAI reported a problem on their side ({status}). This is worth simply trying again.

said.extensions-openai.5f8151b1.text: Nkarhi wa OpenAI wa ku pimiwa ka khii yoleyo wu fikeleriwile. Yimela nkarhi wutsongo u ringeta nakambe.
said.extensions-openai.5f8151b1.from: OpenAI's rate limit for that key has been reached. Wait a little and try again.

said.extensions-openai.60c45cc3.text: OpenAI yi hlamule hi ku nga vuyisi nchumu. Hakanyingi leswi swi vula leswaku vito ra model a ri lulamanga, kumbe xikombelo xi arisiwile.
said.extensions-openai.60c45cc3.from: OpenAI answered with nothing. That usually means the model name is wrong, or the request was refused.

said.extensions-openai.d344fc6b.text: A ku na khii ya API ya OpenAI leyi hlayisiweke eka wena. Yi engetele eka Swivekiwa. Yi suka eka platform.openai.com, naswona a yi fani ni sabsikripishini ya ChatGPT.
said.extensions-openai.d344fc6b.from: No OpenAI API key is stored for you. Add one in Settings. It comes from platform.openai.com, and is not the same as a ChatGPT subscription.

said.extensions-openai.dacd1031.text: Yi tirhisa khii ya wena n'wini ya API ya OpenAI, leyi endliweke eka platform.openai.com. A hi sabsikripishini ya ChatGPT Plus: leyo i xihlahluva xin'wana naswona a yi katsi ku fikelela ka API. Ku hambana ni Gemini a ku na xiyimo xa mahala, hikwalaho ku vitana ku hakeriwa eka akhawunti leyi khii yi nga yaka eka yona.
said.extensions-openai.dacd1031.from: Uses your own OpenAI API key, created at platform.openai.com. Not a ChatGPT Plus subscription: that is a separate product and does not include API access. Unlike Gemini there is no free tier, so calls are charged to the account the key belongs to.

said.extensions-openai.e6f50a09.text: A ku kotiwanga ku fika eka OpenAI. Kambisisa leswaku muchini lowu wu na vuhlanganisi bya intanete.

said.invigilation.01f9be44.text: Amukela khandidheyiti sungula. Ku tiyisisa khamera ya munhu loyi a nga amukeriwangiki i ku tsala ku kambisisa loku a ku endliwanga.
said.invigilation.01f9be44.from: Admit the candidate first. Confirming a camera for somebody who was never admitted records a check nobody made.

said.invigilation.1505c6a0.from: Say why they were turned away. An appeal turns on the reason, and the candidate has to be told what happened.

said.invigilation.17e1f6a7.text: Khandidheyiti yoleyo a yi eka ku tshama loku.
said.invigilation.17e1f6a7.from: That candidate is not on this sitting.

said.invigilation.35819929.text: Khandidheyiti yoleyo a yi amukeriwanga, hikwalaho a ku na skripi ya yona yo yi amukela.

said.invigilation.47b2b98a.from: That person is not on this cohort, so they cannot be admitted to its sitting.

said.invigilation.50504405.from: That candidate dropped out of this sitting and cannot be readmitted. Record what happened as an incident instead.

said.invigilation.7eff3ae0.from: Admit the candidate first. A declaration from somebody who was never admitted records an agreement nobody witnessed.

said.invigilation.994f7ce0.from: This sitting has no declaration wording, so there is nothing for a candidate to accept. Set it on the sitting first.

said.recognition.165f2f8f.text: Khandidheyiti leyi a yi si va ni sesheni ya switsundzuxo. Ku avanyisa dyondzo leyi tshameke yi ri kona hi ku landza leswi nga hlamuseriwangiki hi ndlela leyi khandidheyiti yi hluleke ha yona hi ku hlengeleta vumbhoni lebyi nga lulamangiki. Tsala switsundzuxo sungula.
said.recognition.165f2f8f.from: This candidate has not had an advisory session. Judging prior learning against requirements nobody explained is how a candidate is failed for assembling the wrong evidence. Record the advice first.

said.recognition.2f3e0747.text: Xiboho xi tsariwile. A xi nyiki nchumu ku fikela xi languteriwa.

said.recognition.3d78b1cc.text: Vula leswi u swi langutiweke ni loko u pfumelelana. Ku languteriwa loku nga na nhlamuselo i ku sayina ntsena.

said.recognition.4cf70aee.text: Vula ndlela leyi mbuyelo wa leswi va nga na swona swi funengetaka mbuyelo wa modyuli leyi ha yona. Ndzimana yoleyo hi yona xiboho hinkwaxo, naswona ku hundzisela loku nga na yona i xikombiso lexi nga riki na munhu la nga xi kambisisaka.
said.recognition.4cf70aee.from: Say how the outcomes of what they hold cover this module's. That paragraph is the whole of the decision, and a transfer without it is a claim nobody can check.

said.recognition.61201ac5.text: Vula leswaku vumbhoni a ku ri byihi ni leswaku hikwalaho ka yini byi eneta modyuli. Ndzimana leyi hi yona xiboho hinkwaxo, naswona hi yona xilo xo sungula lexi mukambisisi wa le handle a xi hlayaka.
said.recognition.61201ac5.from: Say what the evidence was and why it satisfies the module. This paragraph is the whole of the judgement, and the first thing an external verifier reads.

said.recognition.86f838fe.text: Leyo yi nyikiwile hi {awardedOn}, ku tlula lembe {CAT_YEARS} ku nga si va ku pfumeleriwa loku. Ku Hlengeleta na Ku Hundzisela Kridithi ku funengeta leswi hetiweke endzeni ka malembe ya {CAT_YEARS2}; ku tlula kwalaho ndlela i Ku tiveka ka Dyondzo leyi Tshameke yi ri Kona (RPL), leyi kambisisaka leswi mudyondzi a ha swi kotaka ku nga ri leswi a swi hundzeke khale. Pfula xikombelo xa RPL ematshan'weni.
said.recognition.86f838fe.from: That was awarded on {awardedOn}, more than {CAT_YEARS} years before this approval. Credit Accumulation and Transfer covers completions within {CAT_YEARS2} years; beyond that the route is Recognition of Prior Learning, which assesses what the learner can still do rather than what they once passed. Open an RPL application instead.

said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.text: A ku na swimodyuli swa {wantedCount} leswi dokumente leyi yi swi vulaka leswi fambisaneke, hikwalaho a ku vekiwanga nchumu ehansi ka yuniti ya dyondzo. Dokumente yi vula {wanted}. Kharikhulamu leyi yi na {held}. Ku fambisana ku tshika switshuxo ni tihayifeni, hikwalaho tinkongomiso timbirhi ti hambana hakunene. Lulamisa tikhodi eka tlhelo rin'wana ni rin'wana kutani u nghenisa dokumente nakambe.
said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.from: None of the {wantedCount} modules this document names could be matched, so nothing has been placed under a study unit. The document names {wanted}. This curriculum holds {held}. Matching ignores spaces and hyphens, so the two schemes genuinely differ. Correct the codes on either side and upload the document again.

said.support.6396d34b.text: Siku rin'wana se ri vekiwile eka nkambisiso lowu: {additionalDate}, endzhaku ka ku hlwela hi {missedOn}. Endlelo ri pfumelela rin'we. Loko siku rero na rona ri hlwerile, tsala leswi humeleleke eka rona ku nga ri ku veka rin'wana.
said.support.6396d34b.from: An additional date was already set for this assessment: {additionalDate}, after a miss on {missedOn}. The procedure allows one. If that date was also missed, record what happened to it rather than setting another.

said.support.6947b9e5.text: Xilaveko xa nseketelo a xi kumiwanga.

said.support.6af4db9d.text: Loko nseketelo wu nga tirhi, vula leswi swi cincaka. Ku languteriwa loku tsalaka ku hluleka kambe ku nga cinci nchumu ku vonaka ku ri ku tikarhatela, kambe i leswo hambaneke.
said.support.6af4db9d.from: If the accommodation is not working, say what is changing. A review that records a failure and adjusts nothing reads as diligence and is the opposite.

said.support.7af7d42b.text: Siku ro engetela ri fanele ku va endzhaku ka leri hluleriweke.
said.support.7af7d42b.from: The additional date has to be after the one that was missed.

said.support.8452172c.text: Vula leswi u swi kumeke. Ku languteriwa loku nga na nchumu lowu kumiweke i siku ntsena eka fayili.
said.support.8452172c.from: Say what you found. A review with no finding is a date in a file.

said.support.e34f2e55.text: Vula leswi swi nga ta endliwa hakunene. Xilaveko lexi nga na nseketelo xi nga cinci nchumu eka mudyondzi.
said.support.e34f2e55.from: Say what will actually be done. A need with no accommodation against it changes nothing for the learner.

said.support.f4565c1a.text: Vula leswaku xivangelo xa rihanyo a ku ri xihi. Nkambisiso wa nomu lowu pfumeleriweke hi xivangelo lexi nga tsariwangiki hi wona ku tshama loku mukambisisi wa le handle a ku vutisaka.
said.support.f4565c1a.from: Say what the medical ground was. An oral assessment authorised on an unrecorded reason is the sitting an external verifier asks about.

login.intro.text: Inicie sesión para continuar con su aprendizaje.
login.intro.from: Sign in to continue your learning.

login.trouble.text: ¿Tiene problemas para iniciar sesión? Hable con su facilitador: puede restablecer su contraseña.
login.trouble.from: Trouble signing in? Speak to your facilitator: they can reset a password for you.

login.locked.text: Demasiados intentos. Espere quince minutos e inténtelo de nuevo.
login.locked.from: Too many attempts. Wait fifteen minutes and try again.

login.missing.text: Ingrese su correo electrónico y su contraseña.
login.missing.from: Enter your email address and password.

login.sso.refused.text: Esa cuenta no puede iniciar sesión aquí. Debe usar el mismo correo electrónico que su cuenta en esta plataforma. Inicie sesión con su contraseña o consulte a su administrador.
login.sso.refused.from: That account cannot sign in here. It has to use the same email address as your account on this platform. Sign in with your password, or ask your administrator.

login.sso.cancelled.text: Se canceló el inicio de sesión.

login.sso.expired.text: Ese inicio de sesión tardó demasiado o se inició en otro lugar. Inténtelo de nuevo.
login.sso.expired.from: That sign-in took too long, or was started somewhere else. Try again.

login.sso.off.text: Esa forma de iniciar sesión no está activada aquí.
login.sso.off.from: That way of signing in is not switched on here.

account.forcedIntro.text: Otra persona estableció la contraseña con la que inició sesión. Cámbiela antes de continuar.
account.forcedIntro.from: Somebody else set the password you signed in with. Replace it before carrying on.

account.newHint.text: Al menos 12 caracteres. Una frase de varias palabras sin relación entre sí es más segura y más fácil de recordar que algo corto con símbolos.
account.newHint.from: At least 12 characters. A phrase of a few unrelated words is both stronger and easier to remember than something short with symbols in it.

account.mismatch.text: Las dos contraseñas nuevas no coinciden.
account.mismatch.from: The two new passwords do not match.
