said.qualifications-id-modules.f5a96609.from: Saved. This is assessed against {selected} module.

said.qualifications-id-remove-actions.08.text: Ese no es el título. Escríbalo exactamente como aparece arriba para confirmar a qué cualificación se refiere.
said.qualifications-id-remove-actions.08.from: That is not the title. Type it exactly as it appears above to confirm which qualification you mean.

said.qualifications-id-remove-actions.6c.text: Su rol no incluye la administración de cualificaciones.
said.qualifications-id-remove-actions.6c.from: Your role does not include managing qualifications.

said.qualifications-id-remove-actions.6d.text: No se pudo eliminar esa cualificación.
said.qualifications-id-remove-actions.6d.from: That qualification could not be removed.

said.qualifications.2276ff00.text: Los documentos no se enviaron con el formulario. Elíjalos de nuevo.
said.qualifications.2276ff00.from: The documents were not sent with the form. Choose them again.

said.qualifications.cab5f65e.text: Elija el documento de currículo: es el que establece los módulos.
said.qualifications.cab5f65e.from: Choose the Curriculum Document: it is the one that states the modules.

said.readiness-qualificationId-userId.2b.text: El registro de un certificado de cualificación está limitado al personal que administra las matrículas.
said.readiness-qualificationId-userId.2b.from: Recording a qualification certificate is limited to staff who manage enrolments.

said.readiness-qualificationId-userId.87.text: La emisión de una constancia de resultados está limitada al personal que puede emitir certificados.
said.readiness-qualificationId-userId.87.from: Issuing a Statement of Results is limited to staff who can issue certificates.

said.reassessment.051a9a39.text: Escriba lo que se preguntó y se respondió antes de registrar el resultado. Un aprobado oral sin registro del intercambio no es evidencia.
said.reassessment.051a9a39.from: Write down what was asked and answered before recording the outcome. An oral pass with no record of the exchange is not evidence.

said.reassessment.2a95a5d9.text: Una revisión del programa sigue a {ATTEMPTS_BEFORE_REVIEW} resultados aún no competente. Este estudiante tiene {notYetCompetent}.
said.reassessment.2a95a5d9.from: A programme review follows {ATTEMPTS_BEFORE_REVIEW} not-yet-competent results. This learner has {notYetCompetent}.

said.reassessment.54d33118.text: Este estudiante ya pasó por una revisión del programa en esta evaluación.
said.reassessment.54d33118.from: This learner has already been through a programme review on this assessment.

said.reassessment.7eeb4562.text: Nombre a la persona del empleador que fue consultada. Un empleador sin nombre no es prueba de que se realizó una consulta.
said.reassessment.7eeb4562.from: Name the person at the employer who was consulted. An unnamed employer is not evidence that a consultation happened.

said.reassessment.b07a9b03.text: No puede realizar su propia evaluación oral.
said.reassessment.b07a9b03.from: You cannot conduct your own oral assessment.

said.reassessment.cea9b770.text: Esa revisión decidió {outcome}, no una reevaluación oral.
said.reassessment.cea9b770.from: That review decided on {outcome}, not an oral reassessment.

said.reassessment.d374ded8.text: Este estudiante ya fue considerado competente en esta evaluación.
said.reassessment.d374ded8.from: This learner has already been found competent on this assessment.

said.reassessment.df7ff299.text: Esa autorización ya se usó. Un tercer intento concedido dos veces no es un tercer intento.
said.reassessment.df7ff299.from: That authorisation has already been used. A third attempt granted twice is not a third attempt.

said.reassessment.eacc2318.text: Ese intento no es una reevaluación oral autorizada.
said.reassessment.eacc2318.from: That attempt is not an authorised oral reassessment.

said.reassessment.f272ec97.text: Usted autorizó este tercer intento, por lo que otra persona debe realizarlo.
said.reassessment.f272ec97.from: You authorised this third attempt, so somebody else must conduct it.

said.reassessments.b53b937e.text: Escriba al menos una pregunta y la respuesta dada. Un aprobado oral sin registro del intercambio no es evidencia.
said.reassessments.b53b937e.from: Write down at least one question and the answer given. An oral pass with no record of the exchange is not evidence.

said.recognition.056d89d8.text: Eximir {title} llevaría a que el {wouldBePercent} por ciento de la cualificación de este estudiante se reconozca sin haber sido enseñado, y el límite en esta cualificación es {maxPercent}. El resto debe cursarse como aprendizaje ordinario, o bien cambiarse el límite en la cualificación indicando un motivo.
said.recognition.056d89d8.from: Exempting {title} would take this learner to {wouldBePercent} per cent of the qualification recognised without being taught, and the limit on this qualification is {maxPercent}. The rest has to be done as ordinary learning, or the limit changed on the qualification with a reason for it.

said.recognition.165f2f8f.text: Este candidato no ha tenido una sesión de asesoría. Juzgar el aprendizaje previo frente a requisitos que nadie explicó es la manera de reprobar a un candidato por reunir la evidencia equivocada. Registre primero la asesoría.
said.recognition.165f2f8f.from: This candidate has not had an advisory session. Judging prior learning against requirements nobody explained is how a candidate is failed for assembling the wrong evidence. Record the advice first.

said.recognition.2f3e0747.text: Juicio registrado. No concede nada hasta que se modere.
said.recognition.2f3e0747.from: Judgement recorded. It grants nothing until it is moderated.

said.recognition.3d78b1cc.text: Indique qué revisó y si está de acuerdo. Una moderación sin comentario es una firma.
said.recognition.3d78b1cc.from: Say what you looked at and whether you agree. A moderation with no comment is a signature.

said.recognition.4cf70aee.text: Indique cómo los resultados de lo que posee cubren los de este módulo. Ese párrafo es toda la decisión, y una transferencia sin él es una afirmación que nadie puede comprobar.
said.recognition.4cf70aee.from: Say how the outcomes of what they hold cover this module's. That paragraph is the whole of the decision, and a transfer without it is a claim nobody can check.

said.recognition.61201ac5.text: Indique cuál fue la evidencia y por qué satisface el módulo. Este párrafo es todo el juicio, y lo primero que lee un verificador externo.
said.recognition.61201ac5.from: Say what the evidence was and why it satisfies the module. This paragraph is the whole of the judgement, and the first thing an external verifier reads.

said.recognition.86f838fe.text: Eso se otorgó el {awardedOn}, más de {CAT_YEARS} años antes de esta aprobación. La acumulación y transferencia de créditos cubre las finalizaciones dentro de {CAT_YEARS2} años; más allá, la vía es el reconocimiento del aprendizaje previo, que evalúa lo que el estudiante aún sabe hacer y no lo que aprobó en su momento. Abra en su lugar una solicitud de reconocimiento del aprendizaje previo.
said.recognition.86f838fe.from: That was awarded on {awardedOn}, more than {CAT_YEARS} years before this approval. Credit Accumulation and Transfer covers completions within {CAT_YEARS2} years; beyond that the route is Recognition of Prior Learning, which assesses what the learner can still do rather than what they once passed. Open an RPL application instead.

said.recognition.d4a3fd91.text: Registre lo que se le indicó reunir al candidato. Un candidato rechazado impugna este párrafo, y «asesorado sobre los requisitos» no lo es.
said.recognition.d4a3fd91.from: Record what the candidate was told to gather. A refused candidate disputes this paragraph, and 'advised on requirements' is not one.

said.recognition.e21aaea2.text: No puede moderar su propio juicio.
said.recognition.e21aaea2.from: You cannot moderate your own judgement.

said.recognition.e7122f98.text: Su rol no incluye esto. El reconocimiento corresponde al propio personal del proveedor, y un juicio lo modera una persona distinta de quien lo emitió.
said.recognition.e7122f98.from: Your role does not include this. Recognition is held by the provider's own staff, and a judgement is moderated by somebody other than whoever made it.

said.record-store.177e55ac.text: No se pudo establecer conexión con el almacén: {error}.
said.record-store.177e55ac.from: The store could not be reached: {error}.

said.record-store.2edd3c36.text: Esta plataforma no tiene una clave con la que cifrar secretos, por lo que no puede guardar la clave del almacén.
said.record-store.2edd3c36.from: This platform has no key to seal secrets with, so it cannot keep the store's key.

said.record-store.32a7ad42.text: Se necesita la clave del almacén para conectarse.
said.record-store.32a7ad42.from: The store's key is needed to connect.

said.record-store.426bb3b3.text: La clave del almacén ya no se puede abrir en esta plataforma. Ingrésela de nuevo en la página de Registros de aprendizaje.
said.record-store.426bb3b3.from: The store's key can no longer be opened on this platform. Enter it again on the Learning records page.

said.record-store.62143f17.text: Se necesita el nombre de la clave.

said.record-store.76194b8f.text: El almacén rechazó la clave ({status}). Compruebe el nombre y el secreto de la clave en la página de Registros de aprendizaje.
said.record-store.76194b8f.from: The store refused the key ({status}). Check the key's name and secret on the Learning records page.

said.record-store.9f6b73a1.text: El almacén dejó de responder a mitad del proceso.
said.record-store.9f6b73a1.from: The store stopped answering part of the way through.

said.record-store.c387d2ea.text: La dirección del almacén debe comenzar con https://.
said.record-store.c387d2ea.from: The store's address must start with https://.

said.record-store.fe2456ba.text: No se encontró la dirección del almacén (404). Compruebe que sea la dirección de xAPI, la que termina antes de /statements.
said.record-store.fe2456ba.from: The store's address was not found (404). Check it is the xAPI address, the one ending before /statements.

said.records.05c230ea.text: Indique por qué se conserva más allá de su plazo de retención. Es una postura y no un descuido, y el motivo debe constar en el expediente.
said.records.05c230ea.from: Say why this is being kept beyond its retention period. It is a position rather than an oversight, and the reason belongs in the file.

said.records.94e6ebbb.text: Ese archivo pesa más de {MAX_LIBRARY_BYTES} MB.
said.records.94e6ebbb.from: That file is larger than {MAX_LIBRARY_BYTES} MB.

said.records.bd9361ef.text: Destruir un registro es irreversible, y algún día alguien preguntará por qué falta un registro que un verificador quería. Indique el motivo.
said.records.bd9361ef.from: Destroying a record is irreversible, and somebody will one day ask why a record a verifier wanted is not there. Say why.

said.roster-import.0e607b00.text: Ese libro de trabajo no tiene hojas.
said.roster-import.0e607b00.from: That workbook has no sheets in it.

said.roster-import.1fd8a7f6.from: That file has nothing in it.

said.roster-import.2f5f5231.from: No column was found for: {missing}. A person cannot be created without those three. The headings found were: {Boolean}.

said.roster-import.c40fdd60.text: Los encabezados de columna se tomaron de la línea {headerIndex} y no de la línea 1: todo lo que estaba por encima parecía un título y no encabezados.
said.roster-import.c40fdd60.from: The column headings were taken from line {headerIndex}, not line 1: everything above it looked like a title rather than headings.

said.roster-import.d7c8b42b.text: Se leyeron los encabezados, pero no hay filas debajo.
said.roster-import.d7c8b42b.from: The headings were read but there are no rows under them.

said.roster-import.ddc568e6.from: Fields still to fill: {open}. Unmatched column headings: {heading}

said.roster.b887ae87.text: «{email}» no es una dirección de correo electrónico.

said.scheduling.0592fd69.text: Una sesión no puede terminar a las {endTime} habiendo comenzado a las {startTime}.
said.scheduling.0592fd69.from: A session cannot end at {endTime} having started at {startTime}.

said.scheduling.0b13beb2.text: No se puede leer esa fecha de inducción, por lo que no se puede formar el nombre de una cohorte a partir de ella.
said.scheduling.0b13beb2.from: That induction date cannot be read, so a cohort name cannot be built from it.

said.scheduling.53f8d453.text: Indique por qué se canceló o pospuso la sesión. Un calendario con huecos sin explicar es justo lo que pregunta una visita de supervisión.
said.scheduling.53f8d453.from: Say why the session was cancelled or postponed. A schedule with unexplained gaps in it is the thing a monitoring visit asks about.

said.scheduling.5c76cb4b.text: Use una hora en formato de 24 horas, por ejemplo 20:30.

said.scheduling.6c1a2122.text: Use una hora en formato de 24 horas, por ejemplo 18:30.

said.scheduling.7ebc2d06.text: Esa persona no es miembro actual de esta cohorte, por lo que no se le puede marcar en su lista de asistencia.
said.scheduling.7ebc2d06.from: That person is not a current member of this cohort, so they cannot be marked on its register.

said.scheduling.c988355e.text: Esta sesión fue cancelada, por lo que no hay lista de asistencia que tomar. Nadie faltó a una clase que no se dio.
said.scheduling.c988355e.from: This session was cancelled, so there is no register to take. Nobody failed to attend a lecture that did not happen.

said.scorm.02fb5cf8.text: El archivo de inicio del manifiesto no está dentro del paquete.
said.scorm.02fb5cf8.from: The manifest's starting file is not inside the package.

said.scorm.05c16100.text: Esta lección no pertenece a un curso en el que usted esté matriculado.
said.scorm.05c16100.from: This lesson is not on a course you are enrolled on.

said.scorm.20ff1632.text: No se pudo abrir el archivo zip. Puede estar dañado; expórtelo de nuevo desde la herramienta de autoría.
said.scorm.20ff1632.from: The zip could not be opened. It may be damaged; export it again from the authoring tool.

said.scorm.354841d8.text: El paquete tiene {filesCount} archivos, más de los {MAX_FILES} permitidos.
said.scorm.354841d8.from: The package has {filesCount} files, more than the {MAX_FILES} allowed.

said.scorm.380a5512.text: Solo se conserva el progreso del propio estudiante.
said.scorm.380a5512.from: Only the learner's own progress is kept.

said.scorm.39e77a3f.text: Este es un paquete cmi5. Por ahora la plataforma reproduce paquetes SCORM 1.2; cmi5 vendrá después de SCORM 2004.
said.scorm.39e77a3f.from: This is a cmi5 package. The platform plays SCORM 1.2 packages so far; cmi5 comes after SCORM 2004.

said.scorm.42f68d85.text: El archivo zip contiene «{name}», una ruta que saldría del paquete.
said.scorm.42f68d85.from: The zip holds "{name}", a path that would leave the package.

said.scorm.4de81b55.text: Esta lección no tiene un paquete SCORM.
said.scorm.4de81b55.from: This lesson has no SCORM package.

said.scorm.63cfd3fc.text: El manifiesto no nombra ningún archivo desde el cual iniciar el paquete.
said.scorm.63cfd3fc.from: The manifest names no file to start the package from.

said.scorm.858c848d.text: El manifiesto dice que es «{version}», que no es SCORM 1.2.
said.scorm.858c848d.from: The manifest says it is "{version}", which is not SCORM 1.2.

said.scorm.90319b91.text: El paquete se descomprime a más de un gigabyte, que es más de lo que necesita un curso.
said.scorm.90319b91.from: The package unpacks to more than a gigabyte, which is more than a course needs.

said.scorm.d03f6670.text: Este es un paquete SCORM 2004. Por ahora la plataforma reproduce paquetes SCORM 1.2; 2004 es lo siguiente. La mayoría de las herramientas de autoría pueden publicar en SCORM 1.2 en su lugar.
said.scorm.d03f6670.from: This is a SCORM 2004 package. The platform plays SCORM 1.2 packages so far; 2004 is next. Most authoring tools can publish as SCORM 1.2 instead.

said.scorm.d37e77ff.text: El manifiesto inicia el paquete en «{launchFile}», que no está en el archivo zip.
said.scorm.d37e77ff.from: The manifest starts the package at "{launchFile}", which is not in the zip.

said.settings-drive-actions.b27a46f5.text: Esa no es una unidad que la plataforma conozca.
said.settings-drive-actions.b27a46f5.from: That is not a drive the platform knows.

said.settings-language-actions.ecc301e2.text: Solo un administrador del proveedor puede cambiar esto.
said.settings-language-actions.ecc301e2.from: Only a provider administrator may change this.

said.settings-language-actions.f103b372.text: Guardado. Las personas que no han elegido su propio idioma ahora ven este.
said.settings-language-actions.f103b372.from: Saved. People who have not chosen their own language now see this one.

said.settings-mail-actions.77394510.text: Su rol no incluye probar el servidor de correo.
said.settings-mail-actions.77394510.from: Your role does not include testing the mail server.

said.settings-mail-actions.79f94bc8.text: No hay ningún servidor de correo configurado en esta instalación, por lo que aún no se puede enviar nada.
said.settings-mail-actions.79f94bc8.from: No mail server is set up on this deployment, so nothing can be sent yet.

said.settings-mail-actions.cb649383.text: El servidor de correo aceptó la conexión. Se pueden enviar a los estudiantes sus datos de inicio de sesión y sus notificaciones.
said.settings-mail-actions.cb649383.from: The mail server accepted the connection. Learners can be sent their sign-in details and notifications.

said.settings-mail-actions.cf3cfef0.text: Quien mantiene la plataforma debe definir MAIL_HOST y MAIL_FROM.
said.settings-mail-actions.cf3cfef0.from: Whoever maintains the platform needs to set MAIL_HOST and MAIL_FROM.

said.settings-mail-actions.f1ac9e08.text: No se pudo establecer conexión con el servidor de correo en este momento. Puede ser algo temporal; inténtelo de nuevo en breve.
said.settings-mail-actions.f1ac9e08.from: The mail server could not be reached just now. This may be temporary; try again shortly.

said.settings-mail-actions.fc597e55.text: El servidor de correo rechazó la conexión, por lo que no se puede enviar nada.
said.settings-mail-actions.fc597e55.from: The mail server refused the connection, so nothing can be sent.

said.settings-menu-actions.0005a392.text: Solo un administrador puede reorganizar el menú, porque es el mismo menú para todos en este proveedor.
said.settings-menu-actions.0005a392.from: Only an administrator can rearrange the menu, because it is the same menu for everybody at this provider.

said.settings-menu-actions.c175275c.text: Guardado. Todos en este proveedor ven esta organización.
said.settings-menu-actions.c175275c.from: Saved. Everybody at this provider sees this arrangement.

said.settings-menu-actions.c38853b5.text: No se pudo leer esa organización. No cambió nada.
said.settings-menu-actions.c38853b5.from: That arrangement could not be read. Nothing changed.

said.settings-menu-actions.ffff057d.text: Eso dejaría vacío cada encabezado, lo que sería un menú sin nada. No cambió nada.
said.settings-menu-actions.ffff057d.from: That would leave every heading empty, which is a menu with nothing in it. Nothing changed.

said.settings-module-codes-actions.d585f.text: No se pudo leer esa tabla. Vuelva a abrirla e inténtelo de nuevo.
said.settings-module-codes-actions.d585f.from: That table could not be read. Reopen it and try again.

said.settings-sso-actions.4bbd36a4.from: Switched off, and its secret forgotten.

said.settings-sso-actions.52db415d.text: Guardado. Cierre sesión y pruébelo desde la página de inicio de sesión.
said.settings-sso-actions.52db415d.from: Saved. Sign out and try it from the sign-in page.

said.settings-sso-actions.56bfaa85.text: Solo un administrador del proveedor puede cambiar la forma de iniciar sesión de las personas.
said.settings-sso-actions.56bfaa85.from: Only a provider administrator may change how people sign in.

said.settings-template-actions.0690b0fe.text: Guardado como versión {version}, en borrador. No se usa hasta que usted la ponga en uso.
said.settings-template-actions.0690b0fe.from: Saved as version {version}, as a draft. It is not in use until you put it in use.

said.settings-template-actions.9cc3fe2a.text: Guardado como versión {version}, y ya en uso. Los documentos de este tipo se producen a partir de ella de ahora en adelante; los ya emitidos conservan la versión con la que se produjeron.
said.settings-template-actions.9cc3fe2a.from: Saved as version {version}, and now in use. Documents of this kind are produced from it from now on; ones already issued keep the version that produced them.

said.settings-template-actions.a1bce5df.text: No había ninguna plantilla en uso para ese documento.
said.settings-template-actions.a1bce5df.from: There was no template in use for that document.

said.settings-template-actions.a1ec16e6.text: Volvió al diseño propio de la plataforma. Su plantilla se conserva, no se elimina, de modo que puede volver a ponerla en uso.
said.settings-template-actions.a1ec16e6.from: Back to the platform's own layout. Your template is kept, not deleted, so you can put it back.

said.settings-template-actions.a53f381a.text: Ese no es un documento que produzca la plataforma.
said.settings-template-actions.a53f381a.from: That is not a document the platform produces.

said.settings-terminology-actions.22580f.text: Guardado. Todos en este proveedor ven esta redacción.
said.settings-terminology-actions.22580f.from: Saved. Everybody at this provider sees this wording.

said.settings-terminology-actions.8e2222.text: Nada difiere de la redacción estándar, por lo que se restauraron los valores predeterminados.
said.settings-terminology-actions.8e2222.from: Nothing differs from the standard wording, so the defaults are back.

said.settings-terminology-actions.98e913.text: Indique el singular y el plural de {one}, o deje ambos vacíos para conservar el valor predeterminado.
said.settings-terminology-actions.98e913.from: Give both the singular and the plural for {one}, or leave both empty to keep the default.

said.settings-terminology-actions.bf53eb.text: Mantenga cada palabra por debajo de 40 caracteres.

said.settings-terminology-actions.c225e9.text: «{word}» lo define un ente regulador, por lo que no se puede usar para otra cosa. Cambiar el nombre de una de sus propias palabras por este pondría en la pantalla de un estudiante una afirmación que el registro no respalda.
said.settings-terminology-actions.c225e9.from: "{word}" is defined by a regulator, so it cannot be used for something else. Renaming one of your own words to it would put a claim on a learner's screen that the record does not support.

said.settings-terminology-actions.c27704.text: Solo un administrador puede cambiar cómo se llaman las cosas, porque es la misma redacción para todos en este proveedor.
said.settings-terminology-actions.c27704.from: Only an administrator can change what things are called, because it is the same wording for everybody at this provider.

said.settings.2e2de6f5.text: Guardado. Las cargas a partir de ahora se leen de esta manera.
said.settings.2e2de6f5.from: Saved. Uploads from now on are read this way.

said.settings.5946b233.text: Guardado. Está disponible pero no activada. Use el interruptor de IA en la parte superior de cualquier página cuando la quiera para una tarea.
said.settings.5946b233.from: Saved. It is available but not switched on. Use the AI switch at the top of any page when you want it for a job.

said.settings.68c5f414.text: Token descartado. No se conserva nada de él.
said.settings.68c5f414.from: Token discarded. Nothing of it is kept.

said.settings.7a6e099f.text: No se pudo consultar al proveedor sobre sus modelos.
said.settings.7a6e099f.from: The provider could not be asked for its models.

said.settings.84b6dbd9.text: Su rol no incluye la asistencia de modelos.
said.settings.84b6dbd9.from: Your role does not include model assistance.

said.settings.c0e1fe87.text: Guardado. Los horarios del calendario ahora se rigen por este reloj.
said.settings.c0e1fe87.from: Saved. Timetabled times now mean this clock.

said.settings.f7c1c376.text: Guardado. Todos lo ven a partir de su próxima página.
said.settings.f7c1c376.from: Saved. Everyone sees it from their next page.

said.settings.fdc694bf.text: Su rol no incluye la asistencia de modelos. Corresponde al propio personal del proveedor y no a los estudiantes ni al mentor laboral de un empleador.
said.settings.fdc694bf.from: Your role does not include model assistance. It is held by the provider's own staff rather than by learners or by an employer's workplace coach.

said.single-sign-on.052b3446.text: El inicio de sesión no devolvió una identidad.
said.single-sign-on.052b3446.from: The sign-in did not come back with an identity.

said.single-sign-on.07757676.text: El inicio de sesión devolvió una identidad que no se pudo leer.
said.single-sign-on.07757676.from: The sign-in came back with an identity that could not be read.

said.single-sign-on.180daa0a.text: Iniciar sesión con {kind} no está activado aquí.
said.single-sign-on.180daa0a.from: Signing in with {kind} is not switched on here.

said.single-sign-on.2760f640.text: Microsoft necesita el ID del directorio (inquilino) de su organización, un código como 72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47, que aparece en la página de Información general de la aplicación en Microsoft Entra.
said.single-sign-on.2760f640.from: Microsoft needs your organisation's directory (tenant) ID, a code like 72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47, from the app's Overview page in Microsoft Entra.

said.single-sign-on.27f12034.text: Esa cuenta no puede iniciar sesión aquí.
said.single-sign-on.27f12034.from: That account cannot sign in here.

said.single-sign-on.3d0f2728.text: Se necesita el ID de cliente.

said.single-sign-on.52f76de5.text: Se necesita el secreto de cliente para conectarse.
said.single-sign-on.52f76de5.from: The client secret is needed to connect.

said.single-sign-on.90b663ad.text: Google no ha verificado la dirección
said.single-sign-on.90b663ad.from: Google has not verified the address

said.single-sign-on.af8cc19b.text: Esta plataforma no tiene una clave con la que cifrar secretos, por lo que no puede guardar el secreto de cliente.
said.single-sign-on.af8cc19b.from: This platform has no key to seal secrets with, so it cannot keep the client secret.

said.single-sign-on.b83f2863.text: Ese inicio de sesión no se inició desde esta página. Inténtelo de nuevo.
said.single-sign-on.b83f2863.from: That sign-in was not started from this page. Try again.

said.south-african-id.2a092f1a.text: Un número de identidad tiene exactamente 13 dígitos.
said.south-african-id.2a092f1a.from: An identity number is exactly 13 digits.

said.south-african-id.46e0f0e5.text: El mes de la fecha de nacimiento no es válido.
said.south-african-id.46e0f0e5.from: The month in the date of birth is not valid.

said.south-african-id.738d1584.text: La fecha de nacimiento no es una fecha real.
said.south-african-id.738d1584.from: The date of birth is not a real date.

said.south-african-id.95e7bd33.text: No existe ningún dígito de control de Luhn válido.
said.south-african-id.95e7bd33.from: No valid Luhn check digit exists.

said.south-african-id.e46ae644.text: El dígito de ciudadanía debe ser 0 o 1.
said.south-african-id.e46ae644.from: The citizenship digit must be 0 or 1.

said.south-african-id.f2f17cbd.text: El dígito de control no coincide; es probable que el número se haya escrito mal.
said.south-african-id.f2f17cbd.from: The check digit does not match; the number was likely mistyped.

said.spine-editor.2a5955ae.text: Publicado, pero ninguna de sus pruebas lo está. Un estudiante no encontraría nada que responder.
said.spine-editor.2a5955ae.from: Published, but none of its papers are. A learner would find nothing to answer.

said.spine-editor.c209d3d2.text: Esto sigue siendo un borrador. Ya puede ir en la ruta, y no se ofrecerá a ningún estudiante hasta que se publique.
said.spine-editor.c209d3d2.from: This is still a draft. It can go on the spine now, and a learner will not be offered it until it is published.

said.spine.09e0bbde.text: Un paso de tipo {kind} debe nombrar el {kind2} al que apunta.
said.spine.09e0bbde.from: A {kind} step has to name the {kind2} it points at.

said.spine.0b4713d6.text: «{title}» es formativa, por lo que nunca produce una decisión de competencia, y una barrera que esperara una nunca se abriría. Espere en su lugar a que se entregue o se califique.
said.spine.0b4713d6.from: "{title}" is formative, so it never produces a competence decision, so a gate waiting for one would never open. Wait for it to be handed in or marked instead.

said.spine.129de092.text: Indique por qué se deja avanzar a este estudiante. Se muestra en su registro y en el paquete de moderación.
said.spine.129de092.from: Say why this learner is being let past. It is shown on their record and in the moderation pack.

said.spine.42a3be59.text: Un paso no puede esperarse a sí mismo.
said.spine.42a3be59.from: A step cannot wait for itself.

said.spine.7287fb1d.text: Una lección o un documento no se evalúa, por lo que no se le puede juzgar competente. Espere en su lugar a que se abra.
said.spine.7287fb1d.from: A lesson or a document is not assessed, so it cannot be judged competent. Wait for it to be opened instead.

said.spine.81239e1c.text: Solo se aprueba un módulo de experiencia laboral. Elija otra regla.
said.spine.81239e1c.from: Only a work experience module is signed off. Pick another rule.

said.spine.83528293.text: Un paso solo puede esperar a otro paso del mismo curso.
said.spine.83528293.from: A step can only wait for another step on the same course.

said.spine.91ceb611.text: El orden nuevo debe enumerar cada paso del curso exactamente una vez.
said.spine.91ceb611.from: The new order has to list every step of the course exactly once.

said.spine.ca9b3b5c.text: Eso haría que dos pasos se esperaran mutuamente, y ninguno llegaría a abrirse.
said.spine.ca9b3b5c.from: That would make two steps wait for each other, and neither would ever open.

said.spine.d5e61b5f.text: Ese documento no está a la vista de los estudiantes, por lo que no puede ser un paso de su ruta. Una prueba sumativa les llega como evaluación capturada.
said.spine.d5e61b5f.from: That document is kept from learners, so it cannot be a step on their path. A summative paper reaches them as a captured assessment instead.

said.spine.fc076d64.text: Ese documento está escrito para el personal y no para que los estudiantes trabajen con él, por lo que no puede ser un paso de su ruta.
said.spine.fc076d64.from: That document is written for staff rather than for learners to work through, so it cannot be a step on their path.

said.statement-of-results.09720fce.text: No hay módulos dentro del alcance de esta constancia, por lo que no hay nada que confirmar.
said.statement-of-results.09720fce.from: There are no modules in scope for this statement, so there is nothing for it to confirm.

said.statement-of-results.3b26ff7f.text: Indique un motivo. Se muestra a cualquiera que verifique la referencia.
said.statement-of-results.3b26ff7f.from: Give a reason. It is shown to anybody who checks the reference.

said.statement-of-results.57e1914e.text: Este estudiante ya tiene una constancia de resultados de {code}. Retírela antes de emitir otra, para que nunca circulen dos documentos que afirmen lo mismo.
said.statement-of-results.57e1914e.from: This learner already holds a Statement of Results for {code}. Withdraw it before issuing another, so two documents making the same claim are never in circulation.

said.statement-of-results.ab61210b.text: El currículo no está completamente capturado: {uncaptured} no tienen nada que lograr. Una constancia emitida ahora confirmaría el logro de módulos que nadie ha transcrito.
said.statement-of-results.ab61210b.from: The curriculum is not fully captured: {uncaptured} carry nothing to achieve. A statement issued now would confirm achievement of modules nobody has transcribed.

said.statement-of-results.b5359f01.text: Este estudiante ya tiene una constancia de resultados de esta cualificación. Retírela antes de emitir otra, para que nunca circulen dos documentos que afirmen lo mismo.
said.statement-of-results.b5359f01.from: This learner already holds a Statement of Results for this qualification. Withdraw it before issuing another, so two documents making the same claim are never in circulation.

said.statements-id.5fd85b7c.text: Su rol no incluye retirar una constancia de resultados.
said.statements-id.5fd85b7c.from: Your role does not include withdrawing a Statement of Results.

said.statements-id.f9ea555b.text: Retirada. La referencia sigue resolviéndose, y así lo indica.
said.statements-id.f9ea555b.from: Withdrawn. The reference still resolves, and says so.

said.statutory-export-file.10c070ac.text: Esta declaración tiene problemas que deben corregirse antes de poder producir los archivos. Consulte la página de informes reglamentarios.
said.statutory-export-file.10c070ac.from: This return has problems that must be fixed before the files can be produced. See the statutory reporting page.

said.statutory-notification.0931542b.text: Ese estudiante no está en la cohorte.
said.statutory-notification.0931542b.from: That learner is not in the cohort.

said.statutory-notification.0a104506.text: Obligatorio en cada registro de estudiante.

said.statutory-notification.1e928484.text: Obligatorio, y está dentro del número de identidad.
said.statutory-notification.1e928484.from: Required, and it is inside the identity number.

said.statutory-notification.5c135418.text: El estudiante no ha dado su conformidad en el formulario de matrícula.
said.statutory-notification.5c135418.from: The learner has not agreed on the enrolment form.

said.statutory-notification.69c68cc0.text: El número de acreditación del propio proveedor, tomado de la configuración del inquilino.
said.statutory-notification.69c68cc0.from: The provider's own accreditation number, from the tenant's settings.

said.statutory-notification.6a2cb727.text: Obligatorio, y debe coincidir con el número de identidad.
said.statutory-notification.6a2cb727.from: Required, and must match the identity number.

said.statutory-notification.83725bbd.text: El identificador de la SAQA de aquello en lo que el estudiante está matriculado.
said.statutory-notification.83725bbd.from: The SAQA identifier of what the learner is enrolled on.

said.statutory-notification.9cf40e0d.text: La provincia en la que trabaja el estudiante.
said.statutory-notification.9cf40e0d.from: The province the learner works in.

said.statutory-notification.a5a405af.text: Un acuse de recibo necesita la referencia que emitió el QCTO.
said.statutory-notification.a5a405af.from: An acknowledgement needs the reference the QCTO issued.

said.statutory-notification.bbfb1dec.text: Se registra una discapacidad, por lo que el QCTO exige indicar cuánta dificultad causa.
said.statutory-notification.bbfb1dec.from: A disability is recorded, so the QCTO requires how much difficulty it causes.

said.statutory-notification.ce4a70ee.text: Del formulario de matrícula del estudiante.

said.statutory-notify.77d191e5.text: Borrador preparado, con {learnerIdsCount} estudiantes. Descargue el libro de trabajo, revíselo y luego registre que se envió.
said.statutory-notify.77d191e5.from: Drafted, covering {learnerIdsCount} learners. Download the workbook, check it, then record that it went.

said.statutory-notify.7e3fae5a.text: Volver a la fecha de inducción propia de la cohorte.
said.statutory-notify.7e3fae5a.from: Back to the cohort's own induction date.

said.statutory-notify.8cc067d9.text: Borrador preparado, con {learnerIdsCount} estudiante. Descargue el libro de trabajo, revíselo y luego registre que se envió.
said.statutory-notify.8cc067d9.from: Drafted, covering {learnerIdsCount} learner. Download the workbook, check it, then record that it went.

said.statutory-notify.90d2c47a.text: Elija al menos un estudiante sobre el cual notificar.
said.statutory-notify.90d2c47a.from: Choose at least one learner to notify about.

said.statutory-notify.e80fd17b.text: Registrado como enviado. Agregue el acuse de recibo cuando llegue.
said.statutory-notify.e80fd17b.from: Recorded as sent. Add the acknowledgement when it comes back.

said.statutory-notify.fbbcde8b.text: Su propia fecha de inducción está registrada, y su plazo ahora corre desde ella.
said.statutory-notify.fbbcde8b.from: Their own induction date is recorded, and their deadline now runs from it.

said.statutory.36c11667.text: El estudiante se matriculó después de que cerró el período de registro de la cualificación.
said.statutory.36c11667.from: The learner was enrolled after the qualification's registration period closed.

said.statutory.5a5791f9.text: El evaluador no tiene un número de registro anotado. El NLRD verifica el registro del evaluador frente al logro.
said.statutory.5a5791f9.from: The assessor has no registration number recorded. The NLRD verifies assessor registration against the achievement.

said.statutory.82c0a73c.text: No hay estado de discapacidad registrado.

said.statutory.937d409a.text: No hay código de distrito municipal registrado. El registro del proveedor se valida hasta el nivel de distrito.
said.statutory.937d409a.from: No municipal ward code recorded. The Provider Record is validated down to ward level.

said.statutory.a57124be.text: El módulo del currículo no tiene un valor de créditos registrado.
said.statutory.a57124be.from: The curriculum module has no credit value recorded.

said.statutory.aafb40c2.text: Falta el número de acreditación del proveedor. Todos los registros de la declaración se archivan con él.
said.statutory.aafb40c2.from: The provider accreditation number is missing. Every record in the return is filed against it.

said.statutory.cc126904.text: El moderador no tiene un número de registro anotado.
said.statutory.cc126904.from: The moderator has no registration number recorded.

said.statutory.d8b794f8.text: No hay número de identidad registrado.

said.statutory.e08f5796.from: No equity code recorded; the NLRD flags missing equity data.

said.study-unit-alignment.dfcd9590.text: El documento nombra {wantedCount} módulos ({wanted}) y esta cualificación aún no tiene currículo. Importe primero el currículo; las unidades de estudio y sus resultados se registran de todos modos, y al cargar de nuevo este documento después se vincularán.
said.study-unit-alignment.dfcd9590.from: The document names {wantedCount} modules ({wanted}) and this qualification has no curriculum yet. Import the curriculum first; the study units and their outcomes are recorded either way, and uploading this document again afterwards will link them.

said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.text: No se pudo emparejar ninguno de los {wantedCount} módulos que nombra este documento, por lo que no se colocó nada bajo una unidad de estudio. El documento nombra {wanted}. Este currículo tiene {held}. La comparación ignora espacios y guiones, así que los dos esquemas realmente difieren. Corrija los códigos en cualquiera de los dos lados y cargue de nuevo el documento.
said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.from: None of the {wantedCount} modules this document names could be matched, so nothing has been placed under a study unit. The document names {wanted}. This curriculum holds {held}. Matching ignores spaces and hyphens, so the two schemes genuinely differ. Correct the codes on either side and upload the document again.

said.support.2b757921.text: Una evaluación oral sigue a un segundo intento fallido solo por motivos médicos. Sin uno, el resultado es una pérdida por incomparecencia, que el estudiante aún puede apelar.
said.support.2b757921.from: An oral assessment follows a second miss only on medical grounds. Without one the outcome is a forfeit, which the learner can still appeal.

said.support.32314e12.text: El estudiante debe estar de acuerdo en que esto se registre para que se pueda hacer. La salud, la discapacidad y la situación económica son información personal especial, y aceptar la matrícula no significaba aceptar esto.
said.support.32314e12.from: The learner has to agree to this being recorded before it can be. Health, disability and financial circumstances are special personal information, and agreeing to enrol was not agreeing to this.

said.support.3e521f24.text: Indique por qué termina el apoyo. Un estudiante cuya adaptación se detiene sin motivo no tiene manera de pedir que se restablezca.
said.support.3e521f24.from: Say why the support is ending. A learner whose accommodation stops without a reason has no way to ask for it back.

said.support.6396d34b.text: Ya se fijó una fecha adicional para esta evaluación: {additionalDate}, tras una ausencia el {missedOn}. El procedimiento permite una. Si esa fecha también se perdió, registre lo que ocurrió con ella en lugar de fijar otra.
said.support.6396d34b.from: An additional date was already set for this assessment: {additionalDate}, after a miss on {missedOn}. The procedure allows one. If that date was also missed, record what happened to it rather than setting another.

said.support.6af4db9d.text: Si la adaptación no está funcionando, indique qué cambia. Una revisión que registra un fracaso y no ajusta nada parece diligencia y es lo contrario.
said.support.6af4db9d.from: If the accommodation is not working, say what is changing. A review that records a failure and adjusts nothing reads as diligence and is the opposite.

said.support.7af7d42b.text: La fecha adicional debe ser posterior a la que se perdió.
said.support.7af7d42b.from: The additional date has to be after the one that was missed.

said.support.8452172c.text: Indique lo que encontró. Una revisión sin hallazgo es solo una fecha en un expediente.
said.support.8452172c.from: Say what you found. A review with no finding is a date in a file.

said.support.e34f2e55.text: Indique lo que se hará realmente. Una necesidad sin adaptación asociada no cambia nada para el estudiante.
said.support.e34f2e55.from: Say what will actually be done. A need with no accommodation against it changes nothing for the learner.

said.support.f41a730d.text: Esa necesidad de apoyo está cerrada.

said.support.f4565c1a.text: Indique cuál fue el motivo médico. Una evaluación oral autorizada por un motivo no registrado es la sesión sobre la que pregunta un verificador externo.
said.support.f4565c1a.from: Say what the medical ground was. An oral assessment authorised on an unrecorded reason is the sitting an external verifier asks about.

said.unit-competency.34155bb7.text: Lo que logra cada unidad de estudio de esta cualificación: su resultado del nivel de salida, o la propia unidad cuando no sirve a ninguno. Lo elabora la plataforma a partir de los documentos de la propia cualificación.
said.unit-competency.34155bb7.from: What each study unit of this qualification achieves: its exit level outcome, or the unit itself where it serves none. Made by the platform from the qualification's own documents.

login.intro.from: Sign in to continue your learning.

login.trouble.text: Un problème de connexion ? Adressez-vous à votre animateur : il peut réinitialiser votre mot de passe.
login.trouble.from: Trouble signing in? Speak to your facilitator: they can reset a password for you.

login.wrong.text: Ces informations ne sont pas correctes.

login.locked.text: Trop de tentatives. Patientez quinze minutes, puis réessayez.
login.locked.from: Too many attempts. Wait fifteen minutes and try again.

login.missing.text: Saisissez votre adresse e-mail et votre mot de passe.
login.missing.from: Enter your email address and password.

login.sso.refused.text: Ce compte ne peut pas se connecter ici. Il doit utiliser la même adresse e-mail que votre compte sur cette plateforme. Connectez-vous avec votre mot de passe ou contactez votre administrateur.
login.sso.refused.from: That account cannot sign in here. It has to use the same email address as your account on this platform. Sign in with your password, or ask your administrator.

login.sso.expired.text: Cette connexion a pris trop de temps ou a été lancée ailleurs. Réessayez.
login.sso.expired.from: That sign-in took too long, or was started somewhere else. Try again.

login.sso.off.text: Ce mode de connexion n’est pas activé ici.
login.sso.off.from: That way of signing in is not switched on here.

account.titleForced.text: Choisissez votre propre mot de passe

account.forcedIntro.text: Une autre personne a défini le mot de passe avec lequel vous vous êtes connecté. Remplacez-le avant de continuer.
account.forcedIntro.from: Somebody else set the password you signed in with. Replace it before carrying on.

account.currentGiven.text: Le mot de passe qui vous a été communiqué

account.newHint.text: Au moins 12 caractères. Une phrase composée de quelques mots sans lien entre eux est à la fois plus robuste et plus facile à retenir qu’un mot court rempli de symboles.
account.newHint.from: At least 12 characters. A phrase of a few unrelated words is both stronger and easier to remember than something short with symbols in it.

account.again.text: Confirmer le nouveau mot de passe

account.mismatch.text: Les deux nouveaux mots de passe ne correspondent pas.
account.mismatch.from: The two new passwords do not match.

account.forcedNote.text: Cette modification déconnecte toute autre personne qui utilise l’ancien mot de passe, y compris celle qui vous l’a transmis.
account.forcedNote.from: Changing it signs out anyone else using the old password, including whoever passed it to you.

account.languageIntro.text: La langue dans laquelle cette plateforme s’adresse à vous. Les écrans pas encore traduits restent en anglais, et les noms que votre prestataire donne aux choses sont conservés tels qu’il les a écrits.
account.languageIntro.from: The language this platform speaks to you in. Screens not yet translated stay in English, and your provider's own names for things are kept as they wrote them.

learn.notYours.text: Vous consultez l’inscription d’une autre personne. Vous pouvez voir sa progression, mais pas l’enregistrer à sa place.
learn.notYours.from: You are viewing someone else's enrolment. You can see their progress but cannot record it for them.

learn.noLessons.text: Ce cours ne contient encore aucune leçon.
learn.noLessons.from: This course has no lessons yet.

learn.openMaterial.text: Ouvrir le support de cette leçon
learn.openMaterial.from: Open the material for this lesson

learn.noContent.text: Aucun contenu écrit pour cette leçon.
learn.noContent.from: No written content for this lesson.

learn.scormNote.text: Cette leçon est considérée comme terminée lorsque vous l’achevez dans le paquet de cours ci-dessus. Votre progression est conservée si vous vous arrêtez en cours de route.
learn.scormNote.from: This lesson completes when you finish it in the package above. Your place is kept if you stop part of the way through.

learn.openedByFacilitator.text: Ouvert pour vous par votre animateur : {reason}
learn.openedByFacilitator.from: Opened for you by your facilitator: {reason}

home.feedbackMany.from: A few things to tell us

home.feedbackIntro.text: Les réponses sont communiquées avec celles de tous les autres, et non une par une. Deux minutes chacune : c’est la seule chose qui change la façon dont la prochaine cohorte est encadrée.
home.feedbackIntro.from: Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. Two minutes each, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

home.earnedIntro.text: Enregistré le jour où vous avez terminé, sans attendre que le certificat arrive. Chaque élément porte une référence que n’importe qui peut vérifier.
home.earnedIntro.from: Recorded on the day you finished, rather than when the certificate eventually arrives. Each carries a reference anybody can check.

home.step.afterPrevious.text: S’ouvre lorsque vous terminez l’étape précédente
home.step.afterPrevious.from: Opens when you finish the step before

home.nothingOutside.text: Rien en dehors de vos programmes.

home.nothingYet.text: Rien ne vous a encore été attribué.
home.nothingYet.from: You have not been assigned anything yet.

home.statementsIntro.text: Apportez ce document à l’évaluation externe, avec votre pièce d’identité. Le centre le vérifie avant que vous puissiez passer l’épreuve.
home.statementsIntro.from: Take this to the external assessment with your identity document. The centre checks it before you may sit.

assess.waiting.text: En attente d’examen par un évaluateur.
assess.waiting.from: Waiting for an assessor to review it.

assess.developmental.text: Cette évaluation est formative. Rien ici ne joue en votre défaveur.
assess.developmental.from: This is developmental. Nothing here counts against you.

assess.competent.text: Vous avez été jugé compétent pour cette évaluation ; il n’y a donc rien à repasser.
assess.competent.from: You have been found competent on this assessment, so there is nothing to sit again.

assess.noAttempts.text: Vous avez utilisé toutes vos tentatives pour cette évaluation.
assess.noAttempts.from: You have used all your attempts at this assessment.

assess.awaitingAssessor.text: Cette évaluation compte pour votre qualification : un évaluateur va donc l’examiner et enregistrer la décision de compétence. Vous verrez le résultat dès que ce sera fait.
assess.awaitingAssessor.from: This assessment counts towards your qualification, so an assessor will review it and record the competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

assess.practicePassed.text: Il s’agissait d’un entraînement : le résultat est enregistré dans votre apprentissage, mais il ne décide pas de l’obtention d’une qualification.
assess.practicePassed.from: This was practice, so the result is recorded against your learning but does not decide a qualification.

assess.practiceFailed.text: Il s’agissait d’un entraînement. Révisez le matériel et réessayez.
assess.practiceFailed.from: This was practice. Review the material and try again.

assess.selectEvery.text: Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui conviennent.

assess.pair.text: Associez chaque élément de gauche à un élément de droite.
assess.pair.from: Pair each item on the left with one on the right.

assess.whyMarked.text: C’est le motif qui est noté ici, et non la case ci-dessus.
assess.whyMarked.from: The reason is what is marked here, not the box above.

assess.keptAt.text: Vos réponses ont été conservées à {time}. C’est l’envoi qui les transmet pour correction.
assess.keptAt.from: Your answers were kept at {time}. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

assess.kept.text: Vos réponses sont conservées au fur et à mesure. C’est l’envoi qui les transmet pour correction.
assess.kept.from: Your answers are kept as you work. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

evidence.failed.text: L’envoi n’a pas pu être effectué.

evidence.uploadFailed.text: Le téléversement a échoué. Vérifiez votre connexion et réessayez.
evidence.uploadFailed.from: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.

evidence.doneIntro.text: Un évaluateur va les examiner et enregistrer une décision de compétence. Vous verrez le résultat dès que ce sera fait.
evidence.doneIntro.from: An assessor will review it and record a competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

evidence.fingerprinted.text: Chaque fichier a reçu une empreinte numérique :

evidence.fingerprintNote.text: Si un fichier conservé venait à être modifié, son empreinte ne correspondrait plus. Cela protège votre travail autant que l’évaluation.
evidence.fingerprintNote.from: If any stored file were ever altered, its fingerprint would stop matching. That protects your work as much as it protects the assessment.

evidence.kinds.text: Photographies, enregistrement de la tâche, carnet de bord numérisé ou document. Vous pouvez joindre plusieurs fichiers à la fois.
evidence.kinds.from: Photographs, a recording of the task, a scanned logbook, or a document. You can attach several at once.

evidence.note.text: Tout ce que l’évaluateur doit savoir

paper.summative.text: Cette épreuve est évaluée et compte pour votre qualification.
paper.summative.from: This is assessed and counts towards your qualification.

paper.formative.text: Il s’agit d’une préparation. Elle est corrigée et vous est rendue, mais elle ne décide de rien.
paper.formative.from: This is preparation. It is marked and returned to you, and it does not decide anything.

paper.goBack.text: Retournez au cours pour voir ce qui reste à faire.
paper.goBack.from: Go back to the course to see what is still outstanding.

paper.notSaved.text: Cette réponse n’a pas été enregistrée.

paper.connection.text: Cette réponse n’a pas été enregistrée. Votre connexion a peut-être été interrompue ; une nouvelle tentative aura lieu à votre prochaine modification.
paper.connection.from: That answer did not save. Your connection may have dropped; it will be tried again when you next change something.

paper.handInFailed.text: Le rendu n’a pas pu être effectué.
paper.handInFailed.from: That could not be handed in.

paper.handInConnection.text: Le rendu n’a pas pu être effectué. Vérifiez votre connexion et réessayez.
paper.handInConnection.from: That could not be handed in. Check your connection and try again.

paper.detail.text: Répondez de manière détaillée, en vous référant aux principes que vous avez étudiés.
paper.detail.from: Answer in detail, referring to the principles you have studied.

paper.handedIn.text: Vous avez rendu ce travail. Il ne peut plus être modifié.
paper.handedIn.from: You handed this in. It cannot be changed.

paper.final.text: Une fois rendu, ce travail ne peut plus être modifié.
paper.final.from: Once handed in, this cannot be changed.

paper.confirm.text: Confirmez la déclaration pour rendre votre travail.
paper.confirm.from: Confirm the declaration to hand in.

paper.savedAsYouGo.text: votre travail est enregistré au fur et à mesure
paper.savedAsYouGo.from: your work is saved as you go

notify.nothingYet.text: Rien pour l’instant. Vous serez informé ici lorsqu’une formation vous sera attribuée ou arrivera à échéance, lorsqu’un travail vous attendra, et lorsqu’un résultat d’évaluation ou un certificat sera disponible.
notify.nothingYet.from: Nothing yet. You will be told here when training is assigned or due, when work is waiting for you, and when an assessment result or certificate arrives.

cert.withdrawn.text: Ce certificat a été retiré le {date}.

cert.notNational.text: Il s’agit du certificat propre à {provider} pour un cours que cet organisme a dispensé. Ce n’est pas une qualification nationale et il ne comporte ni crédit ni identifiant SAQA. Lorsqu’un apprenant prépare une qualification professionnelle, le certificat correspondant est délivré par le QCTO.
cert.notNational.from: This is {provider}'s own certificate for a course it delivered. It is not a national qualification and does not carry a SAQA credit or identifier. Where a learner is working towards an occupational qualification, the certificate for it is issued by the QCTO.

cert.anyone.text: Toute personne peut confirmer ce certificat avec la référence ci-dessus, sans avoir besoin de compte.
cert.anyone.from: Anyone can confirm this certificate with the reference above, without needing an account.

work.introCoach.text: Les apprenants que vous encadrez. Vous confirmez ce qu’ils ont fait sur le lieu de travail ; rien n’est transmis à un évaluateur sans votre signature.
work.introCoach.from: The learners you supervise. You confirm what they did in the workplace; nothing reaches an assessor without your signature.

work.introLearner.text: L’expérience en milieu de travail se déroule chez un employeur et est validée par le tuteur en milieu de travail. L’ordre est fixe : vous l’enregistrez, votre tuteur la confirme, puis elle est transmise à un évaluateur.
work.introLearner.from: Work experience is done at an employer and signed off by the workplace coach there. The order is fixed: you record it, your coach confirms it, then it goes to an assessor.

work.setUp.text: Configurer l’expérience en milieu de travail

work.noneManage.text: Pas encore de {records}. Créez-en une ci-dessus : un accord nommant l’apprenant, l’employeur et le tuteur, puis une validation pour chaque module d’expérience en milieu de travail.
work.noneManage.from: No {records} yet. Set one up above: an agreement naming the learner, the employer and the coach, then one for each work experience module.

work.none.text: Pas encore de {records}. Un administrateur en ouvre une dès qu’un accord de milieu de travail nommant l’apprenant, l’employeur et le tuteur est en place.
work.none.from: No {records} yet. An administrator opens one once a workplace agreement is in place naming the learner, the employer and the coach.

work.all.text: ← Toute l’expérience en milieu de travail

work.statement.text: Relevé d’expérience en milieu de travail →

work.kind.work_activity.text: Activités professionnelles : ce que vous faites

work.kind.contextual_knowledge.text: Connaissances du milieu de travail : ce dont vous devez pouvoir parler
work.kind.contextual_knowledge.from: Workplace knowledge: what you must be able to speak to

work.kind.supporting_evidence.text: Preuves à l’appui : ce que le milieu de travail doit fournir
work.kind.supporting_evidence.from: Supporting evidence: what the workplace must produce

work.outstanding.text: Reste à faire : {items}. Votre tuteur ne peut pas signer tant que chaque ligne n’est pas faite et que chaque preuve à l’appui n’a pas de fichier joint.
work.outstanding.from: Still outstanding: {items}. Your coach cannot sign until every line is done and every piece of supporting evidence has a file attached.

work.allRecorded.text: Tout est enregistré. Envoyez-le à votre tuteur lorsque vous êtes prêt.
work.allRecorded.from: Everything is recorded. Send it to your coach when you are ready.

work.signingMeans.text: En signant, vous enregistrez que vous avez vérifié ces preuves et que vous les attesterez si l’évaluateur vous contacte. Il ne sera plus possible de les modifier ensuite.
work.signingMeans.from: Signing records that you checked this evidence and will attest to it if the assessor contacts you. It cannot be changed afterwards.

work.forAssessor.text: Tout ce que l’évaluateur doit savoir

work.readyForPoe.text: Signé par le tuteur en milieu de travail et prêt à être versé au portfolio de preuves.
work.readyForPoe.from: Signed by the workplace coach and ready to be taken into the Portfolio of Evidence.

scorm.failed.text: Le paquet n’a pas pu être ouvert. Vérifiez votre connexion et réessayez.
scorm.failed.from: The package could not be opened. Check your connection and try again.

scorm.preview.text: Aperçu : ce que le paquet signale n’est pas conservé, car il ne s’agit pas de votre propre inscription.
scorm.preview.from: A preview: what the package reports is not kept, because this is not your own enrolment.

certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.text: L’apprenant a peut-être communiqué la référence à un employeur. Elle reste consultable et indiquera que le certificat a été retiré.
certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.from: The learner may have given the reference to an employer. It keeps resolving and will say it was withdrawn.

assessing.intro.text: Travaux prêts pour un jugement de compétence. Vous ne pouvez pas évaluer votre propre travail, et une part de vos décisions sera examinée de façon indépendante par un modérateur.
assessing.intro.from: Submissions ready for a competency judgement. You cannot assess your own work, and a proportion of your decisions will be reviewed independently by a moderator.

assessing.empty.text: Rien n’est en attente. Les travaux apparaissent ici au fur et à mesure que les apprenants les envoient.
assessing.empty.from: Nothing is waiting. Submissions appear here as learners send them in.

assessing.onScreen.text: Cette épreuve a été passée à l’écran. {link} : les réponses, les consignes de correction et la grille sont réunies là, et les critères sont calculés pour vous une fois la correction terminée.
assessing.onScreen.from: This was answered on screen. {link}: the answers, the marking guidance and the matrix are together there, and the criteria are worked out for you once it is marked.

assessing.ownWork.text: Il s’agit de votre propre travail. Vous ne pouvez pas l’évaluer ; quelqu’un d’autre doit le faire.
assessing.ownWork.from: This is your own submission. You cannot assess it; someone else must.

assessing.hash.text: L’empreinte numérique est enregistrée au téléversement. Si un fichier conservé est un jour modifié, elle ne correspond plus et le dossier est signalé.
assessing.hash.from: The hash is recorded at upload. If a stored file is ever altered, it no longer matches and the record is flagged.

assessing.whyDiffers.text: Pourquoi, puisque cela diffère de ce que suggèrent les points
assessing.whyDiffers.from: Why, since it differs from what the marks propose

assessing.permanent.text: Votre nom, la date et ce commentaire sont conservés de façon permanente et ne peuvent plus être modifiés. Une correction est enregistrée comme une nouvelle décision.
assessing.permanent.from: Your name, the date and this comment are stored permanently and cannot be edited afterwards. A correction is recorded as a new decision.

marking.impliesIntro.text: Un calcul, et non un jugement. La moyenne des points aboutit à ce résultat ; la performance pratique et les preuves du milieu de travail n’arrivent pas jusqu’à la plateforme, et il vous appartient d’en tenir compte avant de décider. Modifiez n’importe lequel de ces éléments sur l’écran de décision et dites pourquoi : le motif est conservé à côté de la proposition afin qu’un modérateur voie où les deux divergent.
marking.impliesIntro.from: Arithmetic, not a judgement. The marks average out at this; practical performance and workplace evidence do not reach the platform, and you weigh those before deciding. Change any of these on the decision screen and say why: the reason is stored beside the proposal so a moderator can see where the two parted.

marking.markAllFirst.text: Chaque question doit être corrigée avant que les critères puissent être calculés.
marking.markAllFirst.from: Every question has to be marked before the criteria can be worked out.

marking.summative.text: Cette épreuve est évaluée. Une fois chaque question corrigée, enregistrez une décision : les critères qu’elle atteste vous sont proposés pour confirmation.
marking.summative.from: This is assessed. Once every question is marked, record a decision: the criteria it evidences are proposed for you to confirm.

marking.formative.text: Il s’agit d’un cahier d’exercices, à visée formative : corrigez-le, puis renvoyez le retour. Rien ici n’enregistre de compétence ni ne rapproche l’apprenant de l’admissibilité.
marking.formative.from: This is a workbook. It is developmental: mark it, then return feedback. Nothing here records competence or moves the learner towards eligibility.

marking.matrix.text: Grille de correction : le choix d’un niveau pour chaque critère donne la note
marking.matrix.from: Marking matrix: choosing a level for each gives the mark

marking.told.text: Ce qui est communiqué à l’apprenant

marking.toldHint.from: Where it was strong, and what was missing.

marking.returnIntro.text: Un retour, et non une décision. Il indique à l’apprenant ce qu’il doit revoir avant l’évaluation sommative, et n’enregistre aucune compétence pour aucun critère.
marking.returnIntro.from: Feedback, not a decision. It tells the learner what to go back to before the summative, and it records no competence against any criterion.

marking.returnHint.text: Ce qui était solide, et ce qu’il faut relire avant l’évaluation sommative.
marking.returnHint.from: What was solid, and what to re-read before the summative.

marking.concern.text: Critères autour desquels se concentrent les réponses faibles
marking.concern.from: Criteria the weak answers cluster around

marking.sectionHint.text: Ce qui s’est bien passé ici, et ce qu’il faudra faire autrement la prochaine fois.
marking.sectionHint.from: What went well here, and what to do differently next time.

marking.learnerSees.text: L’apprenant le voit avec son retour.
marking.learnerSees.from: The learner sees this with their feedback.

moderating.intro.text: Examen indépendant des décisions des évaluateurs. Les décisions qui arrivent dans cette liste sont déterminées par le système, et non choisies par quelqu’un. Vous ne pouvez pas modérer une décision que vous avez prise vous-même.
moderating.intro.from: Independent review of assessors' decisions. Which decisions reach this list is decided by the system, not chosen by anyone. You cannot moderate a decision you made yourself.

moderating.empty.text: Rien n’est en attente de modération.

moderating.reason.new_assessor.from: Newly registered assessor: moderated in full

moderating.referBack.from: Refer back: the assessor should look again

moderating.ownDecision.text: Vous avez pris cette décision en tant qu’évaluateur ; vous ne pouvez donc pas la modérer. Un autre modérateur doit le faire.
moderating.ownDecision.from: You made this decision as the assessor, so you cannot moderate it. Another moderator must.

pack.print.text: Imprimez cette page pour la conserver au format PDF.
pack.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF.

pack.settings.text: {provider} · {accreditation} · note de passage {pass} % · taux de modération {rate} %

pack.instrumentIntro.text: L’épreuve telle qu’elle a été posée, et les consignes selon lesquelles elle a été corrigée.
pack.instrumentIntro.from: The paper as it was set, and the guidance it was marked against.

pack.scriptsIntro.text: Prises sur toute l’étendue des notes (les plus hautes, les plus basses et l’écart entre les deux) afin que la correction soit vue à son meilleur et à son pire, et non seulement au milieu.
pack.scriptsIntro.from: Taken across the mark range (top, bottom and spread between) so the marking is seen at its best and its worst rather than in the middle.

pack.departuresIntro.text: Cas où un évaluateur s’est écarté de ce que suggéraient les points, ou un modérateur de l’évaluateur. Un dossier qui les omet est pire que pas de dossier.
pack.departuresIntro.from: Where an assessor differed from what the marks proposed, or a moderator differed from the assessor. A pack that leaves these out is worse than no pack.

pack.exceptionsIntro.text: Apprenants autorisés à franchir une étape par une personne désignée, avec le motif qu’elle a donné.
pack.exceptionsIntro.from: Learners let past a gate by a named person, with the reason they gave.

pack.assembled.text: Constitué le {date} à partir du dossier.

held.intro.text: Un apprenant jugé pas encore compétent à deux reprises n’est pas déclaré en échec. L’évaluation est suspendue et un examen de programme est convoqué avec son employeur, car à ce stade la question n’est presque jamais de savoir s’il maîtrise le sujet, mais le plus souvent ce qui se passe autour de lui.
held.intro.from: A learner found not yet competent twice is not failed. The assessment is held, and a programme review is convened with their employer, because by this point the question is rarely whether they know it, and usually what has been going on around them.

held.empty.text: Cette liste se remplit lorsqu’un apprenant est jugé pas encore compétent pour la deuxième fois à une évaluation sommative. D’ici là, il n’y a rien à examiner.
held.empty.from: This fills when a learner is found not yet competent for a second time on a summative assessment. Until then there is nothing to review.

held.forReview.text: En attente d’un examen de programme ({count})

held.whoConvenes.text: Un animateur ou un administrateur convoque l’examen.
held.whoConvenes.from: A facilitator or administrator convenes the review.

held.oralAuthorised.text: {assessment} · l’examen a autorisé une troisième tentative, menée à l’oral
held.oralAuthorised.from: {assessment} · the review authorised a third attempt, conducted orally

held.whoConducts.text: La tentative orale est menée par un évaluateur, et non par la personne qui l’a autorisée.
held.whoConducts.from: An assessor conducts the oral attempt, and not the person who authorised it.

held.oral.text: Une troisième tentative, menée à l’oral

held.furtherLearning.text: Formation complémentaire avant toute nouvelle tentative
held.furtherLearning.from: Further learning before any further attempt

held.whyHint.text: Ce que l’examen a constaté, et sur quoi cela repose.
held.whyHint.from: What the review found, and what it turns on.

oral.reviewDecidedIntro.text: Les motifs pour lesquels cette troisième tentative a été autorisée.
oral.reviewDecidedIntro.from: The grounds on which this third attempt was authorised.

oral.recordIntro.text: Une tentative orale ne laisse aucune preuve par elle-même. Ce dossier est cette preuve, et le résultat ne peut pas être enregistré sans lui.
oral.recordIntro.from: An oral attempt leaves no evidence of its own. This is that evidence, and the outcome cannot be recorded without it.

oral.outcomeIntro.text: Jugée de la même manière qu’une tentative écrite, selon les mêmes critères, et modérée de la même façon ensuite.
oral.outcomeIntro.from: Judged the same way as a written attempt, against the same criteria, and moderated the same way afterwards.

oral.howHint.text: En personne, ou l’appel vidéo sur lequel elle a eu lieu
oral.howHint.from: In person, or the video call it was held on

oral.presentNote.text: Non obligatoire. Une évaluation orale sans aucune autre personne dans la pièce est plus difficile à défendre lors de la modération, et le dossier doit préciser de quel type il s’agissait.
oral.presentNote.from: Not required. An oral assessment with nobody else in the room is harder to defend at moderation, and the record should say which kind this was.

oral.savedNext.text: Le résultat est enregistré sur l’écran de correction, comme pour toute autre tentative.
oral.savedNext.from: The outcome is recorded on the marking screen, the same as any other attempt.

appeals.intro.text: Un apprenant peut former un recours contre un résultat ou contre la conduite d’un évaluateur. L’accusé de réception est envoyé dans un délai de {hours} heures, échéance qui est souvent manquée, car elle court pendant que quelqu’un enseigne.
appeals.intro.from: A learner may appeal against a result or against an assessor's conduct. Receipt is acknowledged within {hours} hours, which is the deadline that gets missed, because it runs while somebody is teaching.

appeals.late.text: {count} sans confirmation de réception dans les délais

appeals.lateIntro.text: Le délai de {hours} heures est dépassé et la réception n’est toujours pas confirmée. Confirmer tardivement vaut mieux que ne pas confirmer du tout, et le dossier montrera les deux.
appeals.lateIntro.from: Past the {hours} hours and still not acknowledged. Acknowledging late is better than not at all, and the record will show both.

appeals.openIntro.text: Tout ce qui a été déposé et pas encore clos, le plus récent d’abord.
appeals.openIntro.from: Everything lodged and not yet closed, newest first.

appeals.none.text: Rien d’ouvert. Un recours est déposé depuis la page propre de l’apprenant.
appeals.none.from: Nothing open. An appeal is lodged from a learner's own page.

appeals.procedureIntro.text: Confirmer la réception, rencontrer l’apprenant, consulter le modérateur lorsque le motif concerne un résultat, puis résoudre et l’en informer.
appeals.procedureIntro.from: Acknowledge, meet the learner, consult the moderator where the ground is a result, then resolve and tell them.

appeals.closedUnacknowledged.text: Clos sans qu’aucune confirmation de réception n’ait été enregistrée.
appeals.closedUnacknowledged.from: Closed without an acknowledgement being recorded.

appeals.firstCounts.text: La première confirmation est celle que le dossier conserve. Elle ne peut pas être horodatée à nouveau ensuite, car une heure modifiable ne prouve rien.
appeals.firstCounts.from: The first acknowledgement is the one the record keeps. It cannot be re-stamped later, because a time that can be changed is not evidence of anything.

appeals.resultNeedsModerator.text: Un recours contre un résultat est transmis au modérateur interne avant de pouvoir être résolu. C’est l’étape sur laquelle un vérificateur externe pose des questions.
appeals.resultNeedsModerator.from: A result appeal goes to the internal moderator before it can be resolved. That is the step an external verifier asks about.

appeals.conductNoModerator.text: Un recours pour conduite ne se règle pas par une nouvelle correction ; aucun modérateur n’est donc requis.
appeals.conductNoModerator.from: A conduct appeal is not something re-marking settles, so no moderator is required.

appeals.notFeedback.text: Une décision qui n’a pas été communiquée à l’apprenant n’est pas un retour.
appeals.notFeedback.from: A decision the learner has not been given is not feedback.

appeals.whyHint.text: Pourquoi. C’est la partie à laquelle l’apprenant a droit.
appeals.whyHint.from: Why. This is the part the learner is entitled to.

appeals.notesIntro.text: La discussion entre le coordinateur, l’évaluateur et le modérateur. Elle n’est pas montrée à l’apprenant sauf si vous le décidez ; il a droit au résultat et à la justification ci-dessus.
appeals.notesIntro.from: The discussion between coordinator, assessor and moderator. Not shown to the learner unless you say so; what they are entitled to is the outcome and the reasoning above.

appeals.noteHint.text: Ce qui a été discuté, et avec qui
appeals.noteHint.from: What was discussed, and with whom

appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.text: Un retrait doit être motivé. Un retrait sans motif ressemble à une pression, et c’est précisément l’objet d’un recours pour conduite.
appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.from: A withdrawal needs a reason. One with none looks like pressure, and that is exactly what an appeal about conduct would be about.

rpl.intro.text: Pour un apprenant qui sait déjà faire une partie du travail. Rien n’est accordé ici sur la seule parole d’une personne : un jugement est porté selon les critères propres du module, consigné en détail, et modéré par une autre personne que son auteur avant de produire le moindre effet.
rpl.intro.from: For a learner who can already do part of the work. Nothing here is granted on one person's say-so: a judgement is made against the module's own criteria, written down in full, and moderated by somebody other than whoever made it before it counts for anything.

rpl.waitingIntro.text: Un jugement n’accorde rien tant que cette étape n’est pas faite. Lisez la justification au regard du module avant de donner votre accord : c’est la première chose que lit un vérificateur externe.
rpl.waitingIntro.from: A judgement grants nothing until this is done. Read the rationale against the module before agreeing: it is the first thing an external verifier reads.

rpl.appearHere.text: Les jugements apparaissent ici au fur et à mesure.
rpl.appearHere.from: Judgements appear here as they are made.

rpl.openIntro.text: La première étape, celle qui crée le dossier auquel tout le reste se rattache.
rpl.openIntro.from: The first step, and the one that creates the record everything else attaches to.

rpl.transferIntro.text: Différent de la reconnaissance des acquis : l’apprenant détient déjà une qualification dont les résultats couvrent ce module. Pas de conseil, mais la correspondance doit être consignée par écrit ; un transfert sans elle est une affirmation que personne ne peut vérifier.
rpl.transferIntro.from: Different from RPL: the learner already holds a qualification whose outcomes cover this module. No advisory, but the mapping has to be written down; a transfer without it is a claim nobody can check.

rpl.needsBoth.text: Une demande nécessite un apprenant et une qualification visée. Ajoutez-les d’abord.
rpl.needsBoth.from: An application needs a learner and a qualification to apply against. Add those first.

rpl.needsLearner.text: Ajoutez un apprenant avant d’enregistrer un transfert le concernant.
rpl.needsLearner.from: Add a learner before recording a transfer for one.

rpl.mapping.text: Comment les résultats de ce que l’apprenant détient couvrent ceux de ce module
rpl.mapping.from: How the outcomes of what they hold cover this module's

rpl.agree.text: Je suis d’accord avec ce jugement

rpl.checked.text: Ce que vous avez vérifié, et ce que vous avez conclu
rpl.checked.from: What you checked, and what you concluded

record.print.text: Imprimez cette page pour la conserver au format PDF dans le portfolio de preuves.
record.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF for the portfolio of evidence.

record.timeExpired.text: Non accepté : le temps imparti a expiré et le travail a été rendu en l’état.
record.timeExpired.from: Not accepted: the time limit expired and the work was handed in as it stood.

record.returned.text: Rendu le {date}. Cette évaluation est formative : elle n’enregistre aucune compétence.
record.returned.from: Returned {date}. This is developmental: it records no competence.

sor.withdrawConsequence.text: Un centre d’évaluation détient peut-être déjà une copie. La référence reste consultable et indiquera que le relevé a été retiré.
sor.withdrawConsequence.from: An assessment centre may already hold a copy. The reference keeps working and will say it was withdrawn.

sor.print.text: Imprimer ou enregistrer ce relevé de résultats
sor.print.from: Print or save this Statement of Results

fisa.intro.text: L’épreuve que ce prestataire élabore pour son propre programme de compétences. Contrairement à une évaluation externe, c’est vous qui la rédigez et la modérez : la modération a donc lieu avant que quiconque la passe, et une épreuve qui n’a pas été validée comme adaptée à son usage ne peut pas être utilisée.
fisa.intro.from: The paper this provider sets for its own skills programme. Unlike an external assessment, you write it and you moderate it, so the moderation happens before anybody sits it, and a paper that has not been signed off as fit for purpose cannot be used.

fisa.waitingIntro.text: Personne ne peut les passer tant qu’un modérateur ne les a pas validées.
fisa.waitingIntro.from: Nobody can sit these until a moderator signs them off.

fisa.setNewIntro.text: Pour un programme de compétences. Une qualification complète ou partielle est évaluée en externe.
fisa.setNewIntro.from: Against a skills programme. A full or part qualification is assessed externally.

fisa.gate.approved.text: Validée comme adaptée à son usage : les candidats peuvent passer cette épreuve
fisa.gate.approved.from: Signed off as fit for purpose: candidates may sit this paper

fisa.gate.in_moderation.text: Chez le modérateur : personne ne peut encore la passer
fisa.gate.in_moderation.from: With the moderator: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.gate.draft.text: En cours de rédaction : personne ne peut encore la passer
fisa.gate.draft.from: Being written: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.beforeNotAfter.text: Une FISA est modérée avant d’être passée, et non après. C’est ce qui la rend défendable lors d’une visite de suivi.
fisa.beforeNotAfter.from: A FISA is moderated before it is sat, not after. That is what makes it defensible at a monitoring visit.

fisa.practical.text: Comporte aussi une composante pratique, jugée compétent ou pas encore compétent.
fisa.practical.from: Also has a practical component, judged competent or not yet competent.
