Il se lit comme un document d’alignement ; soit les modules qu’il nomme ne figurent pas dans le curriculum sous ces codes, soit les unités d’étude s’y trouvent déjà. Le détail figure dans l’entrée de la bibliothèque de documents.
said.qualifications-id-documents.09def23.from: That document was filed, but no study units came out of it. It reads as an alignment document, so either the modules it names are not in the curriculum under those codes, or the study units are already there. The detail is in the document library entry.

said.qualifications-id-documents.52f263a.text: Classé comme matrice d’alignement du curriculum plutôt que comme le type choisi : il nomme des unités d’étude et des résultats de niveau de sortie, c’en est donc une.
said.qualifications-id-documents.52f263a.from: Filed as a curriculum alignment matrix rather than the kind chosen: it names study units and exit level outcomes, so it is one.

said.qualifications-id-documents.68a2de1.text: Cochez au moins une ligne à ajouter, ou laissez le curriculum tel quel.
said.qualifications-id-documents.68a2de1.from: Tick at least one line to add, or leave the curriculum as it is.

said.qualifications-id-documents.a6619e6.text: Vérifiez les codes de module du curriculum

said.qualifications-id-documents.dac96cb.text: Document d’alignement lu. Unités d’étude créées, mais aucun module n’y est rattaché.
said.qualifications-id-documents.dac96cb.from: Alignment document read. Study units built, but no modules placed under them.

said.qualifications-id-documents.ea9c86d.text: Document d’alignement lu. Unités d’étude créées.
said.qualifications-id-documents.ea9c86d.from: Alignment document read. Study units built.

said.qualifications-id-edit.a8da7938.text: Enregistrée comme qualification partielle de celle qui est nommée.
said.qualifications-id-edit.a8da7938.from: Recorded as a part qualification of the one named.

said.qualifications-id-edit.ca623efc.text: Enregistré comme programme de compétences tiré de celle qui est nommée.
said.qualifications-id-edit.ca623efc.from: Recorded as a skills programme drawn from the one named.

said.qualifications-id-modules.0f95215b.text: Effacé. Aucun module de la qualification parente n’est repris.
said.qualifications-id-modules.0f95215b.from: Cleared. This takes none of the parent's modules.

said.qualifications-id-modules.53a59328.text: Enregistré. Cette qualification est évaluée sur {selected} modules.
said.qualifications-id-modules.53a59328.from: Saved. This is assessed against {selected} modules.

said.qualifications-id-modules.f5a96609.text: Enregistré. Cette qualification est évaluée sur {selected} module.
said.qualifications-id-modules.f5a96609.from: Saved. This is assessed against {selected} module.

said.qualifications-id-remove-actions.08.text: Ce n’est pas le titre. Saisissez-le exactement comme il apparaît ci-dessus pour confirmer de quelle qualification il s’agit.
said.qualifications-id-remove-actions.08.from: That is not the title. Type it exactly as it appears above to confirm which qualification you mean.

said.qualifications-id-remove-actions.6c.text: Votre rôle ne comprend pas la gestion des qualifications.
said.qualifications-id-remove-actions.6c.from: Your role does not include managing qualifications.

said.qualifications-id-remove-actions.6d.text: Cette qualification n’a pas pu être supprimée.
said.qualifications-id-remove-actions.6d.from: That qualification could not be removed.

said.qualifications.2276ff00.text: Les documents n’ont pas été envoyés avec le formulaire. Choisissez-les de nouveau.
said.qualifications.2276ff00.from: The documents were not sent with the form. Choose them again.

said.qualifications.cab5f65e.text: Choisissez le document de curriculum : c’est celui qui énonce les modules.
said.qualifications.cab5f65e.from: Choose the Curriculum Document: it is the one that states the modules.

said.readiness-qualificationId-userId.2b.text: L’enregistrement d’un certificat de qualification est réservé au personnel qui gère les inscriptions.
said.readiness-qualificationId-userId.2b.from: Recording a qualification certificate is limited to staff who manage enrolments.

said.readiness-qualificationId-userId.87.text: La délivrance d’un relevé de résultats est réservée au personnel habilité à délivrer des certificats.
said.readiness-qualificationId-userId.87.from: Issuing a Statement of Results is limited to staff who can issue certificates.

said.reassessment.051a9a39.text: Notez ce qui a été demandé et répondu avant d’enregistrer le résultat. Une réussite à l’oral sans trace de l’échange n’est pas une preuve.
said.reassessment.051a9a39.from: Write down what was asked and answered before recording the outcome. An oral pass with no record of the exchange is not evidence.

said.reassessment.2a95a5d9.text: Un examen du programme fait suite à {ATTEMPTS_BEFORE_REVIEW} résultats pas encore compétent. Cet apprenant en a {notYetCompetent}.
said.reassessment.2a95a5d9.from: A programme review follows {ATTEMPTS_BEFORE_REVIEW} not-yet-competent results. This learner has {notYetCompetent}.

said.reassessment.54d33118.text: Cet apprenant a déjà fait l’objet d’un examen du programme pour cette évaluation.
said.reassessment.54d33118.from: This learner has already been through a programme review on this assessment.

said.reassessment.7eeb4562.text: Nommez la personne de l’employeur qui a été consultée. Un employeur non nommé n’est pas la preuve qu’une consultation a eu lieu.
said.reassessment.7eeb4562.from: Name the person at the employer who was consulted. An unnamed employer is not evidence that a consultation happened.

said.reassessment.b07a9b03.text: Vous ne pouvez pas conduire votre propre évaluation orale.
said.reassessment.b07a9b03.from: You cannot conduct your own oral assessment.

said.reassessment.cea9b770.text: Cet examen a décidé de {outcome}, et non d’une réévaluation orale.
said.reassessment.cea9b770.from: That review decided on {outcome}, not an oral reassessment.

said.reassessment.d374ded8.text: Cet apprenant a déjà été déclaré compétent pour cette évaluation.
said.reassessment.d374ded8.from: This learner has already been found competent on this assessment.

said.reassessment.df7ff299.text: Cette autorisation a déjà été utilisée. Une troisième tentative accordée deux fois n’est pas une troisième tentative.
said.reassessment.df7ff299.from: That authorisation has already been used. A third attempt granted twice is not a third attempt.

said.reassessment.eacc2318.text: Cette tentative n’est pas une réévaluation orale autorisée.
said.reassessment.eacc2318.from: That attempt is not an authorised oral reassessment.

said.reassessment.f272ec97.text: Vous avez autorisé cette troisième tentative ; c’est donc quelqu’un d’autre qui doit la conduire.
said.reassessment.f272ec97.from: You authorised this third attempt, so somebody else must conduct it.

said.reassessments.b53b937e.text: Notez au moins une question et la réponse donnée. Une réussite à l’oral sans trace de l’échange n’est pas une preuve.
said.reassessments.b53b937e.from: Write down at least one question and the answer given. An oral pass with no record of the exchange is not evidence.

said.recognition.056d89d8.text: Dispenser {title} porterait cet apprenant à {wouldBePercent} pour cent de la qualification reconnue sans avoir été enseignée, alors que la limite de cette qualification est de {maxPercent}. Le reste doit être fait comme apprentissage ordinaire, ou la limite doit être modifiée sur la qualification en indiquant un motif.
said.recognition.056d89d8.from: Exempting {title} would take this learner to {wouldBePercent} per cent of the qualification recognised without being taught, and the limit on this qualification is {maxPercent}. The rest has to be done as ordinary learning, or the limit changed on the qualification with a reason for it.

said.recognition.165f2f8f.text: Ce candidat n’a pas eu de séance de conseil. Juger des acquis antérieurs par rapport à des exigences que personne n’a expliquées, c’est ainsi qu’un candidat échoue pour avoir réuni les mauvaises preuves. Consignez d’abord les conseils donnés.
said.recognition.165f2f8f.from: This candidate has not had an advisory session. Judging prior learning against requirements nobody explained is how a candidate is failed for assembling the wrong evidence. Record the advice first.

said.recognition.2f3e0747.text: Jugement enregistré. Il n’accorde rien tant qu’il n’a pas été modéré.
said.recognition.2f3e0747.from: Judgement recorded. It grants nothing until it is moderated.

said.recognition.3d78b1cc.text: Indiquez ce que vous avez examiné et si vous êtes d’accord. Une modération sans commentaire n’est qu’une signature.
said.recognition.3d78b1cc.from: Say what you looked at and whether you agree. A moderation with no comment is a signature.

said.recognition.4cf70aee.text: Indiquez comment les résultats de ce qu’ils détiennent couvrent ceux de ce module. Ce paragraphe constitue toute la décision, et un transfert sans lui est une affirmation que personne ne peut vérifier.
said.recognition.4cf70aee.from: Say how the outcomes of what they hold cover this module's. That paragraph is the whole of the decision, and a transfer without it is a claim nobody can check.

said.recognition.61201ac5.text: Indiquez quelle était la preuve et pourquoi elle satisfait au module. Ce paragraphe constitue tout le jugement, et c’est la première chose que lit un vérificateur externe.
said.recognition.61201ac5.from: Say what the evidence was and why it satisfies the module. This paragraph is the whole of the judgement, and the first thing an external verifier reads.

said.recognition.86f838fe.text: Cela a été obtenu le {awardedOn}, plus de {CAT_YEARS} ans avant cette approbation. Le cumul et le transfert de crédits couvrent les réussites datant de moins de {CAT_YEARS2} ans ; au-delà, la voie est la reconnaissance des acquis antérieurs, qui évalue ce que l’apprenant sait encore faire plutôt que ce qu’il a réussi autrefois. Ouvrez plutôt une demande de reconnaissance des acquis antérieurs.
said.recognition.86f838fe.from: That was awarded on {awardedOn}, more than {CAT_YEARS} years before this approval. Credit Accumulation and Transfer covers completions within {CAT_YEARS2} years; beyond that the route is Recognition of Prior Learning, which assesses what the learner can still do rather than what they once passed. Open an RPL application instead.

said.recognition.a99e5f80.text: Cela n’a pas pu être enregistré.

said.recognition.d4a3fd91.text: Consignez ce qu’on a dit au candidat de rassembler. Un candidat refusé conteste ce paragraphe, et « conseillé sur les exigences » n’en est pas un.
said.recognition.d4a3fd91.from: Record what the candidate was told to gather. A refused candidate disputes this paragraph, and 'advised on requirements' is not one.

said.recognition.e046c5d9.text: Demande ouverte. Le conseil vient ensuite.

said.recognition.e21aaea2.text: Vous ne pouvez pas modérer votre propre jugement.
said.recognition.e21aaea2.from: You cannot moderate your own judgement.

said.recognition.e7122f98.text: Votre rôle ne comprend pas cela. La reconnaissance relève du personnel du prestataire, et un jugement est modéré par une autre personne que celle qui l’a rendu.
said.recognition.e7122f98.from: Your role does not include this. Recognition is held by the provider's own staff, and a judgement is moderated by somebody other than whoever made it.

said.record-store.177e55ac.text: L’entrepôt n’a pas pu être joint : {error}.
said.record-store.177e55ac.from: The store could not be reached: {error}.

said.record-store.2edd3c36.text: Cette plateforme n’a pas de clé pour sceller les secrets ; elle ne peut donc pas conserver la clé de l’entrepôt.
said.record-store.2edd3c36.from: This platform has no key to seal secrets with, so it cannot keep the store's key.

said.record-store.32a7ad42.text: La clé de l’entrepôt est nécessaire pour se connecter.
said.record-store.32a7ad42.from: The store's key is needed to connect.

said.record-store.426bb3b3.text: La clé de l’entrepôt ne peut plus être ouverte sur cette plateforme. Saisissez-la de nouveau sur la page Dossiers d’apprentissage.
said.record-store.426bb3b3.from: The store's key can no longer be opened on this platform. Enter it again on the Learning records page.

said.record-store.62143f17.text: Le nom de la clé est nécessaire.

said.record-store.76194b8f.text: L’entrepôt a refusé la clé ({status}). Vérifiez le nom et le secret de la clé sur la page Dossiers d’apprentissage.
said.record-store.76194b8f.from: The store refused the key ({status}). Check the key's name and secret on the Learning records page.

said.record-store.9f6b73a1.text: L’entrepôt a cessé de répondre en cours de route.
said.record-store.9f6b73a1.from: The store stopped answering part of the way through.

said.record-store.c387d2ea.text: L’adresse de l’entrepôt doit commencer par https://.
said.record-store.c387d2ea.from: The store's address must start with https://.

said.record-store.fe2456ba.text: L’adresse de l’entrepôt est introuvable (404). Vérifiez qu’il s’agit de l’adresse xAPI, celle qui se termine avant /statements.
said.record-store.fe2456ba.from: The store's address was not found (404). Check it is the xAPI address, the one ending before /statements.

said.records.05c230ea.text: Indiquez pourquoi ceci est conservé au-delà de sa durée de conservation. C’est une position assumée et non un oubli, et la raison a sa place dans le dossier.
said.records.05c230ea.from: Say why this is being kept beyond its retention period. It is a position rather than an oversight, and the reason belongs in the file.

said.records.94e6ebbb.from: That file is larger than {MAX_LIBRARY_BYTES} MB.

said.records.bd9361ef.text: Détruire un dossier est irréversible, et quelqu’un demandera un jour pourquoi un dossier voulu par un vérificateur n’est plus là. Indiquez pourquoi.
said.records.bd9361ef.from: Destroying a record is irreversible, and somebody will one day ask why a record a verifier wanted is not there. Say why.

said.roster-import.0e607b00.text: Ce classeur ne contient aucune feuille.
said.roster-import.0e607b00.from: That workbook has no sheets in it.

said.roster-import.1fd8a7f6.from: That file has nothing in it.

said.roster-import.2f5f5231.text: Aucune colonne n’a été trouvée pour : {missing}. Une personne ne peut pas être créée sans ces trois éléments. Les intitulés trouvés étaient : {Boolean}.
said.roster-import.2f5f5231.from: No column was found for: {missing}. A person cannot be created without those three. The headings found were: {Boolean}.

said.roster-import.c40fdd60.text: Les intitulés de colonne ont été pris à la ligne {headerIndex} et non à la ligne 1 : tout ce qui se trouve au-dessus ressemblait à un titre plutôt qu’à des intitulés.
said.roster-import.c40fdd60.from: The column headings were taken from line {headerIndex}, not line 1: everything above it looked like a title rather than headings.

said.roster-import.d7c8b42b.text: Les intitulés ont été lus, mais il n’y a aucune ligne en dessous.
said.roster-import.d7c8b42b.from: The headings were read but there are no rows under them.

said.roster-import.ddc568e6.text: Champs restant à renseigner : {open}. Intitulés de colonne non reconnus : {heading}
said.roster-import.ddc568e6.from: Fields still to fill: {open}. Unmatched column headings: {heading}

said.scheduling.0592fd69.text: Une séance ne peut pas se terminer à {endTime} après avoir commencé à {startTime}.
said.scheduling.0592fd69.from: A session cannot end at {endTime} having started at {startTime}.

said.scheduling.0b13beb2.text: Cette date d’induction est illisible ; un nom de cohorte ne peut donc pas en être construit.
said.scheduling.0b13beb2.from: That induction date cannot be read, so a cohort name cannot be built from it.

said.scheduling.53f8d453.text: Indiquez pourquoi la séance a été annulée ou reportée. Un calendrier comportant des trous inexpliqués est ce sur quoi porte une visite de suivi.
said.scheduling.53f8d453.from: Say why the session was cancelled or postponed. A schedule with unexplained gaps in it is the thing a monitoring visit asks about.

said.scheduling.5c76cb4b.text: Utilisez une heure au format 24 heures, par exemple 20:30.

said.scheduling.6c1a2122.text: Utilisez une heure au format 24 heures, par exemple 18:30.

said.scheduling.7ebc2d06.text: Cette personne n’est pas un membre actuel de cette cohorte ; elle ne peut donc pas être pointée sur son registre.
said.scheduling.7ebc2d06.from: That person is not a current member of this cohort, so they cannot be marked on its register.

said.scheduling.c988355e.text: Cette séance a été annulée ; il n’y a donc pas de registre à tenir. Personne n’a manqué un cours qui n’a pas eu lieu.
said.scheduling.c988355e.from: This session was cancelled, so there is no register to take. Nobody failed to attend a lecture that did not happen.

said.scorm.02fb5cf8.text: Le fichier de démarrage du manifeste ne se trouve pas dans le paquet.
said.scorm.02fb5cf8.from: The manifest's starting file is not inside the package.

said.scorm.05c16100.text: Cette leçon ne fait pas partie d’un cours auquel vous êtes inscrit.
said.scorm.05c16100.from: This lesson is not on a course you are enrolled on.

said.scorm.20ff1632.text: Le fichier zip n’a pas pu être ouvert. Il est peut-être endommagé ; exportez-le de nouveau depuis l’outil de création.
said.scorm.20ff1632.from: The zip could not be opened. It may be damaged; export it again from the authoring tool.

said.scorm.354841d8.text: Le paquet contient {filesCount} fichiers, plus que les {MAX_FILES} autorisés.
said.scorm.354841d8.from: The package has {filesCount} files, more than the {MAX_FILES} allowed.

said.scorm.380a5512.text: Seule la progression propre à l’apprenant est conservée.
said.scorm.380a5512.from: Only the learner's own progress is kept.

said.scorm.39e77a3f.text: Il s’agit d’un paquet cmi5. La plateforme lit pour l’instant les paquets SCORM 1.2 ; cmi5 viendra après SCORM 2004.
said.scorm.39e77a3f.from: This is a cmi5 package. The platform plays SCORM 1.2 packages so far; cmi5 comes after SCORM 2004.

said.scorm.42f68d85.text: Le fichier zip contient « {name} », un chemin qui sortirait du paquet.
said.scorm.42f68d85.from: The zip holds "{name}", a path that would leave the package.

said.scorm.4de81b55.text: Cette leçon n’a pas de paquet SCORM.
said.scorm.4de81b55.from: This lesson has no SCORM package.

said.scorm.63cfd3fc.text: Le manifeste ne nomme aucun fichier à partir duquel démarrer le paquet.
said.scorm.63cfd3fc.from: The manifest names no file to start the package from.

said.scorm.858c848d.text: Le manifeste indique « {version} », ce qui n’est pas SCORM 1.2.
said.scorm.858c848d.from: The manifest says it is "{version}", which is not SCORM 1.2.

said.scorm.90319b91.text: Le paquet décompressé dépasse un gigaoctet, ce qui est plus que ce dont un cours a besoin.
said.scorm.90319b91.from: The package unpacks to more than a gigabyte, which is more than a course needs.

said.scorm.d03f6670.text: Il s’agit d’un paquet SCORM 2004. La plateforme lit pour l’instant les paquets SCORM 1.2 ; 2004 est le prochain. La plupart des outils de création peuvent plutôt publier en SCORM 1.2.
said.scorm.d03f6670.from: This is a SCORM 2004 package. The platform plays SCORM 1.2 packages so far; 2004 is next. Most authoring tools can publish as SCORM 1.2 instead.

said.scorm.d37e77ff.text: Le manifeste démarre le paquet à « {launchFile} », qui ne se trouve pas dans le fichier zip.
said.scorm.d37e77ff.from: The manifest starts the package at "{launchFile}", which is not in the zip.

said.settings-drive-actions.b27a46f5.text: Ce n’est pas un lecteur que la plateforme connaît.
said.settings-drive-actions.b27a46f5.from: That is not a drive the platform knows.

said.settings-language-actions.ecc301e2.text: Seul un administrateur du prestataire peut modifier ceci.
said.settings-language-actions.ecc301e2.from: Only a provider administrator may change this.

said.settings-language-actions.f103b372.text: Enregistré. Les personnes qui n’ont pas choisi leur propre langue voient désormais celle-ci.
said.settings-language-actions.f103b372.from: Saved. People who have not chosen their own language now see this one.

said.settings-mail-actions.77394510.text: Votre rôle ne comprend pas le test du serveur de messagerie.
said.settings-mail-actions.77394510.from: Your role does not include testing the mail server.

said.settings-mail-actions.79f94bc8.text: Aucun serveur de messagerie n’est configuré sur ce déploiement ; rien ne peut donc encore être envoyé.
said.settings-mail-actions.79f94bc8.from: No mail server is set up on this deployment, so nothing can be sent yet.

said.settings-mail-actions.cb649383.text: Le serveur de messagerie a accepté la connexion. Les apprenants peuvent recevoir leurs identifiants de connexion et leurs notifications.
said.settings-mail-actions.cb649383.from: The mail server accepted the connection. Learners can be sent their sign-in details and notifications.

said.settings-mail-actions.cf3cfef0.text: La personne qui assure la maintenance de la plateforme doit définir MAIL_HOST et MAIL_FROM.
said.settings-mail-actions.cf3cfef0.from: Whoever maintains the platform needs to set MAIL_HOST and MAIL_FROM.

said.settings-mail-actions.f1ac9e08.text: Le serveur de messagerie n’a pas pu être joint à l’instant. Ce peut être temporaire ; réessayez dans un moment.
said.settings-mail-actions.f1ac9e08.from: The mail server could not be reached just now. This may be temporary; try again shortly.

said.settings-mail-actions.fc597e55.text: Le serveur de messagerie a refusé la connexion ; rien ne peut donc être envoyé.
said.settings-mail-actions.fc597e55.from: The mail server refused the connection, so nothing can be sent.

said.settings-menu-actions.0005a392.text: Seul un administrateur peut réorganiser le menu, car c’est le même menu pour tout le monde chez ce prestataire.
said.settings-menu-actions.0005a392.from: Only an administrator can rearrange the menu, because it is the same menu for everybody at this provider.

said.settings-menu-actions.c175275c.text: Enregistré. Tout le monde chez ce prestataire voit cette organisation.
said.settings-menu-actions.c175275c.from: Saved. Everybody at this provider sees this arrangement.

said.settings-menu-actions.c38853b5.text: Cette organisation n’a pas pu être lue. Rien n’a changé.
said.settings-menu-actions.c38853b5.from: That arrangement could not be read. Nothing changed.

said.settings-menu-actions.ffff057d.text: Cela laisserait chaque rubrique vide, c’est-à-dire un menu sans rien dedans. Rien n’a changé.
said.settings-menu-actions.ffff057d.from: That would leave every heading empty, which is a menu with nothing in it. Nothing changed.

said.settings-module-codes-actions.d585f.text: Ce tableau n’a pas pu être lu. Rouvrez-le et réessayez.
said.settings-module-codes-actions.d585f.from: That table could not be read. Reopen it and try again.

said.settings-sso-actions.4bbd36a4.from: Switched off, and its secret forgotten.

said.settings-sso-actions.52db415d.text: Enregistré. Déconnectez-vous et essayez depuis la page de connexion.
said.settings-sso-actions.52db415d.from: Saved. Sign out and try it from the sign-in page.

said.settings-sso-actions.56bfaa85.text: Seul un administrateur du prestataire peut modifier la façon dont les personnes se connectent.
said.settings-sso-actions.56bfaa85.from: Only a provider administrator may change how people sign in.

said.settings-template-actions.0690b0fe.text: Enregistré comme version {version}, en brouillon. Elle n’est pas utilisée tant que vous ne la mettez pas en service.
said.settings-template-actions.0690b0fe.from: Saved as version {version}, as a draft. It is not in use until you put it in use.

said.settings-template-actions.9cc3fe2a.text: Enregistré comme version {version}, et maintenant en service. Les documents de ce type sont désormais produits à partir de celle-ci ; ceux déjà délivrés conservent la version qui les a produits.
said.settings-template-actions.9cc3fe2a.from: Saved as version {version}, and now in use. Documents of this kind are produced from it from now on; ones already issued keep the version that produced them.

said.settings-template-actions.a1bce5df.text: Aucun modèle n’était en service pour ce document.
said.settings-template-actions.a1bce5df.from: There was no template in use for that document.

said.settings-template-actions.a1ec16e6.text: Retour à la mise en page propre à la plateforme. Votre modèle est conservé, pas supprimé ; vous pouvez le remettre en service.
said.settings-template-actions.a1ec16e6.from: Back to the platform's own layout. Your template is kept, not deleted, so you can put it back.

said.settings-template-actions.a53f381a.text: Ce n’est pas un document produit par la plateforme.
said.settings-template-actions.a53f381a.from: That is not a document the platform produces.

said.settings-terminology-actions.22580f.text: Enregistré. Tout le monde chez ce prestataire voit ces termes.
said.settings-terminology-actions.22580f.from: Saved. Everybody at this provider sees this wording.

said.settings-terminology-actions.8e2222.text: Rien ne diffère des termes standard ; les valeurs par défaut sont donc rétablies.
said.settings-terminology-actions.8e2222.from: Nothing differs from the standard wording, so the defaults are back.

said.settings-terminology-actions.98e913.text: Indiquez le singulier et le pluriel pour {one}, ou laissez les deux vides pour conserver la valeur par défaut.
said.settings-terminology-actions.98e913.from: Give both the singular and the plural for {one}, or leave both empty to keep the default.

said.settings-terminology-actions.bf53eb.text: Gardez chaque mot en dessous de 40 caractères.

said.settings-terminology-actions.c225e9.text: « {word} » est défini par un organisme de réglementation ; il ne peut donc pas servir à autre chose. Lui donner le nom d’un de vos propres termes placerait à l’écran d’un apprenant une affirmation que le dossier ne confirme pas.
said.settings-terminology-actions.c225e9.from: "{word}" is defined by a regulator, so it cannot be used for something else. Renaming one of your own words to it would put a claim on a learner's screen that the record does not support.

said.settings-terminology-actions.c27704.text: Seul un administrateur peut modifier le nom des choses, car ce sont les mêmes termes pour tout le monde chez ce prestataire.
said.settings-terminology-actions.c27704.from: Only an administrator can change what things are called, because it is the same wording for everybody at this provider.

said.settings.2e2de6f5.text: Enregistré. Les téléversements à venir seront lus de cette manière.
said.settings.2e2de6f5.from: Saved. Uploads from now on are read this way.

said.settings.5946b233.text: Enregistré. Elle est disponible mais pas activée. Utilisez le commutateur IA en haut de n’importe quelle page quand vous en avez besoin pour une tâche.
said.settings.5946b233.from: Saved. It is available but not switched on. Use the AI switch at the top of any page when you want it for a job.

said.settings.68c5f414.text: Jeton supprimé. Rien n’en est conservé.
said.settings.68c5f414.from: Token discarded. Nothing of it is kept.

said.settings.7a6e099f.text: Le prestataire n’a pas pu être interrogé sur ses modèles.
said.settings.7a6e099f.from: The provider could not be asked for its models.

said.settings.84b6dbd9.text: Votre rôle ne comprend pas l’assistance par modèle.
said.settings.84b6dbd9.from: Your role does not include model assistance.

said.settings.c0e1fe87.text: Enregistré. Les horaires du calendrier suivent désormais cette horloge.
said.settings.c0e1fe87.from: Saved. Timetabled times now mean this clock.

said.settings.f7c1c376.text: Enregistré. Tout le monde le voit à partir de sa prochaine page.
said.settings.f7c1c376.from: Saved. Everyone sees it from their next page.

said.settings.fdc694bf.text: Votre rôle ne comprend pas l’assistance par modèle. Elle est réservée au personnel du prestataire et non aux apprenants ni au tuteur en milieu de travail d’un employeur.
said.settings.fdc694bf.from: Your role does not include model assistance. It is held by the provider's own staff rather than by learners or by an employer's workplace coach.

said.single-sign-on.052b3446.text: La connexion n’a pas renvoyé d’identité.
said.single-sign-on.052b3446.from: The sign-in did not come back with an identity.

said.single-sign-on.07757676.text: La connexion a renvoyé une identité illisible.
said.single-sign-on.07757676.from: The sign-in came back with an identity that could not be read.

said.single-sign-on.180daa0a.text: La connexion avec {kind} n’est pas activée ici.
said.single-sign-on.180daa0a.from: Signing in with {kind} is not switched on here.

said.single-sign-on.2760f640.text: Microsoft a besoin de l’ID du répertoire (locataire) de votre organisation, un code comme 72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47, disponible sur la page Vue d’ensemble de l’application dans Microsoft Entra.
said.single-sign-on.2760f640.from: Microsoft needs your organisation's directory (tenant) ID, a code like 72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47, from the app's Overview page in Microsoft Entra.

said.single-sign-on.27f12034.text: Ce compte ne peut pas se connecter ici.
said.single-sign-on.27f12034.from: That account cannot sign in here.

said.single-sign-on.52f76de5.text: Le secret client est nécessaire pour se connecter.
said.single-sign-on.52f76de5.from: The client secret is needed to connect.

said.single-sign-on.90b663ad.from: Google has not verified the address

said.single-sign-on.af8cc19b.text: Cette plateforme n’a pas de clé pour sceller les secrets ; elle ne peut donc pas conserver le secret client.
said.single-sign-on.af8cc19b.from: This platform has no key to seal secrets with, so it cannot keep the client secret.

said.single-sign-on.b83f2863.text: Cette connexion n’a pas été lancée depuis cette page. Réessayez.
said.single-sign-on.b83f2863.from: That sign-in was not started from this page. Try again.

said.south-african-id.2a092f1a.text: Un numéro d’identité comporte exactement 13 chiffres.
said.south-african-id.2a092f1a.from: An identity number is exactly 13 digits.

said.south-african-id.46e0f0e5.text: Le mois de la date de naissance n’est pas valide.
said.south-african-id.46e0f0e5.from: The month in the date of birth is not valid.

said.south-african-id.738d1584.text: La date de naissance n’est pas une vraie date.
said.south-african-id.738d1584.from: The date of birth is not a real date.

said.south-african-id.95e7bd33.text: Il n’existe aucun chiffre de contrôle Luhn valide.
said.south-african-id.95e7bd33.from: No valid Luhn check digit exists.

said.south-african-id.e46ae644.text: Le chiffre de citoyenneté doit être 0 ou 1.
said.south-african-id.e46ae644.from: The citizenship digit must be 0 or 1.

said.south-african-id.f2f17cbd.text: Le chiffre de contrôle ne correspond pas ; le numéro a probablement été mal saisi.
said.south-african-id.f2f17cbd.from: The check digit does not match; the number was likely mistyped.

said.spine-editor.2a5955ae.text: Publié, mais aucune de ses épreuves ne l’est. Un apprenant n’aurait rien à quoi répondre.
said.spine-editor.2a5955ae.from: Published, but none of its papers are. A learner would find nothing to answer.

said.spine-editor.c209d3d2.text: Ceci est encore un brouillon. Il peut être ajouté au parcours dès maintenant, et un apprenant ne le verra pas proposé tant qu’il n’est pas publié.
said.spine-editor.c209d3d2.from: This is still a draft. It can go on the spine now, and a learner will not be offered it until it is published.

said.spine.09e0bbde.text: Une étape {kind} doit nommer le {kind2} qu’elle vise.
said.spine.09e0bbde.from: A {kind} step has to name the {kind2} it points at.

said.spine.0b4713d6.text: « {title} » est formative ; elle ne produit donc jamais de décision de compétence, et une étape conditionnelle qui en attendrait une ne s’ouvrirait jamais. Attendez plutôt qu’elle soit remise ou corrigée.
said.spine.0b4713d6.from: "{title}" is formative, so it never produces a competence decision, so a gate waiting for one would never open. Wait for it to be handed in or marked instead.

said.spine.129de092.text: Indiquez pourquoi cet apprenant est autorisé à passer. Cela figure dans son dossier et dans le dossier de modération.
said.spine.129de092.from: Say why this learner is being let past. It is shown on their record and in the moderation pack.

said.spine.42a3be59.text: Une étape ne peut pas s’attendre elle-même.
said.spine.42a3be59.from: A step cannot wait for itself.

said.spine.7287fb1d.text: Une leçon ou un document n’est pas évalué ; il ne peut donc pas être jugé compétent. Attendez plutôt qu’il soit ouvert.
said.spine.7287fb1d.from: A lesson or a document is not assessed, so it cannot be judged competent. Wait for it to be opened instead.

said.spine.81239e1c.text: Seul un module d’expérience en milieu de travail est validé. Choisissez une autre règle.
said.spine.81239e1c.from: Only a work experience module is signed off. Pick another rule.

said.spine.83528293.text: Une étape ne peut attendre qu’une autre étape du même cours.
said.spine.83528293.from: A step can only wait for another step on the same course.

said.spine.91ceb611.text: Le nouvel ordre doit énumérer chaque étape du cours exactement une fois.
said.spine.91ceb611.from: The new order has to list every step of the course exactly once.

said.spine.ca9b3b5c.text: Cela ferait attendre deux étapes l’une après l’autre, et aucune ne s’ouvrirait jamais.
said.spine.ca9b3b5c.from: That would make two steps wait for each other, and neither would ever open.

said.spine.d5e61b5f.text: Ce document est tenu à l’écart des apprenants ; il ne peut donc pas être une étape de leur parcours. Une épreuve sommative leur parvient plutôt comme évaluation saisie.
said.spine.d5e61b5f.from: That document is kept from learners, so it cannot be a step on their path. A summative paper reaches them as a captured assessment instead.

said.spine.fc076d64.text: Ce document est rédigé pour le personnel et non pour être travaillé par les apprenants ; il ne peut donc pas être une étape de leur parcours.
said.spine.fc076d64.from: That document is written for staff rather than for learners to work through, so it cannot be a step on their path.

said.statement-of-results.09720fce.text: Aucun module n’entre dans le périmètre de ce relevé ; il n’y a donc rien à confirmer.
said.statement-of-results.09720fce.from: There are no modules in scope for this statement, so there is nothing for it to confirm.

said.statement-of-results.3b26ff7f.text: Indiquez une raison. Elle est montrée à toute personne qui vérifie la référence.
said.statement-of-results.3b26ff7f.from: Give a reason. It is shown to anybody who checks the reference.

said.statement-of-results.57e1914e.text: Cet apprenant détient déjà un relevé de résultats pour {code}. Retirez-le avant d’en délivrer un autre, afin que deux documents affirmant la même chose ne circulent jamais.
said.statement-of-results.57e1914e.from: This learner already holds a Statement of Results for {code}. Withdraw it before issuing another, so two documents making the same claim are never in circulation.

said.statement-of-results.ab61210b.text: Le curriculum n’est pas entièrement saisi : {uncaptured} ne portent rien à atteindre. Un relevé délivré maintenant confirmerait la réussite de modules que personne n’a transcrits.
said.statement-of-results.ab61210b.from: The curriculum is not fully captured: {uncaptured} carry nothing to achieve. A statement issued now would confirm achievement of modules nobody has transcribed.

said.statement-of-results.b5359f01.text: Cet apprenant détient déjà un relevé de résultats pour cette qualification. Retirez-le avant d’en délivrer un autre, afin que deux documents affirmant la même chose ne circulent jamais.
said.statement-of-results.b5359f01.from: This learner already holds a Statement of Results for this qualification. Withdraw it before issuing another, so two documents making the same claim are never in circulation.

said.statements-id.5fd85b7c.text: Votre rôle ne comprend pas le retrait d’un relevé de résultats.
said.statements-id.5fd85b7c.from: Your role does not include withdrawing a Statement of Results.

said.statements-id.f9ea555b.text: Retiré. La référence reste consultable et l’indique.
said.statements-id.f9ea555b.from: Withdrawn. The reference still resolves, and says so.

said.statutory-export-file.10c070ac.text: Cette déclaration présente des problèmes qui doivent être corrigés avant que les fichiers puissent être produits. Consultez la page des déclarations réglementaires.
said.statutory-export-file.10c070ac.from: This return has problems that must be fixed before the files can be produced. See the statutory reporting page.

said.statutory-notification.0931542b.text: Cet apprenant ne fait pas partie de la cohorte.
said.statutory-notification.0931542b.from: That learner is not in the cohort.

said.statutory-notification.1e928484.text: Obligatoire, et contenu dans le numéro d’identité.
said.statutory-notification.1e928484.from: Required, and it is inside the identity number.

said.statutory-notification.5c135418.text: L’apprenant n’a pas donné son accord sur le formulaire d’inscription.
said.statutory-notification.5c135418.from: The learner has not agreed on the enrolment form.

said.statutory-notification.69c68cc0.text: Le numéro d’accréditation du prestataire, tiré des paramètres de l’organisation.
said.statutory-notification.69c68cc0.from: The provider's own accreditation number, from the tenant's settings.

said.statutory-notification.6a2cb727.text: Obligatoire, et doit correspondre au numéro d’identité.
said.statutory-notification.6a2cb727.from: Required, and must match the identity number.

said.statutory-notification.83725bbd.text: L’identifiant SAQA de ce à quoi l’apprenant est inscrit.
said.statutory-notification.83725bbd.from: The SAQA identifier of what the learner is enrolled on.

said.statutory-notification.9cf40e0d.from: The province the learner works in.

said.statutory-notification.a5a405af.text: Un accusé de réception nécessite la référence délivrée par le QCTO.
said.statutory-notification.a5a405af.from: An acknowledgement needs the reference the QCTO issued.

said.statutory-notification.bbfb1dec.text: Un handicap est enregistré ; le QCTO exige donc de préciser l’ampleur de la difficulté qu’il cause.
said.statutory-notification.bbfb1dec.from: A disability is recorded, so the QCTO requires how much difficulty it causes.

said.statutory-notification.ce4a70ee.text: Tiré du formulaire d’inscription de l’apprenant.

said.statutory-notify.77d191e5.text: Brouillon établi, couvrant {learnerIdsCount} apprenants. Téléchargez le classeur, vérifiez-le, puis consignez qu’il a été envoyé.
said.statutory-notify.77d191e5.from: Drafted, covering {learnerIdsCount} learners. Download the workbook, check it, then record that it went.

said.statutory-notify.7e3fae5a.text: Retour à la date d’induction propre à la cohorte.
said.statutory-notify.7e3fae5a.from: Back to the cohort's own induction date.

said.statutory-notify.8cc067d9.text: Brouillon établi, couvrant {learnerIdsCount} apprenant. Téléchargez le classeur, vérifiez-le, puis consignez qu’il a été envoyé.
said.statutory-notify.8cc067d9.from: Drafted, covering {learnerIdsCount} learner. Download the workbook, check it, then record that it went.

said.statutory-notify.90d2c47a.text: Choisissez au moins un apprenant à notifier.
said.statutory-notify.90d2c47a.from: Choose at least one learner to notify about.

said.statutory-notify.e80fd17b.text: Enregistré comme envoyé. Ajoutez l’accusé de réception lorsqu’il reviendra.
said.statutory-notify.e80fd17b.from: Recorded as sent. Add the acknowledgement when it comes back.

said.statutory-notify.fbbcde8b.text: Sa propre date d’induction est enregistrée, et son délai court désormais à partir de celle-ci.
said.statutory-notify.fbbcde8b.from: Their own induction date is recorded, and their deadline now runs from it.

said.statutory.36c11667.text: L’apprenant a été inscrit après la clôture de la période d’enregistrement de la qualification.
said.statutory.36c11667.from: The learner was enrolled after the qualification's registration period closed.

said.statutory.5a5791f9.text: Aucun numéro d’enregistrement n’est consigné pour l’évaluateur. Le NLRD vérifie l’enregistrement de l’évaluateur par rapport à la réussite.
said.statutory.5a5791f9.from: The assessor has no registration number recorded. The NLRD verifies assessor registration against the achievement.

said.statutory.937d409a.text: Aucun code de circonscription municipale enregistré. Le dossier du prestataire est validé jusqu’au niveau de la circonscription.
said.statutory.937d409a.from: No municipal ward code recorded. The Provider Record is validated down to ward level.

said.statutory.a57124be.text: Le module du curriculum n’a aucune valeur de crédits enregistrée.
said.statutory.a57124be.from: The curriculum module has no credit value recorded.

said.statutory.aafb40c2.text: Le numéro d’accréditation du prestataire est manquant. Chaque dossier de la déclaration est classé sous ce numéro.
said.statutory.aafb40c2.from: The provider accreditation number is missing. Every record in the return is filed against it.

said.statutory.cc126904.text: Aucun numéro d’enregistrement n’est consigné pour le modérateur.
said.statutory.cc126904.from: The moderator has no registration number recorded.

said.statutory.e08f5796.text: Aucun code d’équité enregistré ; le NLRD signale les données d’équité manquantes.
said.statutory.e08f5796.from: No equity code recorded; the NLRD flags missing equity data.

said.statutory.ef816888.text: La qualification n’a pas d’identifiant SAQA ; l’inscription ne peut donc pas être classée sous celle-ci.
said.statutory.ef816888.from: The qualification has no SAQA ID, so the enrolment cannot be filed against it.

said.storage-s3.01b74469.text: STORAGE_DRIVER est « s3 » mais {missing} ne sont pas définis. Les preuves ne peuvent pas être stockées tant qu’ils ne le sont pas.
said.storage-s3.01b74469.from: STORAGE_DRIVER is "s3" but {missing} are not set. Evidence cannot be stored until they are.

said.storage-s3.cda404d0.text: STORAGE_DRIVER est « s3 » mais {missing} n’est pas défini. Les preuves ne peuvent pas être stockées tant qu’il ne l’est pas.
said.storage-s3.cda404d0.from: STORAGE_DRIVER is "s3" but {missing} is not set. Evidence cannot be stored until they are.

said.study-unit-alignment.dfcd9590.text: Le document nomme {wantedCount} modules ({wanted}) et cette qualification n’a pas encore de curriculum. Importez d’abord le curriculum ; les unités d’étude et leurs résultats sont enregistrés dans les deux cas, et téléverser de nouveau ce document ensuite les reliera.
said.study-unit-alignment.dfcd9590.from: The document names {wantedCount} modules ({wanted}) and this qualification has no curriculum yet. Import the curriculum first; the study units and their outcomes are recorded either way, and uploading this document again afterwards will link them.

said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.text: Aucun des {wantedCount} modules que nomme ce document n’a pu être mis en correspondance ; rien n’a donc été placé sous une unité d’étude. Le document nomme {wanted}. Ce curriculum contient {held}. La correspondance ignore les espaces et les traits d’union ; les deux systèmes diffèrent donc réellement. Corrigez les codes d’un côté ou de l’autre et téléversez de nouveau le document.
said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.from: None of the {wantedCount} modules this document names could be matched, so nothing has been placed under a study unit. The document names {wanted}. This curriculum holds {held}. Matching ignores spaces and hyphens, so the two schemes genuinely differ. Correct the codes on either side and upload the document again.

said.support.2b757921.text: Une évaluation orale ne fait suite à un deuxième échec que pour raison médicale. Sans raison médicale, le résultat est un forfait, que l’apprenant peut encore contester par un recours.
said.support.2b757921.from: An oral assessment follows a second miss only on medical grounds. Without one the outcome is a forfeit, which the learner can still appeal.

said.support.32314e12.text: L’apprenant doit accepter que cela soit consigné avant que cela puisse l’être. La santé, le handicap et la situation financière sont des informations personnelles particulières, et accepter de s’inscrire n’était pas accepter cela.
said.support.32314e12.from: The learner has to agree to this being recorded before it can be. Health, disability and financial circumstances are special personal information, and agreeing to enrol was not agreeing to this.

said.support.3e521f24.text: Indiquez pourquoi le soutien prend fin. Un apprenant dont l’aménagement cesse sans motif n’a aucun moyen de demander qu’on le rétablisse.
said.support.3e521f24.from: Say why the support is ending. A learner whose accommodation stops without a reason has no way to ask for it back.

said.support.6396d34b.text: Une date supplémentaire a déjà été fixée pour cette évaluation : {additionalDate}, après une absence le {missedOn}. La procédure n’en autorise qu’une. Si cette date a aussi été manquée, consignez ce qui s’est passé plutôt que d’en fixer une autre.
said.support.6396d34b.from: An additional date was already set for this assessment: {additionalDate}, after a miss on {missedOn}. The procedure allows one. If that date was also missed, record what happened to it rather than setting another.

said.support.6af4db9d.text: Si l’aménagement ne fonctionne pas, indiquez ce qui change. Un examen qui consigne un échec sans rien ajuster passe pour de la diligence et en est le contraire.
said.support.6af4db9d.from: If the accommodation is not working, say what is changing. A review that records a failure and adjusts nothing reads as diligence and is the opposite.

said.support.7af7d42b.text: La date supplémentaire doit être postérieure à celle qui a été manquée.
said.support.7af7d42b.from: The additional date has to be after the one that was missed.

said.support.8452172c.text: Indiquez ce que vous avez constaté. Un examen sans constat n’est qu’une date dans un dossier.
said.support.8452172c.from: Say what you found. A review with no finding is a date in a file.

said.support.e34f2e55.text: Indiquez ce qui sera réellement fait. Un besoin sans aménagement correspondant ne change rien pour l’apprenant.
said.support.e34f2e55.from: Say what will actually be done. A need with no accommodation against it changes nothing for the learner.

said.support.f41a730d.text: Ce besoin de soutien est clos.

said.support.f4565c1a.text: Indiquez quel était le motif médical. Une évaluation orale autorisée pour une raison non consignée est précisément la session dont s’enquiert un vérificateur externe.
said.support.f4565c1a.from: Say what the medical ground was. An oral assessment authorised on an unrecorded reason is the sitting an external verifier asks about.

said.topic-element.bcd147d2.text: Cette ligne du curriculum n’appartient pas à cette qualification.
said.topic-element.bcd147d2.from: That curriculum line does not belong to this qualification.

said.topic-element.f4f5291a.text: Cette ligne du curriculum n’est pas ici.
said.topic-element.f4f5291a.from: That curriculum line is not here.

said.tracker.e03483b8.text: Cette tâche est à rendre le {dueDate}, avant son début le {startDate}.
said.tracker.e03483b8.from: That task is due on {dueDate}, before it starts on {startDate}.

said.unit-competency.34155bb7.text: Ce que chaque unité d’étude de cette qualification permet d’atteindre : son résultat de niveau de sortie, ou l’unité elle-même lorsqu’elle n’en sert aucun. Établi par la plateforme à partir des propres documents de la qualification.
said.unit-competency.34155bb7.from: What each study unit of this qualification achieves: its exit level outcome, or the unit itself where it serves none. Made by the platform from the qualification's own documents.

said.uploads.05c9749b.from: A logo has to be an image. That file is {label}.

said.uploads.4d034d1a.from: That evidence belongs to somebody else.

said.uploads.6d95a4d9.from: This submission has already been assessed, so evidence cannot be added to it.

said.uploads.a3750fa1.text: Cette soumission appartient à quelqu’un d’autre.
said.uploads.a3750fa1.from: That submission belongs to somebody else.

said.uploads.b414a1d0.text: Ce cours est publié. Créez une nouvelle version pour modifier son contenu.
said.uploads.b414a1d0.from: This course is published. Create a new version to change its content.

said.uploads.d61f0c85.from: That image is {byteLength}. A logo is displayed small, so the limit is {LOGO_MAX_BYTES}. A PNG with a transparent background works best.

said.workplace.49fbb31b.from: Choose an agreement and a work experience module.

said.workplace.9be67445.text: Choisissez à la fois un apprenant et un tuteur en milieu de travail.
said.workplace.9be67445.from: Choose both a learner and a workplace coach.

said.workplace.a04f43fb.text: Ce fichier n’a pas pu être joint.

said.workplace.b858e9d3.from: This logbook has already been submitted.

said.workplace.dab82d97.from: Signed work experience is ready to accept

said.workplace.e681f60c.text: Cet apprenant a déjà un carnet de bord ouvert pour ce module.

shell.account.text: Il Suo account: password e lingua

login.intro.text: Accedere per continuare il proprio apprendimento.
login.intro.from: Sign in to continue your learning.

login.trouble.text: Problemi di accesso? Rivolgersi al proprio facilitatore: può reimpostare la password.
login.trouble.from: Trouble signing in? Speak to your facilitator: they can reset a password for you.

login.wrong.text: Le credenziali inserite non sono corrette.

login.locked.text: Troppi tentativi. Attendere quindici minuti e riprovare.
login.locked.from: Too many attempts. Wait fifteen minutes and try again.

login.missing.from: Enter your email address and password.

login.sso.refused.text: Questo account non può accedere qui. Deve usare lo stesso indirizzo email dell'account su questa piattaforma. Accedere con la password oppure rivolgersi all'amministratore.
login.sso.refused.from: That account cannot sign in here. It has to use the same email address as your account on this platform. Sign in with your password, or ask your administrator.

login.sso.expired.text: L'accesso ha richiesto troppo tempo oppure è stato avviato altrove. Riprovare.
login.sso.expired.from: That sign-in took too long, or was started somewhere else. Try again.

login.sso.off.text: Questa modalità di accesso non è attivata qui.
login.sso.off.from: That way of signing in is not switched on here.

account.forcedIntro.text: La password con cui ha effettuato l'accesso è stata impostata da un'altra persona. Sostituirla prima di proseguire.
account.forcedIntro.from: Somebody else set the password you signed in with. Replace it before carrying on.

account.newHint.text: Almeno 12 caratteri. Una frase composta da poche parole senza legame tra loro è più sicura e più facile da ricordare di una sequenza breve con simboli.
account.newHint.from: At least 12 characters. A phrase of a few unrelated words is both stronger and easier to remember than something short with symbols in it.

account.mismatch.text: Le due nuove password non coincidono.
account.mismatch.from: The two new passwords do not match.

account.forcedNote.text: La modifica disconnette chiunque altro stia usando la vecchia password, inclusa la persona che gliel'ha comunicata.
account.forcedNote.from: Changing it signs out anyone else using the old password, including whoever passed it to you.

account.languageIntro.text: La lingua in cui la piattaforma si rivolge a Lei. Le schermate non ancora tradotte restano in inglese e le denominazioni proprie del Suo ente formativo vengono mantenute come le ha scritte.
account.languageIntro.from: The language this platform speaks to you in. Screens not yet translated stay in English, and your provider's own names for things are kept as they wrote them.

learn.notYours.text: Sta visualizzando l'iscrizione di un'altra persona. Può vedere i progressi ma non registrarli al suo posto.
learn.notYours.from: You are viewing someone else's enrolment. You can see their progress but cannot record it for them.

learn.noLessons.text: Questo corso non contiene ancora lezioni.
learn.noLessons.from: This course has no lessons yet.

learn.openMaterial.text: Apri il materiale di questa lezione
learn.openMaterial.from: Open the material for this lesson

learn.noContent.text: Nessun contenuto scritto per questa lezione.
learn.noContent.from: No written content for this lesson.

learn.scormNote.text: Questa lezione si completa al termine del pacchetto qui sopra. Il punto raggiunto viene conservato se si interrompe a metà.
learn.scormNote.from: This lesson completes when you finish it in the package above. Your place is kept if you stop part of the way through.

learn.openedByFacilitator.text: Aperto per Lei dal Suo facilitatore: {reason}
learn.openedByFacilitator.from: Opened for you by your facilitator: {reason}

home.feedbackMany.from: A few things to tell us

home.feedbackIntro.text: Le risposte vengono riportate in forma aggregata con quelle di tutti gli altri, non singolarmente. Bastano due minuti per ciascuna ed è l'unica cosa che cambia il modo in cui verrà gestita la prossima coorte.
home.feedbackIntro.from: Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. Two minutes each, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

home.earnedIntro.text: Registrato il giorno del completamento, anziché quando arriva infine il certificato. Ognuno riporta un riferimento che chiunque può verificare.
home.earnedIntro.from: Recorded on the day you finished, rather than when the certificate eventually arrives. Each carries a reference anybody can check.

home.step.afterPrevious.text: Si apre al termine del passaggio precedente
home.step.afterPrevious.from: Opens when you finish the step before

home.nothingOutside.text: Nulla al di fuori dei Suoi programmi.

home.nothingYet.text: Non Le è ancora stato assegnato nulla.
home.nothingYet.from: You have not been assigned anything yet.

home.statementsIntro.text: Portarlo alla valutazione esterna insieme al documento d'identità. Il centro lo controlla prima di consentirLe di sostenere la prova.
home.statementsIntro.from: Take this to the external assessment with your identity document. The centre checks it before you may sit.

assess.waiting.text: In attesa della revisione di un valutatore.
assess.waiting.from: Waiting for an assessor to review it.

assess.developmental.text: Questa è una valutazione formativa. Nulla di quanto riportato va a Suo svantaggio.
assess.developmental.from: This is developmental. Nothing here counts against you.

assess.competent.text: In questa valutazione è stato dichiarato competente, quindi non è necessario sostenerla di nuovo.
assess.competent.from: You have been found competent on this assessment, so there is nothing to sit again.

assess.noAttempts.text: Ha esaurito tutti i tentativi a disposizione per questa valutazione.
assess.noAttempts.from: You have used all your attempts at this assessment.

assess.awaitingAssessor.text: Questa valutazione concorre alla Sua qualifica, quindi un valutatore la esaminerà e registrerà la decisione sulla competenza. Il risultato sarà visibile a operazione conclusa.
assess.awaitingAssessor.from: This assessment counts towards your qualification, so an assessor will review it and record the competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

assess.practicePassed.text: Era un'esercitazione, quindi il risultato viene registrato nel Suo percorso di apprendimento ma non decide l'esito di una qualifica.
assess.practicePassed.from: This was practice, so the result is recorded against your learning but does not decide a qualification.

assess.practiceFailed.text: Era un'esercitazione. Riveda il materiale e riprovi.
assess.practiceFailed.from: This was practice. Review the material and try again.

assess.pair.text: Abbinare ciascun elemento a sinistra a uno a destra.
assess.pair.from: Pair each item on the left with one on the right.

assess.whyMarked.text: Viene valutata la motivazione indicata qui, non la casella sopra.
assess.whyMarked.from: The reason is what is marked here, not the box above.

assess.keptAt.text: Le Sue risposte sono state conservate alle {time}. Solo l'invio le trasmette per la correzione.
assess.keptAt.from: Your answers were kept at {time}. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

assess.kept.text: Le Sue risposte vengono conservate mentre lavora. Solo l'invio le trasmette per la correzione.
assess.kept.from: Your answers are kept as you work. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

evidence.uploadFailed.text: Il caricamento non è riuscito. Verificare la connessione e riprovare.
evidence.uploadFailed.from: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.

evidence.doneIntro.text: Un valutatore le esaminerà e registrerà una decisione sulla competenza. Il risultato sarà visibile a operazione conclusa.
evidence.doneIntro.from: An assessor will review it and record a competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

evidence.fingerprinted.text: Ogni file è stato dotato di un'impronta digitale:

evidence.fingerprintNote.text: Se un file archiviato venisse modificato, la sua impronta non coinciderebbe più. Ciò tutela il Suo lavoro tanto quanto la valutazione.
evidence.fingerprintNote.from: If any stored file were ever altered, its fingerprint would stop matching. That protects your work as much as it protects the assessment.

evidence.kinds.text: Fotografie, una registrazione dell'attività, un registro scansionato o un documento. È possibile allegare più file contemporaneamente.
evidence.kinds.from: Photographs, a recording of the task, a scanned logbook, or a document. You can attach several at once.

evidence.note.text: Ciò che il valutatore dovrebbe sapere

paper.summative.text: Questa prova è valutata e concorre alla Sua qualifica.
paper.summative.from: This is assessed and counts towards your qualification.

paper.formative.text: Questa è una preparazione. Viene corretta e Le viene restituita, e non decide nulla.
paper.formative.from: This is preparation. It is marked and returned to you, and it does not decide anything.

paper.goBack.text: Torni al corso per vedere che cosa resta da fare.
paper.goBack.from: Go back to the course to see what is still outstanding.

paper.notSaved.text: La risposta non è stata salvata.

paper.connection.text: La risposta non è stata salvata. La connessione potrebbe essersi interrotta; verrà ritentato al prossimo cambiamento.
paper.connection.from: That answer did not save. Your connection may have dropped; it will be tried again when you next change something.

paper.handInFailed.from: That could not be handed in.

paper.handInConnection.text: Non è stato possibile consegnare. Verificare la connessione e riprovare.
paper.handInConnection.from: That could not be handed in. Check your connection and try again.

paper.detail.text: Rispondere in modo dettagliato, facendo riferimento ai principi studiati.
paper.detail.from: Answer in detail, referring to the principles you have studied.

paper.handedIn.text: Ha consegnato questa prova. Non può essere modificata.
paper.handedIn.from: You handed this in. It cannot be changed.

paper.final.text: Una volta consegnata, non può essere modificata.
paper.final.from: Once handed in, this cannot be changed.

paper.confirm.from: Confirm the declaration to hand in.

paper.savedAsYouGo.text: il Suo lavoro viene salvato man mano
paper.savedAsYouGo.from: your work is saved as you go

notify.nothingYet.text: Ancora nulla. Qui verrà avvisato quando una formazione viene assegnata o è in scadenza, quando un'attività è in attesa di Lei e quando arriva il risultato di una valutazione o un certificato.
notify.nothingYet.from: Nothing yet. You will be told here when training is assigned or due, when work is waiting for you, and when an assessment result or certificate arrives.

cert.withdrawn.text: Questo certificato è stato ritirato il {date}.

cert.notNational.text: Questo è il certificato di {provider} relativo a un corso da esso erogato. Non è una qualifica nazionale e non riporta alcun credito né identificativo SAQA. Quando un discente sta lavorando a una qualifica professionale, il relativo certificato viene rilasciato dal QCTO.
cert.notNational.from: This is {provider}'s own certificate for a course it delivered. It is not a national qualification and does not carry a SAQA credit or identifier. Where a learner is working towards an occupational qualification, the certificate for it is issued by the QCTO.

cert.anyone.text: Chiunque può confermare questo certificato con il riferimento sopra indicato, senza bisogno di un account.
cert.anyone.from: Anyone can confirm this certificate with the reference above, without needing an account.

work.introCoach.text: I discenti che supervisiona. Lei conferma ciò che hanno fatto sul luogo di lavoro; nulla giunge a un valutatore senza la Sua firma.
work.introCoach.from: The learners you supervise. You confirm what they did in the workplace; nothing reaches an assessor without your signature.

work.introLearner.text: L'esperienza lavorativa si svolge presso un datore di lavoro e viene convalidata dal tutor aziendale di quella sede. L'ordine è fisso: la si registra, il proprio tutor la conferma, poi passa a un valutatore.
work.introLearner.from: Work experience is done at an employer and signed off by the workplace coach there. The order is fixed: you record it, your coach confirms it, then it goes to an assessor.

work.waitingOne.text: 1 {record} è in attesa della Sua firma.

work.waitingMany.text: {count} {records} sono in attesa della Sua firma.

work.noneManage.text: Nessun {records} per ora. Ne configuri uno qui sopra: un accordo che indichi il discente, il datore di lavoro e il tutor, poi uno per ciascun modulo di esperienza lavorativa.
work.noneManage.from: No {records} yet. Set one up above: an agreement naming the learner, the employer and the coach, then one for each work experience module.

work.none.text: Nessun {records} per ora. Un amministratore ne apre uno quando esiste un accordo di lavoro che indica il discente, il datore di lavoro e il tutor.
work.none.from: No {records} yet. An administrator opens one once a workplace agreement is in place naming the learner, the employer and the coach.

work.kind.work_activity.text: Attività lavorative: ciò che si svolge

work.kind.contextual_knowledge.text: Conoscenze professionali: ciò di cui si deve saper parlare
work.kind.contextual_knowledge.from: Workplace knowledge: what you must be able to speak to

work.kind.supporting_evidence.text: Evidenze a supporto: ciò che il luogo di lavoro deve produrre
work.kind.supporting_evidence.from: Supporting evidence: what the workplace must produce

work.outstanding.text: Ancora da completare: {items}. Il tutor non può firmare finché ogni voce non è completata e ogni evidenza a supporto non ha un file allegato.
work.outstanding.from: Still outstanding: {items}. Your coach cannot sign until every line is done and every piece of supporting evidence has a file attached.

work.allRecorded.text: Tutto è registrato. Lo invii al tutor quando è pronto.
work.allRecorded.from: Everything is recorded. Send it to your coach when you are ready.

work.signingMeans.text: Firmando si registra di aver verificato queste evidenze e di attestarle qualora il valutatore La contatti. Non può essere modificato in seguito.
work.signingMeans.from: Signing records that you checked this evidence and will attest to it if the assessor contacts you. It cannot be changed afterwards.

work.forAssessor.text: Ciò che il valutatore dovrebbe sapere

work.readyForPoe.text: Firmato dal tutor aziendale e pronto per essere inserito nel Portfolio di evidenze.
work.readyForPoe.from: Signed by the workplace coach and ready to be taken into the Portfolio of Evidence.

scorm.failed.text: Non è stato possibile aprire il pacchetto. Verificare la connessione e riprovare.
scorm.failed.from: The package could not be opened. Check your connection and try again.

scorm.preview.text: Anteprima: ciò che il pacchetto segnala non viene conservato, perché non si tratta della Sua iscrizione.
scorm.preview.from: A preview: what the package reports is not kept, because this is not your own enrolment.

certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.text: Il discente potrebbe aver fornito il riferimento a un datore di lavoro. Esso continua a essere valido e indicherà che il certificato è stato ritirato.
certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.from: The learner may have given the reference to an employer. It keeps resolving and will say it was withdrawn.

assessing.intro.text: Consegne pronte per un giudizio sulla competenza. Non può valutare il Suo stesso lavoro e una parte delle Sue decisioni sarà riesaminata in modo indipendente da un moderatore.
assessing.intro.from: Submissions ready for a competency judgement. You cannot assess your own work, and a proportion of your decisions will be reviewed independently by a moderator.

assessing.empty.text: Nulla in attesa. Le consegne compaiono qui man mano che i discenti le inviano.
assessing.empty.from: Nothing is waiting. Submissions appear here as learners send them in.

assessing.onScreen.text: Questa prova è stata svolta a schermo. {link}: le risposte, le indicazioni di correzione e la matrice si trovano insieme lì, e i criteri vengono calcolati automaticamente una volta corretta.
assessing.onScreen.from: This was answered on screen. {link}: the answers, the marking guidance and the matrix are together there, and the criteria are worked out for you once it is marked.

assessing.ownWork.text: Questa è una Sua consegna. Non può valutarla; deve farlo un'altra persona.
assessing.ownWork.from: This is your own submission. You cannot assess it; someone else must.

assessing.answered.text: Ciò che il discente ha risposto

assessing.hash.text: L'hash viene registrato al momento del caricamento. Se un file archiviato viene modificato, non coincide più e il record viene contrassegnato.
assessing.hash.from: The hash is recorded at upload. If a stored file is ever altered, it no longer matches and the record is flagged.

assessing.proposes.text: In base ai punteggi l'esito proposto è {outcome}{percent}.

assessing.whyDiffers.text: Perché, dato che differisce da quanto propongono i punteggi
assessing.whyDiffers.from: Why, since it differs from what the marks propose

assessing.permanent.text: Il Suo nome, la data e questo commento vengono archiviati in modo permanente e non possono essere modificati in seguito. Una correzione viene registrata come nuova decisione.
assessing.permanent.from: Your name, the date and this comment are stored permanently and cannot be edited afterwards. A correction is recorded as a new decision.

marking.impliesIntro.text: Aritmetica, non un giudizio. La media dei punteggi porta a questo esito; la prestazione pratica e le evidenze dal luogo di lavoro non giungono alla piattaforma e Lei le valuta prima di decidere. Modifichi uno qualsiasi di questi elementi nella schermata di decisione e ne indichi il motivo: la motivazione viene archiviata accanto alla proposta, così che un moderatore possa vedere dove le due divergono.
marking.impliesIntro.from: Arithmetic, not a judgement. The marks average out at this; practical performance and workplace evidence do not reach the platform, and you weigh those before deciding. Change any of these on the decision screen and say why: the reason is stored beside the proposal so a moderator can see where the two parted.

marking.markAllFirst.text: Ogni domanda deve essere corretta prima che i criteri possano essere calcolati.
marking.markAllFirst.from: Every question has to be marked before the criteria can be worked out.

marking.summative.text: Questa prova è valutata. Una volta corrette tutte le domande, registrare una decisione: i criteri che essa attesta vengono proposti affinché Lei li confermi.
marking.summative.from: This is assessed. Once every question is marked, record a decision: the criteria it evidences are proposed for you to confirm.

marking.formative.text: Questo è un quaderno di lavoro. Ha finalità formativa: lo si corregge, poi si restituisce il feedback. Nulla di quanto contenuto registra la competenza né avvicina il discente all'idoneità.
marking.formative.from: This is a workbook. It is developmental: mark it, then return feedback. Nothing here records competence or moves the learner towards eligibility.

marking.matrix.text: Matrice di correzione: scegliendo un livello per ciascun elemento si ottiene il punteggio
marking.matrix.from: Marking matrix: choosing a level for each gives the mark

marking.told.text: Ciò che viene comunicato al discente

marking.toldHint.text: Dove è stato solido e che cosa mancava.
marking.toldHint.from: Where it was strong, and what was missing.

marking.returnIntro.text: Feedback, non una decisione. Indica al discente che cosa rivedere prima della prova sommativa e non registra alcuna competenza rispetto a nessun criterio.
marking.returnIntro.from: Feedback, not a decision. It tells the learner what to go back to before the summative, and it records no competence against any criterion.

marking.returnHint.text: Che cosa era solido e che cosa rileggere prima della prova sommativa.
marking.returnHint.from: What was solid, and what to re-read before the summative.

marking.concern.text: Criteri attorno a cui si concentrano le risposte deboli
marking.concern.from: Criteria the weak answers cluster around

marking.sectionHint.text: Che cosa è andato bene qui e che cosa fare diversamente la prossima volta.
marking.sectionHint.from: What went well here, and what to do differently next time.

marking.learnerSees.text: Il discente lo vede insieme al proprio feedback.
marking.learnerSees.from: The learner sees this with their feedback.

moderating.intro.text: Riesame indipendente delle decisioni dei valutatori. Quali decisioni giungono in questo elenco lo stabilisce il sistema, non una persona. Non può moderare una decisione presa da Lei stesso.
moderating.intro.from: Independent review of assessors' decisions. Which decisions reach this list is decided by the system, not chosen by anyone. You cannot moderate a decision you made yourself.

moderating.reason.new_assessor.from: Newly registered assessor: moderated in full

moderating.referBack.from: Refer back: the assessor should look again

moderating.ownDecision.text: Questa decisione è stata presa da Lei in qualità di valutatore, quindi non può moderarla. Deve farlo un altro moderatore.
moderating.ownDecision.from: You made this decision as the assessor, so you cannot moderate it. Another moderator must.

pack.print.text: Stampare questa pagina per conservarla come PDF.
pack.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF.

pack.instrumentIntro.text: La prova così come è stata predisposta e le indicazioni in base alle quali è stata corretta.
pack.instrumentIntro.from: The paper as it was set, and the guidance it was marked against.

pack.scriptsIntro.text: Presi su tutto l'intervallo dei punteggi (più alti, più bassi e fascia intermedia) così che la correzione sia vista al suo meglio e al suo peggio, e non solo nella media.
pack.scriptsIntro.from: Taken across the mark range (top, bottom and spread between) so the marking is seen at its best and its worst rather than in the middle.

pack.departuresIntro.text: Dove un valutatore si è discostato da quanto proposto dai punteggi, oppure un moderatore si è discostato dal valutatore. Un fascicolo che li omette è peggio di nessun fascicolo.
pack.departuresIntro.from: Where an assessor differed from what the marks proposed, or a moderator differed from the assessor. A pack that leaves these out is worse than no pack.

pack.exceptionsIntro.text: Discenti ammessi oltre uno sbarramento da una persona indicata, con la motivazione da essa fornita.
pack.exceptionsIntro.from: Learners let past a gate by a named person, with the reason they gave.

pack.assembled.text: Compilato il {date} a partire dal registro.

held.intro.text: Un discente dichiarato non ancora competente due volte non è bocciato. La valutazione viene sospesa e si convoca una revisione del programma con il suo datore di lavoro, perché a questo punto raramente la questione è se sappia o no, e di solito è che cosa stia accadendo intorno a lui.
held.intro.from: A learner found not yet competent twice is not failed. The assessment is held, and a programme review is convened with their employer, because by this point the question is rarely whether they know it, and usually what has been going on around them.

held.empty.text: Questo elenco si popola quando un discente viene dichiarato non ancora competente per la seconda volta in una valutazione sommativa. Fino ad allora non c'è nulla da rivedere.
held.empty.from: This fills when a learner is found not yet competent for a second time on a summative assessment. Until then there is nothing to review.

held.forReview.text: In attesa di una revisione del programma ({count})

held.whoConvenes.text: La revisione viene convocata da un facilitatore o da un amministratore.
held.whoConvenes.from: A facilitator or administrator convenes the review.

held.oralAuthorised.text: {assessment} · la revisione ha autorizzato un terzo tentativo, svolto oralmente
held.oralAuthorised.from: {assessment} · the review authorised a third attempt, conducted orally

held.whoConducts.text: Il tentativo orale è condotto da un valutatore diverso da chi lo ha autorizzato.
held.whoConducts.from: An assessor conducts the oral attempt, and not the person who authorised it.

held.furtherLearning.text: Ulteriore apprendimento prima di qualsiasi altro tentativo
held.furtherLearning.from: Further learning before any further attempt

held.whyHint.text: Che cosa ha rilevato la revisione e da che cosa dipende.
held.whyHint.from: What the review found, and what it turns on.

held.consulted.text: Il datore di lavoro è stato consultato

held.who.text: Chi, presso il datore di lavoro

oral.reviewDecided.text: Che cosa ha deciso la revisione

oral.reviewDecidedIntro.text: I motivi per cui questo terzo tentativo è stato autorizzato.
oral.reviewDecidedIntro.from: The grounds on which this third attempt was authorised.

oral.employerNotConsulted.text: Il datore di lavoro non è stato consultato.

oral.recordIntro.text: Un tentativo orale non lascia evidenze proprie. Questa è tale evidenza, e senza di essa l'esito non può essere registrato.
oral.recordIntro.from: An oral attempt leaves no evidence of its own. This is that evidence, and the outcome cannot be recorded without it.

oral.nothingYet.text: Non è ancora stato registrato nulla.

oral.outcomeIntro.text: Giudicato allo stesso modo di un tentativo scritto, in base agli stessi criteri, e successivamente moderato allo stesso modo.
oral.outcomeIntro.from: Judged the same way as a written attempt, against the same criteria, and moderated the same way afterwards.

oral.howHint.text: Di persona, oppure la videochiamata in cui si è tenuta
oral.howHint.from: In person, or the video call it was held on

oral.presentNote.text: Non obbligatorio. Una valutazione orale senza altre persone presenti è più difficile da difendere in sede di moderazione, e il registro dovrebbe indicare di quale tipo si è trattato.
oral.presentNote.from: Not required. An oral assessment with nobody else in the room is harder to defend at moderation, and the record should say which kind this was.

oral.noCriterion.text: Non collegata a uno in particolare

oral.savedNext.text: L'esito viene registrato nella schermata di correzione, come per qualsiasi altro tentativo.
oral.savedNext.from: The outcome is recorded on the marking screen, the same as any other attempt.

appeals.intro.text: Un discente può presentare ricorso contro un risultato o contro la condotta di un valutatore. La ricezione viene confermata entro {hours} ore, che è la scadenza che più spesso si perde, perché decorre mentre qualcuno sta facendo lezione.
appeals.intro.from: A learner may appeal against a result or against an assessor's conduct. Receipt is acknowledged within {hours} hours, which is the deadline that gets missed, because it runs while somebody is teaching.

appeals.ground.assessor_conduct.text: Contro la condotta di un valutatore

appeals.lateIntro.text: Superate le {hours} ore e ancora non confermato. Confermare in ritardo è meglio che non farlo affatto, e il registro riporterà entrambe le date.
appeals.lateIntro.from: Past the {hours} hours and still not acknowledged. Acknowledging late is better than not at all, and the record will show both.

appeals.openIntro.text: Tutto ciò che è stato presentato e non ancora chiuso, dal più recente.
appeals.openIntro.from: Everything lodged and not yet closed, newest first.

appeals.none.text: Nulla di aperto. Un ricorso si presenta dalla pagina personale del discente.
appeals.none.from: Nothing open. An appeal is lodged from a learner's own page.

appeals.procedureIntro.text: Confermare la ricezione, incontrare il discente, consultare il moderatore se il motivo riguarda un risultato, poi risolvere e informarlo.
appeals.procedureIntro.from: Acknowledge, meet the learner, consult the moderator where the ground is a result, then resolve and tell them.

appeals.closedUnacknowledged.text: Chiuso senza che sia stata registrata una conferma di ricezione.
appeals.closedUnacknowledged.from: Closed without an acknowledgement being recorded.

appeals.firstCounts.text: La prima conferma è quella che il registro conserva. Non può essere riportata in seguito con una nuova data, perché un orario modificabile non è prova di nulla.
appeals.firstCounts.from: The first acknowledgement is the one the record keeps. It cannot be re-stamped later, because a time that can be changed is not evidence of anything.

appeals.resultNeedsModerator.text: Un ricorso relativo a un risultato passa al moderatore interno prima di poter essere risolto. È il passaggio su cui chiede chiarimenti un verificatore esterno.
appeals.resultNeedsModerator.from: A result appeal goes to the internal moderator before it can be resolved. That is the step an external verifier asks about.

appeals.conductNoModerator.text: Un ricorso relativo alla condotta non si risolve con una nuova correzione, quindi non è richiesto alcun moderatore.
appeals.conductNoModerator.from: A conduct appeal is not something re-marking settles, so no moderator is required.

appeals.notFeedback.text: Una decisione non comunicata al discente non è un feedback.
appeals.notFeedback.from: A decision the learner has not been given is not feedback.

appeals.whyHint.text: Perché. Questa è la parte a cui il discente ha diritto.
appeals.whyHint.from: Why. This is the part the learner is entitled to.

appeals.notesIntro.text: La discussione tra coordinatore, valutatore e moderatore. Non è mostrata al discente salvo indicazione contraria; ciò a cui ha diritto sono l'esito e la motivazione riportati sopra.
appeals.notesIntro.from: The discussion between coordinator, assessor and moderator. Not shown to the learner unless you say so; what they are entitled to is the outcome and the reasoning above.

appeals.noteHint.text: Che cosa è stato discusso e con chi
appeals.noteHint.from: What was discussed, and with whom
