said.readiness-qualificationId-userId.87.from: Issuing a Statement of Results is limited to staff who can issue certificates.

said.reassessment.051a9a39.text: Annotare che cosa è stato chiesto e risposto prima di registrare l'esito. Un esito orale positivo senza traccia dello scambio non è un'evidenza.
said.reassessment.051a9a39.from: Write down what was asked and answered before recording the outcome. An oral pass with no record of the exchange is not evidence.

said.reassessment.2a95a5d9.text: Una revisione del programma segue {ATTEMPTS_BEFORE_REVIEW} risultati di non ancora competente. Questo discente ne ha {notYetCompetent}.
said.reassessment.2a95a5d9.from: A programme review follows {ATTEMPTS_BEFORE_REVIEW} not-yet-competent results. This learner has {notYetCompetent}.

said.reassessment.54d33118.text: Questo discente ha già effettuato una revisione del programma per questa valutazione.
said.reassessment.54d33118.from: This learner has already been through a programme review on this assessment.

said.reassessment.7eeb4562.text: Indicare la persona del datore di lavoro che è stata consultata. Un datore di lavoro senza nome non è prova che una consultazione sia avvenuta.
said.reassessment.7eeb4562.from: Name the person at the employer who was consulted. An unnamed employer is not evidence that a consultation happened.

said.reassessment.b07a9b03.text: Non può condurre la propria valutazione orale.
said.reassessment.b07a9b03.from: You cannot conduct your own oral assessment.

said.reassessment.cea9b770.text: Quella revisione ha deciso per {outcome}, non per una nuova valutazione orale.
said.reassessment.cea9b770.from: That review decided on {outcome}, not an oral reassessment.

said.reassessment.d374ded8.text: Questo discente è già stato dichiarato competente in questa valutazione.
said.reassessment.d374ded8.from: This learner has already been found competent on this assessment.

said.reassessment.df7ff299.text: Quell'autorizzazione è già stata utilizzata. Un terzo tentativo concesso due volte non è un terzo tentativo.
said.reassessment.df7ff299.from: That authorisation has already been used. A third attempt granted twice is not a third attempt.

said.reassessment.eacc2318.text: Quel tentativo non è una nuova valutazione orale autorizzata.
said.reassessment.eacc2318.from: That attempt is not an authorised oral reassessment.

said.reassessment.f272ec97.text: Ha autorizzato Lei questo terzo tentativo, quindi deve condurlo un'altra persona.
said.reassessment.f272ec97.from: You authorised this third attempt, so somebody else must conduct it.

said.reassessments.b53b937e.text: Scrivere almeno una domanda e la risposta data. Un esito orale positivo senza traccia dello scambio non è un'evidenza.
said.reassessments.b53b937e.from: Write down at least one question and the answer given. An oral pass with no record of the exchange is not evidence.

said.recognition.056d89d8.text: Esentare {title} porterebbe questo discente al {wouldBePercent} per cento della qualifica riconosciuta senza essere stata insegnata, mentre il limite per questa qualifica è {maxPercent}. Il resto deve essere svolto come apprendimento ordinario, oppure il limite va modificato sulla qualifica indicandone il motivo.
said.recognition.056d89d8.from: Exempting {title} would take this learner to {wouldBePercent} per cent of the qualification recognised without being taught, and the limit on this qualification is {maxPercent}. The rest has to be done as ordinary learning, or the limit changed on the qualification with a reason for it.

said.recognition.165f2f8f.text: Questo candidato non ha avuto una sessione di consulenza. Valutare l'apprendimento pregresso rispetto a requisiti che nessuno ha spiegato è il modo in cui un candidato viene bocciato per aver raccolto le evidenze sbagliate. Registrare prima la consulenza.
said.recognition.165f2f8f.from: This candidate has not had an advisory session. Judging prior learning against requirements nobody explained is how a candidate is failed for assembling the wrong evidence. Record the advice first.

said.recognition.2f3e0747.text: Giudizio registrato. Non concede nulla finché non viene moderato.
said.recognition.2f3e0747.from: Judgement recorded. It grants nothing until it is moderated.

said.recognition.3d78b1cc.text: Indicare che cosa è stato esaminato e se si è d'accordo. Una moderazione senza commento è una semplice firma.
said.recognition.3d78b1cc.from: Say what you looked at and whether you agree. A moderation with no comment is a signature.

said.recognition.4cf70aee.text: Indicare in che modo i risultati di ciò che possiede coprono quelli di questo modulo. Quel paragrafo è l'intera decisione, e un trasferimento senza di esso è un'affermazione che nessuno può verificare.
said.recognition.4cf70aee.from: Say how the outcomes of what they hold cover this module's. That paragraph is the whole of the decision, and a transfer without it is a claim nobody can check.

said.recognition.61201ac5.text: Indicare quale era l'evidenza e perché soddisfa il modulo. Questo paragrafo è l'intero giudizio e la prima cosa che legge un verificatore esterno.
said.recognition.61201ac5.from: Say what the evidence was and why it satisfies the module. This paragraph is the whole of the judgement, and the first thing an external verifier reads.

said.recognition.86f838fe.text: È stato conseguito il {awardedOn}, più di {CAT_YEARS} anni prima di questa approvazione. L'accumulo e il trasferimento di crediti riguardano i completamenti entro {CAT_YEARS2} anni; oltre questo limite la via è il riconoscimento dell'apprendimento pregresso, che valuta ciò che il discente sa ancora fare anziché ciò che ha superato in passato. Aprire invece una domanda di riconoscimento dell'apprendimento pregresso.
said.recognition.86f838fe.from: That was awarded on {awardedOn}, more than {CAT_YEARS} years before this approval. Credit Accumulation and Transfer covers completions within {CAT_YEARS2} years; beyond that the route is Recognition of Prior Learning, which assesses what the learner can still do rather than what they once passed. Open an RPL application instead.

said.recognition.d4a3fd91.text: Registrare che cosa è stato detto al candidato di raccogliere. Un candidato respinto contesta questo paragrafo, e «consigliato sui requisiti» non lo è.
said.recognition.d4a3fd91.from: Record what the candidate was told to gather. A refused candidate disputes this paragraph, and 'advised on requirements' is not one.

said.recognition.e21aaea2.text: Non può moderare il proprio giudizio.
said.recognition.e21aaea2.from: You cannot moderate your own judgement.

said.recognition.e7122f98.text: Il Suo ruolo non comprende questa operazione. Il riconoscimento è affidato al personale dell'ente formativo, e un giudizio viene moderato da una persona diversa da chi lo ha espresso.
said.recognition.e7122f98.from: Your role does not include this. Recognition is held by the provider's own staff, and a judgement is moderated by somebody other than whoever made it.

said.recognition.f2bb6227.text: Quel modulo non è stato trovato.

said.record-store.177e55ac.text: Non è stato possibile raggiungere l'archivio: {error}.
said.record-store.177e55ac.from: The store could not be reached: {error}.

said.record-store.2edd3c36.text: Questa piattaforma non ha una chiave con cui proteggere i segreti, quindi non può conservare la chiave dell'archivio.
said.record-store.2edd3c36.from: This platform has no key to seal secrets with, so it cannot keep the store's key.

said.record-store.32a7ad42.text: Per collegarsi occorre la chiave dell'archivio.
said.record-store.32a7ad42.from: The store's key is needed to connect.

said.record-store.426bb3b3.text: La chiave dell'archivio non può più essere aperta su questa piattaforma. Inserirla di nuovo nella pagina Registri di apprendimento.
said.record-store.426bb3b3.from: The store's key can no longer be opened on this platform. Enter it again on the Learning records page.

said.record-store.76194b8f.text: L'archivio ha rifiutato la chiave ({status}). Verificare il nome e il segreto della chiave nella pagina Registri di apprendimento.
said.record-store.76194b8f.from: The store refused the key ({status}). Check the key's name and secret on the Learning records page.

said.record-store.9f6b73a1.text: L'archivio ha smesso di rispondere a metà dell'operazione.
said.record-store.9f6b73a1.from: The store stopped answering part of the way through.

said.record-store.c387d2ea.text: L'indirizzo dell'archivio deve iniziare con https://.
said.record-store.c387d2ea.from: The store's address must start with https://.

said.record-store.fe2456ba.text: L'indirizzo dell'archivio non è stato trovato (404). Verificare che sia l'indirizzo xAPI, quello che termina prima di /statements.
said.record-store.fe2456ba.from: The store's address was not found (404). Check it is the xAPI address, the one ending before /statements.

said.records.05c230ea.text: Indicare perché viene conservato oltre il periodo di conservazione previsto. È una scelta e non una dimenticanza, e il motivo deve stare nel fascicolo.
said.records.05c230ea.from: Say why this is being kept beyond its retention period. It is a position rather than an oversight, and the reason belongs in the file.

said.records.94e6ebbb.from: That file is larger than {MAX_LIBRARY_BYTES} MB.

said.records.bd9361ef.text: Distruggere un record è irreversibile, e un giorno qualcuno chiederà perché manca un record che un verificatore voleva. Indicarne il motivo.
said.records.bd9361ef.from: Destroying a record is irreversible, and somebody will one day ask why a record a verifier wanted is not there. Say why.

said.roster-import.0e607b00.text: Quella cartella di lavoro non contiene fogli.
said.roster-import.0e607b00.from: That workbook has no sheets in it.

said.roster-import.1fd8a7f6.from: That file has nothing in it.

said.roster-import.2f5f5231.text: Non è stata trovata alcuna colonna per: {missing}. Senza queste tre non è possibile creare una persona. Le intestazioni trovate erano: {Boolean}.
said.roster-import.2f5f5231.from: No column was found for: {missing}. A person cannot be created without those three. The headings found were: {Boolean}.

said.roster-import.c40fdd60.text: Le intestazioni delle colonne sono state rilevate dalla riga {headerIndex} e non dalla riga 1: tutto ciò che sta sopra sembrava un titolo e non delle intestazioni.
said.roster-import.c40fdd60.from: The column headings were taken from line {headerIndex}, not line 1: everything above it looked like a title rather than headings.

said.roster-import.d7c8b42b.text: Le intestazioni sono state lette ma sotto di esse non ci sono righe.
said.roster-import.d7c8b42b.from: The headings were read but there are no rows under them.

said.roster-import.ddc568e6.text: Campi ancora da compilare: {open}. Intestazioni di colonna non abbinate: {heading}
said.roster-import.ddc568e6.from: Fields still to fill: {open}. Unmatched column headings: {heading}

said.scheduling.0592fd69.text: Una sessione non può terminare alle {endTime} se è iniziata alle {startTime}.
said.scheduling.0592fd69.from: A session cannot end at {endTime} having started at {startTime}.

said.scheduling.0b13beb2.text: Quella data di induzione non è leggibile, quindi non è possibile costruirne il nome della coorte.
said.scheduling.0b13beb2.from: That induction date cannot be read, so a cohort name cannot be built from it.

said.scheduling.53f8d453.text: Indicare perché la sessione è stata annullata o rinviata. Un calendario con vuoti non spiegati è ciò su cui chiede chiarimenti una visita di monitoraggio.
said.scheduling.53f8d453.from: Say why the session was cancelled or postponed. A schedule with unexplained gaps in it is the thing a monitoring visit asks about.

said.scheduling.5c76cb4b.text: Usare un orario nel formato 24 ore, ad esempio 20:30.

said.scheduling.6c1a2122.text: Usare un orario nel formato 24 ore, ad esempio 18:30.

said.scheduling.7ebc2d06.text: Quella persona non è un membro attuale di questa coorte, quindi non può essere segnata sul suo registro delle presenze.
said.scheduling.7ebc2d06.from: That person is not a current member of this cohort, so they cannot be marked on its register.

said.scheduling.c988355e.text: Questa sessione è stata annullata, quindi non c'è alcun registro delle presenze da compilare. Nessuno è mancato a una lezione che non si è tenuta.
said.scheduling.c988355e.from: This session was cancelled, so there is no register to take. Nobody failed to attend a lecture that did not happen.

said.scorm.02fb5cf8.text: Il file di avvio indicato nel manifest non si trova nel pacchetto.
said.scorm.02fb5cf8.from: The manifest's starting file is not inside the package.

said.scorm.05c16100.text: Questa lezione non fa parte di un corso al quale è iscritto.
said.scorm.05c16100.from: This lesson is not on a course you are enrolled on.

said.scorm.20ff1632.text: Non è stato possibile aprire lo zip. Potrebbe essere danneggiato; esportarlo di nuovo dallo strumento di authoring.
said.scorm.20ff1632.from: The zip could not be opened. It may be damaged; export it again from the authoring tool.

said.scorm.354841d8.text: Il pacchetto contiene {filesCount} file, più dei {MAX_FILES} consentiti.
said.scorm.354841d8.from: The package has {filesCount} files, more than the {MAX_FILES} allowed.

said.scorm.380a5512.text: Viene conservato solo il progresso del discente stesso.
said.scorm.380a5512.from: Only the learner's own progress is kept.

said.scorm.39e77a3f.text: Questo è un pacchetto cmi5. Per ora la piattaforma riproduce pacchetti SCORM 1.2; cmi5 arriverà dopo SCORM 2004.
said.scorm.39e77a3f.from: This is a cmi5 package. The platform plays SCORM 1.2 packages so far; cmi5 comes after SCORM 2004.

said.scorm.42f68d85.text: Lo zip contiene «{name}», un percorso che uscirebbe dal pacchetto.
said.scorm.42f68d85.from: The zip holds "{name}", a path that would leave the package.

said.scorm.4de81b55.text: Questa lezione non ha alcun pacchetto SCORM.
said.scorm.4de81b55.from: This lesson has no SCORM package.

said.scorm.63cfd3fc.text: Il manifest non indica alcun file da cui avviare il pacchetto.
said.scorm.63cfd3fc.from: The manifest names no file to start the package from.

said.scorm.858c848d.text: Il manifest dichiara di essere «{version}», che non è SCORM 1.2.
said.scorm.858c848d.from: The manifest says it is "{version}", which is not SCORM 1.2.

said.scorm.90319b91.text: Il pacchetto, una volta estratto, supera un gigabyte, più di quanto serva a un corso.
said.scorm.90319b91.from: The package unpacks to more than a gigabyte, which is more than a course needs.

said.scorm.d03f6670.text: Questo è un pacchetto SCORM 2004. Per ora la piattaforma riproduce pacchetti SCORM 1.2; il 2004 sarà il prossimo. La maggior parte degli strumenti di authoring può pubblicare invece in SCORM 1.2.
said.scorm.d03f6670.from: This is a SCORM 2004 package. The platform plays SCORM 1.2 packages so far; 2004 is next. Most authoring tools can publish as SCORM 1.2 instead.

said.scorm.d37e77ff.text: Il manifest avvia il pacchetto da «{launchFile}», che non si trova nello zip.
said.scorm.d37e77ff.from: The manifest starts the package at "{launchFile}", which is not in the zip.

said.settings-drive-actions.b27a46f5.text: Non è un'unità di archiviazione conosciuta dalla piattaforma.
said.settings-drive-actions.b27a46f5.from: That is not a drive the platform knows.

said.settings-language-actions.ecc301e2.text: Solo un amministratore dell'ente formativo può modificarlo.
said.settings-language-actions.ecc301e2.from: Only a provider administrator may change this.

said.settings-language-actions.f103b372.text: Salvato. Le persone che non hanno scelto la propria lingua ora vedono questa.
said.settings-language-actions.f103b372.from: Saved. People who have not chosen their own language now see this one.

said.settings-mail-actions.77394510.text: Il Suo ruolo non comprende la verifica del server di posta.
said.settings-mail-actions.77394510.from: Your role does not include testing the mail server.

said.settings-mail-actions.79f94bc8.text: Su questa installazione non è configurato alcun server di posta, quindi per ora non è possibile inviare nulla.
said.settings-mail-actions.79f94bc8.from: No mail server is set up on this deployment, so nothing can be sent yet.

said.settings-mail-actions.cb649383.text: Il server di posta ha accettato la connessione. È possibile inviare ai discenti i dati di accesso e le notifiche.
said.settings-mail-actions.cb649383.from: The mail server accepted the connection. Learners can be sent their sign-in details and notifications.

said.settings-mail-actions.cf3cfef0.text: Chi gestisce la piattaforma deve impostare MAIL_HOST e MAIL_FROM.
said.settings-mail-actions.cf3cfef0.from: Whoever maintains the platform needs to set MAIL_HOST and MAIL_FROM.

said.settings-mail-actions.f1ac9e08.text: In questo momento non è stato possibile raggiungere il server di posta. Potrebbe essere temporaneo; riprovare tra poco.
said.settings-mail-actions.f1ac9e08.from: The mail server could not be reached just now. This may be temporary; try again shortly.

said.settings-mail-actions.fc597e55.text: Il server di posta ha rifiutato la connessione, quindi non è possibile inviare nulla.
said.settings-mail-actions.fc597e55.from: The mail server refused the connection, so nothing can be sent.

said.settings-menu-actions.0005a392.text: Solo un amministratore può riorganizzare il menu, perché è lo stesso menu per tutti gli utenti di questo ente formativo.
said.settings-menu-actions.0005a392.from: Only an administrator can rearrange the menu, because it is the same menu for everybody at this provider.

said.settings-menu-actions.c175275c.text: Salvato. Tutti gli utenti di questo ente formativo vedono questa disposizione.
said.settings-menu-actions.c175275c.from: Saved. Everybody at this provider sees this arrangement.

said.settings-menu-actions.c38853b5.text: Non è stato possibile leggere quella disposizione. Nulla è cambiato.
said.settings-menu-actions.c38853b5.from: That arrangement could not be read. Nothing changed.

said.settings-menu-actions.ffff057d.text: In questo modo ogni intestazione risulterebbe vuota, ovvero un menu senza nulla dentro. Nulla è cambiato.
said.settings-menu-actions.ffff057d.from: That would leave every heading empty, which is a menu with nothing in it. Nothing changed.

said.settings-module-codes-actions.d585f.text: Non è stato possibile leggere quella tabella. Riaprirla e riprovare.
said.settings-module-codes-actions.d585f.from: That table could not be read. Reopen it and try again.

said.settings-sso-actions.4bbd36a4.text: Disattivato, e il relativo segreto è stato dimenticato.
said.settings-sso-actions.4bbd36a4.from: Switched off, and its secret forgotten.

said.settings-sso-actions.52db415d.text: Salvato. Uscire e provare dalla pagina di accesso.
said.settings-sso-actions.52db415d.from: Saved. Sign out and try it from the sign-in page.

said.settings-sso-actions.56bfaa85.text: Solo un amministratore dell'ente formativo può modificare le modalità di accesso delle persone.
said.settings-sso-actions.56bfaa85.from: Only a provider administrator may change how people sign in.

said.settings-template-actions.0690b0fe.text: Salvato come versione {version}, in bozza. Non è in uso finché non lo si mette in uso.
said.settings-template-actions.0690b0fe.from: Saved as version {version}, as a draft. It is not in use until you put it in use.

said.settings-template-actions.9cc3fe2a.text: Salvato come versione {version} e ora in uso. Da ora i documenti di questo tipo vengono prodotti a partire da esso; quelli già rilasciati conservano la versione che li ha prodotti.
said.settings-template-actions.9cc3fe2a.from: Saved as version {version}, and now in use. Documents of this kind are produced from it from now on; ones already issued keep the version that produced them.

said.settings-template-actions.a1bce5df.text: Non era in uso alcun modello per quel documento.
said.settings-template-actions.a1bce5df.from: There was no template in use for that document.

said.settings-template-actions.a1ec16e6.text: Tornato al layout della piattaforma. Il Suo modello viene conservato, non eliminato, quindi è possibile rimetterlo in uso.
said.settings-template-actions.a1ec16e6.from: Back to the platform's own layout. Your template is kept, not deleted, so you can put it back.

said.settings-template-actions.a53f381a.text: Non è un documento prodotto dalla piattaforma.
said.settings-template-actions.a53f381a.from: That is not a document the platform produces.

said.settings-terminology-actions.22580f.text: Salvato. Tutti gli utenti di questo ente formativo vedono questa formulazione.
said.settings-terminology-actions.22580f.from: Saved. Everybody at this provider sees this wording.

said.settings-terminology-actions.8e2222.text: Nulla differisce dalla formulazione standard, quindi sono stati ripristinati i valori predefiniti.
said.settings-terminology-actions.8e2222.from: Nothing differs from the standard wording, so the defaults are back.

said.settings-terminology-actions.98e913.text: Indicare sia il singolare sia il plurale per {one}, oppure lasciare entrambi vuoti per mantenere il valore predefinito.
said.settings-terminology-actions.98e913.from: Give both the singular and the plural for {one}, or leave both empty to keep the default.

said.settings-terminology-actions.bf53eb.text: Mantenere ogni parola sotto i 40 caratteri.

said.settings-terminology-actions.c225e9.text: «{word}» è definito da un ente regolatore, quindi non può essere usato per altro. Assegnare questo nome a una delle proprie denominazioni porterebbe sullo schermo di un discente un'affermazione che il record non sostiene.
said.settings-terminology-actions.c225e9.from: "{word}" is defined by a regulator, so it cannot be used for something else. Renaming one of your own words to it would put a claim on a learner's screen that the record does not support.

said.settings-terminology-actions.c27704.text: Solo un amministratore può modificare come vengono chiamate le cose, perché è la stessa formulazione per tutti gli utenti di questo ente formativo.
said.settings-terminology-actions.c27704.from: Only an administrator can change what things are called, because it is the same wording for everybody at this provider.

said.settings.2e2de6f5.text: Salvato. I caricamenti da ora in poi vengono letti in questo modo.
said.settings.2e2de6f5.from: Saved. Uploads from now on are read this way.

said.settings.5946b233.text: Salvato. È disponibile ma non attivato. Usare l'interruttore IA in cima a qualsiasi pagina quando lo si vuole per un'attività.
said.settings.5946b233.from: Saved. It is available but not switched on. Use the AI switch at the top of any page when you want it for a job.

said.settings.68c5f414.text: Token eliminato. Nulla ne viene conservato.
said.settings.68c5f414.from: Token discarded. Nothing of it is kept.

said.settings.7a6e099f.text: Non è stato possibile chiedere al provider i suoi modelli.
said.settings.7a6e099f.from: The provider could not be asked for its models.

said.settings.84b6dbd9.text: Il Suo ruolo non comprende l'assistenza dei modelli.
said.settings.84b6dbd9.from: Your role does not include model assistance.

said.settings.c0e1fe87.text: Salvato. Gli orari in calendario ora fanno riferimento a questo orologio.
said.settings.c0e1fe87.from: Saved. Timetabled times now mean this clock.

said.settings.f7c1c376.text: Salvato. Tutti lo vedono dalla pagina successiva.
said.settings.f7c1c376.from: Saved. Everyone sees it from their next page.

said.settings.fdc694bf.text: Il Suo ruolo non comprende l'assistenza dei modelli. È riservata al personale dell'ente formativo e non ai discenti né al tutor aziendale di un datore di lavoro.
said.settings.fdc694bf.from: Your role does not include model assistance. It is held by the provider's own staff rather than by learners or by an employer's workplace coach.

said.single-sign-on.052b3446.text: L'accesso non ha restituito alcuna identità.
said.single-sign-on.052b3446.from: The sign-in did not come back with an identity.

said.single-sign-on.07757676.text: L'accesso ha restituito un'identità che non è stato possibile leggere.
said.single-sign-on.07757676.from: The sign-in came back with an identity that could not be read.

said.single-sign-on.180daa0a.text: L'accesso con {kind} non è attivato qui.
said.single-sign-on.180daa0a.from: Signing in with {kind} is not switched on here.

said.single-sign-on.2760f640.text: Microsoft richiede l'ID della directory (tenant) della propria organizzazione, un codice come 72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47, che si trova nella pagina Panoramica dell'app in Microsoft Entra.
said.single-sign-on.2760f640.from: Microsoft needs your organisation's directory (tenant) ID, a code like 72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47, from the app's Overview page in Microsoft Entra.

said.single-sign-on.27f12034.text: Questo account non può accedere qui.
said.single-sign-on.27f12034.from: That account cannot sign in here.

said.single-sign-on.52f76de5.text: Per collegarsi occorre il segreto client.
said.single-sign-on.52f76de5.from: The client secret is needed to connect.

said.single-sign-on.90b663ad.from: Google has not verified the address

said.single-sign-on.af8cc19b.text: Questa piattaforma non ha una chiave con cui proteggere i segreti, quindi non può conservare il segreto client.
said.single-sign-on.af8cc19b.from: This platform has no key to seal secrets with, so it cannot keep the client secret.

said.single-sign-on.b83f2863.text: Quell'accesso non è stato avviato da questa pagina. Riprovare.
said.single-sign-on.b83f2863.from: That sign-in was not started from this page. Try again.

said.south-african-id.2a092f1a.text: Un numero di identità è composto esattamente da 13 cifre.
said.south-african-id.2a092f1a.from: An identity number is exactly 13 digits.

said.south-african-id.46e0f0e5.text: Il mese nella data di nascita non è valido.
said.south-african-id.46e0f0e5.from: The month in the date of birth is not valid.

said.south-african-id.738d1584.text: La data di nascita non è una data reale.
said.south-african-id.738d1584.from: The date of birth is not a real date.

said.south-african-id.95e7bd33.text: Non esiste alcuna cifra di controllo Luhn valida.
said.south-african-id.95e7bd33.from: No valid Luhn check digit exists.

said.south-african-id.e46ae644.text: La cifra della cittadinanza deve essere 0 o 1.
said.south-african-id.e46ae644.from: The citizenship digit must be 0 or 1.

said.south-african-id.f2f17cbd.text: La cifra di controllo non corrisponde; il numero è probabilmente stato digitato male.
said.south-african-id.f2f17cbd.from: The check digit does not match; the number was likely mistyped.

said.spine-editor.2a5955ae.text: Pubblicato, ma nessuna delle sue prove lo è. Un discente non troverebbe nulla a cui rispondere.
said.spine-editor.2a5955ae.from: Published, but none of its papers are. A learner would find nothing to answer.

said.spine-editor.c209d3d2.text: È ancora una bozza. Può essere inserito nel percorso ora, e non verrà proposto a un discente finché non sarà pubblicato.
said.spine-editor.c209d3d2.from: This is still a draft. It can go on the spine now, and a learner will not be offered it until it is published.

said.spine.09e0bbde.text: Un passaggio di tipo {kind} deve indicare il {kind2} a cui rimanda.
said.spine.09e0bbde.from: A {kind} step has to name the {kind2} it points at.

said.spine.0b4713d6.text: «{title}» è formativa, quindi non produce mai una decisione di competenza, e un blocco che ne attende una non si aprirebbe mai. Attendere invece che venga consegnata o corretta.
said.spine.0b4713d6.from: "{title}" is formative, so it never produces a competence decision, so a gate waiting for one would never open. Wait for it to be handed in or marked instead.

said.spine.129de092.text: Indicare perché a questo discente viene concesso di proseguire. Viene mostrato nel suo record e nel fascicolo di moderazione.
said.spine.129de092.from: Say why this learner is being let past. It is shown on their record and in the moderation pack.

said.spine.42a3be59.text: Un passaggio non può attendere se stesso.
said.spine.42a3be59.from: A step cannot wait for itself.

said.spine.7287fb1d.text: Una lezione o un documento non viene valutato, quindi non può essere giudicato competente. Attendere invece che venga aperto.
said.spine.7287fb1d.from: A lesson or a document is not assessed, so it cannot be judged competent. Wait for it to be opened instead.

said.spine.81239e1c.text: Solo un modulo di esperienza lavorativa viene convalidato. Scegliere un'altra regola.
said.spine.81239e1c.from: Only a work experience module is signed off. Pick another rule.

said.spine.83528293.text: Un passaggio può attendere solo un altro passaggio dello stesso corso.
said.spine.83528293.from: A step can only wait for another step on the same course.

said.spine.91ceb611.text: Il nuovo ordine deve elencare ogni passaggio del corso esattamente una volta.
said.spine.91ceb611.from: The new order has to list every step of the course exactly once.

said.spine.ca9b3b5c.text: In questo modo due passaggi si attenderebbero a vicenda e nessuno dei due si aprirebbe mai.
said.spine.ca9b3b5c.from: That would make two steps wait for each other, and neither would ever open.

said.spine.d5e61b5f.text: Quel documento non è accessibile ai discenti, quindi non può essere un passaggio del loro percorso. Una prova sommativa li raggiunge invece come valutazione acquisita.
said.spine.d5e61b5f.from: That document is kept from learners, so it cannot be a step on their path. A summative paper reaches them as a captured assessment instead.

said.spine.fc076d64.text: Quel documento è scritto per il personale e non per essere svolto dai discenti, quindi non può essere un passaggio del loro percorso.
said.spine.fc076d64.from: That document is written for staff rather than for learners to work through, so it cannot be a step on their path.

said.statement-of-results.09720fce.text: Per questo attestato non ci sono moduli di riferimento, quindi non c'è nulla che possa confermare.
said.statement-of-results.09720fce.from: There are no modules in scope for this statement, so there is nothing for it to confirm.

said.statement-of-results.3b26ff7f.text: Indicare un motivo. Viene mostrato a chiunque verifichi il riferimento.
said.statement-of-results.3b26ff7f.from: Give a reason. It is shown to anybody who checks the reference.

said.statement-of-results.57e1914e.text: Questo discente possiede già un attestato dei risultati per {code}. Ritirarlo prima di rilasciarne un altro, così che non circolino mai due documenti che attestano la stessa cosa.
said.statement-of-results.57e1914e.from: This learner already holds a Statement of Results for {code}. Withdraw it before issuing another, so two documents making the same claim are never in circulation.

said.statement-of-results.ab61210b.text: Il curricolo non è stato acquisito per intero: {uncaptured} non riportano nulla da conseguire. Un attestato rilasciato ora confermerebbe il conseguimento di moduli che nessuno ha trascritto.
said.statement-of-results.ab61210b.from: The curriculum is not fully captured: {uncaptured} carry nothing to achieve. A statement issued now would confirm achievement of modules nobody has transcribed.

said.statement-of-results.b5359f01.text: Questo discente possiede già un attestato dei risultati per questa qualifica. Ritirarlo prima di rilasciarne un altro, così che non circolino mai due documenti che attestano la stessa cosa.
said.statement-of-results.b5359f01.from: This learner already holds a Statement of Results for this qualification. Withdraw it before issuing another, so two documents making the same claim are never in circulation.

said.statements-id.5fd85b7c.text: Il Suo ruolo non comprende il ritiro di un attestato dei risultati.
said.statements-id.5fd85b7c.from: Your role does not include withdrawing a Statement of Results.

said.statements-id.f9ea555b.text: Ritirato. Il riferimento continua a essere risolto, e lo indica.
said.statements-id.f9ea555b.from: Withdrawn. The reference still resolves, and says so.

said.statutory-export-file.10c070ac.text: Questa comunicazione presenta problemi che vanno risolti prima di poter produrre i file. Vedere la pagina degli obblighi normativi.
said.statutory-export-file.10c070ac.from: This return has problems that must be fixed before the files can be produced. See the statutory reporting page.

said.statutory-notification.0931542b.text: Quel discente non fa parte della coorte.
said.statutory-notification.0931542b.from: That learner is not in the cohort.

said.statutory-notification.0a104506.text: Obbligatorio in ogni record di discente.

said.statutory-notification.1e928484.text: Obbligatorio, ed è contenuto nel numero di identità.
said.statutory-notification.1e928484.from: Required, and it is inside the identity number.

said.statutory-notification.5c135418.text: Il discente non ha dato il proprio consenso nel modulo di iscrizione.
said.statutory-notification.5c135418.from: The learner has not agreed on the enrolment form.

said.statutory-notification.69c68cc0.text: Il numero di accreditamento dell'ente formativo, tratto dalle impostazioni dell'ente.
said.statutory-notification.69c68cc0.from: The provider's own accreditation number, from the tenant's settings.

said.statutory-notification.6a2cb727.text: Obbligatorio, e deve corrispondere al numero di identità.
said.statutory-notification.6a2cb727.from: Required, and must match the identity number.

said.statutory-notification.83725bbd.text: L'identificativo SAQA di ciò a cui il discente è iscritto.
said.statutory-notification.83725bbd.from: The SAQA identifier of what the learner is enrolled on.

said.statutory-notification.9cf40e0d.text: La provincia in cui lavora il discente.
said.statutory-notification.9cf40e0d.from: The province the learner works in.

said.statutory-notification.a5a405af.text: Una conferma di ricezione richiede il riferimento rilasciato dal QCTO.
said.statutory-notification.a5a405af.from: An acknowledgement needs the reference the QCTO issued.

said.statutory-notification.bbfb1dec.text: È registrata una disabilità, quindi il QCTO richiede di indicare quanta difficoltà comporta.
said.statutory-notification.bbfb1dec.from: A disability is recorded, so the QCTO requires how much difficulty it causes.

said.statutory-notification.ce4a70ee.text: Dal modulo di iscrizione del discente.

said.statutory-notify.7e3fae5a.from: Back to the cohort's own induction date.

said.statutory-notify.fbbcde8b.from: Their own induction date is recorded, and their deadline now runs from it.

said.statutory.36c11667.text: Il discente è stato iscritto dopo la chiusura del periodo di registrazione della qualifica.
said.statutory.36c11667.from: The learner was enrolled after the qualification's registration period closed.

said.statutory.5a5791f9.text: Per il valutatore non è registrato alcun numero di registrazione. L'NLRD verifica la registrazione del valutatore rispetto al conseguimento.
said.statutory.5a5791f9.from: The assessor has no registration number recorded. The NLRD verifies assessor registration against the achievement.

said.statutory.937d409a.text: Nessun codice del distretto municipale (ward) registrato. Il Provider Record viene convalidato fino al livello di distretto.
said.statutory.937d409a.from: No municipal ward code recorded. The Provider Record is validated down to ward level.

said.statutory.a57124be.text: Per il modulo del curricolo non è registrato alcun valore in crediti.
said.statutory.a57124be.from: The curriculum module has no credit value recorded.

said.statutory.aafb40c2.text: Manca il numero di accreditamento dell'ente formativo. Ogni record della comunicazione viene archiviato in base ad esso.
said.statutory.aafb40c2.from: The provider accreditation number is missing. Every record in the return is filed against it.

said.statutory.cc126904.text: Per il moderatore non è registrato alcun numero di registrazione.
said.statutory.cc126904.from: The moderator has no registration number recorded.

said.statutory.e08f5796.text: Nessun codice di equità registrato; l'NLRD segnala i dati di equità mancanti.
said.statutory.e08f5796.from: No equity code recorded; the NLRD flags missing equity data.

said.statutory.ef816888.text: La qualifica non ha un ID SAQA, quindi l'iscrizione non può essere archiviata in base ad esso.
said.statutory.ef816888.from: The qualification has no SAQA ID, so the enrolment cannot be filed against it.

said.study-unit-alignment.dfcd9590.text: Il documento indica {wantedCount} moduli ({wanted}) e questa qualifica non ha ancora un curricolo. Importare prima il curricolo; le unità di studio e i loro risultati vengono comunque registrati, e caricare di nuovo questo documento in seguito li collegherà.
said.study-unit-alignment.dfcd9590.from: The document names {wantedCount} modules ({wanted}) and this qualification has no curriculum yet. Import the curriculum first; the study units and their outcomes are recorded either way, and uploading this document again afterwards will link them.

said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.text: Nessuno dei {wantedCount} moduli indicati da questo documento è stato abbinato, quindi nulla è stato collocato in un'unità di studio. Il documento indica {wanted}. Questo curricolo contiene {held}. L'abbinamento ignora spazi e trattini, quindi i due schemi differiscono davvero. Correggere i codici su uno dei due lati e caricare di nuovo il documento.
said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.from: None of the {wantedCount} modules this document names could be matched, so nothing has been placed under a study unit. The document names {wanted}. This curriculum holds {held}. Matching ignores spaces and hyphens, so the two schemes genuinely differ. Correct the codes on either side and upload the document again.

said.support.2b757921.text: Una valutazione orale segue una seconda assenza solo per motivi medici. Senza di essi l'esito è la decadenza, contro cui il discente può comunque presentare ricorso.
said.support.2b757921.from: An oral assessment follows a second miss only on medical grounds. Without one the outcome is a forfeit, which the learner can still appeal.

said.support.32314e12.text: Il discente deve acconsentire alla registrazione prima che possa essere effettuata. Le condizioni di salute, la disabilità e la situazione finanziaria sono informazioni personali particolari, e accettare l'iscrizione non significava accettare questo.
said.support.32314e12.from: The learner has to agree to this being recorded before it can be. Health, disability and financial circumstances are special personal information, and agreeing to enrol was not agreeing to this.

said.support.3e521f24.text: Indicare perché il supporto termina. Un discente il cui adeguamento cessa senza motivo non ha modo di chiederne il ripristino.
said.support.3e521f24.from: Say why the support is ending. A learner whose accommodation stops without a reason has no way to ask for it back.

said.support.418c0ecd.text: Quel record non è stato trovato.

said.support.6396d34b.text: Per questa valutazione è già stata fissata una data aggiuntiva: {additionalDate}, dopo un'assenza il {missedOn}. La procedura ne prevede una sola. Se anche quella data è stata mancata, registrare che cosa è accaduto anziché fissarne un'altra.
said.support.6396d34b.from: An additional date was already set for this assessment: {additionalDate}, after a miss on {missedOn}. The procedure allows one. If that date was also missed, record what happened to it rather than setting another.

said.support.6af4db9d.text: Se l'adeguamento non funziona, indicare che cosa cambia. Una revisione che registra un fallimento e non modifica nulla sembra diligente ed è il contrario.
said.support.6af4db9d.from: If the accommodation is not working, say what is changing. A review that records a failure and adjusts nothing reads as diligence and is the opposite.

said.support.7af7d42b.text: La data aggiuntiva deve essere successiva a quella mancata.
said.support.7af7d42b.from: The additional date has to be after the one that was missed.

said.support.8452172c.text: Indicare che cosa è stato rilevato. Una revisione senza rilievi è solo una data in un fascicolo.
said.support.8452172c.from: Say what you found. A review with no finding is a date in a file.

said.support.e34f2e55.text: Indicare che cosa verrà effettivamente fatto. Un'esigenza senza alcun adeguamento non cambia nulla per il discente.
said.support.e34f2e55.from: Say what will actually be done. A need with no accommodation against it changes nothing for the learner.

said.support.f4565c1a.text: Indicare quale era il motivo medico. Una valutazione orale autorizzata per un motivo non registrato è la prova su cui chiede chiarimenti un verificatore esterno.
said.support.f4565c1a.from: Say what the medical ground was. An oral assessment authorised on an unrecorded reason is the sitting an external verifier asks about.

said.topic-element.bcd147d2.text: Quella riga del curricolo non appartiene a questa qualifica.

said.unit-competency.34155bb7.text: Che cosa consegue ciascuna unità di studio di questa qualifica: il suo risultato di livello finale, oppure l'unità stessa quando non ne serve nessuno. Prodotto dalla piattaforma a partire dai documenti della qualifica.
said.unit-competency.34155bb7.from: What each study unit of this qualification achieves: its exit level outcome, or the unit itself where it serves none. Made by the platform from the qualification's own documents.

login.intro.text: Melden Sie sich an, um mit dem Lernen fortzufahren.
login.intro.from: Sign in to continue your learning.

login.trouble.text: Probleme bei der Anmeldung? Wenden Sie sich an Ihre Lernbegleitung: Sie kann Ihr Passwort zurücksetzen.
login.trouble.from: Trouble signing in? Speak to your facilitator: they can reset a password for you.

login.locked.text: Zu viele Versuche. Warten Sie fünfzehn Minuten und versuchen Sie es erneut.
login.locked.from: Too many attempts. Wait fifteen minutes and try again.

login.missing.text: Geben Sie Ihre E-Mail-Adresse und Ihr Passwort ein.
login.missing.from: Enter your email address and password.

login.sso.refused.text: Mit diesem Konto ist hier keine Anmeldung möglich. Es muss dieselbe E-Mail-Adresse wie Ihr Konto auf dieser Plattform verwenden. Melden Sie sich mit Ihrem Passwort an oder wenden Sie sich an Ihre Administration.
login.sso.refused.from: That account cannot sign in here. It has to use the same email address as your account on this platform. Sign in with your password, or ask your administrator.

login.sso.expired.text: Diese Anmeldung hat zu lange gedauert oder wurde an anderer Stelle gestartet. Versuchen Sie es erneut.
login.sso.expired.from: That sign-in took too long, or was started somewhere else. Try again.

login.sso.off.text: Diese Anmeldeart ist hier nicht aktiviert.
login.sso.off.from: That way of signing in is not switched on here.

account.forcedIntro.text: Das Passwort, mit dem Sie sich angemeldet haben, wurde von jemand anderem festgelegt. Ersetzen Sie es, bevor Sie fortfahren.
account.forcedIntro.from: Somebody else set the password you signed in with. Replace it before carrying on.

account.currentGiven.text: Das Passwort, das Sie erhalten haben

account.newHint.text: Mindestens 12 Zeichen. Eine Wortfolge aus mehreren nicht zusammenhängenden Wörtern ist sicherer und leichter zu merken als ein kurzes Passwort mit Sonderzeichen.
account.newHint.from: At least 12 characters. A phrase of a few unrelated words is both stronger and easier to remember than something short with symbols in it.

account.mismatch.text: Die beiden neuen Passwörter stimmen nicht überein.
account.mismatch.from: The two new passwords do not match.

account.forcedNote.text: Durch die Änderung werden alle anderen Personen abgemeldet, die das alte Passwort verwenden, auch die Person, die es Ihnen weitergegeben hat.
account.forcedNote.from: Changing it signs out anyone else using the old password, including whoever passed it to you.

account.languageIntro.text: Die Sprache, in der diese Plattform mit Ihnen spricht. Noch nicht übersetzte Bildschirme bleiben auf Englisch, und die eigenen Bezeichnungen Ihres Anbieters bleiben so erhalten, wie er sie geschrieben hat.
account.languageIntro.from: The language this platform speaks to you in. Screens not yet translated stay in English, and your provider's own names for things are kept as they wrote them.

learn.notYours.text: Sie sehen die Einschreibung einer anderen Person. Sie können ihren Fortschritt einsehen, aber nicht für sie erfassen.
learn.notYours.from: You are viewing someone else's enrolment. You can see their progress but cannot record it for them.

learn.noLessons.text: Dieser Kurs enthält noch keine Lektionen.
learn.noLessons.from: This course has no lessons yet.

learn.openMaterial.from: Open the material for this lesson

learn.noContent.text: Kein schriftlicher Inhalt für diese Lektion.
learn.noContent.from: No written content for this lesson.

learn.scormNote.text: Diese Lektion gilt als abgeschlossen, sobald Sie sie im Paket oben beenden. Ihre Position bleibt erhalten, wenn Sie zwischendurch aufhören.
learn.scormNote.from: This lesson completes when you finish it in the package above. Your place is kept if you stop part of the way through.

learn.openedByFacilitator.text: Für Sie freigegeben von Ihrer Lernbegleitung: {reason}
learn.openedByFacilitator.from: Opened for you by your facilitator: {reason}

home.feedbackMany.from: A few things to tell us

home.feedbackIntro.text: Die Antworten werden gemeinsam mit denen aller anderen ausgewertet, nicht einzeln. Zwei Minuten pro Frage, und nur so lässt sich ändern, wie die nächste Kohorte geführt wird.
home.feedbackIntro.from: Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. Two minutes each, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

home.earnedIntro.text: Erfasst am Tag des Abschlusses, nicht erst, wenn das Zertifikat schließlich eintrifft. Jeder Eintrag trägt eine Referenz, die jeder überprüfen kann.
home.earnedIntro.from: Recorded on the day you finished, rather than when the certificate eventually arrives. Each carries a reference anybody can check.

home.step.afterPrevious.text: Wird freigeschaltet, sobald Sie den vorherigen Schritt abgeschlossen haben
home.step.afterPrevious.from: Opens when you finish the step before

home.nothingYet.from: You have not been assigned anything yet.

home.statementsIntro.text: Bringen Sie diese zusammen mit Ihrem Ausweisdokument zur externen Prüfung mit. Das Zentrum prüft sie, bevor Sie teilnehmen dürfen.
home.statementsIntro.from: Take this to the external assessment with your identity document. The centre checks it before you may sit.

assess.waiting.text: Wartet auf die Durchsicht durch einen Assessor.
assess.waiting.from: Waiting for an assessor to review it.

assess.developmental.text: Dies dient Ihrer Entwicklung. Nichts davon wird gegen Sie gewertet.
assess.developmental.from: This is developmental. Nothing here counts against you.

assess.competent.text: Sie wurden in diesem Assessment als kompetent beurteilt, daher müssen Sie es nicht erneut ablegen.
assess.competent.from: You have been found competent on this assessment, so there is nothing to sit again.

assess.noAttempts.text: Sie haben alle Ihre Versuche für dieses Assessment verbraucht.
assess.noAttempts.from: You have used all your attempts at this assessment.

assess.awaitingAssessor.text: Dieses Assessment zählt für Ihre Qualifikation, daher sieht ein Assessor es durch und erfasst die Kompetenzentscheidung. Sie sehen das Ergebnis, sobald dies geschehen ist.
assess.awaitingAssessor.from: This assessment counts towards your qualification, so an assessor will review it and record the competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

assess.practicePassed.text: Dies war eine Übung, daher wird das Ergebnis zu Ihrem Lernen erfasst, entscheidet aber nicht über eine Qualifikation.
assess.practicePassed.from: This was practice, so the result is recorded against your learning but does not decide a qualification.

assess.practiceFailed.text: Dies war eine Übung. Sehen Sie das Material noch einmal durch und versuchen Sie es erneut.
assess.practiceFailed.from: This was practice. Review the material and try again.

assess.selectEvery.text: Wählen Sie alle zutreffenden Antworten aus.

assess.pair.text: Ordnen Sie jedem Element links eines auf der rechten Seite zu.
assess.pair.from: Pair each item on the left with one on the right.

assess.whyMarked.text: Bewertet wird hier die Begründung, nicht das Feld oben.
assess.whyMarked.from: The reason is what is marked here, not the box above.

assess.keptAt.text: Ihre Antworten wurden um {time} gesichert. Erst durch das Einreichen werden sie zur Bewertung gesendet.
assess.keptAt.from: Your answers were kept at {time}. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

assess.kept.text: Ihre Antworten werden während der Bearbeitung gesichert. Erst durch das Einreichen werden sie zur Bewertung gesendet.
assess.kept.from: Your answers are kept as you work. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

evidence.uploadFailed.text: Das Hochladen ist fehlgeschlagen. Prüfen Sie Ihre Verbindung und versuchen Sie es erneut.
evidence.uploadFailed.from: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.

evidence.doneIntro.text: Ein Assessor sieht ihn durch und erfasst eine Kompetenzentscheidung. Sie sehen das Ergebnis, sobald dies geschehen ist.
evidence.doneIntro.from: An assessor will review it and record a competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

evidence.fingerprinted.text: Jede Datei wurde mit einem Fingerabdruck versehen:

evidence.fingerprintNote.text: Sollte eine gespeicherte Datei jemals verändert werden, stimmt ihr Fingerabdruck nicht mehr überein. Das schützt Ihre Arbeit ebenso wie das Assessment.
evidence.fingerprintNote.from: If any stored file were ever altered, its fingerprint would stop matching. That protects your work as much as it protects the assessment.

evidence.kinds.text: Fotos, eine Aufzeichnung der Aufgabe, ein eingescanntes Logbuch oder ein Dokument. Sie können mehrere Dateien gleichzeitig anhängen.
evidence.kinds.from: Photographs, a recording of the task, a scanned logbook, or a document. You can attach several at once.

evidence.note.text: Alles, was der Assessor wissen sollte

paper.summative.text: Dies wird beurteilt und zählt für Ihre Qualifikation.
paper.summative.from: This is assessed and counts towards your qualification.

paper.formative.text: Dies ist eine Vorbereitung. Sie wird bewertet und an Sie zurückgegeben, entscheidet aber über nichts.
paper.formative.from: This is preparation. It is marked and returned to you, and it does not decide anything.

paper.goBack.text: Gehen Sie zurück zum Kurs, um zu sehen, was noch aussteht.
paper.goBack.from: Go back to the course to see what is still outstanding.

paper.connection.text: Diese Antwort wurde nicht gespeichert. Möglicherweise ist Ihre Verbindung abgebrochen; beim nächsten Ändern wird es erneut versucht.
paper.connection.from: That answer did not save. Your connection may have dropped; it will be tried again when you next change something.

paper.handInFailed.from: That could not be handed in.

paper.handInConnection.text: Das Abgeben war nicht möglich. Prüfen Sie Ihre Verbindung und versuchen Sie es erneut.
paper.handInConnection.from: That could not be handed in. Check your connection and try again.

paper.detail.text: Antworten Sie ausführlich und beziehen Sie sich auf die Grundsätze, die Sie gelernt haben.
paper.detail.from: Answer in detail, referring to the principles you have studied.

paper.handedIn.text: Sie haben dies abgegeben. Es kann nicht mehr geändert werden.
paper.handedIn.from: You handed this in. It cannot be changed.

paper.final.text: Nach dem Abgeben kann dies nicht mehr geändert werden.
paper.final.from: Once handed in, this cannot be changed.

paper.confirm.text: Bestätigen Sie die Erklärung, um abzugeben.
paper.confirm.from: Confirm the declaration to hand in.

paper.savedAsYouGo.from: your work is saved as you go

notify.nothingYet.text: Noch nichts. Hier erfahren Sie, wenn Schulungen zugewiesen werden oder fällig sind, wenn Arbeit auf Sie wartet und wenn ein Assessment-Ergebnis oder ein Zertifikat eintrifft.
notify.nothingYet.from: Nothing yet. You will be told here when training is assigned or due, when work is waiting for you, and when an assessment result or certificate arrives.

cert.attesting.text: und damit die folgenden Kompetenzen nachweist

cert.notNational.text: Dies ist das eigene Zertifikat von {provider} für einen Kurs, den es durchgeführt hat. Es ist keine nationale Qualifikation und trägt keine SAQA-Credits und keine SAQA-Kennung. Wenn Lernende auf eine berufliche Qualifikation hinarbeiten, wird das Zertifikat dafür von der QCTO ausgestellt.
cert.notNational.from: This is {provider}'s own certificate for a course it delivered. It is not a national qualification and does not carry a SAQA credit or identifier. Where a learner is working towards an occupational qualification, the certificate for it is issued by the QCTO.

cert.anyone.text: Jeder kann dieses Zertifikat mit der obigen Referenz bestätigen, ohne ein Konto zu benötigen.
cert.anyone.from: Anyone can confirm this certificate with the reference above, without needing an account.

work.introCoach.text: Die Lernenden, die Sie betreuen. Sie bestätigen, was sie am Arbeitsplatz getan haben; ohne Ihre Unterschrift gelangt nichts an einen Assessor.
work.introCoach.from: The learners you supervise. You confirm what they did in the workplace; nothing reaches an assessor without your signature.

work.introLearner.text: Praxiserfahrung wird bei einem Arbeitgeber gesammelt und vom Coach am Arbeitsplatz dort bestätigt. Die Reihenfolge ist festgelegt: Sie erfassen sie, Ihr Coach bestätigt sie, dann geht sie an einen Assessor.
work.introLearner.from: Work experience is done at an employer and signed off by the workplace coach there. The order is fixed: you record it, your coach confirms it, then it goes to an assessor.

work.noneManage.text: Noch keine {records}. Richten Sie oben eine ein: eine Vereinbarung, die die lernende Person, den Arbeitgeber und den Coach nennt, und dann je eine für jedes Modul der Praxiserfahrung.
work.noneManage.from: No {records} yet. Set one up above: an agreement naming the learner, the employer and the coach, then one for each work experience module.

work.none.text: Noch keine {records}. Eine Administration eröffnet sie, sobald eine Vereinbarung mit dem Arbeitsplatz vorliegt, die die lernende Person, den Arbeitgeber und den Coach nennt.
work.none.from: No {records} yet. An administrator opens one once a workplace agreement is in place naming the learner, the employer and the coach.

work.kind.contextual_knowledge.text: Arbeitsplatzwissen: worüber Sie Auskunft geben können müssen
work.kind.contextual_knowledge.from: Workplace knowledge: what you must be able to speak to

work.kind.supporting_evidence.text: Unterstützende Nachweise: was der Arbeitsplatz erstellen muss
work.kind.supporting_evidence.from: Supporting evidence: what the workplace must produce

work.outstanding.text: Noch offen: {items}. Ihr Coach kann erst unterschreiben, wenn jede Zeile erledigt ist und an jedem unterstützenden Nachweis eine Datei angehängt ist.
work.outstanding.from: Still outstanding: {items}. Your coach cannot sign until every line is done and every piece of supporting evidence has a file attached.

work.allRecorded.text: Alles ist erfasst. Senden Sie es an Ihren Coach, wenn Sie bereit sind.
work.allRecorded.from: Everything is recorded. Send it to your coach when you are ready.

work.signingMeans.text: Mit der Unterschrift bestätigen Sie, dass Sie diese Nachweise geprüft haben und dafür einstehen, falls der Assessor sich bei Ihnen meldet. Sie kann danach nicht mehr geändert werden.
work.signingMeans.from: Signing records that you checked this evidence and will attest to it if the assessor contacts you. It cannot be changed afterwards.

work.forAssessor.text: Alles, was der Assessor wissen sollte

work.readyForPoe.text: Vom Coach am Arbeitsplatz unterzeichnet und bereit, in die Nachweismappe aufgenommen zu werden.
work.readyForPoe.from: Signed by the workplace coach and ready to be taken into the Portfolio of Evidence.

scorm.failed.text: Das Paket konnte nicht geöffnet werden. Prüfen Sie Ihre Verbindung und versuchen Sie es erneut.
scorm.failed.from: The package could not be opened. Check your connection and try again.

scorm.preview.text: Eine Vorschau: Was das Paket meldet, wird nicht gespeichert, da dies nicht Ihre eigene Einschreibung ist.
scorm.preview.from: A preview: what the package reports is not kept, because this is not your own enrolment.

certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.text: Die lernende Person hat die Referenz möglicherweise an einen Arbeitgeber weitergegeben. Sie funktioniert weiterhin und zeigt an, dass das Zertifikat zurückgezogen wurde.
certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.from: The learner may have given the reference to an employer. It keeps resolving and will say it was withdrawn.

assessing.intro.text: Einreichungen, die für ein Kompetenzurteil bereit sind. Sie können Ihre eigene Arbeit nicht beurteilen, und ein Teil Ihrer Entscheidungen wird unabhängig von einem Moderator überprüft.
assessing.intro.from: Submissions ready for a competency judgement. You cannot assess your own work, and a proportion of your decisions will be reviewed independently by a moderator.

assessing.empty.text: Nichts wartet. Einreichungen erscheinen hier, sobald Lernende sie senden.
assessing.empty.from: Nothing is waiting. Submissions appear here as learners send them in.

assessing.onScreen.text: Dies wurde am Bildschirm beantwortet. {link}: Die Antworten, die Bewertungshinweise und die Matrix stehen dort zusammen, und die Kriterien werden nach der Bewertung für Sie berechnet.
assessing.onScreen.from: This was answered on screen. {link}: the answers, the marking guidance and the matrix are together there, and the criteria are worked out for you once it is marked.

assessing.ownWork.text: Dies ist Ihre eigene Einreichung. Sie können sie nicht beurteilen; das muss jemand anderes tun.
assessing.ownWork.from: This is your own submission. You cannot assess it; someone else must.

assessing.answered.text: Was die lernende Person geantwortet hat

assessing.hash.text: Der Hashwert wird beim Hochladen erfasst. Wird eine gespeicherte Datei jemals verändert, stimmt er nicht mehr überein und der Eintrag wird markiert.
assessing.hash.from: The hash is recorded at upload. If a stored file is ever altered, it no longer matches and the record is flagged.

assessing.whyDiffers.text: Warum, da es von dem abweicht, was die Punkte nahelegen
assessing.whyDiffers.from: Why, since it differs from what the marks propose

assessing.permanent.text: Ihr Name, das Datum und dieser Kommentar werden dauerhaft gespeichert und können danach nicht mehr bearbeitet werden. Eine Korrektur wird als neue Entscheidung erfasst.
assessing.permanent.from: Your name, the date and this comment are stored permanently and cannot be edited afterwards. A correction is recorded as a new decision.

marking.impliesIntro.text: Arithmetik, kein Urteil. Die Punkte ergeben im Durchschnitt diesen Wert; praktische Leistung und Nachweise vom Arbeitsplatz erreichen die Plattform nicht, und Sie wägen diese ab, bevor Sie entscheiden. Ändern Sie beliebige davon auf dem Entscheidungsbildschirm und begründen Sie es: Die Begründung wird neben dem Vorschlag gespeichert, damit ein Moderator sehen kann, wo beide auseinandergingen.
marking.impliesIntro.from: Arithmetic, not a judgement. The marks average out at this; practical performance and workplace evidence do not reach the platform, and you weigh those before deciding. Change any of these on the decision screen and say why: the reason is stored beside the proposal so a moderator can see where the two parted.

marking.markAllFirst.text: Jede Frage muss bewertet sein, bevor die Kriterien berechnet werden können.
marking.markAllFirst.from: Every question has to be marked before the criteria can be worked out.

marking.summative.text: Dies wird beurteilt. Sobald jede Frage bewertet ist, erfassen Sie eine Entscheidung: Die Kriterien, die damit belegt werden, werden Ihnen zur Bestätigung vorgeschlagen.
marking.summative.from: This is assessed. Once every question is marked, record a decision: the criteria it evidences are proposed for you to confirm.

marking.formative.text: Dies ist ein Arbeitsheft. Es dient der Entwicklung: Bewerten Sie es und geben Sie dann Rückmeldung. Nichts davon erfasst Kompetenz oder bringt die lernende Person näher an die Zulassung.
marking.formative.from: This is a workbook. It is developmental: mark it, then return feedback. Nothing here records competence or moves the learner towards eligibility.

marking.matrix.text: Bewertungsmatrix: Die Wahl einer Stufe für jedes Kriterium ergibt die Punktzahl
marking.matrix.from: Marking matrix: choosing a level for each gives the mark

marking.told.text: Was der lernenden Person mitgeteilt wird

marking.toldHint.text: Wo sie stark war und was gefehlt hat.
marking.toldHint.from: Where it was strong, and what was missing.

marking.returnIntro.text: Rückmeldung, keine Entscheidung. Sie sagt der lernenden Person, was sie vor dem summativen Assessment wiederholen sollte, und erfasst keine Kompetenz für irgendein Kriterium.
marking.returnIntro.from: Feedback, not a decision. It tells the learner what to go back to before the summative, and it records no competence against any criterion.

marking.returnHint.text: Was solide war und was vor dem summativen Assessment erneut gelesen werden sollte.
marking.returnHint.from: What was solid, and what to re-read before the summative.

marking.concern.text: Kriterien, um die sich die schwachen Antworten häufen
marking.concern.from: Criteria the weak answers cluster around

marking.sectionHint.text: Was hier gut war und was beim nächsten Mal anders gemacht werden sollte.
marking.sectionHint.from: What went well here, and what to do differently next time.

marking.learnerSees.text: Die lernende Person sieht dies zusammen mit ihrer Rückmeldung.
marking.learnerSees.from: The learner sees this with their feedback.

moderating.intro.text: Unabhängige Überprüfung der Entscheidungen von Assessoren. Welche Entscheidungen in diese Liste gelangen, bestimmt das System, niemand wählt sie aus. Sie können keine Entscheidung moderieren, die Sie selbst getroffen haben.
moderating.intro.from: Independent review of assessors' decisions. Which decisions reach this list is decided by the system, not chosen by anyone. You cannot moderate a decision you made yourself.

moderating.reason.new_assessor.from: Newly registered assessor: moderated in full

moderating.referBack.text: Zurückverweisen: Der Assessor sollte noch einmal hinsehen
moderating.referBack.from: Refer back: the assessor should look again

moderating.override.text: Außer Kraft setzen: Die Entscheidung ersetzen

moderating.ownDecision.text: Sie haben diese Entscheidung als Assessor getroffen, daher können Sie sie nicht moderieren. Ein anderer Moderator muss dies tun.
moderating.ownDecision.from: You made this decision as the assessor, so you cannot moderate it. Another moderator must.

pack.print.text: Drucken Sie diese Seite, um sie als PDF aufzubewahren.
pack.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF.

pack.counts.text: {submissions} Einreichungen · {decided} entschieden · {moderated} moderiert · {sampled} hier als Stichprobe

pack.instrumentIntro.text: Die Prüfungsarbeit, wie sie gestellt wurde, und die Hinweise, nach denen sie bewertet wurde.
pack.instrumentIntro.from: The paper as it was set, and the guidance it was marked against.

pack.scriptsIntro.text: Über die Punktespanne verteilt entnommen (oberes und unteres Ende sowie die Streuung dazwischen), damit die Bewertung von ihrer besten und ihrer schlechtesten Seite zu sehen ist und nicht nur im Mittelfeld.
pack.scriptsIntro.from: Taken across the mark range (top, bottom and spread between) so the marking is seen at its best and its worst rather than in the middle.

pack.departuresIntro.text: Fälle, in denen ein Assessor von dem abwich, was die Punkte nahelegten, oder ein Moderator vom Assessor. Ein Bericht, der diese auslässt, ist schlechter als gar keiner.
pack.departuresIntro.from: Where an assessor differed from what the marks proposed, or a moderator differed from the assessor. A pack that leaves these out is worse than no pack.

pack.exceptionsIntro.text: Lernende, die von einer namentlich genannten Person an einer Hürde vorbeigelassen wurden, mit der Begründung, die sie angegeben hat.
pack.exceptionsIntro.from: Learners let past a gate by a named person, with the reason they gave.

held.intro.text: Eine lernende Person, die zweimal als noch nicht kompetent beurteilt wurde, gilt nicht als durchgefallen. Das Assessment wird zurückgestellt und mit ihrem Arbeitgeber wird eine Programmüberprüfung einberufen, denn an diesem Punkt geht es selten darum, ob sie den Stoff kennt, sondern meist darum, was um sie herum vorgeht.
held.intro.from: A learner found not yet competent twice is not failed. The assessment is held, and a programme review is convened with their employer, because by this point the question is rarely whether they know it, and usually what has been going on around them.

held.empty.text: Dies füllt sich, wenn eine lernende Person bei einem summativen Assessment zum zweiten Mal als noch nicht kompetent beurteilt wird. Bis dahin gibt es nichts zu überprüfen.
held.empty.from: This fills when a learner is found not yet competent for a second time on a summative assessment. Until then there is nothing to review.

held.whoConvenes.text: Eine Lernbegleitung oder eine Administration beruft die Überprüfung ein.
held.whoConvenes.from: A facilitator or administrator convenes the review.

held.oralAuthorised.text: {assessment} · die Überprüfung hat einen dritten, mündlich durchgeführten Versuch zugelassen
held.oralAuthorised.from: {assessment} · the review authorised a third attempt, conducted orally

held.whoConducts.text: Ein Assessor führt den mündlichen Versuch durch, nicht die Person, die ihn zugelassen hat.
held.whoConducts.from: An assessor conducts the oral attempt, and not the person who authorised it.

held.furtherLearning.text: Weiteres Lernen vor jedem weiteren Versuch
held.furtherLearning.from: Further learning before any further attempt

held.whyHint.text: Was die Überprüfung ergeben hat und wovon es abhängt.
held.whyHint.from: What the review found, and what it turns on.

oral.reviewDecidedIntro.text: Die Gründe, aus denen dieser dritte Versuch zugelassen wurde.
oral.reviewDecidedIntro.from: The grounds on which this third attempt was authorised.

oral.recordIntro.text: Ein mündlicher Versuch hinterlässt keinen eigenen Nachweis. Dies ist dieser Nachweis, und ohne ihn kann das Ergebnis nicht erfasst werden.
oral.recordIntro.from: An oral attempt leaves no evidence of its own. This is that evidence, and the outcome cannot be recorded without it.

oral.outcomeIntro.text: Wird auf dieselbe Weise beurteilt wie ein schriftlicher Versuch, nach denselben Kriterien, und danach auf dieselbe Weise moderiert.
oral.outcomeIntro.from: Judged the same way as a written attempt, against the same criteria, and moderated the same way afterwards.

oral.howHint.text: Persönlich oder per Videoanruf, über den es stattfand
oral.howHint.from: In person, or the video call it was held on

oral.presentNote.text: Nicht erforderlich. Ein mündliches Assessment ohne weitere Person im Raum ist bei der Moderation schwerer zu verteidigen, und der Eintrag sollte festhalten, um welche Art es sich handelte.
oral.presentNote.from: Not required. An oral assessment with nobody else in the room is harder to defend at moderation, and the record should say which kind this was.

oral.savedNext.text: Das Ergebnis wird auf dem Bewertungsbildschirm erfasst, wie bei jedem anderen Versuch.
oral.savedNext.from: The outcome is recorded on the marking screen, the same as any other attempt.

appeals.intro.text: Lernende können gegen ein Ergebnis oder gegen das Verhalten eines Assessors Einspruch erheben. Der Eingang wird innerhalb von {hours} Stunden bestätigt; diese Frist wird am häufigsten versäumt, weil sie läuft, während jemand unterrichtet.
appeals.intro.from: A learner may appeal against a result or against an assessor's conduct. Receipt is acknowledged within {hours} hours, which is the deadline that gets missed, because it runs while somebody is teaching.

appeals.lateIntro.text: Die {hours} Stunden sind verstrichen und der Eingang wurde noch nicht bestätigt. Eine verspätete Bestätigung ist besser als keine, und der Eintrag zeigt beides.
appeals.lateIntro.from: Past the {hours} hours and still not acknowledged. Acknowledging late is better than not at all, and the record will show both.

appeals.openIntro.text: Alles, was eingereicht und noch nicht abgeschlossen ist, das Neueste zuerst.
appeals.openIntro.from: Everything lodged and not yet closed, newest first.

appeals.none.text: Nichts offen. Ein Einspruch wird von der eigenen Seite der lernenden Person aus eingereicht.
appeals.none.from: Nothing open. An appeal is lodged from a learner's own page.

appeals.procedureIntro.text: Bestätigen, die lernende Person treffen, bei einem Ergebnis den Moderator konsultieren, dann lösen und die lernende Person informieren.
appeals.procedureIntro.from: Acknowledge, meet the learner, consult the moderator where the ground is a result, then resolve and tell them.

appeals.closedUnacknowledged.text: Abgeschlossen, ohne dass eine Bestätigung erfasst wurde.
appeals.closedUnacknowledged.from: Closed without an acknowledgement being recorded.

appeals.firstCounts.text: Die erste Bestätigung ist die, die der Eintrag behält. Sie kann später nicht neu gestempelt werden, denn eine Zeit, die sich ändern lässt, belegt nichts.
appeals.firstCounts.from: The first acknowledgement is the one the record keeps. It cannot be re-stamped later, because a time that can be changed is not evidence of anything.

appeals.resultNeedsModerator.text: Ein Einspruch gegen ein Ergebnis geht an den internen Moderator, bevor er gelöst werden kann. Danach fragt ein externer Prüfer.
appeals.resultNeedsModerator.from: A result appeal goes to the internal moderator before it can be resolved. That is the step an external verifier asks about.

appeals.conductNoModerator.text: Ein Einspruch gegen das Verhalten lässt sich nicht durch eine Neubewertung klären, daher ist kein Moderator erforderlich.
appeals.conductNoModerator.from: A conduct appeal is not something re-marking settles, so no moderator is required.

appeals.notFeedback.text: Eine Entscheidung, die der lernenden Person nicht mitgeteilt wurde, ist keine Rückmeldung.
appeals.notFeedback.from: A decision the learner has not been given is not feedback.

appeals.whyHint.text: Warum. Darauf hat die lernende Person Anspruch.
appeals.whyHint.from: Why. This is the part the learner is entitled to.

appeals.notesIntro.text: Die Erörterung zwischen Koordination, Assessor und Moderator. Der lernenden Person nur sichtbar, wenn Sie es festlegen; Anspruch hat sie auf das Ergebnis und die obige Begründung.
appeals.notesIntro.from: The discussion between coordinator, assessor and moderator. Not shown to the learner unless you say so; what they are entitled to is the outcome and the reasoning above.

appeals.noteHint.text: Was besprochen wurde und mit wem
appeals.noteHint.from: What was discussed, and with whom

appeals.learnerMayRead.text: Die lernende Person darf dies lesen

appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.text: Ein Zurückziehen braucht eine Begründung. Ohne eine sieht es nach Druck aus, und genau darum ginge es bei einem Einspruch gegen das Verhalten.
appeals.withdrawNeedsReason.from: A withdrawal needs a reason. One with none looks like pressure, and that is exactly what an appeal about conduct would be about.

rpl.intro.text: Für eine lernende Person, die einen Teil der Arbeit bereits beherrscht. Nichts wird hier auf das Wort einer einzelnen Person hin gewährt: Ein Urteil wird anhand der eigenen Kriterien des Moduls gefällt, vollständig schriftlich begründet und von jemand anderem als der beurteilenden Person moderiert, bevor es irgendetwas gilt.
rpl.intro.from: For a learner who can already do part of the work. Nothing here is granted on one person's say-so: a judgement is made against the module's own criteria, written down in full, and moderated by somebody other than whoever made it before it counts for anything.

rpl.waitingIntro.text: Ein Urteil gewährt nichts, bis dies erledigt ist. Lesen Sie die Begründung im Hinblick auf das Modul, bevor Sie zustimmen: Sie ist das Erste, was ein externer Prüfer liest.
rpl.waitingIntro.from: A judgement grants nothing until this is done. Read the rationale against the module before agreeing: it is the first thing an external verifier reads.

rpl.appearHere.text: Urteile erscheinen hier, sobald sie gefällt werden.
rpl.appearHere.from: Judgements appear here as they are made.

rpl.openIntro.text: Der erste Schritt, der den Eintrag anlegt, an den alles Weitere geknüpft wird.
rpl.openIntro.from: The first step, and the one that creates the record everything else attaches to.

rpl.transferIntro.text: Anders als die Anerkennung früherer Lernleistungen: Die lernende Person besitzt bereits eine Qualifikation, deren Ergebnisse dieses Modul abdecken. Keine Beratung, aber die Zuordnung muss schriftlich festgehalten werden; eine Anrechnung ohne sie ist eine Behauptung, die niemand überprüfen kann.
rpl.transferIntro.from: Different from RPL: the learner already holds a qualification whose outcomes cover this module. No advisory, but the mapping has to be written down; a transfer without it is a claim nobody can check.

rpl.needsBoth.text: Für einen Antrag werden eine lernende Person und eine Qualifikation benötigt, für die er gestellt wird. Fügen Sie diese zuerst hinzu.
rpl.needsBoth.from: An application needs a learner and a qualification to apply against. Add those first.

rpl.needsLearner.text: Fügen Sie eine lernende Person hinzu, bevor Sie eine Anrechnung für sie erfassen.
rpl.needsLearner.from: Add a learner before recording a transfer for one.

rpl.mapping.text: Wie die Ergebnisse dessen, was sie besitzen, die Ergebnisse dieses Moduls abdecken
rpl.mapping.from: How the outcomes of what they hold cover this module's

rpl.checked.text: Was Sie geprüft haben und zu welchem Schluss Sie gekommen sind
rpl.checked.from: What you checked, and what you concluded

record.print.text: Drucken Sie diese Seite, um sie als PDF für die Nachweismappe aufzubewahren.
record.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF for the portfolio of evidence.

record.timeExpired.text: Nicht angenommen: Die Zeit ist abgelaufen und die Arbeit wurde im vorliegenden Stand abgegeben.
record.timeExpired.from: Not accepted: the time limit expired and the work was handed in as it stood.

record.returned.text: Zurückgegeben {date}. Dies dient der Entwicklung: Es erfasst keine Kompetenz.
record.returned.from: Returned {date}. This is developmental: it records no competence.

sor.withdrawConsequence.text: Ein Assessment-Zentrum hat möglicherweise bereits eine Kopie. Die Referenz funktioniert weiterhin und zeigt an, dass die Bescheinigung zurückgezogen wurde.
sor.withdrawConsequence.from: An assessment centre may already hold a copy. The reference keeps working and will say it was withdrawn.

sor.print.from: Print or save this Statement of Results

fisa.intro.text: Die Prüfungsarbeit, die dieser Anbieter für sein eigenes Kompetenzprogramm stellt. Anders als bei einem externen Assessment stellen und moderieren Sie sie selbst, daher findet die Moderation statt, bevor jemand sie ablegt, und eine Prüfungsarbeit, die nicht als zweckmäßig freigegeben wurde, kann nicht verwendet werden.
fisa.intro.from: The paper this provider sets for its own skills programme. Unlike an external assessment, you write it and you moderate it, so the moderation happens before anybody sits it, and a paper that has not been signed off as fit for purpose cannot be used.

fisa.waitingIntro.text: Niemand kann diese ablegen, bis ein Moderator sie freigegeben hat.
fisa.waitingIntro.from: Nobody can sit these until a moderator signs them off.

fisa.setNewIntro.text: Für ein Kompetenzprogramm. Eine vollständige oder Teilqualifikation wird extern beurteilt.
fisa.setNewIntro.from: Against a skills programme. A full or part qualification is assessed externally.

fisa.gate.approved.text: Als zweckmäßig freigegeben: Kandidaten dürfen diese Prüfungsarbeit ablegen
fisa.gate.approved.from: Signed off as fit for purpose: candidates may sit this paper

fisa.gate.in_moderation.text: Beim Moderator: Noch niemand darf sie ablegen
fisa.gate.in_moderation.from: With the moderator: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.gate.draft.text: In Erstellung: Noch niemand darf sie ablegen
fisa.gate.draft.from: Being written: nobody may sit it yet

fisa.beforeNotAfter.text: Eine FISA wird moderiert, bevor sie abgelegt wird, nicht danach. Das macht sie bei einem Überwachungsbesuch vertretbar.
fisa.beforeNotAfter.from: A FISA is moderated before it is sat, not after. That is what makes it defensible at a monitoring visit.

fisa.practical.text: Enthält auch eine praktische Komponente, die als kompetent oder noch nicht kompetent beurteilt wird.
fisa.practical.from: Also has a practical component, judged competent or not yet competent.

fisa.moderatorIntro.text: Prüft, ob sie zweckmäßig ist, bevor sie jemand ablegt.
fisa.moderatorIntro.from: Checks it is fit for purpose, before anybody sits it.

fisa.unsigned.text: Noch keine Vertraulichkeitsvereinbarung. Bis zur Unterzeichnung darf die Person die Prüfungsarbeit weder einsehen noch beurteilen.
fisa.unsigned.from: No confidentiality agreement yet. They may not see or judge the paper until it is signed.

fisa.outcomes.text: Ergebnisse auf Abschlussniveau und wo die Prüfungsarbeit sie beurteilt
fisa.outcomes.from: Exit level outcomes, and where the paper assesses them

fisa.outcomesIntro.text: Abschnitt 2 beider Berichte. Die einzige Stelle, die zeigt, dass die Prüfungsarbeit die Qualifikation abdeckt und nicht nur wie eine Prüfung aussieht.
fisa.outcomesIntro.from: Section 2 of both reports. The only place that shows the paper covers the qualification rather than merely looking like an exam.

fisa.noOutcomes.text: Für dieses Programm sind keine Ergebnisse auf Abschlussniveau erfasst, daher gibt es nichts, dem die Prüfungsarbeit zugeordnet werden könnte. Importieren Sie zuerst das Curriculum.
fisa.noOutcomes.from: This programme has no exit level outcomes recorded, so there is nothing to map the paper against. Import the curriculum first.

fisa.onlyExaminer.text: Nur der ernannte Prüfer kann diese beantworten, sobald seine Vertraulichkeitsvereinbarung unterzeichnet ist.
fisa.onlyExaminer.from: Only the appointed examiner, once their confidentiality agreement is signed, can answer these.

fisa.onlyModerator.text: Nur der ernannte Moderator kann diese beantworten, sobald seine Vertraulichkeitsvereinbarung unterzeichnet ist.
fisa.onlyModerator.from: Only the appointed moderator, once their confidentiality agreement is signed, can answer these.

fisa.handOverIntro.text: Sobald Ihr eigener Bericht vollständig ist.
fisa.handOverIntro.from: Once your own report is complete.
