said.qualification-from-document.04da62c.text: Es nennt {named} Module, führt aber für keines davon Themen oder Beurteilungskriterien auf, so wie das Qualifikationsdokument aussieht.
said.qualification-from-document.04da62c.from: It names {named} modules but sets out no topics or assessment criteria for any of them, which is what the Qualification Document looks like.

said.qualification-from-document.0cde70e.text: Dies ist eine Teilqualifikation, aber die vollständige Qualifikation, aus der sie stammt, ist noch nicht auf der Plattform. Importieren Sie zuerst diese: Eine Teilqualifikation hat kein eigenes Curriculum, daher gibt es nichts, woran sie angehängt werden kann, bis die übergeordnete existiert.
said.qualification-from-document.0cde70e.from: This is a part qualification, but the full qualification it comes from is not on the platform yet. Import that one first: a part carries no curriculum of its own, so there is nothing to attach it to until the parent exists.

said.qualification-from-document.3259ea8.text: Es nennt {named} Modul, führt aber dafür weder Themen noch Beurteilungskriterien auf, so wie das Qualifikationsdokument aussieht.
said.qualification-from-document.3259ea8.from: It names {named} module but sets out no topics or assessment criteria for any of them, which is what the Qualification Document looks like.

said.qualification-from-document.349cca0.text: Es wurde kein Qualifikationsdokument geliefert, daher gibt es keine SAQA-ID und keine Ergebnisse auf Abschlussniveau. Beides kann später ergänzt werden, aber die EISA wird an den Ergebnissen ausgerichtet.
said.qualification-from-document.349cca0.from: No Qualification Document was supplied, so there is no SAQA ID and no Exit Level Outcomes. Both can be added later, but the EISA is set against the outcomes.

said.qualification-from-document.67ca0dc.text: „{filename}“ sieht nach einem Scan aus: {pages} Seiten mit fast keinem Text. Die Plattform kann sie nicht lesen, daher kann nichts daraus indexiert werden. Laden Sie eine digitale Kopie hoch.
said.qualification-from-document.67ca0dc.from: "{filename}" looks like a scan: {pages} pages with almost no text in them. The platform cannot read it, so nothing can be indexed from it. Upload a digital copy.

said.qualification-from-document.9660409.from: The Qualification Document was not filed: {message}

said.qualification-from-document.b40e3a7.text: Als Teil von „{title}“ angelegt, mit {idsCount} von deren {parentModulesCount} Modulen. Sein Curriculum ist das der übergeordneten Qualifikation; es wurde nichts kopiert, sodass die Arbeit einer lernenden Person an einem Modul nur einmal zählt, egal wo sie ihr begegnet ist.
said.qualification-from-document.b40e3a7.from: Created as a part of "{title}", taking {idsCount} of its {parentModulesCount} modules. Its curriculum is the parent's; nothing was copied, so a learner's work against a module counts once wherever they met it.

said.qualification-from-document.b566090.text: Ihr Abschnitt zu den Qualifikationsregeln nannte keine Module, daher kann nichts automatisch ausgewählt werden. Wählen Sie sie von Hand aus, sobald sie existiert.
said.qualification-from-document.b566090.from: Its Qualification Rules section named no modules, so nothing can be selected automatically. Choose them by hand once it exists.

said.qualification-from-document.bd19467.text: „{title}“ hat bereits den Code {curriculumCode}. Ein erneuter Import hier würde das gesamte Curriculum ersetzen, und alles, was einem Kriterium zugeordnet ist, ginge damit verloren. Öffnen Sie stattdessen diese Qualifikation.
said.qualification-from-document.bd19467.from: "{title}" already carries the code {curriculumCode}. Importing again here would replace its whole curriculum, and anything tagged to a criterion would go with it. Open that qualification instead.

said.qualification-from-document.cc83d42.text: Ihr Dokument besagt, dass dies eine Teilqualifikation ist, aber die vollständige Qualifikation, aus der sie stammt, ist nicht auf der Plattform. Importieren Sie zuerst diese: Diese teilt sich deren Curriculum und hat kein eigenes.
said.qualification-from-document.cc83d42.from: Its document says this is a part qualification, but the full qualification it comes from is not on the platform. Import that one first: this one shares its curriculum and has none of its own.

said.qualification-from-document.ce45bc7.text: Ihr Dokument besagt, dass dies ein Kompetenzprogramm ist, aber die vollständige Qualifikation, aus der es stammt, ist nicht auf der Plattform. Importieren Sie zuerst diese: Dieses teilt sich deren Curriculum und hat kein eigenes.
said.qualification-from-document.ce45bc7.from: Its document says this is a skills programme, but the full qualification it comes from is not on the platform. Import that one first: this one shares its curriculum and has none of its own.

said.qualification-from-document.d2e90a8.text: In „{filename}“ wurden keine Curriculum-Module gefunden. {named}Prüfen Sie, ob es das Curriculum-Dokument ist und nicht das Qualifikationsdokument oder die Assessment-Spezifikation.
said.qualification-from-document.d2e90a8.from: No curriculum modules were found in "{filename}". {named}Check it is the Curriculum Document rather than the Qualification Document or the Assessment Specification.

said.qualification-from-document.de980f5.text: Es wurde keine Assessment-Spezifikation geliefert. Sie ist eines der drei Dokumente, die erforderlich sind, bevor Material zu dieser Qualifikation verfasst werden kann.
said.qualification-from-document.de980f5.from: No Assessment Specification was supplied. It is one of the three documents required before material can be authored against this qualification.

said.qualification-preview.37a5ab3f.text: Für diese Lerneinheit wurde noch nichts aufgebaut, daher fände eine für die Qualifikation eingeschriebene lernende Person sie leer vor.
said.qualification-preview.37a5ab3f.from: Nothing has been built for this study unit yet, so a learner enrolled on the qualification would find it empty.

said.qualification-preview.669ce973.text: Diese Qualifikation hat keine Lerneinheiten, daher gibt es nichts, was eine lernende Person durchlaufen könnte. Lerneinheiten stammen aus dem Abgleichdokument.
said.qualification-preview.669ce973.from: This qualification has no study units, so there is nothing for a learner to walk through. Study units come from the alignment document.

said.qualification-preview.8b044785.text: Diese Lerneinheit hat einen Kurs ohne Schritte, daher würde eine lernende Person ihn öffnen und nichts zu tun vorfinden.
said.qualification-preview.8b044785.from: This study unit has a course with no steps in it, so a learner would open it and find nothing to do.

said.qualification-removal.080871bf.text: Diese Qualifikation kann nicht entfernt werden: {what}. Das sind Aufzeichnungen dessen, was Lernende getan haben, und die Plattform bewahrt sie auf.
said.qualification-removal.080871bf.from: This qualification cannot be removed: {what}. Those are records of what learners have done, and the platform keeps them.

said.qualifications-id-documents.051c7df.text: Als {kind} abgelegt. Daraus wurde nichts gelesen: Nur ein Abgleichdokument oder eine Abgleichmatrix wird gelesen.
said.qualifications-id-documents.051c7df.from: Filed as {kind}. Nothing was read out of it: only an alignment document or an alignment matrix is read.

said.qualifications-id-documents.09def23.text: Dieses Dokument wurde abgelegt, aber daraus sind keine Lerneinheiten entstanden. Es liest sich wie ein Abgleichdokument, daher stehen die genannten Module entweder nicht unter diesen Codes im Curriculum, oder die Lerneinheiten sind schon vorhanden. Die Einzelheiten stehen im Eintrag der Dokumentenbibliothek.
said.qualifications-id-documents.09def23.from: That document was filed, but no study units came out of it. It reads as an alignment document, so either the modules it names are not in the curriculum under those codes, or the study units are already there. The detail is in the document library entry.

said.qualifications-id-documents.52f263a.text: Als Curriculum-Abgleichmatrix abgelegt und nicht als die gewählte Art: Sie nennt Lerneinheiten und Ergebnisse auf Abschlussniveau, also ist sie eine.
said.qualifications-id-documents.52f263a.from: Filed as a curriculum alignment matrix rather than the kind chosen: it names study units and exit level outcomes, so it is one.

said.qualifications-id-documents.68a2de1.text: Haken Sie mindestens eine Zeile zum Hinzufügen an, oder lassen Sie das Curriculum, wie es ist.
said.qualifications-id-documents.68a2de1.from: Tick at least one line to add, or leave the curriculum as it is.

said.qualifications-id-documents.a6619e6.text: Prüfen Sie die Modulcodes des Curriculums

said.qualifications-id-documents.dac96cb.text: Abgleichdokument gelesen. Lerneinheiten aufgebaut, aber keine Module darunter eingeordnet.
said.qualifications-id-documents.dac96cb.from: Alignment document read. Study units built, but no modules placed under them.

said.qualifications-id-documents.ea78db1.text: Wählen Sie eine Datei zum Hochladen.

said.qualifications-id-documents.ea9c86d.from: Alignment document read. Study units built.

said.qualifications-id-edit.2a61cca9.text: Wählen Sie, was diese Qualifikation ist.

said.qualifications-id-edit.a8da7938.from: Recorded as a part qualification of the one named.

said.qualifications-id-edit.ca623efc.text: Als Kompetenzprogramm erfasst, entnommen aus der genannten.
said.qualifications-id-edit.ca623efc.from: Recorded as a skills programme drawn from the one named.

said.qualifications-id-modules.0f95215b.text: Zurückgesetzt. Dies übernimmt keines der Module der übergeordneten Qualifikation.
said.qualifications-id-modules.0f95215b.from: Cleared. This takes none of the parent's modules.

said.qualifications-id-modules.53a59328.text: Gespeichert. Dies wird an {selected} Modulen beurteilt.
said.qualifications-id-modules.53a59328.from: Saved. This is assessed against {selected} modules.

said.qualifications-id-modules.f5a96609.text: Gespeichert. Dies wird an {selected} Modul beurteilt.
said.qualifications-id-modules.f5a96609.from: Saved. This is assessed against {selected} module.

said.qualifications-id-remove-actions.08.text: Das ist nicht der Titel. Geben Sie ihn genau so ein, wie er oben steht, um zu bestätigen, welche Qualifikation Sie meinen.
said.qualifications-id-remove-actions.08.from: That is not the title. Type it exactly as it appears above to confirm which qualification you mean.

said.qualifications-id-remove-actions.6c.text: Ihre Rolle umfasst nicht die Verwaltung von Qualifikationen.
said.qualifications-id-remove-actions.6c.from: Your role does not include managing qualifications.

said.qualifications-id-remove-actions.6d.text: Diese Qualifikation konnte nicht entfernt werden.
said.qualifications-id-remove-actions.6d.from: That qualification could not be removed.

said.qualifications.2276ff00.text: Die Dokumente wurden nicht mit dem Formular gesendet. Wählen Sie sie erneut.
said.qualifications.2276ff00.from: The documents were not sent with the form. Choose them again.

said.qualifications.cab5f65e.text: Wählen Sie das Curriculum-Dokument: Es ist das, das die Module angibt.
said.qualifications.cab5f65e.from: Choose the Curriculum Document: it is the one that states the modules.

said.readiness-qualificationId-userId.2b.text: Das Erfassen eines Qualifikationszertifikats ist Mitarbeitenden vorbehalten, die Einschreibungen verwalten.
said.readiness-qualificationId-userId.2b.from: Recording a qualification certificate is limited to staff who manage enrolments.

said.readiness-qualificationId-userId.87.text: Das Ausstellen einer Ergebnisbescheinigung ist Mitarbeitenden vorbehalten, die Zertifikate ausstellen dürfen.
said.readiness-qualificationId-userId.87.from: Issuing a Statement of Results is limited to staff who can issue certificates.

said.reassessment.051a9a39.text: Halten Sie schriftlich fest, was gefragt und geantwortet wurde, bevor Sie das Ergebnis erfassen. Ein mündliches Bestehen ohne Aufzeichnung des Gesprächs ist kein Nachweis.
said.reassessment.051a9a39.from: Write down what was asked and answered before recording the outcome. An oral pass with no record of the exchange is not evidence.

said.reassessment.2a95a5d9.text: Eine Programmüberprüfung folgt auf {ATTEMPTS_BEFORE_REVIEW} Ergebnisse mit noch nicht kompetent. Diese lernende Person hat {notYetCompetent}.
said.reassessment.2a95a5d9.from: A programme review follows {ATTEMPTS_BEFORE_REVIEW} not-yet-competent results. This learner has {notYetCompetent}.

said.reassessment.54d33118.text: Diese lernende Person hat für dieses Assessment bereits eine Programmüberprüfung durchlaufen.
said.reassessment.54d33118.from: This learner has already been through a programme review on this assessment.

said.reassessment.7eeb4562.text: Nennen Sie die Person beim Arbeitgeber, die konsultiert wurde. Ein ungenannter Arbeitgeber ist kein Nachweis, dass eine Konsultation stattgefunden hat.
said.reassessment.7eeb4562.from: Name the person at the employer who was consulted. An unnamed employer is not evidence that a consultation happened.

said.reassessment.b07a9b03.text: Sie können Ihr eigenes mündliches Assessment nicht durchführen.
said.reassessment.b07a9b03.from: You cannot conduct your own oral assessment.

said.reassessment.cea9b770.text: Diese Überprüfung hat sich für {outcome} entschieden, nicht für eine mündliche Neubeurteilung.
said.reassessment.cea9b770.from: That review decided on {outcome}, not an oral reassessment.

said.reassessment.d374ded8.text: Diese lernende Person wurde bei diesem Assessment bereits als kompetent befunden.
said.reassessment.d374ded8.from: This learner has already been found competent on this assessment.

said.reassessment.df7ff299.text: Diese Genehmigung wurde bereits verwendet. Ein zweimal gewährter dritter Versuch ist kein dritter Versuch.
said.reassessment.df7ff299.from: That authorisation has already been used. A third attempt granted twice is not a third attempt.

said.reassessment.eacc2318.text: Dieser Versuch ist keine genehmigte mündliche Neubeurteilung.
said.reassessment.eacc2318.from: That attempt is not an authorised oral reassessment.

said.reassessment.f272ec97.text: Sie haben diesen dritten Versuch genehmigt, daher muss jemand anderes ihn durchführen.
said.reassessment.f272ec97.from: You authorised this third attempt, so somebody else must conduct it.

said.reassessments.b53b937e.text: Halten Sie mindestens eine Frage und die gegebene Antwort schriftlich fest. Ein mündliches Bestehen ohne Aufzeichnung des Gesprächs ist kein Nachweis.
said.reassessments.b53b937e.from: Write down at least one question and the answer given. An oral pass with no record of the exchange is not evidence.

said.recognition.056d89d8.text: Die Befreiung von {title} würde dazu führen, dass bei dieser lernenden Person {wouldBePercent} Prozent der Qualifikation ohne Unterricht anerkannt würden, und die Grenze für diese Qualifikation beträgt {maxPercent}. Der Rest muss als reguläres Lernen absolviert werden, oder die Grenze wird bei der Qualifikation mit einer Begründung geändert.
said.recognition.056d89d8.from: Exempting {title} would take this learner to {wouldBePercent} per cent of the qualification recognised without being taught, and the limit on this qualification is {maxPercent}. The rest has to be done as ordinary learning, or the limit changed on the qualification with a reason for it.

said.recognition.165f2f8f.text: Dieser Kandidat hatte keine Beratungssitzung. Frühere Lernleistungen an Anforderungen zu messen, die niemand erklärt hat, ist der Weg, auf dem ein Kandidat scheitert, weil er die falschen Nachweise zusammengestellt hat. Erfassen Sie zuerst die Beratung.
said.recognition.165f2f8f.from: This candidate has not had an advisory session. Judging prior learning against requirements nobody explained is how a candidate is failed for assembling the wrong evidence. Record the advice first.

said.recognition.2f3e0747.text: Beurteilung erfasst. Sie gewährt nichts, bis sie moderiert ist.
said.recognition.2f3e0747.from: Judgement recorded. It grants nothing until it is moderated.

said.recognition.3d78b1cc.text: Sagen Sie, was Sie geprüft haben und ob Sie zustimmen. Eine Moderation ohne Kommentar ist nur eine Unterschrift.
said.recognition.3d78b1cc.from: Say what you looked at and whether you agree. A moderation with no comment is a signature.

said.recognition.4cf70aee.text: Sagen Sie, wie die Ergebnisse dessen, was die Person mitbringt, die des Moduls abdecken. Dieser Absatz ist die gesamte Entscheidung, und eine Anrechnung ohne ihn ist eine Behauptung, die niemand prüfen kann.
said.recognition.4cf70aee.from: Say how the outcomes of what they hold cover this module's. That paragraph is the whole of the decision, and a transfer without it is a claim nobody can check.

said.recognition.61201ac5.text: Sagen Sie, was der Nachweis war und warum er das Modul erfüllt. Dieser Absatz ist die gesamte Beurteilung und das Erste, was eine externe Verifizierung liest.
said.recognition.61201ac5.from: Say what the evidence was and why it satisfies the module. This paragraph is the whole of the judgement, and the first thing an external verifier reads.

said.recognition.86f838fe.text: Dies wurde am {awardedOn} vergeben, mehr als {CAT_YEARS} Jahre vor dieser Genehmigung. Credit Accumulation and Transfer deckt Abschlüsse innerhalb von {CAT_YEARS2} Jahren ab; darüber hinaus ist der Weg die Anerkennung früherer Lernleistungen, die beurteilt, was die lernende Person noch kann, und nicht, was sie einmal bestanden hat. Öffnen Sie stattdessen einen Antrag auf Anerkennung früherer Lernleistungen.
said.recognition.86f838fe.from: That was awarded on {awardedOn}, more than {CAT_YEARS} years before this approval. Credit Accumulation and Transfer covers completions within {CAT_YEARS2} years; beyond that the route is Recognition of Prior Learning, which assesses what the learner can still do rather than what they once passed. Open an RPL application instead.

said.recognition.d4a3fd91.text: Erfassen Sie, was dem Kandidaten zum Sammeln aufgetragen wurde. Ein abgewiesener Kandidat bestreitet diesen Absatz, und „über die Anforderungen beraten“ ist kein solcher.
said.recognition.d4a3fd91.from: Record what the candidate was told to gather. A refused candidate disputes this paragraph, and 'advised on requirements' is not one.

said.recognition.e046c5d9.text: Antrag eröffnet. Als Nächstes folgt die Beratung.

said.recognition.e21aaea2.text: Sie können Ihre eigene Beurteilung nicht moderieren.
said.recognition.e21aaea2.from: You cannot moderate your own judgement.

said.recognition.e7122f98.text: Ihre Rolle umfasst dies nicht. Die Anerkennung liegt bei den eigenen Mitarbeitenden des Anbieters, und eine Beurteilung wird von jemand anderem moderiert als von der Person, die sie vorgenommen hat.
said.recognition.e7122f98.from: Your role does not include this. Recognition is held by the provider's own staff, and a judgement is moderated by somebody other than whoever made it.

said.record-store.177e55ac.from: The store could not be reached: {error}.

said.record-store.2edd3c36.text: Diese Plattform hat keinen Schlüssel zum Versiegeln von Geheimnissen, daher kann sie den Schlüssel des Speichers nicht aufbewahren.
said.record-store.2edd3c36.from: This platform has no key to seal secrets with, so it cannot keep the store's key.

said.record-store.32a7ad42.text: Der Schlüssel des Speichers wird für die Verbindung benötigt.
said.record-store.32a7ad42.from: The store's key is needed to connect.

said.record-store.426bb3b3.text: Der Schlüssel des Speichers kann auf dieser Plattform nicht mehr geöffnet werden. Geben Sie ihn auf der Seite Lernaufzeichnungen erneut ein.
said.record-store.426bb3b3.from: The store's key can no longer be opened on this platform. Enter it again on the Learning records page.

said.record-store.62143f17.text: Der Name des Schlüssels wird benötigt.

said.record-store.76194b8f.text: Der Speicher hat den Schlüssel abgelehnt ({status}). Prüfen Sie Name und Geheimnis des Schlüssels auf der Seite Lernaufzeichnungen.
said.record-store.76194b8f.from: The store refused the key ({status}). Check the key's name and secret on the Learning records page.

said.record-store.9f6b73a1.text: Der Speicher hat mitten in der Übertragung nicht mehr geantwortet.
said.record-store.9f6b73a1.from: The store stopped answering part of the way through.

said.record-store.c387d2ea.text: Die Adresse des Speichers muss mit https:// beginnen.
said.record-store.c387d2ea.from: The store's address must start with https://.

said.record-store.fe2456ba.text: Die Adresse des Speichers wurde nicht gefunden (404). Prüfen Sie, ob es die xAPI-Adresse ist, diejenige, die vor /statements endet.
said.record-store.fe2456ba.from: The store's address was not found (404). Check it is the xAPI address, the one ending before /statements.

said.records.05c230ea.text: Geben Sie an, warum dies über seine Aufbewahrungsfrist hinaus aufbewahrt wird. Es ist eine Entscheidung und kein Versehen, und die Begründung gehört in die Akte.
said.records.05c230ea.from: Say why this is being kept beyond its retention period. It is a position rather than an oversight, and the reason belongs in the file.

said.records.94e6ebbb.text: Diese Datei ist größer als {MAX_LIBRARY_BYTES} MB.
said.records.94e6ebbb.from: That file is larger than {MAX_LIBRARY_BYTES} MB.

said.records.bd9361ef.text: Das Vernichten einer Aufzeichnung ist unumkehrbar, und eines Tages wird jemand fragen, warum eine Aufzeichnung, die eine Verifizierung wollte, nicht da ist. Geben Sie den Grund an.
said.records.bd9361ef.from: Destroying a record is irreversible, and somebody will one day ask why a record a verifier wanted is not there. Say why.

said.roster-import.0e607b00.from: That workbook has no sheets in it.

said.roster-import.1fd8a7f6.from: That file has nothing in it.

said.roster-import.2f5f5231.text: Für Folgendes wurde keine Spalte gefunden: {missing}. Ohne diese drei kann keine Person angelegt werden. Gefundene Spaltenüberschriften: {Boolean}.
said.roster-import.2f5f5231.from: No column was found for: {missing}. A person cannot be created without those three. The headings found were: {Boolean}.

said.roster-import.c40fdd60.text: Die Spaltenüberschriften wurden aus Zeile {headerIndex} übernommen und nicht aus Zeile 1: Alles darüber sah eher nach einem Titel als nach Überschriften aus.
said.roster-import.c40fdd60.from: The column headings were taken from line {headerIndex}, not line 1: everything above it looked like a title rather than headings.

said.roster-import.d7c8b42b.text: Die Überschriften wurden gelesen, aber darunter gibt es keine Zeilen.
said.roster-import.d7c8b42b.from: The headings were read but there are no rows under them.

said.roster-import.ddc568e6.text: Noch auszufüllende Felder: {open}. Nicht zugeordnete Spaltenüberschriften: {heading}
said.roster-import.ddc568e6.from: Fields still to fill: {open}. Unmatched column headings: {heading}

said.scheduling.0592fd69.text: Eine Sitzung kann nicht um {endTime} enden, wenn sie um {startTime} begonnen hat.
said.scheduling.0592fd69.from: A session cannot end at {endTime} having started at {startTime}.

said.scheduling.0b13beb2.text: Dieses Einführungsdatum kann nicht gelesen werden, daher kann daraus kein Kohortenname gebildet werden.
said.scheduling.0b13beb2.from: That induction date cannot be read, so a cohort name cannot be built from it.

said.scheduling.53f8d453.text: Geben Sie an, warum die Sitzung abgesagt oder verschoben wurde. Ein Plan mit unerklärten Lücken ist genau das, wonach bei einem Überwachungsbesuch gefragt wird.
said.scheduling.53f8d453.from: Say why the session was cancelled or postponed. A schedule with unexplained gaps in it is the thing a monitoring visit asks about.

said.scheduling.7ebc2d06.text: Diese Person ist kein aktuelles Mitglied dieser Kohorte, daher kann sie in deren Anwesenheitsliste nicht erfasst werden.
said.scheduling.7ebc2d06.from: That person is not a current member of this cohort, so they cannot be marked on its register.

said.scheduling.c988355e.text: Diese Sitzung wurde abgesagt, daher gibt es keine Anwesenheitsliste zu führen. Niemand hat eine Veranstaltung versäumt, die nicht stattgefunden hat.
said.scheduling.c988355e.from: This session was cancelled, so there is no register to take. Nobody failed to attend a lecture that did not happen.

said.scorm.02fb5cf8.text: Die Startdatei des Manifests befindet sich nicht im Paket.
said.scorm.02fb5cf8.from: The manifest's starting file is not inside the package.

said.scorm.05c16100.text: Diese Lektion gehört nicht zu einem Kurs, für den Sie eingeschrieben sind.
said.scorm.05c16100.from: This lesson is not on a course you are enrolled on.

said.scorm.20ff1632.text: Die ZIP-Datei konnte nicht geöffnet werden. Sie ist möglicherweise beschädigt; exportieren Sie sie erneut aus dem Autorenwerkzeug.
said.scorm.20ff1632.from: The zip could not be opened. It may be damaged; export it again from the authoring tool.

said.scorm.354841d8.text: Das Paket hat {filesCount} Dateien, mehr als die erlaubten {MAX_FILES}.
said.scorm.354841d8.from: The package has {filesCount} files, more than the {MAX_FILES} allowed.

said.scorm.380a5512.text: Es wird nur der eigene Fortschritt der lernenden Person gespeichert.
said.scorm.380a5512.from: Only the learner's own progress is kept.

said.scorm.39e77a3f.text: Dies ist ein cmi5-Paket. Die Plattform spielt bisher SCORM-1.2-Pakete ab; cmi5 folgt nach SCORM 2004.
said.scorm.39e77a3f.from: This is a cmi5 package. The platform plays SCORM 1.2 packages so far; cmi5 comes after SCORM 2004.

said.scorm.42f68d85.text: Die ZIP-Datei enthält „{name}“, einen Pfad, der das Paket verlassen würde.
said.scorm.42f68d85.from: The zip holds "{name}", a path that would leave the package.

said.scorm.4de81b55.from: This lesson has no SCORM package.

said.scorm.63cfd3fc.text: Das Manifest nennt keine Datei, mit der das Paket gestartet werden könnte.
said.scorm.63cfd3fc.from: The manifest names no file to start the package from.

said.scorm.858c848d.text: Das Manifest gibt „{version}“ an, und das ist nicht SCORM 1.2.
said.scorm.858c848d.from: The manifest says it is "{version}", which is not SCORM 1.2.

said.scorm.90319b91.text: Das Paket entpackt sich auf mehr als ein Gigabyte, mehr als ein Kurs braucht.
said.scorm.90319b91.from: The package unpacks to more than a gigabyte, which is more than a course needs.

said.scorm.d03f6670.text: Dies ist ein SCORM-2004-Paket. Die Plattform spielt bisher SCORM-1.2-Pakete ab; 2004 folgt als Nächstes. Die meisten Autorenwerkzeuge können stattdessen als SCORM 1.2 veröffentlichen.
said.scorm.d03f6670.from: This is a SCORM 2004 package. The platform plays SCORM 1.2 packages so far; 2004 is next. Most authoring tools can publish as SCORM 1.2 instead.

said.scorm.d37e77ff.text: Das Manifest startet das Paket bei „{launchFile}“, und das befindet sich nicht in der ZIP-Datei.
said.scorm.d37e77ff.from: The manifest starts the package at "{launchFile}", which is not in the zip.

said.settings-drive-actions.b27a46f5.text: Das ist kein Laufwerk, das die Plattform kennt.
said.settings-drive-actions.b27a46f5.from: That is not a drive the platform knows.

said.settings-language-actions.ecc301e2.text: Nur eine Anbieter-Administration darf dies ändern.
said.settings-language-actions.ecc301e2.from: Only a provider administrator may change this.

said.settings-language-actions.f103b372.text: Gespeichert. Personen, die ihre eigene Sprache nicht gewählt haben, sehen nun diese.
said.settings-language-actions.f103b372.from: Saved. People who have not chosen their own language now see this one.

said.settings-mail-actions.77394510.text: Ihre Rolle umfasst nicht das Testen des Mailservers.
said.settings-mail-actions.77394510.from: Your role does not include testing the mail server.

said.settings-mail-actions.79f94bc8.text: Für diese Bereitstellung ist kein Mailserver eingerichtet, daher kann noch nichts gesendet werden.
said.settings-mail-actions.79f94bc8.from: No mail server is set up on this deployment, so nothing can be sent yet.

said.settings-mail-actions.cb649383.text: Der Mailserver hat die Verbindung akzeptiert. Lernenden können ihre Anmeldedaten und Benachrichtigungen gesendet werden.
said.settings-mail-actions.cb649383.from: The mail server accepted the connection. Learners can be sent their sign-in details and notifications.

said.settings-mail-actions.cf3cfef0.text: Die Person, die die Plattform betreut, muss MAIL_HOST und MAIL_FROM festlegen.
said.settings-mail-actions.cf3cfef0.from: Whoever maintains the platform needs to set MAIL_HOST and MAIL_FROM.

said.settings-mail-actions.f1ac9e08.text: Der Mailserver war gerade nicht erreichbar. Das kann vorübergehend sein; versuchen Sie es in Kürze erneut.
said.settings-mail-actions.f1ac9e08.from: The mail server could not be reached just now. This may be temporary; try again shortly.

said.settings-mail-actions.fc597e55.text: Der Mailserver hat die Verbindung abgelehnt, daher kann nichts gesendet werden.
said.settings-mail-actions.fc597e55.from: The mail server refused the connection, so nothing can be sent.

said.settings-menu-actions.0005a392.text: Nur eine Administration kann das Menü neu anordnen, weil es für alle bei diesem Anbieter dasselbe Menü ist.
said.settings-menu-actions.0005a392.from: Only an administrator can rearrange the menu, because it is the same menu for everybody at this provider.

said.settings-menu-actions.c175275c.text: Gespeichert. Alle bei diesem Anbieter sehen diese Anordnung.
said.settings-menu-actions.c175275c.from: Saved. Everybody at this provider sees this arrangement.

said.settings-menu-actions.c38853b5.text: Diese Anordnung konnte nicht gelesen werden. Es wurde nichts geändert.
said.settings-menu-actions.c38853b5.from: That arrangement could not be read. Nothing changed.

said.settings-menu-actions.ffff057d.text: Dadurch wäre jede Überschrift leer, also ein Menü ohne Inhalt. Es wurde nichts geändert.
said.settings-menu-actions.ffff057d.from: That would leave every heading empty, which is a menu with nothing in it. Nothing changed.

said.settings-module-codes-actions.d585f.text: Diese Tabelle konnte nicht gelesen werden. Öffnen Sie sie erneut und versuchen Sie es noch einmal.
said.settings-module-codes-actions.d585f.from: That table could not be read. Reopen it and try again.

said.settings-sso-actions.4bbd36a4.text: Ausgeschaltet, und sein Geheimnis wurde vergessen.
said.settings-sso-actions.4bbd36a4.from: Switched off, and its secret forgotten.

said.settings-sso-actions.52db415d.text: Gespeichert. Melden Sie sich ab und probieren Sie es auf der Anmeldeseite aus.
said.settings-sso-actions.52db415d.from: Saved. Sign out and try it from the sign-in page.

said.settings-sso-actions.56bfaa85.text: Nur eine Anbieter-Administration darf ändern, wie sich Personen anmelden.
said.settings-sso-actions.56bfaa85.from: Only a provider administrator may change how people sign in.

said.settings-template-actions.0690b0fe.text: Als Version {version} gespeichert, als Entwurf. Sie ist erst in Gebrauch, wenn Sie sie in Gebrauch nehmen.
said.settings-template-actions.0690b0fe.from: Saved as version {version}, as a draft. It is not in use until you put it in use.

said.settings-template-actions.9cc3fe2a.text: Als Version {version} gespeichert und nun in Gebrauch. Dokumente dieser Art werden ab jetzt daraus erzeugt; bereits ausgestellte behalten die Version, aus der sie erzeugt wurden.
said.settings-template-actions.9cc3fe2a.from: Saved as version {version}, and now in use. Documents of this kind are produced from it from now on; ones already issued keep the version that produced them.

said.settings-template-actions.a1bce5df.text: Für dieses Dokument war keine Vorlage in Gebrauch.
said.settings-template-actions.a1bce5df.from: There was no template in use for that document.

said.settings-template-actions.a1ec16e6.text: Zurück zum plattformeigenen Layout. Ihre Vorlage bleibt erhalten und wird nicht gelöscht, sodass Sie sie wieder in Gebrauch nehmen können.
said.settings-template-actions.a1ec16e6.from: Back to the platform's own layout. Your template is kept, not deleted, so you can put it back.

said.settings-template-actions.a53f381a.text: Das ist kein Dokument, das die Plattform erzeugt.
said.settings-template-actions.a53f381a.from: That is not a document the platform produces.

said.settings-terminology-actions.22580f.text: Gespeichert. Alle bei diesem Anbieter sehen diese Formulierung.
said.settings-terminology-actions.22580f.from: Saved. Everybody at this provider sees this wording.

said.settings-terminology-actions.8e2222.text: Nichts weicht von der Standardformulierung ab, daher gelten wieder die Vorgaben.
said.settings-terminology-actions.8e2222.from: Nothing differs from the standard wording, so the defaults are back.

said.settings-terminology-actions.98e913.text: Geben Sie sowohl den Singular als auch den Plural für {one} an, oder lassen Sie beide leer, um die Vorgabe zu behalten.
said.settings-terminology-actions.98e913.from: Give both the singular and the plural for {one}, or leave both empty to keep the default.

said.settings-terminology-actions.bf53eb.text: Halten Sie jedes Wort unter 40 Zeichen.

said.settings-terminology-actions.c225e9.text: „{word}“ ist von einer Regulierungsbehörde definiert und kann daher nicht für etwas anderes verwendet werden. Ein eigenes Wort so umzubenennen, würde eine Behauptung auf den Bildschirm der lernenden Person setzen, die die Aufzeichnung nicht stützt.
said.settings-terminology-actions.c225e9.from: "{word}" is defined by a regulator, so it cannot be used for something else. Renaming one of your own words to it would put a claim on a learner's screen that the record does not support.

said.settings-terminology-actions.c27704.text: Nur eine Administration kann ändern, wie Dinge heißen, weil es für alle bei diesem Anbieter dieselbe Formulierung ist.
said.settings-terminology-actions.c27704.from: Only an administrator can change what things are called, because it is the same wording for everybody at this provider.

said.settings.2e2de6f5.text: Gespeichert. Uploads werden ab jetzt auf diese Weise gelesen.
said.settings.2e2de6f5.from: Saved. Uploads from now on are read this way.

said.settings.5946b233.text: Gespeichert. Sie ist verfügbar, aber nicht eingeschaltet. Verwenden Sie den KI-Schalter oben auf jeder Seite, wenn Sie sie für einen Auftrag möchten.
said.settings.5946b233.from: Saved. It is available but not switched on. Use the AI switch at the top of any page when you want it for a job.

said.settings.68c5f414.text: Token verworfen. Nichts davon wird aufbewahrt.
said.settings.68c5f414.from: Token discarded. Nothing of it is kept.

said.settings.7a6e099f.text: Der Anbieter konnte nicht nach seinen Modellen gefragt werden.
said.settings.7a6e099f.from: The provider could not be asked for its models.

said.settings.84b6dbd9.from: Your role does not include model assistance.

said.settings.c0e1fe87.text: Gespeichert. Terminierte Zeiten beziehen sich nun auf diese Uhr.
said.settings.c0e1fe87.from: Saved. Timetabled times now mean this clock.

said.settings.f7c1c376.text: Gespeichert. Alle sehen es ab ihrer nächsten Seite.
said.settings.f7c1c376.from: Saved. Everyone sees it from their next page.

said.settings.fdc694bf.text: Ihre Rolle umfasst keine Modellunterstützung. Sie liegt bei den eigenen Mitarbeitenden des Anbieters und nicht bei Lernenden oder einem Coach am Arbeitsplatz eines Arbeitgebers.
said.settings.fdc694bf.from: Your role does not include model assistance. It is held by the provider's own staff rather than by learners or by an employer's workplace coach.

said.single-sign-on.052b3446.text: Die Anmeldung hat keine Identität zurückgeliefert.
said.single-sign-on.052b3446.from: The sign-in did not come back with an identity.

said.single-sign-on.07757676.text: Die Anmeldung hat eine Identität zurückgeliefert, die nicht gelesen werden konnte.
said.single-sign-on.07757676.from: The sign-in came back with an identity that could not be read.

said.single-sign-on.180daa0a.text: Die Anmeldung mit {kind} ist hier nicht eingeschaltet.
said.single-sign-on.180daa0a.from: Signing in with {kind} is not switched on here.

said.single-sign-on.2760f640.text: Microsoft benötigt die Verzeichnis-ID (Mandant) Ihrer Organisation, einen Code wie 72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47, von der Übersichtsseite der App in Microsoft Entra.
said.single-sign-on.2760f640.from: Microsoft needs your organisation's directory (tenant) ID, a code like 72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47, from the app's Overview page in Microsoft Entra.

said.single-sign-on.27f12034.text: Mit diesem Konto ist hier keine Anmeldung möglich.
said.single-sign-on.27f12034.from: That account cannot sign in here.

said.single-sign-on.52f76de5.text: Das Client-Geheimnis wird für die Verbindung benötigt.
said.single-sign-on.52f76de5.from: The client secret is needed to connect.

said.single-sign-on.90b663ad.text: Google hat die Adresse nicht verifiziert
said.single-sign-on.90b663ad.from: Google has not verified the address

said.single-sign-on.af8cc19b.text: Diese Plattform hat keinen Schlüssel zum Versiegeln von Geheimnissen, daher kann sie das Client-Geheimnis nicht aufbewahren.
said.single-sign-on.af8cc19b.from: This platform has no key to seal secrets with, so it cannot keep the client secret.

said.single-sign-on.b83f2863.text: Diese Anmeldung wurde nicht von dieser Seite aus gestartet. Versuchen Sie es erneut.
said.single-sign-on.b83f2863.from: That sign-in was not started from this page. Try again.

said.south-african-id.2a092f1a.from: An identity number is exactly 13 digits.

said.south-african-id.46e0f0e5.text: Der Monat im Geburtsdatum ist nicht gültig.
said.south-african-id.46e0f0e5.from: The month in the date of birth is not valid.

said.south-african-id.738d1584.text: Das Geburtsdatum ist kein reales Datum.
said.south-african-id.738d1584.from: The date of birth is not a real date.

said.south-african-id.95e7bd33.from: No valid Luhn check digit exists.

said.south-african-id.e46ae644.text: Die Ziffer für die Staatsangehörigkeit muss 0 oder 1 sein.
said.south-african-id.e46ae644.from: The citizenship digit must be 0 or 1.

said.south-african-id.f2f17cbd.text: Die Prüfziffer stimmt nicht überein; die Nummer wurde wahrscheinlich falsch eingegeben.
said.south-african-id.f2f17cbd.from: The check digit does not match; the number was likely mistyped.

said.spine-editor.2a5955ae.text: Veröffentlicht, aber keine seiner Prüfungsarbeiten ist es. Eine lernende Person fände nichts zu beantworten.
said.spine-editor.2a5955ae.from: Published, but none of its papers are. A learner would find nothing to answer.

said.spine-editor.c209d3d2.text: Dies ist noch ein Entwurf. Es kann jetzt auf den Lernweg gesetzt werden, und einer lernenden Person wird es erst angeboten, wenn es veröffentlicht ist.
said.spine-editor.c209d3d2.from: This is still a draft. It can go on the spine now, and a learner will not be offered it until it is published.

said.spine.09e0bbde.text: Ein Schritt vom Typ {kind} muss angeben, worauf ({kind2}) er verweist.
said.spine.09e0bbde.from: A {kind} step has to name the {kind2} it points at.

said.spine.0b4713d6.text: „{title}“ ist formativ und erzeugt daher nie eine Kompetenzentscheidung, sodass eine Sperre, die auf eine wartet, nie geöffnet würde. Warten Sie stattdessen auf die Abgabe oder die Bewertung.
said.spine.0b4713d6.from: "{title}" is formative, so it never produces a competence decision, so a gate waiting for one would never open. Wait for it to be handed in or marked instead.

said.spine.129de092.text: Geben Sie an, warum diese lernende Person durchgelassen wird. Es wird in ihrer Akte und im Moderationspaket angezeigt.
said.spine.129de092.from: Say why this learner is being let past. It is shown on their record and in the moderation pack.

said.spine.42a3be59.text: Ein Schritt kann nicht auf sich selbst warten.
said.spine.42a3be59.from: A step cannot wait for itself.

said.spine.7287fb1d.text: Eine Lektion oder ein Dokument wird nicht beurteilt und kann daher nicht als kompetent befunden werden. Warten Sie stattdessen darauf, dass es geöffnet wird.
said.spine.7287fb1d.from: A lesson or a document is not assessed, so it cannot be judged competent. Wait for it to be opened instead.

said.spine.81239e1c.text: Nur ein Praxiserfahrungsmodul wird abgezeichnet. Wählen Sie eine andere Regel.
said.spine.81239e1c.from: Only a work experience module is signed off. Pick another rule.

said.spine.83528293.text: Ein Schritt kann nur auf einen anderen Schritt im selben Kurs warten.
said.spine.83528293.from: A step can only wait for another step on the same course.

said.spine.91ceb611.text: Die neue Reihenfolge muss jeden Schritt des Kurses genau einmal aufführen.
said.spine.91ceb611.from: The new order has to list every step of the course exactly once.

said.spine.ca9b3b5c.text: Dadurch würden zwei Schritte aufeinander warten, und keiner würde je geöffnet.
said.spine.ca9b3b5c.from: That would make two steps wait for each other, and neither would ever open.

said.spine.d5e61b5f.text: Dieses Dokument wird vor Lernenden zurückgehalten und kann daher kein Schritt auf ihrem Lernweg sein. Eine summative Prüfungsarbeit erreicht sie stattdessen als erfasstes Assessment.
said.spine.d5e61b5f.from: That document is kept from learners, so it cannot be a step on their path. A summative paper reaches them as a captured assessment instead.

said.spine.fc076d64.text: Dieses Dokument ist für Mitarbeitende und nicht zum Durcharbeiten durch Lernende verfasst und kann daher kein Schritt auf ihrem Lernweg sein.
said.spine.fc076d64.from: That document is written for staff rather than for learners to work through, so it cannot be a step on their path.

said.statement-of-results.09720fce.text: Für diese Bescheinigung sind keine Module im Geltungsbereich, daher gibt es nichts, was sie bestätigen könnte.
said.statement-of-results.09720fce.from: There are no modules in scope for this statement, so there is nothing for it to confirm.

said.statement-of-results.3b26ff7f.text: Geben Sie einen Grund an. Er wird jeder Person angezeigt, die die Referenz prüft.
said.statement-of-results.3b26ff7f.from: Give a reason. It is shown to anybody who checks the reference.

said.statement-of-results.57e1914e.text: Diese lernende Person besitzt bereits eine Ergebnisbescheinigung für {code}. Ziehen Sie sie zurück, bevor Sie eine weitere ausstellen, damit nie zwei Dokumente mit derselben Aussage im Umlauf sind.
said.statement-of-results.57e1914e.from: This learner already holds a Statement of Results for {code}. Withdraw it before issuing another, so two documents making the same claim are never in circulation.

said.statement-of-results.ab61210b.text: Das Curriculum ist nicht vollständig erfasst: {uncaptured} enthalten nichts, was zu erreichen wäre. Eine jetzt ausgestellte Bescheinigung würde das Erreichen von Modulen bestätigen, die niemand übertragen hat.
said.statement-of-results.ab61210b.from: The curriculum is not fully captured: {uncaptured} carry nothing to achieve. A statement issued now would confirm achievement of modules nobody has transcribed.

said.statement-of-results.b5359f01.text: Diese lernende Person besitzt bereits eine Ergebnisbescheinigung für diese Qualifikation. Ziehen Sie sie zurück, bevor Sie eine weitere ausstellen, damit nie zwei Dokumente mit derselben Aussage im Umlauf sind.
said.statement-of-results.b5359f01.from: This learner already holds a Statement of Results for this qualification. Withdraw it before issuing another, so two documents making the same claim are never in circulation.

said.statements-id.5fd85b7c.text: Ihre Rolle umfasst nicht das Zurückziehen einer Ergebnisbescheinigung.
said.statements-id.5fd85b7c.from: Your role does not include withdrawing a Statement of Results.

said.statements-id.f9ea555b.text: Zurückgezogen. Die Referenz funktioniert weiterhin und weist darauf hin.
said.statements-id.f9ea555b.from: Withdrawn. The reference still resolves, and says so.

said.statutory-export-file.10c070ac.text: Diese Meldung hat Probleme, die behoben werden müssen, bevor die Dateien erzeugt werden können. Siehe die Seite zur gesetzlichen Berichterstattung.
said.statutory-export-file.10c070ac.from: This return has problems that must be fixed before the files can be produced. See the statutory reporting page.

said.statutory-notification.0931542b.text: Diese lernende Person gehört nicht zur Kohorte.
said.statutory-notification.0931542b.from: That learner is not in the cohort.

said.statutory-notification.0a104506.text: Bei jedem Eintrag einer lernenden Person erforderlich.

said.statutory-notification.1e928484.text: Erforderlich, und es steckt in der Ausweisnummer.
said.statutory-notification.1e928484.from: Required, and it is inside the identity number.

said.statutory-notification.5c135418.text: Die lernende Person hat dem Einschreibungsformular nicht zugestimmt.
said.statutory-notification.5c135418.from: The learner has not agreed on the enrolment form.

said.statutory-notification.69c68cc0.text: Die eigene Akkreditierungsnummer des Anbieters, aus den Einstellungen des Mandanten.
said.statutory-notification.69c68cc0.from: The provider's own accreditation number, from the tenant's settings.

said.statutory-notification.6a2cb727.text: Erforderlich, und muss zur Ausweisnummer passen.
said.statutory-notification.6a2cb727.from: Required, and must match the identity number.

said.statutory-notification.83725bbd.text: Die SAQA-Kennung dessen, wofür die lernende Person eingeschrieben ist.
said.statutory-notification.83725bbd.from: The SAQA identifier of what the learner is enrolled on.

said.statutory-notification.9cf40e0d.text: Die Provinz, in der die lernende Person arbeitet.
said.statutory-notification.9cf40e0d.from: The province the learner works in.

said.statutory-notification.a5a405af.text: Eine Bestätigung benötigt die vom QCTO ausgestellte Referenz.
said.statutory-notification.a5a405af.from: An acknowledgement needs the reference the QCTO issued.

said.statutory-notification.bbfb1dec.text: Es ist eine Behinderung erfasst, daher verlangt das QCTO die Angabe, wie stark sie beeinträchtigt.
said.statutory-notification.bbfb1dec.from: A disability is recorded, so the QCTO requires how much difficulty it causes.

said.statutory-notification.ce4a70ee.text: Aus dem Einschreibungsformular der lernenden Person.

said.statutory-notify.77d191e5.text: Entwurf erstellt, für {learnerIdsCount} Lernende. Laden Sie die Arbeitsmappe herunter, prüfen Sie sie und erfassen Sie dann, dass sie versendet wurde.
said.statutory-notify.77d191e5.from: Drafted, covering {learnerIdsCount} learners. Download the workbook, check it, then record that it went.

said.statutory-notify.7e3fae5a.text: Zurück zum eigenen Einführungsdatum der Kohorte.
said.statutory-notify.7e3fae5a.from: Back to the cohort's own induction date.

said.statutory-notify.8cc067d9.text: Entwurf erstellt, für {learnerIdsCount} lernende Person. Laden Sie die Arbeitsmappe herunter, prüfen Sie sie und erfassen Sie dann, dass sie versendet wurde.
said.statutory-notify.8cc067d9.from: Drafted, covering {learnerIdsCount} learner. Download the workbook, check it, then record that it went.

said.statutory-notify.90d2c47a.text: Wählen Sie mindestens eine lernende Person, für die gemeldet wird.
said.statutory-notify.90d2c47a.from: Choose at least one learner to notify about.

said.statutory-notify.e80fd17b.text: Als gesendet erfasst. Fügen Sie die Bestätigung hinzu, sobald sie zurückkommt.
said.statutory-notify.e80fd17b.from: Recorded as sent. Add the acknowledgement when it comes back.

said.statutory-notify.fbbcde8b.text: Ihr eigenes Einführungsdatum ist erfasst, und ihre Frist läuft nun ab diesem.
said.statutory-notify.fbbcde8b.from: Their own induction date is recorded, and their deadline now runs from it.

said.statutory.36c11667.text: Die lernende Person wurde nach Ablauf des Registrierungszeitraums der Qualifikation eingeschrieben.
said.statutory.36c11667.from: The learner was enrolled after the qualification's registration period closed.

said.statutory.5a5791f9.text: Für den Assessor ist keine Registrierungsnummer erfasst. Das NLRD verifiziert die Registrierung des Assessors anhand des Abschlusses.
said.statutory.5a5791f9.from: The assessor has no registration number recorded. The NLRD verifies assessor registration against the achievement.

said.statutory.937d409a.text: Kein Code des Gemeindebezirks erfasst. Der Anbietereintrag wird bis auf die Ebene des Bezirks validiert.
said.statutory.937d409a.from: No municipal ward code recorded. The Provider Record is validated down to ward level.

said.statutory.a57124be.text: Für das Curriculummodul ist kein Credit-Wert erfasst.
said.statutory.a57124be.from: The curriculum module has no credit value recorded.

said.statutory.aafb40c2.text: Die Akkreditierungsnummer des Anbieters fehlt. Jeder Eintrag der Meldung wird unter ihr abgelegt.
said.statutory.aafb40c2.from: The provider accreditation number is missing. Every record in the return is filed against it.

said.statutory.cc126904.text: Für den Moderator ist keine Registrierungsnummer erfasst.
said.statutory.cc126904.from: The moderator has no registration number recorded.

said.statutory.e08f5796.text: Kein Equity-Code erfasst; das NLRD markiert fehlende Equity-Daten.
said.statutory.e08f5796.from: No equity code recorded; the NLRD flags missing equity data.

said.statutory.ef816888.text: Die Qualifikation hat keine SAQA-ID, daher kann die Einschreibung nicht dagegen abgelegt werden.
said.statutory.ef816888.from: The qualification has no SAQA ID, so the enrolment cannot be filed against it.

said.storage-s3.01b74469.text: STORAGE_DRIVER ist „s3“, aber {missing} sind nicht gesetzt. Nachweise können nicht gespeichert werden, bis sie gesetzt sind.
said.storage-s3.01b74469.from: STORAGE_DRIVER is "s3" but {missing} are not set. Evidence cannot be stored until they are.

said.storage-s3.81a56f3f.text: Der Objektspeicher hat die Anfrage abgelehnt ({status})

said.storage-s3.9eb93c83.from: Object storage could not be reached: {message}

said.study-unit-alignment.dfcd9590.text: Das Dokument nennt {wantedCount} Module ({wanted}), und diese Qualifikation hat noch kein Curriculum. Importieren Sie zuerst das Curriculum; die Lerneinheiten und ihre Ergebnisse werden in jedem Fall erfasst, und ein erneutes Hochladen dieses Dokuments danach verknüpft sie.
said.study-unit-alignment.dfcd9590.from: The document names {wantedCount} modules ({wanted}) and this qualification has no curriculum yet. Import the curriculum first; the study units and their outcomes are recorded either way, and uploading this document again afterwards will link them.

said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.text: Keines der {wantedCount} in diesem Dokument genannten Module konnte zugeordnet werden, daher wurde nichts unter einer Lerneinheit eingeordnet. Das Dokument nennt {wanted}. Dieses Curriculum enthält {held}. Beim Abgleich werden Leerzeichen und Bindestriche ignoriert, daher unterscheiden sich die beiden Schemata tatsächlich. Korrigieren Sie die Codes auf einer der beiden Seiten und laden Sie das Dokument erneut hoch.
said.study-unit-alignment.e874eba3.from: None of the {wantedCount} modules this document names could be matched, so nothing has been placed under a study unit. The document names {wanted}. This curriculum holds {held}. Matching ignores spaces and hyphens, so the two schemes genuinely differ. Correct the codes on either side and upload the document again.

said.support.2b757921.text: Auf ein zweites Versäumnis folgt ein mündliches Assessment nur aus medizinischen Gründen. Ohne einen solchen ist das Ergebnis ein Verfall, gegen den die lernende Person weiterhin Einspruch erheben kann.
said.support.2b757921.from: An oral assessment follows a second miss only on medical grounds. Without one the outcome is a forfeit, which the learner can still appeal.

said.support.32314e12.text: Die lernende Person muss der Erfassung zustimmen, bevor sie erfolgen kann. Gesundheit, Behinderung und finanzielle Verhältnisse sind besondere personenbezogene Informationen, und die Zustimmung zur Einschreibung war keine Zustimmung dazu.
said.support.32314e12.from: The learner has to agree to this being recorded before it can be. Health, disability and financial circumstances are special personal information, and agreeing to enrol was not agreeing to this.

said.support.3e521f24.text: Geben Sie an, warum die Unterstützung endet. Eine lernende Person, deren Anpassung ohne Grund endet, hat keine Möglichkeit, sie zurückzufordern.
said.support.3e521f24.from: Say why the support is ending. A learner whose accommodation stops without a reason has no way to ask for it back.

said.support.6396d34b.text: Für dieses Assessment wurde bereits ein zusätzlicher Termin festgelegt: {additionalDate}, nach einem Versäumnis am {missedOn}. Das Verfahren erlaubt einen. Wurde auch dieser Termin versäumt, erfassen Sie, was damit geschehen ist, statt einen weiteren festzulegen.
said.support.6396d34b.from: An additional date was already set for this assessment: {additionalDate}, after a miss on {missedOn}. The procedure allows one. If that date was also missed, record what happened to it rather than setting another.

said.support.6af4db9d.text: Wenn die Anpassung nicht wirkt, sagen Sie, was sich ändert. Eine Überprüfung, die ein Scheitern festhält und nichts anpasst, wirkt sorgfältig und ist das Gegenteil.
said.support.6af4db9d.from: If the accommodation is not working, say what is changing. A review that records a failure and adjusts nothing reads as diligence and is the opposite.

said.support.7af7d42b.text: Der zusätzliche Termin muss nach dem versäumten liegen.
said.support.7af7d42b.from: The additional date has to be after the one that was missed.

said.support.8452172c.text: Sagen Sie, was Sie festgestellt haben. Eine Überprüfung ohne Feststellung ist nur ein Datum in einer Akte.
said.support.8452172c.from: Say what you found. A review with no finding is a date in a file.

said.support.e34f2e55.text: Sagen Sie, was tatsächlich getan wird. Ein Bedarf ohne Anpassung ändert für die lernende Person nichts.
said.support.e34f2e55.from: Say what will actually be done. A need with no accommodation against it changes nothing for the learner.

said.support.f4565c1a.text: Sagen Sie, was der medizinische Grund war. Ein mündliches Assessment, das auf einem nicht erfassten Grund beruht, ist die Ablegung, nach der eine externe Verifizierung fragt.
said.support.f4565c1a.from: Say what the medical ground was. An oral assessment authorised on an unrecorded reason is the sitting an external verifier asks about.

shell.account.text: A sua conta: palavra-passe e idioma

login.intro.text: Inicie sessão para continuar a sua aprendizagem.
login.intro.from: Sign in to continue your learning.

login.trouble.text: Problemas ao iniciar sessão? Contacte o seu facilitador: pode repor a palavra-passe por si.
login.trouble.from: Trouble signing in? Speak to your facilitator: they can reset a password for you.

login.locked.text: Demasiadas tentativas. Aguarde quinze minutos e tente novamente.
login.locked.from: Too many attempts. Wait fifteen minutes and try again.

login.missing.text: Introduza o endereço de correio eletrónico e a palavra-passe.
login.missing.from: Enter your email address and password.

login.sso.refused.text: Essa conta não pode iniciar sessão aqui. Tem de usar o mesmo endereço de correio eletrónico da conta nesta plataforma. Inicie sessão com a palavra-passe ou contacte o administrador.
login.sso.refused.from: That account cannot sign in here. It has to use the same email address as your account on this platform. Sign in with your password, or ask your administrator.

login.sso.cancelled.text: O início de sessão foi cancelado.

login.sso.expired.text: Esse início de sessão demorou demasiado ou foi iniciado noutro local. Tente novamente.
login.sso.expired.from: That sign-in took too long, or was started somewhere else. Try again.

login.sso.off.text: Essa forma de iniciar sessão não está ativada aqui.
login.sso.off.from: That way of signing in is not switched on here.

account.forcedIntro.text: Outra pessoa definiu a palavra-passe com que iniciou sessão. Substitua-a antes de continuar.
account.forcedIntro.from: Somebody else set the password you signed in with. Replace it before carrying on.

account.currentGiven.text: A palavra-passe que lhe foi atribuída

account.newHint.text: Pelo menos 12 caracteres. Uma frase com algumas palavras sem relação entre si é mais segura e mais fácil de memorizar do que algo curto com símbolos.
account.newHint.from: At least 12 characters. A phrase of a few unrelated words is both stronger and easier to remember than something short with symbols in it.

account.mismatch.text: As duas novas palavras-passe não coincidem.
account.mismatch.from: The two new passwords do not match.

account.forcedNote.text: Ao alterá-la, termina a sessão de qualquer outra pessoa que use a palavra-passe antiga, incluindo quem lha transmitiu.
account.forcedNote.from: Changing it signs out anyone else using the old password, including whoever passed it to you.

account.languageIntro.text: O idioma em que esta plataforma se dirige a si. Os ecrãs ainda não traduzidos permanecem em inglês e os nomes que a sua entidade formadora dá às coisas mantêm-se tal como os escreveu.
account.languageIntro.from: The language this platform speaks to you in. Screens not yet translated stay in English, and your provider's own names for things are kept as they wrote them.

learn.notYours.text: Está a ver a inscrição de outra pessoa. Pode ver o progresso, mas não o pode registar por ela.
learn.notYours.from: You are viewing someone else's enrolment. You can see their progress but cannot record it for them.

learn.noLessons.text: Este curso ainda não tem lições.
learn.noLessons.from: This course has no lessons yet.

learn.openMaterial.from: Open the material for this lesson

learn.noContent.text: Sem conteúdo escrito para esta lição.
learn.noContent.from: No written content for this lesson.

learn.scormNote.text: Esta lição fica concluída quando a terminar no pacote acima. O ponto em que ficou é guardado se parar a meio.
learn.scormNote.from: This lesson completes when you finish it in the package above. Your place is kept if you stop part of the way through.

learn.openedByFacilitator.text: Aberto para si pelo seu facilitador: {reason}
learn.openedByFacilitator.from: Opened for you by your facilitator: {reason}

home.feedbackMany.from: A few things to tell us

home.feedbackIntro.text: As respostas são comunicadas em conjunto com as de todos os outros, e não uma a uma. Demoram dois minutos cada e são a única coisa que altera a forma como a próxima turma é conduzida.
home.feedbackIntro.from: Answers are reported together with everybody else's, not one by one. Two minutes each, and it is the only thing that changes how the next cohort is run.

home.earnedIntro.text: Registado no dia em que terminou, e não quando o certificado acaba por chegar. Cada um tem uma referência que qualquer pessoa pode verificar.
home.earnedIntro.from: Recorded on the day you finished, rather than when the certificate eventually arrives. Each carries a reference anybody can check.

home.step.afterPrevious.text: Abre quando concluir o passo anterior
home.step.afterPrevious.from: Opens when you finish the step before

home.nothingYet.text: Ainda não lhe foi atribuído nada.
home.nothingYet.from: You have not been assigned anything yet.

home.statementsIntro.text: Leve este documento à avaliação externa, juntamente com o seu documento de identificação. O centro verifica-o antes de poder realizar a prova.
home.statementsIntro.from: Take this to the external assessment with your identity document. The centre checks it before you may sit.

assess.waiting.text: À espera de revisão por um avaliador.
assess.waiting.from: Waiting for an assessor to review it.

assess.developmental.text: Esta avaliação é de desenvolvimento. Nada aqui conta contra si.
assess.developmental.from: This is developmental. Nothing here counts against you.

assess.competent.text: Foi considerado competente nesta avaliação, pelo que não é necessário repeti-la.
assess.competent.from: You have been found competent on this assessment, so there is nothing to sit again.

assess.noAttempts.text: Esgotou todas as tentativas nesta avaliação.
assess.noAttempts.from: You have used all your attempts at this assessment.

assess.awaitingAssessor.text: Esta avaliação conta para a sua qualificação, pelo que um avaliador irá revê-la e registar a decisão de competência. Verá o resultado quando isso estiver concluído.
assess.awaitingAssessor.from: This assessment counts towards your qualification, so an assessor will review it and record the competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

assess.practicePassed.text: Isto foi prática, pelo que o resultado fica registado na sua aprendizagem, mas não decide uma qualificação.
assess.practicePassed.from: This was practice, so the result is recorded against your learning but does not decide a qualification.

assess.practiceFailed.text: Isto foi prática. Reveja o material e tente novamente.
assess.practiceFailed.from: This was practice. Review the material and try again.

assess.pair.text: Associe cada item da esquerda a um da direita.
assess.pair.from: Pair each item on the left with one on the right.

assess.whyMarked.text: O que é classificado aqui é a justificação, e não a caixa acima.
assess.whyMarked.from: The reason is what is marked here, not the box above.

assess.keptAt.text: As suas respostas foram guardadas às {time}. Só ao submeter é que são enviadas para classificação.
assess.keptAt.from: Your answers were kept at {time}. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

assess.kept.text: As suas respostas são guardadas enquanto trabalha. Só ao submeter é que são enviadas para classificação.
assess.kept.from: Your answers are kept as you work. Submitting is what sends them to be marked.

evidence.uploadFailed.text: O carregamento falhou. Verifique a ligação e tente novamente.
evidence.uploadFailed.from: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.

evidence.doneIntro.text: Um avaliador irá revê-las e registar uma decisão de competência. Verá o resultado quando isso estiver concluído.
evidence.doneIntro.from: An assessor will review it and record a competency decision. You will see the result once that is done.

evidence.fingerprinted.text: Cada ficheiro foi identificado por uma impressão digital:

evidence.fingerprintNote.text: Se algum ficheiro guardado fosse alguma vez alterado, a sua impressão digital deixaria de corresponder. Isso protege tanto o seu trabalho como a avaliação.
evidence.fingerprintNote.from: If any stored file were ever altered, its fingerprint would stop matching. That protects your work as much as it protects the assessment.

evidence.kinds.text: Fotografias, uma gravação da tarefa, um livro de registo digitalizado ou um documento. Pode anexar vários de uma só vez.
evidence.kinds.from: Photographs, a recording of the task, a scanned logbook, or a document. You can attach several at once.

evidence.note.text: Algo que o avaliador deva saber

paper.summative.text: Esta prova é avaliada e conta para a sua qualificação.
paper.summative.from: This is assessed and counts towards your qualification.

paper.formative.text: Isto é preparação. É classificado e devolvido, e não decide nada.
paper.formative.from: This is preparation. It is marked and returned to you, and it does not decide anything.

paper.goBack.text: Volte ao curso para ver o que ainda está por fazer.
paper.goBack.from: Go back to the course to see what is still outstanding.

paper.connection.text: Essa resposta não foi guardada. A ligação pode ter falhado; será tentado novamente na próxima alteração.
paper.connection.from: That answer did not save. Your connection may have dropped; it will be tried again when you next change something.

paper.handInFailed.from: That could not be handed in.

paper.handInConnection.text: Não foi possível entregar. Verifique a ligação e tente novamente.
paper.handInConnection.from: That could not be handed in. Check your connection and try again.

paper.detail.text: Responda com detalhe, referindo os princípios que estudou.
paper.detail.from: Answer in detail, referring to the principles you have studied.

paper.handedIn.text: Entregou este trabalho. Não pode ser alterado.
paper.handedIn.from: You handed this in. It cannot be changed.

paper.final.text: Depois de entregue, não pode ser alterado.
paper.final.from: Once handed in, this cannot be changed.

paper.confirm.from: Confirm the declaration to hand in.

paper.savedAsYouGo.text: o seu trabalho é guardado à medida que avança
paper.savedAsYouGo.from: your work is saved as you go

notify.nothingYet.text: Ainda nada. Aqui será avisado quando for atribuída ou estiver a terminar uma formação, quando houver trabalho à sua espera e quando chegar um resultado de avaliação ou um certificado.
notify.nothingYet.from: Nothing yet. You will be told here when training is assigned or due, when work is waiting for you, and when an assessment result or certificate arrives.

cert.notNational.text: Este é o certificado próprio de {provider} para um curso por si ministrado. Não é uma qualificação nacional e não tem crédito nem identificador da SAQA. Quando um formando está a trabalhar para uma qualificação ocupacional, o certificado correspondente é emitido pelo QCTO.
cert.notNational.from: This is {provider}'s own certificate for a course it delivered. It is not a national qualification and does not carry a SAQA credit or identifier. Where a learner is working towards an occupational qualification, the certificate for it is issued by the QCTO.

cert.anyone.text: Qualquer pessoa pode confirmar este certificado com a referência acima, sem necessidade de conta.
cert.anyone.from: Anyone can confirm this certificate with the reference above, without needing an account.

work.introCoach.text: Os formandos que supervisiona. Confirma o que fizeram no local de trabalho; nada chega a um avaliador sem a sua assinatura.
work.introCoach.from: The learners you supervise. You confirm what they did in the workplace; nothing reaches an assessor without your signature.

work.introLearner.text: A experiência de trabalho é realizada numa entidade empregadora e validada pelo orientador no local de trabalho. A ordem é fixa: regista-a, o orientador confirma-a e depois segue para um avaliador.
work.introLearner.from: Work experience is done at an employer and signed off by the workplace coach there. The order is fixed: you record it, your coach confirms it, then it goes to an assessor.

work.noneManage.text: Ainda não existem {records}. Configure-as acima: um acordo que indique o formando, o empregador e o orientador, e depois um para cada módulo de experiência de trabalho.
work.noneManage.from: No {records} yet. Set one up above: an agreement naming the learner, the employer and the coach, then one for each work experience module.

work.none.text: Ainda não existem {records}. Um administrador abre-as quando existir um acordo de trabalho que indique o formando, o empregador e o orientador.
work.none.from: No {records} yet. An administrator opens one once a workplace agreement is in place naming the learner, the employer and the coach.

work.kind.contextual_knowledge.text: Conhecimentos do local de trabalho: aquilo sobre que deve saber falar
work.kind.contextual_knowledge.from: Workplace knowledge: what you must be able to speak to

work.kind.supporting_evidence.text: Evidências de apoio: o que o local de trabalho deve produzir
work.kind.supporting_evidence.from: Supporting evidence: what the workplace must produce

work.outstanding.text: Por concluir: {items}. O orientador não pode assinar enquanto todas as linhas não estiverem feitas e todas as evidências de apoio não tiverem um ficheiro anexado.
work.outstanding.from: Still outstanding: {items}. Your coach cannot sign until every line is done and every piece of supporting evidence has a file attached.

work.allRecorded.text: Tudo está registado. Envie ao orientador quando estiver pronto.
work.allRecorded.from: Everything is recorded. Send it to your coach when you are ready.

work.signingMeans.text: Ao assinar, regista que verificou estas evidências e que as atestará se o avaliador o contactar. Não pode ser alterado depois.
work.signingMeans.from: Signing records that you checked this evidence and will attest to it if the assessor contacts you. It cannot be changed afterwards.

work.forAssessor.text: Algo que o avaliador deva saber

work.readyForPoe.text: Assinado pelo orientador no local de trabalho e pronto a ser incluído no Portefólio de Evidências.
work.readyForPoe.from: Signed by the workplace coach and ready to be taken into the Portfolio of Evidence.

scorm.failed.from: The package could not be opened. Check your connection and try again.

scorm.preview.text: Pré-visualização: o que o pacote comunica não é guardado, porque esta não é a sua própria inscrição.
scorm.preview.from: A preview: what the package reports is not kept, because this is not your own enrolment.

certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.text: O formando pode ter dado a referência a um empregador. Continua a funcionar e indicará que foi retirado.
certAdmin.withdrawConsequence.from: The learner may have given the reference to an employer. It keeps resolving and will say it was withdrawn.

assessing.intro.text: Submissões prontas para um juízo de competência. Não pode avaliar o seu próprio trabalho, e uma parte das suas decisões será revista de forma independente por um moderador.
assessing.intro.from: Submissions ready for a competency judgement. You cannot assess your own work, and a proportion of your decisions will be reviewed independently by a moderator.

assessing.empty.text: Nada em espera. As submissões aparecem aqui à medida que os formandos as enviam.
assessing.empty.from: Nothing is waiting. Submissions appear here as learners send them in.

assessing.onScreen.text: Esta prova foi respondida no ecrã. {link}: as respostas, as orientações de classificação e a matriz encontram-se aí reunidas, e os critérios são apurados automaticamente depois de classificada.
assessing.onScreen.from: This was answered on screen. {link}: the answers, the marking guidance and the matrix are together there, and the criteria are worked out for you once it is marked.

assessing.ownWork.text: Esta é a sua própria submissão. Não a pode avaliar; tem de ser outra pessoa.
assessing.ownWork.from: This is your own submission. You cannot assess it; someone else must.

assessing.hash.text: O código hash é registado no carregamento. Se um ficheiro guardado for alguma vez alterado, deixa de corresponder e o registo é assinalado.
assessing.hash.from: The hash is recorded at upload. If a stored file is ever altered, it no longer matches and the record is flagged.

assessing.whyDiffers.text: Porquê, uma vez que difere do que as pontuações propõem
assessing.whyDiffers.from: Why, since it differs from what the marks propose

assessing.permanent.text: O seu nome, a data e este comentário são armazenados de forma permanente e não podem ser editados depois. Uma correção é registada como nova decisão.
assessing.permanent.from: Your name, the date and this comment are stored permanently and cannot be edited afterwards. A correction is recorded as a new decision.

marking.impliesIntro.text: Aritmética, não um juízo. As pontuações resultam nesta média; o desempenho prático e as evidências do local de trabalho não chegam à plataforma, e cabe-lhe ponderá-los antes de decidir. Altere qualquer um destes no ecrã de decisão e indique porquê: o motivo é guardado junto à proposta para que um moderador veja onde os dois divergiram.
marking.impliesIntro.from: Arithmetic, not a judgement. The marks average out at this; practical performance and workplace evidence do not reach the platform, and you weigh those before deciding. Change any of these on the decision screen and say why: the reason is stored beside the proposal so a moderator can see where the two parted.

marking.markAllFirst.text: Todas as perguntas têm de ser classificadas antes de os critérios poderem ser calculados.
marking.markAllFirst.from: Every question has to be marked before the criteria can be worked out.

marking.summative.text: Esta prova é avaliada. Depois de todas as perguntas classificadas, registe uma decisão: os critérios que evidencia são propostos para que os confirme.
marking.summative.from: This is assessed. Once every question is marked, record a decision: the criteria it evidences are proposed for you to confirm.

marking.formative.text: Este é um caderno de exercícios. É de desenvolvimento: classifique-o e depois devolva os comentários. Nada aqui regista competência nem aproxima o formando da elegibilidade.
marking.formative.from: This is a workbook. It is developmental: mark it, then return feedback. Nothing here records competence or moves the learner towards eligibility.

marking.matrix.text: Matriz de classificação: escolher um nível para cada critério dá a pontuação
marking.matrix.from: Marking matrix: choosing a level for each gives the mark

marking.told.text: O que é comunicado ao formando

marking.toldHint.text: Onde foi forte e o que faltou.
marking.toldHint.from: Where it was strong, and what was missing.

marking.returnIntro.text: Comentários, não uma decisão. Indica ao formando o que rever antes da avaliação sumativa e não regista competência em nenhum critério.
marking.returnIntro.from: Feedback, not a decision. It tells the learner what to go back to before the summative, and it records no competence against any criterion.

marking.returnHint.text: O que estava sólido e o que reler antes da sumativa.
marking.returnHint.from: What was solid, and what to re-read before the summative.

marking.concern.text: Critérios em torno dos quais se concentram as respostas fracas
marking.concern.from: Criteria the weak answers cluster around

marking.sectionHint.text: O que correu bem aqui e o que fazer de forma diferente da próxima vez.
marking.sectionHint.from: What went well here, and what to do differently next time.

marking.learnerSees.text: O formando vê isto juntamente com os seus comentários.
marking.learnerSees.from: The learner sees this with their feedback.

moderating.intro.text: Revisão independente das decisões dos avaliadores. As decisões que chegam a esta lista são determinadas pelo sistema, não escolhidas por ninguém. Não pode moderar uma decisão que tomou.
moderating.intro.from: Independent review of assessors' decisions. Which decisions reach this list is decided by the system, not chosen by anyone. You cannot moderate a decision you made yourself.

moderating.empty.text: Nada está à espera de moderação.

moderating.reason.full_moderation.text: Sumativa: todas as decisões são moderadas

moderating.reason.new_assessor.from: Newly registered assessor: moderated in full

moderating.referBack.from: Refer back: the assessor should look again

moderating.ownDecision.text: Tomou esta decisão como avaliador, pelo que não a pode moderar. Tem de ser outro moderador.
moderating.ownDecision.from: You made this decision as the assessor, so you cannot moderate it. Another moderator must.

pack.print.text: Imprima esta página para a guardar como PDF.
pack.print.from: Print this page to keep it as a PDF.

pack.instrumentIntro.text: A prova tal como foi elaborada e as orientações segundo as quais foi classificada.
pack.instrumentIntro.from: The paper as it was set, and the guidance it was marked against.

pack.scriptsIntro.text: Recolhidas em todo o intervalo de pontuações (topo, base e dispersão intermédia) para que a classificação seja vista no seu melhor e no seu pior, e não no meio.
pack.scriptsIntro.from: Taken across the mark range (top, bottom and spread between) so the marking is seen at its best and its worst rather than in the middle.

pack.departuresIntro.text: Quando um avaliador divergiu do que as pontuações propunham, ou um moderador divergiu do avaliador. Um dossiê que as omita é pior do que nenhum.
pack.departuresIntro.from: Where an assessor differed from what the marks proposed, or a moderator differed from the assessor. A pack that leaves these out is worse than no pack.

pack.exceptionsIntro.text: Formandos autorizados a passar uma barreira por uma pessoa identificada, com o motivo que esta indicou.
pack.exceptionsIntro.from: Learners let past a gate by a named person, with the reason they gave.

pack.assembled.text: Reunido em {date} a partir do registo.

held.intro.text: Um formando considerado ainda não competente duas vezes não é reprovado. A avaliação fica retida e é convocada uma revisão do programa com o respetivo empregador, porque nesta fase a questão raramente é se sabe a matéria e, quase sempre, o que se tem passado à sua volta.
held.intro.from: A learner found not yet competent twice is not failed. The assessment is held, and a programme review is convened with their employer, because by this point the question is rarely whether they know it, and usually what has been going on around them.

held.empty.text: Isto é preenchido quando um formando é considerado ainda não competente pela segunda vez numa avaliação sumativa. Até lá, não há nada para rever.
held.empty.from: This fills when a learner is found not yet competent for a second time on a summative assessment. Until then there is nothing to review.

held.forReview.text: À espera de revisão do programa ({count})

held.whoConvenes.text: Um facilitador ou administrador convoca a revisão.
held.whoConvenes.from: A facilitator or administrator convenes the review.

held.oralAuthorised.text: {assessment} · a revisão autorizou uma terceira tentativa, realizada oralmente
held.oralAuthorised.from: {assessment} · the review authorised a third attempt, conducted orally

held.whoConducts.text: Um avaliador realiza a tentativa oral, e não quem a autorizou.
held.whoConducts.from: An assessor conducts the oral attempt, and not the person who authorised it.

held.furtherLearning.text: Mais aprendizagem antes de qualquer nova tentativa
held.furtherLearning.from: Further learning before any further attempt

held.whyHint.text: O que a revisão concluiu e de que depende.
held.whyHint.from: What the review found, and what it turns on.

oral.reviewDecidedIntro.text: Os fundamentos com que esta terceira tentativa foi autorizada.
oral.reviewDecidedIntro.from: The grounds on which this third attempt was authorised.

oral.recordIntro.text: Uma tentativa oral não deixa evidências próprias. Este é esse registo, e o resultado não pode ser registado sem ele.
oral.recordIntro.from: An oral attempt leaves no evidence of its own. This is that evidence, and the outcome cannot be recorded without it.

oral.outcomeIntro.text: Avaliada da mesma forma que uma tentativa escrita, segundo os mesmos critérios, e moderada da mesma forma depois.
oral.outcomeIntro.from: Judged the same way as a written attempt, against the same criteria, and moderated the same way afterwards.

oral.goMark.text: Ir para o ecrã de classificação

oral.howHint.text: Presencialmente ou na videochamada em que decorreu
oral.howHint.from: In person, or the video call it was held on

oral.presentNote.text: Não obrigatório. Uma avaliação oral sem mais ninguém na sala é mais difícil de defender na moderação, e o registo deve indicar de que tipo foi.
